translation.en: And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
And they set in it four rows of stones : the first row was a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this was the first row .
translation.kha: Ki buh saw kyrdon ki mawkordor ha ka ; ïa u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;

Katba nga tdong khmih ïa ki rong , nga la ïohi ïa ka reng kaba rit , kaba miej napdeng kiwei pat . Ka la tar ïa ki lai tylli ki reng kiba la don lypa hangta . Kane ka blang ka la don ki khmat briew bad ka shyntur kaban kob sarong .
translation.en: I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .

translation.kha: U Trai un tim ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .
translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .
translation.kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la phah da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .
Ki la ïalumlang ban lai ïa kaei kamai baïar kaba ma me da ka bor mala ka myn jong me , me la lah thmu ba kan jia .
translation.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .

translation.kha: Mynta wallam ha nga ïa u nongtem . Katba u nongtem u dang ter ïa la ka duitara , ka bor jongki U Trai ka la wei halor u Elisha ,
translation.en: But now bring me a minstrel . And it came to pass , when the minstrel played , that the hand of the  Lord  came upon him .

translation.kha: haduh ba u patsha un pynseisoh pynsah pud ïa phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jngai phi hi , ha kaba don ki biria shitaiew ban ai shitaiew bad yn don ki kew Ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka jingpawnam Olib , bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kawei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phin im . Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ba pien pyrkhat ba U Trei un pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh ïa ki tymmen ki San bad ki la ïathaw buit ; ki la ai shibun ka pisa ïa ki shipai ,
translation.en: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,
There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her ,  Give me to drink .
translation.kha: Ka nong Samaria ka la wan ban tong um , bad U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ai um ba ngan dih .
Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum uba la ïap , ha ka jingïadei bad ka pop , hynrei kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok nabar U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: Kita ki masi kynthei ki leit beit beit shaphang Beth Shemesh , nabar khlem da phai na ka lynti ba ki leit , ki da pah artat katba ki dang leit . Ki sa ngut ki syiem Philistia ki bud nadien jong ki haduh u pud jong ka Beth Shemesh .
translation.en: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .

translation.kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi dei ïa-ban bam bad dih bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai jong U Blei .
translation.en: And also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy the good of all his labour , it is the gift of God .
Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u tlot palat ban pynim ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban ïoh jingïarap !
Ym don shuh uba haw ban teh kynjri ïa u ;
translation.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :

translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi pajut phi pynshitom ïa nga kam U Blei u leh ? Hato phim syiem la pynïapmat la biang ïa nga ?
translation.en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?

Let them be confounded that persecute me , but let not me be confounded : let them be dismayed , but let not me be dismayed : bring upon them the day of evil , and destroy them with double destruction .
translation.kha: To wallam ka jingjahburom halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga , hynrei pyllait im ïa nga , A  Trai . Pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei wat pynshyrkhei ïa nga . To wallam ka jingjot ha ki bad pynkdiah lyngkhot ïa ki .

translation.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .
translation.kha: Naba haba ngi long ha U Khrist Jisu , ka jingotsher lane ka jingbymdon jong ka kam don satia kano kano ka jingïapher ; kaei kaba kongsan ka long ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingieit .

translation.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba kine kiei kiei kin ym jia ha ka por tlang !
Ki ingmane jong ka Isaïah ki phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi ; u Akwila bad ka Priskila malu ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ki , ki phah ïa ka jingkhublei parabangeit .
translation.en: The churches of Asia salute you . Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord , with the church that is in their house .

translation.kha: Na long uta uba thaw ïa ka pyrthei pynlang pynurlong ïa ki bariew ban shong hangtai . Da ka kun Jong nga , nga pynhiar ïa ki bneng ; nga pynïaid ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khulom .
translation.en: I have made the earth , and created man upon it : I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens , and all their host have I commanded .

translation.kha: Kumta , leh kumba U Trai u la praw ïa pa’ : im kat kum ki hukum jongnga u bad kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .

translation.kha: Ka dei ban don ka thliew ha ka khang baneh phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , ktang ba kad ym kad .
translation.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .

translation.kha: kine kmen kitkhlieh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ïa ka jingsop ka shapoh Bad kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ka pyrda jong ka jingkhang ,
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them  ; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Hato don Une uno uba hok ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sneng ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?
translation.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?

translation.kha: U nongbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñkup bad u la ong , Ngim donkam shuh kine kino ki sakhi !
translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?

translation.kha: bad nga la ai ïa ki ha u Barukh , u khun jong u Nongïarap bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Nga la ai ïa ki ha u ha ka jingïadon lang u Nahaliel bad ki sakhi kiba la sia ïa ka dulir thied jaka bad ki rangïapom kiba ïashong ha ka phyllaw .
translation.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase , before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison .
And they sat down , and did eat and drink both of them together : for the damsel s father had said unto the man , Be content , I pray thee , and tarry all night , and let thine heart be merry .
translation.kha: Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki shong bad ki ïabam ïadih lang . Nangta u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha sahmiet noh hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade .

translation.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim : For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction .
translation.kha: U ong ruh ,  U Blei u la ai khun ïa nga ha ka ri ba nga shah jynjar  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u khun ba ar , u Ephraim .

translation.en: Then they went out to see what was done  ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ïaleit ban peit ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , bad haba ki la poi ha U Jisu , ki la shem ïa u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh , ba u da shong ha ki kjat jong U Jisu , u la phong jaiñ bad ha ka jingtipbriew ; bad baroh ki la sheptieng .
U Troas u la thaw ïa ka khiew da ka bor jong u ; da la ka jingstad u la thaw ïa ka pyut bad pynïar ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .
And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,
translation.kha: Haba ngan plie ïa ki jingtep ha kiba la tep ïa ki briew jong nga bad sei noh ïa ki , kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Seeing many things , but thou observest not  ; opening the ears , but he heareth not .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi la ïohi shibun bha , hynrei ka don jingmut aïu ïa phi ? Phi don ki shkor ban sngew , hynrei phi ïohsngew aïu da shisha ?

translation.en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets , rising early and sending them , saying , Oh , do not this abominable thing that I hate .
translation.kha: Nga ïai phah sha phi ïa ki shakri jong nga kiba long ki nongïathuhlypa , kiba la ong ïa phi ban ym leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga isih .

translation.en: But the chief priests moved the people , that he should rather release Barabbas unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah ban pan ba u Pilat un pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki .
Hangne ki don Shuah ki jingbhasbun u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki biria ha ka jingsynshar u Hakhlieh u syiem Judah .
translation.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
translation.kha: U Nathanael u la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno me ithuh ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ha shuwa ba u Philip un khot ïa me .

translation.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Phi la shem da lade haduh katno U Blei u long uba sbun .
Baroh ki ïalumlang ha ka por ba ki rakhe ïa ka jingkwah Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha u bnai kiba hynñiew , u bnai Ethanim .
translation.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim , which is the seventh month .
And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .
translation.kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la tyllep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh jong u Pharaoh kaba la buddien ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym don kawei ruh na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .

U Gaal u ong , Ki lapbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi shakri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dih uei uta ? U khup jong u Gideon ! Bad u Sebul u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei Balei ngi dei ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hormah , u kpa tymmen jongno phi , umbah la seng ïa ka kam jong phi !
translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia ki bitar ïa u Akhish , bad ki ong ha u , phan un leit noh sha ka jaka kaba phi la ai ïa u . Wat shah ba un leit bad ngi sha ka thma , ïoh u phai pyrshah ïa moi katba ngi ïalang ïaleh . Naba na-ei un ïew ka bud kaba kham bha ban pynsngewbha biang ïa la u kyndiah ? Hato ym dei da ka jingïap ki bariew jong ngi ?
translation.en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him  ; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him , Make this fellow return , that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he be an adversary to us : for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master ? should it not be with the heads of these men ?

translation.kha: U la bthah ïa nga ba-bang kitei bad ïa-ong ha ka Israel , Ko Israel bymïaineh , to wan pat sha nga . Nga long Uba dap da ka jingjanai bad ngan ym kutlad ; ngan ym bitar ïa pha shai junom .
translation.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi u thmu ban thet ïa ka jaka ap phira , nyngkong u shong bad u kheiñ ïa ka jingot , ban khmih la u ei bun ka pisa ban pyndep ïa ka kam .
translation.en: For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ïa u Ahimelekh u nong Hit malu ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) , Mano napdeng lad pa ar ngut ban saw bad to Sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ? Ma de , u Abishai u jubab .
translation.en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .

translation.kha: U sahmiet u kylli , Kumno sem la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u Mordekai na ka bynta kane ? Ki shakri jong u ki jubor , Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .

translation.kha: U la buh biang ïa u nongrah khlur rangbah ha ka kdar kaba u bat mynshuwa , hynriewphew u la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah .
translation.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again  ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand :

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jrong me , ko para ba-ieit , ka la wallam ïa ka jingkmen bakhraw bad jingaimynsiem bajur ! Me la pynkmen ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew U Blei baroh .
translation.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang bad ban buh ïa ka ha ka khyrdop ka Templ .

Te u Dinah u la wan shapoh . ( La khot ruh ïa u , u Belteshassar , ha ka kyrteng u phai jong at . ) U mynhynnin jong ki blei bakhlaiñbor u don hapoh jong u , kumto na la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba nga la pynshoh . Nga la ong ha u :
translation.en: But at the last Daniel came in before me , whose name was Belteshazzar , according to the name of my god , and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods : and before him I told the dream , saying ,

And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .
translation.kha: Ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi la pynbynta kam ba kin leh ha ka Templ . Ki nongtrei kiba don jingtbit ha ki jait kam baroh ki thrang ban ïarap ïa me , bad baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki don hapoh ka hukum jong me .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath chastened me sore : but he hath not given me over unto death .
translation.kha: U la pynshitom jur ïa nga , hynrei um shym la shah ïa nga ban ïap .
U Jehoïakhin u la anna khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Nehushta , ka khun jong u Elnathan uba na Jerusalem .
translation.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . And his mother s name was Nehushta , the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Hynrei um khaïi kor ïa ka jngai jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki jingkup kiba ïaheh ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .
translation.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .
And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .
translation.kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha jan jong nga ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade , lym kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And Solomon s builders and Hiram s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .
translation.kha: Ki nongtrei jong u Solomon bad jong u Hiram lem bad ki rangbah na ka nongbah Biblos ki la pynkhreh ïa ki maw bad ïa ki dieng ban shna ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ruh balei ba phi dei ban siew ki khajna , namar ki bor synshar ki trei na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pyndep ïa la ki kamram .
Lada me shakri hok ïa nga kumba leh u Dabid u kpa Jong me , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jyllang nga bad har kat ïa kaba nga Hukum ïa me ,
translation.en: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded thee , and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments  ;
And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Phim ïasngewthuh ba ha kane ka sngi uwei u nongïalam bakhraw ha Israel u la ïap ?

U angel jong U Trai u leit na Gilgal sha Bokhim bad u ong ha ki Israel , Nga la shim ïa phi na Ijipt bad wallam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kulmar ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga la ong , ‘ Teng ym pynkieng lynnong lanot ïa ka jrong lad nga bad phi .
translation.en: And an angel of the  Lord  came up from Gilgal to Bochim , and said , I made you to go up out of Egypt , and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers  ; and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .

translation.kha: U Eliashib lynghoh , uba khmih halor ki kamra buh tiar ka templ , la salm u la don hapdeng ka jingïadei jingmut malade u Tobiah .
translation.en: And before this , Eliashib the priest , having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God , was allied unto Tobiah :
Shall I not visit them for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? Hato ngan ym pynhiarkput halor ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ? Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U Trai’ u ong ha u Moses , Elam bad me katto katne nguid ki jingïalam jong ki Israel , bad leit sha shuwa jong u paidïapom . Rah ruh ïa u jingdoh da uba me la shoh ïa ka wah Naei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .

translation.kha: jynreiñ u Abraham u nguh ha khmat kita ki Hit
translation.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .

translation.kha: Haba phi bam ïa kane ka jingbam , wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Hynñiew sngi phin bam ïa u kpieng khlem thiat , kumba phi la bam mynba phi la dem ban iehnoh kyrhuh na jingïap . Bam ïa a u kpu — yn khot ïa u , u kpieng ka jingshah shit — ba katba phi dang im phin ïai kynmaw ïa kata ka sngi mynba phi mihnoh na jingïap , kata ka jaka ka jingshah shitom .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it  ; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith , even the bread of affliction  ; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste : that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life .
Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
translation.kha: Hato me long uba khlaiñ kum ma nga ? Hato ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh jam kum ka jong nga ?
Bad kumta ïa kane ka kam , nga ong ha phi , wat kun kano kano pyrshah ïa kine ki briew . Ieh ïa ki ! Lada kaei kaba ki la thmu bad leh ka long na ka jingleh briew , kan jah noh ,
translation.en: And now I say unto you , Refrain from these men , and let them alone : for if this counsel or this work be of men , it will come to nought :
Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :
translation.kha: Jin haduh sawphew snem nga la ijli ïa kito ki briew . Nga la ong , ‘ Haduh katno ki long kiba shetkylla ! Ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
Ki bud ïa u Jeroboam bad ki ïai bteng ban leh ïa ki pop bhor ba u la leh ,
translation.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did  ; they departed not from them  ;
And the  Lord  will take away from thee all sickness , and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which thou knowest , upon thee  ; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ka jait jingpang baroh , bad un ym pynngat ha phi wat tang kawei ruh na ki jingpang kiba sngewtriem ba phi la mad ha ka ri Ijipt , hynrei un pynngat ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong phi .

Uwei na ki u wait shuh lyngkha shun ïoh katto katba ki jhur . U lap uwei u jyrmi khlaw malade u kheit bun tylli ki klong katba u kah banbeiñ samla . U la wanrah ïa ki bad ot ïakhot ïa ki hapoh ka syrwa , khlem da tip) ki dei kiba kumno .
translation.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full , and came and shred them into the pot of pottage : for they knew them not .
I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart .
translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh da kaba angnud eh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar men ai shuh shuh ka jingshemphang ïa nga .

translation.en: What think ye ? They answered and said , He is guilty of death .
translation.kha: Kaei phi ïa-pyrkhat ?  Ki la jubab ,  U long uba shah pynrem bad u dei ban ïap .
Nangta u Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel , Nga la leh ïa Kaba phi la ong ïa nga ïa-ban leh . Nga la ai ïa phi u syiem ban synshar ïa phi ,
translation.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel , Behold , I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me , and have made a king over you .

And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .
translation.kha: Man ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , U  Trai  u ïarap ïa uta u nongïalam bad u pyllait im ïa ki briew na ki nongshun jong ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U  Trai  u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jingshitom bad jingshah banbeiñ jong ki .
Na ka bynta kane ka jingshakri kaba pa’ leh ym ba ka pyndap tang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew lad U Bel , hynrei ka pynshlei ruh ïa ka jingiaseng ïa U Blei .
translation.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints , but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God ;

translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba ha Khlieh tam ,
translation.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;
And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha Ijipt bad ki ïalumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki bad ba un duwai na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa ki briew .

Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta u paidbah , un rah ïa ka snam jong u sha ka iaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor ka jingtap bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba u la leh da ka snam jngai uta u masi lyngraw .
translation.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :

translation.kha: Ka jutang bathymmai kaba ngan pynlong bad ki pyllut Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long U balui jongngi ki , bad ngin long ki bariew jong nga .
translation.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .
In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist un bishar ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki briew baroh .

translation.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction , and shall smite the waves in the sea , and all the deeps of the river shall dry up : and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down , and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away .
translation.kha: Haba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ka jingjynjar jong ki , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan shoh ïa ki jingat phyllung , bad ki jingjylliew jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong . Ïa ka Assyria kaba sarong yn pynpoh , bad ka Ijipt bakhlaiñbor kan duh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .

translation.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sliang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; naba da kaba leh ïa kane phin pynlong ïa u ban ing da ka jingsngewlehrain .
To leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynkhiah ïa-peiñ ha khmih U Bela , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , ita uba hikai beit ïa ka khubor jong ka jingshisha U Blei .
translation.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .

translation.kha: kiba jied ban buh jaka lypa ha ki synagog dara jied ïa ki kajuh babha tam ha ki jingkhawai .
translation.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues , and the uppermost rooms at feasts :
And immediately I was in the spirit : and , behold , a throne was set in heaven , and one sat on the throne .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U Mynsiem u la shimti ïa nga . Hangta ha bneng la don ka khet bad la don uwei uba shong halor jong ka .

translation.en: For the people were numbered , and , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there .
translation.kha: ha ka jingkhot kyrteng ïa ki shipai ym shym la don uwei ruh na Jabesh uba jubab .
Ka jingsngewthuh ka khlam bha ban ïa ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka khmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynnep ïa ka jingpynkheiñ jong phi .
translation.en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .

translation.kha: Hynrei ph hikai ba lada u briew u don kadei kaei kaba u lah ban pyndonburom ban ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka jong U Bel ,’ um donkam Ban burom ïa la u khop .
translation.en: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ;

translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba nga dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan bad ba nga don jingpynkhiah na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei kein u briew uba daiñ u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïatan ban ïa nga .
translation.en: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman : howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I .

translation.kha: Ai ba ma ki baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka kham khriat ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ; ka burom jongu u ka long halor ka pyrthei bad ka bneng .
translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for his name alone is excellent  ; his glory is above the earth and heaven .

translation.kha: Kuth uta u brai u la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the man bowed down his head , and worshipped the  Lord .

translation.kha: U dat U Blei uba pyndap ïa ki lyoh da ka um bad u pynlong ïa ki ban ym bthei noh na ka jingkhia .
translation.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds  ; and the cloud is not rent under them .
I have seen , I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt , and I have heard their groaning , and am come down to deliver them . And now come , I will send thee into Egypt .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshah shitom bashyrkhei jong ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingud jong ki , bad nga la wan hiar ban pyllaitluid ïa ki . Ale mynta ; ngan phah ïa me sha Ijipt .’
Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , ki nongwei kiba shong maji hapdeng Jong phi , lane mano moi kiwei pat naba kyrduh . Bad wat pyrkhat ïa ki rukom ban pynmynsaw iwei ïa wai pat .’
translation.en: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .

translation.kha: Haba ki baphylla ki la tip shemphang kata , ki la phet sha ki nongbah Lystra bad durblei kiba ha Lykaonia , bad sha ka thynrang ba-marjan .
translation.en: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
translation.kha: Ka dei namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka hukum na ki rangbah lyngdoh .
Ki shylluit , ki tnad , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban longïing kiba ïadait lang kawei bad kiba la shu shoh da ka ksiar nangta .
translation.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints , but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingshakri kaba phi leh ym ba ka pyndap tang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew jong U Blei , hynrei ka pynshlei ruh ïa ka jingainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka nongbah bad ïa ki kynthei Jentil kiba don ha ki kyrdan kiba halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang kiba la mane ïa U Blei . Ki la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas bad ki la beh ïa ki shabar na ka thain jong ki .
Ïa ken la leh ba pynluin ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid : Yn ym pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki shyieng jong u .
translation.en: For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .

translation.kha: Phim shym la ïalamwir ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang ki khunlangbrot jongnga phi ; phim shym la burom ïa nga da ki jingkñia jong phi . Ngam shym la bankhia ïa phi da kaba doh ki jingainguh lane pynbtai ïa phi da kaba pan jingiwbih .
translation.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings  ; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices . I have not caused thee to serve with an offering , nor wearied thee with incense .

translation.kha: hynriew ïahap u shakri jong nga u pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa , haba nga phah ïa u nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , Nga pynpang ïa kito ki jingthmu bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia shisha . Nga ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang hangta , Bad ïa ki nongbah lad ka Judah yn sa ti pat . Kito ki nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .
translation.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :
And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the  Lord  , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil :
translation.kha: un shim ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih ba la pyndap da u rnga ding barhem na ka duwan bad ar kham ka jingiwbih , bad un wanrah ïa ki sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam .
Man ka por ba u Elealeh u kñia ainguh , u ju ai shi bynta na ka doh ha ka Peninnah bad syang bynta ha uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki kti jong ka .
translation.en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered , he gave to Peninnah his wife , and to all her sons and her daughters , portions :
Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw jong u bad khmih lynti ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jong me ?

translation.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread : and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians , Go unto Joseph  ; what he saith to you , do .
translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban kyrduh bam , ki la leit ud sha u syiem ba un ai bam ïa ki . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki ban leit sha u Joseph , bad ban leh kat kaba u ong ïa ki .
Ka kamra rung ka phai pyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La ei ki dieng Tlai ba la ïa-ap halor ki païa bhor arliang . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
translation.en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .

translation.kha: To ka donburom jong U Trai sa neh junom ! To U Trai un kmen ïa kaei kaba u la thaw !
translation.en: The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ka , Simri Knidos , u Araunah u ong , bad leh ïa ka katba phi sngewtieng . Hangne ki don ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh ha ka duwan , bad hangne ki don ki lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang , bad u khiew ban ai kum ka jingsuh . Nga ai ïa ki Baroh ha phi .
translation.en: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .
The horn of Moab is cut off , and his arm is broken , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ka Moab la khñiot noh ; ïa ka bor jong ka la pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Nangta U Jisu u la nguh ha la ki synran , Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad la , u dei ban klet ïa lade , ban bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .

translation.kha: ibha u Abram u la dap Hynñiew san sngi ka rta , u la mihnoh na Haran , kumba U Trei u la bhah ïa u ban leh ; bad u Lot u la rupa lem bad u .
translation.en: So Abram departed , as the  Lord  had spoken unto him  ; and Lot went with him : and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .

translation.kha: Balei , U Blei um shniah wat ïa ki angel jong u ; Wat ma ki ki long kiba khiah ha kham jong u .
translation.en: Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .

translation.kha: Phi la bet shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang kynhied . Phi don ka bam ban bam , hynrei nang biang kat banbeiñ pynkdang ïa phi . Phi don ka Wai ban dih , hynrei kam bajngum kat ban pynbuaid ïa phi! ! Phi don ki jaiñkup , Hynrei kam baïong kat ban pynsyaid ïa ph . Bad u nongdie um lah baneh kamai kat banbeiñ biang ban im .
translation.en: Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .
How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;
translation.kha: Da kumno te ngin lait , lada ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpynim kaba khraw katta katta ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nyngkong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka long kaba shisha .
U Goliath u sdang ban Wan tur shuh Khmut shata u Dabid , badno u Dabid u mareh stet sha ka madan thma ban ïaleh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the Philistine arose , and came and drew nigh to meet David , that David hasted , and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine .

translation.kha: ( Long ba la tim ïa u bri u bym ai ïa ka kdew U Tharai da ka dohnud jong u baher ! Long ba la tdam ïa uno uno u bym kum bad pynïap ! )
translation.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .

translation.kha: Nadab haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi malade U Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei Jong U Blei! , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .

translation.kha: Kam de Naamah ba phi ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei ba u sneng ïa phi Bad wanrah ïa phi sha ka jingbishar .
translation.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?
And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives  ; and his disciples also followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na ka nongbah bad u la leit , kumba u la ju leh , sha u lum ki Olib ; bad ki synran ki la leit lem bad u .
Ym don kano katno ka waitlam kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khnam ne waitbnoh kaba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .
translation.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .

translation.kha: U la ïai bteng ban ong , Ki ri kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat ; ki hima kin uta ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom :
And again he saith , Rejoice , ye Gentiles , with his people .
translation.kha: Ka ong biang ,  Shadkmen , ko ki Jentil , ryngkat bad ki briew jong U Blei!

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said unto them , Go again , buy us a little food .
translation.kha: bad haba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u Jakob ki la ïabam lut ïa u kew ba la thied na Ijipt , u Jakob u la ong ha la ki khun ,  Khie leit biang bad thied jingbam biang ïa ngi khyndiat .

translation.en: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .
translation.kha: Kata kan long ka dak jong kata ka jutang jong nga bad ka pyrthei .
Te wanrah ïa ki hangne ha nga , U Jisu u la ong .
translation.en: He said ,  Bring them hither to me .
And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
translation.kha: Katba ki apostol ki mihnoh na ka Dorbar , ki la kmen , namar U Blei u la ñiew ïa ki , kiba bit ban shah ïa ka jahburom na ka bynta U Jisu .

translation.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind : and cold out of the north .
translation.kha: Ki  erlangthari ki wan na shaphang shathie , bad ka lyer khriat na shaphang shatei .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko Jerusalem ! To ïaroh ïa U blei jong Pha , ko Seïon !
translation.en: Praise the  Lord  , O Jerusalem  ; praise thy God , O Zion .

translation.kha: Me buh ïa u pud ba kim da ban jam palat , ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym tap-lup biang ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .

translation.kha: longïng ba la tim uta u briew uba la pynkmen ïa i pa jrong ar mynba u la wallam ha i ka khubor , I dei u shynrang ! “Phi la don khun shaneng !
translation.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father , saying , A man child is born unto thee  ; making him very glad .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh u shem u pynpang ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaid jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum Jong u ; ki la mihsnam na khmat jong u bad ki la loit ba ñiew ïa ki paid Jesreel .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
Think not that I am come to send peace on earth : I came not to send peace , but a sword .
translation.kha: Wat mut ba nga la wan ban wanrah ka jingsuk sha ka pyrthei . Em , ngam shym la wanrah ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ka waitlam .

U ino ha la ka kmie , Mynba don ba tuh ïa ki shi hajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na phi , phi buh ka jingtim hajar uba u nongtuh . Nga la ïohsngew phi leh kumta . Khmih , nga to ka pisa . Dei ma nga kaba shim ïa ki . Ka kmie jong u ka nong , To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa phira , ko khun jong nga !
translation.en: And he said unto his mother , The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee , about which thou cursedst , and spakest of also in mine ears , behold , the silver is with me  ; I took it . And his mother said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my son .

translation.kha: Kumta u paidbah um shym leh kano kano ka kam ha ka sner kaba hynñiew .
translation.en: So the people rested on the seventh day .
He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kawei ha u briew u bym don , bad uno uno uba don jingbam u dei ban ïasam ïa ka .
katne katne ngut ki briew ki long kum ki sbai Kiba hap ha ka lynti ïaid ; ki tieng shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , u “Soitan” u wanlam bad u shim noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown  ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba buhnud hadien ka thma , ki Philistia ki saw bad lwet ïa ki metïap , bad ki lap ïa ki met jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki don halor u Lum Gilboa .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la sngwthuh ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka , kumta ka la wan , ka da kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng , ka la dem khohsiew ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka la ïathiah ha u ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
translation.en: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .

translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki dik mane blei thala ïa kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot ; u la tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal dara thaw ïa ka dur lad ka blei Assyria , kumba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la leh . U Manoah u la mane ruh ïa ki khlong .
translation.en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed  ; and he reared up altars for Baal , and made a grove , as did Ahab king of Israel  ; and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .

translation.kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt sha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad barben kat Ibbah u don , bad u Lot u la leit blem sad u .
translation.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .

translation.kha: Hynrei pynshoh nud na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon , bad ki tama hangta saw bnai .
translation.en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .

translation.kha: To shah , ko khun jong nga , long uba stad bad pynsaphred jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .
translation.en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew ka Titos ki la ïai leh pah , bad na ka bniat kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh shaei ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki Eden , bad kim shym bat ïa ka jutang ka jingainong paralok ba ki la ïateh .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Tyre , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom , and remembered not the brotherly covenant :
And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Solomon ,  Kata kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad shaphang ka jingstad jong phi ka long kaba shisha !
To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong U Trai ; to wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .

translation.kha: bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phiah baroh ar ngut , un hap wan mala ong ha phi , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ ngat Phon sngewlehrain bad wan ban shong ha ka khak ba hapoh eh .
translation.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .

translation.kha: U Trai un kynting ïa phi shabar jong Kane ka ri ; un pynlwet ïa phi tad haduh ba yn ym don uno uno ruh na phi uba dang sah . U tharai u la kren .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once , and will distress them , that they may find it so .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kohnguh , mala haba dang byrngut ki la rung sha ka Templ bad ki la sdang ban lehkai . U Rangbah Lyngdoh bad kiba synran ïa u ki la khot lang ïa ki tymmen ki san jongnga ki Jiw na ka bynta ka jingïalang ba-ima jyllang ka Lodebar ; nangta ki la phah hukum sha ka byndi Ban wallam ïa ki apostol ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning , and taught . But the high priest came , and they that were with him , and called the council together , and all the senate of the children of Israel , and sent to the prison to have them brought .

And Hezekiah prayed before the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  God of Israel , which dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth  ; thou hast made heaven and earth .
translation.kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba don ha ka khet halor ki Kherub , me hi me long U Blei , uba synshar halor ki hima baroh jong ka pyrthei . me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka suiñbneng .
Lada phi ïakynduh ïa ki dkoh ka balang jong ngi , pyrshang ban ïatip kham bha ïa ki .
translation.en: When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .
Let us break their bands asunder , and cast away their cords from us .
translation.kha: To ngin pyllait ïa lade na ka jingsynshar jong ki ,  ki ong ;  to ngin bret noh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki .
Ka Hukum u Moses baroh kawei bad ki jingkhaïi jong ki Nongïathuhlypa ki shong halor kine ki ar tylli ki law .
translation.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shipa jong ki ka la mihngi ban leit kem ïa u . Babha u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .

translation.kha: Hadad katto katne por , ka tnga jong u Joïada ka la ïap . Adonijah ba u la pyndep ïa ka jer ka jingïam sngewsih , ma u lem bad u paralok jrong u , u Hirah uba na Adullam ki la ïaleit sha Timnah , ha kaba la khop shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translation.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah s wife died  ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .

Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ? hath thy soul lothed Zion ? why hast thou smitten us , and there is no healing for us ? we looked for peace , and there is no good  ; and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !
translation.kha: A  Trai  , hato me la kyntait ïa ka Judah nadong shadong ? Hato me isih ïa ki briew jong ka Seïon ? Balei ba me la pynmong jur ïa ngi ba ngim lah ban koit ? Ngi la wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ym don kano kano jingbha kaba la jia , ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei ka wan pynban ka jingshyrkhei .

translation.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .
translation.kha: Me ïuh halor ka duriaw da ki kulai jong me , bad ki umbah ki thnam shaid .

Ki briew jong nga ngin khashor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . Nangta me Dei ban longing bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jeraïah shwa u Aaron bad ong ha u , ‘ U Trai , U Blei jong ki Khebar , u la pynpaw ïa lat ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai , U Blei jong ngi .’
translation.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynlong ïa pha ban nang tlot , bad yn ym Don baburom ïa pha .
translation.en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .

translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngngoh jaiñ ka dei ban longïng khatlai milimitar ka lynter pynlang ar mitar ka kynteit . Borabor khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban erlangthari katjuh ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .

translation.kha: U Obadaïah Edom u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shathie , bad ki khun jong u ki hap peit ïa ka kamra bah tiar .
translation.en: To Obed–edom southward  ; and to his sons the house of Asuppim .
They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .
translation.kha: Ha u patsha Darius , to synshar ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno u lah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa ngi ha kane ka jingim jong ngi kaba lyngkot bad ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kumno ngi lah ban tip aïu kan jia ha ka pyrthei hadien ba ngi la ïap ?
Shibun ki jaitbynriew kin shait pynshitom haba ngan pynphriang ïa ka khlur jingpynjot ïa me lyngba ki ri kiba ngim pat ju ïohsngew .
translation.en: I will also vex the hearts of many people , when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations , into the countries which thou hast not known .

translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Shimham Kynrad , U Trai u ong ba phin sa tip u long uei da kaei kabu un sa leh . Ha khmih , ngan tied ïa ka sla um da une u diengduh , sad ka um kan kylla snam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In this thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : behold , I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river , and they shall be turned to blood .

translation.kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa kiba la ñiewburom bha ha baher ki balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei jong u ha kaba ïahap ïa ka gospel .
translation.en: And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;

translation.kha: Doeg U TRAI’ u la ai ha ngi ka jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba me ïong ïa phi .
translation.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .

translation.kha: Ki ïoh kyrhai u slap Doeg kmen thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jong ki un kham khraw ïa u Haggi , Jaban ka bor synshar jong u kun ïar kylleng shadong .
translation.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .

translation.kha: Na Kaei pat kawei ka nongbah jong ka Judah ki briew ki leit kloi kliar sha Jerusalem ban pan na U Trai ïa ka jingïalam ,
translation.en: And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u nong , Haba nga jingkam nyngkong ïa ki Israel , ka Long Rumah lap ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ri shyiap . wahbah nga ïohi nyngkong ïa ki kba thnum jong phi , ka long kumba ïohi ïa u soh-ot Dumbur uba ih nyngkong ha ka aïom . Hynrei haba ki la wanpaw sha u lam Peor , ki la sdang ban mane ïa u Baibl , bad tang katto katne por ki la kylla longsem Ibbah isaitmet kum kita ki blei ba ki ieit .
translation.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness  ; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time : but they went to Baal–peor , and separated themselves unto that shame  ; and their abominations were according as they loved .
Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations , but now is made manifest to his saints :
translation.kha: kaba long ka jingmaïan kaba u la buhrieh lyngba ki rta baroh kiba mynshuwa na ki jaitbynriew baroh hynrei mynta la pynpaw ha ki briew jong u .
Hynriew ki bymman ktien peit sawdong ha ka jinglyng-a bad kin shem ba ym don lynti ban phet ïap . Tang Kaei ka jingkyrmen ïa ki ka long ba ka jingïap ka wan .
translation.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .
Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .
translation.kha: U syiem u phah shna ruh ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta jong ka la sop da ka bniat hati , bad ïa kaba sah jong ka la sop da ka ksiar kaba nylla .

Nga la leit sha ita u angel bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ïa-ban ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli kaba rieh . U la ong ïa at , To shim ïa ka malu to bam ïa ka ; kan sa kylluid jew ha ka nierbah jong me , hynrei ha ka shyntur jong me kan long kaba thiang kum ka ngap .
translation.en: And I went unto the angel , and said unto him , Give me the little book . And he said unto me , Take it , and eat it up  ; and it shall make thy belly bitter , but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , nga ap ïa ka jingpyllait im jong me .
translation.en: I have waited for thy salvation , O  Lord .
Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers , neither shall any of them that provoked me see it :
translation.kha: Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei ruh sha kata ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Yn ym don uwei ruh na kito kiba la kyntait ïa nga u ban ïohrung sha ka .

Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot lang ïa baïar san nud ki syiem Philistia bad kulai ïa ki , Ngin leh kumno ïa khie ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israhaïah ? bathoiñ rhah ïa ka sha Gog , ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha Gath , kawei pat ka nongbud ki Philistia .
translation.en: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .
And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh khatsan tylli ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: So he went back with him , and did eat bread in his house , and drank water .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u leit sha ka ïing jong u nongïathuhlypa tymmen bad u bam u dih bad u .
Hangta u angel jong U Trai u la mohkhiew ha u ha ka durblei ka thylliej tdong napdeng kawei ka liewlong . U Moses u ïohi ba kata ka lawlynnong ka la kem ding , hynmen kam shym ing satia .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush : and he looked , and , behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .
And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy  ;
translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis . Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bad ka jingsngewkhuslai ki la wan ha u ,

La ïathuh ïa u bashisha ka Assyria ba ki bhabriew kiba u la pynshongduh ha ki nongbah ka Samaria kim shym la tip ïa ki aiñ jong u balieh jong kata ka ri , bad kumta u plie u la phah ïa ki sopti , kiba la pynpei ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria , saying , The nations which thou hast removed , and placed in the cities of Samaria , know not the manner of the God of the land : therefore he hath sent lions among them , and , behold , they slay them , because they know not the manner of the God of the land .

translation.kha: Ha ka arliang ba sha trai jong ka , buh ïa ki dur Soh Pomkranet ba la shna da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba tdong sawphew , bad hapdeng khappud suh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar .
translation.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .

translation.kha: Ngam shym la kam ba nga la ïoh jop lypa lane ba la pynlong janai lympat . Nga ïai ïaleh shitom ban ïoh ïa ka pruid ïa katba U Khereth Jisu u la ïoh ïa nga sha lade hi .
translation.en: Not as though I had already attained , either were already perfect : but I follow after , if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki jingrwai ha ka ïingsyiem kin kylla long ki jingïalumlang ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap Kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa shah bret neh ha ka jingsngur jar .
translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .

translation.kha: ka ding ka la hap ba-halor ki nongbud jongu ki badno ryngkat duh ïa kito ki briew kiba ba-bymman .
translation.en: And a fire was kindled in their company  ; the flame burned up the wicked .
And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta katta haduh ba ka la jan pynlwet ïa nga . Ïashong hangne bad to ïai ap .

translation.en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
translation.kha: Sa tang shipor ka pyrthei kan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , hynrei phin ïohi ïa nga ; bad namar ba nga im , phi ruh phin ïoh im .
Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha Babilonia bad un sah klang haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kiei ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nongtih Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma por U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .

translation.kha: Hynrei kdor shym la shahshkor lane khongdong . Pynkup , uwei uwei barabor u ïai bteng ban long uba mutlop nabar uba sniew kumba u ju un-long . Nga la lei ïa ki ba-bang batip ïa ka jutang , hynrei ki la kyntait . Kumta nga la ïalamwir halor jong ki baroh ïa ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka .
translation.en: Yet they obeyed not , nor inclined their ear , but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart : therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do  ; but they did them not .
And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be grafted in : for God is able to graft them in again .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki Jiw ki iehnoh ïa ka jingbymngeit jong ki , yn sa buh biang ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki ju don ; naba U Blei u lah ban leh ïa kata .
U Trai u ai ha u Mesha ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit rynsan
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta u jubab ïa u syiem , Ai lei ban Wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong . hukum ïa ki jingsdang syiem baneh pyntieng ha u kulai jong phi .
translation.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :

translation.kha: Phira lah ban kynsha ainguh ïa u jingiw uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynmen yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular .
translation.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .

translation.kha: Ngam nang Kumne ban pynroh , bad U Blei Shen un pynshitom ïa nga lada nga leh kumta .
translation.en: For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .

translation.kha: U buh ïa uwei u khun basa ksiar ha Bethel bad ïa uwei pat ha Dan .
translation.en: And he set the one in Beth–el , and the other put he in Dan .

And David said to Abner , Art not thou a valiant man ? and who is like to thee in Israel ? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king ? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Abner , hato mem dei u briew uba khraw tam ha Israel ? Haba kumta , balei mem ïada ïa u syiem , u kynrad jong me ? Myntan uwei u briew u la ïohrung ha ka ïing dara ban pynïap ïa u syiem kynrad jong me .
Namar kata , nongshong hok ïa ki ktien baher ba la thoh ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah lad Phin baroh .
translation.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .

translation.kha: Hynrei me lah mo , A Blei , ban shong shisha ha ka pyrthuh ? Wat ka bneng baroh kam babiang purew ban ngiam ïa me , kumta kumno ka lah ban long ba Kanah ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei Kan heh haduh katta ?
translation.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth ? behold , the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee  ; how much less this house that I have builded ?
Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Wat klim .’

translation.en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad baroh kiba synran ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki Saddusi na kata ka jaka , ki la bishni shikatdei eh ïa ki apostol ; kumta ki la kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .
Hobab ka la dei per ïa ka ban kha , la shem ba kan sa kha khun synrap .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that , behold , twins were in her womb .

translation.kha: Kito kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha ka Sudan sad kiba la kabu sarong shaïong ka ibit kin shaïong jingmut ; la pynjhieh ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .

translation.kha: Un pyntngit ha phi sa shisien ïa ki jingpang kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phin la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .
translation.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .
And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,
translation.kha: Phi ïatip ba ngam shym la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingïarap ïa phi haba nga ïalap bad hikai ha ki paidbah bad ha ki ïing jong phi .
Namarkata ba u Lot u pyrshing ban praw ha Soan , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khwan kynthei jongu u ki la kynjah sha ki lwa , bad ki ïashoh ïasah ha kawei ka krem .
translation.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .

translation.kha: Pynban , ym shym la pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blem thala , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ngab ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translation.en: But the high places were not taken away : the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U Tlai , U blang ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uwei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne haduh ka por jong u .
translation.en: He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .

translation.kha: Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar halor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u don ka iakata halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka balang , ka met jong u .
translation.en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .

And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .
translation.kha: U Jakob u buh pynkhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang bad u pynphai ïa ki khmat jong ki sha kito kiba thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka rukom u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Laban .
Irad u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar malu u ïng ha ka jingkhang lad ka Ïingjaiñ , pynlang U Trai u krenbeiñ ha u Moses na uta u lyoh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .

translation.kha: U pyiar ïa ka ïor kum ka ne bad u pynphriang ïa u thah kum ka khyndew .
translation.en: He giveth snow like wool : he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka waiñ tad ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .
translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
Tremble , ye women that are at ease  ; be troubled , ye careless ones : strip you , and make you bare , and gird sackcloth upon your loins .
translation.kha: Phi la ju im suk , phim don ki jingkhuslai ; hynrei mynta , to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ! To loit ïa la ki jaiñ bad teh da ki jaiñjot sawdong ïa la ka syngkai .

translation.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower , and fought against it , and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Haba u Abimelekh u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa uta u mot , u la leit sha ka jingkhang bad thang ïa uta u mot .

translation.en: Fear not , O land  ; be glad and rejoice : for the  Lord  will do great things .
translation.kha: Ko ki lyngkha , wat sheptieng , hynrei to risa bad lehkmen namar baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa phi .
U syiem u la phah khet ïa u Joseph , bad marbl kamet la wan sei ïa u na ka jingpynbynta . Ynda u la dep khi tmier bad bujli jaiñjot , u leit ha khmat u syiem .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: U Blei u la noh ha nga , Ko khun u brup , ki briew ka Israel ki hir kum kine ki shyieng . Ki ong ba ki la tyrkhong , khlem kano kano ka jingkyrmen bad ym don shuh ka lawei .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel : behold , they say , Our bones are dried , and our hope is lost : we are cut off for our parts .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngi khong ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jingkhiah lad ka jingsliang ba kynja doh jngai ngi .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingdeng ym da Ban shem hapdeng ki brup ; ym don batbor ïa ka dor bashrah jong ka .
translation.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .
Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , ngan pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jong ki bad pynjah noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki baroh .
Kumta ka kynoi baroh kawei ka ïalam ïa u shabar ka Jaka shongsah dara bad la lynghoh maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , kumba U Trei u la suda .
translation.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And when Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , He is sick .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew u Saul ki wan ban kem ïa u Dabid , ka Mikhal ka ïathuh ïa ki ba u pang .
Pynbeit ïa la ki khun katba ki dang lung ban shah Hikai . Lada phim leh kumta , phi ïaroh ïa ki ban pynngat da ki hi .
translation.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .
Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba kham matlah ban ïa u shakri jong nga , uba kham kyllut ban ïa u nonglamktien ba nga phah ?

translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Manasseh u tei pynjrong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah .
Sumar bha bad peitngor , nongmareh phim tip lano kata ka para kan wan .
translation.en: Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .

translation.kha: Haduh mynta film ju pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jyllang sa ; to pang Bad pher ïohpdiang , khnang ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh Long kaban dap pura .
translation.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .

translation.kha: Lada pha sngap jar ha ka prie kum Kanah , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , pynlang kin lehse im , hynrei phan ïap , bad ka longïing u kpa jongki phan kan kut nong . Pynban mano ba lah ban tip — lehniam ka dei na ka bynta ka na kumto kane ba la pynlong mahadei ïa pha !
translation.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?
Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .
translation.kha: Hato phim sngewthuh ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban shah ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew , ban ïa kaba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka jot noh ?

translation.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka long kaba lieh , bad kam shym paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh ha kata ka prum ruh um pat lieh , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa uta u briew hynñiew sngi .

Nga sngewhun kumno ka long hato kyrduh , pynlang Kumne ka long ban don pahuh kyrhai . Nga la kai ïa kane ka buit barieh , ba hangno hangno ha kano kano ka Por , to sngewhun haba lapbah nga sngewdap kyrhai ne sngew kyrduh lane haba nga don palat than eh ne don khyndiat eh .
translation.en: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tyrha thok . U sngewbha ha ki jingthew kiba hok .
translation.en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .

translation.kha: Mano , phi tharai u ban iohsngew ïa ki ktien jong phi baroh ? Mano ba la ai mynsiem ïa phi ngab krung kumne ?
translation.en: To whom hast thou uttered words ? and whose spirit came from thee ?

translation.kha: Ki ri ba-marjan bad ki ri ba hajngai ki krenbeiñ ïa pha namar ka jingbymdon aiñ ha pha .
translation.en: Those that be near , and those that be far from thee , shall mock thee , which art infamous and much vexed .

translation.kha: Kata ka jingbam kan long kum ka jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha kita ki hynñiew snem jong ka nongshim ki ban sa wan ha ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki brup kin ym ïalyngngoh .
translation.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .
And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u syiem Dabid bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot . Hato ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phin wan bad shim bynta ha ka jingïaleh-sngewbha ?
Ki Ishmael ki ïamane na Sukkoth bad ki shem dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong nga kan ïoh long ha phi bad ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap pura .
Jaban mynta U Trai u la pyndep ïa ka kular jong u . Ang la kdew ïa ka khet u kpa jong nga , u syiem ki Israel bad nga la tei ïa ka Templ ba ma ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the  Lord  promised , and have built an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Tang shu kynjat shai , U Jisu u la mihnoh na shnong bad u la wait sha ka jaka bakynjah . Ki paidbah ki la shang ban wad ïa u , bad haba ki la shem ïa u , ki la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u na kaba otsher noh .
translation.en: And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .

translation.kha: Ha syndah jngai me shihajar ngut ki Lah ban kyllon , shiphew hajan nguh ha barieh sawdong jong me , hynrei men ym shah pynshong .
translation.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side , and ten thousand at thy right hand  ; but it shall not come nigh thee .

translation.kha: Kane ka la khia kumta khnang ba u Elimelekh bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem , kiba la pynshlur ïa u ban pynpyut ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon , ktien siaw na ka bynshet ka kam sniew jong ki .
translation.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come , and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother , which slew them  ; and upon the men of Shechem , which aided him in the killing of his brethren .

translation.kha: Nangta shiphew ngut na ki shipai jong u Joab ki kurim sawdong ïa u Absalom bad pyndep shun pynjop ïa u .
translation.en: And ten young men that bare Joab s armour compassed about and smote Absalom , and slew him .
And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .
translation.kha: U la thoh lai hajar tylli ki proberb bad palat hajar tylli ki jingrwai .

translation.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever :
translation.kha: U Trai u dap da ka jingisynei bad un ym kyntait ïa ngi junom .
