Bad U Trai u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi shwa ka lyer sorki kaba jur , kiba la rong noh ïa ki puit malu bret ïa ki shaw ka Duriaw Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei ruh u puit ha ka ri jingïaphet baroh kawei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .

translation.kha: Hamor ka tnum ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ; ba la shna da u ikordor Sapphir ; Bad don bashong halor kata ka khet ba i kumne u bhabriew .
translation.en: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone : and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it .
And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .
Kata ka sngaid ka dei ban long ka sngi kaba khuid bha , ka sngew ha kaba ki shahjingit pynlang kim trei ïa kano kano ka kam . Kine ki dei ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ban rakhe pateng la pateng .
translation.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you , and ye shall afflict your souls , by a statute for ever .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jongu nga kan meh lep kum ka dang , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki tynrai jong ki lumbah .
translation.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .
And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei bad ki la mane ïa U  Trai  ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .
Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng : U Trai u la pynim ïa ki shakri jong u , ki Israel !
translation.en: Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .
And lay siege against it , and build a fort against it , and cast a mount against it  ; set the camp also against it , and set battering rams against it round about .
translation.kha: Nangta , ban pyn-i nuksa ïa ka jingshah kerkut , buh ki kharai , ki kynton khyndew , ki jaka sher dara bad ki tiar pynpait kynroh baroh sawdong jong ka .
U Ananias u la jubab , Ko Trai , ngon ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa nga shaphang une u briew bad shaphang kiei kiwei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew jong me ha Jeroham .
translation.en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Ho-oid , to ki ong , ngin shu te ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . neng ym pynïap ïa me . Kumjuh ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na —kata ka krem .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .

translation.kha: Ha ki lyngdoh la aiti ïa ki kada kat kum ki kur , bad ïa ki Lebi kiba afi snem ka rta ne kham ïaw la aiti ha ki katno kum ki kynran Tertios .
translation.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers , and the Levites from twenty years old and upward , in their charges by their courses  ;
And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En–gedi  ; six cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Nibshan , ka nongbah Mluh , bad ka Engedi : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la ni . ngan thang ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka dong , bun kan bam duh ïa baroh kat kaba ni sawdong jong ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ba ka por kan poi — ka por ka la lah poi — haba kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sa jong U du U blem , bad kito kiba jingsngewsih ïa ka kin ïoh im .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin ïalehkmen bad kin ïa-ai jingai sngewbha markylliang , namar ba kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibun ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .
Ha ki jingkhawai jong Phi , Phi don ki duitara , ki shakri bad ki tangmuri — bad ka waiñ . Hynrei phim sngewthuh aïu U Trai u leh ,
translation.en: And the harp , and the viol , the tabret , and pipe , and wine , are in their feasts : but they regard not the work of the  Lord  , neither consider the operation of his hands .

translation.kha: Hynrei pa hikai ba lada u briew u ni khie kaei kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ban ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka un-long ka jong U blei ,’ um donkam baneh brup ïa la u kpa .
translation.en: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ;

translation.kha: Te uwei na ki nongsharai balang u la ong ha nga , Wat ïam . Ha khmih ! U Sing na ka khait Judah , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , u la oh ïa ka jingjop , bad u da ban pynpait ïa ki hynñiew tylliat ki jingpyndait nabar ban plied ïa ka koit kli .
translation.en: And one of the elders saith unto me , Weep not : behold , the Lion of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , hath prevailed to open the book , and to loose the seven seals thereof .
Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
translation.kha: Ki dur khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .
Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha babniah bad un sah hangta hapoh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kaei Ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nong Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma nga U Trai , la la kren .
translation.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .
When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa nga lane ïohsngew shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la leh .

translation.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood  ; thou hast taken usury and increase , and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion , and hast forgotten me , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Don na ki briew jong pha , kiba pynïap ïa ki briew da kaba ïoh jingsiew . Don kiba shim sut halor ki ram ba ki ai ïa ki para jait Israel bad ki riewspah da kaba shim kabu ïa ki . Ki la klet ïa nga .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , the sons of Saul .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa lai ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u Saul , u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .

translation.en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei u kherub u don saw tylli ki durkhmat . Ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka dei ka jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jong u sing , bad kaba saw ka jong u pukni .

Wat shah ba ki jinghikai bakhyllah baroh keiñ ïalam bakla ïa pa na ka lyndang kaba dei . Ka long kaba bha ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba kyrsiew na shab da ka jingai U Blei , bad ym da kaba kohnguh ïa ki sah” kiba ïadei bad ki jingbam ; iar kiba kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum kim Shim la ïoh jingïarap ei ei na ki .
translation.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines . For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace  ; not with meats , which have not profited them that have been occupied therein .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go , get thee down  ; for thy people , which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves :
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie , leit hiar noh shisyndon , naba ki briew jong me kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , ki la ïaleh pop bad ki la kyntait ïa nga .

translation.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains , and they robbed all that came along that way by them : and it was told Abimelech .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh briew ban apthap ïa u Abimelekh ha ki kliar lum , bad ki la lute ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti nangta . La ïathuh ïa kane ha u Abimelekh .

Haba ka Sngi Bosrah ka poi , kiba bun kin ong ha nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ! Ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la krenbeiñ ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , da ka kyrngah jongngi me I la beh ne ïa shibun ki ksuid bad ngi la leh shibun ki kambah !’
translation.en: Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?

translation.kha: kumta u jong ha u , Khie leit thiah biang , bad lada u khot biang ïa phi sa shisien , sa ong , ‘ To kren , ko Trai , u shakri jong me u sngap .’ Kumta u Samuel u leit ibiang sha la ka jaka thiah .
translation.en: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel , Go , lie down : and it shall be , if he call thee , that thou shalt say , Speak ,  Lord   ; for thy servant heareth . So Samuel went and lay down in his place .

translation.kha: Nga la sngewtynnat ban im . To sngem ïa ki jingud kthang jong nga .
translation.en: My soul is weary of my life  ; I will leave my complaint upon myself  ; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba ngam , ne ïa ki jingsiew kiba pynïap haba shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .

translation.kha: Ha ki jaka maïan Blei’ thala , ha ki lum , bad thah ka syrngiew jong ki dieng baroh , u Akhish u ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit Kaba la pynlong ïa u ban pynskhem ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jinglah , bad hukum ba synreit ïa ka snam ha ki jingkhang , ba u Angel jyllang ka Jingïap un ym pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Jesreel .
translation.en: Through faith he kept the passover , and the sprinkling of blood , lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them .

And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka  tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga .’

translation.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan : the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones  ; for they are come , and have devoured the land , and all that is in it  ; the city , and those that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la da don hapoh ka nongbah Dan ; ngi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa pynhiar mynsiem jong ki kulai jong ki . Ka ri baroh kawei ka khynñiuh haba ki kulai jong ki , ki pah . Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha ka , ka nongbah jong ngi bad baroh ki briew jong ka .

translation.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent , and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations : spare not , lengthen thy cords , and strengthen thy stakes  ;
translation.kha: Kham pynheh ïa ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba pha shong ; pynjrong ïa ki tyllai bad pynskhem ïa ki snar !
Ïa ngi la pyndonnam bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroi . La ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongshong , pynban ngi krong ïa ka jingshisha ;
translation.en: By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;
Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .
translation.kha: Bad u Nathan u bynrap ,  Nangta , katba phi dang ïakren bad u Syiem Dabid , ngan wan rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka khana jong phi .
Nongthaw ki ong ha u Joash , Wallam shabar ïa u khun jong me hangne , ba ngin pynpyut ïa u ! U la pynkhyllem ïa ka kharai ïa u Baal bad pyngngad ïa ka dak jong ka Asherah kaba ha shniah jong ka .
translation.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash , Bring out thy son , that he may die : because he hath cast down the altar of Baal , and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it .

translation.kha: U Haran u don mata ngut ki khwan shynrang : U Nahath uba kah duh , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ahimaas .
translation.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , after their families , by the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Phi kob shaphang kaba oh kyrwep ïa ka shnong Lodebar . Phi kob , Ngi la long kiba khlaiñ bha ban ïohknieh ïa ka Karnaim .
translation.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought , which say , Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Salmone u phah khot ïa baroh ki Nongïalam jongngi ki jait bad ki kur jong ki Jesreel ban wan sha u shad Jerusalem khnai ban leit shim noh ïa ka syntiew ka Jutang U Trai na ka Seïon , ka Nongbah u Dabid , sha ka Templ .
translation.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit shim ïa ki sad u wanrah shaw ka , bad ka ruh ka shet ïa ka jait jingbam kaba u kpa jong u , u ju sngewtynnat .
translation.en: And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
And the angel of the  Lord  came again the second time , and touched him , and said , Arise and eat  ; because the journey is too great for thee .
translation.kha: U angel U  Trai  u la wan biang bad kyrsiew ïa u ha ka sien kaba ar bad u ong ,  Khie joit bad bam , lymda kumta men shitom ha ka jingïaid lynti .
Haba phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai shun bam haw ba Phon da ot ïa u jingthung ha tala ka snem .
translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .

translation.kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kura u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangïapom synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingïohknieh jong ka Tabeel .
translation.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .

translation.kha: Khnang ban pynpaw ha ki jingñiewbeiñ kaban ba nga longïing kaba khuid , ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew jongno nga na ki ri baroh kiba ki shongsah ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: When I have brought them again from the people , and gathered them out of their enemies  lands , and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations  ;

translation.kha: Ka la teng ïa u na ka jaiñkup , bad ka ong , Ale thiah bad to . Hynrei u la lait phet bad u la mareh shabar da katba iehnoh ïa la ka kjap ha ka Ki jong ka .
translation.en: And she caught him by his garment , saying , Lie with me : and he left his garment in her hand , and fled , and got him out .
If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,
translation.kha: Te tharai une u briew u don u khun uba lute bad uba pynïap , uba leh ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u um ju leh .
U Abraham u jubab , To ïa-pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . Da kaweh leh kumne , me templ ba dei ma nga suba la tih ïa kane ka pukri .
translation.en: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khulom u briew , ïaheh ha ki Israel ba haba u briew babha u leh pop , ka jingleh babha ba u kuna kam lai ban pynum ïa u . “lada u briew basniew , u sangeh kaba leh bymman , yn ym pynshitom ïa u , bad lada u briew babha u sdang ban imat pop , ïa ka jingim jong u yn ym pynshah .
translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , say unto the children of thy people , The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression : as for the wickedness of the wicked , he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness  ; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth .
Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth , and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyndonburom ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad pha mynba pha dang samla , bad ngan pynlong ka jutang bad pha ka ban neh junom .

translation.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples .
translation.kha: Bad ki la sah slem hangta bad ki riewngeit .
Kumne u Joshua u phah noh ïa ki , bad ki la rupa sha la ka jakarieh sad ap hangta , ha ka phang sorki jong ka Ai , hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel . U Joshua patar u sahmiet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: Joshua therefore sent them forth : and they went to lie in ambush , and abode between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of Ai : but Joshua lodged that night among the people .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki khulom kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki kin sa die ïa ki sha jngai shuh ki Seba . Ma sa , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :
translation.kha: Dei namar kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba nga long kum nongïakura u bym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingkura jong u .
hynrei phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u mala satar ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh’ ïa kiba la thoiñ ha kñia ka kitab jong ki jinghikai jrong u . “Phi dei ban phai sha u da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .
translation.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , and if thou turn unto the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .

translation.kha: U la ïalam noh ïa ki paid Israel na Ieit ; ka jingieit jong u ka nep bymjukut ;
translation.en: And brought out Israel from among them : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Ha kine ki sawphew snem ki jaiñkup lad phi kim shitrhem man rim bad ki kjat jong phi ruh kim shym at .
translation.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .

translation.kha: Ki shata , ki tnat , bad ka ktang u diengpynïeng sharak ki long ibha ïateh lang kawei da ka ksiew nylla ba la shoh .
translation.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same : all of it was one beaten work of pure gold .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllait ïa ka paro ban tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , kata ka paro kam shym pruh jaka ban em .
translation.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;
And it came to pass after this , that the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Nahash u syiem Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun , u khun jong u , u la long syiem .
Kan jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba ktang ym jaiñ-jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka hok ban ïa kaba tip ïa ka bun nangta pat ban phai dien noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .
translation.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .

translation.kha: Kato nga da kwah ban don ki ban kynjoh ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthiah ïa ki ha ka kino !
translation.en: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !
And he said unto them , What counsel give ye that we may answer this people , who have spoken to me , saying , Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter ?
translation.kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  U kylli .  Kaei ngan ong ïa ki briew kiba kyrpad ïa nga ban pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?

translation.en: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields  ; for they are white already to harvest .
translation.kha: Phi don ka jingong , ‘ Sa saw bnai bad nangta pat ka aïom ot .’ Hynrei nga ong ïa phi , to da khmih ïa ki lyngkha ; ki jingthung mynta ki la ih bad ki la dei ban ot !

uba lah ban ïohpdiang aïu U Blei u nong , Bad uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip kaban wang na U bajhieh Tam Eh . Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingphohsniew na U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :

Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers , and the wickedness of the kings of Judah , and the wickedness of their wives , and your own wickedness , and the wickedness of your wives , which they have committed in the land of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la klet ïa ki kam bymman baroh ïa kiba la leh ha ki shnong jong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem da ki kpa tymmen jong phi , da ki syiem ka Judah bad ki tnga jong ki , bad da ma phi bad ki tnga jong phi ?

U Moses bad u Aaron ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon long U Trai , bad haba ki mian shabar , ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ na ka jingsdang U Trai ka paw ha u paidbah baher .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation , and came out , and blessed the people : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the people .

translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi , u poi sha ka jaka bakhuid bad u la sher dara klang . U dem ban thiah , u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh halor u maw .
translation.en: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kñia , ki ïadem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrkhat jam , U Trai u long U Blei ; U tharai tang ma u , u long U Blei !
translation.en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phin la ong ka long ka jingñiewbeiñ , hynrei na tip kumno ngan jubab ïa phi .
translation.en: I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .

translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , hynriew um long kum u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban , u leh ïa kiei kaba u Joash u kparad Jong u , u la leh .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .

translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit jong ngi ïa U Blei , ka maw ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jongngi u . Bad ki hukum jong u kdor longsyiem bakha eh katta katta ïa ngi ,
translation.en: For this is the love of God , that we keep his commandments : and his commandments are not grievous .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ïai-ong , Katno ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban krong shapoh ka Shimham U Blei’ !
translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: Haduh phim shemphang ? Kano kano kabu rung shapoh ka shym jong u briew ka leit shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta pat shabar na ka met jongu u .
translation.en: Do not ye yet understand , that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly , and is cast out into the draught ?
And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted .
translation.kha: Ka ri kan long kaba shah ieh kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka yn ieh kumto ha ki jingjot .
wah ai ba kum kata ka briew kan ieh jyllop ïa ka dohnud jong phin ; Wat leit shang kylleng shaba ïaid ma ka .
translation.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways , go not astray in her paths .
And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katno ka long kaba itynnat lem bad ki maw bajlih jong ka bad ki jingai ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei .
U Balei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit bashaniah ha uba u la jied , ha u Sabad bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .
translation.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .

Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , u la pynskhem triang ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jong nga ; u la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la ai ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Nga smai da U  Trai  uba im ba u Adonijah un ïap ha kane hi ka sngi !

Ïa u khun nang ba la kha nyngkong baroh’ phin bujli da u khunlangbrot . Lada phim khah ban buhnud ïa uta u khun kada , phi daym ban pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Phi dei ruh ban pyllait ïa u khun nyngkong jong phi barabor .
translation.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb  ; and if thou wilt not redeem it , then thou shalt break his neck : and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem .

translation.kha: nur pyn-i ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ïa ka Jerusalem , sha kito baroh kiba shong halor ki jingpra jong ka . Wat la ka jaka jong ka , ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ngan pynhieng ïa ka , ka kper , kum ka kper kaba nga la rain ha Eden . Ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen kine ne hangta , bad ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ïa nga .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall comfort Zion : he will comfort all her waste places  ; and he will make her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the  Lord   ; joy and gladness shall be found therein , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .

translation.kha: Naba ki ba bun na phi , ba la pynbaptis ha U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa phi da U Khrist hi .
translation.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .
translation.kha: Kaba kham palat ïa kata ka long ba ïa ngi la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shaphang U Blei , namar ba ngi la ong ba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei lada ka long kaba shisha ba ïa kiba ïap ym shym la pynmihpat , te um shym la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist .

Ka Ïalam ka don hapdeng kito kba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ki don ha baroh shadong jong ka . Ki longïing baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la sha pynïap ha ka sur-thma . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei myntan ki thiah ïap bad ki jahburom , ki ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar ryngkat bad iba kiba shah pynïap ha ka thnam .
translation.en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .
At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng synñia nga khie ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .

translation.en: I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïaineh skhem , bad nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh .  Bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .
Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba duk , bad Baroh ki longïing ki nongshukor .
translation.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , barben na im’ , ngi la longsem kum ma ki bad ngi la im kat kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa kano kano kaba ïahap kat kum ki jingkwah jong ki met bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jongno ngi hi . Ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ngi , kumba long uwei pa uei , la buh lypa don shahskhor pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Blei .
translation.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city , as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle .
translation.kha: Ki leit phai noh jar jar shapoh ka nongbah , kum ki shipai kiba lehrain haba ki phet noh na ka thma .

translation.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet : I will be glad in the  Lord .
translation.kha: To un kmen ïa ka jingrwai jong nga , namar ka jingkmen jong nga ka wan na u .
To long naba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! U Saul , u syiem jong phi u la ïap , dara ki paid Judah ki la pynsleh ïa nga kum u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened , and be ye valiant : for your master Saul is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them .
And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan Bethphage bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib , u la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :

translation.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .
translation.kha: U Solomon u don sawphew hajar tylli ki sem ïa ki kulai ring kali , bad khat-ar hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai .

Ïa ka thain baher kiwei naduh Geba ha ka phah bahakhlieh bad shaduh Rimmon ha ka phang bashathie , yn pynmadan . Ka Jerusalem kan ïeng halor ka ri basawdong jong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shaduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba la ju don ka khrud ba-mynshuwa , mala na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot waiñ jong u syep .
translation.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .
And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children s crumbs .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ,  wat ki ksew ha khrum ka miej ki bam ïa ki jingbam ba la sah tam na ki khun !
Namar kata , ieit ïa kita ki nongwei , namar phi ruh phi! la long ki nongthain ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Love ye therefore the stranger : for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: wahbah ka la ïohi ïa u Petros ba u dang syaid ding , ka la peit shaiñ ïa u bad ka la ong , Ma me ruh , me la long nabar U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
translation.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .

Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law , but by the faith of Jesus Christ , even we have believed in Jesus Christ , that we might be justified by the faith of Christ , and not by the works of the law : for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi tip ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha khmat U Blei tang da ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Ngi ruh , ngi la ngeit ha U Khrist Jisu khnang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha U Khrist bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Namar ym don uno uno ruh ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
Phim long kiba kham Stad ban ïa kiwei pat , U Jisu u la ong ïa ki . Hangto tv sheng ? Ym don kaba rung shapoh u briew na Shabar kaba eh shisha ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u ,
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it cannot defile him  ;

Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Josaïah u kut jingmut ban ïaleh . U kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong lyngba u syiem Neko , kumta u riam pher ïa lade bad u leit sha ka thma ha ka them jong ka Megiddo .

translation.en: Moreover ye see and hear , that not alone at Ephesus , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people , saying that they be no gods , which are made with hands :
translation.kha: Mynta , phi lah ban ïohi bad ïohsngew da lade aïu une u Paul u leh . U ong ba ki blei kiba la shna da ki kti jong ki briew kim long da shisha ki blei , bad u la jop ha kaba pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki briew , hangne ha Ephesos bad hajan baroh kawei jong ka probins jong ka Asia .

translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Da sumar bha te , ban ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el : and the horns of the altar shall be cut off , and fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta ki pop jong ki , ngan pynjot ïa ki duwan ka Bethel . Ïa ki dong jong kawei pa kawei ka duwan yn pom noh bad kin hap ha madan .
Ka Duriaw Basaw ka la kham bad ka phet khong , ka wah Jordan ka la shiteng ban tuid .
translation.en: The sea saw it , and fled : Jordan was driven back .
Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei jong nga , ïa baroh kine kiei kiei kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .
Bad kumta u syiem Darius u la soi ïa ka hukum .
translation.en: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree .

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban kdew lynti ïa ki khlur na khwai ka aïom sha kawei pat bad me pynïaid ïa ka thup khlur bameh bad barit ?
translation.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?
And when I beheld , lo , the sinews and the flesh came up upon them , and the skin covered them above : but there was no breath in them .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang peit , la sop ïa ki shyieng da ki thied , bad ka dohksah , bad nangta da ka sniehdoh . Hynrei ym don jingpynhiar mynsiem ha kita ki met .
U Saul u leit mar mar shlip bad na hajar ngat ki shipai kiba kynshew tam ha Israel sha ka ri khlaw Siph ban wad ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .

translation.kha: Na nangno ka lynti ngin ïaid na ka bynta ka jingtur ïaleh ? Ngin ïaid ïa ka lynnong kaba ïalang , lyngba ka ri khlaw Edom , u Joram u jingjubab .
translation.en: And he said , Which way shall we go up ? And he answered , The way through the wilderness of Edom .

translation.kha: Nga , U Trai , na la khot bad ai bor ïa Phin , ban khmih ba ka jingbishar hok la pyndep ha pyrthei . Lyngba jong phi ngan pynlong ïa ka jingmong bad ki briew baroh ; lyngba jrong ph lang wanrah ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: I the  Lord  have called thee in righteousness , and will hold thine hand , and will keep thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , for a light of the Gentiles  ;

translation.kha: jynreiñ haduh kane ka sngi , la ïarap ïa nga da U Blei , bad kumta nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka jingsuki jong nga ha baroh , ha uba rit malu ha uba khraw kumjuh . Kaei kaweh nga jong ka long kajuh hi kaba ki nongïathuhlypa bad u Moses ki la ïai-ong ba kan sa jia :
translation.en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
translation.kha: hynrei haba u la sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingïap u Amnon , u la shlei da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa u Absalom u khun jong u .
Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki Paidbah ïa kane ka phar : La don shikhung uwei u bhabriew ibha don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la aïu ha ki nongshimwai , dara nongtih u la mih na ïinglieng ban jah kham slem .
translation.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable  ;  A certain man planted a vineyard , and let it forth to husbandmen , and went into a far country for a long time .
For David speaketh concerning him , I foresaw the Lord always before my face , for he is on my right hand , that I should not be moved :
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid u la ong shaphang jong u ,   ‘ Nga la ïohi ïa U Trai ha khmat jong nga ha ki por baroh ; u don hajan jong nga , bad ngan ym don ha ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
Ki la ïaleit sha baroh ki nongbah jong ka Joïada bad ki wallam pat bad ki sha Jerusalem ïa ki Lebi bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kur .
translation.en: And they went about in Judah , and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah , and the chief of the fathers of Israel , and they came to Jerusalem .
Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U  Trai  kan wan , ngan phah ha phi ïa u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa .

U Blei u la ai ha ki saw ngut ki samla shynrang ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingtbit ha ka thoh ka tait bad ha ka pyrkhat . Nalor kane , u la ai ha u Daniel ka jingbeit ban batai ïa ki jingïohipaw bad ïa ki jingphohsniew .
translation.en: As for these four children , God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom : and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams .

translation.kha: Da u , la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ka jingpynlong baroh kaba la thaw khlem ma u .
translation.en: All things were made by him  ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .

translation.kha: U Moses u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershom bad u Elieser .
translation.en: The sons of Moses were , Gershom , and Eliezer .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah , Pynkhuid ïa lade , namar lashai U Trai un leh ki kaba hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Sanctify yourselves : for to morrow the  Lord  will do wonders among you .

translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa kano baroh , nga shong nabar nga ïam . Bun sngi nga la sngewsih malade ngam shym bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when I heard these words , that I sat down and wept , and mourned certain days , and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,
Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies , that I might destroy them that hate me .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban phet krad na nga ; nga pynjot ïa kito kiba shun ïa nga .
Ha ki snem Benhesed , kawei ka kynhun barit ka la shang ban pule ïa ka Baibl mala ki la shem biang ïa ka jingshisha jrong ka Baibl .
translation.en: In the 1870’s a small group of Bible students began rediscovering long-lost Bible truths .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot len ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ai ha ki ka ni bad ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid baroh bad ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingap .
translation.en: Then he called his twelve disciples together , and gave them power and authority over all devils , and to cure diseases .
Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours , great of flesh  ; and hast increased thy whoredoms , to provoke me to anger .
translation.kha: Pha la shah ïa ki paramarjan bakwah brai , ki nong Ijipt ban leit ïathiah bad pha , bad pha la pyndonkam ïa ka jingleh nuti jong pha ban pynbitar ïa nga .

bad u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la bret ïa ka mlien ha ka um , bad u ong , Kainan ka dei ka U Trai u ong : ‘ Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka um , bad kan ym pynjia shuh kano kane ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khur .’
translation.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

translation.kha: U la long uba jop , namar baroh kaba u la leh na ka byndi ka Templ lane ha kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum , u la har ha ka mynjur kaba ïaineh tylli bad aiti lutphut ha U Balei jong u .
translation.en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God , and in the law , and in the commandments , to seek his God , he did it with all his heart , and prospered .

translation.kha: Kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin kmen haba ki Ïohi ïa na , namar nga la shaniah ha ka jingkular jong me .
translation.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me  ; because I have hoped in thy word .

translation.kha: Me la sngewbang ba me long uba bhabriew , bad ka nam jongnga me ka la pynjrong ïa me ban kun kumne u bieit . Naamah kane nga la bret ïa me sha khyndew bad ieh ïa me kum ka jingmaham ïa kiwei pat ki syiem .
translation.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty , thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness : I will cast thee to the ground , I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .
Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .
translation.kha: Haei ken kata ka jingkyrkhu ka ba phi la ong ? Nga hi nga lah ban ong ba phin da la khlaw noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lada phi lah , bad ban ai noh ïa ki ha nga .
ka Eltekeh , ka Gibbethon , ka Baal ,
translation.en: And Eltekeh , and Gibbethon , and Baalath ,

translation.kha: Ka la biang ba ïa une u briew la pynïapmat ha kane ka armet da Ibbah bun na phira .
translation.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment , which was inflicted of many .

Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .
translation.kha: Hangta u Jephthah u lumlang ïa ki rangbah Gilead baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Ephraim , bad u jop ïa ki . ( Naba ki Ephraim ki ong ,  Phi ki Gilead kiba ha Ephraim bad Manasseh phi dei ki nongphetwir na Ephraim !  )
Ha kaba Kut u Job u sdang ban krenbeiñ malu ban sngewsih ïa ka sngi ha naba la kha ïa u .
translation.en: After this opened Job his mouth , and cursed his day .

translation.kha: Un kner ïa ki lyngkha , ki bri shawei , bad ki brisoh Ebal jong phi kiba bha tam , bad un ai ïa ki ha ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translation.en: And he will take your fields , and your vineyards , and your oliveyards , even the best of them , and give them to his servants .

translation.kha: Babha u syiem Israel u pule ïa ka sakhi , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai bad u kyang khem , Kumno u syiem Syria u khmih lynti ïa nga ban pynkhiah ïa une u briew ? Hato u pyrkhat ba nga dei U Blei , lakam bad ka bor jong ka jingim bad ka jingïap ? Ka shai kdar ba u pyrshang ban sdang ïakajia bad nga !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king of Israel had read the letter , that he rent his clothes , and said , Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy ? wherefore consider , I pray you , and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynkhreh ïa ka waitlam jong u ha pdeng , pynlang mynta kan mait ïa ki Edom , kita ki briew ïa kiba u la pynbam sha ka jingbieit .
translation.en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven : behold , it shall come down upon Edom , and upon the people of my curse , to judgment .
Brethren , my heart s desire and prayer to God for Israel is , that they might be saved .
translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga , katno nga kwah da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ba ki briew jong nga hi kin long ïa kiba la pynim ! Katno nga duwai ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki !
Mano te , ki ban pynrem ïa ki ? Ym U Khrist Jisu! , uba la ïap , lane , ïa uba la pynmihpat nabar uba don ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , uba ïadait malu u na ka bynta jong ngi!
translation.en: Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .

translation.kha: Katai kob nga mih ka long ba U Blei’ u la pynbang ïa ka jutang bad u Abraham badno u la kular ban batbit ïa ka . Ka hukum , ïa kaba la ai hadien spah laiphew snem , kam lah ban pynkhie ïa ka jutang bad pyndam noh ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
translation.en: And this I say , that the covenant , that was confirmed before of God in Christ , the law , which was four hundred and thirty years after , cannot disannul , that it should make the promise of none effect .
Who shall not fear thee , O Lord , and glorify thy name ? for thou only art holy : for all nations shall come and worship before thee  ; for thy judgments are made manifest .
translation.kha: Uei u ban ym ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa me , A Trai ? Uei u ban kyntait ban pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me ? Tang ma me hi uba khuid . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin wan bad mane ïa me , namar ïa ki jingleh bahok jong me la ïohi da baroh .
Ki briew kiba sniew kin hap ban pyndem ha kiba hok bad kyrthep rit ïa ka jinglehisynei na ki .
translation.en: The evil bow before the good  ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .

translation.kha: Ka khubor babha ka long hima ba ka jingbit ïa ki niam kaba Sakhi bakla kan sa wan shen .
translation.en: The coming judgment of false religion is good news .

translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka Bad un pyndap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thrang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .
And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la sdang ban hikai .

translation.en: Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .
translation.kha: Kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba phi la nang . Ka jingnang jingtip jong phi ka dei ka jingim jong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .
‘ Ka jingtim U Bel kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: bad phin ym lah da lah lah ban sngewthuh aïu U Balei u imat . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym skhem da lili lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki da ban kai ba ki thup , hynrei kim tip .
translation.en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka sngi , ai ba U  Trai  un leh kumjuh ïa nga bad pyllait ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jong nga baroh !
U la leit sha u Pilat bad peiñ ïa ka meeting jong U Jisu .
translation.en: This man went unto Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus .
And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air , and unto the beasts of the earth , and no man shall fray them away .
translation.kha: Ynda phi ïap , ki sim bad ki mrad kin bam ïa ki metïap jong phi , bad yn ym don ba leit beh ïa ki .

translation.en: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face , and were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur , ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta ba ki la dem khrup la ki durkhmat sha khyndew .
U ong ba ngin wad ïa u hynrei ïong ym Shema ïa u , pynlang ba ngin lah ban leit sha kaba un ei . U mut aïu ?
translation.en: What manner of saying is this that he said ,  Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?
translation.kha: U long kumno uta u briew ?  u syiem u kylli .

dong step phyrngab la ïalam ïa U Jisu na ka ïing u Kaïaphas sha ka ïing jong u lyngskor . Ki nongshniah jong ki Jiw kim shym la sping shapoh ka ïong , naba ki kwah shun sumar Khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam , ktang ba ki lah Ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early  ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled  ; but that they might eat the passover .
And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .
translation.kha: U Abner bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Them Jordan baroh shi miet ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan , bad hadien ba ki la ïaid baroh shi step ha ka step kaba bud , ki la wan poi biang ha Mahanaim .

translation.en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew , bad uno uno uba jaboh u dei ban ïai jaboh ; uno uno uba bha u dei ban ïai lehbha , bad uno uno uba khuid u dei ban ïailong khuid .

U Minnith u la bat synshar ïa la , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri shyiap . Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka briew kaba shong halor u khrawburom rong saw uba la ei ki ktung kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba la thoh baroh shi ryndang jong u ; u mradkhlaw u la don hynñiew thylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .
translation.en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast , full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns .

translation.kha: Shilhim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang , bad ong ïa u Aaron bun ïa ki khun shynrang jong u don buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlaw jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jongngi ki , kiba jyrsieh kum ka Sodom bad ka Gomer , ki long kum ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba sei ki Soh kiba kthang malu don bih ,
translation.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom , and of the fields of Gomorrah : their grapes are grapes of gall , their clusters are bitter :

translation.kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la pyrta , Pynïap ïa u ! Pyllait ïa u Barabbas ha ngi !
translation.en: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :

translation.kha: Phi longkmie ba la tim ! Phi khot kaba bha ïa kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ïa ka bha . Phi pynphai ïa ka jingdup sha ka jingshai pynlang ïa ka jingshai sha ka jingdum . Phi pynlong kabu thiang ïa kob kthang Bad kaban kthang ïa naba thiang .
translation.en: Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !
And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ,  u Akhan u jubab ,  nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga la leh .
Nga sla aïu ïa ka jingibieit kaba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lane ki musla na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingainguh jongno ki lane banbeiñ sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .
translation.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .

translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um kai ang dak tang shikyntien ruh .
translation.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .
And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .
translation.kha: Ieh ïa ka kumba ka long ,  u Josaïah u hukum .  Ïa ki shyieng jong u ym dei ban pynkhih .  Kumta ïa ki shyieng jong u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong kito ki jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la wan na Samaria .

ynda me mih nangne mynsiem ka sngi , men ïadoh ar ngut ki rangbah Ashan ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kin ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kai kiba me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuslai Shuah shaphang jngai ki , ishyrkhei i khuslai shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylli , ‘ Ngan leh kumno keiñ shemphang la u khum ?’
translation.en: When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?

translation.kha: Dei namar jong phi ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la bitar ïa nga bad u la klun da kaba shatei ba nur-um ym ïew jam ïa ka wah Jordan ba-bang longing sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh kaba u ai khem ka jingïohkynti jrong phi .
translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :

translation.kha: Baroh kiwei kiei kba u Amon u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Uei uba stad haduh katta ban ñiew ïa ki lyoh bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ki ban theh ïa u slap ,
translation.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom ? or who can stay the bottles of heaven ,

translation.kha: To ïa-pdiang iwei ïa iwei te , na ka bynta ka donburom jongno U Blei , kumba U Khrist u la pdiang ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .

translation.kha: U Trai u ainong , uba rieh bad uba tlot kumba me long , ko Israel , wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me . Nga , U Blei uba khoit ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa me .
translation.en: Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: U Syiem u la kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba u la phohsniew .
translation.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and , behold , it was a dream .
And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ha u Joshua , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u la leh ïa kito ki ar ngut ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh kumjuh ïa kita baroh ïa kiba men dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar ka buddien ïa ki nongpop kylleng , hynrei ki briew kiba hok kin ïoh bainong da kiei kiei kiba bha .

To Ngin ïakhmih shaiñ Sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka kein naduh kob sdang haduh kaba khup . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynbna , namar ka jingkmen kaweh la ap ïa u , um shym pyrkhing ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap halor ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka lok ka mon jong ka khet U Blei .
translation.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewlehrain ïa baroh kaba por la ong badno nga kylla-kaba-mut ha u phet pui bad u diengïap .
translation.en: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes .

translation.kha: Mar kumta , u Saul u rah ïa la u sum sha u Jonathan ban pynïap ïa u , mala u Jonathan u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u la da ngut jingmut shisha ban pynpyut ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him : whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David .

translation.kha: Haba u Abner u wan shuh u dab ha Hebron ryngkat Bad arphew ngut ki Rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .
Which is your favourite colour ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka rong jong phi ba ba phi itynnad duh ?
Ym bieit ïa uno uno u briew ban ïathiah shongkha para shynrang . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .
translation.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .
And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying , I am shut up  ; I cannot go into the house of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ai ha u Barukh ïa kine ki jingbthah harum :  Ym shah shuh ïa nga ban rung hapoh ka Templ .
Uno uno uba har biria ïa la u kpa lane uba ñiewbeiñ ïa la ka kmie ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka u dei ban shah bam ha ki pukni ne shah khlieh ki khmat ha ki tyngab khlaw .
translation.en: The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Lashai dang step , leit ïakynduh ïa u Pharaoh mala ïathuh ha u ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong at , khnang ba ki lah baneh Mano ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
When there were no depths , I was brought forth  ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .
translation.kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki duriaw-bah , mynba ki umpohliew kim pat don .
U syiem ka Ijipt un long uba khlaiñ . Hynrei , uwei na ki nongmareh shipai lad u un kham khraw bad un synshar ïa ka hima kaba kham khraw .
translation.en: And the king of the south shall be strong , and one of his princes  ; and he shall be strong above him , and have dominion  ; his dominion shall be a great dominion .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ki briew kim shah salia ïa u . Kumta u Lebi u shim ïa la ka tnga kliar bad u buh ïa ka shabar pynlang ki . Ki pynjahburom da kaba imat lied ïa ka baroh shi miet bad ki khlem sangeh haduh mynstep .
translation.en: But the men would not hearken to him : so the man took his concubine , and brought her forth unto them  ; and they knew her , and abused her all the night until the morning : and when the day began to spring , they let her go .
My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ bakordor jong nga yn pyntngit , haba ki nongtuh kin rung sha ka bad kin pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .
translation.kha: Phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jong phi ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit !

Na Ibbah kumne kita ki jingjam bashyrkhei jong ka jingïap u la pynim ïa ngi , bad un pyni ïa ngi ; bad ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jrong Ngi ha u ba un pynim biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyndang ki jingduwai lem jong phi na ka boitha jong ine .
translation.en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;
And they laid it up till the morning , as Moses bade : and it did not stink , neither was there any worm therein .
translation.kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , kumta ruh ki buh ïa kaba tam haduh kawei pat ka sngi . Te kam shym la sniew , bad kam shym la boi ksaiñ .

translation.en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngam kwah ban shim shibun ïa ka por jong me , kumta nga kyrpad ïa me ban sngewbha ban shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh lyngkot jong ngi .

translation.en: And I brought him to thy disciples , and they could not cure him .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa u ha ki synran jong me , hynrei kim lah ban pynkhiah ïa u .
Pynban , ïa ki pyntha jong ka nongkhap , lem bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u lapbah u khun jong u Jephunneh kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof , gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha ba-hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , dara hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong u .
translation.en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .

translation.kha: Ko ki shngain , to ieit ïa la ki tnga kamra U Khrist u la iau ïa ka balang bad u la ai ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ka .
translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the church , and gave himself for it ;

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki ! Pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad Phon im ! Balei ba kane ka nongbah kan kylla ka kyndon ki jingpra ?
translation.en: Hearken not unto them  ; serve the king of Babylon , and live : wherefore should this city be laid waste ?

translation.kha: Ma ngi kba long kiba khlaw ha ka jingngeit , ngi dei ïa-ban ïarap ïa naba sleit ba kin ba-eh ïa ki jingkit jong ki . Ngim dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translation.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan sha u , u la ong shaphang jong u ,  Une u dei u kynja Israel uba shisha , ym don kano kano ka bymshisha ha u !
Ka dei namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka sah na ki rangbah lyngdoh .
translation.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba stad uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u mawsiang .
Ka sur ka pyrta jam , To pynbna ïa ka Khubor ! Ka khubor aïu ngan pynbang ? nga kylli . To pynbna ba ki brup baroh ki long kumto u phlang ; ngin ym neh skhem ban ïa ki syntiew khlaw .
translation.en: The voice said , Cry . And he said , What shall I cry ? All flesh is grass , and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field :

translation.kha: Lymda u bieit katta katta ban shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka jingkyntiew Kan long ka bainong jong u .
translation.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym burom ïa U Khun um Burom ïa U Kpa uba la phah ïa u .
translation.en: That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .
That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .
translation.kha: Me ai ïa ka ha ki , bad ki bam ïa ka , me pynbiang jingbam , bad ki sngewhun .
Nga la pynshitom beiñ shuh kaba pynïap ïa ki briew kiba la bud ïa kane ka Lynti . Nga la kumne ïa ki ngab bad ki kynthah bad nga la thep ïa ki ha ka byndi .
translation.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women .

translation.kha: U Saul u la leit sha Jerusalem malu u la pyrshah ban ïasah bad ki synran . Hynrei Kam lah ban ngeit ba u la long u synran , bad baroh ki la sheptieng ïa u .
translation.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .

translation.kha: Nga la iaki ha phi ïa ka jingstad bad ka rukom im kaba dei .
translation.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom  ; I have led thee in right paths .

translation.kha: Mar ïalong syep , u Simri u la pynïap ïa barieh ki dkhot na ka longrynïeng u Bashan . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .

translation.kha: Pha la long ruh ka nuti ïa ki nong Bethania , “kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita umdih kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .

translation.kha: kumto ki leit sha ïing u Mikah , ha kambah u samla Lebi u sah , pynlang ki kylli ïa u Lebi kumno u long u man .
translation.en: And they turned thitherward , and came to the house of the young man the Levite , even unto the house of Micah , and saluted him .
And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses , clothed in fine linen , white and clean .
translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ka bneng ki la bud ïa u , ki da shong halor ki kulai balieh bad ki la riam da ki jaiñ linen balieh bad bakhuid .
La seng ïa ka ha Bneng bad kan synshar ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: It is set up in heaven and will rule over this earth .

translation.kha: Ryngkat bad kita ki kpu , Baroh phin ïa-ai hynñiewphew thylliej ki jinglongbriew kiba shisnem , uwei u masi lyngraw , bad ar tylli ki jingmihnoh ki i don kano kano ka jingduna . Yn ai ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang sha U TRAI’ ryngkat bad ka jingangnud bam bad ka jingainguh dih . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingbna ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year , and one young bullock , and two rams : they shall be for a burnt offering unto the  Lord  , with their meat offering , and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trei u kyrhuh na u lum Sephon ; ka at jong u ka byrthen na Jesreel ; ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng ki khynñiuh . Hynrei un ïada ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Namar ba u Lot u sheptieng ïa-ban sawa ha Seeb , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kynriah shad ki lum , bad ki ïashong ïasoh ha kawei ka skum .
translation.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .

translation.kha: Namar ka long ka bashisha Kane ka pyrthei ka ïaid sih noh bad kata ka jingkwah brai jong ka , hynrei uta uba leh ïa ka mon u Blei u ïaisah bymjukut ,” ban lehkmen jrong ïa ki jingkyrkhu ban thehsei da u Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw . —Ïoannis 2 :17 .
translation.en: For it is a fact : This “world is passing away and so is its desire , but he that does the will of God remains forever ,” to enjoy eternally the blessings to be showered down by our loving Creator .—1 John 2 :17 .
If I do not remember thee , let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth  ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .
translation.kha: To ai ba ngan nym lah shuh ban rwai biang lada ngam kynmaw ïa pha , lada ngam pyrkhat ïa pha kum ka jingkmen bakhraw tam jong nga !

Ki dieng kin sei ïa u soh , ki lyngkha kin pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad uwei pa uwei un shongshngain ha la ka ri . Ynda haba nga dkhat ïa ki kynja Kiba teh ïa ki briew jong nga bad nga pyllait ïa ki na kito kiba pynlong mraw ïa ki , te kin sa tip ba at long U Trai’ .
translation.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit , and the earth shall yield her increase , and they shall be safe in their land , and shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have broken the bands of their yoke , and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them .
Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .
translation.kha: Da shisha nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud ki briew jong nga , bad nga la ïohi ruh kumno ki nong Ijipt ki pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
translation.kha: Me la thwet ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jong me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the  Lord s  sacrifice , that I will punish the princes , and the king s children , and all such as are clothed with strange apparel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka jingpynïap ,  ong U  Trai  ,  ngan pynshitom ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki khun shynrang jong u syiem , bad baroh kiba leh ïa ki rukom nongwei .

translation.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him , Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .
translation.kha: Don uwei u shakri uba kyrteng u Siba ha ka longïing jong u Saul , bad la bthah ïa u ban leit sha u Dabid .  Me dei u Siba ?  u syiem u la kylli .  Nga hangne , ko Kynrad ,  u jubab .
bad sa ar tylli ki jingker ïa ki dong jong ka .
translation.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .

translation.kha: Ka Elam ka don napdeng kito kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingdap jongki ki shipai jong ka ki ne ha baroh sdang jong ka . Ki longsyiem baroh kiba khlem otsher , baïar ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad ki jahburom , ki ioh bynta ïa ka kupar ryngkat bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka sma .
translation.en: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .

translation.kha: U Nathanael u la kylli ïa u , kumne me ithuh ïa nga ? U Jisu u la Joab , Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumah ha shuwa ba u Philip un khiat ïa me .
translation.en: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki briew ki bym pat shongkurim : Ngam don ka hukum na U Trai , hynrei nga ai ïa la ka jingmut kum uwei uba da ka jingisynei U Trai nga long uba lah ban shaniah .
baroh ki ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong pha , ki da sleh pui pui ha ki khleh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .
translation.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :

translation.kha: U Trai u najan ïa ki briew katba Shur .
translation.en: For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Pham shym la jied ïa nga ; at la jied ïa phiah mala nga la thung ïa phi! ban leit bad don seisoh shisien , u jait seh uba ïaineh . Bad kumta U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba Phin pan na u ha ka kyrteng jongu la .
translation.en: Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .

translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u purew ba la khlem bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u purew Lem bad u smai lyngraw , ar kilo u puriskam lem bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,

translation.kha: Uta u syiem u don synshar ïa phi un leh kumne , u Samuel u pynshai . Un pynurlong ba-shiphew ïa ki khun shynrang Jong phi ; don na ki , ki don trei ha ki kali ïapom jong u , khong ki ban long ki shipa shong kylla , bad to ruh ki ban mareh na khmih ki nang ïapom jong u .
translation.en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Porsius , ki Hiar , bad ki Jebus , katba phi nang puta shwa khmut .
translation.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Hato nga la long kum ka ri shyiap ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kat kaba phi sngewbha , ba phin ym wan phai shuh sha nga ?
Hynrei u nongsumar kper u la jubab , ‘ Iehnoh shuwa , ko kynrad , sa tyngka shym ; Ngan tih sawdong jongu u bad ai soh katai katne .
translation.en: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :

translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel naduh Don kaba shaphang shait haduh Beersheba kob shaphang shathie , kum duh naduh ri Gilead kaba shaphang mihngi , ki la ïawanlang . Ki ïalumlang kum Kawei ka kynïan ha khmat U Terah ha Mispah .
translation.en: Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was gathered together as one man , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , with the land of Gilead , unto the  Lord  in Mizpah .

translation.kha: Lyngba ki shakri jongu per ki nongïathuhlypa nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa ki law bad ki jingmaham , hyndai ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la sohkhram ïa kaba mihngi nangta . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut nabar ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Borabor , nga la da pynshitom ïa ki kumba ki Dei ban shah bad kumba nga la kut jingmut ban leh .’
translation.en: But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .
