And of Asher he said , Let Asher be blessed with children  ; let him be acceptable to his brethren , and let him dip his foot in oil .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Asher u ong ,  U Asher u kham ïoh jingkyrkhu ban ïa la ki para jait . To ki hynmen ki para jong u kin burom eh ïa u , Bad to ka ri jong u kan dap da ki diengsoh Olib .
U dat un synshar ïa la ki bariew , Kin long kum kawei ki jat Israel .
translation.en: Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew sner .
translation.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .

And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood  ; and I will rain upon him , and upon his bands , and upon the many people that are with him , an overflowing rain , and great hailstones , fire , and brimstone .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u da ka jingpang bad ka jingïa-umsnam . Ïa u  lapbah  lapsan bad u phria , ryngkat bad ka ding bad u kyndok , ngan theh noh ha u bad ha ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kiba ïashah liang bad u .

Ki la ei mynsiem Namar ka jingsuki jong ka jingïaid ka kam . Hynrei kin ïohthiah ba u Serubbabel u ïangat ïa-ai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kine long bakha kmiesan . U angel u la ong ha de , Ki hynñiew tylli ki sharati ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki khmat jong U Trai kiba khih halor ka pyrthei barieh .
translation.en: For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .

translation.kha: U shym Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw , Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Haman na ka bynta ka jingsyllok pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad ar la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .

translation.kha: Ka jingmut kaba la pynshai bha ka long kum ka dur oh-shrong ksiar ba la pynsat ha ka shoh .
translation.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .
And the people asked him , saying , What shall we do then ?
translation.kha: U paidbah u la kylli ïa u ,  Te kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ?

bad u la pyntrei ïa ki briew jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , bad ki smai nar , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki nongrit jngai ka Ammon baroh . Nangta ma u lam bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit blei sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .
translation.kha: Haba ka waiñ ka la lut noh , ka kmie U Jisu ka la ong ïa u ,  Kim don waiñ shuh .

translation.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth , and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and say unto Zion , Thou art my people .
translation.kha: Nga la pynpyiar ïa ki bneng bad pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ; nga ong ïa ka Jerusalem , ‘ Phi long ki briew jong nga ! Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad nga ïada ïa phi da ka ksang ti jong nga .’

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that like as I have watched over them , to pluck up , and to break down , and to throw down , and to destroy , and to afflict  ; so will I watch over them , to build , and to plant , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumba nga la ïaleh shitom ban rat noh , ban pyntwa , ban jop , ban pynjot bad ban pynpra ïa ki , kumta ruh ngan ïaleh shitom ban thung ïa ki bad ban tei pat ïa ki .
Hattush ki Jiw te ki don ha kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban ïa ki Jentil ? Lane haduh kein kano kane ka dor ha ka jingotsher ?
translation.en: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ngan pynim ïa u briew suba phai ino na nga nabar naba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkitkhlieh jong u bariew u bym im junom .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .

translation.kha: U nongpynim uba lah ban shaniah u ai jinghun mynsiem ïa uta uba phiah ïa u , kum ka umkhriat ha ka jingshit tyrha ha ka aïom ot .
translation.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him : for he refresheth the soul of his masters .
Which covenant he made with Abraham , and his oath unto Isaac  ;
translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jingïakut ba u la pynlong bad u Abraham bad ïa ka kular bad u Isaak .

U ot lyngkhot lynghoh ïa langbrot , bad u sait ïa ki dohnud jem bad ki kjat-dien da ka um , bad u stong ïa ka khlaw , ïa ka khlain bad ïa ki lyngkhot deng baroh ha ka duwan , kamar U Trai u la Hukum . Kane ka jingainguh thang ka long ka jingainguh bam , pynlang ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water  ; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar : it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour , and an offering made by fire unto the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: utai u briew u jyllop , Ki la ïaleit . Nga la ïohsngew ba ki ong ba kin leit sha Don . Kumta u Joseph u leit beh nadien jong ki bad u lap ïa ki ha Dothan .
translation.en: And the man said , They are departed hence  ; for I heard them say , Let us go to Dothan . And Joseph went after his brethren , and found them in Dothan .

translation.kha: Ki proberb jong me kim don jingmyntoi shuh kum ki dpei ; ki jingïasaid jong me ki long kiba tlot kum ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .

translation.kha: Katba uta u brai u khong ryngkat mala u Petros bad u Ïoannis ha ka baranda u Solomon , Rumah la kut ïa ka , ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la maïan sha ki .
translation.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John , all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon s , greatly wondering .

translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kad ha ka khlieh jong ka malu un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mirr na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynlamwir ïa phi , un pynmatlah ïa phi , bad un pynïohnong ïa phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with madness , and blindness , and astonishment of heart :

Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .
translation.kha: To phai bad to ud , ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha rudnong . Phi dei ban leit sha Babilon , hynrei hangta U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain , and came unto the valley of Eshcol , and searched it out .
translation.kha: Kita ki la ïaleit sha kata ka ri lum haduh Them Eshkol bad ki la syntiat ïa ka .
U Moses u la leit Hiar sha ki briew bad u la iathuh ha ki ïa katai kaba U Trai u la lah ong .
translation.en: So Moses went down unto the people , and spake unto them .

translation.kha: Ko Israel me la wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh ïa nga , U Trai U Blei jong me , Kaba nga ïangat ïamareh ïa me ha ka lynñiar .
translation.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?

translation.kha: Mem shym la ai ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta ka khlaw jong de , hynrei ka la sting ïa ka khlieh jngai nga da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih .
translation.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .

translation.kha: bad ita u angel u la bthah ïa nga don pynbna ïa kaei kaba U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong : Nga la don ka jingieit bahynriew bad jingsngewkhia ïa ka Jerushah ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga ,
translation.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me , Cry thou , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy .
Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people : the  Lord  made me have dominion over the mighty .
translation.kha: Nangta kita kiba lah ban shaniah ki la wan hiar sha la ki nongïalam ; Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la wan sha u da ka jinglakloi ban ïaleh .
Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka thar kaba ong , Ko khun u briew ïeng jat . Nga kwah ban ïakren bad me .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .

translation.kha: U ei ruh u Obed Edom , uba U Blei u la kerkut da kaba ai ha u phret ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba la jer te ter kato kum ka rta : u Shemaïah , u Jehosabad , u Jahas , u Sekakah , u Nethanel , u Ammiel , u Issakhar , bad u Peullethai .
translation.en: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him .

translation.kha: Kin ym shaniah shuh ha ki duwan kiba ki la thaw da ki kti jong ki , lane shaniah ha ki kam ki ktem jongu ki hi — ki dak jong ka bleithaw Asherah malade ki duwan ban thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: And he shall not look to the altars , the work of his hands , neither shall respect that which his fingers have made , either the groves , or the images .

translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingaiei U Blei ïa per , nga ong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi : To dak ñiewkor palat than ïa lade ban ïa kaba phi dih Ban leh . Pynïeng , to long adkar ha ki jingjam jingpyrkhat jong phi , bun to bishar ïa lade kat kum ka jingngeit kambah U Blei u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la leit phai pat sha ka ïingsyiem bad u la pynlut ïa ka miet khlem ïohthiah , khlem bam lane khlem kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha .
translation.en: Then the king went to his palace , and passed the night fasting : neither were instruments of musick brought before him : and his sleep went from him .

translation.kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop! ka long ban sngewtynnat shun thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob manna ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u syiem ; lada u syiem u bitar , don uba lah ban ïap .
Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bna kaba bud , ka bynta kaba ar jong ki , nadong ka bynta kaba marpyrshah ïa ka jaka ap phra ka baphylla kaweh heh haduh ka kynroh hajan ka Othniel .
translation.en: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece , over against the great tower that lieth out , even unto the wall of Ophel .

translation.kha: Kyndit kyndit U Trai u phah ïa ka lyer kaba wan kit ïa ki yn khiar na tyrwa , Ibbah jaijai ruma shi mitar na shlur khyndew . Kainan ki dem ha ka jaka sher dara bad baroh sawdong jong ka da badno bhor kilomitar kat shab phai .
translation.en: And there went forth a wind from the  Lord  , and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , as it were a day s journey on this side , and as it were a day s journey on the other side , round about the camp , and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: Bad U Kpa , naba la phah ïa nga , u ruh u phla na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: And the Father himself , which hath sent me , hath borne witness of me . Ye have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his shape .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U Trai u ainong ïa me , ‘ Ka tngaw jong me kan long ka sing ha ki lynti bha , pynlang ïa ki khun jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka sma . Ïa ka khyndew jong me yn phiah bun me ha kiwei pat ; bad me ïa biar men ïa-ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blei . Bad ki paid Israel da shisha kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tyrwa ha me ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me dang kyntait ïa ka ? Ngi la ïakren bad u ha ki ktien bajai jai .

translation.en: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Isaak u mihnoh nangta bad u leit sha Beersheba .

translation.en: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .
translation.kha: Ki la shakri kum ki nongbishar na ka bynta u paidbah ha ki por baroh , da kaba wallam ïa ki kam kiba eh sha u Moses hynrei ki bishar hi ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit .

translation.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , hynrei uno uno u bym shym otsher um lah ban bam ïa ka .
Ka longkmie kumne . Ka kynthei ka shim khyndiat u thiat sad ka khleiñ ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew tad haduh ba ka lyngngun kpu baroh kawei ka sieb .
translation.en: It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .

translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka por ba ïa kane ka pyrthei yn bishar ; mynta ïa u nongsynshar jong kñia ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .
translation.en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .

translation.kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haw mynta . Dei namar kata ba ïa kata jaka la dong ïai khot ka Them jingïailong . Da kumta U Trai um shym da bitar shla shu .
translation.en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la ïa-ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtap ki syiem , sad u khun jong u , u Sekharaïah u long syiem ha ka tare jong u .
translation.en: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel  ; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Baroh ki thyllah teh ha kito ki liengbah kim don jingmyntoi ; ki jaiñ pdang lyer kam lah Ban pyiar ! Ngin knieh nong ïa borbah ka spah jong ki kynhun shipai Nongshun , bad tista bun haduh katta katta ba wat ki bynriew uba dkoh jin kin ïa-ïoh bynta . U Trai hi da lade! un long u syiem jong ngi ; un synshar halor jong ngi bad un ïada ïa ngi .
translation.en: Thy tacklings are loosed  ; they could not well strengthen their mast , they could not spread the sail : then is the prey of a great spoil divided  ; the lame take the prey .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la tep ïa ki shaïong jong u Saul bad u Jonathan ha ka jingap jong u Kish , u kpa jrong u Saul , ha Sela ha ka ri Benjamin , ki da pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba u syiem u la hukum . bad hadien kata , U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki na ka bynta ka ri .
translation.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah , in the sepulchre of Kish his father : and they performed all that the king commanded . And after that God was entreated for the land .
And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .
translation.kha: Kumta , kat kum ka hukum U  Trai  , ki paid Israel ki ai ha ki Lebi katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki jaka jong ki .
Kynsan kynsan ka lyer kaba umjer ka la ba-eh , bad ki jingbat phyllung ki la sdang don phaloh shapoh ka lieng , Haduh ba ka la junom dap da ka um .
translation.en: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .
And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .
translation.kha: Kin bam tang ïa kata ïa kaba la pyndonkam ha ka jinglehniam ka jingmap ha ka por ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki . Tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingbam , namar ka long kaba kyntang .

translation.en: For he served Baal , and worshipped him , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of Israel , according to all that his father had done .
translation.kha: U la mane bad shakri ïa u Baal , bad kumta u kpa jong u ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel .
Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist la bsa ïa ka met baroh kawei bad la pyndait lang da ki mat bad dakhol jong ka , bad ka san kumba U Blei u khiew ïa ka ba kan san .
translation.en: And not holding the Head , from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered , and knit together , increaseth with the increase of God .

translation.kha: Ki Rangbah na Dan ki ong , Kan bha ba phyrnai ym bunktien lyndum phi kwah ïa kine ki briew ban bitar bad ban kynrup ïa phi . Naba ma phi bad ka longsem jongno phi baroh phin ïap .
translation.en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .

translation.kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop ka long don sngewtynnat ban thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob Man ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .

translation.kha: khlur kane baroh , kaei kaweh im lah baneh ong ? Lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi ?
translation.en: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
The  Lord  is my portion , saith my soul  ; therefore will I hope in him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long baroh kaba nga don , bad kumta nga buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha u .

Ki briew ki ai pisa ban siew ïa ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng bad ïa ka jingbam jingdih bad ka umphniang Olib ban phah sha ki nongbah jong ka Tyros bad Sidon kum ka jingbahkhlieh na ka bynta ki dien Kedar na Lebanon , baneh wallam lyngba ka duriaw sha Joppa . Ïa kane barben la leh da ka jingai jingbit u Syros , u patsha ka Persia .
translation.en: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters  ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .

translation.kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan ryngkhiang , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap Naaman ka jingbymman Jong ki bynriew jong ngi , ki briew kaba nguh , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa katei kaba ngi leh .’
translation.en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei kaba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba neh ha la ki dohnud . wat pyrshing lehbha ki briew ki pynsalia sad krenbeiñ ïa Phi ;
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .

translation.kha: Kumta u la sdang bishni badno suba sniew ïa u Dabid naduh kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward .

For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Naba da kumno ki briew kin tip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang bad ïa nga lada me men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi ? Ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ngi kan pyn-i ba ngi long kiba pher na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei .
U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai kaban u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u dang im .
translation.en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all the days of Jehoiada the priest .
For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .
translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba duk , bad baroh ki long ki nongshukor .
bad ban tyngshaiñ na bneng halor kito baroh kiba im ha ka syrngiew ba-dum jong ka jingïap , ban ïam ïa ki sien jam jongngi im’ ha ka lynti jong ka jingsuk .
translation.en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , to guide our feet into the way of peace .
For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .
translation.kha: Namar ngi tip uei uta uba la ong ,  Ngan sa pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang ;  bad uba la ong ruh ,  U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .
Ki ong , Hato U Trai u la kren Tang lyngba u Moserah ? Hato um shym la kren lyngba jong i ruh ? U Trai u la iohnong aïu ki ong .
translation.en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .

translation.kha: Une U Blei u long ka jakarieh baskhem jongngi per , malu u pynshngain ïa ka lynti ïaid jong nga .
translation.en: God is my strength and power : and he maketh my way perfect .

translation.kha: hynrei lehse dat uba kum bakla khlem da smat khnang ha katba sumar ïa Kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,

translation.kha: Katba ka Dang shai , to teh ïa ka song jong me na ka bynta ka jingshah jingthrew , khnang ba kin lah ban Iohi ïa me , bad nangta shah ïa ki ban khmih ïa me ba me mihnoh ha ka premmiet kumba me otsher sha ka jingshah ringmraw .
translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight , as stuff for removing : and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight , as they that go forth into captivity .

translation.kha: Naba lada nga duwai ha kane ka rukom , ka mynsiem lad nga ka duwai da shisha , hynrei ka jingmut jong por kam don bynta ha ka .
translation.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue , my spirit prayeth , but my understanding is unfruitful .

translation.kha: A katno kiba kmen longsyiem Kito ki shakri kiba u kynrad jong ki u shem ba ki dang sleh bad kiba la kloi hajan u wan ! Ngin ong ha phi , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ki ban shongneh , sad un shakri ïa ki .
translation.en: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki imat katba ki sngewbiang . Baroh ka long kajuh ïa ki , la ki pynïap ïa u mai kyndong kum ka jingbna lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kñia da u khunlangbrot Lane ki pyndkut ïa ka ryndang u ksew ; la ki wanrah ka jingainguh kew ne ki ainguh da ka snam sniang ; la ki thang jingiwbih ne ki duwai ha ka bleithaw . Ki shem sngewbha ha ki mano ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .
translation.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .
But there is good news .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ka don ka khubor babha .
Ki ktien sbun ki long kumin ka ngap — kaba tieng ïa ka jingmad bad kaba bha ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah .
translation.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la bitar lip ïa ki Israel pynlang u shahïap ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia don jop ïa ki . Jaban u synshar khlur jongki ki haw pharia snem .
translation.en: Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .

translation.kha: To sngap ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kren , phi uba sheptieng sad tyngkhuh ïa u : Namar phi long kiba ïaineh ha nga , katto katne na ki briew jong ph hi ki shun ïa phi bad kin ym don ïadoh bynta ei ei bad phi . Ki rkhiebeiñ ïa phi bad ong , ‘ Ai ba U Trai’ un pyn-i ïa ka jingkharoi jong u bad pynim ïa phi , kumta ba ïong ïohi ïa phi ba phi shadkmen .’ Hynrei dei ma ki hi , ki ban jahburom !
translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye that tremble at his word  ; Your brethren that hated you , that cast you out for my name s sake , said , Let the  Lord  be glorified : but he shall appear to your joy , and they shall be ashamed .
And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .
translation.kha: Kita ki saw ngut ki syiem ki la shim lut khoit kat kaba don ha Sodom bad Gomorrah , kaba kynthup ruh ïa ka jingbam bad ki la leit noh .
Ki khun bad ki kmie ki kpa ki ïa Mano pur bad ki eh jinghikai kumno ban mynta na ka khubor babha .—Markos Mih 4 :1-4 .
translation.en: Children and parents worship together and learn how to benefit from the good news . —Read Micah 4 :1-4 .
He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good : and whoso trusteth in the  Lord  , happy is he .
translation.kha: Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , bad phin ïoh manbha ; shaniah ha U  Trai  bad phin long uba kmen .

translation.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup la ka jaiñ  saiwul ne ka jaiñ linen ,
Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kamon pun ïashong ïashad bad la ka tngit ha ka paw kaweh khuid bad kaba badonburom ,
translation.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;

translation.kha: Ki metïap ki la saphriang ha kylleng , kum ki kynton sbak halor ki lyngkha , kum u riewkhmat ba la ot bad iehnoh da ki nongot , u riewhadem u bym don mano mano ba lum . Ken ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la bthah ïa la ban ong .
translation.en: Speak , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field , and as the handful after the harvestman , and none shall gather them .

translation.kha: haduh ba ktang da ïohkynti ïa ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka kyrdan ïa kaba U Terah U Bela jong phi u la ai ha ki . Ahian ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel baroh , te Phin haw ban wiang phai pat bad shongduh hangne ha ka ri jong Phi ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba u Mesha , u shatri U Trai , u la ai ha pa .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: mala lehbha uno uno u smai da ka bneng , u smai da ka khet U Blei bad da ita uba shongduh halor jyllang ka .
translation.en: And he that shall swear by heaven , sweareth by the throne of God , and by him that sitteth thereon .

translation.kha: Nga la ïakhmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki rangsan jong u sha sepngi , shawei , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynjngai ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jongki u . U la leh kato u sngewbha bad u la nang sngewmeng .
translation.en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .

translation.kha: ki nongbah ha Ibbah u kynshew jingbah , ki shnong buh kulai bad kali ïapom , bad kat ïa ka u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lehsbun , bad kylleng ka hima jong u .
translation.en: And all the cities of store that Solomon had , and cities for his chariots , and cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .

translation.kha: Ki la ha noh ïa ka snoh jongno ki bariew jongno U Blei bun jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban dih . Ki la ieh ïa kaba ki dei khih ba ïoh !
translation.en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la hiarthma ban tur ïaleit ïa ka Tyros . U la pynlong ïa ki shipai jong u ban kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia haduh ba ki khlieh Jong ki , ki la dkhoi ki shñiuh bad ki tyrpeng jong ki , ki la tyrkhong kheit , hynrei u syiem lymne ka kynhun shipai jong u kim shym ïoh ei ei na baroh ki jinglehshitom jong ki .
translation.en: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre : every head was made bald , and every shoulder was peeled : yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyre , for the service that he had served against it :
The king of Kedesh , one  ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Kedesh , ka Jokneam ( ha Karmel ) ,

translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong nga . Ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na ki jingkit kiba ki don ban bah .

translation.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .
translation.kha: Haba u Absalom u hynmen jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylli ,  Hato u Amnon u la ktah kti ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko hep , wat shah ba kata kan pynsngewsih shibun ïa phi . U dei u ba ïalong shi para bad phi na ijuh i pa , kumta te wat ïathuh hano hano shaphang kata .  Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ha ka ïing jong u Absalom , ka da sngewsih bad sngew marwei .

translation.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it  ; and our princes , Levites , and priests , seal unto it .
translation.kha: Namar baroh kata kaba la jia , ma ngi , ki Israel , hangne ngi pynlong ka jingïakut bakyntang da ka jingthoh , bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki Lebi jong ngi , bad ki lyngdoh jong ngi ki buh ïa ki jingshon muhor ha ka .

Mynsngi , U Trai u ïaid ha shuwa jongu ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynhynne pateng u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki lah ban ïawad mynsngi bad mynhynne .
translation.en: And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :

translation.kha: U Isaak u la Tei ka duwan hangta dara mane ïa U Trai . Nangta u shrah ïa la ka dara hangtai , sad ki shakri jong u ki ïatih sa kawei pat ka pukri .
translation.en: And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .

translation.kha: namar ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki lawbah jong U Blei Badonbor Bakhraw pynlang ki la kyntait ïa ki jingbthah jong u .
translation.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
He that hath a froward heart findeth no good : and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat bad kren ïa kaba sniew u lah ban khmih lynti ban ym shem ei ei kaba bha — tang ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .
translation.kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba leh pop bad ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .
U Jisu u la jubab , badno balei ba phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jongnga U Blei bad phi bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?

translation.kha: U ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah uba shi para bad u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .

translation.kha: Ki rung bahryntieh ki long ki rangbah kiba shlur tam jong ka Kedar , hynñiew tang khyndiat na ki yn iehnoh , nga U Trai U Blei ki Israel , nga la kren .
translation.en: And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pyrshang don pynsngewrem ïa ki , ka ding kan mih na ki shyntur jong ki bad kan ïam mad ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ha kane ka rukom , uno uno uba pyrshang ba pynmynsaw ïa ki un shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if any man will hurt them , fire proceedeth out of their mouth , and devoureth their enemies : and if any man will hurt them , he must in this manner be killed .

translation.kha: Baroh ki narud sad ki sim ki la ïamihnoh shabar na ka lymbung ha la ka kynruh kynhun ka jait jong ki .
translation.en: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .

translation.kha: U ai jingbthah ruh katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kan leit ha kaba shna ïa kita ki khiew ki pliang ,
translation.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service  ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .
translation.kha: Nangta ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang kiba shong ha ki khet jong ki ha khmat U Blei ki la dem ngon ïa lade bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba ong :  Ko Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uta uba long bad uba la ju long ! Ngi ainguh ïa me ba me la shimti ïa ka bor bakhraw jong me bad me la sdang ban synshar !
Ki la pynlong ïa ki apostol ban ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad kylli ïa ki , Kumno phi la leh ïa kane ? Ka bor une phi la ïoh lane ïa ka kyrngah jongno phin pynjyrngam ?
translation.en: And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?

translation.kha: Bakhraw ki ïaleit sha la ki byr-ïe sohwaiñ Bad kheit ïa ki shaiñ , ki shna wei na ki , pynlang ki pynlong ka jingïaleh kmen . Ki leit sha ka templ jong u blei jong ki , ha kaba ki la ïabam bad ïada bad ki krenbeiñ ïa u Abimelekh .
translation.en: And they went out into the fields , and gathered their vineyards , and trode the grapes , and made merry , and went into the house of their god , and did eat and drink , and cursed Abimelech .
And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ki angel jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .

translation.en: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u Jonah bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw , bad ka la long jai jai ha ka shikhyllipmat .
Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la ïohsngew kumno U Trai u la ioh ïa ki nongshun jong ki Israel , ka la sheptieng haduh katta katta .
translation.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries , when they had heard that the  Lord  fought against the enemies of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki synran kim jingshemphang ïa kano kano na ktien kiei kiei ; ïa ka jingmut jong ki kyntien la buhrieh na ki , bad kdor tip shaphang kaei U Jisu u kren .
translation.en: And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .

translation.kha: Ki Joab , Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh kin don hangne bad ba ym pat pyntyllun sharud ïa u maïan ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U Trei u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pynthait ka Moab sha arliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .
translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .

Then Judah came near unto him , and said , Oh my lord , let thy servant , I pray thee , speak a word in my lord s ears , and let not thine anger burn against thy servant : for thou art even as Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u leit kham hajan u Joseph , bad u ong ,  Ko kynrad , shah ïa nga ban kren laitluid bad phi . Wat bitar ïa nga , phi long kum u syiem hi .

Mynba u Moses u wan hiar na u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa Us ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ Namarba ba u la ïakren bad U Trai ; ishyrkhei um tip satia ïa said .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .
Give them , O  Lord  : what wilt thou give ? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngan kylli na phi ban leh ïa kine ki briew ? Pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei jong ki ! Pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym lah ban sumar ïa ki khunlung jong ki !
U alhia u rah biang ïa u khynnah shab sha ka kmie jong u bad u ïong ha ka , peit , u khun jong pha u la im !
translation.en: And Elijah took the child , and brought him down out of the chamber into the house , and delivered him unto his mother : and Elijah said , See , thy son liveth .

Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: to tip skhem ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Pynban , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phi kum ka shangkhawiah lane ka thliew bad kaba pang shikatdei eh kum ka jingsympat ha ka ingdong jong phi lane ki shiah ha ki khmat jong phi . Bad kane kan neh tad haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh napdeng jong phi uba dang lait im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi .
Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh’ , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khñiang ba haba me rupa shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kamai kaei kaba me leh .
translation.en: And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ïa u —Joshua
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,

translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei sad ki ïing kiba tip bthuh . ( Kinah kin treikam hadien ba ki Israel ki la rung shuh ri Kane , ha kaweh U tharai un ai ha ki kum ka jingkhaïi . ) Eliada uno Uno u Shem ba U Trai u phah ïa ka jingpang ïathuh ha ka ïing jong u , te u dei shun leit ïathuh ha u lyngdoh shaphang kata .
translation.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house :

translation.kha: Ka la leit mareh sha u Simon Petros bad shuh uwei pat u synran , uba U ju u imat , bad ka la ïathuh ha ki , Ki la ïahiar noh ïa U tharai na ka jingap , bad ngim tip hangno ki la ïabuh ïa u !
translation.en: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
Ye are bought with a price ; be not ye the servants of men .
translation.kha: U Blei u la thied ïa phi da ka dor ; kumta to wat long ki mraw jong ki briew .

translation.en: Which things also we speak , not in the words which man s wisdom teacheth , but which the Holy Ghost teacheth ; comparing spiritual things with spiritual .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ngim kren ha ki ktien ba la hikai da ka jingstad briew , hynrei ha ki ktien ba la hikai da U Mynsiem , kumba ngi batai ïa ki jingshisha ba kynja mynsiem ha kito kiba don U Mynsiem .
Shuh shuh u la thung ïa u Daniel bad ar ngut kiwei pat ban khum ïa ki lytar bad ban khmih halor ki jingkwah jong u syiem .
translation.en: And over these three presidents  ; of whom Daniel was first : that the princes might give accounts unto them , and the king should have no damage .

translation.kha: Katba uta u khñium u dang wan , u mynsiem bymman u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u sha madan bad u la bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring . U jongu u la ai suda ïa u mynsiem bymman , U la pynkhiah ïa ita u khynnah , bad U la ai pat ïa u ha u kpa jongki u .
translation.en: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .
He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u ong ha lade ,  U Blei um sngew ei ei ! u la khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad un ym ïohi ïa nga da lei lei !
Ki la ai jingtip ha u syiem ïa ka jingdeng barhem jong ki rangbah kiba bat ban long shipai : phra milian ha Israel bad san lat ha Judah .
translation.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong kob u Belshassar u erlangthari u syiem ka bniah , nga la phohsniew bad nga la ïohi ka jingpynïap ha ka por mynmiet . Nga la thoh ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad kane ka Dei ka jingpuh jingkynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohi ha kata ka miet :
translation.en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed : then he wrote the dream , and told the sum of the matters .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñ la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .
translation.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la ïohsngew kumta U Trai u la jop ïa ki nongshun jongnga ki Israel , ka la sheptieng haduh dik long .
translation.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries , when they had heard that the  Lord  fought against the enemies of Israel .
I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , kum ïa u pui pui ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . Ngan pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïarap ïa ki haba ka jingpynjot ka wan .
Nangno u Joab u put ïa ka turoi , kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban sangeh noh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Jerusalem’ , bad kumin ka jingïalumlang ka la sangeh .
translation.en: So Joab blew a trumpet , and all the people stood still , and pursued after Israel no more , neither fought they any more .
If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to phai mynta bad to ïasaid bad U Blei Badonbor Baroh ;
Haba u Jakob u la tip) ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang , Balah phim ïaleh ei ei ?
translation.en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la khie joit ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la shim ïa ka jingthiah ha kaba u la thiah bad u la leit noh sha ïing , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei .
bad u ïasaid lyngba na shatei jong ka sharing lem na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta u hiar arsut shad ka them ,
translation.en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward , and went down unto Arabah :
For I will lay the land most desolate , and the pomp of her strength shall cease  ; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate , that none shall pass through .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , bad ka bor kaba ki ju sngewsarong katta katta kan sa kut noh . Ki lumbah ka Israel kin long khlaw kynjah ba ym don uba nud ban leit jingleit lyngba jong ki .

Te mynta nga hukum ba lada ine uno na katno kano ka hima , ka jaitbynriew , lane ka ktien uba krung khlem burom ïa U Blei jong u Shahshkor , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , dei ba tar ïa u na ka kti bad kjat , bad ïa ka ïing jong u dei ban pynlong ka kynton ki jingpra . Ym don uno Uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .
translation.en: Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .

translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang noh , ki synran ki la wan ha u Bad ki la ong , Ka por ka dier palat , bad kñia ka dei ka iaka kynjah .
translation.en: And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :

translation.kha: U la ñiup ba ka jingshah rkhiebeiñ na ka bynta U Messaïah ka long kaba kham kordor bun shait ban ïa ka spah baroh jyllang ka ri Ijipt , nabar u khmih lynti ïa ka iphieng ka ban sa ïan .
translation.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .

translation.kha: Lada ngim longsyiem kiba ïan , u ïasait hi suba ïaheh , nabar um lah ban shukor ïa lade .
translation.en: If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he cannot deny himself .
And he came up , and told his father and his mother , and said , I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines : now therefore get her for me to wife .
translation.kha: U leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u ong ha la u kpa bad ha la ka kmie ,  Ka don kawei ka kynthei Philistia hangthie ha Timnah kaba la pynïapmat ïa nga . Pynïoh ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga ; nga kwah ban shongkurim ïa ka .

translation.en: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .
translation.kha: U ïohsngew ïa ngi man ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar ba ngi tip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi tip ruh ba u ai ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kyrpad na u .

Phi ong ha lade , Ngim lah ap slem ïa ki sngi bakhuid ba kin kut noh khnang ba moi lah ban die ïa u kew jong ngi . Lano ka sngi Sabbaton kan khun , khnang ba ngin ïoh sdang don die biang ? nangta im la ban oh dor rem , pynkdang da ki jingthew bymkut , bad pynbakla ïa ki tarajur ban thok ïa ki nongthied jong ngi .
translation.en: Saying , When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell corn ? and the sabbath , that we may set forth wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel great , and falsifying the balances by deceit ?
For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , dei ma phi — ma phi keiñ , khlem duna ïa kiwei pat ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi , ka jingkmen jong ngi , bad ka daw jong ngi ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jong ngi ha khmat jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .

translation.en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u pynbor ïa u ban ïaleit lang bad ki ; u la mynjur , bad u ïaleit ryngkat bad ki .
Haba u Syiem Daberath u la Wan poi ha Bahurim , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Saul , u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , u la wan ïakynduh ïa u , u da tim ïa u katba u tdong wan .
translation.en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .

translation.kha: phin sngewsarong ba phoi don ka Hukum U Blei — hynrei hato phi wallam ka jinglehrain ïa U Blei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum jong u ?
translation.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
translation.kha: ban shna ïa lade ka lyngkor da ki tyllai snieh bad ki dieng jingphna bad ban buh ïa ka ha u ryndang jong nga .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut da kaba ong ,  To shahshkor te , lada phi don ki shkor !
Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim pyntip ka la jat ïew ïa une u Moses , u briew uba la ïalam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta , tiduh noh ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .’
translation.en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .

translation.kha: Yn tynjuh ïa phi kumne : Nga smai ha ka kyrteng u syiem ba phin ym Ïohi mihnoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan shaiñ .
translation.en: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab , Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Tiras U Blei jong me .’
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .

translation.kha: Naba ïa u tnga u bymngeit la pynlong uba la pdiang ha U Blei da kabu pynshah ha ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ka tngen ka bymngeit la pynlong kaba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha la u tnga naba ngeit . Lada kane kam long katkum , ki khun jong ki kin long kum ki khun jong ki bymngeit ; hynrei kumba ka longsyiem , la pyningkhong ïa ki kiba la pdiang da U Bela .
translation.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .

translation.kha: Phi lah ruh ban download ïa ki jingpule Baibl ba la pynwandur ha ki rukom drama , ki drama na Baibl bad ki jingrwai ba sngewtynnad ban sngap ha ki jer ba phi shongkai .
translation.en: You can download dramatic Bible readings , Bible dramas , and beautiful music to enjoy at your leisure .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u em lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai , Ko Trai’ U Bela jong na , pynwan biang ïa ka jingim ha une u khynnah !
translation.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .

translation.kha: lymda u brup u klim bad ka tnga jong u para Israel , ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shiah pynïap .
translation.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .
But if ye will not hear these words , I swear by myself , saith the  Lord  , that this house shall become a desolation .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , te nga smai ha phi ba kane ka ïingsyiem kan ngat ha ki jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?
