translation.en: And it shall be , if thou do at all forget the  Lord  thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them , and worship them , I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .
Or have eaten my morsel myself alone , and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof  ;
translation.kha: lane ïa ki khunswet ban shahthngan katba ïa lade nga dang bam .
Kata ka jingduk jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , u Isaïah bad u Jakob .
translation.en: And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .
If we assay to commune with thee , wilt thou be grieved ? but who can withhold himself from speaking ?
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato men sngewmong lada nga kren ? Ngam lah shuh ban shu sngap jar .
U Tharai Badonbor Baroh u la thmu ïa kata . U la thmu ïa kata khnang ban pynbit noh ïa ka jingsarong jong ki ha kaei kaba ki la leh bad Ban pynpoh ïa ki rangbah ïa Ibbah la ñiewburom .
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath purposed it , to stain the pride of all glory , and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth .
And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .
translation.kha: Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa ka nongbah kaba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
ka Sanoah , ka Engannim , ka Tappuah , ka Enam ,
translation.en: And Zanoah , and En–gannim , Tappuah , and Enam ,

translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu u la wan ryngkat bad ki khat-ar lwet ki syndon .
translation.en: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve .

translation.kha: ngiam napdeng ban leit shaei ki rudwah lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun jong ngi ki la kieng atiar badno ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha baroh sawdong jong ngi .
translation.en: Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .
Then went I up in the night by the brook , and viewed the wall , and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley , and so returned .
translation.kha: kumta nga hiar noh sharum sha ka them Kidron bad ïaid shaphrang , da kaba peit ïa ka kynroh . Nangta nga wan phai pat na kajuh ka lynti ba nga wan bad leit phai sha ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them .

translation.en: And Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .
translation.kha: U Abner bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Ishbosheth ki la leit na Mahanaim sha ka nongbah Gibeon .

Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ki Israhaïah kin ïamih shabar bad khar ïa ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ïa-ban ïaryngkat diengïap . Kin longing ding da ki stieh , ki ryntieh , ki khnam , ki sum bad ki dieng tangon , bad kin biang haduh hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :

translation.kha: kynmaw ba phin ym kjat ïa U Trai uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba Phin la long ki mraw .
translation.en: Then beware lest thou forget the  Lord  , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ai ksuid ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: Others cast spells on their enemies to make them sick or even to kill them .

translation.kha: Te u ong ha kita ki shakri , To shong hangne bad ka kada . Ma nga bad u kynhun ngin leit hangtai ban mian Blei , bad hadien kata ngin sa wan pat sha phi .
translation.en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .
There were together Simon Peter , and Thomas called Didymus , and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two other of his disciples .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros , U Thomas ( ba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) , u Nathanael ( uto uba na Kana ha Galilaïa ) , ki khun u Sebedi , bad ar ngut kiwei pat ki synran U Jisu ki la don lang .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , ha uba la phah pynbna ïa ka jingim ba la kular kaba ngi don ha U Khrist Jisu —
Men pynkheiñ ïa ki da u diengduh nar ; men pynpra ïa ki lyngkhot lyngkhai kum ïa u khiew khyndew .’
translation.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron  ; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter s vessel .

For behold this selfsame thing , that ye sorrowed after a godly sort , what carefulness it wrought in you , yea , what clearing of yourselves , yea , what indignation , yea , what fear , yea , what vehement desire , yea , what zeal , yea , what revenge ! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi aïu U Blei u la leh lyngba kane ka jingsngewsih jong phi : Katno ka la pynlong smat ïa phi . Katno phi kwah ban pynshisha ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong phi ! Kaba haduh katno ka jingsngew bitar , ka jingpeit pyrman halor kaba la jia , bad phi la sngew ka jingsngew , ka jingaiti , ka jinglong ba la kloi ban pynshitom ïa ka jingleh bakla ! Phi la pynpaw ïa lade kiba khlem bakla ha kane ka kam baroh .

translation.en: And say , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O kings of Judah , and inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , the which whosoever heareth , his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ,  Ko ki syiem jong ka Judah bad ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan wallam kaba kum kane ka jingpynjot ha kane ka jaka ba uwei pa uwei baroh uba ïohsngew shaphang jong ka un kyndit .
Ki paid Israel ki don khah ka jingshoh bieit ki bleithaw . Ai kin ïaid ha la ka jongnga ka lynti .
translation.en: Ephraim is joined to idols : let him alone .

And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki khuslai , kumta nga ong ha ki bad ha ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew ka ri jong phi , ki khun jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .

translation.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds , to meet the Lord in the air : and so shall we ever be with the Lord .
translation.kha: nangta ïa ngi kiba dang im ha kata ka por yn lumlang lem bad ki ha ki ha ki lyoh ban ïashem ïa U Trai ha suiñ . Bad kumta ngin ïailong borabor bad U Trai .

U Sanballat , u Tobiah , u Geshem bad Kiba sah na ki nongsynran jong ngi , ki la ïohsngew ba ngi la lah pyndep ïa ka jingtei ïa ka kynroh bad ba ym don shuh ki jinglait thliew ha ka , wat la ngim pat shym la pynrkhiang ki khyrdop ha ki kajuh ban shna ïa ki .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and Geshem the Arabian , and the rest of our enemies , heard that I had builded the wall , and that there was no breach left therein  ; ( though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates  ; )

translation.kha: wat ym smai da ka khlieh jong phi , nabar phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynïong ïa iwei i shniah .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba kumba nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi ieit eh ba ngi ïalong lang borabor , lada ngi im lane ngi ïap .

Hato ngin ong te , ba ka Hukum hi ka long kaba pop ? Ym kumta keiñ ! Hynrei ka la long ka Hukum kaba pynlong ïa I ban tip kaei ka pop . Lada ka Hukum kam shitrhem la ong , Wat kwah ïa kaei kabu dei jong uwei pat , ngan ym jaiñ-jin da la tip ïa kum kata ka jingkhah .
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .
And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .
translation.kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad ngan ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ Kumta nga la dih , bad ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .

translation.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand : but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .
translation.kha: Ka jinglong jaipdeh kan pynlong ïa phi ban kyrduh , hynrei ka jingtrei shitom kan pynriewspah ïa phi .

translation.en: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name s sake .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar ïa ki pop jong phi la map na ka bynta U Khrist .

Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam ha U Trai : ar tylliat ki masi lyngraw , ti u byrngut , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrong kiba shisnem ka thma , ki bym to kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shem la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba kino shym la tei . Mynta phi shongneh phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki diengsoh sohwaiñ kiba Phim shym thung , bad ki soh Oholiab na ki diengduh kiba phim shym sting .’
translation.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .

translation.kha: Pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bah bad phin ïoh jingjop ; wat leit tur thma khlem da don ka dur pynkhraw .
translation.en: Every purpose is established by counsel : and with good advice make war .
And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .
translation.kha: Kita ki jingthaw hi ki phet shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh .

bad ban ïathaw ïa ki ba U Trai Badonbor Bahok u la kah ong , Ngan pynpait ïa Kanah ka jaitbynriew bad ïa kane ka nongbah , pynlang kane long kum une u khra khyndew ba la peiñ u bym lah ban pyntam pat . Ki briew kin tat ïa kiba ïap jong ki ha Topheth namar yn ym don hangno hangno hawei pat baneh tep ïa ki .
translation.en: And shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Even so will I break this people and this city , as one breaketh a potter s vessel , that cannot be made whole again : and they shall bury them in Topheth , till there be no place to bury .
So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la hap hapoh u Eglon haduh khatphra snem .

Ha kaba ïadei bad ki ar ngut kiba la ïatei kiba la rai ba kin ym ïashongkurim : lada Uto u briew u sngew ba um shym leh kaweh dien ïa ka theisotti dara paila ki jingkwah brai jong u ki jur haduh main katta bad u sngew ba u dei ban shongkurim , te ki dei ban jingjahburom noh , kamar u kwah . Kam don pop ei ei ha kane .
translation.en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .
translation.kha: Nga long u Gabriel ,  u angel u la jubab .  Nga ïeng ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban kren ha me bad ïathuh ha me ïa kane ka khubor babha .
Mynta nga la leh eiei keiñ ? u Dabid u kylli . Hato ngam haka seh ban kyllut jingkylli ?
translation.en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?

translation.kha: Khynñiuh u pyllait ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ngab roi kum ki jingri .
translation.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?
translation.kha: A Trai , uno uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ? Hano ba U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u ?

translation.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngdoh kum ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kat kum ba la buh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
To phin sumar ïa lade , pyntud , khnang ba phin ym duh noh ïa Kiei naba ngi , im’ la trei , hynrei Phon pdiang ïa ka bainong kaba pura .
translation.en: Look to yourselves , that we lose not those things which we have wrought , but that we receive a full reward .
And the children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and waxed exceeding mighty  ; and the land was filled with them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la ïaroi shikatdei eh ; ki la nang bun nang bun , bad ki la nang khlaiñ haduh ba kata ka ri ka la khapngiah da ki .
Ka diengkhap kaba sah u shna ïa ka pynlwet , bad Nangta u dem bad ma ïa ka . U duwai ha ka bad u ong , phi long U Blei jrong nga — to pynim ïa nga !
translation.en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .

translation.kha: Ka bneng ka long ka jong U Trai hi , hawei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynthiew .
translation.en: The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .

translation.kha: To burom ïa U TRAI’ da ka ai ha u ka jingangnud da Kiei kiei kiba bha tam ba ka lyngkha Jong phi ka pynmih .
translation.en: Honour the  Lord  with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :

translation.kha: Lada nga pynbang ba u briew ba-bymman u dei pun ïap bad ngam shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u Lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïan , kum u nongsngap , bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingtep jong u .
translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .

translation.kha: U Naphtali u long kum ka skei Akaba mareh kat shad ka mo , kaba kha ïa ki khun naba itynnat .
translation.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose : he giveth goodly words .

translation.kha: Mar ïakren ïa kane , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ba jingïakajia , bad ka kynhun ka la ïa-pait arliang .
translation.en: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .

Howbeit when he , the Spirit of truth , is come , he will guide you into all truth : for he shall not speak of himself  ; but whatsoever he shall hear , that shall he speak : and he will shew you things to come .
translation.kha: Pynban , haba U Mynsiem un wan , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei , un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshisha baroh . Un ym kren ha ka bor jong u hi , hynrei un kren ïa kaei kaba u ïohsngew , bad un ïathuh ha phi ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .

Un pynsep ïa u slap ha la ka aïom na ka ïing kynshew jong u ha bneng bad un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh ai kylliang ha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , katba ma phi pat Phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .

translation.kha: Wat peit ianga .
translation.en: Don't look at me .
For I know that the  Lord  is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba U  Trai  u long uba khraw , kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh .

Nangta ki la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong ki bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka kynhun u Herod . Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , ngi tip ba me ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew , khlem da khuslai shapoh kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat , namarba ba mem pyrkhat ïa ka kyrdan jongno jongno .
translation.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
How much did he pay you ?
translation.kha: Katno u siew ia phi ?
U Trai u ai ha u Moses
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
And they dwelt therein , and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki la shong la sah hangne bad tei ïa ka templ ban burom ïa me , da kaba tip
hynrei ki la ïaleh byrsha ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynmiet Bakhuid jong u . Namarba kata U Trei u la kylla long u nongwan jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga la pynduh lwet ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shahskhor iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli — ym shym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
translation.en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkiew rasong ka jingjop jong u , pynban ka jingïakhih jngai ka jingjynjar kan ban Hamor jong u .
translation.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him .
And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kan shit — bad ka long kumta .

translation.en: He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei dei ban otsher , bad kane kan long ka dak kaba paw shabar ban pyn-i ba ka jutang jong nga bad me ka long kaba ïaineh junom .

translation.en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , kata ka reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew jong U Blei bad ka la jop ïa ki .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Namar ba ïa kito ki nong Galilaïa la pynïap ha kata ka rukom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nong Galilaïa ?
ka Hormah , ka Arad ,
translation.en: The king of Hormah , one  ; the king of Arad , one  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei haba kata ka pruh ka la me bad ka la kylla lieh biang , uta u briew u dei ba leit sha u lyngdoh , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa u .
translation.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;
There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof : for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Halor ki tnum ïing baroh ha Moab bad ha baroh ki jaka paidbah ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingïam sngewsih , namar nga la pynpait ïa ka Moab kum u khra uba ym don shuh mano mano ban kwah .
Ngi don , namar kata , ko parabangeit jong nga ïa ka jinglaitluid ba-pura don rung shapoh ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam da kata ka jingïaiban U Jisu .
translation.en: Having therefore , brethren , boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus ,

translation.kha: U Jehoba u noh ha kita ki briew , Phi ïohi mynta ba nga la thied ïa Phin bad ïa ki khyndew jong phi na ka bynta u Syiem . Shim une u symbai ba phin ïabet ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold , I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you , and ye shall sow the land .

translation.kha: U Mushi u don la nud ki khun shynrang : u Mahli , u Eder , bad u Jeremoth .
translation.en: The sons of Mushi  ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .

translation.kha: Haba u Dedan u tip ïa kata , u ong , U Trei u tip ba ma nga bad ki khulom ki ïahiar jong nga ngim don jingrem ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
translation.en: And afterward when David heard it , he said , I and my kingdom are guiltless before the  Lord  for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner :

translation.kha: u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh , u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;
translation.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur hadien ba la pynbna ba uta u long uba khur ,
translation.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing  ;

translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei mala ba U Mynsiem U Blei u shong haw jong phi !
translation.en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?

translation.kha: Phi beh ne shabar ïa ki lyngdoh ki jongngi U Trai , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , bad phi beh noh ïa ki Lebi . Ha ka jaka jongu ki phi la thung ïa ki lyngdoh ha kiaw ka rukom ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki leh . Uno uno ibha wanrah lang bad u masi ne hynñiew tylli ki langbrot u lah ban ïoh pynkyntang kumto u lyngdoh jong wer kiba shu khot ki blei jong phi .
translation.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the  Lord  , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands ? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , the same may be a priest of them that are no gods .

translation.kha: U Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ïa ki byrni jong ki hynmen shynrang jong u da u kew , bad ban thep biang ïa ki pisa jongki uwei pa wai ha ka byrni Jong u , malade ïa-ban ai jingjam de ba kin ïoh bam ha lynti . Ïa kane la leh .
translation.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .

translation.kha: Ki la Wan na Ephraim sha ka them , Henadad ka jait Benjamin bad ki briew jong ka . Ki nongai hukum ki la wan hiar na Makhir , Ki rangbah pynïaidkam na Shebna .
translation.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek  ; after thee , Benjamin , among thy people  ; out of Machir came down governors , and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer .

translation.kha: neng tur ïaleh mynmiet ; ïng pyndait ïa ki kut jongnga ka nongbah .
translation.en: Arise , and let us go by night , and let us destroy her palaces .
But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .
translation.kha: Mynta , lada don mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ïano ïano , um shym la leh ïa kata ha nga hynrei ha phi baroh — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (Nga ong ïa kane namar ngam kwah ban da leh tyngeh halor jong u .)

Kumta u Joahas u la jyllop thiaw ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei . U la jop ïa ki syiem jong ka ri lum , kiba ha ki blaid lwa ha ka phang mihngi , bad kiba ha trai ki lum ha ka phang sepngi , pynlang ïa tun ki jong ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka pdeng bashathie . Um shym la pynsah ïan ïano , u pynkup lut khoit ïa ki baroh . Ken ka long kaba U Trai U Blei ki Israel u la hukum .
translation.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills , and of the south , and of the vale , and of the springs , and all their kings : he left none remaining , but utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the  Lord  God of Israel commanded .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Onan ki la jubab , U Blei jong ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha moi . Shah ïa ngi ba leit lai sngi sha ka ri shympriah ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai uba U Blei jrong ngi . Lada ngim ar kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka thma .
translation.en: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .

translation.kha: Ngi ïohpdiang na u ïa kano kano kaba ngi pan , namar ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ngi bor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .

translation.kha: Katba at ïaid sha khmat , u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew Ibbah kham khraw bad kham khlaw ban ïa phi , khnang ba un shuh ïa phi ha ka ri jong ki , bad ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .
translation.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in , to give thee their land for an inheritance , as it is this day .

And , behold , God himself is with us for our captain , and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you . O children of Israel , fight ye not against the  Lord  God of your fathers  ; for ye shall not prosper .
translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u long u nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh jong u ki don hangne lem bad ki turoi , ba la khreh ban put ïa ki bad ban khot ïa ngi bad ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa phi . Ko paid Israel , wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ! Phin ym jop !
U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied uwei u khreh khyndew . U la ong ruh ïa nga ban ïalam katto katne nguid ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katno katne ngut ki lyngdoh ba la tymmen ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;

But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw ba U  Trai  un sa hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phin jynthut ha kawei pa kawei ka jingjam ba phi shim . Phin sa mynsaw , shah riam bad phin long koidi .
Da shisha katto katne ngut na ki , ki ïapli ïa U Khrist namsop ka jingpynduh bad ka jingïakajia , hynrei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .
translation.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :

translation.kha: Ym mala ïa Uno uno u briew uba ei jingdiang ha ka met Ban ai ïa kata ka jingkñia : kum uba matlah , babha dkoh , naba la sniew ka durkhmat , lane suba la thawsha ka met ;
translation.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,
If that nation , against whom I have pronounced , turn from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them .
translation.kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew ka phai noh na ka jingsniew jong ka , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .
translation.kha: Kata ka khubor na U  Trai  pyrshah ïa u Baasha bad ïa ka longïing jong u la ai da u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa namar ki pop ba u Baasha u la leh pyrshah ïa u  Trai . U la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  ym tang namar ki kam bymman ba u la leh , kumba u syiem Jeroboam u la leh ha shuwa jong u , hynrei ruh namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam .

translation.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei un thew ïa nga ha ki tarajur bahok , bad un ïohi katno uba lui lui nga long .

U Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ki la tad ha tdong kata ka jaka sher dara shuwa ka por shiteng syntiat , hamar ba dang dap ïa-bujli ïa ki nongjop phira . Nangta ki mang ïa ki turoi bad ki pyntam ïa ki khra ba ki bat , bad kita ki ar kynhun hati ki leh kumjuh .
translation.en: So Gideon , and the hundred men that were with him , came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch  ; and they had but newly set the watch : and they blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers that were in their hands .

translation.kha: Haba phi ai ha kiba duk , ka long kamar phi ai kyllan shaei U Trai , bad U tharai un sa siew pat ïa phi .
translation.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the  Lord   ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .
That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u bitar bad u pynshitom , dei u briew uba sniew uba ju lait borabor .

translation.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way , who walk in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingim jong ki ka long ka bym don jingbakla , kiba im kat kum ka aiñ jong U  Trai .
Ha ka jingtep , ki riewtymmen ki sangeh ne ban ai ki kam bymman , bad ki nongdie ba la taïew , khatduh ki ïoh jingjahthait .
translation.en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .
And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .
translation.kha: Katba ngi nang ïaid sha khmat sha kane ka ri , U  Trai  u la beh ïa ki Amor baroh kiba shong basah hangne . Kumta ma ngi ruh , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  , u long U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u mihnoh na Beersheba . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynshong ïa u , ïa ki khun rit jong ki , bad ïa ki tnga jong ki , ha kita ki kali kiba u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah ban kit ïa ki .
Haba U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Dei ma nga uto , ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllaiñ ha madan .
translation.en: As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .

translation.kha: Me pynïoh ki kambah baphylla pyrshah ïa u Pharoah , pyrshah ïa ki rangbah synshar ki briew jong ka ri jong u , namar me tip kumno ki la banbeiñ ïa ki briew’ jongno me . Me la jop ha kata ka por , ka nam kaba me dang don ha kane ka sngaid .
translation.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh , and on all his servants , and on all the people of his land : for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them . So didst thou get thee a name , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Kajuh hi kuna jia ïa ka Edom kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom badno Gomer , mynba ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong ba-marjan la pynjot . Yn ym don ban sawa biang hangta . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord  , no man shall abide there , neither shall a son of man dwell in it .
And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la jop ïa ka ri , ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang ha Shiloh bad pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

U Jisu u la bitar katba u la peit sawdong ïa ki , isynei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jongno ki , ñiar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh daym . Te u la ong ha uta u briew , Rah ïa la ka kti . U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha bapaw .
translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kita kiba bud ïa kane ka rukom ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingsuk bad ka jingisynei kan long lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki briew jong U Blei !

translation.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .
translation.kha: Ha ka ïing kaba heh don ki khiew kiba bun jait : Don na ki ïa kiba la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , kiwei pat da ka dieng bad ka dewbyrtha ; don na ki na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam kyrpang , kiwei pat ban pyndonkam man ka por .
Bad hangta Phin wad ïa U Trai U Blei jongno phi , bad lada phi buid ïa u da ka dohnud jngai phin baroh , phin Shem ïa u .
translation.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul .

translation.kha: U Trai U balui jong phi un ïalam ïa phoi , bad un ïaleh na ka bynda jong phi , kumba phi la ïohi ïa u ba u leh ha Jingtep
translation.en: The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;

translation.kha: Ki khun ki pynbtai ïa por sad ki rkhiebeiñ haba ki ïohi ïa por .
translation.en: Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .

And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki ai sngewbha ïa ki paidbah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi ba kin pyndonkam . Bad ki rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Sekharaïah , bad u Jehiel — ki ai ïa ki lyngdoh ar hajar hynriewspah tylli ki langbrot bad ki khunblang bad laispah tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
U Trai U Nongbishar Badonbor Bakhraw u la khot ïa phi ha katei ka per ban ïabam malu ïam pangnud , ban neng ïa ki khlieh jong phi bad ban phrung ki jaiñ khain .
translation.en: And in that day did the Lord  God  of hosts call to weeping , and to mourning , and to baldness , and to girding with sackcloth :

translation.kha: Wat la nga long uba lui yn , baroh kaba per lah ban leh ka long tang ban kyrpang ïa ki jingisynei U Blei! u nongbishar jong per .
translation.en: Whom , though I were righteous , yet would I not answer , but I would make supplication to my judge .

translation.kha: U Porsius u la jubab , Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me , wat la baroh kiwei pat kmen leh kumta !
translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u beh krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Sheshai , Ahiman , bad Talmai .
To ai da ka kyrteng bathymmai ïa u syiem ka Ijipt — ‘ U riew kob-pia uba la mad ei ïa la ka kabu’ .
translation.en: They did cry there , Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise  ; he hath passed the time appointed .
I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
translation.kha: Ngan long ïa ki paid Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki syntiew ; kin suhthied skhem kum ki dieng ha Lebanon .
Kino kine naba ieit ïa ka jingtip ki kwah pun don ba pynong haba ki bakla . Ka un-long ka jingbieit ban isih haba don ba pynbeit .
translation.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .

translation.kha: To wan hajan U Blei , bad un wan ba-hajan jong phi . To sait ïa la ki kti , ko phin ki nongïapom ! To pynkhuid ïa la ki ïaduna , phi kaba arsap !
translation.en: Draw nigh to God , and he will draw nigh to you . Cleanse your hands , ye sinners  ; and purify your hearts , ye double minded .

translation.kha: Nangta wai bapaw u angel u la wan mihnoh na ka Templ bun u la pyrta da ka sur kaweh jam sha Utai uba shong halor u lyoh , To pyndonkam ïa la ka shlei bad to ot ïa ka jingot , namar ka Por ka la poi ; ka pyrthei ka la ih na ka bynta ka jingot !
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud , Thrust in thy sickle , and reap : for the time is come for thee to reap  ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe .

translation.kha: A katto-katne phin ïam bad kyr-iat ïa la ki bniat haba phi ïohi ïa u Abraham , u Asekah , bad u Jobab , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka Shim U Blei’ , katba ïa phi la bret noh shabar !
translation.en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth , when ye shall see Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , and all the prophets , in the kingdom of God , and you yourselves thrust out .

And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynthei , khnang ba yn ym don uba leit rah khubor sha Gath bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la leh . Kane ka long kaba u Dabid u la ju leh katba u dang sah ha ri Philistia .

Pynban , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Mephibosheth , ki ar ngut ki khun shngain jong ka Shispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïoh na u Saul ; u shimet ruh ïa ki san ngut ki kynhun shynrang jong ka Merab , ka khun jongno u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Jesreel u khun jong u Barsillai uba na Meholah .
translation.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :
And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad , even unto the children of Gad according to their families .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai ruh shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Namar kane ka daw , nga daym khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,
translation.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei skhem u don kyrhai ban bam . Ki briew kiba pynsaja ïa la ka na kin duk lynter .
translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .
translation.kha: Nangta phan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh . Phan ym tap ïa la ki khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
Hangne un sa wiang kynsan ïa u lyoh jong ka jingsngewsih uba ju tap halor ki jingñiewbeiñ baroh .
translation.en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people , and the veil that is spread over all nations .

translation.kha: Kumno phi naduh ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Sngewbha , shahshkor ïa nga ban khlaw noh ïa u thngiat na ka Khmut jong phi ,’ haba phi don ka lyngkhot diengkhap ha la ka jong ka khmat ?
translation.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: ( Ym shym la don mano mano uba aiti lut ïa lade don lai ïa ka bymdei ha khmat U Trai kum u Ahab — baroh da ka jingpynbor ka tnga jongnga u ka Jesebel .
translation.en: But there was none like unto Ahab , which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up .

translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong me ka la long kaba janai nadong ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la ïasdang Ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .
translation.kha: Ki briew na baroh ki hima , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep ïa ki .
Sa Teng shipor phiah ym ioh thuh ïa ar , bad nongkit sa shipor hateng phin sa ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .

translation.kha: Na long U Blei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah pun pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .
translation.en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa kaba biang , uba la kyrkhu bad tang ma u hi , U Nongsynshar , U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .

translation.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the coasts thereof round about , according to their families .
translation.kha: Ka Jordan ka dei u pud uba shaphang mihngi . Kine ki dei ki pud jong ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Haba U Khrist u la shahshitom ha ka doh , phi ruh phi dei ban pynkheiñ ïa lade da kajuh ka jingpyrkhat kaba u la don ; namar a uno kaba shahtehmraw ha ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pum .
translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;

translation.kha: To long ka ïakhreh kaba skhem jong nga , ka kut bakhlaiñ ban ïada ïa nga ; me long ka jakarieh bad ka jingkyrshan jong nga .
translation.en: Be thou my strong habitation , whereunto I may continually resort : thou hast given commandment to save me  ; for thou art my rock and my fortress .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ba ïa uno uno uba la don ha shuwa litar u ban sa ïoh pat hadien .
translation.en: Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .
And the desolate land shall be tilled , whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ju ïaid narud ki lyngkha jong phi ki la ïohi ba kumno ba la san jrong bad ba la iehnoh khlaw ïa ki , hynrei ngan shah ba phin rep biang ha ki .
Ka dei ka jingkhlaiñ jong u kaba jop ïa ka duriaw ; da ka jingpyut jong u , u pynjot ïa u Rahab u mrad kynsha .
translation.en: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .
And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , u la pyn-i ïa ka jingmynjur ïa ki Jentil da kaba ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki , kumba u la leh ha ngi .

translation.en: Then they shall answer , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  their God , and worshipped other gods , and served them .
translation.kha: Te kin jubab ba ka long namar ba phi la lyndet ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U Blei jong phi , bad phi la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot jong u ; hynrei ki long kum u dieng sohwaiñ khlem ki sohwaiñ , kum u diengsoh Dumbur khlem ki soh Dumbur ; wat ki sla ki la jlop . Namar kata , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim noh ïa ka ri .
U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa ka kumba U Trai u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .

translation.kha: Ai ba phan shadkmen borabor ha U TRAI’ ; nga ban biang ïa ka : To ïakmen .
translation.en: Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .

translation.kha: bad u la ïap neh ha ka mar kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .

translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong , Nga la long u traishnong da kaba siew shibun ka pisa . Hynrei nga long shongshngain naduh dang kha , u Paul u la jubor .
translation.en: And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .

translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa kine ki briew bymman malu ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang pyrshah ïa ki , sad yn pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop kiba bun ki jong ki .
translation.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them  ; and the people shall be gathered against them , when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .

translation.kha: bun hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jrong pha , wat pyndei sut ha ka khlieh jong u , Naaman na ka sngi ba la kha ïa u un long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir . Un sdang ïa ka kam ban pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki phylliah .
translation.en: For , lo , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and no razor shall come on his head : for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb : and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines .
And Moses went up unto God , and the  Lord  called unto him out of the mountain , saying , Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel  ;
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha u lum ban ïashem bad U Blei . U  Trai  u la khot ïa u na u lum bad u la bthah ïa u ban ong ha ki Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob :
Ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson , Peit , pa’ la pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba shisha . sngewngiah ïathuh ïa na kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .
translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Behold , thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : now tell me , I pray thee , wherewith thou mightest be bound .

translation.kha: Nga la wan da ka iktiar U Kpa jongnga to ; hynrei kine khim la pdiang ïa nga ; pynban , haba don uno a uba wan ha la ka jong ka iktiar , phyrnai pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: I am come in my Father s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun bakhlaiñbor jrong nga bad na kito barben kiba shun ïa por — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor eh ban ïa nga .
translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .

translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum U Blei bad phin im slem ; lada phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , phin ïap .
translation.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul  ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .

translation.kha: Lada phi im kat kumin ki aiñ jong nga , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ,
translation.en: If ye walk in my statutes , and keep my commandments , and do them  ;
And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad nga ai ïa kata ka ri kaba naduh Gilead haduh ka wah Arnon . U pud uba shaphang shathie u long napdeng jong kata ka wah , bad u pud uba shaphang shatei pat u long ka wah Jabbok ; kaba shi bynta na kata ka pynlong ruh ïa u pud ki Ammon .
U tharai hi un ïalam ïa me dara un don ryngkat bad me . Un ym ieh ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta wat syier dara wat sheptieng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .
Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears , and bucklers , and shields , that had been king David s , which were in the house of God .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u syiem Dabid bad kiba la buh ha ka Templ .

translation.en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba lada ïa kane ka nongbah la tei pat bad ba ïa ki kynroh la pyndep , ko Syiem , phin ym lah shuh ban pynïaid ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh kaba la shong slem . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ym da donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid .
translation.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .

translation.kha: Bakhraw ki briew ki la pyrshang baneh kthaw ïa u , naba ka bor ka la mih na u bad ka da pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .

translation.kha: Hadien ba la weng noh ïa u , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban Long u skhem jong ki . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang jong u : ‘ Nga la shem ba u Sabad u khun jong u Jesse , u long u jait briew uba per sngewbha , u briew u ban kun ïa baroh Kaba nga kwah ïa u ban leh .’
translation.en: And when he had removed him , he raised up unto them David to be their king  ; to whom also he gave testimony , and said , I have found David the son of Jesse , a man after mine own heart , which shall fulfil all my will .
Shall vain words have an end ? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest ?
translation.kha: Hato phin shu kren junom ? Hato borabor phin don ka kyntien khatduh ?

Haba u Barak u tur ïaleh lem bad la ka kynhun shipai , U Trai u buh ïa u Sisera ha ka jingshon jingmut lem bad ki kulai ïapom dara ki Rangbah jong u baroh . U Sisera u Hiar na la ka kali ïapom bad u phet ïap da ka kjat .
translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited Sisera , and all his chariots , and all his host , with the edge of the sword before Barak  ; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot , and fled away on his feet .

translation.kha: Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki rijied , ïa ki tliw tnaw , ïa ki sngur , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllaw .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kabu ar kaba u Duriaw u long u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai umbah hynriew , U Trai u la kren lyntang u Haggan u nongïathuhlypa . Ka khubor ka la long na ka boitha u lut ka Judah , u Serubbabel u khun jrong u Shealtiel , bad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Jehosheba u khuid jong u Jehosadak .
translation.en: In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,

translation.kha: Hato ngam shym la ïam bad ki briew ba shem jingeh bad sngew ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingkyrduh ?
translation.en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble ? was not my soul grieved for the poor ?

translation.kha: U ba-ha-ïing jong u briew uba ïan , uba umbah dadien khmih ïa ka jingleit ontep , un sei shabar ïa ka metïap na ka ïing . Uba ha ïing un khot ïa uno uno ba dang sah hapoh ïing , Dang ei mano mano malu phi hangto ? Ka sur kan jubab , Em ! nangta u ba-ha-ïing un sa ong , Sngap Jar ! Ngi dei ba sumar wat ba-bang ym ong ei ei ïa ka kyrteng U Trai .
translation.en: And a man s uncle shall take him up , and he that burneth him , to bring out the bones out of the house , and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house , Is there yet any with thee ? and he shall say , No . Then shall he say , Hold thy tongue : for we may not make mention of the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la tduh ïa-ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa ki briew shun ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u ïakhun jong u Taberah halor ka khet .
translation.en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
If he be able to fight with me , and to kill me , then will we be your servants : but if I prevail against him , and kill him , then shall ye be our servants , and serve us .
translation.kha: Lada u jop bad u pynïap ïa nga , ngin long noh ki mraw jong phi ; hynrei lada ma nga , nga jop bad nga pynïap ïa u , phin long ki mraw jong ngi .

translation.en: For , as the  Lord  liveth , which saveth Israel , though it be in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . But there was not a man among all the people that answered him .
translation.kha: Nga kular ha U  Trai  uba im , uba ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop , ba uta uba la leh un shah pynïap , wat la u dei u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba ong ei ei .
Mar ïasngewskhem ha ka bor , u Asaraïah u pynïap ïa ki ngab synshar ibha pynïap ïa u kpa lad u , uba long u syiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand , that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .

translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki phai shaiñ , ki iohi ïa ka tdem kaba kiew sha suiñbneng . Ym ei lad shuh ba ktang lait im , naba ki Israel kiba la phet sha ka jaka bashrah mynta ki pait kylla ngab ïateh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and , behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way : and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa nga ; ki ïakren dara sylla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,

translation.kha: Hato kane ka jingsngur kaba U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki sem shym la nujor . Naba ngi ong na ka jingthaw Bakhuid , U Abram u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit lad u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
translation.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai , bad ngam ju kylla . Bad kumta ma phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , phim pat shym la jah napoh khoit .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .

translation.kha: Te U Trai’ u ïai-ong ha u Moses , Rah ïa la ka kti halor ka ri jingtep don wallam ïa ki bret . Kin wan malade bah ïa kawei kaei baïar kaba mih , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba lait na u phria .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up upon the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail hath left .

translation.kha: U ong ïa u Gehasi u shakri jong u ban leit bad khot ïa kata ka briew . ibha ka la wan ,
translation.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant , Call this Shunammite . And when he had called her , she stood before him .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai ban ha ka op bajam ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba me la ai .
translation.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth .

translation.kha: Mynta ba ka por ka jingneh ka la poi , ka Hukum kam dabor shuh halor jong moi .
translation.en: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .

translation.kha: Phi rim ïa ki maw kaba jlih nangta bad mian ïa ki khem ki blei . Phi heh ïa ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh ïa ki bad wanlam sha ki ïa ki jingainguh kew . Phi thah ba ngan sngewbha da Kinah kiei kiei ?
translation.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion  ; they , they are thy lot : even to them hast thou poured a drink offering , thou hast offered a meat offering . Should I receive comfort in these ?
And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you , every man child in your generations , he that is born in the house , or bought with money of any stranger , which is not of thy seed .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta me dei ban otsher ïa u khunlung baroh haba u la dap phra sngi , kynthup ruh ïa ki mraw kiba la kha ha ki longïing longsem jong me bad ïa ki mraw kiba me la thied na ki nongwei . Kane kan pyn-i ba ka don ka jutang hapdeng jong nga bad me .

translation.en: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him .
translation.kha: Lada u dang marwei mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , um dei ban ïalam ïa ka tnga jong u haba u mihnoh ; hynrei lada u la shongkurim mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , u lah ban ïalam ïa la ka tnga lem bad u .

translation.en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga halor u lum .  Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la ïaid nangta bad u la phah ïa ka lyer bajur kaba la kad arliang ïa ki lum bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawsiang — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ban beh , bad nangta la khie u jumai — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha u jumai .
Kumno ka ktien U Blei kan kham pynbha ïa ka jingim jong phi ?
translation.en: How can God’s Word improve your life ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka barandi kaba dei ban kup haduh ka ephod la suh da u saiwul uba jngum .
translation.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work , all of blue .

translation.kha: To ki shnong jong u kin longsem kiba la ker da ki khyrdop nar , Bad to un shongsuk shongsaiñ borabor .
translation.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .

translation.kha: Ha ka sneng kaba hynriew , ki ïalum ar shah , saw kilo ïa uwei uwei u bri . Ki nongïalam baroh jong ka kynhun ki wan ïathiah shapoh kata ha u Moses ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .

translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa ki shata U Trai ban kylli ïa u , Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wei , ne hato ngin Khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?
translation.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?

translation.kha: Haba ka kyntiap ka la nang , U Jisu u la shongkha ha la ka jaka ha ka imat laiñ bad ki apostol .
translation.en: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .

translation.kha: Don wahbah la ïaheh ha ka Tamar ba u khot kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .
translation.en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .
So the Philistines were subdued , and they came no more into the coast of Israel : and the hand of the  Lord  was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Philistia ki la shahjop , bad U  Trai  u la khanglad ïa ki na kaba jop ïa ka ri Israel katba u Samuel u dang im .
Ynda ki pioneer batista ki la Trei pahara shisnem , ïa ki la ju pynrung kyrteng ha ka skul ba hynriew sngi kiba ju pynlong ha ka ïng Hima ba jan tam .
translation.en: At the end of a regular pioneer’s first year of full-time service , he or she is enrolled in a six-day school that may be held at a nearby Kingdom Hall .

translation.kha: Da ka jingrisa U Khrist kaba dat ha nga , nga kular ba ïa kane ka jingsngew sarong jong de yn ym pynsngap jar hangno hangno ha Akhaïa baher kawei .
translation.en: As the truth of Christ is in me , no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia .

translation.kha: Pynban U Trai u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U kloi ban sngewlem ïa ph namarba u long borabor uba leh ïa kaba dei . Suk kito ibha buh ïa ka jingïaishah jongki ki ha U Trai .
translation.en: And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .

translation.kha: Phi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka jait Reuben . Nangta ha khmat jong phin barhem , ka khynraw ka ang dara ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jongno ki baïar .
translation.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :

translation.kha: Ki la mihnoh na uta u brup bun ki la rung hakpoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh ka la noh shaw riat shaphang ka durblei bad ki la ïap jyllop .
translation.en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba rong jubor ïa la u para Isaia bad u pynlong mraw lane die mraw ïa u , u dei ba shah pynïap . Da kumjuh phin pynduh ei ïa kane ka jingmaham napdeng jong phin .
translation.en: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel , and maketh merchandise of him , or selleth him  ; then that thief shall die  ; and thou shalt put evil away from among you .

translation.kha: Naba ki ktien kiba phin krenbeiñ kim dei ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem jong U Kpa jong phi uba kren Lyngba jongki phoi .
translation.en: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .

translation.kha: U Benabinadab u la pynlong ïa u Mattanaïah u Kñia jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad u la pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u Sha u Sedekaïah .
translation.en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father s brother king in his stead , and changed his name to Zedekiah .

translation.kha: Phi la ban thung ki rangbah synran ha man ki probins jong ka hima dara hukum ïa ki ban ïalam ïa baroh kine ki samla kynthei ba-bhabriew sha ka ïing ki kynthei jong phira hangne ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima . Buh ïa ki haw ka jingkhmih jong u Hikai , u ïunukh kaba plied halor ki kynthei jong phi , bad ban ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki .
translation.en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace , to the house of the women , unto the custody of Hege the king s chamberlain , keeper of the women  ; and let their things for purification be given them :
And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .
translation.kha: kawei ka leit shaphang Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka leit shaphang ka khappud na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bad ïa ka ri khlaw .
Kam long kaba phylla , te , ba uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha ka jingjahburom ïa u , malade ba um ñiew ïa kito kiba kam ba ki hir kiba stad .
translation.en: Men do therefore fear him : he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .

translation.kha: Ba U Khrist un pynsuhthied ha mynsiem jongphi da jingieit , ba phin , pynslem nongring ha ka jingieit ,
translation.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith ; that ye , being rooted and grounded in love ,

The matter is not so : but a man of mount Ephraim , Sheba the son of Bichri by name , hath lifted up his hand against the king , even against David : deliver him only , and I will depart from the city . And the woman said unto Joab , Behold , his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall .
translation.kha: Kata kam dei ka jingthmu jong ngi . U briew uba kyrteng u Sheba , u khun jong u Bikri , uba na ka ri lum Ephraim , u la sdang ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Dabid . Aiti ïa une u briew , bad ngan kynriah noh na ka nongbah .   Ngin bret ïa ka khlieh jong u sha phi nalor ka kynroh ,  ka ong .

Hangta ha ka Templ , u Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ki hynñiewphew Sngi . Hangta la anna u paidbah bynriew babun naduh ki jaka kiba jngai kum ka Khie Hamath shaphang shatei bad ka u pud ka Ijipt shaphang shathie .
translation.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him , a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the  Lord  our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .
translation.kha: U la thew ïa kane ka kamra bad u la lap ba ka jylliew saw mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tduh jong ka lynti rung kaba jan tam sha ka Templ bad sha bakut jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mitar .

translation.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonathan um shym la ïohsngew ba u kpa jong u , u la maham jur ïa ki rangbah da ka jingtim ; kumta u la kner da u dieng ba u rah , u pynngam ïa u ha ka rewngap , bad u bam khyndiat ka ngap . Hangta hi u la sngew ïohbor .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , ba uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u klim lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .
U Ono u kylli , Kumno pat shaphang kato ka kynhun kaba nga la ïakynduh ? Ka mudui aïu kato ? U Jakob u jubab Bam eh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translation.en: And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .

translation.kha: lang ai ïa me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad kin sa long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pyndonnam ïa ka kyrteng jong me , ba kamut men sa long ka jingkyrkhu .
translation.en: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee , and make thy name great  ; and thou shalt be a blessing :

translation.kha: haba i peit ïa ka lawei , ka Baibl ka ïathuh shaphang “Ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka khynñiat kiba thymmai , katba kum kata ka jingkular jong u ( Bela ) ngi ïakhmih lynti , ha kiba ka hok ka shnong sah” . —2 Petros 3 :13 ; Isaïah 65 :21 .
translation.en: Looking to the future , the Bible tells of a “new heavens and a new earth that we are awaiting according to [God’s] promise , and in these righteousness is to dwell .”—2 Peter 3 :13  ; Isaiah 65 :17 .
Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it  ; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king  ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them  ;

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong , Kane ka dei ka jaka sher Dara jong U Blei ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka dik ka Mahanaim .
translation.en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .

translation.kha: U long u synran uba la kren kine kiei kiei , uta uba la thoin ruh ïa kine ; bad ngi tip ba kadei kaba u ong ka longsem kaba shisha .
translation.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .

translation.kha: Ki khyrdep hapoh ka wah ki bthei ; ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ka jingsngewtriem .
translation.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened , and the palace shall be dissolved .
As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .
translation.kha: Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit , nga la ju pynshlur ïa u ban wan jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki parabangeit , hynrei um da mon eh ban wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïoh ïa ka lad , un sa wan .

Phi dei ban ïabam kyrkieh ïa ka , namar Phin dei pun riam na ka bynta ban leit jingleit , lem bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka kti jrong phi . Ka dei ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .

translation.kha: Ainong ïa uwei pa iwei baroh katba kum ki kam jong u , Haneng ba ki briew jong me Kin kohnguh ïa me ha ki por baroh katba ki dang im ha kane ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .

translation.kha: U bhabriew umbah jaiñkup uba kyntait ban trei u Shu pynïap ei ïa lade ; baroh kaba u leh ka long baneh pyrkhat shaphang kaei ba u kwah ban ba-don .
translation.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .

translation.kha: U daym u parabriew jngai me uba shahshitom na ki pop jong me , bad kaba bha kaba me leh ka ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art  ; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .

translation.kha: Da shisha phira pyntip ba naduh ki por mynhynnin , mynba ïa u briew la buh nyngkong ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: Knowest thou not this of old , since man was placed upon earth ,

translation.kha: Ainguh ïa U Blei namsop ka jinglongbriew jong pa’ , bad namar kaei kaba phi! la leh ha kane ka sngew ha kaban khang ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynïap briew’ sad na kabu pynhiarkput da lade” hi .
translation.en: And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .
Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .
translation.kha: Te ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Templ bad ka ïaid shaphang ka jaka kaba halor kita ki jingthaw .
Hamar ba mih ka sngem , u Lot u la tad ha Soar .
translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .
The burden of the valley of vision . What aileth thee now , that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Them ka Jingïohipaw . Kaei kaba jia ? Balei ki briew baroh jong ka nongbah ki rakhe lehkmen halor ki tnum ïing ?
Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki na ki pop kiba ki la ai pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki .
translation.en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity , whereby they have sinned against me  ; and I will pardon all their iniquities , whereby they have sinned , and whereby they have transgressed against me .

translation.kha: Hato phim thup ba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u la pynlong ka jingmong badno u Dabid ka bym lah ban pynkheiñ , da kaba ai ha u bad ha ki khunlung ki ksiew jong u ïa ka jinglong syiem jymphong halor ki Jeriel ?
translation.en: Ought ye not to know that the  Lord  God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?
Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyn-i ha ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ka jingsarong jong ki .
Hynrei kan kyrkhu ïa u briew uba buh ïa ka jingshan jong u ha nga .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the  Lord  , and whose hope the  Lord  is .
Son of man , speak to the children of thy people , and say unto them , When I bring the sword upon a land , if the people of the land take a man of their coasts , and set him for their watchman :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew  , u la ong , ïathuh ha ki briew jong me ïa kaei kaba jia haba nga wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka ri . Ki briew ha kata ka ri ki jied ïa uwei napdeng jong ki ban long u nongap .
U la pynlong ïa phi u nongsynshar ïa baroh ka pyut bashongbriew bad u nongsynshar ïa baroh ki mrad bun ki da . Phi long ka khlieh kaba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell , the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand , and hath made thee ruler over them all . Thou art this head of gold .
Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate , and at the valley gate , and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingker kynroh ïa ka Jerusalem da kaba tei ïa ki kut ha Khyrdop Dong , ha Khyrdop Them , bad ha ka jaka ba khun ka kynroh .
Kine ki syep baroh ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan Ngan ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Yiron ban ïakhleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno u khnam uba haw shun pynher krad ïa u ; ki mawbah kba la kawang ïa u ki long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap .
translation.en: The arrow cannot make him flee : slingstones are turned with him into stubble .
For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid :  Yn ym pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki shyieng jong u .

translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , hynrei ïai kren bad wat sangeh , naba nga long lem bad me .
U Akhsib u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat , Nga la ong ïa phi ba um juh ïathuhlypa ïa kano kane kaba bha ïa nga ; ka long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me , but evil ?
When they went from one nation to another , from one kingdom to another people  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .

Hynrei ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Syria ki ïai btep ban thaw ïa la ki balaitluid , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki kajuh mane kba ki Israel ki la tei . Kawei pa kawei ka kynoi ka la ïakit ïa ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah ha kiba ki shong ki sai :
translation.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .

translation.kha: Ïa kine ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , U Jisu u la phah napoh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum : wat rupa sha kano kan ka thoiñ jong ki Jentil lano shwa kano kano ka shang ki nong Samaria .
translation.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :

translation.kha: Ngan pynhapoh ïa ki bri ka Moab na kaba thang jingainguh ha ki jaka mane jong ki bad shun ai ïa ki jingbna sha ki blei jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .
And this man shall be the peace , when the Assyrian shall come into our land : and when he shall tread in our palaces , then shall we raise against him seven shepherds , and eight principal men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Assyria ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi bad tur lyngba ki jingïada jong ngi , ngin phah ïa ki nongïalam bakhlaiñ tam ban ïaleh ïa ki .
Hato phi la ju tipbriew ba don uno uno na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ne uwei u Pharisi kiba ngeit ha u ?
translation.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?
