translation.kha: Nangta u Shelomoth u la pynkut noh ïa u Abiathar na kaba shakri kum u lyngdoh jong U Trai , bad kumta u la pynurlong ïa kaei kiba U Trai u la ong ha Shiloh shaphang u Eli , u lyngdoh bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the  Lord   ; that he might fulfil the word of the  Lord  , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh .
I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist Jisu bad jong ki angel to kohnguh ïa kine ki jinghikai khlem jingujor lane khlem shah shiliang ïano ïano ha kano kano kaba me leh .

translation.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done : and there is no respect of persons .
translation.kha: Bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla yn siew na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba bakla kiba u leh , namar U Blei u bishar ïa uwei pa uwei da kajuh ka jingthew .

Nga la ïalamwir ïa me na kaba kut ka pyrthei ; nga la khot ïa me nongdih ki pud bajngai baheh jong ka bad nga la ong ha me ‘ me long u shakri jong nga ,’ im shym la kyntait ïa me , hynmen nga la jied ïa me .
translation.en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth , and called thee from the chief men thereof , and said unto thee , Thou art my servant  ; I have chosen thee , and not cast thee away .

Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions  ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,
translation.kha: Na u Rehum , u lat , na u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , na ki paralok jong ki , ki nongbishar bad na baroh ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar , kiba long ki rangbah traishnong na Erekh , Babilon bad Susa ha ka ri Elam ,

naba u la buh ka sngi ha kaba un shrah ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jinglehhok , da uta u briew ïa uba u la jied . U la ai ka jingpynshisha ïa kane ha uwei pa uwei da kaba pynmihpat ïa uta u briew na ka jingïap !
translation.en: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained  ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ahas u syiem ka Judah , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khyndai snem ha Samaria .

translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkulmar jingmut ïa ki Amor ha ka jingïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel . Ki Israel ki pynïap ïa ki ha Gibeon bad ki la beh ïa ki arsut ïa ka khim lum ha Beth Horon , da kaba ïai ïaleh shaduh shaphang shathie ha Asekah bad Makkedah .

Hynrei mem shym ngeit ïa ka khubor jong at , ka ban urlong shisha ha ka por kaba dei . Namar ba mem skhem la ngeit , men ym lah ïa-ban kren , men ïailong uba jar jar tad ynda ka sngi ha kabu ka jingkular jong nga ha me ka urlong shisha .
translation.en: And , behold , thou shalt be dumb , and not able to speak , until the day that these things shall be performed , because thou believest not my words , which shall be fulfilled in their season .

translation.kha: Shisyndon u Ahab u leit sha ka ber shoiñ ban shatei ïa ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead , that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , to take possession of it .

translation.kha: A Trai Badonbor baroh , me long u nongsynshar ha ka pyrthei baroh ; me kham khraw palat ngab ïa ki blei borbah .
translation.en: For thou ,  Lord  , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .
So Joshua did as Moses had said to him , and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumba u Moses u la hukum ïa u , bad u la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , katba u Moses , u Aaron , bad u Hur ki la leit kiew sha kliar u lum .
U Jonah u sdang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , bad hadien ba u la ïaid baroh shi sngi , u la pynbna , Hapoh sawphew sngur ïa ka Ninebeh yn sa pynring !
translation.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day s journey , and he cried , and said , Yet forty days , and Nineveh shall be overthrown .

translation.kha: hynrei ka ktien jongnga U Trai ka ïaineh junom . Kñia ka ktien ka long ka Kherub Babha ïa kaba la pynbynta ha phi .
translation.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jehoïakim nabar ki shipai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la jingïohknieh ïa kaei kambah u Uriah u la lah ong , u shym u la pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u . Khenani u Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewtriem malade u la lait phet sha Ijipt .
translation.en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;
But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor , kumta u syiem Jehoash u tur shaphrang lem bad ki rangbah jong u bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .

Ki shipai ki la ong lai ma ki , To ngi ym thab pynkad ïa ka , to ïeng ïakynting sbai ban shem mano ba Ïohi ïa ka . Kane ka la jia khnang ba ka jingïathoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha : Ki la pynïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong nga hapdeng jong ki bad ki la ïakhalai ïa ka jaiñkup jong por . Keiñ ka long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la leh .
translation.en: They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .
And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingri kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u Jakob u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha khmat jong ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin dup seng khun hapdeng kita ki tnat dieng .

translation.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand : that the  Lord  may turn from the fierceness of his anger , and shew thee mercy , and have compassion upon thee , and multiply thee , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers  ;
translation.kha: Wat shim sha lade ïa kaei kaei kaba la mang ban pynjot , te U  Trai  un phai na ka jingbitar shla jong u bad un isynei ïa phi . Un leh-isynei ïa phi bad un pynroi ïa phi , kumba u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,
Bad don sa kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kambah ong , Ki briew kin ïakhmih ïa uta ïa kiba ki la sum .
translation.en: And again another scripture saith , They shall look on him whom they pierced .

translation.kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew Suit rah ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïadem bynta lam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jentil , ki Jentil ki de ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki ïew .
translation.en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .
For all the promises of God in him are yea , and in him Amen , unto the glory of God by us .
translation.kha: Dei namar kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist ba ngi ïa-ong  Amen  na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .

translation.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaba kjit noh ïa u slap uba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba ai jingmyntoi na ka bynta kita kiba rep ha ka .

translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?
translation.kha: Kine ki maw kin pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,
Ha kaba nyngkong , ki brup ha ka pyrthei baroh ki la don tang kawei ka ktien ka thyllah bad pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki kyntu .
translation.en: And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .

translation.kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u parabriew kat hajuh ba un da ïap u dei ban shahshkor pynïap .
translation.en: He that smiteth a man , so that he die , shall be surely put to death .
And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent , the half curtain that remaineth , shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Wah ïa kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba tam shiteng shadien ka Ïingjaiñ .

Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U Trai , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew’ ha kane ka ri da ka waiñ tad haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , bakha long kba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baher ki briew jngai ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .

translation.kha: U shem Solomon u kham riewsaid bad kham stad ngab ïa uno uno u syier ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u pah ïa u Adoniram , kiba peit ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor , ban leit shwa ki Israel , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Mar kamut , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet rieh shat Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: bad ki la lynñiar jam haba ki la ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki tylli dieng kiba la bam ruh ïa ka : Ym pat ju don kawei pat ka nongkhap khim kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !
translation.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning , saying , What city is like unto this great city !

translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ngab klim , — hynrei phi kylla ? Pi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei phi! luin ha ki templ ?
translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ki pyntha jong ka nongbud , lem Bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u Kaleb u khun jong u jynhaw kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof , gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .

translation.kha: Bad ïa ka dor ka jingtrei jong uwei pa wai u briew yn sa ïohi hajan ka Sngi U Khrist kan pynpaw ïa ka . Naba ha kata ka sngur , ka ding ka pynpaw ïa ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei ; ka ding kan tyngab ïa ka bad kan pyn-i ïa ka dor bashisha .
translation.en: Every man s work shall be made manifest : for the day shall declare it , because it shall be revealed by fire ; and the fire shall try every man s work of what sort it is .
But the midwives feared God , and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them , but saved the men children alive .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki nongpynkha khun ki dei kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei ; kumta kim shym kohnguh ïa u , hynrei ki shah ba ki khun shynrang kin im .

translation.en: At that time , saith the  Lord  , they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah , and the bones of his princes , and the bones of the priests , and the bones of the prophets , and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , out of their graves :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki shyieng jong ki syiem bad jong ki rangbah synshar ka Judah , kumjuh ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh , jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Jerusalem , yn khlong noh na ki jingtep jong ki .

Don uwei pat u ban ong , Ka jingbam ka dei na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka khrup na ka bynta ka jingbam . Iohi , hynrei U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam awria , hynrei ïa ka ban Sikhri ïa U Trai ; bad U Tlai u bsut ïa ka met .
translation.en: Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kiba la kha iing na ki maw , ki Langbrot bad ki phalang ym dei don thied pat ; ki long kiba la pynkyrpang shaei por , bad de Ban kñia ïa ki . Synreit ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan bad thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki kum ka jingainguh bim , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa ang .
translation.en: But the firstling of a cow , or the firstling of a sheep , or the firstling of a goat , thou shalt not redeem  ; they are holy : thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar , and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kuth U Trai u la pynkhia ba u Hadad , na ka longïing symboh jong u Edom , ban phai pyrshah ïa u Solomon .
translation.en: And the  Lord  stirred up an adversary unto Solomon , Hadad the Edomite : he was of the king s seed in Edom .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , bad U Tlai u la trei lem bad pynsawa ba ka jingïalap jongnga ki ka la long kaba pahara da ki kambah babha ki la leh .]
translation.en: And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .

translation.kha: Ngan ïam na ka bynta ki briew ka Sibmah , wat kham palat ban ïa ki briew ka Jaser . Ko ka nongbah Sibmah , pha long kumta u dieng sohwaiñ uba ki tnum jong u ki poi shaduh sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap bad jngai shaduh Jasper . jynreiñ mynta ïa ki sieh lyiur jongno pha bad ïa ki sohwaiñ jongngi phasi la pynjot .
translation.en: O vine of Sibmah , I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer : thy plants are gone over the sea , they reach even to the sea of Jazer : the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieid U Trai ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw kor Iso ba u la jied ïa phi nongput ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long haduh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .
translation.en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Hato don uno ine Uba kham matlah ban ïa u sharak jong nga , wahbah kham kylluid ban ïa u nonglamktien ba na phah ?
translation.en: Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?
And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
translation.kha: U la pyrkhat ,  Lada u Iso u wan ïaleh ïa kawei ka kynhun bad u pynjot ïa ka , kata kawei pat ka kynhun ka lah ban lait im .

translation.en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
translation.kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , hynrei kan ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong ,  Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham bit kham biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long mynta .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u mynsiem bymman na U Blei kynsan kynsan u ïoh tylli ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing la kum uba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , bad u Saul u bat ïa la u sum .
U la hukum ïa ki shakri ban pynsngap ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh lad u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta , bad nala ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U Trai u dang ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
When Israel was a child , then I loved him , and called my son out of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Mynba u Israel u dang khynnah , nga la ieit ïa u , bad nga la khot noh ïa u na Ijipt kum u khun jong nga .

translation.en: And the second day they compassed the city once , and returned into the camp : so they did six days .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba ar , ki ïaid tawiar biang ïa ka nongbah shisien bad nangta ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara . Ki la leh kumne haduh hynriew sngi .
Na ka bynta jngai me , ko khun jong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei kaba dei ka jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: kambah pynlong ïa ka pud sepngi . Hapoh kine ki pud sawdong ki shong ki sah ki briew katba na ki longïing u Judah .
translation.en: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .

translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tyllai kiew pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , Ibbah raikhoh bad ba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba riewkhraw ki la nguid noh ïa kiba tat .
translation.en: And , behold , seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .
For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba ïa ki ïing , ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ yn sa thied biang ha kane ka ri .
U pynbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u lytar rung Shobab ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam man ka snem thang malu ka snam ki mrad . Jamynrei U Kiriath um shym la rung shapoh ban kñia nongtuh ïa lade” bunsien .
translation.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others  ;

translation.kha: thawsha ïa ka iba da ka diengkhap akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon : of shittim wood shalt thou make it .

translation.kha: Katno uba Ïohi ïa ka u ïa-ong , Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kane kaei kamai ! Ym pat ju Jia mynno mynno kaba kum kane napoh ba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt ! Ngi den ban leh ei ei na ka bynta kane ! Kan jia aïu hadien ?
translation.en: And it was so , that all that saw it said , There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day : consider of it , take advice , and speak your minds .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing Ibbah kyrhuh khashor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh pynlang ki jingdon jingem katai kaba ki lah ba-bang ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap brisoh ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .
translation.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: hynrei , to leh ïa said ha ka jingjai jaijai bad da kaba burom . To Sumar khuid ïa ka jingïabam jong phi , khnang ba haba phi shah krenbeiñ , kita kiba kren sniew ïa ka jingsliang jingshim babha jongu pa’ kum ki nongbuaid jngai U Khrist kin Shah lehrain na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong .
translation.en: Having a good conscience  ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .

translation.kha: Ki khuid shynrang jong kito kiba la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan ban dem khrup ba burom ïa pha . Baroh kito Ibbah la ju ibeiñ ïa pha ktien dem ngon ha ki kjat jong phah . Kin Khot ïa phai , ‘ Ka Nongbishar U Trai ,’ ‘ Ka Seïon , ka nongbah U Balei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’
translation.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: uba la leit noh sha bneng bun u don ha ka kti kamon U Blei , da kaba synlar halor ki angel baroh bad ki nongsynshar pynlang ki bor ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God  ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .

translation.kha: ka Ophir , ka Habilah , sad ka Hobab . Kieng baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .
translation.en: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .

translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ka duriaw-bah ! La pynjot ïa ka nongbah kaba phi shaniah .
translation.en: Howl , ye ships of Tarshish : for your strength is laid waste .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u Ong , Phim shym leh satia ïa kane ha ka rukom kaba dei .
translation.en: And Moses  father in law said unto him , The thing that thou doest is not good .
You are so beautiful .
translation.kha: Phi bhabriew bha .

translation.en: And our adversaries said , They shall not know , neither see , till we come in the midst among them , and slay them , and cause the work to cease .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki pyrkhat ba ngin ym ïohi ïa ki ne tip ïa kaei kaba jia haduh ba ki la long halor jong ngi , ban pynïap ïa ngi bad ban pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi .

U Ahas u long syiem haba u la dap arphew snem ka rta , bad u synshar khyrwait sngi ha Jerusalem . Um shym la bud ïa ka nuksa babha jong u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Abda ; pynban u la leh ïa kadei ka bym pynsngewbha ïa U Trai bad u la bud ïa ka jingleit jong ki symboh Israel .
translation.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem : but he did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , like David his father :

translation.kha: Phim pat ju poh hangta mynshuwa , kumta kyang pyn-i ha phi ka lyngkot ba phin leit . Hynrei wat leit sha jan ka syndon ka jyntang ; pynjngut kamar shi kilomitar nadien jong ka .
translation.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba pha long kaba blang blem , ka sem shiteng lymne khraw , ngan na noh ïa pha na ka shyntur jong nga !
translation.en: So then because thou art lukewarm , and neither cold nor hot , I will spue thee out of my mouth .

translation.kha: Shisien uwei u briew u la wei sha U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , u la kylliang , kaei kob bha kambah ar dei ban leh ba ngan ïoh ïa ka jingim bymkut ?
translation.en: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?

translation.kha: Ngan shah katto katne ngut na ki ban lait im na ka sur-thma , ka nongshim , bad na ki jingpah , khnang ba hangthie hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kin sngewthuh haduh katno kiba ijli ki Long ki jingleh jong ki bad ngin pdiang ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence  ; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïaksaid , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïawad lem bad ki ;
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , katne kiba donbok Phin long ! Ki khmat jong phira ki ïohi bad ki shkor jong phi ki ïasngew .
translation.en: But blessed are your eyes , for they see : and your ears , for they hear .

translation.kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab , hato ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ïohi ba ha kaba kut ym to ei ei hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Me long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki pynrangbah jong me ban shaneng na kaba beh kohnguh ïa ngi ?
translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u Ong , Mynba ki Kpa tymmen jongu phoi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkheiñ ka jingpynjot ïa ki bad ngam shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei nga pynjop ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :

translation.kha: bad shibun ki jingjynjar kaba ishyrkhei kan wan ngat ha ki . Hynrei ïa kane ka jingrwai yn dang ïai rwai , bad ka tista ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . Wat mynta hi , shu ba ngan ïalam ïa ki shata kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , nga tip aïu ki pynkut .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when many evils and troubles are befallen them , that this song shall testify against them as a witness  ; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed : for I know their imagination which they go about , even now , before I have brought them into the land which I sware .

Ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , and my servant whom I have chosen : that ye may know and believe me , and understand that I am he : before me there was no God formed , neither shall there be after me .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , phi long ki sakhi jong nga ; nga la jied ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , khnang ba phin tip ïa nga bad ngeit ha nga bad sngewthuh ba nga long tang ma nga U Blei . Nalor jong nga ym don uwei pat u blei ; u bym pat ju long bad u ban nym long .

Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la Sangeh ; ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng ka la sahkut bad kam lah ba-bang khiar , katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la Shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki jingat phyllung bahakhlieh .
translation.en: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .
And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .
translation.kha: Te u Samson u rwai ,  Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , shihajar ngut nga pynïap ; Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kine ki brisoh ki la ai ïa ki dohnud jong ki ha ki Bealoth bad ki la shah ba ki blei kin ïalam ïa ki sha ka pop . Hangto ki pyrthuh ba ngan ai ha ki ka Jubab ?
translation.en: Son of man , these men have set up their idols in their heart , and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face : should I be enquired of at all by them ?

translation.kha: U Jakob u kyrkhu khublei bad u leit noh .
translation.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from before Pharaoh .
And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .
translation.kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïap noh .
Kiwei pat , kim ïalap ïa U Khrist da kaba sngur , Hynrei na ka mynsiem ka jingkwah rhah ; ba ki da pyut ba kin nang pynjynjar shuh shuh ïa nga katba nga sdang kein ha byndi .
translation.en: But the other of love , knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel .
That I may know him , and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , being made conformable unto his death ;
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga kwah ka long ba ngan ithuh ïa U Khrist bad ban mad ïa ka bor ka jingmihpat jong u , ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshahshitom jong u , bad ban long kum ma u ha ka jingïap jong u ,
Ka dei tyngkan ka mynsiem kaba hapoh u briew hi , kaba tip ïa baroh shaphang jong u ; ha kwah ka rukom , Tang U Mynsiem U Blei , uba tip ïa baroh shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa Phi , ka jingshai sngewbang kaba ai ha kaba rieh ka pynjem jai ïa u .
translation.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .

translation.kha: U ong , Baroh ki nongïalam , kiba dei ban mawjam ïa ki briew jong nga , ki long kiba matlah ! Kim tip ei ei . Ki long kumin ki sew-ap ki bym ju wiar — ki shu thiah bad phohsniew . Katno ki sngewtynnat ban thiah !
translation.en: His watchmen are blind : they are all ignorant , they are all dumb dogs , they cannot bark  ; sleeping , lying down , loving to slumber .
And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïalumlang ban shahjingit ban pynpaw ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki jaiñ khain bad sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki ïeng bad sdang ban phla ïa ki pop kiba ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .
To ïathuh ïa moi , shano ka un-long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ba ngi dei ban siew khajna sha u Patsha ka Hima Rom , ne kumne ?
translation.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar , or no ?

translation.kha: Lada phi! shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lymne ïa u Ephron u khun jrong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkhot jrong u .
translation.en: And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi khang ïa ka jingkhang sha ka Hima ki bneng na khmat ki briew , hynrei ma phi da lade hi phim leit rung shapoh , lymne ba phi shah shapoh ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung !

Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki kynhun Jeriel kaba dih na ka jait Judah , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong nga kaba ha ki lumbah . Ki briew ba la jied jong nga , babha shakri ïa la , kin shong hangta .
translation.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains : and mine elect shall inherit it , and my servants shall dwell there .

translation.kha: Me la ïada ïa ngi ha kaba mynhyndai , kumta te to wat bitar thuh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka longsem ka nongap jong me , u lum bakyntang jongngi me . Baroh ki briew ha ki ri ba-ima ki khmih beiñ ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jongu me namar ki nongpop jong ngi bad ka jingbymman ba ki kpa tymmen Jong ngi ki la leh .
translation.en: O Lord , according to all thy righteousness , I beseech thee , let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem , thy holy mountain : because for our sins , and for the iniquities of our fathers , Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us .

translation.kha: Ki pynpyiar la ki thapniang bad khiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba nga dang peit ïa ki , bad ki shitrhem ki bud lang ïa ki . Ki sangeh shiphang ha ka pha kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngam ka shong halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria jong ka Damaskos ki phah ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u syiem Hadadeser , u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
Hato phi kynmaw haei u Tom u ieh ka shatri ?
translation.en: Do you remember where Tom left his umbrella ?
We are bound to thank God always for you , brethren , as it is meet , because that your faith groweth exceedingly , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth ;
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi . Ka long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh kumta , namar ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka la san shikatdei eh bad ba ka jingieit kaba iwei pa iwei na phi , phi don na ka bynta kiwei pat ka la nang kham khraw .
Na phan ïa ki jingkhublei ïa ka Pukri bad u Akwila , ki para nongtrei jong nga ha ka jingshakri ïa U Khrist jongu ;
translation.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus :
Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien lai sngi . U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u ban mihpaw ,

U Dabid u ai hukum , bad ki shipai jong u ki la pynpoh ïa u Rekhab bad ïa u Baanah bad ki la ot ïa ki kti bad ki kjat Jong ki , ïa kiba ki la sdien hajan ka pung ha Hebron . Ki la shim ïa ka khlieh jong u Jotbathah bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u Abner hangtai ha Hebron .
translation.en: And David commanded his young men , and they slew them , and cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ish–bosheth , and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .
translation.kha: Shaphang mihngi , don hynriew ngut ki nongap phira man la ka sngi ; shaphang shatei , bad shaphang shathie , saw ngut saw ngut la buh na ka bynta ka kamra buh tiar .
Nangta kato u dang ïam kumta , u nap u doh sa ïa ki hynmen Jong u baroh ; hawei kata , ki Ahiman jong u ki sa ïakren ïakhana bad u .
translation.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them : and after that his brethren talked with him .

translation.kha: Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shangkhawiah kum U te uba dei peit ïa ka ïing U Blei . Ngi long ka ïing jong u lada ngi ïaishah ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kabu ngi kylli .
translation.en: But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .

translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ban ïaleh thma , bad ka jingot halor ki nongshun jong ang .
translation.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :
translation.kha: U la ïohi ba la plie ïa ka bneng bad kaei re kawei kaba wan hiar kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: The  Lord  is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u synshar halor ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka burom jong u ka don halor ki bneng .
U don ka dakmong ha mait kamon .
translation.en: He has a bruise on his right leg .
So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , bad uwei pa uwei u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jong ka jaka .

translation.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;
translation.kha: U la shem ba u Jakob u la kohnguh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .
Te u la mihnoh nangta dara u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , da kaba kitei sha Bethel .
translation.en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el , unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Beth–el and Ai  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa babha la kular ïa ka jingsuh ïa kito kiba da siewdor ïa ki , hynrei ki byrngem da ka thma ïa tun ki bym siew .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .

translation.kha: Kumta u la jubab , Kane ka smat , te , ba uwei pa uwei u nonghikai Aiñ uba long u synran hapoh ka Hoham ki bneng u hir khim u trai jong ka ïong uba la sei shakor ïa kaei kiei bakha thymmai bad kiba rim napoh ka dom kynshew jong u .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .

translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïoh ïa u , u la kylli ïa U Jisu , Ko Trai , Kumno shaphang a u briew ?
translation.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?

translation.kha: Lydda phi kohnguh ïa ki praw U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa bakha nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , lada phi ieit ïa u , lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad lada Phi Sumar ïa ki saiñ jongnga u , phin manbha bad phan long ruh ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid . U Trai U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa Phin ha —kata ka ri ba phan ïohkynti .
translation.en: In that I command thee this day to love the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments , that thou mayest live and multiply : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei na ka bynta jong ki , namar ki la khuslai bad kim lah ban leh ei ei , kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .

translation.en: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :
translation.kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki lumbah , ha shuwa ban pynïeng ïa ki lumrit ,

translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How then doth David in spirit call him Lord , saying ,
translation.kha: Balei , te ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  ba U Mynsiem u pynshlur ïa Dabid ban khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai’ ? U Dabid u la ong ,

Da shisha kiba kum kine ki kyndok ki i kitab la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymdei , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka soh .
translation.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .
And Saul arose from the earth  ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .
translation.kha: U Saul u la khie joit na madan bad u la peit , hynrei um lah ban ïohi ei ei . Kumta ki la shim ïa u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha Damaskos .
Ïa kine baroh ngan ai ha me , u Soitan u la ong , lada nam dem khohsiew badno mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And saith unto him , All these things will I give thee , if thou wilt fall down and worship me .
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki sngap ïa ki jingmut kiba sniew , bad ki nongshukor ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .
Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ai hynñiew tylli ki smai lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shyieng , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka ther , ki bym dat kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa U Trai , bad ruh ban tei ka ïongjngum na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .

translation.kha: U Kush u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Nimrod ; uba la long u nongap pyrthei uba khynraw banyngkong eh .
translation.en: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga dang sngew Shaniah ïa phira . Ka jingshim jong ngi ha U Trai , ka pyntong ïa nga ban sngewskhem ba phin ym shim da kumwei pat bad uta u briew uba pynkulmar ïa phi , la u long uei uwei , un shah pynshitom ha U balui .
translation.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .

To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they offer in the open field , even that they may bring them unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest , and offer them for peace offerings unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingmut jong kane ka hukum ka long ba naduh mynta ki Israel ki dei ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ki mrad ba ki ju pynïap ha lum ha wah . Mynta ki dei ban wallam ïa ki ha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ bad pynïap ïa ki kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
Kumta u Abram u ong ha u Lot , Ki briew jong me bad ki briew lad nga ktien dei ban ïakajia , namar ngi ïalong shi ïingjaiñ shi sem .
translation.en: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee , between me and thee , and between my herdmen and thy herdmen  ; for we be brethren .

translation.kha: Hato phi pyllait ba per la tad ïajah ïa ka ri jongu phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap jong U Trai ? U Trai da laiñ hi u noh ha nga banbeiñ tad ïaleh bad ban pynjot ïa ka .
translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .

translation.kha: Kane ka mut ban ïathuh ha u ha ka jingduwai ba jar jar marwei , ba phi aiti ïalade ha u ban leh ïa ka mon jngai u .—Sekharaiah 16 :24 ; 22 :37 .
translation.en: This means that in a personal , private prayer you tell him that you are giving yourself to him to do his will .—Matthew 16 :24  ; 22 :37 .
These were born unto the giant in Gath  ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine ki lai ngut kiba la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , ki long kiba hiarpateng na ki ramhah ha Gath .

U Trai u ong ha u Aaron , Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi duh , phin iphuh shad ïa kiei kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Krit jong ar , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me ngin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .

translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .

translation.kha: Kiei pat ki kynhun jong ki Lebi , ka kur Gershon , ka ïohpateng ar tylli ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha mihngi : ka Golan ha Bashan ( kadei na ki nongbeh jakarieh ) sad ka Bethnimrah lem sad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs  ; two cities .

translation.kha: Shah ngin ïaid na ka ri jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri ngin ym leit sakma na ka lynti lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki briew sohwaiñ jong phi ; bad ngin ym dih um na ki riphin jongno phi ; ngin ïaid beit na lyngkot baher haduh ba ngim da maji na ka ri jyllang phi .
translation.en: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards  ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king s high way , until we be past thy borders .

Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
translation.kha: To ai hukum , te , ba yn da ap phira biang biang ïa ka jingtep jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khnang ba ki synran jong u kin ym lah ban leit ban tuh ïa ka met , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap . Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba nyngkong .
U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha , um dei ban leit phai pat sha ïing na ka byndi ka jaiñkup .
translation.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment .

translation.kha: Ban ïoh jingbymman naba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt bad Israhaïah .
translation.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .

translation.kha: La ñiew ïa ine kumin ka synrum lad ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kynja beiñ haduh kane ka khyllipmat !
translation.en: Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .
Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles , and shalt suck the breast of kings : and thou shalt know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem kin sumar ïa pha , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa la ki khun jong ka . Phan sa tip ba nga U  Trai  , nga la pyllait ïa pha , ba U Blei Bakhrawbor ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa pha .

translation.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .
translation.kha: Ka kur Gershon ka ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Issakhar , Asher , Naphtali , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .

translation.en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .
translation.kha: Lada nga la kwah ban sngewsarong , ngan ym jin da la long uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei ngan ym kob sarong , namar ngam kwah mano mano ban don ka jingpyrkhat ba kham halor ïa nga ban ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi ba nga leh lane u la ïohsngew ïa kaba nga ong .

translation.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;
translation.kha: U Darius u nong Mid , uba long u khun jong u Serksis , u la synshar ïa ka hima Babilonia .

Nangta u Syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw kum ka jinglehburom ïa ka Esther bad khop sngewma ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar bad nongpynïaidkam . U la pynbna shuti ha ka hima baroh kawei nabar ai ki jingai sngewbha kiba shongkhlad kum ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .

translation.kha: U Joïada u dei u khunlung jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh , hynrei wai na ki khun jong u Joïada u la shongkurim ïa ka kynhun jong u Sanballat na ka shang Beh Horon , kumta nga la pynlong ba u Joïada un mihnoh na Jerusalem .
translation.en: And one of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite : therefore I chased him from me .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ph ïa ka khyndew ha Kaba kitab shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba phim shym la tei . mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam-im ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kine shym thung , bad ki soh Olib na ki dieng kiba phim syiem sting .’
translation.en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .

translation.kha: U jubab , Nga kein ka jingïakut bad u Mikah , u da sarew ïa nga ba ngan shakri kum u lyngdoh jongnga u .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me , and hath hired me , and I am his priest .

translation.kha: Nga la hap sha madan bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kob ong ha nga , ‘ Saul , Saul ! barli me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?’
translation.en: And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .
translation.kha: Mynta ba ka por ka jingngeit ka la poi , ka Hukum kam donbor shuh halor jong ngi .
U Blei u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga leh ; u ïohi lad ka leit skum ba nga jem .
translation.en: Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?
And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there was none like it , nor shall be like it any more .
translation.kha: Kan don ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , ka bym pat ju don mynno mynno kaba kum kata lane ka ban ym don shuh lano lano .
phi throsh eiei ianga ?
translation.en: Did you buy me anything ?

translation.kha: Mynmiet hir ki briew ki dang ïohthiah , U blei u kren ha ki jingphohsniew bad jingïohipaw .
translation.en: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falleth upon men , in slumberings upon the bed  ;
And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi kin wan phai pat sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: My fruit is better than gold , yea , than fine gold  ; and my revenue than choice silver .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me ïoh na nga ka kham bha ban ïa ka ksiar banylla , ka kham bha ban ïa ka rupa kaba kynsai .

Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumta ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Sior kiba nongjapan mihngi jngai ka wah Ïuphratis badno buh ïa ki ioh ka jingïamai sah” u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipawa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sorah .
translation.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .
translation.kha: Da ki jingsmai ba bunsien u la ong ha ka ,  Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha kano kano kaba pha pan , wat haduh shiteng ka hima jong nga !

translation.en: For they are life unto those that find them , and health to all their flesh .
translation.kha: Ki long ka jingim bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ïa uno uno uba sngewthuh ïa ki .
halor ki lum ka Israel ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ïarap ! Kiba shlur den na ki shipai jong ngi , ki la kyllon !
translation.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places : how are the mighty fallen !
I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .
translation.kha: Naba wat ba phi la tip ïa kane baroh , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phi ba kumno U Trai u la pyllait im shisien ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei hadien , u la pynjot ïa kito ki bym shym la ngeit .
Lada u briew u ïakdang ha lum ïa ka briew kaba la ïateh bad uwei pat u briew , malu u batbor ïa ka , dei ban pynïap tang ïa uta u shynrang .
translation.en: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field , and the man force her , and lie with her : then the man only that lay with her shall die :
And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother s fury turn away  ;
translation.kha: Khie leit noh kumne hi sha u Laban u hynmen jong nga ha Haran , bad sah bad u shipor , tad haduh ba ka jingbitar u hynmen jong me kan pjah , bad ba u klet noh ïa kata kaba me la leh ïa u .

Wat nym duh noh ïa ka jingsynshar ne sheptieng namar ki khohruh lamler ba phi ïohsngew . Man ka snam ki khubor lamler bapher ki phrang — ki khor lamler! shaphang ka jinglehbeiñ ha ka ri bad ba uwei u syiem u ïaleh ïa uwei pud .
translation.en: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land  ; a rumour shall both come one year , and after that in another year shall come a rumour , and violence in the land , ruler against ruler .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan wallam ïa u syiem bakhraw tam na bhor — u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia — baneh tur ïaleh ïa ka tyrsim . Un wan na Shaphang shatei ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai babun , lem malade ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , a king of kings , from the north , with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .

translation.kha: Tob ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
Concerning Kedar , and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite , thus saith the  Lord   ; Arise ye , go up to Kedar , and spoil the men of the east .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka jait Kedar bad ïa ki distrik hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Hasor , ïa kiba la jop thma da u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia :  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Kedar bad pynjot ïa kata ka jait jong ki briew na mihngi !
Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha Ijipt bad ki ïalum ïa ki Nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Nalorkata U ijuh u la ong skhem ïa u bad phah noh ïa kumta hi ,
translation.en: And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away  ;
A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes .
translation.kha: U syiem u shong ban bishar bad u tip ïa kaba sniew haba u ïohi ïa ka .

translation.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die ? saith the Lord  God  : and not that he should return from his ways , and live ?
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga kmen ban ïohi ba ki briew kiba sniew ki ïap ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kylli .  Em , nga kham mon ban ïohi ïa ki ba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki im .
Un wanrah ïa u ha u lyngdoh , u ban shim Shi kham na u kumta ka dak ba la ainguh sha U Trai , bad un thang ïa u ha ka duwan kum ka jingkieng ainguh bam . Ka long ka jingkñia ban pynkhuid ïa ka pop .
translation.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it , even a memorial thereof , and burn it on the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: U tharai u la ong , Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka sma lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingpang . Hynrei uno uno uba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingbitar jong nga , yn ym don u banbeiñ shong shun sah ha Babilon ; kan sah ha ka jingjied , bad baroh kiba ïaid nongtih kin kyndit bad lyngngoh .
translation.en: Because of the wrath of the  Lord  it shall not be inhabited , but it shall be wholly desolate : every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong , Ngan ai ha phasi buiñ ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba da ban ñiup ïa ki .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u ka ban neh jingdum lada u ïai kohnguh tyngka ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh kumba u leh mynta .’
translation.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ruh ba u Laban um da leh jan Shuah ïa u Rumah mynshuwa .
translation.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .

translation.kha: Phi dih ïa ka ding , phi kup ki jaiñ-jin ba la thai na u saiwul , phi pynïap bad bah na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynriew phim ju sumar bha ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .

And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war , even four hundred thousand chosen men : Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , being mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U Abijah u pynkhreh ka kynhun shipai kaba don saw lakh ngut , bad u Jeroboam u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u da ka kynhun shipai kaba don phra lakh ngut .
Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh khih katta! jaka bad ki la ong , Kumno une u briew u tip katne katne haba um patan ju Ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?
translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it  ; for their wickedness is come up before me .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah kaba khraw , bad to kren pyrshah ïa ka ; nga tip haduh katno kiba bymman ki briew jong ka ki long .
bun katno ka jingkhraw eh long kata ka bor kaba trei ha ngi kiba ngeit .
translation.en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe , according to the working of his mighty power ,

translation.kha: Naba ar erlangthari U Trai U Blei jrong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , uba pynim ïa phi . Ngan kynta ïa ka Ijipt ban pyllaitluid ïa phi ; ngan kyntait ïa ka Sudan bad ka Seba .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  thy God , the Holy One of Israel , thy Saviour : I gave Egypt for thy ransom , Ethiopia and Seba for thee .

translation.kha: bad ba phi la pynbeit ba kato katto-katne ki nongïathuhlypa kin pynbynta ha Jeremaïah ba phi long u syiem ka Judas . U syiem , khlem pep , un ïohsngew shaphang kano , kumne sa ai jingmut ba ma phoi bad la ngin ïakynduh ban ïakren shalor kane ka kam .
translation.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem , saying , There is a king in Judah : and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let us take counsel together .
Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?
translation.kha: Nga long hok , A Blei . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jong nga . Ym don mano mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba nga ong .

translation.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him , and gave it to David , and his garments , even to his sword , and to his bow , and to his girdle .
translation.kha: U law ïa ka jaiñkup ba u phong bad u ai ïa ka ha u Dabid , ryngkat bad ka jingkieng atiar jong u bad ruh ïa ka waitlam , ka ryntieh , bad u panpoh jong u .

translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la rwai ïa ka jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child , which am old ?
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Balei ka Sarah ka rkhie bad ong , ‘ Hato ngan dang ïoh khun shisha haba nga la tymmen ?’
u Dabid u ju iehnoh ïa ki malade u leit phai sha Bethlehem na kaweh ka por shiah kawei pat ba-bang sharai ïa ki langbrot u kper jong u .
translation.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father s sheep at Beth–lehem .
For she said , If I may touch but his clothes , I shall be whole .
translation.kha: da kaba ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong u , ngan ïohkhiah .

La katta shwa , nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jingrang mynsiem . Hynriew , kam long ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei lynti lad ki bor kiba synshar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki bor ki ban sa hajuh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :

translation.kha: To lymne , ko ka khyndew bad ka sahit bneng ! To kyrhuh , ko ka ïarwai bad baroh ki jingthaw ba don ha pha ;
translation.en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .

translation.kha: ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katei katne na ki , ktien longsyiem ki syiem . Men ïoh shibun ki khun ki ksiew bakha yn sa long ki jingtipbriew .
translation.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .
And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan , in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood : and they are there unto this day .
translation.kha: U Joshua u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw hapdeng jong ka Jordan , ha kaba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïeng . ( Kito ki maw ki dang don hangta . )

Hynrei ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym kohnguh ïa U Tlai bad u Manasseh u la ïalam ïa ki ban har waiñ ïa ki pop babha khem khraw ban ïa pli kiba la leh ïa ki jingpyniwbih ibha U TRAI’ u la beh napoh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki puta shaphrang .
translation.en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .
And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen  ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u la ong .  Nga tip ba phi ïawad ïa U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba la sahnarphna . Um don hangne — u la mihpat ! Ha khmih , hangne ka jaka ha kaba ki la buh ïa u .

Ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ; ki la katei ïa baroh kaba me la bor ; ki la klet noh ïa ki kambah uba me la leh . Ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki la jied u jingïalam ban ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei me long U Blei uba map ; me long uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingkheit , kiba suki ban bitar . Ka jingsiew jong me ka long kaba khriat ; mem shngiam ingiew ïa ki .
translation.en: And refused to obey , neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them  ; but hardened their necks , and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage : but thou art a God ready to pardon , gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and forsookest them not .

translation.kha: Uwei u nongbah phira kaba ïng halor ka jakarieh ap phiah ha Jesreel u la ïohi ïa u Jehu bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wang , Nga ïohi shi kynhun ki shipai , u la pyrta . U khohram u jubab , Phah uwei u nongshong kyllaiñ don pynthiah la ki dat ki paralok ne ki nongshniah .
translation.en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel , and he spied the company of Jehu as he came , and said , I see a company . And Joram said , Take an horseman , and send to meet them , and let him say , Is it peace ?

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Na ka boitha jyllang phi ngi la long ha ka jingma jong ka jingïalap ha ki por baroh ; la leh ïa ngi kumno ïa ki langbrot ba la ïalumlang sha ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: As it is written , For thy sake we are killed all the day long ; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter .

translation.kha: Ka ong ha u , Lada phi la kular ha U Trai , leh ïa per kumba phin la klun ba leh , naba U Trai u la ai ha phi ba phin pynhiarkput ïa ki Ammon , ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: And she said unto him , My father , if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the  Lord  , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth  ; forasmuch as the  Lord  hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies , even of the children of Ammon .
I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .
translation.kha: Ngam treh ban kyntait ïa ka jingaiei U Blei . Hynrei lada la pynksan ïa u briew ha U Blei da ka Hukum , ka mut ba U Khrist u la ïap lehnoh-ei!
Katto katne ngut ki nonglum khajna ki la wan ban shah pynbaptis , badno ki la kylli ïa u , Ko nonghikai , kaei ba sem dei ban leh ?
translation.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized , and said unto him , Master , what shall we do ?

translation.kha: Ka jingpyrkhat ïa ka jingpang jong nga , ka jingbymdon ïing jong nga , ka un-long ka bih bakthang .
translation.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .

translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u la phah ka khubor don ïathuh ha u syiem Jehiskaïah kaba ïajubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem .
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :
Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew ; u kynjrat ïa ki païa kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .
translation.kha: U Saul u khot lang ïa ki ha Besek : ki rangbah Israel ki don lai lakh ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .

translation.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people , his disciples asked him concerning the parable .
translation.kha: Haba u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad leit sha la ïing , ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ban batai ïa kane ka jingong .
Hato ki kynjoh mawsiang jong ka Lebanon ki ju hir khlaw ka ïor ? Hato ki ïabuaid ba dait-thah na ki lumbah ki ju rngad ?
translation.en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field ? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken ?
And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .
translation.kha: U la batai ,  Ko Daniel , nga la wan hangne ban ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka jingïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe : for there is no difference :
translation.kha: U Blei u pynlong ka hok bad ki briew lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki ha U Jisu Khrist . U Blei u leh ïa kane ïa baroh kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , namar ym don satia kano kano ka jingïapher :

translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit bad u .
Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih katba ïadait bad ki jingainguh bam . U lyngdoh na ki khun shynrang u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingnguh bam sha U Trai ha khmat ka duwan .
translation.en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .
translation.kha: Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri ,  Ha khmih , ka lyngkha u Joab ka don markhap bad ka jong nga , bad ka don u barli uba mih ha ka . Khie leit bad wiang ding ïa ka .  Kumta ki la leit bad wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha .

translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , to be set by the four corners of it  ; even two rings upon the one side of it , and two rings upon the other side of it .
translation.kha: U thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .
translation.kha: Nga bishni ïa kito kiba la ïap bad kiba la leit noh ; ki long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba dang im .
Nangta ngi la kitei na ryngkew Sha Philippi , ka nongpang jong ka distrik banyngkong lad ka Makedonia ; kaba longsyiem ruh ka kyntoit shnong jong ki nong Rom . ngin la pyndkut bun sngi Hangne .
translation.en: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .

translation.kha: Ka jingainguh bam baroh ïa kaba la syang ha diengïap , lane ïa kaba la sieh ha ka karai lane ha u khiew ba la tap ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei .
translation.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven , and all that is dressed in the fryingpan , and in the pan , shall be the priest s that offereth it .

translation.kha: Kumta pynkhreh kadei ka kada thymmai bad ar tylli ki masi kynthei ha kiba ym pat ju pyndait lyngkor ; teh ïa ki ha sier ka kali , bad ïalam noh ïa ki kynhun masi sha sem .
translation.en: Now therefore make a new cart , and take two milch kine , on which there hath come no yoke , and tie the kine to the cart , and bring their calves home from them :

translation.kha: Ki la ïasaid najan ka khang ap phira kaba jingsuh bad nongap ïa kaba ar , pynlang ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nar kaba lam sha ka nongbet . Ka khmied ka la peiñ hi na ka bynta jong ki , bad ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïaid ha ka lynti ba-eh , bad kynsan u ebanjelist u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .
translation.en: When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .

translation.kha: bad na katai ka jaka ki la leit pat da ka lieng sha Antiokh , ka jaka ha kaba la aiti ha ki ha ka jingsynshar jong ka jingaiei Jong U Blei na ka bynta ka kam kaba mynta ki la pyndih .
translation.en: And thence sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled .
But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the  Lord  , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines : for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel .
translation.kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ba kane baroh ka dei na U  Trai  , naba U  Trai  u wad ka lad ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ki Israel .
Anab ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ïa u brisoh uba nyngkong , u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ; hynrei u Adam uba khatduh u la long U Mynsiem uba ai jingkem .
translation.en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .

translation.kha: U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bun ki ba-ïashun ha-sem jong u kpa jong u ; u la ïap noh ibha u la dap shispah Shiphew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki paid Israel kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Kumta ki la kylli ïa u , Kaei ngi lah ban ni khnang ban ïoh bor ïa kaei ka U Blei u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do , that we might work the works of God ?

translation.kha: Lymda u sait ïa kata bad ka jingtynjuh ka ja noh , u dei pun sait bneng ïa ka sa shisien , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .
translation.en: And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Gideon u kylli ïa u Shabeh bad ïa u Salmone , Kumno shaphang ki briew babha phi la pynïap ha Tabor ? Ki jubab , Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei na ki u syriem ïa u khuid jong u syiem .
translation.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .

translation.kha: Une u long uta U Jisu u nongïathuhlypa , uba na Nasareth ha Galilaïa , ki paidbah ki la jyllop .
translation.en: And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .

translation.kha: U Lebi u la ïingjaiñ joit , u la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei barben bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And he left all , rose up , and followed him .

translation.kha: Phi lah ba bam ïa ki ha ïing . Baroh na phi , la phi long kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates : the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike , as the roebuck , and as the hart .
Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .
translation.kha: Da phikir kumno phi pyrkhat ; naba ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ki saiñdur ïa ka jingim jong phi .

translation.en: Yea , ye yourselves know , that these hands have ministered unto my necessities , and to them that were with me .
translation.kha: Phi hi phi ïatip ba nga la trei da kine ki kti jong nga ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei kaba ki paralok jong nga bad ma nga ngi donkam .

translation.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh kumba u Elijah u la ong ïa ka , bad baroh na ki , ki dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .
Lada kata ka Hukum , kob wallam ïa ka jingïap haba la pyntreikam ïa ka , ka la wan ha katei kata ka burom , kaba katno tam ka burom kaba kham khraw ka long kata ka jingieit jongngi U Mynsiem!
translation.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious ?

And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and , behold , a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , kynsan ki la ïohi shi kynhun ki nong Ishmael kiba wan ïaid lynti na Gilead sha Ijipt . Ïa ki ut jong ki la pynkit ïa ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih .

translation.en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba un phah shabar ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung shapoh ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . Kan ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingjot .
Ka ïing jong pha ka long ka duriaw . Ki nongtei jong pha ki la shna ïa pham kum ka liengbah kaba pynitynnat ;
translation.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas , thy builders have perfected thy beauty .

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew ka la sdang ban khiew , bad ki la sdang ban pyrkhat la u Ïoannis lehhok u lah ban dei U Messaïah .
translation.en: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not  ;
Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse , and said , Send me David thy son , which is with the sheep .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jesse ban ong ,  Phah ïa u khun jong me u Dabid , uto uba sharai ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw ngi la poi sha ka jaka ba la khot , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , ka bym da jngai na ka shnong Lasaïa .
U syiem Ahab , u la hiar sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki khuslai nabar ki kali ïapom , bad u jlop thiaw ïa ki nong Syria .
translation.en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .

translation.kha: U Un uba pyrshang ban lait na ka jingshyrkhei un hap hapoh ki lyoh , bad uno uno uba kiew na ki liewlep un ngat ha ki jingriam , namar U Trai u la nguh por na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ka Moab .
translation.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for I will bring upon it , even upon Moab , the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai hi un ïalamwir ïa me bad un Don ryngkat bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta kad syier Bad wat sheptieng .
