translation.en: And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u , Ka kyrteng jong me ka dat u ïakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long noh U Jesreel . Kumta U Blei u la khot Kyrteng ïa u , u Israel .
translation.en: And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .

translation.kha: Phi kiba bieit ! Hato phi kiaw ban da pyn-i ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long ka bymmyntoi ?
translation.en: But wilt thou know , O vain man , that faith without works is dead ?

translation.kha: Ïa phi baroh yn pynkhlaiñbor — ma phi kiba ong ba u dieng u dei u kpa jong phi bad ba u mawlynnai u dei ka kmen jongki phi . Kane kan jia namar ba phi la phai noh na nga ha ka jaka ba phin phai sha nga . Hynrei Haba phi dat ha ka jingjynjar , phi kyrpad ïa nga ban wan Bad pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Saying to a stock , Thou art my father  ; and to a stone , Thou hast brought me forth : for they have turned their back unto me , and not their face : but in the time of their trouble they will say , Arise , and save us .

translation.kha: ka lawbah , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long sawphew khyndai thyllah ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongtrei kiba don Sdang jong ki .
translation.en: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :
Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki shim katto katne na ki jinglute ba ki ïohknieh ha ka thma bad pynkyntang ïa ki ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
Bad tharai u paralok jongu phi un jyllop Neah ïing , ‘ Wat pynïeng ïa nga ! Ïa ka jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban kaei bad ai ei ei ha phi .’
translation.en: And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .
But when the time of the promise drew nigh , which God had sworn to Abraham , the people grew and multiplied in Egypt ,
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la nang jan na ka bynta U Blei ban bat ïa ka kular kaba u la kular ha u Abraham , ka jingdon jong ki briew jong ngi ha Ijipt ka la roi bun shah .
U Trai u la pynshitom jur ïa ki nongïam Ashdod mala u pyntriem ïa ki . U la pynsum ïa ki bad ïa ki biria sawdong ka ri da kaweh pynmih ha ki ïa ka jingpang thung .
translation.en: But the hand of the  Lord  was heavy upon them of Ashdod , and he destroyed them , and smote them with emerods , even Ashdod and the coasts thereof .

translation.kha: U Gedalaïah u la ong ïa ki , Nga ai ïa phi ïa la ka ktah ba kam donbok ïa phi ban sheptieng don pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , to shongduh ha Kane ka ri , to shakri ïa u syiem ka Babilonia , bad baroh ka bha ïa phi .
translation.en: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying , Fear not to serve the Chaldeans : dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you .
Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynthei ka Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa kiba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka kyiad !
bad Ladan phi mon ban ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ki , u Ïingjaiñ u long u Eli , uba ïa ka jingwan jong u la ïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias , which was for to come .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki Rangbah synshar ki la poi , kim shym shem ïa ki apostol ha byndi , kumta ki la wan phai noh sha ka Dorbar badno ki la ïathuh ,
translation.en: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , kumno uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa kawei kaba phi kren lada ka khubor Jong phira ha ki thylliej bapher kam long kaba shai ? Ki katei jong phi kin jah noh ha suiñ!
translation.en: So likewise ye , except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood , how shall it be known what is spoken ? for ye shall speak into the air .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki phetwir ïap na ki Judia , bad U Bela u shah ïa ki Judia ban thombor ïa ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .
And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki ïalaw noh ïa la ki sohshkor ksiar bad ki wallam ïa ki ha u Aaron .
U Mikah u Ong , Shong noh bad nga . Long u nongaibuit nabar u lyngdoh jong nga , bad ngan ai ïa pa shiphew ki shai reng shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbam ïa phi .
translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .

translation.kha: Khmut ki briew ki la ïor ïa ki tnat bad shna ïa ki ïingtrep halor ki tnum ïing ba madan jong ki ïing jong ki , ha la ki jaka , ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , bad ha ki jaka paidbah mawdong hasem ka Khyrdop Um bad khatsan ka Khyrdop Hapharaim .
translation.en: So the people went forth , and brought them , and made themselves booths , every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .
Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .
translation.kha: To ïa-ap bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka mon , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

translation.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad u Jonadab ki la leit shapoh ban ai ki jingkñia bad jingainguh thang sha u Baal . U la pyn-ap phraphew ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbthah ïa ki :  Phi dei ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew baroh ; uno uno na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un siewdor ïa ka da la ka jong ka jingim !

kata ka long , ym ka jingïalam jong phoi , hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong uta uwei pat u briew . Kumta , te , don u ban kylli , balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jongno nga ban leh ïa kaei kaei la Buh pud da ka jingïalang jong uwei pat ?
translation.en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?

translation.kha: Nangne ïa ka pyrda kaba la wah hapoh ka Templ la kam arliang Naduh khlieh haduh tbit . Ka khyndew ka la khynñiuh , ki mawshun ki pra la ka jong ka jyllang ,
translation.en: And , behold , the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom  ; and the earth did quake , and the rocks rent  ;

translation.kha: To shad , to shad , ko thlim ka Shullam . Shah ïa im’ ban plied ïa phi Kaba phi dang sharud . Baalah phi kwah ban khmied ïa nga Katba nga dang shad hapdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?
translation.en: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .

translation.kha: Ka la don hangta lai bnai , bad U Trai u kyrkhu ïa u Obed Edom bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And the ark of the  Lord  continued in the house of Obed–edom the Gittite three months : and the  Lord  blessed Obed–edom , and all his household .
And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it , when ye have heaved from it the best of it : neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .
translation.kha: Haba phi la wanrah ïa kaba bha tam sha U  Trai  , phim long kiba shah rem haba phi bam ïa ka . Hynrei da sumar ban ym pyntngit ïa ki jingai kiba khuid jong ki Israel da kaba bam ïa kino kino ki jingai shuwa kaba ai ïa kaba bha tam . Lada phi leh kumta , yn pynïap ïa phi .
Hadien ba ki la peh ha ka jingïamynjur lai shaphang kata , ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka Lyngkha u Nongthaw kiaw , kum ka jaka thup ïa ki nongthain .
translation.en: And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter s field , to bury strangers in .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Jerusalem halor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Isaia ki la shah pynïap hangthie bad kaba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la pait ïap .
translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .

And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which she had brought unto the king . So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka Sheba kat ïa kaba ka pan . Kane ka long nalor kaei kaba u la ai markylliang ha ka na ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha kiba ka la wanrah ïa u . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki la leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
U blem u la khang ïa ka lynter , bad ngam lah banbeiñ ïaid lyndang ; u la buhrieh ïa ka lynti jong nga ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .

And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na ka ri shyiap Sin , da kaba ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ka jaka kat kum ka hukum U  Trai . Ki la sher dara ha Rephidim , hynrei ym don umdih hangta .

translation.en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ? Khmih ïa kito kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki paid Israel ki leh hangne , ban beh noh ïa nga sha jngai bad kham sha jngai na ka jaka bakhuid jong nga . Men dang ïohi shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham jahburom ban ïa kane .
U Tharai u long u syiem , sad ki briew kine khynñiuh . U shong ha ka khet Hamor ki kherub , bad ka pyrthei kan khynñiuh .
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the people tremble : he sitteth between the cherubims  ; let the earth be moved .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrang bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga hir u syiem , U Trai nongbanbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .
translation.en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa kito ki khun balui lui , bad ïa ka ri la pynjyrsieh da kita ki jingpanpoh briew .
translation.en: And shed innocent blood , even the blood of their sons and of their daughters , whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan : and the land was polluted with blood .
For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshoh samthiah ïa phi , bad phi sdang ban ngat ha ka jingïohthiah kaba jur . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki dei ban long ki khmat jong ki briew , hynrei U Blei u la pynmatlah ïa ki .

translation.en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
translation.kha: Thaw ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong bad pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .

translation.en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Uba bishar wat ïa kito kiba heh kyrdan ?
Ki ktung ba u kren da ka hukum U Trai pyrshah ïa ka duwan ha Bethlehem bad pyrshah ïa ki jaka mane baïar ha ki shnong kiba ha Samaria , da shisha kyang sa urlong .
translation.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the  Lord  against the altar in Beth–el , and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria , shall surely come to pass .

translation.kha: U ai hukum ïa ka pyrthei , bad ïa kamai kaba u ong la leh kloi .
translation.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth : his word runneth very swiftly .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa kane , ïa ka hebrew la khot ka nongbah jngai U Arba . ( U Arba u la lama uba khraw kad pyndeng ki Anakim ) . Mynta ka don ka jingsuk ha ka ri .
translation.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba  ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan jia ha ka sngap ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U bynriew .
translation.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .
translation.kha: Kata ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop ka la ong ha u Petros ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong utai u briew ?   Em , ngam dei ,  la jubab u Petros .

Ïa u la ostrit hadien , bad ka jingsynshar ïa u ka la long ka dak ïa-ban pyn-i ba namar ka jingngeit jyllang u , U Balei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok shuwa ban otsher ïa u . Bad kumta u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jongu baroh bakha ngeit ha U Blei bun ïa kiba la pdiang kamon kiba hok da u , Wat la ïa ki ym khim la otsher .
translation.en: And he received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised : that he might be the father of all them that believe , though they be not circumcised ; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba iing jong ka snem , de la ïing harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khlaw .
translation.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;

translation.kha: Hynriew u Asalaïah u kyntait pun shahshkor , kumta u syiem Jehoash u tur shaneng lam bad ki rangbah jongno u bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .
translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .

translation.kha: Pynban ka jingkyrmen ka wan phai haba nga kynmaw ïa khnai kawei :
translation.en: This I recall to my mind , therefore have I hope .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam miet ïa u hangamei , ha kaba ka Marah ka la ïarap pun sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na kito kiba la ïashong bim ha ka mih lem bad U Jisu .
translation.en: There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi dara ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad ki tiar ki thir baroh jong ka sha ka Templ .
translation.en: And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
She saith unto him , Yea , Lord : I believe that thou art the Christ , the Son of God , which should come into the world .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ko Trai !  ka la jubab .  Nga ngeit ba me long U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , u ban sa wan sha ka pyrthei .
?(Nga sngewkynduh shapoh jong phiah ! Hato ka lah ban longsyiem ba baroh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi ka la shu long lehnoh-ei ?
translation.en: I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .

translation.kha: Kan ïalam ïa phi sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; ka lynti ba ka ïada ka dei ka lynti shaei ka jingïap .
translation.en: Her feet go down to death  ; her steps take hold on hell .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha at .
translation.en: Also the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongïalam jong phi kin leit sha Kaisaria lem bad nga bad mudui ïa uta u briew lada u leh ïa kano kano ka bymdei .
Baroh ki bat ïa ki dongmusa ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa ki turoi ha la ki kti kamon , bad ki pyrta , Ka waitsum ïa U Trai bad ïa u Gideon !
translation.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .
translation.kha: U Blei um dei uba bishar bymhok . Un ym klet ïa ka kam kaba phi la leh lane ïa ka jingieit kaba phi la pynpaw na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïarap kaba phi la ai bad dang ïai ïarap ïa ki parabangeit .
Ha Kajuh ka rukom u shakor uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tyllun ki sbai u la ïohnong sa ar hajar .
translation.en: And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
And the king communed with them  ; and among them all was found none like Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah : therefore stood they before the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ïakren bad ki baroh , bad u Daniel , u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah ki la pynhun shibun ïa u ban ïa uno uno uwei pat . Kumta ki la kylla long ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar jong u syiem .
Ka shadem jong pa sa kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . man ka paw phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka janmiet patan phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka step .
translation.en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .

translation.kha: Hadien habud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa Phi ka mut Aïu kane ka jinglait , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndonkam ïa la ka borbah , U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa ine na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba sem la long ki mraw .
translation.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :

Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ki khlaw barben kiba don shi lynter ka rud Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang bajyrngam , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan wan bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Babilonia ban phet krad kynsan na ka nongbah jong ki . Te u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban wan kob ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?

translation.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , Great and marvellous are thy works , Lord God Almighty  ; just and true are thy ways , thou King of saints .
translation.kha: bad ki da rwai ïa ka jingrwai u Moses , u shakri jong U Blei , bad ïa ka jingrwai U Khunlangbrot :  U Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh , katno kiba khraw bad kiba phylla long ki kam jong me ! U Syiem jong ki jaitbynriew , katno kiba dei bad kiba shisha ki long lynti jong me !
Kan Kham bha ïa u lada la teh ha ka ryndang jong u ïa u mawtylliat uba hajuh bad bret ïa u Sha ka duriaw shun ïa kaba ma u , u pynlong ïa uwei na Kine kiba rit ban leh pop .
translation.en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he cast into the sea , than that he should offend one of these little ones .
And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Nangta shibun ki nongïathuhlypa lamler kin mih bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .
Ka kren da ka jingstad kaban jai jai .
translation.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
And to them which were in Aroer , and to them which were in Siphmoth , and to them which were in Eshtemoa ,
translation.kha: Aroer , Siphmoth , Eshtemoa ,

U Ishbosheth u ne ar ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba long ki nongïalam ïa ki kynhied lute , u Baanah bad u Rekhab , ki khun Shynrang jongu u Rimmon , uba na Beeroth , hapoh ka jai Benjamin . ( Ïa ka Beeroth la ñiew kum ka pynbha jong ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And Saul s son had two men that were captains of bands : the name of the one was Baanah , and the name of the other Rechab , the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite , of the children of Benjamin : ( for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin :

translation.kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah sher un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingjynjar jongki iwei pa kiei i briew .
translation.en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .

translation.kha: U Trai u phah ïa u Nathan , u nonghiarthma sha u ïaiban . U Nathan u la leit sha u badno u ong , Don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba shon ha kiaw ka shnong ; uwei u long uba riewspah , bad uwei pat uba duk .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Nathan unto David . And he came unto him , and said unto him , There were two men in one city  ; the one rich , and the other poor .
And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u hukum ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met u kpa jong u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki leh kumta .

Khmih shane , to don ar ngat ki khun kynthei kiba dang sotti . Shah ngan wallam ïa ki shat phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ki katsha phi mon . Khynñiuh wat leh ei ei ïa kine ki rangbah ; ki dei kiba nga la Khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong nga , bad nga dei ban ïadoh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .

translation.kha: Dem banbeiñ lied noh ïa ka , bad ïa ki maw , ki dieng , bad ka sorkar jong ka baroh dei ngab kit shabar shnong bad bret ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
translation.en: And he shall break down the house , the stones of it , and the timber thereof , and all the mortar of the house  ; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri jongnga u ban pynhieng ïa u Daniel ha ka jaiñkup syiem kaba sawbthuh bad ban pyndeng u kynjri ksiar ka jingtiengburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hangamei .
translation.en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .

translation.kha: Ki thad jong ki , ki pynïap ïa ki bad ki lait na ka jingshah pynshitom . Ki die ïa ka doh bad ki ong , ‘ To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Ngi la riewsaid !’ Wat ki langbrot jong ki hi kim don jingisynei ïa ki .
translation.en: Whose possessors slay them , and hold themselves not guilty : and they that sell them say , Blessed be the  Lord   ; for I am rich : and their own shepherds pity them not .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap kan wan kum u nonglamktien barunar ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynkhih jingkulmar borabor .
translation.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .

translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; me kren ha ki briew mala me ai ïa ki , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .
translation.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi , u Pharaoh u la lawlynnong ïa ki nongai Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw sad ïa ki rangbah Israel Ibbah pynsngewrem :
translation.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,

translation.kha: Aïah ngi ïohnong na ka kad jong ngi baroh ?
translation.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth ?

translation.kha: U Elieser u khong tang uei u khun , u Rehabaïah , hynrei u Rehabaïah u don shibun ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief . And Eliezer had none other sons  ; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .
Satan questioned whether God rules in a worthy way and in the best interests of His subjects .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la woh nia la U Blei u donhok ne em ban synshar bad la ka jingsynshar jong u ka pynmyntoi ne em ïa la ki khun ki hajar .

Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kumin kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang eiei u syiem u ba-bang synshar halor jong ki , malade kin ym long shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .
translation.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :

translation.kha: te phim donkam ban sngew baïap jlan bynñiaw , ko kynrad , ba phi la pynpoh khlem rupa Lane ba pa la pynhiarkput da lai hi . Bad haba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa pa’ , ko kynrad , sngewbha wat klet ïa nga .
translation.en: That this shall be no grief unto thee , nor offence of heart unto my lord , either that thou hast shed blood causeless , or that my lord hath avenged himself : but when the  Lord  shall have dealt well with my lord , then remember thine handmaid .

translation.kha: Lymda kumta ki nong Ijipt kine ong ba Amam lah ban ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki . Kin ong ba me la ïalam noh ïa la ki briew sha ka ri shyiap ban pynïap ïa ki , namar me la isih ïa ki .
translation.en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the  Lord  was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them , and because he hated them , he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kaei ka banbeiñ jia , ki la kylli , Haseroth ngin pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jyllang ngi , ko Kynrad ?
translation.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?

translation.kha: Ynda phoi ïingjaiñ ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blang jong phi u ai ha phi! , wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u ïamareh jong phi ïa uba la thung naduh mynhynne .
translation.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyang khem namar ka Jobab ! Ki briew ki la pher sha ki shongneh jongnga ka Soar , mala sha ka Eglath Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kdew ïa ka surok sha Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki lytar ; katto katno ki lait phet sha Horanaim , ki da ïam sngewsih jam .
translation.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .
Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .
translation.kha: U patsha u la phah katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai bad nga , bad nga leit sha ka Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi . Hangta nga ai ïa ki shithi u patsha ha ki lat .

translation.en: And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka la jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong nga mynta ka miet ha ka jingkhawai ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days , no flesh should be saved : but for the elect s sake , whom he hath chosen , he hath shortened the days .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynduna ïa ka jingjlan jong kita ki sngi ; lada um shym la leh kumta , yn ym don u ban lait im . Hynrei , na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong u , u la pynduna ïa kita ki sngi .

translation.en: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
translation.kha: Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u la jan ba un shah aiti ha ki briew ,
Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Blei u la pynpyut ha u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .

translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki leit sha u , bad ki ong , Ko kynruh , lade u nongïathuhlypa u la phah ïa phoi ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jwat , phin jin da la leh ïa ka . Mynta balei kitab sha sia ïa lade , kumba u ong bad ban ïitkhmih ?
translation.en: And his servants came near , and spake unto him , and said , My father , if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing , wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then , when he saith to thee , Wash , and be clean ?

translation.kha: Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunlung , ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi , lane mano mano kiwei pat Kiba kyrduh . Bad Wat pyrsad ïa ki rukom banbeiñ pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat .’
translation.en: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong , Plie ïa ka jaka rung shat ka Kem bad wallam ïa kito ki sai ngut ki syiem sha de .
translation.en: Then said Joshua , Open the mouth of the cave , and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa ne u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew u lah ban kular ïa ka kambah ne ka kamphylla ,
translation.en: If there arise among you a prophet , or a dreamer of dreams , and giveth thee a sign or a wonder ,

translation.kha: Nangta pat ki leit shet ayu ha Them Sered .
translation.en: From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zered .

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab , Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarep ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kiba suk i kumba ki long thiang uwei u brup .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .

translation.kha: Namar ba Kanah ka long kaba shuwa , kaba katno tam Lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la arphew ïa laiñ kum ka jingkynha kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jyllang u kan pynduh ïa ka jingïatiplem jong moi na ki mem ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban sharai ïa U Blei uba im .
translation.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?

translation.kha: To ïaroi ïa u , phiah ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka shathie bneng .
translation.en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .

translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long u paralok jyllang phi .
translation.en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing : but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha U Blei ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .

translation.en: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men beh noh ïa ngi shabar , to phah ïa ngi sha katai ka kynhun ki sniang .
Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u la Wan phai sha Shuh bad u la leit kiew sha la ka kamra ban pynkhriat .
translation.en: And it fell on a day , that he came thither , and he turned into the chamber , and lay there .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam im ne phon ïa ka , hynrei bam ïa ka da kaban shu syang thyllah kynthup ïa ka khlieh , ki khet bad ki doh jem .
translation.en: Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire  ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof .
Better is a dinner of herbs where love is , than a stalled ox and hatred therewith .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa ki jhur bad ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ban ïa kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba bha tam ha kaba don ka jingpihuiñ .
U Blei u long uba sngewstad bad uba donbor katta katta ; ym ba-don u briew umbah lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?

In the midst of the street of it , and on either side of the river , was there the tree of life , which bare twelve manner of fruits , and yielded her fruit every month : and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations .
translation.kha: bad ka tuid sha ka pdeng jong ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka wah la don u dieng ka jingim , uba pynmih soh khat-ar sien shisnem , shisien ha uwei uwei u bnai , bad ki sla jong u ki long na ka bynta ban ai jingkhiah ïa ki jaitbynriew .
Hynrei , ïeng joit bad leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , ha kaba yn ïathuh ïa me ïa kaei kaba me dei ban sa .
translation.en: And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .

translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa phi , u la jubab , bad film Shimham la shahshkor . Balei ba phi kwah ban ïohsngew biang ïa ka ? Lehse ma phi , ruh , phi! kwah ban long ki synran jongu u ?
translation.en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?

translation.kha: Kaei Ka Khubor Babha ?
translation.en: What Is the Good News ?

translation.kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang sha ki pung , bad ïa ki jingrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew kiba tuid .
translation.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkem ïa u dieng uba la khet ; u lah ban im pat Bad un khie lung .
translation.en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .
translation.kha: laiphew tylli ki ut ai dud lem bad ki khun jong ki , sawphew tylli ki masi kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki masi kyrtong , arphew tylli ki kada kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki kada shynrang .
?(Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba dat katto Katno thut shnat ki ban ym ïap tad ynda ki la ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , there be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: To wat pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ni , na ka daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbat borbah ki long kba lah ban bam , hynrei ka long ka bym dadien ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynlong ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .
translation.en: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki angel kiba shakri ïa u ? Hato don kano kano ka jaka kaba ka jingshai U Blei kam lah ban tyngshaiñ ?
ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba dum , ne ïa ki jingsniew kiba pynïap hir shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .

translation.kha: U Abram u ong , Ñiuma , ka dat ka saraw jong phah nabar shapoh ka jingpynïaid jong pha ; leh ïa ka katba phan sngewbit . Kumta ka Sarai ka lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ka kat haduh ba ka la phet noh .
translation.en: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold , thy maid is in thy hand  ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her , she fled from her face .
This was the word of the  Lord  which he spake unto Jehu , saying , Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka jingkular la pyndep ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha u syiem Jehu :  Ki khun ki ksiew jong me , haduh ka pateng kaba saw , kin long ki syiem ha Israel .
Te ki Israel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri rahah kaei pat ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u long shispah u nongïathuhlypa jongu U Tiras .
translation.en: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Tlai , u Syiem ki Israel , u don ïa kane ban ong : Phai ki plie jong ki jaitbynriew , to buh ïa ka kam jong phoi . Wallam ïa ki jingïasaid nia babha tam ba phi don !
translation.en: Produce your cause , saith the  Lord   ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob .
The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju long kiba skhem , hynrei mynta u jynthut ; u kyllon — u shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingmut jong u hi .
Ka thain Goshen , ha kaba ki Israel ki shong ki law , ka long thrang ma ka , ka jaka ha kaba u phria um shym hap .
translation.en: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .

translation.kha: Don ki ban pynbam da ka ksiar ne da ka dabi ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba ti halor ka nongrim ; kiwei pat kin pynjyrngam da ka dien ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .
translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;

translation.kha: U Johanan bad baroh ki Nongïalam ka kynhun ba-shiphew kiba don bad u ki la ïasngew ïa ka kam runar kaba u Ishmael u la leh .
translation.en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U Trai u ai ha u ka jingjop .
translation.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .

translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la don ahor san snem ka rta mynsngi u la Long u syiem , malade u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jesreel . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jerusalem .
translation.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Baroh shi miet ki paidbah ki la kyang ha ka jingnoh myn .
translation.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice , and cried  ; and the people wept that night .

translation.kha: Haba u tnga jong ka u khiew ha kata ka step , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang ban mihngi shabar ban leit noh , u lap ïa la ka tnga kliar ba ka thiah ha khnam jingkhang , ïaryngkat bad ki ki Kiba kner sha kata ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And her lord rose up in the morning , and opened the doors of the house , and went out to go his way : and , behold , the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house , and her hands were upon the threshold .

translation.kha: Wat pynshitom beiñ ïa ki , hynmen kohnguh ïa U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour  ; but shalt fear thy God .

translation.kha: Don ki nongtei Ibbah ïaleit sam bad ki Israel . Kine ki ba-don ka jingkwah palat ïa-ban bam doh , mala kdew ki Israel hi ki la sdang ban ud : A , ba ma ngi pajut ngin da ïor khyndiat ka doh !
translation.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting : and the children of Israel also wept again , and said , Who shall give us flesh to eat ?

translation.kha: U Kush u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Nimrod ; uba la long u nongjop pyllait uba khriat baryngkhiang eh .
translation.en: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .

translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynpang bad ki kpa tymmen jngai ngi —
translation.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :

And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .
translation.kha: Phin lait phet lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah . U  Trai  U Blei jong nga un wan , un wallam ïa ki angel baroh lem bad u .

translation.en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa U Blei bad kiba ngeit ba um lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .

translation.en: According to their pasture , so were they filled  ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted  ; therefore have they forgotten me .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi la rung sha ka ri kaba bha , phi la kdang bad sngewhun , bad nangta phi la sngewsarong bad klet noh ïa nga .
Bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . A Trai , me ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga bad me ïada ïa nga na ki riewthombor .
translation.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long naba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar nud na ki , ki la kyllan ïap .
translation.en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .

translation.kha: U Tlai un ri sumar ïa phi . Un ym shah ba phin hap ha ka jingri .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .

And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u kpa jong ki , ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh . Da kane ka jingpynsleh , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh shi rta .

translation.en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Ananias u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , bun ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa nga shaphang une u briew bad shaphang kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew jong me ha Jerusalem .

Kin shong ha ka ri ba ang la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob , ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shong ki sah . Kin sheng jongu hangta , bad kum ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh Ibbah hiarpateng na ki . U syiem uba kum u sharati jong nga , u Dabid un synshar halor jong ki junom .
translation.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei Myntan phi phai pyrshah ïa ka longïing jong i pa jong nga . Phi la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad namar ba u Abimael , u khun ba i ïoh na ka shakri jong i , u dei uba ha ïing jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Shekhem .
translation.en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ai ïa ka jingphla jong ki bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Terah , u Petros nabar u Ïoannis ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Ha lynti ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha katba pung ki shnong ha Samaria .
translation.en: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .

translation.kha: Uei umbah stad khih main ban ñiew ïa ki lyoh bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ki ba-bang theh ïa u sting ,
translation.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom ? or who can stay the bottles of heaven ,

translation.kha: Nga la wan ban pynmeh ding ïa ka pyrthei , bad katno nga kwah ba ïa ka , la lah pynmeh lypa !
translation.en: I am come to send fire on the earth  ; and what will I , if it be already kindled ?

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynjai ka rta kabu la tymmen bha haba u la ne shispah laiphew snem , u la ïap .
translation.en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .

translation.kha: U la long u kpa jong ki hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki lai ngut ki khum kynthei .
translation.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters .
That brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ba ngan ïoh long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .
Kynmaw batbor ïa kaei kaba pa’ la nang . Ka jingnang jingtip jong phi ka dem ka jingim jong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .
translation.en: Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .
But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki bneng bad ka pyrthei kiba long mynta la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban ïoh pynjot da ka ding . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka bynta ka sngi haba ïa ki briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .

translation.en: And he said , Hear ye now , O house of David  ; Is it a small thing for you to weary men , but will ye weary my God also ?
translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ïa kata ,  To shahshkor , mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka long kaba sniew eh ïa phi ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah jong ki briew — hato phi donkam ruh ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah ka jong U Blei ?
Wat la ka jingkyrpad ïa u Joseph man la ka sngi , um ter ban leit thiah bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her , to lie by her , or to be with her .

translation.kha: shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki khohwah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haw katno u long kaba khrum bad uba khlaiñ .
translation.en: I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .

translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki ar ñiut shi para — ngan pynshitom ïa phiah namar ka jingkit awria bad ka pop jong ka jingmane bleithaw . Te phin tip ba nga longïing U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you , and ye shall bear the sins of your idols : and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Katno katne ngut na ki Persis uba ïadon Haneng lem sad u ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa u , Da shisha mem mut ba I ruh moi matlah ?
translation.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words , and said unto him , Are we blind also ?
He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :
translation.kha: Un long uba khraw , bad yn khot ïa u , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pynlong syiem ïa u , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la long ,

Ngin ïaleit lili shata ? Ngi te ngi suiñbneng . Kito ki rangbah kiba ngi la phah ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba ki briew hangta ki kham khlaiñ mala kham jingjrong shun ïa ngi , bad ba ki shong ha ki nongbah kiba ki kynroh jrong ki , ki kynjoh ïa ka suiñbneng . Ki la ïohi ruh hangta ïa ki ramhah .’
translation.en: Whither shall we go up ? our brethren have discouraged our heart , saying , The people is greater and taller than we  ; the cities are great and walled up to heaven  ; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there .

translation.kha: Hadien u Tola , la wan u Jair uba na Eliada . U la ïalumlang ïa ki Israel ïaheh arphew ar sngem .
translation.en: And after him arose Jair , a Gileadite , and judged Israel twenty and two years .

translation.kha: ka sniang u khunlangbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba jlih , sad ka dieng Akhsah ,
translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadei bad ka Hukum , la kumno kumno nga la ïap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka bynta U Blei . La pynïap ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jong u ,

translation.en: Behold , I set before you this day a blessing and a curse  ;
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha phi ïa ka jingjied hapdeng ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim —

Ki la set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing , ki la pynlip ïa ki dang uba klong , ki la laitim im na kaba shah pynïap da ka waitlam . Ki la long uba tlot , hynrei ki la kylli lama kiba khlaiñ ; ki la Long kiba khlaiñbor ha ka thma bad ki la jop ïa ki kynhun shipai nongwei .
translation.en: Quenched the violence of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , out of weakness were made strong , waxed valiant in fight , turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .

Da ka jingjemnud bad jingbha U Khrist , nga kyrthep ïa phi ban nym pynbor ïa nga ban lama uba eh haba nga wan ; ibha nga thikna ba nga lah ban leh da kob eh ïa kito kiba ong ba ngi leh ïa kiei kiei na ki jingthmu ba kyntang pyrthei .
translation.en: But I beseech you , that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence , wherewith I think to be bold against some , which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki pop jong phi ki la bat noh ïa kine keiñ kiei kiba bha na phi .
translation.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .

translation.kha: Lada ki Rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , ngan wad ïa ki badno kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha men duriaw , ngan sah” ïa ki mrad durbriew bakynsha ban ïadat ïa ki .
translation.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :

translation.kha: Bad haba ki la bam bad dih , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynhun ïa ki hi .
translation.en: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?

translation.kha: Khie leit bran bran mynta , bad ïathuh ha ki synran jong u , ‘ La pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïapan , sad myntor u tdong leit shata Galatia ha shuwa jong pa’ ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u !’ To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .
translation.en: And go quickly , and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead  ; and , behold , he goeth before you into Galilee  ; there shall ye see him : lo , I have told you .

translation.kha: Hato tv kynjoh mynba nga la kshaid ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno pukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ? Khat-ar , ki la jubab .
translation.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .

translation.kha: Namarba da u , U Blei’ u la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew , ktien kiei kiba lah ban ïohi bad kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi , kynruh ïa ki bor ba kynja mynsiem , ki kynran , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor synshar . U Blei u la thaw ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei da u na ka bynta jongnga u .
translation.en: For by him were all things created , that are in heaven , and that are in earth , visible and invisible , whether they be thrones , or dominions , or principalities , or powers : all things were created by him , and for him :

translation.kha: Kiriathaim , Bethgamul , Bethania ,
translation.en: And upon Kiriathaim , and upon Beth–gamul , and upon Beth–meon ,

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap ,
translation.en: But God raised him from the dead :

translation.kha: Lada ka met baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad lada ka longïng tang ka shkor , da kumno yn iw ?
translation.en: If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?
Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication , and compelled Judah thereto .
translation.kha: U la tei wat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki ri lum Judia bad u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
U Amon un kñia ïa u langsohmoh uba hap ha U Trai da ka jingnang sbai , bun un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .
translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .

translation.kha: Wat shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa i ba long ki jong u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh longïng kiba khuid bad kiba khlem sha kynnoh pop ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :

translation.kha: Uta u long U Mynsiem uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshim shaphang U Blei . Ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïew ïa u lane ithuh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u , namar ba u ïaisah bad phi bad u Don hapoh jong phi! .
translation.en: Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .
He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad ba dih ïa ka snam jong nga ki ïaisah ha nga , bad ma nga ha ki .
Hynrei wat shait ïa u ban pynkohnguh ïa phira ; waiñ shahshkor ruh ïa u . Wat isynei ïa u lieng dak sngewshyrkhei ïa ki , dara wat ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not consent unto him , nor hearken unto him  ; neither shall thine eye pity him , neither shalt thou spare , neither shalt thou conceal him :

translation.kha: hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlei don khun shynrang ; u don tang ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kynthih jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , ki khun u Kish .
translation.en: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew tud to ban pdiang ïa u bad kun phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar khah . Nga , U Trai , tun pynlong ïa kane ban jia .
translation.en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .
And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nonglum khajna u la ïeng ha pajih bad um shym khmied la ka durkhmat sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka shadem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’

translation.en: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .
translation.kha: Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u baroh pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa nga katba nga dang kren .
Hynriew ki briew jrong nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi ban pynshahshkor ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingot jong ki
translation.en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .

translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew , uba la long u synran , u la ong , Ko Kynrad , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit pha bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .
translation.en: And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
God wants us to benefit ourselves .
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ba ngin pynmyntoi ïalade .

translation.en: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :
translation.kha: Haba nga la wan sha ka pukri mynta ka sngi , nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , sngewbha ai ka jingjop ha nga ha kaei ba nga leh .
kaban pynkylla maw ïa ka um , bad kaba pynkhriat ïa ka sla durbriew ?
translation.en: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .
If my land cry against me , or that the furrows likewise thereof complain  ;
translation.kha: Lada nga la tuh ïa ka jaka kaba nga rep bad knieh ïa ka na ki trai kiba dei hok —
U Samuel u ong , wiat la phi ñiew ïa lade ba phim long ei ei , phi dei u nongïaleh jong ki jait Israel . U Trei u la pynsleh ïa pa ba un-long u syier jong ki Ishmael ,
translation.en: And Samuel said , When thou wast little in thine own sight , wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel , and the  Lord  anointed thee king over Israel ?
And many women were there beholding afar off , which followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him :
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki kynthei hangta , kiba la ïakhmih na pajih , kiba la ïabud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa bad kiba la ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: And said unto the king , Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me , neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , to klet noh ïa ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh ha kato ka sngi kaba phi la iehnoh ïa ka Jerusalem . Wat buhnud ei ei pyrshah ïa nga lane pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: So Joash the king of Israel went up  ; and they saw one another in the face , both he and Amaziah king of Judah , at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoash , u syiem ka Israel u leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah , u syiem ka Judah . Ki la ïakynduh ha Beth Shemesh kaba ha Judah ,

translation.en: Praise the  Lord  , O Jerusalem  ; praise thy God , O Zion .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko Jerusalem ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon !

Wat Ladan tun ki bym dei hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ma phi Phin lait nong khlem shah pynshitom ? Em , phi dei ban dih na kane ka khuri !
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato phi pdiang ïa U Mynsiem U Blei da ka leh ïa kaei ba ka Hukum ka daiñ ne da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad jingkit ïa ka ?
translation.en: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
translation.kha: U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïapom jong u Hadadeser .
Yn ne ka jingseisoh kaba khynraw ha ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri jingpeit barhem kawei .
translation.en: Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: Na ka jaka jongno ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang mata tyllep ki nongbah : ka shisyndon , ka Daberath ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: U Trai u phah ïa ki kynran kieng atiar jong ka Babilonia , ka Syria , ka Moab , sad ka Amon pyrshah ïa u Jehoïakim ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , kumba U Trai u la ong lyndang ki ïathuhlypa ki shakri jong u ba un leh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , and bands of the Syrians , and bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: Ko kynrad , kata ka bariew ka la ïa-ong , mem don ïa ka jingtong , bad ka pukri ka long kaba jylli . Nangno men eh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingim ?
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .
translation.kha: Hynrei long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei! Naba wat mynshuwa haba phi la long ki mraw jong ka pop , phi la kohnguh da la ka dohnud baroh ïa ki jingshisha ba la shem ha ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: And if some of the branches be broken off , and thou , being a wild olive tree , wert grafted in among them , and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne na ki tnat jong u dieng Olib ba la thung , la pynkheiñ noh , bad ba ïa u tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw la pynïasoh bad u . Ma phi ki Jentil phi long kum ki dieng Olib khlaw , bad mynta phi ïadon bynta ha ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem bakhlaiñ jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Lada me kwah ban long uba janai , to khie leit bad die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta to wan bad bud ïa nga .
Khie leit ha kob suk , u Eloi u ainong , bad to U Blei ki Ishmael un ai ha pha ïa kata Kaba pha pan na u .
translation.en: Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .

translation.kha: Hynrei long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei! Naba wat mawshun haba phi la long ki miaw jong ka pop , phi la kohnguh da la ka dohnud baroh ïa ki jingshisha ba la shem ha ka jinghikai kambah phi la ïohpdiang .
translation.en: But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .
The elder unto the elect lady and her children , whom I love in the truth  ; and not I only , but also all they that have known the truth  ;
translation.kha: Na u Nongsharai Balang    — Sha ka Kynthei badonburom bad sha ki khun jong ka , ïa kiba nga ieit da shisha . Bad ym dei tang ma nga hi , hynrei baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingshisha ki ieit ïa phi ,
Wat iada phi la ïoh ban bam katto ïa kaba phi khoh bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ba-bang shang ,
translation.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;
And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .
translation.kha: Man ka step , uwei pa uwei u lum katba u lah ban bam , bad ynda ka la shit ka sngi , kaba sah baroh ha madan ka la um noh .

Lehkmen ha khmat U Trai ryngkat bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shahskhor jong phi , badno ki Lehbha , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shang jong phiah . Leh ïa kane ha katai ka jaka manla Blei .
translation.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates , and the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are among you , in the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to place his name there .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka kamra jong ki synrum jongu u Kanah u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Igdalaïah . Kane ka kamra ka long hajir ka kamra u Maaseïah u khur jong u Shallum , u rangbah synshar bapawkhmat jong ka Templ , bad Ashan ki kamram jong kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar .
translation.en: And I brought them into the house of the  Lord  , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God , which was by the chamber of the princes , which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ngan phar ïa ki leit tukri ki jingpynshitom basniew hano jongki nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka thmu , ka nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?

translation.kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U Trai un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka langbrot lane kawei ka masi jongno phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait Haneng ba-bang Pyndonburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .

translation.kha: Kumba u Trai u la hukum , u Moses u buh ïa la ki kti halor ka khliehduh jong u Jehoash , bad u la pynbna ba i'u un long u nongmih bujli jong u .
translation.en: And he laid his hands upon him , and gave him a charge , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Shen hadien kata , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka un long syiem . Un uta ïaleh ïa ka kynruh shipai jongngi u skhem Syria , un rung Shobab ki kut jong ki , bad jop ïa ki .
translation.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate , which shall come with an army , and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and shall deal against them , and shall prevail :

translation.kha: Khie leit dara khmih ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Nangta ïai rupa sha ka nongbah bakhraw ka Ramath bad leit Hirah sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judah bad Ishmael ? Hato ka ri jong ki ka kham heh shun ïa ka jong pa ?
translation.en: Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?

Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan shim noh ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba phin long ki nongsharai jong ki ; ngan ym shah shuh ba phin sumar bha tang ïa lade . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi bad ngan ym shah ba phin bam ïa ki .
Ruth , mynta woh khuslai . Teng leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phin pan ; kumba baroh ha shnong ki ïatip , phi dei ka kynthei kaba donburom .
translation.en: And now , my daughter , fear not  ; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .

translation.kha: To shahshkor! mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jongngi baroh kiwei pat ki shakri jong me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka bur . Ai ïa ka jingjop mynta ka sngi bad pynlong ba u patsha un isynei ïa nga . Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ jongno u patsha .
translation.en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .
And Saul cast the javelin  ; for he said , I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice .
translation.kha: Ngan sum ïa u ha ka kynroh ,  u Saul u ong ha lade , bad u kawang ïa u sum ha u ar sien ; hynrei ha baroh ar sien u Dabid u kynriah .

translation.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki ,  To wan kiew shane !  Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang khmih , ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh .
thaba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka borbah da kaba U Tlai u jyllop ïa ki jingïap , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U Troas ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U Trai bad ha u Moses u shakri jong u .
translation.en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ieh ïa ka , kim tip ka dei kadei , bad kumno ki ïakylli para ma ki , Kaei mo ken ? Te u Moses u ong ha ki , Une u dei u kpu ba U Trai u la ai ha phi ban bam .
translation.en: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .

translation.kha: A katno ka longsem kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nongpynkhiah ka Judia bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shnat ki lum jingmihpat ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki ïathuhlypa bad phi pynngeit ïa ki mot sahkynmaw jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,

translation.kha: Naba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , Ym dei ban teh ïa ka shyntur u masi ngab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh kew bad u nongtrei u dei ban eh ïa la ka bainong .
translation.en: For the scripture saith , Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn . And ,  The labourer is worthy of his reward .

translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la hajuh ïa phi , phi sahit ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .
And the remnant of the sodomites , which remained in the days of his father Asa , he took out of the land .
translation.kha: U la pynduh jait ïa baroh ki nuti shynrang bad kynthei kiba shakri ha ki duwan jong ki blei thala kiba dang sah naduh ki sngi u Asa u kpa jong u .
Kumta u ïasam ïa ki sha la ïinglieng mala u ai bam ïa ki kada jong ki . Ki ruh ki ïasait ïa la ki kjat bad ki ïasam jingdam miet .
translation.en: So he brought him into his house , and gave provender unto the asses : and they washed their feet , and did eat and drink .

translation.kha: Nga la jied ban kohnguh ; na la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .
translation.en: I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Damascus , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki ; ki la shohbeiñ ïa ki briew ka Gilead da ka kam runar ba khleh bieit .
Haoid kadei ka Jubab .
translation.en: It is the answer .

translation.kha: Ki bastad Israel kim khong bynta ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ; lang! jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad synrum ïa ki ; kum u dieng ba ïai jyrngam len kah tngen ïa ki ; nga long u tynrai jong ki jingkyrkhu jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him : I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u Stephan , uba dap da U Mynsiem bakhia , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ïoh ïa ka burom jongno U Blei badno ïa U Jisu uba ïeng Sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translation.en: But he , being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,

translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha —kata ka tare , u la jong ha ki , Duwai ba phna ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translation.en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .

translation.kha: Phim don hok ban khñiot ïa ki brai jong nga bad ngab shim kabu ïa kiba duk . Ma nga U Nongsynshar U Trai Badonbor baroh nga la kren .
translation.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces , and grind the faces of the poor ? saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
For if thou refuse to let them go , and wilt hold them still ,
translation.kha: Lada me kyntait biang ban shah ïa ki ban leit ,

translation.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingim u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat shisha ne em ba ki khun jong u kin kmen ?

translation.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him , and every man shall draw after him , as there are innumerable before him .
translation.kha: bun hajar ki ïasoh lang ha ka jingleit ontep , bad wat ka khyndew ka tap suki jai halor ka met jong u .
Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shnong jongki phi ïa u shaneng lap ka kynthei kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai pynlang pynkheiñ ïa ka jingmong jong u ,
translation.en: If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,

Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
translation.kha: Nga la leh katba nga lah ban pynbiang ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka Templ — Ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ki dieng , ki mawkordor , bad ki mawlynnai , ki maw na ka bynta ki jingthaw dur , bad shibun u maw marbl .
Nangta u ju leit pat sa sha la ïing ha Ramah , hangta ruh u ju shakri kum u nongbishar . Ha Ramah u la tei ïa ka duwan ha U Trai hangta .
translation.en: And his return was to Ramah  ; for there was his house  ; and there he judged Israel  ; and there he built an altar unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong phiah kumba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar ba ha kaba mane ïa ki , ki leh umdih ïa ki kam isaitmet borbah kiba U Trai u isih . Ki kñia wat ïa la ki khun ki kti shwa ha ka ding halor ki duwan jyllang ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the  Lord  thy God : for every abomination to the  Lord  , which he hateth , have they done unto their gods  ; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods .
And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai bad ki la ïathuh ha kiwei pat , hynrei kim shym la ngeit ïa kata .
To ïai trei , te , bad pyndep ïa ka kam ! To long kiba thrang ban pyndep ïa ka kumba phi la longkmie ha kaba thmu ïa ka , bad to leh ïa ka da kaei kaba phi don mynta .
translation.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will , so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have .

And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka jait Reuben . Hangta ha khmat jong phi baroh , ka khyndew ka ang bad ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jong ki baroh .

Te ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shongduh Slem ha katai ka ri katba U Trai U Blei’ jong phi u la kutlad ha ki khop tymmen jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta katba ka suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka pyrthei .
translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .

translation.kha: U Trai un pyn-i ha ngi ïa ka burom jong u . Ngin shong ngin sah harud ki wah bad ki wahduid kiba ïar , hawei ki liengbah jong ki nongwan kin ym ïaid ha ki .
translation.en: But there the glorious  Lord  will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams  ; wherein shall go no galley with oars , neither shall gallant ship pass thereby .

translation.kha: Katba uta u lum baroh uwei u dang mehding nabar phi ïohsngew ïa ka thar kaba wan napdeng ka jingdum , ki nongïalam bad ki tymmen ki san na ki jait jong phi ki ïawanlang sha nga
