translation.en: And it came to pass , when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness , ( for the mountain did burn with fire , ) that ye came near unto me , even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders  ;

translation.kha: Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jakob namar ba ki kti jong u ki long kiba mih jingkhynñiuh kum ki jong u Iso .
translation.en: And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .

translation.kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka bamaïan — kan ngam bad kan ym lah khie shuh , namarba ka jingpynjot ba U Trai un wallam ha ka .’ Ki ktien Jong u Jeremaïah ki kut hangne .
translation.en: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink , and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her : and they shall be weary . Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .

translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judith ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïasuk ïa u Amon bad ki pynurlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .
translation.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .
translation.kha: U sakhi uba lah ban shaniah , borabor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei u bym lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lamler .

Ïa u la otsher hadien , bad ka jingotsher ïa u ka la long ka dak ban pyn-i ba namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei’ u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok shu ban otsher ïa u . Bad Kumta u Abraham u Long u kpa ba kynjai mynsiem jong baroh kiba ngeit ha U Blei bad ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok da u , wat la ïa ki ym shym la otsher .
translation.en: And he received the sign of circumcision , a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised : that he might be the father of all them that believe , though they be not circumcised ; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also :

translation.kha: Ka jingim bashispah jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phira ruh phin mihpaw lem malu u bad eh bna ïa ka baburom jong u!
translation.en: When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shna ïa u seiñ rong bad u wah ïa u ha u Dieng . Kat uba shah puh bseiñ u peit sha uta u seiñ jrong bad u kot .
translation.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass , and put it upon a pole , and it came to pass , that if a serpent had bitten any man , when he beheld the serpent of brass , he lived .

And Jehiel , and Azaziah , and Nahath , and Asahel , and Jerimoth , and Jozabad , and Eliel , and Ismachiah , and Mahath , and Benaiah , were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother , at the commandment of Hezekiah the king , and Azariah the ruler of the house of God .
translation.kha: Shiphew ngut ki Lebi ki shimti ban trei hapoh jong ki : u Jehiel , Asasaïah , Nahath , Asahel , Jerimoth , Josabad , Eliel , Ismakhaïah , Mahath , bad u Benaïah . La leh ïa kane baroh hapoh ka bor jong u syiem Hesekaïah bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

Ïa ka met jong u Joseph , kabu ki pangnud Israel ki la wanrah na Ijipt , la tep ha Shekhem , ha kata ka Jaka ba u Jubab u la thied ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai dabi na ki khun jngai u Hamor , u kpa jong u Shekhem . Ïa kane ka bakwah la ïohpateng da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph .
translation.en: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem , in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver : and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .
And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jinghikai kiba me la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ha khmat ki sakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah ban shaniah , kiba lah ban hikai ïa kiwei ruh .

katba ngi dang shong ha kñia ka ïingjaiñ kaba na kane ka khyndew , im ud sat da ka jingsngew ba shah banbeiñ ; kam dei ba moi kwah ban lait noh na ka met kaba na ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah ban ïoh noh ïa-ban phong da kata kaba kynja bneng , khnang ba ïa katai kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla dur nala da kaba im .
translation.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .

translation.kha: Ka leh kumba ki pylleng kim dei ki jong ka , bad kam salia ba ki jingpyrshang jong ka ki pulom .
translation.en: She is hardened against her young ones , as though they were not hers : her labour is in vain without fear  ;
And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .
translation.kha: Kumba shi taïew hadien ba u la kren ïa kine kiei kiei , U Jisu u la ïalam lem bad u ïa u Petros , u Ïoannis bad ïa u Jakob bad leit sha u lum ban duwai .

translation.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .
translation.kha: U Syiem Jeroboam u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Sngewbha duwai na ka bynta jong nga ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga !  U nongïathuhlypa u la duwai ha U  Trai  , bad la pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong u syiem .
u u long u jingthaw bathymmai naba U Balei , u Nongthaw jong u , u ïai pynkhyllem ha ka dur jong u hi , khnang ban wallam ïa phi sha ka jingtip ba-pura shaphang Jong u .
translation.en: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him :
And , lo , thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice , and can play well on an instrument : for they hear thy words , but they do them not .
translation.kha: Ha ki mem long ei ei lait tang u nongpynbyrngia da kaba rwai ki jingrwai jingieit ne tem ka duitara . Ki shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong me baroh hynrei kim kohnguh ïa kawei ruh na ki .
Thaw pajut ka tnum ïa kata ka lieng bad pyllait jaka kumba siaw saw sentimitar hapdeng ka tnum bad ki krung . Shna ïa ka lai mala sad bthuh ïa ka jingkhang ha pruh jong ka .
translation.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above  ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof  ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it .

translation.kha: ba ka jaitbynriew kaba la wan na Ijipt ka la saphriang ha ka ri barben kawei . U kwah ïa nga ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad baheh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .

translation.kha: Ha sier hi , ka lyer kaba jrong ka la beh bad la pynkhih ïa ka um .
translation.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .

translation.kha: bad ha u Isaak nga la ai ïa u Jakob bad u Iso . Nga la ai ha u Iso ïa ka ri lum Edom kum ka jingïohthiah jong u , hynrei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong phi , bad ki Kynhun ki kti jngai u , ki longing hiar sha Ijipt .
translation.en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave unto Esau mount Seir , to possess it  ; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .

And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :
translation.kha: Haba ki hynñiew snem ki la leit ,  la ong u syiem ,  Nga la khmih shajrong sha sahit bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai . Nga la ïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh bad nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom ïa uta uba im junom .  Un synshar junom , bad ka hima jong u kan neh ha ki por baroh .
Ai brup ïa ka ïa baroh kaba ka leh . Ka dei hok ba-bang burom da baroh .
translation.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands  ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .
He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .
translation.kha: U la pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha , bad u la phah noh thylli ïa kiba riewspah .

translation.en: And said , I beseech thee , O  Lord  God of heaven , the great and terrible God , that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments :
translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ,  A  Trai  U Blei jong ka bneng ! Me long uba khraw , ngi ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa me . Me batskhem ïa la ka jutang bad kito kiba ieit ïa me bad kiba leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Wat sheptieng ! Ïeng skhem , bad phin sa ïohi aïu U  Trai  un leh mynta ka sngi ban pyllait im ïa phi ; lano lano ruh phin ym ïohi shuh ïa kine ki nong Ijipt .
U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ngan pynlong ïa me kum U Blei ha u Pharaoh , bad u Amon u hynriew jong me un kren-ïa ha u kum u nongïathuhlypa jong me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonghikai ka lawbah kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki ïa-ong , U ne ïa u Beelsebul ha u ! U dei u ksiew pynbah kiba ai ïa u ka bor ban beh noh! ïa ki .
translation.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren : Kito kiba synshar ïa ka Judah ktien jot ei nalor ki ïaleit pyrshang ïa nga . Ki bud ïa ki jingthmu kiba ngam shym la shna , bad ki soi ïa ki jingïateh kular pyrshah ïa ka mon jong nga , da kaba kynton kawei ka pop ba-halor kamai pat .
translation.en: Woe to the rebellious children , saith the  Lord  , that take counsel , but not of me  ; and that cover with a covering , but not of my spirit , that they may add sin to sin :
For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
translation.kha: Kawei ka briew , kaba ka khun jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad mar kumta hi ka la wan sha u bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u .

Mynta de ïam ïa ki sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah kumba na ïam namarba ka Jaser . Ki ummat jongno nga ki hapdeng na ka bynta ka Heshbon bad ka Ïaleh , namar ym don kano kano ka jingkheit soh kaba pynrem ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah : I will water thee with my tears , O Heshbon , and Elealeh : for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen .

translation.kha: Kim donkam ban kitei , la jubab U Josis . Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ban bam !
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  They need not depart  ; give ye them to eat .
And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb  ; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kine ki jingainguh thang ki dei ki jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Ha kajuh ka sngi , u Pharaoh u la hukum ïa ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw bad ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam :
translation.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,

translation.kha: Na kawei pat kawei ka nongbat jong ka Judah ki briew ki leit kloi kloi sha Jerusalem baneh pan na U Trai ïa ka jingïalam ,
translation.en: And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kambah bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka syntiew ka Jutang U Trai . Kumta ki khyllie bad buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .
translation.en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .

translation.kha: Ngi la ban ïoh shibun ki jingmyntoi na ki bad na ki lok jong ki ruh lada ki la shongkurim .
translation.en: We can benefit greatly from the experience of these brothers and if they are married , that of their wives .

translation.kha: U sakhi u pyllait im ïa ki briew’ haba u ong ïa kaba shisha ; haba u ong ïa kaba shukor , u shetkylla ïa ki briew .
translation.en: A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .

translation.kha: U paidbhur u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Paul , haba la phah ïa ka khubor shaw u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynha shipai rhem ba ka Jerusalem baroh ka la khihwin .
translation.en: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka sdang poi banbeiñ , namar ka longsem ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .

translation.kha: U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoiñ , Namar U Trai u Ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .

translation.kha: hangno I ïor katai U Blei u long uba sbun bad katno u long ibha eh . U long uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lade phi ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jongki u . Hynrei lada phim leh kumin , ma phi mad phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
translation.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .

translation.kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kyang jong u , ‘ Khie leit neh na nga , phira kiba hapoh ka jingshem jong U Blei! ! Khie leit noh sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !
translation.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :

translation.kha: Kito kiba dei jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta uba la wan na bneng .
translation.en: As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .

And David arose , and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah , to bring up from thence the ark of God , whose name is called by the name of the  Lord  of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims .
translation.kha: bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Baal ha Judah khnang ban wallam nangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jong u ka long halor ki Kherub .

Jamynrei la katta ruh , katba ki dang don ha ka ri ki nongshun jongno ki , ngan ym iehnoh syndon lane pynim ïa ki . Da kumta ngan ym pyndkut noh ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ki , naba nga long U Trai U Blei Jong ki .
translation.en: And yet for all that , when they be in the land of their enemies , I will not cast them away , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly , and to break my covenant with them : for I am the  Lord  their God .

Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Un aiti noh ïa me bad ïa ki Israel ha ki Philistia . Lashai ka sngi ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa ïadon ryngkat bad nga , bad U  Trai  un aiti noh ruh ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ha ki Philistia .

translation.en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever : and they have no rest day nor night , who worship the beast and his image , and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name .
translation.kha: Ka tdem jong ka ding kaba pynsaja ïa ki ka kiew shajrong junom la junom . Ym don jingtngen mynsngi ne mynmiet ïa kito kiba mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u , ïa uno uno uba don ïa ka shab jong ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: Then said he unto all Israel , Be ye on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . And the people said unto Saul , Do what seemeth good unto thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha ki ,  Phi baroh ïeng hangtai , u Jonathan bad nga ngin ïeng hangne .   Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab .
Ka jingmut kaba phi dih ban don ka hir kata kaba U Khrist Jisu u la ne :
translation.en: Let this mind be in you , which was also in Christ Jesus :

Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . And they kept the feast seven days  ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according unto the manner .
translation.kha: Naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh , ki pule ïa ki bynta jong ka Hukum U Blei man ka sngi . Ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la long na ka bynta hynñiew sngi , bad ha ka sngi kaba phra , ka la don ka jingpynkut ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba la ong ha ka Hukum .
Kum ka erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa ki hukum jong u ha u Massah u shakri jong u , u Moses u la ai ïa kita ha u Josaïah , bad u Joahas u la kohnguh ïa ki . U la leh ïa baroh kaba U Trai u la lawbah ïa u Moses .
translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua  ; he left nothing undone of all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Un ym mad jingkyrmen ne jingshlur ; un pynlong ka jingbit hok ha ka pyrthei . Ki ri bajngai ki ap kmang ïa ka jinghikai Jong u .
translation.en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged , till he have set judgment in the earth : and the isles shall wait for his law .

translation.kha: dara nangta ma u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad ki nongap phira ha ïingsyiem ki synran ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ïingsyiem , bad bud sa u babha baroh . U Joash u rung lyngba ka Khyrdop Phira bad u shong ha la ka jaka ha ka khet .
translation.en: And he took the rulers over hundreds , and the captains , and the guard , and all the people of the land  ; and they brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king s house . And he sat on the throne of the kings .

translation.kha: naba ïa ka set hi ym shym la pynlong tang da kawei ka dkhot met , hynriew da shibun ki dkhot .
translation.en: For the body is not one member , but many .
And they took Joseph s coat , and killed a kid of the goats , and dipped the coat in the blood  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki la pynïap uwei  langsohmoh bad ki wieh ïa kata ka sopti jong u Joseph ha ka snam jong u .
Ïa isangsot uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad shah pynduh .
translation.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki hima ki sem shakri ïa pha yn pynjot thiaw .
translation.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish  ; yea , those nations shall be utterly wasted .
See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka iktiar halor ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima ban rat bad ban pynkhyllem , ban pynjot bad ban bret sharud , ban tei bad ban thung .
Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ki ri bajngai kin ai ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa U Tlai .
translation.en: Let them give glory unto the  Lord  , and declare his praise in the islands .
Woe is me ! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingduh jingkyrmen ! Nga long kum u briew uba thngan uba shem ba ym don soh ba dang sah ha ki dieng bad ym don sohwaiñ ha ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ïa baroh ki sohwaiñ bad baroh ki soh Dumbur ba-bang la kheit lut .
Kam pher kaei pham leh , ïa pha hi yn thang pynïap lane yn pynïap ha ka tmoh . Yn weng noh ïa pha kum ki jingthung ba la bam noh da ki puit . Pha la roi kum ki puit !
translation.en: There shall the fire devour thee  ; the sword shall cut thee off , it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm : make thyself many as the cankerworm , make thyself many as the locusts .

translation.kha: Shata ka kynthei ka jubab , Da shisha , phi tip Aiu u syier Saul u la leh , kumno u la beh ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong na Israel . Te balei phi riam ïa nga bad ba ngan shah pynïap ?
translation.en: And the woman said unto him , Behold , thou knowest what Saul hath done , how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land : wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life , to cause me to die ?

translation.kha: ka Nibshan , ka nongbah Mluh , badno ka Engedi : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En–gedi  ; six cities with their villages .

translation.kha: ( Wat ki para shynrang jong u hi kim shym la ngeit ha u . )
translation.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him .

translation.kha: Ujuh shwa , ibha nga dang trei bad ki Jehiel , nga im kum u Jingtylli , shabar ka Hukum ki Jiw , khnang ban jop ïa ki Jentil . Kane kada mut ba nga khlem kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Balei ; nga longsyiem shisha hapoh ka hukum U Khrist .
translation.en: To them that are without law , as without law , ( being not without law to God , but under the law to Christ , ) that I might gain them that are without law .

translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa barben ar tylli ki kurup ka dulir thied jaka — ka kopi ba la shon muhor kaba don ka jingïakut bad ki kyndon , bad ka kopi ba khlem shon ngor —
translation.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase , both that which was sealed according to the law and custom , and that which was open :

translation.kha: ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryngkhat na ka pyntha ki paid Israel ban bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Ki myrsiang ki don ki thliew , badno ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U ibhabriew um don hangno hangno ban thiah bad pynjahthait .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .

translation.kha: U tnga jong ka u don thok ban pynskhem ne shun pyndam ïa kano kano ka jingkular ba ka la pynlong .
translation.en: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .

translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa me ñiar ba me long u bri uba eh . Me shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong me bad ot ïa kaei Kaba mem shym lade .’
translation.en: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .

translation.kha: Nangta u ai sa kawei ka lei : Khie saw sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri dara ki langbrot hangne . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban kun pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka . Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingïar bad ki pynkup ïa ki Hangne .
translation.en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .

translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phi longsyiem kiba mutlop , ki biria kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .

translation.kha: jynreiñ phi , phi dih ki brup kiba u la pyllait im na Jingtep , ka bapaw kaba klong da ka ding . U la wiang ïalam ïa Phi ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jongnga u hi , kumne kumba phi long mynta .
translation.en: But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpoh ha ki kumno na pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa ki jingïohi bahok jong to .
translation.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .

translation.kha: Trei hynriew sngi shi thiat , hynrei wat trei ha ka sngur kaba hynñiew , khring ba ki mraw jong phi bad ki nongwei kiba trei dara phi , bad wat ki jingrem jongngi phi hi , kan Ïohi shongthait .
translation.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work , and on the seventh day thou shalt rest : that thine ox and thine ass may rest , and the son of thy handmaid , and the stranger , may be refreshed .

translation.kha: kum ka erïong nga la sar noh ïa ki ban shongsah ïa-ban sah ha ki ri nongwei . Ïa kane ka ri babud la iehnoh kynjah ïa ka , khlem don mano myn bashongshit ba sah hangta .
translation.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not . Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned : for they laid the pleasant land desolate .

translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah hynñiew snam . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khwan
translation.en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: ne sngewsarong ha ka jingdon jingem jong nga .
translation.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;

translation.kha: U ne shi kynha ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha duriaw ryngkat badno ka kynhun lieng u Jehoram . shisien lai snem ki kynhun lieng jong u ki ju wan peiñ , ki da wan pita ïa ka khiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translation.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tarshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , bun haba ki mih shabar , ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ na ka jingdon U Trai ka paw ha u paidbah baroh .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation , and came out , and blessed the people : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the people .

translation.kha: badno u ong ha ka , Keiñ noh kane ka jingit buaid jyllang pha ! Wat dih hajuh bad pynpyngngad nong !
translation.en: And Eli said unto her , How long wilt thou be drunken ? put away thy wine from thee .
And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out  ; and they could not .
translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem u tur ïaleh ïa u , u bret ïa u sha madan , bad u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur , u kyr-iat ki bniat , bad u eh tnen baroh shi rynïeng . Nga la ong ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid , hynrei kim shym la lah .
Kaei kabu nga ïa-ong ïa phi , te , nga ong ïa barieh : To khmih bha !
translation.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .

translation.kha: Nga la sngewthikna bha sanphew kane baroh kum na la buh ki jingthmu jingsuh eh ngab wan jngoh ïa phiah , haneng ba phin ïuh jingkyrkieh ar shah .
translation.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before , that ye might have a second benefit ;
And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki maw ba phi la ñiad astor , thoh shai ïa ki ktien baroh jong ki hukum U Blei .
haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pyut u suh sha Betheden , u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel ha ka lynñiar shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bteng shaphang shatei shata ka Kabseel ,
translation.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,

translation.kha: Nongthaw ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kajuh ka Kanah : U u mraw Hebru ba phi! la wan ïalam hangne , u la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .
translation.en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :

translation.kha: Ym dat mano mano ruh uba la ïuh ïa U Blei . U Khun ba marwei jong u , uba longïng kumjuh kumno U blang bad uba don ha syndah jyllang U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .
translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .
The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin shahjop haba ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh ki dong .
Ki ong ïa ki nongïalap ban sngewbang jar . Ki ong , Wat kren ha ngi shaphang kaei kaba dei . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kaei katba me khiah ban ïohsngew . Ai ba ki jingïadei rkhiang jong ngi kin sah bad sem .
translation.en: Which say to the seers , See not  ; and to the prophets , Prophesy not unto us right things , speak unto us smooth things , prophesy deceits :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïaid ha ka jingmut ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ki la shong ha ka ri jong ki jingrkhie , hynrei mynta ka jingshai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jongno ki .
translation.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .

translation.kha: Katba kata ka sur ka dang Kren , U Mynsiem U Blei u la rung ha nga , bad u la pynïeng ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur ba ka dang ïaphai kren ,
translation.en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .
We have transgressed and have rebelled : thou hast not pardoned .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop bad ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , bad ma me A  Trai  , mem pat shym map ïa ngi .

translation.en: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her , Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them .
translation.kha: Bad ki la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ka Rebekka da kine ki kyntien :  To phi , ka para , phin long ka kmie u paidbah byllien ! To ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin da jop thiaw ïa ki nongbah jong ki nongshun jong ki !
Ki da shongsah ha ki jingïaishah ba-ieit , bad ha khmih jong ki kin buh ïa ka miej ba la dap da kiei keiñ kiba bha , ba kynthup ïa ki jingiw bad ka umphniang Olib kaba nga la ai ha ki .
translation.en: And satest upon a stately bed , and a table prepared before it , whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil .

translation.kha: U Paul u la sdang Ban kren : Mynta nga sngewthuh ba ka long ka shisha ba U Blei u ñiew kumjuh ïa uno uno barben .
translation.en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :

translation.kha: Ka pynïeng kum ka step , ka thikna kum ka jingmih ka sngem .
translation.en: They are new every morning : great is thy faithfulness .

translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynthrong nabar u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïew ïa u briew uba mareh mudui .
translation.en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .

translation.kha: Ha ki Jiw dara ki Jentil kumjuh nga la ai ka jingmaham da ka jingkhia ba ki dih ban pei sha U Blei na ki pum jong ki bad ban ngeit ha U Jisu naba U Trai jongngi moi .
translation.en: Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Te at aiti ïa ka sha ki long leh-ieit jong ka , ki Assyria ïa kiba ka thrang palat .
translation.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers , into the hand of the Assyrians , upon whom she doted .
In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khot sngewbha ïa la u paramarjan ban wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain , ba la ker sawdong da ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .

translation.en: If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga um lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u ieit ïa nga kham palat ban ïa kaba u ieit ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong u , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong u , bad ïa lade kumjuh .

translation.en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïashong lang ban ïabam ha kajuh ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lamler uwei ïa uwei pat . Kin ym ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka bynta kata kam pat poi .

Pynkyntang ba yn ym don napdeng jong phi u shynraiñ , lane ka kynthei , lane ka longïing , lane ka jait , ki ban phai noh na U Trai U Blei jongno phi ban mian ïa ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Kum Uta , un long kum u thied uba pynmih u soh uba ktung bad uba don bih .
translation.en: Lest there should be among you man , or woman , or family , or tribe , whose heart turneth away this day from the  Lord  our God , to go and serve the gods of these nations  ; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood  ;

translation.kha: Kito kiba don ki mawkordor ki la ai ïa ki shwa ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ , katba la khmih da u Jehiel jong ka kur Loit jngai u Gershon .
translation.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .

translation.kha: ïa u turoi , u Agate , nabar u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;
translation.en: And the third row , a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .

translation.kha: U biria wahbah shemphang u Ïoh jinghikai kham bun na kawei ka jingsneng ban kaba uba bieit u ïoh jinghikai na naba shah sympat shispah sien .
translation.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Blei u la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong kata ka them ha kaba u Lot u shong shnong , u la buh jingkynmaw ïa u Abraham , bad u la ailad ïa u Lot ba lait im .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .
Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :
translation.kha: Mynta khreh kloi ban leit sha i pa , bad ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jong i u ong kumne , ‘ U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; wan noh sha nga , bad wat pynslem .

translation.en: And , behold , thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite of Bahurim , which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim : but he came down to meet me at Jordan , and I sware to him by the  Lord  , saying , I will not put thee to death with the sword .
translation.kha: Don ruh u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , na ka shnong Bahurim kaba ha Benjamin . U la tim tyngeh ïa nga ha ka sngi kaba nga leit sha Mahanaim , hynrei haba u la ïakynduh ïa nga ha ka wah Jordan , nga la ai ha u ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba ngan ym shah ban pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .
translation.kha: Haba nga khot ïa u shakri , um jubab — wat la nga kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap ïa nga .

Ka long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingmut ba-bieit jyllang u ki la ïabam bakla ïa u ha kaba u ne sha lyndet ka jingïarap . Un ym pynong ha lade ba ka pynlwet ba u bat ha ka kad jong u kam long satlak ka blang .
translation.en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?

translation.kha: Te u Joseph u jubab , Kane ka mut kumne : ki lai tylli ki shang ki long kad tylli ki sngi .
translation.en: And Joseph answered and said , This is the interpretation thereof : The three baskets are three days :

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi U Trai u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa phiah ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ Jong u baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;
And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew , uba la long u synran , u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit phai bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .
Ngim burom ïa U Blei namar kaei kaba u la buhrieh ; ngi burom ïa ki syiem ïa kaei kaba ki batai .
translation.en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .

translation.kha: Te naba me pyrthuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u leh , hato me khmih lynnong ïa u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kaweh ? Ka rai ka long ka jong me , kam dei ka jngai nga ; ïathiah ïa ngi mynta kamai kaba me pyrkhat .
translation.en: Should it be according to thy mind ? he will recompense it , whether thou refuse , or whether thou choose  ; and not I : therefore speak what thou knowest .

And it came to pass , when the king of Israel had read the letter , that he rent his clothes , and said , Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy ? wherefore consider , I pray you , and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Israel u pule ïa ka shithi , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai bad u kyang jam ,  Kumno u syiem Syria u khmih lynti ïa nga ban pynkhiah ïa une u briew ? Hato u pyrkhat ba nga dei U Blei , lem bad ka bor jong ka jingim bad ka jingïap ? Ka shai kdar ba u pyrshang ban sdang ïakajia bad nga !

Kin ïing jngai bah na ka , namar ba ki suiñbneng ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshitom jongu ka . Ki ong , Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ! Kane ka nongbah Babilon ka khraw dara kaba khlaiñbor ! Tang hapoh shi kynta pha la shah pynshitom !
translation.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .

translation.kha: Neng pynsaphred na ka bynta kito kiba la shah pynïap ; ngan ym map ïa kiba leh kam sniew . Hynrei ha Judah bad Jeroham yn don ki nongshong shnong junom , bad ma nga U tharai , nur-um shong ha u lum Sidon .
translation.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the  Lord  dwelleth in Zion .

translation.kha: To pynpaw ïa ka jinglong jemnud Sha uwei pa eiei barhem . U Trai u la jan wan .
translation.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .
But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba ka don kaei kaei hangne kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka Templ .
U Ohad Edom u khun jong u Jephunneh bad ki pynbhabriew phra nguh ki rangbah jong ka kur jong u kin ïarap ïa ki . Ïa u Hosah bad u Obed Edom la shuh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .
translation.en: And Obed–edom with their brethren , threescore and eight  ; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters :

translation.kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Akhbor ha Jesreel , ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kambah long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .

translation.kha: Kynmaw aïu U Trai U Blei jongno phi u la leh ïa ka Miriam mynba phi wan na Ieit .
translation.en: Remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Miriam by the way , after that ye were come forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ban pynkut : Wat ai ba uno uno un buh jingeh Shua ïa nga , namar ki dak wanna kiba ar don ha ka met jong nga ki pyn-i ba nga long u miaw jong U Jisu .
translation.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: Ym ne u nongrep uba lur sah ïa ki lyngkhai jong u bad uba pynheh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbet .
translation.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow ? doth he open and break the clods of his ground ?
Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .
translation.kha: Wat leh shiliang khmat ïa uba duk haba bishar ïa u .

Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phiah bad ngan ym shuh ba phin bam ïa ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .
Their wings were joined one to another  ; they turned not when they went  ; they went every one straight forward .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Ki da sngewbang kthang eh namar u la da ong ba kin ym ïoh shiah ïa u . Bad kumne ki la ïaleit bad u sha ka lieng .
translation.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .

translation.en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .

translation.en: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .

translation.kha: Phi la kyntait noh ym tang na kaba ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei , hynrei phi la ïalute ïa ki khunswet ba la shah lehbeiñ .
translation.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .

translation.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .

translation.en: Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .
translation.kha: Nga pynïaidkam bad nga ai ki jingrai ; nga la ïalam ïa ki kumba u syiem u ïalam ïa la ki shipai , bad nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingshngain haba ki duh jingkyrmen .
Phi lah ban thain jaiñ na u saiwul jngai ki lumlang jong phi bad krad jaka da ka pisa kaba phira ïoh na kaba die na ki katto katne ki pla jong phira .
translation.en: The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .

translation.en: Also he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , whereof the  Lord  had said , In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .

Ngan wanrah kliar . Sumar kyndong ïa kaei kaba pha don , khnang ba yn ym don uno uno u ban lute na phah ïa ka bainong jong ka jingot .
translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : hold that fast which thou hast , that no man take thy crown .

translation.en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .

translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .

translation.en: David also arose afterward , and went out of the cave , and cried after Saul , saying , My lord the king . And when Saul looked behind him , David stooped with his face to the earth , and bowed himself .

translation.en: He should be self-sacrificing in his love for his wife .

translation.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity , but rejoiceth in the truth ;

translation.en: Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .

translation.kha: Ka por ka pa haba ngan pyntong ïa ka sngi ba kan sep noh hamar shiteng sngi , bad ïa ka pyrthei ban dum ha ka por mynhynne . Ma nga , U Trai nongsharai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the Lord  God  , that I will cause the sun to go down at noon , and I will darken the earth in the clear day :

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ? Shi shang ki soh , nga la jubab . Nangta U TRAI’ u la ïong ha nga , Kaba ktung ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Jeraïah . Ngan ym kylla Shu la ka jingmut sanphew kaba pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .

translation.kha: phiah dei ban sngewthuh te , ba ki khun ki ksiew bashisha jong u Abraham ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingtah .
translation.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith , the same are the children of Abraham .

translation.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .

translation.en: She seeketh wool , and flax , and worketh willingly with her hands .

translation.en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .

translation.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?

translation.en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .

translation.en: And now , O  Lord  God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .

translation.en: And set two men , sons of Belial , before him , to bear witness against him , saying , Thou didst blaspheme God and the king . And then carry him out , and stone him , that he may die .

translation.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .

translation.en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .

translation.en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .
translation.kha: kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kata kawei pat kum ka jingainguh thang ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam . Kumne keiñ uta u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .

translation.kha: Hangto la dei ki wah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar , A Trai ! Hato la dei ka duriaw kaba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar shla ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka erïong u la long ka kali ïam jong me , mynba me la wallam jingjop ha la ki briew .
translation.en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la mane ïa u , wat la don na ki , babha la sngew artatien .
translation.en: And when they saw him , they worshipped him : but some doubted .

translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .

translation.kha: Nalorkata Nga ñiew ïa U Blei kum u sakhi jong nga — u tip ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka long na ka bynta ban ïada ïa phi ba nga la rai ban ym leit sha Korinth .

translation.en: And Moses brought their cause before the  Lord .

jynreiñ ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongpyntrei jong U Blei , kim suidñiew ïa ki ktien jong u bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ha kaba kut ka jingbitar U Trai pyrshah ïa la ki briew ka Long Kaba jur katta katta kat ban ym don lad Shu ban lait na ka .
translation.en: But they mocked the messengers of God , and despised his words , and misused his prophets , until the wrath of the  Lord  arose against his people , till there was no remedy .
Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .
