translation.en: And Jonadab said unto the king , Behold , the king s sons come : as thy servant said , so it is .
And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim , and came unto the house of Micah .
translation.kha: Ki leit sha khmat nangta bad ki wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba don ha ri lum Ephraim .
Kam mynta hi u dang rieh ha kawei na ki krem lane ha kawei pat ka jaka . Hamar ba u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong phi , kat uba ïohsngew ïa kata un ong ba ki rangbah jong phi ki la shahjop .
translation.en: Behold , he is hid now in some pit , or in some other place : and it will come to pass , when some of them be overthrown at the first , that whosoever heareth it will say , There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom .

translation.kha: Katai ba ngan leh ïa me ka pynkyndit ïa shibun ki jaitbynriew . Haba nga talain ïa ka wallam jong per , ki syiem kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ha ka sngi ba me kyllon , baroh na ki kin khñium ha ka jingsheptieng na ka bynta ki jingshim jong ki .
translation.en: Yea , I will make many people amazed at thee , and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee , when I shall brandish my sword before them  ; and they shall tremble at every moment , every man for his own life , in the day of thy fall .

translation.kha: Ka thadrong ïa lade bun ka ailad ba baroh kin tip ba ka long ka nuti . Nga la sngewngiah ïa ka kamra nga la long ïa ka hynmen jong ka .
translation.en: So she discovered her whoredoms , and discovered her nakedness : then my mind was alienated from her , like as my mind was alienated from her sister .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba u Moses u longing shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , u la ïohi ba u diengduh jyllang u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la shylluit , phuh syntiew , bad saiñ ki soh almond naba ih !
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .

translation.kha: Nangta , u syiem bathymmai u bymtip ei ei shaphang u Joseph , u la synriah ha Ijipt .
translation.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .

translation.kha: Ka Telem ka erlangthari mynta kaba ïoh burom shibun , hynrei katno uba ïadait najan jong ka un lyngngoh bad un kylli , ‘ Balei ba U Trai u la leh kumne ïa kñia ka ri bad ïa kane ka Templ ?’
translation.en: And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?

translation.kha: te uwei pa uwei uba im un ïap bad un kylla long dewmet sa shisien .
translation.en: All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .
See , I have set before thee this day life and good , and death and evil  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi nga ai ba phin jied napdeng kaba bha bad kaba sniew , napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap .
To sngewskhem , ko mynsiem jong nga , namar U Trai u la lehbha ïa nga .
translation.en: Return unto thy rest , O my soul  ; for the  Lord  hath dealt bountifully with thee .
And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Te balei ba me wad bniah ïa baroh ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?
translation.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynrei la shah ïa ki ban im shipor .
translation.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .

translation.kha: U Joseph u la dap laiphew sner ka rta mynba u sdang ban tyngam na ka bynta u syiem Ijipt . U la Iehnoh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u leit kylleng ka ri jingïap .
translation.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .
And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit jngoh kylleng ki nongbah bad ki nongrit . U la hikai ha ki synagog , u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang babun jait bad ki jingshitom .
Mynta ka sngi , U Trai U Blei jrong phi u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jongnga u baroh ; kumta kohnguh ïa ki da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: This day the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments : thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
Then said Saul unto the people that were with him , Number now , and see who is gone from us . And when they had numbered , behold , Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Ñiew ïa ki shipai bad wad uei uba jah .  Ki leh kumta , bad ki shem ba u Jonathan bad u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u kim don .
Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh , ‘ Uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh hikai na U Blei .’ Uno ine uba shahshkor! ïa U Kpa bad ïoh hikai na u , u wan sha nga .
translation.en: It is written in the prophets , And they shall be all taught of God . Every man therefore that hath heard , and hath learned of the Father , cometh unto me .

translation.kha: Haba u Solomon u ïohsngew ïa kadei kaba u Shimei u la leh ,
translation.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and was come again .

Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan nym shah ba phin lait khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Buh sanphew thlia ki kyrwoh ha ka jingkah kaba nyngkong , bad sa basanphew tylli pait ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh pur ha ka jingkah kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la duwai , A Trai Badonbor Baroh , me longïng u nongbishar ba bishar haw ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingsngew jongno ki briew . Ngi la buh ïa ka kam jongu nga ha ki kti jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .
translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
And he said unto them ,  Full well ye reject the commandment of God , that ye may keep your own tradition .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la bteng da kaba ong ,  Phi don ka rukom basian jong ka jingkyntait ïa ka hukum U Blei ban pynneh ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai hi .

Ngin phla ïa kane ha me : Ngi mane ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong Ngi da kaba bud ïa kata ka Lynti ïa kaba ki ïai-ong ba ka long kob kynroh . Hynrei at umdih nga ngeit ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses nabar ha ki kitab jyllang ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But this I confess unto thee , that after the way which they call heresy , so worship I the God of my fathers , believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets :
And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrngem shuh da ka jingpynjot .
myntri , A TRAI’ , to sngap ïa ngi bad to peit ïa kawei kaweh la jia ha i'u . To shahshkor ïa barieh kiew kiei kiba u Sennakherib u la ong ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me , U blei ba-im .
translation.en: Incline thine ear , O  Lord  , and hear  ; open thine eyes , O  Lord  , and see : and hear all the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent to reproach the living God .
For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .
translation.kha: Naba don ha Jingthoh Bakhuid la ong ïa kane shaphang ka sngi kaba hynñiew :  U Blei u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew na ka kam jong u baroh .
Hynrei ki nongtuh bad ki brup bym ne Blei ki im ha ka jinglah , wat la u blang jong u longsem tang ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .
translation.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .

translation.kha: Sa khyndiat , ki la jan ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym leh lyntait ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth  ; but I forsook not thy precepts .
But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap biang junom , bad hadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
Lada phi dei ban jied hapdeng ka nia babha bad ka spah kaba khriat , jia ïa ka nam babha .
translation.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .

translation.kha: Ko khun u bariew , u ong , kyndat ïa ka Jerusalem . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki briew’ ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,

translation.kha: Ïa u khiew khyndew ha kaba la shet ïa ka doh dei ban pynpait noh ïa u , bad lada dei u khiew shait da ka rnong , dei ban da kyrshut bha ïa u bad phler da ka um .
translation.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken : and if it be sodden in a brasen pot , it shall be both scoured , and rinsed in water .

translation.kha: Un kuna kumjuh ïa une u masi lyngba kumba u ju leh ïa u masi lyngraw jong ka jingkñia ainguh ñiar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong ithuh u paid , dara yn map ïa ki .
translation.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering , so shall he do with this : and the priest shall make an atonement for them , and it shall be forgiven them .
And it came to pass , when he was come near to enter into Egypt , that he said unto Sarai his wife , Behold now , I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon :
translation.kha: Hamar ba un sa rung ha ri Ijipt , u ong ha ka Sarai ka tnga jong u ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba bhabriew .

translation.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me : and I caused the widow s heart to sing for joy .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ki jingjynjar bakhraw ki ïaroh ïa nga , bad nga la ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei ban ïoh jingshngain .
Ha Kata ka por , ki dkhot Jong ki bujli ha Judia kim pat ithuh ïa nga markhmat .
translation.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :

translation.kha: Nalor baroh , dei ma phi — ma phi keiñ , khlem duna ïa kiwei pat ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong I , ka jingkmen jongu sem , bad ka daw jong ngi ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jongki moi ha khmut jongki U Jeshua uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .
translation.en: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?

translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , naba mut Ka jaka ka mala khlieh .
translation.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,

translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la pyrta khim ha u Elijah , Ko pa jong nga , ko pa jong nga ! Ko nongïada bakhrawbor jong ki Israel ! Phi la leit ne ! Bad um shym la ïohi Shua ïa u Elijah . Ha ka jingsngewsih , u Elisha u la kad arliang ïa la ka jaiñkup .
translation.en: And Elisha saw it , and he cried , My father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof . And he saw him no more : and he took hold of his own clothes , and rent them in two pieces .

Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .
translation.kha: Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . To shahshkor ïa ki jingmudui jong ki ! Ki jingkyang jong kito kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki la poi sha ki shkor jong U Blei , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
Hynrei naba la shah khot jingsngewbha kdor suidñiew bad ki la kitei shad la ki kam ki jam : uwei sha ka lyngkha jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,
translation.en: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :

translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar jrut ki khwan shynrang jongu u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingpisa lyng-a ka la tyllep ïa u ,
translation.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
For if these things be in you , and abound , they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jinglong kiba phi donkam , bad lada phi don kyrhai ïa ki , kin pynlong ïa phi kiba smat bad kiba seisoh ha ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

Wat la ka la long ha ka jingkhluit ba u la shah pynïap halor ka jingpynbha , dien da ka har U Blei ba u im . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad Phi ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lem ïa ka bor U Blei ha ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .
The bloodthirsty hate the upright : but the just seek his soul .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba thrang snam ki isih ïa uno uno uba lehhok , hynrei ki briew bahok kin ïada ïa ka jingim jong kum uta u briew .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , and make thereto a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla , bad pynpur da ka ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
Ka wahduid Nimrim ka ryndang , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym don kano kano kaba jyrngam kaba ïangat hukum .
translation.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .

translation.kha: Hynrei pyn-i ka jinglyngngoh ïa ki ïakhun shynrang jong u Barsillai uba na Gilead bad ri sumar ïa ki , namar ki la lehsbun ïa nga Mynba nga la phut krad na u Absalom , u hynmen jong me .
translation.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be of those that eat at thy table : for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother .

translation.kha: men ba U Trai u ai ha ki Jeriel ïa u nongaikam , U Troas u ïar ïa uta u nongïalam bad u phlait im ïa ki bri na ki nongshun jong ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U Trai u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jinglehniam bad jingshan banbeiñ jong ki .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .

translation.kha: A katno men long uba shadkmen dara uba kmang , bad katno Kawei ruh kin kmen long yn kha ïa u !
translation.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness  ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .

translation.kha: U dei Shisha u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis , ibha la im patar , u la ïathuh ha ki rangbah syier jong u . Dei kata keiñ barli ba une u la don ïa Kanneh ka bor ban ni ki kambah .
translation.en: And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist  ; he is risen from the dead  ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Phin bam bad dih ha ka miej jong nga ha ka Hima jong nga , bad phin shong halor ki khet ban synshar halor ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .
Kine ki jingmlien ki long ki bymdei namar ( 1 ) Ki pynlong ïa im’ ki mraw jong ki ( 2 ) Ki pynsniew ïa ka tat jong ngi , bad ( 3 ) Ki long ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: These practices are wrong because ( 1 ) they make us their slaves , ( 2 ) they harm our bodies , and ( 3 ) they are unclean .

translation.kha: Hobab ph don ha ka jaka shong dara ha ka por thma , kiar na kano kano ka ïa-ban pynlong ïa phoi ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies , then keep thee from every wicked thing .

translation.kha: Ym shitrhem la ai phlangïap Shua ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai lawlynnong ïa im’ ban shna maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi shah shoh . Dei ki briew lad phi keiñ kiba bakla .
translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .

translation.kha: Ko syiem Ijipt , saihon pli ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki lah ban ïathuh ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U Terah Badonbor Baroh kaba u don ïa ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .

translation.kha: U thri u la ai ïa ki Hukum jyllang u ha u Moses u shakri jong u , u Moses u la ai ïa kita ha u Joshua , bad u Joshua u la kohnguh ïa ki . U la lai ïa baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua  ; he left nothing undone of all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .

There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ruh ba lah ban pyllait ïa lade na ka ban ïap lane pynslem ïa ka sngi ka jingïap jong u . Kata ka dei ka thma kaba ngim lah ban lait ; ngim lah ban pyllait ïa lade da ka jingshukor .

Shi taïew haei ki synran ki la ïadon nur-um bneng hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la anna lem bad ki . Ïa ki jingkhang la khang sngem , hynrei U Jisu u la Wan bun u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki mala u la noh , To ka jingsuk sa long lem bad phi .
translation.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .

translation.kha: Ka Makhir , ka khun jong u sarew , kam shyiap la ïoh khun .
translation.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .

translation.kha: bakha long ki khlieh jong ki kur kiba thapniang na u Ladan . ( U Shim u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shelomoth , u Hasiel , bad u Haran . )
translation.en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .
Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
translation.kha: Katno uba kmen u long uta u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha ïing !
“Wat ha Lum Sinai ruh phi la pynhiarkput shla ïa U TRAI’ kat haduh ban pynjot ïa ph .
translation.en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day , then rejoice ye in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you :
translation.kha: Mynta te , lada kaei kaba phi leh mynta ka sngi ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u ka long da kaba khuid mynsiem bad kaba hok , te to kmen bad u Abimelekh bad ai ba un kmen bad phi .
Balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bym lah shun ar ei ei shiah ishyrkhei ibha kyrpad ïa ka jinglehisynei ?
translation.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .
translation.kha: Nga thmu ban tei ka Templ kaba khraw , namar U Blei jong ngi u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei .
badno nga la kyrmen ha u kynruh jong nga , ‘ Kumno lada jia ba kata ka bariew kam Tertios ban wan rynsied bad nga ?’
translation.en: And I said unto my master , Peradventure the woman will not follow me .

translation.kha: Nalor baroh , ki ïa suba bieit la pyrkhat ba u long uba stad bad peiphang lada u shu shong Jar jar nabar set ïa la ka shynrang .
translation.en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .

translation.kha: Katai ka khubor na U Tiras pyrda ïa u Bathsheba bad ïa ka longsem jong u la ai da u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa nongmareh ki pop ba u Birsha u la leh pyrshah ïa u Trai . U la pynkhih bitar ïa U tharai ym tieng namar ki kam bymman ba u la leh , main u syiem Jeroboam u la sa ha suk jong u , hynrei jin namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh’ na ka un-long jong u Jobab .
translation.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada um pynshlur jingman ïa kane , phi wat salia ïa u .
translation.en: But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .

When thou criest , let thy companies deliver thee  ; but the wind shall carry them all away  ; vanity shall take them : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land , and shall inherit my holy mountain  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , ai ba kito ki bleithaw jong phi kin pyllait ïa phi ! Tang shisien pyrsad ka lyer kan rong noh ïa ki ! Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha nga kin ïoh im ha ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha ka Templ jong nga .
U Josis u la jubab , Me don ka bor halor jong to tang namar ba la ai ha me da U Blei . Kumta u briew umbiah pait noh ïa nga ha me u long uba la rem na ka pop kaba kham khraw .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .

Saying ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes  ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :
translation.kha: Sngap ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi dang leit kiew sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Kin rai pynrem ban pynïap ïa u bad nangta kin aiti ïa u sha ki Jentil ,

translation.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again  ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand :
translation.kha: U la buh biang ïa u nongrah khuri rangbah ha ka kyrdan kaba u bat mynshuwa , hynrei u la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah .

translation.en: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban thaw ïa ka pyrthei , u Ktien u la lah don lypa ; u la don bad U Blei , bad u long kumjuh kum U Blei .

translation.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar , he shall bring the live goat :
translation.kha: Ynda u Aaron u la lah pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , ïa kaba sah jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad ïa ka duwan , un ai sha U  Trai  ïa uta u  langsohmoh uba dang im uba la jied na ka bynta u Asasel .

Haba u ïohi ïa ka , u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih bad u ong , Waw , ko khun ! Phi la pynpait ïa ka dohnud Jong nga ! Balei ba yn dei da ma phi kaba pynpang ïa nga ? Nga la ai ïa ka jingkylli bakmen ha U Trai , malu ngam lah ïa-ban kylla pang ïa la ka kular !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw her , that he rent his clothes , and said , Alas , my daughter ! thou hast brought me very low , and thou art one of them that trouble me : for I have opened my mouth unto the  Lord  , and I cannot go back .

Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki ban lute ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lane ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And he took all the gold and silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and hostages , and returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba u lah ban ïoh , ki tiar ka templ baroh bad ki jingkynshew baroh jong ka ïingsyiem , bad u rah biang ïa ki sha Samaria . U rah ruh ïa ki koidi bad u .

Me la shong ha Eden , ka kper jngai U Blei , bad me deng ïa ki malai ba bun jait : ki Rubi dara ki Diamond ; u Topas , u Beryl , u Karnelian bad u Jasper ; ki Sapphir , ki Emerald , bad ki Garnet . Me don ki jingdeng da ka ksiar . Ïa ki la shna na ka bynta jongno me ha ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me .
translation.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God  ; every precious stone was thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold : the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .

translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki pangnud Israel . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar nabar u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .
translation.en: This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u bad kyrsiew ïa u .  Pyllait im ïa ngi , A Trai !  ki la ong .  Ngin sa ïap !

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Moses u leit shata , ki paidbah ki ïeng ha ki jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïa-peit ïa u Moses haduh ba un da rung shapoh .
Ym dei ban bam ïa ka khleiñ jongu ki masi , ki langbrot , ne ki blang .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Ye shall eat no manner of fat , of ox , or of sheep , or of goat .

translation.kha: ngan pyllaitluid ïa me na ka jingma , bad yn ym pynïap ïa me . Men lieh im ñiar me la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha nga . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword , but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee : because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the  Lord .
Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada ki briew na Makedonia kin wan bad nga bad kin shem ba phim pat long kiba la kloi , katno kan long ka jingpynlehrain ïa ngi — khlem da kren ïa ka jinglehrain ïa phi — naba ngi la shaniah katta ïa phi!
Kata ka long kumno ki briew jong ka Moab bad ka Armoni kin shah pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingsarong badno jingmeng jong ki bad na ka bynta ka jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki briew jngai U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: This shall they have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the  Lord  of hosts .
But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .
translation.kha: Me tap ïa ka jingbymtip jong me da ka jingshukor ; Me long kum ki doktor ki bym lah ban pynkoit ïano ïano .

translation.en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew .

Nangta un thang ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh Hamor ka duwan , kumba ju thrang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka byndi ki jingkohnguh ïasyllok . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia Naamah ka pop! jong uta u nongsynran , bad yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang sngewlyngngoh shaphang ka jingmut jong khie ka jingïohipaw , ki rangbah kiba u Kornelios u la phah ki la tip hangno ka ïing jongngi u Simran ka don , bad mynta ki la ïeng ha khmat ka Khyrdop .
translation.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,

If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law , ) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
translation.kha: Dei ha ka nongrim jong ka jinglong lyngdoh ki Lebi ba la ai ïa ka Hukum ha ki paid Israel . Mynta , lada ka kam lyngdoh jong ki Lebi ka la long kaba janai , yn ym donkam shuh ïa uwei pat u lyngdoh ban mih , uwei uba na ka jinglong lyngdoh u Melkhisedek , ym jong u Aaron .

translation.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ka ïing jong u ki leit sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïarap sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad pynshong pynsah ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
Ha ki briew kiba kyntait ban sngap ïa kaei kaba nga la ong , ki ïai-ong ba baroh ka long bha bad ki . Bad ki ïathuh ïa uwei uwei baroh uba mluh ba ka jingjynjar kan ym ktah ïa u .
translation.en: They say still unto them that despise me , The  Lord  hath said , Ye shall have peace  ; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart , No evil shall come upon you .

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingmut u wanrah ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa uba bieit , uba babit u shu rkhie bad u khyllie bad u tim .
translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ngan wan sha Jerusalem ban ïada ïa phi bad ban pynim ïa phi baroh kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .
Te U Trai , U blang ki Israel , u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u Sedekaïah ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :
translation.kha: U shna ruh ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
U jingdon u leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u shongksuid hangta .
translation.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house .
And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .
translation.kha: Kumta ki sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad u Moses u ong ha ki ,  La shi sngi , phi dei ban long kiba la pynkhreh bad ha kajuh ka por phim dei ban ïathiah shongkha .
Kumta u Jehoshaphat u synshar ha ka jingsuh , bad U Blei u ai ha u ka jingshongshngain ha ki liang baroh .
translation.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet : for his God gave him rest round about .

translation.kha: Ki shympriah kjat — shi bniat da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha — ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba khlaiñ bad shi bynta jong ka kaba sleh .
translation.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .
My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .
translation.kha: Ngan ym randien lano lano ruh na ka jingdawa ba ngam shym bakla ; ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka beit .
Haba ka Shem ïa ka , ka khot lang! ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong ka , bad ka ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta dik ba nga la shet ïa ka pyrta kaba nga la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’
translation.en: And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together , saying , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found the piece which I had lost .

translation.kha: Ym Kumta da shispah ! Pynban , phi noh ha u , ‘ To pynkhreh ïa ka jingbat mut jong nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da jong me bad shakri ïa at katba la dang bim bun dih ; hadien Kata me lai ban bim ïa ka jingbam jong me .’
translation.en: And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken  ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?

translation.kha: U Gideon u la Phah ïa ki nonglamktien shuh ka ri lum Ephraim baroh ban ong , Ale wan khih ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian . Ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ban khanglad ïa ki Midian na kaba jam ïa ki sha shiliang . Ki rangbah Ephraim ki la ïapynlong , malu ki la ïeng skhem ha ka wah Joanan mala ha kita ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah .
translation.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .

translation.kha: Hobah U Jisu u la dep ïathuh ïa kine ki pharshi , u la iehnoh ïa kata ka jaka
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
Have you already bought your ticket ?
translation.kha: Phi lah thied lypa ka ticket jong phi ?

translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
translation.kha: Ale wan shane , phi ki briew kiba duna ka jingsngewthuh !  Ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,
Ko Pa ! To ai ka baburom ïa nga ha khmat jong me mynta , khah ka burom kaba nga la khong lem sad me ha shuwa ïa-ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , phi ki shakri jongnga U Trai ,
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the name of the  Lord   ; praise him , O ye servants of the  Lord .
Plead with your mother , plead : for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband : let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight , and her adulteries from between her breasts  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , kyrpad jur ïa la ka kmie — wat lada kam dei tnga shuh ïa nga , bad nga ruh ngam dei shuh u tnga jong ka . Kyrpad ïa ka ba kan sangeh noh na kaba klim bad ka jingleh nuti .
U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki aiñ bad ki suda baroh ïa kaba phi dei ban sar Bad leh ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it .

translation.kha: Da ki jinglamler jong phi , phi pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew babha , kiba ngim kwah ba kin sngewmong . “Phi khang ïa ki briew basniew ban iehnoh ïa kabu sniew bad pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ki .
translation.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad , whom I have not made sad  ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jong me , naba ka dei hi ka kmienah jong me .

Pynthikna ba ïa kane ka Kitab ka Hukum dei ban pule baburom ha ka jingmane jong me . Puson ïa ka mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa katai kaei barabor ba la thop ha ka . Te men sa manbha sad erlangthari kaba jop .
translation.en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth  ; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night , that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein : for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous , and then thou shalt have good success .

translation.kha: U Tiras u ainong , Ko Baal , to hiar noh na ka khoit jong Phah , bad shong ha u kjit pui Halor ka khynwin . Sihon pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei phan long shuh kiba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !
translation.en: Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .

translation.kha: badno u la beh ei ïa ki shabar ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat .

And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki ong ,  Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel .  U  Trai  u la rai ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot kan wan ha u Absalom .

translation.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .
translation.kha: Ki briew ha kiba ki la kren ïa kine kiei kiei kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn bret shabar ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kynthup ïa ki tnga jong ki , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki . Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki .

Wat la me lehsbun ïa ki riewbymman , pynbah kim ju shuki ban leh ïa Kiei kaba dei . Wah hangne ha ka ri jong ki briew bakha hok ki ding leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki kynjat ïa-ban ïa-ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jngai me .
translation.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked , yet will he not learn righteousness : in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly , and will not behold the majesty of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , ph long u khun ba-ieit eh jong ang , u khuid uba nga ieit tam . Man ba nga ong ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , nga pyrkhat shaïong jngai phi da ka jingieit . Ka dohnud jong nga ka leit shai phi ; ngan isynei ïa phi .
translation.en: Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khadar jongno ka jingsynshar u Ahas u syiem ka Jehudi , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u long u shem ka Jesreel , bad u syier khyndai snem ha Syria .
translation.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years .

translation.kha: Haba u Saul u Ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Goliath , u kylli ïa u Abner , u rangbah shipai jongu u , Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ? Ngam khong jingap , syiad Kynrad , u Abner u jubab .
translation.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .
The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u ,  Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki la jubab ,  Ngin leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai noh ïa ka jaka bad ngin pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram .  Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad pynlong ïa ki nongïalam ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban bat ïa ka kular kaba ki la lah khlei .
Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha naba ap ïa ka jingkylli jong me ; katba nga kylla , Lano keiñ men ïarap ïa nga ?
translation.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me ?

translation.kha: Ha kawei na ki jingit thombor pyrshah ïa ki Eliel , ki Syria ki la ringmraw ïa kawei ka khynnah rit Jeraïah , kabu la long ka shakri jong ka tnad jong u Naaman .
translation.en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid  ; and she waited on Naaman s wife .

translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u uba la long naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thok sha pa , ko ki khun samla , namar phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: I write unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I write unto you , young men , because ye have overcome the wicked one . I write unto you , little children , because ye have known the Father .
And other sheep I have , which are not of this fold : them also I must bring , and they shall hear my voice  ; and there shall be one fold , and one shepherd .
translation.kha: Don kiwei pat ki langbrot ki bym dei na kane ka sem langbrot . Nga dei ban wallam ïa ki ruh ; kin shahshkor ïa ka sur jong nga , bad kin ïalong kawei ka kynhun langbrot bad uwei u nongaplangbrot .

translation.en: For this cause , when I could no longer forbear , I sent to know your faith , lest by some means the tempter have tempted you , and our labour be in vain .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la phah ïa u Timothi . Ngam lah shah shuh , kumta nga la phah ïa u ban tip shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi . Da shisha kam lah ban long ba u Ksuid u la pynshoi ïa phi bad ba ka kam jong ngi baroh ka la long kaba lehnoh-ei !
Ai ba U Trai un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshemphang ba khem khriat jongki ka jingieit U Blei bad sha ka jingïasoh kabu la ai da U Khrist .
translation.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .

translation.kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewkhyllah bad kito naba leh ïatong , kiba ïarah bad ki nongpynïap bynriew , kito kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
translation.en: For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .

translation.kha: U Khrist u synshar hangta halor baroh ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng , ki bor synshar , ki hab , malu ki kynrad ; u don ka kyrteng kaba kham hajrong ban ïa kiwei pang ki kyrteng kiba don ka bor ha kane ka pyrthei mynta bad ka ban sa wanrah .
translation.en: Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :
And Ahab said , By whom ? And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces . Then he said , Who shall order the battle ? And he answered , Thou .
translation.kha: Mano ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh ?  u Ahab u kylli . U nongïathuhlypa u la jubab ,  U  Trai  u ong ba ki shipai samla hapoh ka hukum jong ki lat jong ki distrik kin leh ïa kata .   Mano ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun kaba kongsan ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ma me ,  u nongïathuhlypa u la jubab .

Haba ka kynta kaba khatsaw jongki u syiem ka Sirion ka la jan wan artat , u syiem ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa u , sad u syiem ka Syria un ïaleh pyrshah da la ka bor baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ki liengbah kiba bun . Un hiarthma ïa kiba bun ki ri , khem ka jingshlei ki um .
translation.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him : and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , and with horsemen , and with many ships  ; and he shall enter into the countries , and shall overflow and pass over .

When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment , and two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight , then I coveted them , and took them  ; and , behold , they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent , and the silver under it .
translation.kha: Napdeng kita ki mar kiba ngi la kurup , nga la ïohi kawei ka barandi Babilon kaba itynnat , kumba ar kilo ka rupa , bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia palat shiteng kilo . Nga la ikwah eh ïa ki , bad nga la shim ïa ki . Phin shem ba la tep ïa ki hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong nga , bad ka rupa ka don ha trai .
Naba ngi pynkut ba u bariew u don ka jinglonghok bun U Blei tong lyngba ka jingngeit , bad ym da kaba ni ïa kaei kaweh ka Hukum ka ïadep .
translation.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .

translation.kha: U Abraham u khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa u langbrot naba la sahkut ki reng ha ka bniap . U leit ban shim ïa u , malu kñia ïa u kamon ka jingainguh thang ha ka iaki u khun jrong u .

translation.en: And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .

translation.en: And he was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together .

translation.kha: Hato un kyrpad ïa me ban pyllait ïa u ? hato un ïasaid badno me ban ïoh jingisynei ?
translation.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee ? will he speak soft words unto thee ?

translation.kha: Kaba ma u hi u la ong , Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju ñiewkor ha la ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .

translation.kha: Te , to kylla-kaba-mut , bad to phai sha U Blei , khnang ba un map ïa ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord  ;

translation.kha: Manla u briew’ un har ban kit ïa la ki jong ki jingeh .
translation.en: For every man shall bear his own burden .
For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret , and he himself seeketh to be known openly . If thou do these things , shew thyself to the world .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba buhrieh ïa kaei kaba u leh lada u kwah ba kiwei kin tip . Naba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei , to ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip shaphang jong me !
U Jisu u dang shong hajar u lum ki Abib , pyrsad ïa ka Templ , Mynba u Petros , u Jakob , u Ioannis Bad u Andriw ki la wan jar jar ha u .
translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately ,

translation.kha: U dei u nongïohipaw bashisha , u syiem Shephataïah u ong . Kumta ki lai jrut ki syiem ki la leit shata u Elisha .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said , The word of the  Lord  is with him . So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .
For it hath been declared unto me of you , my brethren , by them which are of the house of Chloe , that there are contentions among you .
translation.kha: Naba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka longïing jong ka Khloi ki la ïathuh ïa nga da kaba shai kdar , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba don ki jingkajia hapdeng jong phi .
Naba u Abraham u la ap khmih ïa ka nongbah kaba U blang u la pynbuaid bad u la tei , ka nongbah kaba don ki Nongrim baneh .
translation.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .

translation.kha: Bad ki lynti bah kin iap patiaw da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ïalehkai .
translation.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof .

translation.kha: Da lei lei nur ym ïadon bad ki ha ki jingïaphylliew jingmut barieh jrong ki . Da lei lei ngan ym ïashongsuk len bad ki ha ki jingïakynduh jongngi ki , naba hir ki kiei bitar ki pynïap ïa ki briew , bad ki pyndkoh ïa ki masi shynrang kum ka jinglehkai sngewbha .
translation.en: O my soul , come not thou into their secret  ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .

translation.kha: U rangbah pynkular jong ka kynhun shipai u Pekahaïah , u Pekah u khulom jong u Remalaïah , ki ïasylla lem Bad ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah na Gilead , ki pynïap ïa u Pekahaïah ha ka bynta baheh jong ka kynroh ka ïingsyiem ha Samaria , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah , a captain of his , conspired against him , and smote him in Samaria , in the palace of the king s house , with Argob and Arieh , and with him fifty men of the Gileadites : and he killed him , and reigned in his room .

translation.kha: U la ailad ïa phi! ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong u na bneng khnang ba u ia ban hikai ïa phi ; bad hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phin iohi ïa ka ding kiba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .
translation.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei , ïa uba nga shakri da ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la leh . Nga ainguh ïa u haba nga kynmaw ïa me borabor ha ki jingduwai jong nga mynmiet bad mynsngi .

translation.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ki dkhot jong ki balang ha Judia kim pat ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

translation.en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding kaba meh , bad ka bam duh khoit ïa kita ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wanrah ïa ki jingiwbih .

translation.en: And now the  Lord  shew kindness and truth unto you : and I also will requite you this kindness , because ye have done this thing .
translation.kha: Bad mynta pat , to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh skhem bad phi . Nga ruh ngan lehbha ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .
Lada phi klet ïa U Terah U Blei jong phi , bad phiah phai sha kiwei! patar ki plie ban mane bad ban shakri ïa ki , nga maham jrong ïa pa’ ha kane ka sngi ba phin ïap da shisha .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou do at all forget the  Lord  thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them , and worship them , I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew kin ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jyllang ki .
translation.en: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?

translation.kha: kaba kynthup ïa ka ri ki Ken , ki Kenis , ki Gadmon ,
translation.en: The Kenites , and the Kenizzites , and the Kadmonites ,

translation.kha: Ym donkam ban thom ha phi , ko phlangïap , shaphang ki por bad ki khep haba kine kiei kiei kin jia .
translation.en: But of the times and the seasons , brethren , ye have no need that I write unto you .

translation.kha: Ngi khlem iohpateng iakane ka pyrthei na ki mynmiet jingai , ngi pankylliang na ki khun jongngi .
translation.en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors , we borrow it from our children .

translation.kha: naba ngi long ki dkhot ka jemnud jong u .
translation.en: For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Benabinadab u la hukum ïa u Nebat , u rangbah shipai , ban ai ïa kaei ka hukum harum :
translation.en: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard , saying ,

translation.kha: Pha la don ki jingdeng kiba da ka ksiew bad ka rupa , bad borabor pha ju phong ki jaiñ linen badno rusom ba la suh syntiew . Pha la bam u kpu uba la shna na u purew babha tam malade pha la ne ka ngap pynlang ka umphniang Olib ïa-ban bam . Ka jingaibor jong pha ka long kaba phin itynnat , bad pha la long ka syiem .
translation.en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver  ; and thy raiment was of fine linen , and silk , and broidered work  ; thou didst eat fine flour , and honey , and oil : and thou wast exceeding beautiful , and thou didst prosper into a kingdom .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiew ki synran , ki la ieh ïa u paidbah babun sawdong jong ki bad katto katne na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïaduna mala ki .
translation.en: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san sad ki la noh , Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam kan kano tad ynda ngi la pynïap ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .

translation.kha: Kumta wir ki syiem phylliew ki wanrah ha ka ikhyllah hynñiew thyllah ki saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , bad ka khum ïa u Samson da ki .
translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried , and she bound him with them .

translation.kha: hynrei u la pynngam jyllop ïa u syiemsad ka jingpeit Bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jongngi u ; ka jingieit jong u ka noh bymjukut .
translation.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea : for his mercy endureth for ever .
And they answered the angel of the  Lord  that stood among the myrtle trees , and said , We have walked to and fro through the earth , and , behold , all the earth sitteth still , and is at rest .
translation.kha: Ki la wan ïathuh ha u angel :  Ngi la leit sha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngi la shem ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapdeng ka jingbymlah ban leh ei ei bad ha ka jingshah pyndem .

translation.en: And they went up , and pitched in Kirjath–jearim , in Judah : wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day : behold , it is behind Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Ki leit kiew bad sher dara ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Kiriath Jearim kaba ha Judah . Dei namar kata balei ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Jaka Sher Dara ki Dan .
uta u bariew un khi lyngdoh ïa la ka khlieh , wai noh ïa ka jaka bit prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngew .
translation.en: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :

translation.kha: Ken ym bud ïa uwei patar ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , ñiar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jongnga u .
translation.en: And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .

translation.kha: Tharai uno uno u shim ïa ka lyngkhot deng ba la pynkyntang na ka jingkieng bad u rah ha ka jingpyndep jong ka jaiñkup jong u . Te lada u kum pyndei ïa la ka jaiñkup ha uno uno u kpa , ka jingbam ba la shet , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Seeb , ne ka dei kano kano ka jait jingman , hato kane pynlong ba la pynkyntang ruh ïa kata ka jingbam ? Haba la kylli ïa said ka jingkylli , ki lyngkhuh ki Joab , Em .
translation.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Abimelekh ba ki la ïalum hangta ,
translation.en: And it was told Abimelech , that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .

translation.kha: bad Sei kilo u purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot , lem thang malu ïa ki jingainguh saiñ kiba donkam .
translation.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs :
Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .

translation.en: Having therefore , brethren , boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus ,
translation.kha: Ngi don , namar kata , ko parabangeit jong nga ïa ka jinglaitluid ba-pura ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam da kata ka jingïap U Jisu .

translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , Can the blind lead the blind ? shall they not both fall into the ditch ?
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : U briew uba matlah um lah ban ïalam ïa uwei pat ; lada u leh kumta , baroh ar ngut kin hap hapoh kharai .

U Trai u ong , Ki paid Israel ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki die sha ka jinglongmraw ïa ki briew kiba hok ki bymlah lah siew pah ïa ki riam jong ki , ki briew kiba duk ki bym lah siew bapaw wat ïa ka pynseisoh sia jur ki juti .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban kit ïa ka ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad ïa ki tiar baroh ïa kiba la pynbunkam ha ka jingmlien .
translation.en: And also unto the Levites  ; they shall no more carry the tabernacle , nor any vessels of it for the service thereof .
Gradually they would have made the entire earth into a paradise .—Genesis 1 :28  ; 2 :8 , 15 .
translation.kha: Suki suki kin pynkylla ïa ka sha ka paradais .—Jenesis 1 :28 ; 2 :8 , 15 .

translation.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
translation.kha: U Jeshua , u Lebi , lem bad ki khun shynrang bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka kur Henadad . )

?(Nga la ong ha lade ba ki kular jong phi! , ko kyndon , kin pynshngain ïa nga , namar ba u syiem u long kum u angel jong U Blei bad u lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew . To U Trai U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi !
translation.en: Then thine handmaid said , The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable : for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad : therefore the  Lord  thy God will be with thee .
( Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley . ) To morrow turn you , and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jong ka . Phai noh lashai ka sngi bad leit sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang jong ka khmut duriaw Akaba .

translation.en: And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee .
translation.kha: Une u maw buh jingkynmaw ïa uba nga la thung un long ka jaka ha kaba ïa me yn mane , bad ngan ai sha me ïa kaba shiphew na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ïa nga .
Ka dei ka jingkhlaiñ jong u kaba jop ïa ka duriaw ; da ka jingtbit jong u , u pynjot ïa u Rahab u mrad kynsha .
translation.en: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .

translation.kha: Kumta ngi iohi ia ka jongisynei jinglui , ba u la ai ha ngi ka jingisynei , te ngiam dei ban kyllon
translation.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry , as we have received mercy , we faint not ;
Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar da lade un kyrshan ïa nga — uno te , uba lah ban pynshisha ba nga long uba la shah pynrem ? Baroh ki nongmudui jong nga kin jah noh ; kin jah kum ka jaiñ ba la bam khñiang .
Kyrpad na U Trai ban kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phin ïoh jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .
translation.en: Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
The same followed Paul and us , and cried , saying , These men are the servants of the most high God , which shew unto us the way of salvation .
translation.kha: Ka la bud ïa u Paul bad ïa ngi , ka da pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki long ki shakri U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Ki pynbna ha phi kumno ba yn pynim ïa phi !
Ki synriah ki la kylli ïa u , Hangno , ko Trai’ ? U Jisu u la jyllop , Hangno hangno ha kaba ne ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .
translation.en: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Uta uba waiñ ïa u kpu ha ka pliang blem bad at , un shetkylla ïa nga .
translation.en: And he answered and said ,  He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish , the same shall betray me .

translation.kha: U Abraham u pynkyrpang hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot na ka kynhun langbrot jongngi u ,
translation.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves .

translation.kha: Wat beit ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phira thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lama Phin har kumta , drama lai ba-bang pyndonkam ïa ki sohwaiñ lane ïa u soh jong uta uwei pud u jingthung .
translation.en: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .

translation.kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah Uba arphew snem litar kham Heh uba la wan na Ijipt un ym eriong sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Issakhar , bad u Jakob .’
translation.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :

translation.kha: U la Ong ba kane kan dei ka kupar jong pha . Kane ka den kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ba leh ïa pha , namar pha la kheit ïa u dara pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .
translation.en: This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .

translation.kha: haduh kata u la ïalap , bad la thop ïa u ha Bethlehem .
translation.en: Then died Ibzan , and was buried at Beth–lehem .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa jong u , u kyrngah , dara u ong , Nga tip , khur ; de tip . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Manasseh ruh kyang sa kylla un-long ka jingbhabriew ka khraw . Hynrei u para jong u un kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ki khunlung ki ksiew Jong u kin kylla long ki jingïambriew kiba khraw .
translation.en: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka por kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .

translation.en: These practices are wrong because ( 1 ) they make us their slaves , ( 2 ) they harm our bodies , and ( 3 ) they are unclean .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingmlien ki long ki bymdei namar ( 1 ) Ki pynlong ïa ngi ki mraw jong ki ( 2 ) Ki pynsniew ïa ka met jong ngi , bad ( 3 ) Ki long ki bymkhuid .
Te ha ka jingjot jong ki , ki la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u la pynim ïa ki na ka jingjlan jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .

translation.kha: To shim ïa nga bad phiah , bad ngin ïaphet noh ; to long u syiem jong nga bad smat ïa nga sha ka kamra jong phi . Ngin ïakut lang , ngin ïathied bun badno pyllaitluid borbah ïa lade ha ka jingieit . Kam long ka phylla ba borbah ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !
translation.en: He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .

translation.kha: Da pahara Leit ym pynïap ïa kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym ia ban long . niam ia ban ai kumta . Lada me leh kum , kiba hok kin shuh pynshitom ryngkat bun ki pyrman . Katta ka i lah don long . U nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh u dei ban lyoh .
translation.en: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , balei me pyntud ? To ïeng joit bad shah ba yn pynbaptis ïa me bad sait noh ïa ki pop jong me da kaba duwai sha u .’

translation.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation  ; and give him a charge in their sight .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u paidlang baroh , bad hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh to pynbna ba ma u un long u nongmih bujli jong me .
Ka ong , Ko rangbah , to dih bad ka pynhiar krai kloi ïa uta u khiew um na ka tyngkreiñ jong ka , bad ka pynbat kato u dang sdieh .
translation.en: And she said , Drink , my lord : and she hasted , and let down her pitcher upon her hand , and gave him drink .

translation.kha: Kumta la la ang ïa la ka shyntur , bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli ban bam .
translation.en: So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat that roll .

translation.kha: Kñia ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U Trai u la ong shaphang ki khun ki khiew jongnga u Ahab ka wan jia shisha . U tharai u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa jong u .
translation.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , ka sngi kaba u hi u la buh , u leit sha Bethel malu u kñia ka jingainguh ha ka duwan ban raikhoh ïa ka jingkwah niam ba u la seng na ka bynta ki pangnud Israel .
translation.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart  ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .

translation.kha: Phibi ïatei ïoh ïa ki briew kiba duk lem badno Phin , hynrei phin ym ïoh ïa nga borabor .
translation.en: For ye have the poor always with you  ; but me ye have not always .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha Ramah , ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam kthang . Ka Rakkath ka ïam namar ki khun jong ka ; ki la ïalap noh , bad kam treh ba yn pyntngen ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .

Then said David , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father shewed kindness unto me . And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father . And David s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Nga dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jingneh ka jingïalong paralok ïa u Hanun , kumba u Nahash , u kpa jong u , u la leh ïa nga .  Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon ,

U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Phim tip ïa kaei kaba pa’ pang . Hato phi lah banbeiñ dih na ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom kaba por dei ban dih ? Hato phi lah Ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar ïa ki Eliel malade u pyndam ïa ki na khmat jrong u , da kaba iehnoh Tang ïa ka hima Judah .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .

translation.kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kba jong u , u dei u nongthain jingïaphet bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dem ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri wahbah na ka jait Dan . Une u biria u ïakdang bad uwei u Israel hapoh ka jaka shong dara . Katto ki dang ïakajia kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U Trai : kumta ki wan ïalaw ïa u ha u Moses .
