translation.kha: Ka kada ka phai ktien , Hato ngam dei kajuh ka kada ha kaba phi la ju shong baroh shi rta haduh mynta ? Hato nga la ju leh kumne ïa phi ? Em , u jubab .
translation.en: And the ass said unto Balaam , Am not I thine ass , upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day ? was I ever wont to do so unto thee ? And he said , Nay .

translation.kha: Ka ri jong phi harud duriaw kan kylla long ki pyntha bym don jingkah lema bad ki trep jong ki nongap langbrot badno ki sem langbrot .
translation.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds , and folds for flocks .

translation.kha: Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kam u pyrkhat .
translation.en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .

translation.kha: Ka por ka wan haba U Trai Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na khnai ka ri ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ nabar kaba donbor , ki briew kiba jrong bad kiba lyoh ka sngewthait , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei barben . Ken wan sha u Lum Seïon , ha kaba la mane ïa U TRAI’ badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .
Therefore the  Lord  hath recompensed me according to my righteousness  ; according to my cleanness in his eye sight .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei , namar u tip ba nga long uba shida .

Ha ki shiteng na ka jat Manasseh , nga ai ïa kaweh sah na ka ri Gilead bad ïa ka Bashan baroh kawei , ha kaba u Og u nongsynshar , kaba mut ïa ka thain Ariopagos baroh kawei . ( Ïa ka Bashan la tip kumto ka ri jong ki Rephaim .
translation.en: And the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , being the kingdom of Og , gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh  ; all the region of Argob , with all Bashan , which was called the land of giants .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba bahynriew , jong ka snem kob hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah Kiba la shah rmiang na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing jong nga . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jongki U Trai Nongsynshar ka la wan halor jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .

translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh ,
translation.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .

translation.kha: Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ? U Jiw u la kylli . Hynñiew tylli ki kpu , ki la jubab , bad khyndiat ki donhok rieh .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u :  Hato mem long U Messaïah ? To pynim ïa lade bad ïa ngi !
U Haron bad u Moses ki la long kita ha katba U Trai u la ong , Ïalam noh ïa ki jait Israel na jingïaphet .
translation.en: These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the  Lord  said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .

translation.kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u Samuel , kumba u Samuel u la Bthah ïa u ban har , hynrei u Samuel um pat shym wan poi sha Gilgal .
translation.en: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh , pynban , u la ïai mutlop bad Rumah U Terah u la ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translation.en: And he hardened Pharaoh s heart , that he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .

But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada U  Trai  u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ym pat ju ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don , ba kumta ki hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa tip ba kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa U  Trai .
U Tom u dei u paralok jong u paralok jong nga .
translation.en: Tom is a friend of a friend of mine .
Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,
translation.kha: Hato ka jingim jong me ka lyngkot kum ka jong ngi ?

Hynrei nangta ki kynthih ïa ki por kiba mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u Shakri U Trai bad ki kylli , Hangno Mynta u don U TRAI’ , uba pynkoit im ïa ki jingïalam jong ki brai jongno u na ka duriaw ? Hangno u don U Trai , uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?
translation.en: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?

translation.kha: Kine ki long khie kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew . Khenani ban ïam khlem da thet ïa ki kti Jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban leh kum — Kanaan kur pynlong bymkohnguh ïa u briew .
translation.en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Dei ma nga , ma nga ken kiba ïakren bad pha .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  I that speak unto thee am he .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw Bad ym khem ki Jeiel bapop kumba la khot ïa ki .
translation.en: We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,

translation.kha: Ki ong ïa ki nonghiarpateng pun sngap jar . Ki ong , Wat kren ha ngi shaïong kaei kaba dei . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa Kiei kaba ngi kwah ban ïohsngew . Ai ba ki jingïohi rngai jongngi ngi kin sah bad ngi .
translation.en: Which say to the seers , See not  ; and to the prophets , Prophesy not unto us right things , speak unto us smooth things , prophesy deceits :

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shrak ha ki jaka mane blei jong ki Jiw kim don hok ban bameh na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kabu la buh halor ka duwan jong ngi .
translation.en: We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Hib ki wallam ïa phi ban shah tyngkan kotbah ha ki synagog lane ha khmat ki lyngskor lin ki nongsynshar , wat sngewkhuslai Shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade lane ïa kaei phin kren .
translation.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues , and unto magistrates , and powers , take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer , or what ye shall say :

translation.kha: Phi la banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad la shim jubor na ki ïa u kew Jong ki . Bad kumta phin ym ïoh law ha ki ïing maw ba-itynnat ba phi la teh lane dih waiñ na ki byrni shongsaiñ kiba itynnat ba pa’ la thung .
translation.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .

And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .
translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kaba harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .

translation.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang sah ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U  Trai  ba lada un ïalam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan mane ïa u ha Hebron .
Baroh shi miet , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïaid na Gilgal sha Gibeon bad ki la tur kyntu ban ïaleh ïa ki hati .
translation.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah ha Judah bad ha baroh ki shnong jong ka , bad kin don ki nongrep , bad ki nongap langbrot ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
Ha U Khrist la otsher ïa phi , ym da ka jingotsher kaba la thab da ki briew , hynrei da ka jingotsher ba la pynlong da U Khrist , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglong ba la laitluid na ka bor jong ka pop hi .
translation.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands , in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ :

translation.kha: Baroh ki la jingphohsniew ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel , bad na ka bynta kane , nga sngewkmen shibun shaphang jong phi . Nga kwah ïa pa ban long kiba bajar shaphang kadei kaweh bha , hynrei ban long lui lui ha kaei kaba sniew .
translation.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .

translation.kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki brup baroh kiba im ha ka pyllait da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw umbiah iing . U mradkhlaw u la ainong ïa ki ban teh ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shahshkor pynsniew da ka waitlam malade pynban uba dang im .
translation.en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros bad uwei pat u synran ki la bud ïa U Jisu . Uta uwei u synran u la long uba la ïa-ithuh bha bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh , kumta u la leit rung lem bad U Jisu sha ka phyllaw ïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , katba u Petros pat u la ïeng shabar hajan ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .
translation.kha: Haba ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shu knieh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu shim ïa ki . Ym don ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem jongno jongno kaba shongshngain .

Wanlam ïa ka jingmih baroh jongki shipai sha ka Tep , khnang ba yn khong ka bim kyrhai hangta . To tynjuh ïa nga bad phna sa ïohi ba ngan plie ïa ki jingkhangïit jong ka bneng bad theh noh ha phi kyrhai ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh .
translation.en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse , that there may be meat in mine house , and prove me now herewith , saith the  Lord  of hosts , if I will not open you the windows of heaven , and pour you out a blessing , that there shall not be room enough to receive it .

translation.kha: pynngam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba bajrong . Nga longïng U Trai U Blei jngai phi bad la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nabar , ka ding katba thang hapoh jong de . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jrong nga bad u la wanrah ïa to sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga bad ieh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baneh .
translation.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?

translation.kha: U pahuh ïa u diengpynïeng sharai hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka bujli kaba shaphang shathie , riewarsap kata ka miej ,
translation.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .

translation.kha: Ngi Tip ba U Khun U Blei u la wan sad u la ai ha i ïa ka jingshongshngain , Haneng ba ïeng tah ïa U Blei uba shisha . ngin im ha U Blei kiba bashisha — ha U Josis Khrist U Khun jong u . Une u long U Blei uba bashisha , bad kane ka long ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .
translation.kha: Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa me da kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ba me kren .
kumta u ong ha u , I pa i pynryngkang ban pynïap ïa phi . Sngewbha da kuna husiar lashai mynstep ; rieh ha ka jaka bym ne batip bad sah hangta .
translation.en: But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :

translation.kha: Katno keiñ ?
translation.en: How much are these ?
Rise , let us be going : behold , he is at hand that doth betray me .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit , ïa ngin leit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !

translation.en: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged  ; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin  ; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder , the groves and images shall not stand up .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki pop jong ki Israel yn map tang haba ïa ki maw jong ki duwan ki blei thala la pynlwet jin kum u shok , bad ba ym don shuh ki duwan thang iwbih lane ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kiba dang sah .

Ki shiphew ki la ïalam noh ïa U ijuh , dara katba ki dang leit , ki la ïashem ïa u briew babha ka Kyrini uba kyrteng u Shimron babha la wanpaw rung sha ka nongkhap . Ki la kem ïa u , ki buh ïa ka diengphna halor jongu u , bad ki la pynbang ïa u ban bah ïa ka haei U Jisu .
translation.en: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .
Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan bad khlem poi pyrkhat U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki  erïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki  erlangthari bad ka ding baklang ;

Namar ba u syep Ahas u la bor pop , U Trai U Blei jong u , u la shah ïa u syiem ka Syria ban jop ïa u sad ban kyrkhu koidi bun bah na ki Judia sha ïasakma . U tharai u la shah umdih ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u riewlamler , ban khop ïa u Ahas bad pynïap shi lakh synreit hajar ki shipai Judah kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U Tharai U Blei! jong ki kop tymmen jong ki u la shah ïa kane ban jia , namar ki briew ka Joïada ki la kyntait noh ïa u .
translation.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .
And the sign or the wonder come to pass , whereof he spake unto thee , saying , Let us go after other gods , which thou hast not known , and let us serve them  ;
translation.kha: khnang ban ïalam ïa phi ban mane bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba phim pat ju mane mynshuwa . Wat la kata kaba u kular ka urlong shisha , wat shahshkor ïa u .
Haba U Jisu u la snar shapoh ka ïing , ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba Mahalath ki la ïawan sha u , bad u la kylli ïa ki , Haseroth phi kjit ba nga lah ban pynkhiah ïa phi ? Hooid , Kynrad ! ki la jubab .
translation.en: And when he was come into the house , the blind men came to him : and Jesus saith unto them ,  Believe ye that I am able to do this ?  They said unto him , Yea , Lord .

translation.kha: Kan ym long jingmut! U Blei un hir uba shisha , wat la uwei pa uwei u briew u longsyiem uba shukor . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phi ba phi long kiba shisha haba phi kren ; phi dei banbeiñ jop ïa ka jingïaleh hato la bishar ïa phi .
translation.en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .

translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba nga ïalap ha pa kdew long kaba na ka tynrai u briew .
translation.en: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .

translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa ka pisa na ka pynbha ban siew ïa ka khajna ! Ki la wanrah ha u ïa ka pisa ,
translation.en: Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jiw u la ïuh ïa ka buit bashapoh jong ki bad u la jubab , Balei ba phi ïapyrshang ban rieh ïa la ? Wallam ïa ka sbai saw , bad ai ba ngan khmih ïa ka .
translation.en: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .

translation.kha: Haba ka plied ïa ka , ka ïor ïa u khunblang . Uba u khunlung u ïam , Bad ka sngewieit ïa u . Une te u dei uwei na ki khun Hebron , ka la ong .
translation.en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and , behold , the babe wept . And she had compassion on him , and said , This is one of the Hebrews  children .

translation.kha: bad u la leit phai pat sha la ka shnong . U la hikai ha ka synagog , bad kito babha ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh . Nangno u la ïoh kat kane ka jingstad ? ki la Kylli . Bad kumno shaphang ki kaweh jong u ?
translation.en: And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?

translation.kha: Kane ka lah ban i kum ka bym haka long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mandriek , hynrei kam long ka lai lah pun long ïa nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .

But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech , and Seraiah the son of Azriel , and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel , to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet : but the  Lord  hid them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa u khun syiem Jerahmeel , ryngkat bad u Seraïah u khun jong u Asriel bad u Shelemaïah u khun jong u Abdeel , ban kem ïa nga bad ïa u sekretari jong nga u Barukh . Hynrei U  Trai  u la buhrieh ïa ngi .
U Jehobah u ong ïa i ban kiar na ka jingmlien ba long pop namar ba u tip ba kin pynsniew ïa ngi .
translation.en: Jehovah tells us to avoid sinful practices because he knows they will harm us .

translation.kha: Kin shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingpynjot bymhok , kiba la pynïakhlad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong U tharai bad na ka jingkhlaiñbor badonbor jongki u ,
translation.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord , and from the glory of his power ;
Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Shano ba un sa leit ba ngi ngin ym shem ïa u ? Hato un leit sha ki shnong jong ki Grik ha kaba ki briew jong ngi ki sah , bad ban hikai ïa ki Grik ?
Ha ka jingim jong de kaba lyngkot ha ka pyrthei , ang thaw ki jingrwai shaphang ki sah jong me .
translation.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage .

translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki phasi , ki la kylli te ïa u Ïoannis , Lada Amam dih u Messaïah lap u Elihu lane u nongïathuhlypa , barli pat me pynbaptis ?
translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .
translation.kha: hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlem don khun shynrang ; u don tang ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kynthei jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , ki khun u Kish .
Nga kiaw ban don u ban ïasaid nabar U Blei na ka bynta jong de , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paralok jong u .
translation.en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: To ïarep ïa u da ki wiang ïohnong . To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong bajam .
translation.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .

translation.kha: Mynmiet ki shyieng Jong nga baroh ki pang ; ka jingpang kaweh bam ïa nga kam kut shuh .
translation.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .

translation.kha: Ki shympriah kjat — sei bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha — ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba khlaiñ bad shi bynta jongu ka kaba tlot .
translation.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ñiut ki tnad na ka bynta u syiem Joash , malu ki kha ïa u , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynther .
translation.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki sakhi ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib bad ki ar tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak Ibbah ïeng ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: These are the two olive trees , and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth .

translation.kha: Ha kine ki san bnai Kin wad ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka ; kin kwah ban ïap noh , hawei ka jingïap kan phet na ki .
translation.en: And in those days shall men seek death , and shall not find it  ; and shall desire to die , and death shall flee from them .

translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew’ ; wat tduh ; kam mudui lamler ïano ïano ; baburom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie .’
translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Honour thy father and thy mother .
Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoh ,  Namar U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .
Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba shut halor ka jingtei pynbha ïa ka Telem ,
translation.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :

translation.kha: ïa ka jingkyrhuh , lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U Blang jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha phiah mynta ka sngi ;
translation.en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :
I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .
translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ha phi ha kiei kiei baroh ba da kaba trei shitom ha kane ka rukom ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , da kaba kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba U Trai Jisu da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ka don ka jingkmen kaba kham khraw ha kaba ai ban ïa kaba pdiang .’

Na ka pynbha jong phi pat , ko ki pynbang jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban un-long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba kane ka jinglaitluid kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkyang pruh ka doh ban synsar ïa phi . pynban , ai ba ka jingngeit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa kiei pat .
translation.en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Samuel , naba ka ong ,  Nga la pan ïa u na U  Trai .

translation.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh hangta .

translation.en: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .
translation.kha: Don kiba la ong ,  U dei ma u ,  hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  Em , um dei ma u , u shu ïasyriem ïa u .  Kumta uta u briew hi u la ong ,  Dei ma nga uta u briew !

translation.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .

translation.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel ki ong ha u Gideon ,  To long u nongsynshar jong ngi — ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me . Me la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Midian .

Ha khmih kumno ki synñia khlaw ki san : Khim shym Tertios lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei de ong ha phi ba wat u skhem Simeon ha ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba pynitynnat katno Uei na kine ki syntiew .
translation.en: Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .

translation.kha: Ngan thung ïa ki nongsynshar ki ban sumar ïa ki . Ki briew jong nga kin ym sheptieng ne sngewshyrkhei , bad ngan ym pynshitom shuh ïa ki . Ma nga , U Trai , de la krai .
translation.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them : and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed , neither shall they be lacking , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingbishar ïa-ban mudui ïa Phin na ka bynta ka sopti-poh jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur pajut .
translation.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ngab bud pateng la pateng . Ha ka sneng kaba shiphew jongu u bneng uba hynñiew , ki Israel nabar ki nongwei kiba shong ryngkat bad ki , ki dei ban shahjingit bad ban ym trei ïa kano kano ka kur .
translation.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you : that in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , ye shall afflict your souls , and do no work at all , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger that sojourneth among you :

translation.kha: Ai ba ngan kohnguh janai ïa ki hukum jong me , ba ngan lait na ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop .
translation.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes  ; that I be not ashamed .

These are spots in your feasts of charity , when they feast with you , feeding themselves without fear : clouds they are without water , carried about of winds  ; trees whose fruit withereth , without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots  ;
translation.kha: Da ki jingkhroh bym don jinglehrain , ki long ka jingthohbria ha ki jingkhawai ïasyllok jong phi . Ki kitkhia tang na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki long kum ki lyoh ba rah ka lyer , hynrei khlem wanrah slap . Ki long kum ki dieng ba khlem soh , wat ha ka synrai , ki dieng ba la rat naduh ki thied bad kiba la ïap noh .

translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka long ka jingleh bieit ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka por ha ki kam bymmyntoi .

woh u briew ibha jem tam ka dohnud uba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , un poi ha ka kutlad ha ka por ba u shahshkor kerkut , kat ban da bam ïa la ki khulom namarba ba um don kawei pat ka jait jingbam . Un ym ai ei ei wat ïa la u para ne ka tnga kaba u ieit ne ïa la ki khun kiba dang don bad u .
translation.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat : because he hath nothing left him in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates .

Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang kine ki briew ,  Ki ieit ban phet noh na nga , bad kin ym lah ban bat synshar ïa lade . Kumta ngam shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la leh bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .

Markylliang yn tap ïa phi da ka jinglehrain ha ka jaka ka brup . Phi ruh pher ïadih bad ïaid sheng sheng . U Trai un pynlong ïa phi ban dih na la ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , bad ka bhor jrong phira kan kylla sha ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory : drink thou also , and let thy foreskin be uncovered : the cup of the  Lord s  right hand shall be turned unto thee , and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory .

translation.kha: Man ka sngi nga la don pynlang phoi ban hikai ha ka Templ , mala Kino shym la kem ïa nga . Hynrei ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki de ban urlong shisha .
translation.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and ye took me not : but the scriptures must be fulfilled .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u suda ba kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met u kpa jyllang u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki lai kumta .
translation.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .

translation.kha: ka Eglon , ka Geser ,
translation.en: The king of Eglon , one  ; the king of Gezer , one  ;

translation.kha: U la jied ïa u Jakeh na ka bynta ïa ailad , ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai jong ki , ki tur jubor sha khmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shispah .
translation.en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .

translation.kha: kiew kiei kiba nga ïathuhlypa myntoi ki la jhieh shisha . Myntan ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin sdang ban jia .
translation.en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
As saith the proverb of the ancients , Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingong mynbarim , ‘ Ïa ka jingbymman la leh tang da ki riewbymman .’ Bad kumta ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki long ka Siddim , ka Ser , ka khamtam , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,
translation.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,

translation.kha: Phi sngew wohnia phi! ne halor ka duriaw-bah , phira ïohpang duriaw , shiah pynshad kynting shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka lyngngoh .
translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
In the first chariot were red horses  ; and in the second chariot black horses  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom kaba nyngkong la tan da ki kulai rong saw , ïa kaba ar da ki kulai rong ïong ,

translation.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
translation.kha: Ki tih shaduh ki tyllong jong ki wah , bad ki wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh .
Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylla , Hato ym don sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ngin kylli ïa U Trai ?
translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?

translation.kha: Uwei hajan uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ sa erlangthari u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasan bad u bastad Israel . Uwei pa uwei un shon ha ka ksing ti jong u ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai bad un khot ïa latai uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kpa jong ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , bad mynta ki kmie jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .
Ka Silpah ka kha sa uwei pat u khun ïa u Jakob ,
translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a second son .

translation.kha: Um shym bud ïa ki nuksa babha jong u syiem Dabid u kpa thnam jong u ; pynban , u ni ïa khie kaba pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei jong u bad u bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki syier Israel .
translation.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .
When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?
translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me long u nongwei , bad ba ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa me ha ki ïing jong ngi , lane ba me lyngkhuit bad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they departed from him , Peter said unto Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias : not knowing what he said .
translation.kha: Katba kita ki rangbah ki dang leit noh na U Jisu , u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .  ( Um tip da shisha ïa kaei kaba u kren . )

translation.en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
translation.kha: Borabor nga la lehhok bad lehbha .
Ong ïa ki briew ban kynriah sha jngai na ki ïingjaiñ jongngi u Kohath , u Dedan , bad u Abiram .
translation.en: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban ïatip ïa ka mon U Blei , hynrei U Blei da lade hi u ai ïa ka jubab .
translation.en: The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins    baroh kawei jong ka Judia bad na kylleng ka ri kaba hajan ka wah Jordan .

Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki kba tymmen jong ki mynba nga la pynpaw ïa la ka bol ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U Trai , nga lah Ban long U Blei jong ki . “Nga longïing U Trai .
translation.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee : begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn .
translation.kha: Ñiew hynñiew taïew naduh ba phi sdang ot ïa u kew ,

translation.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods , and one call thee , and thou eat of his sacrifice  ;
translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri , namar haba ki mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki , bad kñia ha ki , kin sa khot sngewbha ïa phi ban ïasoh bad ki , bad phin shah pynshoi ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki ai ïa ki blei jong ki .

Na thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong per , namar Phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kjap , namsop phi tiduh ïa u , suba la don nud kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phiah , ko ki khun jingkup , namar phi long Kiba khlaiñbor ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , Bad phi la jop noh! thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad kine nang ïoh ka nam ka barhem , hynrei ki bariew kiba brup kin nang angnud ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
As for thee , O king , thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed , what should come to pass hereafter : and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass .
translation.kha: Mynba u Syiem Kynrad u dang ïohthiah , phi la phohsniew shaphang ka lawei ; bad U Blei uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan , u la pyn-i ha phi kaei ka ban sa jia .
Na ka bynta ki angel , te , ka briew ka dei ban don ka jingwad halor la ka khlieh ban pynsep-ei ba ka long haw ka bor u tnga jong ka .
translation.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels .
We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban siew na ka bynta ka um kaba ngi dih ; ngi dei ban thied ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .
Uta u nongkheiñ ka Hukum u la ong ïa U Jisu , Kaba dien , ko Nonghikai ! Ka long kaba shisha , wohnia me la ong , ba tang U Trai u long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ma u .
translation.en: And the scribe said unto him , Well , Master , thou hast said the truth : for there is one God  ; and there is none other but he :

translation.kha: Kumta ine ki rangbah san ngut ki mihnoh bad ki leit sha ka shnong laiñ . Ki ïohi kumno ki briew klang ki ïashong shngain , kumba long ki nong Sidon . Ki long Kiba ïashongsuk bad ki bynriew kiba jar jar , kim don jingïania Badno badno ; ki don lut kato kaba ki donhok . Ki shong kham jngai na ki nong Sidon dara ktieh pynïadei nabar kiwei ki briew .
translation.en: Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .

translation.kha: Ka ri kan seisoh bha , bad phin ïoh Ban bam kat ïa kaba phi khih , bad phin ïoh shongshngain hangta .
translation.en: And the land shall yield her fruit , and ye shall eat your fill , and dwell therein in safety .
And the king of Israel called for one of his officers , and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u khot shapoh ïa u rangbah ka ïingsyiem bad ong ïa u ban leit bad wallam shisyndon ïa u Mikaïah .

U syiem Ahas u shim keirang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ dara treng ne ïa ki khiew kiba don hiar jong ki ; u shimti ïa ka pait ïohnong na ki bynta ba hadien jong ki khat-ar tylli ki malai ibha rnong , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim .
translation.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .
And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pynbiang ïa lade kawei ka kali ïapom bad ki kulai lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synran ïa u .

translation.en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob , and also my covenant with Isaac , and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember  ; and I will remember the land .
translation.kha: ngan sa kynmaw ïa la ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad u Jakob bad u Isaak bad u Abraham , bad ngan sa pynthymmai ïa la ka kular ban ai ïa kata ka ri ha ki briew jong nga .

Haba ka jingjot ka wan bad ïa ki briew la pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin lalot ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep hangta ha Memphis ! Ki jingdon jingem Jong ki kumin ka rupa bad ki jaka ha naba ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la sheng yn tap da ki ñiuhtmoh bad ki bniap shiah .
translation.en: For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .

translation.kha: Hynrei U baburom u ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , Kumno keiñ por lah ban tip ba sa long ka jong nga ?
translation.en: And he said , Lord  God  , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?

For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Naba don ki briew ki bymriewblei hapdeng jong ngi , kiba la syntuid noh khlem poi pyrkhat , ki briew kiba la pynkylla ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi , khnang ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia , bad kiba kyntait ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi . La slem bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingpynrem kaba ki la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka la khie bad ka la sdang ban ïaid shane shatai . ( Ka la don khat-ar snem ka rta . ) Haba kane ka la jia , ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh .

Hynrei ka long namar ba U Terah u ieit ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kob u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , badno namar kata u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u bad u la pyllait na ka jinglongmraw ïa phi na u Pharaoh u syiem ka Ijipt .
translation.en: But because the  Lord  loved you , and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the  Lord  brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ap ïa uta uba ïaid sakhi na ka lynti ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .

translation.kha: bad kumjuh ruh ki para ba-ïatrei lema bad at u Markos , u Iskariot , u Rameses , nabar u —Loukas .
translation.en: Mark , Aristarchus , Demas , Luke , my fellowlabourers .

translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nongbylla , kob long ka dak kaba khuid jyllang ka jingpynkyntang , bad ki thoh ha ka , La Pynkyntang sha U thri .
translation.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .

translation.kha: bad ki la ïa-rai ban shukor ïa u . Ki la leit bad rah katto katne ka jingbam bad ki pynkit ha ki puta jong ki da ki byrni jot bad ki pla snieh waiñ babha la syrdep .
translation.en: They did work wilily , and went and made as if they had been ambassadors , and took old sacks upon their asses , and wine bottles , old , and rent , and bound up  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno naba peit bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllew ïa ki briew , kiba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka bad ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ba-bang klet napoh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei ha kaei kaei naba u leh .
translation.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .

translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la kwah ban tipthuh tiak ïa kaei ba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa u Paul ; kumta ha ka sngi kaban bur u la phah weng noh ïa ki kynjri na u Petros bad u la hukum ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh pynlang ïa ka Dorbar baroh ban ïaknieh lang . Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jongu ki .
translation.en: On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .
And the graves were opened  ; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose ,
translation.kha: ki jingtep ki la ang , bad ïa shibun ki briew jong U Blei kiba la ïap la pynmihpat .
Ki la khot ïa u Barnabas da ka kyrteng Seus , bad ïa u Baal da ka kyrteng Hermes , namar ba u long u nongkren kiba kham ha khmat .
translation.en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter  ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .

translation.kha: kiei pat ki briew ki longsem kiba khwan myntoi bad ibha kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khring ban brup ïa kaei ka bym dei ; halor jongnga ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla .
translation.en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,

translation.kha: ïathiah ha ki , ba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbit ban iohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jingem da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba leh pah bad u im . Ko Isaia , sangeh noh ka bymman ba phalang kun . Balei pha kwah ban ïap ?
translation.en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban shahshkor ïa ki ktien kiba jar jar jong uno uno uba stad ban ïa ki jingpyrta jong u nongsynshar ha ka dorbar jong ki bieit .

translation.en: And if it be meet that I go also , they shall go with me .
translation.kha: Lada ka i long kaba myntoi ïa nga ban leit , te ki lah ban ïaleit ryngkat bad nga .

translation.en: How say ye , We are mighty and strong men for the war ?
translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah ka Moab , balei ba phi kam ïa lade kum ki riewkhraw , ki shipai bashlur ba la tynjuh ha ka thma ?
Ha ka por ka jingsynshar lad u ka rupa ka don kynrei ha Jerusalem Rumah don u miej , bad ïa u dieng Kedar kitab pahuh u dieng Dumbur ha ki kjat lum ka Judah .
translation.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones , and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale , for abundance .

And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum lem bad ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka jaka madan lem bad kiba bun ki synran jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangta na kylleng ka Judia bad na Jerusalem bad na ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon kiba harud duriaw ;

translation.en: Now upon the first day of the week , very early in the morning , they came unto the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared , and certain others with them .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step Sngi U Trai ki kynthei ki la leit sha ka jingtep ki da rah ïa ki musla kiba ki la pynkhreh .
Ki shata , ki tnum , bad ka ktang u diengpynïeng sharak ki long kiba ïadait Ngan kawei da ka ksiar nylla ba la shoh .
translation.en: Their knops and their branches were of the same : all of it was one beaten work of pure gold .

translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jingïaroh jongno ki ingmane ki para jong pha ha Judah . Pha la dei ba-bang ym lehkmen ha ka sngi ka jingpynjot ïa ki . Pha la dei ban ym ishyrkhei ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jyllang ki .
translation.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .

translation.kha: Kum ki shah ïa ki Philistia ban ïohi ïa ki , bad ki Philistia ki ino , Ha khmih ! katto katne ki Hebru ki wan mih na ki thliew ha kiba ki rieh !
translation.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines : and the Philistines said , Behold , the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves .

translation.kha: U ïohsngew ïa ngi man ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar ba moi ïatip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi thup ruh ba u ai ha moi ïa kaei kaba ngi kynrad na u .
translation.en: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .

translation.kha: Barukh sawdong jong u ka jingshyrkhei ka ap ; ka bur ïa u ha man ka sien jam .
translation.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side , and shall drive him to his feet .
And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?
translation.kha: u pyrta ïa ki shipai u Saul bad ïa u Abner ,  Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew ïa nga ?   Uei uta uba pyrta bad uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ?  u Abner u kylli .
Phi la pynmeh bad phi la pynpei ïa ki briew kiba yn lui , bad Ki shym pyneh ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just  ; and he doth not resist you .
And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the  Lord  , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony , that he die not :
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat U  Trai  un thang ïa kata ka jingiwbih , halor ka ding bad ka tdem jong kata ka jingiwbih kan kah ïa ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang khnang ba un ym ïohi ïa ka bad u ïap .

translation.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :
translation.kha: Ma phi baroh kiba nga la phah sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong .’
Kumne ki Israel ki bret noh ïa ki bleithaw u Baal bad ka Astarte , bad ki la mane tang ïa U thri .
translation.en: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtoreth , and served the  Lord  only .

translation.kha: Nangta u pud jongnga ka u suh beit shaphang sepngi shaid Mareal , da kaba ktah ïa ka Dabbesheth bad ïa ka thohshuid kaba sha mihngi jrong ka Jokneam .
translation.en: And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;
Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .
translation.kha: Khie leit biang , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u don ban ong . Nangta wan phai pat bad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la kren ha phi . Ngin shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa ka .’
Namarba phim pat rung ha kata ka ri ba U Trai’ U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , ha kaba phin ïoh shongsaiñ shongsah .
translation.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance , which the  Lord  your God giveth you .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba kheit kor bol ïa kano Kano ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , ine uno u ban bim ïa kaei kaei , un leh Kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U thri , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Un un umbiah kynta ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U blem .
translation.en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na pha shano ha Sabad kiei shym la pyntngit ïa ki jingkup jong ki . Phan ïaid ryngkat bad nga , da kabu phrang da ki jabieng balieh , namar pha long kaba dien hok ban leh kumta .
translation.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments  ; and they shall walk with me in white : for they are worthy .
Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob  ;
translation.kha: To khynñiuh , ko khyndew , ha ka jingwan jong U  Trai  , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei jong u Jakob ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God , he stood by the lake of Gennesaret ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la ïeng harud jong ka duriaw Gennesaret katba ki briew ki dang ïawan kiew sha u ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .
kumto u Ïoannis u la leit kylleng ka thain Baroh jong ka woh Jordan , u da ïalap , To pait noh na ki pum jong ph bad to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei un map ïa ki pep Jong phi .
translation.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;

translation.kha: manbha per ïambriew , ngam shem la Bam ei ei na ka ; mynba nga long u bymkhuid , ngam Shimham la rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka kumto ka jingiw ïa kiba ïap . Nga la kthong ïa me , ko Trai ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh’ katto kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei bad kamai na ki shiphew .
translation.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .

translation.kha: “Nga la ong , Nga la trei , hynrei kattne ka un-long kaba duh jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei . Pynban nga lah ba-bang shano ha U Trai ban kyrshan na ka pynbha jngai nga ; un ai bainong ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga leh .
translation.en: Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .
And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri haduh kawei pat ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u long shisha u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai .

U syier Manasseh u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei Kiba kham sniew ngab ïa kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la ni , bad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki briew jong ka Judah ban leh pop .
translation.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :

translation.kha: pynap kim sngewthuh kaei kaba la jia tad haduh ba ka jinglehkai um ka la wan bad ka rong noh ïa ki baroh . Kan sa long kumta haba U Khun U bhabriew u wanpaw .
translation.en: And knew not until the flood came , and took them all away  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , to kruiñ pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh Ibbah ha ka ri Jingtep kin shah pynkhyllem .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :

translation.kha: U Trai u la Ong , Ko khun u brai , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bun pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u ñiuhtmoh bad u khliehduh jong me barben . Nahath thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .

translation.kha: U Jakob u kylli ïa ki nongap langbrot , Ko paralok , phi dei kiba na-ei ? Na Haran , ki jubab .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto them , My brethren , whence be ye ? And they said , Of Haran are we .

translation.kha: ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Politics ki la sdang ban khñium , Uno u bariew u pyndeng sngewbha ïa kiba shah kyntait bad u da ïabam lem bad ki !
translation.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .
Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee ,  Take up thy bed , and walk ?
translation.kha: Ki la kylli ïa u ,  Uei uta u briew uba la ong ïa me ban leh kumne ?

translation.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , namar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mane blei thala , ki ban sa ïuhroit ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid haduh sawphew ar bnai .
Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka erïong , ka hir ka ban khie bitar halor ki khlaiñ jong ki bymdon ,
translation.en: Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .

translation.kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jong me ha nga , u shakri jong me — ka jingkular kaban me pynpang ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa me .
translation.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .

translation.kha: To ki shnong jong u ktang long kiba la kurim da ki khyrdop nar , Bad to un shongsuk shongsaiñ borabor .
translation.en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .

translation.kha: Namar ba ngi dien ki khun jong ki ngi la iohpateng ia ine ki jingbymïaineh bad jingairam . —Nong Rom 5 :12 .
translation.en: Consistent with the laws of genetics , we have inherited that imperfection and death . —Romans 5 :12 .

translation.kha: Hynrei naduh mynta U Khun U Briew un shong ha ka buit kamon jongno U blang Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .
Take heed to yourselves , that your heart be not deceived , and ye turn aside , and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
translation.kha: Da husiar ban ym shah ïalam bakla noh na U  Trai  ban mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate : and the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died , as the man of God had said , who spake when the king came down to him .
translation.kha: Ka leit jingjia ryngkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la buh ha ka khyrdop nongbah hapoh ka jingpeit jong u rangbah pynïaidkam uba dei u nongïarap ba-hajan jong u . U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shah ïuh hangta ha ki paidbah bad u la ïap kumba u Elisha u la ïathuh lypa mynba u syiem u la leit ïakynduh ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .
translation.kha: Kumta haba U Blei u la phah noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga sha ki ri nongwei , nga ong ha ka , ‘ Pha lah ban pyn-i haduh katno pha shaniah ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa iwei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jong pha .’
Ki la sngewma bad ki la thiaw ban siew pisa ïa u .
translation.en: And they were glad , and covenanted to give him money .
And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; and he fell upon him that he died .
translation.kha: Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la leit bad pynïap ïa u Adonijah .

Naba U Moses u la ong , ‘ U Trai naba U Blei jong phi un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la pah ïa nga , bad un long uwei na ki briew jong phi hi . Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kamai kaei baroh kaba u ong ïa phi ban bor .
translation.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongbeh jongngi U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki la wanrah sha U Jisu , ki da kylli , Balei ba ma ngi Bad ki Pharisi ngi shahjingit basniew , hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shahjingit da lei lei ?
translation.en: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?

translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipa Babilonia ka la kynran dien noh na Jerusalem ñiar ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la wan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh s army ,

Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki Philistia ki wallam sha u Jehoshaphat shibun bah ka rupa bad kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , bad katto katne ki Arab ki wallam hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki blang .
To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu uba don u tat uba rim jong ka pop badno ka jingbymman , hynrei da u kpu u bym don thiat , u kpu jong ka jingkhuid bad ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .

translation.kha: Tahan ïa kaei kaba sniew , ainguh ïa kaei kaba bha , Bad peit ba ka jingbrai hok ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U Trai , un eiei ïa ki brup jong kane ka hima Kiba dang pynsah ban im .
translation.en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .

translation.kha: Kuth im iaki ia ka jongisynei jingbit , ba u la ai ha ngi ka jingisynei , te ngim dei ban jingkyllon
translation.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry , as we have received mercy , we faint not ;

translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin pynkynmaw ïa phi ban satar ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad phin long ki jong nga nadong shadong .
translation.en: That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .

translation.kha: Ki shabi uba la hap sohpdung ki bniap shiah ki ïong na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei ki jingjakhlia bad ka spah mala ki jingsngewbha jyllang kano ka jingim ki ïatyllep bad kjap ïa ki , Bad ki soh jong ki kim ju ih .
translation.en: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ïatyngkhuh ha nga baneh ainong ha u paidïapom , To shahshkor ! Ma nga , U Trai , nga ai ha phira ka jingkyndit hapdeng ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingtim bad ka lynti ka pun lam shad ka jingïap .
translation.en: And unto this people thou shalt say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I set before you the way of life , and the way of death .

translation.kha: Mynta buh ïa u khiew rnong ba suda halor ki rnga bad ai ba un sawlep . Te u khie un longïng ba la pynkhuid ha ka jinglehniam sa Shisien hadien ba ka sarang ka la ing lut ,
translation.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof , that the brass of it may be hot , and may burn , and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it , that the scum of it may be consumed .
And they taught in Judah , and had the book of the law of the  Lord  with them , and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit lyngba ïa baroh ki shnong ka Judah , da kaba hikai ïa ka ha ki briew .

Khenani , ko Trai Badonbor Bakhraw , me tynjuh hok ïa ki Briew ; me tip kawei kaba don shapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingot jyllang ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki ktieh jong me .
translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .
For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
translation.kha: U Blei un bishar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ngi leh , la kaba bha ne kaba sniew , wat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kaba rieh .

Pynban , phi la wan pha bad phi bam phi dih ha ka iaka ha kaban u la khang ïa phi ban bah ban dih . Namar kane yn sa pynïap ïa phi , bad ïa ka met jong Phi yn ym tep ha ka jingtep ki kpa bymman jongnga phi .
translation.en: But camest back , and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place , of the which the  Lord  did say to thee , Eat no bread , and drink no water  ; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers .

translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha ka , To wat sheptieng , ko Mari ; U Blei u la sngewbiang ïa pha .
translation.en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .

translation.kha: Nangta u Massah u buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong sha mihngi na wah Jordan
translation.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynrngad ïa ka wah Nile bad ngan buh ïa ka Ijipt hapoh ka bor jong ki briew kaba sniew . Ki nongwei kin pynjulor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ma nga , U Trei , ar la krensih .
translation.en: And I will make the rivers dry , and sell the land into the hand of the wicked : and I will make the land waste , and all that is therein , by the hand of strangers : I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Une u ong ha la ki briew , Kine ki Israel ki la ïaroi palat , bad ki la ïakhlaiñ eh ruh , bad ki long ka jingmane ïa ngi .
translation.en: And he said unto his people , Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we :

translation.kha: U la Kylli ïa nga , Hato mem tip ? Em , ngam tip , ko rangïapom , nga la jubab .
translation.en: And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .

translation.kha: lem bad kine ki hukum : Rieh ha kawei ka liang jongngi ka nongbah , hynrei wat leit jngi than na ka ; long ba la khreh Ban tur ïaleh .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Behold , ye shall lie in wait against the city , even behind the city : go not very far from the city , but be ye all ready :
But sought to the  Lord  God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not after the doings of Israel .
translation.kha: U shakri ïa U Blei jong u kpa jong u , u kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei , bad um shym leh ha ka rukom ba ki syiem Israel ki la leh .

nongthaw ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai u la ong , ‘ Ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pait dien noh na nga bad ki la mane malade shakri ïa khawai pat ki bleithaw . Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad kim syiem khlong ïa ki jinghikai jong nga .
translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Because your fathers have forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , and have walked after other gods , and have served them , and have worshipped them , and have forsaken me , and have not kept my law  ;
Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one : and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour .
translation.kha: Ym don jingïapher hapdeng u briew uba bet bad u briew uba ai um ; U Blei un ai bainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka kam kaba u la leh .

U syiem un ïam pangnud , u khun shym un duh jingkyrmen , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la ai , bad ngan bishar ïa phi ha khiew ka rukom kumba phi la hajar ïa kiwei . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai hi u la ong ba um shym phah ïa ki bad ba ki lamler ïa pa ha ka kylleng jong u . Jaban kamut un beh noh ïa phi , sad ïa pa yn pynïap , ïa phi bad ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa phi ïa Kine ki jinglamler .
translation.en: For I have not sent them , saith the  Lord  , yet they prophesy a lie in my name  ; that I might drive you out , and that ye might perish , ye , and the prophets that prophesy unto you .
