translation.en: Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house  ; and I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , saith the  Lord .
For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .
translation.kha: ( U syiem ka ri Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser bad u la ïohknieh ïa ka , u la pynïap ïa ki traishnong hangta bad u la thang ïa ka . Nangta u la ai ïa ka ha ka khun jong u kum ka jingïoh bynta jong ka ha ka por ba ka shongkurim ïa u Solomon , bad u Solomon u tei thymmai ïa ka . )
U ïabah da kaba shlur bun u jop wat ïa ki paidbhur Amalek . U la pyllait im ïa ki Israel na baïar ki jingtur ïaleit .
translation.en: And he gathered an host , and smote the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them .

translation.kha: Ha ka pdang bashatei u pduh u phai shaphang ka Hannathon , bad u kut ha ka Toi Eshtaol .
translation.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el :

translation.kha: U Trai u waiñ na ka jaka shong jong u na bneng pun pynshitom ïa ki briew jongno ka pyrthei namar ki pop jyllang ki . Ki jingpynpaw briew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kan ym Lah shuh ban bakyrhuh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynïap .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .

translation.kha: U Trai u wallam shwa ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ïa ki nongïalam . U pynlong ïa kane ka jingkynnoh : Phi la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïohnang jong phi ki dap da ki kiei kiba phi la Shim na kiba duk .
translation.en: The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem u khot ïa Phin bad u kylli phi ïatrei ïaktah aïu ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when Pharaoh shall call you , and shall say , What is your occupation ?

translation.kha: Uwei u don ha ka phang bashatei jong ka khim , u da phai sha Mikhmash , bad uwei pat ha ka phang bashyrkhei , u da pait shwa Geba .
translation.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .
And the taskmasters hasted them , saying , Fulfil your works , your daily tasks , as when there was straw .
translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei mraw ki ïai pyrshang ban pynbor ïa ki ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la shna mynba dang ai phlangïap ïa ki .
Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar Hamor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u to ka ieid halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka bran , ka met jong u .
translation.en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
Israel is swallowed up : now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad kin long ki bymlarkam kum u khra ba la pait .

U Ahab u jong ha u Jehoshaphat , Katba Ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong skhem jong phi . Kumjuh u Syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam phler .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .

translation.kha: Nangta sa shisien pait ar dem khrup ha khmat U Trai sawphew sngi dara sawphew miet , bad ngam shitrhem la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh pah pyrshah ïa U Trei bad phi la pynbitar ïa u .
translation.en: And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .

translation.kha: Ki la leit ruh ban ai jingkñia da shi jur ki lyngdkhur lane ar tylli ki khun Parosh , kumba la dawa da ka aïu jong U Trai .
translation.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord , A pair of turtledoves , or two young pigeons .

translation.kha: To ïateh shitom ban pynneh ïa ka jinglong shi thylliej ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba ka jingsuk kaban tehsong lang! ïa phi .
translation.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .
And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
translation.kha: U la ong shai bha ïa kane ha ki . Kumta u Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa u bad u la sdang ban sneng ïa u .
phiah long kum u biria ba la thoh ha ka proberb , uba pyrshang don Thiah ha ka jingthiah kaba lyngkot palat bym lah ban jyrtieng , dara ka nep kambah rit palat ka bym lah ban tap ïa u .
translation.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .
And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka ïing U Blei kum u shakri , bad u kren ïa kiei kiei kiba U Blei un sa kren ha ki por ki ban sa wan .
Ka Jingthoh bakhatduh ka ong , Neng pynjot noh ïa ka jingstad jong kiba stad bad ngan kyntait sharud ïa ka jingsngem jong ki riewshemphang .
translation.en: For it is written , I will destroy the wisdom of the wise , and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent .

translation.kha: Ïa uta u Kynhun la kha ha ka por ba U Bela u la nguh ba yn sa kha ïa u .
translation.en: For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .

translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la ong , Ka dohnud jong nga ka ïarieh ïa U thri ;
translation.en: And Mary said , My soul doth magnify the Lord ,

translation.kha: Kito ki nongïohipaw kiba ai jingpynthikna ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei Kaei baroh ka mala ka biang , hajan baroh kam bit kam biang ! U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Na Kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assyria , bad u tei hangta ïa ki nongjop ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,
translation.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,

translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong sem , un long ryngkat malu phi baroh . Amen .
translation.en: Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: Hib ki syiem kiba hap thah u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Abda malu ki kylla longïing ki raïot jngai u . Ki Syria kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .

translation.kha: Lada ka um ka tyrkhong noh , dei ma ki kiba ïapli nyngkong , katba ki sdang rit eh ïa ka ïa-ban ot mala pyndonkam .
translation.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .

translation.kha: Pha lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa mala ka ksiar kaba kamar-tama na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi mala ki para ri jngai phi , phiah kwah ba-bang pyndonkam , kat kum ka “mon U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u jaboh , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynlong bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , malu ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaba me la Kular ba kan long ka jingïakynduh jong ki junom .
translation.en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .

translation.kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u sharak uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la longkmie uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pyniaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham dara . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh pyntha lem na ka jingkhem lad nga !’
translation.en: His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant  ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .

translation.kha: Wat pynphriang lamler shaphang jingnoh jongno , bad hajuh uno uno u tdong don ha ka jingbishar namar la ka jingim , kren pynpaw lada ka jingphla jong phi kan long jingïarap ïa u . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people : neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lano kum ki kper harud ka wah , Kum ki Alos ba U Trai u la thung , Lane kumto ki tieng Kadesh harud ki um .
translation.en: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the  Lord  hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .
That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
translation.kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki briew jong u .
Nga shahjingit ar sien shi taïew , bad nga ai ha me kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jingïoh jong nga baroh .’
translation.en: I fast twice in the week , I give tithes of all that I possess .

translation.kha: Hynñiew shuwa ba ka jingkut kan wan , ïa ka Gospel yn ïalap ha ki jaitbynriew baher .
translation.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations .

translation.kha: dei ban Shu lynthem ïa u da u maw , ne pun siat ïap ïa u da ki khnam , khlem da ktah kti mano mano ïa u . Kane ka treikam ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki . Hynrei haba la put ïa ka turoi , te ki briew’ ngin sa leit kiew sha u lum .
translation.en: There shall not an hand touch it , but he shall surely be stoned , or shot through  ; whether it be beast or man , it shall not live : when the trumpet soundeth long , they shall come up to the mount .
If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .
translation.kha: Lada hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap ban siew na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa u Kain , Hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap lada uno uno u pynïap ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said David , Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? And the  Lord  said , They will deliver thee up .
translation.kha: Bad hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga ha u Saul ?  u Dabid u kylli biang .  Kin ai ,  U  Trai  u jubab .

translation.en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .
translation.kha: Men sa ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangta men ïoh ka jingshlur ban tur ïaleh .  Kumta u Gideon bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit hiar sha ka tduh jong ka jaka sher dara jong ki nongshun .

translation.en: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings . And he offered the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la sdang ban iehnoh noh ïa u Saul , kumta u ong ha ki ,  Wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father  ; and his kingdom was established greatly .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la kiew khet kum u syiem hadien u Dabid , u kpa jong u , bad ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong u la pynskhem bha .
Phi tip ba U Khrist u long uba khoh ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U Blei! .
translation.en: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew ha uta u paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u dei da shisha u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .
translation.kha: Mynba nga ïambriew , ngam shym la bam ei ei na ka ; mynba nga long u bymkhuid , ngam shym la rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka kum ka jingainguh ïa kiba ïap . Nga la kohnguh ïa me , ko  Trai  ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .
translation.kha: Leh kumba u Joab u ong ,  u Solomon u jubab .  Pynïap ïa u bad tep ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bynta kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah kiba lui lui .

translation.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jong phi , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .

translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .
translation.kha: Lehse nga long u bym da nang ban kren , hynrei da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingshem baroh .
Kumta u la pyn-at ïa ki , bad ki paid Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uei hapoh ka nongbah , lehse tangba une u briew bad ka longïing jngai u .
translation.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city , they smote the city with the edge of the sword  ; but they let go the man and all his family .

translation.kha: Ko ki kynthei , to pyndem ha la ki tnga , kumba ha U Trai .
translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Ken ka dei kumno U balui Badonbor Baroh u pynkhyllem ïa ki bymman , ki biria Ibbah lehbor .
translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .

translation.kha: Naba ki sam thliew lyngba ïa ki mawsiang , Ki shem ïa ki mawkordor .
translation.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks  ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .

translation.kha: U Solomon u pynteh jubor ïa ki khun ki ktieh jong ki nong Kana ki bym shym la shah pynïap ha ki Israel mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , badno ki Jehu , kiba ki khun ki kyiuh jong ki , ki dang long ki mraw haduh kane ka por .
translation.en: Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .
And call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will shew thee what thou shalt do : and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee .
translation.kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Jesse sha kata ka jingkñia , bad ngan sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew uba ngan ïathuh ha me .
Katba nga tip ka long ba ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah U Mynsiem bakhyndai u la maham ïa nga ba ka byndi bad ki jingjngem ki ap ïa nga .
translation.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up , and to pull down , and to destroy it  ;
translation.kha: Lada ha kano kano ka por nga ong ba ngan rat , ngan pynkheiñ , lane pynjot ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,

translation.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki la ai jingtip ha u syiem ïa ka jingdon baroh jong ki rangbah kiba bit ban long shipai : phra lakh ha Israel bad san lakh ha Judah .
Ka jingïarap kaba ka Ijipt ka ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta nga la khot-sin ïa ka Ijipt , ‘ U Ïakjakor bym kah pynmynsaw .’
translation.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain , and to no purpose : therefore have I cried concerning this , Their strength is to sit still .
So Joshua rose up early in the morning , and brought Israel by their tribes  ; and the tribe of Judah was taken :
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Joshua u wan ïalam ïa ki Israel sha khmat , shi jait shi jait , bad la kdew ïa ka jait Judah .
ka Elon , ka Timnah , ka Ekron ,
translation.en: And Elon , and Timnah , and Ekron ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la pyndap ïa U Jisu! da ka jingkmen da U Mynhyndai Bakhuid badno u la ong , Ko Kpa , U Tharai jong ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me nabar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymnang bymstad ïa Kaei kaba me la ibhabriew na kiba stad bad Kiba shemphang . Ho-oid , ko Ka , kane ka la long kumin me la khih ïa ka ba kan jia .
translation.en: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit , and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes : even so , Father  ; for so it seemed good in thy sight .
What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
translation.kha: U briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .
Hynrei kitab u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha phira , Kumta ruh un pynjop ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .
translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds  ; and the cloud is not rent under them .
translation.kha: U dei U Blei uba pyndap ïa ki lyoh da ka um bad u pynlong ïa ki ban ym bthei noh na ka jingkhia .
U Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Sekharaïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Arsa u la pah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka ri Judah kaba dawa ïa uwei pa uwei , khlem lait ïano ïano , don ïarap kit noh na Rakem ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ba pynskhem ïa ka . Da kine ki tiar ki tar u Asa u tei pynskhem ïa ka Mispah pynlang ïa ka Tebah , ka nongbah kiba don ha ka ri Bethmeon .
translation.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .

translation.kha: Ki la khot ïa u Barnabas da ka kyrteng Seus , bad ïa u Petros da ka kyrteng Hermes , namar ba u long u nongkren uba kham ha khmat .
translation.en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter  ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïohi ïa ka jingshim kaba jur lad ki Israel ; ym don mano Mano ruh ban ïarap ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .
If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Lada U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
Bad to ai ba U Trai un pynlah ïa phi baroh ar lwet ban shongkurim bajrong badno shun don la ka longsyiem . Kumta ka Naomi ka doh khublei ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sdang ban ïam bad ki noh ha ka ,
translation.en: The  Lord  grant you that ye may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . Then she kissed them  ; and they lifted up their voice , and wept .
What Is the Good News ?
translation.kha: Kaei Ka Khubor Babha ?

translation.en: And he thought within himself , saying , What shall I do , because I have no room where to bestow my fruits ?
translation.kha: U la sdang ban pyrkhat ha lade , ‘ Ngam don hangno hangno ban buh ïa ki jingthung jong nga baroh . Aïu nga lah ban leh ?
Sangeh ! u Samuel u hukum , bad ngan ïathuh ha phiah ïa kaei kaba U tharai u la ong ha nga hynne mynmiet . Ïathuh ïa nga , ong u Saul .
translation.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul , Stay , and I will tell thee what the  Lord  hath said to me this night . And he said unto him , Say on .
But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country , Go into the harlot s house , and bring out thence the woman , and all that she hath , as ye sware unto her .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongsyntiat ,  Khie leit sha ka ïing jong ka nuti bad wan ïalam ïa ka bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka , kumba phi la kular ïa ka .

translation.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap ki long ki bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam haduh hynñiew sngi .
U la sngew thngan , bad u la kwah ban bameh ei ei ; katba dang pynkhleh ïa ka jingbang , u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumta len kyrkhu ïa u nabar ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un hir u kper jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , nabar ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kambah khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .

translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jongngi u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , malu u ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .

translation.kha: Ki shalyntem baroh sawphew tylli ki ïasyriem kumjuh , kawei pa katai ka phyrnai la kum u mawkordor , bad kawei kawei ka don kawei patan ka shalyntem halor jongki ka ha ka liang ka mon ,
translation.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl : and they four had one likeness : and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel .

translation.kha: Ha U Khrismas la otsher ïa phi , ym da ka jingotsher kaba la thaw da ki bhabriew , hynrei da ka jingotsher ba la pynlong da U Khrist , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglong ba la laitluid na ka bor lad ka pop hi .
translation.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands , in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ :
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno shuh phi ki briew phin dang kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ?

translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .
translation.kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi bad kin kylli ,  U la kular ban wan , hato um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u don ? Ki kpa tymmen ki la lah ïap , hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki dang ïaisah kumjuh kum mynba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei !
Ka Mari ka nong madiah bad ka Mari ka kmie u Jisu ki la khmih badno Ïohi hangno ba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu .
translation.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .

translation.kha: Kanaan la Don ka jingsawa na sahit pdeng kaba sawa kum ka jingbeh ka lyer bajur , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei ha kaweh ki la ïasdang .
translation.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .
The  Lord  repented for this : It shall not be , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylla noh la ka jingmut bad u ong ,  Kaei kaba phi la ïohi kan ym jia .
Lada phi long uba tlot ha ka por shipa , phi dien uba tlot shisha .
translation.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity , thy strength is small .

translation.kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kai kaba u la thah , kumno phi lah ba-bang ngeit ïa katai kaba na ong ?
translation.en: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?

translation.kha: Haba u Moses u ïohsngew ïa kaei , u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u duwai .
translation.en: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :

translation.kha: Ka nga Kan sa poi haba ki briew kin ym shahshkor ïa ka jingïohi shongtynrai badei , hynrei kin kohnguh ïa la ki jingkwah Bad kin nang pynbun ïa ki nonghikai ki don ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki shkor ba-dait jong ki , ki kwah ban ïohsngew .
translation.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;

translation.kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngi ne ar sngi , ne san sngem , ne shiphew sngi , ne wat Nepheg sngi ruh ,
translation.en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;

translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pat , bad la thoh ïa Kino kum ka jingmaham ïa im . Naba ngi im ha ka por ba kaba kut ka la jin poi .
translation.en: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .

And every creature which is in heaven , and on the earth , and under the earth , and such as are in the sea , and all that are in them , heard I saying , Blessing , and honour , and glory , and power , be unto him that sitteth upon the throne , and unto the Lamb for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingthaw baroh ha bneng , ha khyndew , ha ka pyrthei shapoh , bad ha ka duriaw — baroh kiei kiei kiba im ha ka pyrthei — bad ki ïarwai :  Ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot , long ka jingïaroh bad ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom bad ka bor , junom la junom !

translation.en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la sah hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .

U la kynriah noh nangta bad tuh ïa kawei pat ka pukri . Ym skhem don jingïakajia shuh ïa kata , kumta u khot kyrteng ïa ka , Ka Jinglaitluid . U Ong , Mynno te U Troas u la ai jinglanot ïa moi ban shon ban kamar-tama ha kane ka jaka , bad ngin sa nang raïot ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah sad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki Suki ki saiñ .
translation.en: Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .

But when I speak with thee , I will open thy mouth , and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; He that heareth , let him hear  ; and he that forbeareth , let him forbear : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Nangta haba nga kren biang ïa me bad ai biang ha me ïa ka bor ban kren , men ïathuh ïa ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Don na ki , ki ban sngap , hynrei don na ki , ki bym leh salia ïa me , naba ki long ka jaitbynriew jong ki nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: The burden of the desert of the sea . As whirlwinds in the south pass through  ; so it cometh from the desert , from a terrible land .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Babilonia . Kum ka  erlangthari kaba sar sha shiliang ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot kan wan na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
translation.kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , namar ki tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ban ïada ïa ka gospel .
Baroh shi miet nga kyang badno ka jingpang , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa ki shyiap jong nga . Nga pyrkhing ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translation.en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .

translation.kha: Bad u ong ha u Shimei , Nga khlieh la ka jubanlak ha phi ba phin ym shah pynïap .
translation.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei , Thou shalt not die . And the king sware unto him .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong la na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa ka jingdoh jongki ki shat ka jingshai bad pynjrong ïa ki jakarieh khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki ïakular jong nga , bad ngan bameh ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .

translation.kha: Ïa ki bnoh , kba jrong hynñiewphew san milimitar la pynskhem na khap ki miej baroh sawdong . Ïa ka doh barben ba dei ban ai kumno ka jingkñia la buh halor ki imat .
translation.en: And within were hooks , an hand broad , fastened round about : and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering .
For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ri sumar ïa phi . Un ym shah ba phin hap ha ka jingriam .

Ki ba-ha-ïing Ha-ei jong u , ki hynmen ki para jong u , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem baroh’ jong u kpa jngai u , ki ïaleit ryngkat bad u . Kiba sah ha Goshen ki hir tang ki khunlung rit , bad ki langbrot , ki blang , bad kiwei kiwei de ki jingri jong ki .
translation.en: And all the house of Joseph , and his brethren , and his father s house : only their little ones , and their flocks , and their herds , they left in the land of Goshen .
The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways , and hatred in the house of his God .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga kum u nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel . La katta ruh shano shano ba nga leit , phi pyrshang ban riam ïa nga kum ïa ka sim . Wat ha ka Templ U Blei , ki briew ki dei ki nongshun jong u nongïathuhlypa .
Sin lada u lyngkot un ïohsngew ïa kane , ngin pynngeit ïa u ba phi erlangthari ki bymtip ei ei , bad phin ym don ei ei ban khuslai .
translation.en: And if this come to the governor s ears , we will persuade him , and secure you .

translation.kha: Ki arphew sawphew ngut ki nongsharai balang Bad ki saw tylli ki kherub ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , uba la shong ha ka kheit . Ki la ong , Amen ! To ïakhreh ïa U Blei !
translation.en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne , saying , Amen  ; Alleluia .

translation.kha: Ki la kyntoit ïa ang malu ki la ai ïa ki jingkñia ha kiwei! ki blei , malade kumta la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da barhem kaba ki leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka khia pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kan ym duh noh .
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and shall not be quenched .

translation.kha: bad lada ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew ,
translation.en: And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .
Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka para ne bad la ka para ar kmie .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
U Paul u la jubab , Ngam shym lamwir , ko Kynther badonburom ! Nga kren ïa ka jingshem ha ka jingriewblei .
translation.en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .

translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jongu pha da ki Maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdong jong pha da ki maw kiba rim Kum ka ryndang , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .
translation.en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
Every man s work shall be made manifest : for the day shall declare it , because it shall be revealed by fire ; and the fire shall try every man s work of what sort it is .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ka dor ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei u briew yn sa ïohi haba ka Sngi U Khrist kan pynpaw ïa ka . Naba ha kata ka Sngi , ka ding kan pynpaw ïa ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei ; ka ding kan tynjuh ïa ka bad kan pyn-i ïa ka dor bashisha .
Ai ki jingnguh sha U Trai , pynnep ïa ka jingkhraw Jong u ; Ïathuh ha ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la imat .
translation.en: Give thanks unto the  Lord  , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .

translation.kha: Haba ki Apostol ki la ïalumlang bad U Jisu , ki la kylli ïa u , Ko Kynrad , hato ha kane ka por men ai pat ïa ka Hima ha ki Israel ?
translation.en: When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?

translation.kha: “lada ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u badno ki khunlung jong u dei ban pyllait pat ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka baneh wan .
translation.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .

translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew malade kiba riew ; u tip kaei naba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , badno ïa u hi la ker sawdong da ka jingshai .
translation.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .

His glory is like the firstling of his bullock , and his horns are like the horns of unicorns : with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth : and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim , and they are the thousands of Manasseh .
translation.kha: U Joseph u khlaiñ kat u masi kyrtong , Kat ki reng u masi prut . Ki reng jong u kiba kat ki hajar jong u Manasseh , Bad kat ki shiphew hajar jong u Ephraim . Da ki , u tur pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew , Bad u shop ïa ki sha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will help thee .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ïa u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga , bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit ban ïarap ïa phi .
Na kata u suh sha ki umpohliew ka Nephtoah bad mih sha ki nongbah hajan u Lum Ephron . Hangta u phai sha Baalah ( lap Kiriath Jearim )
translation.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron  ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath–jearim :

translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng kseh , malu kita kiba don ki law ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha nga . Nga bret ïa ki ha ka ding , malu wan mih da une u khun masi .
translation.en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la nang khamtam kren shlur : Ka long kaba donkam ba ïa ka ktien jongngi U Blei dei ban kren nyngkong ha phi . Hynrei nalor ba phi kyntait ïa ka bad ba ‘Phim ñiah ïa lade kiba bit ïa ka jingim bymjukut , ïng iehnoh ïa phi pynlang leit sha ki Jingtylli .
translation.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kamra la ïa-bta ïa ki . U Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u symboh u la hukum , pynlang u ai jingbamsap ïa ki ba kin ba-ima ha lynti .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .

translation.kha: Ka jingïohipaw kaba khlem ka jingïalam U Blei ka erlangthari ka jaitbynriew ka bym ïaid bieit . A suk uta u briew umbah sumar ïa ka hukum U balui !
translation.en: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .

translation.kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , isynei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa nga napdeng ki Jesreel ; ?(Nga long U Trai’ uba pynkyntang ïa phi ,
translation.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .
translation.kha: U phai sha uwei pat u rangbah bad u kylli ïa u ïa kajuh ka jingkylli , bad man ba u kylli , u ïoh ïa kajuh ka jubab .
Naba ki tdong ïabam , U ijuh u la shim ïa u kpu , u la duwai ainguh bad u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synrang jong u , Shim ïa u , une u long ka met jong nga u la ong .
translation.en: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body .

translation.kha: Kat kumba U Blei u kren ïa ka jingshisha , ka jingkular jong nga ïa phi kam long kaba Ho-oid bad kaba Em .
translation.en: But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .
Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .
translation.kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong nga ka long ba phin lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , ki ban bun kat u shyiap ka rud duriaw , bad ba ma phi da lade hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thma .

translation.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u briew u la thew ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei , kaba lam sha ka phyllaw bashabar .

translation.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis    lano ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lane mano ba ïathuh ïa u syiar ba u slap un sa hap ?
A Blei me la iehnoh ïa ki briew jong me , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ! Ka ri ka ïap da ki jingleh myntor na ka ri Mihngi bad na ka Philistia . Ki briew ki burom ïa ki suhjer nongwei .
translation.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob , because they be replenished from the east , and are soothsayers like the Philistines , and they please themselves in the children of strangers .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi katba bud u Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan ha ka jingpynpaw burom kaba khriat bad ha ka jinglehkmen bad ki la rung sha ka khem bishar lem sad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah pawkhmat jong ka nongbah . U Phestos u la ai ka hukum , bad ïa u Saul la wallam shapoh .
translation.en: And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .

And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .
translation.kha: U Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , ki peit sah ïa ka shyllangmat jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad mar mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar ban mihnoh na ka Templ . U pynkloi ban mih shabar , namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u .

translation.en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .
translation.kha: Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno uba hukum ïa phi lane uba shim kabu ïa phi lane uba riam pah lane uba peit poh ïa phi lane uba thab ïa phi ha ka ngab .

translation.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la shim ka rai halor U Jisu ïa kaba ki la pan .

translation.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga kum ki nongshun . Ki rangbah ki wan phai na ka thma , da kaba pyrkhat ba kin shngain ha ïing , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka met jong ki .

translation.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek  ; after thee , Benjamin , among thy people  ; out of Machir came down governors , and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer .
translation.kha: Ki la wan na Ephraim sha ka them , Hadien ka jait Benjamin bad ki briew jong ka . Ki nongai hukum ki la wan hiar na Makhir , Ki rangbah pynïaidkam na Sebulun .
U pyrshang ban hikai ha ngi ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai .
translation.en: For precept must be upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little :
If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka jingim ,
Ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la lah pynkhreh bad buh ïa ka hapoh . Nangta ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok sha U Blei .
translation.en: So they brought the ark of God , and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it : and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God .

For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?
translation.kha: Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi kat shaba nga leit . Mynta ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: Then came in the magicians , the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers : and I told the dream before them  ; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Te la wallam shapoh ïa baroh ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga , hynrei kim lah ban batai ïa ka ha nga .

Men kynting ïa ki ha ka lehkmen ; ka lawar kaba julam kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka erïong . Te men sa kmang namsop ang long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakyllut ki Israhaïah .
translation.en: Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ba U Trai u la pynbna shaw ka pyrthiew baroh : To ainong ha ki paid ka Jerusalem ba U Trai un wan ban ïada ïa phi un wallam bad u ïa ki biria kaba u la phlait im .
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  hath proclaimed unto the end of the world , Say ye to the daughter of Zion , Behold , thy salvation cometh  ; behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .

translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban rieh ha kaba ngam lah ban ïew ïa u . Hato ‘Phim tip ba nga don ha ki jaka barben ha bna bad ha khyndew ?
translation.en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him ? saith the  Lord . Do not I fill heaven and earth ? saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi la pynïap bun bah ki brisoh hangne hapoh ka nongbah ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .
translation.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .

And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha phi ban ym shah ba ki Assyria kin pynkhaw-eit ïa phi da ki jingkob jong ki ba um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .
Uwei na kito kiba la ïadih lang nabar U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka khor jyllang u .
translation.en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .

translation.kha: Naduh mynta ïa ka longïing kaba ba-don sa ngut yn phiah , ki to ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bad ki ar ngut pyrshah ïa ki to ngut .
translation.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .

translation.kha: Haba la dap hynñiew bnai , ki Israel ki la ïashongduh ha la ki shang lad ki . nongthaw baroh ki ïalumlang ha Jeremaïah ,
translation.en: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U shym u kyllut , Kumno ngi la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u markordor na ka bna kane ? Ki shakri jongnga u ki jubab , Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jngai u .
translation.en: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .

translation.kha: Ïwei na ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah in wan sha ïing jong pa’ lieng ha kano kano ka jaka kaba pa’ kajuh , bad man la ka taiew kin wan ban phylliew jingmut bad phi na ka Baibl .
translation.en: Without charge , a friendly neighbor qualified to teach the Bible can come to your home or another convenient location and spend a little time each week discussing the Bible with you .

translation.kha: Ngan wan ïalang pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba la jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thrang ki bri shitaiew bad kin dih ïa ka saiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin bam na kaei kaba mih .
translation.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha por , Ko khun u briew , kine ki rangbah ki thaw ki jingthmu basniew bad ki ai ïa ka jingai jingmut bym un-long hapoh kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :

If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
translation.kha: Lada phi la long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , sangeh bad pyrkhat !
Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei naba ki dei ban ïuh na ka bna ka jingbymkhuid sad ka jingmaham lad ki , bad at la phai noh na ki .
translation.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .

translation.kha: U Mesha u la jubab , Ngin ïaleit lut barieh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki tymmen jong ngi . translation.en: And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la duwai , A Trai , U Blei jong u kynrad jongu nga u Abraham , to ai ka jingjop ïa nga mynta ka sngi bad to bat ïa la ka kular ïa u kynrad jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , I pray thee , send me good speed this day , and shew kindness unto my master Abraham .

translation.kha: Ka jingainguh waiñ kaba biang ka long ar litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , shi litar shiteng ka waiñ lem bad u langbrot , bad shi litar ka waiñ lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . translation.en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt : and ye came unto the sea  ; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea .

translation.kha: U nongleitkurim u la slem ban wan , kumta ki theisotti ki la sdang ban kohnguh samthiah .

Nangta ngan ong ïa u shakri jong nga ban leit tam ïa ki . Bad lada nga ïong ha u , ‘ Khmih , kito ki khnam ki khong ha kane ka liang jong phi ; tam ïa ki ,’ kata ka mut ba kam lei lei dara pa lah ban mih shabar . Nga smai ha U Trai ibha im ba phin ym don ha ka jingjam .
translation.en: And , behold , I will send a lad , saying , Go , find out the arrows . If I expressly say unto the lad , Behold , the arrows are on this side of thee , take them  ; then come thou : for there is peace to thee , and no hurt  ; as the  Lord  liveth .

translation.en: And David laid up these words in his heart , and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath .

translation.en: And of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brethren , men of valour , a thousand and seven hundred , were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the  Lord  , and in the service of the king .

translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;

translation.en: And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .

translation.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom : also he observed times , and used enchantments , and used witchcraft , and dealt with a familiar spirit , and with wizards : he wrought much evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .

translation.en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .

translation.kha: u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba pawnam ; ka jingieit jongu u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me , it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he were cast into the sea .

translation.en: Study the Bible with us .

translation.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .
Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift , and the strong shall not strengthen his force , neither shall the mighty deliver himself :
translation.kha: Wat ki nongmareh stet kin ym lait im , ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ kin duh ïa la ka bor , bad ki shipai kin ym lah wat ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .

U Blei umbah khroh u ïashoh ïa u Shim Kynrad kaei ka ban sa jia ha ka nawei . Nga la ïathuh thik ïa kaei kaban phi la pyniehnoh bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jingmut bashispah .
translation.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it brake in pieces the iron , the brass , the clay , the silver , and the gold  ; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter : and the dream is certain , and the interpretation thereof sure .

translation.kha: U Joah u thiat ïa la ka ryntieh bad katba don la ka tam u siat ïa u khnam bad u dei ïa u Joram na shadien bad u ngam haduh u klongsnam jong u . U Joram u kyllon ïap ha ka kali ïapom jongki u ,
translation.en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength , and smote Jehoram between his arms , and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .

translation.en: For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .

translation.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .

translation.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .

translation.en: I will bear the indignation of the  Lord  , because I have sinned against him , until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me : he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ha u ba pynslem bad ban pynkhraw ïa la ki kynhun baroh hapoh ka jingïalam Jong u .
translation.en: Be thou prepared , and prepare for thyself , thou , and all thy company that are assembled unto thee , and be thou a guard unto them .

And Jehu sent through all Israel : and all the worshippers of Baal came , so that there was not a man left that came not . And they came into the house of Baal  ; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another .
translation.kha: La pynlong ka jingpynbna bad u Jehu u phah ktien ha kylleng ka ri Israel . Baroh kiba mane ïa u Baal ki la wan ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba pep . Baroh ki leit rung ha ka templ u Baal , da kaba pyndap ïa ka na kut ha kut .
Haba phi pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , phi lai ngab pynkylla paralok ïa ki nongshoh-nar jong phi .
translation.en: When a man s ways please the  Lord  , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him .

translation.kha: badno baroh ar jngut kin ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar nud , hynrei kawei .
translation.en: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .
And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .
translation.kha: Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Ka por ka la kut noh ; to shah ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khun jong phi .
Ka shim une Tom katto-katne kyndit Ban pyndait ia ka jingïaishah ba ki jingbatai ki noh ba kan shim shikynta duna ban pyndam .
translation.en: It took Tom several hours to assemble a bunk bed that the instructions said would take less than an hour to assemble .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit lad ang , wat ngeit ïa baroh kiba kam ba ki don U Mynsiem , hynñiew , to phin da tynjuh ïa ki ban shem lada u mynsiem ba ki don u wan ne em na U Blei . Baana shibun ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ki la leit kylleng sawdong .
translation.en: Beloved , believe not every spirit , but try the spirits whether they are of God : because many false prophets are gone out into the world .

Israel is an empty vine , he bringeth forth fruit unto himself : according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars  ; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba dap da ki sohwaiñ . Katba ki nang manbha , katta ki nang tei kham bun ki duwan . Katba ka ri jong ki ka nang pahuh , katta ruh ki nang pynitynnat ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang ba ki mane .

translation.en: And he hardened Pharaoh s heart , that he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh , pynban , u la ïai mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
Bad u nongshun uba la bet ïa ki ñiad u long u Ksuid . Ka jingot ka longïng kaba kut jong ka Ïa , bad ki nongot ki long ki angel .
translation.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil  ; the harvest is the end of the world  ; and the reapers are the angels .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ïa ki khun shngain jong u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , la kynthup lang hapdeng ki Lebi . )
translation.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi leh ïa kine ki briew ? ki la kylli . Uwei uwei baroh ha Jerusalem u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kambah pher la leh da ma ki , bad ngim lah ban len ïa ka .
translation.en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .

translation.kha: Hib phi pynbamphlang ïa U Trai , phi lah Ban pynkylla lop ïa ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: When a man s ways please the  Lord  , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him .

translation.kha: Kan leit beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jyllang ka , hynrei kan ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong , Ngan loit pah noh sha u tnga uba nyngkong jong nga — nga kham bit Kham biang mynno ha “kata ban ïa kaba de long mynsiem .
translation.en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong biang ha u Moses ,  Mynta ba me leit phai sha Ijipt , da kynmaw ban leh ha khmat u Pharaoh ïa ki kambah baroh kiba nga la ai ha me ïa ka bor ban leh . Hynrei ngan pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .

translation.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places , and brake down the images , and cut down the groves :
translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang , bad u ot noh ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah .

Nangta halor u Lum Senas bad halor baroh kiba la ïapynlong hangta , U Trai un phah ïa u lyoh ha ka por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka thylliej ding baphyrnai ha ka por myn . Ka burom U Blei kan tap bad da ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .

translation.kha: Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki Duwai sha me , ki da phyllaw haduh katno ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingjai jong ki A Trai .
translation.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;
And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat haba kane baroh ka la jia , kim shym la wan phai sha nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
U Shisha u pan um , hynrei ka ai ha u da ka bud ; Ka wanrah malai ïa u ha ka pliang kaba eitnar .
translation.en: He asked water , and she gave him milk  ; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish .
And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane ban tynjuh ïa u Philip ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un leh . )

U Syiem Dabid u ïohsngew ba namar ka Synduk ka Jutang , U Trai u la kyrshut ïa ka longïing jong u Obed Edom bad baroh kat kiba u don ; kumta u leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka jinghun na ka ïing jong u Obed ban leit rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad ka jinglehkmen kaba khroh .
translation.en: And it was told king David , saying , The  Lord  hath blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that pertaineth unto him , because of the ark of God . So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed–edom into the city of David with gladness .
When I have brought them again from the people , and gathered them out of their enemies  lands , and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations  ;
translation.kha: Khnang ban pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew babun ba nga long uba khuid , ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri baroh kiba ki shong ki nongshun jong ki .
Kumta yn ne phra tylliat ki jingkit bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .
translation.en: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U Trai , nga pham ïa ki ba ngan wanrah ka Jingpynjot halor jyllang ki , bun kin ym lah ban lait . Bad hir ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingpynïap , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon them , which they shall not be able to escape  ; and though they shall cry unto me , I will not hearken unto them .
Thus have I been twenty years in thy house  ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .
translation.kha: Ka la long kumta ha baroh ki arphew snem kiba nga la don bad phi . Khatsaw snem nga la shakri ban ïoh ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi ar ngut — bad hynriew snem na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi . Wat la katta ruh , phi la pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong nga haduh shiphew sien .

Ulla u shakri uba Peit halor ki jingdon jingem jong u Abraham , u shem shiphew tylli ki ut jongngi u kynrad jong u bad u leit sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u sah” ha ka byndi bashaphang shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .

translation.kha: Bad katkum , kat kum ka Khubor babud kaba de ïalap , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Kynther un bishar ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki briew baroh .
translation.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .

translation.kha: Syiem ïa ka , Syiem kynrad , u Sharuhen u ong , bad leh ïa ka Kaba phi sngewbit . Hangne ki dat ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingngeit ha ka duwan , bad shnat ki don ki lyntang shoh keiñ ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang , bad u kew ban ai kum ka jingiw . (Nga ai ïa ki baroh ha Phin .
translation.en: And Ornan said unto David , Take it to thee , and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes : lo , I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings , and the threshing instruments for wood , and the wheat for the meat offering  ; I give it all .

translation.kha: Hynriew bnai kynthih , u la pyn-i ïa ki spah jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha ka jingitynnat bad jingkhraw jong ka .
translation.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .

translation.kha: Mynta , nga ong skhem ha phira , ba shano shano ba yn ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa Kiei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ban kynmaw ïa ka .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .

translation.kha: Bad pynban phi sngewsarong ban jong ba ph long ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phiah shaniah ha U Blei’ ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai Badonbor Balah .
translation.en: For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .

And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the  Lord  , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the  Lord . So he finished the house .
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , u Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh pynïasuk ha kata ka duwan ba u la tei ha U  Trai . U thang ruh ïa ka jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai . Bad kumta u pyndep kaba tei ïa ka Templ .
U Troas u la mihpaw ha u iaka bad u ong , Wat leit shad ri Ijipt ; sai ha kane ka ri ha kaba nga la ong ha me ban sah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said , Go not down into Egypt  ; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of :

translation.kha: Martl ïaskhem ha ka bor , u Amasaïah u pynsep ïa ki ïabah synshar katba pynïap ïa u kpa jong u , Uba longïng u skhem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand , that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .
And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :
translation.kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para ,  I pa jong ngi i la tymmen , bad ym don shynrang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki ban shongkurim ïa ngi ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti .
U Trai u la ong , Bret ïa u ha madan . Haba u Moses u bret ïa u , uta u diengduh u kyllan bseiñ , bad u Moses u phet na uta .
translation.en: And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent  ; and Moses fled from before it .

translation.kha: Khmut u Amnon u sien thiah bad u la leh mynleh kum uba pung . U Syiem Dabid u la leit jngoh ïa u , bad u Onan u ong ha u , Sngewbha shah ïa i Tamar ban wan bad shet katto katne ki khup hangne ha kaba ang lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad nangta in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .
translation.en: So Amnon lay down , and made himself sick : and when the king was come to see him , Amnon said unto the king , I pray thee , let Tamar my sister come , and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat at her hand .

translation.kha: La pynjynjar ïa ngi bunsien , hynrei ym shym la pynlwet noh ; teng teng napdeng ka jingthngan , isynei da lat lei ym ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ; Don bun ki nongshun , hynrei ngi ju duh paralok ; bad wat la ngi julam ka jingmong hateng hateng , ym shym la pynpait nong ïa ngi .
translation.en: Persecuted , but not forsaken ; cast down , but not destroyed ;

translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Lasaros , uba sah ha Bethania , u la pang . Ka Bethania ka de ka shnong ha kaba ka Mari malu ka Matthias ka para lad ka , ki shong ki sah .
translation.en: Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .

But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .
translation.kha: Ki briew U  Trai  ki la riewspah , hynrei kiba ïaleh pyrshah ; ki la sngaid bad ki la dap bha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .

Katto katne ngut na ki Paidbah’ ki la pynskhem ba u Aleksandar u kitkhlieh , namar ba ki Siew ki la pynlong ïa u ban sien Sha khmat . Te u Aleksandar u la ai dak da la ka kti ba ki paidbah kyang sngap jar , malade u la pyrshang ngab kren ïasaid da .
translation.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . And Alexander beckoned with the hand , and would have made his defence unto the people .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka myn jong U Trai ba u shakri jyllang u un san kum u jingthung uba ktem ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong . Um don main ne jingit ban pynlong ïa ngi ban peit ïa u . Ym don kano kano kaba ngin ibha ïa u , ym don kano kano ka ban khring ïa ngi shwa u .
translation.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la pynïap ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki la pynlong syiem u Josaïah u khun jongu u .
translation.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .

translation.kha: Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba nong : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingsbun ba nga kwah , ym ki jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ nongïam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew badonburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
translation.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .

translation.kha: Ka jingteh baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U Trai ka ïaineh ,
translation.en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .

Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them : because I have spoken unto them , but they have not heard  ; and I have called unto them , but they have not answered .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam halor jong phi ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ïa baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga la kular . Ngan leh ïa kane namar phim shym la shahshkor haba nga la kren ha phi , bad phim shym la jubab haba nga la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,
translation.kha: Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane ka ri khlaw . Namar ba phi la khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat arphew snem ka rta u ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri .
U dab u wan sha u Shual bad u rung kam noh bad u . U Saul u sngewbha eh ïa u bad u jied ïa u khem u nongrah atiar jong u .
translation.en: And David came to Saul , and stood before him : and he loved him greatly  ; and he became his armourbearer .

translation.kha: Hynrei Ladan um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lam bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh lah pun kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai lwet ki sakhi .’
translation.en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .

translation.kha: thaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka , Ko ka briew , pha la lait phar na ka jingpang jong phad !
translation.en: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jat ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad ki pynsleh shym ïa u ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka dei shaphang U Khun jong u , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi : Shaphang ka jinglongbriew jong u , ïa u la kha uba hiarpateng na u dabi ;
translation.en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord , which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh ;
Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
translation.kha: U Paul , u shakri jong U Jisu Khrist , u ba la shah khot u apostol bad ba la jied da U Blei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong u .

translation.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them : they sank as lead in the mighty waters .
translation.kha: Pynban tang shisien pyrsad na me , ko  Trai  , ka la pynïap jyllop ïa ki nong Ijipt ; ki ngam kum ka sisa ha ka umbah bashyrkhei .
U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thom , Namar U Trai u i-ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem lad ki .
translation.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .

translation.kha: Kito ïa kiba U blang u la lah jied lwep u la pynspong ruh ban Long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un long uba nyngkong hapdeng ki per .
translation.en: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongmareh barben na kata ka shang kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka batip kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi ,
translation.en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :
And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man , and to birds , and fourfooted beasts , and creeping things .
translation.kha: ha ka jaka ba kin mane ïa U Blei uba im , ki mane ïa ki dur ba la thaw ban i kum u briew ne ki sim ne ki mrad ne ki mrad bapar kiba ïap noh .

translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the  Lord  : whosoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it , an offering of the  Lord   ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
translation.kha: Wallam ka jingainguh sha U  Trai . Kat uba kwah ban leh ïa kata un wanrah ïa kata ka jingainguh da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;

translation.en: And Moses said , Thus saith the  Lord  , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt :
translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Pharaoh ,  U  Trai  U ong , ‘ Ha ka por shiteng synñia ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka Ijipt ,

translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
translation.kha: La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Mari da ka khubor jong u angel , bad ka la lyngngoh aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingmut .
Ki sah ha paramarjan , ha ka kper Eden . ka long ka jaka kambah itynnat kaba don ka wah , ki dieng soh bad ki mrad .
translation.en: Their Paradise home was the garden of Eden —a place of great beauty with a river and fruit trees and animals .

translation.kha: Hato phah la ïoh jinghun ban stem ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh stem ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang hapoh khyndiat per phar la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa Kaba ki long ha keiñ kiei Baroh kiba phai la leh .
translation.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Katba ki synran jong u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki sdang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .
U la keirang bad u ong ha ka , Ha khmih , u kynrad jong ang um donkam ban pynshyrkhei shuh shaphang ïa lade bad kano kano ka kam hapoh ïing , namar nga don hangne .
translation.en: But he refused , and said unto his master s wife , Behold , my master wotteth not what is with me in the house , and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand  ;
The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa kim kren ei ei hynrei tang ki jinglamler ; ki lyngdoh ki synshar tang kumba hukum ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki briew jong nga kim shym pynpaw jingpyrshah ei ei . Hynrei kin leh aïu haba baroh ka poi sha kaba kut ?

translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David , king of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki proberb u Solomon , u khun jong u Dabid bad u syiem ki Israel .
Ka jingidiaw lamler ka long kaba ma kum ka tiensyiem , u dieng tangon ne u khnam banbeiñ .
translation.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .
According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane kat kum ka jingthmu bymjukut kaba u la pyndep lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
Naamah Kata , U Trai un pynshitom tyngkan ïa ki briew jong me , ïa ki khwan jong me , bad ïa ki tnum jong me , bad un pynjot thew ïa ki jingdon jingem jyllang me .
translation.en: Behold , with a great plague will the  Lord  smite thy people , and thy children , and thy wives , and all thy goods :

translation.kha: Kumta , U Trai un sa aiti noh ïa la ki briew sha ki nongshun jong ki haduh ba ka briew ka ban sa kha kan ïoh ïa u khuid jong ka . Nangta kito ki paidbhur Israel kiba dang dat ha ka jingshah ringmraw kin wan ïasoh lang bad ki briew la jong .
translation.en: Therefore will he give them up , until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth : then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel .

translation.kha: bad kam U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha na ka ba pun synshar , kumta sam ai ha phi ïa kajuh ka kuna .
translation.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;

translation.kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatduh ngut ki synran katba ki tdong ïabam . U la kren tyngeh ïa ki , namar kdor shym la don jingbeit bad Namar ka jingmutlop patlun ïa ka banbeiñ ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .
