translation.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .

translation.kha: Ngam oh kurup ïa ki markordor ibha bor rukom bad pyndap ïa la ki ïing da ki mar lute !
translation.en: We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :
And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .
translation.kha: Nga don kajuh ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei kaba kine hi ki don , kata , ba ki briew baroh , kiba bha bad kiba sniew , kin mihpat na ka jingïap .
Hynrei haba uta u briew u la jingphohsniew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh , namar u la long ibha riewspah shibun .
translation.en: And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .

translation.kha: Bel phim shitrhem leh ïa kane ha u Jeremaïah jong ka Anathoth , uba la kren kum u nongïathuhlypa sha ki briew ?
translation.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ka por Kaba babiang na ka bynta jong nga kam patar peh . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmie , namar mem dei ban pynjahburom ïa la ka jong ka kmie .

translation.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing  ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him .
translation.kha: U syiem u lah ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon , kumta mihnoh na khmat jong u ; wat shong ha kaba kum kane ka jaka ba ma .

translation.en: And he made haste , and came down , and received him joyfully .
translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la hiar pynstet bad u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingkmen kaba khraw .

translation.en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kata ka jingbam baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .

Nangta Uto uba la im junom u la wang bad u la pynbah ïa ka jingbishar ha ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei bajhieh Tam Eh . Ka por ka la poi na ka pyntha ki briew jong U Blei ngab pyngkiang ïa ka bor kaba kynjai syiem .
translation.en: Until the Ancient of days came , and judgment was given to the saints of the most High  ; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom .

translation.kha: Ym lah ïa-ban thied da ka rupa lane ka ksiar .
translation.en: It cannot be gotten for gold , neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof .
And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la jubab .  Ko Trai , lada dei shisha ma me , hukum ïa nga ban wan sha me halor ka um .
U la pyndait bun ki jaitbynriew bad u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba khrup :
translation.en: Who smote great nations , and slew mighty kings  ;

translation.kha: baroh kiba kein hangta ki la ïasam bad ïam sngewsyiad na ka bynta ka khynnah . U Jisu u la ong , Wat ïam ; ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translation.en: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount , and called his brethren to eat bread : and they did eat bread , and tarried all night in the mount .
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u jingri , ïa uba u ai kum ka jingkñia halor uta u lum , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew jong u ban ïabam . Ynda ki la lah bam , ki sahmiet halor uta u lum .

U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la pynkhih ïa u ïaiban ban kren : ‘ U TRAI’ u la noh ïa U Trai jong por ; shong hangne sha ka liang kamon jong nga haduh ba ngan da pynmeh ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
translation.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost , The Lord said to my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khunlung ki ksiew jong ki naduh kaba lai pateng bynriew ter ter ia shun kynthup hapdeng ki briew U Trai .
translation.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem Mediterranian , u Sah bad u Salmunna , ki her ïap , hynrei u beh kthong ïa ki bad u ïohkem ïa ki , malade u pynkulmar thlim ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki baroh kawei .
translation.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled , he pursued after them , and took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and discomfited all the host .

translation.kha: Nangta u Balak u ong ha u Balaam , Ale bad nga sha kawei pat ka jaka na kaba phi da ban ïohi tong katto katne ki Israel . Tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .
translation.en: And Balak said unto him , Come , I pray thee , with me unto another place , from whence thou mayest see them : thou shalt see but the utmost part of them , and shalt not see them all : and curse me them from thence .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong :  Lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh ïa ki kamram kiba nga la shaniah ha me , te men ïailong uba khmih ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ïa ki phyllaw jong ka , bad ngan shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me , kumba nga shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga .

translation.en: Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
translation.kha: To ong ha ki jaitbynriew baroh ,  U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .

U Jehoash u la ïohkem ïa u Amasaïah malade u ïalum ïa u sha Jeremaïah . Haneng u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh nongbam nadong ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong , ka jingjngai kumba pyrshah mitar .
translation.en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , at Beth–shemesh , and brought him to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la syaid ïa ki kjat jong ki , u la kup biang ïa ka jaiñkup bad u la leit phai sha la ka jakarieh ha ka imat . Phi sngewthuh ïa kai kaba nga ïan shu ngap ban leh ïa phoi ? u la kylli .
translation.en: So after he had washed their feet , and had taken his garments , and was set down again , he said unto them ,  Know ye what I have done to you ?
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he shall lift you up .
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un pynkhraw ïa phi .
Pynlong ïa ka , ka jingthmu jong phi Ban im ka jingtim kabu jar jar , ban pyrkhat ïa la ka kam , ban kamai na ka bynta ka jingim jong phi hi , kumba ngi la bthah ïa phi mynshuwa .
translation.en: And that ye study to be quiet , and to do your own business , and to work with your own hands , as we commanded you ;
Aijalon with her suburbs , Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Aijalon , bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
U Trai u la nguh ha u , Aïu uba ai ha u briew ïa ka shyntur ? utai uba pynlong ïa u uba kyllut ne u bajngum kren ? Uei uba ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa u , uba matlah ? Dei ma nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Nangta sa khmied biang ïa ka pyrthei , kumno uba skhem bad uba shlur .
translation.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot  ; yea , thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :

translation.kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong Phin ïa ki , khnang ba ki balang baroh kan sngewskhem ïa kata bad kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha katba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .
And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .
translation.kha: Haba me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pat sha ka krung kamon jong me bad shahshitom sawphew sngi namar ki kam bymman ka ïing Judah — kawei ka sngi namar kawei kawei ka snem jong ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki .

translation.en: But if any widow have children or nephews , let them learn first to shew piety at home , and to requite their parents : for that is good and acceptable before God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka riewkynthei ka don ki khun ne ki khun ksiew , ki dei ban nang shuwa nyngkong ban khmih ïa ki kam ba kynja mynsiem ka longïing la jong hi bad ha kane ka rukom ki siew kylliang ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa ki kmierad parad , namar kata ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear your words , when ye depart out of that house or city , shake off the dust of your feet .
translation.kha: Bad lada kano kano ka ïing ne ka shnong kam pdiang sngewbha ïa phi lane pynshahshkor ïa phi , te mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi .

translation.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u phah khot ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , hynrei ki ong ,  Ngim wan !
hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlem ni khun shynrang ; u Don tang ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kyntur jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , ki khun u Kish .
translation.en: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .
And the children of Aram  ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aram ki long ki briew jong ka Us , ka Hul , ka Gether , bad ka Meshek .

translation.en: And I will bless them that bless thee , and curse him that curseth thee : and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba kyrkhu ïa me , Hynrei ngan tim ïa kito kiba tim ïa me . Bad da me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah : and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day , and made them an ordinance in Israel : and , behold , they are written in the lamentations .
translation.kha: U Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa u thaw ïa ka jingrwai pangnud ïa u syiem Josaïah . Ka long ka rukom ha Israel na ka bynta ki nongrwai , kynthei bad shynrang , ban rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai haba ki ïambriew namar jong u . La shem ïa kane ka jingrwai ha ki jingrwai pangnud ba la lumlang .
Ban pynbuaid ïa kata ka ïing , un shym ar tylli ki sim , pynïadait u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnga Hissop .
translation.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :

translation.kha: U Trai , U Blei jong ka bneng , u la ïalam noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga bad na ka ri ki tam ki joit jong na , bad u la kular skhem ha na ba un ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Un phar ïa u angel jong u ha shuwa lad me , ba me eh ban pynïoh hangno ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga .
translation.en: The  Lord  God of heaven , which took me from my father s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me , and that sware unto me , saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land  ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence .
Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la leit shabar sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïamudui aïu ïa une u briew ?

translation.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people , and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead .
translation.kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki briew , bad ban sakhi ba u long uta ïa uba U Blei u la thung ban long u Nongbishar ïa kiba im bad kiba ïap .

translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon noh , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , bad ki briew jong ki , ki kyndit ha kata ka jingpynjot .
Nga lah ban ai baroh kaba ang khong , bad wat ïa ka sien jong nga ïa ka ban thang — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingngeit , kane kam mangi ei ei ïa ar .
translation.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned , and have not charity , it profiteth me nothing .
And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Khrist hi da lade u la kular ban ai ha ngi — ka jingim bymjukut .
Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka tang poi bnai , namar ka long ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .
Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
translation.kha: shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel ka rupa ,
U Jisu u la jubab , Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingbishar : Phi ïawad ïa ang namar ba phi! la bam ïa u kpu Bad phi la Ïoh barieh kaba phi kwah , ym nabar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kaweh lad nga .
translation.en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .

translation.kha: To U Bela uba U Kpa bad U Jisu! Kherith , U Khun jong U Kpa , un ai ha ngi ka jingaiei , ka jingtei bad ka jingsuk ; to ai ba kin long ki jong ngi ha ka jingrisa bad ka jingkheit .
translation.en: Grace be with you , mercy , and peace , from God the Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .
Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying  ; who can hear it ?
translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki nongbud jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka jinghikai ka long kaba eh than . Uei u ban shahshkor ïa ka ?
Ki bymman ki lah ban don shibun bhah ka sien ban ñiew bad shibun ki jingriam ban ïa kaba ki jingdonkam ;
translation.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay  ;
And Cornelius said , Four days ago I was fasting until this hour  ; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house , and , behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing ,
translation.kha: U Kornelios u la ong ,  Ka la long kumba ha kane ka por lai sngi mynshuwa ba nga dang duwai ha ka ïing jong nga ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi . Kynsan u briew uba riam ha ki jaiñ kiba phyrnai u la ïeng ha khmat jong nga , bad u la ong :

Ki nongïalam behmrad jong ki bynriew kin ïasam ïa ka jingstad jong ki bad kiwei pat ki bariew babun . Hynrei shipor katto katai na ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane shah thap ïap , bad katto katne kin shahskhor lute mala shah pynlong koidi .
translation.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many : yet they shall fall by the sword , and by flame , by captivity , and by spoil , many days .

translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki la leit sha u syiemsad bad ki ong ha u , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei ki hynmen ki para Shynrang jong ngi , ki pynbah ka Judah , ki kyrkhoit ba ki don ka hok baneh rah noh ïa phi bad synñiang ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi , bad ïa ki rangbah jong phi shiah Shillong ka Jordan ?
translation.en: And , behold , all the men of Israel came to the king , and said unto the king , Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away , and have brought the king , and his household , and all David s men with him , over Jordan ?

translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka jingpynmihpat na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki rangbah balui lui kan hap halor jrong phi , naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel balui lui haduh ka jingpynim ïa u Sakharaïah u Kynhun Jong u Berakhaïah , ïa umbah phi la pynïap hapdeng ka Templ bad ka duwan .
translation.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias , whom ye slew between the temple and the altar .

translation.kha: dien sier beiñ balei ba la bat noh ïa u slap , bad u slap pyrem um shym la ïan . Pha la da i syriem hi kum ka jingjot ; pham don kano kano ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain  ; and thou hadst a whore s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .

translation.kha: Mar ïarung shapoh , ki lytar sha ka kamra thiah u Ishbosheth , ha kaba u sdang ïohthiah lyngkien , malade ki la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki la ot ïa ka khlieh jong u , ki rah ïa ka sad ki , malu ki ïadie barben shi Die lyngba ka Them Jordan .
translation.en: For when they came into the house , he lay on his bed in his bedchamber , and they smote him , and slew him , and beheaded him , and took his head , and gat them away through the plain all night .

translation.kha: Nahath nga la ïohi sa tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shyntur jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jongki u mradkhlaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa Baaltamar .
translation.en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .

translation.kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Umpohliew sha Kedemah , badno shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la otsher sad u .
translation.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .

translation.kha: Me la ïohsngew kaei ba u patsha Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato me pynkut ba men laitim im ?
translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?

translation.kha: U Jethro u la wanpaw bad ka tnga jongki u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka shuh ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha u lum bakhuid .
translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :

translation.kha: Khenani kam longsyiem tang kumta ; ngi lehkmen na ka bynta kadei kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba U Jingsuk Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba mynta u la pynjrong ïa ngi ki paralok jong U Bel .
translation.en: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .

translation.kha: Uba ka long , don shibun ki dkhot hyndai tang kawei ka met .
translation.en: But now are they many members , yet but one body .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba u la kren ha ki shaphang u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis .
translation.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist .

translation.kha: U den-um ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong , Ko rangbah , por don hangne ban shrak ïa Phi . sngewlah wan sha Ïing jong na . Phin lah ban sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phiah lah ban khiew dang step , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit . Hynrei ki jubab , Em , ngin Shemaïah Hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jongki ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .

translation.kha: Katto don un uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw kattne ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju longkmie ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba ki long ei ei ruh .
translation.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?

translation.kha: Ka ki Gershon ka oh khatlai tylli ki nongap na ki dik jong ki jait Issakhar , Assir , Umpohliew , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .
translation.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .

translation.kha: Hynriew u Jakob u ong , U khun jong nga um lah ban leit ïaryngkat bad Phin ; u bymman jong u , u la ïapom , bad u sah sa tang marwei . Kaei khie ka lah ban ngat ha u ha lyndang . Nga dei u briew uba la tymmen , bad ka jingsngewsih kob phin pynjia ha ang kan sa pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .

translation.kha: Hangne u la leh ïa ki kaba bad ki kamphylla banbeiñ pynshitom ïa u syiem malu ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
translation.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee , O Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his servants .
And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa ka jaiñkup thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlup ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And he came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up : and , as his custom was , he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and stood up for to read .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha Nasareth , ha kaba la pynheh pynsan ïa u , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la leit sha ka synagog kumba ju long . U la ïeng ban pule ïa Ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ,
U la nang san nang san dat haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :

translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ïasaid da ïa lade ha kane ka rukom , u Phestos u la pyrta ha u , Me la ïalamwir , ko Paul ! Ka jingstad bakhraw jong me ka la pynpyiar ïa me !
translation.en: And as he thus spake for himself , Festus said with a loud voice , Paul , thou art beside thyself  ; much learning doth make thee mad .

translation.kha: U Blei uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , u la buhrieh ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki pateng baroh kiba mihpaw ,
translation.en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: U tharai U Blei! jong phi u la byrngem ïa kane ka ri da ka jingjynjar , bad Myntan u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la ong ba un leh . Beor kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong Phin ki la leh pep pyrshah ïa U Trai bad kiei shym la kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .

translation.kha: Lehse U Trai un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha nga katto katne ki jingkyrkhu Ban shim bujli ïa ka jingtim jngai u .
translation.en: It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .
Save that the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

translation.en: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .
translation.kha: Mynba kiba na ka longïing jong u ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la leit ban shimti ïa u , namar ki briew ki la ïa-ong ,  U la lamwir !
Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , dak u briew u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba distrik un nang na kata kaba la hikai ïa u .
translation.en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .

translation.kha: A Trai’ , nga la wan ha me ban ïoh jingda ; wat shah da lei lei ba ngan shahjop !
translation.en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .

translation.kha: Hynrei kim Shim la iehnoh ïa ki pop! sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïamareh ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Ishar ka daiñ ïaisah ha Samaria .
translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )

translation.kha: Wat la u symboh Jehoshaphat u shong u sah ha Jerusalem , u saw bhor sha ki briew’ , na Bathsheba shaphang shathie shaduh kaba ktung jong ka ri lum Ephraim shaïong shatei , khnang ban khot patiaw ïa ki briew sha U Trai , U blang jong ki kpa tmain jong ki .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .
But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Jerusalem .
Ki Israel baroh’ ki dei ban shong hynñiew sngi ha ki ïingtrep ,
translation.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days  ; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths :

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor kaba me la ai ha nga , bad ki la pdiang ïa ka ; ki tip ba ka long kaba shisha ba sa la wan na me , bad ki ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me  ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .

translation.kha: Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga ; me Long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka wan .
translation.en: Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .

translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng malu khet noh ïa ki tnat jongno u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Ber noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki da na ki tat jong u .
translation.en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :

translation.kha: U ijuh u la phah ïa u Petros badno ïa u Ioannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah : Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ngi ban ïabam .
translation.en: And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynba U Herod u long u syiem ka Judia , la don u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Sekharaïah , uba dei na ka pdang lyngngeit jong u Abijah . Ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u , ka long ka Elisabeth ; ma ka ruh ka la lama na ka longïing lyngkhot .
translation.en: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judaea , a certain priest named Zacharias , of the course of Abia : and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron , and her name was Elisabeth .
And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand :
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka umphniang ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,
Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri jong ki bad ki jinglut na ki shaneng jong ki .
translation.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves , and the spoil of the cities which we took .
They come to encourage us .
translation.kha: Ki wan ban pynshlur ïa ngi .

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Te u syiem u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki lat kiba kham hapoh , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat tyngka , ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ki jylla . Ki la dei ban wan sha ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .

Ki don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Anab bakha shongduh dew ha ka nongbah Sarai . U Jehu u thoh ka shithi bad u la Phah ïa ki kopi jyllang ka sha ki nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , sha ki riewkhraw , bad sha ki nongsumar ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab .
translation.en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria . And Jehu wrote letters , and sent to Samaria , unto the rulers of Jezreel , to the elders , and to them that brought up Ahab s children , saying ,

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , ki synrang ki la jubab , ïalang shon ki briew hangamei ki la khih ban lyndum maw ïa me , bad hato me thmu ban leit phai shata ?
translation.en: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?
If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .
translation.kha: U nongsharai balang u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit bad ki bym don jingbudnam ba ki long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .
namar ka long ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad lada uno uno u bam ïa ka , ngan ym pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .
translation.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day , it is abominable  ; it shall not be accepted .

translation.kha: Uta uba da mutlop u kular ïa-ban kitkhlieh ïa ka ram u nongwei u dien hok ban buh ïa la ka jongno ka ingdong jingem ban pynshisha ïa ka jingsiew .
translation.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
For he commandeth , and raiseth the stormy wind , which lifteth up the waves thereof .
translation.kha: U hukum , bad ka lyer bah ka sdang ban beh bad pynmih ki jingat phyllung .
ka Harbonah , bad ka Jaser , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs  ; four cities in all .
Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  Ka jingshyrkhei kaba khraw i pa jong nga i la leh ïa ki briew jong ngi ! Khmih haduh katno nga sngew ïohbor namar ba nga bam khyndiat ka ngap !

translation.en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array before the gate of the city : and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki ïaid bad ki pynskhem ïa ki jaka jong ki ha ka khyrdop sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ka ri jong ki , bad ki syiem kiba la wan ban ïarap , ki apthap ha ki rudnong .

translation.en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .
translation.kha: Kan ym long kumta! U Blei un long uba shisha , wat la uwei pa uwei u briew u long uba shukor . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phi ba phi long kiba shisha haba phi kren ; phi dei ban jop ïa ka jingïaleh haba la bishar ïa phi .

Nangta ki la wan poi ha ka jaka ïa kaba la khot ka Marah , hynrei ka um hangta ka longsem kaba khñiang haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban dih ïa ka . Dei na kata ka kata ba la khot kyrngah ïa ka , ka Naarah .
translation.en: And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong , To khih joit , ko waitlam , bad uta ïateh ïa u nongaplangbrot uba trei na ka bynta jong nga ! Pynïap ïa u , bad ïa ki langbrot yn pynsakma . Ngan tat ïaleh ïa ki briew jongki por
translation.en: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man that is my fellow , saith the  Lord  of hosts : smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered : and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la ai noh ïa wir ki briew sha ka ban leh ïa kiei kiei bakha jakhlia Kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki kwah , mala ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki .
translation.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :

translation.kha: Bad ma phin , ruh , phi dei ban long kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U briew un wan ha ka kynta haba drama shym khih lynti ïa u .
translation.en: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u Dei ban ai ïa ka tnga banyngkong jong u katjuh ka bam bad ka jaiñkup jaiñsem , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kam ka ju ïoh .
translation.en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him ?
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u kem ïa me bad u wallam ïa me sha ka jingbishar , uei uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u ?
Haba u gospel u la kren ïa kane , ki paid Israel baroh ki la sdang ban ïamih ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the angel of the  Lord  spake these words unto all the children of Israel , that the people lifted up their voice , and wept .

translation.kha: Namar ka ñiut iaka ka para jong ka , ngam nang pynper ia ki .
translation.en: Because she takes after her younger sister , I cannot tell one from the other .

translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synran — ym tang Naaman ka jingpynshitom U blem , hynrei na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem ruh .
translation.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .

translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta , ym ne shiah nawei ruh Uba sdang lait im , malu la thrang ruh ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword , utterly destroying them : there was not any left to breathe : and he burnt Hazor with fire .

translation.kha: Irad u Noah u la dup sanspah snem ka rta , u ïoh lai nguid ki khur shaneng , u Shimham , u Ham , bad u Japheth .
translation.en: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

translation.kha: Lada nga daiñ ban sngewsarong , ngan sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba pyni haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translation.en: If I must needs glory , I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities .

translation.kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingiw Jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu bad ïa ka jingieit jong phira ïa ki briew baroh ki jong U blem .
translation.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus , and of the love which ye have to all the saints ,

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka waiñ bathymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai !
translation.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew ki bym ñiewkor ïa kiwei paw , ki ha ban pynkhih kulmar ïa ki nongbah baroh . Kito kiba riewstad ki pynjai jai ïa kiei kiei .
translation.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .

Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth–el  ; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth–el : the words which he had spoken unto the king , them they told also to their father .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u nongïathuhlypa uba la tymmen uba shong ha Bethel . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki la wan ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u la leh ha Bethel ha kata ka sngi bad ïa kaei kaba u la kren ha u syiem Jeroboam .
to Lehkmen ko ki lyngkha bad borbah kiew kiei kiba don ha pha ! Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin risa da ka jingkmen ,
translation.en: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein : then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

translation.kha: Bun kumta naduh mynsiem hi , yn ym don hajuh u dieng , kam pher katno la ai um beh ïa u , un jrong pat sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la ka kliang lyngba ki lyoh mala u ban kot kat kato ka ryñiot . Ïa ki baroh la shuh ban ïapom kumno ïa barhem ki briew ba dei ban ïap , la buh ba ngin ïasoh pynlang pli kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .

translation.kha: Don ar tylliat ki dieng Olib hajan u diengpynïeng sharak , uwei ha Kawei kawei ka Hul jong u .
translation.en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .
But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewshyrkhei , da kaba pyrkhat ba ki ïohi ïa ka rngai .

translation.en: But though he cause grief , yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies .
translation.kha: U lah ban wallam ka jingsngewsih ha ngi , hynrei ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba thikna bad kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will plead thy cause , and take vengeance for thee  ; and I will dry up her sea , and make her springs dry .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan shimti na ka bynta jong phi bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin hap siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa phi . Ngan pynrngad ïa ki tyllong um jong ka Babilonia bad ngan pynlong ïa ki wah jong ka ban tyrkhong .
Haba ngi la poi ha phret , ngi la syiem ba la khan pynskhem ïa ka bad borbah ki nongjop phria Ibbah ap ki ni ha ka khyrdop ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ïa ki khyrdop , ngim shem ïano ïano jin hapoh !
translation.en: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .

translation.kha: Ki kynthah kiba la buiñ ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa ki la leit bad u Joseph pynlang ki la ïohi ïa ka jingtep bad kumno ba la buh ïa ka met ka jongnga U Jisu hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .

And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave s mouth , which remain until this very day .
translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai ka hukum , bad la pynhiar noh ïa kita ki metïap bad bret ha kajuh ka krem ha kaba ki la ïarieh mynshuwa . La buh ïa ki maw kiba heh ha ka jaka rung sha ka krem , bad ki dang don hangta .

Khot lang ïa ki shynrang , ïa ki kynthei , bad ïa ki khynnah baroh , sad ïa ki nongwei ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , khnang ba uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang ïa ka pynlang un nang ban burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi! bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong U .
translation.en: Gather the people together , men , and women , and children , and thy stranger that is within thy gates , that they may hear , and that they may learn , and fear the  Lord  your God , and observe to do all the words of this law :
And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Have faith in God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  To don ka jingngeit ha U Blei .

Ka long kumne . Uwei u briew u shim ïa u symbai tlor bad u bet ïa uta ha ka lyngkha jongngi u . U jingthung u saiñ bad u kylla long u diengïap , bun ki ha-sem ki thawsha ïa la ki skum ha ki tnat jong u .
translation.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and cast into his garden  ; and it grew , and waxed a great tree  ; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it .
Then said the king to the servants , Bind him hand and foot , and take him away , and cast him into outer darkness  ; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ïa ki shakri jong u , ‘ To khum ïa u bad kti bad kjat , bad bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum . Hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’

translation.en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .
translation.kha: Don kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u dang buhrieh na ka jingtip u briew ; hynrei u la pynpaw ïa ka Aiñ jong u , bad ma ngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi , ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa ka junom .
To ïakhaïi iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translation.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .

translation.kha: Hangta de ai pajut ha ki ïa keiñ ki jingbthah : ‘ U Trei U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa khnai ka ri kaba sha mihngi na Jadon ba pher ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pateng , pynkheiñ atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi! bad phah ïa ki sha arliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
translation.en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .
And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .
translation.kha: Kin pynrem ïa u sha ka jingïap bad kin aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil , ki ban krenbeiñ ïa u , kin sympat ïa u , bad kin sahnarphna ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; ngam shym phah ïa ki , lymne ngam shym la ai kino kino ki hukum lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw kiba ki ïakren kim shym wan na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki long kiei kiei ki bymdondor kiba ki la mutdur .

translation.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
translation.kha: U buh ha khmat eh ïa ki tnga kliar bad ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatduh ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .

Lada phi kham pyn-i barhem ïa u brup uba riam bha badno phi ong ïa u , To shong ha kane ka dik shong kaba bha tam , hynrei phiah ong ïa u briew uba duk , To ïong hangtai , lane to shong hangne ha madan hajan ki jat jyllang nga ,
translation.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :
And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Ahab kumba nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel bad jong u Baasha u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno uba theh ïa ka waiñ thymmai ha ki lwa snieh barim , namar ka waiñ kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , bad baroh ar , ka waiñ bad ki snieh kin sniew noh . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ thymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai .
Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , phi la shem da lade haduh katno U Blei u long uba sbun .
translation.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious .
And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
Katto katne lwet ki nongai ka Hukum bad katto katto ngut ki Pharisi ki la kwah daw ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u leh bakla , kumta ki la ïakhmih bniah ïa u ban ïohi lada un pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day  ; that they might find an accusation against him .
Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel u la tei kynroh ïa ka shnong Shekhem kaba ha ri lum Ephraim bad u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shnong Penuel .
Ki la shim ïa ka met lad u Absalom , ki la bret ïa ka ha ka thliew bajlih hapoh ka khlaw , bad ki la tep ïa ka da ka kynran maïan kaba khraw . barieh ki Israel ki pher krad sha la shnong .
translation.en: And they took Absalom , and cast him into a great pit in the wood , and laid a very great heap of stones upon him : and all Israel fled every one to his tent .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synran jong u Saul ki leit ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa Kaba u Saul u la ong , malu u Dabid u sngewbha ïa ka jingpyrkhat ba un sa long u pyrsa kurim jongu u syiem . Ha ka sngi Shuah ka jingkyntiew kurim ,
translation.en: And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .
Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: hynrei namar ba u don ka jingduna ha ka met , um bit ban wan hajan ka jingkah pyrda kaba kyntang ne ban leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dei ban pynbit tngit ïa kine ki jaka kyntang jong nga ; namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga pynkyntang ïa ki .
bad kumin u Shual u la sah bad ki bad u la leit kylleng ka Jerusalem , da kaba ïalap da ka jingshlur ha ka kirteng jong U Tlai .
translation.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem .
Absalom said moreover , Oh that I were made judge in the land , that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me , and I would do him justice !
translation.kha: Bad u ju bynrap ,  Ba ngan jin da la long u nongbishar ! Te uno uno uba don ka jingïakajia lane ka jingkam ïa kano kano u lah ban wan sha nga , bad ngan ai ha u ka jingbishar hok .

Yn ym ei na ki bri jong ka Jehud kiba la iehnoh shadien bad kiba la wang sha Ijipt ban shong don hukum kin lait phet ne lait ïap . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban leit phai sha Judah , sha kabu ki sliang ban shongduh don sah sa saihon pat . Yn ym don ba ïoh wan phai lait noh katto katne ki nongphetwir .
translation.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah , which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall escape or remain , that they should return into the land of Judah , to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there : for none shall return but such as shall escape .

translation.kha: To wat ai ba ka jingsniew kan jop ïa phi ; pynban , to jop ïa kaba sniew da kaba beh .
translation.en: Be not overcome of evil , but overcome evil with good .

translation.kha: Bad lama ka khmat jong me ka pynphong ïa me ban hajuh napoh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khlaw noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban thring shai ka Hima U Blei tong da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad pun shah bret sha dujok .
translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :

translation.kha: U haka u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Arbad , bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .
Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka bor mynbarim jong ka jaitbynriew bad pynskhem biang ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u khun , ki la ong ha lade , ‘ Une u long u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin pynïap ïa u , bad ngin ïoh ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u !’

translation.en: But when he was strong , his heart was lifted up to his destruction : for he transgressed against the  Lord  his God , and went into the temple of the  Lord  to burn incense upon the altar of incense .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u syiem Ussaïah u la kylla long uba khlaiñbor , u la sngewmeng noh pynban , bad kata ka ïalam sha ka jingkhyllem noh jong u . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u da kaba u leit rung sha ka Templ ban thang jingiwbih ha ka duwan thang jingiwbih .
U Isaak u la im shispah phraphew snem ,
translation.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years .

translation.kha: Phi kiba shong ha Lakhish , teh ïa ki kali ïapom ha ki kulai . Phi pynbud ïa ki pop jong ki Israel bad kumta ka pyningkhong ïa ka Jerusalem ban leh pop .
translation.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee .

translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong ha u , Sngewbha kylli na U Blei la ngin shem bha ne em ha kane ka jingleit jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Ask counsel , we pray thee , of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous .
Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?
translation.kha: Lane lehse phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da shisha phi tip ba U Blei u long uba sbun , namar u pyrshang ban ïalam ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut .

translation.en: Libnah , and Ether , and Ashan ,
translation.kha: Don ruh ka Libnah , ka Ether , ka Ashan ,

translation.en: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
translation.kha: Naba nga long thikna ba ym don kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingim , lymne ki angel , lymne kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wan ,
Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongbat phira ; mynsngi ne mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U Tharai ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba un klet ïa ki .
translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Babha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong ,  A Trai , uei uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?

translation.en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .
translation.kha: Wat shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad shah ïa uta u para Israel jong phi ban shong marjan bad phi .
Hato me long uba khlong kum ma ang ? Hato ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh ïam kum ka jongno nga ?
translation.en: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong kata ka kynthei ka dei ka Kosbi . U Sur , u kpa jong ka u long u rangbah bahakhlieh jong kawei ka kynhun ki jait Midian .

Ka dei ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa thnum jong ki mynba nga la wallam noh ïa ki na jingïaphet , ka ri kaba longkmie kum ka lamwir ding baklang ïa ki . Neng la ong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga bad ban ar ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah hukum . Nga la ong ïa ki ba lada ki kohnguh , kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïoh un-long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace , saying , Obey my voice , and do them , according to all which I command you : so shall ye be my people , and I will be your God :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïa-ong , Ka Hima jong nga kdew hir na ka jong kane ka pyrthei , lada ka hima jngai nga ka la long na ka jong Kane ka pyrthei , ki nongbud jrong nga kin jin da la ïaleit ban ïadih ïa nga na ka aiti ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Em , ka hangta jong nga ki long hangne !
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  My kingdom is not of this world : if my kingdom were of this world , then would my servants fight , that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now is my kingdom not from hence .

translation.kha: bad laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba lai kilomitar . U phah buh ïa ki barben ha ka Kamra Heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon .
translation.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold : three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .

translation.kha: Aïu ngi ïohnong na ka kam jngai ine baroh ?
translation.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth ?
Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtoreth , and served the  Lord  only .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki bret noh ïa ki bleithaw u Baal bad ka Astarte , bad ki la mane tang ïa U  Trai .

U Hobab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Asahel bad ki la ter ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miej , bad ha ka Por kynjat shai ki la wan poi biang ha Hebron .
translation.en: And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .

translation.kha: Hajan ka Khyrdop Nongaplangbrot ha Jerusalem ka la don ka pungsum kaba don sai tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la khot ïa ka , ka Bethesda .
translation.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .

translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw jrong u , U Trei u la smam ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lyndet ba ki briew ki la bud . U Ong ,
translation.en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli , Balei ba phi wan Sha nga mynba , lehbha phi la kito ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la pynlong ïa nga ban mihnoh na ka ri jongnga phi ?
translation.en: And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them  ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kito kiba don ha ïingbyndi , la kumba phi don lang bad ki ha ïingbyndi . Kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom , la kumba phi ruh phi shahshitom kum ma ki .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
translation.kha: ‘ Me la lehbha ,’ u la ong ; ‘ me long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit , ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ki shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’
Kumba u Moses u la kyntur ïa u seiñ rnong ha u dieng ha ka ri shylliah , ha kajuh ka rukom ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn kyntiew shajrong , ba uno uno uba ngat ha u un eh ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .

translation.kha: Kawei na ki babe ka long da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kaba ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .
translation.en: One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .
I am come in my Father s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .
translation.kha: Nga la wan da ka iktiar U Kpa jong nga ; hynrei phim shym la pdiang ïa nga ; pynban , haba don uno uno uba wan ha la ka jong ka iktiar , phin pdiang ïa u .

translation.en: Moreover it is required in stewards , that a man be found faithful .
translation.kha: Kawei kaba donkam ïa kum uta u shakri ka long ba un long uba ïaineh ha u kynrad jong u .
bad lade nur wan blei patan da kaba suk sha ïohnang u kpa jong sa , te men long U Blei jongki nga .
translation.en: So that I come again to my father s house in peace  ; then shall the  Lord  be my God :

translation.kha: ibha ki siew ïa kane ka dor na ka bynda la ka jingim , uba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad uba duk un ym ai duna .
translation.en: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .

translation.kha: Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka ka bad u shem ba u shñiuh suba hangta um pat kylla lieh , nabar ba kam long ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sngewtynnat sawdong jong ka hynriewphew ka stang ha ka dong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .
translation.kha: bad ïa u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon kaba saw . Ïa kine baroh la pyndait ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Hanani , uwei na kiba shi para bad nga , u wan poi na Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun jong kiwei pat ki rangbah , bad nga kylli ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ki para Jiw jong ngi kiba la leit phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilon .

Ym khong ei ei ruh hapoh ka syntiew ka Jingthoh laiñ tang ki ar tyllun ki mawlyngkniap ïa bakha u Moses u la buh hangta ha u Lum Sinai , manbha U Terah u pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel katba ki dang wan mihnoh na ri Ijipt .
translation.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone , which Moses put there at Horeb , when the  Lord  made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Tharai u ong , U sharati jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom bakhraw .
translation.en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .

translation.kha: ‘ Ko Karmel ! U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong me malade u la kynmaw ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me .
translation.en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
Jesus saith unto him ,  Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to ïaid .
Haba ki bri ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh , Bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .
translation.en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .
translation.kha: Ïa kaba sah jong ka yn pynsaphriang hangta kum ka jakhlia , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano uba lah ithuh ïa ki .’
Hynrei don ki nongap langbrot kiba wan beh khong ïa ki . Te u Moses u leit ban ïada ïa ki bad u ïarap ai um ruh ïa ki jingri jongngi ki .
translation.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .
So David and his men came to the city , and , behold , it was burned with fire  ; and their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , were taken captives .
translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki poi , ki shem ba la thang ïa ka shnong , bad ba la rong noh ïa ki tnga jong ki , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
ïohthiah ha u skhem ba U Trai u ong , ‘ Men ym jhieh na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’ U Elijah u la leh kumba la hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .
For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
translation.kha: ( Na ka bynta ki Pharisi , kumjuh ruh na ka bynta ki Jiw baroh , ki bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa tymmen jong ki : Kim ju bam lymda ki sait ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ;

Ko ki bri ka bamaïan , to phet ban lait im ! Phet noh! na Jerusalem ! Pynjah ïa ka turoi ha Tekoa bad to thaw ka ding-ai-dak ha Beth Hakkherem . Ka jingit bad ka jingpynjot ki la wan Ataroth na shait .
translation.en: O ye children of Benjamin , gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem , and blow the trumpet in Tekoa , and set up a sign of fire in Beth–haccerem : for evil appeareth out of the north , and great destruction .
Is Israel a servant ? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled ?
translation.kha: U Israel um dei u mraw ; ym shym la kha ïa u sha ka jinglongmraw . Balei te ba ki nongshun jong u ki behmrad ïa u ?
Naduh kata ka por , ki briew jong ka Hima bashatei jongngi ka Ishmael ki ïaw ïabeh pynshah ïa ka longïing syep jong u Dabid .
translation.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u mynsiem bymman na U Trai u wan tyllep ïa u saraw . U dang shong ha la ïng bad u sum ha la ka kti , bad u Dabid u don Hangta , u ïangat tem ïa la ka thawdur .
translation.en: And the evil spirit from the  Lord  was upon Saul , as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand : and David played with his hand .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la ïaleit sha ki lynti bah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh kiba ki lah baneh ïashem , kiba bha bad kiba snieh kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .
translation.en: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .

But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ïa uno uno uba bitar ïa la u para yn wallam sha ka jingbishar , ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ Me u bymlarkam ei ei !’ yn wallam ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah , bad ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ u bieit bymmyntoi’ un don ha ka jingma ka jingleit sha ka dujok ding .
U la bat ïa ka Jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , Bad u la wan ïa-ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong u , u Israel .
translation.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel , in remembrance of his mercy  ;

translation.kha: Pyntrei shitom kham tyngshaiñ ïa kine ki briew bad pynbunkam ïa ki , khnang ba kin ym don por ban shahshkor ïa ki nia lamler .
translation.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein  ; and let them not regard vain words .

translation.kha: U Trai u pynbiang ïa ka sngi ban pynshai mynsngi , ïa u bnai bad ki khlaw ban pynshai mynmiet . U pynkhia ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ïa ka ban kyrhuh ; ka kyrngah jong u ka long U thri Badonbor barieh .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , which giveth the sun for a light by day , and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night , which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name :

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la smai da la ka jong ka jingim ba un ïalamwir shibun ki rangbah ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia kum shi kynhun ki puit , bad ken pyrsa da ka jingjop .
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam jong ka shnong kaba jan tam na kata ka iaki ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin jied kawei ka masi lud ka bym pat ju ring lyngkor .
translation.en: And it shall be , that the city which is next unto the slain man , even the elders of that city shall take an heifer , which hath not been wrought with , and which hath not drawn in the yoke  ;

translation.kha: Kane kup da ka jaiñ khain bad kin kyiuh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn nang lyndum ïa ki khlieh lad ki , bad yn pynlehrain ïa ki barhem .
translation.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .
So that his life abhorreth bread , and his soul dainty meat .
translation.kha: U briew uba pang u duh noh ïa ka jingkwah ban bam , bad wat ka jingbam kaba bang tam ka pyn-i ngiah .
Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw bad ym kum ki Jentil bapher kumba la khot ïa ki .
translation.en: We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,

translation.kha: Nga ïasngew ïa ki paid Israel ba ki ong ha ka jingsngewsih , ‘ A Trai , ngi la long kamon u mrad uba khlem shah khwai , hynrei me la hikai ïa ngi ban kohnguh . To khulom pat ïa ngi ; ngi long kiba la kloi ban wan phai pang sha me , U TRAI’ U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus  ; Thou hast chastised me , and I was chastised , as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke : turn thou me , and I shall be turned  ; for thou art the  Lord  my God .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,
translation.kha: uba ha khappud ka hima Edom . Hangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,

translation.en: And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :
translation.kha: Dang tang khyndiat sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki para Israel , bad phi la pynlong ïa ka jutang ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ha ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa nga .
