translation.kha: Haduh kato sien ba u briew un kumin ïa u nongshun jongu u bad nangta un pyllait ïa u Ban leit noh khlem mynsaw ? U Trai un kyrkhu ïa phi ïa Kiei kaba phi la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !
translation.en: For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .
And a certain man was there , which had an infirmity thirty and eight years .
translation.kha: Hangta la don u briew uba la pang haduh laiphew phra snem .

translation.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living : and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u syiem Ijipt ba un pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im , hynrei ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kin shah pynïap bad kin thiah ha ka jingjahthait lem bad baroh kiba khlem otsher kiba ïap ha ka thma ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Lada uno uno uba ïasngew ïa ka hynrei um suidñiew , bad u nongshun u wan bad pynpei ïa u , te un kit pop hi ïa la ka jong ka jingïap .
translation.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet , and taketh not warning  ; if the sword come , and take him away , his blood shall be upon his own head .

Yet many years didst thou forbear them , and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets : yet would they not give ear : therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands .
translation.kha: Na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat , ha ka jingïaishah me la maham ïa ki . Me pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren , hynrei ki briew jong me ki long kyllut , kumta me shah ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban jop ïa ki .

translation.en: When thou buildest a new house , then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof , that thou bring not blood upon thine house , if any man fall from thence .
translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïing thymmai , kynmaw ban da ker ïa ka tduh jong ka tnum ïing , ïoh phi hap kit pop lada uno uno u briew u hap nangta bad u ïap .

Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka long kaba lieh , bad kam shym paw ba ka khnam jylliew ban ïa ka sniew sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh ha kata ka burom ruh um pat lieh , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa uta u biria hynñiew sneng .
translation.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :

translation.kha: kumto kane ka dei kaba u Joshua u la leh : u ïada ïa ki bad um khim la shahshkor ïa ki Ishmael ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And so did he unto them , and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel , that they slew them not .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah Ephraim ki khreh ban ïabeh thma ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha Saphon dara ki ong ha u Jephthah , Balei phi leit ïaleh ïa ki Ammon khlem da khot lem ïa ngi ban ithuh lang bad phi ? Ngim thang im ïa me ioh ïing !
translation.en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and went northward , and said unto Jephthah , Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon , and didst not call us to go with thee ? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kham jem ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ïa-ban jah noh ban ïa kaba iohnong ïa ka bynta kaba rishot tam jong ka Hukum .
translation.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass , than one tittle of the law to fail .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , Uno uno uba la dep sum u longïing uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki khiat . Baroh na phi , phi long kiba khuid — baroh lait noh uwei .
translation.en: Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew kim long kumne da lei lei ; ki longsyiem kum u phlangïap uba ka lyer ka ba-eh noh .
translation.en: The ungodly are not so : but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away .
And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;
translation.kha: ka Ebron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .
Nangta ki leit sha Gudgodah bad nangta pat sha Jotbathah , ka jaka kaba pahuh um .
translation.en: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah  ; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah , a land of rivers of waters .
All things are delivered unto me of my Father : and no man knoweth the Son , but the Father  ; neither knoweth any man the Father , save the Son , and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .
translation.kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Khun lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Kpa lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa u .
Katto katto na ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la bthing namar kaei kaba U Trai u la kren , bad ki wan ïalam noh kloi ïa la ki mraw pynlang ïa la ki jingri shapoh ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: He that feared the word of the  Lord  among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .
translation.kha: Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab ka jutang ha kaba la thoh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u paidbah ; ki ruh ki ïa-ong ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u la hukum , ngin leh , bad ngin kohnguh .

translation.en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ngam shym lamwir , ko Kynrad badonburom ! Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka jingtipbriew .
‘ Ka bneng ka hir ka khet jong nga , ong U Trai , bad ka khyndew ka longïing ka jingkordit Jong nga . Ka ïing kaba kumno te phin tei ïa nga ? Hangne ka jaka ba ngan shong ?
translation.en: Heaven is my throne , and earth is my footstool : what house will ye build me ? saith the Lord : or what is the place of my rest ?

translation.kha: hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano ba me leit . Nga tap kumno me bitar shwa pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .

translation.kha: Wat ju kren ïa kano kano ka bymshisha . ksiar na kaba kren lamler bad na ki ktien Kiba ïalam lud .
translation.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .
Let us swallow them up alive as the grave  ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
translation.kha: Ki lah ban shait ban khlaiñ haba ngi lap ïa ki , hynrei kin ïap haba ngi ïoh leh dusmon ïa ki !
To kmen , ko Jerusalem , namar u Nongthaw jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jngai phi !
translation.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .

translation.kha: Ha katai ka sngi U Trai u la hukum ïa ki bastad Israel banbeiñ ai ïa kaei ka bynda jongu ka jingainguh . Ka dei ka aiñ ba ki paid Israel ki dei ban kohnguh pateng la pateng .
translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them , by a statute for ever throughout their generations .

translation.kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ïai-ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u bri uba ot ki daiñ baneh trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kyrmen ban ïew bynta na u jingthung .
translation.en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nong ha ki , kiei kaba nga lah ban leh kai long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi la leh . Wat kata kaba rit eh kaba ma phi ki paid Ephraim phira la leh ka erlangthari kaba hasem kor shikatdei eh ba-bang ïa kadei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la kuna .
translation.en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .
translation.kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .
Shatei na Sela , u pud ka Edom u ïaid lyngba ka Khlem Akhbor .
translation.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .

translation.kha: U Jakob u bteng , Mynta , phin baroh , bad phi ruh , Benjamin , Phin ïohi ba nga dih shisha u Joseph Uba kren ha phi .
translation.en: And , behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you .

translation.kha: U Saul u jubab , To U Trai un kyrkhoit ïa phi ba lehsbun ïa nga !
translation.en: And Saul said , Blessed be ye of the  Lord   ; for ye have compassion on me .
But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow , or a voluntary offering , it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice : and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u wanlam ïa ka jingainguh ïasyllok ban pyndep ïa la ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong u hi , ym da donkam ban bam lut ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba la kñia ; hynrei ïa kaba sah lah ban bam ha ka sngi kaba bud .
U Jingsuk u la sah ïa u ksuid , pynlang u la mihnoh shabar jong u khynnah , pynlang ha —kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed , u khun jongngi u Boas , u ïakhun jong u Salmon , u Kynhun jong u Nahshon ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,

translation.kha: badno u Annas bad u Kaïaphas ki la long ki nongbah lyngdoh . Ha kata ka por , ka ktien jong U Blei ka la wiang ha u Ïoannis u khun jngai u Sekharaïah , ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests , the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness .
Then the men feared the  Lord  exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the  Lord  , and made vows .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki maji ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ha kaba ki la ai ka jingkñia bad kular ban shakri ïa u .
Ym don shuh uba ia ban teh kynjri ïa u ;
translation.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :

translation.kha: To siew te , katai kaba phin dei ban siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dei ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom dara to ai ka bhor ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .

translation.kha: Ynda phi ïap , ki sih malu ki mrad kin bah ïa ki metïap jongu phi , bad yn ym don ba saw beh ïa ki .
translation.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air , and unto the beasts of the earth , and no man shall fray them away .

translation.kha: Na ki nongbah barieh jong ka Benjamin ki ïan sha Ayyah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Isaia .
translation.en: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .
And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Paul u la rung ha ka synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kren shlur bad ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynngeit ïa ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , pynban , kim mon ban ngeit ba une u briew u la long uba matlah bad mynta u la lah ban imat pat , tad ynda ki la khot ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u bad kylli na ki ,

translation.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples , saying , Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun jong ki , ki la khñium ha ki synran jong U Jisu .  Balei ba phi ïabam bad ïadih bad ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ?  Ki la kylli .

translation.en: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .
translation.kha: Kito ïa kiba U Blei u la lah jied lypa u la pynkyrpang ruh ban long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un long uba nyngkong hapdeng ki para .
Kiei ïamihnoh na katba ka lieng bad la ka tnga , ki khun shynrang jong me lem sad ki tnga jongngi ki .
translation.en: Go forth of the ark , thou , and thy wife , and thy sons , and thy sons  wives with thee .

translation.kha: Ngi ïap namarba ngi hiar pateng na u Adam bad ka Im .
translation.en: We die because we all come from Adam and Eve .

translation.kha: Ha u bnai ba-shiphew jong ka snoh bakhyndai ba u Sedekaïah u longïing u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilon u la wan bad ka kynjoh shipai jong u baroh bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the tenth month , came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem , and they besieged it .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin ïoh ïa kawei kaba ki dei ban ïew . Ki briew Ibbah babha kin oh bainong na ka bniat ki kam jong ki .
translation.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u paidbah u la nang kyntur ïa ki , kumta u la lei ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid . mynhynne bakyllut bad bymnang kren , u la ong , Nga hukum ïa me ban iehnoh na u khynnah pynlang wat ju sping shuh hapoh jong u !
translation.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him ,  Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .

Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering , which I have commanded in my habitation  ; and honourest thy sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people ?
translation.kha: Balei mynta pat , me da kwah rhah sa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ba nga dawa na la ki briew ? Balei Eli ba me kham ai burom ïa la ki khun shynrang ban ïa nga da kaba me shah ba kin pynsngaid ïa lade da ki bynta kiba bha tam na ki jingkñia ba ki briew ki ai ha nga ?

translation.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñduh la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .
Mynta shah ngan ai buit slem ïa phi , bad U Blei un ei lem bad phi . Ka long kaba dei ba phin ñiuhmat ïa kine ki Briew ha khmat U Blei , bad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki shaw u .
translation.en: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :

translation.kha: Ngan phah sha jngai bah ïa ki briew bad kan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .

translation.kha: malu un kñia ïa u bad ka jingainguh bam halor ka dil . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid , nabar Uta u briew un sa long uba khuid .
translation.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar : and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and he shall be clean .

translation.kha: Nangta ki dei ban pynsawa ïa kawei ka sur kaba jyllang . Dang mar shuki ïohsngew ïa kata , ki briew baroh ki dadien ban risa jam , mala ki kynroh jong ka Nongbah kin khyllem . Nangne ka kynthup shipai baher kawei kan leit pait ibieit shapoh ka nongbah .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when they make a long blast with the ram s horn , and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet , all the people shall shout with a great shout  ; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat , and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him .

translation.kha: Phin ithuh ïa ki da kaei kabu ki leh . Ki bniap shniah kim ju pynmih ki sohwaiñ , bad ki shi buaid kam ju pynmih ki soh Dumbur .
translation.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits . Do men gather grapes of thorns , or figs of thistles ?
Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me , and have multiplied your words against me : I have heard them .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki rukom kren kob-pia jong me ba me la kren pyrshah ïa nga .

U angel uba ar u la bud ïa uba nongdih , u da ong , Ka la kyllon ! Ka bamaïan Bakhraw ka la kylleng ! Ka la pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jngai ka — ka waiñ kaba khop jong ka jingkwah byrni khlem akor !
translation.en: And there followed another angel , saying , Babylon is fallen , is fallen , that great city , because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication .

And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering , of a cubit and an half long , and a cubit and an half broad , and one cubit high : whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki miej ha ka kamra ba la pynïasoh ba la pynkhreh ban ai kum ki jingkñia batylli , ki la long da u maw ba shu phiah . Ki jrong sanphew sentimitar bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ka long hynñiewphew san sentimitar sawdong . Ïa ki tiar baroh ba pyndonkam ban pynïap ïa ki mrad ban kñia la buh halor kine ki miej .

translation.en: And they cried out again , Crucify him .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta kylla ,  Sahnarphna ïa u !
u la ong ha nga : To thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaei kadei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .

translation.kha: Haba ktieh kiei ki bit ki babiang ïa ph , to kmen , bad haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , shu kynmaw : U Blei u phah ïa ka jingkmen bad ka jingjngem ; phin ym tip da lin lei kaei ka ban jia hadien .
translation.en: In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other , to the end that man should find nothing after him .
Son of man , when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land , they defiled it by their own way and by their doings : their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  haba ki Israel ki dang shong ha la ka ri , ki la pyntngit ïa ka da ki rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , nga ñiew ïa ka rukom im jong ki kum ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam kum ka kynthei ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi leit lyngba ki duriaw bad phi ïaid sha kylleng ki ri baroh ban pynkylla ïano ïano ; bad haba phi lah , phi pynlong ïa u ar shah uba dei ban leit sha dujok kumba phi hi , phi long !

translation.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka Jaka Kyntang bad ka duwan , khnang ba ngan ym khie bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :
translation.kha: Haba u Shelah u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Eber ;
Ki la ïakynduh pur baroh pynlang ki la ïasnohkti lang ban ïaleh pyrda ïa u —Joshua bad ki Israhaïah .
translation.en: That they gathered themselves together , to fight with Joshua and with Israel , with one accord .

translation.kha: Te shibun ki briew kine ïing ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Bun katto katne ki rangbah thombor na ka jaitbynriew jong me , ko Daniel , kin ïeng ïaleh pyrsad namar ka jingïohipaw katba ki la lah ïuh , hynrei kin sa shahjop .
translation.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south : also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision  ; but they shall fall .

translation.kha: khnang ba ym dei shuh ma nga uba im , hynrei dei U Khrist uba im ha nga . Kane ka jingriam kaba nga im mynta , sa im da ka jingngeit ha U Khun U Blei , uba la i-ieit ïa at bad uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied upon the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki paid Judah ki la long nongjop halor ki Israel , namar ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
Ka long ka jingpyrkhat jyllang la , u Jakob u la ong , ba ngim dei ban pynjynjar ïa ki Jentil kiba la phai shaei U Blei .
translation.en: Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them , which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :
And it came to pass in the morning , when the meat offering was offered , that , behold , there came water by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , ha ka por kñia ba man ka step , ka um ka la wan tuid na ka phang Edom , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka madan .
Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka jingshemphang kum ka paralok ba-ibieit thep mynsiem jong phi .
translation.en: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :

translation.kha: Ki don ki jingïadie Paralok ki bymneh , hynrei ki ni ki paralok kiba lah ban shano palat ban ïa ki hynmen ki para .
translation.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .

translation.kha: Mynba Kren ha ki paid Israel bad ong ïa ki bhor ban pan na la ki paramarjan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar dara ki jingdeng rupa .
translation.en: Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man borrow of his neighbour , and every woman of her neighbour , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold .

translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , Kumne kito ki bariew ki la pyntngit ïa baroh ar , ka jingrang lyngdoh bad ka jrong kaba me la pyntong bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translation.en: Remember them , O my God , because they have defiled the priesthood , and the covenant of the priesthood , and of the Levites .

translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la kham sheptieng shuh Shuah .
translation.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he was the more afraid  ;
Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , katba phi nang tur sha khmat .

translation.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .
translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga : Nga hi nga sngewskhem ba phi dap da ka jingbha , ba phi don ka jingtip baroh , bad ba phi lah ban hikai iwei ïa iwei pat .
Ko Kynrad , ka la jubab , ki ki ksew ha khrum ka miej ki bam ïa ki jingbam ba la sah tam na ki khun !
translation.en: And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children s crumbs .

translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei uba la wallam ïa ki na Ijipt , bad ki la sdang ban mane ïa kiwei paw ki blei , ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew ibha don sawdong lad ki . Ki mian den-um ïa ki , bad ki la pynlong ïa U Trai ban bitar .
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba Phi pynduk ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalaw shaw ka jingïap .
translation.en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .

translation.kha: U syep Isaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkha ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngkhot ïa ki dur jong ka blei Esra , malade ïa ka jaka ha kiba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shynrang briew .
translation.en: And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .

translation.kha: Lymda pa ai jingsngewbha shat ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ba-bang ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .
translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .

translation.kha: Kiba ka long ha ki balang jong u paidlang U Blei , ki kynthei ki dei ban sngap jar ha ki jingïaseng . Ym shah ïa ki ban kren ; kumba ka Hukum ki Jisu ka ino , kim dei ban leh trai khlieh .
translation.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches : for it is not permitted unto them to speak ; but they are commanded to be under obedience , as also saith the law .

For the  Lord  shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water , and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers , and shall scatter them beyond the river , because they have made their groves , provoking the  Lord  to anger .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki Israel , bad kan khynñiuh kumba pynkhih ïa u khah ha ka wahduid . Un rat dyngkhong ïa ki paid Israel na kane ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad un pynsakma ïa ki sha lyndet ka wah Ïuphratis , namar ba ki la pynbitar lep ïa u da kaba thaw ïa ki bleithaw jong ka blei Asherah .

translation.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away , he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle , and it rent .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u phai ban leit noh , hynrei u Saul u ïohbat ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka la kad .
U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la ong , Khot ïa u . Kumta ki la khot ïa uta u briew uba matlah . To lehkmen ! ki la ong . Ïeng joit , u khot ïa me .
translation.en: And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise  ; he calleth thee .

translation.kha: Ki long Badonbor kiba kloi banbeiñ ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka synshar ïa ka ri . U Trai u ong , Ki brisoh jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew hadien kawei patiaw bad kim shym pdiang ïa na kum U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .
Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold : but they went not  ; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u shna ïa ki liengbah ban ïaid ha duriaw sha ka ri Ophir ban wad ksiar ; hynrei ki la paitlieng ha Esiongeber bad kim shym lah ïaid shuh .

Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi karai . Un kyrkhu umdih ba phin ieh shibun ki khun ki kti ; un kyrkhu ïa ki lyngkha jong phi! ba phira ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa Phin da kaba ai ha phi shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .
translation.en: And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .

translation.kha: Ynda U Trai u la pynjot ïa kita ki jingbhabriew , da lei lei wat buiñ ïa ki rukom lehniam jongno ki , namar ka longsyiem kaba ma . Wat phyrngab ban tip kumno ki mane ïa ki phai jong ki , ïoh ba phi mane Blei kumba leh ma ki .
translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them , after that they be destroyed from before thee  ; and that thou enquire not after their gods , saying , How did these nations serve their gods ? even so will I do likewise .
And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , bad ai ïa ka ha ki briew jong phi .
Dor ki bariew kiba tim ïa la ki kjap bad ki bym ju pyn-i ïa la ka jingïaroh ïa la ki kmierad .
translation.en: There is a generation that curseth their father , and doth not bless their mother .

translation.kha: Kine ki Long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh bam . U lyngdoh na ki khun shynrang u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai ha khmat ka dil .
translation.en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another , and toward all men , even as we do toward you :
translation.kha: To U Trai un pynlong ïa ka jingieit jong phi iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh ban nang ïai san bad ban man khraw ha ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi .

U ïeng hajan ka khak ïeng ki syiem bad u pynlong ka jutang bad U Trai ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki lawlynnong jong u da la ka dohnud mala mynsiem barabor , sad ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingdawa ba ïasoh pynlang ka jutang , kumba la tah ha ka kitab .
translation.en: And the king stood in his place , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments , and his testimonies , and his statutes , with all his heart , and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book .
Be of good courage , and let us play the men for our people , and for the cities of our God : and the  Lord  do that which seemeth him good .
translation.kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongbah jong U Blei jong ngi . Bad ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  !
U Trai u la mihpaw ha u Abram bad u nong ha u , Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ngan ai ha ki khun ki ksiew ong me . Nangta u Abram u la tei klang ïa ka duwan ha U Trai , uba lah mihpaw ha u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto Abram , and said , Unto thy seed will I give this land : and there builded he an altar unto the  Lord  , who appeared unto him .
Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .
translation.kha: Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlieh ; ka long ka jingbieit ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .

translation.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa uno uno , bad hadien un ïaroh ïa ka kham bun ban ïa kaba pynroh .

translation.en: For this is the love of God , that we keep his commandments : and his commandments are not grievous .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit jong ngi ïa U Blei , ka mut ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . Bad ki hukum jong u kim long kiba eh katta katta ïa ngi ,

U la ong , Hato me tip barli ba nga la wan sha me ? Ka long ban pynpaw ha me ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka jingshai . Mynta de dei ban leit noh pat bad ban ïaleh ïa u angel ïadih jongngi ka Peres . Hadien kata , u angel ïada jngai ka jingruma un mihpaw . Ym don mano mano banbeiñ ïarap ïa nga lait noh u Mikhael , u angel ïada jong ka Israel .
translation.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth : and there is none that holdeth with me in these things , but Michael your prince .

translation.kha: Ka spah ba phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ym ha shuwa ba kane ïalam ïa phi sha ki tynneng jong ka jingïap .
translation.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha pli na phi uba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei pat ; nga la ong ïa Kanneh mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngi kaba ar ïa phi , hynrei ngan nong wiang mynta ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka na ba nga wei yn ym ba-don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshna pynshitom .
translation.en: I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la biah ha ka khyndew badno u la khleh ktieh da ka nongbah ; u la kyllan da ita i sbai ktieh ha ki khmat iathuh u briew bad u la ong ,
translation.en: When he had thus spoken , he spat on the ground , and made clay of the spittle , and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay ,
Whose possessors slay them , and hold themselves not guilty : and they that sell them say , Blessed be the  Lord   ; for I am rich : and their own shepherds pity them not .
translation.kha: Ki trai jong ki , ki pynïap ïa ki bad ki lait na ka jingshah pynshitom . Ki die ïa ka doh bad ki ong , ‘ To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ngi la riewspah !’ Wat ki nongaplangbrot jong ki hi kim don jingisynei ïa ki .

Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga nong ha phi , kan don ka jingkmen kaba khim bun ha bneng halor uwei u nongpop umbiah kylla-kaba-mut ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai ki briew badonburom ki bymdonkam ba kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .

translation.kha: U Trai u leh kumba u Moses u kyrpad , malu kita ki jakoid kiba don hapoh ïing , ha phyllaw ïing , bad ha lum ruh , ki ïa-ïap lutphut phar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the villages , and out of the fields .

translation.kha: Yn ym khot Shuh ïa pha , Kaba la shah iehnoh , ne ïa ka ri jong pha yn khot , Ka tnga ba la shah iehnoh . Ka kyrteng bathymmai jong phar kan long U Blei! u sngewbha ïa ka . Ïa ka ri jrong pha yn khot , Ka jingshongkurim kaba suk , naba U Trai u sngewbha eh ïa pha , bad un long kum u tnga ïa ka ri jong pha .
translation.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken  ; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate : but thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah , and thy land Beulah : for the  Lord  delighteth in thee , and thy land shall be married .
Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la dem ngon ha madan ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh .
Phin ym sheptieng haba phi thiah , bad phin ïohthiah suki baroh shi miet .
translation.en: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .

translation.kha: Na kawei pat ka liang jong ka Sarid , u pud u suh shaïong mihngi sha u pud jong ka khyllah thaba , nangta sha Abiathar bad tait haduh Japhia .
translation.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,
Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki long ki bym don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kyntang , bad ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .
Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um kein hangta ; ïam shym la shet ïa u haba por pud shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :

translation.kha: Un kynnoh ïa ki lyngkha , ki beiñ sohwaiñ , dara ki brisoh Olib jong phiah kiba bha tam , bad un ai ïa ki ha ki rangbah syier jong u .
translation.en: And he will take your fields , and your vineyards , and your oliveyards , even the best of them , and give them to his servants .
Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .
translation.kha: Phi ki nong Philippi phi tip bha shibun ba haba nga la mihnoh na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , phi dei tang ma phi ka balang ban ïarap ïa nga ; phi dei tang ma phi kiba la shim bynta ha ki jingïoh bad jingduh jong nga .

U long kum u dieng uba Mih hajan ka wahduid bad uba ki thied ki ksam shai ka um . Um sheptieng haba ka jingshit ka suiñbneng ka wei , namar ki sla jong u ki sawa jyrngam ; um don jingkhuslai haba ym don slap ; u ïai pynmih soh .
translation.en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river , and shall not see when heat cometh , but her leaf shall be green  ; and shall not be careful in the year of drought , neither shall cease from yielding fruit .

translation.kha: Me la jubab ïa nga bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .
translation.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u dieng uba la khot U Jingsngewbha badno nga la khiah ïa u , ban pyndih noh ïa ka ïong kaba U Trai u la pynlong bad ki jingñiewbeiñ barhem .
translation.en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .

translation.kha: U Blei’ u ong , Ngan pynim ïa kito kiba ieit ïa ar , sad ngan ïada ïa kito bakha ithuh ïa nga khim U Tlai .
translation.en: Because he hath set his love upon me , therefore will I deliver him : I will set him on high , because he hath known my name .
Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; naba kata kan pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
Naba ha kane ka kynti ngan pynshitom ym tang ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki bri jong me , hynrei ïa me hi ruh , khnang ba trai ïoh pyntip ba ym ei uba kum ma nga ha ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people  ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
And Humtah , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , and Zior  ; nine cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Humtah , ka Hebron , bad ka Sior : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

U Amram u la shim ïa ka Sarai ka tnga lad u , bad ïa u Lum u pyrsa jong u , bad ïa ka sawspah ka phew baroh , bad ïa ki mraw baroh ba ki la lah ïoh ha Haran , bad ki la ïamihnoh ban leit Sha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran  ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan  ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that , behold , twins were in her womb .
translation.kha: Haba ka la dei por ïa ka ban kha , la shem ba kan sa kha khun synrap .

U Saul bad u Barnabas ki la nang shai ka jingïasaid nia kaba julam bad ki shaphang kane , kumta la ïakut ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katjuh ngut kiwei paw ha Oniks ki dei ban leit shad Jerusalem bad ïakynduh ïa ki gospel bad ki nongsharai balang shaphang kane ka kam .
translation.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .
And the  Lord  came down in the pillar of the cloud , and stood in the door of the tabernacle , and called Aaron and Miriam : and they both came forth .
translation.kha: Ki la leit , bad U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u rishot lyoh , u la ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad u pyrta  Aaron ! Miriam !  Baroh ar ngut ki wan sha khmat ,

Kata ka briew ka la jubab , Me longïing u Jiw , bad nga long ka nong Samaria — te kumne me lah ngab pan um na nga ban dih ? ( Ki Jiw ktieh pynkdang ïa kijuh ki khuri sad ki pynbang kiba ki nong Samaria ki pyndonkam . )
translation.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him , How is it that thou , being a Jew , askest drink of me , which am a woman of Samaria ? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans .
And the priest that offereth any man s burnt offering , even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered .
translation.kha: Ka snieh jong u mrad ba la kñia ïa uba la wanrah kum ka jingainguh thang ruh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
Kine ki longsem ki ktem bashongkhia jong u Agur u Kynhun jong u Jakeh : U Blei um long nabar nga , U Blei um long Bad nga , bad na longsyiem khlem jingïarap .
translation.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki pop jong phi ki la bat noh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba hynriew , jong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing jong nga . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ka la wan halor jong nga .
ïada phi leit sha ka ïeng jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . ba leit shata ka longïng ba tur shaei ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
Wherefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , Because ye speak this word , behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire , and this people wood , and it shall devour them .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim long ei ei hynrei ki pla dap lyer bad ba kim don ka khubor na U  Trai . U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , namar ba kine ki briew ki la kren ïa kum kine kiei kiei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ktien jong nga kum ka ding ha ka shyntur jong me . Ki briew kin long kum ka dieng , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki .
bad u la ong ha ki , La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Tep jongki nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh ïa ki nongtuh !
translation.en: And said unto them ,  It is written , My house shall be called the house of prayer  ; but ye have made it a den of thieves .
And it came to pass , that when the Jews which dwelt by them came , they said unto us ten times , From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka por sha ka por ki Jiw kiba shong hapdeng ki nongshun jong ngi ki wan ban maham ïa ngi ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nongshun jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi .
Ha ka miej jong nga kin Bam baroh katba lah na ki kulai badno ki nongshong kulai jong ki bad na ki shaei bad ki nongïaleh . Ma na , U Trai Nongsynshar , por la kren .
translation.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots , with mighty men , and with all men of war , saith the Lord  God .
And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Ha U Khrist Jisu , la pynmihpat ïa ngi lem bad u , ba ngin ïoh synshar lem bad u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .

Phim kynroh kumno u Abimelekh , u khwan jong u Bethdagon u la shah pynïap ? Ka dei ha Thebes ba ka kynthei ka la pynhap shapoh ïa u mawtylliat na ka kynroh bad la pynïap ïa u . Balei , kew , phi lytar tur sha jat eh jong ka kynroh ?’ Lada u syiad u kylli ïa kane na phi , ïathuh ïa u , ‘ U Uriah hajuh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .’
translation.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall , that he died in Thebez ? why went ye nigh the wall ? then say thou , Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ban wallam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiem . Ka mahadei ka long ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiem u kwah ban pyn-i sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ka ha ki rangbah synshar bad ha baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

translation.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjulor ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur jong ka , kiba ka ju ong ba kiba ieit jong ka ki ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngan pynkylla ri khlaw ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki brisoh jong ka ; ki mradkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .
Ngan pynhap ïa ka ksang ti jong nga halor ki kam tuh Bad pynïap briew .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made , and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee .

And they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We have sinned , because we have forsaken the  Lord  , and have served Baalim and Ashtoreth : but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: Nangta ki kyang sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , bad ki ong , ‘ Ngi la leh pop , namar ngi la phai noh na me , ko  Trai  , bad ngi la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong u Baal bad ki Astarte . To pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ngin mane ïa me !’

translation.en: There shall not an hand touch it , but he shall surely be stoned , or shot through  ; whether it be beast or man , it shall not live : when the trumpet soundeth long , they shall come up to the mount .
translation.kha: dei ban shu lynthem ïa u da u maw , ne ban siat ïap ïa u da ki khnam , khlem da ktah kti mano mano ïa u . Kane ka treikam ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki . Hynrei haba la put ïa ka turoi , te ki briew kin sa leit kiew sha u lum .

translation.en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
translation.kha: Un phah sa ïa ki jait jingpang bad jingïapthem baroh ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai U Blei , bad phin sa jot thiaw .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: kumta kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
Nangta nga la kdiah ïa u dieng suba ar , uta uba la khot U jingshlei , bad ïa ka jinglui jong ka Judah bad ka Israel la pynkhynñiuh .
translation.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff , even Bands , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: hynne mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka kam lyngngeit kob kham halor ban ïa ka jong ki , kumba ka jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit hapdeng U Blei! dara la ki briew ka long kaba kham bha , namar la seng Nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa ki kiei kiba kham beh .
translation.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .

translation.kha: Nangne ki Leah kiba shnong ha kita ki lum ki la wei tur pyrshah ïa phi kumba beh u ngap . Ki la beh ïa phi shawkad Hadoram , bad ki la jop ïa phi hangta ha ri lum Edom .
translation.en: And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki nongbah ka Israel yn pynjot noh , kumta ba ïa ki duwan jong ki pynlang ki bleithaw jong ki yn pynpait lyngngeit lyngkhai , ïa ki duwan jingiwbih jong ki yn pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai , bun ïa ki jingtei jong ki baroh yn sa pyndeng noh .
translation.en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste , and the high places shall be desolate  ; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate , and your idols may be broken and cease , and your images may be cut down , and your works may be abolished .

translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong ; u la pynjot ïa ka nongbet baskhem ha kaba ki shong , pynlang u pynlong ba ki kynroh jong ka kin pra bun hap sha tbian .
translation.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high  ; the lofty city , he layeth it low  ; he layeth it low , even to the ground  ; he bringeth it even to the dust .

translation.kha: dara ngan ai ïa me ha ki bariew ïa kiba me sheptieng , ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa me . Ngan ai ïa me ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Baalah bad ha ki shipai jong u .
translation.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .

translation.kha: len pynkmen ïa ki briew jong por ha khmat ki nongshong jong ki , kum ïa u pui puid ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . ngam pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïabeh ïa ki haba ka jingpynjot ka wan .
translation.en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .

translation.kha: NGA shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jongki me , namar ar ieit ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .

translation.kha: Ki ter ruh ïa u shñiuh blang .
translation.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats  hair .
Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
translation.kha: man ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndem , hynrei um sngap ïa ki .  Nga dei u Jiw ,  u batai ,  bad ngam lah ban dem ha u Haman .  Kumta ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Haman , bad ki pyrkhat la un lah ban shah ïa kane ka jingleh u Mordekai .
hynñiew ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki , mala ki la pynïap ïa lah ngut na ki khun shynna jong u Saul , u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .
translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , the sons of Saul .

Pynkhreh lwep katto katne ki kot ba ngin sa ïasyllok ha ki jingïalang ki ngab sa wan .
translation.en: Examine some of the material that will be discussed at the next few meetings .

translation.kha: Dang step eh ha ka Sning U Trai , hamar ba dang shu miaw ka sngi , ki la leit sha ka jingdap .
translation.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katto katne na ki , keiñ lama ki Syiem . Men ioh shibun ki khun ki ksiew kiba yn sa Long ki jingïambriew .
translation.en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .

translation.kha: kumta nga la siew khatsan lyngkhot ka daw bad shispah sanphew kilo u barben ban thied ïa ka .
translation.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingstad kaba wan najrong nyngkong eh ka long kaba sngur ; ka long kaba pynïashong suk , kiba jemnud Bad kaba pynlong paidlang ; ka dap da ka jinglehisynei bad ka pynmih ïa ka jingseisoh ha ki kdew babha ; ka lait na ka jingkhah shiliang bad ka jingarsap .
translation.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceable , gentle , and easy to be entreated , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .

translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab , To da ïakhmih bha ba men ym pham noh ïa u khun jong nga shata !
translation.en: And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .
And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries : but the people that do know their God shall be strong , and do exploits .
translation.kha: Da ka buit shukor u syiem un ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka niam , hynrei kito kiba bud ïa U Blei kin ïaleh pyrshah .
Katba ki kulai thohbroin ki daiñ wan mih , ki la hir kiba da khiew eh banbeiñ leit bad Ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la nong , Khie leit mala jurip ïa ka pyiar ! — bad ki la leh kum .
translation.en: And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .
And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years : seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la long u syiem ka Israel sawphew snem , u da synshar hynñiew snem ha Hebron bad laiphew lai snem ha Jerusalem .
bad u la ong ha ki , Ka jingsngewsih hapoh ka dohthang jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta kata kat haduh ba ka jan pynpeit ïa nga . To sah hangne bad ïa-ïap slem malu de .
translation.en: Then saith he unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .

translation.kha: U Damaris u la kham noh ha ki kam pyrthei bad u la iehnoh ïa nga , bad u la leit noh sha Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la leit shai Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .
translation.en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .
And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .
translation.kha: Bad ïa kane ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pyrthei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kaba kut kan wan .

translation.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons  ; and now the  Lord  thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude .
translation.kha: Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki leit sha Ijipt , ki ïadon baroh tang hynñiewphew ngut ; hynrei mynta U Blei u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: ( Luke 23 :43 ) Also , millions of dead ones will be resurrected to human life on the earth .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 23 :43 ) Shuh shuh yn sa pynmihpat ïa ki milian ngut ki briew kiba la ïap sha ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa u briew , u la lynñiar jam , bad u la mihnoh na u .

Tei ïa na kamai ka jingnguh da ka khyndew , bad ktien ïa ki longïng bad ki musli jong ph halor jong ka kum ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha bathoiñ la ka jakarieh ba nga pynkyrpang ba phin myn ïa nga , ngan wan bad kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u leit sha ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth mala u ong , Kynmaw haba Phin la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga ? Phi ong ba phim lah shun ai jingbamsap ei ei ïa ki shipai jong nga bakha la Thiat ïan namar ba ngam pat shym la ïohknieh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna . Te , kine hangne !
translation.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth , and said , Behold Zebah and Zalmunna , with whom ye did upbraid me , saying , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary ?

translation.kha: Kata ka long balui ba wat ka jrong kaba nyngkong ka thik tang da kaba pyndonkam da ka snam .
translation.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood .

translation.kha: Ha man ba phi rung ha Kanaan kan ka ïong , to ong nongtong , ‘ Ka jingsuk kan long ha kane ka ïing .’
translation.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .
As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .
translation.kha: Ki jingtim kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi lait tang haba phi dei hok ban ïoh ïa ki . Ki long kum ki sim kiba her bad ki bym ju shongneh .
Hangta phin shong , nga ong ïa pa’ , tat haduh ba phin da siew thep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh lad ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .
translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew lad u Ijipt ki long ki briew jong ka Lydia , ka Anakim , ka Lehab , ka Naphtuh ,
translation.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim , and Anamim , and Lehabim , and Naphtuhim ,

translation.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .

translation.kha: Haseroth don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki ebanjelist kiba shakri ïa u ? Hato don kano katno ka jaka kaba ka jingshai U Blei kam lah ban tyngshaiñ ?
translation.en: Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad u la ai ka jingïohi pat ha kiba bun ki briew kiba matlah .

translation.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan , Tell me what thou hast done . And Jonathan told him , and said , I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand , and , lo , I must die .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Me la leh aïu ?  U Jonathan u jubab ,  Nga la bam khyndiat ka ngap da u dieng uba nga rah . Nga don hangne — nga la kloi ban ïap .

translation.en: Therefore they say unto God , Depart from us  ; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways .

u khun jong u Melea , u khun jong u Menna , u khun lad u Mattatha , u khun jong u Nathan , u khun jngai u Dabid ,

And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
translation.kha: Kumta ha kata ka sngi ki la kmen shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .
Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phoi la ïohi ïa uba khim palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .

translation.kha: Ngam pynmutlop khih katta katta ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin beh nadien jong ki , bad ngan ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ka jingjop jong ang ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , ïa ki kali ïap jong u , bad ïa ki nongñiah jong u .
translation.en: And I , behold , I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they shall follow them : and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang shong dang sah ha kata ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u bitar shla . U Jakob u don khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
U Jisu u la tip) lypa ba kin sa wanlam bad kem ïa u khnang ban pynlong syiem ïa u da ka ni ; kumta u la leit phad biang sha ki jaka lum maw hi .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force , to make him a king , he departed again into a mountain himself alone .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngngeit la thung ban ai ki jingainguh nabar ki jingkñia da ki mrad sha U Blei , Bad kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh jongki ngi u dei ruh ban ei ei ei ban jingeh .
translation.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .

translation.kha: Ym don sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa ine ki lynti bakynjah .
translation.en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .

translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew ; u kynthih ïa ki phiah kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .

translation.kha: U Jethro , u lyngkhot ka Midian , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalum nong ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;

translation.kha: U Abraham u la ujor ha u Abimelekh sanphew ka pynkut um ïa kaba ki shrak u Abimelekh ki la knieh bor .
translation.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech s servants had violently taken away .
He lost his job through his irresponsibility .
translation.kha: U duh ia ka kam jong u lyngba ka jingbymshimkhia jong u .
Kim sheptieng ïa U Blei , bad kumta ki wang ïaleh pynshisha ïa phi haba phi la thait bad la haduh bor , badno ki la pyndap lut ïa kito baroh kiba bud suki nadien .
translation.en: How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .

And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .
translation.kha: Kin long ka dak jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangta la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , un phah ïa uno uno ban pyllait ïa ki .
Ka erlangthari kaba sngewlehrain ïa phi! Da shisha yn don la kumno kumno u briew uba stad ha ka kynhun jong phi uba haw don pynbeit ïa ka jingïashongkha hapdeng ki parabangeit .
translation.en: I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?
And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa kata ka synduk hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad u wah ïa ka pyrda . Da kumne u kah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

U Trai u la khang ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa phi . Hynrei nga smai da U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba lymda phi la pynkloi ban ïashem bad de , baroh ki Briew jongngi u Nabal kin jin da la ïap lut kat ban da mih ka step !
translation.en: For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki sad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalap ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , suba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai khashor jong u .
translation.en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .

translation.kha: Ko khur u briew , u la ong , to thoh ïa ka tarik mynta ka sngew , namar kane ka long ka sngi kaba u syiem ka Babilonia u sheng ïa ka jingkerkut ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Son of man , write thee the name of the day , even of this same day : the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u mih purim , lane u mih tohjaw , lane u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka lah ban kylla sha ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , dei ban leit ïalam ïa u ha lyndum uba na ka longïing jong u Aaron .
translation.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :

translation.kha: Shu kito kiba iwei ïa kiwei pat ; U Blei un isynei ïa ki !
translation.en: Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .

translation.kha: U Blei u la bitar ba u Balaam u la leit , bad Kaba u Balaam u ïangat leit da kaba shong halor ka kada jong u , la synrai ïa u da ar ngut ki shakri jong u ; u angel U Trai u la ïeng ha ka surok ban ksiang lynti ïa u .
translation.en: And God s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the  Lord  stood in the way for an adversary against him . Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him .

translation.kha: U shniah ruh laispah tylli ki stieh bakha khim rit bad ar kilo ka ksiar ka leit ha kawei kawei ka stieh . U phah buh ïa kine ki stieh baroh ha ka Kamra hajuh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon .
translation.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold  ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un heh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ Pa’ , ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Damaskos bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn kit noh da u patsha ka Assyria .
U nongshun un kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad pyrshing ban pynïap ïa ki briew . Ka jingtrud kaba shyrkhei katta katta ba ki bhabriew hapoh ka nongbah kin ïabam iwei ïa Uei pat bad wat ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters , and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness , wherewith their enemies , and they that seek their lives , shall straiten them .
