Em , ym kumta ! Bun nga ong ha phi ba lada kitab phan noh na ki pah jong phi , phi baroh phin ïalap kum ma ki .
translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .

translation.kha: Kumba hain shiphew sngi , U Trai u shoh ïa u Nob bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .

translation.kha: Katba u leit khamtam hajan ban doh ïa u , u Isaak u iw ïa ki jaiñ jong u — bad kumta u la ai ha u ïa ka jingtyrkhong jong u . U ong , Ka jingsma sngewtynnat u khun jong nga ka long kum ka jingiw ka lyngkha ïa kaba U Tharai u la kyrshut .
translation.en: And he came near , and kissed him : and he smelled the smell of his raiment , and blessed him , and said , See , the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the  Lord  hath blessed :

translation.kha: To U Troas un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng Jong ngi ! To un pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jinglehhok jong phi marpyrshah ïa nga , naba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi da lei leilieh ruh .
translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .

translation.kha: Balei ba me la kren ha ka kirteng jong U Trai ba kane ka Templ sa erlangthari kum ka shalor bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah yn pynjot bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta ? Nangta ki briew ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga .
translation.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkut mynta ïa ka bor jong ka Assyria hajar jong phi bad lang pynpait ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa phi .
translation.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .
Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem .
Ko Jeremaïah , kylli ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ‘ Kaei kaba U Trai u la jubab ïa phi ? Kaei kaba U Terah u la krung ?’
translation.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet , What hath the  Lord  answered thee ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?

translation.kha: Kumba ar snem ka la nang jur tad haduh ba u syiem u la ïap ha ka jingkordit . Ki raïot jong u kdor shem thang ding sharak ha kaba ïambriew ïa u kam la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jongu u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in process of time , after the end of two years , his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness : so he died of sore diseases . And his people made no burning for him , like the burning of his fathers .

translation.kha: Da sngap ha shuwa ba phin jaboh . Lymda phim leh kumta , phi long umbiah bieit bad shah krenbeiñ .
translation.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kito kiba don ha ïingbyndi , la kumba phi don lang bad ki ha ïingbyndi . Kynmaw ïa eit kiba shahshitom , la kitab phi ruh phi shahshitom kum ma ki .
translation.en: Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them  ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .
And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron  ; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jabin u don khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar , bad u la synshar ïa ki Israel da kaba banbeiñ bad lehbor haduh arphew snem . Nangta ki paid Israel ki la kyang jam ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ym map kum ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka jingbitar shla jong u kan meh lep pyrshah ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin ngat ha u haduh ba U  Trai  un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
Hato ki prie kynthei jong u baroh kim shong ktem praw hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane Baroh ?
translation.en: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?

translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki Ong , Ka jingai jingmut jong u Hushai ka kham bha ngab ïa ka jong u Ahithophel . U thri u la rai ban pynpulom ïa ka jingai jingmut babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjop kan wan ha u Amraphel .
translation.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .
Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .
translation.kha: To lute ïa ka rupa ! To lute ïa ka ksiar ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !
Wat long uba mutlop , kumba ki kpa tymmen ki la Long ha Meribah , kumba ki la long ha kato ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap ha Massah .
translation.en: Harden not your heart , as in the provocation , and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness :

translation.kha: Kham hawei , u Joab bad ki kiaw patan ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la wan phai na naba leit lute , ki da nongrah shikatdei ka mar lute sad ki . Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid hangta ha Hebron , Naamah u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkylli jingshngain .
translation.en: And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .

translation.kha: U Jehoash , u khun jong u Paruah : ka ri Issakhar
translation.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :

translation.kha: Uwei na ki , u lah ban pynshoi ïa phi ban mano ïa ki blei jongu kita ki briew Ibbah shong marjan bad phi , jlan kiba shong sha jngai na Phin .
translation.en: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Blei u la ramhah ïa nga sha ka ri Israel , bad u la pynshong ïa ar shalor uwei u lumbah uba jrong . Nga la ïohi ha khmat jong na shi kynhun ki jingtei kiba i kum ka nongbah .
translation.en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel , and set me upon a very high mountain , by which was as the frame of a city on the south .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u , Naba lashai ka dien ka jingkhawai Mih bnai thymmai , ka jingbnoh jong Phi kan paw shai lada phim don ha jingïabam .
translation.en: Then Jonathan said to David , To morrow is the new moon : and thou shalt be missed , because thy seat will be empty .

translation.kha: U Blei u la long ryngkat Bad uta u khynnah katba u nang Heth nang san ; u la im ha ka ri khlaw lad ka Paran bad u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit .
translation.en: And God was with the lad  ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .

translation.kha: Kumta shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai badno rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Balei dara kiwei pat ki koidi ki dang ïashukor ïa ki .
translation.en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la kjap ïa ki syiem jong ktien ki nongbah : ka Jerikho , ka Ai ( hajan Bethel ) ,
translation.en: The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka synagog , la Don u briew kaba don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u , bad u la kadiang da ka sur kaba jam ,
translation.en: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,

translation.kha: Hangta u tei ïa ka duwan , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka kum ka kyrteng U Blei ka Bethel , namar dei hangta U Blei u la pynkup ïa ailad ha u mynba u phet ïap na la u hynmen .
translation.en: And he built there an altar , and called the place El–beth–el : because there God appeared unto him , when he fled from the face of his brother .

translation.kha: Tang da kumta , U Jehosheba un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .—Hebru 11 :6 .
translation.en: Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .

translation.kha: kan ym long kaba bha ïa ph ban kyr-ang jam ban ïoh ka jingïarap ; ka jingkhih jongu phi baroh kam lah banbeiñ ïarep ïa phi mynta .
translation.en: Will he esteem thy riches ? no , not gold , nor all the forces of strength .

translation.kha: Bad lada kano kano ka ïing ne ka shnong kam pdiang sngewbha ïa phi dawai pynshahshkor ïa phi , te Mynno na kata ka Jaka bad kynther noh ïa u pui phet na ki kjat jong phi .
translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear your words , when ye depart out of that house or city , shake off the dust of your feet .

translation.kha: Ka Hukum u Moses baroh kawei bad ki jinghikai jongki ki nongïathuhlypa ki shong ba-halor kine ki ar tylli ki hukum .
translation.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets .
And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .
translation.kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u ,  Hangno kito ki rangbah kiba wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar !  Ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
La don uwei u riewngeit ha Damaris uba kyrteng u Ainias . U la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u , Ananias ! Hangne nga don , A Trai , u la jubab .
translation.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias  ; and to him said the Lord in a vision ,  Ananias .  And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .

translation.kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin tlot , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .
translation.en: All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .

translation.kha: bad u tang sha rah ïa la ka kti , ki pynbah kiba la rieh ki ïong joit , ki mareh sha ka nongbah sad kurup ïa ka . Mari mar shwa ki thang ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .
Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um dei ruh ban pyntngit ïa ka jaka kyntang da kaba mih shabar jong ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u sha nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . Nga long U  Trai .
ianga wan kaba kut , Mano Ban laitim ?
translation.en: When the end comes , who will survive ?

translation.kha: Ka la shim por arphew snem ïa u Solomon ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , wherein Solomon had built the house of the  Lord  , and his own house ,

translation.kha: Boas na ki nong Samaria ha katai ka shngain ki la ieit ha U Jisu namar kata ka briew ka la ia ïong , U la ïathuh ïa nga ïa khie Kiei baroh kiba nga la leh .
translation.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman , which testified , He told me all that ever I did .

translation.kha: U Nahash u jubab , Ngan ïateh jingot bad ph halor kawei ka kyndon : Ngan khlaw ïa ka khmat kamon jongu phi baroh , dara da kumno sam pynjahburom halor ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .
Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder , and pushed all the diseased with your horns , till ye have scattered them abroad  ;
translation.kha: Phi kyndat sharud ïa kiba pang bad phi ñiat ïa ki shabar na ka kynhun .

translation.en: Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all .
translation.kha: U da ong ,  Shibun ki kynthei ki long ki tnga kiba bha , hynrei phi long kaba bha tam na ki baroh .

translation.en: When a ruler hath sinned , and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  his God concerning things which should not be done , and is guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada u dei u nongsynshar uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam kiba stad kin tyngshaiñ da ka jingphyrnai baroh jong ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .
Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u Elijah ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying ,

translation.kha: Barukh na kiwei ki Nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh . Leit kiew ïa-pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , badno phin jop , ki ong . U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .

translation.kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh ! To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor . Ai ba ka pyrthuh baroh kaweh bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .
translation.en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .

translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi! ïa kane bunsien mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ïathuh biang ïa ka da ki jingjaw sum ; don shibun kiba ka jingimat jong ki , ka pynurlong ïa ki , ki nongshun jyllang ka jingïap U Khrist ha ka diengphna .
translation.en: (For many walk , of whom I have told you often , and now tell you even weeping , that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ :

translation.kha: Ngan wallam ne ïa ki na ki ri nongwei , ngan lumlang ïa ki , bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki shiah ka ri jong ki hi , ngan ïalam ibiang ïa ki sha ki lumlang bad ki wahduid ka Jerusalem pynlang lang! bsa ïa ki ha ki jaka bam phlang kiba sngewtynnat .
translation.en: And I will bring them out from the people , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them to their own land , and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers , and in all the inhabited places of the country .

translation.kha: Ktien ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar ba ki Philistia ki phah pat kumin ka jingainguh namar ka jingpalat sha U Trai ki longsyiem na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka shnong : Ka Ashdod , ka Gehasi , ka Ashnah , ka Gath , mala ka Aaron .
translation.en: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the  Lord   ; for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one  ;
Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ïa ki khuri ksiar bad rupa la wallam shapoh , bad ma ki baroh ki la ïadih waiñ na ki
( Jingpynpaw 3 :14 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la ‘ pyntip ia ka ktung jong U Blei’ bad u la ïai “phla skhem ia ka jingshisha” shang U blang .
translation.en: ( Revelation 3 :14 ) Jesus himself said that he ‘ made God’s name known’ and kept ‘ bearing witness to the truth’ about God .
My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong phi u long kum u mot jong u Dabid , uba pyllun bad jlih , lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .

translation.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba stad phin sngap jar .

translation.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me uba skhem kum u mawsiang , uba eh kum u diamond ; wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
translation.kha: Bad shano shano ba U Jisu u leit , sha ki nongrit , ki shnong , ki lyngkha , ki paidbah ki rah ïa kito kiba pang sha ki jaka ïew bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ïa ki la kumno kumno ban ktah ïa ka rmiang jaiñkup jong u ; bad baroh kiba ktah ïa ka , ki ïohkhiah .

translation.en: And Bilhah Rachel s maid conceived again , and bare Jacob a second son .
translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun biang , bad ka la kha khun shynrang uba ar ïa u Jakob .
U Araunah u la ai lwait ha u syiem dara u ong ha u , To U Trai U Blei jong phi un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .
translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .

translation.kha: Long kiba sngewsynei kumba U Kpa jong ph u erlangthari uba sngewsynei .
translation.en: Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .

translation.kha: Ka Judah ka la ïohi ba nga la pynkoit tnum ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa ka ñiar ba ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la sylla long ka jingrisa . Hynrei ka Jehudi , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , kdew shym bthing . Ma ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti
translation.en: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .

translation.kha: Naba im sngewlehrain , wat “lada nga la sngewsarong lehbor palat shaphang ka bor kaba U Tharai u la ai ha ngi — ka bor ban tei ïa phi , ym ban pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority , which the Lord hath given us for edification , and not for your destruction , I should not be ashamed :

And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh na ki jaka baseisoh jong ka Moab . Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot waiñ ; ym don shuh mano mano ba shna ïa ka waiñ bad ban pyrta da ka jingkmen .

Ki khoh nur-um arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngew . Nalor kine , ki nongshong shnong ka Gibeah ki lumlang hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang bakha tiak da sdang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u tbit ban kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u ñiuhkhlieh .
translation.en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .

translation.kha: Balei kynrad phi ïalam ? u Hasael u kylli . U Elisha u jubab , Namar ba nga tip ïa ki kiei katba shyrkhei kiba men leh pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel . Men sa wiang dieng ïa ki kut jong ki , men sa pynïap ïa ki rangsamla bakynsai jong ki , men sa lynthaw ïa ki khun rit jongno ki ha ban da ïap , bad Man sa pakor ïa ki kynthei jongnga ki kiba armet .
translation.en: And Hazael said , Why weepeth my lord ? And he answered , Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel : their strong holds wilt thou set on fire , and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword , and wilt dash their children , and rip up their women with child .

translation.kha: U Abijah bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki thom ïa ki Israhaïah da ka jingjop kaba khraw — shitom na ki shipai batynrai ka Israel ki la shah pynjop .
translation.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter : so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men .

translation.kha: Namar me long uba thok , to ïarap ïa per bad to pyllun ïa nga . To shahshkor ïa por , bad to pynim ïa nga !
translation.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me , and save me .

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt baroh ki ïatih shi lynter ïa ka rudwah baroh ban ïoh umdih , namar kim lai shuh ban dih ïa ka um na ka wahbah .
translation.en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink  ; for they could not drink of the water of the river .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym kohnguh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kamai kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah khim ka jingtim .
translation.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .
The  Lord  is exalted  ; for he dwelleth on high : he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness .
translation.kha: Katno uba khraw u long U  Trai  ! U synshar halor kiei kiei baroh . Un pyndap ïa ka Jerusalem da ka jinglehhok bad ka jinglong ba-beit bad pynlong ka jingskhem ha ka hima .

Nga long U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me ha Bethel , ha kaba me la pynryngkang ïa u maw kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw da kaba me la theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u bad ha kiba me la smai ha per . myntri to khreh ban leit phai pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .’
translation.en: I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ka nar na ka khyndew ; bad ki pynum ïa ka rnong na ki mraw .
translation.en: Iron is taken out of the earth , and brass is molten out of the stone .
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :
translation.kha: To ngin ai ki jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi! Naba ha U Khrist , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem baroh ha ka pyrthei kaba kynja bneng .

translation.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan ap phira ïa ka ri jong nga bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Ngan ym shah shuh ïa ki nongbanbor ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong nga ki la shahshitom .
Ngan pynsangeh ïa ki briew ka Moab na kaba lane jingainguh ha ki jaka mane jong ki bad ban ai ïa ki jingkynjah shuh ki blei jong ki . Ma por , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .
And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons , and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat .
translation.kha: Namar ba la palat ka jingthngan , phin hap bam sa ïa la ki jong ki khun .

U Shallum , u khun jong u khohwah , u nongsynshar ïa ka Mispah distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Umpohliew . U siang ïa ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khyrdop , u pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingshong ka khyrdop . Ha ka Pungsum Mahlah , u tei ïa ka khyrdep markhap ïa ka kper syiem , ïaheh ki mawjam bakha hiar sha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translation.en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh , the ruler of part of Mizpah  ; he built it , and covered it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king s garden , and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David .
Who shall offer it before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for her  ; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un kñia ïa ka jingainguh jong ka ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka ; bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid . Kane ka long kaba ka kynthei ka dei ban leh hadien ba kha khun .

translation.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew bad kin kyang , bad ka nongbah hi kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shong ha madan kaba la shah sloit lyngkhuit .

translation.en: And so all Israel shall be saved : as it is written , There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer , and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob :
translation.kha: Bad baroh ki Israel yn pynim . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Nongpynim un wan na Seïon bad un weng noh ïa baroh ka jingbymman na ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba paw , pynlang ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .
translation.en: For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .

translation.kha: Nangta U Moses u kyrpad , Sngewbha shah ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jrong me .
translation.en: And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta , hangta ha khmat jong phi nga bret ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .

Kane ka Long namar ki Aaron bad ki mawbah kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na ibieit . Pyndep , ki la siew pisa sha u Bakhlem ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla long ïa ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .
translation.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .

translation.kha: Hynrei dei tang uwei nabar hajuh hi U Mynsiem uba leh ïa kane baroh ; ha ka moi jong u , u ai ïa ka jingai bapher ha uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit , dividing to every man severally as he will .

translation.kha: Te kin longsyiem ki brisoh jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jngai ki .
translation.en: And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sawphew khyndew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Simri u la synran hynñiew sngi ha Tirsah ïa ka Israel . Ki shipai Israel ki kerkut ïa ka nongbah Bethmeon ha Philistia ,
translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah . And the people were encamped against Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines .
Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .
translation.kha: To ai khublei ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong U Blei kiba ha U Khrist Jisu . Ki parabangeit hangne lem bad nga ki phah sha phi ki jingkhublei jong ki .
Naba uno uno umbiah ïohpdiang ïa ka jingthiah ïa kaweh U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam Jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jrong u .
translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .

translation.kha: To shahjop mynta ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad ïa ki jingduwai jongno baroh kiwei pat ki shakri jong me kiba kwah ban ai ïa me ka burom . Ai ïa ka jingjop mynta ka sngi badno pynlong ba u patsha un leh-isynei ïa nga . Ha kita ki sngi nga la long u nongrah waiñ jong u patsha .
translation.en: O Lord , I beseech thee , let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant , and to the prayer of thy servants , who desire to fear thy name : and prosper , I pray thee , thy servant this day , and grant him mercy in the sight of this man . For I was the king s cupbearer .
Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka pop jong nga bad duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban shim noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei na nga .
Yn ym don nongkhaïi ki ïa-ban im haduh shun ïor biang ïa kaei kaba ki la duh , namarba ka jingbitar U Blei ka longkmie ba-halor baroh . Kito ibha bymman kin ym lait im .
translation.en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold , although they were yet alive : for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof , which shall not return  ; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .
And Manoah arose , and went after his wife , and came to the man , and said unto him , Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: U Manoah u ïeng joit bad u bud ïa la ka tnga . U leit sha uta u briew bad u kylli ,  Dei ma phi mo u briew uba la ïakren bad ka tnga jong nga ?   Ho-oid ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki sdang ban mih , ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw ka la wan hap ha ki briew kiba don ha ki shnong ba-marjan , bad kim shym la beh satia ïa ki .

Katba ki dang ïadih , u Belshassar u la ai hukum ban khulom ha ki khuri ksiar bad rupa bad ha ki pliang kiba u Nebukhadnessar u kpa jong u , u la rahah noh na ka Templ kaba ha Jerahmeel . U syiem u la phah shim ïa ki khnang ba ma u , ki rangbah donburom Jong u , ki tnga jyllang u , bad ki tnen kliar jong u ki lah ngab dih na ki .
translation.en: Belshazzar , whiles he tasted the wine , commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem  ; that the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , might drink therein .

So he came to the king . And the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? And he answered him , Go , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Haba u wan mih ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Khie tur ïaleh !  u Mikaïah u jubab .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you , and suffer you ? Bring thy son hither .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno phi ki briew phi long ki bymngeit bad bakla ! Sa katno nga dei ban sah bad phi ? Sa katno nga dei ban don bad phi ?  Nangta u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Wallam ïa u khun jong me hangne .
U Jeshua u la ong ha ki , To sumar ; to phikir ïa lade byrsha ïa u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .

translation.kha: Ki don u syiem uba shihajar hajar jong ki , uba erlangthari u jin ibha khmih ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka longsem u Abaddon ; bad ha ka ktung Grik ka long u Apollyon ( kaba mut u Nongpynjot ) .
translation.en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , u la leit noh na kata ka jaka , sad bun ki briew ki la bud ïa u . U la pynkhiah ïa kito baroh bakha pang
translation.en: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all  ;
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .
translation.kha: Phan sa ïoh khun shynrang , bad phan khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , namar U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud sngew jynjar jong pha .
“Kane ka jingpynhun kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Persia ha ka sngi ba la bthuh na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi ka khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
translation.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .

translation.kha: Mynta to ïeng kjit kumne u nongbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli bakha nga kylli ïa me .
translation.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .

translation.kha: Namar ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dan ka para jong ki , ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la phai ktien ïa u Shekhem bad u Hamor u kpa jong u da ka buiñ shkor .
translation.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :

translation.kha: khnang ba ki brisoh jong u ktang kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jongno u bad ban bat ïa ki hukum jong u baroh . Ïoh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi kylluid , Hangno ka don ka ïong jong u biria bakhraw mynnin , u briew uba leh ïa kaba sngi ?
translation.en: For ye say , Where is the house of the prince ? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked ?

Then Amaziah separated them , to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again : wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah , and they returned home in great anger .
translation.kha: Kumta u Amasaïah u la phah noh ïa ki kynhun shipai ba la shim wai bad u ong ïa ki ban leit noh sha ïing . Ha kane ki la leit sha ïing , ki da bitar tyngeh ïa ki briew ka Judah .
Naba u Job u jaboh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then Job answered the  Lord  , and said ,

translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u , mem kren ei ei ha at ? To kynmaw , la don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phuh Sansannah ïa me .
translation.en: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?

translation.kha: Bad hangto at ai jingmut , ka long ba ka kham bol ïa phi ban pyndep mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la sawdong mano snem . Phi la long kiba nyngkong , ym tyngkan ban treh ïa ka kam , hynrei ban long ruh kiba la kloi ba-bang ar ïa ka .
translation.en: And herein I give my advice : for this is expedient for you , who have begun before , not only to do , but also to be forward a year ago .
For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
translation.kha: Naba u kpu ba U Blei u ai u long uta uba wan hiar na bneng bad uba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .
Um sheptieng ïahap u ïohpdiang ïa ka khur kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jong u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u shaniah ha U Trai .
translation.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .

And Solomon said , Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy , according as he walked before thee in truth , and in righteousness , and in uprightness of heart with thee  ; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness , that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne , as it is this day .
translation.kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Me la ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , u shakri jong me , bad u la long uba bha , uba ïaineh , bad uba hok ha ka jingïadei jong u bad me . Bad me la ïai bteng ban pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad baneh skhem da kaba ai ha u ïa u khun uba mynta u synshar ha ka jaka jong u .
Kumta u sahmiet ka Syria un kerkut ïa ka nongbah ba la ker kynriah bad kurup ïa ka . Ki shipai jong ka Ijipt kin ym ïaleh shuh ; waiñ kiba tbit tam na ki kin ym don ka jingkhlaiñ kaba bajngum .
translation.en: So the king of the north shall come , and cast up a mount , and take the most fenced cities : and the arms of the south shall not withstand , neither his chosen people , neither shall there be any strength to withstand .

translation.kha: Te u Joseph u ong ha la ki bymman , ?(Nga la jan ïap , hynrei U blang un ri un da ïa phi , bad un ïalam noh ïa phi na kane ka ri sha kata ka ri kaba u la kular shadem ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakeh .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
And Moses gat him into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .

Haba u Serubbabel u khun jongu u Shealtiel bad u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak ki la ïohsngew ïa ki shukor , ki shadong ban tat baklang ïa ka Templ ha Jeruel , bad ki ar lwet ki nongïathuh ki ïalap ïa ki .
translation.en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem : and with them were the prophets of God helping them .
Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .
translation.kha: U Petros u la khot sngewbha ïa kita ki rangbah shapoh bad u la kyrpad jur ïa ki ban sahmiet hangta . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki ; bad katto katne ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la ïasynran lem ïa u .

translation.en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongïaleh jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .
Haba U jongu u la rung ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah baroh khwai ka la khñiang jlang . Uei une ? ki briew ki la kylliang .
translation.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , nabar u kpa jngai u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tip kumno Ban thaw ïa kiwei kiei na ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , u maw bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei bad ki jaiñ babha jngai , sawbthuh , bad kba rong mata , badno ka linen . U eh ban Tertios ïa bun jait ki jingohdur bad u lah ban buhnud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ duli kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shuah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jong phi kiba tbit bad kito kiba la ter na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong phi .
translation.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun lumlang baroh kin don haneng bad ba ym pat pynlapmiet sharud ïa u maw ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .

translation.kha: Naba kumba ïa ka briew la Thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha na ka briew ; bad de U Blei uba pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . And the land had rest fourscore years .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel ki la jop ïa ki Moab , bad ka jingsuk ka la don ha ka ri haduh phraphew snem .
Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u bad ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem Halor ki Israel pynlang ki Judah . Lada kane nang pat biah , tun jingsan da la ai sha sa ar shah ïa me .
translation.en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .

The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien ki wan urlong shisha mar kumta hi . Ïa u Nebukhadnessar la beh noh na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad u la bam phlang kum u masi dab . Ka umjer ka la hap halor ka met jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrong kum ki sner jong ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki jrong kum ki tnaw jong ki sim .

translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :
translation.kha: Hynrei wat mynta ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kylla-kaba-mut da shisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew .
Ha kata ka por , uwei u briew na ka jait Lebi u shongkurim ïa ka khuid jong uwei u Libni bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u .
translation.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
Remember this , and shew yourselves men : bring it again to mind , O ye transgressors .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , phi ki nongpop ; pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .
U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u pynthylli ïa ngi — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: As for our redeemer , the  Lord  of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka ñiut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren shang kaei !
translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .
But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga namar jong phi bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang katta ! Wat kren ei ei shuh shaphang kata !
U Jisu u la bteng , ithuh ju don uno isangsot uba wallam ïa ka sharak bad bah ïa ka haw ka shang lane ha khrew jingïathuh ? Hato um buh ïa ka ha u diengpynïeng sharati ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel , or under a bed ? and not to be set on a candlestick ?
Stop tickling me !
translation.kha: Sangeh pynsmieij ianga .

Ha khmih , u nongkyllan u wanpaw halor ki lumlang lem badno ka khubor kaba bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jongngi phi bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kaba ph la kular kyntur ha u . U bymman da laiñ lah ruh un ym hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jyllang phira . La pynjot tliw ïa ki baroh !
translation.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .

translation.kha: Haba u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynruh ïa ka jutang baïaineh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kam jong u Rehoboam Naduh Kaba sawdong haduh kabu kut bad ki jinglum jingthoh ïa ka longïing jong u la buh jingïathuh ha Ka Histori Jong u Shemaïah u Nongïathuhlypa bad ha Ka Histori jrong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa . U Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ki ïai ïaleh thma wai ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam , first and last , are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet , and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies ? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Tharai u la sdang ban pynrit ïa ka jingneh jong ka ri Israel . U Hasiel u syiem ka Syria u la iitkhmat ïa baroh ka ri Israel kaba shat mihngi jong ka Jordan
translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to cut Israel short : and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel  ;
My soul melteth for heaviness : strengthen thou me according unto thy word .
translation.kha: La ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewsih ; to pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , kumba me la kular .

translation.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
translation.kha: U briew uba bieit mutlop tam u kham bha ban ïa uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba stad haba um long kumta .

Ym don kawei paw ka jingbhabriew ha ka pyrthuh kaba kum ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait im na ka jingkynmaw ban pynlong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiei kiba khraw bun kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng satlak ka pyrthei . Me la bhah noh ïa kiwei patan ki jingriewblei bad ïa ki blei jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la ïapyllait na Ijipt ban long ki jong me hi .
translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?

translation.kha: Nangta halor u Lum Seïon bad halor baroh kiba la ïailong Haneng , U Trai un phiah ïa u lyoh ha ka por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka tyllep dang baphyrnai ha ka por mynmiet . Ka brup U Blei kuna tap bad da ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .

translation.kha: Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangïapom balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa uwei i dkoh ka jar .
translation.en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .

translation.kha: Ym don me mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sngi lane ban siew kylliang ïa u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la imat .
translation.en: Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?

They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki lumbah ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingiwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong bad kiba ïar namar ka jingkahtngen jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat !  Kaba mih nangta , ki khun kynthei jong phi ki ïaleh nuti , bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong phi ki ïaklim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent thee on a journey , and said , Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they be consumed .
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa phi lem bad ka hukum , ban pynjot ïa ki Amalek , ki briew bymman . U la ong ïa phi ban ïaleh haduh ba phin da pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And I wept much , because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book , neither to look thereon .
translation.kha: Nga la ïamkthang namar ym shym lah ban shem ïa uno uno uba dei hok ban plied ïa ka kot kli lane ban khmih shapoh jong ka .

Ha ka ih Jordan ka kynthup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Saphon , kaba praw na ka Hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ki ka dei ka kwah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka phang bashatei .
translation.en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .

translation.kha: Da u saiwul uba jngum , kiba bthuh , bad uba rong saw , ki khuid ïa ki jaiñphong kiba iohnong ba ki lyngdoh ki dih baneh kup lehbha ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang . Ki suh ïa Kinah ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Mushi .
translation.en: And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Haba u wan mih ha khmat u syep Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u , Mikaïah , katto u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga Ngin sien ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ? Khie tam ïaleh ! u Mikhael u jubab . Da shisha phiah jop . U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: So he came to the king . And the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? And he answered him , Go , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
And Jacob said unto Joseph , God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan , and blessed me ,
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la wan mihpaw ha nga ha Lus ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la kyrkhu ïa nga .

translation.en: And their eyes were opened  ; and Jesus straitly charged them , saying ,  See that no man know it .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingïohi jong ki la pynïoh pat . U Jisu u la maham jur ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh ïa kane hano hano ruh !

translation.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Hynrei mano mano ba leh pop khnang , la ki dei ki traishnong ne ki nongwei , ki long kiba la rem ba kim ñiewkor ïa U  Trai  , bad ki dei ban shah pynïap ,

translation.en: Owe no man any thing , but to love one another : for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law .
translation.kha: To long kiba laitluid na ka jingshah teh na uno uno — ka jingteh kaba phi dei ban shah , ka long tang ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei . Uno uno uba leh ïa kane , u la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum .
Phi don shait ?
translation.en: Where are you ?

translation.kha: U ong ha u Samson , Ngam nang pyrkhat ba me isih ïa ka , te kumta nga la ai noh ïa ka ha u Paralok jngai me . Hynrei kam pher , ka para jong ka , ka kham pynbhabriew ban ïa ka . Me lah ban shim noh da ka .
translation.en: And her father said , I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her  ; therefore I gave her to thy companion : is not her younger sister fairer than she ? take her , I pray thee , instead of her .
Jesus saith unto her ,  I that speak unto thee am he .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Dei ma nga , ma nga keiñ uba ïakren bad pha .
Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .

translation.kha: To phah ïa u paidbah ban lute ïa ki ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong ïa ki ban kyang ha ka jingshyrkhei . Ki la tynneng ka thwet na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ban pynngat ïa nga .
translation.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .
And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Hearken unto their voice , and make them a king . And Samuel said unto the men of Israel , Go ye every man unto his city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , bad ai syiem noh ïa ki .  Nangta u Samuel u ong ïa ki rangbah Israel baroh ban leit phai sha la ïing .
Ma ngi pynban , i long ki traishnong jong ka bneng , bad ngi ïa-ïap hir hir ïa U Nongpynim , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ban wan na bneng .
translation.en: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
Judah mourneth , and the gates thereof languish  ; they are black unto the ground  ; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up .
translation.kha: Ka Judah ka don ha ka jingïambriew ; ki nongbah jong ka ki la jan ïap , ki briew jong ka ki thiah ha madan ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ka Jerusalem ka kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression , and take away mine iniquity ? for now shall I sleep in the dust  ; and thou shalt seek me in the morning , but I shall not be .
translation.kha: Mem lah ban map da lei lei ïa ki pop jong nga ? Hato mem lah ban map ïa ka jingbymdei ba nga leh ? Shen , ngan sa don ha la ka jingtep bad ngan ym don shuh haba men khmih ïa nga .
Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki liewlep bajrong , bad ki phyllung ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .
translation.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .

translation.kha: Ki law lyngngeit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nongap ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei kylleng ki ïathuh lorni Shaphang ka pan jong ka .
translation.en: These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
And it came to pass , as he sat at the table with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .
translation.kha: U la shong bam bad ki , u la shim ïa u kpu , bad u la duwai ; nangta u la kdiah ïa u kpu bad u la ai ïa u ha ki .
Phi sngewsarong ba phira don ka Hukum U Blei — hynrei hato phira wallam ka jinglehrain ïa U Blei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ka law jong u ?
translation.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
After him repaired their brethren , Bavai the son of Henadad , the ruler of the half part of Keilah .
translation.kha: U Babbai , u khun jong u Henadad , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat ka shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;
U Elisha u pan khyndiat u purew , u bor ïa u ha uta u khiew , bad u ong , To theh khnam bun ka syrwa na ka bna jrong ki . Bad kam shym don kano kano kaba sner ha ka .
translation.en: But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki i bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam ïa ki da kiwei pat . Kim thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad leh sngewbiang ha ka waiñ — yn ym ieh ïa ka da kiwei pat .
translation.en: And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .

When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies , and seest horses , and chariots , and a people more than thou , be not afraid of them : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Haba phi leit ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad phi ïohi ba ki kali ïaleh thma , ki kulai , bad ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki jong phi , wat sheptieng ïa ki . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt , un don ryngkat bad phi .
Kumta u ïeng ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta , Kut uba don ha ka liang jong U Trai , wang shane ! Kumta baroh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,
translation.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .

translation.kha: Wat ïaheh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ha Gath shaphang ka jingshahjop jong ngi ; wat ai ba ktang ïohi ba phi ïam . Ko ki briew ka beit Leaphrah , pyn-i ïa ka jinglyng-a Jong phi da kaba kyrsum ha u pui pui !
translation.en: Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .

translation.kha: Hadien u Elon , u Abdon u khup jong u Hanniel babha na Pirathon u ïalaw ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel , a Pirathonite , judged Israel .

translation.kha: Hangta U Josis u leit ibiang shuh Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u pynbah synshar ka sorkar u la don hangta uba u khum jong u , u la pang , ha Kapernam .
translation.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine . And there was a certain nobleman , whose son was sick at Capernaum .

translation.kha: Ka wan da ka bus mynnin .
translation.en: She came by bus yesterday .
Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u angel uba hynriew ,  To pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !
Haba kin ïap , kin leit phai bapaw shaw ka khynraw ; ha kata ka sngi baroh ki jingthmu jong ki kin sa kut noh .
translation.en: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .

translation.kha: Ki la nang longing na Perga bad ki la iar ha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la leit shat ka synagog bad ki la shong .
translation.en: But when they departed from Perga , they came to Antioch in Pisidia , and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and sat down .

translation.kha: U Eser u long u riewstad uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ka Hukum kaba U thri U Blei ki Ishmael u la ai ha u Moses . Namar ba u Esra u don ïa ka jingkyrkhu U Trai U Balei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u pan . Ha ka snoh kaba hynñiew jong ka jingkyrshan u Artakserksis , u Eser u la mih na Babilonia ban leit shaei Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki Israel kiba kynthup ïa ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem ka Templ , ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ki nongphetwir .
translation.en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .

translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shajrong jong u ki leh ïa kata baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Ang bad ïoh bynta lang bad ngi , sad ngin ïasam ïa kaba im ïoh lute .
translation.en: Cast in thy lot among us  ; let us all have one purse :

translation.kha: Uto u samla , uba kup tang da ka jaiñ lieng , u brup ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body  ; and the young men laid hold on him :

translation.kha: Hynrei lehbha kata ka prum ka la ngim bad ka la kliar lieh biang , uta u briew u dei shun leit shuh u lyngdoh , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa u .
translation.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;

translation.kha: Nalor jong ka Hebron ( kawei na ki nongbud jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Haran u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,
translation.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
Now Peter sat without in the palace : and a damsel came unto him , saying , Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang shong habar ha ka phyllaw mynba kawei na ki shakri kynthei jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh ka la wan sha u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me long bad U Jisu u nong Galilaïa .
phin la ïohi ïa baroh ka U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ha Kine ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta jong phi . U thri U Blei jong phi u la ïabah na ka bynta jong pa .
translation.en: And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .

translation.kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaweh phah ïa ka jingpang bad pynïap ïa ka met jongngi u da ka jingshitom .
translation.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :
And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga ,  Hato mem tip ?   Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .

translation.en: For from Israel was it also : the workman made it  ; therefore it is not God : but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces .
translation.kha: U nongsaiñdur na Israel uba la thaw ïa u bleithaw , bad um dei satia u blei ! Ïa u khun masi ksiar ba mane ha Samaria yn sa pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai .
Kawei pat ki ong , Ngi la bynda ïa ki pynthor nabar ki bri sohwaiñ Bad ki ïing jong ngi ba ïoh kew uba biang ban lait na ka jingshahthngan .
translation.en: Some also there were that said , We have mortgaged our lands , vineyards , and houses , that we might buy corn , because of the dearth .

translation.kha: ( U la pyrkhat ba ki briew jong u kin shemphang ba U Blei un sa pyndonkam ïa u ban pyllaitluid ïa ki , hynrei ktem smam shemphang . )
translation.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .

translation.kha: U Blang u wan ha u Balaam , pynlang u ong , Kiei kine ki briew’ kiba shimet bad me ?
translation.en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Hynrei phi la thait ïa nga , ko Israel ; phim shym la ma ïa nga .
translation.en: But thou hast not called upon me , O Jacob  ; but thou hast been weary of me , O Israel .

translation.kha: U Bengeber : ka nongbah Hammoth ha Gilead , bad ki sneng ha Gilead kiba dei jongnga ki kur u Jair , uba ïapthngan na u Manasseh , bad ka thain Argob ha Bashan , baroh hynriewphew thyllah ki shnong kiba Heh , kiba la per da ki kynroh bad ki nar rnong ha ki kyrdoh
translation.en: The son of Geber , in Ramoth–gilead  ; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead  ; to him also pertained the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars :

translation.kha: Phi shisha Phi la thmu snem ïa nga , hynrei U Blei u la pynphai ïa kata sha kaba bakha , khnang ba bun ki briew kiba ding im mynta kin ïoh im namar kaba la jat .
translation.en: But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .

translation.kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai jngai ka bneng malu Phi la wallam shapoh ïa ki kyrni bad ïa ki pliang kiba la shim na ka Templ jyllang u . Ma pa’ , ki rangbah donburom jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki tnat kliar jong phi ki la ieh waiñ na ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki blei naba la shna da ka ksiar , ka mata , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng , bad u maw — ki blem ki bymïap lah ban ïohi lin ïohsngew bad ba kim lah ban tip ei ei . Hynrei phim Shim la pyndonburom ïa U Blei uba rai la phin im ne phin ïap bad uba synshar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh .
translation.en: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :
For at the window of my house I looked through my casement ,
translation.kha: Shisien katba nga dang peit shabar ka jingkhangïit ka ïing jong nga ,
Te U Trai u la Hukum ïa u dohkha ban prie noh ïa u Jonah harud duriaw , bad u la leh kumta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .

translation.kha: To wan ! la jubab U Jingsuk . Kumta u Petros u la hiar na ka lieng bad u la sdang ban ïaid halor ka um sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And he said ,  Come .  And when Peter was come down out of the ship , he walked on the water , to go to Jesus .
Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor , he also shall cry himself , but shall not be heard .
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ka jingud kiba duk , ïa ka jingkyang jingïarap jong phi hi yn ym don ba ïohsngew .
Suk uta u briew uba long Stad — kaba ïew ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .
Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don khyndiat , kaba la kamai da ka hok , ban ïa kaba ïoh shibun , ba la lum da ka jingbymhok .
Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynna yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka barhem yn pynjot .
translation.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Khie leit sha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingkheiñ ïa ka pisa ba ki lyngdoh babha treikam ha ka khyrdop jong ka Templ ba ki la ïor na ki briew .
translation.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the  Lord  , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :

translation.kha: Hobab ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki la jingïalumlang ha mihpat , ine ki san ngut ki shym Philistia ki otsher kiew bad la ki bri ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , bad ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kata bad ki la ïasheptieng ,
translation.en: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . And when the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you  ;
And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u jubab ,  Duwai na ka bynta jong nga la shai .  U Moses u ong ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong , ba phin ïoh tip ba ym don mano mano ruh uba kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

Haba uno uno u kñia ïa ka jingtah pynïashong sha U Trai , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh kam dei ban don kano kano ka jingduna khnai ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka .
translation.en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  to accomplish his vow , or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep , it shall be perfect to be accepted  ; there shall be no blemish therein .

translation.kha: Henadad ka jingïarap u Ahab u syiem Israel , ka ri Moab ka la ïaleh byrsha ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .

translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban ïalum ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u kein ha ïing lem bad katto katne ngut ki bymman ki san kiba dang wan jngut ïa u . Shuah ba u nongkren jong u syiem un poi , u Elisha u ino ha kita ki thymmai ki san , Uto u nongpynïap u la phan briew ban pynpaw ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shuh ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wei nadien jong u .
translation.en: But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?

translation.kha: U la buh ïa la ka kad halor jong ka , bad kumta hi ka la pynpeit ïa la ka met bad ka la ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And he laid his hands on her : and immediately she was made straight , and glorified God .

Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with . In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness  ; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .
translation.kha: Khmih shatei halor ki kliar lum . Hato don kano kano ka jaka ha kaba pham shym la leh kum ka nuti ? Pha la ap ïa ki nongleh-ieit shi lynter ka rud surok , kumba u Arab u apthap ha ka ri shyiap . Pha la pyntngit ïa ka ri da ka jingleh nuti jong pha .

Hynrei mem shym la thwet ïa ki tad angnud nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki da lade hi . Hynrei ngam shym la ïohsngew wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad ka sawspah jong phi ki long Kiba khriat sbun eh ban ïa katei kaba la ïathuh ha nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam jong nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  ka long ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga bad ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba u la ai ha nga ban leh .
Bad kumta ka ktien U Blei ka la ïai shaphang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka la nang kiew bad kad kiew , mala bun bah ki Lyngdoh ki la pyndeng ïa ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .

translation.kha: Wat ym sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Hangne u syiem jong phah u wanlam , u da shong halor u khur kada .
translation.en: Fear not , daughter of Sion : behold , thy King cometh , sitting on an ass s colt .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa ka durkhmat jong nga . Pynngam shukor .
translation.en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .
Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .
translation.kha: Hynrei tang ka jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit kaba lah ban beh noh shabar ïa une u jait ; ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba lah .

translation.en: But Israel shall be saved in the  Lord  with an everlasting salvation : ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel la pynim da U  Trai  , bad ka jingjop jong u ka neh junom ; ki briew jong ka kin ym jahburom .’

translation.en: Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , bad pynjot lut khoit kat kaba ki don . Wat pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynïap lut ïa ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi bad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kada baroh .

U Sedekaïah u la khong arphew iwei snem ka ita mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la shihajar khatwei snep ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hammath , ka khum jongngi u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
translation.en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoram lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la mih bad ki kada ïapom bun ki hiarthma ïa ka Edom . Hangta ka kynhun shipai jngai ki Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki , hynrei ha ka por mynmiet ki la ïohlad ban mian shabar bad lait phet .
translation.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him : and he rose up by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Joab , kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh ka longkmie ban ngeit ha uta ïa umbiah u la phah .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .

translation.kha: Namar kane , kiba bun na ki nongbam jrong U Jisu ki la phai dien noh bad kim leit shuh mala u .
translation.en: From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki mynsngi ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka jaka kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khet Ka Armageddon .
translation.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .
And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sdang ïa ka ding ha ka ri u Magog bad ha baroh shi lynter ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki briew ki shong khlem jingpynwit bad uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .
‘ wiat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , ibha nga U Trai U Blei jrong phi ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain : for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong phi kin lah ban ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , ki ban ïalam ïa ki ban ym ïaineh shuh ha nga bad ban mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient , and rebelled against thee , and cast thy law behind their backs , and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee , and they wrought great provocations .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong me ki ïaleh pyrshah bad leh bymkohnguh ïa me ; ki phai dien noh na ka Hukum jong me . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba maham ïa ki ,

translation.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you , nor persuade you on this manner , neither yet believe him : for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand , and out of the hand of my fathers : how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynta wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi lane ïalam bakla ïa phi kumta . Wat ngeit ïa u ! Ym don blei jong kano kano ka hima uba la lah ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na uno uno u patsha ka Assyria . Kumta da kaba thikna une U Blei jong phi un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi !
Da la ka kti hi per thoh ïa kane : Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .
translation.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynhyndai ki long ki jong ngi !’

translation.en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .
translation.kha: U Issakhar u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .

translation.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .
translation.kha: Ki bania bad ki nongkhaïi , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba kut eh , na ka kamra ha ka dong haduh ka Khyrdop Langbrot .

Ka jingngeit ka ni bymjukut . Ki kein ki khlur da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem , hynrei ki long Teng Shipai ; ki don ki jingai shun Kren ha ki thylliej bapher , hynrei kin dam noh ; ka don ka jingtip , hynrei kan sa jah napoh .
translation.en: Charity never faileth : but whether there be prophecies , they shall fail ; whether there be tongues , they shall cease ; whether there be knowledge , it shall vanish away .

translation.kha: Kum ka dak jong kata ka jutang baïaineh junom ïa kaba to la pynlong bad phi lem bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , nga buh ïa ka ryntieh jongki nga ha u lyoh .
translation.en: And God said , This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you , for perpetual generations :

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Mynta nga pynlong ka jutang sad ki paid Israel . Ha Khmut jong ki ngan leh ïa kiei kaei kiba khraw , ïa kiba ym pat ju leh mynnor mihnoh ha ka pyrthei pangnud kano kano ka jaitbynriew . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïew ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba ma nga , U Trai at lah ba-bang leh , namar ngan leh ïa kaei kaei ka khraw na ka byndi jong phi .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I make a covenant : before all thy people I will do marvels , such as have not been done in all the earth , nor in any nation : and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the  Lord  : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee .
And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la ïohkhiah , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah bad u la sdang ban ïaid .

translation.en: And the families of the children of Kohath , the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath , even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .
By telling her lies , he got her to disobey God .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka ban saitlah ïa U Blei da ki ktien lamler jong u .
