translation.en: How Do the Elders Serve the Congregation ?

And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da kaba buh ha ki reng jong ka baroh saw tylli ïa ka snam jong ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ban leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki por baroh ki ban wan . Kane ka duwan ka dei ban long kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , U  Trai .
Hynrei em , ha ka jingshisha , phi la ïohi hi da lade ; te kumta balei ba phi kren ïa kamon kata ka jingkren bieit ?
translation.en: Behold , all ye yourselves have seen it  ; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?

translation.kha: Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka phah ktien sha u Daberath ban ïathaw ïa u .
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .
As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .
To ïa-rai , ko ki bneng ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen , ko ka pyrthei ! To ai ba ki lumbah kin win ha ka jingrwai ! U Trai un pyntngen ïa la ki briew ; un don jingisynei ha ki briew jong u kiba jynjar .
translation.en: Sing , O heavens  ; and be joyful , O earth  ; and break forth into singing , O mountains : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , and will have mercy upon his afflicted .
As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la bynta ïa ka ri kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad khatduh ïa kata baroh kawei la tan pat sha bneng .

translation.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Paul u la mihnoh na Athens bad u la leit sha Korinth .
Haba u ïabah pynïaidkam u la iohsngew shaphang U Jisu , u la phah katto katne jrut ki tymmen ki syn jongngi ki Jiw baneh kyrpad ïa U Josis don Wan bad pynkhiah ïa u shakri jong u .
translation.en: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeroham , me ïohi aïu ? Nga jingbabe , Ki soh dumok . Kiwei kiba bha ki da bha shisha , dara kiwei kiba sniew ki da sniew shisha , haduh ba ym long bam shuh .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , What seest thou , Jeremiah ? And I said , Figs  ; the good figs , very good  ; and the evil , very evil , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .

translation.kha: Katno tylli u kpu phi don ? U Jisu u la kylli . Hynñiew tylli ki kpu , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he asked them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven .
And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïeng hangta ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Kumta kiwei pat ki la ong ha u ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong uta u briew ?  Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata .  Em , ngam dei ,  u la ong .
Me la hikai ïa at naduh ba nga tang samla , bad nga dang ïai ïathuh ïa ki kur uba phyllung jong me .
translation.en: O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u ïap ha Ijipt haba u la dap shispah shiphew sniew ka rta . Ki kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met jong u , bun hangta ha Ijipt ki buh ïa u ha ka synduk ïapbriew .
translation.en: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ha kine ki thait bad Namarba ba nga la ju kajuh la bun snem ban wanlam khmih ïa phi , nga kyrmen ban leh kumno mynta .
translation.en: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khubor sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pynbna ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Wat buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiat ! Ïa ki lynthaw jong bamaïan la nguh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !
translation.en: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .

And it shall be , when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down  ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
translation.kha: Da pynthikna bha ha-ei u thiah , bad hadien ba u la ïohthiah , leit bad khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad thiah ha ki kjat jong u . Un sa ïathuh ïa phi kaei ba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin sngewkhuslai wat hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin set ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
Hynrei phi la ïateh pyrshah ïa ka sah” U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad Phim treh ban leit rung sha kata ka ri .
translation.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God :
And Abram said , Lord  God  , what wilt thou give me , seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abram u ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , kan myntoi aïu ka bainong jong me ïa nga haba ngam don khun ? U nongïoh pateng jong nga u dei tang u Eliesar uba na Damaskos .

Hodaïah kata U Jisu u leit bam ha ka ïeng u Lebi . Don bun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait na ka imlang ka sliang kiba ïabud ïa U Jisu , mala bun na ki , ki la ïadon bynta bad u lem bad ki synrang jongu u ha ka miej bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , phi ki shakri jong U Trai ,
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the name of the  Lord   ; praise him , O ye servants of the  Lord .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba u syiem Jehoïakim u la leh .
Baroh kiei Kiei kiba u Amon u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Politics Jong Ki Shimiet Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.en: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , which is not betrothed , and lay hold on her , and lie with her , and they be found  ;

translation.en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .
A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
translation.kha: Lada don uno uno uba bitar shen , to ai ba un shim ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . Lada phi pyllait ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap leh biang .
U buhrieh ïa u bneng bapyllun hadien ki lyoh .
translation.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it .

translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jehu u la pynsngap balang ïa ki Saddusi , ki la ïawan ,
translation.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .

translation.kha: To khmih naki na ka jaka shong bakynjah jong me ha bneng mala kyrhai ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud malu ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jongki me .’
translation.en: Look down from thy holy habitation , from heaven , and bless thy people Israel , and the land which thou hast given us , as thou swarest unto our fathers , a land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: bad ai ïa kata ka rupa ha u Aaron badno ki khun shynrang jongno u .
translation.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
translation.en: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
So when his fellowservants saw what was done , they were very sorry , and came and told unto their lord all that was done .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shakri ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , ki la sngewsih shikatdei eh , bad ki la leit sha u Syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaei baroh .

Phim dei ban ïathuh jutang bad ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Phi Dei ban pynpyiar ïa ki duwan jyllang ki .’ Hynñiew phim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa phi . Phi la leh pynban ïa kaba pyrshah !
translation.en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land  ; ye shall throw down their altars : but ye have not obeyed my voice : why have ye done this ?

translation.kha: Ki atiar kiba ki nongshong jong ki , ki rah ; ki sawa bad ki thaba ha ka sngi .
translation.en: The quiver rattleth against him , the glittering spear and the shield .
He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .
translation.kha: Ki shong jngai bah na ki nongbah kiba khynwin ; bad ym don ba lah ban pynjuh bad pyntreikam ïa ki .

translation.en: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa uta u khun bad ki la pynïap ïa u bad bret ïa ka met jong u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ .
Ka jingïaroh ïa umbah bieit kam longïng kaba dei , kum ka ïng ha ka por pyiar lane u slap ha ka aïom ot .
translation.en: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
My son , give me thine heart , and let thine eyes observe my ways .
translation.kha: Ko khun , to shahshkor bha , bad shah ba ka jingim jong nga kan long ka nuksa ïa phi .

Un thma khlem ka jingmaham ïa ka probins jyllang ka ri bariewspah Bad un leh ïa keiñ kiew kiba ym don na ki kpa tymmen jong u kiba la ju leh . Nangta un pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongbud jong u ïa ki mar ki nonglum bad ïa ki jingdeng jingtim kiba u la kurup ha ka thma . Un pyntong ki jingthmu ban tur ïabeh ïa ki khun , hynrei ka por jong u kan kut ei shen .
translation.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province  ; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done , nor his fathers  fathers  ; he shall scatter among them the prey , and spoil , and riches : yea , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds , even for a time .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa ruh kiba u syiemsad Benabinadab u la wallam Sha Babilon na ka Templ ha Jerusalem , dei ban pynphai pat shaw ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .

translation.kha: Wat pynbudnam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba sngur , ba nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi , ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jrong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain  ; for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .

translation.kha: To leit sha la ki para ri kba shah ringmraw bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki , la ki shahshkor ne kim shahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: And go , get thee to them of the captivity , unto the children of thy people , and speak unto them , and tell them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi tharai ba nga shukor — bad pa kharai ba ngam lah ban ïathuh ïa ka badei na ka bymdei .
translation.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?

translation.en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?

translation.kha: Hangne mynta sa kob ïa ka kynhied ïapom ki Israel . Nga kob ïa phi ba pher phah da uno uno ban ïaleh bad at !
translation.en: And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .
For I know that my redeemer liveth , and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth :
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip ba don ha bneng u ban wan ha kaba khatduh ban pynksan ïa nga .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la ïohsngew kumno U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki Israel , ka la sheptieng haduh katta katta .

translation.en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .

translation.en: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :

translation.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .

translation.kha: Hato men tei pang ïa ka ha ki lai snoh ? ki la kylli ïa u , Ka la shim por seraph hynriewphew snem ban tei ïa kan ka Templ !

U Simon Petros , uba kieng ïa ka waitlam , u la sei ïa ka bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u da mait ïa ka shkor kamon jong u . Ka kyrteng uta u mraw ka long u Kolhoseh .

translation.en: And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . translation.en: So Samuel called unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  sent thunder and rain that day : and all the people greatly feared the  Lord  and Samuel .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu ki la ïalam ïa u shat ka ïing jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kaba ki nongkhaïi ka Law bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïalumlang .
translation.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .
For by it the elders obtained a good report .
translation.kha: Ka dei da ka jingngeit jong ki , ba ki briew ha ki por mynbarim ki ïohpdiang ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei .
U Trai u ong ha u Aaron , Man ym ïoh ka jingdon jingem kumne ka jingïohpateng bad ym don kano kano ka bynta na ka ri Israel ban ai ha me . Tang ïa nga U Trai , me nongkam .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them : I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta ba ka jingkmen jong ngi sha phi kan ym khih lano lano ; ngi tip ba kumba phi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingshahshitom jong ngi , kumjuh ruh phin ïoh bniat lam na kata ka jingïarap kaba ngi ïohpdiang .
translation.en: And our hope of you is stedfast , knowing , that as ye are partakers of the sufferings , so shall ye be also of the consolation .

translation.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah .

translation.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .

translation.en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .

translation.en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me  ; and , behold , he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth  ; and , lo , it was the latter growth after the king s mowings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka nga la ïohi ïa u ba u pynmih shi kynhun ki puit tang hadien ba la ot noh ïa u skum uba long ka bynta u syiem bad u phlang u la sdang ban mih biang .

translation.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lyer ka beh kat sha kaba ka mon ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba ka pynmih , hynrei mem tip nangno ba ka wan lane shaei ba ka leit . Ka long kumta ïa uwei pa uwei ïa uba la kha na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: The posts went out , being hastened by the king s commandment , and the decree was given in Shushan the palace . And the king and Haman sat down to drink  ; but the city Shushan was perplexed .

translation.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and , behold , the Egyptians marched after them  ; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the  Lord .

U Trai u ong , To rwai da ka jingkmen na ka bniat ki Israel , kiba khraw kuna na ki jaitbynriew . To ri ïa ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh jong phi , ‘ U Trai u la pynim ïa la ki bynriew ; u la pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Balaam u ong ha u Barak , Ïeng hangne hadien ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga pat ngan leit peit la U Trai un ïakhun ne em ïa nga . Ngan sa ïathuh ha phi kat ïa kambah u pynpaw ha nga . Kumta u la leit marwei sha kliar jongno uwei u lumlang ,
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the  Lord  will come to meet me : and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee . And he went to an high place .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ngan pynïapmat ïa Aner ki Lebi , jingset bad ïa eit kiba na ki paidbah Israel , kiba la hynne ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehosheba u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u kpa jong u , Ngam dih ban leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba ki hynmen ki para jong la bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem i pa kiba shong ha Kanaan ki la wan poi sha nga .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;
And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba  ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa kane , ïa ka Hebron la khot ka nongbah jong U Arba . ( U Arba u la long uba khraw tam napdeng ki Anakim ) . Mynta ka don ka jingsuk ha ka ri .
Haba u Isaïah u ïohpdiang ïa ka shukor jong u syiem Hesekaïah , u phah pat ïa khnai ka jubab :
translation.en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah .
He was a mighty hunter before the  Lord  : wherefore it is said , Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da ka jingïarap U  Trai  u la long u nongbeh mrad uba khraw ; ba kumta sa mih ka jingong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynlong ïa me u nongbeh mrad uba khraw kat u Nimrod .

translation.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart  ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba phra , ka sngi kaba u hi u la buh , u leit sha Bethel bad u kñia ka jingainguh ha ka duwan ban rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam ba u la seng na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :
translation.kha: Don saw jait ki mrad kiba rit ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kiba sian shikatdei eh :

translation.en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba nga pynshitom ïa ka Ijipt ha kane ka rukom , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
U la pynjynjar ïa ki symboh bakhrawbor na ki khet jong ki , bad u la kyntiew hajrong ïa kiba rangli .
translation.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .

translation.kha: A Trai , hato me la kyntait ïa ka Judah nadong shadong ? Hato me isih ïa ki briew jong ka Seir ? Balei ba me la pynmong jur ïa ngi ba ngim lah ban koit ? Ngi la wad ïa ka jingit , isynei ym don kano kano jingbha kaba la jhieh , im’ la kyrdem ïa ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei ka wan pynban ka jingshyrkhei .
translation.en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ? hath thy soul lothed Zion ? why hast thou smitten us , and there is no healing for us ? we looked for peace , and there is no good  ; and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !
Did I say , Bring unto me ? or , Give a reward for me of your substance ?
translation.kha: Hato nga la pan na phi ban ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha lane ban tyrwa ei ei ïano ïano na ka bynta jong nga

translation.en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong : “U Blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei baroh ba u la thaw , ha khmih ruh , ka la bha eh .”
U Tlai u la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap , u la pynsangeh ïa ki ummat jrong nga , bad u la sumar ïa nga na ka jingshahjop .
translation.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .

translation.kha: bad ngan pynsamthiah ïa ki . Ki lah lait na kawei ka ding , hynrei mynta ka thiang Kan thang Khot ïa ki . Haba nga pynbudnam ïa ki , phin tip ba de lama U Trai .
translation.en: And I will set my face against them  ; they shall go out from one fire , and another fire shall devour them  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I set my face against them .

translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jongno ki bad un pynstet ïa ki namar ki nongpop jong ki ; U TRAI’ U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .

translation.kha: Ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha ki , bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: And they went , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .

translation.kha: Sa kawei pat ka Khubor ka la wanrah ha nga na U Trai .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .
translation.kha: Bad da kumta u Saul , ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut , bad uta u samla , ki la ïap ; baroh ki briew jong u Saul ki ïap ryngkat ha kajuh ka sngi .
Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ki brisoh jong ka Judah pynlang ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Wat ym smai da ka khlieh jngai phi! , naba phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynsting ïa iwei i shñiuh .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , nguh u Stad pynkhriat , nga la shem ïa ken pynïadait pa pynïadait katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .
translation.en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :

translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh u la jingjubab Ngan , Ngin ai ïa kaei kiei baroh kaba U Trai u la kren , bad u Maaseïah u la leit ïathuh ïa kane ha U Trai .
translation.en: And all the people answered together , and said , All that the  Lord  hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom lad ngi , namar ngi tip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,
translation.en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;

translation.kha: Wat haba la pynshitom , ym shem la pynïap ; wat haba la pynsngewsih , ngi longïing Badonbor kiba ken ; ngi paw kum kiba duk , hynmen ngi pynriewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun ; ngi paw kum ki bym don ei ei , pynbna moi don lut ïa kiei kiei Baroh .
translation.en: As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u don ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem , u la leit na ka pud hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .
translation.kha: Pynban , men leit sha ki briew u kpa jong nga , bad sha ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad jied ka tnga na ka bynta jong u .’

translation.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .
translation.kha: Ka jingpyrkhat ïa ka jingpang jong nga , ka jingbymdon ïing jong nga , ka long ka bih bakthang .

Ki lyngkot ïaid ba ki bud kin long kaba bthei nabar kiba dum ; kan pynlong ïa ki ba kin jynthut bad kin kyllon . Ngan wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki ; ka por ka jingpynmihpat ïa ki ka la nang wan , ma nga , U Troas , nga la kren .
translation.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
This is the portion of a wicked man from God , and the heritage appointed unto him by God .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar ba U Blei u la buh bynta ïa ki .
U la leh ïa kane ban pynkhih ïa ki briew jong U Bel baroh na ka bniat ka kam jong ka jingshakri ba kynja mynsiem , khring baneh te ïa ka met U Khrist .
translation.en: For the perfecting of the saints , for the work of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :

translation.kha: Kumta u Lot u jied ïa ka them Jordan baroh na ka bynta ïa lade bad u leit noh shaphang mihngi . Da kumta kheiñ kine ar ngut ki la ïakhlad .
translation.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan  ; and Lot journeyed east : and they separated themselves the one from the other .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati bad ïa baroh ki nongbud ïa kiba u la tei , la shuh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jongngi Ki Syiem Ka Israel
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
If thieves came to thee , if robbers by night , ( how art thou cut off ! ) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee , would they not leave some grapes ?
translation.kha: Haba ki nongtuh ki wan mynmiet , ki rah tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah . Haba ki briew ki lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , borabor ki pynsah khyrdong khyndiat . Hynrei ki nongshun jong pha ki la pyndam noh khoit ïa pha .
Hynrei ki la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kynrad , u la don lypa shiphew tylli ki sbun ksah !’
translation.en: ( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )

translation.kha: Phi pynbunkam ïa ka bor jong phi bad ïa ka kyrdan jong pa’ ban shem noh ïa ka jaka baroh .
translation.en: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth  ; and the honourable man dwelt in it .
And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( kaba mut  ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah  ) , namar hangta ki la tep ïa ki briew kiba la kwah rhah ban bam doh .

Ladan phi sngewbiang , ko syiem , pynmih da ka sah” ba dei ban pynïap noh ïa ki . Lada phin leh kumin , la pynthikna ba ngan lah ban buh pyllait lai lakh sawphew khadar kilo ka phong sha ka jingtynjuh ka jingsngem na ka bynta ka jingpynïaid kam ha ka hima .
translation.en: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed : and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring it into the king s treasuries .

translation.kha: Kito uba la ieh ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia ïa uta u briew babha don ksuid , sad ïa kita ki sniang .
translation.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .
translation.kha: Long kiba sngewsynei kumba U Kpa jong phi u long uba sngewsynei .

translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , u phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei jong ngi ka neh bymjukut .
Ma phi hi pa long kata ka shithi ba ngi Don , ïa kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ngi khnang ba baroh kin thop sad kin pule .
translation.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts , known and read of all men :

translation.kha: Kito kiba ïapyrshang don buhrieh ïa ki jingthmu jong ki na U Trai , kyang jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh bad ki pynkut ba yn ym don ba ïohthiah ïa ki lane tip ïa kaei kambah ki leh .
translation.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?

translation.kha: kumba don uba la ong , ‘ Ha u ngi im , I khim bad ngi hir .’ Ka long kumba katto katne na ki myllung jong phi kiba la ong , ‘ Ngi ruh ngi long ki khun jong u .’
translation.en: For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehosheba u duwai ha U Trai , malade U thri , haba u ïohi kumno u syiem ka syriem u lehhok stai ïa ki Israel , u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translation.en: And Jehoahaz besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hearkened unto him : for he saw the oppression of Israel , because the king of Syria oppressed them .

translation.kha: Kito kiba shimti ha ki bleithaw jong ka Samaria , kiba ong , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Don ,’ lane , ‘ Da u bleithaw jong ki Beersheba ,’ — iba ki briew kin kyllon , malu kin ym khie patar .
translation.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , Thy god , O Dan , liveth  ; and , The manner of Beer–sheba liveth  ; even they shall fall , and never rise up again .
Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu saiñ na ka sisa bad ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Ka long kum ka shiteng na u kpa u bieit thep mynsiem sha la ki khun .
translation.en: It is like a letter from a loving father to his children .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon rijied lad nga ha ka jaka ryndang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum u Solomon ki la shtah ïa ki maw kiba heh itynnat na ka bynta ka nongrim jong ka Templ .
Ïa uba ar la kha da kaba u bapawkhmat triang ïa ka khongdong jait jong u Ita ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snieh ka ther mynnin la kha ïa ki .
translation.en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .
And I entreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .
translation.kha: Bad ïa phi ruh , ko paralok baïaineh jong nga , nga kwah ïa phi ban ïarap ïa kine ki kynthei ; naba ki la trei shitom lem bad nga ban pynsaphriang ïa ka gospel , ryngkat bad u Klemen , bad baroh kiwei pat ki para nongïatrei lem jong nga , kiba ki kyrteng jong ki , ki don ha ka kitab jong kiba im jong U Blei .
U syier u la phah sa uwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki Rangbah , kiba la leit khie dara ong ha u Eli , Ko briew’ jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban woh hiar shisyndon !
translation.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
And the man of God said unto the king , If thou wilt give me half thine house , I will not go in with thee , neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place :
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  Wat lada phi ai ïa nga shiteng na ka spah jong phi , ngan ym leit bad phi lane bam lane dih ei ei bad phi .

translation.en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .
translation.kha: namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba hok u ïarap ïa ki .

Ngin la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba ngi lah ngab ïohi ïa ka Sypros , bad nangta ngi la leit shaphang shathie jong ka sha Syria . Ngi la khar ryngkew ha Tyros , ha kaba ka lieng ka dang pynhiar ïa ka jingtip lad ka .
translation.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus , we left it on the left hand , and sailed into Syria , and landed at Tyre : for there the ship was to unlade her burden .

translation.kha: Lada phi bitar , wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong phi kad ïalam ïa Phi ban leh nongpop , wat pisa sah baroh shi sngi .
translation.en: Be ye angry , and sin not : let not the sun go down upon your wrath :

translation.kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jyllang ka . Phai noh lashai ka snoh bad leit sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang Jong ka khmut duriaw Akaba .
translation.en: ( Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley . ) To morrow turn you , and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .

translation.kha: lymda ka met jongki phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingïakhaïi , khlem kano kano ka bynta Jong ka ha kaba dum , kan longïng kaba phyrnai ha baroh , kum haba ka sharak ka tyndong ha phi da ka jingphyrnai jong ka .
translation.en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light , having no part dark , the whole shall be full of light , as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light .

translation.kha: U hukum ïa la ki rangbah syier ba-bang ïakren jar jar bad u Dabid bad ba-bang ïathuh ha u , U syiem u shem sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi ; mynta ka dei ka por kaba biang ba phiah shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u .
translation.en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie ha u syiem Moab , bad ki la sah klang katba u Dabid u dang rieh ha ka krem .
translation.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .
His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .
translation.kha: Um khuslai lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u ki shahjop .

translation.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh  ; and they shall be drunken with their own blood , as with sweet wine : and all flesh shall know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kiba banbeiñ ïa pha ban ïa-pynïap para ma ki ; kin shu buaid ha kaba pynïap briew bad ha ka jingbitar . Nangta u bynriew baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai  , uta uba pynim ïa pha bad uba pyllaitluid ïa pha . Kin tip ba nga long U Blei bakhlaiñbor jong ki Israel .
hadien u Ibsan , u Elon kiba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel Shipai snem .
translation.en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .

translation.kha: Bun Snem Hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria baneh leit khmih ïa u Hobab . Ban lehburom ïa u Shaphat bad kito kiba bad u , u Ahab u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot pynlang ki masi ban pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ba-bang pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang nabar u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translation.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jyllang phi ? u kylli . ïathuh ïa nga , phi don aïu ha ïing ? Ym don ei ei shuh , lehse sa tang u khra umphniang Olib uba rit , ka jubab .
translation.en: And Elisha said unto her , What shall I do for thee ? tell me , what hast thou in the house ? And she said , Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house , save a pot of oil .

translation.kha: ki rangbah bashlur tam ki leit bad shim ïa ki mihpat jong u Suah bad jongnga ki khun jong u , bad ki wanrah ïa ki sha Hephsibah . Ki tep ïa ki hangta hapoh u dieng sniang , bad ki jingkynthih hynñiew sner lynter .
translation.en: They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

translation.kha: Por ba u Jisu u don ha ka pyllait , manla ka-por u duli ha la u Kpa , ym ha kiwei pait .
translation.en: When Jesus was on earth , he always prayed to his Father , not to anyone else .
And if the  Lord  thy God enlarge thy coast , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers  ;
translation.kha: Bad lada U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la ïathuh ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad u ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular ,
Knidos ngi la wan shane Sihon ban thied jingbam .
translation.en: And said , O sir , we came indeed down at the first time to buy food :

And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;
translation.kha: Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kum ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin hap shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pynlong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom haba ki ïashong bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lynti bashukor !
Ngan Pha Sha jngai bah ïa ki briew bad ngan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .

Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances , and have not kept them . Return unto me , and I will return unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts . But ye said , Wherein shall we return ?
translation.kha: Ma phi , kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha shuwa jong phi , phi la phai noh na ki aiñ jong nga bad phim shym la sumar ïa ki . To phai pat sha nga , bad ngan phai sha phi . Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ban phai pat sha me ?’

translation.en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phai sha kata ka briew bad u la ong ha u Simon ,  Me ïohi ïa kane ka briew ? Nga la wan shapoh ka ïing jong me , bad mem shym la ai um ïa nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga , hynrei ka la sait ïa ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka bad ka la ñiad rkhiang ïa ki da u shñiuh jong ka .

translation.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .

translation.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God , defer not to pay it  ; for he hath no pleasure in fools : pay that which thou hast vowed .

translation.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him .

translation.en: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .

translation.kha: U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmienah jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka para ha kaba u la ïap .
translation.en: And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .

translation.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you , or of man s judgment : yea , I judge not mine own self .

translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .

Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the  Lord  cometh , for it is nigh at hand  ;

translation.en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .

translation.en: And I brought them into the house of the  Lord  , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God , which was by the chamber of the princes , which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :

translation.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the  Lord  shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .

translation.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed , and the diviners confounded : yea , they shall all cover their lips  ; for there is no answer of God .

translation.en: If the wicked restore the pledge , give again that he had robbed , walk in the statutes of life , without committing iniquity  ; he shall surely live , he shall not die .

translation.kha: Kumta ki mih na ka jaka shong dara jong ki Sirion , ki rupa phai Sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop : Ngi la leit sha ka jaka shongneh dara jong ki Syria bad ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki khuslai bad ki kada kiba dang shat teh , sad ki ïingjaiñ ki longsyiem kumjuh bania ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .
translation.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .
This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :
