translation.en: And Joshua adjured them at that time , saying , Cursed be the man before the  Lord  , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho : he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn , and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it .
So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .
translation.kha: Ki pynbor ïa kiba duk ban kyrpad jam sha U Blei , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa u :  Mynta te , ïathuh ïa ngi ! Mano uba long ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Me leh aïu hangne ? Me wan na kano ka ri ? Kaei ka jinglong traishnong jong me ?
U tnga jong na um don ha ïing ; u la leit jingtap sha jngai .
translation.en: For the goodman is not at home , he is gone a long journey :

translation.kha: Ka per ka la pra biang ba u Elkanah dara kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki leit biang sha Shiloh ban kñia ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem ha U Trai , bad ban ai ka jingainguh kyrpang ba u la kular .
translation.en: And the man Elkanah , and all his house , went up to offer unto the  Lord  the yearly sacrifice , and his vow .

Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh kiwei ki nongbah ka Judah . Wat mynta ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , bad ym don ba sah ha ki namar ki briew jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar . Ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki ne ma phi ne ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane .
Wat ki paralok jong per ki rkhie ïa ang mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga long uba hok bad u bym shah kynsi pop ; Hynrei ka don ka por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .
translation.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .

translation.kha: Namar ba ïa kine kiei kiei baroh yn pynjot ha kane ka rukom , ki brai kiba kumno phi dei ba longsem ?
translation.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam na ki jai Israel baroh ki ïadon ryngkat ha kata ka jingialeh jyllang ki briew U Blei , bad ki ïadon saw lakh ngut ki shipai hangta .
translation.en: And the chief of all the people , even of all the tribes of Israel , presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God , four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ki paid ka Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jong nga . Phi kmen bad phi sngewbha , phi da leh kum ka masi ba ïaid haba Saw kba ne kamon u kulai uba pah ,
translation.en: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced , O ye destroyers of mine heritage , because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls  ;

translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano mano ba lah baneh pyntngen ïa nga ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban ai jingshlur ïa ang . U nongshun u la jop ïa nga ; ki briew jong nga ktem don ei ei shuh kaba sah .
translation.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .

translation.kha: U shakri u la biah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka pa ha kaban u la ïap .
translation.en: And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .

translation.kha: Kiei ki kiba nga ïathuhlypa mynta ki la jia shisha . myntri ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei ki ibha thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin dang ban jia .
translation.en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u !’

Kumta u Saul u riam pher ïa lade da kaba phong da kiwei pat ki jaiñ , sad ynda la dum ma u bad ar ngut na ki rangbah jong u ki leit sha kata ka kynteit . Wad jingtip na ki mynsiem na ka beit jong la pynlang to ïathaw ïa nga kaei ka banbeiñ sa jia , u ong ha ka . Kut ïa uta u mynsiem jong uta u briew uba na khot kyrteng .
translation.en: And Saul disguised himself , and put on other raiment , and he went , and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night : and he said , I pray thee , divine unto me by the familiar spirit , and bring me him up , whom I shall name unto thee .
And look that thou make them after their pattern , which was shewed thee in the mount .
translation.kha: Da kitkhia ba men thaw ïa ki kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me ha une u lum .
Haba ki kherub ki ktieh sha suiñ bad ki khih , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki . Haba ki pyiar ïa ki thapniang ban her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang sad ki .
translation.en: And when the cherubims went , the wheels went by them : and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the same wheels also turned not from beside them .

translation.kha: Ngam kein hok ïa kaba kumin kane ka peiñ barabor . Kumta ngan shu leit on lynti ïa phi tang katto katne palat ïa ka Jordan .
translation.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king : and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward ?
And while the day was coming on , Paul besought them all to take meat , saying , This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting , having taken nothing .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , u Paul u la kyrpad ïa ki baroh ban bam khyndiat ka jingbam :  Phi la ïa-ap la khatsaw sngi mynta , bad ha kane ka por baroh phim shym la bam ei ei .
Nga ar ïa kane khnang ba baroh na kawei ka tduh Jong ka pyrthei shaduh kawei patar ka thoh kan tip ba la long U Trei bad ym to uwei patar U Blei .
translation.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is none beside me . I am the  Lord  , and there is none else .
And now I say unto you , Refrain from these men , and let them alone : for if this counsel or this work be of men , it will come to nought :
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa kane ka kam , nga ong ha phi , wat leh kano kano pyrshah ïa kine ki briew . Ieh ïa ki ! Lada kaei kaba ki la thmu bad leh ka long na ka jingleh briew , kan jah noh ,

Lada ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaba sngur mynsiem , badno ki duwai ha me da naba pah khmat sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , shuh kane ka nongbah kaba me la jied , bad sha khnai ka baphylla ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translation.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath  ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :
translation.kha: Ngan leh ki kambah ha ka sahit bneng shajrong bad ïa ki jingphylla ha ka khyndew sha tbian . Kan don ka snam , ka ding , bad ka tdem kaba rben ;

translation.en: Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .
translation.kha: Shu ap ,  U  Trai  u ong .  Ap ïa ka sngi haba ngan ïeng ban pynrem ïa ki jaitbynriew . Nga la pynbeit ïa la ka jingmut ban lumlang ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima khnang ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla jong nga .

translation.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms , wrought righteousness , obtained promises , stopped the mouths of lions ,
translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa baroh ki hima bad ki la jop . Ki la leh ïa kaei kaba dei hok bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .
translation.kha: Ka jingbymman jong me ka paw da kaei kaba me kren ; me pyrshang ban buhrieh ha lyndet ki ktien sian jong me .

translation.en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?
translation.kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da kat ka ïing kan kylla long kaba sah kynjah , bad kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un kyndit thret bad un pang met ; bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U  Trai  u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’
Mano ba pynhap ïa u snar ha ka jaka bym don bashong basah ?
translation.en: To cause it to rain on the earth , where no man is  ; on the wilderness , wherein there is no man  ;

translation.kha: lang ïathuh ïa me kaei ka ban Jia ïa ki khynraw kiba la kha hangne bad ïa ki kmie ki kper jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place , and concerning their mothers that bare them , and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land  ;
Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel kim long jingmyntoi ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kum ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nar , bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .

translation.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the  Lord   ; and they shall be afraid of thee .
translation.kha: Te ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei kin ïohi ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa phi ban long ki briew jong u , bad kin sheptieng ïa phi .

translation.en: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and the right shoulder  ; for it is a ram of consecration :
translation.kha: Ot noh ïa ka khleiñ jong uta u langbrot , ïa u tdong jong u , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki  nierlang , ïa ka sbiar kaba haneng u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka lbong kamon .
To Reu bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohkha baroh , ko Jerusalem !
translation.en: Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na uba kput ka khyndew . U pynlong ïa ka lei ban thaba ha u slap malu u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .
translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .

translation.kha: Ïa ka sharati ha ka ïingjah jong u yn pyndum .
translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .

translation.kha: Nga la pyndeng katto kat na phi kitab na la pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . Kito na phi kiba la laiñ im ki long kum ka dieng barhem ba la sei na ka ding . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat shaei nga , ong U TRAI’ .
translation.en: I have overthrown some of you , as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

And they gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the  Lord  , and fasted on that day , and said there , We have sinned against the  Lord . And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tong ïa ka um bad ki theh ïa ka kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  bad ki shahjingit baroh shi sngi . Ki ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .  Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki Israel .

translation.en: Wherefore , though I wrote unto you , I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered wrong , but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you .
translation.kha: Kumta , wat la nga la thoh ïa kato ka shithi , ka la long ym namar jong uta uba la leh bymdei lane na ka bynta uta uba la shah leh bymdei . Pynban , nga la thoh ïa ka khnang ban pynshai ha phi , ha khmat jong U Blei , katno ka long da shisha kaba jylliew ka jingaiti jong phi sha ngi .

translation.en: Then said Absalom , Call now Hushai the Archite also , and let us hear likewise what he saith .
translation.kha: U Absalom u ong ,  Mynta khot ïa u Hushai , bad to ngin sngap aïu u don ban ong .

translation.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them  ; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
translation.kha: Phi bam syndon ïa ki briew jong nga . Phi puid noh ïa ka sniehdoh jong ki , pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki , bad shaiñ ïa ki kum ïa ka doh ha u khiew .

translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi bad un pynkhuid ïa ngi na ki kam bymman baroh .
La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Mari da ka khubor jong u angel , badno ka la lyngngoh aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingmut .
translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .

translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ u la lade ïa ki briew kiba ïadie ïa ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki paro , nabar ki nongïapeiñ pisa ruh ki ïashoh ha ki miej jong ki .
translation.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :
Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
translation.kha: To wan bad khmih ïa u briew uba la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . Hato une u lah ban long U Messaïah ?

translation.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :
translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phim dei ban rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga hadien ba phi la dih waiñ lane dih kyiad ; lada phi leh kumta phin ïap . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba dei ban bud da ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng .
Ngam ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh na kane ka waiñ tad khah tala ka sngi ba nga dih na ka waiñ bathymmai ha ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine , until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: U Abishai , u khum jngai ka Seruïah u la kren , Ïa u Shimei dei ngab pynkup namar ba u la tim ïa uta uba U Trai u la jakoid khim u syiem .
translation.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said , Shall not Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the  Lord s  anointed ?
And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .
translation.kha: U la ïaphylliew jingmut hapoh synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , da kaba pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki Jiw bad ki Grik .
Kum u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh’ ki la mih mynmiet bad ki Rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .
translation.en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .
Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kaba u don la shim noh ; u ïap , khlem pat dap pura ka jingstad .

translation.en: But he refused , and said unto his master s wife , Behold , my master wotteth not what is with me in the house , and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand  ;
translation.kha: U la kyrngah bad u ong ha ka ,  Ha khmih , u kynrad jong nga um donkam ban pynkhuslai shuh shaphang ïa lade bad kano kano ka kam hapoh ïing , namar nga don hangne .
Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tuh ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jrong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khñiot bad ka la ïuh halor jong ki .
translation.en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .

translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka shai ha kob dum , bad ka jingdam kam lah ban pynsep ïa ka .
translation.en: And the light shineth in darkness  ; and the darkness comprehended it not .

translation.kha: Ka barhem jong Kito ki nongïalam basarong ka nang jah noh kum ki soh Dumbur ba mih nyngkong jongu ka aïom , ba la shim bad bam ïa ki tang shu ih .
translation.en: And the glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fat valley , shall be a fading flower , and as the hasty fruit before the summer  ; which when he that looketh upon it seeth , while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up .
Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?
translation.kha: Kumta , te , balei mem buh ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa ? Nangta te ngan jin da la ïohpdiang pat ïa ka lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .’
Ïa ka jingsngewieit jong nga ym lah shun pynkhiah ; nga pang ha ka dohthang .
translation.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow , my heart is faint in me .

translation.kha: phan ïakhaïi pateng ha Gris , Tubal , bad ha Meshekh bad ïakylliang ïa ki mar na ka byndi ki mraw bad na ka bynta ki tiar rnong .
translation.en: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they were thy merchants : they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit ki pynpaw ïa la ka jingbitar ha kaba paw , hynrei ki briew ibha shemphang ki ïaishah bad ki suit khop ïa ka .
translation.en: A fool uttereth all his mind : but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards .

translation.kha: Kin tieng ïa phi , hynrei phim daym ban ïaknieh jaka mala ki , nalor ngan ym ai ha phi wat tang khyndiat mad na kata ka ri jong ki . Nga la ai ïa ka Edom ha ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .
translation.en: Meddle not with them  ; for I will not give you of their land , no , not so much as a foot breadth  ; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession .

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab , Kane ka long kata kaei ka ban sa jia . Ïa ki koidi jong u shiphang yn ïabam noh , bad ïa ka jinglute jong u nongsynshar leh Jubab yn bat noh . Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba ïabah ïa pha , bad ngan pyllun ïa ki khun jongki phah .
translation.en: But thus saith the  Lord  , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered : for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee , and I will save thy children .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jongki pha ki long kum ka kynhun ki puit katba them ha ka kynroh ha ka sngi kaweh khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym anna mano mano batip shano ki la jah noh !
translation.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .
And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .
translation.kha: U tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kaba ki tnga nongwei jong u baroh kin ïoh thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki .

Em , U Trai u la ïathuh ïa ine ïa kaei kaba bha . Khie kaweh u doh na ngi ka longïng kane : Ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok , don pyn-i ïa ka jingtieng baneh , bad ban im ha ka jingïasyllok basngewrit bad U Blei jongu i'u .
translation.en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la tei ïa ki ïingshong , hynrei ki la kjat ïa la U nongïathuh . Ki paid Judith ki la Tei ïa ki nongbet ba la ker kynroh . Hynrei tun phah da ka ding ka ban thang duh ïa ki ïingsyiem bad ki nongbah lad ki .
translation.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker , and buildeth temples  ; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities : but I will send a fire upon his cities , and it shall devour the palaces thereof .
And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
translation.kha: U Paul u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan ha ki ; ki la kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna ruh ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .

translation.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa uta u briew .
Ha kob ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew Kiba den ban ïap ; hynrei ïa u Melkhi ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da uba uba im , Rumah ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translation.en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .

translation.kha: Wat leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingiw ba kynjoh mynsiem kaba don ha me , ïa katba la ai ha me mynba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren bad ki nongsharai jar ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong me .
translation.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee , which was given thee by prophecy , with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery .

translation.kha: Ki Suh ki tian ïa ka ephod da ka jait linen kaba ni ; da u sawar uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad da u sai ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the ephod of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba nga ïalap ha phi kam long kaba na ka tynrai u briew .

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah

Ngan pynbunkam ïa ki jingimat jongnga ki nong Ijipt dara ngan pynngat ïa ka jingsngewskhem jongnga ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki pynlwet jong ki ban ïarap ïa ki , bad kin lytar ban kylli na ki nongleh byrtong dara kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba ïapom ban ïoh jingmut .
translation.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .

translation.kha: Lada hadien kat kan film treh ban shahshkor ïa nga malu phi dang ïai pyrshah hi ïa nga ,
translation.en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me , but walk contrary unto me  ;
And Ahab said to Elijah , Hast thou found me , O mine enemy ? And he answered , I have found thee : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u Elijah , u ong  Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , nga la lap ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  Me la aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki paid Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh jingmut ïa kawei ruh ka ktien kaba phi ong .
Naba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , Ym dei shun teh ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban seh kew bad u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa la ka bainong .
translation.en: For the scripture saith , Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn . And ,  The labourer is worthy of his reward .
And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u tar ïa ka jaiñ na ka khmat jong u , bad kumta hi u syiem u ithuh ïa u bad u long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
Haba ngan plie ïa ki jingtep ha kiba la tep ïa ki briew jong per bad saiñ nep ïa ki , kin sa tip ba at long U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u shah pynshoi haba u shah ring pah bad shah riam ha ki jingkwah brai jong u hi .
translation.en: But every man is tempted , when he is drawn away of his own lust , and enticed .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u ong , Ym dei ban pynïap ïano ïano ha kane ka sngi , naba Kanneh ka Dei ka sngi ba U TRAI’ u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And Saul said , There shall not a man be put to death this day : for to day the  Lord  hath wrought salvation in Israel .
And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
translation.kha: hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . Bynrap sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,

Kumta te , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong U Blei ïa ngi , nga Kyrpad ïa phoi : To aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkieng ba-im sha U Blei , ba la pynshngain ha ka jingshakri ïa u bad ka jingsngewpihuiñ ïa u . Ken ka long ka jingmane bashisha kaba phi dei ban ai .
translation.en: I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .

Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jaitbynriew kaba ïa ka ktien jong ka phim tip .
U nongpeit phatok u la pan ïa ka jingshai , u la rung Shabeh , nabar u la dem da kaba khynñiuh ha ki khait jong u Paul bad u sylla .
translation.en: Then he called for a light , and sprang in , and came trembling , and fell down before Paul and Silas ,

translation.kha: Me la ai ha nga ïa ka jingim bad ka jingieit baïaineh , bad ka jingsumar Sakkur jongki me ka ri pynim ïa la .
translation.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynthrong , ko parabangeit jong to , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi katba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la khong hajuh ka jingïadoh jong u lyoh , dara baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .
translation.kha: Hato don mano mano ba la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ? Mano ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong haduh kaba kut ka por ?

translation.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten , and destruction shall be ready at his side .
translation.kha: U la ju long uba riewspah , hynrei mynta u ïaid ha ka jingthngan ; ka jingjot ka ïeng bad ka ap ha syndah jong u .

translation.en: And they slew every one his man : and the Syrians fled  ; and Israel pursued them : and Ben–hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen .
translation.kha: bad uwei pa uwei u la pynïap ïa u briew uba u ïaleh . Ki nong Syria ki phet ïap , bad ki Israel ki beh kthong , hynrei u Benhadad u la lait im da kaba u shong halor u kulai , ïa kaba la synran da katto katne ngut ki shipai shong kulai .
Un pyndep ïa kata kaba u la tmoh na ka beit jong nga ; Katai ka jingthmu ka long tang Kaei na bakha bun kiba u don ;
translation.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me : and many such things are with him .

translation.kha: Jehoaddin kata , u la lytar shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel mala u la pynïeng ïa ka Gera hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang shongkai bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u la mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .
And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .
translation.kha: Ai ba U Trai un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshemphang ba kham khraw jong ka jingieit U Blei bad sha ka jingïaishah kaba la ai da U Khrist .

translation.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba la poi ktien ha ki Assyria ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syiem Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
Ka jingmad ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , ko ba-dait jong nga ; u thylli jong phi u un-long ka dud bad ka dap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .
translation.en: His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .

translation.kha: ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . Kin pyndeng ïa ktien keiñ kiba itynnat baroh kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit Bad jingstad jngai me .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , kata ka reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew jong U Blei bad ka la jop ïa ki .
translation.en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;

translation.kha: Nga jaboh , Ko thri Nongsynshar , ngam tip kumno ban kren ; nga dang khynnah eh .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , I cannot speak : for I am a child .
But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
translation.kha: Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba lait na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .

To phai bad to ud , ko ki briew ka Jesreel , kum ka bri ka ban sa kha khun , naba mynta phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha ïarung . Phi dei ban leit sha Babilon , hyndai hangta U Trai un phlait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .

translation.kha: Tang shu kynjat shai , U Jehu u la mihnoh na shnong bun u la kitei sha ka jaka bakynjah . Ki paidbah ki la sawdong ban wad ïa u , bad haba ki la shadem ïa u , ki la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u na kaba saw ne .
translation.en: And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .
Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good , and judgments whereby they should not live  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ki bym long kiba bha , bad ïa ki hukum ki bym lah ban wanrah jingim .
U Sebadaïah u la Joab , woh ai ba uno uno ruh un tip ïa kane ka jingïakren , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym Don ha ka jingma .
translation.en: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah , Let no man know of these words , and thou shalt not die .

translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phim dei ban ring shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon hir jong nga hadien ba phi la theh waiñ lane dih kyiad ; lada phi leh kumta phin ïap . Kenan ka long ka aiñ kaba dei ban bud da ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pait .
translation.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :

translation.kha: Bad salia ki antad Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Aiñ baroh ba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ha ki , nangta ngan ym shahïap ba yn beh ino ïa ki na ka ri kob nga la ai ha ki kper tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers  ; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem’ , baroh ki nongwei kiba tur ïaleh ïa pha kin shah beh noh kum ïa u pyut pui , bad ki kynhun shipai bashyrkhei jong ki kyang her kum u phlangïap .
translation.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .
I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?
translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa u Titos ban leit , bad nga la phah ïa uwei pat u parabangeit bad u . Hato phi lah ban ong ba u Titos u la shim kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u bad ma nga ngim shym la leh na kijuh hi ki jingthmu bad leh ha kajuh ka rukom ?
Balei ba me la iehnoh ïa ine slem katta katta ? Hato manna dang kynruh biang ïa ngi ?
translation.en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?

translation.kha: Ka leilieh ka thapbawa na ki lyoh ,
translation.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
But woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs , and pass over judgment and the love of God : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina bad u rue    bad baroh kiwei pat ki jait jhur , hynrei phi leh klet ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingieit ïa U Blei . Ïa kine phi la dei ban leh , khlem da leh klet ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .
translation.kha: U paidbah baroh u la jubab ,  Ai ba ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u kan hap halor jong ngi bad halor ki khun jong ngi !
Haba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jingkhawai , u la phah ïa u shakri jong u ban ïong ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , ‘ To wan , la dem Khreh ïa kaei Kaei baroh !’
translation.en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come  ; for all things are now ready .

translation.kha: U la kynsai pynïap ïa ka da kaba ong ba kdew long shuh kaba sotti haba u shongkurim ïa ka . Hynrei film ki long ki dak jong ka jingnang sotti ka khun jong nga ; khmih ïa ki jingbitsnam ha ka jingsiangthiah shongkurim !’
translation.en: And , lo , he hath given occasions of speech against her , saying , I found not thy daughter a maid  ; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter s virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .

translation.kha: Ki dkhoh kin thaw ïa ki skum jong ki , kin kha pylleng bad pynmih ki kynhun , bad sumar ïa ki hangno . Ki pukni kyang ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei! patiaw .
translation.en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .

translation.kha: Kam ju rung ha ki jingmut jong ki ba ngan kynthup ïa kane ka kam sngi baroh ; hynrei ki pop jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa ki , dara ngam lah khlem da ïohi ïa ki .
translation.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .

translation.kha: U Petros u la khot sngewbha ïa kita ki rangbah shapoh Bad u la kyrpad jubor ïa ki ban sahmiet hangta . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki ; bad katto katne ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la ïasynran lem ïa u .
translation.en: Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki , Phi long ki sakhi ïa lade hi ïa ka jingbishar ba phi la jied ban shakri ïa U Trai . Ho-oid , ki ong , ngi long ki sakhi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the  Lord  , to serve him . And they said , We are witnesses .

translation.kha: ( U Trai’ u la ong , nur ym isynei shuh ïaineh ïano ha ka pyrthei . Ma nga da ailad ngan buh ïa ki briew baroh hapoh ka bor jongngi ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kino ki nongsharai kin pynjot ïa ka pyiar , dara ngan ym pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong ki . )
translation.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .

translation.kha: Ïa phi ym dei ban khot ‘ ko Nonghikai ,’ namar ba phi baroh Phin ïalong mar shrong bad ni tang uwei U Nonghikai .
translation.en: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba thang ïa ka sharak Bad tap ïa ka da ka shang lane buh ïa ka ha khrup jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengkhap sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin Ïohi ïa ka jingshoh katba ki dong wan rung .
translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .

translation.kha: Kumba ka ïor ka haka noh ha ka jingshit bad ka jinglyngngoh , kumjuh ruh u nongpop u Da-ei noh na ka ri jong bakha im .
translation.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .
translation.kha: Katba kata ka sur ka dang kren , U Mynsiem U Blei u la rung ha nga , bad u la pynïeng ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur ba ka dang ïai kren ,
U Jephthah u kular ha U Trai : Lada me ai ha nga ka jingjop pyrshah ïa ki Armoni ,
translation.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands ,

For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .
translation.kha: Wat lada kito ki bym dei hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ma phi phin lait noh khlem shah pynshitom ? Em , phi dei ban dih na kane ka khuri !
Phi Dei ban kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt , bad ba nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi , nga la pyllait im ïa phi da ka borbah jong ar . Dei namar kata ba nga hukum ïa phi ban ramhah ïa ka Shebat .
translation.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the  Lord  thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Ki paid ka Horonaim ki kyang , ‘ Ka Jinglehbor ! Ka Jingpynjot !’
translation.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim , spoiling and great destruction .

translation.kha: U Saul u bat ïa u Dabid ban ïaisah bad u naduh kata ka snieh badno um shym shah ïa u ban leit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: And Saul took him that day , and would let him go no more home to his father s house .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit shaw u Ïoannis bad ki la ong , Ko Nonghikai , phi kynmaw ïa u briew uba la don lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jehoaddin , ïa uba phi la klun shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , u la pynbuaid mynta , bad baroh ki la leit sha u !
translation.en: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .

translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ha kane ka nongbam ; ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ; kin ïap da ka khlam kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city , both man and beast : they shall die of a great pestilence .
Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?
translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ha u da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?

translation.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :
translation.kha: u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .

Kumne shaphang kito ki khatphra ngut ki briew ha Siloam kiba la shah pynïap mynba ka jaka ap phira ka hap halor jong ki ? Hato phi tharai ba kane ka pynshisha ba ki long kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh’ kiwei pat ki biria kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ?
translation.en: Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit sha u Ishmael u khun jong u Abraham , bad u shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kaba long ka para jong u Nebaïoth .
( Lukios 1 :30-33 ) Mynba u Ujuh u don ha ka pyrthei , u la pynshai ba un long u Nongsynshar umbah sbun , uba hok bad uba janai .
translation.en: ( Luke 1 :30-33 ) When Jesus was on earth , he proved that he would be a kind , just , and perfect Ruler .

translation.kha: Kiba riewspah ki shukor bad ki lute . Ki leh bymdei ïa kiba duk bad ki shim katba ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: The people of the land have used oppression , and exercised robbery , and have vexed the poor and needy : yea , they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully .

translation.kha: Me Tip kumno ki nongshun jong nga ki la isih ïa nga bad kumno ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me .
But unto the place which the  Lord  your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there , even unto his habitation shall ye seek , and thither thou shalt come :
translation.kha: Na ka ri ki jait jong phi baroh , U  Trai  un jied tang kawei ka jaka sha kaba phi dei ban wan mane ïa u .
Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kambah haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhih bad pynbiang , ha kaba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .

translation.kha: U la sngewtieng shikynta , namar ki bariew ki syiem don jingbet . Nangta U Jingsuk u la rupa sha ki nongrit kiba don sawdong ha kata ka thoiñ , u da shithi ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .

translation.kha: Ki Jingkñia namar ka Pop ki donkam na ka boitha kine ki jingleh . Lada uno uno u shah khot da ki bor ba-halor ban ai sakhi ha ka ïingbishar bad um ïathuh ei ei ïa tala kaba u la ïohthiah ne u la ïohsngew , u dei ban kit hi ïa Kaba mih nangta .
translation.en: And if a soul sin , and hear the voice of swearing , and is a witness , whether he hath seen or known of it  ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity .
For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
translation.kha: Phi donkam ban long kiba ïaishah , khnang ba phi lah ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa kata kaba u kular .
Haba nga ai jingmut , ki brup ki sngap jar bad ki shahshkor bha ïa kaei kaba nga noh ;
translation.en: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .

translation.kha: U Jeshanah u dih u kper jong u Sheba bad u Dedan , malade ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dan ki long ki Asshurim , Ki Letushim , bad ki Leummim .
translation.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba , and Dedan . And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim , and Letushim , and Leummim .
Thus saith the  Lord  , Keep ye judgment , and do justice : for my salvation is near to come , and my righteousness to be revealed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba dei , naba shen ngan pynim ïa phi .

U Jisu u la hukum ïa u , Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei kaei leit beit sha u lyngkhuit bad ai un peit bniah ïa me ; nangta un pynjia ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la koit . To ai ïa ka jingkha kumba U Moses u la hukum .
translation.en: And he charged him to tell no man :  but go , and shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing , according as Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
For both prophet and priest are profane  ; yea , in my house have I found their wickedness , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki long ki bymriewblei ; nga la lap ïa ki ba ki leh bymman ha ka Templ hi .
Kumno la pyndonkam ïa ki jingnoh synñiang ?
translation.en: How are the voluntary contributions used ?

translation.kha: Mynba to hiar noh na ka diengphna bad to pynim ïa lade !
translation.en: Save thyself , and come down from the cross .
And they took every man his censer , and put fire in them , and laid incense thereon , and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding , u buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ lem bad u Moses bad u Aaron .

translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Mynta nga la dap shispah arphew snem bad ngam lah shuh ban long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ba ngan ym ïoh ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan .
Um shym bud ïa ki nuksa babud jong u shem Dabid u kop tymmen jong u ; pynban , u leh ïa kiei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei jong u bad u bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki syiem Jeraïah .
translation.en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .

translation.kha: Baroh ar , u nongïathuhlypa pynlang tur umbiah kyllan na u , kin ïoh ïa kajuh ka jingshah pynshitom .
translation.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Rephidim ,
translation.en: And the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Rephaims ,

translation.en: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .

translation.kha: Nangta U Ujuh u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleh lang bun U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki liang .
translation.en: And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
But the wise answered , saying , Not so  ; lest there be not enough for us and you : but go ye rather to them that sell , and buy for yourselves .
translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ kiba stad ki la jubab , ‘ kam don shibun ban dap ïa phi bad ïa ngi ruh . Khie leit sha dukan bad thied khyndiat na ka bynta ïa lade .’
Nga la jubab , Lada nga ïathuh ïa pa ïa ka jingshisha , phin sa pynïap ïa por , bad paila nga ai jingmut ïa phi , phin ym shakor satia .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
Now Jesus was not yet come into the town , but was in that place where Martha met him .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu um pat shym la poi ha kata ka shnong , hynrei u dang don ha ka jaka ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïakynduh ïa u . )
Hib u briew u shah marwei ba u leh bymdei ïa uwei pat , bad la ïam shai ka duwan jong me ha kane ka Templ ban shym ïa ka jingsmai ba u Long babha lui lui ,
translation.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour , and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear , and the oath come before thine altar in this house :

translation.kha: Lada ka long ka mon U Trai , nga kyrmen ba nga lah ban phah shen shai phi ïa u Timothi , khnang ba na lah ban ïoh ka jingpynshlur da ka khubor shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you , that I also may be of good comfort , when I know your state .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki synran ki la de ,
translation.en: And they did so , and made them all sit down .

translation.kha: Ha-ei , me long ka sur jong u paidbah . Ynda men ïap , ka jingngeit jong me kan ïap lang pynlang me .
translation.en: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you .

translation.kha: U Kpu uba im u la phah ïa nga , bad Naaman jongnga u nga ruh nga im . Ha khih ka mano uno uno uba bam ïa de un im Namar jong nga .
translation.en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .

translation.kha: Ka la jan dei artat ka por na ka pyntwa ka Jingkhawai mem Ka Jinglait , kumto U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka don u imon uba kyrteng u Laban ; bad u Laban u la mareh bran krung sawar shun leit sha kata ka pukri ha kaba u shakri jong u Abraham u dat .
translation.en: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .
For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u shakri jong u .
Ko khunlung u briew’ , u la ong , to ïathuhlypa bad pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong . Men pyrta ïa phim ki ktien : Ka sngi kaba sngewtriem lai Wan !
translation.en: Son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Howl ye , Woe worth the day !

translation.kha: Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaweh ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shong bad ki pun ïam bad dih .
translation.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .
( James 1 :17 ) You will come to know how to approach him in prayer .
translation.kha: ( U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin ioh tip kumno ban wan shajan jong u lyngba ka jingduwai .

U Trai u ong , Nga phah kut ïa shibun ki nongtong dohkha ïa-ban wan bad kem ïa kine ki briew’ . Nangta ngan phah khot ïa shibun ki nongbeh mrad ban thwet pynïap ïa ki halor uwei pa uwei u lumbah Bad u lumlang bad hapoh ki kram hap ki mawkhang .
translation.en: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the  Lord  , and they shall fish them  ; and after will I send for many hunters , and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .
And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .
translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ruh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi baroh ; ki briew jong u ki ñiah ïa kita ki jingri ha shuwa jong ki bad ki ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jong u Dabid !
U Huram bad u Shekhem u khulom jong u ki la leit sha ka jaka long dorbar ha ka khyrdop shong malu ki kren ha la ki para shngain ;
translation.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,

translation.kha: U Dabid u bsuh ïa ka waitlam u Saul ha kata ka jingkieng atiar bad u pyrshang ban ïaid , hynrei um lah , namsop ba um ju mlien ban phong ïa kita . Nahum lah ban leit ïaleh ryngkat bad kine , u ong ïa u Shual . Ngam ju mlien ïa ki . Kumta u loit nep ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour , and he assayed to go  ; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul , I cannot go with these  ; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him .
For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snem ka rta , ka la jan ïap . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh .
Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka snieh kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bna Kisleb ) , U Trai u la ai ka khubor ha la .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;

translation.kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglonghok bakongsan shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sngi bakhadduh ,” U Jingsuk u la nguh : “Te ia kane ka bishar jongki ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei barben , ia kaban long ka jingthala ha ki kynja bynñiaw baroh ; ynda kumta kein kan jia kata kaba khot .” —Mathaios 24 :14 .
translation.en: Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U thri nongbishar , nga kular kyntang ba ki jingñiewbeiñ kiba don sawdong kin shah pynpoh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I have lifted up mine hand , Surely the heathen that are about you , they shall bear their shame .

translation.kha: Balah ki hima kiba ïalumlang pun tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusha kin longïing kum u briew uba ïap-tyrsaw kaba phohsniew ba u bam jingbam Bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah hapdeng ka jingthngan , lane khim u briew u ban sa ïap na ka jingsliang wahbah phohsniew ba u tiduh um bad u kyndit na ka jingïaineh ryngkat pynlang u pdot ba-tyrkhong .
translation.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth , and , behold , he eateth  ; but he awaketh , and his soul is empty : or as when a thirsty man dreameth , and , behold , he drinketh  ; but he awaketh , and , behold , he is faint , and his soul hath appetite : so shall the multitude of all the nations be , that fight against mount Zion .

translation.kha: Bud ïa nga , U Jiw u la jubab , malade ai kiba ïap ktang tep ïa kiba ïarap jong ki .
translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .
And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Sekharaïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: The new wine mourneth , the vine languisheth , all the merryhearted do sigh .

Kino bapaw pyrshang hi .
translation.en: You haven't even tried .

translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingbthah jong u ïa ki Eri ha kaba la mane ïa u Baal la pyniar , bad ïa ki kharai jingiwbih hajan jong ki la pyntha . Ki pynlwet kum ki pui pui ïa ki dik ka Ishar bad ïa kiwei ki bleithaw barben bad nangta ki bret ïa u pui pui ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba la ai jingkñia ïa ailad ha ki .
translation.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .

translation.kha: Nangne u Lum u la leit sha ki rangbah kiba la ïatehktien bad ki khun kynthei jong u , bad u ong , To pynjulor bad mihnoh nangne ; naba U Trai un sa pynjot thiaw ïa khie ka iaki . Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shwa kren biria .
translation.en: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .

translation.en: Passing through the street near her corner  ; and he went the way to her house ,

Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .

translation.en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynkynriah ïa ka metïap na lynti , uwei pa uwei u la bud ïa u Joab ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .

translation.en: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .
translation.kha: Da shisha un pynïap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew ,  ki la jubab ,  bad un aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai , ki ban ai ha u ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit ha ka por kaba biang .
Ki bri kiba shemphang ki kajuh ngab ïohi hikai , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewmeng ha ka jingaibor .
translation.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .

translation.kha: U jingthung u la sheng bad u la long u dieng sohwaiñ uba lyngkot Bad uba pynhiar kylleng . Ki tnat ki san shajrong sha u pukni , bad ki thied ki suh jyllang . La tap ïa u dieng sohwaiñ da ki tnat bad ki sla .
translation.en: And it grew , and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and the roots thereof were under him : so it became a vine , and brought forth branches , and shot forth sprigs .

translation.en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece , from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynkulmar jingmut ïa ki sympat ha ka jingïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel . Ki Israel ki pyndap ïa ki ha Gibeon bad ki la Beh ïa ki arsut ïa ka khim lum ha Beth Horon , da kaba ïai ïaleh shaduh shaphang shai ha Asekah bad Makkedah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .
