If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard  ;
translation.kha: Lada u briew ne ka briew ki mih prum ha ka khlieh ne ha ka tmoh , u lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa ka .
Shi sngi hadien ka thma ki Philistia ki leit ban lwet na ki metïap , ki lap ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u lai ñiut ba ki thiah ïahap ha Lum Gilboa .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .

Then Achish called David , and said unto him , Surely , as the  Lord  liveth , thou hast been upright , and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight : for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day : nevertheless the lords favour thee not .
translation.kha: U Akhish u khot ïa u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Nga smai ha U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba phi long uba hok ïa nga ; bad nga hi nga sngewdei ba phin leit ryngkat bad nga sha ka thma ; naba ngam shym la shem kano kano ka jingbakla ha phi naduh ka sngi ba phi wan sha nga haduh kane ka sngi . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem kim pdiang ïa phi .

Ha kane kajuh ka per ki Philistia jin ki ïathmu ïa ki shnong kiba ha ki mait lum kiba shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ki la ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shemesh , ka Aijalon , bad ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongap jong ka Soko , ka Timnah , mala ka Gimso lem bad ki nonglur jong ki , bad ki shongdor hangta .
translation.en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .

And next him were Eden , and Miniamin , and Jeshua , and Shemaiah , Amariah , and Shecaniah , in the cities of the priests , in their set office , to give to their brethren by courses , as well to the great as to the small :
translation.kha: Ha kiwei pat ki nongbah ha kiba ki lyngdoh ki shong , la kyrshan jingïarap ha kane da kiwei ki Lebi : u Eden , Miniamin , Jeshua , Shemaïah , Amaraïah , bad u Shekanaïah . Ki sam ryntih ïa ka jingbam sha ki para Lebi kat kum ki kamram jong ki , bad ym kat kum ki kur .

translation.en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .
translation.kha: Ki nongshna da ki kti ki ïarap bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat .
U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngut hangta ;
translation.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha la ki briew , Nga la pynsakma ïa phi ha ki liang barhem . Hynrei mynta , ma phi bakha sha ringmraw , phet noh na Babilonia badno sien phai pat sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Deliver thyself , O Zion , that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin Sangeh phad ring ha nga .
translation.en: I wish you'd quit throwing things at me .
O give thanks to the Lord of lords : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khlaiñbor tam na ki kynrad baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Bad ym don ba long shngain haba phi don Hangne . Berakah Kaba phi leh ka long ka bymhok . Phi bud ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba kliar , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïaid na dat ka lyndet u ban long shngain .
translation.en: The way of peace they know not  ; and there is no judgment in their goings : they have made them crooked paths : whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace .

And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ïa ka jingïakajia bad u Saul lem bad ka longïing jong u ym lah ban pynbeit da ka rupa lane ka ksiar , lymne ba ngi kwah ban pynïap ïa uno uno u Israel .   Te , kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u Dabid u kylli .

translation.en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Khrist u im hapoh jong phi , U Mynsiem u long ka jingim na ka bynta jong phi namar la pynlong ka hok hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei .

translation.en: I have sworn by myself , the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and shall not return , That unto me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall swear .
translation.kha: Ka jingkular jong nga ka long kaba shisha , bad kan ym kylla . Nga kular shisha da baroh kaba nga long ; baroh kin wan ban dem ha khmat jong nga bad kular ba ki long hok ha nga .
Nangta ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namsop ba kim ngeit ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
translation.en: Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :

translation.kha: Ka pyngngad kum ka step , ka thikna kum ka jingmih ka sngi .
translation.en: They are new every morning : great is thy faithfulness .
Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me , What are these , my lord ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Ko rangbah , kaei ka jingmut jong kine ki kali ïapom ?
Namar ba phi Long ki briew jngai U Blei , kam long naba dei kad ban ïakren hapdeng jong phi ïa kino kino ki kam ïahiar ne ki kam khyllie ne ki kam kwah lalot .
translation.en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
How do we benefit from these gatherings ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingmyntoi ba ngi ïoh na kum kine ki jingïakynduhlang ?
U Thomas u la jubab ïa u , U Trai jong por bad U Blei jong sa !
translation.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jong ki lyngdoh te um shym thied . Kim donkam ban die ïa la ka khyndew namar ba ki ïoh ka baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da kata .
U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kabu ïa U Trai la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingweng thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Jehud borbah ban mane ïa U Trei , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: thaw ïa ki Dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , nabar suit ïa ki ruh da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .

translation.kha: Ngi la ïaid lyngba ka jingpynjot bad jingpra ; ngi im ha ka jingma bad ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us , desolation and destruction .

translation.kha: Phin baibam bad dei ha ka miej jngai nga ha ka Hima jong nga , bad phin Shong hajar ki khet ban synshar halor ki Khat-ar jait ki Israel .
translation.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u purew ba la khleh pynlang shi litar shiteng ka umphniang Olib dei Ban ai kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka wieh .
translation.en: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .

translation.kha: U briew uba la shuh Sabad kum u masi , lane uba la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kyntiew hapdeng ki briew U Trai .
translation.en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong nga ba U Blei un ai ha ang ïa ka khubor haba nga la kloi ban krong , khnang ba nga lah ban kren shlur bun pynpaw shai ïa ka jingmaïan ka gospel .
translation.en: And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,

translation.kha: Ynda Phin kein ha ka jingujor , bad nia kiei kiei baroh ki wanpaw jia ha phi , te ha kaba khatduh phin phai shuh U Trai bun kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: When thou art in tribulation , and all these things are come upon thee , even in the latter days , if thou turn to the  Lord  thy God , and shalt be obedient unto his voice  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaleit baroh sha Jahlil , bad Hangne ha ka Jaka kyntang ki pynbna ba u Saul u long u skhem . Ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad u Saul bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalehkmen ha kane ka jingjia .
translation.en: And all the people went to Gilgal  ; and there they made Saul king before the  Lord  in Gilgal  ; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the  Lord   ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .
And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da shong bad ki nonghikai jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ïa ki bad kylli jingkylli .
Nangta ka jingïalang paidbah ka phah kiei shai ki Benjamin kiba don ha u Mawsiang Rimmon bad tyrwa pun pynwai noh ïa ka thma .
translation.en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon , and to call peaceably unto them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , me la brup ïa ka jinghikai jong per , ka jinglong jingim jong nga , bad ka jingthmu jong to ha ka jingim ; me la khmih ïa ka jingngeit jyllang nga , ka jingïaishah jong nga , ka jingieit jong la , ka jingïaineh jrong nga , ka jingshah pynshitom jong nga , bad ki jingshah shitom jong nga .
translation.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,

translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A Trai , U Blei jong ngi , sad wallam pat ïa ngi napdeng ki jaitbynriew , ba ngi lah baneh sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kirteng bakhuid jong me .
translation.en: Save us , O  Lord  our God , and gather us from among the heathen , to give thanks unto thy holy name , and to triumph in thy praise .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharoah bad katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jyllang ka kynhun jong ki , ki la khñium ha ki synran jong U ju . Balei ba phi ïajubab bad ïadih bad ki nonglum khajna bad kyiuh pat kiba la shait kyntait ? Ki la kylli .
translation.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples , saying , Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners ?

translation.kha: Nangta Katai ka sur ïa kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga , ka da jong , To leit bad shim ïa ka kot kli kaweh la plied kaba don ha ka kti jong u angel uba ïeng hajar kata ka duriaw malu Halor ka khyndew .
translation.en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again , and said , Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth .

translation.kha: U Soitan , u Ksuid—u wan nangno ?
translation.en: Satan the Devil—where did he come from ?

translation.kha: Kam don hangtei ha shata bneng . Phim donkam ba da ong , ‘ Uei kew u ban leit kiew shatei bad ïalamwir ïa ka shane sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban jingsngewsih bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translation.en: It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?

translation.kha: hynrei ka la bitar ïa u , ka loit phai pat sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem , bad ka sai hangta saw bnai .
translation.en: And his concubine played the whore against him , and went away from him unto her father s house to Beth–lehem–judah , and was there four whole months .

translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u ruh jong u ban set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing khñiang ba kin ym pynsmieij ïa nga . U la leh ïa kane namar u tip ba nga la longkmie umbah lui lui bad namar ba ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba barew ïa Phi , ko Shem Kynrad .
translation.en: My God hath sent his angel , and hath shut the lions  mouths , that they have not hurt me : forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me  ; and also before thee , O king , have I done no hurt .

translation.kha: u la kem im ïa u Agag , u syep Amalek bad u la pynsep ïa ki brai baroh .
translation.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .
And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit phai pat bad ki sha Nasareth , ha kaba u la kohnguh ïa ki . Ka kmie jong u ka la kynshew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh hapoh la ka dohnud .

Phi lah ïa-ban khleiñ sut long phi ai ram ïa u nongthain , ym haba phi ai Rakem ïa la u para Israel , ba kumta U tharai U Blei jong phiah un kerkut kat ïa kaba phi leh ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translation.en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury  ; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la Ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa uta u briew .
translation.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .

translation.kha: Ko khuid u briew , u ong , to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew Meshekh bad Tubal ha ka ri Magog .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,

translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi U Trei ! kawei kaba bha ba kata ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka bynta jong phi kuna long tang ka sngi jong ka jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingai .
translation.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .

translation.kha: Bad kaei kaba ngan ïatyngkhuh ïa me ka long kaba shisha . U angel u la ong , Sa lai ngut ki syiem kin syier khashor ka Persia , yn bud sa uba saw , u banbeiñ kham riewspah ban ïa baroh kiwei pat . Hib u la khlaiñbor bha malu riewpoh eh un kob ïa ka hima Gris .
translation.en: And now will I shew thee the truth . Behold , there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia  ; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all : and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia .
Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .
translation.kha: Mynta hukum ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal bad sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka blei Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .

translation.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .
translation.kha: u da ïaid na shatei jong ka sharing lum jong ka Beth Hoglah , bad u kut ha ka jaka ba ka wah Jordan ka wan tuid ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka Duriaw Baïap . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang shathie .

translation.en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa u hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .

U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ïai-ong , Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u khun jong nga ha ka jingshongkurim . Bad u Judas um shym ïaisah shongkha shuh bad ka .
translation.en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .
The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
translation.kha: Don uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U Trai ; Pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta jong u ban ïaid !’

Haman katba khem kane ka por , u syiem ka Babilonia , u Mithredath Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u la ïohsngew ba u syiem Shekanaïah u pang , kumta u la phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingïoh sngewbha .
translation.en: At that time Merodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah : for he had heard that he had been sick , and was recovered .

translation.kha: U syiem Ahasaïah u la ïap bad la Tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U Asa u khum jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka jingsngur haduh shipa snem .
translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la jingsngewsih ïa kawei pat ka sur na bneng , ka da ong , To mihnoh , ko ki briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ba-bang ïashim bynta ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh bynta ha ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka !
translation.en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .
translation.kha: To ki shnong jong u kin long kiba la ker da ki khyrdop nar , Bad to un shongsuk shongsaiñ borabor .
Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uto uba la lum shibun um shym la don tam keiñ , bad uta uba la lum jingkyndit um shym ïor ïaduna palat .
translation.en: As it is written , He that had gathered much had nothing over ; and he that had gathered little had no lack .
And there followed another angel , saying , Babylon is fallen , is fallen , that great city , because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication .
translation.kha: U angel uba ar u la bud ïa uba nyngkong , u da ong ,  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Ka la pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ kaba khor jong ka jingkwah brai khlem akor !
Kumta u Ïoannis u la longing kylleng ka thain baroh jong ka wah Jordan , u da ïarap , To phai noh na ki ngop jong phi dara to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei’ un map ïa ki pop jyllang phoi .
translation.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;

translation.kha: Lada me leh pop , kata kam ktien ei ei ïa U Blei . Lada bunsien me leh bakla , Hato kata ka ktah ïa u ?
translation.en: If thou sinnest , what doest thou against him ? or if thy transgressions be multiplied , what doest thou unto him ?

And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u . Ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh .
Phi donkam ban juti ïa u kulai , Phi dei ban teh lakam ïa u kada , bad phi dei shun sympat ïa Uba bieit .
translation.en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .
What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .
translation.kha: hynrei ha ka jingshit ki jah noh , bad ki phud wahduid ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .

translation.en: Who smote great nations , and slew mighty kings  ;
translation.kha: U la pynjot bun ki jaitbynriew bad u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba khrawbor :

Ha kata ka par ïa ki lumbah yn tap da ki bnai sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki mar yn shem ha uwei pa uwei u lum ; yn don kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki ïathied baroh ha Judah . Ka wahduid kan tuid na ka Templ jong U tharai , dara kan ai um ïa ka Them Akasia .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the mountains shall drop down new wine , and the hills shall flow with milk , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters , and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the  Lord  , and shall water the valley of Shittim .

translation.kha: Katto Uba kmen u long uta u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u har ïa kane Haba u wan sha ïing !
translation.en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .

translation.kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kjap u la khwai ? Uta uba kham san , ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shaphang ka Hima U Blei ha shuwa jong phi! .
translation.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .

translation.kha: Ko kynthei , balei phan ïam ? ki la ïakylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab , Ki la rah ei ïa U Trai jong nga , bun ngam tip shano ki la buh ïa u !
translation.en: And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .

translation.kha: Kaba byrngia ha ki jingim pahuh , ka waiñ bad ka jingbam lwet kin ym pynpang ïa phiah uba riewspah’ .
translation.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell ;
translation.kha: Naba ka la long da ka jingrai ka jong U Blei hi ba U Khun u la don ha lade hi ïa ka jinglong ba-pura jong U Blei .

translation.en: But Peter said , Ananias , why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost , and to keep back part of the price of the land ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Ananias , balei me la shah ïa u Soitan ban bat synshar ïa me bad pynlong ïa me ban lamler ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid da kaba bat noh katto katne ka pisa kaba me la ïohpdiang na kaba die ïa ka jaka ?

translation.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats  hair .
translation.kha: Ki thir ruh ïa u shñiuh blang .

Tang hadien khyndiat por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lyer ka sdang ban beh mala u slap bajur u sdang ban hap . U Hapoh u shongneh ha ka kila ïam bad u sdang ban leit phai sha Jesreel .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .
Behold , what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us , that we should be called the sons of God : therefore the world knoweth us not , because it knew him not .
translation.kha: Ha khmih haduh katno U Kpa u la ieit ïa ngi ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba ïa ngi la khot ki khun U Blei — bad kumta , ha ka jingshisha , ngi long . Dei kane ba balei ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa ngi : Kam pat la ithuh ïa U Blei .

Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u kdup ba kynja mynsaw bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki la dih na tur u mawsiang ba kynja mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la Long U Kynther hi .
translation.en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Jeroboam .

translation.en: Furthermore then we beseech you , brethren , and exhort you by the Lord Jesus , that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God , so ye would abound more and more .
translation.kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi la ïohnang na ngi kumno phi dei ban im khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei . Kane ka long da shisha , kumno phi la ju im . Bad mynta ngi kyrpad bad kyntu ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh kham bha shuh shuh .
kiba long ki Khlieh jong ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Ladan . ( U Shimei u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shelomoth , u Hasiel , bad u Haman . )
translation.en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .

translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada lad u symboh , babha la ioh hukum ban pyndep ïa ka jingpyndap . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
translation.en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :

translation.kha: Ki la tim ïa u bad ki da ïa-ong , Me Long u synran jong une u bariew : Hynrei , ngi Long ki synran u Moses .
translation.en: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple  ; but we are Moses  disciples .

translation.kha: Jaban mynsiem , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem babha ki la pynpang , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .
translation.en: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,

translation.kha: Nalorkata Nga ñiew ïa U Blei kum u sakhi jongno nga — u tap ïa ka dohnud jong por ! Ka longsyiem na ka bniat ban ïada ïa phi! ba to la rai ban ym leit sha Kynthei .
translation.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul , that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth .

translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha Antiokh , Bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut ki la ïakynduh ïa ki briew ka balang bad ki la hikai ïa ka kynhun kaba heh . Ka la long ha Antiokh ba ïa ki pynphalang la khot nyngkong eh Ki Khristan .
translation.en: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .
And the scribe said unto him , Well , Master , thou hast said the truth : for there is one God  ; and there is none other but he :
translation.kha: Uta u nonghikai ka Hukum u la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Kaba dei , ko Nonghikai ! Ka long kaba shisha , kumba me la ong , ba tang U Trai u long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ma u .
( U Jisu u la lah tip lypa uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa u ; na katai ka daw balei u la ong , Baroh na phi , lait noh uwei , phi long ibha khuid . )
translation.en: For he knew who should betray him  ; therefore said he ,  Ye are not all clean .
And upon all the ships of Tarshish , and upon all pleasant pictures .
translation.kha: Un pynngam wat ïa ki liengbah kiba khraw bad kiba itynnat tam .

translation.en: Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .
translation.kha: To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko  Trai  ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa ka burom ba-mynbarim .
Shibun ki briew , ki ban kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , ktang wan bad ong , ‘ Nga lama ma u !’ bad kin shukor ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
And he took them , and sent them over the brook , and sent over that he had .
translation.kha: Ynda u la phah ïa ki sha shiliang , u la phah ruh sha shiliang ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ,
Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit sah noh ha ka ïing jong u Jenesis uba kyrteng u Titius Justos , uba mane ïa U Blei ; ka ïing jong u ka don ha syndah jong ka synagog .
translation.en: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .

translation.kha: Khatsaw sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun kynthei , kuna long ka bymjukut kumne ha ka por ba ka poi bna . Nangta kan shim por pat sa hynriewphew hynriew sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid beiñ na ka jingmihsnam .
translation.en: But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .
These things said he : and after that he saith unto them ,  Our friend Lazarus sleepeth  ; but I go , that I may awake him out of sleep .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane bad nangta u pynbud ,  U paralok jong ngi u Lasaros u la ïohthiah , hynrei ngan leit bad ngan kyrsiew noh ïa u .

translation.en: Also Jeshua , and Bani , and Sherebiah , Jamin , Akkub , Shabbethai , Hodijah , Maaseiah , Kelita , Azariah , Jozabad , Hanan , Pelaiah , and the Levites , caused the people to understand the law : and the people stood in their place .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka , bad kine ki Lebi ki batai ïa ka Hukum ha ki : u Jeshua , u Bani , u Sherebaïah , u Jamin , u Akkub , u Shabbethai , u Hodaïah , u Maaseïah , u Kelita , u Asaraïah , u Josabad , u Hanan , bad u Pelaïah .
une uno u lyngdoh um lah ban shongkurim ïa ka briew ba la iehnoh tnga ; un jingshongkurim Tang ïa ka isaitmet Israel lane ïa ka riewkynthei jong utai pat u lyngdoh .
translation.en: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow , nor her that is put away : but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel , or a widow that had a priest before .

And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ngan kut ka jingduwai bajar jar jong nga , ka Rebekka ka la wan bad u khiew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka bad ka la leit hiar sha kata ka pukri ban tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba ngan dih .’

Ka long ka jingduh jingkyrmen ! Nga long kum u briew umbah thngan uba shem ba ym don soh ba dang sah ha ki dieng bad ym khong sohwaiñ ha ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ïa baroh ki sohwaiñ bad baroh ki soh Dumbur ba-bang la kheit lut .
translation.en: Woe is me ! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa lad u sha u Iso u tymmen jong u ha ri Edom .
translation.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .
And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la lah ïap . U la khot ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la kylli ïa u la U Jisu u la lah ïap la slem .
Ka pyrthei hi kan khih khem u nongbuaid bad khih shane bad sharati kum ka ïohpateng ha ka erïong . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynkhia da ki pop jong ka ; kan khyllem bad kan ym lah khie khlieh shuh .
translation.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard , and shall be removed like a cottage  ; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it  ; and it shall fall , and not rise again .
Praise ye the  Lord  : for it is good to sing praises unto our God  ; for it is pleasant  ; and praise is comely .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka long kaba bha ban rwai ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi ; ka long kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phi dei ban shadkmen , bad ïasam bynta lak ïa ka jingkmen jong phi sad per .
translation.en: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .

translation.kha: Pynnep ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , bad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynkhleh ban ïada ïa lai ; ïa kiei Kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !
translation.en: Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .

translation.kha: U nongsharai balang u dei ban longïng u me don jingïashad kynnoh pop ; u Dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit bad ki i don jingbudnam ba ki longïing kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .
translation.en: If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .

translation.kha: Nangta u maham ïa ki ha ka jingtah bad u pyntriem ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla jong u .
translation.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath , and vex them in his sore displeasure .

translation.kha: Kata ka dei kamai ba ki kpa jongnga phi ki la leh haba ang la phah ïa ki na Kadesh Baana ban leit swar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Thus did your fathers , when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land .
He answered and said unto them ,  Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa ka jingtip shaphang kiei kiei kiba rieh jong ka Hima ki Bneng la ai ha phi , hynrei ym ha ki .

translation.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool : much less do lying lips a prince .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba donburom kim ju kren ïa kaba lamler , bad kiba bieit kim don ei ei kaba dondor ban ong .
Ki lyngkhot , ki nonghiarpateng , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa kine kiew kiei ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Naduh bad u Abinoam , ki kynhun shynrang jong u Aaron , ki shngiam ïa la ki khiew thang jingiwbih , ki buh rnga tdong ha ki , ki thang ïa ka jingiwbih hangta , bad ki kñia ingiew ïa ka ha U Trai . Hynrei kane ka ding ka long ka bymkhuid , namar U Trai um shitrhem la hukum ïa ki ban leh kumta .
translation.en: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .

translation.kha: Aroer , Shelomith , Eshtemoa ,
translation.en: And to them which were in Aroer , and to them which were in Siphmoth , and to them which were in Eshtemoa ,

translation.kha: Me den ban sngewthuh ba U Trai u la ieid ïa me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jongngi u . Mynta leh ïa kata — bad ai ïa kata da ka olib jingmut baskhem .
translation.en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .

translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la poi hajan kata ka jaka sher dara na kaba u ïohi ïa uta u khun masi bad ïa ka jingïada jong kita ki paidbah , u Moses u bitar lem . Hangta ha tei u lum , u lynthaw ïa Us ki mawlyngkniap kiba u rah haduh ba ki da pait .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses  anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .

translation.kha: baroh kob la shna da ka rupa , ka ksar , ka rnong lane ka nar , la bthuh keirang na ka bynta U Tlai . Dei Ban buh ïa said ha ka ïohnong jingkynshew U Trai .
translation.en: But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka phyllaw kaba ïaleh ka long kham hapoh ban ïa ka phyllaw kambah hapoh . Ka la don ka khyrdop khim hajrong kiba lam sha ka phlait kaba hapoh .
translation.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement .
Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel  ; and David went down , and his servants with him , and fought against the Philistines : and David waxed faint .
translation.kha: Ka la don sa kawei ka thma hapdeng ki Philistia bad ki Israel , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit bad ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kawei ka thma u Dabid u khie tlot .

translation.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul bad ki briew jong u ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewsheptieng her .
Ban ïoh ïa u soh Uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba shipai , phin ïoh u soh uba sniew . Ïa u dien la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmeh .
translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .
And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
translation.kha: bad u Ahio u ïaid na khmat .
Nga Dem khroh da pyllup ha madan , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Blei u rung hapoh jong nga bad u pynïeng ïa nga . U Trai u la ino ha de : Khie loit sha ïing dara set khop ïa lade hapoh ïing .
translation.en: Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .

And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki khuri jong u syiem Solomon la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ha ki sngi u Solomon ïa ka rupa ym pat ñiew kaba kordor .

translation.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .
translation.kha: Naba ka long da ka jingngeit jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei ; ka long da ka jingphla jong ngi ba ïa ngi la pynim .

translation.en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish–bosheth , and said , Am I a dog s head , which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father , to his brethren , and to his friends , and have not delivered thee into the hand of David , that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar lep ïa u Abner ,  Me tharai ba ngan shetkylla ïa u Saul ? Me tharai shisha ba nga shakri ïa ki Judah ?  u ong .  Naduh mynnyngkong , nga la ïaineh skhem na ka bynta u Saul u kpa jong me , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki paralok jong u , bad nga da ïa me na kaba shahjop ha u Dabid ; pynban ha kane ka sngi me wad dong ïa nga shaphang ka kynthei !

translation.en: When I therefore was thus minded , did I use lightness ? or the things that I purpose , do I purpose according to the flesh , that with me there should be yea yea , and nay nay ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jingthmu , hato nga i kum u bymneh jingmut ? Haba nga pynlong ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , hato nga leh ïa ki da ki jingthmu ba khwan myntoi , kum uba la kloi ban ong  Ho-oid , ho-oid  bad  Em , em  ha kajuh ka por ?
Te u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U Blei dara u ong , Kumno sam haka baneh shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad nga mynta ?
translation.en: And David was afraid of God that day , saying , How shall I bring the ark of God home to me ?
For as touching the ministering to the saints , it is superfluous for me to write to you :
translation.kha: Kam da donkam shisha ïa nga ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïarap ïa kaba dang ïai phah sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .

translation.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner  ; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .
translation.kha: u la sdang ban beh kthong ïa u Abner , u da mareh beit beit sha u .

U Trai u ong ha u Joshua , Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynjrong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin ieh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me kumba la la long bad u Moses .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .

translation.kha: hynrei ha Kine ki snieh kiba khatduh u la kren ha ngi liengbah U Khun jong u . U la long uta da uba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uta ïa uba U Blei! u la jied ïa-ban hir u nongïoh kynti ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kaba kut .
translation.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds  ;

translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum ïa baroh ki nongwei baroh kiba shong basah ha Ri Israel ban ïalumlang , bad u pyntylli ïa ki . Katto katne na ki , ki shna ïa ki mawkynroh banbeiñ tei ïa ka Tabor .
translation.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel  ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .

translation.kha: Nangta shah ba ngan leit phai pat shata ïingjaiñ bad ban ïarap hajan ka jingtep jong i mei pynlang i pa jong nga . un hangne u Shimham , u khun jong nga , u ban shakri ïa phiah ; shim ïa u bad phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ; bad leh na ka bynta jong u katba phi pyrkhat kaba Bha tam .
translation.en: Let thy servant , I pray thee , turn back again , that I may die in mine own city , and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother . But behold thy servant Chimham  ; let him go over with my lord the king  ; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee .
And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpule na ka Hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah synshar jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki :  Ko hynmen ko para , ngi kwah ïa phi ban kren ha u paidbah lada phi don ka khubor ai mynsiem na ka bynta jong ki .
U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai badno um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa lai ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba klun ïa ka ktien U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngap jar bad um ong shikatdei ruh . U Rabbah lyngngeit u la kylli biang ïa u , Hato me long U Jeshaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?
translation.en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?

For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .
translation.kha: Kumba ki patlun lyngkot ki biang sbiak sawdong ka syngkai , kumta nga la thmu ba baroh ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah kin snoh skhem ha nga . Nga la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad wallam ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; hynrei kim shym kohnguh ïa nga .
Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka rnong , bad ki khohwah jrong u ki long kum ki shongkai namar .
translation.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .

He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynkut noh ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong baroh bad un weng noh ïa ka jingjahburom kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren !
Wat kular ban kitkhlieh na ka bynta ki ram jong kiwei pat .
translation.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .
Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade , and mine arm be broken from the bone .
translation.kha: te to ai ba yn kdiah ïa ki kti jong nga ; to ai ba yn sloit ïa ki na ki tyrpeng jong nga .

translation.en: And there came a messenger to David , saying , The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  Ki Israel ki la ïakular ban ai jingkyrshan noh ïa u Absalom .
Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha khyndew bad ngan wanrah ïa ki sim bun ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabuh ïa ka doh jong me .
translation.en: Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .
Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha kiba ngeit , katba ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka long ka jingpynshisha ïa kiba ngeit , ym ïa ki bymngeit .
Ki paid Ishmael ki khot ïa kata ka jingbang , ka manna . Ka long kum u shabi banleh uba rit , malade ka jingshim kumno u kpu lyngkniap ba la shat bad ka ngop .
translation.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed , white  ; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey .

translation.kha: Te ngan kynja ban ïarap ïa ki namar ba ki la leh pyrman pynlang mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .

translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ïa-ei , U briew uba shongksuid um da ban krung kamon ! Kumno u Ksuid u lah ban ai jingïoh imat pat ïa ki briew kiba matsohlah ?
translation.en: Others said , These are not the words of him that hath a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un leit bneng bad khmih babha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translation.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day , and shall look : and , behold , if the plague be spread in the walls of the house  ;

translation.kha: Ki synrap ki la king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um , u la na wan shata jan ka lyngki , bad ki la sngewtriem .
translation.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .

translation.kha: U Blei u la khang ïa ka lyndet , bad ngam haw ban ïaid lyngba ; u la buhrieh ïa ka lynti jong nga ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .
Cast me not off in the time of old age  ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .
translation.kha: Wat kyntait ïa nga mynta ba nga la tymmen ; wat iehnoh ïa nga mynta ba nga la tlot .

U Joseph kum u laiñ jong ka ri Ijipt u die kew ha ki bhabriew kiba wan na kylleng ka pyrem . Kumta ki hynmen shaneng jong u Joseph ki la ïalang bad nguh ngon ha Khmut jong u , ki da pynmeh la ki khmat sha khyndew .
translation.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land , and he it was that sold to all the people of the land : and Joseph s brethren came , and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth .
And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .
Ko ki khup jong nga , to ïashukor ïa kadei ba u kpa jong phi u hikai ïa Phi . Shahshkor bha , bad phin ïoh ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !
translation.kha: Ym don myntor , ym don jingleh byrtong , Kaba lah ban pyndonkam pyrshah ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Mynta ki briew kin ïakren shaphang ki Israel , ‘ Khmih aïu U Blei u la leh !’
Ka peit bniah ïa ka lyngkha bad ka thied ïa ka , bad da ka kamai ba ka ïor ka thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ka brisoh .
translation.en: She considereth a field , and buyeth it : with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .

And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of them that seek their life , and into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which are gone up from you .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u sha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ngan aiti ïa ki sha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , kaba la sangeh ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .
Lada lap ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongneh bad ka tnga jyllang uwei pat u briew , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shah pynïap , bad kumta phin pynduh ne ïa kane ka jingbymman na Jesreel .
translation.en: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .

translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ka jingud kiba duk , ïa ka jingkyang jingïaroh jong Phin hi yn ym ei ba jingïashoh .
translation.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor , he also shall cry himself , but shall not be heard .

translation.kha: U Josis u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah sha Bethania , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .
translation.en: And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .
But if ye will not hearken unto me , and will not do all these commandments  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin shah pynshitom .

translation.en: All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .
translation.kha: Lada mano mano , u briew ne ka briew , u ban leit sha ka jaka ba kham shapoh ka phyllaw u syiem bad leit ïakynduh ïa u khlem shah khot , un ïap . Kata ka dei ka aiñ ; naduh ki nongai jingmut u syiem haduh ki riewpaidbah jong ki jylla , ki tip ïa kata . Ka don tang kawei ka lynti ban lait na kane ka aiñ : lada u syiem u pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ïano ïano , tang kata ka ban pyllait im ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka la long mynta shi bnai ba u syiem u la phah khot ïa nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
translation.kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .

translation.en: Then I commanded , and they cleansed the chambers : and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God , with the meat offering and the frankincense .
translation.kha: Nga ai hukum ban leh ka jinglehniam jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa ki kamra bad ïa ki tiar ki tar ka Templ , jingkñia jingbam , bad ki jingiwbih ban buh pat hangta .
Haba u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka khamtam bad u ïap .
translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .

translation.kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shithi sha u Jehoram , kob ong kumto harum : U Tiras , U Blei jong u Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem shym buiñ ïa ki nuksa u syep Jehoshaphat , u kpu jrong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u kparad jong me .
translation.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,

translation.kha: Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak , Khie sien ! U Trai u ïalamwir ïa me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjop halor u Sisera . Kumta u Bakhraw u la leit arsut na u Lum thalab lem bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .
translation.kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bitar ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis .
U dieng Khubor , ko parabangeit Jong nga , um lah ban sei ïa ki shuh Olib ; ne u dieng sohwaiñ um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Dumbur , Leummim ka umpohliew mluh kam lah ban pynmih ïa ka um ka bang .
translation.en: Can the fig tree , my brethren , bear olive berries ? either a vine , figs ? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban shimet noh shajrong ïa u , u la ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki ngab bakha u la jied kumta ki apostol jong u .
translation.en: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :

translation.kha: U Terah u la kren ha nga :
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka khlam ha pa kum kata kob ang la phah ha Ijipt . Nga la pynïap ïa ki samla shyieng jong phin ha ka thma bad nga la kyntiew noh ïa ki kular jong ph . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jong Phin da ka jingiwtung ki tapmoh ha ki jaka shong dara jong pa . Kato shiah Phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translation.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: na lehkmen ha ka pyrthei , bad lai sngewbha bad ki jingriewblei .
translation.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth  ; and my delights were with the sons of men .
Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la shah ïa ka jingshitom kaba la dei hok ïa ngi , ka jingpang kaba ngi la dei ban shah . Baroh shi katta ngi la pyrkhat ba ki jingshitom jong u ki la long ki jingpynshitom ba la phah da U Blei .
To U Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ha ka longkmie u Onesiphoros , namar ba u la pynrkhiang ïa nga bunsien .
translation.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus ; for he oft refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain :
Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to ïai ainguh borabor na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh sha U Blei uba U Kpa .

Lai snem ka jingkyrduh bam ? Lane , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? Lane lai sngur ha kaba U Trai u tur ïaleh ïa me da ka waitlam malu phah ka jingïapthem halor ka ri jong me , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u ruh jong u ban wallam ka jingïap ha kylleng ka Israel ? kawei ka jubab ba Ngan ai ha U Trei ?
translation.en: Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .
translation.kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynshitom beiñ ïa nga da ki jinglamler — A ïarap ïa nga !

Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingpynkheiñ jutang jong phi , bad lada phi wad jingïadoh da kaba ïalumlang ha la ki shnong , ngan phah ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah hapdeng jongngi Phi mala phan hap pyndem ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .

translation.kha: Man ka sngi u Mordekai u ju ïaid sharum haneng ha khmat ka phyllaw ka ïong ki kynthei , khnang ban tip kumno ka long bad kaei ka ban jied ïa ka .
translation.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .
For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata kaba da sang eh ka dei ban shah pynshitom da ka jingïap .

Nalor kine baroh , ko parabangeit jongngi nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingaimynsiem haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smam da ka bneng ne da ka khiew ne da kaei kaei pat . Shu ong Ho-oid haba phi mut ho-oid , bad Em haba phi mut em , bad pien ym thap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .
translation.en: But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglah , u briew uba thaw ïa ki khiew u don ka hok baneh pyndonkam ïa ka dewbyrtha katba u kwah , bad ban thaw ar tylli ki khie na kawei ka lyngngun dewryngkhiang , ïa uwei na ka bynta ki por bakyrpang bad ïa uwei pateng na ka bynta ka jingpynksan paidbah .
translation.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?

translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng Asekah bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .

translation.kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumno , bad ki ïa-ïeng para ma ki , Ho-oid , mynta ngi shahshkor jynjar namar kai kaba ngi la ar ïa la u jong u na . Ngi la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad Ngam shym la shahshkor . Dei namar kata ba ngi shat jynjar kamut mynta .
translation.en: And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar ïa ki Israel sa shisnem , bad kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ngab wanrah jingjynjar halor jong ki . U Trai u ong ha u , Khie leit bad ñiar ïa ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .
translation.en: And again the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he moved David against them to say , Go , number Israel and Judah .
I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , uba itynnat , da ka jingpyiar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei .

Haba u syier ka Arad , u nong Kanaan uba shong shaneng shathie ka ri Kanaan , u la jingïohknieh ba ki Israel ki wan ïaid lynnong na sanphew Ithamar , u la tat ïaleh ïa ki bad u la ïohkem katei katne ngut na ki .
translation.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite , which dwelt in the south , heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies  ; then he fought against Israel , and took some of them prisoners .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko khun jrong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei kaba dei ka jong ngi ha U Khrist jongu .
translation.en: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
Kumta ki la kem ïa u , bad ki la bret ïa u sawar ka bri sohwaiñ , bad ki la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And they caught him , and cast him out of the vineyard , and slew him .

translation.kha: Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , ha kaweh U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u samla ïa la ki briew , phan long pait sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima-patsha kaba la ju long ka jong Phah .
translation.en: And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .

For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .
translation.kha: Ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba im bad kaba donbor , kaba kham nep ban ïa kano kano ka waitlam arliang syrti . bad uwei na ki , u nonghikai ka Hukum , u la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da ka jingkylli .

translation.en: They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .

translation.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .

translation.en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .

translation.kha: Uba bieit u kren bieit bad u pyrkhat ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Kaei kaba u leh bad kaei kaba u ong ka long ka jingibeiñ ïa U  Trai  , bad um ju bsa ïa kiba thngan lane um ju ai ka jingdih ïa kiba sliang .
Hato me pyrshang ban ïadoh ïa u ? Hato men leit baneh ïasaid ïa ka kur jong u ha ka jingpynhiar ?
translation.en: Will ye accept his person ? will ye contend for God ?
Through desire a man , having separated himself , seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym ïadei bad kiwei ki pyrkhat tang ïa lade ; kin ym ïahap bad kaei kaba baroh ki tip ba ka long kaba dei .

translation.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak , Told not I thee , saying , All that the  Lord  speaketh , that I must do ?

translation.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans , The thing is gone from me : if ye will not make known unto me the dream , with the interpretation thereof , ye shall be cut in pieces , and your houses shall be made a dunghill .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la ithuh ba u daym u Jiw , ki la ïa-pyndap lang ïa kajuh haduh ar kynta : Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis lad ka Ephesos !
translation.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai  , bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; ym dei ban die mraw ïa ki .
Hangta un kynting shai da ki ar tylli ki maw , uwei na ka bynta U Trai bad uwei pat na ka bynta u Asasel .
translation.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats  ; one lot for the  Lord  , and the other lot for the scapegoat .
And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .
translation.kha: Hadien u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel shiphew snem .

Ka nongleitkurim ka dat ka jong u nongleitkurim ; hynrei u paralok jong u nongleitkurim , uba ïeng marsyndah Bad shahshkor , u kmiesan haba u ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u nongpynshitom . Kainan ka long kumno ba ïa ka jingkmen jong nga la pyndap pura .
translation.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom : but the friend of the bridegroom , which standeth and heareth him , rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom s voice : this my joy therefore is fulfilled .

translation.kha: Ka jubab , Sha ba u Adonijah , u hynmen jong me un ïoh ïa ka Abishua kamon ka tnat jong u .
translation.en: And she said , Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife .

translation.kha: Mane ka step haba u Aaron u wan ban pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u Dei ban thang ïa ka jingibieit halor jong ka .
translation.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .
And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .
translation.kha: Kumta u kynrad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Khie leit sha ki lynti bah ha rudnong bad sha ki lynti khim bad ïawer ïa ki briew ban wan shapoh khnang ba ka ïing jong nga kan dap .
U her stet halor ki Kherub u ïaid halor ki thapniang jongu ka lyer .
translation.en: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .

translation.kha: U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: To lutphut ïa ka rupa ! To lute ïa ka kiar ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !
translation.en: Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .
When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .
U Paul u la noh , Nga ainong ha khmat ka kamra bishar ka jong u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar ïa nga . Ngam syiem leh Kanah kano kaba bakla ïa ki Jisu , kumba me hi me tip bha .
translation.en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
And the woman said to Elijah , Now by this I know that thou art a man of God , and that the word of the  Lord  in thy mouth is truth .
translation.kha: Ka la jubab ,  Mynta nga tip ba me long u briew jong U Blei , bad ba U  Trai  da shisha u kren lyngba jong me !
Kito kiba ha Judah uba lait im kin rieh kum ki jingong kiba ki thied ki sam jylliew ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kyrhuh ïa u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh bad u la ai ha u ïa ka nongbah Hebron kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: And Joshua blessed him , and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Mynta , khie ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynjrong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , Ong U Trai : Neng buh ïa ki hukum jong nga ha ki jingmut jongno ki , bad ngan thop ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jngai ki , mala ki kmen long u paidlang jongu nga .
translation.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing kiba kyrhuh halor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh bad ki jingdon jingem kat kaba ki lah ban ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap brai ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .
translation.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Pynban , kaei kaba dang sah ka long ban ap da ka jingsheptieng ïa ka Jingjynjar ka ban sa wiang bad ïa ka ding kaba klang ka ban sa bam duh ïa kita kiba ïaleh pyrda ïa U Blei !
translation.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .

translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei ka ban pynsawa ïa said ha phi : Phin shem ïa u khunlung uba la sop da ki jaiñsop bad uba thiah ha ka jingsyiad .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto you  ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khyrdop Jerikho la khang khop bad la ap phra ban ym ïuhroit ki Israel . Ym don mano mano ba la ban rung shapoh lane maw baher ka nongbah .
translation.en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel : none went out , and none came in .

translation.kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ha u sahmiet , Haseroth phi pyrkhat ba ka dei na ka bynta ka burom jongngi u khap jongngi phi ba u Dabid u la pha ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Ym kumta da shisha ! U la phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban swar ïa ka nongbah , ba kumta u lah ban jop ïa ngi !
translation.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee , to search the city , and to spy it out , and to overthrow it ?

And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ba ki la sdang ban ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei kane ? Hato ka dei ka jait jinghikai thymmai ? Une u briew u don ka bor ban ai hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !
Mynta kumne kumne phan sa sngew ïa ka bor jingbitar jong nga barhem . Ngam bishar ïa pha kat kum khie kiei kiba pha la bor , bad pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kdew ba-ijli jong Pha baroh .
translation.en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .

translation.kha: “Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban Trei jingtrei , hynrei wat trei ei ei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , wat la ka long ha ka aïom lur ne ka aïom ot .
translation.en: Six days thou shalt work , but on the seventh day thou shalt rest : in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest .

translation.kha: U Trai u nong kumne ha ki paid Jeriel , wiang sha at , malu phin ïoh im .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the house of Israel , Seek ye me , and ye shall live :
The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .
translation.kha: Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba lah , hynrei ki pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynlehrain ïa ki .
Minnith , ko Job , to shahshkor ïa kaei ka nga ïa-ong ; long jar jar bad shah ba ngan kren .
translation.en: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na kita ki jingkah baroh ar tylli .

translation.en: But what I do , that I will do , that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion ; that wherein they glory , they may be found even as we .

translation.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .
