And she said unto her , Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son s mandrakes also ? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son s mandrakes .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka jubab ,  Hato pham pat sngewhun ba pha la knieh noh ïa u tnga jong nga ? Mynta pat pha pyrshang ban shim sa ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong nga .  Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  Lada phan ai ïa nga ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha , pha lah ban thiah bad u Jakob mynta ka miet .
Bad phi hi phi tip , kumno u la pynshah ïa ka jingker jong u , kumno ma u bad ma nga , kum u khun bad u kpa jongno u , ngi la ïatreilang na ka byndi ka Gospel .
translation.en: But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha U Jehu , To kynmaw ïa nga , ko Jisu , haba me wan kum u Syiem !
translation.en: And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .
translation.kha: Ki kynthei ki dei ban nang ban sngap jar bad da ka jingsngewrit baroh .
U pynbeit ïa ki briew ka tyrtho badno Sidon ban wanlam sha u shibun ki dieng Kedesh tylli .
translation.en: Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .

translation.kha: Ma nga U Trai , ang pham ïa me ba-bang ym shukor ïa lade da kaba pyrkhat ba ki nong Babilonia Kin ym woh shuh , namar kin sa wan biang .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .

And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt sha ka jaka kaba sniew kum kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei ruh um mih ? Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba u kew ruh um long , u soh Dumbur ruh um long , u sohwaiñ ruh um long , bad u soh Pomkranet ruh um long . Wat ka umdih ruh kam don !
Lada phi ngai kynruh ïa ka dud , ka pynmih makhon . Lada phi tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongngi , ka pynmih snam . Lada phi pynkhih ïa ka jingtah , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .

translation.kha: khlem da peiphang ei ei ka mut aiñ kano baroh ; thrang u Hannathon bad u Dabid ki tip .
translation.en: But the lad knew not any thing : only Jonathan and David knew the matter .
Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened , and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped .
translation.kha: Kiba matlah kin lah ban ïohi , bad kiba kyllut kin ïohsngew .

translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
translation.kha: Lada phi wan poi ha ka shnong kaba ki briew kim khot sngewbha ïa phi lane kim sngap ïa phi , mihnoh na ka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi . Kata kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki !
Ki rangbah jong ka Anathoth ki la kwah ïa nga shun shah pynïap , bad ki la ong ïa nga ba kin pynïap ïa nga ïada nga dang ïai pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of the men of Anathoth , that seek thy life , saying , Prophesy not in the name of the  Lord  , that thou die not by our hand :
Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .
translation.kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade bad ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .
Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïohi ïa ka sngi lane ïa ki khlaw , bad ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh ngi la haduh jingkyrmen ïa ka ban lait im .
translation.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .

translation.kha: Haba u la kren , ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong ; ha ka hukum jong u baroh ka la thop .
translation.en: For he spake , and it was done  ; he commanded , and it stood fast .

translation.kha: To pli ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad to ai ba ka jaitbynriew baïaineh kan rung , ka jaitbynriew kaba ki briew jong ka , ki ai ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Open ye the gates , that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in .

translation.kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade , Un ym pynshitom ïa de ?
translation.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .

translation.kha: Ynda kita ki nonglamktien ki la wan pah pat sha u Jakob , ki ong , Ngi la leit ïashem ïa u Ono u bymman jong phi , bad u la don ha lynti ban ïan ïashem ïa phi . U don sawspah ngut ki rangbah bad u .
translation.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying , We came to thy brother Esau , and also he cometh to meet thee , and four hundred men with him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngkha bad baroh katba synreit ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki Adadah na sakma ka jaka , ki la bishni shikatdei eh ïa ki apostol ; kumta ki la kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .
translation.en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,

translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Israel u ong , Baroh shi sngi nga la rah ïa la ki kti ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: But to Israel he saith , All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people .
And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba san phi lah ban bam ïa u soh . Lada phi leh ïa kane baroh , ki diengsoh jong phi kin seisoh kham bun . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Bad kad ai ïa u baneh pynngeit ïa phi ban shaniah ha U Tharai . Wat pyrkhat ba U Trai un pyllait ïa phi bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ki shipai Asaraïah na kaba knieh ei ïa ka nongjop jngai phi .
translation.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us : this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad dei ban ba-im noh ha kata hi ka sngem ba la kñi ïa u ; ym dei ngab pynsah wat tang khyndiat ruh haduh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered  ; he shall not leave any of it until the morning .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khup kynïan jong phi yn ai khong kumin ki mraw ha ki nongdie katne phi pat Phi shu peit . Man ka sngi phi pynshitom sat ïa la ki khat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei! ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phai pat .
translation.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
But they cried , saying , Crucify him , crucify him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la pyrta biang ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !
Mynta ki nongtih Ishmael ki la ïalam ïa u Joseph sha ka ri Ijipt bad ki die ïa u ha u Sipporah , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jongnga u syiem , uba long u kapten jong kiba ap pher ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt  ; and Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh , captain of the guard , an Egyptian , bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites , which had brought him down thither .
Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  Ha kane ka por balyngkot , hato me pyrkhat ba men pynlong Khristan ïa nga ?

translation.en: He that smiteth a man , so that he die , shall be surely put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u parabriew kat haduh ba un da ïap u dei ban shah pynïap .
Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym khong mynhyndai nongmareh de shahshitom na ka bniat jong phi ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi barben .
translation.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .

translation.kha: Ho-oid bashisha , u Petros u la jingjubab . Haba u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong , Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mane ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki thynrang jongnga ka ri ne ki nongwei ?
translation.en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?

translation.kha: Kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem , u Hilkaïah bad Kiwei ki kitei ïakhlaiñ bad ka kynïan kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongpynkhiah kaba sah ha ki bynta ba khnam thlim jongki ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jngai u Tikbah bad u khun ksiew jong u Horesh , ki long kiba sumar ïa ki jaiñkup ha ka Templ . )
translation.en: And Hilkiah , and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath , the son of Hasrah , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college : ) and they spake to her to that effect .

translation.kha: “lada ki kohnguh ïa U Blang bad shakri ïa u , kin pynleit ïa ka jingim jong ki ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingmanbha .
translation.en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .
And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah kin plie baroh shi sngi ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lei , namar yn ym don ka miet hangta .
Man ka step malade man ka janmiet kin thang tylli ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan kat kum ba la thoh ha ka Hukum kumba U tharai u la ai ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;

translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki briew kiba u la khop , ym tang napdeng ki Jiw hawei napdeng ki Jentil ruh .
translation.en: Even us , whom he hath called , not of the Jews only , but also of the Gentiles ?

translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingshim bymjukut — phi kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Bela .
translation.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .

translation.kha: Ha kano Kana ka to ba phi ïoh ka kabu , leh ïa kaba bha ïa Kito kiba donakor ïa ka .
translation.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .
Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  , phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi ki jait jong ka Israel .
haduh lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shiphew hajar kilo u keiñ , ar hajar litar ka waiñ , ar hajar litar ka umphniang Olib , bad katsha donbok ka mluh .
translation.en: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .
And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ki ,

translation.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingud jong nga ; ym don mano mano ban pyntngen ïa nga . Ki nongshun jong nga ki kmen ba me la wallam ka jingjot halor jong nga . To wallam ïa ka sngi kaba me la kular ; to pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban shahshitom kum ma nga .

translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings , and his anger was kindled greatly .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kane , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u wan ha u da ka bor , bad u bitar lep .

translation.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw , ki la rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai banyngkong jong ka snem kaba bud .
Katba dang sei ïa ka pisa na ka dik kynshew , u Hilkaïah u shem ïa ka blad jong ka Hukum jong U Trai , ka Hukum kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  , Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the  Lord  given by Moses .

translation.kha: U Shimiet u jubab , Lada uno uno u byrngem ïa pha , wan ïalam ïa u sha nga , bad un ym pynwit shuh ïa pham lano lane .
translation.en: And the king said , Whosoever saith ought unto thee , bring him to me , and he shall not touch thee any more .

translation.kha: Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long uta uba pynrit ïa lade bad uba longïng kum eit u khynñiat .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .

And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: La ai ha ki ka jingkitkhlieh ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ka Templ , bad ban ïarap ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , ha ka jingmane ha ka Templ .

Hato U Trai un sngewbha lada nga wallam sha u da ki hajar ki langbrot lane da ka umphniang Olib kaba tuid khlem kut ? Hato ngan ai ha u da u khum nyngkong jong nga ban siew na ka bynta ki pop jong nga ?
translation.en: Will the  Lord  be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?

translation.kha: Don kiwei paw ki langbrot ki bym dei na kane ka sem langbrot . Nga dei ban wallam ïa ki ruh ; kin shahshkor ïa ka prie jong nga , bad kin ïalong kawei ka kynhun langbrot bad uwei u nongaplangbrot .
translation.en: And other sheep I have , which are not of this fold : them also I must bring , and they shall hear my voice  ; and there shall be one fold , and one shepherd .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh , ong u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingjam jong ka . Ym don man mynshem na ki nongai jingat na ka ïingsyiem jong nga Ibbah lah ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jongno me .
translation.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .
Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat uwei u khynnah u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïing jong uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka pukri hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .

U Kpa jongngi nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don moi mano ba ithuh ïa U Khun mait tang U Ka , bad ym don mano mian ba ithuh ïa U Kpa lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jakoid baneh pynpaw ïa u .
translation.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father : and no man knoweth the Son , but the Father  ; neither knoweth any man the Father , save the Son , and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .

And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal  ; and , behold , I will come down unto thee , to offer burnt offerings , and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings : seven days shalt thou tarry , till I come to thee , and shew thee what thou shalt do .
translation.kha: Men nang leit sha khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ap hangta hynñiew sngi haduh ba ngan da wan bad ïathuh ha me kaei ba men leh .
Kane baroh ka pynshisha ba ka jingbishar ka jong U Blei ka long kaweh hok , bad kumta phin lama babha bit na ka boitha ka Hima jong u , katba na ka bynta jong ka Phin shahshitom .
translation.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
And he said , Hear now my words : If there be a prophet among you , I the  Lord  will make myself known unto him in a vision , and will speak unto him in a dream .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Mynta sngap aïu ngan ong ! Haba don ki nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , nga pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ka jingïohipaw bad nga kren ha ki ha ki jingphohsniew .
U pynshaitbor ïa kito Kiba sleh bad kiba thait .
translation.en: He giveth power to the faint  ; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength .

translation.kha: U Akhbor u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ïong ha u . U dem ha la ka jingthiah , u pei Shaphang ka kynroh , bad um treh bah ei ei .
translation.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .

translation.kha: Kane ka hir ka jingong kaba sha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad Ban ngeit .
translation.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation .

translation.kha: Phi dak sngewlyngngoh , ko ki para jongngi nga , lada ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki isih ïa phi .
translation.en: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .

translation.kha: Kut , te , me la dei don thep ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa , bad kun jin da la iohpateng ïa ka baroh lem bad ka sut haba ang la wan phai .
translation.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers , and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury .

translation.kha: Buh hangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki Shiphew Hukum , bad kah ïa ka da ka pyrda .
translation.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony , and cover the ark with the veil .

translation.kha: wat la kum ki apostol jong U Khrist i lah ban dawa na phi . Hynñiew i la longsem kiba jaijai jai mynba ngi la don bad phi , kumba ka kiei ka satar ïa ki khulom jong ka .
translation.en: But we were gentle among you , even as a nurse cherisheth her children :

translation.kha: Kumta ki Medad ki la jaboh ha ki Jerusalem’ bad kim skhem long sha ka jingma ïa ki . Ka ri ka la don ha ka jingsuk rahah sawphew snem , hajuh ba u Gideon u ïap .
translation.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel , so that they lifted up their heads no more . And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon .

translation.kha: Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei . La khoit ïa u dieng ha khlur ; la Ohad da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,
translation.en: For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .
Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la sdang ban tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka jingïap ka la jan .
Nga ngeit , ko Trai ! uta u briew u la ong , bad u la dem ksiew ha lamkhmat U Jisu .
translation.en: And he said , Lord , I believe . And he worshipped him .

translation.kha: U Jemuel u sngewsih ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki ban ïoh syiem ; kumta u duwai ha U TRAI’ ,
translation.en: But the thing displeased Samuel , when they said , Give us a king to judge us . And Samuel prayed unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar , uba la wallam pud ïa ki paid Israel sha ïing na ka ri ka jingsngewmeng , u la kular ba un sa wanlam ïa kawei pat ki briew ban ïasah lang bad ki .
translation.en: The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .
Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .
translation.kha: Ko khun , haba phi sangeh ban shah hikai , shen phin iehnoh noh ïa kaei kaba phi la tip mynshuwa .

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  pruid dak ar tylli ki lynti na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lah ban wan lem bad la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . Buh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .

Ki symbai babha la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito Kiba jingphohsniew ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai bad ka spah bad ki jingsngewbha jong kane ka jingtem ki ïatyllep bad kjap ïa ki , bad ki soh jong ki kim ju ih .
translation.en: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .

translation.kha: Kita bhor ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingïateh kular bakyntang iwei ïa iwei pat . U Dabid u sah ha Hoshaïah , pynlang u Jonathan u longing noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .

translation.kha: U briew uba shemphang u ïoh jingïakhaïi kham ngon na kawei ka jingsneng ban kaba uba bieit u ïoh jinghikai na kaba shah sympat shispah sien .
translation.en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , kthang ïa-ban stem ïa la ka jong ka jingkhie .
translation.en: And honour not his father or his mother , he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition .

translation.kha: Lada un isangsot u imat pop khlem tip da kaba u pynkhlaiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U Trai , u long uba la rem bad u dei banbeiñ ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And if a soul sin , and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the  Lord   ; though he wist it not , yet is he guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .

translation.kha: Ha ki lyngdoh la aiti ïa ki kam kat kum ki kur , bad ïa ki Lebi kba arphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw la aiti ha ki kat kum ki kynhun trei .
translation.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers , and the Levites from twenty years old and upward , in their charges by their courses  ;

translation.kha: Pynbna , pynpra ïa ki jingnguh jong ki , pynjot ïa ki riewstad kyntang jong ki , bad pom pynduh ïa ki shab jong ka Asherah , ka blei jong ki .
translation.en: But ye shall destroy their altars , break their images , and cut down their groves :

translation.kha: nangta u kynrad un wan phai pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por naba um pyntip . U kynrad un ot lyngdoh lyngkhai ïa u bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh pynbha ïa ka kupar jong ki bymkohnguh .
translation.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .

translation.kha: Barukh ki la ong , Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U blang ? U la jubab ïa ki , Phi ong ba nga long .
translation.en: Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba hajan jong u Paul ki la ong ha u , Me rkhiebeiñ ïa u nongbah Lyngdoh jongngi U Blei !
translation.en: And they that stood by said , Revilest thou God s high priest ?
Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face  ; for he was afraid to look upon God .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob de .  Kumta u Moses u tap ïa la ka khmat , namar um nud ban peit sha U Blei .

translation.en: In my opinion , the meeting was a success .
translation.kha: Ha jingpyrkhat jongnga , ka meeting ka long kaba seisoh .
Kine ki long ki hukum ba phi de ban ïanguh katba phi dang shong ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa thom jong phi , u ai ha phi .
translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments , which ye shall observe to do in the land , which the  Lord  God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it , all the days that ye live upon the earth .

translation.kha: u sangot u la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , Ko ki brai jong ki ri baroh , ki jaitbynriew bad ki jaitniam ktien !
translation.en: Then an herald cried aloud , To you it is commanded , O people , nations , and languages ,

translation.kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu , un pan ban ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïakynduh . Uno uno uba shim syiem un smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei uba ïan ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin leit noh bad yn klet noh .
translation.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .

translation.kha: Da U Trai umbah im , U Blei jong pa’ , nga smai ba u syiem u la phah Wad ïa phi ha barabor sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba uno uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim don ha ka ri Jong u , u Ahab un dawa na uta u nongsynshar ban smai ba phi long u bym lai ban shem .
translation.en: As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .
Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn sa ïalam ïa ngi sha rud duriaw ha kawei ka dewlynnong .

translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me uba ngi kwah .

translation.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days  ; where we abode seven days .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng na Philippi hadien ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , bad hadien san sngi ngi la ïasoh ïa ki ha Troas , ha kaba ngi la sah shi taïew .

A katno ka longïng kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nongshniah ka sah badno ki Pharisi ! Phira kiba arsap ! Phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka tukri bad ka pliang jong phi , katba kaba shapoh ka dap da kaei kaba phi ïoh da ka jingleh jubab bad ka jingpynkoit tang ïa lade .
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .

translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki la shong la sah ha ka ri ki Amal ,
translation.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites .

translation.kha: Ka kynoi kba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei ka wan phai bad jop ïa ka Phoenisia jingïohi bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sephath . Kiba shah ringmraw na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis kin kurup ïa ki shnong jong ka Judah Bashti .
translation.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paid Jeriel , ngan pynmih ïa phi . Badno Namarba ba ngan leh ïa Kanneh , to pynkhreh banbeiñ mad ïa ka jingïar jyllang nga !
translation.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee , O Israel : and because I will do this unto thee , prepare to meet thy God , O Israel .

translation.kha: Ki la lah bud ïa U Jisu mynba u don ha Galilaïa bad ïarap ïa u . Bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la wan shaei Jeroboam ryngkat bad u ki la ïadon ruh hangta .
translation.en: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him  ; ) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .

And on the morrow when he departed , he took out two pence , and gave them to the host , and said unto him , Take care of him  ; and whatsoever thou spendest more , when I come again , I will repay thee .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u la sei ar tylli ki sbai rupa bad u la ai ïa ki ha u trai ïing . ‘ To sumar ïa u ,’ u la ong ïa u trai ïing , ‘ bad ynda nga wan phai na kane ka lynti , ngan siew ïa me ïa kano kano kaba me pynlut halor jong u .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u mutlop bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ngi ban leit , U  Trai  u la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt , uba na u briew bad na u mrad ruh . Dei namar kata ba ngi kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa uwei pa uwei uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad , hynrei ngi pyllait pat ïa la ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong .
NGA la ud da ka jingsngew namar ka Moab , da ka jingpangnud namar ka Kir Heres .
translation.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .
And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u sangeh na kaba tei kut ïa ka Ramah bad iehnoh ïa ka kam .
(Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngap ka nongbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham buiñ ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Shion ban ïa phira !
translation.en: But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .

translation.kha: Te ka Sipporah ka tnga jong u , ka la shim ïa u mawthew kaba nep , ka otsher ïa u khun jong ka , nangta ka pynshad tiak da ka doh otsher ïa ki kjat u Moses . Namar ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher ka la ong ha u Moses , Me long u tnen da ka snam ïa nga . Kut U Trei u la pynsah ïa ka jingim u Maaseïah .
translation.en: So he let him go : then she said , A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision .

translation.kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u khun jrong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U Trai u la ong ha nga
translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmut bad phi kulai ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngi phin long kiba stad .
translation.en: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .

translation.kha: U Joseph u la tlot ïa ka jaiñ linen , u la pynjynjar ïa ka saw shabi , u la sop ïa ka da ka jaiñ , bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingdap ïa kaba la lah tynneng ha u mawsiang . Nangta u pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh ha ka jaka rung jong ka jingtep .
translation.en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me , dara ha ki ïakhun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kane ka ri ha kaba mynta me long u nongwankai . Ka ri Kanah baroh kawei kan long ka jingïohkynti junom lad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ; bad de ngan long U Balei jong ki .
translation.en: And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .
And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalyngngoh shikatdei eh ! Ki la dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  A katno kiei kiei kiba phylla ngi la ïohi ha kane ka sngi !
U Jisu u la Iohi ïa ka ba ka ïam , bad u la iohi kumno ba ki brai kiba la ïatan lem bad ka , ki ruh ki la ïa-ïam ; ka la khia ïa ka angnud jong u , bad la pynkhih jur ïa u .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,
Speak , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field , and as the handful after the harvestman , and none shall gather them .
translation.kha: Ki metïap ki la saphriang ha kylleng , kum ki kynton sboh halor ki lyngkha , kum u riewhadem ba la ot bad iehnoh da ki nongot , u riewhadem u bym don mano mano ba lum . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong .
Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat ïa ki rangbah synshar katba lah , Hynrei ki pynshitom ïa pli kiba pynlehrain ïa ki .
translation.en: The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa khnai , ki la lyngdoh ; bad ki la iehnoh ïa u nabar ki la leit noh .
translation.en: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki parabangeit Jiw ki la sdang bor kum ki khadu ryngkat pynlang u Peris ; bad wat u Barnabas hi umdih u la liat lang ha ka jingleh khawpud jong ki .
translation.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jong ha ki paid Simeon , Ale ithuh bad ngi shwa ka ri ba la ai ha ngi , bad ïng ïakhun lang ïa ki Kano . Nangta ngin ïaleit bad phi sha ka ri kiba la ai ha phi . Kumta ki jait Samson
translation.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .

translation.kha: Pyndait ha ka , saw kyrdon ki mawkordor , u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;
translation.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .

translation.kha: Nga shen ïa ka jingmane jongki la ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: This I had , because I kept thy precepts .

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shlur bad ki bymïap tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !
translation.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :

translation.kha: Ki para bangeit kiba shim ka jingkitkhlieh ha ka tnad treikam ki mynjur ïa ki jingpanpoh balang thymmai .
translation.en: Responsible brothers at the branch office approve the formation of new congregations .

translation.kha: ka jingkren jong ki ka dap da ki jingtim bakthang .
translation.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness :

translation.kha: Bad Naaman ma u hi u un-long uba tlot , u dei ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ym tang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew hynrei namar ki pop jong u ruh .
translation.en: And by reason hereof he ought , as for the people , so also for himself , to offer for sins .

translation.kha: Hadien kñia , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit na Makkedah shai Lehbha bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la dap khadar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bun u synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmierad jong u ka dei ka Hephsibah .
translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .

translation.kha: Kaei , te , ngan lai ïa U Jisu babha la khoh U Messaïah ? Sahnarphna ïa u ! Barukh ki la jubab .
translation.en: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
For ye , brethren , became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus : for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen , even as they have of the Jews :
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , kijuh kiei kiei kiba la jia ha phi ki la jia ha ki balang jong U Blei ha Judia , ha ki briew hangta kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu . Phi la shah ïa kijuh ki jingpynshitom beiñ na ki briew ki para ri jong phi hi kiba ki la shahshitom na ki Jiw ,

translation.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u wan ïalam ïa u Jakob u kpa jong u bad u pynithuh ïa u ha u syiem . U Jakob u kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa u syiem ,

Bad to pynkyntang khuid ïa ka snem kaba sanphew bad pynbna ïa ka jinglaitluid ha ki traishnong barieh jong kata ka ri . Ha kane ka snem , ïa ki jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die daym ba-bang pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka , lane Sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u , malade uno uno u briew uba la shah die mraw un leit phai pat sha la ïing .
translation.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year , and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof : it shall be a jubilee unto you  ; and ye shall return every man unto his possession , and ye shall return every man unto his family .
And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , bad un wallam ki jingpynjot halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingtim ba la jer ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai U  Trai .
Naba ka kham bha ban shahshitom haba leh ïa kaba babha , lada kane shisha ka longïing ka mon U Blei , ban ïa kaba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: For it is better , if the will of God be so , that ye suffer for well doing , than for evil doing .
And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law , Go , return each to her mother s house : the  Lord  deal kindly with you , as ye have dealt with the dead , and with me .
translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh sha ïing bad sah bad la ki kmie . Ai ba U  Trai  un lehbha ïa phi kumba phi la leh ïa nga bad ïa kito kiba la ïap .

translation.en: Thus he shewed me : and , behold , the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline , with a plumbline in his hand .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai . Ha ka , nga ïohi ïa u ba u dang ïeng marsyndah ka kynroh ïa kaba la tei da ka jingïarap u sawar , bad la don u sawar ha ka kti jong u .
pynban ki briew’ jong de bad ma nga ngin lah Shisha ban ai ei ei ïa me , namar kaei kaei baroh ka dei ka jingjia sngewbha jong me , bad ngi la ai biang shaei me ïa kaei kabu dei ka jong me hi .
translation.en: But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort ? for all things come of thee , and of thine own have we given thee .
For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .
translation.kha: U Barnabas u la long u briew uba bha , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingngeit , bad bun ki briew la wallam sha U Trai .
Bad kum ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kine tip ba tang U Trai hi u longsem U Blei — ym don uwei pat .
translation.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .
So we can be sure that both Jehovah and Jesus want to help us to enjoy a happy future ! —Psalm 72 :12-14  ; 145 :16  ; 2 Peter 3 :9 .
translation.kha: Namar kata ngi lah ban sngew thikna ba baroh ar ngut u Jehobah bad u Jisu ki kwah ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïoh ïa ka lawei kaba suk ba kmen .—Salm 72 :12-14 ; 145 :16 ; 2 Petros 3 :9 .
U Lebiathan u jubab , Ka kham bha ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phiah ban ïa kaba nga ai ha uwei pat ; to sah hangne bad nga .
translation.en: And Laban said , It is better that I give her to thee , than that I should give her to another man : abide with me .

He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïakynduh ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba don ha Pethor hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jong ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba kawei ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la wan na Ijipt ; kita ki briew ki la saphriang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ,  U Jisu u la maham ïa ki ,  bad sumar ïa lade na u thiat jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Herod .
U pynkhiah ïa kiba la phet dohnud bad u sop thaw ïa ki jingsngem jong ki .
translation.en: He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .

translation.kha: Haba Kanneh ka jingkrenbeiñ kaba tyngkong ka la jia , u Kyrinios u long u lyngskor jong ka Samaria .
translation.en: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria . )

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam , Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka bakwah sher dara tad ynda ngi wanlam phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki ne hangne bad phi ; bad kumta uno Un uba don kano kano ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u eh ban leit sha ki .
translation.en: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew’ ka ibit la pynlehrain ; la jop ïa ki da ki bhabriew ba na shatei . Ma per , U Trai’ , ar la klun .
translation.en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded  ; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north .

translation.kha: U Saul u la otsher sha Jerusalem bad u la pyrshang ban ïasoh bad ki synñiang . Hynrei kim lah ba-bang ngeit ba u la long u synran , bad baher ki la suiñbneng ïa u .
translation.en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .
So likewise ye , when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you , say , We are unprofitable servants : we have done that which was our duty to do .
translation.kha: Ka long kumjuh bad phi ; haba phi la pyndep ïa baroh kaba la bthah ïa phi ban leh , to ong , ‘ Ngi long ki tang ki shakri , ngi la pyndep tang ïa ka kamram jong ngi .’
Kumta ka jubab jngai ki ïa U Jisu ka la long , Ngam thop . U Jisu u la ino ïa ki , Nga ruh ngan ym iathuh ïa phi te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .
Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
translation.kha: Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka rud jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
Mar kumta u la shem ïa u Simon , u para jong u malade u la ong ha u , Ngi la shem ïa u Mahseïah . ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut U Khrist . )
translation.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .

translation.kha: U Babbai , u khun jong u Henadad , u nongshoh-nar ïa kawei pat ka shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u twa ïa ka bynta kob bud ;
translation.en: After him repaired their brethren , Bavai the son of Henadad , the ruler of the half part of Keilah .
The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?
translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohnud briew ? Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba shukor katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ban ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .

translation.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma me napdeng ki para jait jong ki hi ; ngan sa ïathuh ha u aïu un ong , bad un kren ha ki briew kat ïa kaba nga hukum .
Ngan pynthymmai leh ïa kito kiba la thait pynlang pynhun da ka jingbam ïa baroh kiba la tlot na ka jingthngan .
translation.en: For I have satiated the weary soul , and I have replenished every sorrowful soul .

translation.kha: ‘ Ïa ngin ïawad waiñ Khyndiat ,’ kine ki nongdih kyiad ki ong , ‘ bad dih katba i lah ! lashai kan kham palat ban ïa kaba mynta !’
translation.en: Come ye , say they , I will fetch wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink  ; and to morrow shall be as this day , and much more abundant .

translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah laiphew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei patan ki ïakhun
translation.en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Kine ki jingpynjot baroh kin sa ngat ha phi , bad kin bam bad lynshop ïa phi haduh ba phin da jot thiaw , Namarba ba phim kohnguh ïa U tharai U Blei jong phi badno phim sumar ïa ki hukum baroh ïa Ibbah u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee , and shall pursue thee , and overtake thee , till thou be destroyed  ; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee :

translation.kha: (Nga , nga longïing u kpu ka jingïam , U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki . Kito kiba wang sha per da lei lei kin ym tyngkan ; kito kba ngeit ha nga da lei lin kmen ym sliang .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .

translation.kha: U Jehoram u la long syiem haba u don laiphew ar Snem ka rta , bad u synsar phra snem ha Jeroham .
translation.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: katjuh hi kan jia ïa ka Edom kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , mynba ïa ki bad ïa ki shaneng ba-marjan la pynring . Yn ym don ban sah baïong hangta . Ma nga , U Terah , por la kren .
translation.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord  , no man shall abide there , neither shall a son of man dwell in it .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar Jong ka jingsyier u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Jehoram u lama u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign .
Now she that is a widow indeed , and desolate , trusteth in God , and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei kaba long tang marwei , ka bym don mano mano ban sumar ïa ka , ka la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei bad ka ïai duwai bad pan na u ïa ka jingïarap mynmiet bad mynsngi .
Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh nur-um bad ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga , hynrei ngan pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .

Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynjot ! Ki kynthei ka Rabbah , ki leit ïam sngewsih ! Ki phong ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïam pangnud . Ki mareh lamwir . Ïa u Molekh u blei jong phi yn ïalam mraw , lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  against all mine evil neighbours , that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit  ; Behold , I will pluck them out of their land , and pluck out the house of Judah from among them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga don ei ei ban ong shaphang ki paramarjan jong ka Israel kiba la pynjot ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan shim noh ïa kito ki briew bymman na ki ri jong ki kum ïa u jingthung ba la rat , bad ngan pyllait im ïa ka Judah na ki .
Ka dei da ka jingngeit jong ki , ba ki briew ha ki por mynbarim ki ïohpdiang ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei .
translation.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report .

translation.kha: Ki briew jongki ka Judah ki ong , Ngi la ïohsngew katno ki briew jong ka Moab ki long kiba sarong . Ngi tip ba ki longsyiem kiba sngewmeng bad naba sarong palat , hynrei ka jingkob jong ki ka long kaba thylli .
translation.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .
In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them : in his love and in his pity he redeemed them  ; and he bare them , and carried them all the days of old .
translation.kha: Ym dei u angel , hynrei dei U  Trai  hi uba pyllait im ïa ki . Ha ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei jong u , u la pyllait ïa ki . U la ju sumar ïa ki borabor ha ki por kiba mynshuwa ,

translation.en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la wan sha ïing , ki leit rah sha u hapoh ïing ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .

Ba ka jingaiei ka hikai ïa ngi ban iehnoh ïa ka mano im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kyntang pyrthei , bad ïa-ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kaei ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;

translation.kha: U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong u Siloam : ka thain Dong baroh kawei ;
translation.en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :

translation.kha: Kat koum ka rukom ba la bud da ki Lyngdoh , la jied ïa u da Kaba kynting sbun ban thang jingiwbih khlur ka duwan . Kumta u la otsher Shabeh ka Templ jong U Trai ,
translation.en: According to the custom of the priest s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .
Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,
translation.kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jong U  Trai  , ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong ngi .

Mynba u Hesekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Meshakh u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la ïa-bta ïa baroh ki bynriew ba U Tharai Badonbor Baroh u la lah noh , ‘ Ïa ka Seïon yn lup koum ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , nabar u lum ka Templ un kylla khlaw .’
translation.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .
Also Judah kept not the commandments of the  Lord  their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat ki paid Judah ruh kim shym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki pyrthuh bud ïa ki rukom ba dang bat da ki paid Israel .
Ki la wan ban maham ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ban ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki nongshun ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bah . Kine ki nongshun Kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki nongbah jongu ka Judah
translation.en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .
And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,
translation.kha: U Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u ki la leit sha ka jaka long dorbar ha ka khyrdop shnong bad ki kren ha la ki para shnong ;

translation.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki briew ki bymkhuid . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u dei ban pynkhuid ïa kito , kiba , hadien ba ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad sum ïa lade , ki kylla long kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngi kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: The bows of the mighty men are broken , and they that stumbled are girded with strength .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ryntieh jong ki shipai kiba khlaiñ la pynkheiñ , hynrei kiba tlot ki ïohbor .

ha kaba la don u briew uba don ka kti kaweh la ïapshiliang . katjuh katne ki briew hangto kiba la kwah ban mudui ïa U Jisu ha ka jingleh bakla , kamet ki la kyllaiñ ïa u , Hato ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Ïa jongu ngi ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translation.en: And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .

translation.kha: Nangta u tad ïa ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u , bad u leit phai bad ïeng harud ka Jordan .
translation.en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and went back , and stood by the bank of Jordan  ;

translation.kha: U Jehu u la synshar arphew phra snem ha Sarai kum u syep ka Israel .
translation.en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years .

For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
translation.kha: Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki  erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong tlang ,

Ha ka sngi haba U Trai un pyn-at ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u , Wat ka spoiñ bad ka ksiar jong ki baroh kan ym lah ban pynjam ïa ki . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka dang ka jingbitar jong u . Un pynkut — ka jingkaw kaba kynsai — ïa uwei pa uwei uba im ha ka pyut .
translation.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the  Lord s  wrath  ; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land .
And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That there be some of them that stand here , which shall not taste of death , till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ki don katto katne ngut hangne ki ban ym ïap haduh ba kin da ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei ba ka wan ha ka bor .

Um da ban shah ïa kiwei pat kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad u , bad lada phi iehnoh ïa u ban shakri ïa ki blei nongwei , un phai pyrshah ïa phi bad un pynshitom ïa phi . Un pynjot tiew ïa phi , Wat la u long uba bha ïa phi mynshuwa .
translation.en: If ye forsake the  Lord  , and serve strange gods , then he will turn and do you hurt , and consume you , after that he hath done you good .
Then Joab came to the king , and said , What hast thou done ? behold , Abner came unto thee  ; why is it that thou hast sent him away , and he is quite gone ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab u leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? U Abner u la wan sha phi — balei phi shah ba un shu leit kumto ?

translation.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ka Israel ,  Ko Israel bymïaineh , to wan pat sha nga . Nga long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad ngan ym bitar ; ngan ym bitar ïa pha shi junom .
Te nga aiti ïa ka sha ki long lehhok jong ka , ki Syria ïa kiba ka thrang palat .
translation.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers , into the hand of the Assyrians , upon whom she doted .

translation.kha: Shisien ka por la don u syiem Bad ka syiem , bad ki don u khun ba kyrteng u Sigurd uba khlei ba smat , bad ba bhabriew bha .
translation.en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .

Behold , thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not , and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the  Lord  thy God , and for the Holy One of Israel  ; for he hath glorified thee .
translation.kha: Mynta phin phah khot ïa ki hima ri nongwei ; mynshuwa kim shym la tip ïa phi , hynrei mynta kin wan mareh ban ïasoh bad phi ! Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , ngan pynjia ïa kane baroh ; ngan ai ha phi ïa ka burom bad jingpyndonburom .

translation.en: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof :
translation.kha: U dei U Blei uba shim ïa ka um na ka khyndew bad pynkylla ïa ka sha ki jingjaw jong u slap .

Na la jied ïa u bariew uba sheng basah shaphang mihngi ; Ngan wallam ïa u ban tur ïaleh na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh khashor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka kti , kum u nongthaw khiew uba ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .

translation.kha: U Elkanah u tnga jong ka u kylli ïa ka , Hannah , balei ba pa da ïam ? balei ba phim bam ei ei ? balui ba phi Shi sngewsih tama ? Hangto ngam kham lah ma nga ha ph ban ïa shipawa thut ki khun shynrang ?
translation.en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her , Hannah , why weepest thou ? and why eatest thou not ? and why is thy heart grieved ? am not I better to thee than ten sons ?

translation.kha: bad sawphew tyrnem ki thliew tnaw phong ha trai jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnum hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jongnga ka ar tylli .
translation.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .

translation.kha: U Lot u la khmih sarong bun u la ïohi ba ka yn Jordan baroh kawei haduh Soar , ka don kriah ka um , kum ka Kper jong U Trai lane kum ka ri Ijipt . ( Kane ka long ha shuwa ba U Trai un pynstet ïa ka Siloam malu ka Gomorrah . )
translation.en: And Lot lifted up his eyes , and beheld all the plain of Jordan , that it was well watered every where , before the  Lord  destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah , even as the garden of the  Lord  , like the land of Egypt , as thou comest unto Zoar .
Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Kane ruh ka kynthup ïa phi kiba ha Rom , ïa kiba U Blei u la khot ban long ki jong U Jisu Khrist .
Nga dang don shibun kai ki ba-bang ong ha phi , hynrei mynta kan long pyllait eh ïa phi ban shah .
translation.en: I have yet many things to say unto you , but ye cannot bear them now .

translation.kha: Kaba kan long ka dak jong kata ka jutang jong nga bad ka Pyrthei .
translation.en: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .
When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee  ; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them :
translation.kha: Haba me khang ïa u slap ban hap namar ba ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta haba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai khmat sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .

translation.en: These have one mind , and shall give their power and strength unto the beast .
translation.kha: Kine baroh shiphew ngut ki don kajuh ka jingthmu , bad ki ai ïa ka bor bad ka iktiar jong ki ha u mradkhlaw .
Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lai shuh don khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka me ju wang . ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym to ei ei ïa-ban ai .
translation.en: As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
He is eating an apple .
translation.kha: U Bam Mynta ia u Soh Apple .
To ai ba baroh katba pyrsa ïa de bad kiba ïaleh ïa nga yn pynshitom Kum ïa ki briew bymnang bad ki briew bymhok .
translation.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .

translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi slem bad ki briew jong U Blei barhem , phin lah ban ïoh ka leh ba-bang sngewthuh katno ka jingïarisa bad ka lynter , katno ka jingrang bad ka jingïabujli , ka long ka jingieit U khriat .
translation.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;

translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha u Elisha , umbiah dang ap ïa ki ha Erekh , bad u ong ha ki , Ngam shym la ainong ïa phi ban ym leit ?
translation.en: And when they came again to him , ( for he tarried at Jericho , ) he said unto them , Did I not say unto you , Go not ?
Then are they glad because they be quiet  ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .
translation.kha: Ki la kmen namar kata ka jingjai jai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingma bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka kadlieng kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban long kiba khuid bad kiba lait phar na ka jingjakhlia ka jingawria .

translation.en: To God only wise , be glory through Jesus Christ for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha U Blei tang uba stad , to long ka burom lyngba U Jisu Khrist junom . Amen .
kumto u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka Mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïaineh Ka Jingdon ikhain U Trai , bad u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa ki Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .

translation.kha: Kum U Jisu u la ïohnong joit bad u la bud ïa u , bad ki synran Jong u ki la ïaleit ryngkat bad u .
translation.en: And Jesus arose , and followed him , and so did his disciples .
The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
translation.kha: U paidbah u la jubab ,  Ka hukum jong ngi ka ïathuh ba U Messaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ban kyntiew ? Uei une U Khun U Briew ?
Ïa u mradkhlaw la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kba long ki jingkheiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban ba-don ka bor synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .
translation.en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .

translation.kha: Ka syiem Athalaïah ka la iohnong ïa ka jingaiti ba mih na ki nongap phin bad u Paidbah’ , kumta ka pynstet ban leit sha ka Templ , ha kaba u Paidbah’ u la ïalumlang .
translation.en: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people , she came to the people into the temple of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki kheit sohwaiñ , ki ïuh de katto katne halor ding , bad haba ki nonglute ki wan mynmiet , ki shim tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: If grapegatherers come to thee , would they not leave some gleaning grapes ? if thieves by night , they will destroy till they have enough .

translation.kha: Ïa katba dang sah na kata ka umphniang un kylliang ha ka khlieh jongno uta u bariew , dara da kumta un pyndep ïa ka jingkam lehniam kaba ïadei dara ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed , to make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
translation.kha: ( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Edom , da kaba jia ryngkhat u don hangta ha kata ka sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )
balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bim lah ban leh ei ei shuh ishyrkhei naba kyrpad ïa ka jinghikai ?
translation.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .

I shall see him , but not now : I shall behold him , but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
translation.kha: Nga khmih sha ka lawei , Bad nga ïohi ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . U syiem , uba kum u khlur phyrnai , un mih ha kata ka jaitbynriew . Kum u  lur dih duma un wan mih na Israel . Un shoh ïa ki nongïalam ki Moab , Bad un pyndem ïa ki briew jong u Seth .
Ki jait Israel ki Phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha baroh ka ri jong ka jait Benjamin , ban ong , Ka kam bymman aïu kane kaba phi la leh ?
translation.en: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin , saying , What wickedness is this that is done among you ?

translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong me ; kba dara ki briew kin kyrpad jingïarap na me .
translation.en: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .

Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hynmen ki para jong phi hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh sha ïing phi baroh . Kaei kaba jia ka long kaba nga mon .  Baroh ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .

Kumta u Paul u la ïalang ïa ine ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid blem pynlang ki . Nangta u la leit shiah ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno snieh kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , ïahap yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba pynbam ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bamaïan banbeiñ syrdep ïa ka sopti barim , namar ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai sa ran bad tista pynkad katto katne ïa ka jaiñ barieh , kan pynlong dak ïa ka jingkam kaba khah heh .
translation.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .
translation.en: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .

translation.kha: Wat sukher ïano ïaineh da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingthew thok , ha ka brai , ha u mawthew , ne ha ka jingbun .
translation.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in meteyard , in weight , or in measure .
Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga . Leh kumba nga ong , bad phin long suk .
Ngi la leit da ka lieng na Philippi hadien ka Jingkhawai Anam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , bad hadien sai sneng ngi la ïasoh ïa ki ha Troas , ha kaba ngi la law shi tawah .
translation.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days  ; where we abode seven days .

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khlaiñbor Tam na ki kynrad baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ïai-ong ïa ki nongïalap jong u Baal , Namar ba pa kham ïabun , rim shuwa ma phi ïa u masi dab . Duwai ha u beit jong phira , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king s sons arose , and every man gat him up upon his mule , and fled .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Absalom bad ki la pynïap ïa u Amnon . Baroh kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki kiew halor ki khashor jong ki bad ki la phet krad .

translation.en: And Joseph s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki shiphew ngut ki hynmen shynrang ar kmie jong u Joseph ki la ïaleit sha Ijipt ban thied kew ,
Hynrei kin sa hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade ha U blei , uba la kloi ban habar ïa kiba im bad ïa kiba ïahap .
translation.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead .

translation.kha: Nangne kin jubab ïa u , ‘ mihnoh , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ba me thngan jlan shiliang lane ba me long u nongwei lane ba me la lyngkhuit jlan ba me pang lane hapoh ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngim khim la ïarap ïa me ?’
translation.en: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?

And verily they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the office of the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is , of their brethren , though they come out of the loins of Abraham :
translation.kha: Bad ïa kito kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi kiba long ki lyngdoh la ai ïa ki da ka Hukum ba kin lum kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na ki paid Israel , kata ka long , na la ki briew , wat haba ki briew jong ki ruh ki hiarpateng na u Abraham .

translation.en: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .
translation.kha: Haba u Boas u la dep bam dep dih , u la don ha ka jingsngewtynnat bha . U leit sha ka kynton barli bad u thiah hangta . Ka Ruth ka leit jar jar , ka khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad ka thiah ha ki kjat jong u .
Mynta to iehnoh ïa nga mawlynnai ban ïamkthang halor kito na ki briew jong de kiba la ïaphah . Wat pyrshang ïa-ban pyntngen ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore said I , Look away from me  ; I will weep bitterly , labour not to comfort me , because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people .

translation.kha: La kha ïa de shaw ki duriaw-bah , mynba ki umpohliew kim pat khong .
translation.en: When there were no depths , I was brought forth  ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .

translation.kha: Kaba kum dat ka jingstad kam long kaba wan hiar na bneng ; ka longïng jong ka pyrthei , kam long kob kynja mynsiem bad ka long kaba kynja ksuid .
translation.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above , but is earthly , sensual , devilish .

translation.kha: Ha Jehoba la don ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Tabitha , kaba long ka riewngeit . ( Ka kthang jong ka ha ka ktieh Grik ka longkmie ka Dorkas , kaba mut ka skei . ) Ka la pyntyllun ïa ka por jong ka barabor ha kaba leh ba-pnah bad ha kaba ïarap ïa kiba duk .
translation.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .

translation.kha: bad u hukum ba yn hikai ïa ka ha ki biria ka Judah . ( La buh jingkynmaw ha Ka Biblos U Jashar . )
translation.en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )
Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .
translation.kha: Mano te , ki ban pynrem ïa ki ? Ym U Khrist Jisu , uba la ïap , lane , ïa uba la pynmihpat bad uba don ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , uba ïasaid bad u na ka bynta jong ngi!
U Moses u ong ha u , Nga tang shu poi shabar kane ka shnong , ngan duwai ha U Trai . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phria un ym hap shuh , ba Phin ïoh tip ba ka pyrthei ka long ka lad U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .
And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit pat sha ka Ïuphratis bad shim ïa ki patlun lyngkot .
U Terah u ong , Ki briew jong nga ki pyut , ‘ U Trai u la pyn-i ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei . Ïa ngim ïaleit bad ïathuh ïa ki briew jongnga ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kob U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la leh .’
translation.en: The  Lord  hath brought forth our righteousness : come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: bad ha shuwa ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la leh ? Mynta phar longsem kum ma ka — ka jingbiria ïa ki nongri Edom , ki Philistia bad kiwei pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa phad .
translation.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .
Nevertheless the king s word prevailed against Joab . Wherefore Joab departed , and went throughout all Israel , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u pynkohnguh ïa u Joab ban leh ïa ka hukum jong u . U Joab u mihnoh , u la leit lyngba ka ri Israel baroh kawei , bad nangta u wan phai pat sha Jerusalem .

Bad ïahap phi shahjingit , wat leh pita sngewsih kumba ki riewarsap ki leh . Kin kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jongu ki khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ba ki shahjingit . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsuhsieng kiba pura .
translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .

translation.kha: ki kynïan , to pynkhap ïa lade ha ki tnga jong phoi , naba kata ka long kaei kaba phi dien ha U Blei
translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as it is fit in the Lord .

translation.kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jia ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ba-im jngai me , ki lehbha , napdeng ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gaddah , u nongpynkhiah jong u Arbad , Khie leit bad ong ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan imat ïa kano kano kaba u jied . Ha ka step kaba Bud , hadien ba u ïaiban u la khih thiah ,
translation.en: Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .

translation.kha: U Blei u la jied khnang ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka ïakheiñ ba ka long kaba ibieit khnang ban pynlehrain ïa naba stad , bun u la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthiew ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba tlot khnang ban pynluin ïa bakha kotbor .
translation.en: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise ; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , ïa ka deng daym ban syang , bad bam ïa ka lam bad u khup khlem thiat bad ki jhur ïamkthang .
translation.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa nga . Hato kata kam la biang ba phin khmih ïa nga ha ka jingkyndit pynlang ban sngap noh jar ?
translation.en: Mark me , and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .
But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .
