translation.kha: Pha long kaba khlem bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan sha khmat ban pyllait im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba wad jingtip shaphang ki khlur , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki bneng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat kaei ka ban jia ïa pha .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom kaba nga dei ban dih ? Hato phi lah ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?

Ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong ar ; ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki Israel . Namar nga dei U blem bad ym u briew . Ma nga , uta umbah Haduh ngan long bad phira . Ngan ym wan sha phira ha ka jingbat .
translation.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man  ; the Holy One in the midst of thee : and I will not enter into the city .

translation.kha: Balei ba me shukor ? Hangto me pyrkhat ba ki jingujor jong me kin lama jingmyntoi ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him ?

translation.kha: U blem u buh ïa u lyoh shalor ki briew jong u bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban ai jingshai ïa ki .
translation.en: He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the  Lord  , and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw , U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga ïa u Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh uba ïeng ha khmat u angel jong U  Trai . Bad hangta hajan jong u Joshua la ïeng u Soitan , uba la khreh ban wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And afterward when David heard it , he said , I and my kingdom are guiltless before the  Lord  for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner :
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u ong ,  U  Trai  u tip ba ma nga bad ki khun ki hajar jong nga ngim don jingrem ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .

translation.en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :
translation.kha: Um shym la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thain jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .

translation.en: Ho , every one that thirsteth , come ye to the waters , and he that hath no money  ; come ye , buy , and eat  ; yea , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To wan , phi kiba sliang — hangne ka don ka um ! To wan , phi ki bym don pisa — thied ïa u kew bad bam ! To wan ! Thied ïa ka waiñ bad ka dud — phin ym hap siew ei ei !

translation.en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la lah khum ïa u ban sympat , u Paul u la ong ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïeng hangta ,  Hato ka shong aiñ ïa me ban sympat ïa u traishnong ka Hima Rom u bym shym la shah bishar na ka bynta kano kano ka kam runar ?

Ha lynti ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Simon , uba dang wanrah sha ka nongbah na rudnong , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u baneh bah ïa ka diengphna U ju . ( U Simon u dei na Kyrini bad u la long u kpa jong u Aleksandar bad u Ruphos . )
translation.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian , who passed by , coming out of the country , the father of Alexander and Rufus , to bear his cross .
And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , u ong ,  Une seh u para khatduh jong phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , khun .
Bad wat la kim shym la Shem kano kano ka daw ban rai pynpoh ïa u , ki la Kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban phad pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain .

translation.kha: uto u nongaplangbrot u bymmyntoi ei ei u long uba la tim ! U la iehnoh ïa la ka kynhun byrngut . Ka thma kan pynjot koit ïa ka bor jong u . Ka kti jong u kan ïapstai bad ka khmat kumne jong u kan long kaba matlah .
translation.en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock ! the sword shall be upon his arm , and upon his right eye : his arm shall be clean dried up , and his right eye shall be utterly darkened .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u Elasah u ong , Hato ngam shym la don hangta ha ka myn haba u briew u hiar na ka kali ïapmat jong u ban ïashem ïa me ? Kainan kam dei ka por ba-bang pynhieng ïa ka tyngka bad ki jaiñ , ki brisoh olib bad ki bri sohwaiñ , ki nongaplangbrot bad ki masi lane ki shakri !
translation.en: And he said unto him , Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee ? Is it a time to receive money , and to receive garments , and oliveyards , and vineyards , and sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and maidservants ?
Read Acts 15 :1-35 , and see how the first-century governing body discussed and resolved a dispute with the help of the Scriptures and holy spirit .
translation.kha: Pule ki Kam 15 :1-35 , peit kumno ba ha ka spah snem banyngkong , ka kynhun pynïaidkam ka la ïamir jingmut bad pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia lyngba ki Jingthoh bakhuid bad u mynsiem bakhuid .
Baroh ki syiemsad jong ka pyrthei ki thiah ha ki jingtap kba itynnat ,
translation.en: All the kings of the nations , even all of them , lie in glory , every one in his own house .

translation.kha: U Bel u jubab , Ngan long lem bad me , mala haba me ïalamwir noh ïa ki brisoh jong per na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lum . Kata kan long ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phuh ïa me .
translation.en: And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .

translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la sop da ka rupa na Spain bad da ka ksar na Uphas bhor ki jingtrei jong ki nongtrei ; la pynphong jaiñ ïa ki ha ki jaiñ ïongjngum bun sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongthain daiñ batip .
translation.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .

translation.kha: Ka jingieid kam julam jingsniew ia ki marjan , namarkata , ka jinieid ka jingpyndap pynkmen jong ka kyndon .
translation.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .

translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti u leit phai ? u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And their father said unto them , What way went he ? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went , which came from Judah .

translation.kha: shym khat-ar kilo u phetwir mala shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .
translation.en: And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .
Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton — ki la kham jied ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
Haba u ïadei , U Blei un jingjubab ïa u ; un mane ïa U Blei da kaba kmen ; U Blei un buh beit sa shisien pat ïa kiei kiei na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren biang ha nga .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: U Jephthah u kular ha U Trai : Lada me ai ha nga ka jingjop pynshah ïa ki Ammon ,
translation.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands ,

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong , Ko Israel bad Judah , Kaei kob ngan leh ïa phi ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa nga ka jah noh shna kum u slap myn ; ka longïing kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka sngi .
translation.en: O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba afi wieh jong u bnai uba hynñiew ha kata khiah ka snem , U Trai u la kren biang lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,
Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Jied ïa ki nongbah jakarieh kiba nga la hukum ha u Moses ban ïathuh ha phi .
Kat ka dang suh kha , uwei na ki u pynmih shabar ïa la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata ka kti , ka teh ïa ka da u saisaw , bad ka ong , Une u Dei uba ñiah nongking .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .

translation.kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew . Hynrei ba-bang bam khlem da thet ïa ki kti jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban leh kumta — Kane kam pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew .
translation.en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .

translation.kha: jynreiñ uta uba la lehbeiñ ïa uta uwei pat u la khynñiat snar ïa u Moses . ‘ Mano ba la pynphong ïa me u nongbishar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ u la Kylli .
translation.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?
And it came to pass , as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wouldest thou ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada ba ka shong , bad u Kaleb u kylli aïu ba ka kwah .
ngan batlot ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong malu u Dabid u kpa jong me mynba nga la ong ha u ba ïa ka Israel yn synshar borabor da ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel .

translation.kha: Ka jingjia jingsumar mano ka pa na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki kynthei ka napoh shisnem — ki jingkhem met da ka umphniang mirr na ka bynta hynriewspah bnai bad da ka umphniang balsam sa hynriew bniap . Hadien kata , ïa kawei pa kaweh ka samla yn ïalam kawei hadien kiwei sha u syiem Serksis .
translation.en: Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )

translation.kha: Un jah noh na ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sah ;
translation.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .

translation.kha: U Jehoram u la don laiphew ar snem ka rta mynba u un-long syep , bad u synshar phra sner ha Jerusalem . Ym don mano mynno ba sngewsih haba u ïapom . Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingmihpat ki syep .
translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .

translation.kha: Pynban katba ki Israhaïah ki nang shah pynum beiñ , long ruh ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang shynrang kyrteng ka ri .
translation.en: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la ong ha kaba dum yn ïohsngew ha kaba shai ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la pashait ha kaba jar jar ha ka kamra ba la khang , yn pyrta na ki tnum ïing .
translation.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light  ; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops .

translation.kha: U la ïa-ong ïa kane bad u la pynim ha ki ïa ki kti jongki u dara ïa ki kjat jongnga u .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he shewed them his hands and his feet .

translation.kha: phi! ka leilieh dara u phria , ka ïor bad ki lyoh , ki lyer bahkhlieh ibha kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .
translation.en: Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , Ko Judith , hato dei da ka jingthoh ba me la shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ?
translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?

translation.kha: U Blei ki Israel , uba pynim ïa la ki briew , u lama U Blei uba buhrieh ïa lade .
translation.en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself , O God of Israel , the Saviour .
Unto Timothy , my own son in the faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit : To U Blei U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof .
translation.kha: Haba u byrthen ïa ki rishot kiba bat ïa ka suiñbneng , ki khih bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba dap da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .
translation.kha: Pynngam jylliew ïa ki nongrim jong phi ha u , to tei ïa ka jingim jong phi halor jong u , bad to nang kham khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit jong phi , kumba la hikai ïa phi . Bad to long kiba la pyndap da ka jingainguh .

translation.en: And thou shalt say , I will go up to the land of unwalled villages  ; I will go to them that are at rest , that dwell safely , all of them dwelling without walls , and having neither bars nor gates ,
translation.kha: Men sa rai ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri ka bym don jingïarap ha kaba ki briew ki ïashongsuk shongshngain ha ki shnong kiba khlem ker kynroh bad ki bym don jingker .

translation.en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat , nga la shem ïa kane khyndiat pa khyndiat katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .
Ang ong ha phi , un bashrah ha ka liang jong ki bad un ar kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthat haba u wiang ?
translation.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha ki Israhaïah ka jingjngem Hamor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki shaphang shatei khah Misrephoth Niam badno Sidon , sad shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Ishbah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh u nongshun suba lait im .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .

translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki Israel ki ïakajia , bad ki leit sha ka jingsyier , ki nongbishar kin riej pynksan ïa uba hok bad pynjyrngam ïa uba leh palat .
translation.en: If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .

translation.kha: Ki jingmong ba phi lum kine long kiba bun , mala kmen biang na ka bynshet shisnem ; wat la katta ruh , Phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kiba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .
translation.en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .
Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .
translation.kha: Khie leit ha kaba suk ,  u Eli u ong ,  bad to U Blei ki Israel un ai ha pha ïa kata kaba pha pan na u .
nabar ktieh kohnguh ïa ki suda U Trai ban ym mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: For they served idols , whereof the  Lord  had said unto them , Ye shall not do this thing .

translation.kha: U Hobab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , Balei ba ngim shym la leh ei ei ban ïitkhmih pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Sirion ? Ka dei ka Jong ngi !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
translation.kha: Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , ngi ïathuh lut ha i kat ïa kaba phi ong .

translation.en: Even us , whom he hath called , not of the Jews only , but also of the Gentiles ?
translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki briew kiba u la khot , ym tang napdeng ki Jiw hynrei napdeng ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki paid Amalek namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt .

translation.en: Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :
translation.kha: U Syiem Kynrad u la pynmih ka hukum ba tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , uwei pa uwei u dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,
Un jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad ba yn ym ïohi shuh .
translation.en: He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea , he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .
And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; as Moses commanded .
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa ki shadem bad ki kjat-dien kamon kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , kumba u Moses u la hukum .

U Trai Badonbor baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , Haba ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew sha ka ri jongnga ki , sa shisien pat kin ong ha ka ri Judah malu ki shnong jong ka , ‘ To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa u lum mawkyntang jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba u shong .’
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .

translation.kha: Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksaiñ kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tyllun ki mynsiem ki longing noh Sha ki syiem baïar jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa ki na ka boitha ka thma ha ka Sngi kaba khroh jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .
Again he said unto her , Stand in the door of the tent , and it shall be , when any man doth come and enquire of thee , and say , Is there any man here ? that thou shalt say , No .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa ka ,  Ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka dara , bad lada uno uno u wan bad kylli ïa phi la hangne don briew ne em , sa ong em .

U tharai Nongsynshar u ong , Ko ki paid Israel , khie leit sha ka khang bakhuid ka Bethel nabar leh jop , lada phi hap ban leh kumta ! Kiwei rupa sha Gilgal bad to leh jop da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi barhem ! Ïaid shaphrang nabar khlam ïa ki mrad ban kñia na ka step sha ka step , bun wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jongki phi bathoiñ la ka sngi kiba lai .
translation.en: Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :
The highways lie waste , the wayfaring man ceaseth : he hath broken the covenant , he hath despised the cities , he regardeth no man .
translation.kha: Ki lynti bah ki long kiba ma shibun ba ym don uba ïaid ba ïeng ha ki . Ïa ki jingïateh kular la pynkheiñ bad ïa ki jingïakut ym shym burom . Ym don shuh ka jingïaburom ïano ïano ruh .
hynrei U Trai um mo ban pyndeng ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid , namar u la lah pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid bad ba u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .
translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  would not destroy the house of David , because of the covenant that he had made with David , and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .

translation.kha: Ki bynriew jong phi kyang wan phai na kylleng — na Assyria kaba ha mihngi , na Ijipt ha ka phang shathie , na ki thain ka Ïutikhos , na ki duriaw ba sha jngi bad ki lumbah ba Don sha jngai baher .
translation.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .
And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .
translation.kha: Bad lada phi lehbha tang ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki leh kumta !

translation.en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kornelios ! U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad u la kynmaw ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me .

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee , of thy brethren , like unto me  ; unto him ye shall hearken  ;
translation.kha: Un phah ha phi napdeng jong phi hi ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma nga , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u .
Nangta ki la shim ïa u bad phret ïa u sha ka tukri , kaba la tyrkhong .
translation.en: And they took him , and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it .

translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u kan long kaba don ba em bad kaweh riewspah ; bad un roi kyrhai junom .
translation.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Kam long Kaba dei ïa phi ba phin sngewsarong ! Phi kop ïa ka jingong , Tang kyndiang u thiat , u pynsieb ïa u kpu im ba la khleh ?
translation.en: Your glorying is not good . Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump ?

translation.kha: namar nga la jied ïa ka bad nga la pynkyntang ïa ka koum ka bakwah ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngam khmied hiar jongngi ka bad ïada ïa ka ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever : and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .
Kaba tip kynum ban pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymman lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh sneng .
translation.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .

translation.kha: Haba ka kherub ka la pah ha u Ngim Shelomoth ba u Joab u la kjit krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u jaboh ban kylli ïa u bajai ba u la phetwir sha ka duwan . U Joab u jubab ba u la phet krad sha U Trai namar ba u la sheptieng ïa u Simeon . Kumta u Syiem Simon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ba-bang pynïap ïa u Joab .
translation.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .

translation.kha: Bakhraw kiei kiei naba dei jong ka pyrthei — kaei kaba ka malade bapop ka brai , kaei kaba ki briew ki ïohi malade kwah , bad baroh Kiei kiei kiba ha ka pyrthei uba ki bariew ki sngewsarong — ym don na kane kaba wanrah na U Kpa ; baroh ka wan na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .

translation.kha: Ha kiba wai noh , ko pynbang jong nga , to pyndap ïa ki jingmut jong phi da kita kiei kiei kiba bha bad kita naba dei ïaroh : Kiei kiei uba shisha , kiba donburom , Ibbah beit , kiba khuid , Ibbah ba-itynnat , bad kiba burom .
translation.en: Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong sa , to la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bam duh ïa baroh kaei kaei kaba jyrngam ha ka ri , bad nangta sa la ong , A Trai Nongsynshar , to map ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ban lait im ? Ki un-long kiba rit bad kiba tlot dik katta !
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .

Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno u bymkohnguh wat ïa iba rit tam jong ki hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei pat ban leh kumjuh , un long uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng . Ha kawei pat ka liang , uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei ban leh kumjuh , un long uba khraw ha ka Hima ki Bneng .

translation.en: And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .
translation.kha: Katba ki kulai thohbroin ki dang wan mih , ki la long kiba da kwah eh ban leit bad ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la ong ,  Khie leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei !  — bad ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
translation.kha: U syiem jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-iwbih .

translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
translation.kha: Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongap phira ; mynsngi ne mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U  Trai  ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba un klet ïa ki .

translation.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew bad shah pynïap .
Ha kawei ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u , Wat sheptieng , hynmen ïai kren bad wat sangeh , naba nga long lem bad me .
translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;
translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin phai pat sha U  Trai  , bad kohnguh da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki hukum jong u kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ,

translation.en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki ong ,  Kan bha ba phin ym bunktien lymda phi kwah ïa kine ki briew ban bitar bad ban kynrup ïa phi . Nangta ma phi bad ka longïing jong phi baroh phin ïap .
Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka haw Habor , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga sah hangta ingiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kamai kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew .
translation.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .

translation.kha: Ka ki jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap kiba waiñ hap na suiñbneng baneh ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pyntong ïa ki jingthung ba-bang san bad pynmareh ïa u symbai ban ïoh bet bad ka jingbat ban bam .
translation.en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :

translation.kha: Haba ki Jentil ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kmen bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khubor jrong U Trai , bad kito ïa kiba la lngaid na ka bynta ka jingshem bymjukut ki la long ki riewngeit .
translation.en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .

translation.kha: U nongmihkhmat u ïeng na ka bynta ka hima jingruma , bad ka reng kob paw bha khappud ki khmat jongnga u ka dei u syiem banyngkong .
translation.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia : and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king .

translation.kha: Me ong ïa la ba-bang shakor katba me dang kren bad ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong me .
translation.en: Hear , I beseech thee , and I will speak : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .
translation.kha: Te , kaei pat ? Nga ong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie bad ai ha phi ïa u kpu , namar ba phi dei u paralok jong u , pynban un khie joit bad ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi donkam namar ba phim lehrain ban ïai pan .
U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la lytar sha ka Synrap ,
translation.en: And when he was departed thence , he went into their synagogue :

translation.kha: Phi ïamihnoh na ka ri jingïaphet ha kane ka sngi jong u bnai uba nyngkong , u bnai Abib .
translation.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib .
As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .
translation.kha: Kajuh kaei kaei kan jia ïa ka Babilon kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , haba nga la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong kiba marjan . Yn ym don ba shong shuh hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U syiem u kren-ïa ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi Shaphan kine ki jingïoh ,
translation.en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps .

translation.kha: Ka barim jong u kan kah ïa ka nongbah na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka Jaka kaba shngain , kaba la da na u slap bad ka erïong .
translation.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .

translation.kha: U Blei u pynkhiah ruh ïa u rynsun u khun jong u Eliada ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon . U Reson , u la phet ïap na la u kynrad , u Hadadeser u syiem ka Sobah , bad u la long u nongïalam ïa kaei ka kynha ki riewrangbah .
translation.en: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :

translation.kha: Nangta ngi la khublei ïakhlad iwei ïa eiei pat , bad ngi la leit kiew ha ka lieng katba ma ki , ki la leit phai sha ïing .
translation.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship  ; and they returned home again .

translation.kha: Berakah kaba nga don ka long ka jong me , bad baroh’ kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom jongnga nga la pynpaw lyngba jong ki .
translation.en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .

translation.kha: U te u ong ha u , Wanrah kawei ka mai , kawei ka blang , uwei u langbrot , kawei pa kawei na ki ka dei ban longïng kaba lai snem ka rta , bad kawei ka paro , bad kawei ka lyngdkhur .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .

translation.kha: Nongthaw u la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar bad u la kylli , Ko rangbah , kaei nga dadien ban leh ba yn pynim ïa nga ?
translation.en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?

translation.kha: bad kin phla , ‘ Ym dei ma I kiba pynïap ïa uto u briew , bad ngim shym ieh ruh mano ba la leh ïa kata ka kam .
translation.en: And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .

translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba u paidbah u la ïakynduh ïa U — namar ba ki la jingsngewsih ba U la leh ïa kane ka kambah .
translation.en: For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ijon ki la jubab ïa ki , Phi hi kotbah kano kambah dei ha khmat U Blei — ban khunlung ïa phi ne ban ïanguh ïa U Blang .
translation.en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .

Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion , and shall flow together to the goodness of the  Lord  , for wheat , and for wine , and for oil , and for the young of the flock and of the herd : and their soul shall be as a watered garden  ; and they shall not sorrow any more at all .
translation.kha: Kin wan bad rwai da ka jingkmen ha u lum Seïon bad kin kmen ha ki jingai sngewbha jong nga — ki jingai sngewbha da u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ki jingai sngewbha da ki langbrot bad ki masi . Kin long kum ka kper bad la ai um bha ; kin don baroh kat kaba ki donkam .

Kumta u pynphai pat ïa ki shwa la ka kmie . Ka shimet arspah tylli ki sbai rupa dara ka ai ïa ki ha u bania , babha la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka rupa . La Buh ïa ka ha ïinglieng u Mikah .
translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .

Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :
translation.kha: Wat la ki dieng Dumbur kim don soh bad ym don sohwaiñ ba mih ha ki dieng sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei bad ki lyngkha kim pynmih kew , wat la ki langbrot baroh ki ïap bad ki sem masi ki thylli ,
Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jngai u Jakob lem bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawan ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka Nehemaïah ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: Jaban kumta ka la long ba ka tong ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la Ïohi shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka pynlang ka la nang san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .

translation.kha: Kumta u Sheshbassar u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jongki ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid naduh kata ka por haduh mynta , isynei ym pat pyndep ïa ka Tabeel .’
translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .

And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U syiem Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki sum , bad ar lakh phraphew ngut ki rangbah na Benjamin , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki long kiba shlur , ki rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .

‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan haw ha utai u briew uba thaw durblei da u maw , da u dieng , lap da u nar bad Uba mane ïa ka ha kaba rieh ; U Trai u isih ïa ka jingmane lynthaw .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab len , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image , an abomination unto the  Lord  , the work of the hands of the craftsman , and putteth it in a secret place . And all the people shall answer and say , Amen .

translation.kha: U syiem u lwa noh na ka shaniah ti jong u ïa ka sati kaba don ka mudui syiem bad u pyndeng ïa ka ha ka shyieng ti jong u Joseph . U pynkup ruh ïa u da ka jaiñ linen bani , bad u pyntieng ïa u kynjri khiar ha ka rmiang jong u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand , and put it upon Joseph s hand , and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen , and put a gold chain about his neck  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u nguh ha ki ïabah jong u , Hato to uno uno hangne naba isih ïa ki Jebus kamar najan ma de ? Haduh katta kat ban pynïap ïa ki ? Te khie leit kyiuh lyngba ka nur-um bad tur ïaleh ïa kito ki bapli ki matlah bad ki dkoh . ( Dei na kata ka daw ba la ong , Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kim lah ba-bang rung sha ka ïing ka jongu U Trai . )
translation.en: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .

translation.kha: hynñiew u Ïoannis u la pyrshang ba pynïakhlad ïa ka jingmut jong u . Nga dei ban shahïap pynbaptis ha me , u Ïashong u la ong , bad me la wan pynban shaw nga !
translation.en: But John forbad him , saying , I have need to be baptized of thee , and comest thou to me ?

translation.kha: La otsher ïa ki borbah ar ngut ha hajuh ka sngi ,
translation.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .

translation.kha: Ki jingbynta , Ïa ka hima jong ph la pynbynta bad la ai ha ki Mid bad ki Persia .
translation.en: PERES  ; Thy kingdom is divided , and given to the Medes and Persians .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , u Adrammelekh u khot plain ïa ki ngab shihajar jong u baroh , bad u ïathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh .
translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba ka balang ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la ïoh shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la nang san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .

Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongpynïaidkam . Ki kynhun shipai ka Persia bad ka Media ki la ïadon nur-um , kumjuh ruh ki lat bad ki riewpawkhmat jong ki jylli .
translation.en: In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants  ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him :

translation.kha: Dang ka jingieit kaba la pynjrong ïa u Moses , haba u la lapbah , ban kyntait ba yn khot ïa u , u kynhun jong ka khun u Pharaoh .
translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u ïam ïa ki da ka lynti khlaiñ lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba poi sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ki Israel ki long kiba la kieng atiar ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba mynsaw phi dang long kiba miej bleithaw , la ïalam sakma ïa phi ha ki rukom Ibbah bun shwa ki jingmeng ïa ki bleithaw) ki bim ei jingim .
translation.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles , carried away unto these dumb idols , even as ye were led .
And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynmaw kumno phi baroh phi la kloi ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkyiuh .

translation.en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la don ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; u angel U Trai u la wan hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u maw , bad u la shong halor jong u .
U la ai ha ngi ïa U nongïapom bakhrawbor , uba thapniang na u Dabid u shakri jrong u .
translation.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David  ;

translation.kha: Lada ar pynbna ba u briew ba-bymman u daiñ ban ïap bad mem shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïap , kamon u nongpop , bad ngan pyntngit pop ïa me na ka pynbha ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .

translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka kyrhai ïa ka , haneng phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un pyrkhat ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi ! Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la trei ha ka lyngkha ka dien jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .
translation.en: And her mother in law said unto her , Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou ? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee . And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .

translation.kha: lymne kim ju bam ïa kaei kaei kaba wanrah na ïew lympat ki sait shuwa ïa ka . Bad ki bud ïa ibha bun kiwei ki aiñ kiba ki la ïohpdiang , kum kiba put ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa ki khlur , ki khiew , ki pdiang ïong , bad ki jingthiah . )
translation.en: And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingthoh ha ka jingpyndap daym ban pyntip paidbah ha kawei pa kaweh ka probins , khnang ba bhor kin long ba la pynkhreh haba said ka sner kan woh .
translation.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people , that they should be ready against that day .

And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ud pang na ka jingotsher jong ki , ar ngut na ki khun shynrang u Jakob , u Simeon bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shynrang jong ka Dinah , ki la shim ïa la ki waitlam bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang baroh , kynthup ïa u Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u .

U Trai u ainong , Baroh ki kam sniew jong ki , ki la sdang ha Gilgal . Ka la erlangthari hangta ba ar shadong ban isih ïa ki . bad namar ka jingsniew ba ki la leh , ngan beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong ang . Ngan ym ieit shuh ïa ki ; baroh ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrsad ïa de .
translation.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal : for there I hated them : for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house , I will love them no more : all their princes are revolters .
Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long kum u jingthung uba ki thied ki la tyrkhong bad um pynmih soh ei ei shuh . Kin ym ïoh khun shuh , hynrei wat lada ki dang ïoh , ngan pynïap ïa ki khun thep mynsiem jong ki .
Ha kata ka suri ki la ai saiñ ïa la u kpa , bad kata ka khun nongdih ka la ïathiah shongkha bad u . Hynrei u la buaid shaba palat kat khah ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .
translation.en: And they made their father drink wine that night : and the firstborn went in , and lay with her father  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
And the sons of Izhar  ; Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .
translation.kha: U Ishar u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Korah , u Nepheg , bad u Sikhri .

translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u Gad u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Khie leit shatei sha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah bad tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai .

Ym don jingpynkoit ei ei ïa ki jingmynsaw jongnga me , bad ïa ki jingmong jong me ym Lah ban pynkoit . barieh kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynjot ïa me ki thep ïa la ki kti ha ka jingkmen . Hato une uno un lait phet na ka jinglong Rung bymkut jong me ?
translation.en: There is no healing of thy bruise  ; thy wound is grievous : all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee : for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually ?
But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .
translation.kha: Hynrei khyndiat ki symbai u la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha , bad ki jingthung ki la pynmih symboh ; katto katne ki la pynmih shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .

translation.en: And he said to David , Thou art more righteous than I : for thou hast rewarded me good , whereas I have rewarded thee evil .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Dabid  Phi la leh ïa kaba dei , bad nga la leh bakla . Phi la lehbha shikatdei eh ïa nga , katba nga pat nga la leh haduh katne kaba sniew ïa phi !

translation.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh s house , saying , Joseph s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha ka ïingsyiem ba ki hynmen u Joseph ki la poi , u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la sngewbha shibun eh .
Te kin Jubab ba ka long namar ba phi la lyndum ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U Blei jong phi! , bad phira la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei patan ki blei .
translation.en: Then they shall answer , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  their God , and worshipped other gods , and served them .

translation.kha: Haba ngam smam la jubab , u Neraïah u la ong , Khie leit phai pat sha u Gedalaïah , u khuid jong u Ahikam bad u kseh jong u Shaphan , ïa naba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . phin lah ban sah bad u bad im hateng ki briew , lane phi lah ban leit hangto shano ba phi pyrkhat ba phi! dei ban leit . Kumta u la ai ïa to ka jingai sngewma bad katto katne ka jingbam ban rah bad nga , bad u la shah ïa nga ba kun leit noh ha la ka lynti .
translation.en: Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
Yet let no man strive , nor reprove another : for thy people are as they that strive with the priest .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Wat ai ba uno uno un kynnoh ïa ki briew lane pynrem ïa ki — ka jingmudui jong nga ka long pyrshah ïa phi ki lyngdoh .
bad ïa lade” ka leit shong kamra siewspah mitar na kata ka jaka . Ka ong ha lade , Ngam lah shah shun ïohi ïa la u khun ba u ïap . Katba ka sdang shong hangamei , ka la shang banbeiñ ïam .
translation.en: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .

translation.kha: Bakhraw ar ki leit sha khiew ka jaka — ka khyndew . Baroh ar ki la wan na ka bad baroh ar ken leit pei pateng sha ka .
translation.en: All go unto one place  ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .

translation.kha: Badno mynta , A Trai Nongsynshar , me long U Blei ; me ju ïai bat ïa la ki kular , bad me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kular kaba phylla .
translation.en: And now , O Lord  God  , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :

translation.kha: Te ma phi badno ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ha kata ka ri Kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa thymmei jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta kaban ka suiñbneng ka dong neh halor ka pyrthei .
translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .

translation.kha: Lada me leh pop , kata kam ktah ei ei ïa U Blei . ïada basan me leh bakla , hato kata ka ktah ïa u ?
translation.en: If thou sinnest , what doest thou against him ? or if thy transgressions be multiplied , what doest thou unto him ?

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ong ha kabu ïohsngew paidbah , Nga la leh pop . Nangne shym la leh kaba dei , hynrei U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga .
translation.en: He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not  ;

translation.kha: Te U Trei u wan bad u ïing hangta , bad u khot kum mynshuwa , Samuel ! Ko Samuel ! U Samuel u jubab , To kren ; u sharai jong me u shahshkor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  came , and stood , and called as at other times , Samuel , Samuel . Then Samuel answered , Speak  ; for thy servant heareth .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , Ko Mahli ! Ka la blei sha u bad ka la ong ha ka ktien Hebru , Rabboni ! ( kane ka mutdur Ko Nonghikai ! . )
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Mary .  She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni  ; which is to say , Master .

translation.kha: U Abram u la don Pharisi hynriew snem ha kata ka por .
translation.en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .

translation.kha: phi tip kaei kaba U blang u kwah ïa phoi ban ar , malade phi ïoh jinghikai na ka Hukum ban jied ïa khie kaba dei ;
translation.en: And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko pyrthei ! Kum ka jingpynshitom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nga wallam ka jingud halor kine ki briew , namar ki la kyntait ïa ka jingïakhaïi jong to pynlang kim shyiap la kohnguh ïa ki ktung jong per .
translation.en: Hear , O earth : behold , I will bring evil upon this people , even the fruit of their thoughts , because they have not hearkened unto my words , nor to my law , but rejected it .

translation.kha: U Ariokh , uba ha byndi lem bad nga , u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , bad kumta ruh u markhap , u bakha jong u Rangbah . ( Phi la da ïohpdiang lypa ïa ki jingbthah ban pynpdang sngewbha ïa u Markos lada u wan sha Phi . )
translation.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you , and Mark , sister s son to Barnabas , ( touching whom ye received commandments : if he come unto you , receive him ; )

translation.kha: Suh kito naba sait pynkhuid ïa la ki jaiñkup bad kamet ki don ka hok ban bam ïa u shuh na u ding ka jingim bad ban sien lyngba ki khyrdop shapoh ka nongbah .
translation.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments , that they may have right to the tree of life , and may enter in through the gates into the city .
Be ye followers of me , even as I also am of Christ .
translation.kha: To pyrthuh bud ïa nga , te , kumba nga ruh nga pyrthuh bud ïa U Khrist .
Katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la leit lyngba ïa ki phang kiba Shobab jong ka probins bad u la poi ha —Ephesos . Hangta u la shem katto katne ngut kiba ngeit ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,

translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u la ngab bha pun pynlong ïa la ki jingkut jingmut , ki briew kin dih bud bad bameh dap .
translation.en: Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jaitniam sim ki shrong skum ha ki tnat jong u ; ki mradkhlaw ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jong u ; ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .
translation.en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .

translation.kha: ( Jubab 1 :27 ; 4 :4 ) Phin lah mo ban ithuh ïa ka kynhun ha shnong jong phi kaba don kum kine ki tam jongki ka jinglong Khristan bashisha ?
translation.en: ( James 1 :27  ; 4 :4 ) Can you identify a religious group in your community that has these marks of true Christianity ?
And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .
translation.kha: Lyngba ka duriaw me pynlong ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta ki briew jong me bad me ïalam ïa ki lyngba ka khyndew ba-rkhiang . Ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki , me pynïap jyllop ha ka um bajylliew , kum u maw uba ngam ha ka duriaw ba-atphyllung .

Wat bakha bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiad . Ka sngi ka la pah hab U Blei’ un pynbudnam ïa ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki jingïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingdam .
translation.en: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .

translation.kha: La don Orpah ngut ki Rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; ki tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .
translation.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .

In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country  ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ka kynthup ïa ka ri lum , ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi , ka Them Jordan bad ki kjat lum jong ka , ka sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi bad ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka ri ka la ju long ka ïing jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .

translation.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds , and folds for flocks .
translation.kha: Ka ri jong phi harud duriaw kan kylla long ki pyntha bym don jingkah lem bad ki trep jong ki nongap langbrot bad ki sem langbrot .
Kanaan ka kynhun bah jong ki angel ka bneng , ka la mihpaw lem bad u duh , ki da ri ki jingïarap ïa U Blei :
translation.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,
But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki rangbah synshar ki la poi , kim shym shem ïa ki apostol ha byndi , kumta ki la wan phai noh sha ka Dorbar bad ki la ïathuh ,

translation.en: And the king said unto Zadok , Carry back the ark of God into the city : if I shall find favour in the eyes of the  Lord  , he will bring me again , and shew me both it , and his habitation :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Sadok ,  Khie leit rah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka nongbah . Lada U  Trai  u sngewbha ïa nga , shisien ka sngi un shah ba ngan wan biang ban ïohi ïa ka bad ïa ka jaka ha kaba ka don .
U ong ha ki , Haba la poi ha ka tduh ka jakarieh sher dara , ïitkhmih shata sa bad leh ïa kaba nga leh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Look on me , and do likewise : and , behold , when I come to the outside of the camp , it shall be that , as I do , so shall ye do .
The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not , It is enough :
translation.kha: U thliem u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei , bad baroh ar ki kyrteng  Ai ïa nga !  Don saw tylli kiei kiei ki bym ju kdang :
Hynrei na ka bynta u Dabid , U Trai U Blei jrong u , u la ai ïa u Abijah u khun ban synshar hadien jong u ha Jerusalem bad ngab sumar ïa ka Jerusalem ba kan skhem .
translation.en: Nevertheless for David s sake did the  Lord  his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem , to set up his son after him , and to establish Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Ishmael — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh khiew pat Ibbah la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Tabor .
translation.en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,

translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , To U Trai un pynrem ïa me , ko Soitan ! To U Trai , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusha , un pynslem ïa me . Une u briew u long kum u diengkhap ïa uba la sei noh na ka ding .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?

translation.kha: Iathuh ianga haei ka wei ka don .
translation.en: Tell me where the wine is .

translation.kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Isaia sha said ka jingkñia , bad ngan sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew’ uba ngan ïathuh ha me .
translation.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will shew thee what thou shalt do : and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee .
For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim .
Nangta u pudina jong ka u basah beit shaphang sepngi shaduh Migdalel , da kaba khie ïa ka Shabbethai bad ïa ka ïawad kaba sha mihngi jongu ka jubanlak .
translation.en: And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u Salmone u longing hiar sha Timnath ryngkat malu la u kpa bad ka kmie . Katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki bri sohwaiñ hangta , u ïohsngew ïa u sing set ba u kyrhuh .
translation.en: Then went Samson down , and his father and his mother , to Timnah , and came to the vineyards of Timnah : and , behold , a young lion roared against him .

translation.kha: Khenani kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong , Em ! u khulom naba dang im u daiñ u jong to , bad uba la ïap u dei u jyllang pha ! Kata ka kynthei kaba nyngkong ka jubab , Em ! u khunlung uba la ïa-ïap u dei u jong pha , bad umbah dang im dei u jong nga . Bad kumta ki ïakajia ha khmat u syiem .
translation.en: And the other woman said , Nay  ; but the living is my son , and the dead is thy son . And this said , No  ; but the dead is thy son , and the living is my son . Thus they spake before the king .

translation.kha: La katta ruh , ki briew jong nga uba hok kin ngeit bad kine im ; hynrei lada uno uno na ki u pei dien sam ym jingsngewbha shuh ïa u .
translation.en: Now the just shall live by faith : but if any man draw back , my soul shall have no pleasure in him .
He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .
translation.kha: bad nangta u bynrap ,  Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi .   Kaei kata ?  ka kylli .
ki diengthew : ki dei naba tlot , hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;
translation.en: The ants are a people not strong , yet they prepare their meat in the summer  ;

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la phiah ïa ki paid Jerusalem ha la ka lynti , bad uwei pa uwei u briew u la leit ban shim kynti ïa la ka bhah jyllang ka ri .
translation.en: And when Joshua had let the people go , the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .

translation.kha: Nadab ka janmiet jong ka sneng kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong haduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kabu arphew wei jong utai u bnai , phin ym ïajubab ïa u kpu ba la khlem thiat .
translation.en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even , ye shall eat unleavened bread , until the one and twentieth day of the month at even .

And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba shong basah ha ka Them Jesreel ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ka la phet ïap , bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong ha ki .
bad iba kiba ha mihnoh kin ïaroh ïa u . Ki briew kiba im harud ka duriaw kin ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Wherefore glorify ye the  Lord  in the fires , even the name of the  Lord  God of Israel in the isles of the sea .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phna ïoh ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pjiar ha baroh ki liang .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .

translation.kha: Nga smai ha me ba ngan pynlong ïa uwei na ka longïing jong me hi ban wallam jingjur halor jong me . Men ïohi ïa ka hab nga smat na me ïa ki tngen jong me bad ai ïa ki ha uei pat u briew ; bad un ïathiah shongkha sad ki haba dang shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house , and I will take thy wives before thine eyes , and give them unto thy neighbour , and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun .

translation.kha: Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Asaph jong ki lehbha ki ne ha la ki khang ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem Dabid : u Asaph , u Gaham , malu u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u shem . Ki nongap pher ha ki khyrdop ka templ kim shym dakmong baneh mihnoh na ki jaka ba ki ap , namar kiwei paw ki Lebi ki pynkhreh ïa ka Jingkhawai Anam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place , according to the commandment of David , and Asaph , and Heman , and Jeduthun the king s seer  ; and the porters waited at every gate  ; they might not depart from their service  ; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them .

translation.kha: Ka jingpyrkhat ïa ka jingpang jong per , ka jingbymdon ïing jong nga , ka longsyiem ka bih bakhatduh .
translation.en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .
It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .
translation.kha: Lehse U  Trai  un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha nga katto katne ki jingkyrkhu ban shim bujli ïa ka jingtim jong u .

A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shna ki lwa jingtep ba-bieit na ka bynta ki ïathuhlypa dara phi pynitynnat ïa ki mot sngewkhlaiñ jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins .
translation.kha: U siat ïa la ki khnam jylliew shapoh ka met jong nga .
Hadien kata , u Judas u nong Galilaïa u la mih ha ka por jong ka jingkheiñbriew ; u la khring ïa u paidbah ban stem ïa u , hynrei ïa u ruh la pynpoh , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma .
translation.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished  ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .

But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ïa nga , ba nga la pynïap shibun eh ki briew bad ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kumta , namar ba nga la pynmih shibun ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .
U Balaam u leh kumta , bad u kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha Kaei pa kawei ka duwan .
translation.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei bad ki khot kyrpad ïa u ban eh jingïalap .
translation.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .

translation.kha: Naba ne ha jingthiah Bakhuid la ong ïa kane shaphang ka sngi kaba hynñiew : U balui u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaban hynñiew na ka kam jyllang u baroh .
translation.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .

translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa u biria , u la lynñiar jam , bad u la mihnoh na u .
translation.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
All the kingdom of Og in Bashan , which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei , who remained of the remnant of the giants : for these did Moses smite , and cast them out .
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka hima jong u Og , uba khatduh jong ki Rephaim , uba la synshar ha Ashtaroth bad Edrei . U Moses u la jop ïa kine ki briew bad u la beh noh ïa ki .

(Nga duwai ha U Blei , A Trai U Blang jong ka bteng ! Me longsyiem uba khraw , ngi ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa me . Me batskhem ïa la ka jutang mala kita kiba ieit ïa me bad kiba leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .
translation.en: And said , I beseech thee , O  Lord  God of heaven , the great and terrible God , that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments :

translation.kha: Nga la kyndit sad nga jubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , to im junom ! Kumne ngan lah khlem imat sngewsih haba ka nongbud ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa thom jong ang ka Don hap ki jinglwet bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ha ka ding ?
translation.en: And said unto the king , Let the king live for ever : why should not my countenance be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers  sepulchres , lieth waste , and the gates thereof are consumed with fire ?

translation.kha: dem kata keiñ bapli ba la khot Ka Lyngkha Ka Saph hapoh kñia ka snoh .
translation.en: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .

translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab , Kynrad , phi la lehbha shibun ïa nga . Phin la pynpang ïa nga ban khlam sngewbiang da kaba kren jem jai jai ïa nga , wat la ngam ïaryngkat kyrdan bad kawei na ki sharai jrong phi .
translation.en: Then she said , Let me find favour in thy sight , my lord  ; for that thou hast comforted me , and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid , though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jyllang ka Moab la khñiot noh ; ïa ka bor jong ka la pynstet . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: The horn of Moab is cut off , and his arm is broken , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong pa’ ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkoit bad ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh lem .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .
For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .
translation.kha: Ki la theh noh ïa ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei bad jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban dih . Ki la ïoh ïa kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !
Nangta ki hynmen jong u hi ki ïawan bad ki ïadem ngon ha khmat jong u . Ngi long ki mraw jong phi , ki ong .
translation.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face  ; and they said , Behold , we be thy servants .

translation.kha: Te namarkata , lada ngi don ka bam bad ka kup ka sem , kata kan dei ka la biang ïa ngi .
translation.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content .

translation.kha: Tang uta uba mutlop shaba palat ban jingkam ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .
translation.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
translation.kha: Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um pat shym la kren ha u Shemaïah , hynrei ba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la pynbam pisa ïa u ban ai ïa nga ïa kane ka jingmaham .

translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother : that thy days may be long upon the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , ba phi lah ban im slem ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phi .

Da ki jingkyrkhu jongki me , ki syiem ki la synshar ïa ki bhabriew Jong me haba ki shong ki sahit ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh ba me la ai ïa ki ; hynrei kim shym la phai ne na ka pop ban shakri ïa me .
translation.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .
I am a brother to dragons , and a companion to owls .
translation.kha: Ka sur jong nga ka long sngewsih bad marwei kum ka jingïam u myrsiang lane ka ostrit .
U Jingsuk uba na Nasareth , ki la jubab . Dei ma nga u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat nabar ki .
translation.en: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane , U ijuh u la bynrap , ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju pdiang sngewbha ha la ka shnong .
translation.en: And he said ,  Verily I say unto you , No prophet is accepted in his own country .

That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: bad u la phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel :  Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt .
Ki la tmoh ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pynteh ïa ki briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u kynhun jongki u Tabeel halor ka khait .
translation.en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :

translation.kha: bad ïada ngan ïan phai pateng da kaba juk sha ïing u kpa jong nga , te men long U Balei jong nga .
translation.en: So that I come again to my father s house in peace  ; then shall the  Lord  be my God :

translation.kha: Nangta per la ong ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki paidbah ba U Trai u la lah ong : Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba Ong ba ïa ki jingkynshew ka Templ yn sa wanpaw pat shen shen na bniah . Ki shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you , saying , Behold , the vessels of the  Lord s  house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la sdang baneh kylli para ma ki uno napdeng lad ki uba lah ban hir u ban sa leh ïa kane .
translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .

translation.kha: Ïa u briew la kha ha ka doh na ki kmie ki kpa kiba long ki briew , hynrei la kha ha kaba kynjai mynsiem na U Mynsiem .
translation.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh  ; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la mudui , A Tlai , to sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong bad to shahshkor ïa kaei ba ki nongshun jong nga ki ong shaphang jong nga .
translation.en: Give heed to me , O  Lord  , and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me .

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba dkhoh u sangeh ban leh ïa kaba bha malu u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad hadien dat u ïap , u ïap Naaman ka jingsniew kaba u la leh .
translation.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .
For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Perasim bad ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kaba u thmu ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin long kum kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam jong u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .
Ki nongtong dohkha ktang pynrkhiang ïa la ki lade halor Jong u , hangta ha kaba u ïeng ha ka duriaw . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki jaitbynriew ktang pynjot ïa ka tyrsim .
translation.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God  : and it shall become a spoil to the nations .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh bad phi kyntait ban shahshkor , bad phi shad ïalam bakla ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translation.en: But if thine heart turn away , so that thou wilt not hear , but shalt be drawn away , and worship other gods , and serve them  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin ïalehkmen bad kin ïai jingai sngewbha mawkyntang , namar ba Us ki ar nguh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibit ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .
translation.en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .

translation.kha: Ngan leh ki kambah ha ka sahkut bneng shajrong sad ïa ki jingphylla ha ka khyndew sha thapniang . Kin don ka snam , ka ding , bad ka tdem ka rben ;
translation.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath  ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi Katto u la long uba distrik ha ka jingbabe jongu u , nabar kumta U la ong ïa u , Mem long jngai na ka Hima U Blei . Hadien kane , ym don shuh moi mano ba nud ban kylli kino kine ki jingkylli ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly , he said unto him ,  Thou art not far from the kingdom of God .  And no man after that durst ask him any question .

translation.kha: Hynrei U thri u la sngewngiah eh ïa u Noah .
translation.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jakob u shimti ïa ki tnad kiba dang im na ka dieng lyntang , u diengsoh almond , bad u Dieng Sning , bad u khoh sniew ha katto katne jaka haduh ba ki thet dieng kin da paw ka meeting lieh .
translation.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .

translation.kha: Uno une u Israel lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong ryngkat pynpdang jong ki , kiba ktien ïa ka jingtieng thang dawai ïa kano Kane ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U Trai hangno hangno lait tang ha ka jingkhang Jong ka Ïing , yn ym ñiar shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongnga U blang .
