translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: Ngan waiñ ïalamwir pat ïa ki briew’ jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa ter pat ïa ki shnong ba la jaiñjot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa ka waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin ïam na kaei kaba mih .
translation.en: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa ki mardor Khenaanah bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar . Ha kita la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Jakob .
translation.en: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold , graven , as signets are graven , with the names of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Bad phi pynthikna ba phi long daladie u nongïalam ïa uba matlah , ka jingshai ïa kito Kiba ha ka jingdum ,
translation.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,
Those by the way side are they that hear  ; then cometh the devil , and taketh away the word out of their hearts , lest they should believe and be saved .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei u Ksuid u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka khubor na ki dohnud jong ki khnang ban khang ïa ki na kaba ngeit bad ïohlait im .
Ki la tan ïa ki lynti sharud durblei , ki la iehnoh ïa kiei keiñ barabor bad ki la bud ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .

translation.kha: Kine khathynriew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u .—Jakob u ïoh na ka Silpah ïa kob u Lehab u ai ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban erlangthari ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .

translation.kha: Nga la leh thup da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew kaba lui ia ban ïap ! u la ong . Kan ïadoh aïu kata bad ngi ? ki la jubab . Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !
translation.en: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .

translation.kha: U Uriah u jubab , Ki rangbah Israel bad Judah ki don jingjia ha ka thma , bad ka Synduk ka Jutang ka Don Bad ki ; u Joab u pynbah nongai hukum ïa nga bad ki nongbah pynïaidkam jong u ki ïasah ha padun . Kumno nga lah ban shu leit Sha ïing , ïa-ban bam shun dih , bad ban thiah bad la ka rnga ? Ka long kaba kyntang ïa at , nga smai ba ngan ym leh ïa kaba kumin kata ka kam !
translation.en: And Uriah said unto David , The ark , and Israel , and Judah , abide in tents  ; and my lord Joab , and the servants of my lord , are encamped in the open fields  ; shall I then go into mine house , to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? as thou livest , and as thy soul liveth , I will not do this thing .

translation.kha: Ki ïakren shaphang U Blei ka Jerusalem kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong Kiwei pat ki jingïambriew , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kiei ki bariew .
translation.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
translation.kha: To ñiewburom ïa baroh , to ieit ïa la ki parabangeit , to tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad ñiewburom ïa u Patsha .
U ïabuaid u kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Trai dara u sien , dom u Gad u la ong ïa u .
translation.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the  Lord .

Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .
translation.kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri bad u la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh kiba shong sawdong jong phi , pynïap lut ïa ki Amalek baroh , khnang ban ym don shuh uba kynmaw ïa ki . Wat klet ïa kane !
ka Kedesh , ka Hasor , ka Ithnan ,
translation.en: And Kedesh , and Hazor , and Ithnan ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Jiw u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu malade ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la khyndai ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synreit jong u ban sam ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .

translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei ka them dei ban pyndap , ïa uwei ba uwei u lumrit bad u lumbah dei ban pynmadan . Ïa ki lynti kiba kyllaiñ dei ban pynbeit , bad ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba khohruh khroh dei ban pynjlih .
translation.en: Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low  ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth  ;

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingshai jong pa ka dei ban shatai ha khmat ki briew , khñiang ba kin ïor ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phiah leh bad ïaroh ïa u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .
translation.en: Let your light so shine before men , that they may see your good works , and glorify your Father which is in heaven .
And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites , and unto the judge that shall be in those days , and enquire  ; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment :
translation.kha: bad mudui ha u lyngdoh Lebi bad u nongbishar uba treikam ha kata ka por , bad ieh kin rai ma ki ïa kata ka mokotduma .

translation.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?
translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi dei ban leh ïa kijuh ki pop kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh bad ba phi ïabud nadien ki bleithaw jong ki ?
Ïeng la leh pop dara sheng ïalaw pyrshah , bad ma me A Trai , Amam pah shym Map ïa ngi .
translation.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled : thou hast not pardoned .
Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
translation.kha: Me tip ba kum uta ki briew u long uba bamsap bad ki pop jong u ki pynshisha ba u bakla .

Mynta ong ïa ki paidbah , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa lade” na ka bynta lashai ; bad phin sa ioh ka doh ban bam . U Trai u la ïohsngew ba phi ïakren khñium bad ong ba pa mutdur ba phi ei jingkyndit ka doh , bad ba pa’ khlam ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U TRAI’ un ai ka doh ba phin bam , bad phoi de ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .

translation.kha: Kumta u Uriah u thaw ïa ka duwan thik kum kata , bad u pynmihpat ïa ka shuwa ba u Ahas un wan phai .
translation.en: And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus : so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus .

translation.kha: U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jubab , Uta uba la lehbha ïa u . U Jisu u la jubab , Te , ma me khie saw nabar leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .
In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew bad u kylli ïa u ,  Kaei me mon ïa nga ban ai ha me ?
U Joab u ïohsngew ba ki khun Shaneng jong u Laban ki ïa-ei , U Jakob u la shim lut baroh kat kaba dei ka jrong i pa jong ngi . U la ïoh lut ïa ka spah baroh na kaei Kaba i pa jong ngi i don .
translation.en: And he heard the words of Laban s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father s  ; and of that which was our father s hath he gotten all this glory .

translation.kha: lada phim kohnguh ïa ka lei , U Blei un skhem ïa ki jingduwai jong pa kiba ijli eh ban sngap .
translation.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .

translation.kha: U la wan ha u Simon Petros , uba la ong ha u , Hato men saisaw ïa ki kjat jong la , ko Trai ?
translation.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter : and Peter saith unto him , Lord , dost thou wash my feet ?

translation.kha: U pynpoi ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh ; u tip kaei kiba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , bad ïa u hi la por shohdoh da ka jingshoh .
translation.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .

translation.kha: Um skhem la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynñiew u la leit ban shong ban sai ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thain jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .
translation.en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :

And when they were gone out of the city , and not yet far off , Joseph said unto his steward , Up , follow after the men  ; and when thou dost overtake them , say unto them , Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good ?
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïaid ym pat da jngai na shnong , u Joseph u ong ha uta u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Khie , leit bud mar mar nadien kito ki briew . Ynda phi lap ïa ki , ong ha ki , ‘ Balei phi siew kylliang da kaba sniew ïa kaba bha ?
Ki la mawkynroh na uta u briew bad ki la rung Shabeh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sngur baroh ka la noh shata rishot shapoh ka durblei bad ki la ïap jyllop .
translation.en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .
Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ki Ken phin sa shah pynjot thiaw Ynda u Assyria u ringmraw ïa phi .

translation.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
translation.kha: Bad pynban u dei U Blei uba la pynriewspah ïa ki — ngam lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bymman .
len pynshitom ïa u Balah , u Blei ki nong bakhia , dara ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u bakha shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew kin ym Mane shuh ïa u . Ki kynruh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .
translation.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .
For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .
translation.kha: Ngam leh ïa kaba bha kaba nga kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .
Khenani Haba U Blei u la pynpait ïa ki nongbah jong tala ka Them ha katba u Lot u shong shnong , u la buh jingkynshew ïa u Abraham , bad u la ailad ïa u Jutang ban lait im .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .
And , behold , there came a man named Jairus , and he was a ruler of the synagogue : and he fell down at Jesus  feet , and besought him that he would come into his house :
translation.kha: Te u briew uba kyrteng u Jairos u la wan poi ; u la long u rangbah synshar ha ka synagog kaba ha kata ka shnong . U la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha ïing jong u ,

translation.en: Doth our law judge any man , before it hear him , and know what he doeth ?
translation.kha: U la ong ha kiwei ,  Kat kum ka Hukum jong ngi ngim lah ban pynrem ïa u briew ha shuwa ban ïohsngew na u bad ban shem kaei ba u la leh .
Elam ïa u Haran bad ki khuid shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Khidon Ryngkat jong nga badno ong ba kin bet katei kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah synshar ki Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh ba kin da lah thoh sha u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .
Kumta u la sdang bishni bad suba Sniew ïa u Dabid naduh sakma ka sngi .
translation.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward .

translation.kha: hynrei leit rah ïa ki thrang ha kawei ka tare ha kaba U Trai un iaid na ka ri jong kaei na ki jait jong phin , bad hangta phin har ïa kita baroh ibha sa la hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïong , ‘ Dei ka jingbynrap kaba ang kwah , ym ïa ka jingkynha ïa ki mrad .’ Lada Phin la tap kaei ka jingmut jong kane , phin ym da la pynbam ïa ki Briew ki bym shym shah pynrem ;
translation.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .

translation.kha: hynrei U Troas u longïng wahbah bha bad leh-isynei ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynïong ïa ki , hynrei u ïap ïa ki , namar ka ïong jong u bad u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Um pat ju klet ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .
So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites in their courses , according to the king s commandment .
translation.kha: Haba la dep pynbiang ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki shim ïa la ki bynta , kumba la hukum da u syiem .

translation.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .
translation.kha: Ki shipai na Persia , Lydia , bad Libya ki shakri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh bad ïa ki jingïada khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .
Kaba mih nongkit ka long , ba ka kynhun nongkhap phira jong ka ïongjngum barhem kawei bad baroh kawei pud hangne , ki tip) ba nga don ha ka byndi namar ang long u shakri jong U Khrist .
translation.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace , and in all other places ;
Then said he , Lo , I come to do thy will , O God . He taketh away the first , that he may establish the second .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Nga hangne , A Blei , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me .  Kumta U Blei u la pynsangeh noh ïa baroh ki jait jingkñia kiba rim bad u la pynlong ba ka jingkñia U Khrist kan mih bujli ha ka jaka jong ki .

translation.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet  ; and he called his name Jedidiah , because of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u la hukum ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ban jer kyrteng ïa u khynnah , u Jedidaïah , namar ba U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u .
nangta , ki lai ngut ki synrai ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Maaseïah ba ki ïakynton bad U Jisu .
translation.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .

translation.kha: To isynei ïa nga , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem jingsngewbha ha ka aiñ Jong me .
translation.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?
translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shaphang ki kam runar jong ki ?

translation.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .
translation.kha: Hadien kata ka jingpynïap , kita kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la lute ïa kata ka shnong ban pynhiarkput namar ka jingpynkheiñ burom ïa ka para jong ki .
Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! ïa-ong u Ebron . Khie leit Bah ïa uwei na ki shipai bad shim kat ïa kiba u don . Hynrei u Jehasiel u ïai beh kthong hi sia ïa u .
translation.en: And Abner said to him , Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left , and lay thee hold on one of the young men , and take thee his armour . But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him .

translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah ka Moab , balei ba Phi kam ïa lade kum ki riewkhraw , ki shipai bashapoh ba la tyngkan ha ka sur-thma ?
translation.en: How say ye , We are mighty and strong men for the war ?

translation.kha: Kñia ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kin tat kumto ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kba shnong basah bad phiah .
translation.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .
Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles , shalt quicken me again , and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth .
translation.kha: Me la phah ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom halor jong nga , hynrei men pynïoh pat ka jingkhlaiñ ha nga ; men sumar ïa nga na ka jingtep .

Haba U Ujuh u la wei sha ka thain Gadara ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , la ïashem ïa u da ki ar ngut ki jingbabe kiba la wan mih ïa ki krem jinghap kiba kein hangta . Kine ki rangbah ki la don ki ksuit thah jong ki bad ki la long kiba itriem shikatdei ba ym don moi mano ba nud ban leit na kata ka lynti .
translation.en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes , there met him two possessed with devils , coming out of the tombs , exceeding fierce , so that no man might pass by that way .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba pahara ba ine im ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngim ïateh na ki jingtem ba kynja pyrthei .
translation.en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :

translation.kha: ianga ma sa bad ka kynhun lad na moi put ïa la ki turoi , phi shiah lade ïa la ki turoi baroh sawdong ka jaka shijur dara , bad pyrta jam , ‘ Ïa U Trai bad ïa u Gideon !’
translation.en: When I blow with a trumpet , I and all that are with me , then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and say , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market : and thou wast replenished , and made very glorious in the midst of the seas .
translation.kha: Ïa ki mar khaïi jong pha la pynkit ha ki kynhun liengbah kit mar baheh tam .  Pha long kum ka liengbah ha duriaw ba la pynkit da ki jingkit bakhia .

translation.en: Take ye wives , and beget sons and daughters  ; and take wives for your sons , and give your daughters to husbands , that they may bear sons and daughters  ; that ye may be increased there , and not diminished .
translation.kha: To ïashongkurim bad to ïoh ki khun ki kti . Nangta shah ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban shongkurim , ba kumta ma ki ruh kin don ki khun ki kti . Phi dei ban roi ha ka jingbun briew bad ym ban duna .
U Trai Nongsynshar u Ong : Ha ka sngi haba u Gog u hiarthma ïa ka Israel , ngan sa bitar lep .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , that my fury shall come up in my face .

translation.kha: U krem ïa ka leilieh da la ki kti bad u hukum ïa ka don tied ïa kaba thmu .
translation.en: With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .
Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me shukor ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ki jingshukor jong me kin long jingmyntoi ïa U Blei ?
Nga la kliar ba ngan shait ïa phoi ban shong hangta , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban eh ïa Kata , lait tang u Kaleb pynlang u Jehoash .
translation.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein , save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .

translation.kha: Te mynsiem , ko ki khun jong na , sngap ïa nga . pynlieh jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translation.en: Hearken unto me now therefore , O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
And all the house of Joseph , and his brethren , and his father s house : only their little ones , and their flocks , and their herds , they left in the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: Ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , ki hynmen ki para jong u , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem baroh jong u kpa jong u , ki ïaleit ryngkat bad u . Kiba sah ha Goshen ki long tang ki khun rit , bad ki langbrot , ki blang , bad kiwei kiwei de ki jingri jong ki .

Ma Phi bad ki khun ki ktem jong phi , lem Bad ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi ruh kiba shongsuk ha ki shnong jong phi , phi dih ban bam ïa kine ki jingainguh tang ha khmat U Trai U Bela jong phi , ha kawei ka jakarieh mane Blei kaba u la jied . Bad hangta phi Dei ban sngewkmen na ka bynta kaei kiei baroh kaba phi la har .
translation.en: But thou must eat them before the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates : and thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan ha kabu ma nga , U Trai , nur-um bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew bhor . Ko Edom , ïa kaei kaba pha la leh yn sa leh ha pha . Phan sa ïoh pat ïa kaei kaba phasi la ai .
translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  is near upon all the heathen : as thou hast done , it shall be done unto thee : thy reward shall return upon thine own head .
Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .
translation.kha: Mynta , to shim noh ïa ka pisa na u bad ai ïa ka ha uta uba la don shiphew hajar tylli ki sbai .

Wat ki thring ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban wan phah ; ki lyngdkhur , ki lyntait , bad ki throsh ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban leit noh shawei . hynrei , ko ki briew jong nga , phim shym tap ïa ki aiñ da naba nga synshar ïa phi .
translation.en: Yea , the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times  ; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming  ; but my people know not the judgment of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Pontios u la ong ha u , Ngam don pyrsa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kaei Kaba nga don : Ha ka kyrngah jong U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth na hukum ïa me ban ïeng joit bad ïaid !
translation.en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .

And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one that is learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I cannot  ; for it is sealed :
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingmut jong kawei pa kawei ka jingïohipaw u nongïathuhlypa yn buhrieh noh na phi ; kan long kum ka kot kli ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor . Lada phi leit rah ïa ka sha uno uno uba tip ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un ong ba um lah ban pule namar ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor ïa ka .

translation.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent , and leave a blessing behind him  ; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the  Lord  your God ?
translation.kha: Lehse U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kylla ka jingmut bad un kyrkhu ïa phi da ki jingthung bakyrhai . Te phin lah ban ainguh ha u da u kew bad ka waiñ .
Nangta u lap kawei ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada kabu dang shuh ïap shen . U dem bad u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .
And Solomon built Gezer , and Beth–horon the nether ,
translation.kha: Da kaba pyntrei jubor ïa ki briew , u Solomon u tei ruh ïa ka Beth Horon kaba shathie ,
Ki jingleh bad jingjahburom Jong phi kin kut noh . Phin sa shong ha la ka jong ka ri , bad ka spah jong phiah kan rai ar shah ; ka jingkmen jrong phi lai neh bymmyntoi .
translation.en: For your shame ye shall have double  ; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion : therefore in their land they shall possess the double : everlasting joy shall be unto them .

translation.kha: U Issakhar bad ki khun shaneng jong u : u Ulla , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translation.en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to long khlaiñ bad long khrud biang ! Ko nongbat Bakhuid jong U Blei , to kup ïa lade da ka burom ! Kiba mane blei tala kan ym ïohrung shuh da leilieh lei lyngba ki khyrdop jong pha .
translation.en: Awake , awake  ; put on thy strength , O Zion  ; put on thy beautiful garments , O Jerusalem , the holy city : for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean .

translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh keiñ sa ïohsngew aïu ka la jia , bad kin sheptieng ; bad yn ym don shuh mano mano u ban leh khem ïa kata ka kam bymman .
translation.en: And all Israel shall hear , and fear , and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you .

translation.kha: Te u la ai ha u Dannah ka kyrdan kaba halor , u la ai sngewbha ïa u da ki jingaiei kiba kynsai tam , u la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa ka probins lad ka Babilon , bad u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh jong baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syier .
translation.en: Then the king made Daniel a great man , and gave him many great gifts , and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon , and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon .

And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Ki briew jong nga ki la shim ïa ki na ki Amalek . Ki la buh ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa kiba sah ngi la pynduh lut khoit .
Wat ïa-lamler iwei ïa iwei pat , naba phi la loit ei ïa ka jinglong barim lem bad ki jingmlien jong ka mala ba phi la kup ïa ka jinglong bathymmai .
translation.en: Lie not one to another , seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds ;

translation.kha: Kiba la ïa-ïeng ha syndah ka diengphna U Jisu ki la long ka kmie jong u , ka para jngai ka kmie jong u , ka Mari ka tngit u kliar , bad ka Mari ka nong Magdala .
translation.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .

translation.kha: Khenani wat myntor , ong U Trai , katto-katne da Shisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingmih malu ka jingïambriew .
translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :

translation.kha: Haba ki thngan , me ai kpu ïa ki na bneng , bad ka um na u mawlong haba ki sliang . Me noh ïa ki ban shimti sad pynïaid ïa ka ri kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger , and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst , and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them .

translation.kha: U Blei um smam la khot ïa moi ban im ha ka jingthala , ishyrkhei ha ka jinglongkhuid .
translation.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness , but unto holiness .
For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .
translation.kha: Lada ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynrem ïa ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi bad ba u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh .
katba u Apostol u la jied ïa u Sillah bad u la rupa khong , la niam ïa ki da ki riehtngen ha ka jingïada jngai ka jingaiei jongngi U Trai .
translation.en: And Paul chose Silas , and departed , being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God .
And it came to pass , when they saw him , that they brought thirty companions to be with him .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ïa u , ki phah laiphew ngut ki samla shynrang ban sah bad u .
Lada phi pan na nga ïa kano kano ha ka kthang jong nga , ngan leh ïa kata .
translation.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it .

translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap Sinai U Trai u hukum ïa u Moses
translation.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof , wherewith they minister about it , even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basins , all the vessels of the altar  ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers  skins , and put to the staves of it .

translation.kha: Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa kane ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kiwei ka pyniaid jongki ka hima . Ka don ki jingïathuh ba tyngka ha kawei ka sngi , ka Sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlup jingisynei sad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jyllang ki dei ban shim noh .
translation.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .
A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha ; u briew uba sniew u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him .
translation.kha: Da sngap ha shuwa ba phin jubab . Lada phim leh kumta , phi long uba bieit bad shah rkhiebeiñ .
hynrei U Ujuh u la jubab , Haba ka sngi ka sep , phi nguh , ‘ Ngin sa ïoh ïa ka suiñbneng kaba bha , namar ka sahit bneng ka saw .’
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .
Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u la rung hapoh u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Iskariot , uba long uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .

Ha kajuh ka stang , U Khreh ruh u la kñia ainguh tang shisyndon ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa paw ha ka rupa kaba ar , ym ba-bang weng noh ïa ka jop , hynmen ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .
translation.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .

translation.kha: U Tharai , u la pynskhem twa ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jongno nga ; u la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la ai ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . (Nga smai da U Trai uba im ba u Adonisedek un ïap ha kane hi ka snoh !
translation.en: Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .

translation.kha: U la ïap ha ka rta kaba la tymmen bha , uba la dap kyrjaw da ka spah bad ka brup ; bad u Solomon u khun jong u , u long syiad ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab , Kynrad , ngin leh kumba U Trai u la lawbah .
translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .

translation.kha: U shakri jong u Joseph u la wad bniah da kaba sdang na suba nyngkong ter ter haduh uba khatduh , bad ïa ka khuri la shym ha ka byrni jong u Benjamin .
translation.en: And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin s sack .

translation.kha: Pynban ym shym la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa , ban snar ha kaba Shna ïa ki khuri rupa , ki khihwin , ki turoi , ne ki tiar pynim ïa ki sharak , ne kiwei de ki tiar ba la Shna na ka rupa ne na ka ksiar .
translation.en: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the  Lord  bowls of silver , snuffers , basins , trumpets , any vessels of gold , or vessels of silver , of the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Haseroth phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingsuk , hynrei ka jingïaphet .
translation.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pyrkhat tong ïa lade ki jingkyrkieh ban Ïoh spah ha kaba kim tap lieng ka jingduk kan jingkam .
translation.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him .

translation.kha: Hynrei mem dei ban shah ïa u ban lait khlem ka Jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba men leh , bun me dei ban khmih ba u dien ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .

translation.kha: Naduh ba phi la pdiang ïa U Khereth Jisu kumno U Trai , to im ha u .
translation.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord , so walk ye in him :

translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka ma U Blei u un-long u Apostol lad U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timon u para jong ngi —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother ,

The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters : but God shall rebuke them , and they shall flee far off , and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki ïaid shaphrang kum ki jingat phyllung kiba wan stet , hynrei U Blei u sneng ïa ki bad ki kynran , la beh noh ïa ki kum u pui pui ha ki sharing lum , kum u phlangïap ha ka  erlangthari .

translation.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me , saying , Come , let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono . But they thought to do me mischief .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sanballat bad u Geshem ki phah khubor sha nga , da kaba ai jingmut ba ngan ïakynduh bad ki ha kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Madan Ono . Kane ka la long ka buit sianti jong ki ban pyrshang ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma .

translation.en: For if we would judge ourselves , we should not be judged .
translation.kha: Lada ngi la ïit shuwa ïa lade , ngin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei .

translation.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki synran ki la sdang ban ïakylli para ma ki hi ,  Hato la don mano mano ba la wanrah jingbam ïa u ?
U pynim kdew ïa kiba la ïap .
translation.en: He even raised the dead .

translation.kha: U Trai u khah ba ki tarajur bad ki mawbah ki Dei ban un-long kiba babit bad baroh ka jingïadie ïathied ka un-long kaba hok .
translation.en: A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .
But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñ kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba riam kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingdap kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !
Ki don ki jingairam , hynrei kim lah ban kren , badno ki khmat , hyndai kim lah ban ïohi .
translation.en: They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;

translation.kha: Iddo ki la wan poh ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lwait ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
translation.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,

translation.kha: Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka kham bha ban leit hangta ïa-ban ïoh jingïakhih ban ïa kob ai jingjia kamon ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .
translation.en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .

translation.kha: Un rah pat sha Ijipt ïa ki dur jong ki blei jong ki malade ïa ki tiar kiar mala rupa kiba la pynkyntang sha kito ki blei . Hadien bun bun snoh ka jingsuk
translation.en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods , with their princes , and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold  ; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north .

translation.kha: Da kaba pyntrei jahburom ïa ki briew , u Solomon u ti ruh ïa ka Beth Horon kaba shathie ,
translation.en: And Solomon built Gezer , and Beth–horon the nether ,

translation.kha: U Phah ïa ka lyer ha shuwa jong u kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lumrit ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki song sha ka jingjot bad u pynkit ïa ki jingtem basniew jong ki .
translation.en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko hynmen ko Para , to jakoid hynñiew nongput ki rangbah napdeng jong phi! ïa kiba la ithuh ba ki longïing kiba dap da U Mynsngi Bakhuid bad ka jingstad , bad ngin buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa kane ka kam .
translation.en: Wherefore , brethren , look ye out among you seven men of honest report , full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom , whom we may appoint over this business .

translation.kha: U mynnin u ong ïa u baneh , ‘ Me la lehbha !’ U briew uba shoh pynjlih ïa ka thliew u pynsaphriang ïa uwei uba sah preg ban pyndait lang ïa ka . Ki ong ‘ ka jingpyndait ka long ka baroh’ — malade ki pynskhem ïa ka bleithaw ha ka jaka da ki preg .
translation.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith , and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil , saying , It is ready for the sodering : and he fastened it with nails , that it should not be moved .

translation.kha: Nga la Ïohi sa kawei pat ka jingpyniwbih . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw tylli ki khi ïapom kiba wan miaw nadong ki ar tylli ki lumbah rnga .
translation.en: And I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came four chariots out from between two mountains  ; and the mountains were mountains of brass .

translation.kha: Ïa u sdie la pynkhynñiuh banbeiñ khet ïa ki tieng na ki thied ; ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym sei ki soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .
translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .

translation.kha: ‘ Ïa ngin ïawad waiñ khyndiat ,’ kine ki nongtih kyiad ki ong , ‘ bad dkhoh katba ngi lah ! Lashai kan kham pyllait ban ïa kaba mynta !’
translation.en: Come ye , say they , I will fetch wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink  ; and to morrow shall be as this day , and much more abundant .
Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki syiem bad phi ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki khun syiem shynrang bad baroh kiwei ki nongsynshar ;

translation.en: And he brought me to the door of the court  ; and when I looked , behold a hole in the wall .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa nga sha ka jaka rung sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar bad pyn-i ïa nga ïa ka thliew ha ka kynroh .

U syiem ka Syria un leh kat kaba u sngewbha . Un kob ba u long kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u blei , kham halor wat ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh tad Eh . Un lah ban leh ïa kane dat haduh ha ka por haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa u . U Blei un leh thik ïa kaei kaba u la thum .
translation.en: And the king shall do according to his will  ; and he shall exalt himself , and magnify himself above every god , and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods , and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished : for that that is determined shall be done .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehiskaïah u khun Jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka har jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïadait ïasakma ; hynrei mynba nga kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .

translation.kha: Haba u khunlung u la dap shi taïew , ki la wan ban otsher ïa u , pynlang ki la mut ban kyrteng ïa u , u Sekharaïah , kaba bud ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child  ; and they called him Zacharias , after the name of his father .
But the voice answered me again from heaven ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren biang na bneng , ‘ Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .’

Hynñiew sngi lynter ym daym ban lap ïa u thiat ha ki ïing jong phi ; nalor lada uno Une u bam ïa u kpu uba la khleh thwet la u dei u nongwei ne u traishnong , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongnga nga .
translation.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened  ; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki bteng la ka jingïaid lynti . U Shimei u bud ïa ki , u da ïaid na ka sharing lum ; u da tim bad kawang miej bad khynñiuh ha ki katba u tdong ïaid .
translation.en: And as David and his men went by the way , Shimei went along on the hill s side over against him , and cursed as he went , and threw stones at him , and cast dust .

translation.kha: Ka la Ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka meng jong u , ïa ki ïing sah jong ki rangbah synshar jong u , ïa ki shakri Kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia kiba u la ai ha ka Templ . Ki la pynlyngngoh ïa ka .
translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai u la ïoh ïa kane , u kren sa shisien ha u Shemaïah malade u ong ha u , Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki pop , ngan ym pynjot ïa ki . Hynrei haba u Shishak u turoi ïaleh , kin ym lait im .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .

translation.kha: Un rah pat sha Ijipt ïa ki dur jong ki blei jong ki bad ïa ki tiar ksiar bad rupa kiba la pynkyntang shad kito ki blei . Hadien bun bun snem ka jingsuk
translation.en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods , with their princes , and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold  ; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north .

translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak , (Nga la sngewngiah bad sngewthait ïa ki tnga nongwei jong u Katta . Lada u Jakob ruh u jingjahburom ïa kawei na ktien ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïan noh shwa .
translation.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashabar jyllang u lin pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kaba u phong .
translation.en: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?

translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei , U Jisu u la jubab ; to leh ïa kane bad man im .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Thou hast answered right : this do , and thou shalt live .

And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong nga na ki lynti kiba kim pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkylla ïa ka jingdum jong ki sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki jingkular jong nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .
To pan , bad sam ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka Pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
And Moses brought their cause before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u wanrah ïa ka kam jong ki ha khmat U  Trai  ,
U Petros u la kner ïa la ki ktem , bad u la ïarap pynkhie ïa ka . Nangta u la khop ïa ki parabangeit baroh , kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei , u la Aiti ïa ka ha ki , ka briew kabu la im pat .
translation.en: And he gave her his hand , and lifted her up , and when he had called the saints and widows , presented her alive .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thnum ba ïatei khie , u Arbad , u kpa jong sa u la dei ban ïaleh pynshah ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong u , um shym la lah ban twa ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U Trai U Blei jongu u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong u baroh .
translation.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .

And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house , and , behold , his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances : and she was his only child  ; beside her he had neither son nor daughter .
translation.kha: Haba u Jephthah u wan phai sha la ïing ha Mispah , ka khun jong u ka wan ban ïakynduh ïa u , ka da shad bad tem ïa ka ksing . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong u .

translation.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: bad ngan ai ïa me ha ki briew ïa kiba me sheptieng , ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa me . Ngan ai ïa me ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ha ki shipai jong u .

translation.en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .
translation.kha: Ki la ïeng kham pajih bad ki la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad ! To isynei ïa ngi !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
translation.kha: Hadien ngan sa theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha uwei pa uwei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki tymmen shynrang kin don ki jingphohsniew , bad ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .

translation.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kur , ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki nongai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u syiem da la ka mon sngewbha ki ai
bad ki bnai shait Bad ki shynrang ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jongu to . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kambah ki bhabriew ki la ju long kiba kmen bad ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .
translation.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;
translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki thang jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lynti ba ki dei ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti ba khlem buh dak .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko Mynsiem jong nga !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise the  Lord  , O my soul .
And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u wan hiar bad u la khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la mihpaw na u bri , u ïadei napdeng ka jaka jingkyang da kaba khmih ïa ka iaka ban ïoh pynjahthait . Lydia um lah ban shem ïa kano kano ,
translation.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest , and findeth none .
Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .
translation.kha: To sharai , te , bad to kynmaw bad da ki ummat kiba bun , mynsngi bad mynmiet , nga la hikai ïa iwei pa iwei na phi haduh lai snem .
U Trai u ong , Ka waiñ , kaba rim badno kaba thymmai ruh , ka pyntlot ïa ka bor pyrkhat ki briew jyllang nga !
translation.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart .
Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ngut uba la leh kum u paramarjan ïa u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?

translation.en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki ka ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , bad nga la kha khun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka ruh ka don lang .
U ïam rangbah rangsan hangtei haduh ba ine ki nong Ijipt ki ïohsngew , bad la leit rah ïa ka khubor shaw ka jingmihsnam .
translation.en: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .

translation.kha: Uta u Basniew un wan ha ka bor u Soitan bad un leh shibun ki khampoh bad ki kamphylla kiba bakla ,
translation.en: Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Joab u kitei shiah u syiem bad u ong ha u , Kaei kane ka phi la har ? U Abner u la waiñ shata phin — balei phi shah ba un shu leit kumto ?
translation.en: Then Joab came to the king , and said , What hast thou done ? behold , Abner came unto thee  ; why is it that thou hast sent him away , and he is quite gone ?

translation.kha: U Trai u jong , Ka por kan wan haba ngan jied kumto u syiem ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid uba hok . utai syiem u don synrai da ka jingstad , bad u ban leh ïa kaei kaba dem bad kaba khop ha kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch , and a King shall reign and prosper , and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .

translation.kha: Te ki la ong ha u , Ma me bad u Jeremaïah phi dei ban leit noh bad ban rieh . Wat ai ïano ïano ngab tip Hangno phi ïadon .
translation.en: Then said the princes unto Baruch , Go , hide thee , thou and Jeremiah  ; and let no man know where ye be .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkynduh shatai eh da ka jingshemphang ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka longïing ka nongbah kaba heh kum kano kane ka nongbah kabu don la u syiem ; ka kham heh Ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewïaleh kiba tbit .
translation.en: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki sumar ïa ki jingri jong ki , hynrei ki riewïaleh ba-bymman ki lehsbun ïa la ki jong .
translation.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa u Pharaoh bad u paidïapom jong u ba ki tur shuh ki , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh , badno ki Kieng jam sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and , behold , the Egyptians marched after them  ; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem pynlang u rangbah synshar naba daiñ peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat nabar ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka Khubor sha u jhieh : Ngi long ki shakri jngai phi bad ngi long kiba la khleiñ ban kuna kat ïa kaba phi nguh ; hynrei ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; leh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .

translation.kha: Man ka thang , uwei pa uwei u lut katba u lah ban bam , bad ynda ka la shit ka sngi , kaba sah baher ha madan ka la um noh .
translation.en: And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .

translation.kha: Ki bniah bad ki nongkhaïi , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba kut eh , na ka ruma ha ka Dong haduh ka Khyrdop Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .

translation.kha: Nga Long ka shakri jrong U Trai , ka Mari ka la ong , ai kan long ha nga bania me la ong . Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .
translation.en: And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord  ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .

translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki pynbah jong u ki la Sher dara ha ka ri Gilead .
translation.en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead .
And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .
translation.kha: Da kine ki ktien , nga pynlong ka jutang bad phi : Nga kular ba lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im da ka jingshlei um , da lei lei ruh ka jingshlei um kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then went king David in , and sat before the  Lord  , and he said , Who am I , O Lord  God  ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam long uba bit ïa kaei kaba me la leh na ka bynta jong nga lymne wat ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
translation.kha: U kpa jong u briew uba hok u don ka daw babiang ban kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha u khun uba stad .

Nangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , u la saw sha ka probins jongnga ka Judia , bad u la jam Sha shiliang ka wah Jeraïah . Ki paidbah ki la ïalumlang biang ha u , bad u la hikai ïa ki , ruma u ju leh .
translation.en: And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again  ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop borabor ki pyrkhat ba ki har ïa kaba dei . Ki bariew kiba stad ki shahshkor ïa ki jingpyn-i lem .
translation.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .

translation.kha: Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jongnga U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Da la ki khmat jong i hi ngi la ïohthiah ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .

translation.kha: Ki shynna ïa ka jingsdang shadem da kijuh ki tiar da kiba la suhjer ïa ka ephod , bad ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka mano .
translation.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan ha nga , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long na ka bynta kum kine .

translation.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the  Lord  , or being his counsellor hath taught him ?
translation.kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban ïathuh kaei ba U  Trai  u leh ? Mano ba lah ban hikai ïa u lane ban ai jingmut ïa u ?
Ai ba ki khmied jong ki kin matlah khnang ba kin ym ïew ; bad ai ba kin dem khoh ki jingjynjar jongnga ki ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .

translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u don ka jingjaw jong ka mirr haba u dem halor ka shadem jongki nga .
translation.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs , and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell . Arise , my love , my fair one , and come away .
Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u , nga la kyllon ha khyndew khlem tipbriew bad nga thiah pyllup hangta .
Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kñia baroh , ki la riewkhñium ïa U Josis , namar ba ki ieit ïa ka pisa .
translation.en: And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba bha dara kaba pynsngewbha ïa U blang U Nongpynim jong im’ , namar u kwah ba uwei pa uwei un jingjynjar im mala ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingsuki .
translation.en: Who will have all men to be saved , and to come unto the knowledge of the truth .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym syiem ïa ka pop ha Jeriel bad ïa ka jingbymman ha Judah , namar ngan map ïa kito ki briew kiba nga la pynsah ïa ka jingim jong ki . Ma nga , U Terah , nga la kren .
translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and there shall be none  ; and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found : for I will pardon them whom I reserve .

translation.kha: Baroh sawdong jong u ka jingshyrkhei ka ap ; ka Bud ïa u ha man ka sien jam .
translation.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side , and shall drive him to his feet .

translation.kha: Adonijah ba u la pynlut ar sngi hangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh bad u la loit sha Galilaïa .
translation.en: Now after two days he departed thence , and went into Galilee .
And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?
translation.kha: Bad dang step phyrngab phi ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , namar ba ka suiñbneng ka saw bad ka dum .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , hynrei phim lah ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad kine ki por !
Namar me long uba khah , to ïar ïa nga bad to pyllait ïa sa . To shahshkor ïa at , bad to pynap ïa por !
translation.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me , and save me .

Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wallam ha Jerusalem kan nym wan haduh hadien ka jingïap jong phi . Ngan shah ïa phi ban ïap ha kaba suk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah bad kane ka khubor .

translation.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .
translation.kha: Ki nongshong kulai kin tur lyngba ki lynti bah jong pha , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakhraw jong pha kin hap ha khyndew .

translation.en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood : and his name is called The Word of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaiñkup kaba u phong la tap da ka snam . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long  U Ktien jong U Blei .
U Jakob u ong , Haba ka sngi ka dang jlang kumne sad ka por mad kai pat dei ban leit set ïa ki nongaplangbrot , te balei phim nangto ai um ïa ki bad ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jaka bam phlang ?
translation.en: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .
And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren  ; the  Lord  is his inheritance , according as the  Lord  thy God promised him .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ka jait Lebi kam shym ïoh bynta ïa kano kano ka jaka kum kiwei pat ki jait ; kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular . )

translation.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
U Jehoïada u lyngdoh u pynlong ïa u shem Jeush bad ïa ki paidbah ba ïaskhem lang bad u ha kaweh pynhieng ka jutang ba kin long ki briew jong U Trai .
translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him , and between all the people , and between the king , that they should be the  Lord s  people .

translation.kha: Pynban , to long kiba khuid ha keiñ kiei barhem kiba phin har , kumba U Blei uba la khot ïa phi u Long umbah khuid .
translation.en: But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation  ;

translation.kha: Bakhraw kiba me ong , ang la iohnong mynlyiur . Nga sngewthuh ïa kata baroh’ ; nga thop lut kat kaba me , me tip . Ngam long kiba hapoh jong me .
translation.en: What ye know , the same do I know also : I am not inferior unto you .
Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused  ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka jingïalang baroh kawei ka la don ha ka jingkhynwin : Katto katne ngut ki briew ki pyrta ïa kawei , kiwei ki pyrta ïa kawei pat , namar kiba bun na ki kim da tip balei ba ki la ïawan lumlang .

translation.en: Son of man , there were two women , the daughters of one mother :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  la don shisien ar ngut ki kynthei kiba shi para .

translation.en: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold , thy maid is in thy hand  ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her , she fled from her face .
translation.kha: U Abram u ong ,  Ñiuma , ka dei ka mraw jong pha bad hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong pha ; leh ïa ka katba pha sngewbit .  Kumta ka Sarai ka lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ka kat haduh ba ka la phet noh .
U syiem u nong , Nga la pynnoh ba nga ïeng harud ka woh Nile ,
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold , I stood upon the bank of the river :

And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U Blei un ym shah ba phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymdonkam , bad im ju buhrieh ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !
Ïa u sdie la pynkhreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa utai pa uwei u diengïap u bym sei ki soh babha yn khet nala bad brup ha ka ding .
translation.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”
translation.kha: Kumba ka Baibl ka ong , phin nym sngew sih kum kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”
Dang step phyrngab nga la kren bad ki Briew . Ha kata ka janmiet ka tnga jong nga ka la ïap , bad ha ka sngi Kaba bud nga la leh kumba la bthah ïa nga .
translation.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning : and at even my wife died  ; and I did in the morning as I was commanded .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Bela un pyn-i kham dara ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Sodom bad Gomorrah ba ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbud !
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .

translation.kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyndum bad ki tymmen ki san .
translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllun ïa ka pat baneh tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , katai ka paro kada shym lap khang ban den .
translation.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;

translation.kha: bad ha ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong me , bad ka Apphia ka para jongki ngi , bad u Arkhippos u Para shipai jong ngi :
translation.en: And to our beloved Apphia , and Archippus our fellowsoldier , and to the church in thy house :

translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u la kylli na U Trai ïa kaei ba u Dabid u daym ban leh , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Daberath bad ïa ka waitbnoh u Goliath u nong Philistia .
translation.en: And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .

translation.kha: Hynrei la nang pynïasoh khap bun ki briew shaei ka kynhun — u paid ki rangbah bad ki kynthei kiba la ngeit ha U TRAI’ .
translation.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord , multitudes both of men and women . )

translation.kha: U Dabid , uba Shi pang tang da ka jreiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka ba jong u baroh ban burom ïa U Terah .
translation.en: And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .

translation.kha: Kito kiba leit shuh Ijipt ban ïoh jingïarap kin jot ! Ki shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakor jong ka ibieit — ki kulai , ki kali ïapom , bad ki shipai . Hynrei ki tip ban shaniah ha U Trai , U Blei Bakyntang ki Israel , Lane pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !

translation.kha: U syiem u la ïakhun bad ki borbah , bad u Daniel , u Ananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah ki la pynhun shibun ïa u don ïa Une a uwei pat . Kut ki la kylla long ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar jong u syiad .
translation.en: And the king communed with them  ; and among them all was found none like Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah : therefore stood they before the king .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar um ju leh ei ei khlem da pynpaw ïa ka jingthmu jong u ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Surely the Lord  God  will do nothing , but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets .
After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites , which dwelt in Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei :
translation.kha: hadien ba U  Trai  u la jop ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba shong ha Heshbon , bad ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , uba synshar ha ki shnong Ashtaroth bad Edrei .

translation.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa ka kular jong nga bad nga pynlong ïa pha ka jong nga , bad phan sa pdiang ïa nga kum U  Trai .

translation.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir .
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u leit phai pat ha kata ka sngi sha Edom .

translation.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka jingduwai jong nga ka long ba ka jingïasyllok jong ngi bad me kum ki bangeit kan wallam ïa ka jingsngewthuh ba kham jylliew ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngi ïoh ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist .

translation.en: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthuh sa kawei pat , ba ha kane ka pyrthei ki nongmareh kiba stet kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ki jingïamareh thong , bad kiba shlur kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ka thma . Ki briew kiba stad kim ju ïai kamai sah ban im , ki briew kiba proh jingmut kim ju ïai ïoh spah , bad ki briew kiba lah ban leh ei ei kim ju ïai kiew sha ki kyrdan bashalor . Ka kupar basniew ka jia ha uwei pa uwei .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people , and the inhabitants of many cities :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ka por ka poi haba ki briew na ki nongbah babun kin wan sha Jerusalem .
Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Isaiah u wan ïalam ïa ki Israhaïah sha kham , Sei jait shi jait , bad la kdew ïa ka jait Judah .
translation.en: So Joshua rose up early in the morning , and brought Israel by their tribes  ; and the tribe of Judah was taken :

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab , Leh ïa kaei kaba ki khwai , bad ai syiem noh ïa ki . Nangta u Samuel u ong ïa ki rangbah Israel baroh baneh leit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Hearken unto their voice , and make them a king . And Samuel said unto the men of Israel , Go ye every man unto his city .
Flee ye , turn back , dwell deep , O inhabitants of Dedan  ; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him , the time that I will visit him .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Dedan , to phai noh bad phet ! To rieh ! Ngan pynjot ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , namar ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .
translation.kha: ‘ U para jong me u la wan phai pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , ‘ bad u kpa jong me u la phah pynïap ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha , namar u la ïoh pat ïa u ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingkoit jingkhiah .’
Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ki la ïalumlang Ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki jong , Ïa ka Jerusalem dei ïa-ban pynjot ! Ngin ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingot !
translation.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .

translation.kha: Mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki mrad kum ka jingainguh thang halor ka duwan lane ïa ki jingkñia ban shim ei ïa ki pop .
translation.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .

translation.kha: Ki Midian ki long kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki Israel , bun ki paid Ishmael ki rieh ïa lade na ki ha ki krem bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain ha ki lumrit .
translation.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .

translation.kha: U Dabid u leit noh na kata ka jaka sha Mispah ha Moab bad u noh ha u syiem Moab , Sngewbha shah ïa i pa pynlang i mei jong la ban wan bad sah bad phi! haduh ba ngan da tip aïu U Blei un bor na ka beit jong nga .
translation.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .

translation.kha: ba me pynïap ïa la ki briew ha ka ri khlaw namar ba mem Lah ngab ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la kular ngab ai ha ki .
translation.en: Because the  Lord  was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them , therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness .
The  Lord  hath accomplished his fury  ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong u ; u la pynmeh ka ding ha Seïon kaba la thang duh ïa ka haduh khyndew .

translation.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .
translation.kha: Phi pynthait ïa lade ban leit wad ïa kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei phim shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi kin ai bor ïa phi , bad kumta phim ju khie tlot .

translation.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , baroh na ngi , ngi la long kum ma ki bad ngi la im kat kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa kano kano kaba ïahap kat kum ki jingkwah jong ki met bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi hi . Ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ngi , kumba long uwei pa uwei , la buh lypa ban shah pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Blei .

Ha ka sngap kaba sian jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem Kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew uba la wai im na Jesreel , u la wan sha por bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la Khilion .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .

translation.kha: Da thmu bol bad pien ïoh kyrhai ; paila phi leh kyrkieh palat phin nym ba-dap biang .
translation.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .
And Saul said , Blessed be ye of the  Lord   ; for ye have compassion on me .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ba lehsbun ïa nga !

translation.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Philip ,  To khreh bad leit shaphang shathie sha kata ka lynti kaba leit na Jerusalem sha Gasa .  ( Kane ka long ka lynti ka bym ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )

U Blei u long uta uba la tiduh ïa ki lumlang bad uba pynlong ïa ki liat . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u bhabriew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u : U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh !
translation.en: For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan yn pynjot noh bad ki duwan jingiwbih kin pra . Baroh ki briew kiba hangta kin shah pynïap ha khmat ki bleithaw jong ki .

Ka jingduwai u syiem bad ka jingbah U Blei ïa ka , bad ka jingshoh shaphang ki pop kba u la kun ha shuwa ba un kylla-kaba-mut — ka jingsniew kaba u la leh , ki jaka mane plie thap bad ki bariewblei jongki ka blei Asherah kambah u la sloit bad ki pynlwet kiba u la mane — baroh’ la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jongki ki ïathuhlypa .
translation.en: His prayer also , and how God was entreated of him , and all his sin , and his trespass , and the places wherein he built high places , and set up groves and graven images , before he was humbled : behold , they are written among the sayings of the seers .

translation.kha: U wan phai biang sa shisien bad u la shem ba ki synran ki ïohthiah ; kim lah ban khlei ïa ki khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .

translation.kha: Bad u la siew ïa u Araunah hynriewspah ki sbai ksiar na ka bynta ka jaka shoh khie .
translation.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .

translation.kha: Kaba shithi khlieh ka thaw ki jingïania , hynrei ka jingïaishah ka wallam ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .
