translation.kha: Lada uto u briew u jubab , Ai ngin leh ïa kaba dei bad ieh kin da thang shuwa ïa ka khleiñ ; ngat sa shim katba phi kwah , ita u sharati u lyngdoh u ju ong , Em ! Ai noh mynta kumne ! Lum kumta , ngan shim ïa ka da ka bor !
translation.en: And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
The son of Shallum , the son of Zadok , the son of Ahitub ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Shallum , u khun jong u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub ,

translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers , of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods : write thou every man s name upon his rod .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wan ai ha me khat-ar tylli ki diengduh , uwei uwei u diengduh na u nongïalam jong kawei kawei ka jait . Thoh ïa ka kyrteng uta u briew ha u diengduh jong u ,
Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka Judah kumne ka ryntieh jong u shipai bad ïa ka Ishmael kum ki khnam . lang pyndonkam ïa ki radbah jong ka Seïon kumne ka wallam , ban ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong ka Girsi .
translation.en: When I have bent Judah for me , filled the bow with Ephraim , and raised up thy sons , O Zion , against thy sons , O Greece , and made thee as the sword of a mighty man .

Therefore hear the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Edom  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them .
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga don pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Edom , bad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ban leh ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah Teman . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad uwei pa uwei un sngewtriem .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Nga kwah ban ïohsngew ïa une u briew da lade hi .   Phin ïohsngew ïa u lashai ka sngi ,  u Phestos u la jubab .
bad u la hukum ïa kito kiba ïadie paro , rahah noh ïa ki nangne ! wah pynlong jaka ïuh ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !
translation.en: And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .

translation.kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh san ngut ki don hangtei , bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynïan halor tngen ïohnong , kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .
translation.en: Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Mahli , u kynhun jong u Addi , u khun jong u Kosam , u khun jong u Elmadam , u ïakhun jong u Er ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Addi , which was the son of Cosam , which was the son of Elmodam , which was the son of Er ,

translation.kha: Ai ka jubab beiñ ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kulai ïa ka un sngewbit ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat .
translation.en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibun , Bad un pynmih ki jait jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .
Hangta hi u la lai ban imat pat , bad u la Bud ïa U Jisu , da kaba ieit ïa U Blei . Habor ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .

translation.kha: Nga pyndeng ïa ka Babilon bad nga pynsngap pan ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipawa ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad puta ïabah da ki jingpyut bajam .
translation.en: Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :

translation.kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka leh kumne : ka ïaklim , ka dung , bad ka ong , Hynrei ngam smam leh ei ei ka bymdei !
translation.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .

translation.kha: baroh ki mrad ba la pynjuh badno kiba ha khlad , ki nard bapar bad ki sim .
translation.en: Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :
And it came to pass in those days , when Moses was grown , that he went out unto his brethren , and looked on their burdens : and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew , one of his brethren .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , haba u la rangbah , u Moses u leit jngoh ïa la ki para jait , ki Hebru , bad u ïohi kumno la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . U ïohi ruh ïa uwei u nong Ijipt ba u pynïap ïa uwei u Hebru , u para jait jong u Moses hi .
U Dabid hi da lade u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; te kumno U Messaïah u ha ban hiarpateng na u dab ? U paidbah babun u ding shahshkor ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord  ; and whence is he then his son ?  And the common people heard him gladly .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la kyang jam , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .

When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , ) then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Israel , da kaba buh ïa ki ha ka khim khait . Katto katne na ki Israel ki rieh ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew , lane hapdeng ki mawsiang lane ha ki thliew bad ki pukri um ;

translation.en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki reng jong u sha sepngi , shatei , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jong u . U la leh katba u sngewbha bad u la nang sngewmeng .

translation.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds  ;
translation.kha: U lah ban man khraw , ban jrong shaduh suiñbneng , u khraw haduh ba ka khlieh jong u ka kot sha ki lyoh ,

translation.en: Ish–bosheth Saul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .
translation.kha: U la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba la thung ïa u kum u syiem Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem . Hynrei ka jait Judah ka ïaineh skhem ha u Dabid ,
U haw ban khang ïa ka sngi ba kan mih , bad ïa ki khlur ban tyngshaiñ mynmiet .
translation.en: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not  ; and sealeth up the stars .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jong me ki wan urlong — bad kin wan rnong shisha — te kyang sa tip ba plie hateng jong ki u don u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .

translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la mihngi na Ijipt , mynba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ki la mihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei ,
translation.en: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of strange language  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Leh ïa kane banbeiñ pynshisha ha ki Israel ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei Jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jehoba , u la mihpaw ha me .
translation.en: That they may believe that the  Lord  God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee .

translation.kha: Hammoth phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Bel ? Kata ka bha ! Ki ksuid ruh ki jingieit — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !
translation.en: Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .

translation.kha: Ha u patsha Darius , to synshar ha ka jingsuh .
translation.en: They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .

translation.kha: Pi , phi long kum ka mluh ïa u paid bynriew baroh . Hynrei lada ka mluh ka la blad noh , ym don kano nangno ka lad ban pynbha pat ïa ka . Ka la kylla long ka bymdondor , kumta la brai noh ïa ka shrak dara ki brisoh ki ïuh halor jong ka .
translation.en: Ye are the salt of the earth : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be salted ? it is thenceforth good for nothing , but to be cast out , and to be trodden under foot of men .

translation.kha: Ka Law u mawshun dara ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki treikam haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ; naduh katai ïa ka Khrawbor Baanah shaphang ka Hima U Blei la ïai ïathuh , bad uwei pa uwei u bsut jubor shapoh .
translation.en: The law and the prophets were until John : since that time the kingdom of God is preached , and every man presseth into it .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Shisien la don u briew wahbah la leit hiar na Jerusalem sha Jerikho mynbarim ki nonglam ki la tur ïaleh ïa u , ki la sloit lyngkhuit ïa u , malu ki la shoh ïa u , ki da Iehnoh lyngktop ïa u kum uba ïap .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and fell among thieves , which stripped him of his raiment , and wounded him , and departed , leaving him half dead .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ka jingsngem ha ïingsyiem ki la kylli ïa u baluilui ba um kohnguh ïa ka hukum u syiem ;
translation.en: Then the king s servants , which were in the king s gate , said unto Mordecai , Why transgressest thou the king s commandment ?
Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and to the residue of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: U la ong ïa u Haggai ban kren ha u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah , ha u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ha ki paidbah , bad ban ong ha ki ,
Une uno u bym long ha ka liang jong nga u pyrshah da shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lut u pynsaphriang da shisha .
translation.en: He that is not with me is against me : and he that gathereth not with me scattereth .

For when ye offer your gifts , when ye make your sons to pass through the fire , ye pollute yourselves with all your idols , even unto this day : and shall I be enquired of by you , O house of Israel ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
translation.kha: Wat haduh mynta phi ai ïa kijuh ki jingai sngewbha bad pyntngit ïa lade da kijuh ki bleithaw da kaba kñia ïa la ki khun sha ki ha ka ding . Bad nangta ma phi ki Israel phi dang ïai wan ban kylli kaei ka long ka mon jong nga ! Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei na nga .
Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jongngi U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei baneh im pynlang aïu ki Dei baneh ar .
translation.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .

translation.kha: To ngin shong ha ka ri jong ngi . To ïada ïa ngi na kito kiba kwah baneh pynjot ïa ngi . ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bun ka jingpynduh kin ngut , bad kito kiba pynpait ïa ka ri kin jah napoh .
translation.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .

translation.kha: U Blei u tap film ki briew ki bymlarkam ; u ïohthiah ïa ki kam sngew jong ki baroh .
translation.en: For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also  ; will he not then consider it ?

translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Abraham u la kohnguh ïa U blei malu u la otsher ïa u Ishmael u khun jong u , nabar ïa kiwei pat ki shynrang baroh na ka longïing longsem jong u , kyntiew ruh ïa ki mraw baroh kiba la kwah ha longsem longsem jong u bad kito kiba u la lah thied .
translation.en: And Abraham took Ishmael his son , and all that were born in his house , and all that were bought with his money , every male among the men of Abraham s house  ; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day , as God had said unto him .
He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
translation.kha: U la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong lem bad ki jingthmu jong ki .
Shisyndon ïa ki khuri ksiar bad rupa la wallam shapoh , bad ma ki baroh ki la ïadih waiñ na ki
translation.en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .
And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .
translation.kha: Me pyllait im ïa kito kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong .

U wiang poi ha ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka set blang ibha harud lynti , bad u rung shapoh ban leit shabar . Ka jia ryngkhat ba ka dadien kajuh ka krem ha kaba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki rit kham shapoh jongki kata ka krem .
translation.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .

translation.kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bad ki dieng Kedar jongngi ka Libnah ki risa da kiba kilomitar Halor u shem uba la kyllon , namar ym don mano mano banbeiñ khet ïa ki , mynta ba um don shuh !
translation.en: Yea , the fir trees rejoice at thee , and the cedars of Lebanon , saying , Since thou art laid down , no feller is come up against us .

translation.kha: hangta ha khat uta u paidbah baroh , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh ïa U Trai . U ong A tharai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me junom la junom !
translation.en: Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .

Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar , which is in the king s dale : for he said , I have no son to keep my name in remembrance : and he called the pillar after his own name : and it is called unto this day , Absalom s place .
translation.kha: Mynba u dang im , u Absalom u la tei u mot na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka Them jong u Syiem , naba um don khun shynrang u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jong u . Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u da la ka jong ka kyrteng , bad haduh kane ka sngi la tip ïa u kum u Mot jong u Absalom .

translation.en: Six days shalt thou labour , and do all thy work :
translation.kha: Phi don hynriew sngi ban trei bad ban leh ïa ki kam jong phi ,

translation.en: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel , I fear my lord the king , who hath appointed your meat and your drink : for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort ? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king .
translation.kha: U Ashpenas pat u la sheptieng ïa u syiem , kumta u la ong ha u Daniel ,  U syiem u la rai ïa kaei kaba phin bam bad dih , bad lada mem i kum uba bit kum kiwei pat ki samla shynrang , u lah ban pynïap ïa nga .
Hangta halor u lum , U Trai u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .
translation.en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,

translation.kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong me , kiba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong me Sha ki syiem jong ine , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , badno ka jaitbynriew jong ngi Baroh kawei .
translation.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets , which spake in thy name to our kings , our princes , and our fathers , and to all the people of the land .

translation.kha: Me la khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki ban pyrkhat beit ; wat shah ïa ki ban jop shalor jong nga mynta .
translation.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .

translation.kha: lymda u bymngeit u khot ïam sngewbha ïa phoi bad phi! moi ba-bang wait , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi , khlem kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong pa .
translation.en: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go ; whatsoever is set before you , eat , asking no question for conscience sake .

translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingkem , bad utai pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .
translation.en: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .

translation.kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ka la long kaban donburom ; kaba katno tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!
translation.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .

translation.kha: U Joab u longsem u rangbah ai Law jong ka kynhun shipai Israhaïah ; u Hananaïah , u khun jong u Judah u khmih ïa ka kynhun ïada ïa u Dabid ;
translation.en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel : and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites :

translation.kha: Ka long ka nuti ïa baroh ki shipai Kaisaria , bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka , ka Pynlong ïa ka ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Assyria .
translation.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them , with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria , and with all on whom she doted : with all their idols she defiled herself .

translation.kha: Kane , mynta , ka dem kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u Ong : Ngan buh ha Seïon ka nongrim kaba skhem bad bakhlaiñ . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaba skhem ka long ruh kaba ïathiah .’
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah , Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjuh noh ïa ki bri borbah . Ngan pynjot Thiah ïa ki namar ka pyrthei ka la jyllei da ki kam leh jubor jong ki .
translation.en: And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me  ; for the earth is filled with violence through them  ; and , behold , I will destroy them with the earth .

translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka kum haba ki briew kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .
translation.en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei! ka ïeng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing sahmiet Khaldi . Ïa ka thalab la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Bithynia .
translation.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , nangno u Ïoannis u la ïoh ïa ka thok ban pynbaptis : Ka la long na U Blei ne na u briew ?
translation.en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ? answer me .

translation.kha: Haba phi don ha ka jaka shong dala ha ka por thma , kiar na kano ïano ka ban pynlong ïa phin ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies , then keep thee from every wicked thing .
We looked for peace , but no good came  ; and for a time of health , and behold trouble !
translation.kha: Ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka por ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ; ka jingtriem ka wan pynban .

translation.en: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .
translation.kha: Kum u lyoh uba mih bad u jah noh , u briew u ïap bad um wan phai shuh ; la klet noh da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .

translation.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha un ïoh jingkyrkhu . Ki ktien u riewbymman ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .
Nangta u la ong ha u briew uba khong ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang , To Kner shabar ïa la ka kti . U la kner shabar ïa ka bad ka la kylla bha pat , kumba long dat kawei pat .
translation.en: Then saith he to the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it forth  ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .

translation.kha: u la ai ïa ki ha u Israel , u shakri jong u ; ka jingieit jongno u ka nep bymjukut .
translation.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: U briew wahbah kum utai , um lah ban khun jingmut bad ban rai ha kiwei Kiei baroh ba u leh , um dei ban pyrkhat ba un sa ïohpdiang ei ei na U Trai .
translation.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways .

translation.kha: Haba U Troas u ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyngkub kaba khluit , kambah tyrkhong , kim shym la shahshitom na ka jingsliang . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mihnoh na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong ki ; u pynthait ïa u mawdong , dara ka um ka mih nangta .
translation.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai ktien , Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi baroh khat-ar lwet ? Pynban uwei na phi u long u ksuid !
translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?

translation.kha: bad la sneng ïa u na ka bynta ka pop . U kada jongno u , u la kren ha ka sur briew bad u la ksiang ïa ka kam leh bieit jong u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But was rebuked for his iniquity : the dumb ass speaking with man s voice forbad the madness of the prophet .

Who is the wise man , that may understand this ? and who is he to whom the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken , that he may declare it , for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness , that none passeth through ?
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ka ri ka ha ka jingjot jingpra bad ka tyrkhong kum ka ri shyiap , ba ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ka ? Uei uba stad eh ban shemphang ïa kane ? Hano me la batai ïa ka ba u lah ban ïathuh ha kiwei pat ?
uba ha khappud ka hima Ephod . Hangta U Trai u nguh ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,

translation.kha: To shah ïa nga , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel , phi kiba isih ïa ka jingbishar hok sad pynkylla ïa kaba dei sha kaba bakla .
translation.en: Hear this , I pray you , ye heads of the house of Jacob , and princes of the house of Israel , that abhor judgment , and pervert all equity .

translation.kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kba bat ïa ka ki ïajah pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
And I will smite the winter house with the summer house  ; and the houses of ivory shall perish , and the great houses shall have an end , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki ïingshong tlang bad ki ïingshong lyiur . Ki ïing ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati kin kyllon ha ka jingjot ; man la kawei pa kawei ka ïing bah kan jot thiaw .

translation.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .
translation.kha: Nga salia aïu ïa ka jingiwbih kaba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lane ki musla na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingainguh jong ki lane ban sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .
Hynrei mynta nga pynrieh ban kyrkhu ïa ki paid ka Jerusalem malu Judah . Kumta wat sheptieng .
translation.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah : fear ye not .

translation.kha: U lah ban man khraw , ban ïong shaduh suiñbneng , u khraw haduh ba ka khlieh jong u ka kot sha ki lyiur ,
translation.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds  ;

translation.kha: Pynban , ym don uno uno shiah uba tip lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta Kan wanpaw — ym ki angel ha bteng lehniam U Khun ; tangba U Kpa hi uba tip .
translation.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Ahimaas jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingkem kaba ïadei bad katai kaba don ha ka Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki ñiad dara ki briew .
translation.en: In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .

translation.kha: Kim shym pyntip ba u Jehoba u sngewthuh aïu ki ong , namar ki ïakren malu u da ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .
translation.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .

translation.kha: To pynrem ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki baroh ; to pynshitom ïa ki kumba me la pynbudnam ïa nga na ka bynta ki pop jong per . Nga ud ha ka jingjynjar , bad nga pangnud ha ka dohnud jong nga .
translation.en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about , so that in the day of the  Lord s  anger none escaped nor remained : those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed .

translation.kha: Ki la buh ïa de hapoh ka jingsumar u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam mala u ksiew jong u Shaphan , u ban peit ba nga poi suk sha ïing . Bad kumta nga la sahit hangta hateng ki Briew .
translation.en: Even they sent , and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison , and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , that he should carry him home : so he dwelt among the people .
And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah . And Saul said , God hath delivered him into mine hand  ; for he is shut in , by entering into a town that hath gates and bars .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la leit sha Keilah , bad u ong ,  U Blei u la buh ïa u ha ka bor jong nga . U Dabid u la pynngat ïa lade da kaba leit sha ka nongrit ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba skhem .

Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba sawa kumto ka jingkyrkhu jong ka kshaid , bad kumto ka jingtian jam jong u pyrthat . Ka sawa kum ka sur jingtem ba la tem da ki nongtem kiba tem ïa la ki duitara .
translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven , as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of a great thunder : and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps :
And Esau said , I have enough , my brother  ; keep that thou hast unto thyself .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u ong ,  Ko hep , nga dap biang kyrhai ; buh ïa kaei kaba phi don .
Te u Ananias u la phar noh ïa u , uba tdong shah khim , sha u Mephaath u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translation.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ki ka hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh hano hano pajut , bad u la ïai-ong , Ai ei ei ïa ka baneh bim .
translation.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .

translation.kha: Ha ki bahynñiew snem kiba bahok , ka khyndew ka pynmih shikatdei eh ki jingthung , ïa kiba u Joshua u lum bad kynsha ha ki nongbah .
translation.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .

translation.kha: U Paul u la nang leit sha Derbe bad Lystra , ha kaba wai u Khristan uba kyrteng u Timothi u shong u sah . Ka kmie jongnga u , kaba long ruh ka Kreskens , ka long ka Jiw , hynrei u kpu jong u , u long u Grik .
translation.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed  ; but his father was a Greek :

translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki , Hato phim sngewthuh ïa kane ka pharshi ? Kumno , te phi Lah ban sngewhun ïa kiwei pat ki pharshi ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?

translation.kha: u klop uba pyneh ïa u phet pui sha ki rain tylli ?
translation.en: When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba yn don uno uno u ban ym kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba ngi phah sha phi ha kane ka shithi . Lada ka long kumta , khmih ïa u bad wat ïadon bynta ei ei bad u , khnang ba un lehrain .
Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingshoh , ka lama kaba donkam ban pynshisha ba u brisoh uba ai ïa ka u la ïatip ,
translation.en: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .

translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka klass u Sekharaïah ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang don ha ka jingïalap . U Elam , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jongnga u Shemaïah , u Jehonathan u khun jong u Akhbor , u Gemaraïah u khum jong u Shaphan , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baroh kiwei pat ki rangbah nongsynshar ki la don hangta .
translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki synran bad u la ong ,  Phi dang ïohthiah bad pynjahthait ? Ha khmih ! Ka por ka poi ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn aiti noh ha ka bor ki briew kiba pop .

translation.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .
translation.kha: Dei U Blei uba pynïaid ïa ka jingim jong ki jingthaw jong u ; ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei ka don hapoh ka bor jong u .
ïoh kin phai dat noh na U Trai ban mane ïa kiei pat ki balieh . Lada jia kumta , U Trei un bit pei ïa phi bad un pynpait ïa phi shongshngain .
translation.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .
The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .
translation.kha: Ïa U  Trai  yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïap , da kino kino kiba leit hiar sha ka ri ka jingsngap jar .

U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U Trai , Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingiw ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim shwa wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
translation.kha: Haba me khreh ka jingkhawai , khot sngewbha ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba dkoh , bad kiba matlah ;

Ym Naaman kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynni ïa ine , lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , Uba ai ïa im ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .
translation.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki shaid jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kumta ki jingïada shadem da ka nar , sad ka jingbhasbun kaba mih na ki thapniang Jong ki ka long kum ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai thma babiang kiba leit tur shiah ka thma .
translation.en: And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .
Therefore said I , Look away from me  ; I will weep bitterly , labour not to comfort me , because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people .
translation.kha: Mynta to iehnoh ïa nga marwei ban ïamkthang halor kito na ki briew jong nga kiba la ïap . Wat pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga .
Lada ka longïing ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , dat ka longkmie kun kyllon noh .
translation.en: And if a house be divided against itself , that house cannot stand .

translation.kha: Nga ïasngew ba don kew ha Ijipt ; khie leit thied kew nangta , ba ngin ym jingïapthngan .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .

When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Hima hynrei ki bymshemphang ïa ka , ki long kum ki symbai kiba la hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat . Uta u Basniew u wan bad u knieh noh ïa kaei kaba la bet hapoh jong ki .
Bad lada uno uno u briew u ïa-ong ei ei , ïathmu ha u , ‘ U Kner u donkam ïa ki ;’ pynlang nangta un sa pyut ïa ki shisyndon .
translation.en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .

translation.kha: Te i'u kyang sha U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ieh ba ngi shah jynjar , ine khup trei shitom , bad me shah lehbeiñ .
translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :

translation.kha: pyndeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nongot Magdala , ka Mari ka kmienah u Jakob bad u Jeush Bad ka tnga u Sebedi .
translation.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .

And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel , saying , If ye do return unto the  Lord  with all your hearts , then put away the strange gods and Ashtoreth from among you , and prepare your hearts unto the  Lord  , and serve him only : and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Lada phin phai sha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , phi dei ban bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Astarte . Pynkyntang lut ïa lade sha U  Trai  bad mane tang ïa u , te un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor ki Philistia .

translation.en: And God said unto him , Because thou hast asked this thing , and hast not asked for thyself long life  ; neither hast asked riches for thyself , nor hast asked the life of thine enemies  ; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment  ;
translation.kha: bad kumta u ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la pan ïa ka jingstad ban synshar hok , ha ka jaka ka jingim bajlan na ka bynta ïa lade lane ka spah lane ka jingïap ki nongshun jong me , ngan leh ïa kaba me la pan .
Ki long uba ïong kat ki Anakim , kiba bun paid , bad kaba khlaiñ . Hynrei U Trai u la pynïong ïa ki baroh , kumta ki Ammon ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .
translation.en: A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :

translation.kha: Haba phi ïakhun ïa ki Ahimelekh badno ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka tdam ; U Trai un ym don lem bad phi , nalor phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .
translation.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ken , la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiad Jehoshaphat u dem ngon , ka khmut jong u kaba dei ha ka khiew , bad baroh u paidbah u de ryngkat bad u bad mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the  Lord  , worshipping the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Arbad u kylli ïa u , kumin keiñ me nud ban pynïap ïa u sahmiet ba la jied da U Trai ?
translation.en: And David said unto him , How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the  Lord s  anointed ?
Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! Pynshahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ! Ngan rwai bad tem jingtem ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: The first angel sounded , and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood , and they were cast upon the earth : and the third part of trees was burnt up , and all green grass was burnt up .
translation.kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la put ïa la ka turoi . U phria bad ka ding , ba la khleh lang bad ka snam , ki la hap halor ka khyndew . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka khyndew la thang duh noh , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki dieng , bad ïa baroh ki phlang bajyrngam .

translation.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut ki la jubab ,  Ym don mano mano ha sla pyrthei kiba lah ban ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban tip . Ym don u syiem , ym don wat uba khraw tam bad uba donbor tam , uba la pynlong kum kane ka jingdawa na ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor bad ki nongleh byrtong .
Ko kyrdan , ki la ong ïa u , to ai ha ngi ïa une u kpu kotbor .
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .

translation.kha: Ka long ka jingstad ban sheptieng ïa U Trai . U pyrthuh ïa ka nongap , To shukor phi ki briew bakha ïalum ha ka nongbah !
translation.en: The  Lord s  voice crieth unto the city , and the man of wisdom shall see thy name : hear ye the rod , and who hath appointed it .
For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred , and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten , to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ka nongbah ha Israel ka phah noh shihajar ngut ki shipai , hynrei tang shispah ngut ki wan phai ; kawei pat ka nongbah ka phah shispah ngut , hynrei tang shiphew ngut ki wan phai pat .
U Simon Phestos , Uba kieng ïa ka waitlam , u la sei ïa ka bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u radbah Lyngdoh , u da kjit ïa ka shkor kamon jong u . Ka kyrteng uta u mraw ka long u Lakhish .
translation.en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant s name was Malchus .

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab , Dei ïa kito kiba la kun pop pyrshah ïa la babha ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jrong nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Whosoever hath sinned against me , him will I blot out of my book .
And the chief priests took the silver pieces , and said , It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury , because it is the price of blood .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la khar ïa ki sbai rupa bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka dei ka pisa babit snam , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban buh ïa ka hapoh ka jingkynshew ka Templ .
Katba ngi nang ïaid sha khmat sha kane ka ri , U Trai u la baheh ïa ki Amal baroh kiba shong basah hangne . Kumta ma ngi ruh , ngi shakri ïa U Trai , u long U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .

translation.kha: Naba ka lyngkor kaba ngan ai ha phi ka long kaba jem , bad ka jingkit ba ngan buh halor jong Phin ka long kaba sting .
translation.en: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïalap noh ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .

translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha u pynmih ki soh kiba bha , hynrei u dieng uba swai u pynmih ki soh kiba sniew .
translation.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit  ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma me da ka bor bad ka mon jong me , me la lah thmu ba kan jia .

translation.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .
translation.kha: U Shaphan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem ha u Hilkaïah bad u Hilkaïah u ïathuh ïa u ba u la shem ïa ka Kitab ka hukum ha ka Templ . U Hilkaïah u la ai ha u ïa ka Kitab , bad u Shaphan u pule ïa ka .
Te phin shangkhawiah ha U Blei borabor bad shet ba u long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong phi .
translation.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , ngan leh kumjuh ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it , they are the flesh , and this city is the caldron : but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it .
translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi . Kane ka nongbah ka dei da shisha u khiew shet , hynrei kaei ka doh ? Ki metïap jong kito kiba phi la pynïap ! Phin ym don shuh hangne — Ngan bret ïa phi shabar kane ka nongbah .
Ïa kane ka jingainguh thap dei ba-bang ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh ka man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translation.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .

translation.kha: Kum ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .
translation.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,

translation.kha: Kumno da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , phin kham bha ba ph shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot Jong nga ki la shah bapar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong nga kim shym la pyrshang ban pud ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bol ïa lade badno ym ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;

translation.kha: U Sadok u skhem ïa ka jingbuh bymshemphang Olib kaba u la wanrah na ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Syndong ryngkat U Trai , bad u la pynsleh ïa u Solomon . Ki la mang ïa ka turoi , bad ki paidbah baroh ki pyrthuh , Im Slem Syiem Solomon !
translation.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon . And they blew the trumpet  ; and all the people said , God save king Solomon .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kambah ut , da kaba nguh ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
translation.en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , baroh na ngi , ngi la long kum ma ki bad ngi la im katba kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa Kane kano kaba ïahap kato khem ki jingkwah jong ki randien bad ki jingmut jingpynkhreh jong ngi hi . Ha ka jingweng tynrai jongngi ngi , main un-long eiei pa uwei , la buh lypa ban shah pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Balei .
translation.en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
The son of Hesed , in Aruboth  ; to him pertained Soco , and all the land of Hepher :
translation.kha: U Benhesed : ki nongbah Arubboth bad Sokoh bad baroh ka ri Hepher

translation.en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u lah ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ka hukum , nga long uba khlem jingrem .
U buh ïa ine ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki kynhun langbrot ha ki shyngkub dih um jong ki . U buh ïa ki hangta , namar ki langbrot ki ju ïa-peiñ haba ki wanrah dei um .
translation.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthat kaba wah ha ka Templ ka la kad arliang , naduh khlieh haduh tbian .
translation.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .

translation.kha: Ki ong ha ki bariew jong ka Judah , Ong ïa im kaei ba ïeng ar . To ïada ïa ngi khim u dieng uba shat syrngiew tngen ha ka jingsat jong ka shit sngi , bad shah ïa ngi ban pynjahthait ha ka jingda jongno me . Ngi Long ki phetwir ; to babuhrieh ïa ngi ha ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano myn ban shem ïa ngi .
translation.en: Take counsel , execute judgment  ; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday  ; hide the outcasts  ; bewray not him that wandereth .

translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : Phi daym ba pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng barim ïa U Trai , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi leh .
translation.en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .
How Do Bible Principles Benefit Us ?
translation.kha: Kumno ki Aiñ jong U Blei ki ai Jingmyntoi ïa ngi ?

Ïa ka ri jongki pha la pynjot bad la iehnoh kynjah — hynrei mynta kan riew eh na ka bynta kito ki ban wan ban shong hangta . Bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa pha ha ka jingjot yn pynkynriah jngai na pha .
translation.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places , and the land of thy destruction , shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants , and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away .

translation.kha: kumba ym don ba la ithuh , pynban la thiah ïa ngi da baroh ; la kumne kiba la ïap , hynrei , kumba ph ïohi , sem dang ïai im .
translation.en: As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;
And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite , the porter toward the east , was over the freewill offerings of God , to distribute the oblations of the  Lord  , and the most holy things .
translation.kha: U Kore u khun jong u Imnah , u Lebi uba long u rangbah ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Mihngi jong ka Templ , u long u khlieh ha ka jingpdiang ïa ki jingai ba ai sha U  Trai  bad ha kaba sam ïa ki .

translation.en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :
translation.kha: Mynta to kynmaw aïu phi la long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Na ka liang kaba kynja briew tang khyndiat na phi , phi la long kiba stad ne kiba khlaiñbor ne kiba don kyrdan kaba halor ha ka imlang sahlang .

Namar U Khrist da latai hi u la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingsuk da kaba pynlong kiwei ka jyrthiaw ïa ki Jiw badno ki Jentil . Da ka kun jong u hi , u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynjri kaba pynïakren ïa ki bad kaba pynlong ïa ki , ki nongsuhjaiñ .
translation.en: For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;

translation.kha: Haduh katno kan jin da la kham bha lada ki briew’ jong ngi ha kane ka sngi ki la bam ïa ka jingdam ba ki la shim haba ki kjap ïa ki nongshoh-nar . Shu pyrkhat haduh katne ngut shuh shuh ki Philistia kin jin da la pynjop .
translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kumno lada katto katto na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?
translation.en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?

translation.kha: Balei pa’ wan ?
translation.en: Why did you come ?

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: U Josis u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synrai , bad u la ong ïa ki , Uno uno uba kwah ban long nyngkong u dei ban buh khatduh eh ïa laiñ bad u dei ban long u shakri ïa borbah .
translation.en: And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .

And Joshua said unto them , Pass over before the ark of the  Lord  your God into the midst of Jordan , and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder , according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  Khie leit sha ka Jordan ha shuwa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un bah ïa u maw ha la ka tyrpeng jong phi , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
La pynmeh ïa ka ding hapdeng jong ka phyllaw , bad u Patmos u la ïasoh lem badno kito kiba ïaishong sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .

translation.kha: Bad lada uwei na ki shiphew u pynbor ïa phiah ban kit ïa ka jingkit jong u shi kilomitar , to klet ïa ka ar kmiesan .
translation.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile , go with him twain .

Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la jubab ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngit ïa lade . Naduh dang khynnah ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pat ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymkhuid .
Da ka jingshisha U Khrist kaweh don ha nga , nga kular ba ïa Kane ka jingsngewdiaw sarong jongu nga yn ym pynsngap jar hangno hangno ha Akhaïa barben kawei .
translation.en: As the truth of Christ is in me , no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia .

translation.kha: Ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , nabar ki ong , Kan jin da la kham bha ban ïap ha Ijipt lieng wat hangne ha ka ri khlaw !
translation.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron : and the whole congregation said unto them , Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt ! or would God we had died in this wilderness !

Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khatwei ( u bnai Shebat ) , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka khubor ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet .
Ki paid nongkhaïi ki jah lynti ha kaba wad um ; ki ïadat ruma bad ki ïap ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: The paths of their way are turned aside  ; they go to nothing , and perish .
For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka Hukum ka long kaba kynja mynsiem ; hynrei nga long u briew uba kynja doh , ba la die kum u mraw ha ka pop .
Ka Bithynia ka la thong tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngkhai , bun mynta uta u tynneng u khynñiuh ! Ki jingriewblei baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la khia ïa Kata ka ri .
translation.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !

translation.kha: Kum ki ïasylla plain ba Wan bad tur ïabah ïa ka Jerusalem bad thaw jingkulmar ,
translation.en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem , and to hinder it .
Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
translation.kha: Nalorkata , une um dei u Dabid , uta uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’

translation.en: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned  ; and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate  ; and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity  ;
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Phi la ïasngewtynnat ban ïohi ba ïa ka Templ jong nga la pyntngit , ban ïohi ïa ka ri Israel la pynjot thiaw , ban ïohi ïa ki paid ka Judah ba ki shah ringmraw .

Ngim ju tei ki ïing ki sem ban Shong ban sah — ngi shong ha ki ïinglieng — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkha , lane u kew . Ngi la kthong tylli ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kpa bymman jong ngi u Jonadab u la sah ïa ngi .
translation.en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .

translation.kha: Uba rangbah duh na ki Lebi u dei u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba Long lyngdoh . U dadien uba khmih ïa kito kiba pyndep ïa ki kamra ha ka Katta Kyntang .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them , every one that entereth into the service , to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: ne sngewsarong ha ka jingdon jingem jong nga .
translation.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;
Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :
translation.kha: me tap ïa lade da ka jingshai . Me pyiar ïa ki bneng kum ka ïingjaiñ
Katno kiba khraw ki long ki jingphylla jongno U Balei kiba u pyn-i ha ine ! Katno kiba khrup ki long ki kambah kiba u leh ! U Blei u lama u syiem junom ; un synshar ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: How great are his signs ! and how mighty are his wonders ! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and his dominion is from generation to generation .

translation.kha: Lehsbun haba ki paid Judah kin jingsngewsih shaphang baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga thmu ban wallam shalor jongu ki , kin phai nala na ki lyndang bymman jong ki . Te ngan map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jongnga ki .
translation.en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .
By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip ba ngi ieit ïa ki khun U Blei : Ka long da kaba ieit ïa U Blei bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
Ïa ki jingdon jingem jngai ki la knieh bad la rah noh kum ka jinglute .
translation.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller : as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them .

translation.kha: Hadien khie , ki leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan Ibbah shong ha ka ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , malade ha ka ri ryngkhiang kaba shaphang shat .
translation.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u Petros u la khot len ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhot bad ki . Nangta u la iehnoh malade u la leit sha Makedonia .
translation.en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Samuel , Sa katno slem men dang ïai sngewsih ïa u Saul ? Nga la kyndat ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel . Hynrei mynba pyneh katto katai ka umphniang Olib bad leit sha Bethlehem , sha u briew uba kyrteng u Jesse , ñiar nga la jat ïa uwei na ki khun shynna jong u ban long syiem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , How long wilt thou mourn for Saul , seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel ? fill thine horn with oil , and go , I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons .

translation.kha: Hynrei phim im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jongngi phi ka ïong ïa pa’ ban leh ; pynban , phi im kumba U Mynsiem u ong ïa phi ban leh — lada , shisha , U Mynhyndai U Blei u kein hapoh jong phi . Uno uno u ngi don ïa U Mynsiem jongnga U Khrist , um long u jong u .
translation.en: But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki kti , ba ki jingthung jong phi kin seisoh shibun , bad ba ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi kin nang bun .
U la kren ha ki na u rijied lym ; ki kohnguh ïa ki waiñ bun ki hukum ba u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar : they kept his testimonies , and the ordinance that he gave them .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la ong ïa kane , u la khuslai jur malade u la pynbna da kaba shatei , Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ussaïah na phi un sa shetkylla ïa nga .
translation.en: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .

Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ngut ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud hangta ki thiah , baroh ki la ïap !

U Laban u la ïohi ïa ka sati khmut bad ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka para jong u , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka ba ka ïathuh ïa Kiei kaba uta u briew u la ong ha ka . U saw sha u shakri jong u Abraham , uba ïeng hajan ki ut jrong u harud kata ka pluh ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister s hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , Thus spake the man unto me  ; that he came unto the man  ; and , behold , he stood by the camels at the well .

translation.kha: Baroh ktieh kiei kiba u Pekahaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shimham Ka Jesreel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U Trai u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban krung lamler . U Trai u ong , leit malade shukor ïa u . Phin sa iap .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .
So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Eleasar , u Joshua , bad ha kiwei pat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel :

translation.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed ? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard ? and how shall they hear without a preacher ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno kin lah ban khot kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta ka jingïarap lada kim shym la ngeit ? Bad kumno kin lah ban ngeit lada kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Bad kumno ki lah ban ïohsngew lada ïa ka khubor ym shym la pynbna ?
U Ïashong u Nongpynbaptis u la wei , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih wei , bad phin ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’
translation.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .
translation.kha: U nongsynshar uba khlem ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba runar . Uta uba isih ïa ka jingbymhok un synshar slem .
Kam pher ei ei satia la otsher ne ym Shim la otsher , kaei kaba donkam ka long ban long u jingthiah Uba thlim .
translation.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
And when he went out the second day , behold , two men of the Hebrews strove together : and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?
translation.kha: Haba u leit sa ha kawei pat ka sngi , u ïohi ar ngut ki Hebru kiba ïashoh . U ong ha uta uba leh bymdei ,  Balei me da shoh ïa la u para Hebru ?
te ïa ka Kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad sohpdung ki briew jyllang to khlam blem ban ïa kaba me don ki khum shynna bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano jin .
translation.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Nga la ong ha ki , Lada phi manna , to ai ïa ka kyang jong nga . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to bat noh ïa ka . Kumta ki la siew ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka bainong jong to .
translation.en: And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .
And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain : for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley :
translation.kha: Ki Amor ki beh da ka bor ïa ki briew na ka jait Dan sha ka ri lum bad kim shah ïa ki ban wan hiar sha ri thor .

Phi ki nongïeng Philip phi tip bha shibun ba hir nga la mihsnam na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïalap ïa ka Khroh Babha , phira dei tang ma phi ka balang ngab ïalap ïa nga ; phoi dei tang ma Phi bakha la shim bniat ha ki jingïoh bad jingduh jong nga .
translation.en: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .

translation.kha: U jubab , Sngewbha kylli ïa u Syiem Solomon — nga pyntip un ym kyrngah ïa phi — ban shah ïa nga ba-bang ïoh ïa ka Abishag , ka theisamla na Shunem , kum ka tnga jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , Speak , I pray thee , unto Solomon the king , ( for he will not say thee nay , ) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife .
It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .
translation.kha: kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la shong slem . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ym da donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid .
Kñia uwei u nongaplangbrot mynhyndai bad uwei pat ynda janmiet .
translation.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :

translation.kha: haba ki Moab ki ïohsngew ba ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , ki la khot ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba da ngab kieng atiar , naduh kiba tymmen haduh kiba dang khñiang , bad la buh ïa ki ha ki khappud .
