( Isaiah 2 :4 ) God will bring an end to all injustice and suffering .
translation.kha: ( Isaia 2 :4 ) U Blei un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingleh bymhok bad ki jingjynjar baroh .
Ko phi ki briew kiba shongsah basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano hangno ruh . U Trai u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ban ïoh jingïarap , un jubab ïa phi .
translation.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .

translation.kha: Ki khmat bad ki shkor jong ki kin ïohi bad kin ïasngew ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew .
translation.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim , and the ears of them that hear shall hearken .

translation.kha: U —Ïoannis u la jingjubab , Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi don uwei uba ïeng uba phim tohjaw .
translation.en: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;
And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return , and will build them , as at the first .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Judah bad Israel kiba roi kyrhai , bad ngan pynlong pat ïa ki kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .
translation.kha: U shna saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .

Kine ki Briew kiba khynnah bad borabor ki kynnoh ïa kiwei ; ki ïadoh katno kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki ; ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad ïaroh arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïew ai ïa kaba ki kwah hi .
translation.en: These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .

translation.kha: Nalorkata ha ka snoh kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynran u syiem Syros kum u patsha ka Babilonia , u Sirion u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka pyntwa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .

translation.kha: Lehse kin duwai ha U Trai dara phad pait na ki lynti bymdon jong ki , namar U Trai u la byrngem ïa kane ka jaitbynriew da ka jingbitar dara ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei .
translation.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the  Lord  , and will return every one from his evil way : for great is the anger and the fury that the  Lord  hath pronounced against this people .

translation.kha: Bad ai ba U Trai U Blei jongu me un ai ha me ka jingtip bad ka jingwad ba kumta me lah ban synshar ïa ka Israel kat kamon ki Hukum jongngi u .
translation.en: Only the  Lord  give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the  Lord  thy God .
Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kum ki masi ?
Jamynrei u pyrshah bud ïa ka pop! jong u syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Jerusalem ban leh pop ha kabu Mano ïa ki khup masi ksiar kiba u la pynïeng ha Bethel bad ha Dedan .
translation.en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , Jehu departed not from after them , to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth–el , and that were in Dan .
Then when lust hath conceived , it bringeth forth sin : and sin , when it is finished , bringeth forth death .
translation.kha: Nangta ki jingkwah brai jong u ki pun hapoh jong u bad ka jingmih ka long ban leh ïa ka pop ; bad ka pop , haba ka la ih bha , ka pynmih ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Ha u Philemon , u paralok jong ngi bad u para ba-ïatrei lang ,
Wat ki nongmareh stet keiñ ym lait im , ki rangïapom kiba khlem ktang duh ïa la ka bor , bad ki shipai kin ym lah wat ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .
translation.en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift , and the strong shall not strengthen his force , neither shall the mighty deliver himself :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miat U Trai u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew bad u kylli ïa u , Kaei me mon ïa nga ban ai ha me ?
translation.en: In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .
In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoash u khun jong u Jehoahas kum u syiem ka Israel , u Amasaïah u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Judah
Ka jinglorni ka long kaba bang bha ; a katno ngi ibit ban ïaid ïa ka !
translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .

translation.kha: Kita ki nongpynkha khun ki jubab , Ki kynthei Heber kim long kum ki kynthei Ijipt ; ki kha suki ïa ki khun , bad katba ngin da poi ma ngi , ki la lah khaïi .
translation.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women  ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them .
And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew lai mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .

Bad kumne ang kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonbor : To ai ba barhem ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kanneh kam long ka hukum kaba thymmai kaba nga thoh sha phi ; ka long ka suda kob ngi la don nadong mynnyngkong .
translation.en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa at ngab kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar ha ki nga shem ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments  ; for therein do I delight .

translation.kha: U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem ; u kynrup ïa nga kum u jingjngem .
translation.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .

translation.kha: ka Hapharaim , ka Shion , ka Naarah ,
translation.en: And Hapharaim , and Shion , and Anaharath ,

translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kyrpad ïa U Jisu! ban ym phah noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid na kata ka thain .
translation.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country .

translation.kha: u Hadad , u Tema , u Jetur , u Naphish , pynlang u Kedemah .
translation.en: Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :

translation.kha: Mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , U Terah u la ong ha nga , Hammoth me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Jeruel , —kata ka kynthei bymneh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad shalor uwei pa ti u lum basarong bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bymlarkam , ka la kun kum ka nuti .
translation.en: The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .

translation.kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa la ki Briew ban sdang ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbat , lema bad ka kynhun shipai kaba ïaid ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai .
translation.en: And he said unto the people , Pass on , and compass the city , and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki nongïalam jong pa’ kiba mynshuwa , uba la kren ha phiah ïa ka khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumta ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit jong ki .
translation.en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .

translation.kha: U baïap byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynjah ïa Kito kaba pang .
translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u ong ha u Absalom , Baalah ka Sarah ka rkhie bad ong , ‘ Hato ngan dang ïoh khun shisha haba nga la tymmen ?’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child , which am old ?

translation.kha: Ki briew Ibbah duk ki longsyiem khulom jingïarap ha khnam u nongsynshar Uba sniew ; u un-long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrduh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .
translation.en: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad ang la bynrap , To shahjop , ko Hananaïah ! U Trai um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngat ïa ka lakam .
translation.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .

translation.kha: Naba ngam shym la buhrieh na kaba pynbna ha phi ïa ka jingthmu Baroh ka jong U Blei .
translation.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God .

translation.kha: U Gideon u loit phai pat sha la ïing bad u shongsah hangta .
translation.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house .
And sent Timothy , our brother , and minister of God , and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ , to establish you , and to comfort you concerning your faith :
translation.kha: Bad ngi la phah ïa u Timothi , u parabangeit jong ngi uba ïatrei lem bad ngi na ka bynta U Blei ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist . Ngi la phah ïa u ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi bad ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ,

translation.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei kam shym la pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka kupar . Ka jingkyllon jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingisynei .

translation.en: Who is like unto the  Lord  our God , who dwelleth on high ,
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U shong ha kiba kynjang shajrong ,

translation.en: And Joab said unto him , Thou shalt not bear tidings this day , but thou shalt bear tidings another day : but this day thou shalt bear no tidings , because the king s son is dead .
translation.kha: Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  mynta ka sngi men ym rah kano kano ka khubor babha . Ha kawei pat ka sngi me lah ban leh kumta , hynrei ym mynta , naba u khun jong u syiem u la ïap .

translation.en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
translation.kha: To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thap basniew jong u Soitan .
Ha ki jingkhawai jong phi , phi don ki duitara , ki shakuriaw mala ki tangmuri — bad ka waiñ . Hynrei phim sngewthuh aïu U Trei u leh ,
translation.en: And the harp , and the viol , the tabret , and pipe , and wine , are in their feasts : but they regard not the work of the  Lord  , neither consider the operation of his hands .

translation.kha: Kaba ïa uwei pa uwei u bariew kaba don ei ei , yn sa ai kham bun , bad un dat kyrhai ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wiat ïa kaba khyndiat kaba u don yn shim noh na u .
translation.en: For unto every one that hath shall be given , and he shall have abundance : but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la klet ïa U Trai U Bela jong ki ; ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa u bad mane ïa ki bleithaw Baal nabar Asherah .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and forgat the  Lord  their God , and served Baalim and the groves .
When pride cometh , then cometh shame : but with the lowly is wisdom .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong kin shah pynjahburom . Ka long kaba kham stad ban long kiba sngewrit .
Da shisha nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud ki briew jong na , bad nga la ïohi hajuh kumta ki nong Ijipt ki pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga pynbna ba ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad banbeiñ pynjah pyndon ïa ki . ngam pynjot ïa kiba sah baroh kiba dang im ha ki tare madan ka Philistia .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethims , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .

translation.kha: Em , ym tang hynñiew sien , la jubab U Jisu , hynrei haduh Hynñiewphew sien hynñiew ,
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I say not unto thee , Until seven times : but , Until seventy times seven .

translation.kha: U syiad Hesekaïah tang mar ïohsngew ïa kaweh la ïathaw , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewthuh , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit sha ka Templ jong U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sympat , bad ïa kyiuh pat la teh ha ki kynrei bad la kit bakut ïa ki .
translation.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :

translation.kha: To kmie ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u ngin lehkmen !
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hadien sanphew ar sner jong ka jingtriem , ïa ka kynroh baroh kawei la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba bapar san jong u bnai Elul .
translation.en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul , in fifty and two days .
And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse , which sword proceeded out of his mouth : and all the fowls were filled with their flesh .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki la pynïap da ka waitlam kaba mihnoh na ka shyntur jong uta uba la shong halor u kulai ; bad ki sim baroh ki la bam baroh kat kaba ki lah na ka doh jong ki .

translation.en: And the king said unto her , Be not afraid : for what sawest thou ? And the woman said unto Saul , I saw gods ascending out of the earth .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng ! Phi ïohi aïu ?   Nga ïohi ïa ka sna-ïap ba ka mih na khyndew ,  ka jubab .
Khie leit sha ka Wah Ephrath bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngktop hapoh ka thliew ha ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .

translation.kha: Khie leit , U Jisu u ong ïa u , ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me . Mar kumta hi u la lah ban Ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Ujuh ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .

translation.kha: woh ha ka jingshitom jong nga , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .
translation.en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .

translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba tukri , bad baroh ki long ki nongshukor .
translation.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .

translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , u Aaron un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da kaba buh ha ki reng jong ka barhem rupa tylli ïa ka snam jong ka jingkynjah na ka bynta ka pop . Dei ba leh ïa kane man ka snem ha ki por baroh ki pun wan . Kane ka kharai ka dei ban hir kaba khuid , kaba la pynkyntang shwa per , U Trai .
translation.en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements : once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations : it is most holy unto the  Lord .
Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
Bad mynta , da kaba kohnguh ïa U Mynhyndai Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jerusalem , khlem da tip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u la jied laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kum ki nongtrei ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Israel ,
U paidbah u la jubab , Ka hukum jong me ka ïatih ba U Messaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Toi U Briew ban kyntiew ? Uei une U Toi U Briew ?
translation.en: The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain  ; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain .
translation.kha: Kumta la pynmih ïa ka hukum na ka bynta jong ki baroh ban shah pynïap , kynthup ïa u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u .

Nangta uno uno u bri u bymhok kat kum ka jinglehniam un khat ïa u dpei Jong kata ka masi bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba khur katto khem ka jinglehniam shabar ka jaka Sher dara , ha kaba dei ban buh pynpang ïa ka hangta na ka bynta ka kynhun Israel ban pyndonkam ha katba pynkhih ïa ka um na ka pyntwa ka jingweng ïa ka jingbymkhuid kat kum ka jingleh . Ïa kan ka jinglehniam dei ban leh ban bneng ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up without the camp in a clean place , and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation : it is a purification for sin .

Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph um sngewlah kun shuh ïa la ka jingsngew ha khmat ki shakri jong u , kumta u la hukum ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym shym don mano mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki hynmen shynrang jong u .

translation.en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dabid da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka synduk metïap .
Ka jingkmen ka la haduh noh na ki jingim jong i ; ka jingsngewsih ka la shim ïa ka khang jong ki jingshat jong ngi .
translation.en: The joy of our heart is ceased  ; our dance is turned into mourning .

translation.kha: U Khun U Briew u la woh ban wad bad ban pynim ïa kba la sih noh .
translation.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .

translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la kren ïa U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , hukum ïa ki synran jong me ban sngewbishni jar !
translation.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .

translation.kha: U Jethro u la wan bad ka tnga jong u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka sha ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha u lum bakhuid .
translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
And God helped him against the Philistines , and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal , and the Mehunims .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïarap ïa u ban jop ïa ki Philistia , ïa ki Arab kiba shong ha Gurbaal , bad ïa ki Meun .

Hadien kane , u Manasseh u theh pynphieng ïa ka kynriah bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jongno ka Nongbah u Dabid , na ka tduh jong ka them Ashan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Dohkha bad ka jaka jong ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . U buh ruh ïa u shipai pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ki shipai ha man ki nongbah ba la kurim kynroh jong ka Judah .
translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .

translation.kha: Nangta u Asalaïah u khun jongu u Mahseïah bad u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah bad baroh khawai ki rangbah ba leh meng ki la ong ïa nga , Phi sukher . U thri U blei jong ngi um shym la phah ïa phi ba-bang ong ha ngi ba ngin ym leit bad shongsah ha Ijipt .
translation.en: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah , and Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the proud men , saying unto Jeremiah , Thou speakest falsely : the  Lord  our God hath not sent thee to say , Go not into Egypt to sojourn there :

translation.kha: Mano ba khang ïa ki khyrdop ban beit ïa ka duriaw haba ka bthei na ka kpoh jong ka khyndew ?
translation.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it brake forth , as if it had issued out of the womb ?

translation.kha: U Kornelios , u ïabah shipai u la pham ïa ngi , ki la jubab . U long u Briew uba bha uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U blem u la ïathuh ïa u ban khet sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing jong u , khnang ba u kah ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong .
translation.en: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .

translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Hosah ki ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang syngkai bad ka khyrdep Shallekheth ha ka surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap pyrsa la pynbynta ha ki por ba la buh , khawai hadien kawei pah .
translation.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .

translation.kha: na ka Them Jingjynjar artet sha Debir , mala nongtuh ka phai shatei sha Gilgal , kaba pyrshah ka Khlem Adummim ha ka phang bashathie jong ka them . Nangta ka ïaid sha ki umpohliew ka Enshemesh , ka miat sha Enrogel ;
translation.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that is before the going up to Adummim , which is on the south side of the river : and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh , and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel :
And within were hooks , an hand broad , fastened round about : and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bnoh , kiba jrong hynñiewphew san milimitar la pynskhem na khap ki miej baroh sawdong . Ïa ka doh baroh ba dei ban ai kum ka jingkñia la buh halor ki miej .

translation.en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ha ka ,  To wat sheptieng , ko Mari ; U Blei u la sngewbha ïa pha .
Ka khun u Phan ka ong ha ka , Shem ïa une u khunlung mala ri ïa u na ka bynta jong nga , bad nur-um da siew ïa pha . Kumta kata ka kyntiap ka shim ïa uta u khlong , bad ka ri ka satia ïa u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .
And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .
translation.kha: Suh ïa ka sopti u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñspong ruh da ka linen bani ; bad ïa u panpoh ruh uba la suh pynpur itynnat .
U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . Bad kumta u syiem Bad ki paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the  Lord  , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ? U Trai u kylli . Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei Uba ïaineh bad uba bha katjuh ma u . U mane ïa per bad u kiar ban ym har ïa kano ïano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don kano kano ka daw , hynmen u Job u ïailong hi suba ïaineh kumba u ju long .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .

translation.kha: Un hiarthma khlem ka jingmaham ïa ka probins jong ka ri bariewspah bad un leh ïa kiei kiei Ibbah ym don na ki kpa tymmen jrong u kiba la ju leh . Nangta un pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongbud jong u ïa ki mar ki shoh bad ïa ki jingdon jingem kaba u la kurup ha ka thma . Un pynlong ki jingrem ban tur ïakhleh ïa ki kut , hynrei ka por jongngi u kan kut noh shen .
translation.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province  ; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done , nor his fathers  fathers  ; he shall scatter among them the prey , and spoil , and riches : yea , and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds , even for a time .

translation.kha: U Abner u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid uba don ha Hebron ha kata ka para , ban noh , Uei u ban synshar ïa kane ka ri ? Ïateh kyllum bad nga , bad ngan ïarap ïa phi ban pynwan ïa ki Isaia baroh sha ka liang jrong phi .
translation.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , Whose is the land ? saying also , Make thy league with me , and , behold , my hand shall be with thee , to bring about all Israel unto thee .
Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field ? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken ?
translation.kha: Hato ki kynjang mawsiang jong ka Lebanon ki ju long khlem ka ïor ? Hato ki wahduid ba dait-thah na ki lumbah ki ju rngad ?
Hynrei u syiem u pynlong ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam Jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa ka lawbah jong u ; ki la mihnoh na khmat jong u bad ki la leit ban ñiew ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .

Kumta ka la leit , bad ka leit sha u Lum Karmel , ha kaba u Elisha u don . U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , ba ka wan katba ka dang to kham ha pajih , bad u ong ha u Gaash , u shakri jong u , Ha khmih — katai ka briew na Shunem ka wan !
translation.en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel . And it came to pass , when the man of God saw her afar off , that he said to Gehazi his servant , Behold , yonder is that Shunammite :

translation.kha: kumta u thang jingkñia da ki mrad bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u heh ïa ka jingainguh waiñ bad ka slem jong ka jingsuh ïasyllok ha ka .
translation.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .

translation.kha: Wat ju pynbeit ïa u briew uba hangamei ; un isih ïa phi na ka bynta kata . hynriew lada Phin pynbeit ïa u briew uba stad , un burom ïa phi .
translation.en: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee : rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee .
If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Lada lap ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shah pynïap , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .
Bad u la ïa-ong ha nga , Wat bat kum kaba rieh ïa ki ktieh ka jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka blad , namar ka por ka la jan long kane baroh kan jia .
translation.en: And he saith unto me , Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book : for the time is at hand .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynjot ïa ki long-briew jong ki Briew ibha sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewbieit .
translation.en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .

translation.kha: Ki khup shynrang jong u , u Isaak sad u Ishmael , ki la tat ïa u ha ka balsam Makhpelah , kaba ha ka lyngkha ka don shaphang mihngi na Moreh , kaba dei ka jong u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar u nong Hit .
translation.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre  ;

translation.kha: La don ruh ka Ain , ka Rimmon , ka Ether , bad ka Ashan : saw thylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jrong ki .
translation.en: Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :

And the children of Israel said unto them , Would to God we had died by the hand of the  Lord  in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full  ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
translation.kha: Kan jin da la bha ba U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa ngi ha ri Ijipt . Hangta , la kumno kumno , ngi dang ïoh ban shong bad bam doh bad kyrhai ka jingbam kat kaba ngi kwah . Hynrei phi la wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri shyiap ban pynïapthngan ïa ngi baroh .

translation.en: Praise ye him , sun and moon : praise him , all ye stars of light .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ka sngi bad u bnai ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki khlur baphyrnai .
U Ehud u shna da lade hi kawei ka waitlam arliang syrti kaba shi phut shiteng ka jingïailong . U teh ïa ka ha ka liang kamon lad u hapoh la ki jaiñkup .
translation.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges , of a cubit length  ; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh .

translation.kha: Nga la sa mynmiet kum u bieit — hynrei phi! la pynlong ïa nga ban imat kumta . Dei ma phi Ibbah la dei ba-bang pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa nga . Namarba kam lade Ngam long ei ei , ngam shym anna ei ei na kita ki apostol kiba hasem kyrpang jong phi .
translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .

translation.kha: U pyndonburom ïa ka tnga ka sem don khun ha ka ïingshong jong ka ; u pynkmen ïa ka da kaba ai ki khun ha ka . A to ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house , and to be a joyful mother of children . Praise ye the  Lord .
At the end of a regular pioneer’s first year of full-time service , he or she is enrolled in a six-day school that may be held at a nearby Kingdom Hall .
translation.kha: Ynda ki pioneer batista ki la trei pura shisnem , ïa ki la ju pynrung kyrteng ha ka skul ba hynriew sngi kiba ju pynlong ha ka Ïing Hima ba jan tam .
U pynjot ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Templ . ( Ka dei hangta ba ki kynthei ki ju thain ïa ki ran kiba ju pyndonnam ha kaba mane ïa ka Asherah . )
translation.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .

translation.kha: Phin ïawad ïa nga , hawei Phin ym shem ïa nga , namar phim lah ban leit sha kaba kun don .
translation.en: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .

translation.kha: U Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh kin don hangta ; ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh’ kaba phoi ïohsngew ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests ? therefore it shall be , that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king s house , thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .

translation.kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jyllang u syiem u la ong ha u Elisha , Kata kam lah ban jylla — em waiñ lada U Trai da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew ! U Isaiah u jubab , Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .
translation.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .

translation.kha: Ki Shaneng baroh na ka jait Lebi kiba la dap shi bnai bad kham kah ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ñiew shi kur syang kada da ka hukum U Trai ki long arphew ar hajar ngut .
translation.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Hynrei iathuh uba pynïasoh ïa lade sha U Trai u long kawei bad u ha kaba kynja mynjur .
translation.en: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit .
And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great : so that they wearied themselves to find the door .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shoh pynmatlah ïa kita ki shynrang baroh kiba don habar khnang ba kin ym shem ïa ka jingkhang .

Khynñiuh kumno U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la leh . U la sumar sukher ïa ph haba phi ïaid sakma lyngba Kanneh ka ri shyiap kaba ïar . U la don ryngkat bad Phin ha kine ki sawphew sneng , bad phi la ïoh duh kat ïa kaba phi donkam .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand : he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness : these forty years the  Lord  thy God hath been with thee  ; thou hast lacked nothing .

translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la ïap sawphew snem ka rta , u shongkurim ïa ar ngut ki kynthei Hit , ka Judith ka khun jong u Beeri bad ka basohsat ka khun jong u Elon .
translation.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :

translation.kha: ba nur ai ha ki Israel ïa kane ka khubor : Pha sarong ha ka jingkraw Jong ka Templ . Pha sngewbha ban khih ïa ka bad ban leit jngoh ïa ka , hynrei U Trai un pyntngit ïa ka . Bad ki dkhot ba kham samla ha ki longïing jong phai bakha la shah iehnoh ha Jeremaïah kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: Speak unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will profane my sanctuary , the excellency of your strength , the desire of your eyes , and that which your soul pitieth  ; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword .
But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u ïeng ha ka lynti kaba khim kaba don hapdeng ar tylli ki bri sohwaiñ ba la ker da ka kynroh maw baroh arliang .
Ha kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad hap . bad “kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khyndew kad kylla eh kum u nar .
translation.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .

translation.kha: U ïa-ong , Namar keiñ ki briew ki la kyntait ïa ki um bajai jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha khmat jongnga u syiem Risia bad u syiem Pekah ,
translation.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;

translation.kha: U Abijah u pynkhleh ka kynhun shipai kaweh don saw lakh ngut , bad u Jeroboam u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u da ka kynhun shipai kaba don phra kilo ngut .
translation.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war , even four hundred thousand chosen men : Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , being mighty men of valour .
And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongshimwai ki la pynmynsaw ïa u ruh , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar .

translation.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .
translation.kha: Man ka por , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw bad ki nongïalam jong ki , nalor ki briew kiba wan sha nga na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
Ynda ki jaitbynriew ki ïalumlang , ngan pynngat ïa me ha ka buid jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka jar shata ryndang .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Omri u la ai bad baroh ki jinghap jong u la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: hangto , u Elihu u ong ha u Elisha , To ong ha nga kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ha shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga . Ai ngan ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong ka bor jongu phi ka Ban pynlong ïa nga u nongmih bujli jong phi , u Elisha u jubab .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were gone over , that Elijah said unto Elisha , Ask what I shall do for thee , before I be taken away from thee . And Elisha said , I pray thee , let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me .
Behold , God exalteth by his power : who teacheth like him ?
translation.kha: To kynmaw katno kaba khraw ka bor jong U Blei ; u dei u nonghikai uba khraw tam na baroh .

translation.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong me ?
U Moses u duwai ,
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Te yn pynsaphred ïa me bun men peitbeiñ da ka jingsngewpihuiñ haba me ïor ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha kiwei pat ki briew jong ka Israel , hynriew yn ym dat uwei hima na ka ïing jong me u ban im tymmen .
translation.en: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation , in all the wealth which God shall give Israel : and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever .
And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki ong ha ki paid Simeon ,  Ale leit bad ngi sha ka ri ba la ai ha ngi , bad ngin ïakhun lang ïa ki Kanaan . Nangta ngin ïaleit bad phi sha ka ri kaba la ai ha phi .  Kumta ki jait Simeon
Haba ki la poi ha Salamis , ki la ïalap ïa ka ktieh U Blei ha ki synagog . Ki la don lang bad ki u Ïoannis Markos ban ïarap ha ka kam .
translation.en: And when they were at Salamis , they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews : and they had also John to their minister .

translation.kha: Song ki tiar .
translation.en: Pack your bags .

And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand . If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come  ; and I will look well unto thee : but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear : behold , all the land is before thee : whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .
translation.kha: Mynta , ngan law noh ïa ki kynjri na ki ryndang-kti jong phi bad pyllait noh ïa phi . Lada phi kwah ban leit sha Babilonia ryngkat bad nga , phi lah ban leh kumta , bad ngan sumar ïa phi . Hynrei lada phim kwah ban leit , phi lah ban ym leit . Phi don ïa ka ri baroh kawei ban jied , phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi kwah .
U Trai u la ong , Kñia ka long kum ka dak ba ki Israel ki hap ban smam ïa ka jingbam ba ka Aiñ ka khang , haba ngan pynbunkam ïa ki sha ki ri nongwei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles , whither I will drive them .
So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sher dara ha ka ri Gilead .
Babha ki nongap phira ki la leit pha ino , ki rangbah lyngdoh sad ki Pharisi ki la kylla ïa ki , Balei phi khlem wan ïalam ïa u ?
translation.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?

translation.kha: Ka um kan rit ha ka Nile , bun ka wah kan sdang ban rngad .
translation.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea , and the river shall be wasted and dried up .

translation.kha: To long uba stad bha ym ban ym pyrshang ban pynpaw ïa lade shun ïoh spah .
translation.en: Labour not to be rich : cease from thine own wisdom .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh sha u bad u la ong , Phi tipbriew ba ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba miej Blei thap , ki leh donbor Hamor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka har naduh sdang .
translation.en: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .

translation.kha: Pha sngewshngain ïa lade ha la ki kam sngur ; phalang pyrkhat ba ym don mano mano ba Iohi ïa pha . Ka jingdih Bad ka jingtip jong pha ki ïamareh bakla ïa pha , nabar pha ong ha lade , ‘ Nga long U Blei — ym don uno uno pat kum ma nga .’
translation.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la im poh pahai shisien mynta ki leit bylla ban ïoh bam , hynrei tun kiba thngan kam thngan Shu . Ka briew kaba lyngki ka ïoh khuid hynñiew ngut , Hynrei ka kmie kaba lep ki khun ka sah marwei .
translation.en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread  ; and they that were hungry ceased : so that the barren hath born seven  ; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble .
Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah ñiew ha ka jingkheiñbriew , kata , naduh uba arphew snem shaneng , u dei ban siew sha nga ïa kane ka dor ba la buh .
Ha kaweh ka sngi , saw bnai hadien , haba u patsha Artakserksis u dang shongkha bam , nga leit thah ïa ka waiñ sha u . Um patiaw ju ïohi ïa nga ba nga miat sngewsih mynshuwa ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan , in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king , that wine was before him : and I took up the wine , and gave it unto the king . Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence .

translation.kha: Nga la shahjop ha ka jingshyrkhei ; ka barim jong nga ka la mihnoh kum ka kyntu , bad ka spah jong nga kum u lyiur .
translation.en: Terrors are turned upon me : they pursue my soul as the wind : and my welfare passeth away as a cloud .

translation.kha: Te haba ka sngi ka la shit , ka la thang noh ïa ki jingthung ba dang lung ; bad namar ba ki thied kim da ngam jylliew bha , ki jingthrang Shen ki tyllong noh .
translation.en: But when the sun was up , it was scorched  ; and because it had no root , it withered away .
If I must needs glory , I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities .
translation.kha: Lada nga dei ban sngewsarong , ngan sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba pyn-i haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
Hadien u lumlang ïa ka kynhun ki riewmadan , bad ki pynduhbor ïa ka mon jong ki ha u Rehoboam u khun jong u Salmunna , uba Dang Khynnah eh pynlang ba dang pluh ka jingtbit ban ïohnong pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial , and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted , and could not withstand them .

translation.kha: U Trai u te patar ïa ka Jerusalem ; u khulom pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
translation.en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
But and if ye suffer for righteousness  sake , happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror , neither be troubled  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada phi hap ban shahshitom haba phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , katno kiba kmen phi long ! Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , bad wat khuslai .
Nga ong ïa me , to ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , malu to leit noh sha ïinglieng !
translation.en: I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .

translation.kha: U Jakob u bteng , Joseph , ki khun shynrang jong me ar ngut naba me la ïoh ha Ijipt shuwa ba lang! wan haneng ki dei ki jong nga ; u Ephraim bad u Manasseh ki long ki khun jong nga kumba longsyiem u Reuben bad u Simeon .
translation.en: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .

translation.kha: Lydda dat nawei na ki riewbieit uba leh pop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba u pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;
And Saul said unto Michal , Why hast thou deceived me so , and sent away mine enemy , that he is escaped ? And Michal answered Saul , He said unto me , Let me go  ; why should I kill thee ?
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa ka Mikhal ,  Balei pha shet shukor ïa nga kumne bad shah ïa u nongshun jong nga ban lait phet ?  Ka jubab ,  U byrngem ban pynïap ïa nga lymda nga ïarap ïa u ban lait phet .

Kumta u Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu , Ko Trai , katno ka long kob bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Lada me mon , ngan shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ hangne , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Eli .
translation.en: Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh nabar ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u :
translation.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders , said ,
Then she saddled an ass , and said to her servant , Drive , and go forward  ; slack not thy riding for me , except I bid thee .
translation.kha: Nangta ka phah teh jin ïa ka kada , bad ka hukum ïa u shakri ,  Pynïaid stet ïa ka kada katba ka lah , bad wat pynsuki , lymda nga ong ïa me ban leh kumta .
Ka longïng thik bania por la ong , phi dei ki nongsyntiat , u Joseph u jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , That is it that I spake unto you , saying , Ye are spies :

translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei un thiaw ïa nga ha ki tarajur bahok , bad un ïohi katno uba lui lui ang long .
translation.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .
He answered and said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they say unto him , Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread , and give them to eat ?
translation.kha: Phi dei ma phi hi ban ai ei ei ïa ki ba kin bam ,  U Jisu u la jubab . Ki la kylli ,  Hato me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad pynlut arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ha u kpu khnang ban bsa ïa ki ?

translation.en: If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .
translation.kha: Haba uba lui lui u ïap kynsan , U Blei u rkhie .

translation.en: I will therefore chastise him , and release him .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .
Haba ki paidbah ki la sngewkyiuh shaphang kata , ki la bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shemphang ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba donburom ïa ka .
translation.en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u don ka dur kum u sing ; uba ar u don ka dur kumin u masi kyrtong ; uba na u don ka lamkhmat khem ka durkhmat u briew ; bad uba saw u don ka dur kum u pukni uba her .
translation.en: And the first beast was like a lion , and the second beast like a calf , and the third beast had a face as a man , and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle .

translation.kha: Shna ïa ka bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jyllang ka baroh kat kumne ka dur kaba ngan pyn-i ha me .
translation.en: According to all that I shew thee , after the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all the instruments thereof , even so shall ye make it .

translation.kha: Mynta , khie leit bad khmih ïa ka ri bhor kawei , naba ngan ai ïa ka baroh ha me .
translation.en: Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it  ; for I will give it unto thee .

translation.kha: Dang trep ha ka sngi kiba bud ki paidbah ki tei ïa ka duwan hangta , ki ai ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok bad thang ïa ki jingiw pynïasuk .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .

translation.kha: Nga la Ong , Hato u syiem Jehoïakhin u la kylla long kum u khra naba la piat uba la bret nala bad u bymlah to ba kwah shuh moi mano ? Hato ka erlangthari kata balei ba ma u bad ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri kaba kim tip ei ei ?
translation.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?

translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynsamthiah beiñ ïa phi , sad ong bun jait ki jingtriem basanphew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi! long ki nongbud jong ar .
translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .

translation.kha: U la rah pat sha Samaria kum ka mar lute ïa baroh ka ksiew bad ka rupa kaba ha ka Tabor , ki tyrha ki tar ka thalab ïa kiba la ap phira da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Obed Edom , bad ïa ki jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem . U la ïalam ruh ïa ki kordit lem mala u .
translation.en: And he took all the gold and the silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom , and the treasures of the king s house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .

translation.kha: Phan long kum ka pansngiat kaba itynnat ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .

translation.kha: Na ka kur jrong u sharai la don u Hosah , uba ba-don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shimei , ( u kpa jong u , u la pynlong nongïalam ïa u dak la um dei u khun nyngkong ) ,
translation.en: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons  ; Simri the chief , ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief  ; )

translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U Trai u tlot pyllait ban pynim ïa phiah lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban eh jingïarap !
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw lad ka jingshukor u syiem Hesekaïah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la per kynjri jong ka Judah bad ki iap ïa ki .
translation.en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah , and took them .
For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong me , ko para ba-ieit , ka la wallam ïa ka jingkmen bakhraw bad jingaimynsiem bajur ! Me la pynkmen ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew U Blei baroh .

translation.en: And Isaac his father said unto him , Who art thou ? And he said , I am thy son , thy firstborn Esau .
translation.kha: U Isaak u kylli ,  Me dei uei ?   Nga dei u Iso , u khun nyngkong jong phi ,  u jubab .

Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem thup da kaba kum kliar shun wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba un-long kyntang sha U Trai , un wallam ïa ka jingbna namar ka jingleh palat sha U Trai da u langbrot ne u nongmih u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong pynseisoh ïa u kan longïng kumba la buh .
translation.en: If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :

translation.kha: Ujuh U Blei uba la thaw ïa nga u la jingaiti ruh ïa ki shatri jong nga .
translation.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him ? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?

translation.kha: Ki khun jong ka Para ba-ieit jong phi ki pham ïa ka jingïamai khublei ïa phi .
translation.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee . Amen .

translation.kha: U la wan shen ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . Khlem pep , Phi kop ïa kata !
translation.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lyntang bad u la leit pait pat sha jingsliang ka duriaw sha la ka jong shnong ,
translation.en: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .

translation.kha: U Eser , u khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jrong ka Mispah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha khmat ka jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha Kaba ka kynriah ka phai ;
translation.en: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .

And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .
translation.kha: U la pyndem ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan ïa phi , bad hadien kata u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju ïoh mynno mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u briew um im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba mih na U  Trai .

translation.en: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .
translation.kha: Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahpanhes ki la pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .

translation.en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka lyer ha shuwa jong u kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lut ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki hima sha ka jingjot bad u pynkut ïa ki jingthmu basniew jong ki .

translation.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .
translation.kha: Katto katne kiei kiei kiba ngi ïohsngew ba me kren ki long kiba sngewphylla ïa ngi , bad ngi kwah ban tip aïu ki kit jingmut .

Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynleh ba u Jakob u Shem ba ka dei pynban da ka Leah . U leit shwa u Laban , bad u ong , balieh pa leh ïa kane ha nga ? Nga la trei ban ïoh ïa ka Rephael ? Balei phira la shukor ïa sa ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong u Dabid ka sdang ban pynjynjar ïa u ,
translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that David s heart smote him , because he had cut off Saul s skirt .

translation.kha: Ngan kren jam ban pynshlur ïa ka Jerusalem ; ngan ym sngap Jar haduh ba yn pynim ïa ka , malade ka jingjop jong ka tud tyngshaiñ kamon ka jingshai ha ka por mynsngi .
translation.en: For Zion s sake will I not hold my peace , and for Jerusalem s sake I will not rest , until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness , and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth .

Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasyriem thik bad ka dur U Blei hi , uba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jong u . Hadien ba u la ïohpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki pop u khunbynriew , u la shong ha bneng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor Tam .
Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpdem ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki nongtuh ki rung shapoh ki ïing , hynrei mynsngi ki rieh bad ki kiar ïa ka jingshai .

translation.en: Canst thou by searching find out God ? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban shem ïa ki pud ki sam jong ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong U Blei ?
Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phlang ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khet Jong u , bun u la kren ha u Paidbah .
translation.en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .

And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart , she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines , saying , Come up this once , for he hath shewed me all his heart . Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and brought money in their hand .
translation.kha: Haba ka Delilah ka sngewthuh ba u la ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha , ka phah ktien sha ki syiem Philistia bad ka ong ,  Wan biang sa shisien . U la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingshisha .  Kumta ki la ïawan bad ki wanrah artat ïa ki sbai rupa .
Ki la dei ban im ha ki krem , ha ki thliew ba la tih ha ki sharing jong ki riat .
translation.en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
And he answered them , saying ,  Who is my mother , or my brethren ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga ? Kiei ki para jong nga ?

translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .
translation.kha: Ko syiem , phi dei ban tip ba ngi la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judah bad shem ba ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bakhraw la dang shna biang da ki maw baheh bad da ki bim dieng ba la pyndait ha ka kynroh . Ïa ka kam la pyntrei ha ka rukom kaba biang bha bad ka dang ïaid shaphrang .

Ki shane ruh sa ar thlia ki kyrwoh kseh bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong me ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmat jong ka ephod , sei ka khang suh pyndait , nabar haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thapniang itynnat bol .
translation.en: And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .

translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem haba ki syiem ki ju otsher sha ka tdam , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Jehoba lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka kynhun shipai Israel ; ki la iap ïa ki Amon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid hi u la sah ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .
And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .
translation.kha: Ai ha u khyndiat ka iktiar jong me , khnang ba u paidbah un kohnguh ïa u .
Katba khrum ka long ka jingaiei U Balei , kaba u la ai ha ngi ha kat kata ka jingthew bakhraw!
translation.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence ;
And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .
translation.kha: Pyndait ha ka , saw kyrdon ki mawkordor , u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;

translation.en: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
translation.kha: Nangta u la khot ïa la ki shakri bad u la ong ha ki , ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga , hynrei ki briew kiba nga la khot sngewbha kim don hok ban ïoh ïa ka .

U Hesekaïah u phah ïa ka khubor shaw u Shemeber , uba don ha Malkhijah : Nga la leh bakla ; sngewngiah pynsangeh ïa ka jingat ïaleh jong phi , bad ngan sleit kat kaba phi dawa . Ka jubab u nongsynshar ka long ba u Hesekaïah un phah sha u shiphew tan ka rupa Bad shi ton ka ksiar .
translation.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish , saying , I have offended  ; return from me : that which thou puttest on me will I bear . And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .

translation.kha: Ynda uta u khunlung u la san , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Moses , Namar , ka ong , nga la sieh ïa u na ka um .
translation.en: And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .

translation.kha: u la nguh , Ngan sa kotbah ïa me ynda poi ki nongïam jong me . Nangta u la ai hukum shun buh ïa u Petros ha ka jinghap phira Hapoh ka jaka sah jong u lyngskor .
translation.en: I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod s judgment hall .
Gad , a troop shall overcome him : but he shall overcome at the last .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki nonglute kin sa wan ïaleh ïa u Gad , Hynrei un phai kylla ban beh ïa ki nadien .

translation.en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;
translation.kha: U syiem u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew , kumba la ai jingmut kita ki samla .
Lada yn kylliang ïa sem Myntan shaphang ka kad babha ïa kaba la leh ha u bri uba dkoh bun kynum la pynkhiah ïa u ,
translation.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole  ;

translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la dep kren , u la dem khohsiew bad ki bad u la mudui .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .

translation.kha: Te thah une u briew u don u khun uba lute bad uba pynïap , uba ai ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei babha u kpa jongki u um ju leh .
translation.en: If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,
And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had  ; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la ai ha u ïa ka kali syiem kaba ar ba un shong ; bad ki nongap ïa ka ïingsyiem ki ïaid ha khmat jong u bad ki pyrta ,  Kynriah ! kynriah !  Bad kumta la thung lat ïa u Joseph halor ka ri Ijipt baroh .
Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah” ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki imon ha Ijipt , ha ka pynbha kaba bha tam hajan ka nongbah ramhah , kitab u syiem u la suda .
translation.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki la kyntait ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang hapoh ka shnong jong u bad da kiba ha ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .
translation.kha: Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymdei ha ka ri shyiap bad tynjuh ïa U Blei ;

translation.en: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .
translation.kha: Haba ka um ka la lut , ka ieh ïa u khunlung hapoh kawei ka bniap ,
Ka Sdang kumba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la thoh : U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shwa jong phi Ban pynkhreh lynti na ka bynta jong phi .’
translation.en: As it is written in the prophets , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sekakah u la phah wallam ïa nga shat u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong , Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .

translation.kha: La lynthem maw ïa ki , la ot ïinglieng ïa ki , la pynïap ïa ki da ka thnam . Ki la ïaid kylleng , ki da phong da ki jaiñ snep langbrot lane snieh blei — ha ka jingdum , ha ka jingshah pynshitom , bad ha ka jingshah lehbeiñ .
translation.en: They were stoned , they were sawn asunder , were tempted , were slain with the sword : they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins  ; being destitute , afflicted , tormented  ;
Our fathers worshipped in this mountain  ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen nong Samaria jong nga ki la ïamane ïa U Blei halor une u lum , hynrei phi ki Jiw phi ong ba ka Jerusalem ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngi dei ban mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  Nga ong ha me , to khie joit , shim ïa la ka jingthiah , bad khie leit noh sha ïing !
U Jingsuk u la ïa-ong ha ki , Ki Syiem jong kiba mane bieit thala ki don ka bor halor ki briew jong ki , bad ki nongsynshar ki kam ïa ka im ba ki dei ‘ Ki paralok jong u Paidbah’ .’
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .

translation.kha: U Trai un ïadon ïa u Lum Seïon , hynrei ki briew jong ka Moab kmen shah ïohphet , kumba ïa u phlangïap la ijuh haba shniah sboh .
