Ngam khong hok ban kob tang namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Angel . La katta ruh , nga don hapoh ki hukum ban leh kumta . Bad katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa nga lada ngam shem la ïalap ïa ka gospel!
translation.en: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel!

translation.kha: Ka Bithynia ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad shibun ki Nong Judia ki la wan Ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ngab pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u per jong ki .
translation.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei katba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki Kam shlur lad u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Ong Ki Shimiet Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .
translation.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
O praise the  Lord  , all ye nations : praise him , all ye people .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki hima baroh ! A to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh !

translation.en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la ong ha ki ,  Duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pjiah la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?
translation.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
translation.kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ; kata ka long baroh kaba ngi donkam .
Nangta u ong ha u Uriah , Khie leit sha la ïing bad pynjahthait katto katne . U Ujuh u la mih , Bad u Dabid u la phah ka jingai sngewbha sha ïing jong u .
translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Go down to thy house , and wash thy feet . And Uriah departed out of the king s house , and there followed him a mess of meat from the king .

translation.kha: nia ki briew kiba leit bad u ïaiban ki lap ïa uwei u khynnah Ijipt ha lum , bad ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Dabid . Ki ai ha u ïa u kpu ban bam bad ka um ban dkhoh ;
translation.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he did eat  ; and they made him drink water  ;

translation.kha: Un kyrkhu ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyndonburom ïa u , kiba khraw bad kiba rishot kumjuh .
translation.en: He will bless them that fear the  Lord  , both small and great .
And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison  ; and whatsoever they did there , he was the doer of it .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa u Joseph ban khmih ïa kiwei pat ki koidi kiba don hangta , bad u la buh jingkitkhlieh ha u ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba la ju leh hangta .

Kumno re kumno , u Ebedmelekh , u nongai Sodom , u ïunukh uba trei ha ka ïingsyiem u la ïohsngew ba ki la thep ïa na ha ka pungsum . Ha katai ka por u Syiem u tang pynlong ka jingbishar ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin .
translation.en: Now when Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon  ; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin  ;

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ba duk Bad ba longïing hok ba ïa kaba riewpoh bad ïaid kynriang .
translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua badno ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit na Makkedah shaei Libnah bad ki ter ïalap ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :

translation.kha: Kaba ñiewshiliang ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei don katto katne ki nongsynshar ki ban lai bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka jingbah .
translation.en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .

translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa u kpa jong u , u sa ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai’ .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Amaziah had done  ;

Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .
translation.kha: U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u dieng ban thang ding bad shi bynta jong u ban pynlong bleithaw . Da shi bynta u pynmeh ding ban pynsyaid ïa lade bad shet kpu ; da kawei pat ka shi bynta u shna blei bad mane ïa ka .
U la buh ïa u Jehosabad ban kham ïa kiaw bapaw ki koidi kiba don hangta , malade u la buh jingkitkhlieh ha u ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba la ju leh hangta .
translation.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison  ; and whatsoever they did there , he was the doer of it .

translation.kha: Wat la phi bun kat ki khleh ha sahit bneng , tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im , namar ba phim shym jongu ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
And the king took his ring from his hand , and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews  enemy .
translation.kha: U syiem u law ïa la ka sati ba pyndonkam ha kaba shon muhor ban pynkupbor ïa ki jingpynbna , bad ai ïa ka ha u nongshun jong ka jaitbynriew Jiw , u Haman u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .
Mynta to shah ïa kane ka jingsngem , ma phi ki syiem ; to ïohi jingkhie na kane , phi ki nongsynshar jong ka pyrthuh .
translation.en: Be wise now therefore , O ye kings : be instructed , ye judges of the earth .

translation.kha: ‘ Hadien kaei ngan wan phai pat , ong U TRAI’ , bad tun pynïeng pat ïa ka hima jong u Dabid . Ngan tei pat ïa kaba la jot jong ka bad tun pynkhlad pud ïa ka .
translation.en: After this I will return , and will build again the tabernacle of David , which is fallen down  ; and I will build again the ruins thereof , and I will set it up :

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Moses u daiñ shongthait harud kawei ka puk , hynñiew ngut ki khun kynthei Jong u Jehu , u lyngdoh ka Midian , ki ïawan tong um ban pyndap ïa ki shyngoid ba Kin Ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong u kpa jong ki .
translation.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .

translation.kha: Susah U Blei , uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , u la pyn-i ïa ka jingsynran ïa ki Jentil da kaba ai ïa U Mynsiem bakylluid ha ki , kumba u la imat ha ngi .
translation.en: And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;

translation.kha: Ki la shah banbeiñ ha ki nongwan jong ki bad ki la long nadong shadong hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong ki .
translation.en: Their enemies also oppressed them , and they were brought into subjection under their hand .

translation.kha: U Bela borabor Baroh un ym bor ïa kaba sniew ; um ju leh bymdei ïano ïano .
translation.en: Yea , surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
And the rough goat is the king of Grecia : and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh u ïeng na ka bynta ka hima Gris , bad ka reng kaba paw bha hapdeng ki khmat jong u ka dei u syiem banyngkong .

translation.en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pyrshang ban pynsniew ïa uwei pat u briew da kaba mudui lamler ïa u ,
U Abram u la shaniah ha U Trai ; bad namar kano , U Trai u la sngewma ïa u bad u la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .
The joy of our heart is ceased  ; our dance is turned into mourning .
translation.kha: Ka jingkmen ka la duh noh na ki jingim jong ngi ; ka jingsngewsih ka la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki jingshad jong ngi .
La don uwei u mot Bakhlem hangno , bad uwei pa Uei u shynrang nabar ka kynthei ha ka nongjop , kynthup ïa ki nongïalam , ki mareh sha u . Ki khnang ïa lade shapoh bad ki kiew shaw ka tnum .
translation.en: But there was a strong tower within the city , and thither fled all the men and women , and all they of the city , and shut it to them , and gat them up to the top of the tower .

translation.kha: Ka don ka kabu da shisha stong na ka bynta ka jingtrei kiba khraw bun kaba myntoi , wat lapbah anna Bun ki nongïoh pyrshah .
translation.en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me , and there are many adversaries .

translation.kha: Ko khuid u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tylli , bad men ym lai ban leit shai jaka paidbah .
translation.en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u jubab , Hato ka brup ka lah pun klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym Ieit ïa i khun iba ka la khaïi ? wat la ka kilomitar ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet ïa phi .
translation.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .
As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant , who is for you a faithful minister of Christ ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïoh tip ïa ka jingaiei jong U Blei na u Epaphras , u para shakri ba-ieit jong ngi , uba long u nongtrei baïaineh jong U Khrist na ka bynta jong ngi .
Ha sngap ! Ka Jingstad ka pyrta ha ki lynti sneng sad ha ki bakwah ïew ,
translation.en: Wisdom crieth without  ; she uttereth her voice in the streets :
And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering , and laid it upon Isaac his son  ; and he took the fire in his hand , and a knife  ; and they went both of them together .
translation.kha: U Abraham u pynkit ha u Isaak ïa ki dieng na ka bynta ka jingkñia , bad ma u pat u rah ïa ka tari bad ïa ki rnga barhem ban sliew ding . Katba baroh ar ngut ki dang ïa-ïaid ,
Shahshkor katba nga tdong ïasaid ïa ka kam jong to .
translation.en: Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .
And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia bad u la phah noh ïa ki sha Joppa .

Uno uno u lah ban kiew na ka jingduk ban longïing u syiem jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban loit na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long uba ngeit eh ban shim ïa ka jingbet , um long uba kham bha Kum u jingkup uba duk hynrei uba shaphang .
translation.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .

translation.kha: Ha la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la iehnoh na ka nongbah .
translation.en: And when even was come , he went out of the city .

translation.kha: Hadien jong phi kan don sa kawei ka hima , ka bymïap da khraw kum ka jrong phi , bad hadien “kata sa kaba lai , ka hima kaba da ka rnong , ka baneh synlar ïa ka pyrthei baroh khwai .
translation.en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee , and another third kingdom of brass , which shall bear rule over all the earth .

translation.kha: hangta ki jingweng ki plung . Ki san kum ka bri ki diengsoh Pomkranet bad ki sei ki soh bakynjang . Ym don Kanaan kano ka jingduna ïa u kñia bad ïa u nard ,
translation.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .
And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .
translation.kha: Katba ki briew ki dang shahshkor ïa kane , U Jisu u la bteng bad u la ïathuh ïa ka pharshi ha ki . U la jan poi artat ha Jerusalem , bad ki la tharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan paw .

ka Shelah , ka Haeleph , ka Jehud ( lane ka Jerusalem ) , ka Jogbehah , bad ka Kiriath Jearim : khah thylliej ki nongbud , lem bad ki nongri sawdong jong ki . Kane ka long ka ri kiba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang khim ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And Zelah , Eleph , and Jebusi , which is Jerusalem , Gibeah , and Kirjath  ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .

translation.kha: Ïa kadei khie Kaba phiah leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynhynnin , kam phi trei na ka bynta U Trai’ bad ym na ka bna ki briew .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;

translation.kha: Kito ibha pynbudnam ïa me ken kmen lehbha ki ïohthiah ïa nga , namar de la shaniah ha ka jinglorni jong me .
translation.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me  ; because I have hoped in thy word .

translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Jesreel .
translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
The children of Shem  ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shem — u Elam , u Asshur , u Arpakhshad , u Lud , bad u Aram — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
Ki la pynlong ïa lap ki bymkhuid da ki jingleh lad ki bad ki la long bymïaineh ha U Blei .
translation.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .
When the  Lord  thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee , whither thou goest to possess them , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their land  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang leit ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka bad shong hangta .
Nangta , ha ka janmiet jongki ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong une u bnai , ki paid Israel baroh ktang ïa-pynïap ïa wir ki nard .
translation.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki khun shynrang lad u Ladan ; u Setham bad u Joel , ki dei peit ïa ki ïing jingkynshew bad ïing Buh tiar jong ka Templ .
translation.en: The sons of Jehieli  ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the  Lord .

When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid najan ka jaka ap phira kaba nyngkong bad nangta ïa kaba ar , bad ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nar kaba lam sha ka nongbah . Ka khyrdop ka la plie hi na ka bynta jong ki , bad ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïaid ha ka lynti bah , bad kynsan u angel u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .
U KA uba im u la phah ïa nga , bad namar jong u per ruh nga im . Ha kaweh ka rukom uno uno uba bam ïa nga un im namar jong nga .
translation.en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
How should one chase a thousand , and two put ten thousand to flight , except their Rock had sold them , and the  Lord  had shut them up ?
translation.kha: Balei ba shihajar kin shahjop tang ha uwei , bad shiphew hajar pat tang ha ki ar ngut ? U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la iehnoh ïa ki , bad U Blei badonbor jong ki u la kyntait noh ïa ki ?

translation.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim s children of the third generation : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph s knees .
translation.kha: U la im haduh ba u da ïohi ïa ki khun bad ki ksiew jong u Ephraim , bad haduh ba u da ïohpdiang ïa ki khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh .

translation.en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah bad u la ïai kren haduh shiteng synñia , namar ba un sa mihnoh ha ka sngi kaba bud .

translation.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished , as many as came with Peter , because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw kiba la ngeit kiba la wan na Joppa lem bad u Petros ki la sngewlyngngoh ba U Blei u la theh ïa ka jingai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?
translation.kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And David sent messengers to Ish–bosheth Saul s son , saying , Deliver me my wife Michal , which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid ruh u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Ishbosheth ban ong ,  Ai noh ha nga ïa ka Mikhal ka tnga jong nga . Nga la siew shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia ban shongkurim ïa ka .

?(Nga hir U Blei naba khriat bun kaba khuid , uba im shi jingmut . Nga shong ha ki jaka kiba jrong nabar kiba khiah , nabar nga im ruh mala ki brisoh kiba sngewrit malu kylla-kaba-mut , kumin ba ngan pynïoh biah ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity , whose name is Holy  ; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite ones .
Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
translation.kha: Balei me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa nga ban shim ïa ka kum ka tnga jong nga ? Kane hangne ka tnga jong me ; shim noh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .

translation.en: And Absalom answered Joab , Behold , I sent unto thee , saying , Come hither , that I may send thee to the king , to say , Wherefore am I come from Geshur ? it had been good for me to have been there still : now therefore let me see the king s face  ; and if there be any iniquity in me , let him kill me .
translation.kha: U Absalom u jubab ,  Namar ba phim wan haba nga la phah khot ïa phi . Nga la kwah ïa phi ban leit sha u syiem bad ban kylli na ka bynta jong nga : ‘ Balei nga dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Geshur bad wan hangne ? Kan jin da la kham bha ïa nga ban sah hangta .’   U Absalom u bteng ,  nga kwah ïa phi ban pynbeit ïa nga ban ïohi ïa u syiem , bad lada nga la kit pop , te shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa nga .

Hynrei haba phi mudui , to leit shwa ka ruma jong phi! , khang ïa ka jingkyang , bad duli shat U kpa jong phoi , ïa uba ym lah shun ïohi . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phoi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .
And he entreated Abram well for her sake : and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .
translation.kha: Namar jong ka , u syiem u la lehbha ïa u Abram bad u la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad ki blang , ki masi , ki kada , ki mraw bad ki ut .

translation.en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .
translation.kha: u phah shata ïa ka kynhun babun ryngkat bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ki la poi ha ka nongbah mynmiet bad ki kerkut ïa ka .
U Daberath bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïashad kmen bad ïarwai shitrhem da ka bor baroh ban Burom ïa U Trai . Ki da tem ïa ki duitara , ki jingtem ksai , ki ksing , ki kynjri , bad ki shakuriaw .
translation.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the  Lord  on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .
Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh katno phi long kiba ieit ïa nga bad haduh katno nga la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynkmen ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi ! Kane te , ko ki parabangeit ba-ieit , ka long kumno phi dei ban ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai .
Ha ka snem kaweh lai jong ka jingsynshar u Arsa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah u la long u syiem ka Israel baroh kawei , sad u la synshar arphew saw snieh ha Tishbe .
translation.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .

translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka jop ka synshar da ka jingïap , kumta ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingriam bymsuidñiew lyngba U Jisu kyrshut U Trai jong i .
translation.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: Phi te pa’ nud ban kynting sbai ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paralok bajan tam eh .
translation.en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , shaneng khong kaba radbah ïa ki jingkhaïi Niam kum ki riewbieit . “Phi la phai lyndet na la U Blei malu phi la long ki bymsngewtynnat ha u . Ha borbah kawei ka ri phi la die ïa latai kum ki nud ha u blei Baal bad phi la iau ïa u kew uba phi pyrkhat ba u la shaw na ka bynta jong phi !
translation.en: Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .

translation.kha: Na kano ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pynbud ïa pa’ da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U mynsaw jong u , u ai .
translation.en: For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;

translation.kha: U sharak ibha syang un ïoh long khlieh ba-halor u khun bymdonkam jong u kynrad Bad ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka jingïohpateng .
translation.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .

translation.kha: Lada ki kpa jlan ki hynmen shynrang Jong ki , ki wan ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi , phi lah ngab ong , ‘ Sngewbha shah ba kin don bad ngi , Namar ngim Shim shim ïa ki na phi ha ka madan thma ban long ki tnga jong ngi . Bad lehbha phim shym la ai ïa ki ha ngi , Phim long kiba la pynrem ba phi la pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular .’
translation.en: And it shall be , when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain , that we will say unto them , Be favourable unto them for our sakes : because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war : for ye did not give unto them at this time , that ye should be guilty .

translation.kha: Mynta , namar ba im’ don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiem , ngim kwah ban Ïohi ïa kane ba tud ia , bad kumne ngi ai jingmut
translation.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;

translation.kha: U synran ïa ibha U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros , U dei U Trei ! Haba u Petros u la iohnong ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .
translation.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ma pa’ ki Jiw phin shah pynrem ha ki jingtylli namar Phi pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum , Wat la na ka bynta jong Phi ïa ka Hukum la theh bad ïa phi la otsher ; hynrei ki kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , wat la ym shym la otsher ïa ki ha ka doh .
translation.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature , if it fulfil the law , judge thee , who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law ?

translation.kha: Em , ym dei u Beelsebul , hynriewphew U Mynsiem U Blei , uba ai ha nga ka tam don beh khong ïa ki ksuid , kaba pynshisha ba ka Hima U Blei ka la da wan lytar ha phi .
translation.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .
And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me kumba nga la long bad u Moses .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Samuel was old , that he made his sons judges over Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Samuel u la tymmen , u thung nongbishar ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ha Israel .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka —Judah , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .
translation.kha: U Esra u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei uba khraw !  Baroh u paidbah u rah la ki kti shajrong bad ong ,  Amen ! Amen !  Ki dem khohsiew ha ka jingshakri , ki phai ki khmat jong ki sha khyndew .
Phi long ba la tim ! Ha ka jingtur shla jong phi , phi la pynnoh bad pynbamphlang ïa la ki paramarjan ; phi pynlong ïa ki ban ïadei sheng sheng kum kiba la buaid .
translation.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink , that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also , that thou mayest look on their nakedness !

translation.kha: Ynda u Joshua u la wan sha ïing , ki leit rieh sha u hapoh ïohnong ïa kita ki jingïohi sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .

translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewphylla bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Ki jait ki aïu kine ? Da ka iitkhmat sad ka bor une u briew u ai ki hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki ïamihnoh !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .
And ye are witnesses of these things .
translation.kha: Phi long ki sakhi ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: Thou also , son of man , take thee a tile , and lay it before thee , and portray upon it the city , even Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim uwei u maw-it , buh ïa u ha khmat jong me bad pruid dak ha u ban ïeng na ka bynta ka nongbah Jerusalem .
Kam dei ka rta kaba pynstad ïa me jlan Kaba ïarap ïa ngi ban tip kaei kiba dei .
translation.en: Great men are not always wise : neither do the aged understand judgment .
And when they had been there many days , Festus declared Paul s cause unto the king , saying , There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix :
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la don hangta bun sngi , u Phestos u la batai ïa ka jinglong jingman jong u Paul ha u syiem .  Don u briew hangne ïa uba la ieh koidi da u Pheliks ;

Ha kane hi ka sngi u la leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U la ïakhot sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh , ïa u Jogbehah u rangbah ai sah” jong ka kynjah shiphew jong phi , bad ïa u atiar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adonijah !’
translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .

translation.kha: Sumar ïa nga na kaba kitei ha ka lynti kaba bakla , bad ha ka jingbha jongno me to hikai ïa nga ïa ka Aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Remove from me the way of lying : and grant me thy law graciously .
That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkyndit shikatdei eh da ka jingsheptieng ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaba heh kum kano kano ka nongbah kaba don la u syiem ; ka kham heh ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewïaleh kiba tbit .

translation.en: In those days came John the Baptist , preaching in the wilderness of Judaea ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Ïoannis Nongpynbaptis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap jong ka Judia bad u la sdang ban ïalap .
Ki nang ba ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jingleh jongno ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba thap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban leh ïa kan kano kaba bha .
translation.en: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jakarieh mane beit jong ki Jiw ktem kein hok ban bam na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kaba la thuh halor ka duwan jong ngi .
translation.en: We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Naba , salia um tip ïa ka jingot jong ka met jong U Trai haba u bam ïa u Kpu malade dih na ka khuri , u wallam ïa ka jingïar ha lade hi kaba u dang bam bad dih .
translation.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .
In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .
translation.kha: U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñ eh ba baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .

translation.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kane ka long kumno kan jia ha kito kiba kynton ka spah na ka bynta ïa lade hynrei ki bym riewspah ha ka jingkhmih jong U Blei .
Ka khubor jong nga ka longsem kum ka ding , nabar kum u tyrnem uba pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?
And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .
translation.kha: Ka por kaba dei ka la poi ,  u ong ,  bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !
Katai ka long kaba shisha . Ïa ki la pynkheiñ noh Namarba kim shym la ngeit , katba phi tama ha la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng .
translation.en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :

translation.kha: “Phi donkam ban long kiba ïaishah , khnap ba phi haw ïa-ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa Kata kaba u kular .
translation.en: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
All these are the beginning of sorrows .
translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki long kum ki jingpang banyngkong jong ka jingsuh kha .

translation.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down  ; why cumbereth it the ground ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ha u nongsumar kper jong u , ‘ Ha khmih , la lai snem nga la wan shane da kaba wad soh Dumbur ha une u diengsoh Dumbur , bad ngam shym shem ei ei . Khet noh ïa u ! Balei un shu pynsep-ei ïa ka khyndew ?’
Ma pa mala ma nga me long kumjuh ha khmat U Bel , ïa baroh ar ngut na ngi la thaw na ka dewmet .
translation.en: Behold , I am according to thy wish in God s stead : I also am formed out of the clay .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïai plied sawdong ban ïohi mano ba la leh ïa kata .
translation.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing .
Wherefore , said they , if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .
translation.kha: Sngewbha ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jaka kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad to wat ai ïa ngi ban jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ban shong ban sah hangta .

translation.en: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof , to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong la pynïasoh lang naduh trai baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . La shna ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong ha kajuh ka rukom .
Hangne don na ki syiem jong ki nongbah ka Hammoth , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena bad Ibbah ?
translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ?

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por phi la long jngai eh na U Blei mala phi la long ki nongshun Jong u namar jyllang kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ph la leh bad pyrkhing .
translation.en: And you , that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works , yet now hath he reconciled
( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .
translation.kha: kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khmat U Blei , ha uba u Abraham u la ngeit — U Blei uba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .
U buh ïa kaba sah na ki shipai jong u khah ka jingjia hukum uba Sei lai bad u Abishai , uba pynap ïa ki shiphew da kaba phah khmat sha ki Ammon .
translation.en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother , and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon .
And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it .
translation.kha: La ai ha ki ïa ka nongbah Arba ( u Arba u dei u kpa jong u Anak ) , ïa kaba mynta la khot ka Hebron , ha ka ri lum Judah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ka .
Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynjur ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathuh wat ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi mano ban long syiem haei jrong phi ?
translation.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?

translation.kha: Habor nga tbeh ding ha ka Ijipt bad ïa ki nongkyrshan jong ka baroh yn pynïap , te ki tip ba nga erlangthari U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have set a fire in Egypt , and when all her helpers shall be destroyed .
And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands , and brought it down unto us , and brought us word again , and said , It is a good land which the  Lord  our God doth give us .
translation.kha: Ki la wanrah khyndiat ki soh ba ki shem hangta , bad ki la ïathuh ruh ba kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi ka long kaba seisoh bha .
Hynrei tang Namar ka jingïoh pisa bymdei phi shah ïa kiba shah pynrem ban mait malade phi khang ïa kiba lui lui na kaba ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !
And there arose certain , and bare false witness against him , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ïeng bad ki la ïathuh ïa kane ka jinglamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ;

Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïai-ong , U Blei u buh ïa kaei kiei baroh haw ki kjat Jong u . Ka long kaba shaei , da shisha , ba ki ktien kiei kiwei baroh ki kynthup ïa U Blei hi , suba buh ïa kiei keiñ barben hapoh U Khrist .
translation.en: For he hath put all things under his feet . But when he saith all things are put under him , it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him .

translation.kha: hynrei ki shym smam ïa ka met jong U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U Troas u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ ngan leit sad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler . U Trai u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .

translation.kha: Haba u briew bymman u sangeh noh na kaba leh pop mala u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha , u la pynim ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall live thereby .

translation.kha: Sngewbha ai ha moi ïa kane ka tare kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad to wat ai ïa moi ban khem sha Shillong ka Jordan bad ban shnong ban sah hangta .
translation.en: Wherefore , said they , if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .
But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
translation.kha: U Petros bad ki paralok jong u ki la ïohthiah lyngngai , hynrei ki la kyndit thiah bad ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Jisu bad ïa kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la ïeng lem bad u .

translation.en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .
translation.kha: Ngam khot shuh ïa phi ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u leh . Pynban , nga khot ïa phi ki paralok , namar nga la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ïohsngew na U Kpa jong nga .

translation.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed , to make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa kaba dang sah na kata ka umphniang un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew , bad da kumta un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad barben ar ngut , u Philip bad uta u rangbah synshar ki la ïatyllun hiar shat ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbaptis ïa u .
translation.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .

translation.kha: U rangbah shipai uba pynstad u lah ban jop ïa ka nongbah kaba la ïada da ki briew kaba khlaiñ , bad pynkhyllem ïa ki kynram ha ibha ki shaniah .
translation.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty , and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof .

translation.kha: Phin shah beh noh na ki synagog , bad ka por kan poi haba uno du uba pynïap ïa phi un pyrkhing ba da kaba imat kumta u shakri ïa U Blei .
translation.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues : yea , the time cometh , that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service .

translation.kha: Ym shym la don syiem ha Jesreel ha said ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .

translation.kha: Me dei ban shim katto katne na ka snam jongnga u bad ban bah ïa ka ha ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong kiba halor ha ka jingset , bad ha ki dong jong ka bynta ba hapdeng Jong ka duwan , bad ha barabor sawdong jong ki tduh . Ha kan ka rukom men pynsuhthied ïa ka skei malu pynkyntang ïa ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .
And to masons , and hewers of stone , and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the  Lord  , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .
translation.kha: ki nongtrei maw , bad ki nongshniah maw , ki thied ïa ki dieng sawdong bad ïa ki maw kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingshna pynbha , bad siew ïa ki jingpynlut ba dei baroh .
Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewnguh bad leit bad ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kai kabu u Rangbah synshar Assyria u la ong .
translation.en: Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .

translation.kha: Dedan saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ktah jur ïa ka jingmut haba peit ba ki ïaid :
translation.en: There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :
And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep hikai ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , u la ong ha la ki synran .

translation.en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .
translation.kha: Ki wallam ïa ka jingtieng bad jingpyntriem , bad ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki shim ïa ka aiñ ha lade .
Haba nga la sngi kumba ka jingim jong at ka la syntuid noh na por , te , A Trai , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad ha ka thalab bakhuid jong me , me la sngewkwah ïa nga .
translation.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .

translation.kha: Wat thmu sniew ei ei ban pynmong ïa la u paramarjan , babha sah hajuh jong phi , uba shaniah ïa phi .
translation.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour , seeing he dwelleth securely by thee .

translation.kha: bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon noh ; u ieit ïa ki biria kiba khah jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :

translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Kat ki synriah jongu u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki sdang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
translation.kha: bad ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kaba ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen bad ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .
Um shym la krong shapoh namar ym to uba lah ban rung shab ha ki jaiñ khain .
translation.en: And came even before the king s gate : for none might enter into the king s gate clothed with sackcloth .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel ki ïa-pyndap : dat napdeng jong ki kiba kwah ban pynlong syiem ïa u Tibni u khun jong u Haggith , bad kiwei pat ki kwah ïa u Omri .
translation.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king  ; and half followed Omri .

And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon , and from Cuthah , and from Ava , and from Hamath , and from Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel : and they possessed Samaria , and dwelt in the cities thereof .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u wallam ïa ki briew na ki nongbah Babilon , Kuth , Ibbah , Hamath , bad Sepharbaim , bad pynshongduh ïa ki ha ki nongbah ka Samaria , ha ka jaka jong ki Israel ba la shah ringmraw . Ki shimti ha lade ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki sah hangta .
To pynkloi ban wan shuwa ka nangto . U Urbanos sad u Pudens bad u Linos bad ka Klaudia bad kumjuh mad kiwei pat ki parabangeit baroh ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei jongu ki .
translation.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , sam phah ïa me sha ki paid Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lynti ïa nga bad ki dang ïai marpyrshah hi , kumba ki kput tymmen jong ki , ki la longkmie .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .
I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad kohnguh syiem tam ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka ? Balei phi kwah ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U  Trai  ?
To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And you , be ye fruitful , and multiply  ; bring forth abundantly in the earth , and multiply therein .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u die ïa ka ïing ha ka shnong ba la ker kynroh , u ni hok ban thied pat ïa ka hapoh shisnem naduh ka snieh ba u la miet ïa ka .
translation.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city , then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold  ; within a full year may he redeem it .

Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .
translation.kha: Nangta nga shim ïa ka jaiñ ba nga teh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong nga bad kynther ïa ka .  Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïano na phi u bym bat ïa la ka kular ,  nga ong .  U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi don , bad un iehnoh ïa phi khlem don ei ei shuh .  Baroh kiba don hangta ki ong ,  Amen !  bad ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai . Bad ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .

translation.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri yn pynbynta mar katjuh ha ki hynñiew bynta ; ka jait Judah kan sah ha la ka jaka shaphang shathie , bad ka jait Joseph ha la ka jaka shaphang shatei .
Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynna jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin sum kat kumno ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: U Blei um shym jied ïa ngi ban shah ïa ka jingbitar jong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynim lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ,
Ha ki ïing jong ki bynriew ibha sniew don ki jingkynshew kiba ki la lum da kiba leh bymhok . Ki pyndonkam da ki jingthew bashapoh , kaei kaei kaba sa pli .
translation.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
And it came to pass , when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah , and dwelt in Tirzah .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la sangeh noh ïa ka jingtei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah bad u leit sha Tirsah .

translation.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ba ïa u Ïoannis la thep ha ka ïingbyndi , u la leit noh sha Galilaïa .
Nga la ïoh kamai pang ka jingïohipaw na U Tharai Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la Iohi shi shang ki shuh .
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and behold a basket of summer fruit .

translation.kha: Lada phi lai kumta , Kiwei pat kin ïoh ïa ka donburom kaba phi la ïoh shisien , bad phin ïapom samla ha ki Ki ki bynriew ki bym don jingisynei .
translation.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :
The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners : thy wise men , O Tyre , that were in thee , were thy pilots .
translation.kha: Ki maji jong pha ki long na ki nongbah ka Sidon bad Arbad . Ki rangbah batbit jong pha hi ki la long ki maji .

translation.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Gibeon ki la phah ktien sha u Joshua ha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal , ki da ong ,  Kynrad , wat iehnoh ïa ngi ! Wan mar mar ban ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyllait im ïa ngi ! Baroh ki syiem Amor ha ri lum ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi .
Ai ba kiba sarong kin lehrain , namar ki mudui lamwir ïa nga ; hynrei ma nga , ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: Let the proud be ashamed  ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki durkhmat , saw tylli ki thapniang , bad kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .
Haba u Ïoannis u la wan , u la shahjingit bad um shym dih waiñ , bad uwei ti baroh u la ong , ‘ Une uba shongksuid !’
translation.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , uta u briew u la ong , napoh ba nga dang khnai , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai bad ka spah bad ki jingsngewbha jong kane ka jingim ki ïatyllep bad kjap ïa ki , bad ki soh jong ki kim ju ih .

Hynrei lada phi phai pat sha nga bad leh ïa kaei kaban ar hukum ïa phi , ngan wallam pat ïa Phin sha ka iaka sha kaba nga la jingduh ban mane ïa nga , Wat la ïa phi la pynsakma sha kiba kut ka pyrthei .’
translation.en: But if ye turn unto me , and keep my commandments , and do them  ; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven , yet will I gather them from thence , and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there .

translation.kha: Nga ïaroi ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki khop tymmen jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhih ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .
translation.en: I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki rangbah synriah , Uwei pa uwei na phi un pynsep ïa wai pa uwei u briew na ka jait jong phi uba la long u nongmane ïa u Baal ki peiñ .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel , Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor .

translation.kha: Haba ki dep ban pynbna ïa ka khublei jong ki , uta u mradkhlaw uba wan kiew na ka lybong ba khlem trai un ïateh pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they shall have finished their testimony , the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them , and shall overcome them , and kill them .

translation.kha: hynne nga ong ha phi kiba shahshkor ïa nga : Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi , lehbha ïa wer kiba isih ïa phi ,
translation.en: But I say unto you which hear , Love your enemies , do good to them which hate you ,

translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha haba phi ai jingrai ; phim pynïap ïa ka kam ha ka bor briew , hynrei ha ka bor U Tlai , bad u long bad phi hajan phi ai ïa ka jingrai .
translation.en: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do : for ye judge not for man , but for the  Lord  , who is with you in the judgment .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka Mane sawphew snem lyngktar , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .

They shall hold the bow and the lance : they are cruel , and will not shew mercy : their voice shall roar like the sea , and they shall ride upon horses , every one put in array , like a man to the battle , against thee , O daughter of Babylon .
translation.kha: Ki la rah ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bymsngewsynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki dang ïaid halor ki kulai . Ki long kiba la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia .
Hynrei lade ka long kumta , da kumno ki Jingthoh Bakhuid kba ong ba kane ka long kaei kabu dei ban jia , kin jia long shisha ?
translation.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?

translation.kha: Man ka sngi ki Libni ki leit rah ïa kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaid u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha bathoiñ ba ka ba-dap , u sekretari syiem sad u nongmih ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei sharak ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka synduk ha ka jaka jong ka . Bad kumta ki la ïohlum shibun ka pisa .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngkhot ki la ïakynduh ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ïathuh buit ; ki la ai shibun ka pisa ïa ki shipai ,
translation.en: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,

Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations  ; that ye may know that I am the  Lord  that doth sanctify you .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait jong nga namar ka long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi pateng la pateng , ba phin ïoh tip ba nga U  Trai  nga la pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga hi .
Wat ïabeit ïa ki blem thab ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pynim ïa phi namar kim dih kiba shisha .
translation.en: And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .

translation.kha: U Tiras u ong , Lada phim kumjuh ïa ki hukum jong por , phin shah pynum .
translation.en: But if ye will not hearken unto me , and will not do all these commandments  ;

translation.kha: U Jakob u la tip ba la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka khunlung jong u ; hynrei namar ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang don sha ki pyntha bad la ki jingri , um shym leh ei ei tad haduh ba kin da wan phai .
translation.en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan hajan bad u la ong ha ki , La ai ha nga baroh ka bor ha weng bad ha khynwin .
translation.en: And Jesus came and spake unto them , saying ,  All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth .
Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la ong ,  Ai ba kan jia long , te , kumba phi ngeit !  —
utai u briew u long ibha sarong bad uba ïaleh pyrshah ; u bat ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei! .
translation.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un Mih , u la khot ïa ki shiphew nud ki shakri jong u bad u la ai ha ki katai kawei ka sbai ksiar bad u la noh ïa ki , ‘ Khmih aïu phi lah ban kamai da kane katba nga dang saw jingleit .’
translation.en: And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .

translation.kha: hynriew u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la nang kham krenbeiñ shlur : Ka long ka nongkam ba ïa ka ktien jong U Blei Dei ban kren nyngkong ha phin . jynreiñ namsop ba phi kyntait ïa ka bad ba phim ñiew ïa lade Ibbah bat ïa ka jingim bymjukut , ngin iehnoh ïa phi bad leit sha ki Jentil .
translation.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka wanrah ïa ka jingbitar kumba da shisha ka lehkmen na Shaei ka wanrah slap .
translation.en: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .

translation.kha: Habor la pynsleh ïa u lyngdoh , ïa ka shadem badno ka lbong jong uta u langbrot ïa uba la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh dat pun pyningkhong sha nga kum ka jingtieng sngewkwah bakyrpang bad kaba la buh kyrpang na ka bna ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :

translation.kha: Nangta u satang u la pyrta jam sha nga , Ki kulai kiba la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia ki la pynjai jai ïa ka jingbitar jong U Trai .
translation.en: Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u hajuh ki ai sngewbha ïa ki paidbhur , ki lyngdoh , malade ki lehbha ba kin pyndonkam . Bad ki rangbah syier ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Sekharaïah , bad u Eliel — ki ai ïa ki lyngdoh ar hajar hynriewspah tylli ki lumlang bad ki khunblang bad lypa tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .

translation.kha: bad u —Judah Iskariot , uba la shetkylla ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .

translation.kha: khih leit sha ki paramarjan jong phi bad pan kylliang badno tylli ki khra thylli kat kiba phi lah ban ïoh , u Eliesar u la ong ha ka .
translation.en: Then he said , Go , borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours , even empty vessels  ; borrow not a few .

translation.kha: ( 1 Thessaloni 2 :14 ) Lada ph pyndonkam kaei ka jinghikai ka Baalsebub phin ioh shibun ka jingmyntoi .
translation.en: ( 1 Thessalonians 2 :13 ) If you apply what the Bible teaches , you will benefit greatly .
What is your age
translation.kha: afi kirteng ayu
Une u brup , ki la ong , u pyrshang shun pynrkhiang ïa ki briew ban miej ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !
translation.en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .

translation.kha: Usai uba khot ïa phi un leh ïa kata , namar u long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: Faithful is he that calleth you , who also will do it .

Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .
translation.kha: Mynta leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih sngewbha . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka waiñ bad kito ki bym dap bym biang . Mynta ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ha U  Trai  jong ngi , kumta wat sngewsih . Ka jingkmen kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword : and these cities shall go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ki samla shynrang jong ki nongbah ka Heliopolis bad Bubastis kin ïap ha ka thma , bad kiwei ki briew kin shah rah kum ki koidi .
Kumno u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad u ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ; um shym la iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar lep ïa u Aaron ruh kat Ban pynpoh ïa u ; kumin ha kajuh ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong u ruh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him : and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .

translation.kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïashong lang ban ïabam ha kajuh ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin Long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lamler uwei ïa uwei pat . Kin ym ïor ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka byndi Katai kam pat poi .
translation.en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ym kein uno uno napdeng ki Kynhun U Blei uba ïai leh pop , namarba U Khun U Blei u sumar ïa u , bad u Basniew um Lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .
translation.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .
translation.kha: Bad hadien ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u , ki la pynhiar noh ïa u na ka diengphna bad ki la buh ïa u ha ka jingtep .
Te ngi lah ban ïapli ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi malu yn ym donkam ban har sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew .
translation.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
Till he fill thy mouth with laughing , and thy lips with rejoicing .
translation.kha: Un shah ïa phi ban rkhie bad ban kyang jam pat ,

translation.en: He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not  ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ong ha kaba ïohsngew paidbah ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym la leh kaba dei , hynrei U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga .
Uno uno u dkhot na ka erlangthari jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , Bad uno uno ibha ïap ha rudnong un Shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U thri , nga la kren .’
translation.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .

translation.en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïaid hynriew jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh katba u dang ai ka jingkñia ïa U  Trai  da u masi bad u khun masi ba la pynsngaid .

translation.en: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the  Lord  , and he heard me  ; out of the belly of hell cried I , and thou heardest my voice .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad me la jubab ïa nga . Na ka jingjylliew jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap nga la khot kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me la ïohsngew ïa nga .

translation.en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , bad u theh ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .

translation.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow . For what is your life ? It is even a vapour , that appeareth for a little time , and then vanisheth away .
translation.kha: Phim tip wat ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa ka jingim jong phi ha ka lashai ! Phi long kum ka tdem , kaba paw tang shipor bad nangta ka jah noh .
Bad kumta nga ong ha me , ko Petros : me long u mawsiang , bad halor Kane ka nongrim mawsiang ngan tei ïa ka balang jong nga , bad wat ka jingïap hi kan ym lah ban jop ïa ka .
translation.en: And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church  ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Tharai u la dem kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas , Nga setkut ïa me bad ïa ki ar ngut ki paralok lad me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha Shaphan jongu sa , kumba u Job u shakri jong at u la leh .
translation.en: And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .
That which is altogether just shalt thou follow , that thou mayest live , and inherit the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Leh beit bad lehhok borabor , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad ba phin ïaishong hangta .

translation.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .
translation.kha: ba ki samla kynthei kin leit saw sngi man la ka snem ban ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah u nong Gilead .

Bad kumta ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynta nga kylluid ba balei Phi imat kum kata ka kam kaba sniew ïa lade . Hato phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangïapom bad ki kynthei , ki khana malu ki thlun , Haneng ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?
translation.en: Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
And it shall be , when ye have taken the city , that ye shall set the city on fire : according to the commandment of the  Lord  shall ye do . See , I have commanded you .
translation.kha: Ynda phi la kurup ïa ka nongbah , thang ïa ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kine ki long ki hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And the table and all his vessels , and the candlestick and his vessels , and the altar of incense ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar ki tar jong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ,
Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u : Hato mem long U Maaseïah ? To pynim ïa lade bad ïa me !
translation.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .

translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynthup ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , malu u la nguh dem ha khmat Jong u .
translation.en: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .

translation.kha: Nob U Khrist u la ïa-ïap bad u la iathuh sha ka jingim khnang ban erlangthari U Trai jong kba im bad jong kiba ïap .
translation.en: For to this end Christ both died , and rose , and revived , that he might be Lord both of the dead and living .

translation.kha: Shisien la dat hynñiew nguid Sei para ki shynrang ; wahbah nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïapom khlei don khun .
translation.en: There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .

What daily practice is good for anyone wanting to learn God’s will ?
translation.kha: Ban tip ïa ka mon jong U Blei , aïu dei ban leh man la ka sngi ?

Na la iohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka khet : myntor ka ïohnang jong U Blei ka long bad u bynriew ! Un shong bad ki , bad ktien long ki briew jong u . U Blei da laiñ hi un long bad ki , bad un long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying , Behold , the tabernacle of God is with men , and he will dwell with them , and they shall be his people , and God himself shall be with them , and be their God .
And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
translation.kha: U Isaak u phah noh ïa u Jakob sha Mesopotamia , sha u Laban , uba long u khun jong u Bethuel u nong Aram , bad u hynmen jong ka Rebekka , ka kmie jong Jakob bad u Iso .
haba ka la shai , u la khot ïa la ki synran sha u bad u la jied khat-ar ngut na ki , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , ki apostol :
translation.en: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;
And God did so that night : for it was dry upon the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u leh ïa kata . Ha ka step kaba bud u shñiuh langbrot u rkhiang , hynrei ka khyndew ka la jhieh da ka umjer .

La pynlong ka jingleit wad bniah ïa u Ahasaïah , bad la shem ïa u ba u rieh ha Samaria . Ki la leit lam ïa u sha u Jehu bad pynïap ïa u . Hynrei ki la tep ïa ka met jong u naba ki burom ïa u syiad Jehoshaphat u krad jong u , uba la ar kat kaba u lah ban shakri ïa U Trai . Ym don Un uno u dkhot jyllang ka longïing jong u Ahasaïah uba tang sah uba ha ba-bang synshar ïa ka hima .
translation.en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .

translation.kha: Phin ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , malu da ka bor jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy might .

translation.kha: Shijur ki sohshkor ki long ki jingai ba itynnad iaka .
translation.en: A pair of earrings is a nice present for her .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki lum ka Jesreel ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai — ban sngi ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki lumbah , ki lute , ki khap maw bad ki them : Ngan phah ïa ka tiensyiem ban pynjot ïa ki jaka ha bakha ki briew ki mane bleithaw .
translation.en: And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys  ; Behold , I , even I , will bring a sword upon you , and I will destroy your high places .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba ka jinglong bashaniah bad baïaineh kin iehnoh ïa phi . Teh ïa ki sawdong ka ryndang jong phi ; thoh ïa ki ha ka jemnud jongnga phi .
translation.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee : bind them about thy neck  ; write them upon the table of thine heart :

translation.kha: U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lam .’ U Trai u ïa-ong , ‘ Khim lytar badno shukor ïa u . Phin jop .’
translation.en: And he said , I will go out , and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the  Lord  said , Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail : go out , and do even so .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Abimelekh ba ki la ïalang hangta ,
translation.en: And it was told Abimelech , that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .

translation.kha: Ki dohkha ha ka bhah ki la ïap , bad ka la sma iwtung eh kat rahah ba ki nong Ijipt kdor angnud shuh ban dih um na ka . Ka snam ka la don ha kyllaiñ ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the fish that was in the river died  ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river  ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .

For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynrngad ïa ka um jong ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi haduh ba phin da la jam sha shiliang , kumba u la pynrngad ïa ka Duriaw Basaw na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Study the Bible with us .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka Baibl bad ngi .
Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U Trai bad ki la shakri ïa ki blei Baal nabar Astarte .
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .

translation.kha: Buh kyr-ang shata U Trai U Blei jngai phi ïa ki shynriah baroh ba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phira ; woh pyntreikam ïa kita ki masi , bad wat ot khynñiuh ïa kita ki langbrot .
translation.en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ino : U ai sbun mynsiem sha ibha kyrwoh ; ka jinglehsbun lad u ka noh junom .
translation.en: (As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .

translation.kha: Ka hima basarong jongki pha kan jynthut bad kyllon , Bad yn ym don ban ïarap ban khyllie ïa pha . Ngan thang ïa ki nongbah da ka ding , bad kai kiei barabor sawdong yn pynjot .
translation.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall , and none shall raise him up : and I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it shall devour all round about him .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang ïa kata ka khlong baroh’ halor said ka duwan kumne ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai . Ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat .
translation.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a trespass offering .

And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive , and her father s household , and all that she had  ; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day  ; because she hid the messengers , which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la pyllait im ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka baroh , namar ba ka la pynrieh ïa ki ar ngut ki nongsyntiat kiba u la phah sha Jerikho . ( Ki khun ki ksiew jong ka ki shong ki sah ha Israel haduh kane ka sngi . )

translation.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy land , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa phi da kaba pynduna ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , da kaba pynduna ïa ka jingseisoh ki jingthung jong phi , bad da kaba pynduna ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
Ïathuh ïa ki syiem mala ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judas badno ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ba sah ha Jerusalem nabar rung sha kine ki khyrdop , ban shahshkor ïa kadei kaba nga ino .
translation.en: And say unto them , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , ye kings of Judah , and all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :
Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,
translation.kha: U Petros , uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ko nongïalam jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :

U Tharai u ïakren markhmat Bad u Moses , kamra u briew u ïakren bad la u paralok . Nangta u Moses u leit phai sha ka jaka sher dara . Hynrei u samla , u Joshua u khuid jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u , u shongsah ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Khie leit ïathuh ha u Jeroboam ba kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa u : ‘ Ngam la ieid ïa me ngap u Baïap malu nga la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew’ jong nga ki Israel .
translation.en: Go , tell Jeroboam , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people , and made thee prince over my people Israel ,
Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .
translation.kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong u briew ki long kum ka um ha ka pukri kaba jylliew , hynrei uba don ka jingïohi jngai u lah ban tong noh ïa ki shabar .

Ïa kaweh pa katai ka them dei ban pynpyut , ïa uwei ba uwei u lumrit bad u lumbah dei ban pynmadan . Ïa ki lynti kiba kyllaiñ dei ban pynbeit , bad ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba khohruh khohram dei pun pynjlih .
