translation.en: Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low  ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth  ;

translation.kha: Haba nam skhem la jubab , u Benabinadab u la ong , Khie leit phai pud sha u Gedalaïah , u khun jongngi u Ahikam malu u ksiew jong u Shaphan , ïa uba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynhieng ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . Phi haw ban sai sad u bad im hapdeng ki briew , lane phi lah ban rupa shano shano ba phi pyut ba phi dei ban leit . Kumta u la ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha bad katto katto ka jingbam ban rah bad por , bad u la shah ïa nga ba lang! longing noh ha la ka lynti .
translation.en: Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .
translation.kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong jong nga , ban ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: Say ye to the righteous , that it shall be well with him : for they shall eat the fruit of their doings .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok kin kmen , bad kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ïa ki . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ki la trei .

translation.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia  ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u patsha ka Persia , u Bishlam , u Mithredath , u Tabeel bad ki paralok jong ki , ki thoh shithi sha u patsha . Ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad ban pynkylla ktien ha ka por ba pule ïa ka .

translation.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lynti jong nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno lait tang ha Jerusalem .
Ïa ka khubor la phah sha ka Jesebel , Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .
translation.en: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .

translation.kha: Hynrei bud u Briew uba hok u sangeh ban lypa bad sdang pun leh ïa kaba sniew baroh , ïa ki kiei kiba ijli kiba ki briew kiba sniew ki leh , hato un ïai im ? Em , yn ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha’ naba u la leh . Un ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u bad ki pop jong u .
translation.en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth , shall he live ? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned : in his trespass that he hath trespassed , and in his sin that he hath sinned , in them shall he die .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ino ha por .
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
For he longed after you all , and was full of heaviness , because that ye had heard that he had been sick .
translation.kha: U kwah eh ban ïohi ïa phi baroh , bad u la sngew pisa shibun namar ba phi la ïohsngew ba u la pang .

translation.en: I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me ha Bethel , ha kaba me la pynkyntang ïa u maw kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw da kaba me la theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u bad ha kaba me la smai ha nga . Mynta to khreh ban leit phai pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .’

translation.en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite , which was set over the servants of Saul , and said , I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .
translation.kha: U Doeg u dang ïeng hangta bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Dabid mynba u leit sha u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Ahitub ha Nob .

U Amaraïah u Rabbah Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor kaba hakhlieh tam ha baroh ki kam ma , bad u Sebadaïah u khun jong u Ishmael , u lat ka Judah , un don ïa ka bor bahakhlieh duh ha baroh ki kam hima sima . Ki Lebi ktang ñiuhlieh pun dabor halor ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingrang jong ki ïingbishar . Long shijur bad pynbud ïa kine ki jingbthah , bad to U Trai un Long ha ka liang jong kaba imat ïa kaba dei !
translation.en: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .

translation.kha: Phi ki briew phi isih ïa uta naba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bad kren ïa ka jingshim baïar ha ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .

Behold , he is hid now in some pit , or in some other place : and it will come to pass , when some of them be overthrown at the first , that whosoever heareth it will say , There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom .
translation.kha: Wat mynta hi u dang rieh ha kawei na ki krem lane ha kawei pat ka jaka . Hamar ba u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong phi , kat uba ïohsngew ïa kata un ong ba ki rangbah jong phi ki la shahjop .

Uta u briew u jyllop , mano ba thung ïa phi kum u Syiem bad nongsynran Jong ngi ? Hato phi maw ban pynïap ïa nga kumba phi! la pynïap ïa uto u nongot Ijipt ? Kumba u Moses u la sheptieng , bad u pyrkhat , Pdeng , ki briew ki la tip ïa kadei ba de la leh .
translation.en: And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us ? intendest thou to kill me , as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua ki la saw sha ka ïingjah bad U Trai u ïaphawar ha ki hangta ha u raïot lyoh kaba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïaineh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .

Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .
translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane ïa me bad halor ki briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki briew jong me ; ki la pynjot khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ha ka jingjot jingpra .
U Trai u la ong , Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbah ; sa long tang ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .
translation.en: The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kawei pat katai kaei ha ka jingim kaba long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Then I returned , and I saw vanity under the sun .

translation.kha: Ym don uba stad u ban krenbeiñ kitab kren-ïa ma me lano ïada ïa lade da kum kita ki ktien bym don jingmut .
translation.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?

There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .
translation.kha: Man la ka jingtynjuh kaba phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba bat ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha palat ka bor jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi shah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba phi lah ban shah ïa ka , bad kumta un thaw ïa ka lad ba phi lah ban lait na ka .

translation.en: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia  ;
translation.kha: U Lyngskor u la pule ïa ka shithi bad u la kylli ïa u Paul na kano ka probins    u la wan . Haba u la tip ba u dei na Kilikia ,
Da kumta keiñ u Jehoash u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .
translation.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: NGA ïarap ïa ki syiem ban synshar , bad ki nongsynshar ban tiduh ki aiñ kiba bha .
translation.en: By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .

translation.kha: Wat ka kynthei kaba jem tam ka dohnud kaba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , kob siewspah katta katta katba kam donkam ban ïaid shano shano , kan leh kumjuh . Ynda u nongshun u kerkut ïa ka shnong jong ka , kan sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban da Bam buhrieh wat ïa la i khun ba ka dang shu kha bad ïa kito la kha umdih . Kan ym ai ei ei ïa la u tnga uba ka ieit lane ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet , and toward her children which she shall bear : for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness , wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates .
And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada kumta , phin hap pynbiang ïa ngi da ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u la kren napdeng ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum .

mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ka peiñ ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia . Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia ba-bang leh .
translation.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .

translation.kha: Gera pynban , nga long U Blei uba map ïa ki bapop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane namar uei ba nga long . Ngan ym bat ïa ki pop jong phi pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .

translation.kha: Ka Eliel ka her kum ka parad kaba bieit ; nyngkong ki briew jong ka ki wad jingïapan na jingïaphet , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !
translation.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .

translation.kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la Dem un ym pynlip ïa ka shrah ba dang mehding , un wanrah ka jingbishar hok banbeiñ ïa baroh .
translation.en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .

translation.kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka Jingdon jingem jong u barhem .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , That he shall make him ruler over all his goods .

translation.kha: Hynrei sam rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me ; ngan ai ka jingkñia ïa me bad ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka wiang na U Trai !
translation.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving  ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the  Lord .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynrem ïa u briew uba phai noh na nga bad uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u briew u bym im junom .

ïada ki dei da shisha ki nongïathuhlypa sad lada ki don ïa ka khubor jong de , shad ïa ki ban kylli ïa nga , U Trei Badonbor Baroh , ban ym shah ïa ki jingkynshew kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingjah ban shahïap thah sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .

translation.kha: U Trai un Phah ïa ka jingtipbriew na kaba kut ka pyrthei pyrshah ïa phi , ka jingtipbriew kaba ka kti ka thlia jong ka phin ym sngewthuh . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kumba khuid u pukni .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ma phi , ki briew jong nga phim donkam shuh ban lehrain ba phi la ïng ïaleh pyrsa ïa nga . Ngan weng noh! ïa uno uno baroh uba sarong dara uba sngewbang , bad phin ym ïeng ïaleh pyrshah shuh da laiñ lei ïa nga ha u lum bakyntang jong to .
translation.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings , wherein thou hast transgressed against me : for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride , and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain .

translation.kha: Ki jinghikai jong ki kin pynbha ïa ka jingjrong jong phi kum ka jaiñspong kaban ishongkhia ha ka khlieh jong phiah , lane kum u jingdeng uba pyniphuh ïa ka dur jong phi .
translation.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head , and chains about thy neck .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka ktien jyllang u , u long uta uba ïa ka jingieit ïa U Blei la pynjanai da shisha . Dei da Kane ba kumno ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba ngi long ha U Blei :
translation.en: But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi Kin roi kum ki symboh syep , bad ngan jin da la pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot ïa ki da lei lei .
translation.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la pa ha ka jaka shon dara , ki Israel ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad ki la biah thret ïa ki . Ki Israel ki la ïai beh kthong , da kaba pynïap ïa ki Moab
translation.en: And when they came to the camp of Israel , the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites , so that they fled before them : but they went forward smiting the Moabites , even in their country .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleh badno u .
translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
And he sent Eliakim , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .
translation.kha: U phah khot ïa u Eliakim , u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki lyngdoh kiba ha shuwa jong u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khain .

Nga la jied ka Jaka ïa ki brup jong nga ki Israel bad to la pynsaja ïa ki hangta , ha kaba Kin im khlem da shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki rung sha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh ha ki riewrunar , hynñiew kan lai ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban sumar ïa me na ki nongshun jong me baroh bad ban ai ha me ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the  Lord  telleth thee that he will make thee an house .

translation.kha: Me la buh ïa ka pyrthiew ha ki nongrim baskhem , bad yn ym pynkhih shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Jeshaïah u la ai jingsngewbha na ki kynhun jongnga ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tyllep ki blang , ki longïng , bad ki jingkhwan , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .
translation.en: And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .

translation.kha: U Lot u mih shabar , u da khnang tdam ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,

translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham U Trai bad ki ieh ïa la ki mraw malade ïa la ki jingri ha lumlang .
translation.en: And he that regarded not the word of the  Lord  left his servants and his cattle in the field .

translation.kha: Phi lah lehse ban tmain ïa u paralok jong phi kato haduh baneh da pynkhie ïa u dang step phyrngab da ka jingkhublei kaba jam .
translation.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice , rising early in the morning , it shall be counted a curse to him .

translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka jingrem , lada phi leh lyndet ïa kine ki hukum Bad phai noh ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ïa katba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .
translation.en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .
And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .
translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh wat la u pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’ ngan pynshitom ïa u bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
Mynta tharai une u bhabriew kaba ar u don kynhun shynrang . U Iohi ïa baroh ki pop kiba u kpa jong u , u la ju leh hynriew um shym bud ïa ki jingleh jong u .
translation.en: Now , lo , if he beget a son , that seeth all his father s sins which he hath done , and considereth , and doeth not such like ,

translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar Jong ka baroh , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar ki tar lad u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban tdong jingiwbih ,
translation.en: And the table and all his vessels , and the candlestick and his vessels , and the altar of incense ,

translation.kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lynti jongki nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kambah bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno lait tang ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
And when Moses heard that , he was content .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewhun .
Ha ka step kaweh bud ki kuna synshar ka Hima Rom ki la phah ïa ki rangbah pynkdor lem nabar ka hukum , Pyllait noh ïa eit ki briew .
translation.en: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .

translation.kha: Ïa ngi la krenbeiñ bad la ñiewbeiñ da baroh ki nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us .

translation.kha: ha kaba hynñiew tylli ki maw kynthei kiba sngaid pynlang kiba plung ki wan mih na kata ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .
translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .
translation.kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa haduh katno nga long uba donbor ha Ijipt , bad ïathuh ruh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïaleit bran bran , bad wan ïalam ïa i shane .
U Jedaïah , u khun jong u Hormah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba Bud , kaweh ne hajan ka ïohnang jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u ter ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
Then his lord , after that he had called him , said unto him , O thou wicked servant , I forgave thee all that debt , because thou desiredst me :
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah khot shapoh ïa uta u shakri . ‘ Me u shakri bymmyntoi !’ u la ong . ‘ Nga la map ïa ka ram jong me baroh kaba me shah na nga , namar ba me la kyrpad ïa nga kumta .

Nga tipthuh ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan neh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uto uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .
translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .

translation.kha: U la ong , Shim ïa ki jingai sngewma ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah mala u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïinglieng jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .
translation.en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;

translation.kha: U la ïai-ong ïa kan , bad nangta u la kamar-tama noh ha Igdalaïah .
translation.en: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .
Him that is weak in the faith receive ye , but not to doubtful disputations .
translation.kha: To pdiang sngewbha ïa u briew uba tlot ha ka jingngeit , hynrei wat ïania bad u shaphang ki jingpyrkhat bashimet jong u .

translation.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbam bad ka um phi lah ban thied na ki .’

translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam , ha kiba ki la buh ban khmih ïa ka kam . Ki la dawa ,  Balei ba phim shym shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?

Ngi baroh i'u la long kamon ki langbrot ba la sakma , uwei pa uwei na ngi u leit ha la ka jong ka lynti . Hynrei U Trai u la pynlong ba ka jingpynshitom kan haduh halor jong u , ka jingpynshitom kaba baroh ngi dei hok pun ïoh .
translation.en: All we like sheep have gone astray  ; we have turned every one to his own way  ; and the  Lord  hath laid on him the iniquity of us all .
But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last first .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba long nyngkong mynta kin sa long khatduh , bad bun kiba long khatduh mynta kin sa long nyngkong .

translation.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .
translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba ha Atad , kaba sha mihngi na ka Jordan , ki ïapynlong hangta ïa ka jingïambriew kaba jur bad kaba kthang mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndep ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngi .
To sohshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei katba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba kein ha la ki nadong . Wat sheptieng haba ki bynriew ki pynsalia Bad krenbeiñ ïa phi ;
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .

translation.kha: Nangta u la phai shai kata ka bynriew bad u la ong ha u Simon , Me ïohi ïa kane ka briew ? Nga la wan shapoh ka ïing jongno me , dara mem skhem la ai um ïa nga na ka bynda ki kjat jrong nga , hynrei ka la sait ïa ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka bad ka la ñiad pyngkiang ïa ki da u shñiuh jong ka .
translation.en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .

translation.kha: Kato katne na wer ki nongïalam bastad kin shah pynïap , hynrei kaba mih na kane ka long ba yn pynkhuid ïa ki briew . Kane kan ïailong tad haduh ba kaba kut kan wan , ka por kaba U Blei u la buh .
translation.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall , to try them , and to purge , and to make them white , even to the time of the end : because it is yet for a time appointed .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u Dabid , U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phira barhem — ym ba-don uwei ruh uba lait !
translation.en: And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .

translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw nabar ka jingkhlaiñ jongngi nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthiew , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno babha nga jied .
translation.en: I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .

translation.kha: Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kumta ruh U Blei u shithi ïa ki briew katsha ba bha kuna ka rukom ban im .
translation.en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .

translation.kha: Ki la phai ktien , Ka kambah aiwai men lai ba ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka bad ngeit ha me ? Kaei ba men leh ?
translation.en: They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U Trai na ka bynta jong ki , bad u la ai ha kawei pa kawei na ki jait ibha sah jong ki Israel shi bynta jong ka ri .
translation.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the  Lord  : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him  ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .
translation.kha: U Herod u la sheptieng ïa u Ïoannis namar u la tip ba u Ïoannis u long u briew uba bha bad uba khuid , bad kumta u ju da ïa u . U ju sngewbha ban sngap ïa u , wat la u shitom jingmut shikatdei eh man ka por ba u ïohsngew ïa u .
bad u ong , Na ka khyndew ha kaba U Trai u la shuh ka jingtim , une u khunlung un wallam ha ngi ka jingpynkheiñ na barabor ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi ; kamut u la kyrteng ïa u , u Noah .
translation.en: And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the  Lord  hath cursed .

translation.kha: Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri , Ha khmih , ka lyngka u Jehoba ka don manbha malu ka Jong nga , bad ka don u barli uba mih ha ka . Khie loit bad wiang ding ïa ka . Kumta ki la leit bad wan ding ïa ka lyngkha .
translation.en: Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .

translation.kha: U long U Blei uba isynei . Un ym iehnoh lane pynïong ïa phi , bad un ym klet ïa ka Jutang kaba u hi u la pynlong Bad ki khop tymmen jong phira .
translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a merciful God  ; ) he will not forsake thee , neither destroy thee , nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them .

translation.kha: Ki khunlung , ïai kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , naba kata ka longkmie kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Children , obey your parents in all things : for this is well pleasing unto the Lord .

translation.kha: lam bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingker .
translation.en: And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

translation.kha: Haba ka jingtipbriew jong at ka la waiñ phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong ar , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pud ha nga . Ki rangbah synshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jongngi nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pang ha nga ïa ka bor ba kyntang syiem , bad wat ka jingtiengburom ka kham khraw ba ïa kiba mynba .
translation.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .
And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki langbrot jong nga ki hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba phi la kyrdem bad dih ïa ka um kaba phi pynjngut .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel s ,
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  bad nga ong ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing ne ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei lane ka kmie lane u kpa lane ki khun lane ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka gospel , un ïohpdiang kham palat ha kane ka pateng ba mynta .
Ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai uba lai jyllang ka snem kaba khiat ba u Asa u long syiem .
translation.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .

translation.kha: U Blei u longsyiem uba stad bad uba donakor thar katta ; ym don u briew uba ha ban ïng marpyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?
Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .
translation.kha: Ki jait Gad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , Bad ki jait Dan ki ïai don ha ki lieng . Ki jait Asher ki shongduh harud ka duriaw , Ki ïai don harud ka duriaw .
Ki ktien thok ki long kiba lah ban pynngeit , hynrei phi kren khlem don jingmut .
translation.en: How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
And it came to pass in the morning , that he went out , and stood , and said to all the people , Ye be righteous : behold , I conspired against my master , and slew him : but who slew all these ?
translation.kha: Ynda mynstep , u leit sha kata ka khyrdop shnong , bad u ong ha ki briew kiba don hangta ,  Nga dei ma nga uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram bad uba la pynïap ïa u ; phim dei kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta kata . Hynrei mano ba la pynïap ïa kine baroh ?

translation.en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ki jong U Blei , ko ki khun jong nga , bad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , namar U Mynsiem uba don ha phi , u long uba kham donbor ban ïa u mynsiem ha kito kiba long na ka pyrthei .

Kumta ki la shim ïa nga dara ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khulom syier Malkhaïah , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw ïingsyiem . Ym kein um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngam shapoh ha ka .
translation.en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .

translation.kha: Kine ki briew barben ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Noah , ha la ka jait ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkieng jait bapher batip ha ka jinghiarpateng . Henadad ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthiew ki iohpateng na ki khun shynrong jong u Noah .
translation.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .

translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la iohi ïa kaei kaei Baroh kaba u Mosah u dei ban leh , u la kylli , Kaei ksaiñ kane kaba phi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei ph sha leh hi marwei ïa kane baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng shnat naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .
translation.en: And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpisa lyng-a ka la tyllep ïa u ,

translation.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying , Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring thee a red heifer without spot , wherein is no blemish , and upon which never came yoke :
translation.kha: ban ai ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki Israel .  Wallam ha u Moses bad u Aaron kawei ka masi lud rong saw ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ïa kaba ym pat shym la pyntreikam ,

hynrei uno du uba klet bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew , uba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka nabar ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ban kliang noh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrduh na U Blei ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la khot ïa eiei na ki nongïalap samla , bad u ong ha u , Khreh bad leit sha Ramath ha Gaddah . Rah ïa une u khiew umphniang Olib bad me ,
translation.en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets , and said unto him , Gird up thy loins , and take this box of oil in thine hand , and go to Ramoth–gilead :

And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uta u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
Kumta ngi la kynta ïa u Titos , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kim , ban bteng ïa ka bad ban ïarap ïa pa ban pyndih ïa kane ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ka jingieit .
translation.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus , that as he had begun , so he would also finish in you the same grace also .

translation.kha: Slem bah ki Israel ki la im khlem U Blei uba Shishak , khlem ki lyngdoh ban hikai ïa ki , bad khlem ka hukum .
translation.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God , and without a teaching priest , and without law .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka jingpeit . U Trai u wan shiah Ijipt , u da Shong ha u lyoh uba ïaid stet . Ki thliew jong ki Ijipt ki khñiang ha khmat jong u , bad ki briew jyllang ka Ijipt ki umdih nep ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .
translation.en: The burden of Egypt . Behold , the  Lord  rideth upon a swift cloud , and shall come into Egypt : and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence , and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it .

translation.kha: Hynrei tang ka jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit kaba lah ban beh noh Shabar ïa une u jait ; ym kein kano kano kawei pat kaba lah .
translation.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .

translation.kha: Te ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan kiba shong hangta ki ïan tat ïaleh bad ki la jop ïa ki , bad ki beh thret ïa ki haduh Hotham .
translation.en: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them , and discomfited them , even unto Hormah .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïajubab , ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , da la ka mynsiem baroh , bad da la ka jingmut barieh .’
translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind .

translation.kha: U la ju long uba riewspah , hynrei mynta u ïadat ha ka jingïathong ; ka jingjot ka ïeng bad ka ap ha syndah Jong u .
translation.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten , and destruction shall be ready at his side .

And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the  Lord  , and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you . And this shall come to pass , if ye will diligently obey the voice of the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba sah sha jngai bah kin wan bad ïarap ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai . Bad haba la tei pat ïa ka , phin tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga sha phi . Kane baroh kan jia lada phi kohnguh lut ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Ki kam ba ki pyntip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jinglehhok jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki i bajrong ban leh ïa kano kano kaba bha .
translation.en: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngap jar bad um ong shikyntien ruh . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato me long U Messaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?
U Shomer u para jong u , u don na ngut ki khun shynrang : u Hobah , u Ishbah , bad u Aram .
translation.en: And the sons of Shamer  ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .

translation.kha: Na ka ri ki jait jong phi baroh , U Trai un jied tang kawei ka jaka sha kaba phi dadien ban wan mano ïa u .
translation.en: But unto the place which the  Lord  your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there , even unto his habitation shall ye seek , and thither thou shalt come :
And he said unto his men , The  Lord  forbid that I should do this thing unto my master , the  Lord s  anointed , to stretch forth mine hand against him , seeing he is the anointed of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  To U  Trai  un bat ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa u kynrad jong nga , ïa uba U  Trai  u la jied kum u syiem ! Ngam dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u , naba u dei u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai  !

U ong ha u paidbah baroh , Une u maw un lama u nongsakhi ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh ba U Trai u la kren ha ngi . kumto un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa pa’ , ban da ïa phira na kaba ïaleh pyrsa ïa U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
The nakedness of thy father s wife shalt thou not uncover : it is thy father s nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano na ki tnga jong u .

Te u syiad u la ai hukum ïa barieh ki rangbah synshar jong u ban ïawanlang — ki khun syiem shynrang , ki lat , ki laiñ kaba kham hapoh , ki kommisshonor , ki nongbat tyngka , ki nongbishar , ki majistor , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jongno ki jylla . Ki la dei ban wan shaei ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka durbriew kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes , the governors , and the captains , the judges , the treasurers , the counsellors , the sheriffs , and all the rulers of the provinces , to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Nga la ai ha phi ka bor , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaid halor ki bseiñ bad ki  ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .

ki ïa-pihuin , ïabuaid , ki ni jingkhawai jingdih kyiad , bad leh ïa kiwei kiei kiei kiba kamon Kine . Nga maham ïa phi mynta kamar nga la maham mynshuwa ; ba kita kiba ïai leh ïa Kine kiei kiei ngin ym jingidiaw ïa ka hamsaïa U Blei .
translation.en: Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past , that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba la bthei ïa la . Katba nga dang kren , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingkhih shane shatai , bad ki shyieng ki la sdang ba-bang ïadait lang .
translation.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded : and as I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold a shaking , and the bones came together , bone to his bone .
( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing . )
translation.kha: ( Naba baroh ki traishnong jong ka Athens bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hangta ki sngewtynnat ban pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh ha kaba ïathuh bad sngap ïa kaei kaei kaba thymmai tam . )

Wat u Mikhael , u angel rangbah um shym la har ïa kane . Ha ka jingïakajia jong u bad u Rogelim , mynba ki la ïania shaphang uei u ban Ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym ngat ban pynrem ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong , U Tlai un da sneng ïa me !
translation.en: Yet Michael the archangel , when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses , durst not bring against him a railing accusation , but said , The Lord rebuke thee .

translation.kha: Ngi ïohpdiang ïa kane baroh , bad nga kyiuh ; ki rmiang shyntur jong por ki khih da ka jingsheptieng . Ka met jong nga ka jem lwep , bad ki kjat jong nga ki jynthut hapoh jongngi nga . Ngan ap jar jar ïa ka por ka ban wan haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa ngi .
translation.en: When I heard , my belly trembled  ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself , that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .

translation.kha: Bad u Absalom u la isih ïa u Ahiman haduh thar katta namar ka jingbatbor ïa ka Amam , ka para jong u kat haduh ba um mon Shua ban kren ïa u .
translation.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .

translation.kha: Nahum kyrpad ba men shym noh ïa ki na ka pyrthei , hynrei nga da kyrpad ba men ri jingkynduh ïa ki na uta u bymdonkam .
translation.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .
And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Lot u sheptieng ban sah ha Soar , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kynriah sha ki lum , bad ki ïashong ïasah ha kawei ka krem .
Dei ma nga uba pynlong ïa ka , kaba bieit bad ngam shym ai ha ka ïa ka jingstad .
translation.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki lieng , kiba na Tiberias , ki la waiñ poi ha ka ryngkew hajan ka jaka ha kaba ki paidbah ki la bam ïa u kpu hadien ba U Trai u la ainguh .
translation.en: ( Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread , after that the Lord had given thanks : )

translation.kha: Ïa ka phlait ba la ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh ba hap siew pat bad na ka pyntha ki jingkñia pop ym shym thet ha ka synduk ; ka dei ka jong ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the  Lord  : it was the priests .

And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat hi la jia ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi bynta na ka shiphew bynta jong ka nongbah la pynjot , bad hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew ki la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .

translation.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria , ki leit phai sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop :  Ngi la leit sha ka jaka shong dara jong ki Syria bad ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki kulai bad ki kada kiba dang shah teh , bad ki ïingjaiñ ki long kumjuh kumba ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .
U Trai u la ong ïa nga ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , saying ,
And he said , All these have I kept from my youth up .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Naduh ba nga dang samla nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .

translation.en: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah , I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans , lest they deliver me into their hand , and they mock me .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u la jubab ,  Nga sheptieng ïa la ki para ri kiba la phet bad ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia . Ka lah ban long ba ïa nga yn aiti noh sha ki bad kin pynshitom sat ïa nga .
U shim ïa ka sien bad ka ksah barben kaba u lah ban eh , ki thong ka Templ baroh malade ki jingkynnoh baroh jong ka ïingsyiem , bad u rah biang ïa ki sha Samaria . U rah ruh ïa ki koidi bad u .
translation.en: And he took all the gold and silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and hostages , and returned to Samaria .

translation.kha: Nangta U jongu u la jubab , Ïa nga la phah tang sha ki nongaplangbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .

translation.kha: pun ithuh bad ong ha u Hananaïah : U Trai u la nong ba me lah ban pyneh ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkor nar .
translation.en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .

translation.kha: Ïa ka par ka jingpahuh yn kli lut baroh , nalor ka Neiel ka ban bud sa long kaba shongkai katta katta .
translation.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following  ; for it shall be very grievous .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U TRAI’ la pynkhih pynshah ïa ka —Judah da kaei ka u Syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam Shim la dih noh .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .

translation.kha: Ngan ring ïa kito kiba ïai sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad ki bymlah pyndonkam bakla ïa ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa wer ki bym leh ïa kaei kaei naba sniew .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this , and the son of man that layeth hold on it  ; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and keepeth his hand from doing any evil .
I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u dieng sohwaiñ bashisha , bad U Kpa jong nga u long u nongsumar brisoh .
Nga ong ha phi , U Jisu! u la Bynrap , U Ïoannis u kham khriat ïa-ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei Utai uba rit tam ha ka Hima U Blei u long uba kham khynraw shun ïa u Ïoannis .
translation.en: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la jam kham shad khmat na ka kliar lum , u la ïakynduh kynshoit ïa u Siba , u Sikhri jong u Mephibosheth , uba la don malade u shi jrong ki kada kiba kit arspah tylliat ki kper , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh ba dang shi ktieh , bad khwai ka pla sngi ba-dap da ka waiñ .
translation.en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold , Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him , with a couple of asses saddled , and upon them two hundred loaves of bread , and an hundred bunches of raisins , and an hundred of summer fruits , and a bottle of wine .
And this is the record , that God hath given to us eternal life , and this life is in his Son .
translation.kha: Ka jingphla ka long kane : U Blei u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kane ka jingim ka don ka tyllong jong ka ha U Khun jong u .
Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah Jong pha bad keiñ pynpra ïa ki kut jong phad . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki puid pui bad ngan ieh sa Tang ïa u mawsiang .
translation.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .

translation.kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah harum , ma ïaroh ïa Phi , namar ki jingïaseng jngai phiah na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ban ïa kaba pynbha .
translation.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .

translation.kha: Naei pa’ wan ?
translation.en: Where did you come from ?

translation.kha: haduh ba ki pud ka Kainan ki la ïar naduh Sidon , pyut beit shathie shaphang Gerar hajan Gasa , bad shaphang mihngi shaduh Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , malade bymseisoh ïasan Lasha .
translation.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza  ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboiim , even unto Lasha .

And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang sah kham bun sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Korinth , nangta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit da ka lieng lem bad ka Priskila bad u Akwila sha Syria . Ha shuwa ba un leit da ka lieng na Kenkhria u la phah khi ïa la ka khlieh namar ka jingsmai kaba u la pynlong .
Ngan phah ïa u angel ha Shuah jongno phi ban ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleh bad ban ïalum ïa phi sha kata ka jaka kaba ang la pynkhreh .
translation.en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .

translation.kha: Ki kynthei kiba la dud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa ki la otsher bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa ka jinghap bad kumno ba la buh ïa ka met ka jong U Jisu hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .

translation.kha: Lymda une u briew u la wan na U Blei , un ym haw ban bor ïa kaba kum kane .
translation.en: If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .
And they buried him  ; and all Israel mourned for him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad ki tep ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa .

hadien u la jong ïa u , Sngap , wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang kaei . Hynrei otsher ba-beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai ba un khmih ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha baroh ba me la ïohkhiah , sa ai ka jingkñia ka u Moses u la praw .
translation.en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .
translation.kha: Lehse haba ki paid Judah kin ïohsngew shaphang baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga thmu ban wallam halor jong ki , kin phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong ki . Te ngan map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jong ki .
wahbah ka Rebekka ka ïohi ïa u Isak , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,
translation.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .

translation.kha: ngan ai ba yn tur ïabah ïa ki nongpang kiba ïadoh ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Balaam Meon , bad ka Kiriathaim .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,

translation.kha: Nga la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong me ha ka pyrthei ; nga la pyndep ïa ka ki kaba me la ai ha nga ban leh .
translation.en: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka plie jingkthang ha U Blei ; ym don ka jingtap kaba kah ïa ka na ka jingïohi jong u .
translation.en: Hell is naked before him , and destruction hath no covering .

translation.kha: To Ngin ïakhmih shaiñ sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka to naduh kaba ïasdang haduh kaban kut . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynban , namar ka jingkmen kaba la ap ïa u , um shym pynduk ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap khlur ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka liang ka mon jong ka khet U Blang .
translation.en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .

And he said , Let me go , I pray thee  ; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city  ; and my brother , he hath commanded me to be there : and now , if I have found favour in thine eyes , let me get away , I pray thee , and see my brethren . Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .
translation.kha: ‘ Sngewbha , shah ba ngan leit ,’ u ong , ‘ namar ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi ki pynlong ka jingkhawai jingkñia ha shnong , bad u hynmen jong nga u la hukum ba nga dei ban don hangta . Te kumta , lada phi long u paralok jong nga , shah ba ngan leit jngoh ïa la ki kur ki jait .’ Dei namar kata ba um shym la don ha la ka jaka ha ka miej bam jong phi .
Bad kumta u long uba lah , mynta bad batbor , ban pynim ïa kita ibha wan sha U blem da u , namar u im junom ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta lad ki .
translation.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .

translation.kha: bad ki thang jingñiewbeiñ ha barabor ki duwan ki blem thala , da kaba buiñ ïa ki jingsuh jong ki brisoh kiba U Trai u la biah ne na ka ri . Ki pynkhih bitar ïa U Tharai da ki jingleh kynriang jong ki baroh
translation.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places , as did the heathen whom the  Lord  carried away before them  ; and wrought wicked things to provoke the  Lord  to anger :

translation.kha: Bad u brup u dadien ngab ieit ïa U Blang da ka dohnud jrong u baroh badno da ka jingmut jong u baroh nabar da ka ber jong u Baroh ; malade u dei ban ieit ïa la u Paran kumba u ieit ïa lade . Ka long kaba khap donkam ban kohnguh ïa kine ki ar thylli ki hukum ban ïa kaba ai jingainguh da ki mrad sad kiwei ki jingkñia sha U Blei .
translation.en: And to love him with all the heart , and with all the understanding , and with all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbour as himself , is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices .

But the women , and the little ones , and the cattle , and all that is in the city , even all the spoil thereof , shalt thou take unto thyself  ; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi lah ban shim sha lade ïa ki kynthei , ki khun rit , ki jingri jingdup , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha kata ka shnong . Phi lah ban rah ïa kata baroh kaba dei ka jong ki nongshun jong phi . U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .
translation.kha: Katba u Moses u dang rah shajrong ïa la ki kti , ki Israel ki jop , hynrei haba u pynhiar shapoh ïa la ki kti , ki Amalek ki jop .
Ki nabar jong phi ki thaba pnah ka jaiñtapkhmat jong phoi .
translation.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree , and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .

translation.kha: Haei hynriew sien ki hynñiew sner , kata borbah kan longïng sawphew khyndai snem .
translation.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee , seven times seven years  ; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years .

translation.kha: Ong ha ki ban thep ïa u ha ka byndi bad ban ai ha u ïa u kpu bad ka um haduh ba ngan da wiang phai khlem shah pynïap .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I return in peace .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la trei hynñiew snem ba u da pun eh ïa ka Rakhel , bad dat ka por ka i kum khyndiat tukri ki sngi ïa u , namar u la ieit ïa ka .
translation.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel  ; and they seemed unto him but a few days , for the love he had to her .

translation.kha: U Trai nongbishar u jong , Ynda haba ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki pop jong phi baroh , ngan sa shah ba phin shong biang ha ki nongbat jong phi bad shah ba phan tei pat ïa ki jaka ba la tip .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities , and the wastes shall be builded .

translation.kha: Sin ma phi ruh , kiba la kylla long ki briew jong U Blei mynba Phin la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor kaba shisha , ka khubor babha kaba wallam ïa phi ka jingpynim . Phi la thwet ha U Khrist , bad U Blei u la buh ïa ka jingshonshab ka jinglong trai ha phi da kaba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba u la kular .
translation.en: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .
translation.kha: Ma phi to nang ïaleit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit sha kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar ba ka por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta jong nga .
Ki atiar katba ngi pyndonkam ha ka jingïaleh jongnga ngi kim long ki atiar jrong ka pyrthei Hynrei ki adkar kiba donbor jngai U Blei , ïa kiba ngi pyndonkam ban pynpyiar ïa ki kut baskhem .
translation.en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .

translation.kha: u Kynhun jong u Khynnah , u khun jong u Arkhippos , u khun jong u Shem , u khun jong u Noah , u khun jong u Lamekh ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Cainan , which was the son of Arphaxad , which was the son of Sem , which was the son of Noah , which was the son of Lamech ,
And he laid his hands on them , and departed thence .
translation.kha: U la buh la ki kti halor jong ki bad nangta u la leit noh .

Ym ei jingpynkoit ei ei ïa ki jingmynsaw jongno me , bad ïa ki jingmong jong me ym lah ban pynkoit . Baroh kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynjot ïa me ki thap ïa la ki kti ha ka jingkmen . Hato uno uno un lait phet na ka jingnang runar bymkut jong me ?
translation.en: There is no healing of thy bruise  ; thy wound is grievous : all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee : for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually ?

translation.kha: Pha la dih ban ym ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad pun kem ïa eit uba pyrshang ba lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingshipa jong ki .
translation.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .
▪ PRACTICES LOVE : True worshippers are “no part of the world ,” are not divided by race or culture , and display ‘ love among themselves .’
translation.kha: ▪ KA PYNI IA KA JINGIEID : Ki nongmane bashisha kim “long na ka jong ka pyrthei ,” ym shym la phiah ia ki da ka jait ne ka dustur , bad ki pynpaw ba ki ‘ don ka jingioieit paralok hapdeng jong ki .’

Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh Thang sha U TRAI’ , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewsih ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynriew thylli ki khunblang shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym dat kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field : and he shall make a fort against thee , and cast a mount against thee , and lift up the buckler against thee .
translation.kha: Kito kiba shong basah ha ki shnong ha ka ri kin shah pynïap ha ka jingïaleh . Ki nongshun kin tih ïa ki kharai , kin tei ïa ki kynton khyndew , bad pynlong ki kynroh baskhem pyrshah ïa pha .

translation.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses , so do these also resist the truth : men of corrupt minds , reprobate concerning the faith .
translation.kha: Kumba u Jannes bad u Jambres ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Moses , kumta ruh kine ki briew ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha — ki briew kiba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad kiba la shahjop ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad rep ïa kata ka ri , phi ki briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Spain ! Ym don shuh mano mano ban ïada ïa phi .
Ngan knieh ïa ka hima na u khun jongki u Shalman bad ngan ai ha me shiphew joit ,
translation.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son s hand , and will give it unto thee , even ten tribes .

translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la phet noh na Ijipt bad u la sien noh ban shong don sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la anna ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
translation.en: Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai na ka skhep jong ki Epikuri Bad ki Stoik ki la ïatainia ruh bad u . Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la kylli , Aïu une u sarong bieit u pyrshang ban kren ? Kiwei pat ki Jubab , U i kumba u kren shaphang ki blei nongwankai . Ki la noh ïa kane namar ba u Paul u la ïalap shngain U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .
translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: Baroh ki parabangeit hangne ki phah ka jingkhublei . To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit .
u Emerald , u Saphon , bad u Dem ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translation.en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen : because their tongue and their doings are against the  Lord  , to provoke the eyes of his glory .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka Jerusalem ka long ba la tim ! Ka Judah ka dang khyllem ! Kano kano kaba ki kren lane ki leh ka long pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; ki ibeiñ khlem buhrieh ïa U Blei hi .
Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kan ïashong lem sad u Abraham , u Isaak mala u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: U Kynther u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkyrhuh kaba U Blei u la kular ha u Abiram kad ïoh wan ha ki Jentil da U Khrist Jisu , khnang ba lyngba ka jingngeit ngin ïapynbiang ïa U mynsaw ba la pynkulmar da U Blei .
translation.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .
For to me to live is Christ , and to die is gain .
translation.kha: Naba kaei ka jingim ? Ïa nga , ka long U Khrist . Da ka jingïap , te , ngan wallam kham bun .

To kynmaw , ba ngan long ryngkat bad me malade ïada ïa me kat ibha me leit , bad ngan wallam pat ïa me sha kane ka ri . Ngan ym iaineh ïa me tad haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa tala baroh ïa kaba nga la kular ha me .
translation.en: And , behold , I am with thee , and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land  ; for I will not leave thee , until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of .

translation.kha: Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Telem don duwai : Uwei u la long u Pharisi , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .
translation.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaroh ïa uba bieit kam long kaba dei , kum ka ïor ha ka por lyiur lane u slap ha ka aïom ot .

Wat ai ban hap u slap ne ka jur halor ki lum Gilboa ; Ai ba ki lyngkha jong ka kin ïailong shrah ! Naba ki stieh jong kiba shlei ki don hangta ha ka jingjahburom ; ïa ka stieh u Saul ym shym la peitmat phyrnai hajuh da ka umphniang .
translation.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew , neither let there be rain , upon you , nor fields of offerings : for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away , the shield of Saul , as though he had not been anointed with oil .

What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper , or hath a running issue  ; he shall not eat of the holy things , until he be clean . And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead , or a man whose seed goeth from him  ;
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , uba ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh lane ka jingpang mih jor , ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba un da long uba khuid . Lada uta u ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid da kaba pyndei bad ka metïap , lane lada u ïoh ka jingpang mih jor ,

U Boas u jubab , Nga la ïohsngew shaïong kiei kiei Baroh kaba phiah la leh ïa la ka khiew koum naduh ba u tnat jong phi u la ïap . Nga tip kumno phi la ino ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa la ka ri mad , bad kumno phi la wan baneh shong ïa-ban sah hapdeng ki briew kiba phim pat ju ithuh mynno mihnoh .
translation.en: And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not , and he doth not sin , he shall surely live , because he is warned  ; also thou hast delivered thy soul .
translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew uba bha ba un ym leh pop , bad u shahshkor ïa me bad um leh pop , un im da shisha , bad ïa ka jingim jong me ruh yn pyllait .

translation.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures , thine end is come , and the measure of thy covetousness .
translation.kha: Kata ka ri ka don shibun ki wah bad ka spah kyrhai , hynrei ka por jong ka , ka la kut , bad ïa u ksai jingim jong ka , la pyndkut .
ka Ophir , ka Habilah , bad ka Jobab . Kine baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .
translation.en: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .

And he came unto the men of Succoth , and said , Behold Zebah and Zalmunna , with whom ye did upbraid me , saying , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u leit sha ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth bad u ong ,  Kynmaw haba phi la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga ? Phi ong ba phim lah ban ai jingbam ei ei ïa ki shipai jong nga kiba la thait ïan namar ba ngam pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna . Te , kine hangne !

translation.en: Wherefore ? because I love you not ? God knoweth .
translation.kha: Hato nga ong ïa kane namar ba ngam ieit ïa phi ? U Blei u tip ba nga ieit ïa phi !
u dei ban shah pynshitom kumba u thuh ban leh ïa la u para . Da kumta phin rat noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .
translation.en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri bsiat , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , mala kiei Kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynïap ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngen ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .
translation.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .
And give thee the blessing of Abraham , to thee , and to thy seed with thee  ; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger , which God gave unto Abraham .
translation.kha: To un kyrkhu ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me kumba u la kyrkhu ïa u Abraham , bad ai ba men shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me la shong la sah bad ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham !
U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U kyrdan jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Kaei ba ngan leh ? Ngam long uba khlaiñ baneh thiah kharai , bad nga sngewshyrkhei ban khraw .
translation.en: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ha kaba shabar phi i kumba phi bha ïa baroh , hynrei shapoh phi dap da ka jingarsap bad ki pop .
translation.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .

translation.kha: Kin don khie ktieh kiba phylla ki ban jia ha ka sngi , ha u bniat , bad ha ki khlieh . Ha ka pyrthiew , ki ri barhem kin don ha ka jingnoh mynsiem , ki tieng ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-rit malade ïa ka jingkhih phaloh ki jingat phyllung .
translation.en: And there shall be signs in the sun , and in the moon , and in the stars  ; and upon the earth distress of nations , with perplexity  ; the sea and the waves roaring  ;

translation.kha: Ka per ka la ainong ha u , Ïeng joit , ko Petros ; to pynïap bad to ba-ima !
translation.en: And there came a voice to him ,  Rise , Peter  ; kill , and eat .

translation.kha: To wat ai ba ka jingsniew kan jop ïa phi ; pynban , to jop ïa kaba sniew da kaba babha .
translation.en: Be not overcome of evil , but overcome evil with good .

translation.kha: U Salome u kynha ïa ki jingainguh ha U Trai ha ka jingnguh ba u la tei ha khmat ka Templ ,
translation.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  on the altar of the  Lord  , which he had built before the porch ,

translation.kha: Te baroh ki rangbah synshar ki la wanpaw ban kylli ïa nga , bad nga la ïai-ong ïa ki thik ruma u shym u la ong ïa la ban ong ha ki . Ym don ei ei pat kaba ki lah ban leh , namar ym don moi mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren .
translation.en: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him : and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded . So they left off speaking with him  ; for the matter was not perceived .
And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .
translation.kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u don . Nangta ka  nemsniew kaba jur ka la saphriang kylleng jong kata ka ri , bad um don ei ei shuh .

translation.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer , being the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit sha ka Templ ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi , kaba long ka kynta jingduwai .

translation.en: And the woman said , Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God ? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty , in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Balei ba phi la leh kum kane ka jingbakla ha ki briew jong U Blei ? Phim shym la shah ïa la u jong u khun ban wan phai noh na ka jingphet wir , bad kumta phi la pynrem ïa lade da kaei kaba phi dang shu dep ong .
hynrei U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la katai ïa u ha ngi , bad Ngi la pynïap ïa u , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jrong u baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  our God delivered him before us  ; and we smote him , and his sons , and all his people .
The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew la shna da ka rupa bad ka ksiar ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .
hynrei hadien , kata ka jingïapthngan ka phai noh na ka jingsniew jong ka , ngan ym ar ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .
translation.en: If that nation , against whom I have pronounced , turn from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them .

And he brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , Now when this letter is come unto thee , behold , I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee , that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy .
translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u rah ka ong :  Kane ka shithi kan pynithuh ïa u Naaman , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong nga . Nga kwah ïa phi ban pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki dang ïeng hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moses uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u don .

translation.en: And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .
translation.kha: bad ki ïa-ong , ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynpaw ha ngi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka burom jong u haba ngi ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren napdeng ka ding ! Mynta ka sngi ngi la ïohi ba u briew u dang lah hi ban im , wat la U Blei u la kren ha u .
U Jisu bad ki synrang jong u ki la poi sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa , ha ka ri Gasa .
translation.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .

translation.kha: Ki briew bahynñiew ki ngat ha la ki jongnga ki ngop , katba ki briew bakwah ki kmen bad ki lwait .
translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .

translation.kha: Phim Shimham la throsh jingiwbih ïa nga dawai pynhun ïa nga da ka khlaw ki jinglur jong phiah . Pynban phi la bakhia ïa de da ki pop jongno phi ; phi la pynbtai ïa ar da ki jingbakla ba phi la leh .
translation.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money , neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices : but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins , thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities .
And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
translation.kha: Lada me leh kumne ïa nga , to sngewsynei ïa nga bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang ba ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka jingleh badonbor jong me .
Ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei pajut kin ïamih malu ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , namar ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thiat ïa ki mar jong ki ;
translation.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa la ka dohkha kaba beit , ko Job . Phai sha U Blei .
translation.en: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;

translation.kha: Un kren ki kynti ha phi da kaba ma phi bun baroh ka longïing phin ïohlait im .’
translation.en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
Three shepherds also I cut off in one month  ; and my soul lothed them , and their soul also abhorred me .
translation.kha: Ngam lah shah shuh ïa ki lai ngut kiwei pat ki nongaplangbrot , kiba la isih ïa nga , bad nga la beh noh ïa ki baroh hapoh shi bnai .

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na u Lum Sinai ; u mih kum ka sngi ha Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Paran . Shiphew hajar ki angel ki don ryngkat bad u , bad ka ding kaba meh ha ka kti kamon jong u .
Nga long uta uba Thaw ïa ka pyrthuh bad pynlong ïa ki briew ban shong hangta . Da ka bor jong nga , por pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; nga pynïaid ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur .
translation.en: I have made the earth , and created man upon it : I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens , and all their host have I commanded .

translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa u , u la kylli ïa U Jisu , Ko Trai , kumno shaphang une u briew ?
translation.en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?

translation.kha: A katno nga ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me ! Ngin pyrkhat ïa ka baroh shi sngi .
translation.en: O how love I thy law ! it is my meditation all the day .
