And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit ban ïeng bad duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

Man la ka jingthoh kaba phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blei u long uba batbit ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah banbeiñ tynjuh ïa phi sha paila ka bor jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba phi shah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba phi lah ban shah ïa ka , bad kamut un thaw ïa ka lad ba phi haka ban lait na ka .
translation.en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .
And I will bring Israel again to his habitation , and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan , and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ka ri jong ki . Kin bam ïa ka jingbam kaba mih ha u lum Karmel bad ha ki phang ka Bashan , bad kin bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah na ki jingthung kiba mih ha ki jaka jong ki Ephraim bad Gilead .
Ha kata ka miet ki la ai waiñ ïa la u kpa , bad kata ka khun nyngkong ka la ïathiah shongkha bad u . Hynrei u la buaid shaba palat kato ïathuh ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .
translation.en: And they made their father drink wine that night : and the firstborn went in , and lay with her father  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .

translation.kha: Ma phi , ki langbrot jong la , ka kynthup kaba nga bsa , phi hir ki bri jong nga , bun nga long U Blei jong phi , jong U Terah Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And ye my flock , the flock of my pasture , are men , and I am your God , saith the Lord  God .
When Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sanballat , na ka shnong Beth Horon , bad u Tobiah , u rangbah synshar jong ka probins Ammon , ki la ïohsngew ba don mano mano ba la wan ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki Israel , bad ki la bitar haduh katta katta .
Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ki ïawanlang ha ka kyrthat jong nga , nga Don hangta lem mala ki .
translation.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa uta u khun bad ki la pynïap ïa u bad prut ïa ka kun jong u sharak ka bri sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha ita u paidbah , Kohnguh ïa ki hukum bhor ïa kiba ang hikai ïa phi , te phin ïoh im malu phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba U Trai U blem ki kpa thnum jong Phi , u ai ha phi .
translation.en: Now therefore hearken , O Israel , unto the statutes and unto the judgments , which I teach you , for to do them , that ye may live , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  God of your fathers giveth you .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba U TRAI’ Nongsharai u ong : Kwah ka jingjynjar hadien kiwei pat kan wan ha phar .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .

translation.kha: Da ki jingsmai ba basniew u la ino ha ka , Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha kano kano kaba pha pan , wat haduh shiteng ka hima jong sa !
translation.en: And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .
A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;
translation.kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bad u diengsoh Dumbur , u diengsoh Pomkranet bad u diengsoh Olib , bad ka ngap .

Haba Phi map ïano ïano ïa kaei naba u la sa , per ruh na map ïa u kumjuh . Naba hajan nga map — lada , pahara , ka dei ïa nga ban map ïa kano katno — nga leh ïa kata ha khmat U Kiriath namar jong phi , khnang ban ym shah ïa u Soitan ban leh donbor halor jong ngi ; nabar ngi tip kiei ki jingthmu jong u ki long .
translation.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us : for we are not ignorant of his devices .

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka ther mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la pynsynjor khaweh sngem ha Jerusalem’ . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hanamel , ka khuid jyllang u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .

translation.en: And they shall comfort you , when ye see their ways and their doings : and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.en: Baana the son of Ahilud  ; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth–shean , which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel , from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah , even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam :
But ye shall destroy their altars , break their images , and cut down their groves :
translation.kha: Pynban , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki , bad pom pynduh ïa ki shab jong ka Asherah , ka blei jong ki .
U Jisu u la jubab , Lada phi la longïng kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang don ha ka jingpynrem .
translation.en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .

translation.kha: To pdiang ïa u , te , da ka jingkmen , kum u na ha U Trai . To phin ñiew ïa katba kum kita ki brup kum ma u ,
translation.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness ; and hold such in reputation :
And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Abarim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .

Ko phyrngab jongngi nga , lada uwei na pa’ u ïadait sakma na ka jingshisha malu uwei pat u pynphai pat ïa u , to kynthrong ïa ken : Uno isangsot uba pynwai pat ïa u nongpop na ka lynti kaba rumal un pynim ïa ka mynsiem jong uta u nongpop na ka jingïap sad yn ïamap ïa ki pop kiba bun byllien jong u .
translation.en: Let him know , that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death , and shall hide a multitude of sins .

translation.kha: Ka wan da ka bus mynnin .
translation.en: She came by bus yesterday .

translation.kha: Lehbha ïa kiwei kumba phi kajuh ïa ki ban leh ïa phi .
translation.en: And as ye would that men should do to you , do ye also to them likewise .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynïan Shiphew jong u ki la leit khiew na Eglon sha ki lum ka Hebron , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka sad ki la kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , unto Hebron  ; and they fought against it :

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ba pynpoi ha ki por barhem ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingkhraw tam eh ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingieit ïa Kaba u la pyn-i shata ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .

But it came to pass within a while after , in the time of wheat harvest , that Samson visited his wife with a kid  ; and he said , I will go in to my wife into the chamber . But her father would not suffer him to go in .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Samson u leit jngoh ïa la ka tnga ha ka por ot kew , u da rah ïa ka uwei u khunblang . U ong ïa u kpa jong ka ,  Ngan leit rung sha kamra ka tnga jong nga .  Hynrei um shym shah ba un rung shapoh .

translation.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , namar ka long ka bymkhuid .

Nangta u khun sha kawei patar ka balang , da kaba phad shathie na ka liang syngkai jong uta u lum bad u suh shaduh ka Kiriath Baalah ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) , kaba dei jong ka jait Judah . Une u Dei u pud uba shaphrang sepngi .
translation.en: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward , from the hill that lieth before Beth–horon southward  ; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , a city of the children of Judah : this was the west quarter .

translation.kha: Wan ïalam ruh ïa u prie khatduh jong phi sha ar . Da kumta ngan thop ba phim dei ki nongsyntiat , hynrei ki bhabriew kiba khak ; ngan ai pat ha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad phi lah ngab sah hangto bad khaïi ruh .’
translation.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me : then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men : so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .
My doctrine shall drop as the rain , my speech shall distil as the dew , as the small rain upon the tender herb , and as the showers upon the grass :

translation.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house : when I begin , I will also make an end .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba nga la kren pyrshah ïa ka ïing u Eli , naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut .
Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki maji ban sheptieng ïa U Trai ha kaba ki la ai ka jingkñia bad kular ban shakri ïa u .
translation.en: Then the men feared the  Lord  exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the  Lord  , and made vows .
And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again , and said , Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta kata ka sur ïa kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga , ka da ong ,  To leit bad shim ïa ka kot kli kaba la plied kaba don ha ka kti jong u angel uba ïeng halor kata ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew .

translation.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers , and have not hid it :
translation.kha: Kito kiba stad ki la hikai ïa nga ïa ki jingshisha kiba ki la nang na ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim shym buhrieh ei ei .
Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim ki la ïamihnoh shabi na ka lieng ha la ka kynhun kynoi ka jait jong ki .
translation.en: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U Trai , Hangne la ïalam ïa ki hynriew lakh ngut ki briew , bad me , me ainong ban men ai dohnud ïa ki ka pun biang Haduh shi bnai ?
translation.en: And Moses said , The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen  ; and thou hast said , I will give them flesh , that they may eat a whole month .

translation.kha: Haba ki tnga jongu ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem jongno ka Persia bad Media kin ïohsngew shaphang ka jingit jong ka mahadei kin ïa-ong ïa la ki tnga jong ki shaphang “kata shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut . Ki kynthei ha kylleng sawdong kin ym burom shuh ïa la ki tnat , bad ki Shaneng kin ïadep da ka jingbitar ïa la ki tnga .
translation.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .

translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u la long shlur sad u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u sha ka Them mudui . Hangta ki la ïaleh bad ki pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki Shipai Edom ,
translation.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself , and led forth his people , and went to the valley of salt , and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .
For all these things do the nations of the world seek after : and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things .
translation.kha: ( Naba kiba mane blei thala jong kane ka pyrthei ki ïai pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh . ) U Kpa jong phi u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: His legs of iron , his feet part of iron and part of clay .
translation.kha: ïa ki khohwah jong ka da ka nar ; bad ïa ki kjat jong ka shi bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,
translation.kha: ka Kinah , ka Dimonah , ka Adadah ,
U Jisu u la leh ïa kane ka kambah kaba nyngkong ha Kana ha Galilaïa ; hangta , u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u .
translation.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory  ; and his disciples believed on him .
And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kynrad !   Kata ka la biang !  u la jubab .

translation.en: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee : thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Te men khot , bad ngan jubab , bad men shem sngewbha ïa nga , u jingthaw jong me .
Hynrei phi ki Ken pien sa shah pynjot thiah ynda u Assyria u ringmraw ïa phi .
translation.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .

translation.kha: bad ha man ba thang ïa ki jingweng ba la ai sha U Trai ha ka Sabbaton , ha ka jingkhie Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei kiwei ki Jingkhawai Niam . La thaw ïa ki jingpynbeit ryntih da Kaba kdew ïa ka jingdon ki Lebi kiba la pynkhamti ngab leh ïa Kanneh ka kam man ka por .
translation.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the  Lord  in the sabbaths , in the new moons , and on the set feasts , by number , according to the order commanded unto them , continually before the  Lord  :

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
Therefore Sarah laughed within herself , saying , After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure , my lord being old also ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka Sarah ka rkhie sammut marwei , bad ka ong ,  Mynta ba nga la tymmen bad ngam donbor shuh , ngan dang lah mo ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha ? Nalor kata , u tnga jong nga ruh u la tymmen .

translation.en: Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar tem , ki briew jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u Syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
Naba U Blei u la pynïap ïa ka jingaiei jong U na ka bynta ka jingpynim jong ki briew barhem .
translation.en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki kam babha ki paw shai kdar , bun woh ïa kito ki lai da paw shai ym lah ban buhrieh .
translation.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand ; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid .
The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , U  Trai  u shahshkor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew .

Nangta u ai sa kawei ka suda : Khie leit sha ki briew’ bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingijli bad ki long-briew hangne . Ki dei ngab pynïap ïa ki bad Bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang khong snam haduh jong ka . Kumta ha Katai ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangamei .
translation.en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .

When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur kren jong u samla Lebi , kumta ki leit sha u bad ki kylli ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba wallam ïa me shane ?
Hangta la don ki dkhot ba la khot ka Governing Body , ka kynran jong ki kor kiba tbit Bha , ki ban peit ïa ki balang ha satlak ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Located there is the Governing Body , a central group of experienced elders who oversee the worldwide congregation .

Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nonglamktien u wan halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kaba bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi la kular kyntang ha u . U bymman da lei lei ruh un ym hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jong phi . La pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh !
A Trai , men shakor ïa ki jingduwai jong kiba rit kyrdan ; me ai ha ki ka jingshlur .
translation.en: Lord  , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :

Namar u Ephraim u long u kpa ba kynja mynjur jong ngi Baroh ;
translation.en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,

translation.en: He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .

translation.kha: Kaei pha kwah ? u la kylli ïa ka . Kynrad , nga dei ka riewkynthei kaba juk , ka la jubab . U tnga jongno nga u la ïap .
translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , I am indeed a widow woman , and mine husband is dead .
When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba hok u sangeh ban leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad hadien kata u ïap , u ïap namar ka jingsniew kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And Gideon said unto him , Oh my Lord , if the  Lord  be with us , why then is all this befallen us ? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of , saying , Did not the  Lord  bring us up from Egypt ? but now the  Lord  hath forsaken us , and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ong ha u ,  Kynrad , lada long ban kylli , balei kane ka wan jia ha ngi lada U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad ngi ? Jia aïu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba ki kpa jong ngi ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u ju leh — kumno u la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt ? U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi bad u la ieh ïa ngi ha ka jingisynei jong ki Midian .

translation.en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .

Ka tnga jong nga kam haw ban shah ïa ka jingsma ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga , ki hynmen ki para jongnga nga kim wan hajan jongki nga .
translation.en: My breath is strange to my wife , though I entreated for the children s sake of mine own body .

translation.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?

translation.kha: Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei Kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kan ong ïa kaei naba ki mut .
translation.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .

translation.kha: Baroh kin kop ba nga ïada ïa ki Jeriel bad ba ki long ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: Thus shall they know that I the  Lord  their God am with them , and that they , even the house of Israel , are my people , saith the Lord  God .

And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la dep kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas ,  Nga bitar ïa me bad ïa ki ar ngut ki paralok jong me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga , kumba u Job u shakri jong nga u la leh .
Ki la ïashongkurim hapoh ki khi kiba na ka jait u Mnason u khun jong u Jehosabad , bad ka bri ka khyndew jong ki ka ïaisah bad ka jait u kpa jong ki .
translation.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph , and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father .
And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .

Te ki rangbah synsar ki la rupa sha u syiem bad ki ong , Ïa i u bynriew dei ban pynïap . Um khim pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ki paidbah ; u kwah tang ban pynmong ïa ki .

translation.kha: Nga la ieh sa kawei pat ka jingïohipaw . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw tylli ki kali ïapom kiba wan mih napdeng ki ar tyllep ki lumbah rnong .

But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .

translation.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they had made .

Na ka bynda jongngi nga , ka para ka la Nakon ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga don hynne ïa kane ka jingim .
translation.en: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .

translation.en: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .

The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .
translation.kha: Un pynhap ïa u slap ha la ka aïom na ka ïing kynshew jong u ha bneng bad un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh ai kylliang ha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , katba ma phi pat phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano .

translation.en: This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;

U syiem u la hukum ïa u Ashpenas , u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh jong u , ban jied napdeng ki nong Israel kiba la shah ringmraw ïa ki katto katne nguid ki samla shynriah na ka longïing symboh bad na ki longïing ki riewkhraw .
translation.en: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs , that he should bring certain of the children of Israel , and of the king s seed , and of the princes  ;

translation.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .

translation.kha: hynrei namar ba u don ka jingduna ha ka met , um bit ban wan hajan ka jingkah pyrda kambah kyntang ne ba-bang leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dih ban pynbit tngit ïa Kino ki jaka kyntang jong nga ; namarba nga longïing U Trai bad ar pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .

translation.kha: Ka Long thiat kamar per la ïathuh ha phi — U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi ïa kaei ba un sa leh .
translation.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .
Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the  Lord  in Jerusalem : and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong ki pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .
Hynrei kita kiei kiei Baroh kiba nga lah ban ñiew kum ka jingmyntoi ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew myntoi ka jingduh na ka bynta U Kherith .
translation.en: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .

translation.kha: Hib U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kino kiei kiei , u la mihnoh na Galilaïa dara u la leit sha ka thain Ïuodia sha shiliang jong ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan  ;
For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .
translation.kha: U long tang ma u marwei , uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingsngew jong nga , bad uba sngewlem shisha shaphang jong phi .

Mynta , shakri ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa ka jemnud bad ka mynhyndai jong phi barieh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai bad ïa baroh Kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha katba mane ïa u .
translation.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Mynta tun pynlong ïa me uba mutlop bad eh pangnud kum ma ki .
translation.en: Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .

translation.kha: Hato me wan ha ka jingsuk ? u Joram u kylli ïa u . U Jehu u jubab , Kumno kan don ka jingit haba ngi dang don baroh ki jingleh byrtong sad ki jingmane bleithaw kiba ka Jesebel ka kilomitar jong me ka la sdang ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joram saw Jehu , that he said , Is it peace , Jehu ? And he answered , What peace , so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many ?

translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jngai phin , wat ot ïa u kew uba ha tduh jongu ki lyngkien , bad wat leit kylla dien ban khar ïa ki soh naba sai ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwan ; Nga long U thri U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest , neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest : thou shalt leave them unto the poor , and to the stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ki ïong ha u Moses , Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin ïashukor ; isynei ngi bthing ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi , iing ïap .
translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .

translation.kha: Ha snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u khun Jong u Jehoahas u long u syiem ka Judah , u Barukh u thoh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha u .
translation.en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah , when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?
translation.kha: Kumno u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la long uba la pynksan da U Blei ? Ka la long namar ki kam ki jong u , mynba u la aiti ïa u Isaak u khun jong u ha ka duwan .

Nangta to ïathaw ha ki ba ma nga , U Troas nongsynshar , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong ang baroh na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , nur lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jyllang ka ri .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him , and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king s treasuries for the Jews , to destroy them .
translation.kha: U Mordekai u ong ïa u ïa kaei baroh kaba la jia ïa u bad haduh katno ka pisa ba u Haman u la kular ban buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew u syiem lada ïa baroh ki Jiw la pynïap .
Ym dei u angel , hynrei dih U Trai hi babha pyllait im ïa ki . Ha ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei jong u , u la pyllew ïa ki . U la ju sumar ïa ki borabor ha ki por kiba ba-mynshuwa ,
translation.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them : in his love and in his pity he redeemed them  ; and he bare them , and carried them all the days of old .

translation.kha: Ki thied bad ki tnat jong u ki la smat nabar tyllong .
translation.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath , and above shall his branch be cut off .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la nang , u Samuel u ïohi ïa u Eliab u khun jong u Jesse bad u ong ha lade , un uba ïingjaiñ hangne ha khmat U Trai da shisha u dei uba U la jied .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .

translation.kha: U ruh na bneng u la paw ha u mala u la pynshaitbor ïa u .
translation.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .
But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , me la bud ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , ka jinglong jingim jong nga , bad ka jingthmu jong nga ha ka jingim ; me la khmih ïa ka jingngeit jong nga , ka jingïaishah jong nga , ka jingieit jong nga , ka jingïaineh jong nga , ka jingshah pynshitom jong nga , bad ki jingshah shitom jong nga .
Ym don shiah u briew uba hok suba dang don ha ka ri , ym don mynshem mynno baïaineh bad U Blei . Uwei pa uwei u ap ïa ka katba ban pynïap briew . Uwei pa uwei u bamut ïa la u la shnong .
translation.en: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood  ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa de ; ki ïakren bad sla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Ym don jingthaw ba-im ba lah ban ïohi ïa ka , ym don , wat ka sim kaba her .
Wah la U Balei u kren malade ïai kren , ym anna uba pynsngap ïa kaei kiba u ong .
translation.en: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not .

translation.kha: Me leh ïa kaba dei ban pynshitom ïa ngi ; Me long uba ïaineh , wat la ngi la ar pop .
translation.en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us  ; for thou hast done right , but we have done wickedly :

translation.kha: badno ïa ka siasia , ki musla , ïa ka jingiwbih , ka mirr , bad ka jingñiewbeiñ remdor ; ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Ophel , ïa u purew bad u kew , ïa ki jingiw malade ki longïng , ïa ki kulai bad ki kali kulai , ïa ki mraw bad woh ïa ki mynsiem briew ruh .
translation.en: And cinnamon , and odours , and ointments , and frankincense , and wine , and oil , and fine flour , and wheat , and beasts , and sheep , and horses , and chariots , and slaves , and souls of men .
And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u la wan ha ki mynstep , u la ïohi ba ki leh diaw .

Hynrei u skhem Jehoash u phah kylla ïa ka jubab kumne : Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u pham ïa ka khubor sha u diengsoh Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jongno phi ban shongkurim bad u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïadat nangta bad u kyrdem ïa u dieng shiah Shabeh .
translation.en: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot sam ïa ki baroh bad u la ong , Phi tip ba ki nongsuhjaiñ jong ki bymngeit phai ki donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ka iktiar ba-pura .
translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .

translation.kha: Ki nongïam Ijipt ki la sheptieng ïa ki bad ki la kum haba ki la mih .
translation.en: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them .

translation.kha: sad ïada uwei na phi u kwah baneh long suba nyngkong , u dih Ban long u mraw jong phoi —
translation.en: And whosoever will be chief among you , let him be your servant :

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongsynshar jrong ki jlih ki la pan na u Bildad ban shuh ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jongki kita ki briew kiba la shah sahnarphna , nabar ban pynjar noh ïa ki met jong ki na ki diengpynïeng . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sngi Thohdieng , bad ki kwah ba ki met kin sah kumta ha ki diengphna ha ka sngur Shebat , naba ka sngi Tabbath ka long kyrpang kaba khuid .
translation.en: The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .

translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khup ki ksiew jong u Aaron , uba ngat ïa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh lane ka jingpang mih jor , ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad shuh ba un da long ibha khuid . Lada uta u kwah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid da kaba pyndei bad ka metïap , lane lada u ïew ka jingbang mih jor ,
translation.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper , or hath a running issue  ; he shall not eat of the holy things , until he be clean . And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead , or a man whose seed goeth from him  ;

translation.kha: Te , lada ka jingbuh ka thop bajngum , ka mutdur ba ka la wan pur biang , bad u trai u de ba-bang thang noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .

translation.kha: Kut u Amasaïah u la phah noh ïa ki kynoi shipai ba la shim wai bad u ong ïa ki ban leit noh sha ïohnang . Ha kane ki la leit sha ïong , ki da bitar tyngeh ïa ki brai ka Judah .
translation.en: Then Amaziah separated them , to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again : wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah , and they returned home in great anger .

translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno Une u briew uba hiarpateng na u Aaron , u lyndum , uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .
translation.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : he hath a blemish  ; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God .

translation.kha: U Jisu u don ha ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka lyntang , u da ïohthiah , ka khlieh jong u ha ka syngkhlieh . Ki syndon ki la kyrsiew ïa u bad ki la ong , Ko Nonghikai , haei mem sngewlem ïa ngi ba ngin sa ïarep ?
translation.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?

translation.kha: U Arbad u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynther , khnang ba yn ym ne uba leit rah khubor sha Gog bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la kuna . Kane ka long kaba u Dabid u la ju kun katba u dang Hukum ha ri Philistia .
translation.en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Ki pynbah nongïaleh Jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .
translation.en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
And Jesus answering said ,  Were there not ten cleansed ? but where are the nine ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  La don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ïa kiba la pynkhiah ; shano kiwei pat ki khyndai ngut ?
Kumta U Trai u kylla ïa u , Aïu me bang ha la ka kti ? U diengduh , u jubab .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .

translation.kha: Ngin sa leit noh shen bad ngan ym wiang phan shuh — ban leit shwa ka ri kaba puta bad kaba bym dat jingkem ,
translation.en: Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death  ;

translation.kha: Shuh shuh , nga la ïohi ruh ba ha khnai ka pyrthuh ph shen ka jingbymman ha ka jaka kaba ka jinglehhok bad ka hok ki dei ban don .
translation.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there  ; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there .
If he destroy him from his place , then it shall deny him , saying , I have not seen thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei phut noh ïa ki — ym don mano mano batip ba ki ju don hangta .

translation.en: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him , Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me , seeing I am a stranger ?
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka nguh ngon haduh khyndew , bad ka ong ha u Boas ,  Balei phi da pyrkhat ïa nga haduh katta katta ? Balei phi da lehsbun haduh katta katta ïa ka nongwei ?
U Rehoboam u la rupa sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki paidbah baroh na ka Israel bashatei ki la ïapynlong ngab pynlong syiem ïa u .
translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ong shuh , Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba kmen ïingbasa ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . Pynlong ïa ki ban sngewlehrain ïa ki kam pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .

translation.kha: lin ban leh myntor , lane baneh ïakren bad ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap .
translation.en: Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar tang lai bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem . U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
haba ngan plie ïa ki jingtap ha kiba la thop ïa ki briew jong nga bad sei noh ïa ki , ktang sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,
And he said ,  A certain man had two sons :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ban ong ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
Te u kpa u la kynmaw ba ha kata hi ka kynta mynba U Jisu u la ong ïa u , U khwan jong me un im . Kumta ma u bad ka un-long jong u baroh ki la jait .
translation.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him ,  Thy son liveth :  and himself believed , and his whole house .
Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew uba leit rung ha kata ka ïing kaba dang khang un long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
dalade don ki kad larkam jyrngam lane lam saw kiba paw kumba ki la mem ha ka kynroh ,
translation.en: And he shall look on the plague , and , behold , if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes , greenish or reddish , which in sight are lower than the wall  ;

translation.kha: Hangno ki blei kiba pa’ la thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ? ibha phin don ha ka jingjynjar , ai ba ma ki kyang pynim ïa phi — lada ki lai ! Ko Judah pha la don shibun ki blei kam pha don ki nongbah .
translation.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee ? let them arise , if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble : for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods , O Judah .

translation.kha: ( U Tiras u la ong , Ngan ym leh-isynei shuh ïano ïano ha ka pyrthei . Ma at da lade ngan pahuh ïa ki briew baroh hapoh ka bor jong ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kñia ki nongsynshar kin pynjot ïa ka pyrem , dara ngan ym pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jyllang ki . )
translation.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .

translation.kha: Haba phi pang ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki lyngkhuh Loit ki ong ïa phi , sad Bud ïa ki jingsuki ïa kiba nga la ai ha ki .
translation.en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .

And saith unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down : for it is written , He shall give his angels charge concerning thee : and in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , pynnoh ïa lade sha tbian ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :   ‘ U Blei un ai hukum ïa la ki angel shaphang jong me ; kin bat ïa me hajrong da ki kti jong ki , khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me ruh kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’

Shu kylli ïa ki , bun Kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngim la wanpaw ha ka sngi jingkhawai , bad u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phi ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa kiba phi lah ha i'u ki shakri jong Phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phin , u Dabid .
translation.en: Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .

translation.kha: Hynrei lehbha ki sharak ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ka la kyntait ban wan . Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop , ngi la longsyiem kiba sniew , ngi la leh bakla . Ngi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba me la hukum ïa ngi ban leh bad me la phai noh na Kiei kaba me la pyn-i ha ngi ba ka longkmie kaba dei .
translation.en: We have sinned , and have committed iniquity , and have done wickedly , and have rebelled , even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments :

translation.kha: Te U thri u bitar bun ïa ki ,
translation.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel .

translation.kha: Haba ka jingeh ka wan , hato U blei un iohsngew ïa ki jingïam jong ki ?
translation.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him ?

translation.kha: Haba u la ïashem ïa Ngi ha Assos , ngi la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng malu ngi la leit sha mlien .
translation.en: And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .

translation.kha: mynba u Elishama u la la ïakhot ha ka bri naba shong ha Shunem , ha kaba ïa u khun jong ka u la pynim pat , ba U Trai un phah ïa ka nemsniew ka ban neh hynñiew snem ha ka ri bad ba ka dei ban mihnoh bad ka longïing jong ka bad leit hukum shawei pat .
translation.en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman , whose son he had restored to life , saying , Arise , and go thou and thine household , and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn : for the  Lord  hath called for a famine  ; and it shall also come upon the land seven years .

translation.kha: Pynban to shawkad ba phi ïoh beit lem ha ki jingshitom u Khrist , khnang ba phi lah ban longsem kiba dap da ka jingkmen haba ïa ka burom jong u yn pynpaw .
translation.en: But rejoice , inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ s sufferings  ; that , when his glory shall be revealed , ye may be glad also with exceeding joy .

translation.kha: kaba itynnat bad sohkhia kum ka skei . Ai ba ki jingitynnat jong ka kin pynkmen ïa pa ; ai ba kan ker sawdong ïa phi da ka jingieit jong ka .
translation.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .
Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .
translation.kha: La u Abraham u la ïap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih bun kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , kat u shyiap bymlah ñiew shuh harud duriaw .

translation.en: Ye fools , did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also ?
translation.kha: A ki bieit ! Hato ym dei U Blei uba la thaw ïa kaba shabar , uba la thaw ruh ïa kaba shapoh ?
U Joshua myntan u la tymmen bha . U Trai u ïai-ong ha u , Me la tymmen bah , hynrei ïan ngon ka jaka kaba dien ban ïohkynti .
translation.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years  ; and the  Lord  said unto him , Thou art old and stricken in years , and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed .

translation.kha: Ki la ïaleit shad shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .

translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynlong ïa me pun duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khleh noh ïa ka ! Ka kham Bha ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylliat ki lamkhmat bad ban shah thret sha dujok .
translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :

translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki shuh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , bad un sa jem .
translation.en: For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jrong nga , to long phi kiba ïeng skhep nabar kiba ïakheiñ . To long kiba ïai trei minot ïa ka kam U Trai , namar phi tip ba kano kano kaba phi har ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai kada ju long Kaba lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .

translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , de kyrpad ïa me ba men ïathmu ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jong me , khnang ba nga lah ban ïai shakri Bad pynsngewbha ïa me . To da kynmaw mad ba me la jied ïa kane ka jingïambriew ba kan long u paidlang jong me .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee , that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .
translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ha kaba kiba ïap kin mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Ma ki baroh ki la shongkurim ïa ka .

Ngan phah ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shyrkhei ba kin kuna donbor Hamor jong phi ; keiñ kin pynsep ïa ki khun ki kti jongngi phi , kin pynïoh ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phira , malade kmen sahit sa tang khyndiat eh na phiah , ba kumta ki lyndum bah jong phi kin kynjah .
translation.en: I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .

translation.kha: Badno kiei pat kiba U Blei u la kutlad haduh siewdor snem ? Jaban kita ki briew kiba la leh pop , Ibbah la kyllon ïap ha ka ri shyngkub .
translation.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years ? was it not with them that had sinned , whose carcases fell in the wilderness ?

translation.kha: hynrei u sngewbha ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u , ha kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  taketh pleasure in them that fear him , in those that hope in his mercy .

translation.kha: Hynrei Lada ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jong me phi phai dien noh na at , mala phim khlong ïa ki aiñ mala ki lawbah ïa kiba nga la ai ha phoi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translation.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :

translation.kha: Wat la phi lep kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , tyngkan khñiot eh na phiah phin lait im , namar ba phim shym ïanguh ïa U Trai U Blei! jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king s household , and to do what he thought good . And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king , as he was come over Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Ki la jam sha shiliang jong ka wah ban synran ïa ka kynhun ba kynja syiem bad ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u syiem u kwah . Katba u syiem u khreh ban jam sha shiliang , u Shimei u rynsied ïa lade ha khmat jong u ,
Ki skain kiba ïap ki haw ban pynkyiuh ïa baroh ka jingiwbih hapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingtip ka lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingsyiad kaba khraw tam .
translation.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To ka jingaiei U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi baroh . Amen .
Ka ong ba u Abraham u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , uei na ka kynthei mluh bad uwei patan na ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translation.en: For it is written , that Abraham had two sons , the one by a bondmaid , the other by a freewoman .

Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of Jehoiakim king of Judah  ; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga U  Trai  , nga ong ha me , ko syiem Jehoïakim , ba yn ym don u ban hiarpateng na me u ban synshar shuh halor ka hima u Dabid . Ïa ka metïap jong me yn bret shabar ha ka jingshit kyr-ang ka sngi ha ka por mynsngi bad ha u thah mynmiet .

Mynta khie loit , ïalam ïa u paidbah shwa kata ka jakarieh kaba nga la ïatyngkhuh ïa me . Kynmaw ba u satang jong nga un ïalam ïa phi , hynrei ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynshitom ïa kine ki briew namar ka pop jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee : behold , mine Angel shall go before thee : nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U Trai , bad u shah ba ki phylliew kine synshar ïa ki sawphew snem .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .

translation.kha: Ka long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingput ba-ïaitrei jong u ki la ïamareh bakla ïa u ha kaba u don sha lyndet ka jingïarap . Un ym pdiang ha lade ba ka balaitluid ba u bat ha ka kti jong u kam long siat ka Blei .
translation.en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?
For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , nga duwai ha U Blei .

translation.en: A loving father provides for his family materially and spiritually .
translation.kha: U Blei u khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .
Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka pyntha ki hajar ki pateng .
translation.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
And Noah begat three sons , Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khana shaphang u Noah . U Noah u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . U Noah um don ka jingthohbria bad u la long tang ma u , u briew uba bha ha ki sngi jong u .
U la ïai bteng shun nguh , Ki ri ngin ïaleh khwai ïa kawei pat ; ki hylla kin tur ïalap kawei ïa Kawei pat .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom :

translation.kha: Nangta sa duwai , ‘ A Troas , me la ong ba men pynjot ïa kane ka jaka , haduh ba yn ym don jingthaw ba im ha ka , u briew lane u mrad , bad ba kan long khem ka ri shyiap junom .’
translation.en: Then shalt thou say , O  Lord  , thou hast spoken against this place , to cut it off , that none shall remain in it , neither man nor beast , but that it shall be desolate for ever .
By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .
translation.kha: Kum ka  erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
Nalorkata baroh ki rangbah jong u Joshua ki la wan phai suk sha u ha ka jaka sher dara ha Makkedah . Ym don uwei ruh u briew ha kata ka ri uba nud ban kren pyrthuh ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u jingbabe shipai u la tuklar bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na ine .
translation.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ngan salm ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei ti baroh un tare shane shatai kumin u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrthuh ïa la , Bad mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kumto ka um , bad ki metïap jong ki ktang pyut ha khyndew .
translation.en: And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .

translation.kha: Dei ma ngi , ym ma ki , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingotsher kaban shisha , naba ngi Mane ïa U Blei da U Mynsiem jong u bad ngi lehkmen ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu . Ngim buh ïa kano kano ka jingshaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar .
translation.en: For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .

translation.kha: bad ka da phyrnai da ka burom jongu U blang . Ka nongbah ka la phyrnai kum u mawkordor , kum u maw Jair , kob shawei sngur bha .
translation.en: Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;

translation.kha: ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong pa’ , bad kito kba phi iam kin synshar halor jong phi ; phin sngewtieng khah katta katta ba phin phet ïap ibha ym don ba beh ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .
And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded , saying ,
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum :

Ha khmih , u nonglamktien u waiñ halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kambah bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbun ïa ka jingtip ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong pa’ bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kiba Phi la kular kyntang ha u . U bymman da lei lei jin un ym hiarthma shiah ïa ka ri jong phi . La pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh !
translation.en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .
For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong , ‘ U Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad ki briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
Kumta ki la tyrwa ar ngut ki rangbah : U Joseph ïa uba la khot u Baalsebub ( ïa uba la tip ruh kum u Justos ) , bad u Matthias .
translation.en: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai ; U Tharai u la kren ha u nongïarap lem jong u Manasseh , u Hosea u khun jong u Nun .
translation.en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the  Lord  it came to pass , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses  minister , saying ,
Take heed therefore unto yourselves , and to all the flock , over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers , to feed the church of God , which he hath purchased with his own blood .
translation.kha: To sumar bha ïa lade bad ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ïa kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la buh ha ka jingsumar jong phi . To sharai ïa ka balang U Blei , ïa kaba u la pynlong ka jong u hi lyngba ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u khun jong U .

Khmih ! Hangne ka don ka tnga kliar jong u bad ka khun jongno at , kaba sdang sotti . Ngan wan ïalum ïa ki mynta shabar , bad phi lah ban shim ïa ki . Leh ïa ki katba phira sngewthuh . Hynrei dak leh ïa ka kim bymshemphang ha une u briew !
translation.en: Behold , here is my daughter a maiden , and his concubine  ; them I will bring out now , and humble ye them , and do with them what seemeth good unto you : but unto this man do not so vile a thing .

translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , Kumta ki por shynrang jyllang U Jiw ki la ong ïa u , To mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judah , ba ki nongbuaid jong me kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba me leh .
translation.en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .

translation.kha: Ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u ki la ïeng , ishyrkhei kim shitrhem mudui ïa u ïa kano kano na ki kam runar kiba nga la pyrkhat ba kin leh .
translation.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up , they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed :
And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .
translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban dang wan ba kan long ka jutang kaba ïaineh junom . Ngan long U Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
U Trai u la bitar ha kata ka sngur , bad u la kular ,
translation.en: And the  Lord s  anger was kindled the same time , and he sware , saying ,

translation.kha: U Hanniel jyllang U Blei uba la ju ei ha khmat jongno ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadkmen . U rishot lynghoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don phangpdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :

translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka jubab ïa kata ka jingkylli ha ISAIAH 48 :16 , 18 bad 2 TIMOTHI 3 :16 , 17 .
translation.en: The Bible answers that question at ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 and 2 TIMOTHY 3 :16 , 17 .
Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .
translation.kha: Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei phin ym shem ïa ka .
Baroh kaei kiei kiba u Manasseh u la leh , kynthup ïa ki pop ba u la sa , la Buh jingïathuh ha Ka Asia jrong Ki Ngim Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and all that he did , and his sin that he sinned , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym don U Mynsiem , um lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai kiba wan na U Mynsiem U Blei . Kum uta u briew da shisha um sngewthuh ïa ki ; ki long ka jingbieit ha u , namar ïa ka dor jong ki lah ban bishar tang na ka nongrim kaba kynja mynsiem .
Baroh ki la ïa-ïam hir ki la kdup ïa u bad ki la doh khublei ïapkhlam bad u .
translation.en: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,
Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .
translation.kha: Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei bad buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong u .
U nongriam Simri un leh ïa ki kot kaba u sngewbha , khlem kano kane ka jingïapyrshah . Un ïeng ha ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un ïoh ïa ka barhem ha ka hab jong u .
translation.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will , and none shall stand before him : and he shall stand in the glorious land , which by his hand shall be consumed .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shet ïa la ki jaipdeh , badno u Massah u ïai-ong ha ki , La shiah sngi , phi dadien ban erlangthari kiba la pynkhreh bad ha kajuh ka para phim dei ban ïaisah shongneh .
translation.en: And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .

translation.kha: U ngor neh ïa kano kano ka tnat kaba don ha nga ka bymngeit , bad u khyllad ïa kano Kanah ka tnat kaba seisoh , khnang ba kan long khuid bun kan hasem Siddim .
translation.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .

translation.kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha uwei pa uwei naba wan najan , bad pha la kham long kum ka nuti man la ka sngi .
translation.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .

translation.kha: U nongpeit phatok u la kyndit na kaba ïohthiah , bad haba u la ïohi ba ki jingkhang ka byndi ki la Plie , u la pyrkhing ba ki koidi ki la pher ; kumta u la sei ïa la ka khamtam bad u la mudui ban dung ïan ïa lade .
translation.en: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep , and seeing the prison doors open , he drew out his sword , and would have killed himself , supposing that the prisoners had been fled .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong uta u pylleng kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , Bad kin pynïap ïa u hangta .
translation.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka la un-long kumto ha baroh ki arphew snem kiba nga la don bad phi . Khatsaw snoh nga la shakri ban ïoh ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi ar ngat — bad hynriew snem na ka pyntwa ki jingri jong phi . Wai la Iso ruh , phira la pynkylla ïa ka kyang jong nga haduh shiphew sien .
translation.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house  ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .

translation.kha: Ki paralok Badonbor ki pynpoi ïa ka jingkheit jong ki . Ki hynmen ki para ki dei na ka bynta kaei lada kim ïarep Lem ha por jingjynjar ?
translation.en: A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .

translation.kha: Ngan sdang ïa ka ryndang ha ka ri u Magog bad ha barabor shi lynter ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki bariew ki shong khlem jingpynwit bad uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Em , ka dih Naaman ba phi la leh pop haduh katta katta ; ka hir namar ka jingsneng baroh kaba phi leh .
translation.en: Is not thy wickedness great ? and thine iniquities infinite ?

translation.kha: Em , u Joab u jubor , mynta ka sngi men ym thah kano kano ka khubor babha . Ha kamai pat ka sngap me lah banbeiñ leh kumta , hynrei ym mynta , naba u kynhun jong u syiem u la ïap .
translation.en: And Joab said unto him , Thou shalt not bear tidings this day , but thou shalt bear tidings another day : but this day thou shalt bear no tidings , because the king s son is dead .

translation.kha: Phi hir kiba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba die ha ka ïew die doh , khlem da kyrmen jingkylli ei ei nongmareh ka jingïatiplem jong phi .
translation.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat nga maham ba uno uno u briew uba shah ïa lade ban otsher u pynbor ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei .
Me la thwet ïa ngi badno pyndap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jong me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,
translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
Then the king made Daniel a great man , and gave him many great gifts , and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon , and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u la ai ha u Daniel ka kyrdan kaba halor , u la ai sngewbha ïa u da ki jingai kiba kynsai tam , u la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa ka probins    jong ka Babilon , bad u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh jong baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem .

translation.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant : there have they dealt treacherously against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki tang mar ïarung ïa ka ri ha Adam , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh bad ki .
Kumta ki la kem ïa u , bun ki la bret ïa u shabar ka bri shaiñ , bad ki la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And they caught him , and cast him out of the vineyard , and slew him .
And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la don ha ka ïingbishar syiem haduh ba u Syros u patsha jong ka Persia u la jop ïa ka Babilonia .

translation.en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;
translation.kha: U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki bad u la ong ha ka Mari , ka kmie jong u ,  Ïa une u khunlung la jied da U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynim ïa kiba bun ha Israel . Un long ka dak na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun ki briew kin kren pyrshah bad kumta un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong ki .

translation.en: For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .
translation.kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewkhyllah bad kito kiba leh byrtong , kiba awria bad ki nongpynïap briew , kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .

translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohi ïa ki bymman ba ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong me , nga la dap da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki leit wad phlangïap kylleng ka ri Ijipt .
laiphew tylli ki masi ba la bsa pynsaphriang ha sem , arphew tylli ki masi bam phlang ha lum , bad shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki skei , ki khiat , ki keirang , bad ki syiar .
translation.en: Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .

translation.kha: bad paila nga kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , phin ym jubab .
translation.en: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me , nor let me go .

translation.kha: Ko khunlung u briew , u la ong , kane ka long kaei kaba ki briew ha ka nongbah Titos ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pra ! Ka bor khaïi pait jong ka kam anna shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïalam pyrshah jong ngi !’
translation.en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :
And Joshua said unto the people , Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the  Lord  , to serve him . And they said , We are witnesses .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki ,  Phi long ki sakhi ïa lade hi ïa ka jingshisha ba phi la jied ban shakri ïa U  Trai .   Ho-oid ,  ki ong ,  ngi long ki sakhi .

translation.en: Whose soever sins ye remit , they are remitted unto them  ; and whose soever sins ye retain , they are retained .
translation.kha: Lada phi map ïa ki pop jong ki briew , la map ïa ki ; lada phim map ïa ki , ïa ki ym shym la map .

translation.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .

translation.en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .
Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka la long kumta ; ka la kohnguh ïa u Abraham bad ka khot ïa u , u kynrad jong ka . Phi long ki khun kynthei jong ka mynta lada phi leh ïa kaba dei bad phim sheptieng ïa kano kano .
Man ba u lyngkdong khiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim ïa ka dewbyrtha sad pynwandur ïa ka shuh kawei pat .
translation.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki bleithaw kiba itynnat jong ki , kiba da u dieng , da u maw , da ka rupa , bad da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And ye have seen their abominations , and their idols , wood and stone , silver and gold , which were among them : )
And they will salute thee , and give thee two loaves of bread  ; which thou shalt receive of their hands .
translation.kha: Kin khublei ïa me bad tyrwa ïa me ar tylli ki kpu , ïa kiba me dei ban pdiang .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , U  Trai  un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt ban wan kum ki skain na ki shnat kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Nile , bad ïa ki Assyria ban wan kum ki ngap na ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh pop pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , U Blei u lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei mano ba lah ban ïasaid na ka bynta u briew uba leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ?  Hynrei kim shym sngap ïa la u kpa , naba U  Trai  u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .
U Trai u ong ïa ki Israel , La slem bah nga la ïathuh lyngba kaei ka ban sa jia ; nangta kynsan nga pynbang ba kan Jia .
translation.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning  ; and they went forth out of my mouth , and I shewed them  ; I did them suddenly , and they came to pass .

translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïai-ong ? Hato ing ïai im ha ka pop ba ka jingaiei U Blei kan dum khraw ?
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?

translation.kha: Jamynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : Wat pynhiarkput ïa uno uno ibha leh sniew ïa phi . Lada uno eit u thap ïa ph na ka ngab kamet , ai ba un thab ïa ka ngab kadiang jong phi ruh .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .

translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shang sepngi .
translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh . Ang pynthikna ïa pha ba phan ym ïohi ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi ibha phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U thri .’
translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .

translation.kha: Lymne ba uno uno un tbeh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai ha ki lwa snieh ba la pynjyrngam , namar ka waiñ bathymmai kan pyndeng ïa ki snieh , ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki snieh yn pynjot .
translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles  ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .

translation.kha: Ka por Jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la ïajan , malu bun ki briew ki la leit kiew na ki nynkong sha Jerusalem ban pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkhihwin ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Amam .
translation.en: And the Jews  passover was nigh at hand : and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover , to purify themselves .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai kaba phra , ka sngi kaba u hi u la buh , u leit sha Bethel bad u kñia ka jingainguh ha ka duwan ban rakhe ïa ka jingkhawai niam ba u la seng na ka bynta ki paid Israel .
translation.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month , even in the month which he had devised of his own heart  ; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel : and he offered upon the altar , and burnt incense .

translation.kha: Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , Ngi ainguh ïa me , bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba shukor .

Haduh ngi baroh ngin wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jong ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin erlangthari ki biria kiba rangbah bha , kiba kut shaduh ka lynnong ka jinglong pynrangbah pura U Khrist .
translation.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :

translation.kha: U la buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ka sorkar jong u bad pyningkhong ïa u , u nongsynshar halor ka ri baroh kawei ,
translation.en: He made him lord of his house , and ruler of all his substance :
And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ,  Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , bad da la ki kti hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .
Wat ju bam ïa ka napdeng palat ngab ïa kaba phi nongkam ; kaba bam Palat ka lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .
translation.en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .
Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .
translation.kha: La kumno kumno , lada kata ka lah ban long , to ngin ïa-ïaid sha khmat kat kum kijuh ki kyndon kiba ngi la bud haduh mynta .

Kumta Phim den ban bishar ïano ïano shuwa ba ka por kiba dei kan poi . Ka jingbishar bakhatduh ka dei don ap tad ïada U Trai un wan ; un wallam ha ka jingshai ïa ki jingbuhrieh ba-dum dara pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu barieh jong ki jingmut ki briew . Bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka jingïaroh kaba u dei khot ban ïoh .
translation.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord come , who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness , and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts : and then shall every man have praise of God .

translation.kha: U la pyndam ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan ïa pa , bad hynne kata u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ba bam , ka jingbam kaba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju ïoh mynno Mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u briew um im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba maw na U Trai .
translation.en: And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .

translation.kha: Tharai don u briew uba bha shisha , uba hok malu kiba beit .
translation.en: But if a man be just , and do that which is lawful and right ,

translation.kha: U Jeraïah u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew ba u Abda u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit sanphew ka pateng longïing jong ki khun ki ksiew jongnga u Hesron , bad la shem ba ki shipai riewpawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gilead .
