translation.en: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .

translation.kha: Baroh Kiba ïohi ïa phad kin kynran dien . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba don kano Kano ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mano ba khiew shun pyntngen ïa ka ?’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?

translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh shaw ïing , ba nga la tymmen pun shongkurim biang . Wat lama nga pyrkhat ba ding don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban shongkurim ha kano ka mirr bad ieh khun shngain ,
translation.en: Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;

translation.kha: U Petros u la ong biang Em — bad mei kumta u synriah u la kyn-ih .
translation.en: Peter then denied again : and immediately the cock crew .

translation.kha: Nga pan na me , A Blei , ban shah ïa nga ban don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :
translation.en: Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :
The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .
translation.kha: Long kiba sbun , bad phin manbha . Ïarap ïa kiwei , bad yn ïarap ïa phi .

U Dabid u ong ha lade , Ha kawei na kine ka sngi , u Saul un sa pynïap ïa la . Kaba bha tam eh ïa nga ba leh ka longsem ban phet noh sha ka ri ki Pisidia . Te u Saul un sa sangeh ban wad ïa nga ha Israel , bad ngan sa lait na ka kti jong u .
translation.en: And David said in his heart , I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul : there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines  ; and Saul shall despair of me , to seek me any more in any coast of Israel : so shall I escape out of his hand .
And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .
translation.kha: Ngam shym ïohi ïa ka templ ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ jong ka , u long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad U Khunlangbrot .
Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ïa u , ki phan laiphew ngut ki samla shynrang ban sah bad u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they saw him , that they brought thirty companions to be with him .

translation.kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi ai , ha kaba bam ne ha kiba dih , to sa phi ïa ktien kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
translation.en: Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .
And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Kynrad , baroh ngi ïadon khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u briew ha ka ri Kanaan . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u don mynta bad i pa .

translation.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .
U ino ha nga , Ka jingpynjot kad tdam na ka phang bashatei khashor baher ibha shong dew ha kane ka ri ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .

translation.kha: Ka them baroh katai , ha kaba la tep ïa babha ïap bad ha kob la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntam shaneng ka wah Kidron ïathuh ka Kyrpad Kulai shaïong mihngi , kan longïng kiba kyntang ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpyiar Shuh lane shah pynjot .
translation.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u thoh ïa ka sah” U Blei bad u ai ïa ka ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka syntied ka Jutang U Trai , bun ha ki nongïalam jyllang ki Israel .
translation.en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and unto all the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: Namar U Trai u sneng ïa baroh kiba u ieit , bad u sympat ïa uno uno ïa uba u pdiang kum la u khun .
translation.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .

translation.kha: Katba u dang hikai ïa ki , u la Ong , Salm bha na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ngab leit kylleng ha ki jaiñkup jynsur bad ba yn khublei ïa ki da ka jinglehburom ha ka jaka ïew ,
translation.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine ,  Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,
And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
translation.kha: Haba ka la poi ha ïing , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka ,  Ka long kumno , ko khun kynthei jong nga ?  Ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynta jong ka .
U Aaron un sumar bad buh ryntih ïa kita ki sharak ha u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , bad un khmih ba kin maïan man ka por ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the  Lord  continually .

But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :
translation.kha: haba mynta u Timothi u la wanna ph sha ngi , bad u la wanrah sha ngi ïa ka khubor kaba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi . Bad U la ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pyrkhat bha ïa ngi borabor ba phi kwah hir hir ban ïohi ïa ngi kumba ma ngi ruh , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa phi .

translation.en: And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?
translation.kha: Ka Hagar ka kylli ïa lade ,  Hato nga da ïohi shisha ïa U Blei bad ba nga dang im ban ïathuh ïa kata ?  Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba la kren ha ka ,  U Blei uba ïohi .

translation.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel s grave unto this day .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la pynïeng u maw sahkynmaw hangta , bad u dang pynsah dak ïa ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel haduh kane ka sngi .

Da pynthikna ba phin ym leh ïa ki kam mai jong phi ha kaba paw khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa kaei Kaba phi! leh . Lada phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ha naba paw , phin ym ïoh kano kano ka nong na U Kpu jong phi uba ha bneng .
translation.en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men , to be seen of them : otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Ahian ki nongpruid ki wan biang sha u Ahab bad khawai pat ka jingdawa na u Benhadad ; Nga la phah ktien sha me ba men aiti noh ha nga ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiang jong me , bad ïa ki kynthih bad ki khun jong me .
translation.en: And the messengers came again , and said , Thus speaketh Ben–hadad , saying , Although I have sent unto thee , saying , Thou shalt deliver me thy silver , and thy gold , and thy wives , and thy children  ;
And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingim bymjukut ka mut ban ithuh ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba ithuh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa uba me la phah .
Ha ka krai aiu ka para ka jong phi ka pule ?
translation.en: In which class is your sister studying ?

translation.kha: Neng ai jingsuk ïa baroh , ïa kiba hajan bad ïa kiba shai jngai ! Ngan pynheh ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: I create the fruit of the lips  ; Peace , peace to him that is far off , and to him that is near , saith the  Lord   ; and I will heal him .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u , u Abraham u tei ïa ka dil bad u pynbeit ïa kita ki dieng halor jong ka . U la khum ïa la u khun bad pynthiah ïa u halor ka duwan , hajrong kita ki dieng .
translation.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .

translation.kha: hynriew ka la jia namar ba ki nongïohipaw jngai ka ki la leh pop bad ki lyngdoh jong ka ki long kiba la rem Naamah ka jingpynjia ïa ka jingdap jong ki briew balei lui .
translation.en: For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her ,

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh da lade u ong , Ko ki paid Israel , ngan phah ïa ka kynruh shipai nongwei ban knieh ïa ka ri jongnga phi . Kan banbeiñ ïa phi nongdih ka Khim Hamath bashaphang shatei Haduh ka wahduid Arabah bahaïing shathie .
translation.en: But , behold , I will raise up against you a nation , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts  ; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness .

translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew un wang kamon u Syiem bun ki angel baroh lem Bad u , un shong ba-halor ka khet syiem jong u ,
translation.en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory :

translation.kha: Lydda me kohnguh tyllun ïa nga , me im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , nabar me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong na da kaba leh ïa kaei kaban nga hukum , kumba u Dabid u shakri jong ar u la leh , ngan ïai don jingset bad me . Ngan pyntong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba Kiba hiarpateng na me kan synshar hadien jrong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .

translation.kha: Haei loit bad rep ïa kata ka ri , pa’ ki briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Stephanas ! Ym don shuh mano mano ban ïada ïa phi .
translation.en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shang ka Babilonia . Kum ka longrynïeng kaba saraw sha shaïong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot kan wan na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: The burden of the desert of the sea . As whirlwinds in the south pass through  ; so it cometh from the desert , from a terrible land .

translation.kha: U Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , um Don khulom Shaneng ; hynrei tang ki khunlung kynthei . Ki kyrteng jong ki , ki long ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Oholah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah .
translation.en: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .

translation.kha: U Trai hi u la nong ba um shym phah ïa ki bun ba ki balamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong u . Bad kumta un beh noh ïa phin , bad ïa phi yn pynïap , ïa phi bad ki nongïathuhlypa ibha ïathuh ïa pa ïa kine ki jinglamler .
translation.en: For I have not sent them , saith the  Lord  , yet they prophesy a lie in my name  ; that I might drive you out , and that ye might perish , ye , and the prophets that prophesy unto you .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , haba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh da u khep thymmai sha U Trai , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kino daym ban treikam ei ei .
translation.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits , when ye bring a new meat offering unto the  Lord  , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work :

translation.kha: Kumba lai bnai hadien kane , don ba ïathuh ha u Judah , Ka pyrsa kurim jong phi ka la leh kum ka nuti , bad mynta ka la punkhun . Sei shab ïa ka , bad thang im ïa ka , ong u Judah .
translation.en: And it came to pass about three months after , that it was told Judah , saying , Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot  ; and also , behold , she is with child by whoredom . And Judah said , Bring her forth , and let her be burnt .

translation.kha: U la ai jingkheiñ ha u Dabid ïa ka Jingdon baroh lang jongno ki rangbah kiba bit ïa ka kam shipai : khawai lakh ngut ha Israel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judas .
translation.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .

translation.kha: Ma ka , ka long shisha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khwan jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jongki nga ; malu nga la shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .
As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khyndew . Hynrei hapoh jong kajuh ka khyndew , baroh ka long ba la pra bad ba la phret .

Kumno u Asa u kpa jngai u , uba ha shu jongngi u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha iitkhmat U Trai ; hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , badno ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkylla bad thang jingbeh hangta .
translation.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father  ; he turned not aside from it , doing that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  : nevertheless the high places were not taken away  ; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la kliang jam ha U Trai , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . U u dei u Jehud , u briew uba ba-thurmur da kadiang , u khun jong u Gera na ka jait Benjamin . Ki paid Israel ki phuh ïa u Ehud ïa-ban leit ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon u syiem Moab .
translation.en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised them up a deliverer , Ehud the son of Gera , a Benjamite , a man lefthanded : and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab .

translation.kha: Bad u Keiñ u leit ino na ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai bad u la shong la sah ha ka ri ba la ktung Ka Nod kaba don shaphang mihngi na ka Kper Eden .
translation.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the  Lord  , and dwelt in the land of Nod , on the east of Eden .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land , as I have punished the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ma nga U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad ïa ka ri jong u , kumba nga la pynshitom ïa u patsha ka Assyria .

translation.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw U Blei u la kyntiew eh ïa u sha ka jaka kaba hajrong tam eh , bad ai ha u ïa ka kyrteng kaba kham khraw ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka kyrteng .

translation.en: And Hazael said , Why weepeth my lord ? And he answered , Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel : their strong holds wilt thou set on fire , and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword , and wilt dash their children , and rip up their women with child .
translation.kha: Balei kynrad phi ïam ?  u Hasael u kylli . U Elisha u jubab ,  Namar ba nga tip ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba men leh pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel .   Men sa wiang ding ïa ki kut jong ki , men sa pynïap ïa ki rangsamla bakynsai jong ki , men sa lynthaw ïa ki khun rit jong ki ha ban da ïap , bad men sa patar ïa ki kynthei jong ki kiba armet .
Hynñiew ma phi! te , phi dei ban leit phai biang sha ka ri shahïap shaei ka phang jong ka ïarieh Basaw .’
translation.en: But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .

translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Jedaïah ki la jingpdiang shi boitha ka jaka kumba la batai khum : Ka ri ka kynjoh shathie sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jong ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka phuh Jong ka ephod .
translation.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jongu u , u Isaak sad u Ishmael , ki la ter ïa u ha ka krem Meholah , kaba ha ka lyngkha ka don shang mihngi na Merari , kaba dei ka jong u Ephron u khun Jong u Sawar u nongot Hit .
translation.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miat U Trai u la mihpaw ha u nabar u ong , Nga long U Blei jngai u kpa jong me u Abraham . Wat suiñbneng , nga don ryngkat sad me . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew Namarba ka jingkular jong na ïa u shakri jong nga u Abraham .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .

translation.kha: Nangno nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngat ki ebanjelist : Kiwei rupa bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .

translation.kha: Khie leit bad khot ïa u tnga jong pha , U Jisu u la ong ïa ka , dara sa wan biah .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Go , call thy husband , and come hither .

translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong me kane ym long shuh u Abram , hynrei u Abraham , naba nga pynlong ïa me u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .
translation.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .
And Saul called all the people together to war , to go down to Keilah , to besiege David and his men .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u khot ïa ki kynhun nongïapom jong u sha ka thma , ban ïaid pyrshah ïa ka Keilah bad ban kem ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u .
Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab kaba im la bret sha ka pun ka ding .
translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .

translation.kha: Gera ‘Phim dei ïa-ban khot ïano ïan ha kane ka pyrthei ‘ u Kpa ,’ namsop ba phi don tang uwei u Kpa ha Bteng .
translation.en: And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jongki me ha nga , u sharati jong me — ka jingkular kaba me pynlong ha pli katba kohnguh ïa me .
translation.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .

translation.kha: U la don ka jingsuh kaba kham pher bad u Long kaba kata bad uba tbit ha kaba pait ïa ki jingphohsniew , uba ai jubab ïa ki jingkyntip , bad sammut ïa ki jingmaïan ; kamet to pah khot ïa une u bhabriew , u Nathanael , ïa umbiah u syier u la ai kyrteng u Belteshassar , bun un ïathuh ïa phi aïu kan baroh ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit , and knowledge , and understanding , interpreting of dreams , and shewing of hard sentences , and dissolving of doubts , were found in the same Daniel , whom the king named Belteshazzar : now let Daniel be called , and he will shew the interpretation .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la poi ha ka bakwah shong dara , ki Israel ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad ki la beh krad ïa ki . Ki Israel ki la ïadie beh kthong , da kiba pynïap ïa ki Moab
translation.en: And when they came to the camp of Israel , the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites , so that they fled before them : but they went forward smiting the Moabites , even in their country .
And David said unto the young man that told him , Whence art thou ? And he answered , I am the son of a stranger , an Amalekite .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u samla uba la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor ,  Me dei uba na-ei ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u nong Amalek , hynrei nga shong ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: U briew uba pang na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan ha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap .  Lada me mon ,  u la ong ,  me lah ban pynkhuid ïa nga .

La ïathuh ha u Saul , khmied , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Troas da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka . Phi dei ki shetkylla ! u Saul u kyang . Pynïeng imat u maw heh shane shwa nga .
translation.en: Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
For a great door and effectual is opened unto me , and there are many adversaries .
translation.kha: Ka don ka kabu da shisha hangne na ka bynta ka jingtrei kaba khraw bad kaba myntoi , wat lada don bun ki nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah Israel !  ki la pyrta .  To ïarap ! Dei une u briew uba leit kylleng kylleng da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa uwei pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel , ïa ka Hukum u Moses , bad ïa kane ka Templ . Bad mynta u la wan ïalam wat katto katne ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !

translation.en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .
translation.kha: U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ong ,  Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u khun jong nga ha ka jingshongkurim .  Bad u Judah um shym ïathiah shongkha shuh bad ka .
Lydda ngi shahskhor bad ïai leh ha kane ka rukom , baroh kan ngeit ha u , nabar ki nongsynshar ka Hima Rom ken leh ei ei bad kin pynjot ïa ka Templ mala ïa ka jingriewblei jong ngi .
translation.en: If we let him thus alone , all men will believe on him : and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation .

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Troas U Blei jong phi ! Uba la pynpaw katno u sngewbha eh ïa phi bad pynjrong ïa phin u sahmiet ki Israel . Nahum ba U Trai u ieit ïa ki Israel junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban synshar bha bad gospel hok .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .

translation.kha: nangta ïa ngi kiba dang im ha kata ka por yn lumlang lem pynlang ki ha ki ha ki lyoh ban ïashem ïa U Trai ha suiñ . Bad kumta ngin ïailong borabor sad U Trai .
translation.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds , to meet the Lord in the air : and so shall we ever be with the Lord .

Yea , they shall not be planted  ; yea , they shall not be sown : yea , their stock shall not take root in the earth : and he shall also blow upon them , and they shall wither , and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble .
translation.kha: Ki long tang kum ki jingthung ba dang lung , ba dang shu mih bad bym pat suhthied , haba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer , ki tyrkhong noh bad kit noh kum u phlangïap .

Dei U Blei jong u kpa jong me suba ïarap ïa me , U Blei Badonbor Bakhraw umbah kyrkhu ïa me da ki jingkyrkieh u slap najrong , Gera da ki um kiba jylliew Neah khyndaiphew , Ki jingkyrkhu da shibun ki jingri bad ki khun ki kti ,
translation.en: Even by the God of thy father , who shall help thee  ; and by the Almighty , who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lieth under , blessings of the breasts , and of the womb :
And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .
translation.kha: Lada u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha ka shi sngi , bad man ka por u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban map ïa u .
Haba ki briew kiba stad ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew uba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka jingbieit .
translation.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren patiaw ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
translation.kha: U la kham jied ban shahshitom bad ki briew jong U Blei ban ïa kaba lehkmen ha ka pop katto katne por .

translation.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kata ka hukum na ka bynta uta u briew uba ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh hynrei u bym kotbor ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kumba ju long ka rukom ïa kiba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
Kum Uei un sngewthikna ba ka mynsiem briew ka kiaw artet katba ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hiar Sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?
translation.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?

translation.kha: Mynta , ngam khuslai da lei lah shaphang kaba shah bishar da Phi lane da kano kano ka jingthew ba la buh da u briew ; ngam bishar wat ïa lade hi ruh .
translation.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you , or of man s judgment : yea , I judge not mine own self .

translation.kha: Naba phi tip ïa kaei kaba la siew ban pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka rukom im bymïaineh kaba la ïohpateng na ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kam shym long kaei kiei ïa kaba lah ban pynjot , kum ka rupa ne ka ksai ;
translation.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers  ;
Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .
translation.kha: Me la jubab ïa nga bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .
Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baher khie kiei kiba la pyntngit ïa phi .
translation.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .

translation.kha: U Peres bad khiew pat ki Apostol ki la phai ktien , Ngi dei shun kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .

translation.kha: hynriew to tip skhem ïa kane : Eliada phi pynnep ïa nga , ma ph dara ki briew jngai kane ka nongbah phiah hir kiba la rem ha kob pynpoh ïa u briew uba lui hun namar u dei U Trai wahbah la phah ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka jingman .
translation.en: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death , ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof : for of a truth the  Lord  hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .

translation.kha: mala kohnguh ruh ki para ba-ïatrei lem bad sa u Makas , u Aristarkhos , u Demas , bad u Loukas .
translation.en: Mark , Aristarchus , Demas , Luke , my fellowlabourers .

translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , lashai dang step baroh na phira kiba la hynñiew ïa u Saul Bad kiba la wan sha nga ki dem baneh khie dang step bad mih mar Shuh kynjat sharai .
translation.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .

Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban ai jingbam bad ai um ïa phi mynba phi don ha lynti na Ijipt , bad ki la khot wai ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tim ïa phi .

translation.en: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .
translation.kha: Nga la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong me ha ka pyrthei ; nga la pyndep ïa ka kam kaba me la ai ha nga ban leh .
Baroh ki kut jong pha kin long Kum ki diengsoh Dumbur dara ki soh Dumbur ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap pynbit hapoh ka shyntur jong pha !
translation.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried , and the house was filled with smoke .
translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka sur jong ki ka pynlong ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban khynñiuh , bad ka Templ hi ka kylla dap da ka tdem .

kabu ngi lah , ngi la ïathied pat ïa ki para jlih ïa kba la suri sha ki nongkhaïi . Mynta phoi pynlong ïa la ki para ki hynmen jrong Phi ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw jong ki ! Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jarjar malade kim don ei ei ban jong .
translation.en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .

translation.kha: hato nga ong ïa kano namar ba ïam ieit ïa phi ? U Blei! u thop ba nga ieit ïa phi !
translation.en: Wherefore ? because I love you not ? God knoweth .

translation.kha: Kordit ïa u briew uba ong , ngam tei ïa lade ka ïing paki dulan bad ki kamra naba kylluid shajrong ki mala . Kumta u pahuh ki jingkhangïit ha ka ïing lad u , bad u shna biar da ki dieng Kedar , bad u airong ïa ka da ka rong saw .
translation.en: That saith , I will build me a wide house and large chambers , and cutteth him out windows  ; and it is ceiled with cedar , and painted with vermilion .
And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pukri , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .
Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat kaba Phi lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba Phin ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .
translation.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
translation.kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop ka long ban sngewtynnat ban thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob man ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .
Ki ïathiah ha ka ïa Kaei kaba la jia , sad ka ong ïa ki ïa-ban leit phalang pait shiah u Syiem bad ban ai ha u ïa Kane harum ka Khubor na U Trai :
translation.en: And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,

translation.kha: Don naba klim , bad kiwei ki pynbieit ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ne ïa la ki bakha kynthei .
translation.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .

translation.kha: bad baroh kiba mon ban leh kumta , ki nongrah ïa ka jingainguh sha U Trai ïa kaba yn pyndonkam ha kaba shna ïa ka ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U TRAI’ . Ki wallam kat ïa kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingmane , bad na ka pyntha ban thain ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh .
translation.en: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the  Lord s  offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .

Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .
translation.kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to pyndap ïa ki jingmut jong phi da kito kiei kiei kiba bha bad kita kiba dei ïaroh : Kiei kiei kiba shisha , kiba donburom , kiba beit , kiba khuid , kiba itynnat , bad kiba donburom .
Ha ka snem kaba saw , ïa u soh baroh dei ban pynkyntang kum ka jingangnud ïaroh ïa nga , U thri .
translation.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the  Lord  withal .
And Elisha said unto them , This is not the way , neither is this the city : follow me , and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek . But he led them to Samaria .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u sha ki bad u ong ,  Phi la bakla lynti ; kane kam dei kata ka shnong kaba phi wad . Bud ïa nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha uta u briew ïa uba phi wad .  Bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Samaria .
Uno eit uba ïai pyllait shaphang ka jingkmen u dei u beiñ . U briew uba stad u pyrkhat shaïong ka jingïap .
translation.en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning  ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .
And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kin dep duwai ha nga , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
Nimrim shym la sohshkor ïa me , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , mynba me la ong ïa ngi ban im kat kum ki aiñ kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong me .
translation.en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God , to walk in his laws , which he set before us by his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: bad Judah ki la leit ryngkat sha ka thma . U Trai u la ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad ki la jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Besek .
translation.en: And Judah went up  ; and the  Lord  delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand : and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men .
And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la don u shakri uba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew bariewspah ba u sordar jong u , u la pynsep-ei ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,
namar jongki kiei kiei kaba khraw Ibbah U Blei barabor Baroh u la bor na ka bynta jong nga . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid ;
translation.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things  ; and holy is his name .
Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ki la ong ïa u ,  to ai ha ngi ïa une u kpu borabor .
Long ba la tim kata ka sngi ba la khap ïa per ! To klet ino ïa ka sngi ba i Mei’ jongnga de i kha ïa to !
translation.en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born : let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed .

translation.kha: U her stet halor ki khohruh u ïaid halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
translation.en: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Wat klim .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :
For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel , bad na ka bynta kane , nga sngewkmen shibun shaphang jong phi . Nga kwah ïa phi ban long kiba stad shaphang kaei kaba bha , hynrei ban long lui lui ha kaei kaba sniew .
kine baroh ki jingbthah bad ki jinghikai .
translation.en: These things command and teach .

translation.kha: Ki ïaleh ban phai lyndet na nga . Kin sa lynnong namar ka lyngkor Kaba ban ïa ki , hynrei yn ym don ban bneng ïa ka na ki .
translation.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .

translation.kha: Ki bniap shiah bad ki diengduh Jamynrei harud ka riewhadem ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingap syrngiew jongngi ki .
translation.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .

translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Bad kane ka long kaei kaba jing leh , Lada U blem u shiah .
translation.en: And this will we do , if God permit .

translation.kha: Kane ka lama kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kumta u kajuh ba sarang u bym ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kamai ka dkhoh doh la sei Shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei ruh .
translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .
And it came to pass , that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu bad ki lai ngut ki synran ki la hiar na u lum , bad u paidbah babun u la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .
translation.kha: Ka um ka la tap bad ka set mynsiem ïa nga ; ka duriaw ka la tap lup ïa nga , bad ki phlang duriaw ki la sop baroh sawdong ïa ka khlieh jong nga .
Kñia baroh ka la jia ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar .
translation.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar .

translation.kha: Kumta ki langbrot jong nga ki ïadoh sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pyrshang ban ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .

translation.kha: Jaban ai ba U Trei U Blei jongno me un ai ha me ka jingtip dara ka jingstad ba kumta me lah ban synshar ïa ka Israel kat kum ki Hukum jrong u .
translation.en: Only the  Lord  give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Ki dei ïa-ban sngewnguh ïa U Tlai na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bniat kiei kiei Kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !

translation.kha: Hynrei ka tnga u Lot ka la phai dat bad ka la kylla long u pjiah mluh .
translation.en: But his wife looked back from behind him , and she became a pillar of salt .
But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïano ban sheptieng : To sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba , hadien ka jingpynïap , u don ka bor ban bret sha ka dujok . To ngeit ïa nga , u long ma u uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng !
Kenan ka long kumno ka jingbishar ka trei : Ka jingshai ka la wan sha ka pyrthiew , hynrei ki brup ki ieit ïa ka jingdum shun ïa ka jingshai , namar ba ki kam jong ki , ki long kiba Sniew .
translation.en: And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .
Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh nga dang dap hi da ka jingshlur ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kata ynda phin leit sha ka kamra ba shadien ban rieh ,  u Mikaïah u jubab .
Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namsop ba phi longïng ha ka liang jong nga , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka bainong .
translation.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem ban pynum jingisynei ïa ka nongbet . Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka Templ jong nga , bad ïa ka nongpang yn tei pat .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nga bam lang man ka jingïamai .
translation.en: We eat together every evening .
And God spake unto Moses , and said unto him , I am the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Te U Blei u la kren ha u Moses bad u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .
Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Mahanaim bad kynhun ïa ka Bashan baroh — baroh ka hima u Og , u syiem Bashan , bad ruh baher hynriewphew tyllep ki shnong jong u Jairos ha Bashan .
translation.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :

translation.kha: Ko Khun u bynriew , u la ong , tang shi syntied ngan shim noh ïa u briew uba phad i-ieit eh . Pham dei ban wad dat lane ïam ne sylla ki ummat .
translation.en: Son of man , behold , I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke : yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep , neither shall thy tears run down .
Then the prophets , Haggai the prophet , and Zechariah the son of Iddo , prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel , even unto them .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Iddo , ki sdang ban kren ha ka kyrteng U Blei ki Israel ha ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem .
U Dabid u sah ha ka jakarieh ha ri lum kaba ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph . U Saul u ïai pyrshang ban shem ïa u , hynrei U Blei um shym la aiti ïa u Dabid ha u .
translation.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds , and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph . And Saul sought him every day , but God delivered him not into his hand .

translation.kha: Adonijah lai sngi , ha ka lyngkhuh sner kha jong u , u syiem u pynurlong ka jingkhawai ïa ki pynrangbah synrai jngai u baher ; u la pyllait khong ïa u nongrah khuri bad ïa u nongshet kpu ïabah jong u , dara u la ïam ïa ki ha khmat ki nongbah synshar jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass the third day , which was Pharaoh s birthday , that he made a feast unto all his servants : and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants .

translation.kha: Ki la phai stet sawdong hynrei kim syiem la ïohi ïabun ïano pat ; tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
translation.en: And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Tharai , U Blei ki Israel , nga ong ba ki ïing ha Jerusalem badno ka ïingsyiem Judah kin sa shah pynkhyllem na ka daw jongki ka jingshad kurat bad ka jingtur ïalap .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning the houses of this city , and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah , which are thrown down by the mounts , and by the sword  ;
As the Father knoweth me , even so know I the Father : and I lay down my life for the sheep .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha . Kumba U Kpa u ithuh ïa nga bad nga , nga ithuh ïa U Kpa , ha kajuh ka rukom nga ithuh ïa la ki langbrot bad ki ithuh ïa nga . Bad nga kloi ban ïap na ka bynta jong ki .

Ka long ka mon jong U Trai U Blei Ban pynjia ïa kaei ba u la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Akhaïa u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Kane ka long balei ba u syiem um shym la shahshkor ïa ki briew .
translation.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people : for the cause was of God , that the  Lord  might perform his word , which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

translation.kha: bad shisyndon ki la iaineh ïa ka lieng badno ïa la u kpa bad ki la ïaleit bad u .
translation.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .
And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la phai biang sha U  Trai  bad u la ong ,  A  Trai  , balei me lehbeiñ sat ïa la ki briew ? Balei me phah ïa nga shane ?
une uno uba ïai pyrkhat shaphang ka jingman u Dei u beiñ . U briew uba stad u pyrkhat shaphang ka jingïap .
translation.en: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning  ; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth .

So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .
translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Ahikam , u Akhbor , u Shaphan , bad u Asaïah , ki leit ban kylli na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa , kaba shong ba sah ha ka jaka ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u ksiew jong u Harhas , uba dei khmih ïa ki barandi ka Templ . ) Ki batai ha ka , ïa kaei kaba la jia ,

translation.en: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained  ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
translation.kha: Naba u la buh ka sngi ha kaba un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jinglehhok , da uta u briew ïa uba u la jied . U la ai ka jingpynshisha ïa kane ha uwei pa uwei da kaba pynmihpat ïa uta u briew na ka jingïap !

ngat u Syiem Dabid u dem ngon ha ka jingmane ha la ka jingthiah bad u duwai , ‘ To ing ïaroh ïa U thri , U Blei! ki Israel , uba ha kane ka sngi u la pynlong syiem hadien jongki nga ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad ba u la shah ïa nga ban ïohi ïa Kata !’
translation.en: And also thus said the king , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which hath given one to sit on my throne this day , mine eyes even seeing it .

translation.kha: Hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam Jeruel ki don klang , kyntiew ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Shaphan . Uwei pa uwei u bat ïa u kiaw thang jingiwbih , badno ka tdem ka dang kiew na ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand  ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .

translation.kha: U Rehoboam u leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba baroh ki briew na shaneng shatei ka Jeraïah ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .
translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .
And he said , This will I do : I will pull down my barns , and build greater  ; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ,’ u la ong ha lade ; ‘ ngan pynpra ïa ki thiar jong nga bad shna ïa kiba kham heh , ha kaba ngan kynshew ïa u kew jong nga bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki mar jong nga .
U Bela u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , kine ki Rangbah ki jingaiti ki jingthmu basniew bad ki ai ïa ka jingai jingmut bym long Hapoh kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la saphriang ha kylliang ka pyrthei , bad hab ki la ïoh ki khun kynthei ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when men began to multiply on the face of the earth , and daughters were born unto them ,
Therefore came I forth to meet thee , diligently to seek thy face , and I have found thee .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta nga la wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi . Nga la kwah eh ban wan wad ïa phi , bad nga la lap ïa phi !

translation.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman , neither the woman without the man , in the Lord .
translation.kha: Pynban ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , u briew u long uba donkam ïa ka briew kumba ka briew ka long kaba donkam ïa u briew .

ym don mano mano ïa-ban thiah ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , bad ki pait jong ki ; ki mar linen , ka jaiñ sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , Bad ka jaiñ basaw hain hain ; ïa baroh ki jait dieng bakynsai sad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba la shniah na ka bniat hati bad na ka dieng baremdor , na ka rong , ka nar , bad u maw mar ;
translation.en: The merchandise of gold , and silver , and precious stones , and of pearls , and fine linen , and purple , and silk , and scarlet , and all thyine wood , and all manner vessels of ivory , and all manner vessels of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ,

translation.kha: Phah ïatan ïano sha jrop ban shem ïa u briew umbah ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simeon Petros . U shongsuk basma ha ka ïong jong u Simon , u nongpdem sniehdoh , uba shong basah harud duriaw .’
translation.en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .

translation.kha: Katba u Jemuel u dang im , um shym ïohi shuh ïa u syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U Trai u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u skhem ki Israel .
translation.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .

translation.kha: Bun na kita Ibbah la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto katne ngin ïoh ka jingim bymkhuid , bad katto katne kine shah ka jingïaburom bymjukut .
translation.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .

translation.kha: Kainan ka phyllaw kaweh bashabar ka un-long kham shiah ban ïa ka phyllaw kaba ioh . Ka la don ka khyrdop kham hajrong kaba lam sha ka phyllaw kaba haw .
translation.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement .
Now is my soul troubled  ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
translation.kha: Mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka pisa — bad aïu ngan ong ? Hato ngan ong , ‘ Ko Pa , wat ai ba kane ka kynta kan wan ha nga ?’ Hynrei dei na ka bynta kata nga la wan — khnang ba ngan ïoh ïaid lyngba kane ka kynta jong ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country : Is not the  Lord  in Zion ? is not her king in her ? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images , and with strange vanities ?
translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Ha kylleng ka ri nga ïohsngew ba ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam ,  Hato U  Trai  um don shuh ha Seïon ? Hato u syiem ka Seïon um don shuh hangta ?  U  Trai  , u syiem jong ki , u jubab ,  Balei phi la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong phi bad da kaba nguh dem ïa ki blei nongwei bymmyntoi ?
Dor saw tylli ktieh kiei ba ka pyrthiew da lade kam lah Shah :
translation.en: For three things the earth is disquieted , and for four which it cannot bear :

translation.kha: Aïu Phah ong haba ki briew kiba pha pyrkhat ki lama ki paralok jong pha , ki ioh ïa pha badno ki synshar halor jong pha ? Phan don ha ka Jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba kha khun .
translation.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee ? for thou hast taught them to be captains , and as chief over thee : shall not sorrows take thee , as a woman in travail ?

translation.kha: Ka dei shaphrang kane ka jingpynïap ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïawad mala ïit bha biang biang , bad ki la ïathuhlypa shang kane ka jingai ïa kaba U Blei un ai ha phi .
translation.en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently , who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you :

translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Eser , u Hebron , bad u Ussaïah .
translation.en: The sons of Kohath  ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ainong , Balei ngin pynlong ka jingïateh lyoh nabar phi ? Ka lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi sah hajan .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?

translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga U Trai , nga ong ha me , ko syiem Jehoash , ba yn ym don u baneh jingkahtngen na me u don syier shuh halor ka hima u Dabid . Ïa ka metïap jongu me yn bret shabar ha ka jingshit kyr-ang ka sngi ha ka por mynmiet bad ha u thah mynmiet .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of Jehoiakim king of Judah  ; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .
In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the  Lord  of hosts  ; one shall be called , The city of destruction .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka ktien Hebru yn kren ha ki san tylli ki nongbah jong ka Ijipt . Ki briew hangta kin shim jingsmai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ïa kawei na ki nongbah yn khot ,  Ka Nongbah jong ka Sngi .
Nangta U Blei u la ainong , Ko khun u briew , leit sha ki bastad Israel bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa me ba men nguh .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban ïalam ïa pha , ym don uno uno naphang ki briew jongngi pha ban btin ïa pha da ka kti .
translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .

translation.kha: Ynda u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dei ban ai sha U Trai ïa u khulom nyngkong Baroh . Leit Uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad u longïing u jrong U Trai .
translation.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .

translation.kha: bad lada phi mon shun ngeit ïa ka khur jong ki , u Ïoannis u long u Elijah , uba ïa ka jingwan jong u la ïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias , which was for to come .
For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi pat , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba kane ka jinglaitluid kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ban synshar ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .

Ha Kaei ka sngi manbha U Jisu u dang hikai , katno kattne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nongshniah ka Hukum kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka shnong na Galatia bad Joïada bad na Jerusalem ; ki la ïashong hangta . Ka bor jong U Trai ka la anna na ka bynta U jongu ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang .
translation.en: And it came to pass on a certain day , as he was teaching , that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by , which were come out of every town of Galilee , and Judaea , and Jerusalem : and the power of the Lord was present to heal them .
They are all hot as an oven , and have devoured their judges  ; all their kings are fallen : there is none among them that calleth unto me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhluit ka jingbitar jong ki , ki pynïap ïa la ki nongsynshar . Ki syiem jong ki , ki shah pynïap uwei hadien uwei , hynrei ym don na ki uba khot kyrpad ïa nga ban ïoh jingïarap .
U Trei u ieit ïa la ki bri , bad u ïada ïa la ki jong . kamut ngi dem ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang purew kam Shim la ba-thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .
translation.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba mih ban leit tep ïa ka , kim shem ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh jong ka bad ki shyieng kti bad shyieng kjat jong ka .
translation.en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .

translation.kha: Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . ngam wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jylla , dara nangne lang! law ïa ki daiñ jong phan bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba pha lyngkhuit .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .
And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?
translation.kha: Ka Templ ka long mynta kaba ïoh burom shibun , hynrei kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un lyngngoh bad un kylli , ‘ Balei ba U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka Templ ?’

Ka jingshisha ba phi ïadon ki jingïakajia hapoh ka aiñ hapdeng jong phi hi , ka pynim phi la rem nadong shajrong . Hammoth kam kham bha ïa phi ban shat bymdei ? Hato kam khim ibha ba phin shah lute noh ?
translation.en: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you , because ye go to law one with another . Why do ye not rather take wrong ? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded ?

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha nga ka khubor na ka bynta u Shemaïah jong ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shiteng ha ka kyrteng jong u hi sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah bad sha baroh kiwei paw ki lyngngoh . Ha kane ka sakhi , u Shemaïah u la thoh sha u Sephanaïah :
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,
And there shall be signs in the sun , and in the moon , and in the stars  ; and upon the earth distress of nations , with perplexity  ; the sea and the waves roaring  ;
translation.kha: Kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla ki ban jia ha ka sngi , ha u bnai , bad ha ki khlur . Ha ka pyrthei , ki ri baroh kin don ha ka jingnoh mynsiem , ki tieng ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw bad ïa ka jingkhih phaloh ki jingat phyllung .

translation.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet , and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his device that he had devised against the Jews .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Esther ka kren biang ha u syiem da kaba dem ha ki kjat jong u bad ïam . Ka kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingsylla basniew kaba u Haman , uba hiarpateng na u Agag , pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .
khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka , ka dien ban long da u masi , ne da u langbrot , ne da u langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish , of the beeves , of the sheep , or of the goats .

translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa u sha Kaisaria , ki la ai ïa ka shithi ha u lyngskor , Bad ki la pait ïa u Paul ha u .
translation.en: Who , when they came to Caesarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .
For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin , to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .
translation.kha: Kum u Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop jong u bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki briew ban leh pop bad mane bleithaw .
Nangta U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u khun umbah la kha ha ka rukom biria u la pynshitom ibeiñ ïa uba uba la kha namarba U mynhynne U Blei ; bad ka long khmut mynta .
translation.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .
For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :
translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat

translation.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals , and I heard , as it were the noise of thunder , one of the four beasts saying , Come and see .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait noh ïa kawei na ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei na ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ba u ong ha ka sur kaba sawa kum u pyrthat ,  To wan !

translation.en: God wants people to enjoy life on earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ba ki briew kin im ka jingim kaba kmen ha pyrthei .

translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban rung sha ka jingïateh jutang bad U  Trai  ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai  ; u pynlong ruh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u syiem bad ki paidbah .
Ko Pa , u la ong , Lada me mane , shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka myn jongu nga , pynap , ïa ka mon jongno me yn pynjop .
translation.en: Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
And the men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city , did as Jezebel had sent unto them , and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them .
translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba ka Jesebel ka la hukum .

Haba u syiem Israel u pule ïa ka shithi , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai bad u kyang dam , Kumba u syiem Syria u khmih lynti ïa nga ban pynkhiah ïa une u briew ? Hato u pyrkhat ba nga dei U Bela , lem bad ka leh jong ka jingkem bad ka jingïap ? Ka sha kdar ba u pyrshang ban sdang ïakdang bad nga !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king of Israel had read the letter , that he rent his clothes , and said , Am I God , to kill and to make alive , that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy ? wherefore consider , I pray you , and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me .

translation.kha: U la ino ïa ki , Leit sha ka pyrta baroh kawei bad ïalap ïa ka Gospel sha ki jyrthiaw baroh .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .
There is no peace , saith my God , to the wicked .
translation.kha: Ym don jingshngain ïa ki nongpop ,  ong U  Trai .

translation.en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .
translation.kha: Judah , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa phi .

translation.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it : and he that hateth suretiship is sure .
translation.kha: Lada phi kular ban siew ïa ka ram u nongwei , phin babe ïa kata . Kan kham bha lada phi kiar na kata .
Ai ba kito kiba pynïohburom ïa me kin wan sha nga — kito baroh bakha tip ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don katto katne ngut hangne ki shun ym ïap tad ynda ki la ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , there be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the kingdom of God .
Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,
translation.kha: bad beit beit sha Gilead bad sha Kadesh ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha Dan , bad na Dan ki leit shaphang sepngi sha Sidon .

Ha kaba ïadei bun ki ar ngut kiba la ïatehktien kiba la rai ba kin ym ïashongkurim : “lada uta u briew u sngew ba um shym leh kaba dei ïa ka theisotti bad lada ki jingkwah brai jong u ki jur haduh katta katta bad u sngew ba u dei ban shongkurim , te ki dei ban ïashongkurim nong , dom u kwah . Kam don ngop ei ei ha kane .
translation.en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u duwai ,  Ko Pa jong nga ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me kwah .

translation.en: Till a dart strike through his liver  ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .
translation.kha: ha kaba u  namsop u dung ha u klongsnam jong u . U long kum ka sim kaba tur ruma sha ka jar — um shym tip ba ka jingim jong u ka don ha ka jingma .
To ap tad ïathuh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad len ai ha me ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka byndi jngai nga sa hynñiew snem .
translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , thaw san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka ksiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta kine ki rishot .
A Trai U Blei jongki im’ , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jrong me da kaba wallam noh ïa ki briew jong me na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jongnga me la ïa kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la ar bakla .
translation.en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
Now it came to pass , when they had heard the law , that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka hukum ba la pule , ki la kyntait noh ïa ki nongwei na ka imlang sahlang .
U ong , Khim lytar sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah bakhraw , Bad to pynbna ha ki briew ïa ka khubor kaba de la ai ha me
translation.en: Arise , go unto Nineveh , that great city , and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong pynïeng ïa ka jingïaineh ka Jingdon Harud U Troas .
translation.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .

translation.kha: Kynmaw te , ïa kaei kaba la hikai ïa pha bad ïa kaei kaba phah la ïohsngew ; kumjuh ïa kata bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha . Lada pham kyndit bynriew noh , ngan wan ha pha khim u nongtuh , bad phan ym lah wat ban tip) ïa ka par Lano ngan wan .
translation.en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard , and hold fast , and repent . If therefore thou shalt not watch , I will come on thee as a thief , and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee .

translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Blei namar ka jingtei ba-dap da ka brup jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha im’ ha U Khun babha ieit jong u!
translation.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi hi ba ki pynïap ïa ki khun jong at kum ki jingkñia sha ki bleithaw , ki la wan sha ka templ jong ang bad pyntngit ïa ka !
translation.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .
Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .
translation.kha: lymne ka pyrthei shalor lymne ka pyrthei sha tbian — ym don kano kano ha ki jingthaw baroh ki ban lah lano lano ruh ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit U Blei kaba ha ngi lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .

Nangta men leit kiew sha u Lum jong U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba ei ka jaka sher dara jong ki Philistia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh shnong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa babha dang wan hiar na ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da ainguh ïa ki duitara , ki ksing , ki sharai , malade ki kanjari . Kin sa ïaishah bad ïarisa .
translation.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :

translation.kha: Ym don sabon kaba lah ban sait ïa ki pop jong nga .
translation.en: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïohnang da ka snam jongnga kata ka sim , ka um sngur , ka da kaba dang im , u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u tnat Hissop , Bad u shylliah saw .
translation.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird , and with the running water , and with the living bird , and with the cedar wood , and with the hyssop , and with the scarlet :

translation.kha: Ki la rung lyngba ki thliew lad ki jaka ïadoh jong por bad ki wan ïuh beit nalor jongngi nga ;
translation.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters : in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .

translation.kha: Bad balei kam shym la long kumta ? Namar kim Shimham la shaniah ha ka jingngeit hynrei ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Bad kumta ki la jingpynthut ha U maw jong ka jingjynthut
translation.en: Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;

translation.kha: Bad u la bteng da kaba ong shuh shuh ha u Sadok , Peit shane , khie ïalam noh ïa u Ahimaas , u khun jong me bad ïa u Jonathan u khulom jong u Abiathar sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest , Art not thou a seer ? return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz thy son , and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .

translation.kha: Ki khmat jong u kiba saw snam , bad u don ki jingmong khlem daw .
translation.en: They that tarry long at the wine  ; they that go to seek mixed wine .

And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven , and with the creeping things of the ground : and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth , and will make them to lie down safely .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ngan pynlong ka jutang bad baroh ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan weng noh ruh ïa baroh ki tiar thma na ka ri , baroh ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh , bad ngan ailad ba ki briew jong nga kin ïoh im ha ka jingsuk bad jingshngain .

translation.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka synduk da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .

translation.en: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .
translation.kha: Katba uta u khynnah u dang wan , u mynsiem bymman u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u sha madan bad u la bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring . U Jisu u la ai hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman , U la pynkhiah ïa uta u khynnah , bad U la ai pat ïa u ha u kpa jong u .

translation.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :
translation.kha: To shadkmen bad ka Jerusalem ; to lehkmen na ka bynta jong ka , phi baroh kiba ieit ïa kane ka nongbah ! To shadkmen bad ka , mynta phi baroh kiba la ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong ka !
Ko Hagar , ka khra-maw jong ka Sarai , na-ei phar wan bad Shano phan leit ? Ka jubab , Nga phet neh na la ka kynrad .
translation.en: And he said , Hagar , Sarai s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .
But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan wan biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok kin kyrshan ïa ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O  Lord  , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .
translation.kha: Me wan ïalam ïa ki shapoh bad me buh ïa ki ha u lumbah jong me , ha ka jaka kaba me , ko  Trai  , me la jied na ka bynta ka ïing jong me , ka Templ kaba me hi me la tei .

translation.en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
translation.kha: Hangno phi la tep ïa u ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  To wan bad peit Ko Trai ,  ki la jubab .
U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon lad u Kum u Nongleitkurim badno u Nongpynim , ban ai ha ki paid Israel ka kaba ba-bang kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .

translation.kha: Ki la rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai : Me long uba dei hok ban shim ïa ka kot kli bad ïa-ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait jong ka . Baana la pynpaw ïa me , bad da ka jingïalap ba aiti lut jong me me la thret kuna na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei na kawei pa kawei ka jait , ka jait ktien , ka Hima bad ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And they sung a new song , saying , Thou art worthy to take the book , and to open the seals thereof : for thou wast slain , and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred , and tongue , and people , and nation  ;

translation.kha: ingiew ïa uwei mynshem bad uwei pat janmiet ,
translation.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning , and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even  ;
A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingduwai u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa :

U bneng : ka nongbah Hammoth ha Gilead , bad ki shnong ha Gilead kiba dei jong ki kur u Jair , uba jingartatiend na u Manasseh , bad ka thiang Abib ha Bashan , baroh hynriewphew tyllai ki shnong kiba heh , kiba la ker da ki kynroh bad ki nar rnga ha ki khyrdop
translation.en: The son of Geber , in Ramoth–gilead  ; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh , which are in Gilead  ; to him also pertained the region of Argob , which is in Bashan , threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars :

translation.kha: Kynmaw ruh ban ym leh klet ïa ki Lebi katba phi dang shong ha la ka ri .
translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jeremaïah yn pyllait im bad kin im hapdeng ka jingshngain . Ïa ka nongbah yn khot ‘ U Trai ka Jingpynim jong ngi .’
translation.en: In those days shall Judah be saved , and Jerusalem shall dwell safely : and this is the name wherewith she shall be called , The  Lord  our righteousness .

translation.kha: Rah sha u shiphew tylli ki kpu , khyndiat ki ksew stang , bad shi khihwin ka um ngap . Kylli ïa u kaei ka ban jia ïa u khun jong i , bad un sa ïathuh ïa phi .
translation.en: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey , and go to him : he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .

translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba u Aaron u leit rung shuh ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban pynmihpat ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei badno ka jingpynkhuid haduh ba un da Mih nangta , ym bit ïano ïano ban don hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . Ynda u la pyndep ïa kata ka rukom lehniam na ka bynta ïa lade , na ka bynta la ka longïing , bad na ka bynta u paidbah baroh ,
translation.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out , and have made an atonement for himself , and for his household , and for all the congregation of Israel .
For thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , The barrel of meal shall not waste , neither shall the cruse of oil fail , until the day that the  Lord  sendeth rain upon the earth .
