translation.kha: Naba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong : ‘ Kata ka pliang kan ym thylli  purew lane uta u klong un nym long khlem umphniang shuwa kata ka sngi ba nga , U  Trai  ngan phah slap .’
Kaba U Jisu u ïalang kiew sha Jeroboam , u la shim kyrpang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la kren jar tong ha ki , katba ki dang ïa-ïaid .
translation.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way , and said unto them ,

translation.kha: Da shisha phoi tip ba don shibun ki nongïamareh kiba ïashim byndi ha ka jingmareh thong , hynrei tang uwei na ki u ïoh ïa ka prais . Kumta to mareh ha kata ka rukom ban ïoh ïa ka pra .
translation.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
But that we write unto them , that they abstain from pollutions of idols , and from fornication , and from things strangled , and from blood .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi dei ban thoh ka shithi da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ba la kñia ïa ka ha ki bleithaw ; ban kyndiah na ka jingawria ; bad ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam .

translation.en: Wherein God , willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel , confirmed it by an oath :
translation.kha: Ha kito kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba u kular , U Blei u kwah ban pyn-i shai ba un ym pynkylla ïa ki jingthmu jong u ; kumta u wanrah de ïa ka jingsmai ha ka jingkular .
To phin pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un pynkhlaiñbor ïa phi .
translation.en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he shall lift you up .

translation.kha: U long tang ma u marwei , uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingsngew jongno nga , bad uba sngewlem shisha shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .

translation.kha: Pynban , to pyrkhat ïa ka Hima jongngi u , bad un pynbud ïa phi da kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Bel ba u kynhun un ym shahshitom namar ki pop jong u khop jong u ?’ Ka jubab ka long ba u khun jong u la leh ïa kaei kob dei bad kaba bha’ . U la sumar ïa ki aiñ lad nga bad u la bud biang biang ïa ki , malu kumta un im da shisha .
translation.en: Yet say ye , Why ? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father ? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right , and hath kept all my statutes , and hath done them , he shall surely live .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u la ïeng pynlang u la hukum ïa ka lyer , un-long janai jai ! bad u la ong ïa ki jingat phyllung , Long jat jai ! Ka lyer ka la kynjah jar bad ka la don ka jingjia jai naba khraw .
translation.en: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea ,  Peace , be still .  And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .

But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynsah im ïa u Agag , bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun masi bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynsai tam , bad ïa kano kano kaba kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .
Haba U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la tdong ban dom shatai eh ïa u bad kylli ïa u ki jingkylli shaphang bun khie ktien ,
translation.en: And as he said these things unto them , the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently , and to provoke him to speak of many things :
So David hid himself in the field : and when the new moon was come , the king sat him down to eat meat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit rieh ïa lade ha ki bri . Ha ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , u syiem Saul u wan shong bam ,
ha kaba ki lapbah lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la wallam ki jingmudui byrsha ïa u Paul .
translation.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,

translation.kha: Kum ïa ki shiah katba la thain bad ïa u phlangïap ba-rkhiang , ïa phi ki nongbuaid yn thang duh !
translation.en: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .

translation.kha: U syiem Serksis ngat u noh ha ka Ishar ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw , Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Hamath na ka pyntha ka jingjakhlia pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .

Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai  :  Ngan rwai ha U  Trai namar ka jingjop kaba khraw jong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai .

translation.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : he hath a blemish  ; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba hiarpateng na u Aaron , u lyngdoh , uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .

Bohan snem Hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria ban leit khmied ïa u Ahab . Ban lehburom ïa u Jehoshaphat malade kito kiba bad u , u Ahas u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot bad ki maw pun pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gaddah .
translation.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jrong u ; da ka jingthaba ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .
translation.en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
And Moses and Aaron did as the  Lord  commanded them , so did they .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .
Adonijah ba iwei uwei baroh u la bam pdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka Lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh shaw ka duriaw .
translation.en: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .

translation.kha: U skhem Jobab jongngi ka Israel um shym phai napoh na ki lynti bymman jong u , hynrei u ïai jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing riewpyrthei banbeiñ shakri ha ki duwan kiba u la tei . U pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ïa uno eit kat uba kwah ban long u lyngdoh .
translation.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way , but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places : whosoever would , he consecrated him , and he became one of the priests of the high places .

translation.kha: U dei pahara u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , suba la im pat , u la ïathuh ha ki rangbah synshar jong u . Dei katai keiñ Balei ba une u la don ïa kane ka bor banbeiñ leh ki kambah .
translation.en: And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist  ; he is risen from the dead  ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .

translation.kha: Naba U Bel u kwah ïa phi ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingkren khlem pyrkhat jong ki Briew kiba bieit da ki kam babha ba phi leh .
translation.en: For so is the will of God , that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men :

translation.kha: U Sephon u la jubab , Ko ki hynmen ki por bad ko ki kpa , shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha Shuah ba u kpa tymmen jongki ngi u Ephraim un ithuh noh ban shong ha Haron , U Blei ka burom u la mihpaw ha u ha Mesopotamia malu u la ong ha u ,
translation.en: And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,

translation.kha: Da phikir kumno phiah pyrkhat ; naba ki jingpyrkhat jong phin ki saiñdur ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .

translation.kha: Da kumta , te , kabu kumno ka jingpynbaptis phi la ïohpdiang ? Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis , ki la jop .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .
If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee ?
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban siew , kin knieh noh wat ïa ka jingthiah jong phi ruh .
Lada uno du u briew u pyrshang ïa-ban pynpyut ïa uei pat u briew da kaba mudui lamler ïa u ,
translation.en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong  ;

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U Trai u pynspong ïa u kyndok ting ha ki nongbah Sodom bad Gomorrah ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;
Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
translation.kha: Uei te uba lamler ? U dei uno uno uba ong ba U Jisu um dei U Messaïah . Kum uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .
Nga la sneng ïa ki nongïalam Jiw bad ong , Peit ïa kaba sniew kaba phi leh ! Phi pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah , and said unto them , What evil thing is this that ye do , and profane the sabbath day ?
And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .
translation.kha: U buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie , marpyrshah kata ka miej ,

Ngan phah ïa ki jingpang ha pha malade ban shah ba ka snam kan thad ha ki lynti bah jong pha . Phan shah tur ïaleh na baroh ki wad , bad ïa ki briew jong phan yn pynïap . Te phlang tip ba nga long U TRAI’ .
translation.en: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets  ; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Jubab ïa nga , A Terah , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un pyntip ba me , U Trai , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki shata lade hi .
translation.en: Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .

And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .
translation.kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa kiba ki dei ban shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na ki para Israel jong phi .

Ngan wanrah ruh khathynñiew ka jingbam ; kan ai bor ïa phi katne phi nang bteng ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong phi . Phi la pynjyrngam ïa nga ïahap phi ïan rung ha ïing jong nga , kumta shiah ngan shakri ïa phi! . Ki jubab , Khublei shibun ; ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kata .
translation.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .

translation.kha: Bun ki Briew ki la wan sha Jerusalem , da kaba wanrah ïa ki jingangnud sha U Trai bad ki jingai ïa u Mahseïah , ba nangta sha khmat baroh ki jingpyniwbih ki pyndonburom ïa u Hesekaïah .
translation.en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .

translation.kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ban leit noh , U Blang um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba poi shatei shaw ka phang phria , wat la ka lama kaba ju tam . U Blei u ong , Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kin kylla dien bad kin leit phai pait sha Ijipt haba ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleit thma .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :

translation.kha: Hynrei lapbah don uba sheng lang ha ka jingïaseng u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U Blei , uta uba kren u dei ban sangeh noh .
translation.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by , let the first hold his peace .
And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
translation.kha: katba ki ïaid ha ka mon U Blei . Ki leh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u hukum , hangno hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
Kynton ym map lane leh-isynei ïabun ïadon , la ki dei ki samla ne ki tymmen .
translation.en: A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :
They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Dei ma nga  u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki .
Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Damaskos da ka ryndang bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma nga , U Trai borabor Borabor , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: U la leit phai sha ka nongkhap Jesreel ban ïoh jingkoit ïa ki jingsngem jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shad baneh jngoh ïa u .
translation.en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kiwei pang ki shakri lem badno kane ka khubor ïa ki nongshahkhot sngewbha : ‘ La dep Khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga mynta , la ngap shohdoh ïa ki masi dab malu ïa ki khun masi bakynsai jong nga , badno la khreh ïa kiei kaei baroh . To ale sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim !’
translation.en: Again , he sent forth other servants , saying , Tell them which are bidden , Behold , I have prepared my dinner : my oxen and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready : come unto the marriage .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka nongrim baskhem ka U Blei u la buh ym eh ban pynkhih ; bad halor jong ka la thoh ïa kine ki ktien : U Trai u ithuh ïa kito kiba den ki jong u bad Baroh kiba Ong ba ki dei ki jong U Trai ki dei ban phai noh na kaba leh bymdei .
translation.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure , having this seal , The Lord knoweth them that are his . And , Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity .
But ye shall be named the Priests of the  Lord  : men shall call you the Ministers of our God : ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves .
translation.kha: bad ïa phi yn khot ki lyngdoh U  Trai  , ki shakri jong U Blei jong ngi . Phin sa lehkmen ïa ka spah ki jaitbynriew , bad phin sa sngewsarong ba ka dei ki jong phi .
Haseroth me la ju poi sha ki umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jongno ka duriaw ? hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong ka duriaw-bah ?
translation.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , ki bhabriew Jong ka hima bashatei jong ka Israel ki ïai ïaleh pyrthuh ïa ka longsyiem syiem jongno u Dabid .
translation.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jongki ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah bad u la ïai kren haduh shngain synñia , namar ba un sa mihnoh ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .

translation.kha: Un shim khyndiat ka snam Jong uta u masi lyngraw pynlang un synreit ïa ka da la ka shynrong ti ha khmat kata ka jingtap , bad nangta un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha kham ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translation.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward  ; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times .

translation.kha: U biah u kren-ïa nabar ïaphai kren . Ym don mano mano batip khie ka ban jia marbud , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh kan jia Aïu hadien ba ngi ïap .
translation.en: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be  ; and what shall be after him , who can tell him ?

translation.kha: To ïateh ha u shun pynkloi bad ban pynkhreh ïa la ki kynhun baroh hapoh ka jingïalam jong u .
translation.en: Be thou prepared , and prepare for thyself , thou , and all thy company that are assembled unto thee , and be thou a guard unto them .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïada pyllut bad nga ki phah ïa ki jingïoh khublei ïa me . To ai khlieh ïa ki paralok jong ngi kiba ha ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei U Blei kan Long lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: All that are with me salute thee . Greet them that love us in the faith . Grace be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei ban long kiba sngewtynnat ha shuwa ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la wiang sha ki bad u la ktah ïa ki . To ïeng joit , u la ainong . To wat sheptieng !
translation.en: And Jesus came and touched them , and said ,  Arise , and be not afraid .

translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba hiarpateng beit na u Jakob ki long baroh hynñiewphew jngut . U khun jong u , u Joseph u la don lyngba ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls : for Joseph was in Egypt already .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïalam noh ïa phi ; ar la wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki la baher kthong nadien jong ki da ki kali ïapmat bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt : and ye came unto the sea  ; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea .

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ïa u Jehoaddin ( u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u ksiew jong u Shelemaïah , malu u ksiew tun jong u Kushi ) ban ïong ïa u Barukh ba-bang wallam ïa ka khot kli na kaba u la pule ha ki paidbah . U Barukh u la wallam ha ki ïa ka kato kli .
translation.en: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Cushi , unto Baruch , saying , Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people , and come . So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand , and came unto them .
He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
translation.kha: U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem ; u kynrup ïa nga kum u sing .
Kumba U Trai u la lawbah ïa u Messaïah , ïa ki jaka jong ki khynñiat jait bad kawei ka shiteng jaiñ ha ka phang Sepngi jongu ka Judah la rai da kaba kynting sbai .
translation.en: By lot was their inheritance , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half tribe .

translation.kha: La otsher ïa nga haba nga la don shi taïew ka rta . Nga long u Israel naduh ba la ha ïa nga , na ka jait Benjamin , u Hebru uba nuksa . Ha ka liang kaba sumar ïa ka hukum ki Jiw , nga la long u Pharisi , malade nga la long uba shitrhem katta katta haduh ba na la pynshitom ïa ka balang .
translation.en: Circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , an Hebrew of the Hebrews ; as touching the law , a Pharisee ;
Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar bad ka rupa jong phi ka la bam sarang , bad kane ka sarang kan long ka sakhi pyrshah ïa phi bad kan sa bam duh ïa ka doh jong phi kum ka ding . Phi la kynshew spah ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh .
Leit rah ïa ki jingainguh jong phi bad ïa ki jingai sngewlah ba phi la kular sha U Trai tang sha kata ka bakwah mane Blei .
translation.en: Only thy holy things which thou hast , and thy vows , thou shalt take , and go unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose :

translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka bymnang ha la ka sloit ti kadiang ,
translation.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand :

translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , kin shitom Namarba —kata ka jingbymïaineh jongki phi , tad khah ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .
translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ha u ba phi dei ki nongri jingri , bun ba phi la wan ïalam ïa la ki kynjoh langbrot , ïa kiwei de ki jingri , bad ïa kiei kiei Baroh kat kiba phi don .
translation.en: And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle  ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have .

translation.kha: Kumne ka kynthei ka la leit shaei la ïing lem bad la ki khur shynrang , ka la khang ïa ka jingkhang , ka la shim ïa u khra jingmane Olib uba raïot , badno ka la phylliew umphniang ha ki khrum kiba ki khun shaneng jong ka ki la wallam .
translation.en: So she went from him , and shut the door upon her and upon her sons , who brought the vessels to her  ; and she poured out .

translation.kha: nangta u phah ïa u shakri jong u , u Moses , nabar u Aaron , ïa kiba u la jied .
translation.en: He sent Moses his servant  ; and Aaron whom he had chosen .

translation.kha: Ki la shem ba la pynlut noh ïa u maw na ka iaki rung sha ka jingput , kumta ki la rung shispah ;
translation.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre .

translation.kha: ibha u Iso u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u lynñiar jam bad ïakdang ruh , bad u ong , Ko Pa ! to ai ha ar ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu Jong me .
translation.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la sait ïa ki phet jong ki , u la kup baklang ïa ka jaiñkup bad u la leit phai sha la ka jaka ha ka miej . Phi sngewthuh ïa kamai kaba nga dang shu dep ban leh ïa ph ? u la kylli .
translation.en: So after he had washed their feet , and had taken his garments , and was set down again , he said unto them ,  Know ye what I have done to you ?

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la dih ïa ka khuri bakthang jong ka jingpynshitom ha u lum bakhain jong nga . hynriew ki jingpyniwbih ha baroh sawdong kan dih ïa ka kyrni kiba kham kthang jong ka jingpynshitom ; kin dih ïa ka baroh bad kin jah Shisyndon .
translation.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain , so shall all the heathen drink continually , yea , they shall drink , and they shall swallow down , and they shall be as though they had not been .

translation.kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba pha imat ki longsem kiba nga ijli , ngan pynthnam ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaba ngam pat ju leh mynno mian , bad ïa kaba ngan ym leh shuh lano lano ruh .
translation.en: And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , pa’ ki nongsynshar ki Israel , phi katba isih ïa ka jingïar hok bad pynïakhlad ïa kaba dei sha kaba baklang .
translation.en: Hear this , I pray you , ye heads of the house of Jacob , and princes of the house of Israel , that abhor judgment , and pervert all equity .
And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?
translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri ïa u Solomon u kpa jong u kum ki nongaibuit .  Kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki briew ?  u kylli .
U Jisu hadien u la mih paw ha ki synrum jong u .
translation.en: Jesus later appeared to his apostles .

translation.kha: U Herod u la kwah ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei u la sheptieng ïa ki paid Ïwei , Naaman ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kumto u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .

translation.kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynnong jong i'u bad wat ktah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . ngim kiaw ngab ïohsngew shaphang U Bel Bakhuid jong phi ki Isaia .
translation.en: Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .

translation.kha: U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kaba ïa U Trai la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Jedaïah baroh ban myn ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .

But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .
translation.kha: Lada ki dei da shisha ki nongïathuhlypa bad lada ki don ïa ka khubor jong nga , shah ïa ki ban kylli ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ban ym shah ïa ki jingkynshew kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem ban shah rah sha Babilonia .
halor ki shadem jongu ki malu u rah ïa ki baroh sha ka duwan . U thap ïa ka khleiñ halor ka duwan ,
translation.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burnt the fat upon the altar :
That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
translation.kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , ki bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .
ha ka jingtip jongki phi pynlang ïa ka jingsynshar ïa lade ; ha ka jingshlur ïa lade pynlang ïa ka jingïaishah ; ha ka jingïaishah pynlang ïa ka jinglong riewblei ;
translation.en: And to knowledge temperance  ; and to temperance patience  ; and to patience godliness  ;

translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba ka jingngeit ba phi baroh phi long ki khuid U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Me la thung ïa ki , bad ki la jingsawa ; ki san bad ki pynmih soh . Ki ju kren bha shaphang lad me , pynban ki da salia eh shisha shaphang jong me .
translation.en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .

translation.kha: U sangeh jong U Trai u leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lat phraphew syn hajar ngut ki shipai . Dang step pynrangbah ka sngi kaba bud hangta ki thiah , Baroh ki la ïap !
translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you : whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not , and their damnation slumbereth not .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglalot jong ki , kine ki nonghikai balamler kin kamai da kaba ïathuh ïa phi ïa ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw . La kham slem mynta U Nongbishar jong ki u la long uba la kloi , bad u Nongpynjot jong ki u la long u bym ju ïohthiah !

translation.en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ong ba u don ka jingngeit lada da ki kam jong u , um pynshisha ïa kata ? Hato kata ka jingngeit kan pynim ïa u ?

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :
translation.kha: haba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki la wan mih na ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .

translation.en: And the king of the south shall be strong , and one of his princes  ; and he shall be strong above him , and have dominion  ; his dominion shall be a great dominion .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Ijipt un long uba khlaiñ . Hynrei , uwei na ki nongïalam shipai jong u un kham khraw bad un synshar ïa ka hima kaba kham khraw .
Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher ngon Harhas ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .
translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
Neither do men light a candle , and put it under a bushel , but on a candlestick  ; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba thang ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; hynrei u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , na kaba ka ai jingshai ïa baroh kiba hapoh ka ïing .
Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka par ba ki leit sha ka ïing U Trai , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïapom bad nang ba-thurmur ban baibam ei ei .
translation.en: And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .

translation.kha: Ai ba phin shadkmen borabor ha U Trai ; la ban biang ïa ka : To ïakmen .
translation.en: Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .

translation.kha: U Herod u la sngewbishni ïa u Ïoannis Namarba u la ïatip ba u Ïing u long u briew uba bha bad uba khuid , bad kumta u ju da ïa u . U ju sngewbha ban sngap ïa u , Wat la u shitom jingmut shahjingit eh lad ka por ba u ïohsngew ïa u .
translation.en: For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him  ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .

translation.kha: “lada nga la trei ïa la ka kam da ka mon sngewbha , te de la lah ban khmih lynti ban ïuh ïa ka bainong ; hynrei nga leh ïa ka tang kum ka kamram , namar U Bel u la aiti ha nga ïa khnai ka kam .
translation.en: For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .

translation.kha: ( U Shemida u don saw nguh ki khun shynraiñ : u Aïah , u Shekhem , u Likhi , bad u Aniam . )
translation.en: And the sons of Shemida were , Ahian , and Shechem , and Likhi , and Aniam .

translation.kha: Lydda u brup u ïathiah shongkha malade ka tnga jong u kyrni jong u , u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u keiñ , kumta ma u bad kata ka briew kin kit hi ïa la ka pop ; barben ar ngut kin ïalap khleiñ khun .
translation.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ngan kut ka jingduwai stad jar jongki nga , ka Rabbah ka la wan malade u ksew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka nabar ka la leit khih sha kata ka puk ban tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba tun thah .’
translation.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .
And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Kanaan ïa kaba u la kular skhem ha phi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Nga pynbna ha ka jingbitar bameh ding lad nga ba ha kata ka sngi kan don ka jingkhaïi jumai kaba jur ha ka ri Israel .
translation.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken , Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka khlaiñ jyllang u mrad ïa uba wanlam kumto ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongu U Blei .
translation.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast , of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people .

translation.kha: Ka Jehobah ka sumar ïa u khynnah hapoh hynriew snoh bad ka pynrieh ïa u ha ka Templ , katba ka Athalaïah ka dang synran kum ka syiem .
translation.en: And he was with her hid in the house of the  Lord  six years . And Athaliah did reign over the land .
And the cherubims spread out their wings on high , and covered with their wings over the mercy seat , with their faces one to another  ; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims .
translation.kha: Kita ki Kherub ki ïaphai markhmat halor kata ka jingtap , bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa ka .
kad haduh ba U Trai un da khmih sha tbian na bneng bad ïohi ïa ngi .
translation.en: Till the  Lord  look down , and behold from heaven .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jongnga phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha man uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem suba ïong synrum u tap bad na uba ka ding kaba rhem ka jing shaduh suiñbneng .
translation.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïajubab ïa u , Uno uno uba ieit ïa at un kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga . U Kpa jong ar un ieit ïa u , bad U Kpa jong at bad ma nga ngim wan ha u bad sawa hapoh jong u .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .

translation.kha: mynno daiñ uta ba pynlong ïa kane ban jia ? Uba la thmu sngem ïa ka jingïaid ka histori ? Nga , U Trei , nga la don klang naduh mynnyngkong , pynlang nga , U Trai , ngan ïai don hangta ha kaba kut .
translation.en: Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I the  Lord  , the first , and with the last  ; I am he .

translation.kha: Lada U blem u ai ha ngi ka spah bad ka jingdon jingem bad to ngin Lehkmen ha ki , ngi dei ban sngewnguh bad lehkmen ïa kaei ka ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai na U Blei .
translation.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .
The  Lord  render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness : for the  Lord  delivered thee into my hand to day , but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ainong ïa kito baroh kiba hok bad ïaineh . Ha kane ka sngi u la aiti ïa phi ha ka bor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi , uta ïa uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem .

translation.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , hynñiew ngut ki kynthei kin bat ïa uwei u briew bad ong ,  Ngi lah ban bsa bad pynkup jaiñ ïa lade , hynrei sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ong ba phi long u tnga jong ngi , ba kumta ngim donkam ban shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong ka jinglong bym pat shongkurim .

translation.en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad phi !  Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha sepngi bajngai tam , ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong phi .
Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngkot haduh katta katta bun ki la ïong , Kumjuh une u briew u tip katne katne haba um pait ju Ïohi jingjai ei ei ?
translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ki pop jong sem ïa u la pynum , la pajut namar ka jingbymman kaba ngi la leh . La pynkhiah ïa ngi da ka jingpynshitom kaba u la shah , la pynkhih ïa I da ki jingsympat kiba u la ïoh .
translation.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions , he was bruised for our iniquities : the chastisement of our peace was upon him  ; and with his stripes we are healed .
Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Ye shall eat no manner of fat , of ox , or of sheep , or of goat .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa ka khleiñ jong ki masi , ki langbrot , ne ki blang .
Kumta u Laban u pynlong ka jingkhawai sohkhram bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew baroh .
translation.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .

translation.kha: Um dei ban pynngeit ïa lade da kaba leit sha ïajan ka metïap , ki la ka daym ka jong u kpa ne ka kmie jong u .
translation.en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body , nor defile himself for his father , or for his mother  ;

translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam kaba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewkhuslai ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki apostol .
translation.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi te , phi dei ban leit phai biang sha ka ri shyiap sha ka phang jong ka Duriaw Basaw .’
badno ha ka sien kaba ar ki Benjamin ki wan mih na Gibeah , bad ha kane ka sien ki pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai borbah ka Israel .
translation.en: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men  ; all these drew the sword .

translation.kha: Haba ka por ïambriew ka la kut , u Dabid u phah wan ïalang ïa ka sha ka jingmihsnam ; ka la long noh ka tnga jong u , bad ka kha u khun shynrang na u . Hynrei U Trai um jingsngewbha ïa khie kaba u Dabid u la leh .
translation.en: And when the mourning was past , David sent and fetched her to his house , and she became his wife , and bare him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the  Lord .

translation.kha: To ai ba ngan nym lai shuh ban ria biang lada ngam kynmaw ïa pha , lada ngam pyrkhat ïa pha kum ka jingkmen bakhraw tam jongnga nga !
translation.en: If I do not remember thee , let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth  ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong , U tharai u la suda ïa phi ba-bang lai ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u ka paw ha phi .
translation.en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .
And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul : and when Saul saw any strong man , or any valiant man , he took him unto him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang im , u Saul u hap ban ïaleh tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . Kumta , man ka por ba u lap ïa u briew uba khlaiñ lane uba shlur , u ju pynrung ïa u ha ka kynhun ïapom jong u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki shaphang shatei haduh Misrephoth Maim bad Sidon , bad shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Mispah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh u nongshun uba lait im .
Nalorkata U Jisu u la leit pat Sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïew ïa uba ïapshiliang ka ktien .
translation.en: And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .

translation.kha: sheng , u Jisu un weng khong baroh ki jingsngew bad jingjynjar na kane ka pyrthei .—Salm 37 :9-11 ; Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .
translation.en: Soon Jesus will remove all wickedness and suffering from this earth .—Psalm 37 :9-11  ; Proverbs 2 :21 , 22 .

translation.kha: kumno nga kah ban leh ïa kata ? U Samuel u kylli . Lada u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynïap ïa por ! U Trai u jubab , Shim ïa u khun masi bad ong ba me Don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la ïadep hynñiewphew san snem ka rta , u la mihnoh na Hajan , kumba U Trai u la baheh ïa u ban leh ; bad u Lot u la leit lem malu u .
translation.en: So Abram departed , as the  Lord  had spoken unto him  ; and Lot went with him : and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .

For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ïeng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua ban ong ïa u paidbah ban leh . Kane ka dei kata kaba u Moses u la hukum . U paidbah u la pynkloi sha shiliang ka wah .
Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u lbong ban pynsakma na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad Ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban pahuh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim ti u maw , u pynngat ïa u hateng ka Mispah bad ka Shen , bad ong , U Tharai u la ïarap ïa ngi barieh shi lyndet lynti — bad u la pyntngen ïa u , u maw ka jingïar .
translation.en: Then Samuel took a stone , and set it between Mizpah and Shen , and called the name of it Eben–ezer , saying , Hitherto hath the  Lord  helped us .

translation.kha: Namar ba ïa ka snam jong u langsohmoh ym shym la nongrah shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , phi la dei ban bam ïa ka jingkñia hangta , kumba nga la hukum .
translation.en: Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
And the third angel sounded , and there fell a great star from heaven , burning as it were a lamp , and it fell upon the third part of the rivers , and upon the fountains of waters  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba lai u la put ïa la ka turoi . U khlur uba heh , uba meh kum ka dongmusa , u la hap na sahit bneng bad u la hap halor ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki wah bad halor ki pukri um .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la bthah ïa u sakhrai don ïai-ong ha ki brai , Ma la , U Trai , nga la bitar shikatdei ïa ki kpa tymmen jrong phi ,
translation.en: The  Lord  hath been sore displeased with your fathers .

translation.kha: Khyndiat pat u la hap halor ka jaka mawthew ha ka ba-don tang khyndiat ka khynñiat . Shen ki symbai ki la speh , nongmareh ka khyndew kada da jylliew .
translation.en: Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . U la phah ktien ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor bad u la ong ïa u ban buh ka jingtim halor jong phi .

translation.en: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .
translation.kha: I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon lang bad ki nongbud jong u Korah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; i la ïap namar ka pop la jong .

Haba me ïathuh ha ki ïa kane baroh , ktang kylli ïa me baïar ba nga la kut jingmut shun pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki . Ki kylli kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shah pynrem sad Kaei ka pop ba ki la kuna pyrshah ïa U Trai U Blei jongu ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?

translation.kha: Haba ka Bathsheba ka la jingïohknieh ba u tnat jong ka u la Shah pynïap , ka ïambriew na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .

translation.kha: Haba uno uno na ki shakri jong nga u mudui pyrshah ïa nga , lang shah bad bor da kaba hok ïa u .
translation.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me  ;

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka nga mynba u la ïong ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai , ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem . Ha kaba khatduh u la phet shaei ka nongbah Lasha , hynrei ki nongshniah jongngi u ki la buddien ïa u shata bad ki la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the  Lord  they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem  ; and he fled to Lachish : but they sent to Lachish after him , and slew him there .

translation.kha: kumta U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la lawbah ban wallam sha u ïa u brup uba matlah . Haba u la wan hajan , U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,
translation.en: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,

translation.kha: Pynnep na ka bynta jong ngi , ki jingkob sarew jong ngi ktang ym ïaid palat pud ; tud ni hapoh u pudina jong ka jingtrei kaba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi , bad kane ka kynthup ïa ka jingtei jongki ngi hap jong phiah .
translation.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure , but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us , a measure to reach even unto you .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing hasem , khamtam ïa ki khot ka longïing jong u hi , u la len ïa ka jingngeit bad u kham sniew don ïa u bymngeit .
translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .

translation.kha: Ha ka step jyllang ka sngaid kaba lai , la don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la pait halor u lwa , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka tur katba sawa jam . Baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka Jaka sher dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .

And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .
translation.kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jong ka Tyros bad Sidon , kumta ki la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . Nyngkong ki la pynngeit ïa u Blastos , u briew uba dei khmih ïa ka ïingsyiem , ba u dei ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Herod bad pan ban ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ka jong ki ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .

translation.en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Lada phi kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud da kaba leh ïa kata kaba nga ñiew ba ka long kaba dei , bad da kaba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi da kano kano ka jingpang kaba nga la pynngat ha ki nong Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkhiah ïa phi .
Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kynroh da ka rmiang tylli ha ka jingïadei bad ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me , hynrei kin ym jop ïa me . Ngin long bad me ban ïada ïa me malade sumar pynim ïa me .
translation.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha “kata hi , ka lyer kaba jur ka la baheh bad la pynkhih ïa ka um .
translation.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
Then Samuel said unto Saul , Stay , and I will tell thee what the  Lord  hath said to me this night . And he said unto him , Say on .
translation.kha: Sangeh !  u Samuel u hukum ,  bad ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha nga hynne mynmiet .   Ïathuh ïa nga ,  ong u Saul .
Sumar ïa ki ai bad ki hukum lad nga baroh , ba kumta phin ym shah kyntait ha ka ri Kanaan sha kaba kan ïalam ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .

translation.kha: Kin wallam ïa ka kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem katba dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ kum ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai . Kine ki pyntwa ki long ki jong me dara jong ki khun jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .

translation.kha: U Judas Ishar , uwei na ki synran jong u — uta u ban sa shetkylla ïa u — u la nguh ,
translation.en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,
Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban tynjuh ïa U Trai , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad la pynïap ïa ki da ki bseiñ .
Gera hangno ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat sniew .
translation.en: And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga ,
U Dabid u kylli ïa u , Kumno keiñ me nud ban pynnep ïa u syiad ba la jied da U Troas ?
translation.en: And David said unto him , How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the  Lord s  anointed ?

translation.kha: bad u buh ïa u Adullam shun khmih ïa ki . U la pynbynta ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun kiba kein shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , pynlang kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka pynlut shi bajanai ha Lebanon bad ar bnai pat ha la shnong .
translation.en: And he sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home : and Adoniram was over the levy .
And he said , Do it the second time . And they did it the second time . And he said , Do it the third time . And they did it the third time .
translation.kha: Ki la leh kumta , bad u ong ,  Leh biang kumta  — bad ki la leh biang kumta . U la ong ,  Leh biang sa shisien ,  bad ki la leh kumta .

kamut baroh ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tong ïa ka um sad ki theh ïa ka kum ka jingweng ha U Trai bad ki shahjingit baroh shi Sngi . Ki ong , Ngi la ai pop! pyrshah ïa U Trai’ . Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynpait ïa ki jingïakajia pangnud ki Israel .
translation.en: And they gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the  Lord  , and fasted on that day , and said there , We have sinned against the  Lord . And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .

And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .
translation.kha: U Boas u jubab ,  Nga la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim naduh ba u tnga jong phi u la ïap . Nga tip kumno phi la iehnoh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa la ka ri ruh , bad kumno phi la wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng ki briew kiba phim pat ju ithuh mynno mynno .

translation.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju shong ha ka templ ; nga la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .

Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit , nga la ju pynshlur ïa u ban wan jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki parabangeit , Hynrei um da mon eh ban wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïoh ïa ka lad , un sa wan .
translation.en: As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .

translation.kha: Ki trud khyllung kin paw ha ki khmut jongu phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
And when he had made an end to offer the present , he sent away the people that bare the present .
translation.kha: Haba u Ehud u la dep ai ha u ïa ki jingai sngewbha , u la ong ha ki rangbah kiba la kit ïa kita ban leit phai noh pat sha ïing .

translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sheshbassar u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid naduh kata ka por haduh mynta , hynrei ym pat pyndep ïa ka Templ .’
Hynrei wat u ksah ruh un ym wiar ïa ki Israel jlan ïa ki jingri jingdap jong ki . Te men tipbriew ba nga U Trai nga pynïapher hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .’
translation.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue , against man or beast : that ye may know how that the  Lord  doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel .

translation.kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng , Khenani kane ka long kaba jem ïa U Trai ïa-ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjngem halor ki Moab .
translation.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .

translation.kha: Ar ne lai jngut kiba ïoh ïa ka khubor U blem ki dei ban kren , kaban kiwei paw kin bishar ïa katai kaba ki kren .
translation.en: Let the prophets speak two or three , and let the other judge .

translation.kha: Da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u la pyllaitluid ïa moi na Jingtep . U leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad u la pynjia ïa ktieh kiei kiba sngewtieng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand , and with an outstretched arm , and with great terribleness , and with signs , and with wonders :

translation.kha: Ka long kum ka shithi na u kba ba olib shata la ki khun .
translation.en: It is like a letter to us from a loving father .
But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , longsuffering , gentleness , goodness , faith ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u pynmih ïa ka jingieit , ka jingkmen , ka jingsuk , ka jingïaishah , ka jinglehsbun , ka jingbha , ka jingïaineh , ka jingsngewrit , bad ka bor halor lade .

Katba u sahmiet u dang ïaid , u nongïathuhlypa u khot ïa u bad ïa-ong , Syiem Kynrad , katba nga dong ïaleh thma , u shipai u wallam sha sa ïa u nongshun ba shah kem bad u ong , ‘ Ap babha ïa une u briew ; lada u lait phet , phin hap ban thor da la ka jrong ka jingim lane phiah hap siew kuna la hajar ki sbai rupa .’
translation.en: And as the king passed by , he cried unto the king : and he said , Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle  ; and , behold , a man turned aside , and brought a man unto me , and said , Keep this man : if by any means he be missing , then shall thy life be for his life , or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver .
Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
translation.kha: U Shuppim bad u Huppim ruh ki long na kane ka jait . U Dan u don uwei u khun , u Hushim .
Te nga la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , Nga kyrpad ïa me , A Tiras , to pynim ïa nga !
translation.en: Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha u Mosah , Kane ka long kata ka ri ba nga la Kular ïa u Abarim , u Isaak , bad u Jubab ngab ai ha ki khur ki ksiew jong ki . Nga la shah ïa me ban ïohi ïa ka , Hynrei ngan ym shahskhor ba men leit shata .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , This is the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , saying , I will give it unto thy seed : I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes , but thou shalt not go over thither .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan bad ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat : Ka kynhun shipai babun paidbah na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duwai Baïap ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason Ithamar . ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka Addi . )
translation.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .

translation.kha: Ki la Shah tur ïaleh da borbah kiba ïakynduh ïa ki . Ki nongshun jong ki , ki nong , ‘ Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , bad kumno kaei kaba ngi la leh , kam long kaba bakla . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la shaniah ha U Trai , bad ma ki hi kiba la dei ngab ïailong uba ïaineh ha u .’
translation.en: All that found them have devoured them : and their adversaries said , We offend not , because they have sinned against the  Lord  , the habitation of justice , even the  Lord  , the hope of their fathers .

And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :
translation.kha: Ynda ka por pynkhuid ïa ka , ka la kut , la ka long na ka bynta u khun ne ka khun , ka dei ban wallam sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ïa u khunlangbrot uba shisnem kum ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka lyngdkhur ne ka paro kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .

U Jiw u la ïong ha ki , Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ïong ? ‘ Ïa u maw ba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh’ . Ïa kaei la leh da U Trai ; katno ka long kaba itynnat !’
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Did ye never read in the scriptures , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner : this is the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?

translation.kha: Hobah u Mordekai u tip ïa kata barhem ba la ai , u tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bajur . Nahath u phong da ki jaiñ shaiñ bad sleh ïa ka khlieh da u dpei , bad ïaid liengbah ïa ka nongbah , u da ïam lynñiar kthang , haduh ba un da poi ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: When Mordecai perceived all that was done , Mordecai rent his clothes , and put on sackcloth with ashes , and went out into the midst of the city , and cried with a loud and a bitter cry  ;

translation.kha: U syiem u ong , Nga la phohsniew ba de ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold , I stood upon the bank of the river :
Did you buy me anything ?
translation.kha: Phi thied eiei ianga ?
Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingïashun u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Asaïah u khunlung jongno u Ahab u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; dara u shihajar ar sngi ha Samaria .
translation.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .

translation.kha: La Pha ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki la leit shad Antiokh , ha ka ki la lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh jong ki parabangeit bad ki la ai ha ki ïa ka shithi .
translation.en: So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :

translation.kha: Haba pa’ leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khnam jongno pa’ bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,
translation.en: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
For three things the earth is disquieted , and for four which it cannot bear :
translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei ba ka pyrthei da lade kam lah shah :
Kumta nga ïakren dara u markordor , da kaba shatei , bad ym ha ki jingkyntip ; u la ïohi wat ïa ka dur Jong at . Kumno keiñ phi nud Ban kriah pyrshah ïa u Moses u shakor jong nga ?
translation.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth , even apparently , and not in dark speeches  ; and the similitude of the  Lord  shall he behold : wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses ?
If I shut up heaven that there be no rain , or if I command the locusts to devour the land , or if I send pestilence among my people  ;
translation.kha: Man ba nga khang ïa u slap ba un ym hap lane phah ïa ki puit ban bam ïa ki jingthung lane phah ïa ka khlam ha ki briew jong nga ,

translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , The Chaldeans made out three bands , and fell upon the camels , and have carried them away , yea , and slain the servants with the edge of the sword  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Lai kynhun ki nonglute Khaldi ki wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi , ki shim noh ïa ki ut , bad ki pynïap ïa baroh ki shakri jong phi lait sa tang ïa nga . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
Ki shipai jong phi ki jinglute bad ki kyllon ; uei u ainong ïa uwei pat , ‘ Pynkloi ! Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïing shaei ki bynriew jong sem bad ban ïohlait im na ka waitlam u nongshun !’
translation.en: He made many to fall , yea , one fell upon another : and they said , Arise , and let us go again to our own people , and to the land of our nativity , from the oppressing sword .

translation.kha: ban ong ha u , U blei ha uba phi shaniah u la ong ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jongnga nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba de ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lieh dei ban leh shisien shisnem ban pynsuhthied ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumne u Moses u kun , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .
translation.kha: Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga ; me long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka wan .
( Ym shym la don mano mano kiba kitei lut ïa lade ban leh ïa ka bymdei ha kham U Trai kum u Ahab — baroh da ka jingpynïap ka tnga jong u ka Jesebel .
translation.en: But there was none like unto Ahab , which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up .
And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing  ; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season  ; there shall be showers of blessing .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ngan shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha sawdong u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hangta ngan kyrkhu ïa ki da kaba pynhap ïa u  lap praw haba ki donkam ïa u .

Ka dang long mynmiet eh , hynrei u syiem u khie joit na jingthiah nabar u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , nur ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei ba ki Syria ki thmu . Ki tip ba ngi shahthngan hangne , kumto ki mih na la ka jaka shong Dara ba-bang leit rieh ha ki rnong . Ki da pyrkhat ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ban leit wad jingbam bad kumta kin sa kem ïa ngi bad kurup ïa kane ka nongjop .
translation.en: And the king arose in the night , and said unto his servants , I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we be hungry  ; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , When they come out of the city , we shall catch them alive , and get into the city .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , Hattush u syiem Jehiskaïah u la kylla long kumin u khrew uba la pait uba la bret noh bad u bym don ba kwah shuh mano mano ? Hato ka long dat balei ba ma u bad ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri kaba kim tip ei ei ?
translation.en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?

And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingmut bad sheptieng haduh katta ba uwei uwei baroh un kem ïa u briew hajan jong u bad tur ïaleh ïa u .
Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki leh ïa ki kam bieit ; ki briew kiba stad ki long jai jat .
translation.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .

translation.kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kun shit — bad ka longsyiem kumta .
translation.en: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .

translation.kha: te ki Benjamin ki sngewbit ba ki la shahjop . Ki Jerusalem’ Kiba ha khmat eh ki la kynran dien na ki Benjamin namar ba ki shaniah ha Us ki nongbah ba la buh ban apthap baroh sawdong ïa ka Gibeah .
translation.en: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten : for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites , because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah .

translation.kha: La don sa uwei u pukni radbah uba don ki thapniang kaba khraw bad ki snep kiba rben . Bad mynta u dieng shaïong u pyiar ïa la ki thied shwa u malade u la pynphai ïa la ki sla sha u , ha ka jinglehkmen ba un ai ïa u kham bun ka um ban ïa kaba ka don ha ka kper ha kaba u san .
translation.en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers : and , behold , this vine did bend her roots toward him , and shot forth her branches toward him , that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation .

translation.kha: U Potiphar u la sngewbang eh ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u kum u shakri ïa u shait hi ; kumta u buh ïa u ban hir u nongpeit ïa ka ïing ka sem jong u , bad ïa ktien kiei barieh kiba u don .
translation.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .

translation.kha: U tharai u la ong Ka nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sepharbaim , bad ka ñiewbeiñ ïa me .
translation.en: This is the word which the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin , the daughter of Zion , hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri — ha ki lumrit jong ka , ha ki lyngkha kew jong ka , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki brisoh Elul — ha baroh ki jingthung kiba ka khyndew ka pynmih , ha ki briew malu ki mrad , ha baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban pynmeh .
translation.en: And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .

translation.kha: Ha kaweh pat ka jingïohpdiang , U Trai u la pyn-i ha sa ïa u Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh uba ïeng ha khmat u angel jong U Trai . bad hangta hajan jong u Joshua la ïeng u jingjot , kiba la khreh banbeiñ wallam ka jingpynduh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the  Lord  , and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him .
And the sons of Midian  ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Midian ki long u Ephah , u Epher , u Hanokh , u Abida , bad u Eldaah . Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Keturah .
Nongthaw batip ïa kine ki ar tylli ki dieng na thmu ha tduh ha ka kti jong me ba keiñ i kum uwei u dieng .
translation.en: And join them one to another into one stick  ; and they shall become one in thine hand .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u symboh ba U Trai u ong , ‘ Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jrong me ; men ïarep !’ U Elijah u la leh kumba la hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .

translation.kha: Ngan sa ïan sha phi hadien ba nga la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — naba nga dei shun ithuh lyngba ka Makedonia .
translation.en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
But the high places were not taken away out of Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .
translation.kha: Wat la u Asa um shym pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala ha ka ri , u ïailong uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  shi lynter ka jingim jong u .
Hynrei lada phi! ñiew ïa ki briew kat Kum ba ki paw shabar , phi long ba la rem ha ka pop , dara ka hukum ka pynrem ïa phi kum u nongpynkheiñ hukum .
translation.en: But if ye have respect to persons , ye commit sin , and are convinced of the law as transgressors .
And the arches thereof were toward the utter court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof : and the going up to it had eight steps .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung ka long marpyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La oh-shrong ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki kynroh baroh shi lynter ka lynti ïaid . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
Nangta u Adonijah , uba ka kumwei Jong u ka dei ka Haggith , u la leit sha ka Bathsheba , kaba dat ka kumwei jong u Solomon . Hato kane ka dei ka jingwan jngoh kaba sngewtynnat ? Ka dei , u jubor ,
translation.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon . And she said , Comest thou peaceably ? And he said , Peaceably .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien Kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap biang junom , bad hadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translation.en: But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki mrad , wat bthing . Ki jaka phlang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki dieng ki sei ïa la ki soh , dara don khrai ki soh Khubor malu sohwaiñ .
translation.en: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
And there shalt thou build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God , an altar of stones : thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them .
translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan hangta da ki maw ïa kiba ym pat pyndei shniah .

translation.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka kam lyngdoh kaba kham halor ban ïa ka jong ki , kumba ka jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit hapdeng U Blei bad la ki briew ka long kaba kham bha , namar la seng nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa kiei kiei kiba kham bha .

translation.en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,
translation.kha: Nangta u khun shaphang shatei sha Enshemesh bad nangta pat sha Geliloth , marpyrshah ïa ka khim Adummim . Nangta u hiar arsut sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
Lada kata ka prum ka la kylla lieh , uta u briew u hir suba khuid , bad ithuh u lynghoh un pynbna ba Uta u longsem uba khuid .
translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the plague be turned into white  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .

translation.kha: woh ka kynjoh shipai kaban khlaiñ tam jongno u syiem ka Ijipt kdew lah ngab ïahap ïa u ban ïaleh haba ki Nong Ijipt ki twa ki jingtei khyndew bad tih ki kharai khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki brup .
translation.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :

translation.kha: bad u la noh , Nga pyn-i ha me ïa kaei kaba mih na ka jingbitar U Blei kan long . Ka jingïohipaw ka kdew ïa ka por jong ka jingkut .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation : for at the time appointed the end shall be .

translation.kha: U Iso u la ïoh jingtip ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob bad ba u la phah noh! ïa u sha Mesopotamia ban shem ïa ka thngan . U la ïoh jingtip ruh ba haba u Isaak u la ring ïa u , u hukum ba un ym shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
translation.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Paddan–aram , to take him a wife from thence  ; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan  ;

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh bakylluid ka ong , Na ka daw jong phi ki Jiw , ki Jentil ki kren sniew ïa U Blei .
translation.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you , as it is written .

translation.kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki reng u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .
translation.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .

translation.kha: Ai ba ktang wan ïalam shaei ïa u kpa jong phira ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tur ha Ijipt , badno kin ïoh patlun ïa kaba ki donkam .
translation.en: And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .
After a long time the lord of those servants cometh , and reckoneth with them .
translation.kha: Hadien ka por kaba jlan u kynrad jong kito ki shakri u la wan pat bad u la pan jingkheiñ na ki .

U long u khlieh jongno ka balang kaba long ka met jong u ; u long u tynrai jong ka jingim jong ka . U longsem U Khun uba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , khnang ba tang ma u hi un eh ïa ka bynta kaba nongtong ha khie kiei baroh .
translation.en: And he is the head of the body , the church : who is the beginning , the firstborn from the dead ; that in all things he might have the preeminence .

translation.kha: ( U Og u long u syiem uba khatduh na ki Rephaim . Ka jingthiah jong u , kaba la shna da u nar-khang , ka long saw mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka pyngkiang , katjuh kum ka jingthew ba de rukom . Dang ia ba ïohi ïa ka ha ka nongbah Rabbah jong ki Ammon . )
translation.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants  ; behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron  ; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof , and four cubits the breadth of it , after the cubit of a man .
So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban da thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat , ba kin ym ïap . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dei ban bud junom la junom .
Te , lada ka jingbnoh ka paw biah , ka mut ba ka la wan pur bajrong , Bad u trai u dien ban thang noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .
And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
translation.kha: Men ïoh im uba skhem bad uba dap da ka jingkyrmen ; U Blei un ïada bad un ai jingjahthait ïa me .

translation.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath , which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad : and he also delivered Israel .
translation.kha: U nongïalam uba bud u dei u Shamgar , u khun jong u Anath . Une ruh u la pyllait ïa ki Israel , bad u la leh kumta da kaba pynïap hynriewspah ngut ki Philistia da u dieng ñiah masi .

translation.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,
