translation.kha: Ki wallam sha u Moses ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh , ïa ki bnoh jong ka , ïa ki jingker jong ka , ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;

translation.en: Lachish , and Bozkath , and Eglon ,
translation.kha: ka Lakhish , ka Boskath , ka Eglon ,
Ngan har ïa phah khlem ka jingñiewkor bad tap ïa phad da ka jakhlia . Ki briew kin khmih ïa pha ha ka jingsngew jingshyrkhei .
translation.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee , and make thee vile , and will set thee as a gazingstock .

translation.kha: Kam la ki paidbah ki ïa bthah ban ai jingainguh thang ha kiwei ki jaka mane , ki nongkit ïa ki tang sha U Trai .
translation.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places , yet unto the  Lord  their God only .

translation.kha: Kumjuh u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ; ki la pynïap buiñ ngut na ki dara ki la shim ïa ki jingri jongno ki . Bad ka la long kumta ba u Dabid u la pyllait im ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: So David and his men went to Keilah , and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their cattle , and smote them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .
For he knew that for envy they had delivered him .
translation.kha: U la tip bha ba ki rangbah Jiw kiba ha ka bor ki la aiti ïa U Jisu ha u namar ba ki bishni .

hynriew ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki , bun kumta u la shah ïa ki phylliah bad ïa u syiem Moab bad ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai ka nongbah Ishar , ban ïajah pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ban ioh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .

translation.kha: U Jeraïah , u khun lad u Harumaph u ti ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
Behold , the noise of the bruit is come , and a great commotion out of the north country , to make the cities of Judah desolate , and a den of dragons .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka khubor ka wan ! Ka don ka jingkhihwin bakhraw ha ka jaitbynriew bashatei ; ka kynhun shipai jong ka kan pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ka Judah sha ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ki shong ki myrsiang .

translation.en: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
translation.kha: Ka la leit mareh sha u Simon Petros bad sha uwei pat u synran , uba U Jisu u ieit , bad ka la ïathuh ha ki ,  Ki la ïarah noh ïa U Trai na ka jingtep , bad ngim tip hangno ki la ïabuh ïa u !

Kynmaw kumno U Trai U Blei lad phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi ha kiei kiei borbah kiba phi la leh . U la sumar sukher ïa phi haba phi ïaid sakma lyngba kane ka ri shispah kaba ïar . U la don pyntud bad phi ha kine ki sawphew snem , bad phi la ïoh ruh kat ïa kaba phoi donkam .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand : he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness : these forty years the  Lord  thy God hath been with thee  ; thou hast lacked nothing .

translation.kha: ( Ïa u lum Hermon la khot Sirion da ki nongïam Sidon , bad Semar da ki Teman )
translation.en: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion  ; and the Amorites call it Senir  ; )
And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .
translation.kha: la kum ba leh ïa u nongbylla uba trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa u .
Hynrei Kito ki briew kim shahshkor , mala ki ïai bteng ngab bud ïa ki kynsi kaba rim jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .
Purge out therefore the old leaven , that ye may be a new lump , as ye are unleavened . For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us :
translation.kha: Phi dei ban weng noh ïa u thiat barim jong ka pop ba kumta phin long khuid nadong shadong . Te phin long kum kawei pat ka jingkhleh jong u kpu im uba khlem don thiat , kumba da shisha nga tip phi long kumta . Naba ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait la pynkhreh , mynta ïa U Khrist , u khunlangbrot ka Jinglait jong ngi , la lah kñia .
Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ïai-ong ha ka , Khie loit . Kumta kata ka khynnah ka leit malade ka wan ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong jong kito ki nongïalam buaid yn ïuhroit hapoh ki kjat .
translation.en: The crown of pride , the drunkards of Ephraim , shall be trodden under feet :

translation.kha: Ka ong , Hangne ka don ka mraw jong nga ka Bilhah ; thiah dara ka , ba kumta kan ïoh khuid na ka bynta jong nga . Da kane ka rukom ngan ïoh long kmie lyngba jong ka .
translation.en: And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her  ; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her .

translation.kha: Lada u para jong me u har pop pyrshah ïa me , khie leit sha u bad pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingbakla jongngi u . Hynrei leh ïa ka ha kaba jar jar , kumba tang hapdeng para ma phi . Lydda u shakor ïa me , me la ïoh paw ïa la u por .
translation.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee , go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone : if he shall hear thee , thou hast gained thy brother .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïakhun markhmat bad u Moses , bania u briew u ïakren pynlang la u paralok . Nangta u Moses u leit phai shat ka iaka shet dara . Hynrei u samla , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u , u shongsah ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .
For the  Lord  your God is God of gods , and Lord of lords , a great God , a mighty , and a terrible , which regardeth not persons , nor taketh reward :
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long uba khrawbor tam halor ki blei baroh bad halor ki bor baroh . U long uba khraw bad uba donbor , bad uba dei ban sheptieng . U bym ñiewshiliang khmat bad u bym ju pdiang ïa ki jingai kiba da ka dohnud ka bymkhuid .
Ki jingbabe na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïalumlang sa shisien sawdong ïa u Abram bad ki la ïingjaiñ ha kliar uwei u lum .
translation.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner , and became one troop , and stood on the top of an hill .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ieh ïa kata ka jingman ha u pynbah uba dei peit ïa ka smam , u mareh sha ba don ki hynmen , bad u kylli kumno ki ïalong .
translation.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage , and ran into the army , and came and saluted his brethren .
I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .
translation.kha: Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka por jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kaba ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
translation.kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Kan ym khie pat lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .
Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha ka sngi . U la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ïa ki sim baroh kiba her ha shiteng suiñ : Ale pynlang ïapynlong na ka bynta ka jingkhawai kaba khrud jong U Blei !
translation.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun  ; and he cried with a loud voice , saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven , Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God  ;

And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u baroh ki la ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei u kyntait ban shah pyntngen bad u ong ,  Ngan leit noh sha ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong nga .  Kumta u ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u Joseph u khun jong u .
bad haba u la shem ïa uwei uba ohdur tam , u leit bad daiñ lut ïa kaei kaei katba u la don , bad u thied ïa tur u mawlynnai .
translation.en: Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .

translation.kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki blang jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynïap ksiar baroh’ sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .

translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki shah kynting shaei suiñ bad ki ngam shaphang ki jingioieit . Hapdeng kum tala ka jingma ki bri ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ;
translation.en: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .

translation.kha: U Jehoram u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u hir sahmiet ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Joram slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïalap ïa pha , mala kin wei kum ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .

translation.kha: hynne mynta ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Hobab haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .
translation.en: We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
Then if any man shall say unto you , Lo , here is Christ , or there  ; believe it not .
translation.kha: Nangta , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangne U don U Messaïah !’ lane ‘ U don hangtai !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .
Ngan ailad ïa ki nongai ban lute ïa ki , ong U Trai , bad ki nongpynkheiñ aiñ kin shim noh ïa ka shtah jong ki bad pyntngit ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey , and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil  ; and they shall pollute it .

translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa phi na kata baïar kaba pyntngit ïa phi . Ngan hukum ïa u khep ba un bun kyrjaw , Haneng ba phyrnai ym mad thuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .
translation.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .

translation.kha: hynñiew ki riewbymman ki long kum ka duriaw kaba khih phaloh , kiba ki jingat phyllung jong ka kdor ju sangeh , ki Wanrah ïa ka bajakhlia bad ka ktieh .
translation.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea , when it cannot rest , whose waters cast up mire and dirt .

translation.kha: Wat saw sha kaba ki riewsniew ki leit . Kam pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki riewbymman .
translation.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked , and go not in the way of evil men .

translation.kha: Hato U Blei u ai ïa U Mynsiem bad leh ïa ki kambah hapdeng jong phi namar ba phi leh ïa kadei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ne namar ba phi ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad beit ïa ka ?
translation.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki tei ki Ïing kum ka snur thapbawa lane kum ka ra-ngiep u mraw uba ap phira ïa ki Lyngkha .
translation.en: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .

translation.kha: Na ka jait u Kohath ki mih ki longïing jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
And the apostles , when they were returned , told him all that they had done . And he took them , and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai pat bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh . U la ïalam ïa ki bad u , bad ki la ïaleit tang ma ki hi sha ka shnong ba la khot , ka Bethsaida .
hynrei U Blei! u la leh-isynei ïa nga namar ngam pat smam la khong ka jingngeit bad kumta ngam shym tip) ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .
translation.en: Who was before a blasphemer , and a persecutor , and injurious : but I obtained mercy , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .

translation.kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha la leh ; nga tip ba pham hir kaba kriah ne kaba shit . Katno nga kiaw ba phan jin da la long kawei na Us !
translation.en: I know thy works , that thou art neither cold nor hot : I would thou wert cold or hot .

translation.kha: nabar baroh kin pynban shynna ba U Jiw Khristan u long U Trai , ïa ka burom U Blei uba U Kpa .
translation.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
And he taught , saying unto them ,  Is it not written , My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer ? but ye have made it a den of thieves .
translation.kha: Nangta u la hikai ïa u paidbah :  La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh .’ Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh jong ki nongtuh !
U Blei u ong ha u Moses , NGA LONG UBA IA LONG . Kane ka long kaei kaba me dei ban ainong ha ki : ‘ uta ïa uba la Khot UBA neng LONG u phah ïa per sha pa’ .’
translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .

translation.kha: hynrei ki rangbah jngai u Dabid ki ong ha u , Ngi ei bun bah ban bthing hangne ha Judah ; kan longkmie kaba kham sniew dalade I kitei sha Keilah bad tur ïaleh ïa ki kynthup ïamih jong ki Philistia !
translation.en: And David s men said unto him , Behold , we be afraid here in Judah : how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ?

translation.kha: Ki nongïam Beten Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan haba ki khmied ki la ïohi ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen hir ki ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .
So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khrist , bad la pynïasoh iwei bad iwei pat kum ki dkhot bapher jong kawei ka met .
Ka longsyiem kaba dem ban ym bam doh , dih waiñ , lane Ban leh kano Kanah ka don pynlong ïa la u parabangeit ban kylleng ne .
translation.en: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .

translation.kha: Lada kata ka prum ka la kylla lieh , uta u bynriew u long uba khuid , bad uta u lyngdoh un pynbun ba uta u long uba khiah .
translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the plague be turned into white  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .

translation.kha: Haba u syiad u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingurlong na kata ka kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the law , that he rent his clothes .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , A Trai nongshukor , me erlangthari U Blei ; me ju ïai bat ïa la ki kular , bad me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kli kaba phylla .
translation.en: And now , O Lord  God  , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :

translation.kha: Haba ki jingbrai kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u ïakob u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha khmat jong ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin ïap shaba khun hapdeng kita ki Tnat dieng .
translation.en: And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .

translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki ryngkoh kum ki blang ; ki lumrit , ki kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot .
translation.en: The mountains skipped like rams , and the little hills like lambs .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ruh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki brai kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbsa jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewburom ïa baroh kiwei bapaw .
translation.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .
translation.kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïah u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrdan kaba ar ïa u syiem .
U Trai u la mih da shisha ! U la paw ha u Simon !
translation.en: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom la pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jong i'u ?
translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?

translation.kha: Ngi ryntih ïa ka jingkhlaiñ ka jinglong samla badno me burom ïa u ñiuhlieh ka jinglong bymman .
translation.en: The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .

translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba pynbun ïa me keiñ wan sha nga — kito baroh kiba tip ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .
O my mountain in the field , I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil , and thy high places for sin , throughout all thy borders .
translation.kha: bad halor ki lumbah ha ka rudnong bym don jingkah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong phi namar ki pop baroh kiba phi la leh ha kylleng ka ri jong phi .
Ym don jingjngem lano uno a u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti bakynjang .
translation.en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .

translation.kha: Ka jingïohipaw kaba khulom ka jingïalam U Blei ka long ka jaitbynriew ka bym ïaid beit . A suk uta u briew uba sumar ïa ka hukum U Bela !
translation.en: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .

translation.kha: dien ki briew naba da jaipdeh woh ban tian jingbam ha la ki jongki ki shrong .
translation.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingshahshitom jongnga Kita ki sngi kan long kabu kham sngur , ban ïa kaei kaei Kaba ka pyrthei ka la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei haduh ka par ba mynsiem . Lym yn ym don sha hadien kum kata kaei kaei .
translation.en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .

translation.kha: Baroh ar nongput ki la kiew halor ka lieng , bad ka lyer ka la Sangeh .
translation.en: And when they were come into the ship , the wind ceased .

translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïing thymmai , kynram banbeiñ da ker ïa ka tduh jong ka tnum ïing , ïoh Phi hap kit pop salia ine uno u briew u hap Nangta bad u ïap .
translation.en: When thou buildest a new house , then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof , that thou bring not blood upon thine house , if any man fall from thence .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar lad u , hadien ba u la pynbuaid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut nep ïa ka jingumsnam Blei’ thala , u Syiem Josaïah u phah lai ngut ki ïabah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U Trai U Blei : u Shaphir u khun jong u Asalaïah , Maaseïah , u lat ka Jeroboam , bad u Jehoash u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .

translation.kha: To ïa-ap nabar to Duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshong . Ka mynsiem ka mon , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .
translation.en: Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .

translation.kha: Ki pynbiang ïa ki syiem jong ka Hit bad ka Samaria da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , da kaba die ïa ki kha ïapom ha ka dor hynriewspah ki sbai saw kawei bad ïa ki kulai ha ka dor shiah sanphew ki sbai rupa uwei .
translation.en: And they fetched up , and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , by their means .

And he cried mightily with a strong voice , saying , Babylon the great is fallen , is fallen , and is become the habitation of devils , and the hold of every foul spirit , and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam :  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Mynta ka la long ka jaka shong ki ksuid bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ; baroh ki jait sim kiba jakhlia bad kiba isaitmet ki shong ha ka .

translation.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lehse don sawphew san ngut ha ka jaka sanphew ngut kiba hok . Hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei namar ba duna san ngut ?  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym pynjot noh ïa ka lada nga shem sawphew san ngut kiba hok .

Mynta , ma nga U Tiras Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ki Israel ba ngan bishar ïa phi iwei pa wai da kaei kaba phi la leh . To phai noh na kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh , bad wat shah ba ka pop jong phi kan pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore I will judge you , O house of Israel , every one according to his ways , saith the Lord  God . Repent , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions  ; so iniquity shall not be your ruin .

translation.kha: Me smam ba u ïaishah ha me , bad me pynurlong ka jingïathiah kular bad u . Me kular ban ai ha u ïa ka ri ki Kanaan , ka ri jongki ki Hit bad ki Leah , ka ri ki Persia , ki Jebus bad ki Haggith , kan longkmie ka ri ha kaba ki khun ki kyiuh jong u kin shong kin sah . Me bat ïa la ka kular , namar me long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee , and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites , to give it , I say , to his seed , and hast performed thy words  ; for thou art righteous :

translation.kha: Te U blang u pynpeit ïa ki khmat jongu ka , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka pukri um . Ka la leit ban pyndap um ïa kata ka pla snieh bad ka la ai um ïa uta khynnah ba un dei .
translation.en: And God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water  ; and she went , and filled the bottle with water , and gave the lad drink .
Behold , I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire , and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work  ; and I have created the waster to destroy .
translation.kha: Nga la thaw ïa u nongshoh-nar , uba pyrsad ïa ka ding bad shna ïa ki tiar thma . Nga la thaw ruh ïa u shipai , uba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ïapom ban pynïap .
Nga la sheptieng ïa ka jingtur shla U Trai , naba u la bitar lep kat Haduh ba u la kloi wat ban pynjot ïa phi ; hynrei sa shisien U Trai u la shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure , wherewith the  Lord  was wroth against you to destroy you . But the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also .
For God commanded , saying , Honour thy father and mother : and , He that curseth father or mother , let him die the death .
translation.kha: Namar U Blei u la ong , ‘ To burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad ‘ Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .’

translation.en: And David s anger was greatly kindled against the man  ; and he said to Nathan , As the  Lord  liveth , the man that hath done this thing shall surely die :
translation.kha: U Dabid u bitar lep ïa u riewspah bad u ong ,  Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba u briew uba la leh ïa kane u dei ban ïap !
Baroh ki briew ki la pyrshang ban ktha ïa u , naba ka bor ka la mian na u malu ka da pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .

translation.kha: Katba u Pilat u dang shon ha ka khem ïingbishar , ka tnga jong u ka la phah khubor sha u : wat leh ei ei ïa uto u briew uba lui lui , namar ba ha ka jingphohsniew hynne mynmiet nga la shahshitom shikatdei eh na ka bynta Jong u .
translation.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat , his wife sent unto him , saying , Have thou nothing to do with that just man : for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him .

translation.kha: Bad kano ïano ka briew kaba dulir ne pynbna ïa ka khublei U blang ha ka jingïamane Blang lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khleh ka pynjahburom ïa la u tnga ; kam don jingïapher hapdeng jong ka bad ka briew kaba la khi noh ïa la ka khlei .
translation.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head : for that is even all one as if she were shaven .

translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba don Hangne phoi daiñ ki Israel . Kaei ngin leh ha kambah ïadei bad kane ?
translation.en: Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .
And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang noh , ki synran ki la wan ha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka por ka dier palat , bad kane ka dei ka jaka kynjah .

translation.en: And the napkin , that was about his head , not lying with the linen clothes , but wrapped together in a place by itself .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen kiba la don hangta , bad ïa ka jaiñ kaba spaiñ ïa ka khlieh U Jisu . Kane kam shym don lang bad ki jaiñsop linen hynrei kaba la kli ïa ka jong .
Da kumwei pateng , ki la ïor ba U blem u la ai ha nga ïa ka kur ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jentil , kumba u la ai ha u Petros ïa ka kam ka jingïatiplem ïa ka Angel ha ki Jiw .
translation.en: But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;

translation.kha: Hynrei baroh na ngi , ngi la kloi ban kitei sha ka thma hapoh ka hukum jongno U Tiras . Ngin jam sha shikhung ka Jordan bad ïalaw , kumba phi la ong .
translation.en: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the  Lord  to battle , as my lord saith .

translation.kha: Kñia ruh uwei u langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , malu ha kane ka rukom pynmihpat ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And one kid of the goats , to make an atonement for you .
And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh kata ka thain ; bad shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la wallam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiah ha ki jingthiah jong ki .

U syiem Ahab u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jongnga ka ri bad u ong , Phin ïor ba une u bhabriew u kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . U la phah khor sha nga da kaba dap ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong nga , ïa ka reng bad ka ksiar jong nga bad nga la mynjur .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .

translation.kha: bad ka Esther ka ai ïa kane ka khubor ngab leit rah pat sha u Miphkad :
translation.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi nabar ki nongpynkhiah ka Hukum ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Balei ba ki synran jong me kim bud ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , hynrei pynban ki bam da ki kti bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ?
translation.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?

translation.kha: A Trai , nga la wan ha me ban eh jingïadei ; wat shah da lin lei ba ngan shahjop !
translation.en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .

translation.kha: Mano ba ai um ïa ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , ba kumta u phlang u mih ?
translation.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u shna shi kynhun ki lynnong ha Enshemesh , kaba hajan Elealeh , harud jong ka Khmut duriaw Akaba , ha ka ri Emim .
translation.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .

translation.kha: U shim shi jurip ki masi lur , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki bad u Phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel ryngkat bad kane ka jingma : katne u me bur ïa u Saul bad u Samuel sha ka thma , kumne yn ni ïa ki masi lur jong u . Te ki bastad Israel ki suiñbneng her ïa kaei ba un bor U Trai , bad baroh khlem lait uwei ruh , ki ïawan mih ryntih lai baroh .
translation.en: And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
And they said unto him , We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it . And Joseph said unto them , Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew la ka jong ka jong ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano hangne u ban batai ïa ka jingmut ki .  Te u Joseph u ong ,  Dei U Blei uba ai ka jinglah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew . To ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingphohsniew jong phi .
Ynda ki la mihnoh na sakma ka jaka , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Abarim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ïathuh ïa kine ki pharshi , u la iehnoh ïa kata ka jaka

To kynmaw ïa ka Simon bad Gomorrah , bad ki shnong ba-bang , ha kaba ki briew ki imat kumba la kun Kito ki angel bad ki kyrsum ha ki jinglwet nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki shah ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka ding bymjukut kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh .
translation.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .

translation.kha: Kat kaba nga kren ka dei ka jingshisha , ha na ki kti lamler ki long babha ijli .
translation.en: For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .

translation.kha: Dei u nong Krit hi , uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , uba la kren-ïa ïa ka jingriam mynba u la ong , Ki nong Khrist ki longïng borabor kaba lamler , ki riewkhlaw bymman , bad ki jlawnguid bajaipdeh .
translation.en: One of themselves , even a prophet of their own , said , The Cretans are alway liars , evil beasts , slow bellies .

translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlem bad ki la ïa-ïeng prie ma ki , Ki jait ktien aïu kine ? Da ka iktiar bad ka bor une u briew u ai ki hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkut , bad ki ïamihnoh !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .

translation.kha: Thaw ruh ïa ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tukri ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïing ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ïohnang hangamei , Kaba kynthup ïa ki Israel kiba shong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u paidbah babun baroh — ki ong ha nga ,
translation.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Te u Moses lem Bad ki nongïaleh Israel , ki ong ha uta u paidbah , khongpong ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .
Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
translation.kha: Uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit lem bad me .  Hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , u da ong ,
Men sa ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangne trai ïoh ka jingshlur ban tuh ïaleh . Kumta u Gideon bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit hiar sha ka tnaw jong ka bakwah sher bun jongngi ki nongshun .
translation.en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .

translation.kha: ( Ki la ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Troas uba na Ephesos ryngkat dara u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalam ïa u shapoh ka templ . )
translation.en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )

translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi halor u lum Seïon ; to ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingiashah jingit bad khot ïa ka jingïaseng bthah !
translation.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :

translation.kha: Babha ka Israel ka ïohi haduh katno ka pang jubor bad haba ka Judah ka ïohi ïa la ki jingmong , nangta ki Israel ki wait sha Asasaïah ba-bang pan jingïarap na u syier uba khrawbor , hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ïa ki Lane pynkhie ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
translation.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la Tap ïa ki jaiñkup jngai ki halor u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor Jong u .
translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .

translation.kha: U syiem Jehosheba u shna ïa ki liengbah ban ïaid ha ïarwai sha ka ri Omri pun wad ksiar ; isynei ki la pyntieng ha Esiongeber bad kim shym lah ïaid shuh .
translation.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold : but they went not  ; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber .
And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong skhem ïa u bad phah noh ïa kumta hi ,
Kuth ki la kem ïa U Jisu bad ki la batskhem ïa u .
translation.en: And they laid their hands on him , and took him .
I know you have it with you .
translation.kha: Nga tip phi don maphi kato .
Akaba pynkhaw-eit ka jingsngewthuh kaba katta katta ïa phi , hynrei kam bha . Hooid , kin kynja ia phi , lah dom phin pynsniew iaki .
translation.en: They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .

translation.kha: Ki buh basanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka sut kaba nongdih , bad sa sanphew tyllun pat ha ka rmiang lad ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khat , ba la suh lang ha ka sut kaba ar . Kita ki kyrwoh ki ïaphai marbl .
translation.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa kata ka prum ha ka sngi kaba khyndew , bad ïada kam pat pur lane ym ba-don u sngewkyiuh uba lam stem ha ka , bad kam paw hima ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka ,
translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague : and , behold , if the scall spread not , and there be in it no yellow hair , and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin  ;

translation.kha: A Trai U Blei , to pyndep ïa ka kylluid kaba me la ong ha u kjap jong nga . Me la pynlong syiem ïa de hajir u paidlang wahbah bun katta main kat hapoh ba ym ha ban ñiew , kumta to ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba nga donakor ban synshar ïa ki .
translation.en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .

translation.kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki tare pynkhreh jong moi baroh kiba u don ha ka jingput ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra sawdong jong ki dara ïa ki kamra pahuh ïa ki thir jong ka Telem , bad ïa ki jingshai sngewbha ba la pynkyntang shat U Trai .
translation.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .
translation.kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ai ïa kiwei ki san hajar . ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga san hajar tylli ki sbai ,’ u la ong . ‘ Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa san hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’

U Tharai un pynroi kyrhai ïa phi kat ha kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh kyrhai ki khun ki kti bad kyrhai ki jinglur , dara ki lyngkha jong phi ruh kin pynmih kyrhai . Un da sngewbit eh ban pynbha ïa phi kamra u la sngewbha ban pynmanbha ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ;
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy land , for good : for the  Lord  will again rejoice over thee for good , as he rejoiced over thy fathers :

translation.kha: Katba dang wallam ïa ka Synduk shapoh ka nongbah , ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , ka la peit na ka jingkhangïit bad ka la ïohi ïa u Susim Dabid ba u shai bad kynthih kyrteng sawdong ha ka jingshad bakyntang , bad ka la i ngiah ïa u .
translation.en: And as the ark of the  Lord  came into the city of David , Michal Saul s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the  Lord   ; and she despised him in her heart .
And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in Samaria : and Joash his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jehoash u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
To ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , to ong ha ki : Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  unto these bones  ; Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and ye shall live :

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la otsher ryngkat bad ki paid Simeon , bad ki la jop ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Shet . Ki la buh ka jingtim hiar ka nongbeh , ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad ki la ai kyrtong ïa ka , ka Harumaph .
translation.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .

translation.kha: khie leit noh sha ïing bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta jong me . Uta u briew u la leit lyngba ïa ka sheng , u da ïathuh ïa kai kaba U Jisu u la leh na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .

translation.kha: thawsha ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot janai kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sboh , pynlang uba rong saw . Shuh pynpur itynnat ha ki ïa ka dik ki kherub .
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .
And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .
translation.kha: Ma ka , ka long shisha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khun jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga ; bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .
bad ka la shim ïa ki na u kiaw shait na ka bynta jong u ban bam , hynriew um treh . U ong , Phah noh sharak ïa iwei pa iwei baroh — bad baroh ki la mihnoh .
translation.en: And she took a pan , and poured them out before him  ; but he refused to eat . And Amnon said , Have out all men from me . And they went out every man from him .

translation.kha: Ma nga hi ngan sah ha Mispah bad ngan long u nongmihkhmat jongki phiah haba ki nong Babilonia kin wiang shane . Hynrei phi lah ban lwa bad kynshew ïa ka waiñ , ki soh , bad ka umphniang Olib , bad ban shong ban sah ha la ki shnongrit ba phin don .
translation.en: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us : but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil , and put them in your vessels , and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .

I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit : and all the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba nga phah ïa u shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyllon jong u , kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ki jaitbynriew . Baroh ki dieng ha Eden bad ki dieng baroh kiba kynsai , kiba la ïoh um bha jong ka Lebanon kiba la leit sha ka pyrthei shapoh kin sa sngewkmen ha ka jingkyllon jong u .
Mynta , haba baroh kiba la ïap , kin sa mihpat ha kata ka sngi ka jingmihpat , ka tnga jongno lai long ? Baroh kita ki khyndew ngut ki la lah shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .

translation.kha: Ki ainong , U Blei u la ioh ïa u ; ïa ngin ïabeh bad kem ïa u ; ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa u .
translation.en: Saying , God hath forsaken him : persecute and take him  ; for there is none to deliver him .

translation.kha: hynñiew u Paul u la leit hiar , bad u la dem tyllep halor jong u bad u la kdang ïa u . Wat khuslai , u la ong , u dang im !
translation.en: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves  ; for his life is in him .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la pyndap khynwin ïa ka jaka ha ka phan mihngi jong ka nongbah , hadien ba ka tnga jong u , ka khun jrong u syiem ka ri Ijipt , ka la wan kynriah na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka jingïamai kiba u Solomon u la tei na ka bynta jong ka .
translation.en: But Pharaoh s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her : then did he build Millo .
So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .
translation.kha: U Jakob u wan poi bad la ki briew baroh ha Lus , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la pyrshang ban ai ïa u ïa ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka jingdih ba la khot ka mirr , hynrei U Jisu um dih ïa ka .
U Absalom u la shong ar snem ha Jerusalem khlem ïohi ïa u syiem .
translation.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem , and saw not the king s face .

translation.kha: Nangta U Bela u la pynlong ïa u Abimelekh bad ïa ki rangbah ka shem ban ïashun iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ki la ïajah pyrda ïa u .
translation.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem  ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech :

translation.kha: Kana ka long ka hukum kaba khraw tam bad kaba donkam tam .
translation.en: This is the first and great commandment .

translation.kha: U briew umbah shong hangta u Jobab , Kumno shaphang film kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa jrong ki , ki dei kiei ? Dei kumta ba la mihngi ka jingong , Haseroth wat u Saul ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
translation.en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?

translation.kha: U Moses u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershom bad u Elieser .
translation.en: The sons of Moses were , Gershom , and Eliezer .

translation.kha: Ngan ïeng namar kane ka nongbah malade ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .’
translation.en: For I will defend this city , to save it , for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ot , phin ai Shi bynshet na ka san bynta ha u syiem , mala kaba kamar-tama synsar beit kan longïing ka jong phi , ba phin ieh buh thymmai , bad ba phin ïoh jingbam na ka pyntha ïa lade sad ïa ki ba-beit ha-sem jong phi .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase , that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh , and four parts shall be your own , for seed of the field , and for your food , and for them of your households , and for food for your little ones .

translation.kha: khlur u lum uba sha mihngi na Jerusalem u tei ka jaka manla ïa u Khemosh , u blei bajai jong ki Moab , bad ka jaka mane ïa u Moreh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translation.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: te to ai ba ka tnga jongngi nga kan shet ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta uwei pat u briew bad ban thiah ha ka jingïaishah jong uwei pat .
translation.en: Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her .

translation.kha: na Phrygia pynlang na Pamphylia , na Ijipt bad na ki thain ka Libya hajan ka Kyrini . Katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Rimmon ,
translation.en: Phrygia , and Pamphylia , in Egypt , and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene , and strangers of Rome , Jews and proselytes ,
And when the time was that Elkanah offered , he gave to Peninnah his wife , and to all her sons and her daughters , portions :
translation.kha: Man ka por ba u Elkanah u kñia ainguh , u ju ai shi bynta na ka doh ha ka Peninnah bad shi bynta ha uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki kti jong ka .
U Dabid u kylli ïa u jingkup uba la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor , Me dei uba na-ei ? U jubab , Neng dei u Nong Abimelekh , hynrei nga shong ha ka ri jong ph .
translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , Whence art thou ? And he answered , I am the son of a stranger , an Amalekite .

translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha , hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym don lynti shuh da kumno kumno don pynbang paw ïa ka .
translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ym don ba la sopkjat spaiñ ïa ka lynti pynïaid ïa ka khnang ba kan ïohktah bad ban khlaiñ kat ban lah don ba-bang biang ïa ka waitlam .
translation.en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and , lo , it shall not be bound up to be healed , to put a roller to bind it , to make it strong to hold the sword .

translation.kha: wiat hadien ba ngi la poi ha Makedonia , ngiah shym la ïoh shongksuid . Ki la ni ki jingjynjar ha khyllung sawdong , ki jingïakajia bad kiwei pat , ki jingsheptieng ha ki dohnud jong ngi .
translation.en: For , when we were come into Macedonia , our flesh had no rest , but we were troubled on every side ; without were fightings , within were fears .
This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad ban ngeit .
U Tom u hap na lybong kmie jyllang u .
translation.en: Tom fell off his mother's lap .
Then I arose , and went forth into the plain : and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  stood there , as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar : and I fell on my face .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit sha ka them , bad hangta nga ïohi ïa ka burom U  Trai  , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka harud ka wah Khebar .
Wat leh ei ei na ka jingkhwan myntoi lane na ka jingkwah bymsngewsynei ban sngewsarong , hynmen , to long kiba sngewbitar iwei ïa iwei pat , kiba ñiew borabor ïa kiwei kiba kham bakha ban ïa laiñ .
translation.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .

translation.kha: Uta u siewspah u la ong , ‘ Kumta to jingkyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jong nga , ha kaba nga ei synran ngut ki hynriew ki para shynrang .
translation.en: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :

translation.kha: Nangta ka ïingbishar ba kynja bneng kan shong bishar , kan knieh noh ïa ka bor jong u bad pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translation.en: But the judgment shall sit , and they shall take away his dominion , to consume and to destroy it unto the end .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jongu ki lyngdoh te um shym thied . Kim donkam ban die ïa la ka khyndew namar ba ki ïoh ka baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da tala .
translation.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid nabar ki ïabah jong u ki la sdang ban khem ïa ka Jordan , badno kat ban da kynta shai mynstep , baroh ki la tad lut shat shiliang .
translation.en: Then David arose , and all the people that were with him , and they passed over Jordan : by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan .

translation.kha: “Nga la ïohsngew ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u ni hapoh jong me bad ba me long kiba btuit bad me don ka jingap pynlang ka jingstad .
translation.en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .
But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la shaniah ïa lade ha ki , namar ba u la tip ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Only fear the  Lord  , and serve him in truth with all your heart : for consider how great things he hath done for you .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad shakri hok ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab , u Abimelekh u khot lang ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , bad u ïathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh .

translation.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .
translation.kha: Na Miletos u Paul u la phah khubor sha Ephesos , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki nongsharai balang    , ban ïakynduh ïa u .
Lum kumno baroh kin tip ba phi long u i lah ban Put ïa kiei kiei kiba rieh malu phin ym lah ngab lait na Kane ka jinglehieit .
translation.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .

translation.kha: Katba u daiñ im , ki briew ha kylleng ka Judah bad Israel , ki im ha ka jingtyngshaiñ , kawei kawei ka longïing ka don la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur .
translation.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely , every man under his vine and under his fig tree , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , all the days of Solomon .

translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ka para jong u Adam haduh ka por jong u Moses , ka jingtep ka synrai halor u bynriew baroh , wat halor kito ki bym shym la leh pop! ha ka rukom kumba u Man u la leh mynba um shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei . U Adam u la long ka dur jongno utai u ban sa wan .
translation.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .

translation.kha: Bad mynnin um long shuh tang kum u mraw , hynrei kham palat ban ïa u mraw : u long u para ba-ieit ha U Khrist . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Susah katno khrong un longsem uba kor ïa me , kum u mraw bad kum u para ha u Trai !
translation.en: Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
This gate of the  Lord  , into which the righteous shall enter .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khyrdop jong U  Trai  ; tang kiba hok ki lah ban rung shapoh .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jied ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me , ki Lebi , napdeng ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
Ko ki briew ka Hasor , ma at , U Trai , nga maham ïa phin ban phet noh bad baneh loit riew . U Nebusaradan , u syiem ka Babilonia u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , bad kane ka dei kaei kaba u noh ,
translation.en: Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor , saith the  Lord   ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you , and hath conceived a purpose against you .

translation.kha: Phi ïohi katno ki dak heh nga pynlong hajan to thoh shiah pa’ mynta da la ka jrong ka pdiang!
translation.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .

translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban kubur ba phi la shem ïa ka jingstad ? U Blei u den u ban jubab ïa u Jobab , naba phim Shim lah leh ei ei .
translation.en: Lest ye should say , We have found out wisdom : God thrusteth him down , not man .

translation.kha: Bad u briew u kham kor bun shah ïa-ban ïa ka langbrot ! Kumjuh te , ka Aiñ jong me ka shah ïa ngi ngab ïabeh ïano nangno ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .

translation.kha: Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob laiñ bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawad ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka nemsniew ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki baïap , u la leit sha Kapernam .
translation.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man s wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power :
translation.kha: Kumta haba nga la wan sha phi , nga la long uba tlot bad uba kyiuh baroh shi rynïeng da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka jinghikai bad ka khubor jong nga ym shym la pynïoh da ki ktien batbit jong ka jingstad briew , hynrei da ka jingpynshisha baskhem jong ka bor U Mynsiem U Blei .
Hynrei u Ittai u jubab , Ko Syiem kynrad , nga smai ha phi ha ka kyrthat U Trai ba ngan ïai leit nabar phi kat shaba phi rupa , wat la ka dei ban ïap .
translation.en: And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .

translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakhana para ma ki . U syiem Arbad u la pyllun im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , ki ïa-ei uwei ïa uwei pat . U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iohnong ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la kren baïong ha nga , bad u la ong ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,

translation.kha: Bad mynsiem kaba ap ïa nga ka long ka kyang jong ka jingjop ïa kaba la thuh beit da U Blei naba U Trai , u nongbishar bahok , u ban ai ha nga ha kata ka Sngi — ym tang ïa nga , Hynrei ïa kito baroh kiba ap ïa u da ka jingieit ba un wanpaw .
translation.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa nga ban otsher sha ka ïing u syiem Judah , u khun Jong u ksiew jong u ïabuaid , bad kren hangta ïa u syiem , ïa ki rangbah pynsynjor bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong :
translation.en: And say , Hear the word of the  Lord  , O king of Judah , that sittest upon the throne of David , thou , and thy servants , and thy people that enter in by these gates :
For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong me ; nga pynkhlaiñ ïa me bad nga ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’

naduh ka jingpynim ïa u Abel haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u sakhrai , uba la shah pynpei khappud ka duwan bad ka Jaka bakynjang . Ho-oid , nga ong ha Phi , ba ïa ki briew jyllang kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta jong ki baroh !
translation.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias , which perished between the altar and the temple : verily I say unto you , It shall be required of this generation .

translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab , Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Israel ba ki sakma ha ki lum kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Bad U Trai u ong , ‘ Kine ki ngab kim don nongïalam ; ai kin leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba suk .’
translation.en: And he said , I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills , as sheep that have not a shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master : let them return every man to his house in peace .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u syiem Joram u mihnoh na Samaria bad u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jongngi u baroh .
translation.en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time , and numbered all Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u pynbna sha baïar ki paid Israel , Lymda pa’ ai ïa ka jingïamynjur jong phira bad lada ka dei ka mon U Trai U Blei jong ngi , to ai ba ngin ïaphah nonglamktien sha kiwei pat ki para ri jong ngi bad sha ki lyngkhuh bad ki Lebi ha ki shnong jrong ki , bad ïathuh ïa ki ban ïalong hangne badno ngi .
translation.en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you , and that it be of the  Lord  our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us :
Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth , I did stamp them as the mire of the street , and did spread them abroad .
translation.kha: Nga pynlwet ïa ki , bad ki kylla long kum u pui pui , nga ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa ka ktieh ha ki lynti .
Nangta u angel uba ar u la put ïa la ka Tur . Ïa kaei re khie kaba i kum u lawbah umbah khriat kiba sheptieng la brai sha duriaw .
translation.en: And the second angel sounded , and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea : and the third part of the sea became blood  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u phah ïa ka khubor kaba ïong ha u syiem Hesekaïah Kum ka Jobab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .
translation.kha: katba kita kiba stad ki la rah ïa la ki jingdiang ba la pyndap da ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak jong ki .
Hynrei ki la ïa-bishni khlam jur shuh Shuah , Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhiah hapdeng ki bri ha barben kylleng ka Judia . U la shadong ha ijakhlia bad mynta u la poi hangne .
translation.en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .

translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid khih ïa ka kad khaweh jong u .
translation.en: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .

translation.kha: U Jonah u la jyllop , Bret nep ïa nga sha ka duriaw , Bad kan sa long jai jai . Nga tip ka dei ka jingleh bymdei jong nga ba phi la ngeit ha kane ka erïong kaba jur .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Take me up , and cast me forth into the sea  ; so shall the sea be calm unto you : for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you .
And the soldiers led him away into the hall , called Praetorium  ; and they call together the whole band .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu shapoh sha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingshong u lat bad ki la khot lang ïa baroh ki shipai ba dang sah jong ka kynhun .
hynrei ïa ki jaka mane ba-thala ym shym la pynjot . Ki briew kim patar shym la phai da ka dohnud baroh ïa-ban shakor ïa U Blei lad ki kop tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ; Lada ph ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,
translation.en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa kaei kiba U Blei’ un ai ha ka jingkut , bad kumjuh u la kren shaphang ka jingtep jong U Mareshah haba u ong , ‘ Ym shym la iehnoh ïa u ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; ka met jongu u kai shym la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’
translation.en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ , that his soul was not left in hell , neither his flesh did see corruption .

translation.kha: Nga lah thngan
translation.en: I am hungry
Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the  Lord  ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh palat , nga lah ban ong ba ngam donkam ïa me . Hynrei lada nga kyrduh pat , nga lah ban tuh bad pynjahburom ïa U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ ka khyndew jong u Ephron kaba ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , ka kylla long ka jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba don hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .
Haba u Josis u la wan ha ki mynstep , u la iohi ba ki leh dait .
translation.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ino ïa ki , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , namar ba ka long kaba eh ban hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .

translation.kha: Nangta u thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ki khyllai , bad ïa ka bynta bakynsai tam jong u dohnud , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: But the fat , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver of the sin offering , he burnt upon the altar  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Kumba U Troas U Blei Jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abbim , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kaweh khong ki shnong naba heh bad kiba pahuh pahai kiba phim shym la tei .
translation.en: And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang . Nga la phohsniew sa kawei pud ka jingphohsniew , ha kaba nga la Ïohi ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïatong ïa nga .
translation.en: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .

translation.kha: Namar kane , u Mesha um shym lah ban ithuh shok shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew u isih ïa ka jingshai bad un ym wan sha ka jingshai , namar um kwah ba ïa ki kam sniew jong u yn paw .

translation.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag , and thou sewest up mine iniquity .
translation.kha: Men map ïa ki bad men weng noh sharud ïa ki ; men ñiad noh ïa ki jingbakla baroh ba nga la leh .

translation.en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep .
translation.kha: U briew uba rung shapoh lyngba ka jingkhang u long u nongap jong ki langbrot .
Nga la aiti ha phi ïa kaei kaba at la ïohpdiang , kaba long kaba donkam tam : Ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bniat ki pop jong ngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;
translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka Templ , u tei ïa ki duwan na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa ki khlur .
“Nga tip ph don maphi kato .
translation.en: I know you have it with you .

translation.kha: Ka jingshem jong to ka la hir ka nuksa ïa kiba bad , namar me la un-long ka jingïada bakhlaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: I am as a wonder unto many  ; but thou art my strong refuge .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u ding uba la khet U Jingsngewbha bad nga la kdang ïa u , ban pyndam noh ïa ka jutang kabu U thri u la pynlong bad ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .

translation.kha: Kine ki shnong baroh ki long kiba la kerkut skhem da ki kynroh kiba jrong , ki khyrdop , nabar ki nar-khang khyrdep , bad don ruh bun ki shnong ki bym kein kynroh .
translation.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars  ; beside unwalled towns a great many .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la nguh ha u , Emim kren ei ei ha nga ? To kynduh , to to ka bor shun pyllait ïa me dara ruh ban phah sahnarphna ïa me .
translation.en: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?

translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang shathie kiba dei ki jong ki , kito kiba ïasan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,
translation.en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , pa ruh phi dei ban shadkmen , bad ïamih pyntwa lem ïa ka jingkmen jong phi pynlang nga .
translation.en: For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness , and all kings thy glory : and thou shalt be called by a new name , which the mouth of the  Lord  shall name .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba pha ïoh ka jingjop ! bad ki syiem jong ki baroh kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong pha . Yn khot ïa pha da ka kyrteng kaba thymmai , ka kyrteng ba U  Trai  hi u ai .
Te myntor , A Trai , kat kumin ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka pynbha ka pop jong kine ki bariew dom me la map ïa ki naduh ba ki la mih na Joppa .
translation.en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .

translation.kha: U teh ïa u khun kai ha u dieng sohwaiñ Ha u diengsoh sohwaiñ uba bha tad ; U sait ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka um sohwaiñ , kaba saw snam .
translation.en: Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass s colt unto the choice vine  ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :
Grace be with you , mercy , and peace , from God the Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong U Kpa , un ai ha ngi ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk ; to ai ba kin long ki jong ngi ha ka jingshisha bad ka jingieit .

translation.en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city , and all the labours thereof , and all the precious things thereof , and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies , which shall spoil them , and take them , and carry them to Babylon .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ruh ba ki nongshun jong ki kin lute ïa baroh ka spah jong kane ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh , wat ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad kit noh ïa kiei kiei baroh sha Babilonia .

translation.en: Then said the high priest , Are these things so ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa u Stephan ,  Hato kane ka dei kaba shisha ?
Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shong lad phira ïa u shynrang lane ka kynthei kiba la leh pop pyrshang ïa U Tharai bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jrong lad u ,
translation.en: If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,
Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .
translation.kha: Ko nong Galilaïa , balei phi ïa-ïeng hangne da kaba khmied sha ka sahit bneng ? Une U Jisu , ïa uba la shim noh sha bneng na phi , un wan pat ha kajuh ka rukom ba phi la ïohi ba u kiew sha bneng .
Nga ïaid lyngba ki lyngkhai bad ki bnai sohwaiñ jong u briew uba alhia , uba mutlop .
translation.en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;

translation.kha: Ki la pyrshang pun kem ïa u , hynmen u la phet lyngkhuit , da ka iehnoh ïa ka jaiñ shajan jong u .
translation.en: And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .

translation.kha: Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ jong phi keiñ dap da ki sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
And the saying pleased the king and the princes  ; and the king did according to the word of Memucan :
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar ki la sngewtynnat ïa kata ka jingai jingmut , bad u syiem u la leh ïa kaei kaba u Memukan u la ai jingmut .

Wat ïa-wohnia para ma pa’ , ko parabangeit jongngi nga . Uno un uba ruma ïa u parabangeit ne gospel ïa u , u wohnia ïa ka Law bad u bishar ïa ka . Lada phin bishar ïa ka Hukum , te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , hynriewphew uwei uba bishar ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi ki Ken pher sa shah pynjot thiaw Ynda u Assyria u jingthrew ïa phi .
translation.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .
And to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to half the tribe of Manasseh , spake Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Reuben bad jait Gad , bad ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ,

translation.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood : two cubits shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
To ïeng skhem , malu Phon ri pynim ïa lade hi .
translation.en: In your patience possess ye your souls .

translation.kha: namar U Blei u trei baburom Hapoh jong phi , ban pynlong ïa phi kiba don ka ma bad kiba lah ban kohnguh ïa ka jingthmu jong u hi .
translation.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .

translation.kha: Ha kob khatsaw eh , ka kynthei ka la ïap .
translation.en: And last of all the woman died also .

translation.kha: Nangta pyningkhong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki thiaw jong ka baroh da kaba synrum da ka umphniang pynsleh ; te sa sa long kaba kynoi nadong shadong .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .

Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha phi : ‘ U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa la u Kynrad .’ Lada ki pynshitom ïa nga , kin pynshitom ïa phi ruh ; lada ki la kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , kin kohnguh ïa ka jong phi ruh .
Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; ngab kata kan pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban ym don pud ïa ka jingdon ki briew kiba u syiem u syier ; haba um don shuh , ym don moi mano uba jingsngewnguh ïa kaei kaba u la leh . Ka longsem ka bymsngewsynei . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .
translation.en: There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them : they also that come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?
translation.kha: Hynrei hangno lah ban shem ïa ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?
bad da kaba pynshahshkor ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki sharak jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïadei Pha sha phi . Phim pat ju kohnguh ïa kaei kiba ki la ong .
translation.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , sha kynhun baheh ki iar khlaw ki la wan her , kat ban thep ïa ka jaka shijur dara , bad ha ka por mynba la don ka umjer ha kyllan ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that at even the quails came up , and covered the camp : and in the morning the dew lay round about the host .
Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  Nga ong ha me ba mynta ka miet , ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
Phim pat ju pra hangto mynshuwa , kumta kine pyn-i ha phi ka lynti ba phin leit . Hynrei wiat leit sha jan ka Synduk ka Jutang ; pynjngai kumba shi kmierad nadien jong ka .
translation.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .
Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?
