translation.kha: Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam jong phi ki long kiba ijli . Uwei pa uwei u klim . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jngai nga ? U TRAI’ u kylli . Ym don uno du ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha katto ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?

translation.kha: da Kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei , badno lehkmen ha ka jingbit jong ki briew’ baroh . Bad man ka sngi U Trai u nang pynïashong ha ka kynhun jong ki ïa kito kiba la pynim .
translation.en: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .
And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi thmu sa ban pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kynthei jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Hato phim tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi ?

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Thy sins are forgiven .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew ,  Ïa ki pop jong pha la map .

U Trai u la ong ha u , Uei uba ai ha u briew ïa ka shyntur ? Uei wahbah pynpang ïa u uba kyllut ne u bymnang kren ? Uei wahbah ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa u , uba matlah ? Dei ma nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: U Tom um iar-ryngkuh kumno ka ka jinglong jyllang u ka ktah ia kiwei .
translation.en: Tom doesn't realise how his behaviour affects others .

translation.kha: Kumta sa shisien pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh malu ki ong , Pynjngai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka jong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi bad ïa ki longïing jngai I . La don ka jingkyrmen baroh Kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pynshitom jur ïa ki .
translation.en: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ngim dei ban ïohthiah kum kiwei patiaw ; ngi dei ban peitmat bad pyngngad .
translation.en: Therefore let us not sleep , as do others ; but let us watch and be sober .

translation.kha: Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka longkmie , ba ka rukom ka jingim jongngi phi ka dei ban hir kat kumba ka Bible U Khrist ka dawa , khnang ba , la nga lah ne ngam lah ban leit bad ïohi ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba Phi ngin slem ha kawei ka jingthmu , bad said , da kawei ka jingthrang , Phin ïakhun lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit ha ka gospel .
translation.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;

translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka don ha ka lyntait ban ïarap ïa me , hynrei kan leit phai noh shai la ka ri .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to enquire of me  ; Behold , Pharaoh s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .

translation.kha: To lyntang da ka jingsngewskhem , phi ki maji ha ka duriaw-bah ! La pynjot ïa ka nongkhap kaba phi shynna .
translation.en: Howl , ye ships of Tarshish : for your strength is laid waste .

translation.kha: Bad mynnin phoi thmu sa banbeiñ pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kyntiew jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Hato khung tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , U blem jongno phi ?
translation.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?

translation.kha: Lada um leh kumta , un kit hi ïa la ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .
And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , ha kaba U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u sumar ïa la ki briew , phan long pat sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima kaba la ju long ka jong pha .
Ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrpad jur ïa u , Une u briew u dei hok shisha ban oh ïa ka jingïarap jong me .
translation.en: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :

translation.kha: pynlong ïa ka jingthmu jong phi ban leh ïa kamai kaba bhah , bun ym ïa kaei kaba sniew , khnang ba phin ïoh im . Te U tharai , U Blei badonburom baroh , da shisha un don ryngkat nabar phi , kam phi kam ba u long .
translation.en: Seek good , and not evil , that ye may live : and so the  Lord  , the God of hosts , shall be with you , as ye have spoken .

translation.kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shim pynlang shongduh ka kynthup ïa ka Bethel bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka naduh shaphang jongngi ka Naaran mala haduh shaphang sepngi ka Jaser bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka . Ka kynrup ruh ïa ki nongbah ka Shekhem bad ka Asaïah bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth–el and the towns thereof , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof  ; Shechem also and the towns thereof , unto Gaza and the towns thereof :
And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u pynlong jingïasuk bad u syiem Israel .

U mradkhlaw uba ar u syriem kum ka dngiem kaba ïeng ha ki kjat-dien jong ka . Ka la batbor lai tylli ki shyieng krung hapdeng ki bniat jyllang ka , bad ka sur ka la ong ha ka , Khie leit , bam shibun ka doh katba pha lah !
translation.en: And behold another beast , a second , like to a bear , and it raised up itself on one side , and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it : and they said thus unto it , Arise , devour much flesh .
And at the side without , as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate , were two tables  ; and on the other side , which was at the porch of the gate , were two tables .
translation.kha: Shabar kata ka kamra la don ruh saw tylli ki miej kiba long kumjuh , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khyrdop bashatei .

translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phin ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar ha baroh ki liang .

translation.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun  ; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka sngi , bad la shah ïa ka ban thang ïa ki briew da jingshit tyrha bajur jong ka .
bad ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal haneng ban thang ïa ki khunlung jong ki ha ka ding kum ki jingkñia . Ngam ju lei ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi ruh ha ka jingpyrkhat jong nga .
translation.en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :
And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew ,  La map ïa ki pop jong me , ko paralok jong nga .

translation.en: And the rest of Gilead , and all Bashan , being the kingdom of Og , gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh  ; all the region of Argob , with all Bashan , which was called the land of giants .
translation.kha: Ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , nga ai ïa kaba sah na ka ri Gilead bad ïa ka Bashan baroh kawei , ha kaba u Og u synshar , kaba mut ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei .  ( Ïa ka Bashan la tip kum ka ri jong ki Rephaim .
A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Wai uba la pynthame ïa phi ? Ha khmat ki khmat jong phi hi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Jisu Khrist halor ka pdiang!
translation.en: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?

translation.kha: Nga khappud ïa me ba men pyllait ïa sa na ka kti u Iso u hynmen jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ban ïaleh bad pynpoh lut ïa I baroh , wat ïa ki kynoi bad ki khynnah ruh .
translation.en: Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .
translation.kha: Ka dieng kaba sah u shna ïa ka bleithaw , bad nangta u dem bad mane ïa ka . U duwai ha ka bad u ong ,  Phi long U Blei jong nga — to pynim ïa nga !

translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .
translation.kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba shahshitom kin shem ka jingshngain hangta .

translation.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body , that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof .
translation.kha: Ka pop kam dei shuh ban synshar ïa ki met ki jong phi , da kaba pynkohnguh sha ki jingkwah jong ka jinglong tynrai jong phi .
Um sheptieng haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jngai u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u Shaniah ha U Trai .
translation.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta katto-katne katne ngut ki briew’ ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa u briew Uba la mareh bad u bymneh kren namar u la shongneh . U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa u bhabriew , ba kumta u la haw ban krai bad ïohi .
translation.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .

translation.kha: Me Don borabor kat katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong me ïa sa ka neng jur nang jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai Ban ïabeh ïa na .
translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .

translation.kha: hynrei un uno ïa kiba la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .

And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
translation.kha: U angel u la jubab ,  U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wan ha pha , bad ka bor jong U Blei kan shong halor jong pha . Na kane ka daw , ïa i khunlung bakhuid yn khot U Khun U Blei .
Shuh sha , nga la ïohi hima ba ha kan ka pyrthei phi shem ka jingbymman ha ka jaka kaba ka jinglehhok bad ka haw ki dei ban don .
translation.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there  ; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there .
And they shall turn the rivers far away  ; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up : the reeds and flags shall wither .
translation.kha: Ki shnat jong ka wah kin iwtung katba ki dang rngad suki suki . Ki khah bad ki japung kin jlop ,
Kin ym map lane leh-isynei ïano ïano , la ki de ki samla ne ki tymmen .
translation.en: A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :
Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ruh ban ym leh klet ïa ki Lebi katba phi dang shong ha la ka ri .

Hynrei haba ka por jong ngi bad ki ka la kut , ngi la mihnoh dara ngi la dum leit ha ka jingleit jongki ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem bad ngi na ka nongbah sha ka rud duriaw-rit , ha kaba ngi la ïadem khohsiew bad ïai .
translation.en: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
Then said Elkanah her husband to her , Hannah , why weepest thou ? and why eatest thou not ? and why is thy heart grieved ? am not I better to thee than ten sons ?
translation.kha: U Elkanah u tnga jong ka u kylli ïa ka ,  Hannah , balei ba phi da ïam ? Balei ba phim bam ei ei ? Balei ba phi shu sngewsih sah ? Hato ngam kham lah ma nga ha phi ban ïa shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang ?

U la shah lehbeiñ sat , hynrei u la shah da kaba sngewrit ; um shitrhem la kren shikyntien hima . Kum i khunlangbrot ban sa shah pynïap , kum ka langbrot ka ban sa shah khih ïa la u shñiuh , um shym kren shikyntien ruh .
translation.en: He was oppressed , and he was afflicted , yet he opened not his mouth : he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter , and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb , so he openeth not his mouth .
If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;
translation.kha: Ym don sabon kaba lah ban sait ïa ki pop jong nga .
Kane ka long naba la leh da U tharai ; A haduh katno ka long kaei kaei kaba ikhyllah !’
translation.en: This was the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?

translation.kha: Nga la Thoh shwa phin ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la kwah eh ban tip rahah Katto phi la ïong ha kata ka jingtynjuh bad la pa’ la kliar borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
translation.en: For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .

And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , Whose is the land ? saying also , Make thy league with me , and , behold , my hand shall be with thee , to bring about all Israel unto thee .
translation.kha: U Abner u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid uba don ha Hebron ha kata ka por , ban ong ,  Uei u ban synshar ïa kane ka ri ? Ïateh kular bad nga , bad ngan ïarap ïa phi ban pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha ka liang jong phi .
Ha ka snem kaba ar ba u Nebukhadnessar u long syiem , u la ïoh ka jingphohsniew . Ka la pynkhuslai shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba um shym ïohthiah ,
translation.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams , wherewith his spirit was troubled , and his sleep brake from him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki jingkwah bran jong u ki pun ioh jong u bad ka jingmih ka long ban leh ïa ka pop ; bad ka pop , hajan ka la ih bha , ka pynjam ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: Then when lust hath conceived , it bringeth forth sin : and sin , when it is finished , bringeth forth death .
For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?
translation.kha: Don jingkyrmen aïu na ka bynta ki briew kiba khlem blei ha ka kynta ba U Blei un dawa ïa ka jingim jong ki ?
Nangta sa shisien pat kan sa khop biang ïa nga u tnga jongngi ka — kan ym khop Shu ïa nga u Baal jong ka .
translation.en: And it shall be at that day , saith the  Lord  , that thou shalt call me Ishi  ; and shalt call me no more Baali .

translation.kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade , Un ym pynshitom ïa to ?
translation.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .

translation.kha: Ko ngab , ka khyndew ka shongdor tang sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa — kan long aïu kata hapdeng jrong ngi ? To tep ïa la ka tnga hangtei .
translation.en: My lord , hearken unto me : the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver  ; what is that betwixt me and thee ? bury therefore thy dead .
And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh , as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nong Moab kin ym sngewbha ïa u blei Khemosh jong ki , kumba ki Israel kim sngewbha ïa u blei Bethel ha uba ki shaniah .
Ha kata ka sngi ngan shim ïa me , ko Serubbabel u shakri jong nga , bad ngan thung ïa me ngab synshar ha ka kyrngah jong nga . Me long Uto wahbah nga la jied . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Sa khyndiat , ki la jan ban oh pynjop ïa la , hynrei ngam shym leh lyndang ïa ki lawbah jong me .
translation.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth  ; but I forsook not thy precepts .
And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying , We came to thy brother Esau , and also he cometh to meet thee , and four hundred men with him .
translation.kha: Ynda kita ki nonglamktien ki la wan phai pat sha u Jakob , ki ong ,  Ngi la leit ïashem ïa u Iso u hynmen jong phi , bad u la don ha lynti ban wan ïashem ïa phi . U don sawspah ngut ki rangbah bad u .

Nangta U Trai u la bthah ïa ar ban phah ka khlur sha ki syiem jong ka Edom , ka Moab , ka Ammon , ka Tyros , bad ka Sidon lyngba ki nongkit tiensyiem jongno ki , kiba lai wan sha Jerusalem shun jngoh ïa u symboh Sedekaïah .
translation.en: And send them to the king of Edom , and to the king of Moab , and to the king of the Ammonites , and to the king of Tyre , and to the king of Zidon , by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah  ;

translation.kha: U Jahasiel u ong , Ko syiem malade baroh ma phi u paid Judah bad Jesreel , U Trai u ino ba ‘Phim dih ban rit mynsiem ne sheptieng ban ïeng pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai ba bun bastad . Ka thma ka shong ha U Blei , ym ha phi .
translation.en: And he said , Hearken ye , all Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem , and thou king Jehoshaphat , Thus saith the  Lord  unto you , Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude  ; for the battle is not yours , but God s .
Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .
translation.kha: Hato ki jingri jong ki bad baroh kaba ki don , kin ym long ki jong ngi ? To ngin ïamynjur ba ki lah ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net , and burn incense unto their drag  ; because by them their portion is fat , and their meat plenteous .
translation.kha: Ki mane wat ïa ki jar tong dohkha jong ki bad ai jingkñia ha ki , namar ki jar jong ki , ki pyndap ïa ki da kiei kiei baroh kiba bha tam .

translation.en: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi long ki jong U Blei , wat la ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u Basniew .

translation.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , from following the sheep , to be ruler over my people , over Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga ong ha u , ‘ Nga la shim ïa me na kaba sharai ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang , bad nga la thung ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel .
Bad haba la pynïap ïa u Stephanas , u sakma jong me , nga hi por la khong hangta , nga da mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u bun nga da sumar ïa ki jaiñsem jongu ki nongpynïap ïa u .’
translation.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed , I also was standing by , and consenting unto his death , and kept the raiment of them that slew him .

translation.kha: Utai u dpei un sa her kum u pui pui uba ni ha ka ri jingïap baroh , bad kat haba u hap un pynmih ki ithuh kiba kylla prum ha u briew bun ha u mrad .
translation.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .

But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bad un thung ïa u ban long nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u .
ba u la pait ha u Petros bad nongbat ha Baroh ki khat-ar ñiut ki Apostol .
translation.en: And that he was seen of Cephas , then of the twelve :

translation.kha: Nangno U Jisu u la khyrdep sha bneng , U la ud jylliew , Bad u la ong ha Uto u briew’ , Ephphatha . Kaba mut , To plie !
translation.en: And looking up to heaven , he sighed , and saith unto him ,  Ephphatha ,  that is ,  Be opened .

translation.kha: Nga la pynduhbor ïa ki briew kiba shyrkhei bad nga la pyllait ïa kiba shah lehbeiñ na ki .
translation.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .
The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the  Lord  lighteneth both their eyes .
translation.kha: U briew baduk bad u nongbanbeiñ jong u ki ïadon ïa kane kumjuh — U  Trai  u ai ïa ki khmat ha baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , u paidbah uba bun u la ïawanlang . Haba ki briew kim don ei ei shuh ban bam , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki synran sha u bad u la ong ,
Hynrei la bishar bad la pynshitom ïa ngi da U Trai , khring ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyllait .
translation.en: But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .

translation.kha: “Nga smai ha me ba ngan pynlong ïa uwei na ka un-long lad me hi ban Wallam jingjynsur halor jong me . Men ïohi ïa ka haba nga shim na me ïa ki tnen jongu me bad ai ïa ki ha uwei pat u briew ; bad un ïathiah shongkha bun ki haba tdong shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house , and I will take thy wives before thine eyes , and give them unto thy neighbour , and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun .
And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri , bad hadien kata ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’

translation.en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate : and they said one to another , Why sit we here until we die ?
translation.kha: Saw ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki don shabar ki khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Balei ngin shu ap hangne haduh ba ngin da ïap ?

translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .
translation.kha: Hamar ba mih ka sngi , u Lot u la poi ha Soar .

translation.en: Then these men assembled unto the king , and said unto the king , Know , O king , that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed .
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah ki la wan biang sha u syiem bad ki la ong ha u ,  U Syiem Kynrad u tip ba kat kum ki aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia ym don kano kano ka hukum kaba u syiem u la ai ïa kaba lah ban pynkylla .

translation.en: What were the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei Kiei Ki Jingkylli ?
Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine baroh ar longsyiem Aner ki bym bapaw shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba 3 ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .

translation.kha: dei ka jingngeit kambah pynlong ïa ki kmen ki kpa u Moses ban buhrieh ïa u lah bnai hadien ba la kha ïa u . Ki la ïohi ba u la long u khunlung uba bhabriew , sad kim shym la pyrshing ban pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u Pharaoh .
translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was born , was hid three months of his parents , because they saw he was a proper child  ; and they were not afraid of the king s commandment .

So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la leit shata namar dei hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ka don , ha kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pynïeng ha ka ri khlaw .

kumta u la phah khot ïa ki nongïatrei kurup , ki nongleh myntri , ki nongkheiñ “ksuid” bad ki nongiarap byrngut ban ïawan bad batai ïa ka jingphohsniew ha u . Haba ki la ïawan bad ïeng ha khat u syiem ,
translation.en: Then the king commanded to call the magicians , and the astrologers , and the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans , for to shew the king his dreams . So they came and stood before the king .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki Jisu ha Tarsos ki la iohsngew ba u Paul u la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha Beria ruh , ki la ïawan shata bad ki la sdang ban pynkhih bad pynjulor ïa u paidbhur .
translation.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .
And it shall turn to you for a testimony .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kabu ïa phi ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha .

translation.en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynti , bad ïa u sing uba ïeng hajan jong ka . Ki leit haduh Bethel bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki la ïohi .

translation.en: I , even I , have spoken  ; yea , I have called him : I have brought him , and he shall make his way prosperous .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba la kren bad ba la khot ïa u ; nga la ïalam ïa u shabar bad la ai ha u ïa ka jingjop .

translation.en: Let me not , I pray you , accept any man s person , neither let me give flattering titles unto man .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah liang ha kane ka jingïatainia ; ngan nym pynroh ïano ïano .
Da ka jingpyrta baïap ki ïakhot jong ka Dorbar ki la set ïa la ki shkor da la ki kti . Nangta baroh ki la tur sha u hangta hi , ki la bret ïa u shakor ka nongbah , bad ki la lynter maw ïa u .
translation.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,

translation.kha: Ngam Khot shuh ïa phi ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u leh . Pynban , la khot ïa phoi ki paralok , namar nga la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kaba nga la ïohsngew na U Kpa jong nga .
translation.en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .

translation.kha: U Tiras un pyndem ïa ka bor bakylluid jong u ; un pynim ïa la ki briew , bun ka pyrthei baroh tista ïohi ïa kata .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .
And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kaba ai burom ïa U  Trai  hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

Wat khum beiñ ïa nga Naaman ka rong sniehdoh jong nga , namar ba ka sngi ka la pynkylla rong ïa per . Ki shynrang kiba shi para bad nga ki bitar ïa nga sad ki pyntylli ïa ang ha ka bri sohwaiñ . Ngam Don por ban sumar ïa lade .
translation.en: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me .

translation.kha: pli kiba pyndonkam ïa ki thiaw ba ki eh , kumba kim shym lap miet ha kita . Nongbah kaei ka pyrthei , kumba ka long mynta , kan ym neh Slem .
translation.en: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .

translation.kha: Hato dei na said ba phi! baroh phi la ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don aiwai ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jrong nga hi u la ïateh kular bun u Dabid . Ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngew ïa sa lin ïashoh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki nongbah jong nga , u ei hangne myntan , u da wad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa de , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !
translation.en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?

translation.kha: Phi la jingïashoh ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki paralok jrong phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong phi .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .
If ye had known me , ye should have known my Father also : and from henceforth ye know him , and have seen him .
translation.kha: Mynta ba phi la ithuh ïa nga ,  u la ong ha ki ,  phin ithuh ïa U Kpa jong nga ruh ; bad naduh mynta phi da ithuh ïa u bad phi la ïohi ïa u .
bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lah lait na kawei ka ding , hynrei myntor ka dang kan thang khoit ïa ki . Haba por pynshitom ïa ki , phin thop ba nga longsem U Trai .
translation.en: And I will set my face against them  ; they shall go out from one fire , and another fire shall devour them  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I set my face against them .

translation.kha: U Siba u Jobab , Ngan leh ïa kaei katei baroh kaba ma phi Syiem Kynrad phi hukum . Kumta u Mephibosheth u ïalam lang ha ka miej bam jong u syiem , kumto uwei na ki khun shynrong jongnga u syiem .
translation.en: Then said Ziba unto the king , According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant , so shall thy servant do . As for Mephibosheth , said the king , he shall eat at my table , as one of the king s sons .

translation.kha: de pynriewspah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , da kaweh pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ki jingkynshew .
translation.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance  ; and I will fill their treasures .
And Peter said unto him , Aeneas , Jesus Christ maketh thee whole : arise , and make thy bed . And he arose immediately .
translation.kha: Ko Ainias ,  u Petros u la ong ha u ,  U Jisu Khrist u pynkhiah ïa me . To ïeng joit bad pynbeit ïa la ka jingthiah .  Mar kumta hi u Ainias u la ïeng joit .
Ym blem hadien , U Jisu u la waiñ na Nasareth kaba ha ka pyniaid jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .

translation.kha: U Ishmael u ïap haba u la dap bashispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died  ; and was gathered unto his people .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jeush u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syep Joram uba dang don ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmeng kiba u la ïoh ha ka tdam ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Kumta u Jehu u la ong ha ki lai rangbah pynïaidkam , Lada phi don bad nga , pynthikna ba uwei ruh na phi un ym leit noh na Ramoth bad maham ïa ki briew jong ka Jesreel .
translation.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .

translation.kha: Ki ong , Hato U Trai u la kren tang lyngba u Moserah ? Hammoth um shym la kruiñ lyngba jrong ngi ruh ? U Trai u la ïohsngew aïu ki ong .
translation.en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .

translation.kha: Katba u leit kham hajan ban doh ïa u , u Isaak u iw ïa ki jaiñ jong u — bad kumta u la ai ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u . U ong ,  Ka jingsma sngewtynnat u khun jong nga ka long kum ka jingiw ka lyngkha ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu .

translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .

Ka burom bad ka main longsyiem ki per shadong ïa u ; ka bor nabar ka jingitynnat ki pyndap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: Honour and majesty are before him : strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .

translation.kha: U la bret noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u la rynsied , pynlang u la wan shuh U ju .

ïa ki sati ba ki deng ha ki shynrang ti jong ki bad ha ki khmut lad ki ;

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  See thou tell no man  ; but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .

translation.kha: bad haba nga la leit sha Jeremaïah , ki rangbah lyngngeit jngai ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rai pynrem ïa u .
translation.en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .

translation.kha: Ki ap ïa ka jingap , hynrei kdew wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jingtep ban ïa ka spah .
translation.en: Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;

Be glad then , ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the  Lord  your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .
translation.kha: To lehkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , to shadkmen ha kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa phi . U la ai ïa phi ïa u slap synrai uba biang ; u la theh ïa u slap tlang na ka bynta jong phi bad ïa u slap pyrem kumba mynshuwa .
Kumta u la praw ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrtong jong U Jisu! Khrist . Te ki la kyrpad ïa u ban tama bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .
translation.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to pyndep na ka bniat ka to baroh ïa ka kular jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kamai kaba me thmu ba-bang leh .
translation.en: Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .

translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la pynkhie ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntien ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad kumta me la ïalamwir ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shrak jong me .
translation.en: Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .

translation.en: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .
Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy ? are we stronger than he ?

translation.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !
And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .
translation.kha: bad mynta une u syiem un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen bad phuh  ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jong nga ki don bad phi . Nga la long u nongïalam jong phi naduh ba nga dang samla haduh mynta .

translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ! Ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Nangta baroh u paidbah u ong ,  Amen ,  bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And all the people that came together to that sight , beholding the things which were done , smote their breasts , and returned .

translation.kha: Jamynrei u Iso u ïa-ong , Ko hep , de dap biang kyrhai ; buh ïa kaei kaba phi don .
translation.en: And Esau said , I have enough , my brother  ; keep that thou hast unto thyself .

Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka har jong u syiem ka Bethania ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi shaei ka ri jong u Bad pynpyut ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa u Paul , ki la wallam ïa u ha khmat ka dorbar jong ka Nongbah , ka Ariopagos , bad ki la ong , Ngi kwah banbeiñ tip kaei kan ka jinghikai bathymmai kaba me kren .
translation.en: And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?

translation.en: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah , who had understanding in the visions of God : and as long as he sought the  Lord  , God made him to prosper .

translation.kha: U Bam Ia U Sah apil .
translation.en: He ate an apple .
O  Lord  our God , other lords beside thee have had dominion over us : but by thee only will we make mention of thy name .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ïa ngi la synshar da kiwei pat , hynrei tang ma me , me long U  Trai  jong ngi .
Khie leit sha ki Lum Abarim kaba ha ka ri Moab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki paid Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :

translation.en: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .

translation.kha: U Laban u jubab , Nga mynjur . Ngin leh kumba phiah ai jingmut .
translation.en: And Laban said , Behold , I would it might be according to thy word .

translation.kha: Haba ki nongpynjot ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba u angel u la ïathuh shaphang u khulom .
translation.en: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .
translation.kha: To ngin pynlong ka jingïateh kular ba kan don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi bad ki jong phi .

translation.en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .

translation.en: And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,

translation.en: O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :

translation.en: Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .
Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me : and there are that raise up strife and contention .
translation.kha: Balei ba me pynlong ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kaba kum kane ka jingjynjar ? Kumno me lah ban shu peit ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh bymdei ? Ka jingpynjot bad ka jinglehbor ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad ka don ka jingïaleh bad jingïakajia ha kylleng .

translation.kha: Sa khyndiat , ki la jan ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym leh lyndet ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .

translation.en: O Lord , what shall I say , when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies !
And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :

translation.en: Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .

translation.en: But thou , Israel , art my servant , Jacob whom I have chosen , the seed of Abraham my friend .

translation.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .

translation.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;

translation.kha: te phin tip ba ka la don ka daw kaba bha ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba to la leh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: And they shall comfort you , when ye see their ways and their doings : and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .

translation.en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial : for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto .
translation.kha: Wat ñiew ïa nga kum ka kynthei ka bymdondor ei ei . Nga duwai kumne namar ba nga sngew kordit sat ïa lade .
Ki jait Epaphras bad Manasseh ki la otsher ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Bethpelet , kaba ha kata ka por la khot kyrtong ka Lus . U Trai u la ïarap ïa ki . Ki la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha ka nongbah ,
translation.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el . ( Now the name of the city before was Luz . )

translation.kha: Ki briew kin thied ïa ki , bun ïa ki dulir thied jakarieh yn soi , shon muhor bad yn sakhi . Kane kan jia ha ka ri Benjamin , ha ki shnong sawdong ka Israel , ha ki shnong ka Judah , bad ha ki shnong ka ri lum , ha ki kjap lum , bad ha ka Judah bashongshit shathie . Teng pynïoh pah ha ki briew ïa ka ri jongu ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Men shall buy fields for money , and subscribe evidences , and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , and in the cities of the mountains , and in the cities of the valley , and in the cities of the south : for I will cause their captivity to return , saith the  Lord .
But Pharaoh s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her : then did he build Millo .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , hadien ba ka tnga jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka ri Ijipt , ka la wan kynriah na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka ïingsyiem kaba u Solomon u la tei na ka bynta jong ka .
U paidbah u la kylli ïa u , Te kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ?
translation.en: And the people asked him , saying , What shall we do then ?
And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong , bad nangta u leit bad ïathuh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And said to the mountains and rocks , Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb :
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta ha ki lumbah bad ha ki mawsiang ,  To tap halor jong ngi bad to buhrieh noh ïa ngi na ki khmat jong uta uba shong halor ka khet bad na ka jingbitar U Khunlangbrot !

Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewskhem , nabar ïa u briew uba la leh ïa kob kum kata kaei kaei la den ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong phi .
translation.en: And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .
And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other  ; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na kawei ka ngab , ai ba un thab sa ïa kawei ruh ; lada uno uno u shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong phi , ai ba un shim ruh ïa ka sopti-poh jong phi .
ka Rephaim , ka Irpeel , ka Taralah ,
translation.en: And Rekem , and Irpeel , and Taralah ,
Then answered the  Lord  unto Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
translation.kha: Te napdeng ka  erïong , U  Trai  u la kren ha u Job sa shisien pat .

translation.en: The sons of Rachel  ; Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Rakhel ki long u Joseph bad u Benjamin .

kumin ma ki , ka ruh ka la don ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh ba la pynitynnat , ka kamra rung , bad ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong . Ka lynter jong ka baroh ka la long arphew san miat , bad ka pyngkiang jong ka khat-ar milimitar satang .
translation.en: The little chambers thereof , the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , and the windows to it round about : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .

And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kynroh da ka rnong tylli ha ka jingïadei bad ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me , hynrei kin ym jop ïa me . Ngan long bad me ban ïada ïa me bad sumar pynim ïa me .

Kumta aiti ha I hynñiew ngut na ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u , badno ngin pharia ïa ki ha khmat U Trai’ ha Gibeah , ka shnong trai jong u Saul , u syiem ba la jied da U Trai . Ngan aiti ïa ki , u syiem u ong .
translation.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us , and we will hang them up unto the  Lord  in Gibeah of Saul , whom the  Lord  did choose . And the king said , I will give them .
His eyes were as a flame of fire , and on his head were many crowns  ; and he had a name written , that no man knew , but he himself .
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong u ki la long kum ka thylliej ding , bad u la phong shibun ki pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u . U la don ka kyrteng ïa kaba la thoh halor jong u ïa kaba ym don batip hynrei lait tang ma u hi .

translation.en: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la kwah ban wallam jingjynjar ha ki paid Israel , kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban rai ban shim ka jingkheiñbriew .

translation.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits , when ye bring a new meat offering unto the  Lord  , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , haba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh da u kew thymmai sha U  Trai  , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei .
Ngan Long shlei bad ngan kren tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil banbeiñ kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktem malade ki kam ,
translation.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,

translation.kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw wat ha ki nongdie kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lyntang ; u sleit ïa iwei pa iwei ban tip ba u dei u bieit .
translation.en: Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .

translation.kha: U Benabinadab u syiem ka Babilonia u tad ïaleh ïa ka Ïuodia , u kem ïa u Jehoïakim , bad u ïalam ïa u shat Bithynia da kabu khum ha ki kynjri .
translation.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and bound him in fetters , to carry him to Babylon .

translation.kha: Ym bit ïa une uno u brisoh ne ka briew ban ïathiah shongsah bad ki mrad ; kum kata ka kam khyllah ka pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith : neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto : it is confusion .
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace , whose mind is stayed on thee : because he trusteth in thee .
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  , me ai ka jingsuk bajanai ïa kito kiba batskhem ïa ka jingthmu jong ki bad kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha me .
U ryndang jongno phi u long kum u mot jongno u Dabid , uba pyllut bad jlih , lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki speh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .
translation.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee  ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another  ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .
translation.kha: Kin pynjot thiaw ïa pha bad ïa ki briew kiba hapoh ki kynroh jong pha ; yn ym pynsah wat uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don , namar ba pham shym ithuh ïa ka por mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa pha !

translation.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David , and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid ; ka long ka jingshahjop kaba sngewshyrkhei , ha kaba la pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi .
Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuri shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ki Israel ki pynjahburom ïa ka katjuh kaba ki leit .
translation.en: But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .

translation.kha: Ngam shym ïohi ïa ka kotbah ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ jong ka , u long U Trai U Blei! badonbok Baroh bad U khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .

translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ka don slem beh ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba bapar snem . Ha said ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U Trai ngab ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u Selsah shaw ka ïing jong u bad u la ai ha ki katto katne ka jingbah ban bam . Ïa u bad ka longïing jongno u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar mynta ki la ngeit ha U Blei .
translation.en: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .

translation.kha: Heth me don jingtip haduh katno ka heh ka pyrthat ? To jubab ïa nga lada me tip .
translation.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la kren ha nga , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki rangbah kiba la phah sha nga ïa-ban ïathuh ha u Shekanaïah ba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel u la ong ,
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :

translation.kha: U Petros u la ong biang Em — bad mar kumta u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translation.en: Peter then denied again : and immediately the cock crew .

translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh’ sawdong bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka khyrdong jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .

translation.kha: Ka thma katba la sdang hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ka neh katba u Abiasaph u dang im .
translation.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .
Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .
translation.kha: U syiem un ïai don ha ka bor katba ka jingsynshar jong u ka dang long kaba khuid , kaba hok , bad kaba biang .

translation.en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u don ka dur kum u sing ; uba ar u don ka dur kum u masi kyrtong ; uba lai u don ka durkhmat kum ka durkhmat u briew ; bad uba saw u don ka dur kum u pukni uba her .

translation.kha: Ki lup ki khynñiuh ha khamtam U Trai jong u Lum Sinai , Ha khmat U Trai , U Blang ki Israel .
translation.en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .
These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .
translation.kha: Kine hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
Lada phi ïaroh ïa ka jingsyiad , u kpa jong phi un sngewlyngngoh ïa phi . Ka longïng ka jingpynlehrain ba-bieit ban pynliem pisa ha ki nuti .
translation.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .

translation.kha: U la kylli ïa ki ha ka por aïu ba u khun jong u , u la kham ïohbor , bad ki la jubab , Mynmiet ha ka nga shi bajai nohphai sngi mynba ka jingshit na u ka la iehnoh .
translation.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .

translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u kylli ïa u , ‘ Kiei kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phi ?’ Un jubab , ‘ Nga la ïoh ïa ki ha ka ïng u paralok .’
translation.en: And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki kiew u Manasseh ki pynïaid ïa ki nongbeh jong ka Beth Shan , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ka Dor , bad ki shnong kiba sawkyr-ang jong ki . Kine baroh ki dei ki khak ha ibha ki khur ki ksiew jong u Joseph , u khun jngai u Jakob , ki shong ki sah .
translation.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth–shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong , whom ye see and know : yea , the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u kaba la ai jingkhlaiñ ïa une u briew uba dkoh . Ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi bad tip , la leh da ka jingngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u ; ka long ka jingngeit ha U Jisu kaba la pynkhiah ïa u , kumba phi baroh phi ïohi .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrshan ïa la ki briew ; un sngewsynei ïa la ki shakri .

translation.en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .
translation.kha: U la ai ïa nga shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jong ki baroh u la jied ïa u Solomon ban synshar halor ka Israel , ka hima ka jong U  Trai .

Bad Mynta ka jingpang jong u Naaman kan wan khlur jong me , pynlang ma me bad ki khun ki kiaw jong me kin ïew ïa ka shi junom ! Haba u Gehasi u la mihnoh , u la ïoh ïa ka jingpang — ka sniehdoh jong u ka la lieh kum ka ïor .
translation.en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee , and unto thy seed for ever . And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow .

translation.kha: Me tip ba ngiam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei ruh uba lah ba-bang pyllait im ïa per na me .
translation.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .

translation.kha: Susah ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ki Israel ki la shah ringmraw namar ki pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga . Nga la phai noh na ki bad nga la shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban pynïap ïa ki ha ka thlim .
translation.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity : because they trespassed against me , therefore hid I my face from them , and gave them into the hand of their enemies : so fell they all by the sword .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ainong ha u Moses , rahah ïa la ka kti shajrong ba ka jingdum kaba rben la kumba eh ban tba ïa ka , kan tap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand toward heaven , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt .

translation.kha: Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kamon u syiemsad jong ngi , hynriew u la shad pynïap ha ka thmu . Kumta , balei ym don mano mano ba pynryngkang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?
translation.en: And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingieit la pynjanai neh ha ngi , ba ngin dat ka jingsleh ha ka Sngi ka jingpynhiar ; bad ngin ni ïa ka namar ka jingim jongno ngi ha kane ka pyrthiew ka long kumjuh kum ka jong U Khrist .
translation.en: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi ar pynlang phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba ngi ïai-ong ïa Phi .
translation.en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .

translation.kha: Kumta u saraw u noh ha la ki rangbah , Ñiew ïa ki shipai bad wad uei uba haka . Ki leh kumta , bad ki shem ba u Jonathan bad u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jrong u kim ni .
translation.en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him , Number now , and see who is gone from us . And when they had numbered , behold , Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .

translation.kha: Heldai ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la kylli jar Jar ïa u , barli ba ngim lah Ban beh nep ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?
translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop shaw ka jingim ka long kaba khim bad ka lynti kaba ïabam shai ka , ka long kaba eh , bad khong khyndiat ki bri kiba shem ïa ka .
translation.en: Because strait is the gate , and narrow is the way , which leadeth unto life , and few there be that find it .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kyllum , bad ki bymneh ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shah pynjot .
translation.en: And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .

translation.kha: Kane ka jaitbynriew ka long kum u sing uba khlaiñ ; Haba u thiah , ym don ba nud ban kyrsiew ïa u . Uta uba kyrkhu ïa ki Jerusalem’ un ïuh jingkyrkhu , Bad uta uba tim ïa ki Jeruel un ïoh ka jingtim .
translation.en: He couched , he lay down as a lion , and as a great lion : who shall stir him up ? Blessed is he that blesseth thee , and cursed is he that curseth thee .

translation.kha: te ha ka jingbet ngan blei pyrthuh ïa phi , bad sa shisien sam pynshitom jhur shuh shuh ïa phi! sa hynñiew shuh ban ïa kambah la long mynshuwa .
translation.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .
And Shaphan carried the book to the king , and brought the king word back again , saying , All that was committed to thy servants , they do it .
translation.kha: U ai ha u Shaphan ïa ka kitab , bad u Shaphan u leit rah sha u syiem . U ïathuh ,  Ngi la leh ïa baroh kaba phi la hukum .

Hynrei , da kiba kila longïing ka jingtim na ka byndi jong ngi , U Khrist u la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uno uno kiba la shah sdien ha u dieng un ni hapoh ka jingshem U Blei .
translation.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :

translation.kha: U samla Lebi u mynjur ban shong bad u Maki bad u la long hi kum u khun .
translation.en: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man  ; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons .

translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shim ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u shata u rangbah ai hukum , bad u la ong , U Paul , u koidi , u la khot ïa nga bad kyrpad ïa nga don wallam ïa une u samla shuh me , Namarba ba u ne ei ei ban ong ha me .
translation.en: So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por , u Gideon bad la ki shispah jngut ki rangbah ki la wan shiah ka wah Jordan bad jam sha shiliang ïa ka . Ki la thait hi ïan , hynmen ki dang beh kthong ïa ki Nongshun .
translation.en: And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .
He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !

translation.en: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaroh ïa nga borabor , bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga kam ju duh noh na nga .
Nga long u kpu ka jingim .
translation.en: I am that bread of life .
My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito kiba lute ïa ka kin shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kwah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Let both grow together until the harvest : and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers , Gather ye together first the tares , and bind them in bundles to burn them : but gather the wheat into my barn .

translation.kha: Ka Hagar , kaba ïeng na ka bynta u lum Sinai ha Arabia , ka long ka dur jong ka nongbah Jerusalem kaba mynta , ka shong mraw ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka baroh .
A kano kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phai ieit ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog bad ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka Ïwei .
translation.en: Woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues , and greetings in the markets .
And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki pharshi jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren shaphang jong ki ,

U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah pynsynjor ba-halor tam ban ibeiñ ïa U Blei uba im . To ai ba U Trai U Blei jong Phin un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ha ki . Kumta duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew babha lehse im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .

And they said unto them , The  Lord  look upon you , and judge  ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , bad un pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi pynlong ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ban isih ïa ngi . Phi la ai daw ïa ki ban pynïap ïa ngi .
Mynta , bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka por ? Ki un-long kum ki khana kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa khawai pat ,
translation.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,

translation.kha: U la don saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki bym patan shongkurim kiba la pynthaba ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .

translation.kha: Te nga ai jingman ïa pha ban thied ksiar na nga , ka ksiar banylla , khnang ba phan riewspah . Thied ruh ïa ki jaiñkup balieh ban kup ïa lade bad ban Tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit bakhlemrain jong pha . Thiat ruh katto katne ka jingat ban tah ha ki khmat jongnga pha , khnang ba phah lah ban ïohi .
translation.en: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire , that thou mayest be rich  ; and white raiment , that thou mayest be clothed , and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear  ; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve , that thou mayest see .

translation.kha: Kane ka longïng kaba bha mala kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei U Nongpynbaptis jong ngi , Naamah u khiew ba uwei pa uwei un ïohlait im bad pun ïoh tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Who will have all men to be saved , and to come unto the knowledge of the truth .
Our holy and our beautiful house , where our fathers praised thee , is burned up with fire : and all our pleasant things are laid waste .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka Templ jong ngi , ka jaka kyntang bad ba-itynnat ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la ïaroh ïa me , la pynjot noh da ka ding . Baroh ki jaka kiba ngi ieit ki la don ha ka jingjot .

Suit pa uwei u la bam ha ban da kdang — la don kumba saw ïahiar ngut ki briew . nongthaw ki synran ki la ïalaw hynñiew tukri kiba la dap da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . U Jeshua u la phah nala ïa ki briew
translation.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .
And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain , and shewed me that great city , the holy Jerusalem , descending out of heaven from God ,
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha kliar jong u lumbah uba jrong . U la pyn-i ha nga ïa ka Jerusalem , ka Nongbah Bakhuid , kaba da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um long kum u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba u Joash u kpa jong u , u la leh .
Te lama ym pat haka ban shaniah ïa phi ha kaba pynïaid ïa ka spah pyrthei , kumno yn shaniah ha phi ïa ka sleh bymshisha ?
translation.en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ?

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Jesreel , u la hukum ïa phi ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied jaka baroh ar tylli , ka tiduh thiat jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban wan .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïai pynpaw ïa lade ha Shiloh , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u la kren ruh ha u . Bad haba u Samuel u kren , ki Israel baroh ki shahshkor .
U lyngkhuh u dei banbeiñ thang nala ïa ka , namar ka dei ka jingpang bthuh kaba pur , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .
translation.en: He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit phalang jongngi u , ki rangbah ka —Judah kiba la wan sha Gamaliel ban synran ïa u shuh shiliang ka haw , ki la ïakynduh ïa u ha ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: So the king returned , and came to Jordan . And Judah came to Gilgal , to go to meet the king , to conduct the king over Jordan .
Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :
translation.kha: La katta ruh , nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jinglong mynsiem . Hynrei , kam long ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei lane jong ki bor kiba synshar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki bor ki ban sa duh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .
Namar kata per la pynbna da ka jingsngewkhia ba ha ka ïohnang u Eli yn ym don jingkñia lane ka jingainguh kaba lah ban weng noh ïa kane ka pop bashyrkhei ba ka ïing jong u ka la leh .
translation.en: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli , that the iniquity of Eli s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever .

translation.kha: Shisien ka sngi , ka ïathuh ianga ba ka kajuh miaw .
translation.en: One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .
Have ye suffered so many things in vain ? if it be yet in vain .
translation.kha: Hato baroh kaba phi la mad kam don jingmut ei ei ? Da shisha ka don katto katne ka jingmut!

Ym shym la ai ha ki ka jingtep jingdonburom kum ïa ki riewïaleh ha ki por mynleh , kiba da kieng adkar bha hir ki leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ïa ki khamtam jong ki la buh hapoh ki khlieh jong ki bad ïa ki stieh jngai ki halor ki met jong ki . Kine ki riewshlur ki la long shisien kiba khlaiñbor bha ban pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .
translation.en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised , which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war : and they have laid their swords under their heads , but their iniquities shall be upon their bones , though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .
For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end  ;
translation.kha: Naba ngi long baroh ki nongïoh bynta bad U Khrist lada ngi batskhem haduh kaba kut ïa kata ka jingsngewskhem kaba ngi la don naduh kaba sdang .
Ka Athalaïah ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu maw ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jongu ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem .
translation.en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang don ha Jerusalem ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , shibun ki la ngeit ha u ibha ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .
Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names : for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar  ; and to Hananiah , of Shadrach  ; and to Mishael , of Meshach  ; and to Azariah , of Abed–nego .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh u la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki : u Belteshassar , u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego .

Kumta u Ahab u khor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sanspah ngut na ki , malade u kylli ïa ki , Hato ngan leit ne em ban tur ïalang ïa ka Ramoth ? Tur ïaleh ïa ka , ki Jubab , U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingtip .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh kata ka thain ; badno shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la wallam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiaw ha ki jingthiah jong ki .
translation.en: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong , ki briew ha ka pyrthei baroh ki la don tang kawei ka ktien ka thylliej bad pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki kyntien .

translation.en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ïa phi , hynrei ka shun ïa nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki lynti jong ka ki long kiba sniew .
u Philip bad u Bartholomai ; u Thomas bun u Matthaïos , u nongrim khajna ; u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos bad u Thaddaïos ;
translation.en: Philip , and Bartholomew  ; Thomas , and Matthew the publican  ; James the son of Alphaeus , and Lebbaeus , whose surname was Thaddaeus  ;

translation.kha: lymda uno uno na phi da ka jingjia ryngkhat u pynïap ïano ïano , u lah ban leit shata bad lait na uta naba wad kput .
translation.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee , the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ki hima badonbor kin ïaroh ïa me bad yn sheptieng ïa me ha ki nongbah jong ki hima bashyrkhei .

translation.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka hok bad u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki .
Mynta , kane baroh ka long ka nuksa ïa ngi , ngab maham ïa ngi ban ym kwah brai ïa kiei kiei babha sniew , kumba ki la lai , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba ne na ki kiba la leh kumta .
translation.en: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .

translation.kha: Da kumno uno uno u Lah ban ïasaid bad u ? U lah ban kulai shihajar tyllun ki jingkylli , ba ym don mano mano ba lah ba-bang jubab .
translation.en: If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .

translation.kha: Ïa ka pud kambah shaphang syngkai jngai ka Ïing , ki shna hynriew tyrnem ki jingïar ,
translation.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .

translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba la ju leit kiew sha bneng lait tang U Khun U bynriew , suba la woh hiar na bnai .
translation.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Lada ka briew kim tap ïa la ka khlieh , ka lah ba khambun ïa la u shñiuh . Bad Naaman ba ka longsem kaba sopti ïa ka briew ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ne khop ïa la u shñiuh , ka dei ban tip ïa la ka khlieh .
translation.en: For if the woman be not covered , let her also be shorn : but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven , let her be covered .

translation.kha: Da shisha ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka duitara ; ngan ïaroh ïa ka jingïaineh jongnga me , A Blei jong nga . Ha ka duitara jong nga ngan tei ïa ki jingrwai sha me , U Uta Khuid ki Jeruel .
translation.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery , even thy truth , O my God : unto thee will I sing with the harp , O thou Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ha-ei ka don , Namarba bishni U Jisu u la ïanguh hangta nabar la ki synran .
translation.en: And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .

Then shalt thou call , and the  Lord  shall answer  ; thou shalt cry , and he shall say , Here I am . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke , the putting forth of the finger , and speaking vanity  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , ngan jubab ïa phi . Haba phin khot ïa nga ngan jubab .  Lada phi pynkut noh ïa ka jingbanbeiñ , na man la ka jingleh ibeiñ , bad na man la ka ktien sniew ,

translation.en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , kum ki sohshnong bad ki nongphetwir ha kane ka pyrthei ! Wat aiti noh ha ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh , kiba long borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka mynsiem .

translation.en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan pyrshang ban lait phet na ki nongshun jong pha .
bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba jingpynïasoh hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Sekharaïah u la noh ïa ki ban leh kumta ; kim shym kriah shikyntien ruh .
translation.en: But the people held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .

translation.kha: Naba U Balei u kwah ïa phi ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingkren khlem pyllait jong ki briew kiba bieit da ki kai babniah ba phi leh .
translation.en: For so is the will of God , that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men :

translation.kha: Kata ka lyndum ïadie baroh shiah lynter naduh ka khyrdop kob shabar shaduh ka liang ba kut jong ka kamra bakhatduh ka la Long arphew san mitar .
translation.en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits .
