translation.kha: Ki khun shajrong malu ki khun kyntiap jong u baroh ki la ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei u kyntait ban shah pyntngen bad u ïai-ong , Ngan leit noh sha ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong ang . Kumta u ïai ïatim sngewieit na ka bynta u Joseph u khun jong u .
translation.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .

translation.kha: Naba u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u kylla Dieng bad phah noh sha Nebaïoth .
translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said unto them , Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ong ha ki ,  Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad hynñiew ngut na phi kin leit ha shuwa jong phi , da kaba kieng ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake to Manasseh , and to his people : but they would not hearken .
translation.kha: Wat la U  Trai  u la maham ïa u Manasseh bad ïa ki briew jong u , ki kyntait ban shahshkor .

translation.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counsellor , they cast lots  ; and his lot came out northward .
translation.kha: U Shelemaïah u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang mihngi , bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u , u briew uba ai ki jingmut kiba bha na ka por sha ka por , u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei .
Balei phim sngewtynnad ianga ?
translation.en: Why don't you like me ?

translation.kha: Lada phi kham pyn-i burom ïa u briew uba riam bha bad phi ong ïa u , To shongduh ha Kane ka jaka shong kaba bha tam , hynrei phi ong ïa u briew uba duk , To ïeng hangtai , lane to shong hangne ha madan hajan ki kjat jong nga ,
translation.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :
And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki paidbah baroh na ka Israel bashatei ki la ïawanlang ban pynlong syiem ïa u .

translation.en: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ai jingpynthikna ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei kaei baroh ka bit ka biang , haba baroh kam bit kam biang !  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Katno kaba bha bad kaba ryntih ka ri kan lama ! Ki samla ken san kin khlaiñ da u kaw bad ka wieh jong ka .
translation.en: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! corn shall make the young men cheerful , and new wine the maids .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit Jong nga ïa kba U blei u la ïakhot ! To pyrkhat ïa U Jisu , ïa uba U Blei u la pha ban long U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïaphla .
translation.en: Wherefore , holy brethren , partakers of the heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession , Christ Jesus  ;
And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?
translation.kha: U Manoah u jubab ,  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai burom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jong phi ki la urlong .
Ynda ki la mihnoh na —kata ka bakwah , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Atharim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: U thri u ïada ïa ki briew kiba ïadoh hok ; hynrei u pynjop ïa kito kiba leh bymdei .
translation.en: The way of the  Lord  is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: haba ki Ammon ki ïew ba ki Simri ki la her ïap , ki ruh ki la phet krad na u Abishai bad ki longing rung khong shapoh ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u wan phalang noh na ka jingïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad u leit ei sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , then fled they also before Abishai , and entered into the city . So Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka Abishag ka dem dara ha khyndew bad ka ong , Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba Kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shakri jyllang u .
translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban khñium , kumba don na ki , kiba la khñiang — bad la pynjot ïa ki da u Angel ka Jingïap .
translation.en: Neither murmur ye , as some of them also murmured , and were destroyed of the destroyer .
Then were they all of good cheer , and they also took some meat .
translation.kha: Ki la sngew ïoh mynsiem bad uwei uwei na ki ruh , ki la bam khyndiat ka jingbam .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard all the words , they were afraid both one and other , and said unto Baruch , We will surely tell the king of all these words .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah pule ïa ka , ki la ïaphai uwei sha uwei pat ha ka jingsngew sheptieng , bad ki la ong ha u Barukh ,  Ngi dei ban ïathuh ïa kane ha u syiem .
Uta u lyngdoh un shym ïa kata ka shong na phi bad buh ïa ka ha kham ka duwan U Trai U Blei jong phi ;
translation.en: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kaba kumne kine ki Dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingithuh .
translation.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours : therefore acknowledge ye them that are such .

translation.kha: Ngi la jlan ïap ! u shem Joram u la kyang jam . U Trai u la shuh ïa ngi lai lwet ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem Moab !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Alas ! that the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab !

translation.kha: hynriew kin ym lah ban leit kham jngai , namar baroh kin ïohi ba katno ki longïing kiba mutlop . Shata ka un-long kiei kaba dang dep jia ïa u Jannes bad u Jambres .
translation.en: But they shall proceed no further : for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was .

translation.kha: Ïa Kano kano kaba la bahryntieh noh yn wallam shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kano kano ka la slap yn sa klop bad yn sa pynpaw ha kaba shai .
translation.en: For nothing is secret , that shall not be made manifest  ; neither any thing hid , that shall not be known and come abroad .

translation.kha: Ki Apostol bad kiwei pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ïohsngew ba ki jingïatylli ruh ki la ïa-pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .
translation.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .

translation.kha: Ïa kane kajuh ka bniat la krong biang , Ken ym ïohnong da lei lei sha kata ka ri ha Kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait .
translation.en: And in this place again , If they shall enter into my rest .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ngeit , bad haba ki ïohsngew ba U Trai u la wan shuh ki bad ba u la ïohi kumto ki la shah lehbor tyngeh , ki la nguh la dem bad ki la ïamane shiah .
translation.en: And the people believed : and when they heard that the  Lord  had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Nophah , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kob la ïohi da u Naaman , uba dei na Elkosh .
translation.en: The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kabu khuid bad ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei , katba phi dang ap khmih ïa ka Sniew jong U Blei bad phi kun ïa kaba bha tam ban pynlong ïa ka ba kan wan kulai — ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ki bneng yn thang duh ei pynlang yn pynjot , bad ïa ki metbneng yn sa pynum ha ka jingkhluit .
translation.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God , wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat ?
As for me , is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?
translation.kha: Ka jingïania jong nga kam dei bad ki briew ki bym im junom ; nga don ka daw kaba biang ba ngam lah ban ïaishah .
Ki la jubab , I pa jong ngi , u sharati barit jong phira , i ïan im dara i shait i khlaiñ . Bad ki la im khohsiew bad ïuh ngon ha khmat jongu u .
translation.en: And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .
For every head shall be bald , and every beard clipped : upon all the hands shall be cuttings , and upon the loins sackcloth .
translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la khapnoh ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh . Baroh ki la pynmong ïa la ki kti , bad uwei pa uwei u phong ïa ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .
translation.kha: Wat pynrem ïa nga , A Blei , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa nga ?
Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa Kanneh khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingsuk da Kaba phi long lem mala nga . Ka pyrthei kan pynong ïa phi ban shahshitom . Hynrei to long shlur ! Nga , nga la jop ïa ka pyrthei !
translation.en: These things I have spoken unto you , that in me ye might have peace . In the world ye shall have tribulation : but be of good cheer  ; I have overcome the world .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngew kaba khat-ar jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem katba shiphew jongki ka jingshah ringmraw jyllang ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: In the tenth year , in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki parabangeit ïa Kiba la pynsakma da ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ kaban la jat mynnor haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , ka la pur shadong shat Phoenisia , Sypros , bad Antiokh , da kaba ïathuh ïa ka khubor tang ha ki Jiw .
translation.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .

translation.kha: Ha ka sur kaba jam ki shim ïa ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba kin bat ïa ka jingong , bad nangta ki Pyrta bad ki put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And they sware unto the  Lord  with a loud voice , and with shouting , and with trumpets , and with cornets .
He sent darkness , and made it dark  ; and they rebelled not against his word .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa ka jingdum ha ka ri , hynrei ki nong Ijipt kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .
Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la mihpaw ha u Salmon bad u kylli , kawei me kwah ba len ai ïa me ?
translation.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon , and said unto him , Ask what I shall give thee .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u rangbah pynïaidkam , Khlieh leit noh sha ïng , bad ïa kaei kaba me ngeit yn sa bor na ka bynta me . Bad ïa u shakri Jong u rangbah pynïaidkam la pynkhiah ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto the centurion ,  Go thy way  ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee .  And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha don ïaishah ban ïa kaba longsyiem uba donbor . Ka khem bha don don ka bor halor lade ban halor ki nongbah baroh .
translation.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty  ; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city .
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , hadien ba phi la lah pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .
Ki khlei jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , ki la ithuh shuh u Moses mala kiwei! pait ki nongïalam .
translation.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitlam ba phi lah ban ai ïa nga ? Ki hukum jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa nga ban mih kyrkieh kumne haduh ba ngam don por ban leit shim ïa la ka waitlam lane ïa kano kano ka atiar .
Naaman sem ne slap bad ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong ki nongrep ki pang ka dohnud ; ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translation.en: Because the ground is chapt , for there was no rain in the earth , the plowmen were ashamed , they covered their heads .

translation.kha: Wat Shua ïohnong hangto ! Leh kyrkieh ! Uta u khñium u Tam ïa uba u khnam bad u wan phai sha la u kynrad ,
translation.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad , Make speed , haste , stay not . And Jonathan s lad gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .

translation.kha: Wat ym shukor phi ïa lade hi , ym don mano mano uba ñiew babit ïa U Blei . U briew un ot ïa kaei kabu u bet .
translation.en: Be not deceived ; God is not mocked : for whatsoever a man soweth , that shall he also reap .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka nga ka wan , iehnoh ngut ki kynthei Kin batbor ïa iwei u briew bad ainong , Naei lah ban bsa bad pynkup jaiñ ïa lade , hynrei sngewma shah ïa ngi ïa-ban ino ba phi long u tngaw jong I , ba kumta ngin donkam ba-bang shah ïa ka jinglehkmen jong ka jinglong bym patan shongtynrai .
translation.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .
So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tebeth , u bnai ba-shiphew , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .
Phi pyrkhat ba katai kaba phi bor ka long kaba dei , hynrei ngan pynpaw ïa ki jingleh jong phi , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin ym lah ban ïarap ei ei ïa phi .
translation.en: I will declare thy righteousness , and thy works  ; for they shall not profit thee .

translation.kha: Te ki bri ki la khiar ïa ki maw ban lynthem ïa u .
translation.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him .

translation.kha: U baïap u la kynhied ïa ki bad ïong ïa ki ban sngap jar . Hynrei ki la nang pyrta kham jam , Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
translation.en: And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki briew hangamei ïa kaei kaba ma at , U Trai nongsharai , nga ong shaphang lad ki : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko Sidon ; ki briew’ kin ïaroh ïa por namar kaei kaweh nga leh ïa pha . Kun ïoh tip ba nga longïng U Tharai , haba nga pyn-i katno uba khuid nga long da kaweh pynshitom ïa kito kiba im hateng jong pha .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Zidon  ; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee : and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall have executed judgments in her , and shall be sanctified in her .
God is not a man , that he should lie  ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?
translation.kha: U Blei um long kum ki briew , kiba kren lamler ; Um long kum u briew uba kylla la ka jingmut . Kat kaba u kular , u pyndep ; U kren , bad la pyndep ïa kata .
U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , Ki phylliew ki la pynhiarkput jubor ïa ki nongshun ba la skhem bhah bad ki la pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingshan jong ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge , and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy it for the old hatred  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur thok . U sngewbha ha ki jingiwtung kiba khor .
translation.en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .
Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .
translation.kha: Mynta to ïeng joit kum u rangbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli kiba nga kylli ïa me .

translation.en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u kylli ,  Tharai ïa uno uno la pyntngit namar ba u la ktah ïa ka metïap . Te lada u ktah ïa kano kano na kine ki jingbam , hato kata kan pynlong ïa ki ruh ba la pyntngit ?  Ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Ho-oid .

Katba u Adonijah bad baroh bakha u la khoit sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli , Kiei ka jingtem jong kata ka jingsawa baroh khah ka nongbah ?
translation.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?

translation.kha: U Abijah u beh kthong ïa ka kynhun shipai u jahburom pynlang u ïohkhiah katto katne na ki nongjop jong u : ka Bethel , ka Hashabneïah , bad ka Ephron , bad ki nongrit kiba hajan jong kine ki nongbah .
translation.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam , and took cities from him , Beth–el with the towns thereof , and Jeshanah with the towns thereof , and Ephrain with the towns thereof .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew Jong nga , Kumno phi lah ban long kiba bieit mutlop sat ? Lano phin nang ïa kan ?
translation.en: Understand , ye brutish among the people : and ye fools , when will ye be wise ?
And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water , that bringeth forth his fruit in his season  ; his leaf also shall not wither  ; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki dieng kiba mih harud ka wahduid , kiba seisoh ha ka por kaba dei , bad kiba ki sla jong ki kim tyrkhong . Ki jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ki leh .

Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki Israel . Ïathuh ïa ki ba ynda la kem ïongreiñ kin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam , bun ha ka par mynstep kin sa Ïoh u kpu suba ki kwah . Te kin tip ba ma nga , U Trai ar long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them , saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God .
And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him : and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :
translation.kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u . U la pynïeng ïa u Joshua ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad uta u paidlang baroh .
Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa kaba beiñ , uba la kyrkhu bad tong ma u hi , U nongshoh-nar , U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .
translation.en: Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :
translation.kha: Haba u nongshet kpu rangbah u la ïohi ba kata ka jingbatai ïa ka jingphohsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga ruh nga la phohsniew ; nga la kit lai tylli ki shang kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .
Bad ha kata hi ka Jaka ha kaba ki la ong , ‘Phim de ki briew jong nga .’ Hangta yn khot ïa ki , ki khun jongu U Balei ba-im .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people ; there shall they be called the children of the living God .
Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad kan pynsngewtynnat ïa ka jingim jong phi bad ka ai jingsuk lynter ïa phi .
sbun ki briew ki la wan sha u . U Ijon um ai kambah ei ei , ki la ong , hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong shaphang une u briew ka la longïng kaba shisha .
translation.en: And many resorted unto him , and said , John did no miracle : but all things that John spake of this man were true .

translation.kha: Ka la erlangthari ka mon lad me badno ka jingthmu jong me , ban leh ïa Kanneh ; me la leh ïa kine ktien kiei kiba khraw khnang ba hikai ïa nga .
translation.en: For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .

translation.kha: bad phi ym lah da lei lei ban sngewkynduh aïu U Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lwa . Ki briew ibha stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hawei kdor tip .
translation.en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
How is Sheshach taken ! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised ! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations !
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Babilon :  Ïa ka nongbah kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la ïaroh la kurup ïa ka ! Katno kaba itriem ban ïohi ba ka Babilon ka la long ïa ki jaitbynriew !
Balei phi! ngiah ia ka kali ?
translation.en: Why do you drive the car ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki mane ha kiba ki shongkha la tap da ka prie bad ym don shuh ka bynta kaba khuid .
translation.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness , so that there is no place clean .

translation.kha: U Issakhar bad ki khum shynrang jong u : u Taralah , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translation.en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .

translation.kha: Bad U Jingsuk u la pynkie , To shahshkor , te , paila phi don ki shkor !
translation.en: Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .
translation.kha: To wan bad bam shuh sa khyndiat ,  u ong , hynrei um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat ka long kaei kaba u long da shisha .
Katba u Jakob u dang ïakren bad ki , ka Rakhe ka la poi bad la ka kynjoh langbrot .
translation.en: And while he yet spake with them , Rachel came with her father s sheep : for she kept them .
But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .
translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi lah ban kum jynrat katto katne u kew lem bad ki .
Kane ka la i koum ka jingai jingtem kaba bha ïa u Absalom bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jongno ki Israel .
translation.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well , and all the elders of Israel .
For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth .
translation.kha: naba ka dei ka jingshai kaba pynmih ïa ka jingot kaba kyrhai ha baroh ki jinglong babha , bahok , bad bashisha .

translation.en: I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ? God is not the God of the dead , but of the living .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’ U long U Blei jong kiba im bad ym jong kiba ïap .

translation.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin , so shall thy sons marry thee : and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride , so shall thy God rejoice over thee .
translation.kha: Kum u samla uba shim ïa ka theisotti kum ka nongleitkurim jong u , uta uba pynlong ïa pha un shongkurim ïa pha , kumba u nongleitkurim u shem sngewbha bad ka nongleitkurim jong u , kumta U Blei jong pha un shem sngewbha ïa pha .

Ki rangbah shipai , ki riewpawkhmat , ki rangbah pyndik , bad ki briew baroh , ki ïadon lang sad u Jehoïada ha jingïa-ïaid paidbah kaba wan ïalam ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ka ïingsyiem . Ki rung na ka khrud bah , bad u syiem u shong halor ka khot .
translation.en: And he took the captains of hundreds , and the nobles , and the governors of the people , and all the people of the land , and brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  : and they came through the high gate into the king s house , and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom .

translation.kha: Da kumta phin leh ïa i'u ki shnong kiba shai jngai na kata ka ri ha kaba phin shong .
translation.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la leit hiar , bad u la dem pyllup halor jong u bad u la kput ïa u . Wat khuslai , u la ong , u dang im !
translation.en: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves  ; for his life is in him .

translation.kha: Nalor Baroh , kine ki long ki briew kiba me la iaid ban longïng ki jong me bad kiba me la wallam noh na ka ri Ijipt da ka tam bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ jong me .’
translation.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia , ko Duriaw , ban pynlong ïa pha ban phet noh ? Bad ma pha , ko Jordan , balei ba pha sangeh ban tuid ?
translation.en: What ailed thee , O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?

And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
translation.kha: Kawei na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa ngi ka dei ka Lydia kaba na Thiatira , ka dei ka nongdie ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh . Ka long ka briew kaba mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trai u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .

U Trai u ong ha u , Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga halor u lum . Hadien kata , U Trai u la ïaid nangta nabar u la phah ïa ka lyer bajur kaba la nang kylliang ïa ki lwa bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawsiang — hynrei U Trai um shym don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ban beh , malu nangta la khie u jumai — hynrei U Trai um shym don ha u jumai .
translation.en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
And ye shall compass the city , all ye men of war , and go round about the city once . Thus shalt thou do six days .
translation.kha: Ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me men ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah shisien shi sngi haduh hynriew sngi .

translation.en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
translation.kha: Mynba U Jisu u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la wan sha u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .
Hynrei kat haduh ka snem kabu arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash ki lyngdoh Kim pat shym la shna pynbha ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: But it was so , that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka on kaba jam kaba kren na ka khet : mynta ka ïng jong U blei ka long Bad u bynriew ! Un shongkha bad ki , bad kin long ki briew jong u . U Blei da lade hi un long bad ki , badno un longïing U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying , Behold , the tabernacle of God is with men , and he will dwell with them , and they shall be his people , and God himself shall be with them , and be their God .
And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh bad u  ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .

Kaba kham shuwa ka kthang ka Oholah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Samaria ) , bad kaba hadien ka kyrteng ka Oholibah ( ka mihngi pli ïa ka Jerusalem ) . Nga shongkurim ïa ki baroh ar ngut , bad ki kha ïa ki khun ïa nga .
translation.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder , and Aholibah her sister : and they were mine , and they bare sons and daughters . Thus were their names  ; Samaria is Aholah , and Jerusalem Aholibah .

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynheh ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da kaban ong ba ba-don eiei patan u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .
translation.en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .

But the people answered , Thou shalt not go forth : for if we flee away , they will not care for us  ; neither if half of us die , will they care for us : but now thou art worth ten thousand of us : therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban leit lang bad ngi ,  ki la ong .  Kam don jingktah ei ei ïa u nongshun lada kiba sah na ngi ki phai dien bad phet lane lada shiteng na ngi ki la shah pynïap ; hynrei phi ïaryngkat dor bad shiphew hajar ngut na ngi . Kan kham bha lada phi shong hangne ha ka nongbah bad phah jingïarap ïa ngi .

translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
translation.kha: ha kaba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki wan mih na kata ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .

translation.en: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban long u riewmadan uba trei ban ïoh bam ban kaba leh mynleh kum uba khraw hynrei bad ka shahthngan .
lada phi pynroh ïa ki paralok jong phi , pa buh jingriam ïa lade .
translation.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet .

translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u woh kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïapom jong u ki longkmie kum ka erlangthari , nabar ki kyllaiñ jongnga u ki kham stet baneh ïa ki pukni . Me la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !
translation.en: Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .

translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la jat sep , u Abram u shoh samthiah eh , bad ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingsngew sngewshyrkhei ka la wan ha u .
translation.en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .

translation.kha: U ïada ïa ki nongwei bakha shnong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki kynduh , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman shwa ka jingjot jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
The  Lord  hath brought forth our righteousness : come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki pyrta , ‘ U  Trai  u la pyn-i ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei . Ïa ngin ïaleit bad ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la leh .’

Namar kano , ha ka shi sngi yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khleh — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewnguh bad ka nemsniew . Bad yn thang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Tlai uba U Blei , uba bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .
translation.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
When I blow with a trumpet , I and all that are with me , then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and say , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
translation.kha: Ynda ma nga bad ka kynhun jong nga ngi put ïa la ki turoi , phi ruh put ïa la ki turoi baroh sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad pyrta jam , ‘ Ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !’

Bteng lang san tyllep kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long kawei ka jaiñ jingtap , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriewspah tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ babha sah ba kin long kawei pat ka jaiñ-jin jingmihpat . Khylliap ar syrtap ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ kob hynñiew kaba ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Kumno pa nud ban pyrshing Ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki Israel na kaba jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri ba U Trai u la ai ha ki ?
translation.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the  Lord  hath given them ?
And he built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .
translation.kha: U la tei biang ïa ki nongbah baroh ha Hamath kiba long ki jaka buh jingbam .

translation.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth  ; because his sons made themselves vile , and he restrained them not .
translation.kha: Nga lah da ïathuh ha u ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka ïing jong u junom , namar ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kren sniew pyrshah ïa nga . U Eli u tip ba ki leh kumne hynrei bad um shym la khang ïa ki .

bad artet lyngngoh ka Them Hinnom ter ter sha ka phang bashathie jong u lum ha kabu don ka nongbah Jerusalem jong ki Jebus . Nangta u pum u kiew artet sha ka kliar u lum ha ka Phan sepngi jong ka Them Ahinoam , ha ka tduh bashatei jyllang ka Them Rephaim .
translation.en: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite  ; the same is Jerusalem : and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward , which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward :

translation.kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khynñiat kan kylla eh kum u nar .
translation.en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .
And the light shineth in darkness  ; and the darkness comprehended it not .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka shai ha kaba dum , bad ka jingdum kam lah ban pynlip ïa ka .
U Peor u la jubab , Ko Kynrad , nga kloi ban leit sha ka ïingbyndi bad me bad ngab ïaphah lem bad me !
translation.en: And he said unto him , Lord , I am ready to go with thee , both into prison , and to death .

translation.kha: Haba ki poi hangamei , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlam pynsah wat uwei hima . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la ïathuh ha u Isaia ba kan jhieh .
translation.en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkloi !’ u la noh . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynjop ïa u . Pynphong sati ha ka shynriah ti jongno u bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Syria ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih ba bun jong pha . Ki la ai ïa ki mawkordor Emerald , ki jaiñ bajrong , ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsha , ki Koral , malade ki mradkhlaw Rabboni kum ka jingsniew na ka boitha ki mar jong pha .
translation.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .

translation.kha: Ong ïa u , ba nga U Trai nga ong ïa u , ‘ Hadien ba me la pynïap ïa u brisoh hab men shim ruh ïa ka khyndew jong u ?’ ïateh ruh ha u ïa kaei ba sa ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka khang ba ki ksar ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth , kin jliah umdih ïa ka snam jong me !’
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .

translation.kha: La sam jingbam ïa ki na ka miej u Jehoshaphat , badno ïa u Benjamin la sam san shah pun ïa uno uno na ki . Kumta keiñ ki la ïabam ïadih mala leh sngewbha dara u Joseph .
translation.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin s mess was five times so much as any of theirs . And they drank , and were merry with him .

translation.kha: Kane namar ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai’ Nongsynshar , nga ong : Ïa ki pah jong phoi la pynpaw . Baroh ki tip katno kiba bymman phi long . Phi pyn-i ïa la ki pop ha ki kam lad phi! baroh . Phi long ba la pynrem , bad ngan aiti neh ïa phi ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered , in that your transgressions are discovered , so that in all your doings your sins do appear  ; because , I say , that ye are come to remembrance , ye shall be taken with the hand .

translation.kha: A katno bathoiñ long uba shadem bad uba ken , bad katno kiwei ruh kin kmen haba yn kha ïa u !
translation.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness  ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .

translation.kha: Wat pynïap briew .
translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .

translation.kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh hangta .
translation.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ha khmih ! U ïakren ha u paidbah , malade kim ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba Ki ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dem U Messaïah ?
translation.en: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?

translation.kha: U Trai , U Balei ki Israel ,
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
In their heat I will make their feasts , and I will make them drunken , that they may rejoice , and sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hato ki jlawnguid ? Ngan pynkhreh ïa ki ka jingkhawai bad pynlong ïa ki ban buaid bad sngewtynnat . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh .
bad kumta u la kylli ïa U Trai kaei ba un leh . Hynrei U Trai um shym jubab ei ei ïa u , la ha ki jingkynshew , lane da u Harim pynlang u Thummim , lane da ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when Saul enquired of the  Lord  , the  Lord  answered him not , neither by dreams , nor by Urim , nor by prophets .

translation.kha: U Absalom u la phet krad Bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Admatha , u syiem Geser bad u la sah Haneng lai snem . U Dabid u la ïapbriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u khun jong u ;
translation.en: So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .

translation.kha: Kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Hima hynrei ki bymseisoh ïa ka , ki long kum ki symbai kiba la hap ha sia lynter ka lynti ïadie kjat . Uta u bahynriew u wan bad u lngaid ei ïa kamai kaba la bet hapoh jong ki .
translation.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ngeit bad uba shah pynbaptis , yn pynim ; ïa uno du u bymngeit , yn pynrem .
translation.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved  ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .

translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bun u Jahas ki kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewdiaw , bad ki leit bad ïakhot sha u syier ïa kaei kabu u rangbah synrai ka Assyria u la ong .
translation.en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rab–shakeh .
Ye shall utterly destroy all the places , wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods , upon the high mountains , and upon the hills , and under every green tree :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka ri ba phi ïohkynti , pynjot ïa ki jaka baroh ha kiba ki briew ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki ha ki lum kiba jrong , ha ki lumrit , bad hapoh ki dieng kiba jyrngam .

translation.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na ki , ki la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .
U Trai u la kren ha per ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
Did not I weep for him that was in trouble ? was not my soul grieved for the poor ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam shym la ïam bad ki briew ba shem jingeh bad sngewsih ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingkyrduh ?

translation.en: And David said unto Achish , But what have I done ? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day , that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla aïu eh keiñ , kynrad ? Lada , kumba phi ong , ba phim shym la shem jingbakla ha nga naduh ka sngi ba nga sdang ban shakri ïa phi , balei ba ngam dei ban leit bad phi , u kynrad bad u syiem jong nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ?

translation.en: According to the custom of the priest s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .
translation.kha: Kat kum ka rukom ba la bud da ki lyngdoh , la jied ïa u da kaba kynting sbai ban thang jingiwbih halor ka duwan . Kumta u la leit shapoh ka Templ jong U Trai ,
Uwei uwei baroh un shun ïa phi namar jong nga .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake .

translation.kha: Hynrei to kynmaw , ko ki paralok jong to , ïa kaei ba la ïathuh ha pa mynshuwa da ki apostol jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong i'u .
translation.en: But , beloved , remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym shym la ngeit ki la pynkhih ïa ki Jehiel malu ki la pynlong ïa ki ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa riewngeit .
translation.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .

translation.kha: Nangta u la thaw ka duwan ïa U Trai bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U Terah u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .
translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .
And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: U Blei uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , u la buhrieh ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki pateng baroh kiba mynshuwa ,
Mynta , ka long kaba bhah ban don kum kata ka jingtasngeng kaba khrup “lada ka jingthmu ka un-long kaba bha — kane ka long naba shisha borabor , bad ym dei tang hajuh nga don ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .
Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , I beseech thee , save thou us out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  God , even thou only .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to pyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khnang ba baroh ki hima ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi , U  Trai  , me long U Blei .
wat la u leit ha shuwa jong phi borabor ban wad ka jaka ba Phon sher dara . ïa-ban kdew lynti ïa phi , u ïaid ha shuwa jong phi ha u rishot ding mynmiet bad ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi .
translation.en: Who went in the way before you , to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , in fire by night , to shew you by what way ye should go , and in a cloud by day .

translation.kha: Khenani tharai mynta me pynim ïa ka met jong u — un tdem ïa me mihkhmat !
translation.en: But put forth thine hand now , and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will curse thee to thy face .
Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki la long kiba bieit , ki shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki bad namar ka jingsniew jong ki ;
Ki bri kiba la ïaid ha ka jingdum ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ki la shong ha ka ri jongno ki syrngiew , hynmen myntoi ka jingshai ka la tyngeh ba-halor jong ki .
translation.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .

Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pynkyntang ïa ka jaka pdeng jong ka phyllaw , ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangta ba la thang tylli , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ na ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa kine ki jingainguh baroh .
U Moses u jubab , Lydda phi da mudui shisha kumba phi ong , te hangno ha khmat U Trai to khreh ïa-ban leit sha ka thma .
translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the  Lord  to war ,

translation.kha: U Ahijah u lwait noh ïa ka jaiñkup thymmai kaba u phong , u kad ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot ,
translation.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him , and rent it in twelve pieces :

translation.kha: Ki kput ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki ; ki kmie kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki kiaw kurim kin long pyrsa ïa ki pisa kurim kynthei jong ki dara ki pisa kurim kynthei byrsha ïa ki kiaw jong ki .
translation.en: The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
And afterwards she bare a daughter , and called her name Dinah .
translation.kha: Hadien ka la kha khun kynthei , ïa kaba ka la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Dinah .

Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kambah ong , Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap ! U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba Khie arliang ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jaijai katba khraw .
translation.en: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .

translation.kha: Nga Duwai , A Blei , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynkhamti ïa ki . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la pyrshang ban pynhieng ïa nga .
translation.en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u pyn-i shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , ba ïa ka lyngki sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ym pat lah don plie , katba kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .
translation.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :

translation.kha: Lada phi leit shuh ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban ithuh sharati ka long ban tur sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kwah ba ki tarajur bad ki mawthew ki dei ban long kiba beit bad baroh ka jingïadie ïathied kan long kaba hok .

translation.en: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him : and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded . So they left off speaking with him  ; for the matter was not perceived .
translation.kha: Te baroh ki rangbah synshar ki la wan ban kylli ïa nga , bad nga la ong ïa ki thik kumba u syiem u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha ki . Ym don ei ei pat kaba ki lah ban leh , namar ym don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren .
Ki ïa-ong , Mynta to ngin ïatei khwai ka nongbah kaba anna u mot Uba kot haduh sahit bneng , ba kumta , ngin da ban thaw nam ïa lade bad ym ban ïasah ha kyllaiñ ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven  ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .

translation.kha: Nongthaw ngan sa weng noh ïa ka kti jong nga , bad men sa ïohi ïa ka ingdong jongnga nga ym ïa ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba ngi la wanrah biang sha phi na Kanaan ïa kito ki pisa ba ngi lade ha khlieh ki byrni jongnga ngi . Balei keiñ ngin leit tuh kat ïa ka rupa ne ksiar na ka ïit u kynrad jong phi ?
translation.en: Behold , the money , which we found in our sacks  mouths , we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan : how then should we steal out of thy lord s house silver or gold ?
Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: U la ailad ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong u na bneng khnang ba u lah ban hikai ïa phi ; bad hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phin ïohi ïa ka ding kaba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .
U Saul u sngewthuh Shaei ba U Trai u ba-don ryngkat bad u Dabid bun ba ka Mikhal ka ïakhun jong u ka ieit ïa u .
translation.en: And Saul saw and knew that the  Lord  was with David , and that Michal Saul s daughter loved him .

translation.kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisnem uwei u Briew uba la ne ar ngut ki khun shynrang . U la leit Sha uba kham san bad u la ong , ‘ Ko khum , khiar sien bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ mynta ka sngi .’
translation.en: But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kiwei pat ki shakri lem bad kñia ka khubor ïa ki nongshahkhot sngewbha : ‘ La dap khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong per mynta , la dep shohdoh ïa ki masi dab mala ïa ki Kynhun masi bakynsai jong nga , pynlang la khreh ïa kaei kiei baroh . To Aber sha ka jingkhawai shongdor !’
translation.en: Again , he sent forth other servants , saying , Tell them which are bidden , Behold , I have prepared my dinner : my oxen and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready : come unto the marriage .
The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps , and strangled for his lionesses , and filled his holes with prey , and his dens with ravin .
translation.kha: U sing u pynïap ïa ka jingbam jong u bad u tar ïa ka lyngkhot lyngkhot na ka bynta ka sing jong u bad ki khun jong ka ; u la pyndap ïa ka krem jong u da ka doh ba la patar .
bad Kum ka bainong namar ka pop jong u , u dem ïa-ban wallam shwa U Trai ïa ka langbrot ne ka Blang kynthei kum ka jingainguh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia nongmareh ka pop jong uta u briew .
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïeng hangta , u da phong ki jaiñ bajakhlia .
translation.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and stood before the angel .

translation.kha: Ka erlangthari kob sngewshngain ïa pop! Da shisha yn don la kumno kumno u briew naba stad ha ka kynhun jongngi phi uba lah ba pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki parabangeit .
translation.en: I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?

translation.kha: Ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu to kan long lym bad phi .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi hi un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un pynpait ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sheng hangta , khnang ba phan ïohkynti ïa ka ri jyllang ki ; nabar u Isaiah un longïing u nongïalam jong phi , kumba U Trai u la ong .
translation.en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .

translation.kha: Haba u syier Ahasaïah u ïohthiah ïa kaei kaba la jia , kumin u phet ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shongneh Beth Haggan , ba la beh kyrtong da u Jehu . Pynïap ïa u ruh ! U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u kaban u dang ñiad ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kiew sha jur kaba khatsan ka shnong Ibleam . Hynrei u la ïohlad ban nang leit dat shuh ba un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo , ha kaba u ïap .
translation.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .

translation.kha: Katno ngi ainguh ïa U Blei ba u la pynlong ïa u Titos ban thrang kum ma ngi ban ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .

translation.kha: U weng nala ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki jaka mane blang thala , u pynpra ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang , badno u ot noh ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah .
translation.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places , and brake down the images , and cut down the groves :

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To ïatyngkhuh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jrong u Jakob , ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah :
translation.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob , and publish it in Judah , saying ,

translation.kha: Ulla u bariew u la batbor ïa kata ka briew kaba la ïatehktien , bad wat la ka la lynñiar ruh , ym don mano mano ba wanrah ïarap ïa ka .
translation.en: For he found her in the field , and the betrothed damsel cried , and there was none to save her .

translation.kha: hynrei kim lah ban shem ei ei , wat la shisha bun ki briew ki la wan sha khmat bad kren ki jinglamler shaphang jong u .
translation.en: But found none : yea , though many false witnesses came , yet found they none . At the last came two false witnesses ,

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Amasa , Khot ngan ïa ki ngab Judah bad wan biang shaniah la Sei sngi lema bad ki .
translation.en: Then said the king to Amasa , Assemble me the men of Judah within three days , and be thou here present .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïohi kawei kaba jai ha ki jakarieh baroh ; u khmih halor jong ngi , la ngi leh ïa kaba bah ne kaba sniew .
translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .

translation.kha: Naduh mynta , te , pa dei ïa-ban im ïa kaba sah jrong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei , ka jingim ba la synshar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da ki jingkwah jong ka doh .
translation.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .
But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shipai jong ki ka la mih ban leit kem ïa u . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la ker kynroh .
Ki mane wat ïa ki jar tong dohthang jongno ki mala ai jingkñia ha ki , namar ki lade jong ki , ki pyndap ïa ki da kiei kiei baroh kiba bha tam .
translation.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net , and burn incense unto their drag  ; because by them their portion is fat , and their meat plenteous .

translation.kha: Nga la bthah ïa ki ban bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba ki la ieit bad ban ym pynlong ïa biar ki bymïaineh da ki plie ba-thala jong ka ibieit , namar ba nga , nga long U Trai U Blei jongno ki .
translation.en: Then said I unto them , Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes , and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba trei shitom , kaba khlaiñ dara kob minot .
translation.en: She girdeth her loins with strength , and strengtheneth her arms .

translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa u pynlang katba ni ïa kaba dei ki un-long kiba la pyndeng sngewma da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .
translation.en: But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .

translation.kha: Un leit phai pang na ka lyngkot ha kaba u wan , khlem da rung ha kane ka nongbah . Nga , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki Don ka long tang don shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :

translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba shisha , da ka dohnud Kaba shlei da ka jingieid ïa la u khun , ka ïong ha u syiem , sngewbit , ko Shimham Kynrad , wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka ! Khenani kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ïa-ong , Waw ai ïa u hano ha na i'u ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .
translation.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .

translation.kha: u la ïai-ong ha ki , Nga la khuslai shaphang ka jingphohsniew kaba ar la ïoh . Nga kwah ba tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: And the king said unto them , I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit was troubled to know the dream .

translation.kha: U jubab , Phi tip ba nga la dem ban long syiem bun ba uwei pa uwei baroh ha Israel u khmih lynter ïa kata . Hynrei ka la jia long da kumwei pah , mala u para jong per u la long syiem Naamah ka dei ka “mon U Trai .
translation.en: And he said , Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign : howbeit the kingdom is turned about , and is become my brother s : for it was his from the  Lord .
A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty  ; but a fool s wrath is heavier than them both .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhia u maw bad u shyiap kam long ei ei ban haba ïanujor bad ka jingjynjar kaba uba mutlop u lah ban pynjia .
U Trai U Blei jongngi phi! un pynlong ïa ki ban kynriah na phi , bad un beh ïa ki katba phi nang ter sha khmat . Phin ïoh ïa ka ri jong ki , kumba U thri U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  your God , he shall expel them from before you , and drive them from out of your sight  ; and ye shall possess their land , as the  Lord  your God hath promised unto you .
Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na phi un ong ha nga ,  Lada kane ka long kumta , kumno U Blei un shem jingbakla badno badno ? Uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?
U syiem u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bun u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew , kam la ai jingmut nia ki samla .
translation.en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;

translation.kha: U wan ïalam ïa ka jait Judah sha khmat , shi kur shi kur , bad la kdew ïa ka kada ki Serah . Nangta u wan ïalam ïa ka kur Serah sha Khmut , shi ïing shi ïing , bad la kdew ïa ka ïing u Sabdi .
translation.en: And he brought the family of Judah  ; and he took the family of the Zarhites : and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man  ; and Zabdi was taken :

translation.kha: wahbah u Moses u la poi hajar tala ka jaka sher dara na kaba u ïohi ïa ithuh u khun masi bad ïa ka jingïashad jong kita ki paidïapom , u Moses u bitar lep . Hangta ha trei u lum , u lynthaw ïa ngi ki mawlyngkniap kiba u rah haduh ba ki da peiñ .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses  anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .

translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba len Wallam ha Jerusalem kad nym wan khih hadien ka jingïap jong phi . Ngan shahskhor ïa phi ban ïaphah ha kaba suki . Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat Sha u syiem Josaïah bad kane ka nongrah-khubor .
translation.en: Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .
How much are these ?
translation.kha: Katno kine ?
Nga la ringswai , A Trai , da kaba ap ïa me ban pynim ïa nga ; nga buh ka jingshaniah ha ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation : but I hope in thy word .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros , Nga ong ha me ba myntri ka miet , ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem iathuh ïa at .
translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .

translation.kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don Shua ka jingmad ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
translation.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jongngi ki , kiba jyrsieh kum ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , ki long kum ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba sei ki soh kiba kthong bad don bih ,
translation.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom , and of the fields of Gomorrah : their grapes are grapes of gall , their clusters are bitter :

translation.kha: Ki khun jong phi kin san shun ïarap ïa phi , ym ki nongwei .
translation.en: Let them be only thine own , and not strangers  with thee .
And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah , What shall be the sign that the  Lord  will heal me , and that I shall go up into the house of the  Lord  the third day ?
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba U  Trai  un pynkhiah ïa nga bad ba hadien lai sngi ngan sa lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?
Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lyngkhot maw-it ïa pha , malu kin ot lyngkhot ïa pha da ki waitlam jong ki .
translation.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u jubab , Wat lada phi ai ïa nga shiteng na ka spah jong phi , ngan ym leit bad phi lane bam lane dih ei ei bad phoi .
translation.en: And the man of God said unto the king , If thou wilt give me half thine house , I will not go in with thee , neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place :

translation.kha: Nga tip ba U Trai u long uba khraw , khnam khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For I know that the  Lord  is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .

translation.kha: bad shai kilo u purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot , lem ryngkat bad ïa ki jingainguh waiñ kiba dakmong .
translation.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs :
How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
translation.kha: Kiei ki pop jong nga ? Kiei ki bym dei kiba nga la leh ? Ki kam sniew aïu ba la ujor ïa nga ?

translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan , U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad ki , bad men kylla long da uwei pat u briew .
Nangta u pynkhih bad ïalam nong ïa ki Israel ; ki rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad barabor ki la long kiba kyr-eit kiba khiah bad katba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold : and there was not one feeble person among their tribes .

translation.kha: Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban dang Wan ba kan long ka jrong kaba ïaineh junom . Ngan long U Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .

translation.kha: Me tap ïa ki hukum : ‘ wai pynïap ; wat klim ; wiat tuh ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmienah jong me .’
translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jesse u phah kut ïa u . U long uba bhabriew , u jingkam bakoit bakhiah bad ki Khmut kiba phyrnai . U Trai u ong ha u Samuel , Dei une — pynsleh ïa u !
translation.en: And he sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , and withal of a beautiful countenance , and goodly to look to . And the  Lord  said , Arise , anoint him : for this is he .
There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam miet ïa u hangta , ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïarap ban sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na kito kiba la ïashong bam ha ka miej lem bad U Jisu .
U Joseph u ong ha u syiem , Ki jingphohsniew baroh ar tylli ki mut ïa kajuh . U Blei u la ïathuh ha Phin ïa kiei kob un sa leh .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka long kaba bang bha ; a katno ngi ieit ban nguid ïa ka !

Ko Patsha ka Asasaïah , ki lat jongu me ki la ïarap , bad ki nongbah donburom jong me ki ïohktah jingmut ! Ïa ki briew jyllang me la pynkmen halor ki lumbah , bad ym don shuh mano mano ba-bang wanlam pat ïa ki sha ïing .
translation.en: Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .

translation.kha: U nongpeit u bet ïa ka khubor U Blei .
translation.en: The sower soweth the word .

translation.kha: Katba nga dang duwai ha ka nongbah Joppa , nga la ioh ka jingïohipaw . Nga la ïohi ïa kiei re kaei kaba wan hiar na bneng kambah i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa ka la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka , bun ka la sangeh hajan jong nga .
translation.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying : and in a trance I saw a vision , A certain vessel descend , as it had been a great sheet , let down from heaven by four corners  ; and it came even to me :

translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan yn pynim noh malu ki duwan jingiwbih kin pra . Beor ki briew kiba hangtei kin shah pynpyut ha khmat ki bleithaw lad ki .
translation.en: And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .

translation.kha: Ki jait Naphtali kdor shym la beh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Beth Shemesh sad ha Bethanath . Ki paid Naphtali ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki iaka , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh , nor the inhabitants of Beth–anath  ; but he dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh and of Beth–anath became tributaries unto them .

translation.kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki bani Israel , ki shim ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , slem Bad ïa ki khun shngain bad khun kynthei jong u Adnah , ki jingri jong u , ki kada jong u , bad ki langbrot jrong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei kamai baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Jingjynjar .
translation.en: And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .

translation.kha: Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kambah kyndok Sha U Trai ba ngin ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthah .
translation.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?

But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael , Slay us not : for we have treasures in the field , of wheat , and of barley , and of oil , and of honey . So he forbare , and slew them not among their brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei la don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha ka kynhun kiba la ong ha u Ishmael ,  Sngewbha wat pynïap ïa ngi ! Ngi don u kew , u barli , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap ba la buhrieh ha ki lyngkha .  Kumta u la pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal :
translation.kha: Nga la ai palat ïa ka shispah ton ka ksiar nylla bad la jan arspah sawphew ton ka rupa nylla ban pynitynnat ïa ki kynroh jong ka Templ
Me wan ïalam ïa ki shapoh bad me buh ïa ki ha u lumbah jong me , ha ka jaka kaba me , ko Troas , me la jied na ka bynta ka ïing jong me , ka Templ kaba me hi me la tei .
translation.en: Thou shalt bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O  Lord  , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .

translation.kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa me bad ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbang jong ka ïingbishar syiem , bad pynshongdor nongrim ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .
translation.en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka por ba nga la don bad phi , ngam shym la pynkhuslai ïa phi ban ïarap haba nga la donkam peiñ ; ki parabangeit kiba la wang na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha per ïa kiei kiei baroh Ibbah na la donkam . Kum ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta jin ha ka lawei : Da lei lili sam ym bashongkhia ïa pa !
translation.en: And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .
Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka dei kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da lade u la dep rai ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !

translation.en: Tell me where the wine is .
translation.kha: Iathuh ianga haei ka waiñ ka don .
Kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u nong kumta kan long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Beor .
translation.en: And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u shah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Ki la kem ïa u Manasseh , ki pyndait jingbnoh ha u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , bad ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .

Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U TRAI’ pynlang u ong , Me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka jingsop kaba khraw ; hab ngan Shu ïap mynta na ka jingsneng um bad ban hap ha ki kti jongki kine ki Philistia bymngeit ?
translation.en: And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
And he arose , and did eat and drink , and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la khie joit , u bam bad u dih bad ka jingbam ka la ai bor ïa u ban ïaid sawphew sngi sha Sinai , u lum bakhuid .

translation.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem dei ban shah ïa u ban lait khlem ka jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba men leh , bad me dei ban khmih ba u dei ban shah pynïap .

Nangta u Apollos u la kut jingmut pun leit shaw Akhaïa , kumta ki parabangeit ha Ephesos ki la ïarap ïa u da kaba thoh sha ki parabangeit Ibbah ha Akhaïa , da kaba Kyrpad ïa ki ban pdiang Sngewbha ïa u . Haba u la poi , u la un-long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa kito kiba da ka jingaiei jong U Blei ki la kylla long ki parabangeit .
translation.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïew ïa ka ba ka ïan , bad u la ïohi kumno ba ki briew bakha la ïadon lem sad ka , ki ruh ki la ïa-ïam ; ka la ktah ïa ka dohnud jong u , bad la pynkhiah jur ïa u .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,

translation.kha: Ym ki rangbah synshar kin ino ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit mynsiem ? dalade don , ai un leit phai sha la iing , ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’
translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
translation.kha: Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat kaba phi lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .
Kumta u la ïeng na ka miej bam , u la law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , bad u la teh ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka syngkai .
translation.en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen .

Ki briew ki la ïai-ong , Ïathuh ïa ki ban pynkloi pynlang Reu ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta lad ngi , dak hajuh ba ki khmat jong ngi kin dap da ki ummat , bad ba ki irmat jong ngi ki ieh na kaba ïam .
translation.en: And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .

translation.kha: namar ki la sangeh na kaba bud ïa u malu leh bymsalia ïa ki praw jong u .
translation.en: Because they turned back from him , and would not consider any of his ways :

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki longïing kiba khwan myntoi bad katba kyntait ïa kaei kaweh dei , khnang ban bud ïa khie ka bym dei ; hiar jong ki U Blei un thuh noh ïa la ka jingtah mala ka jingbitar shwa .
translation.en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,

translation.kha: Mynba ngi don hajuh ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi ïa kaei kabu phi kyrkhoit ba ka hir kaba dei .
translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;
translation.kha: U shah ïa ki briew kiba thngan ban shongduh hangta , bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .

translation.en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ka pyrthei — ka la long ka jingsep ei suda , ha ka sahit bneng — ym don kano kano ka jingshai .
U Pilat u la jubab , Ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh , la thoh .
translation.en: Pilate answered , What I have written I have written .
Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
translation.kha: Pyni ïa nga haduh katno me ieit ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad pynim ïa nga kat kum ka kular jong me .

translation.en: And I will make Pathros desolate , and will set fire in Zoan , and will execute judgments in No .
