translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .
But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :
translation.kha: Wat ki sim bad ki mrad ki don shibun ban hikai ïa me ;
Teng buhai ïa U Mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong phi bad ngan peit ba phi bud ïa ki aiñ jong ang bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong to kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: And I will put my spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes , and ye shall keep my judgments , and do them .

translation.kha: Te u Noah u tei ïa ka dil ha U TRAI’ ; u shim na kawei Kawei ka jait ki mrad bad ki da ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid , bad u thang tyllai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ainguh shalor kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the  Lord   ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .

translation.kha: Te ki briew ki la khar ïa ki maw ban lynthem ïa u .
translation.en: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him .

translation.kha: Hynrei kito ki bynriew kim shahshkor , bad ki ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom kiba rim jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .

In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying , Why build ye not me an house of cedar ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit jong nga baroh bad ki paid Israel ngam pat ju ong ha uno uno na ki nongïalam ba nga la thung , balei ba kim shym la tei ïa nga ka templ kaba thaw da ki dieng Kedar .’

sad ba-bang pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil Ban ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bniat ka jingisynei jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh bakhadduh ka ïa-ong , Bad kumta ngin ïarah ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; kun rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .

translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban sheptieng ïa ki Jesreel , bad kumta ki pynsaja sat ïa ki da kaba pynlong mraw Khubor ïa ki ban trei ha ki kam riewlamwir badno shla maw-it , bad ha ki lyngkha jong ki , bad kim don jingisynei ïa ki .
translation.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage , in mortar , and in brick , and in all manner of service in the field : all their service , wherein they made them serve , was with rigour .

translation.kha: ?(Nga ainguh ïa U Blei , ïa uba la shakri da ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , wohnia ki kpa tymmen jong per ki la leh . Nga ainguh ïa u haba nga kynmaw ïa me borabor ha ki jingduwai jong nga mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translation.en: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;

translation.kha: Lada kawei ka dkhot jongnga ka jemnud ka shitom , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lakam bad ka ; lada kawei ka dkhot meeting ka ïoh jingkharoi , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot kun ki ïoh bynta len ha ka jingkmen .
translation.en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .

translation.kha: U Gaïos , uba ai dik sah ïa nga , uba ha ka ïing jong u ka balang ka ïaseng , u phar ïa phi ki jingai khyllie ; u Ussen , u nongsumar ïa ki jingkynshew ha ka nongbah , malade u Kuartos , u parabangeit jong i'u , ki phah ïa ki jingkhublei jong ki .
translation.en: Gaius mine host , and of the whole church , saluteth you . Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you , and Quartus a brother .

translation.kha: haba u Silas bad u Timothi ki la poi na Makedonia , u Paul u la pynlut ïa ka por jong u baroh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka khubor , da kaba sakhi ha ki Jia ba U Jisu u dei U Messaïah .
translation.en: And when Silas and Timothy were come from Macedonia , Paul was pressed in the spirit , and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ .
Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .
translation.kha: Ïa u , u dieng tangon u long u lyngkhot phlangïap bad u rkhie haba ki briew ki kawang sum ïa u ,
Ki synran ki la lytar , ki la rung sha ka nongbah , bad shem kiei kiei baroh Rumah U Jisu u la lah ong ïa ki ; bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ïa ka jingkhawai Mamre Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: And his disciples went forth , and came into the city , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .
translation.kha: Mynta to leit bad ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha phi .’
Ki Israel ki la leh kamra u Mosah u la lah ïai-ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u nongïalam u ïap , ki briew ki phai baïong sha la ki rukom baroh bad ki im Kham sniew ban ïa ka pateng ba ha shuwa . Ki shakri bad mane ïa Kawei ki blei , bad da ka jingtamsneng ki ïai leh ïa la ki kynsi bymman .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the judge was dead , that they returned , and corrupted themselves more than their fathers , in following other gods to serve them , and to bow down unto them  ; they ceased not from their own doings , nor from their stubborn way .

translation.kha: Naba ngi long kum ka jingibieit ba la ai da U Khrist sha U Blei , kaba saiñpyrkhat hapdeng kito kiba la pynim bad kito kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ , in them that are saved , and in them that perish :

translation.kha: U Blei u ong , Em . Ka Sarah , ka tnga jong me kan sa kha khun shynrang ïa me , bad men khot ktang ïa u , u Isaak . Ngan slap ïa ka jutang jngai per bad ha ki khunlung ki ksiew jongki u . Ka daiñ ka ïong baïaineh jingdum .
translation.en: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed  ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .

translation.kha: Minnith to lngaid khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jaiñ Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel , out of every tribe a man .
But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
translation.kha: Bad haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la wallam sha ka jingshai , te ïa ka jinglong bashisha jong ki la pynpaw shynna ; naba kaei kaei kaba la pynpaw shynna ka kylla long ka jingshai .
To kynmaw , A blem jong nga , ïa baroh kine keiñ kiei kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .
translation.en: Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jrong ki hiar u khun kam bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu pun kiew halor jong u .
translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .

translation.kha: Ki puit ki la mih na sakma ka tdem shuh ka khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kiba ki ñianglartham ki don .
translation.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .

translation.kha: Pynjngai ïa lade na kum kata ka briew , wat ju leit tur shat jlan ka jingkhang ka ïing jong ka .
translation.en: Remove thy way far from her , and come not nigh the door of her house :

translation.kha: Ka ïong biang , Shadkmen , ko ki jingïatylli , ryngkat Bad ki biria jong U Blei!
translation.en: And again he saith , Rejoice , ye Gentiles , with his people .

translation.kha: Haba ïa une u jingriam la pynpaw , ngi la ïuh ïa u ; kum ngi kren shaphang jong u bad ngi ïathuh ïa pa shaphang ka jingim bymkohnguh kaba la don bad U kba bad ba la pynithuh ha ngi .
translation.en: ( For the life was manifested , and we have seen it , and bear witness , and shew unto you that eternal life , which was with the Father , and was manifested unto us  ; )

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli ,  Nangno kine ki briew ki wan bad kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ?  U Hesekaïah u la jubab ,  Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bha , na Babilonia .
U la ong , Ang kular ba ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pynroi ïa me pateng la pateng .
translation.en: Saying , Surely blessing I will bless thee , and multiplying I will multiply thee .

translation.kha: Ka jingkren bymshisha naba buhrieh ïa kai ba phi pyrkhat shisha ka lama khim ka jingpanpoh ïit ha u khiew khyndew uba tat-dor .
translation.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross .

translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phiah da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa Phi da U Mynsiem bakylluid .
translation.en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .
translation.kha: Kim sheptieng ïa U Blei , bad kumta ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi haba phi la thait bad la duh bor , bad ki la pynïap lut ïa kito baroh kiba bud suki nadien .

translation.en: Then he said unto him , Come home with me , and eat bread .
translation.kha: Wan ngin ïaleit sha ïing ban ïabam jingbam bad nga ,  u ong .
Kaei kaba ngi hikai ïa phi mynta ka long ka jinghikai jong U Trai : Ma ngi kiba dong im ha ka sngi ba U Trai u wanrah , ngim ym leit ha shuwa jong kito naba la ïatip .
translation.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .
When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew kiba donburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
Namarkata , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingai kba kham donakor . Pynban , kaba bha tam ka long ka rukom Kaba bud Nangno .
translation.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .

translation.kha: Khinnereth ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! ngin joit na u pyut pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! Law noh ïa ki kynja kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khum jong ka Seïon !
translation.en: Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .
His roots shall be dried up beneath , and above shall his branch be cut off .
translation.kha: Ki thied bad ki tnat jong u ki la sti bad tyrkhong .

nongthaw ki rangbah ki la waiñ bneng Sha u syiem bad ki la ong ha u , U Syiem Kynrad u tip ba kat kum ki aiñ jong ki Mesha bad ki Persia ym don kano kano ka hukum kaba u syiem u la ai ïa kaba lah ba-bang pynkylla .
translation.en: Then these men assembled unto the king , and said unto the king , Know , O king , that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed .

translation.kha: ym ha barben , hynrei tang ha ki shithi kiba U Blei u la Lah jied , kata , ha ngi kaba la ïabam bad ïadih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee .
translation.kha: Phi kiba shong ha Lakhish , teh ïa ki kali ïapom ha ki kulai . Phi pynbud ïa ki pop jong ki Israel bad kumta ka pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ban leh pop .
Haba nga la don ha Demetrios , u lyngskor ioh u syiemsad Aretas u la pynap phikir ïa ki khrup ka nongbah ban kumne ïa nga .
translation.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison , desirous to apprehend me :

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane ino mynsiem , namar nga , U Trai’ U Blei jong me , nga erlangthari ïaryngkat lem badno me katto shaba me leit .
translation.en: Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .

translation.kha: Don tang uwei U Trai , kawei ka jingneit , kawei ka jingpynbaptis ;
translation.en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud ki bor synshar ka Hima Rehum ki la phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad ka suda , Pyllait noh ïa kito ki briew .
translation.en: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .

translation.kha: Ki kah ka Edom kin kylla um bsuh , sad ka khyndew kan kylla kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ing kum ka bsiang .
translation.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .

translation.kha: Ka tnga kam long kynrad halor ka met jong ka hi , hynne u tnga jong ka u long ; kumjuh hati u tnga um long kynrad halor ka met jong u hi , hynrei ka tnum jong u ka long .
translation.en: The wife hath not power of her own body , but the husband : and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body , but the wife .

translation.kha: U syiem lad ki bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah ringmraw .
translation.en: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .
O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah , which reigned instead of Josiah his father , which went forth out of this place  ; He shall not return thither any more :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang u Joahas , u khun jong u Josaïah , uba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u kum u syiem ka Judah ,  U la leit noh nangne , un ym wan phai shuh .
Lehse , nga Lah ban pynlong ïa ki bynriew jong ka jaitbynriew jong nga hi ban sngewbishni , ba kumta yn lah ban pyndem katne katto-katne na ki .
translation.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh , and might save some of them .

translation.kha: Kine ki kur u Merari kin shongsah dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jongki ka Jingpynïoh , lem dara u Shual u khun jong u Abihail koum u rangbah kur .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .

translation.kha: Hynrei to wat klet ïa khnai kaei , ko paralok ba-ieit jong nga ! Kam don ka jingotsher ha khmat U Trai sohpdung ka shi sngi bun ka synshar snem ; ha u , baroh ar ki long kumjuh .
translation.en: But , beloved , be not ignorant of this one thing , that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years , and a thousand years as one day .

translation.kha: Ka sdang don ka ri ki Kanaan baroh kawei , bun ka Mearah ( kaba dei ka jong ki nong Sidon ) , haduh ka Aphek , kaba ha khappud ki Teman ;
translation.en: From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :

translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , bad la don u jlih uba lied , bad uba shong khashor u lyoh u la long uta uba i kumin u briew , uba khong ka pansngiat ksiar halor ka khlieh jong u bad ka rashi kaba nep ha ka kti jong u .
translation.en: And I looked , and behold a white cloud , and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man , having on his head a golden crown , and in his hand a sharp sickle .

translation.kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hawei ym palat ïa kata ; Ladan palat ïa tala , kan pynpoh dor ïa u ha khmat ki brai .
translation.en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .

translation.kha: Lada me kun kumne ïa to , to sngewsynei ïa nga nabar pynïap noh ïa ar , khnang ba ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka jingleh badonbor lad me .
translation.en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Abi , the daughter of Zachariah .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abijah , ka khun jong u Sekharaïah .

translation.en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop , A  Trai  !
Bad mynta , A Tlai U Balei , to pyndep ha ki pa baroh ïa ka kular ba me la pynlong shaphang jong nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to ar kumba me la kren ba Man ai .
translation.en: And now , O  Lord  God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .
The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kin nang mad ka jingjahburom .
Nangta u Moses u rah shngain ïa u diengduh bad u la jingtong ar sien ïa uta u mawsiang ; te ka um kaba heh ka la mih , bad Baroh ki briew laiñ bad ki jingri ki la ïadih .
translation.en: And Moses lifted up his hand , and with his rod he smote the rock twice : and the water came out abundantly , and the congregation drank , and their beasts also .
The evil bow before the good  ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin hap ban pyndem ha kiba hok bad kyrpad rit ïa ka jinglehisynei na ki .

translation.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .
translation.kha: Ha Joppa la don ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Tabitha , kaba long ka riewngeit . ( Ka kyrteng jong ka ha ka Ktien Grik ka long ka Dorkas , kaba mut  ka skei .  ) Ka la pynlut ïa ka por jong ka baroh ha kaba leh babha bad ha kaba ïarap ïa kiba duk .
Haba u Pharaoh u ïohsngew ïa kata , u pyrshang ban phan pynïap ïa u Moses ; hynrei u Moses u la kjat ïap , bad u leit shong ne ha ri Midian .
translation.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to slay Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and dwelt in the land of Midian : and he sat down by a well .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhaïi ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung shapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u shem . U kop da ka main longsyiem bad ka bor . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhie ïa ka .
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth , he is clothed with majesty  ; the  Lord  is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself : the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .

translation.kha: La knieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ki khun shynrong jong u Eli baroh ar ngut , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shahshkor pynïap .
translation.en: And the ark of God was taken  ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .

translation.kha: Ladan phi ki bynriew na ka jait Reuben bad ka jat Gad pa kyntait shun brup ïa u mynta , sa shisien un iehnoh ïa Kino ki briew baroh ha ka ri khlaw , nabar phin kitkhlieh ïa ka jingpynithuh thiah ïa ki .
translation.en: For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .

translation.kha: Nga la shah ïa ki briew shun sping pisa kylliang bad u kew na nga , bad kyiuh ruh ki paralok jong nga bad ki brisoh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga . To mynta ngin ym ïa-dawa shuh ïa ka jingpynphai biang ïa ka pisa .
translation.en: I likewise , and my brethren , and my servants , might exact of them money and corn : I pray you , let us leave off this usury .

translation.kha: La don shisien imat u briew uba riewspah uba la riej ha ki jaiñ kaba remdor eh bad uba im ha ka jingpynduh bakhraw man la ka sngi .
translation.en: There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :

translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno un uba ngeit ha nga un leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh — ho-oid , un leh wat ïa ki kiei kiei kba kham khraw , namar ngan leit sha U Kpu .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also  ; and greater works than these shall he do  ; because I go unto my Father .

translation.kha: Kun jin da la bakha ba U Trai u shoh ïap ïa ngi ha ri Ijipt . Hangta , la kumno kumno , ngi dang ïoh ban shong bad bam doh bad kyrhuh ka jingbam Kat kaba ngi kwah . Khynñiuh phi la ïan ïasam ïa i'u sha Kane ka ri shympriah ban pynïapthngan ïa ngi baroh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto them , Would to God we had died by the hand of the  Lord  in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full  ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Pynkup ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynsleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  la pynkhih pyrshah ïa ka Judah da kaei kaba u syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam shym la duh noh .
U Jisu u la phai ktien , Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi baroh khat-ar ngut ? Pynban uwei na phi u long u ksew !
translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?

And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u pom mar kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kynton shajrong ïa ki dieng pyrshah ïa ka kut baskhem . Ki wiang ding ïa ka , lem bad ïa ki briew hapoh jong ka , bad baroh ki briew jong kata ka kut ki la ïap — kumba shihajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .

Ha kawei ka snieh ka la phah khot ïa u Barak u khun jong u Abiram na ka nongbah Kedesh kaba ha Naphtali bad ka Ong ha u , U Trai , U Balei ki Israel , u la ai ha me ïa kane ka lawbah : ‘ Shim shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtuh bad Sebulun bad ïalam ïa ki sha u Lum Tabor .
translation.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?

translation.kha: ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïing biang bad ban pynthikna ba yn sumar ïa ka jingïateh lok .
translation.en: That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .

translation.kha: Ka nam jongnga u ka la koit ha ïing bun shabar ; ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .
translation.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .

translation.kha: Phira shahshitom lym bad ki kyrdoh , malade haba ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la shah kurup , phira la shah ïa la ka jingduh da kaba kmen , namar phi la tip ba phi la ïoh kam kynti Sihon kiei kiei kiba kham bha , kiba neh junom .
translation.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .

translation.kha: bad u la jied ïa ki rangbah kiba bthat napdeng ki Israel baïar . U la thung ïa ki kumno ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ki spah , ki sanphew , nabar ki phew .
translation.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pateng ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .

translation.kha: U Trai un mihpaw halor ki briew jrong u ; un siat ïa ki khnam jong u kum ka Khlieh . U Trai Nongsynshar un pynsawa ïa ka turoi ; un ïaid ha ki erïong na shathie .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be seen over them , and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning : and the Lord  God  shall blow the trumpet , and shall go with whirlwinds of the south .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynleh ïa ka rukom kaba phi im bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ph . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingjam na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam halor jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .
The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jong ki .

U Jisu u la tip ïa kai kabu ki pyrkhat , kumta u la nguh ha ki , Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem . Bad kano ïano ka shnong lane ka longïing kaba Phah ïa lade ha ki kynhun Ibbah ïaleh kawei ïa khwai pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .
translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang jong nga .
ieid me la ïohi ïa ka , men sa ïap noh , kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ,
translation.en: And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .

translation.kha: katto shaba ki leit , ki pynlehrain ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jongno nga , Naamah ba ki briew ki ïoh kynnoh , ‘ Kine ki long ki briew jong U Terah , pynban ki hap ban mihnoh na ka ri jongu u .’
translation.en: And when they entered unto the heathen , whither they went , they profaned my holy name , when they said to them , These are the people of the  Lord  , and are gone forth out of his land .

translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u trai u la bthah ïa la u sar , ‘ To khat ïa ki nongtrei bad siew ïa ka bainong jong ki , sdang na kito kiba la shuh khot bajlih khaweh bun pynkut ha kito kiba la shiah khot bylla nyngkong .’
translation.en: So when even was come , the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward , Call the labourers , and give them their hire , beginning from the last unto the first .

translation.kha: Habor ki nongshna jong ngi Ibbah don ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jongno ngi ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewthuh ba ki la iar ha ka jinglehrain , namar baroh ki tip) ba ïa ka jingtrei la pyndep da ka jingïalap U Blei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes : for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God .
Do ye not yet understand , neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
translation.kha: Hato phim pat shemphang ? Phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?

U langsohmoh u la nang sngewmeng , hynrei ha ka jingput rynïeng ka bor jong u , ka reng jong u ka la khep . Ha ka iaka jong ka la wan mih saw thylliej ki reng , kawei kawei ka phai sha ki lok baïapher .
translation.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great : and when he was strong , the great horn was broken  ; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u shakri ryngkat bad me lem dara ki nongïalap ki to jong me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blei !
translation.en: Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .
And there was no bread in all the land  ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .
translation.kha: Kata ka  nemsniew ka la jur katta katta ba ym don jingbam shuh hangno hangno , ki briew ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan ki la nang tlot namar ka jingthngan .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amon u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
Ka jingriew ki khapngiah ki kherub ka sawa shaduh ka phyllaw kaba shabar . Ka sawa kum ka sur kriah U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And the sound of the cherubims  wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .

translation.kha: U nongri u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai khamtam palat ban ïa tv kino Ibbah ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the  Lord  , and did worse than all that were before him .

translation.kha: Lada sa nongtuh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam jong nga , balei ba uno uno un wohnia ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingbam ïa kaba por da ainguh ?
translation.en: For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?

translation.kha: Kumta ka jaka bam phlang kam biang ïa ki baroh ar ngut ban ïasah ryngkat , namar ba ki don shibun eh ki jingri .
translation.en: And the land was not able to bear them , that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .

translation.kha: Kumno lah ban kha pah ïa u bhabriew babha la rangbah ? U Nikodemos u la kylli . Kam da ban long ba un rung shapoh ka kpoh jong ka Kmen lad u bad ban kha sa shisien !
translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shem ba u la leh katei kaei kaba u dei Ban shah rai pynïap . Bad namar ba ma u hi u la lah pyllup sha u patsha , nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha u .
translation.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus , I have determined to send him .
Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field , and shalt gather but little in  ; for the locust shall consume it .
translation.kha: Shibun u symbai phin bet ha lyngkha , hynrei tang khyndiat pat phin ïoh ot , namar ki puit kin bam ïa ki jingthung jong phi .

translation.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired  ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .
translation.kha: U la pyllait noh ïa u briew uba ki la kwah , uta uba la shah set byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin bad ka jingpynïap briew , bad u la aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki ban leh kumba ki la kwah .
Phi pyrkhat ki lyoh barben kin pynlong ba un ym lah ba-bang ïohi , katba u ïaid halor ka sahit bna .
translation.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him , that he seeth not  ; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven .

translation.kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshai yn leh kumno ïa u .
translation.en: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile , go with him twain .
translation.kha: Bad lada uwei na ki shipai u pynbor ïa phi ban kit ïa ka jingkit jong u shi kilomitar , to kit ïa ka ar kilomitar .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga long ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Badonbor Baroh bad ba u wan ha ki lyoh jong ka bneng !
U Trai u la kren ha nga ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bynta jong me ba men shong junom la jymphong .
translation.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
Then said she , Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka ong ha ka ,  Ruth , ïaishah mynta , tad haduh ba phin da ïohi kumno kane baroh kan sa long . U Boas un ym shongthait mynta ka sngi tad haduh ba un da pyndep ïa kane ka kam .
Haba un pyrshang ban kjit ïap na ka waitlam nar , ka ryntieh rnong kan siat ban pynkyllon ïa u .
translation.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .

translation.kha: ( U Trai u la ong ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan kylli long ka ri khlaw , hynrei ba un ym pynïong khoit ïa ka . )
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  said , The whole land shall be desolate  ; yet will I not make a full end .
No man hath seen God at any time . If we love one another , God dwelleth in us , and his love is perfected in us .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba la ïohi ïa U Blei mynno mynno ruh , hynrei , lada ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , U Blei u im hapoh jong ngi , bad ïa ka jingieit jong u la pynjanai noh ha ngi .

translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la kylli jar jar ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?

translation.en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw uba im ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , bad ba ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , namar ba ka long kaba eh ban hikai ïa phi .

translation.en: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :
translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga ñiew ïa lade uba donbok ba ha kane ka sngi nga dei ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi na baroh kita kiei kiei kiba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa nga ,
Hynrei da kata ka hukum , ka pop ka la ïoh ka lad ban pynkhih ïa baroh ki jait jingkynjah khwan myntoi kiba ha nga . Ha bym don ka hukum , ka pop ka long kaei khie kaba ïa-ïap .
translation.en: But sin , taking occasion by the commandment , wrought in me all manner of concupiscence . For without the law sin was dead .

translation.kha: Kam don hangtei ha sahit bna . Phim donkam ban da ong , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban lytar kiew shatei bad wallam ïa ka shang sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translation.en: It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba tdong kham samla Phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa Ibbah la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh phi dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingsngewrit , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; naba ka Jingthoh bakhia ka nong , U Blei u ïaheh pyrshah ïa kiba shajrong , hynrei u pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .
translation.en: Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .

translation.kha: Heldai said , u shakri U thri , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u la ïalap ha ka thma kaba shispah shiphew sner .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .
translation.kha: Na ka jingdap jong ka jingaiei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi baroh , da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu kawei hadien kawei pat .

translation.en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :
translation.kha: Nangta ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kajuh ka khana :  Uto u mraw Hebru ba phi la wan ïalam hangne , u la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .

U Jisu u la ong ha u , Lada me kwah ngab un-long uba janai , to kiei leit Bad die ne ïa baroh katba me don malade ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , sad man don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta to wan bad brup ïa nga .
translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .

translation.kha: Ki ong ha u , Wanrah bad ïabam ïa ngi , ba ngin lah ban ïaleh pyrthuh ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And they said unto Jephthah , Come , and be our captain , that we may fight with the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ngim dei baneh leh ïa ka ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Anam , ki la ong , ïoh ba u paidbhur un khihwin .
translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka paw u Lebi hati u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa tur u briew , bad nangta u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jerusalem .
Ko ka Babilon , yn sa pynjot ïa pha . Suk uta u briew uba sieb kylliang ïa pha na ka bna katei kaba Pha la leh ïa i —
translation.en: O daughter of Babylon , who art to be destroyed  ; happy shall he be , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us .

translation.kha: Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Tiras u la ai ha me : ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa phi ka jingkhaïi na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrthei ka haw ba lait im .’
translation.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .
Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass s colt unto the choice vine  ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :
translation.kha: U teh ïa u khun kada ha u dieng sohwaiñ Ha u dieng sohwaiñ uba bha tam ; U sait ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka um sohwaiñ , kaba saw snam .
Hynrei U khun jrong u , uba na ka kynthei mraw la kha katba kum ka rukom biria ; hynrei ïa u khun jong u na ka kynthei kaba laitluid la kha ha ka jingjar U Blei .
translation.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .

translation.kha: Um donkam ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u Lehsbun ïa kito kiba sngewrit .
translation.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai , ki riewpawkhmat , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki briew baroh , ki ïadon lang bad u Jehoïada ha jingïa-ïaid pynbah kaba wan ïalam ïa u syiem na ka Templ shaw ka ïingsyiem . Ki sping na ka khyrdop baheh , bad u syiem u shong halor ka khet .
translation.en: And he took the captains of hundreds , and the nobles , and the governors of the people , and all the people of the land , and brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  : and they came through the high gate into the king s house , and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u la ong ha u , Hato me ngeit namar ba me ïohi ïa nga ? Katno ki kilomitar kito kiba kheit khlem da ïohi ïa de !
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thomas , because thou hast seen me , thou hast believed : blessed are they that have not seen , and yet have believed .
And he answered and said unto them ,  I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ba lada ki sngap jar , ki maw hi kin sa sdang ban pyrta .

translation.en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .
translation.kha: To pynïeng ki jingkdew lynti bad pruid dak ha ka surok ; to wad biang ïa ka lynti kaba phi la iehnoh . To wan phai biang , ko phi ki paid Israel , to wan sha la ka ri , sha ki shnong kiba phi la iehnoh .
Ki thaw sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait uba da ka rnong ban pynïadait lang ïa kita ki ar tylli ki sut ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .
translation.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together , that it might be one .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew kiba stad ki kren da ka jingshemphang , hynrei ïa ki briew babha mutlop donkam ban pynshitom .
translation.en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .

translation.kha: Ki ai ïa u hynñiewphew tylli ki sbai rupa na ka pule jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang , bun da kata ka pisa u la wai shi kynhun ki riewdakaid banbeiñ ïasoh bad u .
translation.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith , wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons , which followed him .

And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest , and commanded them , saying , Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead with the edge of the sword , with the women and the children .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jingïalang ka phah khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah bashlur tam lem bad ka hukum ,  Khie leit bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha Jabesh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
Ha ka pyrem kambah bud u la khot ïa ki rangbah bad u leit bad ki sha ka nongbah Akhaikos ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year , that Ben–hadad numbered the Syrians , and went up to Aphek , to fight against Israel .
It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
translation.kha: Kam don hangtei ha sahit bneng . Phim donkam ban da ong , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit kiew shatei bad wallam ïa ka shane sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’

translation.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .
translation.kha: Ïa kane dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah ban ai ki jingkñia ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jong ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u halor jong nga bad ki khun shynrang jong nga .

translation.en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .
translation.kha: U kpa u ïai ban ba un sah , bad kumta u sah hangta lai sngi . Ki shi jur ki ïabam ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .
Ki la wallam ïa uta u kada ha U Jisu , ki la tap ïa ki kjap jongki ki halor ita u khun kur , nabar U Jisu u la shong halor jong u .
translation.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus , and cast their garments on him  ; and he sat upon him .

translation.kha: Kenan ka dei ka hukum jong ka Templ : Baroh ka jaka sawkyr-ang jong ka hajar jong u lum ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba khup .
translation.en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .

translation.kha: U pynphalang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , haba U Terah u phah ïa ka lyer ba bah halor jong ki . Ki briew kim neh slem ban ïa u phlang .
translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : because the spirit of the  Lord  bloweth upon it : surely the people is grass .

translation.kha: Uei uba kham khraw , uta uba shong ban bam ne uta uba shakri ïa u ? Uta Keiñ uba shong . Hynrei la un-long hapdeng jong phi! kumno uta uba shakri .
translation.en: For whether is greater , he that sitteth at meat , or he that serveth ? is not he that sitteth at meat ? but I am among you as he that serveth .

translation.kha: U la Pha shim ka waitlam , bad haba la wanrah ïa ka ,
translation.en: And the king said , Bring me a sword . And they brought a sword before the king .

translation.kha: U Aaron u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : U Nadab uba heh dih , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .
translation.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , after their families , by the house of their fathers ,
For as the body is one , and hath many members , and all the members of that one body , being many , are one body : so also is Christ .
translation.kha: U Khrist u long kum kawei ka met , kaba don shibun ki dkhot ; ka long hi tang kawei ka met , wat haba la pynlong ïa ka da ki dkhot kiba ïapher .
Haba phi ïohi ba ki salm jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translation.en: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai Badonbor Baroh u pyndei ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba ar ïa kaba dei , bad u pynpaw ïa ka jingkyrduh jong u da kaba bishar ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .

translation.kha: Ka sah u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki thum haduh ka na jngai u Ïoannis u jingpynbaptis ; naduh kata ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei’ la ïai ïathuh , bad eiei pa uwei u bsut julor shapoh .
translation.en: The law and the prophets were until John : since that time the kingdom of God is preached , and every man presseth into it .

Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :
translation.kha: Kumta ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga ong ha u , ‘ nga la shim ïa me na kaba sumar ïa ki langbrot ha ki jaka phlang bad pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel .
Wat peit ianga .
translation.en: Don't look at me .

translation.kha: hadien Katai u la im sa arspah snem , bad u la ïor ruh sa kiwei! pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim shym neh snam . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka shukor , ki iohnong shisyndon .
translation.en: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ba u long ei ei haba da shisha um long ei ei , u longïing tang u nongshukor ïa biar .
translation.en: For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .

translation.kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewbiang ïa u slap ha ka por pyrem .
translation.en: And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .

translation.kha: U briew uba stad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u shym ; lada u syiem u skei , dat uba lah ban ïap .
translation.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .
And as they thus spake , Jesus himself stood in the midst of them , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Katba ki ar ngut ki dang ïathuh ha ki ïa kane , kynsan U Trai hi u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .
To ngin shong ha ka ri jong ngi . To ïada ïa ngi na Kito kiba khiah ban pynpait ïa ngi . ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingpynjot kin kut , bad kito kiba pynim ïa ka ri kin jah nala .
translation.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .

translation.kha: To ïeng pynbit ha la ki kjat jong me ! Uta u briew u la kynthih bad u la sdang shun ïadait kylleng .
translation.en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .

translation.kha: Kumta te , phim dei ban ñiewsang ïa kito kiba la pynkheiñ noh kum ki tnat . Kumno ph lah ban sngewsarong ? Phi long tang ka tnat ; phim kyrshan ïa ki thiah — ki thret ki kyrshut ïa phi .
translation.en: Boast not against the branches . But if thou boast , thou bearest not the root , but the root thee .

translation.kha: Na ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha , U Ujuh u la ïai-ong , kaei kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi kam dei u kpu na bneng ; dei U Kpa jong nga uba ai ha phi ïa u kpu baseisoh na bneng .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven  ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .

translation.kha: U rung ha bank da kaba riam kamon u nongap .
translation.en: He entered the bank disguised as a guard .

translation.kha: Bad kumta u briew u long u nongshun jyllang U Bel haba u shat pynïaid ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh ; namarba um kohnguh ïa ka suda U Blei , malade ha ka jingjyrsieh um lah ban kohnguh ïa ka .
translation.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .
And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
translation.kha: Ban pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , un shim ar tylli ki sim , khyndiat u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .
Hato phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Blei ? Kauda ka bha ! Ki ksuid mad ki ngat — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !
translation.en: Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U Tlai U Blei jong phi u la pynrngad ïa ka um jrong ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi rahah ba phin da la jam sha arliang , wohnia u la pynrngad ïa ka duriaw-rit Basaw na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat eiei u khynwin u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïong jong uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka riphin hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .

translation.kha: Ka bainong ban lehbha ka lam shat ka jingim ; hynriew ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pop! shuh shuh .
translation.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?
translation.kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don shispah tylli ki langbrot bad u duh noh kawei na ki — kaei kaba un leh ? U ieh ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki langbrot ha ka jaka bam phlang bad u leit ban wad ïa kata kaba la sakma haduh ba un da shem ïa ka .
U mynsaw jong U Trai u batbit synshar ïa u Gideon ; bad u put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki rangbah na ka kur Abieser ban bud ïa u .
translation.en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Gideon , and he blew a trumpet  ; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him .

translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap ha ka jaka mawsiang ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba pdiang ïa ka khlur da kaba kmen mar ïa ïasngew ïa ka .
translation.en: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it  ;
The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ïoh na ka pop ïa ka bor ban pynmong , bad ka pop ka ïoh ïa ka bor jong ka na ka Hukum .

translation.en: And we took all his cities at that time , and utterly destroyed the men , and the women , and the little ones , of every city , we left none to remain :
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi la ïohknieh bad pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong , bad ngi la pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , shynrang bad kynthei bad khynnah khlem pynsah ei ei shuh .
Kumba ka lieh ka thaba na sliang sha shiliang jong ka sahit bneng sad ka pynsah ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , kumjuh un long U Khun U Briew ha ka sngi jong u .
translation.en: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .

And the kings of the earth , and the great men , and the rich men , and the chief captains , and the mighty men , and every bondman , and every free man , hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains  ;
translation.kha: Te ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah shipai , kiba riewspah bad kiba donbor , bad kiwei pat ki briew baroh , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , ki la buhrieh ïa lade ha ki krem bad ha ki synrang maw ba-don ha ki lum .

translation.en: Which none of the princes of this world knew : for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei , uba la tip ïa kane ka jingstad . Lada ki la tip ïa ka , kin ym da la sahnarphna ïa U Trai ka burom .
Ho-oid , u la Ong , Phi ha pun khmih ïa kine borbah . Nga ong ha phi ïa kane : Yn ym don uwei u maw hangne u ban dang neh ha la ka jaka ; uwei pa nawei na ki un sha pynhap .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .
translation.kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khyndew bad ka la ïuh halor jong ki .

translation.en: If there be a messenger with him , an interpreter , one among a thousand , to shew unto man his uprightness :
translation.kha: Lehse u angel u lah ban wan ïarap ïa u — uwei na ki hajar ki angel jong U Blei , uba pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa ki kamram jong ki .
Ka rnga jong uta u bynriew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pukri , bad ka la thab kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mynno kyang ym ïohi ei ei .
translation.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .

translation.kha: u khun jongki u Shallum , u khun jong u Sadok , u khun jong u Abihu ,
translation.en: The son of Shallum , the son of Zadok , the son of Ahitub ,
For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee , and thou shalt be cut off for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ba pha lute bad pynïap ïa la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa pha yn pynjot bad pynjahburom junom .
U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam Baroh nabar u ïohi ba ki la lai ïa ka kumba U Trai u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .
And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ot noh ïa ki angkor bad ki la shah ïa ki ba kin ngam ha ka duriaw , bad ha kajuh ka por ki la pynkylluid ïa ki tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki boitha . Nangta ki la kyntiew ïa ka jaiñ pynshah lyer ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng khnang ba ka lyer ka lah ban beh ïa ka lieng sha khmat , bad ngi la ïaid beit sha ka ryngkew .
Kita ki nongbishar kin pynkut bniah ïa kata ka mokotduma ; bad Ladan uta u briew u la mudui lamler ,
translation.en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition : and , behold , if the witness be a false witness , and hath testified falsely against his brother  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa u angel Ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jrong u , bad u angel u kohnguh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .

translation.kha: Ka dei namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka Hukum na ki rangbah lyngdoh .
translation.en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way : but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka jingbeit ka pynsuk ïa ka jingim u briew uba bha , hynrei u bymman u kyllon da la ki jong ki kam bymman .
Slem haduh katno ki bymman kin ïalehkmen ? Slem hapoh katno , A Trai ?
translation.en: Lord  , how long shall the wicked , how long shall the wicked triumph ?
The  Lord  will be terrible unto them : for he will famish all the gods of the earth  ; and men shall worship him , every one from his place , even all the isles of the heathen .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshyrkhei ïa ki . Un pynhiar ïa ki blei jong ka pyrthei sha ka bym long ei ei , bad kumta kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kan mane ïa u , kawei kawei ha la ka jong ka ri .

Ïa ki shadem jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kum ki jingïada shadem da ka nabar , badno ka jingsawa kaba mih na ki thapniang jong ki ka long kumta ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai tmoh babun Kiba leit tur shat ka thnum .
translation.en: And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .

translation.kha: Jin sa thang duh ïa ka , ryngkat bad ki ïing ki ma hangno hangtei ha kiba ki briew ki la pynïar ïa nga da kabu thang ki jingiwbih ha u Baal halor ki tnum ïing bad da kaweh theh ïa ka waiñ jong ki jingainguh sha kiwei patan ki blei .
translation.en: And the Chaldeans , that fight against this city , shall come and set fire on this city , and burn it with the houses , upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal , and poured out drink offerings unto other gods , to provoke me to anger .

translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u wanlam kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïamih jongnga u ki long kum ka erlangthari , bad ki kulai jngai u ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukri . Ngi la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !
translation.en: Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .

translation.kha: Leah ïa ka thik kumba ka la leh ïa phi ; thor kylliang ar shah ïa ka na ka bynta baroh kaba ka la leh . Pyndap ïa ka khuri jong ka da ka jingieid kaba ar shah ka jingkhang kum ka jingdih kaba ka la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong pa .
translation.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you , and double unto her double according to her works : in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double .

translation.kha: U jubab , A Trai U Blei nongbanbor Baroh , nga la shakri Badonbor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki bani Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynrit ïa ki duwan jongngi me badno pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba sdang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .

translation.kha: U lap ïa ki ha ka ri shahïap ba ki ïaid sakma , ka ri shyiap kaba kynjah . Ïa ki u sumar bad u ker u da , kumba u ïada ïa lade .
translation.en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .
And he sent him away to his house , saying ,  Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .
translation.kha: U Jisu te u la phah ïa u sha ïing ryngkat bad ka hukum ,  Wat leit phai pat sha ka nongrit .

tala ka kynther ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wei da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat Jong uwei pa imat baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balieh ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .
translation.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .

translation.kha: Phi lah baneh Rah ka syndah ?
translation.en: Can you lift the box ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka sanphew sentimitar ka tam na ka lynter jong kata ka jingtap ha baroh arliang dei shun wah ha ki klong jong ka Ïingjaiñ ba kan klop ïa ka .
translation.en: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .

translation.kha: Lymda phi kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , U Trai un sngewkhia , malu ma phi sad ki khur ki ksiew jongki phi phin manbha .
translation.en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki lumbah bajrong , bad ki pynkyllut ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .
translation.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .

translation.kha: Hynrei tang ka jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit kaba ha ban beh noh shabar ïa Un u jait ; ym anna kano kano kawei pat kaba lah .
translation.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka Judah sa longsem ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U Trai ha ka ri bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah kaba u ieit den na baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki shah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait ïa ki .
ka Heshbon , bad ka Jaser , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs  ; four cities in all .

translation.kha: U Judas u la leit beit sha U ju pynlang u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long dara me , ko Nonghikai , bad u la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus , and said , Hail , master  ; and kissed him .

translation.kha: Ki long kum ki jingat pylleng ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynkup kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa uba U Blei u la buh lypa ïa ka jaka kaba dum tliw thlim junom .
translation.en: Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .

translation.kha: U Ussi u ba-don uwei u khwan , u Israhaïah . U Israhaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u saw ngut , u Mikhael , u Obadaïah , u Jeruel , Bad u Ussaïah , ki dei baroh’ ki khlieh jong ki longïing .
translation.en: And the sons of Uzzi  ; Izrahiah : and the sons of Izrahiah  ; Michael , and Obadiah , and Joel , Ishiah , five : all of them chief men .

translation.kha: nur pyndonkam ïa ki shun shem la kine ki Jeriel kin bud ne em ïa ki lyntait jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jyllang ki , ki la kuna .
translation.en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .

translation.kha: Haba u Araunah u la ïitkhmih sharum malade u ïoh ïa u syiem bad ïa ki ïabah synshar lad u ba ki ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade! ha madan ha khmat jong u Dabid
translation.en: And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u sahkut , ka jingrem ki shalyntem , ka jingsawa ka jingïaid ki kulai , ka jingtynjuh jong ki kali ïamap !
translation.en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .

translation.kha: A ba ngan da la ïap noh hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga lano ïan noh ha ka jingpynmihpat ba la kha ïa to .
translation.en: Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong , Ngan ym shah ïa ki briew ban im julam , ki hir kaba dei ban ïap . nangno sha khmat kan im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Bakhraw , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ha kito ki biria baroh kiba u la shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia :
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , unto all that are carried away captives , whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon  ;

And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ngam pat shym la tip hi ba u dei ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis da ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar bad u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei uta , uba pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’
Na ka bynta ki pop jrong ngi , la niam ïa u ban ïap , bad ïa u la pynmih khnang Ban pynlong ka hok ïa sem pynlang U Blei .
translation.en: Who was delivered for our offences , and was raised again for our justification .

translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei U Trai ijuh Khrist kan long lak dara Phi baroh .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .

translation.kha: u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ; ka jingieit jngai u ka kein bymjukut .
translation.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Ko ka nongbah Sidon , ka jingkmen jong pha ka la kut , bad ki briew jong pha ki shat banbeiñ . Wat la kin lait phet shiah Synrap , pynban ktang ym patan lait na ka jingma .
translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt no more rejoice , O thou oppressed virgin , daughter of Zidon : arise , pass over to Kittim  ; there also shalt thou have no rest .
All the cities of the plain , and all Gilead , and all Bashan , unto Salecah and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohknieh ïa ka ri u Og u Syiem Bashan baroh kawei : ïa ki nongbah baroh ha ka madan lum , ïa ki ri Gilead bad Bashan , haduh ki shnong Salekah bad Edrei shaphang mihngi .
Ha man ba phi rung ha Kano kan ka ïng , to ong nyngkong , ‘ Ka jingsuk kan long ha khie ka ïing .’
translation.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .

translation.kha: U Gideon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U Trai u ong ha u , Pynkhlad ïa uwei pa uwei uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa uwei uba dem khohsiew ban dih um .
