translation.kha: U Lebi , kaba ka tnga kliar jong u ka la shah pynïap , u jubab , Ma nga bad ka tnga kliar jong nga ngi saw sahmiet ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And the Levite , the husband of the woman that was slain , answered and said , I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin , I and my concubine , to lodge .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Naaman ym don umbiah leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jyllang nga , ba shen hadien un ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .
translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
Their heart is as fat as grease  ; but I delight in thy law .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kim don ka jingshemphang , hynrei nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army . And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field .
translation.kha: Te u la hukum ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban leit na Lakhish sha Jerusalem lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw ban dawa ba u syiem Hesekaïah u dei ban pyndem . U rangbah synshar u ïeng ha ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , harud ka nur kaba wanrah um na ka pung kaba haneng .

U —Joshua bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kaba ha ka ri kaban sha synñiang jong ka Jordan , naduh Baalgad ha Toi Lebanon haduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie Ashan Edom . U Judas u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jait Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki khim ka jingïohkynti baneh junom .
translation.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;

translation.kha: Bad khnang ban pynsngewsih ïa u patsha ki Syria , u Adah u weng ruh na ka Tabor ïa ka rynsan na ka bynta ka khet syiem bad u set noh ïa ka jaka rung bakynjang jong u syiem sha ka Templ .
translation.en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king s entry without , turned he from the house of the  Lord  for the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: A katno ar ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me ! Nga pyrkhat ïa ka baroh shu Sngi .
translation.en: O how love I thy law ! it is my meditation all the day .
* ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .
translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka shong kulai halor une u mrad synshar pyrthei ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad ban pyniaid ia la ka jingialam .

Nga khmih shata ka lawei , Bad nga ïohi ïa ka jingtipbriew Israel . U syiem , uba kum u khlam phyrnai , un maw ha kata ka jaitbynriew . Kum u lur dih duma un wan mih na Israel . Un shoh ïa ki nongïalam ki Moab , Bad un pyndem ïa ki brisoh jong u Seth .
translation.en: I shall see him , but not now : I shall behold him , but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .

translation.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .
translation.kha: Nangta ngin khreh ban leit bad la kiwei pat ki Israel sha ka thma bad ngin ïalam ban tur ïaleh haduh ba ngin da pynïoh pynsah ïa ki ha ka ri ka ban long ka jong ki . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba hap hapoh ka jingsumar sukher jong ngi ki lah ban sah hangne ha ki shnong kiba la ker da ki kut baskhem , khlem jingma na ki briew jong kane ka ri .
bad kumta ka jingpynjot kan ym shoh ïa me , ka jingleh jubor kan ym wanlam hajan ka ïing jrong me .
translation.en: There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , ngam pat shym la iehnoh ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah , wat la ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

Ki briew ha kiba ki la krensih ïa kine kiei ki kin ïap ha kajuh ka rukom . Ïa ki met jong ki yn brup baher ha ki lynti jyllang ka Jerusalem , bad yn ym kein mano mano ban thep ïa ki . Kane kan jia ha ki baroh — kyntiap ïa ki tnga jong ki , ki khun shynrang dara ki khun kynthei jong ki . Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew na ka bynta ka jingmaham jong ki .
translation.en: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword  ; and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters : for I will pour their wickedness upon them .

translation.kha: Baroh uba kwah ban im ïa ka jingim bariewblei ha U Khrist Jisu kin shah pynïapmat ;
translation.en: Yea , and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .
Shall a man make gods unto himself , and they are no gods ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah ban shna ïa ki blei jong u ? Em , lada u leh kumta , kin ym long shisha ki blei .
Ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ïa kaba ju rakhe ngab pyndonburom ïa U Trai’ , ka sdang ha ka por sep sngew ha ka sngem kaba khatsaw jngai u bnai umbiah nyngkong .
translation.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the  Lord s  passover .

So that they shall take no wood out of the field , neither cut down any out of the forests  ; for they shall burn the weapons with fire : and they shall spoil those that spoiled them , and rob those that robbed them , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kin ym hap shuh ban khar diengïap sha lum sha wah ne thoh dieng na khlaw , namar ki don ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh , ban thang ding . Kin kurup bad lute ïa kito kiba la kurup bad lute ïa ki ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Lane nga lah ban phah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban pynïap ïa ki briew , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ri kaban ma thar thar ba ym kein uno uno uba haka ban longing lyngraw ïa ka ,
translation.en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land , and they spoil it , so that it be desolate , that no man may pass through because of the beasts :

translation.kha: hynne lada uta u shakri u ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong u , u shim to skhem ban wanrah phai bad lada u sdang ban shoh ïa kiew pat ki shakri , shynrang pynlang kynthei , bad bam bad dih bad buaid ,
translation.en: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;

translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la pynswai shaphang jong ki , bad u ino , Phi dei ki nongsyntiat ; phiah ïawan ban khem ha-ei ka ri jyllang ngi ka shong tlot .
translation.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
translation.kha: U Asa u syiem Judah bad u Baasha u syiem Israel ki don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma hapdeng jong ki katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
U la ong , To ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng . Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyndong ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien U Trai .
translation.en: Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ai ïa U Troas namar ka jinglehbha jong u baroh ïa nga ?
translation.en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?

translation.kha: Lada ki ong ïa ngi don ap haduh ba kin da wan sha i , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka jaka .
translation.en: If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingkha ïa u Joseph , u Jakob u nong ha u Laban , Pynleit noh ïa nga , ba ngan ïoh leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai’ Nongsynshar , nga khim ïa kane ka hima Israel kaba pop , bad ngan pynjot ïa ka na sla khyndew . Hynriew nur ym pynjot ïa barieh ki ïakhun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translation.en: Behold , the eyes of the Lord  God  are upon the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth  ; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Te mynta , lada phi tyngkhuh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ka jutang jong per , phin long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka long ka jong sa , bad phiah pat phin long ki briew ibha nga la jied ,
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :

translation.kha: Namar kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad kam klet ïa ka lano lano : U Trai u long U balui ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . Ym anna blei da uwei patiaw .
translation.en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .

translation.kha: U Elijah u la iehnoh bad shem ïa u Elisha ba u dang pynlur ïa shi julam ki masi dab ; la don khaw-eit jur ki masi Dabid kiba ni ha ki lyngkar ha khmat jong u , bad u dang pynlur ïa kiba khatduh . U Elijah u la law noh ïa la ka barandi bad u la pynpaw ha u Elisha .
translation.en: So he departed thence , and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth : and Elijah passed by him , and cast his mantle upon him .
Take his garment that is surety for a stranger : and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mutlop palat kat ban kular ban bahkhlieh ïa ki ram jong u nongwei u dei ban don la ki jingdon jingem ban buh bynda .
Hynrei ha kata ka die u ruh jong U Tiras u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka byndi , u la ïalam shabar ïa ki apostol , bad u la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,

translation.kha: ban jop ïa ki hima bad ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew ;
translation.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people  ;
And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew ,  Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynim ïa pha ; khie leit ha kaba suk .
Hato don ine Une phangpdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingpyut ka Templ ka la ju long ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa Kanneh mandriek ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .
translation.en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?

translation.kha: Phi tip) katno ngi lah ainong ?
translation.en: Do you know how much profit we made ?

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ha Ijipt , ki Midian ki la dat noh ïa u Joseph ha u phetwir , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , umbiah dei u kapten jongngi ki nongap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh s , and captain of the guard .

translation.kha: U Trai U blang lad phi u pyndonkam ïa u don tynjuh ïa Phi , ban khmih la phi ieit ne em ïa U Trai da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams : for the  Lord  your God proveth you , to know whether ye love the  Lord  your God with all your heart and with all your soul .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban leh da uwei pa uwei u lyngngeit uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u ba-bang shakri kum u nongbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkñia sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .

translation.kha: Shu pdiang ba pha la bakla bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Troas , U Blei jong phad . To phla ba hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingieit ha ki blei nongwankai bad ba pham shym la kohnguh ïa ki praw jong per . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka rukom haba wanrah ïa ti u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot , ne u langsohmoh .
translation.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ai ka burom , ka nam babha bad ka jingsuk ïa baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba bha , ïa ki Jiw nyngkong bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
U ong , Shahshkor ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Hear , I pray you , this dream which I have dreamed :

translation.kha: To ngin ai ki jingnguh sha U Blei badno U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi! Naba ha U Khrist , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem baroh ha ka pyrthei kaba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :

translation.kha: Ki Heshmon jngai u ki ïasynran , badno haba katto katne ki nongkhaïi na Midian ki ïasaid lynnong nongap , ki hynmen ki la sei napoh ïa u Jehosabad na kata ka pukni bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ishmael arphew tylli ki sbiar rupa , bad ki jin ki la ïalam nong ïa u sha Ijipt .
translation.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .

translation.kha: katba bam than ïa ka ngap kam bha ïa phin ; bad kumta ruh ka long Kaba pyrshang ban ïew palat ka jingïaroh .
translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher kum ka dak jong ka jutang . Kumta u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi taïew naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u Jakob u khun jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen kiba pawnam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli noh ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan sur-thma .
translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :
And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u ïohi ïa ki Ken , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka jaka kaba phi shong ka long kaba skhem , Kaba shngain kum ka skum ba la shna shajrong halor ka synrang ;

translation.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen : and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen , whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots , and with the king at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Solomon u lumlang ïa ki shihajar sawspah tylli ki kali ïapom bad khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na kita u buh ha Jerusalem , bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .
U thri un ïaleh na ka pynbha jong phi , bad phim donkam ban leh ei ei ruh em .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall fight for you , and ye shall hold your peace .

translation.kha: Ha “kata hi ka miet u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah baneh khmih siar ïa ka ïit u Dabid bad ban pynïap ïa u ha ka trep kaweh bud . Ka Mikah , ka tnaw u Dabid , ka maham ïa u , ïada phim phet mynta ka miet , laispah ka sngap phin long uba la ïap noh .
translation.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David s house , to watch him , and to slay him in the morning : and Michal David s wife told him , saying , If thou save not thy life to night , to morrow thou shalt be slain .
And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ka dei ban long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngam shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba nga kren ha ki briew kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jong kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .
Wat long kum ki khynraw ha ka rukom pyrkhat jong phi , ko parabangeit jong la ; to long khynnah ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingbymman , hynrei to long rangbah ha ka rukom pyrkhat .
translation.en: Brethren , be not children in understanding : howbeit in malice be ye children , but in understanding be men .

translation.kha: U Jakob u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la dei baneh phet ïap sha Mesopotamia , ha kambah , ngab ïoh ïa ka tnga , u trei na ka bynta ïa uwei u briew’ bad sumar ïa ki longïng jong u .
translation.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria , and Israel served for a wife , and for a wife he kept sheep .

translation.kha: Katba phi ki lyngdoh phi nang ïabun , long phi nang leh jop pyrshah ïa nga ; bad kumta nur-um pynkylla ïa ka burom jong phi sha ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: As they were increased , so they sinned against me : therefore will I change their glory into shame .
But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! Ym don kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam lane kaba sang kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .’

U Benhadad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jubab u Ahab katba ma u bad kiba ïaktah lok bad u , kiwei pat ki nongsuhjaiñ , ki dang ïadih ha ki ïingjaiñ lad ki . U la hukum ïa ki lapbah jong u ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kumta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka jaka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ben–hadad heard this message , as he was drinking , he and the kings in the pavilions , that he said unto his servants , Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki wan sha ka liang u Asaph na Ephraim , Manasseh , bad Simeon , bad ki shong ki sah ha ka hima jong u , namar ki la Ïohi ba U Terah u long lem bad u . U Asa u phah khot ïa ki baroh bad ïa ki paid Jedaïah bad Benjamin .
translation.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .

translation.kha: Haba Kawei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïasngew shaphang kane , ki la bitar ïa kita ar ngut shi para .
translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ïa sakma , To shahshkor , mynnin , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka long kaban sniew eh ïa phi ban pynpait ïa ka jingïaishah jong ki briew — hato Phin jingdonkam ruh ngab pynjahthait ïa ka jingïaishah ka jong U Blei ?
translation.en: And he said , Hear ye now , O house of David  ; Is it a small thing for you to weary men , but will ye weary my God also ?

translation.kha: Kito kiba thain ïa ka jaiñ lin kin don ha ka jingduh jingkulmar ;
translation.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax , and they that weave networks , shall be confounded .

translation.kha: Babha U Jisu u la wan phai shaw kawei pat ka pud jong ka duriaw , ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , Naamah baroh ki la ïa-ap ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .
Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwei ; phi tip kumno phi sngew ban long u nongwei , naba phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .
U pynsngap jar ïa kito ki lah ban shaniah , bad u shim noh ïa ka jingstad jrong ki riewtymmen .
translation.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi hadien ba la pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang , u Moses u khop ïa u Onan bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Jesreel .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day , that Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel  ;
Which rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?
translation.kha: Kim shym long kiba kmen haduh ka jingïap bad la tep ïa ki ;
U angel jongnga U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , bad ka burom jong U Trai ka la tyngshaiñ khlur jong ki . Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,
translation.en: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ïa ka nar la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha . Kane ka mutdur ba ki nongsynshar jong kata ka hima kin pyrshang ban pynïatylli ïa ki longïing jongki ki da ka jingsngewkhia khleh , hynrei kin ym lah , kumba ka nar-khang kam lah ban ïakhlad bad ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay , they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men : but they shall not cleave one to another , even as iron is not mixed with clay .

translation.kha: Mynta por phah ïa me sha u Phan khnang ba Man ïalam noh ïa ki Jeruel , ki briew jong nga , na Ijipt .
translation.en: Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka don slem bha ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba arphew snem . Ha kata ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .
translation.kha: Ïa uba ar la kha da kaba u batskhem triang ïa ka khongdong jat jong u Iso ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa ki .
U la jubab , U syiem Balak ka ri mawbah u la phah ïa ki ban ïathmu ha nga
translation.en: And Balaam said unto God , Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , hath sent unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka khubor kaba U Trai u la ai mynshuwa shngain ka Moab .
translation.en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning Moab since that time .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na Sheba bad Dedan bad ki nongkhaïi na ki shnong jong ka Spain kin kylli ïa me , ‘ ithuh me la lumlang ïa ka kynhun Shiphew bad uta ïaleh khnang ban lute bad pynjot ? Hato me thma ban knieh noh ïa ka rupa malade ka ksiar , ki jingri bad ïa ki jingdon jingem , bad shet noh pat bad kito ki mar lute baroh ?’
translation.en: Sheba , and Dedan , and the merchants of Tarshish , with all the young lions thereof , shall say unto thee , Art thou come to take a spoil ? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey ? to carry away silver and gold , to take away cattle and goods , to take a great spoil ?
And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .
translation.kha: Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka por ba ki leit sha ka ïing U  Trai  , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïam bad kam treh ban bam ei ei .
Ko syiem , “lada ïa kane ka nongbah yn tei pat bad ïa ki kynroh jongu ka yn pyndep , ki briew kin sa sangeh ban siew khynnah , bad ki jingmih ka ïingsyiem kin sa duna .
translation.en: Be it known now unto the king , that , if this city be builded , and the walls set up again , then will they not pay toll , tribute , and custom , and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings .

translation.kha: Mynta phi lah ban ïashim bynta lem bad nga ha ka thlim . Ka dei kajuh ka sma kaba phin la Iohi ïa ang ba nga la ïaleh ha ki por kiba mynshuwa , bad bania phi ïasngew , ïa sakma kaba nga ïangat ïaleh haduh mynsiem .
translation.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me , and now hear to be in me .

translation.kha: U Blei u iohsngew ïa ka jingïam ita u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jong U Blei u kren ha ka hajir , Ko Haggan , pha shlei ha-ei ? Wat sheptieng . U Bela u la jingïashoh ïa ka jingïam ita u khlong .
translation.en: And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .
O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
translation.kha: Nga long u shakri jong me , ko  Trai  ; nga shakri ïa me , kumba ka kmie jong nga ka la leh . Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap .
Ngam sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad najrong jyllang ka jinghap kaba hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tyllep , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Da ka jingsmai kynha ha u Abraham u kpa tymmen lad ngi u la Kular ban pyrsad im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi bad shah ïa sem ban sharai ïa u khlem jingsheptieng ,
translation.en: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,
Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
translation.kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei u leh .

translation.en: Let the proud be ashamed  ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
translation.kha: Ai ba kiba sarong kin lehrain , namar ki mudui lamler ïa nga ; hynrei ma nga , ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei khwai ka liang .
translation.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :

translation.kha: Ka sdang kumba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la thoh : U Blei u la ainong , ‘ Ngan phiah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuh jong phi ban pynkhreh lynti na ka bynta jngai phi .’
translation.en: As it is written in the prophets , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .

translation.kha: Ki nongsiatkhnam kan ym lah ïeng ha la ki dik ïeng , ki nongaikam kiba stet kin ym lah lait , nabar ki nongshong khlei kin ym lah ïa-ban pyllait ïa la ka lad ka jingim .
translation.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow  ; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself : neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself .
Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .
translation.kha: Lada me leit sha ka ïing jong ka , me don ha ka lynti sha ka ri kiba ïap . Ka dei ka lynti kaba jan tam sha ka jingïap .

Naduh mihpaw eh ïa ka jaka la pynkhynñiuh ha kaweh ka ding bajur kan thang ïa u patsha ka Assyria . Ka long kambah jlew bad kaba ïar , bad ba la kynran jrong da ki diengthang . U Trai un pyrsad da ka phylla ding ban thang ïa ka .
translation.en: For Tophet is ordained of old  ; yea , for the king it is prepared  ; he hath made it deep and large : the pile thereof is fire and much wood  ; the breath of the  Lord  , like a stream of brimstone , doth kindle it .

translation.kha: Une u maw u long ibha kordor eh ïa phi kiba ngeit ; hynrei ha kito ki bymngeit : U maw ïa suba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kyllum long uba donkam tam na baïar .
translation.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious : but unto them which be disobedient , the stone which the builders disallowed , the same is made the head of the corner ,

And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh  ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , of every one according to his taxation , to give it unto Pharaoh–neco .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim u la lum khajna na ki briew kat kum ka jingdon spah jong ki , khnang ban pynmih ïa ka pisa ba dei ban siew ïa ka bai nguh syiem kumba la dawa da u syiem Ijipt .
Tangba ym shym la pynksan ïano ïano hima da ka Hukum ha U Blei , namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Tang iathuh ïa suba la pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
translation.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God , it is evident : for , The just shall live by faith .
Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt : for in her youth they lay with her , and they bruised the breasts of her virginity , and poured their whoredom upon her .
translation.kha: Ka ïai bteng na kaei kaba ka la sdang kum ka nuti ha Ijipt , hangta ha kaba la duh noh ïa la ka jinglong sotti . Naduh ka por ba ka long ka samla ba dang khynraw , ki rangbah ki la ïathiah bad ka bad leh ïa ka la kum ka nuti .

translation.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa ki sha U Trai ban kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wan , ne hato ngin khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?
Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Nalor kata , ngan ai ruh ha me bun ka speh , ka jingmynsaw , bad ka nam ban ïa uno uno u syiem naba la ju ïoh mynshuwa lane un ïoh biang pat .
translation.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .

translation.kha: U Samson u ong ha ki , Shah ngan shuh ha pa kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha nga ïa ka jingmut jngai ka ha shuwa ban kut kine ki hynriewphew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi , ki ong . To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa said .
translation.en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la pyrthat skum sha nga , Ki kulai Kiba la leit shaphang shai sha Baalah ki la pynjai jai ïa ka jingbitar jong U Trai .
translation.en: Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .

translation.kha: U ai hukum ïa ka pyrthei , bad ïa kaei kaba u ong la leh kloi .
translation.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth : his word runneth very swiftly .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit . Ka ong ha la u tnga , (Nga tang shu pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ngan wanrah ïalam ïa u sha ïing U Trai , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .
translation.en: But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne sngi U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha Kapernam , bun ka shukor ka la phriang ba u la don ha ïing .
translation.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days  ; and it was noised that he was in the house .
For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt  ; I am black  ; astonishment hath taken hold on me .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah pynlwet namar ki briew jong nga ki la shah pynlwet ; nga ïam sngewsih ; nga la shaïong jur .
Ym don myntor , ym don jingleh byrtong , Kaba lah ngab pynbudnam pyrshah ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Mynta ki briew kin ïakren shaphang ki Israel , ‘ Khmih aïu U Blei u la leh !’
translation.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !

translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab , Leh kat kaba Don ha ka jingman jong phi , namar U Blei! u long ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .

translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki kiew shai suiñ bad ki khih , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit plain bad ki . Haba ki pyllew ïa ki thapniang ïa-ban her , ki shalyntem ruh ki saw plain sad ki .
translation.en: And when the cherubims went , the wheels went by them : and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the same wheels also turned not from beside them .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pang ka liang , lada nga ong ba ngan seng lane tei ïa katno kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,
translation.en: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to build and to plant it  ;

translation.kha: Na myntoi aiwai da kaba ong ha ki , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi ! To phong syaid bad to bam bha ! — lada phim ai ha ki ïa ki jingdonkam Jong ka jingim ?
translation.en: And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?

translation.kha: dalade ha khwai ka sngi ïa ka suiñ la haka ban thew malade ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei la ïingjah , tang kata hi ka ban pynlong ba un kynjai ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh’ kaba ki la leh . U Trai u la kriah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .
And , behold , I , even I , do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven  ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshlei ïa ka pyrthei da ka um ban pynduh noh khoit ïa ki kynja ba-im baroh . Baroh kat kiba don ha ka pyrthei kin ïap .
Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ïohi ïa ka jingstad u Solomon , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka jingmih ba u la thet .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , and the house that he had built ,

translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba iathuh u paidbah u la phet , ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jongu u ki kylla ka jingmut jong ki , bad ki la ong , Nga la sa aïu ? ngi la shah ïa ki Jeruel ba ktang phetwir noh , bad im’ la duh ïa ki khem ki saraw jong ngi !
translation.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this , that we have let Israel go from serving us ?
The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
translation.kha: Me don u ksuid hapoh jong me !  u paidbah u la jubab .  Mano ba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa me ?

translation.en: And ye have this day rejected your God , who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations  ; and ye have said unto him , Nay , but set a king over us . Now therefore present yourselves before the  Lord  by your tribes , and by your thousands .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi , uta uba pyllait ïa phi na ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom jong phi baroh hynrei mynta phi la kyntait ïa nga bad phi la pan na nga ban ai ïa phi da u syiem . Namar kata , ïalumlang ïa lade ha khmat U  Trai  , shi jait shi jait , bad shi kur shi kur .’
( Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba ki nongmane blang thala ki ju ïai pyrkhat borabor . ) U Kpa jong phi uba ha Bneng u pyntip ba phin donkam ïa film kiei ktien baroh .
translation.en: ( For after all these things do the Gentiles seek : ) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things .

translation.kha: Ynda phi ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jongno phiah u ai ha phi! , wat pynbyrngia ïa u mawdong jong u paramarjan jong phi ïa uba la thung naduh mynjur .
translation.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .

translation.kha: Nangta la phah sa iwei u nonglamktien uba kylliang ha u Jehu ïa kajuh ka jingkylli . U Jehu u la Jobab babiang , Kata kam dei ka kam jong me ! Burom nadien jong sa .
translation.en: Then he sent out a second on horseback , which came to them , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu answered , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me .

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u ong ha ki antad Israel , Nga la leh ïa kaba phi la ong ïa nga ban lai . Nga la ai ïa phi u shem ban synshar ïa phi ,
translation.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel , Behold , I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me , and have made a king over you .
The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .
translation.kha: Ka spah ba phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ym ha shuwa ba kan ïalam ïa phi sha ki tyngam jong ka jingïap .
Haba pa’ shok shapoh ka ïing , to ainong , ‘ Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .’
translation.en: And when ye come into an house , salute it .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , sad lehbha tista sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benjamin .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .

translation.kha: Nga shemphang Ïohi ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba phin iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist — kumba ïa ka Im la shukor da ki buit sianti uta u bseiñ .
translation.en: But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong per ïa Ibbah U Blei u la khot ! To pyllait ïa U jongu , ïa uba U Blei u la phad ba-bang long U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïaphla .
translation.en: Wherefore , holy brethren , partakers of the heavenly calling , consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession , Christ Jesus  ;
And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , ( for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt  ; )
translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban phet ïap na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh na Ijipt .

translation.en: Thus will I magnify myself , and sanctify myself  ; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations , and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ngan pyn-i ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khraw bad uba khuid . Kin sa tip , te , ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: For want and famine they were solitary  ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
translation.kha: Ki la long kiba duk haduh katta katta bad kiba thngan haduh ba ki bam ïa ki thied tyrkhong — mynmiet , ha khlaw , ha ki jaka kynjah .
Ki lyngkdong kim dei ban bam ïa nangno kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kambah la shat pynïap ha uwei paw u krad .
translation.en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself , or torn , whether it be fowl or beast .

Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? yet among many nations was there no king like him , who was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ka dei na ka daw ki kynthei nongwei ba u syiem Solomon u la leh pop . U la long u briew uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki syiem jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew . U Blei u la ieit ïa u bad pynlong syiem ïa u halor ki Israel , bad pynban u hap ha kane ka pop .

translation.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .
translation.kha: Ym don nongwei ha ka ri jong ki ; ym don u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na U Blei .
Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh hangta ! Hadrakh katno ki kam baphylla u la kuna ha ka Duriaw Basaw !
translation.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .

translation.kha: Katto katei ngut ki ino ba me long u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , ki la jubab ; kiwei pud ki ong ba me longïng u Elijah , katba kawei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .

translation.kha: Ka la jan dap artat san baje haba u la sien sha ka khang ïew bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kaba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba phi pynsep-ei ïa ka sngi baroh kawei hangne khlem ki ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?
Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God s behalf .
translation.kha: To ïaishah bad shahshkor sa katto katne ïa kaei ba nga ong na ka liang jong U Blei .

translation.en: And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pynïap ïa uta u masi , ki ïalam ïa uta u khynnah sha u Eli .
To lehkmen , ko ka khyndew bad ka shait bneng ! To kyrhuh , ko ka duriaw bad baroh ki jingthaw ba ba-don ha pha ;
translation.en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap ,
translation.en: But God raised him from the dead :

translation.kha: Kan longing beh nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka , hynrei kane ym lap ïa ki . Kan wad ïa ki hynrei kan ym shem ïa ki . Te kan sa ong , Ngan leit phai noh sha u tnga wahbah nyngkong jong de — nga Kham bit kham biang myn ha kata ban ïa kaba nga long myntri .
translation.en: And she shall follow after her lovers , but she shall not overtake them  ; and she shall seek them , but shall not find them : then shall she say , I will go and return to my first husband  ; for then was it better with me than now .
The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth–shemesh , and Elon–beth–hanan :
translation.kha: U Bendeker : ki nongbah Makas , Shaalbim , Beth Shemesh , Elon , bad Beth Hanan
Phi pynpait ïa lade ban leit wad ïa kiwei pateng ki blei , hynrei kine shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ïa-bujli jong phi kin ai ber ïa phi , bad kumta phim ju khie throsh .
translation.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .

Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .
translation.kha: to ïathuh ha ki , ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang ïa u bad uta uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Judah . Na kita ar tylli ngan pynlong uwei u dieng , bad ngan bat ïa u ha ka kti jong nga .
Un phah ha phi ïa ka jingpang kawei hajan kawei haduh ba yn ym Don shuh uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kata ka ri kaba phiah sa ïohkynti .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee , until he have consumed thee from off the land , whither thou goest to possess it .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka stang u Jubab u kyllum longsem uba riewspah eh . U la don shibit ki kynhun jingri , ki mraw , ki ut , bad ki kur .
translation.en: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .
And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Ruth ka ong ,  Kaba kor tam na baroh , u ong ba ngan ïai tam kew bad ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .

translation.en: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh hikai ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham san ba kin im donakor kum ki kynthei kiba dei ban leh , kiba im ka jingim bakhuid . Kim dei ban long kiba kren siar lane kiba kyrni ha ka dih waiñ .
Pynban , kum u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat uba ha shuwa Jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop , bad um shym sangeh .
translation.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .

translation.kha: Bad kum u shakri jongu U Tiras , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jai ha ki briew borbah , balung hikai , jingshaniah .
translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .
translation.kha: U briew uba stad , uba rangbah jingmut u long uba paw ha ka jingshemphang jong u . Katba nang sngewtynnat ki ktien ba u kren , katta u nang lah ban pynkohnguh .
hynrei ym ei mano mano batip shaphang kata , namar ki i Kumjuh kumba ki long mynshuwa . Nangno nga la kynta thiah .
translation.en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki un erlangthari kum ka jingkah na ka lyer sad ka jaka ban rahah na ki baïong . Kin long kum ki wahduid kiba tuid ha ka ri shyiap , kum ka jingtah syrngiew u mawlynnai bah ha ka ri sharak .
translation.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .

translation.kha: U la buh ïa u Joseph ban khmih ïa kiwei pat ki koidi kiba don hangta , malu u la buh jingkhynñiuh ha u ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba la ju leh hangta .
translation.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison  ; and whatsoever they did there , he was the doer of it .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem Kaba Ephphatha jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat , u syiad Judah , u Joram u khwan jong u Ahab u la un-long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar sngi ha Samaria .
translation.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .
And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la don ha ka jingjynjar haba la bthah ba ki dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la ju shna mynshuwa .
U Trai u lawlynnong ïa u Moses
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Ki khnam ki don ha kawei pat ka liang jong pa’ ,’ te phet noh , namar U Trai u la phah noh ïa phi .
translation.en: But if I say thus unto the young man , Behold , the arrows are beyond thee  ; go thy way : for the  Lord  hath sent thee away .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ha ki , Ki ktien jong phi ki long kiba barew , pynlang ki Jingïohipaw jong phi ki long kiba lamler . Nga long pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum U Trai bad ki otsher lyngba ïa baroh ki shnong ka Judah , da kaba iaki ïa ka ha ki briew .
translation.en: And they taught in Judah , and had the book of the law of the  Lord  with them , and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .

As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingthaw don kaei kaei kaba syriem kum ka dongmusa bameh , kaba ïai khih . Ka ding ka klang bad pynmih ki jingthaba leilieh .
Kane ka long ka hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong phi , uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ïa-ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi ki nongïalam napdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ym ki nongbud ; phin ïaphai manbha bad phyrnai ym kyrduh lada phi nongshong ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynsiem ka sngi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall make thee the head , and not the tail  ; and thou shalt be above only , and thou shalt not be beneath  ; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , which I command thee this day , to observe and to do them :

translation.kha: Ki ktien sbun ki Long kum ka ngap — kaba thiang ïa ka jingmad bad kaba bha ïa ka jingkoit jingkhie .
translation.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .

translation.kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ; wat pynrem ïa kiwei , sad U Blei un ym pynrem ïa phi ; map ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ïohmap ïa phi .
translation.en: Judge not , and ye shall not be judged : condemn not , and ye shall not be condemned : forgive , and ye shall be forgiven :
And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham , U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , uba sah hajan  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .
badno u la kylli ïa ki , Kane ka dur bun ka kyrteng ki dei ki jongno ?
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?

translation.kha: U Dabid u nguh ha lade , Ha kiwei na kine ka sngi , u Saul un sa pynïap ïa nga . Kaba bha tam eh ïa nga ban leh ka long ban phet noh sha ka ri ki Philistia . Te u Saul un sa sangot ban wad ïa nga ha Israel , bad ngan sa lait na ka kti jong u .
translation.en: And David said in his heart , I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul : there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines  ; and Saul shall despair of me , to seek me any more in any coast of Israel : so shall I escape out of his hand .

translation.kha: Phim bit wat tang ban jingaiti ding duh ha la ïing ha ka sneng Sabakhthani .
translation.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jongnga u , U blang u la rah lym ba da U Jisu Khrist un pynlong ïa me ki khun jong u — kane ka long ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingtim jong u .
translation.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his will ,

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long Kumta , to long jar jar bad shahshkor ïa nga , sad ngan iaki ïa phi kumno ba phi long uba stad .
translation.en: If not , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga la kajuh shikatdei eh ban ïabam bad phi ïa kñia ka jingjam ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha shuwa ba ngan shahshitom !
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer :
Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness , and righteousness remain in the fruitful field .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri , ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok , yn pyndep .

Mynmiet , ko ki paid Israel , shahshkor ïa kai kaba U Trai U Balei jong Phi u dawa na phi : Minni ïa U Trai bad leh ïa kata baroh Kaba u hukum . Ïateh ïa u , shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , dara kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .
translation.en: And now , Israel , what doth the  Lord  thy God require of thee , but to fear the  Lord  thy God , to walk in all his ways , and to love him , and to serve the  Lord  thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul ,

translation.kha: Nangta u pud u suh shad u lum shaïong shatei jong ka Ekron , u pah sha ka Shikkeron , lyngba u Lum Baanah , bad thri ter sha Jannai . U kut ha ka Darius Mid ,
translation.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .

translation.kha: bad kumta U Tlai u ong ba ki khulom kynthei u Selophehad ki lah ban ïashongkurim bun uno Uno uba ki mon , hynrei tang haduh ka jait jong ki hi .
translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .

translation.kha: U khñium u saitlah ban ngeit iau nonghikai .
translation.en: The student refused to obey his teacher .

translation.kha: Lehse ïa ka snam jong ka jingim jong nga la den ban theh noh kum ka jingainguh halor ka jingkñia kaba long ka jingngeit jong phi ba ai shata U Blei . Lada tala ka long kumta , nga shadkmen bad nga ïasam pynbha lem ïa ka jingkmen jong ang bad phi! baroh .
translation.en: Yea , and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith , I joy , and rejoice with you all .

translation.kha: Une ki kynteit shi para ki la phah khubor sha U Jisu : Ko Trai , u lop uba me ieit u pat .
translation.en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him , saying , Lord , behold , he whom thou lovest is sick .

translation.kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jingleh bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kaba yn ym klet shuh .
translation.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .

translation.kha: Mynta khatduh U Trai u la ïarap ïa nga , ka la ong . U la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga hapdeng ki briew !
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .

translation.kha: Phet napoh na u briew uba shahshkor , bad ngat yn ym don shuh ki jingïakajia , ka jingïamai lane ka jingsin kyrteng .
translation.en: Cast out the scorner , and contention shall go out  ; yea , strife and reproach shall cease .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai’ u la pyllait im ïa u Dabid na u Saul bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun , u Dabid u la rwai ïa kane ka jingthrew ha U Trai .
translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  the words of this song in the day that the  Lord  had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies , and out of the hand of Saul :

translation.kha: Wat kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa laiñ hangne ha ka pynrieh , ha kaba ki jingkhang bad ka sarang ki pynjot , bad ki nongtuh ki prong bad ki tuh .
translation.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth , where moth and rust doth corrupt , and where thieves break through and steal :

translation.kha: Hato ka turoi thma ka ju sawa ha ka nongbah khlam da pynphong ïa ki briew ba-bang sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjot ka ju ngat ha ka nongbah Lym U Trai u phah ïa ka ?
translation.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?
His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant  ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
translation.kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’

translation.en: For nothing is secret , that shall not be made manifest  ; neither any thing hid , that shall not be known and come abroad .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la buhrieh noh yn wallam shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kano kano kaba la tap yn sa lap bad yn sa pynpaw ha kaba shai .
tala ka briew ka ong ha u , Kynrad , hato per pan khun shynrang na phin ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi ban ym kynhied ïa ki jingkyrmen jong to ?
translation.en: Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?

translation.kha: pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynbna hapdeng ki jaitbynriew : ‘ To Pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thmu ; khot ïa ki nongïaleh thma ; ïalumlang ïa ki shipai nabar tur shankhung !
translation.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :

translation.kha: Uwei pat u nonghiarpateng jongngi u Saul , u dei u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan , uba la dap san snem ka rta mynhynnin u Saul Bad u Jonathan ki la shah pynïap . Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynïap jong ki ka la wan poi na ka nongbah Jeiel , ka nongsumar jong u ka la rah ïa u bad ka phut krad ; hynrei namar ka jingkyrkieh palat ka la pynhap ïa u , nabar u la kylla long uba dih .
translation.en: And Jonathan , Saul s son , had a son that was lame of his feet . He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel , and his nurse took him up , and fled : and it came to pass , as she made haste to flee , that he fell , and became lame . And his name was Mephibosheth .

translation.kha: phang la pateng , kynta ki jingbthah ryntih ki teh ïa phi bad ïa ki nongrwai babha shong basah bad pa’ . Ma phi bad ma ki phi ïanguh kumjuh ha khnam U Trai .
translation.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the  Lord .

translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki kynthei hangta , katba la ïakhmih na pajih , kaba la ïawad ïa U Jisu! na Galilaïa bad kiba la ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: And many women were there beholding afar off , which followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him :
And he went up thence to Penuel , and spake unto them likewise : and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .
translation.kha: U Gideon u la leit sha Penuel bad u la kyrpad kumjuh ïa ki briew kiba hangta , hynrei ki briew jong ka Penuel ki la ai kajuh ka jubab kum ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth .
Lada ki don sanphew ngut kiba hok ha dat ka nongbah , hato men pynjot noh! ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei ? Men ym pyllait ïa ka ba ki sanphew ngut ngin loit im ?
translation.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
And the rest of the acts of Amaziah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amasaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

U Blei u pyndonkam ïa Kanneh ka jingit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon neh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Asaïah u dang don hangta , ma u sad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Heh , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U Trai u la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longsem syiem jong u Ahab .
translation.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u da kaba pyrta jam ,  Em , ym dei ïa u ! Ngi kwah ïa u Barabbas !  ( u Barabbas u la long u nongkamsniew . )

Da pynthikna ba phin ym leh ïa ki kam mon jong phi ha kaba paw khnang ba ki briew kin ïor ïa kaei kaba phi leh . Lada phin leh ïa kino kiei kiei ha kaba paw , phiah ym ïoh kano Kano ka nong na U Kpa jong phi uba ha weng .
translation.en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men , to be seen of them : otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Ka jingkerkut kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka ne sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .
translation.en: One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
translation.kha: Ha khmih ! U ïakren ha u paidbah , bad kim ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba kim ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dei U Messaïah ?
‘ myntri ka sngi ph dei ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab ha Ar .
translation.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :
Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohmap ïa kano kano ka pop bad ïa kano kano kaba sniew kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap .
U bhabriew uba nyngkong ban kren ha ka ïingbishar borabor u sngewdei haka haduh ba wahbah ïaleh pyrshah u sdang ban buh jingkylli ïa u .
translation.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just  ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba rong jubor ïa la u per Israel mala u pynlong mraw lane die mraw ïa u , u de ban shah pynïap . Da kamut phin pynpoh ei ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong pa’ .
translation.en: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel , and maketh merchandise of him , or selleth him  ; then that thief shall die  ; and thou shalt put evil away from among you .

translation.kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Ki sher ïa ki sawa jrong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongkha hangthie . Kin bam ïa u soh nabar kmen dih ïa ka ding bakha dat ki jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
Shall I cause it to return into his sheath ? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created , in the land of thy nativity .
translation.kha: ‘ Buh ïa ka waitlam ! Ngan bishar ïa me ha ka jaka ba la kha ïa me , ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .
lad ïap kum u ksew ha ka Ki jong ki nongwei bym don blei . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa ka hukum .
translation.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .
Uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba u la leh ; hynrei ngi lah tyngka ban shu khmih na jngai .
translation.en: Every man may see it  ; man may behold it afar off .

translation.kha: Mynta , to la ïatih ïa phi ba phi la ïohi ïa nga hynriew phin ym ngeit .
translation.en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .

translation.kha: U la kam ba u long uba khrup , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u . Uno u briew u long kata ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaban la khot ‘ Ka Borbah’ , ki la ong .
translation.en: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .

Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , baroh ki paid Israel kiba don ha Moab , Ammon , Edom bad ha kiwei ki ri , ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la shah katto katne ki nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Judah bad ba u la pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat jong ki .

translation.en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli ,  Hato ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynta kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?
Ka la duwai pan pan : tyngka ki rmiang shylluit jong ka ki khih , hynrei kam khim pynmih sur ei ei . Kumta u ijli la u pyrkhat ba ka la buaid ,
translation.en: Now Hannah , she spake in her heart  ; only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard : therefore Eli thought she had been drunken .
And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u ong ,  To , kam lei lei ! Haba U  Trai  u aiti ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ha nga , ngan shoh ïa phi da ki shiah bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shyiap !
Te un sa beh noh ïa kita ki jingkheiñbriew katba phi on ïadoh shad khmat , bad phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad Kham donbor don ïa phi .
translation.en: Then will the  Lord  drive out all these nations from before you , and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves .

translation.kha: Ïai keiñ uba lah ban pyllait ïa ine na kine ki plie ibha khrawbor ? Kine ki dei me ki blei kiba la shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyiap !
translation.en: Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Uei une uba wan na ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Utai une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup prong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha ka bol bad jingkhaïi ? U dei U Trai , uba donburom ban pyllut im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jinghap jong u .
translation.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .

translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la dap sanspah snem ka rta , u ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Shem , u Hammon , bad u Japheth .
translation.en: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .

translation.kha: Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mirr , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphriang kylleng ka khyndew .
translation.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .

translation.kha: bad ianga me la poi hangta , wan ïa u Jiw u ïakhun jong u Jehoshaphat malu u ksiar jong u Nimshi . Ïalam ïa u sha ka kamram kaba kyrpang jngai na ki paralok jong u ,
translation.en: And when thou comest thither , look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi , and go in , and make him arise up from among his brethren , and carry him to an inner chamber  ;
And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre  ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man  ; for they were afraid .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit noh bad mareh na ka jingtep , ki da sngewkhuslai bad sngewshyrkhei . Kim shym la ïathuh ei ei hano hano ruh , namar ki la sheptieng . [

hynrei da ka jingaiei U blem nga long kumba nga longsem , Bad ka jingaiei kaba u la ai ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kawei ka liang , nga la kham trei shitom ban ïa uno un uwei pat na ki baphylla , wat la kad shym la long da ka jinglehhok jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba ba-thurmur ha to .
translation.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .
