Haba u ïeng ha khmat u syiem Abijah , u syiem u kylli ïa u , Ko Mikaïah , hab u syiem Jehosabad bad at ngin leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ? tyrso ! u Mikaïah u ong . Da shisha phin jop . U Trai un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And when he was come to the king , the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And he said , Go ye up , and prosper , and they shall be delivered into your hand .

translation.kha: U lehhok ïa ki khunswet bad ïa ki riewkhmat ; u iau ïa ki nongwei kiba don bad ngi , bad u ai bam bad ai kup ai sem ïa ki .
translation.en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow , and loveth the stranger , in giving him food and raiment .

translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa u sha Kaisaria , ki la ai ïa ka shithi ha u lyngskor , bad ki la aiti ïa u Paul ha u .
translation.en: Who , when they came to Caesarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .
Then the priest shall look : and , behold , if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white  ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin  ; he is clean .
translation.kha: Lada kita ki dak ki long kiba lieh blad , ki dei tang ki dak thohbria ha ka sniehdoh jong ; uta u briew u long uba khuid .

translation.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it : whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kaba pynbam sap ka treikam kum ka myntor ; ki ngeit ba ka lah ban leh lut ïa kiei kiei .
Bad u Agrippa u la ïai-ong ha u Phortunatos , Ïa une u briew la daym ban pyllait neh lymda u la eh apil sha u pashait .
translation.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Caesar .

And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet  ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .
translation.kha: Ha uwei uwei na ki , thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel .

translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  of hosts said , Hew ye down trees , and cast a mount against Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited  ; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la hukum ïa kine ki syiem ban khet ïa ki dieng bad ban shna ki kynton khnang ban kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem . U la ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kane ka nongbah namar ka la dap da ka jingbanbeiñ .

translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ,

translation.en: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .
translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingaiei U Blei ïa nga , nga ong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi : To wat ñiewkor palat than ïa lade ban ïa kaba phi dei ban leh . Pynban , to long adkar ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi , bad to bishar ïa lade kat kum ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father s sheep at Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: u Dabid u ju iehnoh ïa ki bad u leit phai sha Bethlehem na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ban sharai ïa ki langbrot u kpa jong u .
U Jehobah u ong ïa ngi ban ñiar na ka jingmlien ba longkmie pop Naamah ba u tip ba kin pynsniew ïa ngi .
translation.en: Jehovah tells us to avoid sinful practices because he knows they will harm us .

translation.kha: Haba phi ai kan kano ka jingkular ha U Tiras U Blei jong phi! , wat pynslem ha kaba pynnep ïa ka , U Trai un bat ïa ka kular jong phi , bad ka long ka pop ngab ym pyndep ïa ka .
translation.en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .

translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u wan ha la ki hynmen shynrang jongno u , ki hukum ei ïa ka sopti jynsur jongki u kob jrong kti .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;

translation.kha: ‘ Ha ki ngan pynkdang ïa ki jingpynjot bymkut thuh , ngan siat lute la ki khmat ha ki .
translation.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them  ; I will spend mine arrows upon them .

translation.kha: U Blei u la klun , bad kine ki dat ki ktien jong u :
translation.en: And God spake all these words , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta la wad ïa ka samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , bad ki lap ha Shunem ïa ka kum kata ka kynthei kaban kyrteng ka Abishag , bad ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .
translation.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .
A drought is upon her waters  ; and they shall be dried up : for it is the land of graven images , and they are mad upon their idols .
translation.kha: Wallam ïa ka jingrang ryngkhiang ha ka ri jong ka bad pynrngad lut ïa ki wah jong ka . Ka Babilonia ka long ka ri jong ki bleithaw ba-ishyrkhei , kiba la pynkylla bieit ïa ki briew .

Mynta te , u Hammath u bteng , Hato phi lehhok bad da kaba khuid mynsiem shisha haba phi thung symboh ïa u Abimelekh ? Hato phi kynmaw burom ïa u Gideon sad lehbha ïa ka longïing jong u , kumba ki nang jong u ki daiñ ban ïoh ?
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye have done truly and sincerely , in that ye have made Abimelech king , and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands  ;
Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew ka Shaphir , leit shah ringmraw , ha ka jinglyngkhuit bad jinglehrain . Kito kiba shong ha Saanan kim nud ban mih shabar na ka nongbah jong ki . Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki briew jong ka Bethesel ki ïambriew , phin tip ba ym don jakarieh hangta .
Hato U Bel u ai ïa U Mynsiem malade leh ïa ki kambah hapdeng jong phi! namarba ba phi leh ïa kamai kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ne namar ba pa’ ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel nabar ngeit ïa ka ?
translation.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?

translation.kha: Ki khah shaniah ïa me Ban ïa la ki kmang ki kpa , ki hynmen ki la , ne ki khun ki kti . Ki kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me Bad ki ïaineh ha ka jyntang jong me .
translation.en: Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth , and did reverence to the king , and said , Let my lord king David live for ever .
translation.kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon bad ka ong ,  Ai ba u kynrad jong nga , u syiem un im junom !

Baroh shi miet lynter ka ïan ; ki ummat ki tuid ha ki ngab jong ka . Na baroh ki paralok jong ka kiba mynshuwa , ym don iwei ruh iba sah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Kiba ïateh hok bad ka ki la shekel ïa ka malu baroh ki la long pyrshah ïa ka mynta .
translation.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah  ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof .
And I will lay sinews upon you , and will bring up flesh upon you , and cover you with skin , and put breath in you , and ye shall live  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ki thied bad ki dohksah , bad ngan tap ïa phi da ka sniehdoh . Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim . Te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
translation.kha: lem bad katto katne ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba don hapoh ki pud sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .
Baroh shi sngi nga ïaroh ïa me bad pynthaba ïa ka burom jrong me .
translation.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .

translation.kha: Lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynhiar mynnin na ka jingim ,
translation.en: If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrshang ban leh ïa nga , ko Tyros bad Sidon , bad baroh ki jaka jongno ka Phoenisia ? Hato phi pynryngkang ban thret pat ïa la na ka bynta kaei Kiei ? Lada Phi leh kumta , ngan sawphew kylliang kloi kloi pat ïa pa !
translation.en: Yea , and what have ye to do with me , O Tyre , and Zidon , and all the coasts of Philistia ? will ye render me a recompence ? and if ye recompense me , swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head  ;

translation.kha: Kim don khun namar ba ka Elishaphat kam skhem lah ban Ïohi wat iwei ruh , bad ma ka lem bad u Sekharaïah ki la tymmen bha .
translation.en: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .
And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Kishion , ka Daberath ,

Me long U Blei jongno ngi . Mynba u paid Israel jong me u wan sha kaei ka ri , me beh krad ïa ki briew kiba shong hangne bad me ai ïa ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paro jong me , ban long ka jongngi ki junom .
translation.en: Art not thou our God , who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel , and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever ?

translation.kha: Te , lada phim mon shu ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namar ba phi la pynbor ban ïathiah shongduh dara ka , phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka kum ka mraw bad die ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .
And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Gaal nga la duwai , ‘ A Trai Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki brup kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhyllong bad ka borbah jong me .
translation.en: I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .

If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jaka mane Blei ka jngai eh , phi lah , ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , ban pynïap ïa kano kano ka masi lane ka blang ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi , bad bam ïa ka doh jong ka ha la ïing , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi .
U Syiem kyrdan u la pynum ka hukum ba tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingim , uwei pa uwei u dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,
translation.en: Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :
And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .
translation.kha: Bad u Ïoannis u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla :  Nga la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paro na bneng , bad u shongsah halor jong u .

translation.en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not  ; and we have borne their iniquities .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh pop , hynrei mynta kim don shuh , bad ngi shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me ,  Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash :  and I went and washed , and I received sight .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  U briew ïa uba la khot U Jisu u la pynlong ïa i sboh ktieh , u la kyllan ha ki khmat jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ban leit sha Siloam bad bta ïa ka khmat jong nga . Kumta nga la leit , bad tang mar ïa-bta khmat , nga la lah ban imat .

translation.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests , which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities , in every several city , the men that were expressed by name , to give portions to all the males among the priests , and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites .
translation.kha: Napdeng ki lyngdoh kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew u Aaron , lane ha ki jaka phlang kiba dei jong kine ki nongbah , la don ki rangbah ba kitkhia ban sam ïa ka jingbam sha ki shynrang baroh ha ka longïing ki lyngdoh bad sha uwei pa uwei uba don kyrteng ha ka kur ki Lebi .
Nangta u ong ha u Dabid Phi la leh ïa kaba dem , bad nga la leh bakla . phin la lehbha shikatdei eh ïa nga , katba nga pat to la leh haduh katne kaba sniew ïa phi !
translation.en: And he said to David , Thou art more righteous than I : for thou hast rewarded me good , whereas I have rewarded thee evil .

translation.kha: Ki kyrdoh jong ka nongbah kin plie baroh sei sngi ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lah , nabar yn ym don ka miet hangta .
translation.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .

translation.kha: U kyntait banbeiñ leh ïa kaba sniew bad um ju ai pisa kylliang ban ainong . U sumar ïa ki aiñ jong sa bad ïanguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Un ym ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong u kpa jong u , hynrei un im da shisha .
translation.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor , that hath not received usury nor increase , hath executed my judgments , hath walked in my statutes  ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father , he shall surely live .

translation.kha: Ki ai ka jingpynkylla da ka ktien dara ki batai ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban sngewthuh ïa ka .
translation.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .
Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;
translation.kha: ‘ Tei ïa ki ïing bad shongduh . Thaw ki kper bad bam ïa kaei kaba phi thung hangta .

Ngin shym thawsha ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nangroi khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki thlun shi lynter lynter shaduh ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kparad tymmen jong ki ?
translation.en: Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?
Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki myllung ki rwai ,  Wan sha Heshbon , sha ka nongbah u syiem Sihon ! Ngi kwah ïohi ba yn tei pat bad pynïeng biang ïa ka .
hynne u hynmen jongki ka Rebekka nabar ka kmienah jongki ka ki ïai-ong , Ai ba ka Rebekka kad Hukum shuwa nabar ngi shi tawah ne shiphew sngi , bad hadien kata ka lah ban leit .
translation.en: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten  ; after that she shall go .

translation.kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha Uei pa uwei umbiah wanrah isih , bad pham la kham long kumne ka nuti man la ka sngi .
translation.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .
And the  Lord  shall be seen over them , and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning : and the Lord  God  shall blow the trumpet , and shall go with whirlwinds of the south .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un mihpaw halor ki briew jong u ; un siat ïa ki khnam jong u kum ka leilieh . U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynsawa ïa ka turoi ; un ïaid ha ki  erïong na shathie .

Kine ki long kita ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phira ai burom ïa U Trai da kaweh ïalumlang pun Mano Blei dara kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , ïa ki jingkñia , bad ïa ki jingainguh dih , Leit la ka sngew kumba la buh .
translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :

translation.kha: Ka bynrap , U ong ïa to ba ngam dei ban wan phai thliew sha phi , kamut u ai ïa nga ïa une u barli baroh .
translation.en: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me  ; for he said to me , Go not empty unto thy mother in law .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba don hangamei ki la bitar bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingialeh iwbih ?
translation.en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?
And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban long nyngkong u dei ban buh khatduh eh ïa lade bad u dei ban long u shakri ïa baroh .
U la Ong ha ki , Bret ïa ka lade shang kamon jong ka lieng , bad phin sa ngut katto katne . Kumta ki la bret ïa ka jar nabar kdor lah tan shuh ïa ka , namar ba ki la ngat bun eh ki dohkha .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Cast the net on the right side of the ship , and ye shall find .  They cast therefore , and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes .
But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .
translation.kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang . U la leit sha uba kham san bad u la ong , ‘ Ko khun , khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ mynta ka sngi .’

translation.en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and , behold , the babe wept . And she had compassion on him , and said , This is one of the Hebrews  children .
translation.kha: Haba ka plied ïa ka , ka ïohi ïa u khunlung . Uta u khunlung u ïam , bad ka sngewsynei ïa u .  Une te u dei uwei na ki khun Hebru ,  ka la ong .
Ngin la nang leit Nangta , bad namar ba ka lyer ka beh pyrshah ïa ngi , ngi la ïaid sha ka liang ba kah lynter jong ka dewlynnong Sypros .
translation.en: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .

translation.kha: lada phi kohnguh ïa u bad phi sumar babiang baklang ïa kata baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phin mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day .

translation.kha: La to ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .
translation.en: And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .

Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka lyer ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u hukum ïa ka ba kan wan na baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha kine ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , khnang ban beh noh ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Manasseh u la leh ,

U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingkynthih baneh pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Hebru , ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , kthang ba uno uno ruh un ym dat u para jait Ishmael kumno u mraw .
translation.en: That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap dang step phyrngab ha ka Sniew U Trai , u la mihpaw nyngkong ha ka Mari ka nadong Magdala , na kaba u la pynmih noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki ksuid .
translation.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .

translation.kha: Ki syiem Philistia ki ïailong banbeiñ ïaleh sngewma bad ban ai ïa ka jingainguh kob khraw ïa u Dagon u blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai , U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop ïa u Samson u nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Joash ki ïaleit pyrshah ïa u , mala ar ngut na kine , u Josakar u khun jong u Shimeath Bad u Jehosabad u khun jong u Shomer , ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïing kaba u la tei halor ka khak ba la pyndap khñiot kaban shaphang mihngi jong ka Jeroboam , ha ka lynti kaba hiar sha Silla . Ïa u Joash la tep ha ka jingtip ki syiem ha ka nongbat u Abda , bad u khun jong u , u Amasaïah u long syiem ha ka iaka jong u .
translation.en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , smote him , and he died  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
And when the messengers were come in , behold , there was an image in the bed , with a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster .
translation.kha: Ki leit rung shapoh bad ki shem ïa kata ka bleithaw na ïing ha ka jingthiah bad ïa ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata .
Ka song u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baher ki ri naduh ka heh Ïuphratis haduh ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pun jingpeit . Ki la siew khajna ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u dang im .
translation.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .

translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka long hapdeng ka jingjot , badno ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pyntwa noh .
translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .

translation.kha: Ki ïap ibha ki dang samla , ki ring da ka jingim bajahburom
translation.en: They die in youth , and their life is among the unclean .
And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  , ye shall offer it at your own will .
translation.kha: Haba phi pynïap ïa u mrad ban pynlong ka jingainguh ïasyllok , bud beit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .

translation.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Nga phah ïa ki jingkhublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila , ki para nongtrei jong nga ha ka jingshakri ïa U Khrist Jisu ;
Bad phi lah baneh sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka to haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtong ba-bang prong shapoh ka ïohnang jong u .
translation.en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh  ;
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban khmih bha ïa u , bad lada ka don shisha ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ,
Ïa barabor kambah u la kynshew yn pynjot ; ka ding ïa kaba ym shym la pynmeh da ki ki briew ka thang ïa u bad ïa baroh ka longïng jong u .
translation.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him  ; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .

translation.kha: To leh sngewsih , to ïa-ïam , bad to ïamkthang ; to pynlong ïa ka jingrkhie ban kila shata ka jingïathmu , ka jingkmen sha ka jingsngewdiaw !
translation.en: Be afflicted , and mourn , and weep : let your laughter be turned to mourning , and your joy to heaviness .
For this our heart is faint  ; for these things our eyes are dim .
translation.kha: Ngi pang ha ka dohnud jong ngi hi bad ngim lah ban ïohi bha lyngba ki ummat jong ngi ,
Mynta , U Trai ha kane ka jingkhot u long U Mynsiem ; bad hangno haba U Mynsiem jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .
translation.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .

translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki nongpynkha khun ki sheptieng ïa U Blei , u jin u pynngam ïa ki , pynlang u ai ha ki ba kin kein la ki khup ki kti . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi sad ki nang khlong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
Be not overcome of evil , but overcome evil with good .
translation.kha: To wat ai ba ka jingsniew kan jop ïa phi ; pynban , to jop ïa kaba sniew da kaba bha .

translation.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .
translation.kha: Kumta te ki dieng baroh ki ong ha u dieng shiah , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’

translation.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you , even I Paul , once and again ; but Satan hindered us .
translation.kha: Ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat sha phi . Nga hi nga la pyrshang ban leit phai pat palat ïa ka shisien , hynrei u Soitan um ailad ïa ngi .

translation.en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )
translation.kha: ( Ïa u Barabbas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin kaba lah jia ha ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )
U paidbah baroh u la jubab , Ai ba ka jinglyngkhuit na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u kan hap halor jong ngi bad Halor ki khun jrong Ngi !
translation.en: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .

translation.kha: Hadien ka la kha ïakhun kynthei , ïa kaba ka la khop kyrteng ïa ka , ka Dinah .
translation.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter , and called her name Dinah .

translation.kha: Kum u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangtei , bad u Jeremoth ruh u pynshongkurim ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kaba la kha khun shynrang ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u ong ha u Abraham , Balei ka Sarah ka rkhie bad ong , ‘ Hato ngan dang ïoh khun shisha haba per la tymmen ?’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child , which am old ?

translation.kha: U saraw u kylli ïa u , Ko samla , me dei u khum jongno ? Nga dei u khun jong u shakri jong phi , u Jesse , uba na Bethlehem , U Dabid u jubab .
translation.en: And Saul said to him , Whose son art thou , thou young man ? And David answered , I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite .

translation.kha: Men long kaba leh-isynei sa shisien pat . Men ïuh ha ki kjat ïa ki pop jongnga ngi bad ñiat ïa ki shaei jong jong ka duriaw !
translation.en: He will turn again , he will have compassion upon us  ; he will subdue our iniquities  ; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea .

translation.kha: U Jisu u tang kren mynba ka kynhun ki briew ka la wan peh , ïa kaba la ïalam da u Joïada , uwei na ki khat ngut ki synrum . U la wan sha U Jisu ban doh ïa u .
translation.en: And while he yet spake , behold a multitude , and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve , went before them , and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him .
The mountains quake at him , and the hills melt , and the earth is burned at his presence , yea , the world , and all that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ; ki lumrit ki um noh ha khmat jong u . Ka pyrthei ka khih haba U  Trai  u mihpaw ; ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka baroh ki kyiuh .

translation.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ha ka phyllaw kaba shabar ka la don kawei ka kamra rit ba pynïasoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kaba shaphang shatei . Kane ka lam sha ka kamra rung kaba pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw bad hangta ki sait ïa ki metïap jong ki mrad ba la thang tylli kum ki jingkñia .
bad kun ym kut haduh ba un da kun ïa baroh kaba U thmu Ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew jong U kin sa sngewthuh shai ïa kane .
translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .

translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u , lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki kjap ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga ; bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa ph , ngan leit bad ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .

translation.kha: U sing u pynïap ïa ka jingjam jyllang u bad u ter ïa ka lyngkhot lynghoh na ka pyntwa ka sing jong u bad ki khun jong ka ; u la pyndap ïa ka krem jrong u da ka doh ba la patar .
translation.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps , and strangled for his lionesses , and filled his holes with prey , and his dens with ravin .

translation.kha: Ki nongtrei jongno u Solomon bad jong u Hiar lam bad ki rangbah na ka nongbah Biblos ki la pynkhreh ïa ki maw bad ïa ki diengkhap ban shen ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And Solomon s builders and Hiram s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .

translation.kha: Ïa la u kpa ruh u phah lam shipor tylli ki khi kiba kit ïa ki mar jingïap kiba ba tam , bad shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa u kew , u kpu bad kiwei pat ki jait jingbam ba u kpa jong u un ïohi bam ha lynti .
translation.en: And to his father he sent after this manner  ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .

I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngan ïaid hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi bad ban shim ïa baroh ki khunlangbrot baïong bad ïa ki khunblang baroh kiba thohbria bad thohbroin . Kata kan long ka bainong kaba nga kwah .
U ïada borabor ïa la ki briew bad u ai ïa ki ka jingsdang bad ka jingtip . Ka jingsngewnguh spah bakyrhuh tam lad ki ka un-long ka jingïambriew ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times , and strength of salvation : the fear of the  Lord  is his treasure .
Therefore , O ye shepherds , hear the word of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki nongsharai .

translation.en: That there should be no schism in the body ; but that the members should have the same care one for another .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ba yn ym don ka jingïapait ïapra ha kata ka met , hynrei baroh ki dkhot met kiba ïapher kin ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the  Lord  thy God hath cast them out from before thee , saying , For my righteousness the  Lord  hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  doth drive them out from before thee .
translation.kha: Wat ong ha la ka dohnud ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynher krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi , ka long namar ka hok jong ngi ba U  Trai  u la wan ïalam ïa ngi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .  Pynban ka long namar ka jingbymman kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u la beh krad ïa ki namar jong phi .
Lydia u brup ne ka briew ki mih prum ha ka khlieh ne ha ka tmoh , u lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa ka .
translation.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard  ;

translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u long u nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh jong u ki don Hangne lem bad ki turoi , ba la khreh Ban put ïa ki pynlang ban khot ïa im bad ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa phi . Ko paid Jeriel , wat ïaheh pyrshah ïa U Troas , U Blei jong ki kpa thymmai jong phi ! Phin ym jop !
translation.en: And , behold , God himself is with us for our captain , and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you . O children of Israel , fight ye not against the  Lord  God of your fathers  ; for ye shall not prosper .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah nabar Jerushah
translation.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night , the manna fell upon it .
translation.kha: Ka hap ha ka jaka shong dara mynmiet ryngkat bad ka umjer . Ha ka step kaba bud ki briew ki leit kylleng kylleng ban khar ïa ka , ki tylliat ïa ka lane dung pynni ïa ka , bad nangta ki shet bad pynlong kpu stang ïa ka . Ka jingmad ka long kum u kpu ba la shet ha ka umphniang Olib . )
Mar ïaskhem ha ka bor , u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba la pynïap ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him , that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .

translation.kha: U la pynim ha ki ïa u Joash u khum jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad u ai ha ki ïa kino ki hukum haba : Haba phi wan trei ha ka sngi Sabean , sia bynta na ka lai bynta na phi phna ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem ;
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king s house  ;

translation.kha: Nangta ine ki hynrei ngut ki angel kiba Don me ki hynñiew tyllep ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ban put ïa ki .
translation.en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .

And I went up by revelation , and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately to them which were of reputation , lest by any means I should run , or had run , in vain .
translation.kha: Nga la leit namar U Blei u la pynpaw ha nga ba nga dei ban leit . Ha ka jingïakynduh bajar jar bad ki nongïalam , nga la batai ïa ka khubor ka Gospel ïa kaba nga ïalap ha ki Jentil . Ngam shym la kwah ba ka jingtrei jong nga kaba mynshuwa bad kaba mynta kin shu sep-ei .

translation.en: And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .
translation.kha: Ha ka balang , U Blei u la buh ïa baroh ha la ka bynta : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba lai ïa ki nonghikai ; nangta ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kambah , bud sa kito ha kiba la ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah lane ban ïarap ïa kiwei lane ban pyn-i lem lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .

Adam rah bad me ïa ka ksiang bad ka rupa na ka boitha ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongñiah jingman jongno nga , ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka templ jongki u ka don ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
I rose up to open to my beloved  ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phi ka long kum ki khiat , ki ar tylli ki skei synrap kiba bam jingbam hapdeng ki  tiew lili .
U Ïoannis um khim la kyntait ba-bang jubab , isynei , u la kren ha kaba paw malade da kaba shai , u da ong , Ngam dien u Messaïah .
translation.en: And he confessed , and denied not  ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .

translation.kha: A me u bieit! Haba me bet ïa u rymbai ha ka khyndew , um ha ban shylluit lymda u ïap noh .
translation.en: Thou fool , that which thou sowest is not quickened , except it die :

translation.kha: U Tlai u ong ha u Joshua , Ïasam lang bad me ïa ki shipai baroh bad lytar kiew sha Ai . Wat sheptieng lane khie . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ïa u syiem ka Ai ; ki briew jongki u , ka nongbah jong u , bad ka ri kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :

translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri , malu ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .
translation.en: But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves .

translation.kha: Namar kim lah ba shah ïa kaei kaban U Blei u la hukum kaba ong , Wat lapbah u mrad un ktah ïa uta u lum , yn lynthem mawleiñ ïa u ïaheh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: ( For they could not endure that which was commanded , And if so much as a beast touch the mountain , it shall be stoned , or thrust through with a dart :

translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ine ka long ban leh ïa kaba dei , ym tang ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ha khmat u briew ruh .
translation.en: Providing for honest things , not only in the sight of the Lord , but also in the sight of men .

translation.kha: U Abraham u pynpyut ha u Issakhar ïa ki dieng na ka pyntwa ka jingkñia , bad ma u pat u rah ïa ka ther bad ïa ki rnga barhem ban sliew ting . katba baroh ar ngut ki dang ïa-ïaid ,
translation.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering , and laid it upon Isaac his son  ; and he took the fire in his hand , and a knife  ; and they went both of them together .

translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba pynshitom ïa uba shah pynrem , kin manbha bad kin ïoh ka nam babha .
translation.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them .

translation.kha: Na un-long u nongshun jong pha ! ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh . Ngan thang ïa ki kada ïapom jong pha . Ïa ki shipai jong pha yn pynnep ha ka tdem , bad ngan shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la shim na kiwei . Ïa ka jingdawa jong ki nongkren jong pha yn ym ïohsngew shuh .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword shall devour thy young lions : and I will cut off thy prey from the earth , and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard .
Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house  ; and she shall shave her head , and pare her nails  ;
translation.kha: ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi , bad hangta kan khi ïa la ka khlieh , kan ot ïa la ki tyrsim ,
Kumno phi wan ?
translation.en: How did you come ?

translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u Dang ïaid sha shiliang ha ka khyndew kaba ksing , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka jutang U Trai ki Ïeng ha ka jingryngkhiang hapdeng jyllang ka Jordan tad haduh ba uta u paidbah un da jem shwa arliang .
translation.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .
Woe to the bloody city ! it is all full of lies and robbery  ; the prey departeth not  ;
translation.kha: Long kaba la tim ka nongbah kaba pynïap bad kaba lamler , kaba dap da ka spah ban shah lute bad shah kurup !
U la ïalam ruh ïa la ki briew bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , bad ki la shongduh ha ki nongrit Sawdong ïa ka Hebron .
translation.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up , every man with his household : and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron .
He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
translation.kha: U la buh ka por kaba dei ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ai ha ngi ka jingkwah ban tip ïa ka lawei , hynrei um ju ai ha ngi ka jinghun ban sngewthuh lut ïa kaei kaba u leh .
kumta hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Dan ki mih na Sorah bad Ithlah kiba la khreh ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites , out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol , six hundred men appointed with weapons of war .
And said unto him , Hearest thou what these say ? And Jesus saith unto them ,  Yea  ; have ye never read , Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Me ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki ong ?   Ho-oid nga ïohsngew ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Phim pat la ju pule ïa kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ? ‘ Me la hikai ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ban ai ki jingïaroh bajanai .’
Ki briew kiba thaw jingriam ïa kiwei! pat kin ngat ïa lade . Ki briew Kiba sdang pynhap khyndew ki shahshkor ban ïa lade .
translation.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein : and he that rolleth a stone , it will return upon him .

translation.kha: Phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki tarajur , ba la bud da ka jingput ïa ki tangmuri , ki jingtem kseh , ki myrsiang , bad ki duitara ; bad nangta sa Baroh kiwei! paw ki tiar put tiar ting kin ïasoh lang . Tang mai ïasdang ka jingdup jingtem , phi dei ban im ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksing kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up :
For from within , out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , fornications , murders ,
translation.kha: Naba na shapoh , na ka dohnud u briew , ki wan ki jingmut basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban leh ki kam awria , ban lute , ban pynïap ,
Ngin da siewdor ïa ka jingbam ba im bam bad ïa ka um ba ngi dih . Kaba ngi kwah ka Long tang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong phin ,
translation.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money , that I may eat  ; and give me water for money , that I may drink : only I will pass through on my feet  ;

translation.kha: Neng pyrsad da ka Mynsiem jong nga ha ki , bad keiñ im biang , bad ngan sa shah ïa ki ba im ha ka ri jong ki hi . Te ngin sa tip ba nga long U Trai . Nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan kun . Ma nga , U Trai’ , nga la kren .
translation.en: And shall put my spirit in you , and ye shall live , and I shall place you in your own land : then shall ye know that I the  Lord  have spoken it , and performed it , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko Judah , pha la wallam ïa kane halor latai da ka rukom kaba pha la im bad da kiei kiei kiba pha la har . Ka pop jong pha ka la pynjia ïa kano ka jingjynjar ; ka la dung ïa phai lyngraw ka dohnud .
translation.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee  ; this is thy wickedness , because it is bitter , because it reacheth unto thine heart .

translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ; wat lyngdoh ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ Jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha Phin mandriek ka sngi .
translation.en: Beware that thou forget not the  Lord  thy God , in not keeping his commandments , and his judgments , and his statutes , which I command thee this day :

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit Kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ai kumne ka jinganna ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , mynba U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham . U Abraham u la long uta ïa uba U Bel u la ïatei kular , la mawria ruh u longsem la kloi ba ai ïa la u khun marwei kumto ka jingkñia .
translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried , offered up Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,

translation.kha: ki nongshun basniew tam jyllang u briew kin dei ki dkhot jong ka longïing jyllang u hi .
translation.en: And a man s foes shall be they of his own household .
And David came to Saul , and stood before him : and he loved him greatly  ; and he became his armourbearer .
translation.kha: U Dabid u wan sha u Saul bad u rung kam noh bad u . U Saul u sngewbha eh ïa u bad u jied ïa u kum u nongrah atiar jong u .
dieng step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba u longing phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la thngan .
translation.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
The glasses , and the fine linen , and the hoods , and the veils .
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ bastang jong ki , ki rumal linen jong ki , bad ïa ki jaiñ teh ryndang bad ki jaiñtapkhmat kiba jrong kiba ki tap ha ki khlieh jong ki .

translation.en: And Hilkiah , and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath , the son of Hasrah , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college : ) and they spake to her to that effect .
translation.kha: Kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem , u Hilkaïah bad kiwei ki leit ïasyllok bad ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa kaba sah ha ki bynta ba kham thymmai jong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u khun ksiew jong u Harhas , ki long kiba sumar ïa ki jaiñkup ha ka Templ . )
Kumne nga la siew khanatang lyngkhot ka rupa bad shispah sanphew kilo u barli ban thret ïa ka .
translation.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :

translation.kha: Ynda la ïatip u Aaron , ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh jngai u dei ban aiti ha ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin phong ha ka por ba Pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons  after him , to be anointed therein , and to be consecrated in them .

translation.kha: Ki bri kin kyllon kum ki phasi kyrteng khlei bad ki masi lyngkhot , bad ka khyndew kan shoh da ka snam bad yn tap da ka khleiñ .
translation.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them , and the bullocks with the bulls  ; and their land shall be soaked with blood , and their dust made fat with fatness .

translation.kha: trai ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndem , hynñiew um sngap ïa ki . Na dei u Jiw , u batai , bad ngam lah banbeiñ dem ha u Haman . Kumjuh ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Hanan , bad ki pyrkhat la un la baneh shiah ïa khnai ka jingleh u Mordekai .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kaba nga don ba ngan ïai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam don ka jingkyrmen ?
Te men khot , bad ngan jubab , mala men shem sngewbha ïa nga , u jingthang jngai me .
translation.en: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee : thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .

translation.kha: Ym don dieng Kedar ha ka kper U Bela uba lah ba-bang ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju don kum ngi ki tnat , bad ym don u diengsoh ha madan uba kein kum kita ki tnat , ym don u dieng ha ka kpu jong U Bela uba itynnat katta katta .
translation.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .
And he called Gehazi , and said , Call this Shunammite . So he called her . And when she was come in unto him , he said , Take up thy son .
translation.kha: U Elisha u khot ïa u Gehasi , bad u ong ïa u ban khot ïa ka kmie jong u khynnah . Haba ka la wan shapoh , u ong ha ka ,  Une u khun jong phi .

translation.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , Had Zimri peace , who slew his master ?
translation.kha: Katba u Jehu u dang rung lyngba ka khyrdop , ka la pyrta ,  Me u Simri ! Me u nongpynïap briew ! Balei me wan hangne ?

Ngan pynmutlop ïa u , bad un sa wan thwet nongthain jong phi ; bad kumta ka jingjop jong de ïa u Pharaoh bad ka kynhun swai jong u kan long ka burom ïa nga . Te ki nongai Ijipt Kin sa kop ba per Long U Troas . Ki Israel ki leh kitab la hukum ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will harden Pharaoh s heart , that he shall follow after them  ; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host  ; that the Egyptians may know that I am the  Lord . And they did so .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka Nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusha .
translation.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki slipar ki beh kyrthep na ki liang baroh bad ki shoh ïa ka sla ka duriaw-bah .
translation.en: Daniel spake and said , I saw in my vision by night , and , behold , the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea .

translation.kha: To thaw ki jingpynkhreh jong phi ! Jamynrei kin ym urlong . To kren ïa baroh kaba phi kiaw ! Hynrei baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi , namarba U Blei u long lem badno ngi .
translation.en: Take counsel together , and it shall come to nought  ; speak the word , and it shall not stand : for God is with us .

translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u ïor ïa u Bethmeon u lai jong u , u ong , un seh u para khatduh jong phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa Phi , khun .
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .

translation.kha: bad ki bakla shaphang ka jingbishar , namar ba ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei la lah bishar .
translation.en: Of judgment , because the prince of this world is judged .
And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shadem jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kum ki jingïada shadem da ka nar , bad ka jingsawa kaba mih na ki thapniang jong ki ka long kum ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai thma babun kiba leit tur sha ka thma .

Nangta u dem halor jong u khynnah , u da buh ïa la ka shyntur , ki khamtam , bad ki ktien halor ka shijur , ki iitkhmat bad ki kti jong u khynnah . Katto u dang dem halor u khynnah , ka met jong u khynnah ka sdang ban syiad .
translation.en: And he went up , and lay upon the child , and put his mouth upon his mouth , and his eyes upon his eyes , and his hands upon his hands : and he stretched himself upon the child  ; and the flesh of the child waxed warm .

translation.kha: Katba u Joshua u dang im , ki paid Israel ki shakri ïa U thri , bad wat hadien ka jingïap jongnga u ki ïai leh kumta katba dong im ki nongïalam kiba la ïohi da lade ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Trai u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And the people served the  Lord  all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua , who had seen all the great works of the  Lord  , that he did for Israel .

translation.kha: Ki jinglong jong ka pyrta ki pynshisha ba ka Heman Jong U Blei ka la jat .
translation.en: World conditions confirm that God’s Kingdom will soon come .

translation.kha: Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad san ? Hato ka ym ïapstai haba ka lynter mihngi ka shoh ïa ka ? Haseroth kan ym ïapstai hangta ha kaba ka san ?
translation.en: Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .

translation.kha: ha kaba u Balak u la pynïap ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad u phah rah de katto katne ka doh sha u Baalah badno kita ki nongïalam kiba ïan lem pynlang u .
translation.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him .

translation.kha: Nangta na la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba blei , bad la don u kloi Uba lieh . Ïa u nongshukor ha u la khot Uba Aïah bad Buh Shisha ; ka long da ka jinglehhok ba u bishar bad u ïaleh ïa ki Jingïaleh thma jong u .
translation.en: And I saw heaven opened , and behold a white horse  ; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True , and in righteousness he doth judge and make war .

translation.kha: Ha ki snem 1870 , kawei ka kynhun barit ka la sdang ban pluh ïa ka Gebal bad ki la shem biang ïa ka jingsuki jong ka Baibl .
translation.en: In the 1870’s a small group of Bible students began rediscovering long-lost Bible truths .

translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba hynne la ai ha ki longïing na ka jaiñjot Napdeng .
translation.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .

translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi im ha U Blei bad ba u im hapoh jong ngi , namar ba u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u .
translation.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him , and he in us , because he hath given us of his Spirit .
They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .
translation.kha: Ki kren ki ktien bym don jingmut bad pynlong ki jingkular lamler bad ki jingïateh kular bymlarkam . Ka hok ka kylla long bymhok , ka nang san kum ki ñiut ba long bih ha ka lyngkha ba la dep lur .
Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin leh pop , namar ngim long hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei ? Ym kumta!
translation.en: What then ? shall we sin , because we are not under the law , but under grace ? God forbid .

translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki bhabriew basbun ki bym bur ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
translation.kha: Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?

translation.en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses , every man according to his service , the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings , to minister , and to give thanks , and to praise in the gates of the tents of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u pynskhem biang ïa ka kynhun ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , hapoh jong kata uwei pa uwei u don la ka jong ka jong ka kamram . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok , kaba shim bynta ha ka jingmane ha ka templ , bad kaba ai ïa ka jingïaroh bad jingainguh ha ki bynta bapher jong ka Templ .
Phi eh ban wait rah ïa ka sha i pa jong phi ba in bam bad in sa ai ïa phi ka jingkyrkhu jong i shuwa ba in ïaphah .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la mih shabar bun pynïap ïa u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka jingsynshar kaba pura! .
translation.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .

Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah , even the king s daughters , and all the people that remained in Mizpah , whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive , and departed to go over to the Ammonites .
translation.kha: Nangta u la pynlong koidi ïa ki khun kynthei u syiem bad ïa ki briew baroh ha Mispah kiba dang sah ïa kiba u Nebusaradan u rangbah shipai u la iehnoh ha ka jingpeit u Gedalaïah . U Ishmael u la shim ïa ki kum ki koidi bad u la leit ha ka phang jong ka ri ki Ammon .
Dang step phyrngab u nongpynim briew u khie bad u mih ban sien pynsep ïa uba duk , sad mynmiet u tad .
translation.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .

And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u khun jong me ,  U Blei u ong ,  u Isaak , u khun ba tang marwei jong me , ïa uba me ieit thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . Hangta halor u lum ïa uba ngan sa pyn-i ha me , kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh ha nga .

translation.en: And his return was to Ramah  ; for there was his house  ; and there he judged Israel  ; and there he built an altar unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u ju leit pat sa sha la ïing ha Ramah , hangta ruh u ju shakri kum u nongbishar . Ha Ramah u la tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  hangta .
mynba ka sngi nga ai ba phin jied napdeng kaba bha bad kaweh sniew , napdeng ka jingrem dara ka jingïapan .
translation.en: See , I have set before thee this day life and good , and death and evil  ;

translation.kha: Hynñiew , kumba u Elijah u la lah ong , Enam kata ka por ha ka snieh kaweh bud ka la kha khun shynrang .
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .
And they were scattered , because there is no shepherd : and they became meat to all the beasts of the field , when they were scattered .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki langbrot kim don u nongsharai , ki la sakma noh , bad ki mradkhlaw ki pynïap bad bam ïa ki .

translation.en: And the ass saw me , and turned from me these three times : unless she had turned from me , surely now also I had slain thee , and saved her alive .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kada jong me ka la ïohi bad kiar ïa nga lai sien . Lada kam shym la leh kumta , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa me bad pyllait im ïa ka kada .
U Obadaïah u la jop , Kaei kaba ar la leh ba phi kwah pun buh ïa nga ha ka jingma jong ka jingshah pynïap noh ha u syiem Ahab ?
translation.en: And he said , What have I sinned , that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab , to slay me ?
Hungry and thirsty , their soul fainted in them .
translation.kha: Ki la thngan bad sliang bad ki la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand  ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .
translation.kha: Hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam Israel ki don hangta , kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Shaphan . Uwei pa uwei u bat ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih , bad ka tdem ka dang kiew na ka jingiwbih .

Ki pynpei la ki thapniang bad kiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba to tdong peit ïa ki , bad ki shitrhem ki bud nur-um ïa ki . Ki ïasangeh shiphang ha ka phalor kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ka shong halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .

translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai u la ong , ‘ Ki kba tymmen jongno phi ki la phai dei napoh na nga bad ki la myn bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad kdor shym nongshong ïa ki jinghikai jong nga .
translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Because your fathers have forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , and have walked after other gods , and have served them , and have worshipped them , and have forsaken me , and have not kept my law  ;
And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïathuh ha u ïa kane ka khana :  Bah , ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , namar ngi la ïohsngew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha Ijipt

translation.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .
translation.kha: Um sheptieng haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jong u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u shaniah ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u kum u briew ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka kti kamon jong u halor jong nga bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh .

translation.en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
translation.kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad u la tip aïu U Blei u la kular ïa u : U Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .
Ki jingtim kim lah ban pynïashong ïa Phin lait tang hajan phi dei hok ban ïoh ïa ki . Ki long Kum ki sim kiba her sad ki bym ju shongneh .
translation.en: As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .

translation.en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all : the king himself is served by the field .

translation.en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Martha ka la nguh ïa kane , ka la leit noh bad ka la ïakhot jar jam ïa ka Mei ka para jong ka , U Nonghikai u don hangne , ka la ïathuh ïa ka , bad u phah khoit ïa pha .
translation.en: And when she had so said , she went her way , and called Mary her sister secretly , saying , The Master is come , and calleth for thee .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , khmied ïa ka Jerusalem . Nga buh ïa ka hapdeng ka pyrthei , bad kiwei pat ki ri sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This is Jerusalem : I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her .

translation.kha: Kwah na ki ka ong , Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , bad nga la kha ïakhun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka pajut ka don lang .
translation.en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .
Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Shim ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah bad u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïing jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .

U praw ïa ki baneh Wanlam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiem . Ka mahadei ka long ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiem u kwah ban pyn-i sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ka ha ki Rangbah synshar bad ha baïar kiba u la khat sngewbha .
translation.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga shakri kum u lyngdoh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei , khnang ba ki Jentil ki lah ban long ka jingkñia ba la pdiang sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang sha u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .
translation.kha: ka lyer mihngi kan sar ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki ;
Hynrei wat haba ki khie balung bad ki phuh syntiew ha ka step ba pha thung ïa ki , yn ym don kano Kanah ka jingkit . Yn don tang ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang ka bym lah pynkoit .
translation.en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow , and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish : but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Jedaïah bad ka Jerusalem yn pyllait im bad kin im pynpdang ka jingshngain . Ïa ka nongbah yn Khot ‘ U Trai ka jingpynïap jong ngi .’
translation.en: In those days shall Judah be saved , and Jerusalem shall dwell safely : and this is the name wherewith she shall be called , The  Lord  our righteousness .

translation.kha: Kine ki kamra ap pyrsa ha baïar jingsliang ka jaka ïaid ki un-long baroh katjuh ka jingtah ; bad ki kynroh baroh arliang kat ka jingrben .
translation.en: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side , and three on that side  ; they three were of one measure : and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side .

translation.kha: Wat buhnud ïaduna ïano , hynrei ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïapan jingat hapdeng jong phi , khnang ba yn ym pynleh pop ïa phi namar jyllang u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart : thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour , and not suffer sin upon him .

translation.kha: Sin nangta ki Israel ki duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai : Ma me , Ko Trai , tang ma me hi mawleiñ me long U Trai ; me thaw ïa ki bneng bad ki khlur jong ka sahit bneng . Me thaw ïa ka ryngkhiang pynlang ïa ka duriaw bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingim ïa baroh . Ki bor ha bneng ki dem bad ki mano ïa me .
translation.en: Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jngai u sha u Iso u hynriew jongu u ha ri Edom .
translation.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .

translation.kha: kamut ki bani Isaia ki ïakhih pyrshah , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang jong ki briew kiba shong shongneh ha ka ri Judah .
translation.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .

And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira lai tylli baroh arliang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynroh hapdeng jong ki , bad ka kamra rung baroh ki la don ki jingthew kiba katjuh kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Ka khyrdop baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw kiba pynsaja ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Ki Israel ki tei ïa ki nongbah Pithom bad Rameses ba kin long ki jaka kynshew jingbam u Pharaoh .
Kumta u Herod u la kylli ïa U Jisu shibun ki jingïatylli , hynrei U Jisu um shym jubab ei ei .
translation.en: Then he questioned with him in many words  ; but he answered him nothing .

translation.kha: Ha ka katei Heber “Gilead” ka ñiut “ Sakhi ba Kynton .”
translation.en: In Hebrew , “Gilead” means “Witness Pile .”

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u —Joshua , ki paid Israel ki kylluid ïa U Trai , mynno na ki jahthait jong ngi kaba daiñ ban leit iing ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan ?
translation.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?

translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pham ïaleh pyrthuh ïa nga , bad pha la shad rit ha ka jingriam naba nga la buh ïa pha , wat la phad shym la tip ïa ka .
translation.en: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha ki ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan ryngkat bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?
Katno uba khraw u long U Trai ! U synshar halor kiei kiei baroh . Un pynbud ïa ka Jerusalem da ka jinglehhok Bad ka jinglong ba-beit bad pynlong ka jingskhem ha ka hamsaïa .
translation.en: The  Lord  is exalted  ; for he dwelleth on high : he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness .

translation.kha: Nangta uta u rangbah ai hukum u la thoiñ ïa ka shithi kumne :
translation.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner :

translation.kha: Ngi lah , ki la jubab . U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Da shisha phira sa dih na ka khuri kabu nga dei ban tiduh bad ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba dei ban pynbaptis ïa nga .
translation.en: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them ,  Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of  ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :

translation.kha: U tip kumno ban trei ïa ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .
translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .
And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there  ; for that was the great high place : a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka khep u la leit sha Gibeon ban ai jingkñia namar kata kaba don hangta ka long ka duwan kaba donnam tam . U la ai da ki spah tylli ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka por ba la leit .

U Trai u ong , Kumba u nongaplangbrot u shem patiaw sa tang ar tylli ki kjat , ne ka shkor jong ka langbrot ba u sing u la bam , kumne ruh yn pyllait im tang kyndiang ïa ki briew ka Samaria , uba mynta ki shong shaniah ha ki jingthiah baremdor .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs , or a piece of an ear  ; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed , and in Damascus in a couch .

translation.kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bniah , iwei pa uwei u pynrangbah un jied ïa u langbrot lane ïa u khunblang na ka bniat la ka jong ka ïing .
translation.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :

translation.kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot wahbah ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Olib , badno ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U Trai , malu ka jingiwbih jongnga ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .
translation.kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u wan kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïapom jong u ki long kum ka  erlangthari , bad ki kulai jong u ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni . Ngi la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !
Ym don uba khuid kum U Tlai ; ym don uba kum ma u , ym don nongïada uba kum U Blang jong ngi .
translation.en: There is none holy as the  Lord  : for there is none beside thee : neither is there any rock like our God .

translation.kha: mynta , ïeng babit hangno , badno hangne ha khmat U Trai ngan mudui byrsha ïa pa’ da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang ki kam kiba khraw ba U Trai u la leh ban pyllait ïa phiah bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong Phin .
translation.en: Now therefore stand still , that I may reason with you before the  Lord  of all the righteous acts of the  Lord  , which he did to you and to your fathers .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga hap ban lai ?
translation.en: What should I do ?

translation.kha: Kino ki miej kin pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la leh . Hadien habud , hir ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,
translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?

translation.kha: Die noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jongu phi baroh bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk . Pynban ïa lade ki pla kynshew ki ïa-ban ym jot noh , badno kynshew ïa ka spah jong phi ha pdeng , ha kaba kan ym duna , namar ba ym don u nongtong kiba ia ban ïoh ïa ka , sad ym kein khñiang ba lah ban pynjot ïa ka .
translation.en: Sell that ye have , and give alms  ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingai kiba kham donkam . Pynban , kaba bha tam ka long ka rukom kaba bud nangne .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
translation.kha: Ïa ki them kiba seisoh jong ka Judah la pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki da ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Let a man so account of us , as of the ministers of Christ , and stewards of the mysteries of God .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pyrkhat ïa ngi kum ki shakri U Khrist , ïa kiba la buh ban sumar ïa ki jingshisha barieh jong U Blei .

Ha ka sngew nyngkong jong ka Jingïohipaw Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaba la pynpyut ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synran U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u , Hangno me khwai ïa ngi ban leit dara ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Amam Ka Jinglait ?
translation.en: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki ar ngut ki lapbah pynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jngai ki la pynïap da ka tyngkan na bneng ; ishyrkhei sngewbha isynei ïa por !
translation.en: Behold , there came fire down from heaven , and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties : therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight .
And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .
translation.kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang ban ïakren shaphang kane ,  Aïu kane ‘ kaba mihpat na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?

translation.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe ka long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong ngi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .’
U syiem u trei bad ka iktiar , bad ym don uba ha ngab pyrshah ïa kaei ba u leh .
translation.en: Where the word of a king is , there is power : and who may say unto him , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: Shuwa ban smat ïa ka jingpynbaptis lai kham bha lada peiñ sa kawei de ka kot ba la pynmih da ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .
translation.en: A study of What Does the Bible Really Teach ? or a similar book published by Jehovah’s Witnesses is recommended in preparation for baptism .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga la ïambriew haduh lai taïew .
translation.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks .

translation.kha: U Mushi bad u Hosea u khun jong u nong ki ïathiah ïa ki ktem jong kane ka jingrwai , ba ki Jeriel kin sngewkwah ïa ka .
translation.en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he , and Hoshea the son of Nun .

translation.kha: U briew uba ibha un ïohi jingkyrkhu . Ki ki u riewshemphang ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .
translation.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
And said , O sir , we came indeed down at the first time to buy food :
translation.kha: Kynrad ngi la wan shane shisien ban thied jingbam .

translation.en: Watch therefore , for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  To sumar bha , te , namar ba phim tip ïa ka sngi lane ïa ka kynta .
U briew u lah ban ïohpateng ïa ka ïing bad ka shab na la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei thrang U Trai uba lah ban ai ha u ïa ka tnga kaba jingshemphang .
translation.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
