translation.kha: U Makhir u jubab , Ang ïohi ïa ka kynthup shipai Israel ba la pynkmen halor ki lum kum ïa ki khunlangbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U Trai u ïai-ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah Ki don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïng ha ka jingsuk .’
translation.en: Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .

translation.kha: Ka Shim ki bneng ka long kumne . U brisoh ryngkhat u shet ïa ka jingkynshew ba la buhrieh hapoh ka lyngkha . U tap pateng ïa ka , bad u kmen khah katta katta ba u leit Bad die ïa kiew kiei borbah kiba u la don , malu Nangta u leit pat bad thiah ïa kata ka lyngkha .
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field  ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .

translation.kha: To praw noh bad nga nabar wat sheptieng . U Suah u kwah ban pynïap ïa phi bad ïa nga , hynne phin lehse na ka jingma bad nga .
translation.en: Abide thou with me , fear not : for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life : but with me thou shalt be in safeguard .

translation.kha: Ïa nga pajut yn pyndap da ka jingtim namar ka Jerusha bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don shuh ka jingïam , yn ym don shuh ki ban kut kyrpad ngab ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .

My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem , kaei kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long ka bym dei . Ki la thep ïa u Jeremaïah ha ka pung , ha kaba , da shisha , un sa ïap ha ka jingïapthngan , namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them : but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them .
translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba beit , la ïalam ïa phi da ka jinglonghok . Ïa ki briew kiba ym lah ban shaniah la pynjot da ka jingbymhok jong ki hi .

Ka them baroh kawei , ha katba la tep ïa kiba ïap bad ha kaba la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntha shang ka wah khyrdong haduh ka Khyrdop Kulai shaphang mihngi , kin long kaba kynha ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpra shuh lane shah pynjot .
translation.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .
And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ka khubor shaphang kine kiei kiei ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri lum Judia .

Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lema bad ki ut ibha kit ki jingibieit , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingtylli baroh kat kiba ka lai baneh pyrkhat .
translation.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .
translation.kha: Nangta , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh ne phi ong , dei ban leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba phi ainguh da u ïa U Blei uba U Kpa .
Naba ka pop ka sieb ïa la ka bainong — ka jingïarap ; hynrei ka jingaiei jong U Blei ka long ka jingshem bymjukut ha U Khrist Jisu suba U Trai jong moi .
translation.en: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .

And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .
translation.kha: Ka la ïam shaphang kata ha baroh kita ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u ïathuh ha ka , ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip , naba ka ïai thlia ïa u katta katta . Nangta ka ïathuh pat ha kita ki Philistia .
U Jisu u la phai sawdong malu u la ïohi ïa ki briew bariewspah ba ki thep ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki ha ka jingkynshew ka Templ ,
translation.en: And he looked up , and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury .
Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ki briew jong U Blei , phin long kiba kmen bad phin rwai kumba phi leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin long kiba kmen kum kito kiba ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U  Trai  , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .
Sha ino ‘ Ho-oid’ lane ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pat kaweh phi ong ka wan na Uta uba Sniew .
translation.en: But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
translation.kha: Pynban ki la long kiba bha shikatdei ïa ngi ; kim ju pynthut ïa ngi , bad ha ki por baroh ba ngi don bad ki ha ki lyngkha , ym shym don kano kano ruh kaba dei ka jong ngi kaba la shah tuh .
Hiar ki dieng ba don hajan , ki Da ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki bad ki rwai .
translation.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
But the judgment shall sit , and they shall take away his dominion , to consume and to destroy it unto the end .
translation.kha: Nangta ka ïingbishar ba kynja bneng kan shong bishar , kan knieh noh ïa ka bor jong u bad pynjot thiaw ïa u .
Kaba kan long ka dak jong Kata ka jutang jong nga bad ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .

translation.kha: U la jubab , U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa por u la ong ha per ba ngan rah ïa ka jingïateh bad ban ïaid .
translation.en: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la nong , Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew Ibbah nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh’ kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki antad Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kiba nga la ai ha u sharai jong nga u Jakob .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .

translation.kha: katba ki ïadait ha ka mon U Blei . Ki leh ïa barieh kaba U Balei u hukum , hangno hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun jong ki nongtei mon sngewma ki leit na kamai ka balang sha kawei pat ha kajuh ka ri , wat shaei ki kajuh ba kyndong , ban ïarap tei ïa ki ïng Hiram jong ki .
translation.en: Teams of construction servants and volunteers move from one congregation to the next within a country , even in remote areas , assisting the local congregations with the construction of their Kingdom Halls .

translation.kha: Haba ki Syria na Damaskos ki la phah ka kynhun swai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Dabid u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .

translation.kha: U la ar pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , namar hadien ka jingpynïap u kput jongu u kiwei pat ki dkhot jong ka longïing u syiem Ahab ki la long ki nong jingmad ïa u , bad ki la pynphong ïa ka jingïalong noh jong u .
translation.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem kim lah ban ngeit ïa kan , namar ki jingïateh lap kiba ki la pynlong . Khynñiuh khie ka jingïathuhlypa ka long ban pynkyiuh ïa ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ban maham ïa ki ba kin sa shahskhor dup .
translation.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ki kyrhuh khim ki sing kiba la pynïap ïa ka mrad bad kiba la rong ïa ka sha ka jaka ha kaweh ym don ba lah ba-bang knieh ïa ka na ki .
translation.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion , they shall roar like young lions : yea , they shall roar , and lay hold of the prey , and shall carry it away safe , and none shall deliver it .

translation.kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïong U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan lytar ban pynkhraw ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïathuh ïa phi Ladan kam long kumta .
translation.en: In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .

translation.kha: U angel uba lai u la buiñ ïa ki ar ngut ki angel kiba sha iitkhmat , da kaba kren ha ka per kaba jam , une uno u mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad pdiang ïa ka spah ha ka shyllangmat jong u lane ha ka kti jong u ,
translation.en: And the third angel followed them , saying with a loud voice , If any man worship the beast and his image , and receive his mark in his forehead , or in his hand ,
Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ko phi kiba hok baroh to lehkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba khuid u la leh , bad to ainguh ïa u .

ka um ka Seneh ban tuid bad ka lang shi jaka , kham jngai na kaba wan tuid ha Adam , ka nongbah hajan ka Sarethan . Ïa ka jingtuid jong ka bret shata ka Duriaw Baïap la pyndkut , bad u paidbah u la lah ban jam sha shiliang hajan ka Jerikho .
translation.en: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam , that is beside Zarethan : and those that came down toward the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , failed , and were cut off : and the people passed over right against Jericho .

translation.kha: Ynda ka por pynkdor ïa ka , ka la Kuth , la ka Long na ka bynta u khur ne ka khun , ka dei ban wallam sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai ïa u khunlangbrot umbiah shisnem kum ka jingainguh thang Bad ïa ka lyngdkhur ne ka paro khim ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translation.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :

translation.kha: Kuth , man ka sngi , naduh dang step phyrngab haduh ka por ba la mih ki khlur mynmiet , shiteng na ngi , I trei ha ka kynroh , katba shiteng kiwei pat , ki ïeng ap phira bad ki sum .
translation.en: So we laboured in the work : and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared .
Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .
translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la ïaid lyngba kane ka ïingjaiñ bad rung tang shisien shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam , um shym la shim ïa ka snam ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jong ka snam , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: Why sayest thou , O Jacob , and speakest , O Israel , My way is hid from the  Lord  , and my judgment is passed over from my God ?
translation.kha: Ko Israel , balei te ba me mudui ba U  Trai  um tip ïa ki jingjynjar jong me lane ïa ki jingkhuslai lada me shahshitom bymdei ?

Nangta ki ïaid lyngngoh ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïadie tawiar ïa ka ri Edom sad ka ri mawbah haduh ba kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi Jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki Sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym khem ïa ka Arnon namar u dei u pud ki Joab .
translation.en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .
translation.kha: Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh ; hato men sangeh noh mynta , ne men jubab ?

Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lebi , kat kum ki tam pynlang ki longïing , nabar ïa uwei pa uwei na ki la buh jingïathuh da ka kyrngah . Uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew , uba arphew snem ka rta ne tam , u ieh ka bna ha ka kam ha ka Templ jong U Trai .
translation.en: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers  ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the  Lord  , from the age of twenty years and upward .

translation.kha: Hynrei u ita u jubab , Ko Syiem kynroh , nga smai ha phi ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba Ngan ïai leit bad phi kat shaba phi leit , wat la ka dei ban ïap .
translation.en: And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .

translation.kha: Nangta ki ithuh shad ka jaka ba la khot Ki Pukri , ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Lymne ïa ki briew , bad ngan ai um ïa ki .
translation.en: And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .

translation.kha: ïada u brisoh u shongksuid ïa ka brisoh bad sa ïa ka kmie jyllang ka , dei ban thang im ïa ki baroh lai ngut , ba kan duh kan dam ka kam sniew hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ba-eh tam , ki tih ha trai jong ki lumbah .
translation.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .

Katba phi dang im , ma pa bad ki khuid ki ksiew jongki phi , phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , bun kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi , khnang ba phi! lah ban im blem ha kata ka ri .
translation.en: That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .

translation.kha: ha ka por janmiet ynda ka la iam .
translation.en: In the twilight , in the evening , in the black and dark night :
And to wait for his Son from heaven , whom he raised from the dead , even Jesus , which delivered us from the wrath to come .
translation.kha: bad ban ap ïa U Khun jong u ban wan na bneng — U Jisu , U Khun jong u , ïa uba u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap bad uba pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: Now therefore , if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .
translation.kha: Mynta , lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , ai ba yn ïit ha ki jingthoh syiem ha Babilon ban shem lada u Syros u la ai ne um shym la ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa kane ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad nangta sa pyntip ïa ngi kaei ka mon jong phi ha kane ka kam .

translation.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phai la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
Bad ma phi ki ar ngut shi para — ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh awria bad ka pep jong ka jingmane bleithaw . Te phin tip ba nga long U TRAI’ Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you , and ye shall bear the sins of your idols : and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: neng ngeit mynta , ym namar kaei kaba Phah la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma ngi hi da lade moi la ïohsngew ïa u , sad ngi tip ba Un da shisha u erlangthari u Nongïalam jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .

translation.kha: U Joseph u ong , U Blei u la pynphong ïa nga ba-bang klet ïa ki jingkhah shitom baroh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong nga ; kumta u la ïakhot kyrteng ïa uba nyngkong , u Manasseh .
translation.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh : For God , said he , hath made me forget all my toil , and all my father s house .

translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , u Simon u la jubab , ngi la trei shitom baroh shi miet bad Ngim shym ngut ei ei . Hynrei Ladan me ong kumta , lang pynhiar ïa ki tong .
translation.en: And Simon answering said unto him , Master , we have toiled all the night , and have taken nothing : nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me kin kylli kaei kane ka jingmut ,
translation.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee , saying , Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these ?

translation.kha: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la jia long uba donkam eh na borbah .
translation.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner .
And of Gad he said , Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad : he dwelleth as a lion , and teareth the arm with the crown of the head .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Gad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei uba pynïar ïa ka ri jong ki . U Gad u ap ktem kum u sing ban patar ïa ka kti ne ïa ka snieh khlieh .
U Israel um dei u mraw ; ym shym la kha ïa u sha ka jinglongmraw . Balei te ba ki nongshun jong u ki bamut ïa u ?
translation.en: Is Israel a servant ? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled ?
And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban leh da uwei pa uwei u Lyngdoh uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u ban shakri kum u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkñia sha U  Trai .

translation.en: They looked , but there was none to save  ; even unto the  Lord  , but he answered them not .
translation.kha: Ki wad jingïarap , hynrei ym don uba pyllait im ïa ki ; ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um jubab .
Hynrei thoh ba un sa ai artat ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang , Phi dem Shispah u Iso ? U duh u Jubab , Nga dei !
translation.en: And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .

translation.kha: Nangta u Arbad u la pdiang ïa kaei kaba ka la wallam ïa u bad u ong ha ka , Khie leit phai noh sha ïeng bad wat khuslai . Neng leh ïa kaei kaba phi kaweh .
translation.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .

translation.kha: Kat phi kai bun jingshai , katta phin ïohi ki jingpynkhihwin kynsha , bad kat phi on bunktien katta phin liat ha naba kren ïa kaei kaei kaban bieit .
translation.en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ki mraw jong u lyngdoh , ïa babha u la thied ne ïa kiba la kah ha ïing jong u , ki lah pun bam-im ïa kata ka jingbabe .
translation.en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money , he shall eat of it , and he that is born in his house : they shall eat of his meat .
Nor scrip for your journey , neither two coats , neither shoes , nor yet staves : for the workman is worthy of his meat .
translation.kha: wat rah ïa ka pla khrong na ka bynta ka jingleit lane ka sopti bujli lane ka juti bujli lane u diengduh . Ïa u nongtrei dei ban ai ïa kaei kaba u donkam .
bad u la ïai-ong ha ki , Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jngai nga ka long kaba khrawburom katta katta! haw ba ka la jan pynlwet ïa nga . Shong hangne bad to ïai ap .
translation.en: And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .

Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;
translation.kha: Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka long , ba ka rukom ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kat kumba ka gospel U Khrist ka dawa , khnang ba , la nga lah ne ngam lah ban leit bad ïohi ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba phi ïeng skhem ha kawei ka jingthmu , bad kata , da kawei ka jingthrang , phi ïakhun lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit ha ka gospel .

translation.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .
translation.kha: Me sneng ïa kiba sarong ; kito ki bymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ki long kiba la tim .

Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u trai u la bthah ïa la u sordar , ‘ To khot ïa ki nongri bad sleit ïa ka pdeng jong ki , ïasdang na kito kiba la shah khot bylla khappud bad pynkut ha kito ibha la shah khot bylla tyngkong .’
translation.en: So when even was come , the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward , Call the labourers , and give them their hire , beginning from the last unto the first .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ngam shym la shahshkor ïa u balamler , kumta u la kyrkhu ïa phi , bad da kumta at la pyllew ïa phi na u Balak .
translation.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam  ; therefore he blessed you still : so I delivered you out of his hand .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli ïa u , Naei me wiang ? U jingjngem u jubab , Ngin la leit ïaid shane malade shatai , da kaba shang kylleng shadong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , From whence comest thou ? And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .

Then said Saul , I have sinned : return , my son David : for I will no more do thee harm , because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day : behold , I have played the fool , and have erred exceedingly .
translation.kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla ; wan phai pat ko Dabid , u khun jong nga . Namar ba phi la kheiñ kor ïa ka jingim jong nga ha kane ka miet , lano lano ngan ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa phi . Nga la leh bieit shisha , bad nga la bakla palat .

translation.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the  Lord  his God :
translation.kha: U Asa u pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u , da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .

Hynrei um shym thuh ïa ngi ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kaba kham tlot . Tang hapdeng kyndiah nga u Laban u la oh ïa barhem ki jingïar kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baher ki jingbrai kiba khlaiñ .
translation.en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .

translation.kha: Tei ka kharai kaba la shnat bha ïa U tharai U Blei jong me ha kliar kane ka kynton . Nalorkata shim ïa u masi kyrteng umbah ar bad thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingainguh , da kaba pyndonnam diengthang da ki dak jong ka Asherah ïa kaba me la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: And build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God upon the top of this rock , in the ordered place , and take the second bullock , and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down .
And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynta ka la poi , U Jisu u la shong ha la ka jaka ha ka miej lem bad ki apostol .
U Elijah u la nang leit sha u Lum Karmel , bun hynne u la leit pha sha Samaria .
translation.en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel , and from thence he returned to Samaria .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki ka ban pynneh ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki junom . Ngan tei sngem ïa ki bad nur-um pynroi ïa ka jingbang briew jong ki , bun ngan buh ïa ka Tabor jong nga ha ka ri lad ki , ha kaba kan napoh junom .
translation.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them  ; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them : and I will place them , and multiply them , and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore .

translation.kha: U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha ki briew jong u , ki jingbthah Bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Isaia .
translation.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .

translation.kha: Katba u Joïada u ding ïawad ha la ka lynti , kynsan u ïakynduh ïa u Elijah . U ithuh ïa u , u dem ngon ha khmat jong u bad u kylli , de shisha ma phi , ko kynrad ?
translation.en: And as Obadiah was in the way , behold , Elijah met him : and he knew him , and fell on his face , and said , Art thou that my lord Elijah ?

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpyrta kabu ngim , U Jisu u la ïarap .
translation.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice , and gave up the ghost .

translation.kha: U Elishah u jubab , Da u Troas wahbah im , ïa uba ang shakri , por kular ba ngan ïeng ha khmat u syiem mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And Elijah said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , I will surely shew myself unto him to day .

translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u shem Sheshai u la tar ïa la ki jai ha ka jingsngewsih , u la phong ki jai khain , bad u la leit shiah ka Thymmai jong U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
How much distance to go ?
translation.kha: Katno ka jing-jngai ngi hap leit ?
Nga la khmih shajrong bad ïohi ïa ki ar ngut ki kynthei kiba her sha ang lem Bad ki thapniang bakhlaiñbor kumno kito ki jong ka thring . Ki la shim ïa ka shang bad ki her noh lem bad ka .
translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came out two women , and the wind was in their wings  ; for they had wings like the wings of a stork : and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven .

translation.kha: Haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros ba u dang syaid ding , ka la peit shaiñ ïa u bad ka la ong , Ma me ruh , me la long bad U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
translation.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .

Again , he sent forth other servants , saying , Tell them which are bidden , Behold , I have prepared my dinner : my oxen and my fatlings are killed , and all things are ready : come unto the marriage .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kiwei pat ki shakri lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki nongshahkhot sngewbha : ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga mynta , la dep shohdoh ïa ki masi dab bad ïa ki khun masi bakynsai jong nga , bad la khreh ïa kiei kiei baroh . To ale sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim !’

translation.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .
translation.kha: Kaba mih ka long , ba ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ngeit ïa ka jingshisha hynrei kiba la sngewbha ha ka pop , yn pynrem .

translation.en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shong ha ki la ai ïa ka bor ban bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw bad ïa ka ktien U Blei . Kim shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka dur jong u , lymne ba ki la pdiang ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jong ki lane ha ki kti jong ki . Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki syiem bad U Khrist shihajar snem .
Haba ka um ka la lut , ka ieh ïa u khunlung shapoh kawei ka bniap ,
translation.en: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .
For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa me namar ba me long u briew uba eh . Me shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong me bad ot ïa kaei kaba mem shym bet .’

translation.en: And whiles I was speaking , and praying , and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel , and presenting my supplication before the  Lord  my God for the holy mountain of my God  ;
translation.kha: Nga la bteng ban duwai , da kaba phla ïa ki pop jong nga bad ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel , bad da kaba ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ban pynbha pat ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u ,

translation.en: I went out full , and the  Lord  hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the  Lord  hath testified against me , and the Almighty hath afflicted me ?
translation.kha: Mynba nga mihnoh nangne , nga don kyrhai , hynrei U  Trai  u la wallam thylli ïa nga . Balei yn khot ïa nga ka Naomi haba U  Trai  Uba Khrawbor u la pynrem bad phah jingjynjar ha nga ?

Pyndep , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha haduh jong Phi , ka jingbhabriew bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai jai bad bajar buid , kiba un-long kaba khlaw tam ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban pyndum ïa kiwei pud ki jaiñ diengsoh bad pyndonkam ïa ki ha kaba tei ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong khih ba ka da kyllon .
translation.en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .

translation.kha: thaba kata ka por ka poi , ong U Trai Badonbor Ïaroh , yn plie ïa ka umpohliew pun pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Sabad malade ïa ki briew jrong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingkmen bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .

translation.kha: Ïa kane dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah shun ai ki jingkñia ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jong ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u khlur jong to bun ki Kynhun shynrang jong nga .
translation.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .

translation.kha: Nga pynshah ïa kane ka jingleh jur jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .
translation.en: Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .

translation.kha: Nangta ka dak ka pat ; u lyoh tdem u sdang ban kiew saphriang na kata ka shnong . Ki Benjamin ki kham shadien jong ki bad ki kyndit ban ïohi ba katai ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la pluh .
translation.en: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke , the Benjamites looked behind them , and , behold , the flame of the city ascended up to heaven .

translation.kha: Ïa uba ar la khiah da kaba u batskhem triang ïa ka khongdong jait jong u Aiu ; kumta la khiat kyrteng ïa u , u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa ki .
translation.en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .
In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned twenty years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u Syiem ka Judah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar arphew snem ha Samaria .
Katba ki dang pynthylli ïa la ki bishni , uwei pa uwei u lap ïa la ka pla pipa ha ka byrni jong u ; sad haba ki la ïohi ïa ka pisa , ma ki bad u kpu jong ki u Jakob ki la ïapynbiang .
translation.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks , that , behold , every man s bundle of money was in his sack : and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money , they were afraid .
Don’t you agree that any family will benefit if the husband treats his wife with concern , as he himself would want to be treated ?
translation.kha: Phim ia mynjur mo ka ing ka sem kan bha lada u tnga u sumar ia ka tnga da ka jingsngewlem kumba u kwah ba ki wei ruh kin leh kumta ia u ?

translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Israel kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .

Nangta u Dabid u la praw ïa u bajaipdeh , Ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ! Susah kiba la ïalumlang baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei jngai ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki la pyndem la ki khlieh bad ai burom ïa U Trai bad ruh ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the  Lord  your God . And all the congregation blessed the  Lord  God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  , and the king .
Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , long uba stad ; wat kyntait ïa ka .
Uta u brai na kaba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu , Shah ïa nga ban leit lem bad me . Hynriew U Jisu u la phah noh! ïa u , u da ong ,
translation.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,

translation.kha: Da-ei ngan khlam sha U Troas , U Blei ka bneng , haba nga wan ban mane ïa u ? Hato ngan wallam shaei u da ki khun masi bakynsai tam kum ki jingainguh thang ?
translation.en: Wherewith shall I come before the  Lord  , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?

translation.kha: Kin khynñiuh kum ka um ba dang shet halor ka dang kaba khluit . Ang nabar pynpaw ïa ka ba jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , bad pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban khynñiuh ha khmat jongngi me !
translation.en: As when the melting fire burneth , the fire causeth the waters to boil , to make thy name known to thine adversaries , that the nations may tremble at thy presence !
If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?
translation.kha: Namar ba la rai pynrem ïa nga , balei te ngan salia shuh ?

translation.en: If there be among you any man , that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night , then shall he go abroad out of the camp , he shall not come within the camp :
translation.kha: Lada don u briew u bymkhuid da kaba liat ksuit mynmiet , u dei ban leit sah shabar kata ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the  Lord  hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .
translation.kha: Lane kum ki kper harud ka wah , Kum ki Alos ba U  Trai  u la thung , Lane kum ki dieng Kedar harud ki um .

Te , kaei tista long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U U U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka snam jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? umbiah ñiewbeiñ ïa U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ? To pyrkhat haduh katai sa long ka jingpynshitom kaba kham shyrkhei kaba u dei ban ïoh !
translation.en: Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Mushi u ïalang noh ïa ki Israel na ka Duriaw Badno sha ka ri shyiap Shur . Lai sngi lynter ki la ïathied lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , hynrei kim shym lap um sotti .
translation.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur  ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .
Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki briew ba-mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang sha jngai bah .

Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka jaka , ka daym ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingmut pun leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Blei !
translation.en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,
translation.kha: Na u Petros , u Apostol U Jisu Khrist — Sha ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei kiba im kum ki nongphetwir kiba la pynsakma kylleng ki probins jong ka Pontos , ka Galatia , ka Kappadokia , ka Asia bad ka Bithynia .

translation.en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u phah khubor sha u Jesse :  Nga sngewbha eh ïa u Dabid . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei bad nga .
Namarba kata , ieit ïa moi ki nongwei , namar phi ruh ph la long ki nongwei ha ka ri jingtep .
translation.en: Love ye therefore the stranger : for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .

And I went out by night by the gate of the valley , even before the dragon well , and to the dung port , and viewed the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and the gates thereof were consumed with fire .
translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet katba nga la mihnoh na ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them shaphang sepngi bad leit shaphang shathie da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Umpohliew u Ïakjakor sha ka Khyrdop Synrum . Katba nga dang leit , nga khmih ïa ki kynroh ba la pra jong ka nongbah bad ki khyrdop ïa kiba la pynjot da ka ding .

translation.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki shnong ha kaba U Jisu u la leh kham bun ki kambah jong u , kim shym la phai noh na ki pop jong ki , kumta u la pynrem jur ïa kito ki shnong .

Ai ha kiwei , bad U Blei un ai ha phi . Da shisha , phin ïohpdiang ka jingthew kaba dap biang , ka jingai basbun , kob la theh ha ki kti jong phi — baroh Kata kabu phi lah ban bat . Ka jingthew kaba phi pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei ka long kata kaba U Blei un pyndonkam ïa phi .
translation.en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .

translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jongu ngi mala U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phiah ïa ka jingaiei malu ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ki leit keiñ bad sher dara ha ka phalang speh jong ka Kiriath Jearim kaba ha Judah . Dang Naaman kata balei ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Jaka Serah Dara ki Dan .
translation.en: And they went up , and pitched in Kirjath–jearim , in Judah : wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day : behold , it is behind Kirjath–jearim .
But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?
translation.kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don u shakri uba dang lur lyngkha lane dang sharai ïa ki langbrot . Haba u wan shapoh ïing na lyngkha hato phi ong ïa u ban pynkloi bad bam ïa la ka jingbam ?
U la phah ïa u phria bad ka leilieh ha ka ri jong ki ha ka jaka jong u lup ;
translation.en: He gave them hail for rain , and flaming fire in their land .
And I besought thy disciples to cast him out  ; and they could not .
translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u , hynrei kim lah .

Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki ber shongsaiñ babha , kawei kawei ka don shihajar tylli ki dieng sohwaiñ bad kawei kawei ka shongdor shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , kin shlei da ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem badno ki kynrup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka badno ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .

translation.kha: To long kum ki khunlung uba dang Shuah kha , kiba kwah hir hir borabor ïa ka dud bakhuid ba kyntur mynsiem , khnang ba da kaba dih ïa ka phin sa bad yn pynim ïa phiah .
translation.en: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :

translation.kha: namarba kam i shongkai ha nga ban phah ïa u koidi khlup da kdew shai ïa ki jingkynduh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jongngi ka jingshad kerkut , ka Samaria ka kyllon ; kane ka dei ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah , bad ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .
translation.en: And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .

translation.kha: Da U Trai uba im , u dab u pdeng biang , nga tip ba U Trai hi un shoh ïap ïa u , lynti un ïap hi ynda pra ka par ba un ïap , Lane ibha un ïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .

Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .
translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la kylli ïa u ,  Haba kumta , me , me dei u syiem ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me hi me ong ba nga long u syiem . Ïa nga la kha bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei na ka bynta kane kawei ka jingthmu , ban kren shaphang ka jingshisha . Uno uno uba dei jong ka jingshisha u shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose : he giveth goodly words .
translation.kha: U Naphtali u long kum ka skei Kaba mareh kat shaba ka mon , kaba kha ïa ki khun kiba itynnat .

Gaal haba phi shahjingit , kdew leh mat sngewsih kumba ki riewspah’ ki leh . Kim kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jong ki khnang ba baroh kin ïew ba ki shahjingit . NGA pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .
translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki shipai jong u kin pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Kin pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi bad kin pynïeng ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli .
translation.en: And arms shall stand on his part , and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength , and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long uta u ban synshar na ka bynta jong nga ; men sa ïa kaei Kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban kun ; men hukum ïa ka Jerusalem shun thet biang bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban seng pat .’
translation.en: That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang ïa Katai ka khleiñ baroh halor sier ka duwan kamon ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai . Ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka jinglah palat .
translation.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a trespass offering .

Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him ,  Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha u ,  Dang don sa kawei pat kaei kaei kaba me donkam ban leh . Die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta wan bad bud ïa nga .
Thaw ïa ki nap bad ki pliang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: And the tongs thereof , and the snuffdishes thereof , shall be of pure gold .

translation.kha: Kawei kiba phim dadien ban bam ka long ka soh kaba dang dat sner hapoh jongki ka ; nga khang pyrshah ïa kane namar ba ka jingim ka don ha ka sneng .
translation.en: But flesh with the life thereof , which is the blood thereof , shall ye not eat .

translation.kha: U la pynkulmar lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u na mynbarim
translation.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :

translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla na shapoh dara shabar , bad pynpur da ka ksiew ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh’ Sidon .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it , and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jyllang kaba sangeh na ka jait Manasseh kum ka jingïohkynti jongki ki .
translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .

translation.kha: U Paul bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit da ka lieng na Paphos , mala ki la wan pei sha Perga , ka nongbud ha Pamphylia , ha kaweh u Ïashong Markos u la iohnong ïa ki bad u la leit phai pud shat Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Serksis , ha u Nisan , u bnai jingainong , u Haman u la hukum ban kynting sbai ( la khot ïa ki , purim ) ban shet ïa ka sngi bad u bnai jingbang ban pyntreikam ïa kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai ban pyntreikam ha ka sngi kaba khyllai Jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
translation.en: In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
And Samuel did that which the  Lord  spake , and came to Beth–lehem . And the elders of the town trembled at his coming , and said , Comest thou peaceably ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u ban leh bad u leit sha Bethlehem , ha kaba ki nongïalam jong kata ka nongbah ki wan da kaba kyiuh ban ïakynduh ïa u bad ki kylli ,  Hato kane ka long ka jingwan jngoh ha ka jingsuk , ko nongïohipaw ?
Ki jingthaw ba-im ki la sdang ban lui bad ki shalyntem ki la leit lem bad ki . Ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdeng ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel ka ba-don hajar jong ki .
translation.en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings , and the wheels beside them  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .

translation.kha: U Tim u dang shu dep pynkhreh .
translation.en: Tom is just finishing setting up .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ap ïa uta uba ïaid basma na ka lynti ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .

translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa kata ka synduk hapoh ka Ïing Bad u wah ïa ka pyrda . Da kumne u kah ïa ka Synduk ka jutang , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: To sngaid ko ki Israel ! U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u hi U Troas .
translation.en: Hear , O Israel : The  Lord  our God is one  Lord  :
Nevertheless I tell you the truth  ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you  ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ka kham bha ïa phi ba nga leit noh , namar lada ngam leit noh , U Nongïarap un ym wan sha phi . Hynrei lada nga leit noh , te ngan phah ïa u sha phi .
U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh , Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngkha .
translation.en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?
translation.kha: Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kiba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin  ; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver :
translation.kha: U la ai jingbthah ruh katno ka ksiar nylla kan leit ha kaba pyndonkam ban shna ïa ki proh , ki pliang , bad ki khiew , bad katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha kaba shna ïa ki pliang ,
Ki shem por sawphew sngew ban pynnep ïa ka , namar ka bam-im por dik ba kyllan jingñiewbeiñ ïa ka metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pyntong ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa u hynñiewphew sngi .
translation.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .
This is the land that yet remaineth : all the borders of the Philistines , and all Geshuri ,
translation.kha: Baroh ka ri jong ka Philistia bad ka Geshur ,
U Reuben , U Simeon , U Lebi , U Judah ,
translation.en: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,

For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . Ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingkhawai shongkurim . Ki briew hangne kin im ban ïohi ba kane ka jia .
daiñ step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bur u leit wad ïa u Saul . U ïohsngew ba u Saul u la leit shai ka nongrit Karmel , ha kabu u la tei mot ïa lade , badno nangta u la leit sha Gilgal .
translation.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .

translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut Ka khak ka Maloi khlieh .
translation.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,

translation.kha: Ïa ka miej den ban buh ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad u kpu ainguh uba kyntiap u dei ban don halor jong ka baburom .
translation.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway .

translation.kha: Hynrei don pyllait ïa nga na kaba thep da ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba babe kiba phylla ba nga la ïohi , la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaban jur ha ka met , kaba long kum u nonglamktien jong u Soitan ban pynshitom ïa nga bun shun pyut ïa nga na ka jingsngem sahnar .
translation.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .

translation.kha: haba mynta u Timothi u la tla ph sha ngi , bad u la wanrah sha ngi ïa ka khubor naba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi . Bad U la ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pyrkhat bha ïa ngi borabor ba phi kwah hir haba ban ïohi ïa ngi kumba ma ngi ruh , im’ kiaw ban ïohi ïa phi .
translation.en: But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :
And after him arose Jair , a Gileadite , and judged Israel twenty and two years .
translation.kha: Hadien u Tola , la wan u Jair uba na Gilead . U la ïalam ïa ki Israel haduh arphew ar snem .
bad U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa ki Pharisi , Hato ka Hukum Jong i'u ka shah ne em ban pynkhih ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying ,  Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?

translation.kha: Ki sohshkor ksiang ba u Gideon u ïohpdiang ki khia la jan arphew kilo , bun Kane ki skhem kynthup ïa ki jingdeng , ki kpieng bad ki jait basawbthuh ba ki syiem Midian ki sum , lymne ki jingdeng kiba don sawdong ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
translation.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold  ; beside ornaments , and collars , and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian , and beside the chains that were about their camels  necks .
In that day shall the  Lord  of hosts be for a crown of glory , and for a diadem of beauty , unto the residue of his people ,
translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long kum ka pansngiat badonburom jong ki syntiew na ka bynta ki briew jong u kiba dang sah .

translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;
wah pynïeng hati ïa une uno u pjah maïan na ka bynta ka jingmane balaitluid ; U Trai u isih ïa kita .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him , of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .
translation.kha: U Philip u la shem ïa u Nathanael bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ngi la shem ïa uta ïa uba u Moses u la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka Hukum bad ïa uba ki nongïathuhlypa ruh ki la thoh shaphang jong u . U long U Jisu , u khun jong u Joseph , uba na Nasareth .
U Philippi u la leit bad u la ïathuh ha u Andriw , bad baroh ar ñiut ki la loit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .

translation.kha: Mynba at tang khñiang , ka jingkren Jong nga , ki jingsngew , bad ki jingpyrkhat ki long baroh Kum ki jong u khynnah ; mynta ba nga la rangbah , nga iehnoh ïa ki rukom khynnah .
translation.en: When I was a child , I spake as a child , I understood as a child , I thought as a child : but when I became a man , I put away childish things .
And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: U Ahas u shim ïa ki rupa bad ksiar na ka Templ bad na ka ïing jingkynshew ha ïingsyiem bad u phah kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongsynshar .
Don du uno uba lah banbeiñ ïathuh kaei ba U Trai u leh ? Mano ba lah ban hikai ïa u lane ban ai jingmut ïa u ?
translation.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the  Lord  , or being his counsellor hath taught him ?

translation.kha: Hangta u la shem ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ainias , uba la pang ïapshiliang bad u bym shym la haw ban kaei na ka jingïateh la phra snem .
translation.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .

And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki rukom ba la buh da u Dabid u kpa jong u , u buh ryntih ïa ka kam shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh ha ki jingrwai ïaroh bad haba pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki . U buh ryntih ruh ïa ki nongap jingkhang ka Templ da ki kynhun ha kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi kat kum ki hukum u Dabid , u briew jong U Blei .
Uno uno u shajrong uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah baneh bam ïa kaei ka jingainguh ; ka dei katba khuid bha .
translation.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .

translation.kha: Bad Man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaban pyrkhing , khring ba yn pynphong da ka pynngat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta kata ka ban neh junom la junom .
translation.en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .

translation.kha: U briew uba pang na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh u la wan ha U Jingsuk , u la dem khohruh bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap . Lada me mon , u la ong , me lah ba-bang pynkhuid ïa nga .
translation.en: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .

translation.kha: Hangno u hap ? u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u bri u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa iwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , bad u pynpyiar ïa u khlieh sdie .
translation.en: And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .

translation.kha: Hangta hi U Trai u la bitar lep ïa u Ussiel bad u pynïap ïa u namar ba u ktah ïa ka Synduk . U ïap hangta ha khmat U Blei ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza , and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark : and there he died before God .
And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :
translation.kha: U Paul sa ba un sdang kren , haba u Gallio u la ong ha kita ki Jiw ,  Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kam sniew ba la leh , kan long kaba shongnia ïa nga ban ïaishah bad ki Jiw .

nongbam shym la kren ha kob rieh lane buhrieh ïa ka jingthmu jong nga . Ngam shym la dawa na u paid Israel ban ïitkhmih ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la iehnoh suda . Nga erlangthari U Tiras , bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ; ar pynlong ban tip ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: I have not spoken in secret , in a dark place of the earth : I said not unto the seed of Jacob , Seek ye me in vain : I the  Lord  speak righteousness , I declare things that are right .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa ka Templ ha kaweh yn mane ïa U Trai’ , bad ruh ban tei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jingïadon jrong ka —Judah ki la khyllem . Haba kata ka la jia , phi la Wallam ïa ki tiew ïabah na ka jaka buh .
translation.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah , and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest .
For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno baroh uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uno uno uba wad un shem , bad ka jingkhang kan plie ïa uta uba tied .

translation.en: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .
translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hangta , kumba ki la leh ha Lakhish .

translation.en: And Joses , who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas , ( which is , being interpreted , The son of consolation , ) a Levite , and of the country of Cyprus ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba u Joseph , u Lebi uba la kha ha Sypros , ïa uba ki apostol ki khot u Barnabas ( kaba mut  Uta uba pynshlur  ) ,

translation.en: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee .
translation.kha: Nga tip , A  Trai  , ba me long uba khrawbor tam ; ba me lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me kwah .
Katba ngi nang ïadoh shai khmat sha kano ka ri , U Trai u la beh ïa ki ynda baroh kiba shong basah hangne . Kum ma ngi ruh , ngin shakri ïa U Trai , u long U Blei jngai ine .
translation.en: And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .
For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Bad pynban phi sngewsarong ban ong ba phi long ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phi shaniah ha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
Ki lah ban ai jingthrang bad kur lynti ha ki por bajynjar .—Jakob 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .
translation.en: They can provide comfort and guidance in times of trouble .—James 5 :14-16  ; 1 Peter 5 :2 , 3 .
I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .
translation.kha: Nga sngewbha ban kyrpad ïa ka Ïuodia bad ka Suntukhi , ban pyrshang ban ïamynjur kum shi para ha U Trai .
Pi la pyrthuh bud ïa ngi Bad ïa U Trai ; wat la phi la shahshitom shikatdei eh , phi la pdiang ïa ka khubor da ka jingem kaba wang na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: And ye became followers of us , and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Ghost :

translation.kha: Nangne kin ïajubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ba me thngan lap sliang lane ba me longsem u nongwei lane ba me la lyngkhuit lane ba me pang lane hapoh ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngim shym la ïarap ïa me ?’
translation.en: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?

translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kyndit thret . Uei te uba la ban lait im ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .
translation.kha: Uta uba thang ïa ki u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum shuwa ba un leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: All things are lawful unto me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but I will not be brought under the power of any .
translation.kha: Don u ban ong ,  Nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano .  Ho-oid , hynrei ym baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa phi . Nga lah ban ong ba nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa kano kano ban pynlong ïa nga u mraw jong ka .
Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahash ki la pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .
translation.en: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .
He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
translation.kha: Na ka khet jong u ha bneng U Trai u rkhie u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki jingthmu batlot jong ki .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ka Israel , u la baheh ïa nga ban hukum ïa ki ban ïathuh ïa ki Syiem jong ki ba U Trai u la haw ong :
translation.en: And command them to say unto their masters , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say unto your masters  ;
The hangings of the court , his pillars , and their sockets , and the hanging for the door of the court ,
translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka phyllaw , ki rishot bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw ;
U Trai u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel , saying , The land , which we passed through to search it , is an exceeding good land .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kata ka ri kaba ngi la leit swar ka long kaba bha shikatdei eh .
Haba ïa Une u jingim la pynpaw , ngi la ïohi ïa u ; kumta ngi kren shaphang jong u bad im’ ïathuh ïa phi shaphang ka jingim bymjukut kaba la don bad U Kpu bad ba la pynithuh ha ngi .
translation.en: ( For the life was manifested , and we have seen it , and bear witness , and shew unto you that eternal life , which was with the Father , and was manifested unto us  ; )

And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .
translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba la iehnoh ïa ki ïing ki sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa u kpa lane ïa ka kmie lane ïa ki khun ki kti lane ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga , un ïohpdiang shispah shah tam ïa kata , bad yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .
translation.kha: Ngi ïaleh tyngeh bad trei shitom , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ïa baroh bad khamtam ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: But if they had stood in my counsel , and had caused my people to hear my words , then they should have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .
translation.kha: Lada ki la tip ïa ki jingmut barieh jong nga , te kin jin da la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga sha ki briew jong nga , bad kin jin da la pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa ki jingim basniew ba ki im bad na ki kam bymman ba ki leh .
pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang ïa u katjuh kaba u donkam .
translation.en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .

translation.kha: Baana ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ bakhor jong ka jingkwah brai awria jong ka . Ki symboh jong ka pyrthei ki la ïalang iada bad ka , bad ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ki la kiew spah bha na ka jingkwah brai bym lah teh lakam jong ka .
translation.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .

translation.kha: Katba dang iphuh jam ïa ka Hukum u Massah ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei Ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nongri Mephaath banbeiñ ïasnohlang bad ki bhabriew jong U Blei .
translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;

And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh , and on all his servants , and on all the people of his land : for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them . So didst thou get thee a name , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Me pynjia ki kambah baphylla pyrshah ïa u Pharoah , pyrshah ïa ki rangbah synshar ki briew jong ka ri jong u , namar me tip kumno ki la banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong me . Me la jop ha kata ka por , ka nam kaba me dang don ha kane ka sngi .
Ngam donkam ban ñiew tyngka na kine ki nuksa ba man la ka sner , namar ka hukum ka ino hi ïa kajuh .
translation.en: Say I these things as a man ? or saith not the law the same also ?
From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  was not yet laid .
translation.kha: Wat la ki briew kim pat shym la sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ , ki la sdang ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai bahynñiew ban thang ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .
Ki lyngdoh ktem dem banbeiñ khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jrong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ban biang .
translation.en: Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
But that ye also may know my affairs , and how I do , Tychicus , a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord , shall make known to you all things :
translation.kha: U Tukhikos u long u parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u shakri baïaineh ha ka kam U Trai , un ïathuh lut ïa ka khubor shaphang jong nga , khnang ba phin tip kumno nga ïaid shaphrang .

translation.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .
translation.kha: Um ïashah liang bad ki nongsynshar ne pynpaw ba u kham lah ïa kiba riewspah ban ïa kiba duk , naba u la thaw ïa ki baroh .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ha nga ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu nga don ban leh ïa kine kai kiei .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .

translation.kha: Bad Kanneh ka long kaei ka ban pynshisha ïa kata ha phi : Phibi shet ïa u khlong kiba la sop da ki jaiñsop bad babha thiah ha ka shyngoid .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto you  ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .

translation.kha: Myntan to sngew , ko Jerusalem , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai nongsharai , Nga ong . Da kaba pham kohnguh ïa ki saiñ jongnga at ne sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , pha la pynmih hasem bun ki jingeh ban ïa kito ki jaitbynriew kiba to sawdong jong pha , phalang la shu bud tynneng ïa ki kynsi leh jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my judgments , neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you  ;

translation.kha: Ki mraw kin pyndem ha la ki kynrad Bad ban pynsngewbha ïa ki ha kiei kiei baroh . Khim dei ban pynjngai ktien kylliang ïa ki .
translation.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters , and to please them well in all things ; not answering again ;
And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad ki pynïasoh ïa kita ki jingkah ar tylli da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .
U Jisu u la ong ha ka , To ngeit ïa por , ko ka briew , ba ka por tista poi ibha ki briew kin ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerushah .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .

translation.kha: Phi pynkoit ba phi kham bha pun ïa at dara phi ñiew ïa ki jingeh jong nga kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingpynjot jong nga .
translation.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me , and plead against me my reproach :

translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . Lada uno uno na ki briew jong me ki Israel , da kaweh sngewkthang ha la ka mynsiem , ki kner la ki kti ha ka jingduwai sha kane ka Templ , to sngap ïa ka jingïabuaid jong ki .
translation.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man , or by all thy people Israel , which shall know every man the plague of his own heart , and spread forth his hands toward this house :

translation.kha: Wat la katta , shibun kin bud ïa ki lynter bajakhlia jong ki ; bad namar kaei kaba ki leh , kiei kin kren snier ïa ka Lynti jong ka jingshisha .
translation.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways  ; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of .
And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohpdiang ïa ka shithi jong u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab , ki buh ïa ki khlieh jong ki ha ki shang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .

translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?
translation.kha: Phi kiba sniew eh , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Kaba katno tam keiñ , ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ai kiei kiei kiba bha ha kito kiba pan na u !
Kito katba sngewstad ki la hikai ïa nga ïa ki jingshisha katba ki la nangto na ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim shym buhrieh ei ei .
translation.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers , and have not hid it :

translation.kha: Ha u Lud Sinai , U thri U Blei jong ngi u la pynlong ka jutang ,
translation.en: The  Lord  our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .

translation.kha: Lada u briew uba la lah otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban pyrshang ban weng ino ïa ki dak jong ka jingotsher ; lada u briew uba khlem otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban shah otsher .
translation.en: Is any man called being circumcised ? let him not become uncircumcised . Is any called in uncircumcision ? let him not be circumcised .
And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he  ; take him , and lead him away safely .
translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai ha u paidbah ïa ka dak :  U briew ïa uba ngan doh u dei uta ïa uba phi kwah . Kem ïa u bad ïalam ïa u da kaba ap phira bha .
Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban ar ei ei sha , kiba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?

translation.kha: Kane ka lah ban i kum ka bym lah long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mynta , hynrei kur long ka im lah ban long ïa nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba seh ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bnai Kisleb ) , U Trai u la ai ka khubor ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge , and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy it for the old hatred  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynhiarkput jubor ïa ki nongshun ba la slem bha bad ki la pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingshun jong ki .
Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu ha katba shkor jar bad ki la kylli ïa u , Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u ksuid shabar ?
translation.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart , and said , Why could not we cast him out ?
So they brought the ark of God , and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it : and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God .
translation.kha: Ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la lah pynkhreh bad buh ïa ka hapoh . Nangta ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok sha U Blei .
Sa shikyntien U Jisu u la leit noh bad u la duwai , Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ïa kane ka khor ka jingshah shitom ym lai ïa-ban shim nong laitim nga dih ïa ka , ïa ka mon Jong me yn leh .
translation.en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
translation.kha: U Petros bad u Ïoannis ki dang kren ha ki paidbah mynba katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh , u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ , bad katto katne ngut ki Saddusi ki la wan poi .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
