And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city , and take it , and burn it with fire .
translation.kha: Te ki nong Babilonia kin wan biang , kin tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kin kurup ïa ka , bad kin thang duh ïa ka .
Bun ma phi , ruh , Phin Kren shaphang jong de , namar ba phi la don lem mala nga naduh kaban sdang .
translation.en: And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .
After whom is the king of Israel come out ? after whom dost thou pursue ? after a dead dog , after a flea .
translation.kha: Ha khmih ïa kaei u syiem Israel u pyrshang ban pynïap ? Ha khmih ïano u beh kthong ! Ïa u ksew ïap , ïa u thyllah !
Shuwa ba phira sdang ïalap , u lyngdoh un wang sha khmat bad kren ha kata ka kynhun shipai ,
translation.en: And it shall be , when ye are come nigh unto the battle , that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people ,

translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh woh la u pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingsuh U Trai ,’ Ngan pynshitom ïa u bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .

translation.kha: U la poi ha kata ka Jaka pynpdang ka Bethel bad ka Ai ha kaba u la shijur ngon mynshuwa , bad ba u la lah tei ïa ka duwan . Hangta u la mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Unto the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first : and there Abram called on the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka soskular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u sharai jong u .
translation.en: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .

translation.kha: ka la long ka bymmyntoi wat ha shuwa ba yn thang ïa ka . Mynta ba ka ding ka la thang ïa ka bad pynkylla rnga ïa ka , ka la nang long shuh shuh ka bymmyntoi ei ei .
translation.en: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work : how much less shall it be meet yet for any work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?

translation.kha: Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lema sad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt malade ka rud jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
The sons of Leah  ; Reuben , Jacob s firstborn , and Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Zebulun :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Leah ki long u Reuben ( u khun nyngkong u Jakob ) , u Simeon , u Lebi , u Judah , u Issakhar , bad u Sebulun .
To bato ïa ka aiñ jong me ha nga , pynlang ngan khlong ïa ka ; ngan sorkar ïa ka da ka dohnud lad nga barhem .
translation.en: Give me understanding , and I shall keep thy law  ; yea , I shall observe it with my whole heart .

translation.kha: U Solomon u phah khur sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros : To ïakhaïi bad la kumba phi la ai bad u syiem Dabid , u kpa jongu nga , mynba phi la die ïa u ki dieng Kedar tylli na ka bynta ban tei ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , As thou didst deal with David my father , and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein , even so deal with me .
When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus  knees , saying , Depart from me  ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u Simon Petros u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Khie leit noh na nga , ko Trai ! Nga long u briew uba pop !

translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou afflicted , and drunken , but not with wine :
translation.kha: Phi ki briew kiba jynjar jong ka Jerusalem , phi kiba ïaid sheng sheng kumba phi la buaid ,

Phin shnong ha ri Heshbon , bad phin don hajan jongnga nga — ma phi , ki khun jong phi , ki ksew jong phi , lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , ki blang jyllang phi , kiwei kiwei de ki jingri jong phi , pynlang baroh kat kiba phi don .
translation.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen , and thou shalt be near unto me , thou , and thy children , and thy children s children , and thy flocks , and thy herds , and all that thou hast :

translation.kha: U nongshong basa ne u nongbylla um bit shun bam ïa ka .
translation.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof .
And he set the bread in order upon it before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  had commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad u buh halor jong ka ïa u kpu ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
Ha kata kajuh ka suri , u Jakob u la khie , u shim ïa la ki tnga baher ar ngut , ïa ki tnga kliar jongno u ar ngut , dara ïa la ki khun baroh khatwei ngut , Bad u la jam ïa ka wah Jabbok .
translation.en: And he rose up that night , and took his two wives , and his two womenservants , and his eleven sons , and passed over the ford Jabbok .

translation.kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew baher sha nga .
translation.en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ong , Ha kham ! Kine hangne ar tylliat ki waitbnoh , ko Kynrad ! Kata ka la biang ! u la Joab .
translation.en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .

translation.kha: Pha ong , ‘ Nga long kaba riewspah bad kaba dap babiang ; nga Don baher kaba de donkam .’ Hynrei pham tip hajuh katno phasi long kaba lanot sad kaba isynei ban Khmih ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , bad kaba matlah .
translation.en: Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka na U Jisu u la wan poi na Igdalaïah bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah ïadon ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .
translation.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .

translation.kha: Wat la ka la long ha ka jingtlot ba u la shah pynkup halor ka diengphna , dei da ka bol U Blei ba u im . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad pa’ ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lym ïa ka bor U Blei ha ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .

But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back , that they should not go with him to battle , fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Beth–horon , and smote three thousand of them , and took much spoil .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ki shipai Israel kiba u Amasaïah um shym la shah ba kin leit sha ka thma bad u ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Judia hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Beth Horon , ki la pynïap lai hajar ngut ki rangbah , bad ki la kurup shibun ki mar lute .

translation.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :
translation.kha: Haba u Adam u la dap shispah laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang uba syriem ïa u bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
Ngin ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ bakordor jyllang nga yn pyntngit , hajan ki nongtuh kine rung sha ka pynlang kin pynkit ïa ka .
translation.en: My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .
Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .
translation.kha: Phi baroh kiba don hangne phi dei ki Israel . Kaei ngin leh ha kaba ïadei bad kane ?

translation.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .
translation.kha: U angel u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaba shat phyrnai sngur bha , bad kaba wan mih na ka khet jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot

U Dabid bad ki paidbah ki leit sha ka nongbah Baalah , kata ka dei ka Kiriath Jearim , ha ka ri Judah , ba wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kambah don ka kyrteng jong U Trai uba shong halor ki Kherub .
translation.en: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Myntan u la kiew shajrong eh , u la ïalam bad u ïa shibun kiba shah ringmraw ; u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u briew .
translation.en: Wherefore he saith , When he ascended up on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts unto men .
The heart of the righteous studieth to answer : but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban jubab . Ki briew kiba sniew ki kloi ban jubab , hynrei ka wallam jingeh .

translation.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south : also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision  ; but they shall fall .
translation.kha: Te shibun ki briew kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Bad katto katne ki rangbah thombor na ka jaitbynriew jong me , ko Daniel , kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah namar ka jingïohipaw kaba ki la lah ïohi , hynrei kin sa shahjop .
wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , U Jisu u la Ong ïa u dara ïa kiwei pat ki synran , namar uno uno u bym pyrshah ïa pa u long ha ka liang jongno phi .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Forbid him not : for he that is not against us is for us .

translation.kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong Kanaan uba u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .
translation.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .

translation.kha: Da kumta , phan weng noh ïa ka jingshah kynnoh pop napdeng jong phiah , hajuh phi leh ïa kata kambah dei ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jongngi nga ïa uwei uba kum une u khynnah , u pdiang ïa nga .
translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .
And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
translation.kha: ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ïa ka jingkah pyrda ;

translation.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the  Lord  thy God : for every abomination to the  Lord  , which he hateth , have they done unto their gods  ; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar ba ha kaba mane ïa ki , ki leh ruh ïa ki kam isaitmet baroh kiba U  Trai  u isih . Ki kñia wat ïa la ki khun ki kti ruh ha ka ding halor ki duwan jong ki .

Kumta u Dabid u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa iathuh u khiew um ale ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u malade u Abishai ki mihnoh . Ym don myn mano uba la ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baher ki dang ïohthiah lyngngai , namar ba U Trai u la Phah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .
translation.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .

translation.kha: Namarba ïa u tnga u bymngeit la pynlong uba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynsah ha ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ka thngan ka bymngeit la pynlong kaba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynsah ha la u tnga uba ngeit . Lada kane kam long kumta , ki khun Jong ki kin long kum ki khun jong ki bymngeit ; hynrei kumba ka longïing , la pynlong ïa ki kiba la pynpdang da U Blei .
translation.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .
The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .

Phin lieh pher lyngba kane ka them kaba pynkhlad arliang ïa une u lumbah . Phin phet kitab ki khop thymmei jong phi ki la leh Mynba u jumai u khynñiuh ha ka por jong u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah . U thri U Blei Jong nga un wan , un wanlam ïa ki angel baroh lak bad u .
translation.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains  ; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal : yea , ye shall flee , like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah : and the  Lord  my God shall come , and all the saints with thee .

translation.kha: To ai ba eit kiba stad kin pyrkhat shaphang phim kiei kiei ; to kin pyrkhat shaphang ka jingieit baïaineh U Trai’ .
translation.en: Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the  Lord .

And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .
translation.kha: Lada u sait ïa kata bad ka jingbthuh ka jah noh , u dei ban sait biang ïa ka sa shisien , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .

translation.en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba pynïap ïa uno uno u jingri u dei ban buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynïap ïa la u parabriew u dei ban shah pynïap .
Uta uba thrang ïa kata ka masi umdih u dei ban sait ïa la ki jreiñ badno theh um ïa laiñ , hynrei u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh jingimat .
translation.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .

And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :
translation.kha: Hadien habud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa phi ka mut aïu kane ka jingrakhe , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndonkam ïa la ka borbah , U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba ngi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Go yet , love a woman beloved of her friend , yet an adulteress , according to the love of the  Lord  toward the children of Israel , who look to other gods , and love flagons of wine .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit biang bad leh-ieit ïa ka briew kaba dang ïaleh nuti bad uba ieit jong ka . Me dei ban ieit ïa ka kumba nga ruh nga dang ieit ïa ki paid Israel , wat la ki phai sha kiwei pat ki blei bad ki ieit ban ainguh ha ki bleithaw da ki soh kismis .

Lada Kanaan kano ka mraw ka long ka tnat kliar ba la hajuh jong u briew bad ym pat shym la siew dem ïa ka dor jong ka bad pyllaitluid , te lada ine uno u briew u ïathiah shongkhia bad ka , yn pynshitom ïa ki , hynrei ym dei ba pynpei namar ka dei ka mraw .
translation.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman , that is a bondmaid , betrothed to an husband , and not at all redeemed , nor freedom given her  ; she shall be scourged  ; they shall not be put to death , because she was not free .

translation.kha: U la kop ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shnong kiba markhap . Ki pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u la lai ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Hebron bad ïa ka Libnah pynlang u syep jong ka .
translation.en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .

Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno me lah ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew kiba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khuid palat kat ban peit ïa kaba sniew , bad mem lah shah ban peit ïa ki briew ba leh bymdei . Te balei ba me shu sngap jar jar katba ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?
( Haba u ong ïa kan u kdew ïa ka jingtep kaba kumno un shah . )
translation.en: This he said , signifying what death he should die .
Better is it that thou shouldest not vow , than that thou shouldest vow and not pay .
translation.kha: Kham bha ban ym kular ei ei ban ïa kaba pynlong ka jingkular hynrei khlem bat ïa ka .
Kumta kdew sheptieng , phi kham kor badno shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïinglieng .
translation.en: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .

translation.kha: ka lyer mihngi kan sar ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki ;
translation.en: The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .

translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ïa ka jingsop kaba shapoh bad naba Shaul jong ka , ïa ka pyrda jong ka jingkhang ,
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them  ; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jingsuk u la jubab , Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka jong , ‘ U bynriew um im tang da u kpu hi , hynmen u dakmong ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kiba U blang u kren-ïa .’
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba phi mon jingsngewbha ba-bang ïarap , bad nga la kob sarong ïa pa’ ha ki briew ha Makedonia . Ki bangeit ha Ayyah ar la ong , ki la kloi ban ïalap naduh ka snem kaba la dep . Ka jinglong ba la kloi jong phi ka la pynheh ïa kiba bun na ki .
translation.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind , for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia , that Achaia was ready a year ago ; and your zeal hath provoked very many .
The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan ; bad baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .

translation.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: lada phi kohnguh ïa u bad phi sumar biang biang ïa kata baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .
translation.kha: Hangta u pud u khun sha sepngi shaduh Asnoth Tabor , bad nangta sha Hukkok , da kaba kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaphang sepngi , bad ïa ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Wisdom crieth without  ; she uttereth her voice in the streets :
translation.kha: Ha sngap ! Ka Jingstad ka pyrta ha ki lynti shnong bad ha ki jaka ïew ,

translation.en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
translation.kha: U pyllaitluid ïa la ki briew , bad u pynlong ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Uba khuid bad uba khrawbor u long ma u !
Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas ; u rangbah ai law ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u dei u Abiathar , u bakha jrong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jong u .
translation.en: And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .

translation.kha: Uno uno ibha pyrkhat ba kim long kabu bakla ban tuh na la ki kmie ki kpa um long kham bha’ ban ïa u nongtuh uba la ju mlien .
translation.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother , and saith , It is no transgression  ; the same is the companion of a destroyer .
The king of Tappuah , one  ; the king of Hepher , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Tappuah , ka Hepher ,

Ha kata ka iitkhmat hi la jylla ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi pynbha na ka shiphew bynta jong ka nongbud la pynjot , badno hynñiew hiar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew ki la sngewkmen bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka Bneng .
translation.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .

translation.kha: Ko Moab , pha shaniah ha la ka jingkhleh bad ha la ka spah , hynrei mynta kad ïa Phah ruh yn jop noh ; ïa u blei Khemosh jong pha yn ringmraw , lema bad ki Kynhun syiem bad ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness  ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha u lum Seïon kin don ki ban lait im , bad kan long ka jaka bakyntang . Ki briew jong u Jakob kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri kaba dei hok ka jong ki .

Nga ai ïa ka jingnguh sha U Khrist Jisu ibha U Trai jrong ngi , uba la ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhlaiñ na ka bynta ka kada jong nga . Nga ainguh ïa u ba la ñiew ïa nga uba bit bad la thung ïa na baneh shakri ïa u , Wat la ha ka por ba la leit ei nga la klun sniew ïa u bad pynshitom beiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord , who hath enabled me , for that he counted me faithful , putting me into the ministry ;

translation.kha: u la ong , ngam sa bishar ïa me ynda poi ki nongmudui jong me . Nangta u la ai hukum ban buhai ïa u Paul ha ka jingap phira hapoh ka jaka sah Jong u lyngskor .
translation.en: I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod s judgment hall .
And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .
translation.kha: bad ban pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil ban ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingisynei jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Bad kumta ngin ïaroh ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
Kum ïa kata ka jait jingmap ngam sngewkynduh bam , mala baroh kaba na bam ka pynshitom ïa nga .
translation.en: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat .

translation.kha: bad u Moses u phah ïa ki Briew ban shet ka lynti babniah tam kumno ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Jaser ; ki Israel ki la ïohknieh ïa ka bad ki shngain katba sawdong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof , and drove out the Amorites that were there .
And there they burnt incense in all the high places , as did the heathen whom the  Lord  carried away before them  ; and wrought wicked things to provoke the  Lord  to anger :
translation.kha: bad ki thang jingiwbih ha baroh ki duwan ki blei thala , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki briew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri . Ki pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  da ki jingleh kynriang jong ki baroh
Ka rukom im jong u Er ka long bymman , malade kata ka la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai , kumta U Trai u la pynpoh noh ïa u .
translation.en: And Er , Judah s firstborn , was wicked in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  slew him .

translation.kha: Pyntrei shitom kham tyngeh ïa kine ki briew bad pynbunkam ïa ki , khnang ba kine ym don por ban shahshkor ïa ki nia lamler .
translation.en: Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein  ; and let them not regard vain words .
Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .
translation.kha: To phah ïa u paidbhur ban lute ïa ki ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong ïa ki ban kyang ha ka jingshyrkhei . Ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ban pynngat ïa nga .

translation.en: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki long kiba bha kupar lada ki don u kpa uba beit bad uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

Hynrei ha kine ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jyllang ka jingkem bad ka jinglehkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ki ïaroi katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha ka Templ jongnga nga ; kin ïa-ong , ‘ To ainguh ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh , namar u longsem uba bha bad ka jingieit Jong u ka neh bymjukut .’ Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka ri kiba put kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la klun .
translation.en: The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Mano , phi tharai u ban ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong pa baroh ? Mano ba la ai mynhyndai ïa phi ban kren kumne ?
translation.en: To whom hast thou uttered words ? and whose spirit came from thee ?

translation.kha: Don bun ki jinglah shun shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .
translation.en: And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .

translation.kha: ki da pynïap lwait ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh , bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad wat ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh .
translation.en: And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .

translation.kha: Katba ki ïangat ïashad ïew , u Syiem u la kylla biang ïa ka , Mynta , ko Shethar , ko mahadei , kaei kaweh pha kwah ? ïathuh ïa nga bad phan ïoh ïa kata . Ngan ai ha pha wiat shiteng na ka hima .
translation.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition , queen Esther ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? and it shall be performed , even to the half of the kingdom .

Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee , and shall pursue thee , and overtake thee , till thou be destroyed  ; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee :
translation.kha: Kine ki jingpynjot baroh kin sa ngat ha phi , bad kin bam bad lynshop ïa phi haduh ba phin da jot thiaw , namar ba phim kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad phim sumar ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha phi .
U shem u kren ha ki lyngdoh mala ki Lebi shaphang kine ki jingai ,
translation.en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Trai u lah ban sa , ki kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .
translation.en: These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .
And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la leit hiar na kata ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïaid lait na kawei ka liang .

translation.en: So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel , and smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–beth–maachah , and all Chinneroth , with all the land of Naphtali .
translation.kha: U syiem Benhadad u mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong u lem bad ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Israel . Ki la kurup ïa ka Ijon , ka Dan , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka jaka hajan ka duriaw Galilaïa , bad ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei .

translation.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ba ka kada jong u ka kyllon namar ba ban ka jingkit , ïarap ban pynïeng pat ïa ka ; wat shu ïaid lait .
Kumta uta u briew u la rupa bad u la ïaid lyngngoh ïa ka Dekapolis , da kaba ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U jongu u la lah ni ïa u . Bad baroh ibha la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewkthang .
translation.en: And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .

translation.kha: Haseroth phi Shaphang ïa phim kiei kiei ? U ju u la kylli ïa ki . ho-oid , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Have ye understood all these things ?  They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not , without any intermission ,
translation.kha: Ki ummat jong nga kin mih kum ki wahduid ba ïai tuid .
Kumta hamar ba phyrnai ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei ha ka duwan bad hangtai pa’ kynmaw ba u para jong phi u don ei ei pyrshah ïa phi ,
translation.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee  ;
Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
translation.kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka waiñ , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki langbrot jong u .
To ai ha ngi man ka sngi ïa ka jingbam ka ngi donkam .
translation.en: Give us day by day our daily bread .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh badno ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ nabar ha ki tymmen ki sa kaba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u , Hato phi la dei ban ïawan bad ki thnam bad ki dieng tieng , la main nga dei u riewshukor ?
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?

But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .
translation.kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la ïarap ïa u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ki apostol . U la batai ha ki kumno u Saul u la ïohi ïa U Trai ha ka lynti bad ba U Trai u la lah kren bad u Saul . U la ïathuh ruh kumno u Saul u la ïalap da ka jingshlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .

translation.en: And he wrote in the letter , saying , Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle , and retire ye from him , that he may be smitten , and die .
translation.kha: U thoh :  Buh ïa u Uriah ha khmat duh , ha ka jaka kaba jur tam ka jingïaleh , nangta kynran dien noh bad ai ba un shah pynïap .
Lada du uno u smai khlem da pyrkhat , kam pher la ka long ïa Kanah kano , u long uba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kawei ba u la leh .
translation.en: Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .
And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .
translation.kha: Te , ïa kine , yn phah noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok kin leit sha ka jingim bymjukut .

Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta iwei pat u angel ba u jubab , Kan ïailong haduh syang hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pud ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .
As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ki sha ka pyrthei , kumba me la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei .
Nga pynthikna ïa Phi ba don katto katjuh hangne ki ban ym ïapom tad haduh ba kin da ïohi ba U Khun U Briew u wan kum u syiem .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .

translation.kha: U uno uba wanrah ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kum ka jingweng thang ha U TRAI’ u dei ban wallam lem bad kata ka jingri shi kilo u pura! ba la khleh bad shi lytar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingtah bam , lam bad shi litar ka waiñ .
translation.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .

translation.kha: Ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa ki , khnap ban ym ne ba kynmaw shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: I said , I would scatter them into corners , I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men :

Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .
translation.kha: Te mynta nga hukum ba lada uno uno na kano kano ka hima , ka jaitbynriew , lane ka ktien uba kren khlem burom ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , dei ban tar ïa u na ka kti bad kjat , bad ïa ka ïing jong u dei ban pynlong ka kynton ki jingpra . Ym don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .
Hadien kane , u Hosea bad ka kynhun shipor jongnga u ki la leit na Libnah sha Lakhish , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , unto Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it :
And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them , that they may cleanse the land .
translation.kha: Kan shim por ïa ki Israel hynñiew bnai ban tep ïa ki metïap baroh bad ban pynlong khuid pat ïa ka ri .
U Trai un aiti ha phi ïa ki nongshun jong ph bad un pynkulmar ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjop lat thiaw .
translation.en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .

translation.kha: Keiñ ka bynta ka kynthup ïa ka ri lum , ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi , ka Them Jordan bad ki kjat lum jong ka , ka sharing lum ha ka pdang mihnoh bad ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka pdeng bashathie . Kane ka ri ka la ju long ka ïing jngai ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translation.en: In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country  ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :

translation.kha: Naduh myntor , nga nguh ha pha , phan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga tad haduh ba phan ïai-ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrtong jong u Tharai .’
translation.en: For I say unto you , Ye shall not see me henceforth , till ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba ïan sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlain jyllang uta u briew . Kumne keiñ u lyngngeit un pyndep ïa ka manna lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
And Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from before Pharaoh .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kyrkhu khublei bad u leit noh .
Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synsar ïa phi , ngan haduh sangeh ban pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translation.en: And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Jingpynim jong ngi ,
translation.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;

translation.kha: U la leit kham ha pajih , u la dem pylleng ha khyndew , bad u la ïadie ba lada don ka lad , un ym hap ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka por jong ka jingshah shitom .
translation.en: And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .

Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi long u khun ba-ieit eh jong nga , u khun uba nga ieit tam . Man ba nga ong ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi da ka jingieit . Ka dohnud jong nga ka leit sha phi ; ngan isynei ïa phi .

translation.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat kmen namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng jong phi la thoh ha bneng .

translation.en: The elders guide and help to protect the congregation spiritually .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah balang ki pyni ïa ngi na ka Baibl bad ki ïarap ïa ka balang ban kham jan sha U Blei .
Kin tei pait ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .
translation.en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .

translation.kha: To hukum ïa ki ba kin leh ïa ka bha , pun man kyrhai ha ki kam babha , ban lama kiba rben Bad kiba khlaw ban ïasam bad kiwei .
translation.en: That they do good , that they be rich in good works , ready to distribute , willing to communicate ;

translation.kha: Man ka stait haba u Aaron u wan ban Pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u dei ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih khashor jngai ka .
translation.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpule na ka hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jongnga ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah pynsynjor jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki : Ko hynmen ko para , ngi kwah ïa phi! ban kren ha u paidbah lada phiah don ka khubor ai mynsaw na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .

Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ka wan jia shisha . U  Trai  u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa jong u .
Ki peit ïa ki kam ba donkam ba dei ban leh man la ka por ha ka balang .
translation.en: They care for the important but often routine organizational and physical tasks that must be handled in the congregation .
Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba ka por kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israel bad Judah da ki briew bad ki mrad .

translation.en: Yet Michael the archangel , when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses , durst not bring against him a railing accusation , but said , The Lord rebuke thee .
translation.kha: Wat u Mikhael , u angel rangbah um shym la leh ïa kane . Ha ka jingïakajia jong u bad u Soitan , mynba ki la ïania shaphang uei u ban ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym nud ban pynrem ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong ,  U Trai un da sneng ïa me !

translation.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it  ; and whoso breaketh an hedge , a serpent shall bite him .
translation.kha: Lada phi tih ïa ka thliew , phin hap hapoh jong ka , lada phi phrung lyngba ka kynroh , u bseiñ un puh ïa phi .
Uwei u don ha ka phang bashatei jongnga ka khim , u da phai shaw Mikhmash , nabar uwei pat ha ka phang bashyrkhei , u da phai sha Geba .
translation.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingjrong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongbishar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang ïaw dohthang shuh shuh ba pynïap ïa u ; ym tong ba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum Sabbaton , hynrei ba u la ong ba U Blei hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïapthngan bad U Blei .
translation.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .

translation.kha: Nga la ieh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U Trai Nongsynshar . Ha ka , por la ïohi ïa u ba u dang pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da ka ding . Ka ding ka la thang lut ïa ka duriaw-bah bakhraw hapoh ka sylla pyllait , bad ka la pdang ban bam duh ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and , behold , the Lord  God  called to contend by fire , and it devoured the great deep , and did eat up a part .

translation.kha: Kuth ar ngut ki rangbah ki la wiang badno ki la nguh , Une u briew u la nguh , ‘ Nga lah pun pynjot ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bad ha ki lai snoh ngan tei pat ïa ka .’
translation.en: And said , This fellow said , I am able to destroy the temple of God , and to build it in three days .

translation.kha: Ki shipawa u Amasaïah ki shahjop , bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki phetwir krad sha la ki ïing .
translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel  ; and they fled every man to their tents .

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph , I pa jong phin bad ki ingmane ki para jong ph ki la wan sha phi , ka ri Ijipt ka long ka jong ki .
translation.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee :

translation.kha: U Trai , uba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uba la pynlong ïa ka bad buh ïa ka ha la ka jaka , u la kren-ïa ha nga . Uta kiba ka kthang jong u ka un-long U Trai , u la ong ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the maker thereof , the  Lord  that formed it , to establish it  ; the  Lord  is his name  ;

translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor bad pyllait im ïa nga na iathuh uba pyrshang ngab pynpaw ïa nga bad ïa u kynhun jong nga , bad kumta ban tieng noh ïa moi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .

translation.kha: Ka khet jong me , A Trai , ka la longsem kaba skhem naduh mynnyngkong , bad me la long shuwa ka jingsdang ka por .
translation.en: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop sha ka jingkem ka long kaba khim bad ka lynti kabu ïabam shad ka , ka long kaba eh , bad don jingkyndit ki briew kiba skhem ïa ka .
translation.en: Because strait is the gate , and narrow is the way , which leadeth unto life , and few there be that find it .

translation.kha: Kut ki Pharoah ki la ong ha U Jisu! , reng , ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ba ki synran jong me kin leh ïa kata ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translation.en: And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Phim bit wat tang ban sliew ding ruh ha la ïing ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
NGA smai ba ngan leh ïa kane ha ph u paidlang bymman uba la ïalong ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ang . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa uwei na phi un ïan . Nga , U Trai , to la kren .’
translation.en: I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .

And they come unto thee as the people cometh , and they sit before thee as my people , and they hear thy words , but they will not do them : for with their mouth they shew much love , but their heart goeth after their covetousness .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew jong nga ki ïawan paidbah ban sngap aïu me don ban ong , hynrei kim leh satia ïa kaei kaba me ong ïa ki ba kin leh . Ki ktien ieit ki long ha ki rymmiang shyntur jong ki , hynrei ki ïai bteng ha ki rukom khwan myntoi jong ki .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ngeit ïa nga , ko ka briew , ba ka por kan poi haba ki briew kin ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
translation.kha: Wat ha ka jingshitom jong nga , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .

u jied lai hajan jngut ki rangbah ; u bakut ar hajar ngut na ki bad u ha Meshakh bad ha ka ri lum jong ka Bethel bad u pha shihajar ngut bad u Jonathan u khun jong u sha Gibeah , ha ka thain Benjamin . Ïa kiba sah pat u pham noh sha la ïeng .
translation.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel  ; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth–el , and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin : and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .

This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh ,  ong u syiem Nebukhadnessar .  Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Ym don man mano na ki nongai jingmut na ka ïingsyiem jong nga kiba lah ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me .

U Daniel u la jubab , Bah ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka bynta ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano haei ha uwei pat . Ngan pule na ka bynta u Susim Kynrad ïa Kaei kaba la thoh bad ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , ka por ban tei pateng ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah ka la poi . Ha kata ka por ïa ka ri jongu phi yn pynïaidkam .
translation.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .

translation.kha: Hadien ka Armagedon , yn sa pynlong ïa ka pyrthei ka Paradais
translation.en: After Armageddon , earth will be made into a paradise

translation.kha: Ka la ba-don ka jingpynjot biang hapdeng ki briew namar kine ki ktien .
translation.en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .

translation.kha: Kin mane ïa nga bad ïalam ïa ki lbong bad ki jingri jong ki sha ki jaka phlang ha ka Pyntha ka Sharon ha ka phang sepngi bad ha ka Them ka Jingshitom ha ka phang mihngi .
translation.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in , for my people that have sought me .

He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki jinghikai shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , u dei ban da sum , bad nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ; ka sopti linen , ka patlun lyngkot , ka jingpanpoh , bad ka jaiñspong .
Don sa kaei kadei kawei patiaw kaba nga la ïohi , ka nuksa kaba bha shngain kamon ïa ka jingstad la ñiew ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :

translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa me shun shah ïa u khun jrong nga ban leit , ktang ba un ïoh mane ïa nga , hynrei me la kyntait . mynba te ngan pynïap ïa u khwan nyngkong jong me .’
translation.en: And I say unto thee , Let my son go , that he may serve me : and if thou refuse to let him go , behold , I will slay thy son , even thy firstborn .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , ki shynna san tyrnem ki riat da ka dien akasia bad ki sah ha ki san tylli ki bnoh ; ki suit da ka ksai ïa ki shata bad ki shrong jong ki , bad ki shwa ruh San tylli ki thliew tnga rnong na ka bynta me ki rishot .
translation.en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks : and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold : but their five sockets were of brass .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingput ronsing , ïalumlang sawdong jong ar . U Blei jong ngi un ïalap na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .
Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :
translation.kha: Te mynta , lada phin kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ka jutang jong nga , phin long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka long ka jong nga , bad phi pat phin long ki briew kiba nga la jied ,

translation.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself , and opened her mouth without measure : and their glory , and their multitude , and their pomp , and he that rejoiceth , shall descend into it .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka thngan ïa ki , ka ang pynheh ïa la ka shyntur . Ka klun shapoh ïa ki riewdonburom jong ka Jerusalem bad ki paid ba kaw kaw jong ki riewpaidbah .

U Isaïah nangta u la ïathuh ha u Syiem , U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ka por kan poi ba baroh kaba ha ka ïingsyiem jngai me , baroh kaba ki kpa tmier jong me ki la lum haduh kane ka sngi , yn sa kit nep sha Babilonia . Yn ym don Shuah ka ban sah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: wat rah ïa ka phlait pisa lane ïa ka pla khrong lane ïa ki juti ; wat sangeh ban ïakhublei ïano ïaineh ha ka lyndang .
translation.en: Carry neither purse , nor scrip , nor shoes : and salute no man by the way .

translation.kha: katba ngi dang ap ïa ka jingweng jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jyllang ngi kan paw .
translation.en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : namar me mut ba me stad kum U Blei ,

Nga la pyn-i ha phin ha kiei kiei baroh ba da kiba ba-thurmur shitom ha kane ka rukom i'u dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , da kaba kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba U Trai Jisu da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ka don ka jingkmen kaba hasem khrong ha kaba ai ban ïa kob pdiang .’
translation.en: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .
Also when I cry and shout , he shutteth out my prayer .
translation.kha: Nga kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei u kyntait ban shahshkor ;
ha shu ba kin leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , lane shata ba keiñ rupa hajan ka duwan ban ai ïa ka jingainguh bam khnang ba ktang ym ïarap .
translation.en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation , they shall wash with water , that they die not  ; or when they come near to the altar to minister , to burn offering made by fire unto the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Haba don kano katno ka jingkajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan sha nga , nga hap ban hajar bad rai mano na ki uba dei , malu per ïathuh ha ki ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ U Blei ki ong .
translation.en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .

translation.kha: To hikai ïa ngi aïu ngin ong ha U balui ; ki jingmut jong ngi ki thylli ; ngim anna ei ei ban ong .
translation.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him  ; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .

translation.kha: Uta uba ai ïa ka jingphla jong u ha kane baroh , u ong , Ho-oid da shisha ! Nga Wan kloi ! Ai kan long kumta . To wan , Tharai Jisu !
translation.en: He which testifieth these things saith ,  Surely I come quickly .  Amen . Even so , come , Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: Nangta baroh na kiba lehse im na ki jaitbynriew kiba la tur ïalap ïa ka Jerusalem kin longing Shata men la ka snem ban Mano ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh khim u syiem bad Ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .

translation.kha: Haba u Ïano u phalang sawdong , malade u ïew ïa ki kynthei Bad ïa ki khynnah , u ïong , Kiei kyang ki briew kiba bad phi ? U Jakob u jubab , Ktien , kynrad , ki dei ki khun kiba U Blei u la sngewbha eh baneh ai ïa nga .
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children  ; and said , Who are those with thee ? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .

translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , ibha la samla da ki jaiñ lynñiar lehbha kiba khuid lam bad ki panpoh ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shym jong ki .
translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .

translation.kha: Kane baroh kan long ka jong me , te , lada me mane ïa nga .
translation.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me , all shall be thine .
The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
translation.kha: Ki maw jong ka khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , bad ki pui pui jong u ki don ksiar .

U Dabid u la bah pajut ïa ki ban ong ha u Ïasam , Phi dadien u ba-eh jong nga . Naduh mynta nga bsuh ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka lad u Joab . To U Bela un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam imat kumta !
translation.en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .
For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .
translation.kha: Naba u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh-isynei ha uno uno uba nga kwah ; ngan sngewsynei ïa uno uno uba nga kwah .

translation.en: And Balak s anger was kindled against Balaam , and he smote his hands together : and Balak said unto Balaam , I called thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast altogether blessed them these three times .
translation.kha: U Balak u kham tyngeh ïa la ki sla kti da ka jingbitar bad u ong ha u Balaam ,  Nga la khot ïa me ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei la lai sien me la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .
Ki la thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar ha Sinai bad Mane ïa uta u bleithaw ;
translation.en: They made a calf in Horeb , and worshipped the molten image .

translation.kha: Ngan sah halor u lut ka mirr , u lum ka jingiwbih , tad ynda ka lyer step ka beh bad ba ka jingdum ka jah noh! .
translation.en: I opened to my beloved  ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself , and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him , but I could not find him  ; I called him , but he gave me no answer .
Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
translation.kha: Baroh ki kren shaphang katno u long uba kohnguh bad baïaineh , hynrei shu pyrshang ban wad ïa uno uno uba long kumta !

translation.en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaba kham khlaiñ shuh shuh . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kiba sngewrit .

Naba nga la ïohpdiang na U Trai ïa ka jinghikai kaba sa la ai pateng ha phiah : Ba U Terah Jisu , ha kata ka miet ha naba la shetkylla ïa u , u la shim ïa u kpu , u la nongtuh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ong , une u long ka met jong nga , na ka bynta jongki phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa ang .
translation.en: And when he had given thanks , he brake it , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body , which is broken for you : this do in remembrance of me .
And the sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel .
translation.kha: U Asher bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah lem bad ka Serah ka para jong ki . Ki khun shynrang u Beraïah ki long u Heber bad u Malkhiel .
Ka la leit sha ka ïing jong u Asaraïah bad ka la jingkhublei ïa ka Elisabeth .
translation.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias , and saluted Elisabeth .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katei par u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria badno ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .
translation.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .

translation.kha: Ki Israel laiñ Bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai , da kaba phai pyrsa ïa ki lynghoh Lebi katba bah ïa ka . Shiteng na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jong ki ka phai sha u Lym Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u lum Ebal . U Moses u shakri U tharai u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka na ïa ki ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrduh .
translation.en: And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong , U Trai u la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la kli ïa me .
translation.en: But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .

translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan phai sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar baroh ki la ïa-ap ïa u .

translation.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time  ; and the Egyptians vexed us , and our fathers :

Ym shym la leh da U Blei , umbah la khot ïa pa’ .
translation.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .

translation.kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong nga ka long ba phin lumlang ïa ki Ishmael baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha Kawei pud , ki ban bun katno u shyiap ka rud duriaw , Bad ba ma phi da laiñ hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thma .
translation.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .

translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar ngut ha said ka ïing — ym don Mano mano ba don ryngkat .
translation.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .
I have declared the former things from the beginning  ; and they went forth out of my mouth , and I shewed them  ; I did them suddenly , and they came to pass .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  La slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa kaei ka ban sa jia ; nangta kynsan nga pynlong ba kan jia .

translation.en: Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la otsher phai sha u Elisha , uba dang ap ïa ki ha Jerikho , bad u ong ha ki , Ngam shym la nguh ïa phi ban ym ithuh ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .

translation.kha: Ka la longïng ha kamai ka sngi kumba lah ainguh nohphai sngi mynba u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba u la ïohi da kaba shai kdar ïa u angel jong U blei uba wan hakpoh malade ong ha u , Kornelios !
translation.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .

translation.kha: kumta ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong : Ym don uno un naba hok ,
translation.en: As it is written , There is none righteous , no , not one :

translation.kha: Ki paid ka Hoham ki kyang , ‘ Ka Jinglehbor ! Ka Jingpynjot !’
translation.en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim , spoiling and great destruction .

Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynlong bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , bad ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaba me la kular ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
Pule ïa ka ha ki paid Israel haba ki wei ban mano ïa U Trai U balui jong ki ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .
translation.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .

translation.kha: Mynta ïathuh ïa ki ïa khie kaba ma nga , U Trai nongshoh-nar nga don ban ong shaphang —kata . nur buh ka jingkutlad ïa Kata ka proberb . Yn ym ïai kren shuh ïa ka da lei lei ha Israel . Pynban to ïatih ïa ki : Ka por ka la wan , bad ki jingïathuhlypa ki la urlong shisha !
translation.en: Tell them therefore , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will make this proverb to cease , and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel  ; but say unto them , The days are at hand , and the effect of every vision .

translation.kha: bad uta ruh u rai ba um mian shuh ïa ka , kumta u tah ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga , u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ïing jong u , lane , hajan u tnga jong ka kaba ar u ïarap ,
translation.en: And if the latter husband hate her , and write her a bill of divorcement , and giveth it in her hand , and sendeth her out of his house  ; or if the latter husband die , which took her to be his wife  ;
And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord  God   ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord  God  ?
translation.kha: Pynban , mynta me la leh kham bun , A  Trai  Nongsynshar ; me la pynlong ki jingkular shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan . Bad me shah ïa u briew ban ïohi ïa kane , A  Trai  Nongsynshar !
Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Jerusalem Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?
translation.en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?

translation.kha: Ka la long kaba khriat , kumno ki shakri bun ki nongap phira ki la thap ding da u rnga bad ki la ïeng Sdang jong ka , ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Te u Porsius u la leit shata pynlang u la ïa-ïeng bad ki , ban pynsyaid ïa latai .
translation.en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .

translation.kha: Haba u wan phai na Damaskos , u Ahas u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka duwan ,
translation.en: And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .
I am happy .

kumta nga la pyrkhat , ‘ Ki Philetos kin wan tur ïaleh ïa nga hangne ha jingïaleh , bad ngam shym la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Trai .’ Kumta at sngewrem ba nga daym ban ai ka jingkñia .
translation.en: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal , and I have not made supplication unto the  Lord  : I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .

Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !
translation.kha: Hadien kata , haba u Dabid u la leit sha ïing ban khublei ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing , ka Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u .  U syiem ki Israel u la pynkhraw nam ïa lade ha kane ka sngi !  ka ong .  U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade kum u bieit ha khmat ki shakri kynthei jong ki rangbah synshar jong u .

translation.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
translation.kha: da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri Judah .
U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah sha Bethaben , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .
translation.en: And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .

translation.kha: Um ïashah liang bad ki nongsynshar ne pynpaw ba u kham lah ïa kiba riewspah ban ïa kiba duk , naba u la thaw ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .

translation.kha: Kine ki Jingkhawai niam ki long nalor ki Sabbaton ba ju rakhe , bad kine ki jingainguh ki long nalor ki jingai kiba phira ju ai , ki jingainguh baneh pyndep ïa ka kular , bad ki jingweng mon sngewbha jong phi sha U tharai .
translation.en: Beside the sabbaths of the  Lord  , and beside your gifts , and beside all your vows , and beside all your freewill offerings , which ye give unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka leilieh ka thaba na ki lyoh ,
translation.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u Balaam u la ïohi ïa ki Amalek , bad u la kren ïa kane ka Jingïathuhlypa : U Amalek u Long ka jingïapthngan kaba khlaiñbor tam na Baroh , Hynrei ha kaba kut un jah noh jar .
translation.en: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .

translation.kha: Katba u lyoh u dang neh kamar-tama hajuh , ki jin kim kynriah na ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .
We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Heshbon haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .

translation.en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?

translation.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .
All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .
translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para jong u briew uba duk kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don paralok . Kam pher katno u pyrshang tyngeh , um lah ban ïoh paralok .

Kin wanlam pat ïa borbah ki lai kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kamon ka jingai sngewlah ïa nga . kin wallam ïa ki sha u lum bakyntang jong nga ha Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ha ki ut , bad ha ki kali ïam bad ki kali kit jingkit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingainguh baibam sha ka Templ ha ki khiew lehniam Kiba khuid .
translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u long syiem , ki pyllut Judah kin shongshngain bun ki paid Israel Kin im ha ka jingsuk . Yn khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai ka jingpynim jong ngi .’
translation.en: In his days Judah shall be saved , and Israel shall dwell safely : and this is his name whereby he shall be called , THE  Lord  OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .

translation.kha: Phi ia mynjur bad u Tom , dei ?
translation.en: You agree with Tom , right ?

translation.kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
translation.en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ki biria jong u , Ki jingmong jong phi ki long ki bym lah ban koidi , ïa ki jingmynsaw jong phi ym lah ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Thy bruise is incurable , and thy wound is grievous .

translation.kha: Ka lyer ka beh kat sha kaba ka mon ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba ka pynmih , hynrei ngam tip nangno ba ka wan lane shaei ba ka leit . Ka long kumta ïa wai pa uwei ïa umbiah la kha na U mynsngi .
translation.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .

translation.kha: Lada mano mano ban wan wat tang hajan ka Ïingjaiñ ruh un ïapom , te ine baroh ngi long hi kumne kiba la ïap .
translation.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  shall die : shall we be consumed with dying ?

translation.kha: La haei ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt bad u la hir u briew uba khraw ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
translation.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
And now , O God of Israel , let thy word , I pray thee , be verified , which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko Blei ki Israel , to kan long shisha kumta kumba me la kular ha la u shakri , u Dabid u kpa jong nga .

translation.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod , and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba ïakhleh jaitbynriew kin shong kin sah ha Ashdod . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pyndem lut ïa kine ki Philistia kiba sarong .

translation.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim  ; and they shall be upon Aaron s heart , when he goeth in before the  Lord  : and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the  Lord  continually .

translation.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night , the manna fell upon it .

Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingjia ngin pynkdang ïa ki ban rumal ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym ne shuh uno uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri kaba thup da ka dud bad ka ngap lane ai ha i'u ïa ki lynghoh bad ki brai sohwaiñ kum ka jingkynthih jongnga ngi , bad mynta Phin pyrshang ïa-ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim ïan !
translation.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , ko khuid u briew , wat shemphang ïa ki lane ïa kano kano ba ki ong . Kin beiñ malu ym kheiñ ïa me ; bad kan long kumba im hapdeng ki ñianglartham . La katta ruh , wat sheptieng ïa kito kba ïaleit pyrshah lane ïa kano kano kaba ki ong .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , be not afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns be with thee , and thou dost dwell among scorpions : be not afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki nonghikai ka praw u la ong ha u , Ko nongshniah , haba me ong ïa Kane , me ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ruh !
translation.en: Then answered one of the lawyers , and said unto him , Master , thus saying thou reproachest us also .
Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?
translation.kha: Kumta te , balei mynta phi kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaba buh ka jingkit halor ki met jong ki parabangeit ïa kaba ym don ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lymne ma ngi hi kiba lah ban kit ?
Nga pynlong ïa kane ka jutang malu me : Nga Kular ba men long u kpa tymmen jong ki jingriewblei kiba Bun .
translation.en: As for me , behold , my covenant is with thee , and thou shalt be a father of many nations .

translation.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .

translation.kha: Nangta u la duwai , Ko Trai , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong u bad ai un ïohi . U Trai u Jobab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad u shakri Jong u Elisha haba u peit shajrong malu u la ïohi ïa ka skei lum ba la dup da ki kulai sad ki kali ïapom babha da ka ding baher Sawdong jong u Elisha .
translation.en: And Elisha prayed , and said ,  Lord  , I pray thee , open his eyes , that he may see . And the  Lord  opened the eyes of the young man  ; and he saw : and , behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha .

translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u la long syiem hajuh u la don arphew ar snam ka bta , sad u la synshar shalyntem ha Jerusha . translation.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab : for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly .
