translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki , U Trai u la hukum ba lashai ka den ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynspong shaw u . Shet mynta kat ïa kaba phi dei ban shet , bad pynshitom kat ïa kaba phi daiñ ban pynthnam . Sa buh kyrpang kot ïa kaba tam bad tyngkai ïa ka na ka bynta lashai .
translation.en: And he said unto them , This is that which the  Lord  hath said , To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the  Lord  : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe  ; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning .

translation.kha: hynñiew U Jisu u la ong , Don mano mian ba la ktah ïa ar , naba nga tip ïa ka mynnin ka bor ka la mihnoh na nga .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .

translation.kha: Nangne u Joshua u ïa-ong ïa ki ar ngat ki Rangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongsyntiat , Khie leit sha ka ïohnang lad ka nuti bad wei ïalam ïa ka bad ïa ka longïing longsem Jong ka , kumba phi la kular ïa ka .
translation.en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country , Go into the harlot s house , and bring out thence the woman , and all that she hath , as ye sware unto her .
But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Ar nud ki briew ki lah ban ïada na ka jingtriem ïaleh kaba la ban khop ïa u briew ba tang Moraïah . U tyllai uba la jyrthiaw da ki lai tyllai ki tyllai u long uba jwat ban kdup .
translation.en: And if one prevail against him , two shall withstand him  ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap ïa ki Langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta Pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Israel kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingthoh kiba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U don ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .
translation.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour .
And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Moses ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .
pynphai patiaw ïa ka sha u man la ka janmiet ba un ïoh kup thiah da ka . Te un sngewnguh ïa phi , bad U Trai U Blei’ jong Phi un sngewbha ïa phi .
translation.en: In any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down , that he may sleep in his own raiment , and bless thee : and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka rai jongki ang ka ban ym kylla ba haba ki briew Jong nga ki pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok , ka shadem bad ka jrong jong u mrad ki long ka bynta Jong ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long ka jingai sngewbha jongngi ki briew sha nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons  by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the  Lord .
Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :
translation.kha: To pynkloi ban wan noh sha nga .

translation.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?

translation.kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , nga kular ba u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab un don borabor ïa u shynrang u ban hiarpateng ban shakri ïa nga .
Nangta u —Joshua malade ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la pait noh pat shata Debir bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to Debir  ; and fought against it :

translation.kha: Soh ha u sangeh jong ka balang ha Philadelphia : Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba khuid bad uba shisha . U don u shabi jong u Dabid , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingnang , ym don uba lah ban khang ïa ka , bad haba u khang ïa ka , yn ym don uba lah ban pla ïa ka .
translation.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write  ; These things saith he that is holy , he that is true , he that hath the key of David , he that openeth , and no man shutteth  ; and shutteth , and no man openeth  ;

translation.kha: Me khlem iohnong iakane ka pynrieh na ki mynba jongngi , ngi pyngkiang na ki khun jongki .
translation.en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors , we borrow it from our children .

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong me , ko para ba-ïaitrei , ka la wallam ïa ka jingkmen bakhraw bun jingkynshew bajur ! Me la pynkmen ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew U balui baroh .
translation.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
The trees of the  Lord  are full of sap  ; the cedars of Lebanon , which he hath planted  ;
translation.kha: Ki dieng Kedar jong ka Lebanon ki ïoh shibun u slap — ki dieng jong U  Trai  hi , kiba u la thung .

translation.en: And Leah conceived again , and bare Jacob the sixth son .

translation.kha: Ka jingleit jingïaseng ha ka Kingdom Hall Ki Nongsakhi U Jehosheba , kan ïarap ïa phi ban leh kumta .—Jenesis 11 :9 ; Hebru 10 :24 , 25 .
translation.en: Attending meetings at the local Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses will help you to do so .—Isaiah 11 :9  ; Hebrews 10 :24 , 25 .

translation.kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh’ ! To ïalumlang bad to ïashukor . Ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei mala uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .
translation.en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran , La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah naba la don u shakri suba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingjam jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew pynbyrsieh ba u sordar jong u , u la pyn-i ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,
translation.en: And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria , and reigned forty and one years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Amasaïah u khun jong u Joash kum u syiem ka Judah , u Jeroboam u khun jong u Jehoash u long syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Samaria .

Nga hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka ïing jingkynshew ha ka pyniaid jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi ban pynbiang khlem pynslem ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ha ka Hukum jongki U Blei ka Bneng , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u pan ,
translation.en: And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you , it be done speedily ,

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynjrong ïa ki Syria ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumta ka jingwan jong ki shipai babun , lem sad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad ki Syria ki la pyrkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la khot nong ïa ki syiem Hit bad Ijipt bad ïa ki kynïan shipai jong ki ba-bang wan tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots , and a noise of horses , even the noise of a great host : and they said one to another , Lo , the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites , and the kings of the Egyptians , to come upon us .

Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :
translation.kha: Hynrei , ngan ym knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na u Solomon , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka bor katba u dang im . Kane ngan leh na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jied bad uba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .

Nangta ki pah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Amon ban kupar jingbit ban ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Hynrei u syiem Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u shym Moab , u ruh um shym shahskhor ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki hap ngab sah ha Kadesh .
translation.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .
The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don bad nga , ngan ym sheptieng ; u briew un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?

translation.en: But I say unto you , Swear not at all  ; neither by heaven  ; for it is God s throne :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng , naba ka long ka khet jong U Blei ;

translation.en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?
translation.kha: U Joab u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un pynroi bun ïa ki paid Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki long mynta ! Syiem Kynrad , ki baroh ki dei ki shakri jong phi . Balei phi kwah ban leh ïa kane bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ?

Baroh kim lama ki Apostol ne ki jingïathuhlypa ne ki nonghikai . Ym baroh ki don ïa ka ni ban leh ïa ki kambah lane ïa-ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang lin don kren ha ki thlia bapher lane ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .
translation.en: Have all the gifts of healing ? do all speak with tongues ? do all interpret ?

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar sha ki briew dara u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la lah ong .
translation.en: So Moses went down unto the people , and spake unto them .

translation.kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u khunlung ki la sngewpyngngad ha kiei kiei kiba u Simeon u la kruiñ shaphang jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .

And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u ong ïa u syiem .  Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang kylleng sawdong ka hima jong phi bad ba lah ban shem ha kawei pa kawei ka probins   . Ki bud ïa ki dustur kiba ïapher na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka hima , kumta kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .
Ka Sepher kmie hapoh ka lyngkha ka iehnoh ïa la i khun ba sdang kha namar bym don phlang .
translation.en: Yea , the hind also calved in the field , and forsook it , because there was no grass .

translation.kha: Nangta u Massah Bad kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongriam jongngi ki Israel ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: And Moses gat him into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .
Do not prostitute thy daughter , to cause her to be a whore  ; lest the land fall to whoredom , and the land become full of wickedness .
translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la ki khun kynthei da kaba pynlong nuti ïa ki ha ki jaka mane bleithaw ; lada phi leh kumta , phin phai noh sha kiwei ki blei bad ka ri kan jyllei da ka jingjyrsieh .
Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Jahasiel u shim ïa ka jaiñkup thiah , u woh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlup ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long skhem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .
Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .
translation.kha: Ym don kaba khuid kaba lah ban wan na kano kano ka bymkhuid kat ki khunbynriew .
U Baal hi u la kwah ban leit ha khmut u paidbah , hawei ki parabangeit Kim shahïap ïa u .
translation.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people , the disciples suffered him not .

translation.kha: U kular ba katba ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka erïong ka dang neh , kumin ruh ki Israel kin long ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: If those ordinances depart from before me , saith the  Lord  , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever .

translation.kha: bad napdeng jong ki , la don uba i kamon U Khun U Briew , uba thup ka jaipdeh Kaba kot haduh ki kjat jong u , bad u don u pynpoi ksiar sawdong ka shadem jong u .
translation.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man , clothed with a garment down to the foot , and girt about the paps with a golden girdle .

translation.kha: Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit malu ki lumbah lang pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang nabar ki dieng . Ngan pynkylla ïa ki them wah sha ki jaka shyiap bad pynkyrteng ïa ki pukri um .
translation.en: I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .

translation.kha: hynne ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn smat noh na ki , bad kumta kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .

translation.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness  ; and to brotherly kindness charity .
translation.kha: ha ka jinglong riewblei pynlang ïa ka jingïadei parabangeit ; bad ha ka jingïadei parabangeit pynlang ïa ka jingieit .
Haba phi! wallam sha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bameh jong phi , lang! ym pdiang ïa ki ; ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingri ba phi la pynsngaid ban wallam sha nga kum ki jingainguh .
translation.en: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings , I will not accept them : neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ïaphylliew jingmut ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki Jenesis kiba mane ïa U Blei! , dara ruh ha ki jaka baïap Man ka sngaid bad ki briew kiba jia ryngkhat ki ïaid nangta .
translation.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .

translation.kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem dabi ha Heshbon , bad ki ong ha u , Kenan hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul , u nongshun jong Phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U Trai u la shahïap ïa u Shimham Kynrad pun pynhiarkput ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .

translation.kha: Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jong ki shipai jrong phi , tur ïaleh ïa ka Nongbah , bad knieh ïa ka da lade hi . Nangne kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .
translation.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .

translation.kha: U syier u kiaw ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha bad u sngewbha ïa kito kiba kren ïa ka .
translation.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .

translation.kha: U Trai u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki pangnud Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha ibieit mala ban sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .

translation.kha: U syiem u la ïa-ong , To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Mahseïah , mala u Abednego ! U la phah ïa u angel jongngi u bun pyllait im ïa kine ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga mala ki la khathynñiew ïa la ka jingim don ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei wai tang u jong ki hi .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .

translation.kha: bad kito kiba ha mihngi kin ïaroh ïa u . Ki bariew kiba im harud ka duriaw ktien ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Jesreel .
translation.en: Wherefore glorify ye the  Lord  in the fires , even the name of the  Lord  God of Israel in the isles of the sea .

translation.kha: bad haei ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga ha u Saul ? u Dabid u kylli biang . Kin ai , U Trai u jubab .
translation.en: Then said David , Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul ? And the  Lord  said , They will deliver thee up .
And surely your blood of your lives will I require  ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man  ; at the hand of every man s brother will I require the life of man .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u shim ïa ka jingim briew , yn pynshitom ïa u . Ngan pynshitom da ka jingïap ïa uno uno u mrad uba shim ïa ka jingim briew .
kiba ïasylla nur-um pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba bha bad ria pynrem ïa kiba lui lui shaw ka jingïap .
translation.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles .
translation.kha: Ngam tharai ba nga long uba khampoh khyndiat ban ïa kito ki riewkyrpang ïa kiba la khot ki  apostol  jong phi!

translation.en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan sngewsarong shaphang une u briew — hynrei ngan ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa kiei kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
Wat la u Asa um shym la pynjot lut ïa ki jaka maïan blei thala baroh , u ïaineh ha U Trai katba u dang im .
translation.en: But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .

translation.kha: Te uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen u la leit pait bad wan ïathuh ha U Trai , Nga la bor Rumah me la hukum ïa nga .
translation.en: And , behold , the man clothed with linen , which had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , I have done as thou hast commanded me .

translation.kha: Nga hir U Trai U Blei jongu phi .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Kynrad , phi la kyllan ïa im’ , ‘ Phi dang don kpa ne phi dang don sa shynrang Shua ?’
translation.en: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?
And being found in fashion as a man , he humbled himself , and became obedient unto death , even the death of the cross .
translation.kha: U la long uba sngewrit bad u la ïaid ha ka lynti jong ka jingkohnguh baroh shi lynter lynti sha ka jingïap — ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .

translation.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?
translation.kha: Hato ym dei ba ïa ki san tylli ki sim ïing la die tang ar pisa ? Pynban ym don kawei ruh ka sim ïing ïa kaba la klet noh da U Blei .
Nangta uwei na ki khadar ngut ki synran — uta wahbah kyrteng u Judas Iskariot — u la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ,
translation.en: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,

translation.kha: Naaman ba nawei pa ti un leh ïa kaei katba dei , Kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain jrong .
translation.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace  ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever .
And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,
translation.kha: Kumba u ju leh , u Paul u la leit sha ka synagog . Hangta , ha ki lai tylli ki sngi Sabbaton u la ïatainia bad ki paidbah ,
Ka Nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;
translation.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .

translation.kha: U da ong , Shibun ki kynthei ki long ki tnga kiba bha , hynrei phi long kaba bha tam na ki baroh .
translation.en: Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all .

translation.kha: “Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar baroh kaba snier ba la har da ki paid ka Judah malu ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki syiem bad ki Nongïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki .
translation.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u shah ba kin shahjop ha u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan uba la synshar ha ka nongbah Hasor . U lapbah ai suda jong ka kynhun ba-shiphew jong u , u dei u Sisera , uba shong ha Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan , that reigned in Hazor  ; the captain of whose host was Sisera , which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles .
And Joab said to Amasa , Art thou in health , my brother ? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi long kumno , ko paralok jong nga ?  bad u bat ïa u Amasa na u  ñiuhtmoh jong u da la ka kti kamon ban doh ïa u .
Khmih ba isangsot uno un ym siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da Kaba sngur , hynrei ha ki por baroh to kut jingput ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baher .
translation.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki lapbah lyngngoh ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah ban pan ba u Pilat un pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: But the chief priests moved the people , that he should rather release Barabbas unto them .

translation.kha: U Trei un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong i . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïaduna ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa nga na phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .
Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong u mynta ka sdang ban leit noh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

Keiñ ym pyntngit shuh ïa ailad da ki bleithaw kiba ijli lane pynim ïa lade da ka pop . Ngan pyllait ïa ki na ki lynti jong ka jinglah pah bad ka jingshetkylla ïa nga . Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki , ken hir ki briew jong nga , malu ngan hir U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols , nor with their detestable things , nor with any of their transgressions : but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces , wherein they have sinned , and will cleanse them : so shall they be my people , and I will be their God .

translation.kha: To rwai ha U Trai ! To ïar ïa U Trai ! u la pyllait im ïa kiba la shahïap banbeiñ na ka bor jongnga ki briew basniew .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhluit ka jingbitar jong ki , ki pynnep ïa la ki nongsynshar . Ki syiem jong ki , ki shah pynpyut eiei hadien uwei , hynrei ym anna na ki umbiah khot kyrpad ïa nga ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: They are all hot as an oven , and have devoured their judges  ; all their kings are fallen : there is none among them that calleth unto me .

translation.kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki erlangthari uba lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynshitom beiñ ïa na da ki jingjur — A ïarap ïa nga !
translation.en: All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .

translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot noh kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki bri jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpynkylla kaba nga wallam tista kein junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long ka kut .
translation.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , dat ka long bhor ka jingkmen ba ki rymmiang ki ïoh , kiwei pat mynta ki wan bad ki shim ïa ki jakarieh jong ki .
translation.en: Behold , this is the joy of his way , and out of the earth shall others grow .

translation.kha: U shym u tap ïa la ka durkhmat bad u kyang jam , A , ko khun jong de ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! ko Absalom , ko khulom jong nga !
translation.en: But the king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , O my son Absalom , O Absalom , my son , my son !

translation.kha: Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phin ha kawei ka shnong , to phet sha katai pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi! ba phin ym pat lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam jong phi ha barieh ki sheng jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Khun U Briew un wan .
translation.en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .

translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka wanrah ïa ka jingbet kumba da shisha ka liat na shatei ka Wanlam slap .
translation.en: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .
But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , phi dei ban ngeit bad ban ym artatien da lei lei . Uno uno uba artatien u long kum ka jingat phyllung ha ka duriaw ïa kaba la beh bad ba la pynshad kynting da ka lyer .

translation.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlut hynñiew sngi ha kaba pynkyntang ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew sngi ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .

translation.en: And , behold , there came an old man from his work out of the field at even , which was also of mount Ephraim  ; and he sojourned in Gibeah : but the men of the place were Benjamites .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , uwei u tymmen uba dang wan phai na lyngkha bad ïaid nangta ynda la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lum Ephraim , hynrei ha kata ka por u shong u sah ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei kiba shong hangta ki dei na ka jait Benjamin . )
Hato ‘Phim sngewhun ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban shah ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew , ban ïa kaba ka jaitbynriew baroh khawai ka jot noh ?
translation.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .

translation.kha: Katba U ju u dang bam ha ka ïing u Matthaïos , shibun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kynti ki la ïawan bad shong bad U Jisu lem bun ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Jesus sat at meat in the house , behold , many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples .

translation.kha: Kiba ïan kim lah ban Iohi ne ïohsngew ne sa ei ei .—Eklesiastis 9 :5 , 10 .
translation.en: The dead are not able to see or hear or do anything . —Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .

translation.kha: Uei te uba lamler ? U dei uno Une uba ong ba U Josis um dei U Massah . Kum uta u briew , u long u nongshukor jyllang U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun shwa .
translation.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
Then Jesus saith unto them ,  Children , have ye any meat ?  They answered him , No .
translation.kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ko samla , phi la ïangat ei ei ?   Ei ei ruh em ,  ki la jubab .

Ka kamar rung ka longsyiem marpyrshah ka phlait bashrah . La oh-shrong ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki kynroh baroh shi lynter ka lynti ïaid . La don pharia tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kew sha Kanah ka khyrdop .
translation.en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof : and the going up to it had eight steps .
But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi ïa uba kham palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: O  Lord  , how manifold are thy works ! in wisdom hast thou made them all : the earth is full of thy riches .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong shibun kiei kiei ! Haduh katno me la pynlong ha ka jingstad jong me ïa ki baroh ! Ka pyrthei ka dap tang da ki jingthaw jong me .

ban ym shah pynshaïong jingot da kaba suk ha ka jingpyrkhat jong phi! lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka jingkam ba ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la lah wan . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa ken katba ngi dang jingïathuhlypa lane ïalap , lano ba ngi la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .
translation.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki briew , Ban long uba stad , phi dei baneh don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai . Ban peiphang , phi dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew .
translation.en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .

translation.kha: Tang ma me mawthew men wan sha jan jong nga ; kita kiew pat kim bit baneh wan shaw jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ba wan kiew sha uta u lum .
translation.en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .

translation.kha: U la wan sha la ka jongu ka ri , hynriew ki bhabriew jong u hi kdor shym la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: He came unto his own , and his own received him not .
His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongpop kin kit hi ïa ka jingpynshitom ; ai ba kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: I create the fruit of the lips  ; Peace , peace to him that is far off , and to him that is near , saith the  Lord   ; and I will heal him .
translation.kha: Nga ai jingsuk ïa baroh , ïa kiba hajan bad ïa kiba sha jngai ! Ngan pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga .
Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka manna sawphew snieh lynter , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka ktien U Blei ka la ïai saphriang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka la kad kiew bad nang kiew , bad bun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka iktiar halor ki jaitbynriew badno ki hima ban rat bad ban pynmih , banbeiñ pynjop bad ban bret sharud , Ban tei bad ban thung .
translation.en: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki khampoh bha ban ïa kaba marwei , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei khap bha shibun .
translation.en: Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .

translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to ïashukor ïa kaei kaba nga nguh . Hato la la long kum ka ri shyiap ïa phira , kum ka ri kaba lai bad kaweh ma ? Balei te ba phira ong ba phin leh katjuh kaba phi sngewbha , ba phin ym wan phai shuh shai nga ?
translation.en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?

translation.kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew’ , namar kam Shimham la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dei ban ïap , naba kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kumne ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh sad pynïap ïa uwei pat u briew .
translation.en: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :

translation.kha: Babha u Joseph u la Iohi ïa la ki hynmen , bad u la ithuh ïa ki , hynriewphew u sa kum bym ithuh ïa ki , bad u krong khor ïa ki , Phi kiba na-ei ? Ngi ïaw na ka ri Kanaan , ban thied jingbam , ki jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them , but made himself strange unto them , and spake roughly unto them  ; and he said unto them , Whence come ye ? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .

translation.kha: ki ieit ban shahskhor khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew bad ban shah khot ha ki briew ‘ ko nongkheiñ .’
translation.en: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .

translation.kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka pyrthei kiba ïaw — Ka ne borabor ka jingkhah shuh shuh .
translation.en: Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Tiras ! Ka long kaba bha ban rwai ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi ; ka long kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  : for it is good to sing praises unto our God  ; for it is pleasant  ; and praise is comely .

translation.kha: Ïeng ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka syntied ka jinghun ba ynda ki poi ha ka wah , ki dei ban ïaid ha ki um badno ban ïeng hajan ka rudwah .
translation.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .

Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and his prayer unto his God , and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the  Lord  God of Israel , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba u Manasseh u la leh , ka jingduwai ba u pynlong sha U Blei , bad ki khubor jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
Siba donhok kin rynsied Bad shad , bad kito ki bym lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkren . Ki ïawad ngin tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap ;
translation.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .
And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him :
translation.kha: Une u long u jingthaw bathymmai uba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong u , u ïai pynthymmai ha ka dur jong u hi , khnang ban wallam ïa phi sha ka jingtip ba-pura shaphang jong u .

translation.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem kaba la duh noh ïa la ki khun ban ïa kaba ïakynduh ïa uno uno uba bieit uba bunkam ha ka kam mutlop .

translation.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the  Lord   ; that he might fulfil the word of the  Lord  , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la pynkut noh ïa u Abiathar na kaba shakri kum u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , bad kumta u la pynurlong ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha Shiloh shaphang u Eli , u lyngdoh bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
ngim lah ap shuh , to kajuh ba-bang kren . Ngam lah shuh ban kun ïa ki ktien .
translation.en: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .

translation.kha: Hynrei u da jong ha nga ba ngan sa punkhun sad ïoh khun shynrang . U ïong ïa nga ban Ngim dih wieh lane dih kyiad , dawai bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid , namar uta u khunlung un un-long uba yn pynkyntang shai U Blei koum u Nasir katba u dang im .
translation.en: But he said unto me , Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink , neither eat any unclean thing : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death .

translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab , hato u Job un Mane ïa me lada um ïohi ei ei na ka ?
translation.en: Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Doth Job fear God for nought ?

translation.kha: U Ladan u don lai ngat ki kynhun shynrang : u Jehiel , u Setham , bad u Joel ,
translation.en: The sons of Laadan  ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .

translation.kha: Ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei um jubab , naba ki long kiba Sargon sad ba-bymman .
translation.en: There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un buh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh hynñiew sngi .
Me la Jubab ïa por Bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .
translation.en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit sha u Ïoannis bad ki la ong , Ko nongai , phi kynmaw ïa u bri wahbah la don lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jongki ka wah Jordan , ïa uba phi la kren shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , u la pynbaptis mynta , bad baroh ki la leit sha u !
translation.en: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .

translation.kha: kamut khie leit bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u leit hiar sha ka wah nylla . Raamah bad me ïa u diengthang ïa kiba la pynkylla bsa , bad ap ïa u harud wah .
translation.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong shaphang u Joahas , u khun jong u Jehoahas , uba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u kum u syiem ka Judah , U la leit noh nangne , un ym wan pait shuh .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah , which reigned instead of Josiah his father , which went forth out of this place  ; He shall not return thither any more :

And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
translation.kha: Nangta u jop ïa ki Moab . U la phah thiah ïa ki koidi ha madan bad pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai ngut . Kumta ki Moab ki kylla long noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki siew khajna sha u .
ïa u Emerald , u sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translation.en: And the second row , an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .

translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ki jingbishar jong me kiba mynbarim , bad ki wallam jingpyndep ïa nga , A Tiras .
translation.en: I remembered thy judgments of old , O  Lord   ; and have comforted myself .

translation.kha: lada sa la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mih hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —
translation.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :

translation.kha: To longkmie kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit Jong nga , haduh ba U Terah un wan . Khmih katno u nongpynjot u long Uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa la ka khyndew ban pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa u sleit synrai mala ïa u slap pyrem .
translation.en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .

translation.kha: U Paul u la ïong , Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ka longïng na ka bynta kito kiba la phai ne na ki pop lad ki ; bad u la ïashoh ha ki paid Israel pun ngeit ha uta u ban sa wan hadien jong u — kata , ha U Jeshua .
translation.en: Then said Paul , John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance , saying unto the people , that they should believe on him which should come after him , that is , on Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: La pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Mynsiem ha kano kano ka rukom ha uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingbha ïa baroh .
translation.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal .
How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
translation.kha: Bad ngi dih ïa ka jingbymman la kum ba ka dei ka um ; ho-oid , ngi long kiba bamsap ; ngim dondor ei ei .
Ha kata ka Die U thri u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ong , Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsait na ka bynshet jong la hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ban leh Khmut ruh ha Rom .
translation.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ka jingkhaïi bastad bad me ïai pynïohnong . Katno uba sarong me longkmie ïa ka spah jong me !
translation.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches , and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :
And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .
translation.kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .
Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha kawei pat ka rukom ha ki ar ngut na ki kaban ki dang ïa-ïaid lyngki sha la shnong .
translation.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them , as they walked , and went into the country .
For wheresoever the carcase is , there will the eagles be gathered together .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalumlang .

translation.en: ( For after all these things do the Gentiles seek : ) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things .
translation.kha: ( Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba ki nongmane blei thala ki ju ïai pyrkhat borabor . ) U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .

Ngin ap phira ïa ka ri jong nga bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Teng ym shah shuh ïa ki nongbanbor ba banbeiñ ïa ki briew lad nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong per ki la shahshitom .
translation.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .

translation.kha: Nangta i pa i ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi tip ba ka Rakhel ka tnga jong nga ka ieh tang ar ñiut ki khur shynrang na nga .
translation.en: And thy servant my father said unto us , Ye know that my wife bare me two sons :
He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
translation.kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongbanbeiñ bad u pynlong ïa ki ban sakma ha ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .

translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Dabid ,  Da shisha phi tip ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka liang jong nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .
translation.kha: Pynban , hadien lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la phet noh sha u Akhish , u syiem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .

Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynum ka pyrta ïa kawei paw , ‘ Nga la tem ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta jongu phi , hynrei ‘Phim shym shad ! Ngi la rhah ki jingïarwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym ïam !’
translation.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .

translation.kha: Nangta u la phar ïa ki jingkam shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia shuh U Trai bad ki la kñia katto katne thylli ki jingri kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .
translation.en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong , Ka kyrteng jong me kam longkmie shuh u Jakob . Me la ïaleh bad U balui malade ki briew , Bad me la jop ruh ; kumta ka ktung jong me kan long ei u Israel .
translation.en: And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .

translation.kha: Ki pynbor ïa kiba duk ban kyrpad jam sha U Blei , pynlang u la jingsngewsih ïa ki jingpyrsad jong ki banbeiñ ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .

translation.kha: U shakor , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la jubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngim ym pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade .
translation.en: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .
For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword , but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee : because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka jingma , bad yn ym pynïap ïa me . Men lait im namar me la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
La Don lai tylli ki khyrdop ha kawei katai ka liang : Lai tylli ha ka phang Mihngi , lai thlia ha ka phang shathie , per tylli ha ka phang shatei , bad lai tyllai ha ka phang sepngi .
translation.en: On the east three gates  ; on the north three gates  ; on the south three gates  ; and on the west three gates .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ïa baroh , Namar ym don ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u krung kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .
translation.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .

translation.kha: u Mahlon bad u kylliang ruh ki la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah ieh sa tang Merari , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynrang .
translation.en: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi long ki jong U Balei , kdew la ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka jingkyrshan jong u banbeiñ .
translation.en: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .

translation.kha: Hynrei uba ïeng hajan hangta uba kyrteng u Elihu um lah kun shuh ïa la ka jingbitar , Naamah u Job u pynksan ïa lade bad u kynnoh ïa U Blei . ( U Elihu u dei u khup jong u Barakel , uba hiarpateng na u Bus , Bad u dei na ka kur jong u Ram . )
translation.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïathuh ïa phira ba U Trai U Blei jong phin un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor lad ngi , hynrei u Hesekaïah u shukor ïa phi bad un shad ba phin ïap na ka jingtynjuh bad ka jingsliang .
translation.en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst , saying , The  Lord  our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
They are of those that rebel against the light  ; they know not the ways thereof , nor abide in the paths thereof .
translation.kha: Ki don ki briew kiba kyntait ïa ka jingshai ; kim sngewthuh ïa ka lane ki leit sha kaba ka ïalam .

U Sedekaïah u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Nongsynshar , uba pynbor ïa u sad shaei ha ka kthang U Blei ba un ïaineh ha u . Da kaba leh mutlop u kyntait ban ba-mutlop bad ban phai pat sha U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar , who had made him swear by God : but he stiffened his neck , and hardened his heart from turning unto the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat uei ruh i shñiuh na ki khlieh jong phi in ym jah noh .
translation.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish .

translation.kha: Ka jingkthang jong nga ka kylla sha ka jingsuk . Me pyllait ïa ka jingim jong nga na ka jingma baroh’ ; me map ïa ki pah jong nga baroh .
translation.en: Behold , for peace I had great bitterness : but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption : for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back .

translation.kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u , bad u , un long u khun jong nga . Haba u leh bastang , ngan sneng sympat ïa u kumba u kpa u sngur sympat ïa la u khun .
translation.en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son . If he commit iniquity , I will chasten him with the rod of men , and with the stripes of the children of men :

translation.kha: U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , ïa Uto u seiñ hyndai — kata , u Ksuid lane u Soitan — bad u la teh kynjri ïa u haduh shihajar snem .
translation.en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,

translation.kha: U Joppa u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongshun kan tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki shipai Israel , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .
translation.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoash u wan phai , u la kurup ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u shym lad ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Husiar ka long kaba khlaiñ tam na kito ki hima baroh . )
translation.en: And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .

translation.kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa uba la ñiewburom ba ha baroh ki balang na ka beit ka jingtei jong u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .
translation.en: And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;

translation.kha: Me wanrah ïa ki jingujor bakthang pyrshah ïa nga , wat ïa kaba na la leh mynba por dang khynnah .
translation.en: For thou writest bitter things against me , and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .
That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ban bud ïa ka jingïalam jong kiba kum kita ki briew , bad uno uno de uba trei bad shakri lang bad ki .
U angel U Trai u wanpaw ha ka malade u nong , pham shym la lah ban ïoh kynhun , hynrei sher phan sa punkhun bad phan ïoh ïa u khun shynrang .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto the woman , and said unto her , Behold now , thou art barren , and bearest not : but thou shalt conceive , and bear a son .
How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?
translation.kha: Kumta da kumno ngan shem ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Blei ?
Ka met jong u kan khie lung kumba dang samla bad ban khlaiñ pat ;
translation.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
translation.kha: ki kylli na U  Trai  ,  Dang don shuh mano mano ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  u Saul u don hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .
Ki shipai ki la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki koidi baroh , khnang ban da ïa ki na kambah jongki shiah rud duriaw pynlang shun lait phet .
translation.en: And the soldiers  counsel was to kill the prisoners , lest any of them should swim out , and escape .
Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .
translation.kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , ki Rephaim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .
Katto katne ngut ki Rangbah ki la wan da kaba bah ha ka jingthiah ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , bad ki la pyrshang ban rakhe ïa u shabi ïing malu ban buh ha khmat jong U jongu .
translation.en: And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .

translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Abimelekh bad ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban ïashun iwei ïa iwei pateng , bad ki la ïaheh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem  ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech :

translation.kha: Hadien kata un khmih bha ïa ka , bad dalade kata ka jingbthuh kam kylla rwai , wat la Kam pur , ka dang Long hi ka bymhok ; dei ban thang noh ïa ka , kam pher la —kata ka jingbthuh ka long na shapoh ne shalor .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague , after that it is washed : and , behold , if the plague have not changed his colour , and the plague be not spread  ; it is unclean  ; thou shalt burn it in the fire  ; it is fret inward , whether it be bare within or without .

translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u wallam ïa ki brup na ki nongbah Babilon , Kuth , Ibbah , Hamath , bad Sepharbaim , dara pynshongduh ïa ki ha ki nongbah ka Samaria , ha ka jaka jong ki Israel ba la shahshkor jingkraw . Ki shimti ha lai ïa kine ki nongbah malu ki sah hangta .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon , and from Cuthah , and from Ava , and from Hamath , and from Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel : and they possessed Samaria , and dwelt in the cities thereof .

translation.kha: hynne ngin thaw ïa phi u kynjri da ka ksiar bad ki jingpynitynnat da ka sien .
translation.en: For , lo , the winter is past , the rain is over and gone  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka miet shuwa ba u Herod un wallam ïa u sha u paidbah , u Petros u dang ïohthiah hapdeng ar ngut ki nongap phira . La teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri , nabar la don ki nongap phira kiba ap ha ka khyrdop jong ka byndi .
translation.en: And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .
translation.kha: Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng :  U  Trai  u la pynim ïa ki shakri jong u , ki Israel !

translation.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack , O king , live for ever : tell thy servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u syiem ha ka ktien Aramaik ,  To u Syiem Kynrad un im junom ! To ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi , bad ngin batai ïa ka ha phi .

Ki jubab , ‘ Ngi dih ki shakri jong U Balei ka bneng bad ka khyndew , badno ngi tei pat ïa ka Templ kaba lah dep tei bad pynphriang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat bun snem mynshuwa da u skhem bakhrawbor ka Israel .
translation.en: And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka nongbah jongnga ka Samaria kin sheptieng bun ïam sngewsih namar ka jingduh noh ïa u masi ksiar ha Bethel . Ma ki bad kita ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ïa u paitlieng kin ïamih sngewsih namar jong u . Jin sa ïam pangnud haba yn law lyngkhuit ïa ka jingthaba rong ksiar jong u .
translation.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it , and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it , for the glory thereof , because it is departed from it .

translation.kha: ba ma at , U Trai U Blei ki Israel , nga la buh ka jingtim halor uwei uwei baroh u bymneh ïa ki kyndon jong kane ka jutang .
translation.en: And say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant ,

translation.kha: Gaal kumta nga nguh ha phi ba ki brisoh ki haka ban ïohmap ïa kano kano ka pop bad ïa katno kano kaba sner kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno uba kren kiei kiwei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym Ïoh jingmap .
translation.en: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .

translation.kha: Nga ïaphai bteng ïa ka jingleit sha Jeroboam ,
translation.en: So I came to Jerusalem , and was there three days .

Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoïakim u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u bad ki kam bymman kiba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah . U Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
U Joseph u ong ha kita ki bri , Phai ioh mynta ba nga la thied ïa phi nabar ïa ki khyndaiphew jong phi na ka bynta u syiem . Shim eit u symbai ba phin ïabet ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold , I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you , and ye shall sow the land .

translation.kha: Haba ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shu knieh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu Shim ïa ki . Ym ni ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem jongno jinghun kaba shongshngain .
translation.en: And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u prie jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynpoi ïa u Asahel u hynmen u para jong ki ha ka thma ha Gibeon .
translation.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .
And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synran ïa u ; kumta ka kynhun ka long kaba bun .
U Akhaikos u ai ïa kane ka jingthoh ha u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad , uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ki aiñ bad ki lawbah kiba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel :
translation.en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the  Lord  , and of his statutes to Israel .

translation.kha: Ïa kiew kiei baroh dei ban leh ha ka rukom kaba dei bun kaba rynsan .
translation.en: Let all things be done decently and in order .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan bat ïa la ka jutang bad u khun jong me u Isaak , ïa uba ka Sarah kan sa kha ha me kum ha kane ka im ha ka snem ka ban wan .
translation.en: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac , which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year .

translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Gibbethon Hattaabah ( kabu mut ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah ) , Namarba hangta ki la Thep ïa ki briew’ kiba la kwah rhah pun bam doh .
translation.en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .

translation.kha: Lada ka long kob shisha ba kum kata ka nang bymman ka la jia ha Israel , ïalum ïa kita ki bariew shabar ka khyrdop shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap .
translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman , which have committed that wicked thing , unto thy gates , even that man or that woman , and shalt stone them with stones , till they die .

translation.kha: Dei ban bam ïa ka jingbam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khrup ïa ka ; drama bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; Bad ym dei ban pynheh wat tyngkan kaweh ruh ka shyieng jong u mrad .
translation.en: In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .
Now when the congregation was broken up , many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas : who , speaking to them , persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki paidbah ki la mihnoh na ka jingïalang , ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas la bud da kiba bun ki Jiw bad da kiba bun ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam ki Jiw . Ki apostol ki la kren ha ki bad ki la pynshlur ïa ki ban ïai im ha ka jingaiei jong U Blei .

translation.en: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins ;
translation.kha: Mynshuwa phi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong mynsiem namar ka jingbymkohnguh bad ki pop jong phi .

bad u duwai , A Trai U Blei ki Israel , ym don U Blei uba kum ma me ha bneng shynrang ne ha khyndew shapoh ! Me bat ïa ka jutang bad me pynpyut ïa la ka jingieit ha la ki jong ki briew kiba kohnguh ïa me naduh ka mynsiem .
translation.en: And he said ,  Lord  God of Israel , there is no God like thee , in heaven above , or on earth beneath , who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :

translation.kha: U law ïa ki , Man kaba kput ka hynñiew snem , ynda poi ka sngi ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kane ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,

translation.kha: Ka lehbha ka la punkhun bajrong bad ka kha ïa u khun uba hynñiew ïa u ïakob .
translation.en: And Leah conceived again , and bare Jacob the sixth son .
And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the  Lord  for a drink offering .
translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh da ka waiñ lem bad u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , theh shi litar ka waiñ ha ka duwan .
Kum u Manasseh u kpa jongngi u , u la bor pah pyrshah ïa U tharai , bad u la mane ïa ki thliew kaba u khop jong u , u la mane .
translation.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did Manasseh his father : for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made , and served them  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïalap ha por bad ki ong , Wat ïalap ha ngi . Wat ïalap shaphang kata baroh . U Blei un ym pynjahburom ïa ngi .
translation.en: Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :
translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade , namarkata , hapoh ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Get thee up  ; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïeng joit ! Balei me dem sah kumne ha khyndew ?
Kane ka kynthup ïa kata ka thain baroh kaba shwa mihngi na ka kah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shngain shai , malu nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shang mihngi .
translation.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Me long u nonghikai uba khraw ha Israel , bad Amam tip ïa kane ?
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?

translation.kha: Kumno me lah ban ong ba mem shym la pynngat ïa ailad , ba niam pat ju mane ïa u Baalis ? Ha khmih kumno me la leh pop ha ka dem ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kum ka ut khlaw ha ka por jingkhih shongkha jong ka , kaban mareh laitluid kylleng ,
translation.en: How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;
And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
translation.kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh .

translation.en: And Joshua said , Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave , and set men by it for to keep them :
translation.kha: U ong ,  Pyntyllun katto katne ki maw kiba heh ha khmat kata ka krem . Buh katto katne ki nongap phira hangta ,
U Bel u la ong ha u , Dei lyngba u Isaak ba Man ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .
translation.en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :

translation.kha: Me buh ïa ka duriaw-bah halor jong ka kum ka barandi , bad ka um ka slap ïa ki lwa .
translation.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment : the waters stood above the mountains .

translation.kha: Na ka byndi U Khrist ngi long kiba bieit ; hynriew , phi long kiba stad ha U Khrist ! Ngi long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long katba khlong ! Ngi long kiba la ibeiñ , hynrei phi longsyiem naba la pyndonburom !
translation.en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .

translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u pyllew , La shuh ïa me ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade . U Paul u la kner ïa la ka kti malu u la ïasaid da ïa lade! kumne :
translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :
Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant s name was Malchus .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros , uba kieng ïa ka waitlam , u la sei ïa ka bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u da mait ïa ka shkor kamon jong u . Ka kyrteng uta u mraw ka long u Malkhos .

translation.en: Jesus’ ministry included teaching , performing miracles , and even offering up his life for us
translation.kha: Ki Kam u Jisu ki kynthup ïa ka ban hikai , ban leh ïa ki kambah , wat haduh ban aiti noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi
Haba U Jisu u la dien ïashoh ïa kine ki Parosh , u la ingiew ïa kata ka Jaka
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .
translation.kha: A Blei , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga . To pynbha pat ïa ka Templ jong me , ïa kaba la pynjot ; to pynbha ïa ka khnang ba uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei .

translation.en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit mynta , ym namar kaei kaba pha la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma ngi hi da lade ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi tip ba une da shisha u long u Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .
bad pynbeit ïa ki um ka duriaw ba kin ym kiew palat ban ïa kaba u la ainong . Nga la ni hangta mynba u buh ïa ki nongrim ka Pyrthei .
translation.en: When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :

translation.kha: Leh ïa kamai kaba nga ino , bad phna ïoh im . Da sumar bha ban bud ïa ki jinghikai lad nga kumba phi sumar ïa la ki khmat ;
translation.en: Keep my commandments , and live  ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .

translation.kha: Kim shym la ngeit , namar ba ïa ki jingmut jongngi ki la kah dum da u blei basniew jong kan ka pyrthei . U khangkdong ïa ki ba kan ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaban tyngshaiñ ha ki , ka jingshai kaba mihnoh na kata ka Khroh Babha shaphang ka burom jong U Khrist , uba long ka dur jong U Blei .
translation.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not , lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ , who is the image of God , should shine unto them .

translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew umbiah sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u brisoh wahbah hangamei , wahbah sarong bad u bym ju kheiñ briew .
translation.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Elumas ( kata ka long ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngskor na ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir , and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim , which is Chesalon , on the north side , and went down to Beth–shemesh , and passed on to Timnah :
translation.kha: ha kaba u tawiar shaphang sepngi jong ka Baalah sha ka ri lum jong ka Edom , ter ter sha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Jearim ( lane Khesalon ) , arsut sha Beth Shemesh , bad ter ter lyngba ka Timnah .
Pha la kyntu noh ym tang na kaba ïahap ïa ki riewkynthei , hynrei phi la lute ïa ki khunswet ba la shahshkor lehbeiñ .
translation.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .

translation.kha: Kane ka ri ka ïar naduh ka shngain Arod harud ka Wah Arnon haduh u lem Seïon ( Sirion ) shaphang shatei , ( kaba mut , u lum Hermon . )
translation.en: From Aroer , which is by the bank of the river Arnon , even unto mount Sion , which is Hermon ,
And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban don ka jingai ban ïalap da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingtip baroh bad shemphang ha ki jingmaïan baroh ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donkam ban pynkynriah ïa ki lumbah — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ngam long ei ei .

translation.en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , wat u briew u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba stad un nang na kata kaba la hikai ïa u .
To ïakhublei parabangeit da ka jingdoh pyniwbih .
translation.en: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss .

translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingshai kaba shisha — ka jingjai kaba wan sha ka pyrthei bad pynshai ha u bynriew baroh .
translation.en: That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .

translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bym don jingmyntoi ki la hynne na kaba ïaineh ha me .
translation.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .

translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglehmeng ïa ph ha ka kyrteng jong nga . ngiam shym phah ïa ki . Ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , de la krung .’
translation.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u nguh , Ngam don shuh u kpoh paidbah , don sa tang u kpoh ba la pynkyntang ; phi lah ban bam ïa u tang paila ki rangbah jong phi kim shym la ïatih shongkha dang shen .
translation.en: And the priest answered David , and said , There is no common bread under mine hand , but there is hallowed bread  ; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin long kum ka umjer ba pynpyngngad ba la phah da U Trai na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shaniah ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha u Massah ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit rit na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .
translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u la kylli na U  Trai  ïa kaei ba u Dabid u dei ban leh , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Dabid bad ïa ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia .

Na ka pyntha Kane ka Pyrta , shrong san tylli ki riewsaid da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jongnga ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka khiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynda kine ki rishot .
translation.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .
And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
translation.kha: Un phah noh ïa ki angel sha sawdong ka pyrthei ban ïalumlang ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , na kawei ka dong jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
U Dabid u la pyllut im ïa baroh’ bad ïa kai kiei baroh uba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnaw Jong u ar nguid .
translation.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .
Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
translation.kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim shym lah ban beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha kito ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki dang ïaishong hangta .
U Joshua u Shakri U Trai , u khun jong u Nun , u la ïapom ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Aiu ba u wanlam lem bad sawspah jrut ki nongbah . Kumta u pynïabynta ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga kylla ar ngut .
translation.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .

translation.kha: nabar hadien kata u la im sa phraspah katsha snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translation.en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Kin long ka dak jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai Benabinadab Baroh ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangtai la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U Trai ban ïohi jingïapan , un phah ïa uno uno ban pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .

translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha ; hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingbang jong ka , kumto phi lah ban pynbang pat ïa ka ? To anna ïa ka mluh jong ka jingïalong paralok hapdeng jong phi , bad para ma phi , to im hapdeng ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his saltness , wherewith will ye season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and have peace one with another .

translation.kha: nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : La don shisien uei u briew uba la don uwei u diengsoh Dumbur uba miaw ha ka thri sohwaiñ jong u . U la leit khmih soh Dumah ha u hynrei um shym ei ei .
translation.en: He spake also this parable  ;  A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard  ; and he came and sought fruit thereon , and found none .

translation.kha: Khim ka jingsyllad ka jingshlei um bakhraw u pynjot tiew ïa ki nongshun jong u ; u phah sha ka jingïap jong ki ïa re uba pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof , and darkness shall pursue his enemies .
