translation.kha: Hadien u Japheth , u Ishbah umbah na Bethlehem u ïalum ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And after him Ibzan of Beth–lehem judged Israel .

translation.kha: Kane ka la wia ha ka snem kaba kad jong ka jingsynshar u Amasa u syiem ka Judah . Bad kumta u Baasha u longïing u syiem ka Israel ha ka jaka u Nadab .
translation.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him , and reigned in his stead .
Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u long ka jingbahkhlieh ba ngin sa ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ha ki briew jong u , bad kane ka pynthikna ïa ngi ba U Blei un ai ka jinglaitluid kaba pura ha kito kiba long ki jong u . To ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom jong u!

Ang ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , bad nga ktieh ; ki rmiang shyntur jong sa ki khiar da ka jingsheptieng . Ka met jong de ka jem lwep , bad ki kjat jongngi per ki jynthut hapoh jong nga . Ngan ap jar jar ïa ka por ka ban wan haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa kito kiba ter ïaleh ïa ngi .
translation.en: When I heard , my belly trembled  ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself , that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba ki ïasah mem , uwei na ki u plie ïa la ka byrni banbeiñ ai bam ïa ka Kada jong u , bad u lap ïa ka pisa jong u ha khlieh eh ka byrni .
translation.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money  ; for , behold , it was in his sack s mouth .

translation.kha: Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewsih , bad ïa u briew wahbah la leh ïa kaba kum Katai kaei kaei la dei ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong ph .
translation.en: And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .

translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliem tnaw jong ka ; ïa ka pyrda ïa ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka ; ïa ki snar jong ka Ïingjaiñ ; ïa ki thong baroh kiba pynkdang ha ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,

translation.kha: Ka khyndew hi ka pynlong ïa u jingtngen ban syang bad ban seisoh ; nyngkong u speh balung u mih , hadien ka kop , malade khatduh ka kop ba-ima da u symboh kew .
translation.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself  ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Me la lah ïohi ïa u , bad u dei uta uba ïakren bad me mynta .
Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlaw da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la ih khohsiew , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
translation.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .

translation.kha: Mynta ka dih ka prie ba ïa kane ka pyrthuh yn bishar ; mynba ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .
translation.en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .

translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jyllang ki kpa Thummim jongnga me , U balui Jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jehoba .’ U Moses u la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad um shym la nud ban peitmat .
translation.en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .

translation.kha: Gera kumta da ka jingsngewieit bajylliew kin duwai na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei kaba koit tam kaba U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi .
translation.en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .

translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba Shisha , da ka dohnud kaba shlei da ka jingbeit ïa la u khun , ka ong ha u syiem , jingsngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka ! Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong , Wat ai ïa u hano hano na ngi ; to leh bad phiah arliang ïa u .
translation.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king , for her bowels yearned upon her son , and she said , O my lord , give her the living child , and in no wise slay it . But the other said , Let it be neither mine nor thine , but divide it .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to sumar ïoh ba isangsot uno na phi u don ka dohnud kaba sner eh malade bymngeit kot haduh ba un da phai dien noh na U Balei uba im .
translation.en: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh ïa ki shynrang ba dang kham samla to kyntu jur ïa ki ban synshar bha ïa lade .
Phi dih waiñ na ki khuri ba-dap , bad phi pyndonkam da ki jingsleh bakha kynsai tam , isynei phim khim ïam sngewsih halor ka jingshah pynjot ki Jeruel .
translation.en: That drink wine in bowls , and anoint themselves with the chief ointments : but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai nongsumar , ar kular kyntang ba ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong kin sha pynpoh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I have lifted up mine hand , Surely the heathen that are about you , they shall bear their shame .
And of Levi he said , Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one , whom thou didst prove at Massah , and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah  ;
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Lebi u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpaw ïa la ka mon da u Urim bad u Thummim   Lyngba ki Lebi , ki shakri kiba ïaineh jong me . Me la tynjuh ïa ki ha Massah , Bad me la phrang ïa ki ha ki um ka Meribah .
Ïa ka Assyria yn pynstet ha ka thma , hyndai ym da ka tam briew . Ki nong Assyria kin phet ïap na ka thma , bad ïa ki samla shynrang jong ki yn pynlong mraw .
translation.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword , not of a mighty man  ; and the sword , not of a mean man , shall devour him : but he shall flee from the sword , and his young men shall be discomfited .
He ate an apple .
translation.kha: U Bam Ia U Soh Apple .
Ki nong Babilonia ki kem ïa ki briew da ki khaïi , la kumba ki den ki dohkha . Ki jingleit ïa ki na ki jar sad ki rai da ka jingkmen ïa ka jingïoh jong ki !
translation.en: They take up all of them with the angle , they catch them in their net , and gather them in their drag : therefore they rejoice and are glad .

translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ka jingkhem kaba khraw , ko Trai ; me la pynjrong ïa ki ban kmen . Ki shadkmen ha Kaei kaba me la leh kumba ki brup ki shadkmen haba ki ot kew lane haba ki ïabynta ïa ka spah ba la ïoh kynrup .
translation.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation , and not increased the joy : they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest , and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba donkam ban pynstang jar ïa ka jingïathuh jong ki , namar ki pynkylla khongpong ïa ki longïing baroh da kaba hikai ïa kiei kaba kim dei ba hikai , nabar baroh ka long ïa ka jingthmu basngewlehrain ban thaw pisa .
translation.en: Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre s sake .

translation.kha: Ki tei ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh ,
translation.en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .
And they that understand among the people shall instruct many : yet they shall fall by the sword , and by flame , by captivity , and by spoil , many days .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bastad jong ki briew kin ïasam ïa ka jingstad jong ki bad kiwei pat ki briew babun . Hynrei shipor katto katne na ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane shah thang ïap , bad katto katne kin shah lute bad shah pynlong koidi .

Pynban , ha shuki ba kine kiei kiei baher kin jia , ïa phi yn kem bad pynshitom buiñ ; yn aiti ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog malu ban shah thep ha ka bynriew ; yn wallam ïa phi ha khmat ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar na ka bynta jngai nga .
translation.en: But before all these , they shall lay their hands on you , and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues , and into prisons , being brought before kings and rulers for my name s sake .
By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur da ka sur kren jong u .

U Mesha bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dat ban shong dara ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ shapoh mihngi . Kinah kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam niam baroh kiba de ban pyndih ha ka Jaka Kyntang na ka bynta ki Israel . Uno uno uwei bapaw uba pynryngkang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .
translation.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .

translation.kha: U ïap namar ba um lah synshar ïa lade ; ka jingïailong mutlop jong u kan ïalam ïa u sha ka jingtep jong u hi .
translation.en: He shall die without instruction  ; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray .

translation.kha: ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew kumba U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jongki ki briew jong U Blei . To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kut ngi kyrpad ïa phi ba Phon map ïa ka kam sniew kaba ngi , ki shakri jongngi U Blei u kpa jong pa’ , ngi la leh . U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kano .
translation.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .
Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wan jia ha phi .

translation.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha u ban shah pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ki bseiñ — uei uba la ïathuh ha phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?

U ïong ha kine ki lapbah , Ma nga , u syiem Serug , na la phah ïa ki shrak jongngi nga sha ka bashatei , ka mahadei ; ryngkat bad ka hukum , bad ka kynta ban kohnguh ïa ka ! Aïu ka aiñ ka kren ba ngi dei ïa-ban leh ïa ka ?
translation.en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki lehbeiñ ïa ngi bad pyntrei jubor ïa ngi kum ki mraw .
Kumta te , ko phyrngab jngai ngi , to ïeng skhem bad batskhem ha kita ki jingshisha kiba ngi la hikai ïa phi , ha ka jingialeh jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong ngi .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .

translation.kha: ngi dei ban nguh ha ka jingpyndem , ñiar dang haka ban ni ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust  ; if so be there may be hope .

translation.kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa u Dathan bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;
translation.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la jied la slem bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , na long U Blei nabar ym khong aiwai pat kumno ma nga .
translation.en: Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,

translation.kha: Phi ieh Hynrei sngi ban trei jingri , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ban long kaba kyntang , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga U Terah . Uno uno uba trei ïa kan kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
translation.en: Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day , a sabbath of rest to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death .
And the king said , Who is in the court ? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king s house , to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .
translation.kha: Don mano mano na ki rangbah synshar jong nga ha ïingsyiem ?  u syiem u kylli . Mynta u Haman u dang shu rung ha phyllaw ; u la wan ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien phasi ïa u Mordekai ha ka diengphasi kaba la dep pynkhreh .
Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi bad on khrawbor .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .

translation.kha: Nangta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u symboh Edom baneh pan jingbit Ban ïaid Lyngba ka ri jongngi u . Hynrei u sahmiet Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u syiem Moab , u ruh um shym Shah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . kumta ki Israel ki hap ban sah ha kadei .
translation.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .

translation.kha: Te phin shong ha ka ri ba por la ai ha ki kpa tmain jongno phi . Phin erlangthari ki briew Jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers  ; and ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .

translation.kha: Ïeng joit , ïa ngin ïaleit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !
translation.en: Rise up , let us go  ; lo , he that betrayeth me is at hand .

translation.kha: Ki bymdon ki sarong bad pynshitom biah ïa kiba juk ; pynngat ïa ki ha ki jingriam kiba ki la thaw .
translation.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .

translation.kha: U ngam jong u , u ribon kat u khung ha ka kor u nongthain jaiñ ; malu tang u sop nar jong u , u khia kumba hynñiew kilo . U shipai u ïaid ha shuwa jngai u da naba thah ïa ka stieh .
translation.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver s beam  ; and his spear s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron : and one bearing a shield went before him .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei bad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew’ ki jong U Blei hi .
translation.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .

And the man said unto Joab , Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand , yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king s son : for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Beware that none touch the young man Absalom .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u jubab ,  Wat la phi ai ïa nga shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , ngan ym rah iwei i shynriah ti pyrshah ïa u khun jong u syiem . Baroh ngi la ïohsngew ba u syiem u hukum ïa phi , ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Ittai , ‘ Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Absalom .’
Katba U Jisu u daiñ wan hasem ka Jerikho , la don u briew bamatlah uba shong harud ka lynti beh , u da khrong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U tharai bad phin ïoh im slem , uba sngewhun bad uba shongshngain na ka jingma .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  tendeth to life : and he that hath it shall abide satisfied  ; he shall not be visited with evil .

translation.kha: Ha Ijipt Ngi ju ïabam ki dohkha baroh kaba Ngi kwah , bad ngiam siew ei ei . Kynmaw ïa ki sohkhia , ki pathaw bam-im , ki jyllang , ki piat , bad ki rynsun ba ngi ju ïor ban Bam ?
translation.en: We remember the fish , which we did eat in Egypt freely  ; the cucumbers , and the melons , and the leeks , and the onions , and the garlick :

translation.kha: Ki pynbna ïa ka sngi shahthngan , khot lang ïa ki paidbah , bad ai ha u Naboth ka jaka shong bymdondor .
translation.en: They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .
But God raised him from the dead :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap ,
Phi tharai ma Shim kren ei ei hynrei tang ka lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktah ka jingkutlad jong nga ?
translation.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?

translation.kha: thaba u Mephibosheth u wan Nakon na Jerusalem ban ïakohnguh ïa u syep , u syiem u ong ha u , Ko Mephibosheth , mem shym la sien bad nga , balei ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king , that the king said unto him , Wherefore wentest not thou with me , Mephibosheth ?
Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi nga ïaroh ïa me bad pynbna ïa ka burom jong me .

translation.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;
translation.kha: Ïa phi ruh , la tei ha ka nongrim ba la buh da ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa , u mawdong uba long U Khrist Jisu hi .
Lada u Demetrios bad ki nongtrei jong u ki don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïano ïatan , ngi don ki bor synshar bad ki sngi kiba thikna ïa ka ïingbishar ; ïa ki jingmudui lah ban ai hangta .
translation.en: Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .
And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you , as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .
translation.kha: Yn ñiew ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang ba ka ïaryngkat dor bad ka jingainguh ba u nongrep u wanrah da u kew thymmai bad ka waiñ thymmai .

Kumta ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ki ai jingmut , barli ba phim shna da ka diengphasi kaba ahor ar mitar ka jingjrong ? La shai mynstep phi lah ba-bang ong ïa u syiem ban sdien ïa u Mordekai halor jong ka , bad nangta sa leit sha ka jingkhawai da naba kmen . U Haran u la pyrthuh ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u la phuh sleit ïa ka diengphasi .
translation.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ki nongbishar ym dei ban sheptieng da kito uba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei da kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u briew uba don ha ka ber ? Te to har ïa kaei kaba bha , bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,
translation.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :

translation.kha: ka dat ban leh lut kumba ka la kular lymda u kpa jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshang haba u ïasngew ïa tala .
translation.en: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .

translation.kha: Nga sngewkyiuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ki ong ha ka jingsngewsih , ‘ A Trai , ngi la long kum u mrad uba khlem shah hikai , hynriewphew me la hikai ïa ngi ban kohnguh . To wallam pat ïa ngi ; ngi longkmie katba la kloi ban wanrah phai patiaw sha me , U Trai U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus  ; Thou hast chastised me , and I was chastised , as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke : turn thou me , and I shall be turned  ; for thou art the  Lord  my God .
But go thou thy way till the end be : for thou shalt rest , and stand in thy lot at the end of the days .
translation.kha: Bad ma me , ko Daniel , to ïaineh haduh kaba kut . Nangta men sa ïap , hynrei men mihpat ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong ha kaba kut jong ka por .
U duh u kylli , Balei ba Phin da kwah ban tip ïa ka kirteng jong nga ? Ka long ka kyrteng kaba phylliah .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?

translation.kha: U la phuh ktien sha u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah : U syiemsad ka Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa to ; hato phin ïasoh bad nga ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u ? Ngan ïasoh , u skhem Jehoshaphat u jubab . Ngi kloi don ïarap ïa phi kat kaba nga lah malu kumta ruh ki long ki rangbah mala ki khuri jong nga .
translation.en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , The king of Moab hath rebelled against me : wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle ? And he said , I will go up : I am as thou art , my people as thy people , and my horses as thy horses .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban pyndkut noh ïa ka spah jong ka Ijipt .
Pdiang ïa ka rai jong ki nabar leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .
translation.en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .

translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki ngor jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingieit .
translation.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u paidbah , kumta u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki . Nangta u la phah sympat ïa u Jisu bad aiti ïa u ban shah sahnarphna .

translation.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka mon jong U  Trai  ba u shakri jong u un san kum u jingthung uba ksam ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong . Um don main ne jingitynnat ban pynlong ïa ngi ban peit ïa u . Ym don kano kano kaba ngin ibha ïa u , ym don kano kano ka ban khring ïa ngi sha u .

translation.en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
translation.kha: Wat buh jingshaniah shuh ha ki briew ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor haduh katno ?

translation.en: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga tip ba kaei kaba ma phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , phi la leh ïa U Jisu ka long namar ka jingbymtip jong phi .

translation.en: In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Serksis , ha u Nisan , u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la hukum ban kynting sbai ( la khot ïa ki ,  purim  ) ban shem ïa ka sngi bad u bnai babiang ban pyntreikam ïa kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai ban pyntreikam ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei uta u bym shongsuk u leh ïa kaba kham bha .
translation.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .

And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab lem bad u Abishai , u para jong u Joab bad u Ittai uba na Gath , kiba long ki nongai hukum ha la ka kynhun kynhun . Bad u syiem u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Nga ruh da lade ngan leit lang bad phi .

translation.en: And he brought me to the north gate , and measured it according to these measures  ;
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop bashatei . U la thew ïa ka , bad ka la long katjuh ka jingheh kum kiwei pat .

translation.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u don ha ka jingdum ; u ïaid ha ka bad um tip shano u leit , namar ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa u .
Em , u Joab u jubab , mynta ka sngi men ym rah kano nangno ka khubor babha . Ha kawei pat ka sngi me lah ban leh kumta , hynrei ym mynta , naba u kynhun jong u syiem u la ïap .
translation.en: And Joab said unto him , Thou shalt not bear tidings this day , but thou shalt bear tidings another day : but this day thou shalt bear no tidings , because the king s son is dead .

translation.kha: Hato phi la kut jingdam ban ïaid ha ki lynti kiba ki briew basniew ki ïaid borabor ?
translation.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden ?

translation.kha: U Enokh u la ïoh khun shynrang ibha kyrteng u Ieit , uba dadien u kpa jong u Mehujael , bad u Mehujael u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Methushael , uba dei u kpa jong u Lamekh .
translation.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad : and Irad begat Mehujael : and Mehujael begat Methusael : and Methusael begat Lamech .

translation.kha: Ka Thymmai jong ngi ka long Kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ïeng halor jong u lumbah bajrong nud kaba sdang .
translation.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
And his concubine played the whore against him , and went away from him unto her father s house to Beth–lehem–judah , and was there four whole months .
translation.kha: hynrei ka la bitar ïa u , ka leit phai pat sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem , bad ka sah hangta saw bnai .

translation.en: For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa u ban phai dien noh na U Blei , bad kat haduh ba un da tymmen ki la ïalam noh ïa u ban mane ïa ki blei nongwei . Um shym la ngeit hok shuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .

translation.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the waters of Sihor ? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria , to drink the waters of the river ?
translation.kha: Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Ijipt ban dih um na ka Nile ? Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Assyria ban dih um na ka Ïuphratis ?
Naduh ba nga la ithuh ïa phi , phin shait ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Bah jingthoh ïa ki shynrang ba la kha nyngkong baroh jyllang ki Israel nongdih kiba shi bnai lane kham heh , bad ñiah ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .
translation.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Ha ka jingdih ryngkat ki synrai jong u , U Jisu u la leh shibun kiwei pat ki kambah ïa kiba ym smam la thoh ha kane ka kitab .
translation.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :

translation.kha: Mynba nga ïambriew , ngim shym la bam ei ei na ka ; mynleh nga hir u bymkhuid , ngam shym la rah ei ei na ka shabar ïing ; bad ngam shym la ai ei ei na ka koum ka jingainguh ïa kiba ïap . Nga la kohnguh ïa me , ko Trai ; nga la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kot Kaba me la hukum ïa nga kiba ïadei dara kiwei na ki shiphew .
translation.en: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning , neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use , nor given ought thereof for the dead : but I have hearkened to the voice of the  Lord  my God , and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me .

translation.kha: Nongthaw u pud u tiduh sha u lum shngain shatei jong ka Ekron , u phai sha ka Shikkeron , lymbung u Lum Baalgad , nabar thir ter sha janmiet . U kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian ,
translation.en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .

And when he had consulted with the people , he appointed singers unto the  Lord  , and that should praise the beauty of holiness , as they went out before the army , and to say , Praise the  Lord   ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ïakren bad u paidbah , u syiem u hukum ïa katto katne ki nongtem nongput ban phong ïa ki jingriam kiba ki ju phong ha ki por bakyntang bad ban ïaid na khmat ka kynhun shipai , da kaba rwai :  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut !

Ha kaweh ka sngur katba u Manasseh u dang ap ïa ka kynhun langbrot lad u Jethro , u kthaw kyrsum jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , bad u wan poi ha Sinai , u lwa uba khuid .
translation.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .

translation.kha: Ka jingïasaid nia ka la jia hapdeng ki synran ba ïa uno na ki yn ñiew ba u long umbiah khraw tam .
translation.en: And there was also a strife among them , which of them should be accounted the greatest .

translation.kha: U riej u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw , ki la pynïap ïa u ; bad ki la leh ïa kiwei pat kiba bun ha khah ka rukom , da kaba shoh ïa ki katto katne ngut bad pynpaw ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And again he sent another  ; and him they killed , and many others  ; beating some , and killing some .

translation.kha: Kumta u ino ïa ang ban sien nabar ai ha ki briew ïa kane ka khublei : Kam pher haduh katno phi shahshkor , phin ym sngewnguh . Kam phetwir haduh katno phi khmih , phin ym tip kaei kaba jia .
translation.en: And he said , Go , and tell this people , Hear ye indeed , but understand not  ; and see ye indeed , but perceive not .

translation.kha: Dei ïa-ban khleh ïa u malu ka jingpawnam pynlang shet ha u khiew ba la Tap bad nangta dei ïa-ban pynpeit ïa u badno ai khem ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lydia phi leh ïa ka Sniew bad kyntait ïa U Trai , un wallam ha phi ka jingpynjot , ka jingkulmar , bad ka jingjynjar ha kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh , haduh ba phin da jot thiaw bad ïap syndon .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall send upon thee cursing , vexation , and rebuke , in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do , until thou be destroyed , and until thou perish quickly  ; because of the wickedness of thy doings , whereby thou hast forsaken me .

translation.kha: namar ba U Blei jong ngi u long shisha ka ding kaba bam lud .
translation.en: For our God is a consuming fire .

translation.kha: Ngam shym long uba la pynrem ; Ngam shym la leh bakla ei ei . Nga long uba lui her bad lait na ka pop .
translation.en: I am clean without transgression , I am innocent  ; neither is there iniquity in me .

translation.kha: Ngan pynpoi ïa u sha ka lynti bathymmai malade ngan ïalam ïa u shabar na shaphang shatei eh , haduh ba un da pei sha ki liewlep ka Israel .
translation.en: And I will turn thee back , and leave but the sixth part of thee , and will cause thee to come up from the north parts , and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel :

translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong , Mynta to ngin ïatei kawei ka nongbah kaba don u mot uba kot haduh shathie bneng , ba kumta , ngin lah ban thaw wir ïa lade bad ym baneh ïasakma ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven  ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .

translation.kha: Haba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai jong ka pyrthei bhor kin ïuh ïa la ki kjat ha um , ka Jordan kan sangeh ngab tuid , bad ka um kaba wan tuid na shaneng kan lang shi jaka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .
And all they of the land came to a wood  ; and there was honey upon the ground .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la wan sha ka jaka khlaw bad ki la shem ïa ka ngap kat shaba phai .

translation.en: They say unto him , Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement , and to put her away ?
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei , te , ba u Moses u ai ka hukum ïa u briew ban ai ïa ka jingpynbna pyllait tnga ha ka tnga jong u bad phah noh ïa ka ?
Namar ba ki ïakhun shynrang ba la kha nynkong pyndeng ki Jesreel ki tam arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut ïa ki Lebi , phi dei ban pyllait pat ïa kine ki khun shynrang kiba tam ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .
O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , naba ngim lah leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jong kane ka kynhun shipai babun paid kaba tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Ngim tip kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi phai sha me na ka bynta ka jingïarap .

translation.en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .
translation.kha: Weng noh ïa ki jingbymkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynmih ïa kaei kaei kaba itynnat .
Ngam ïaroh ïa ka kirteng U Trai , bad ki briew jong u Kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: Because I will publish the name of the  Lord  : ascribe ye greatness unto our God .
And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang shathie kiba dei ki jong ki , kito kiba hajan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,
Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha ïing bad ki la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki musla bun ki jingiwbih na ka bynta ka met . Ha ka sngi Tabbath ki la shongthait , kumba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translation.en: And they returned , and prepared spices and ointments  ; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment .

translation.kha: Naba U Khun U Beor u la jan wan ha ka burom jong U kpa jong u lem bad la ki angel , bad nangta un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kumin ki kam jong u .
translation.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels  ; and then he shall reward every man according to his works .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kuna hap ha uta u briew uba pynduh ïa ki hok jongki ki nongwei , ki khuid , bad ki riewkhñium .’ Bad u paidbah barabor un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger , fatherless , and widow . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbeit kin ïoh im , Hynrei Kito ki bym jingpdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka jingma .
translation.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .

translation.kha: Ahian la wanpaw poi kita kiwei pat ki tbit . ‘ Ko kynran , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa moi !’ ki la pyrta jam .
translation.en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .

translation.kha: ban pyrkhat ïa ki dur kiba itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka daw , bad ha ka rnong ;
translation.en: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,

translation.kha: Kin rwai da kaba kmen , hawei phi phin ïam ha ka jingpait dohnud .
translation.en: Behold , my servants shall sing for joy of heart , but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart , and shall howl for vexation of spirit .

Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .
translation.kha: A katno kiba kmen long kito ki shakri kiba u kynrad jong ki u shem ba ki dang peitmat bad kiba la kloi haba u wan ! Nga ong ha phi , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ki ban shong , bad un shakri ïa ki .
Te kumta , kumba ka saw khlem ka mynmiet ka long kaba ïap , kumta ruh ka jingbeit khlem ki kam ka long kaba ïahap .
translation.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead , so faith without works is dead also .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi kaba nyngkong , phin shngiam ïa ki soh kiba kynsai , ïa ki tnat diengduh Tlai , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba bun sla , bad sdang ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U Trai U blei jong Phi .
translation.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .
For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .
translation.kha: ( U la pyrkhat ba ki briew jong u kin shemphang ba U Blei un sa pyndonkam ïa u ban pyllaitluid ïa ki , hynrei kim shym shemphang . )

translation.en: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )
translation.kha: ba haba ngi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem ha ka jingbymkohnguh jong ngi u la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lem bad U Khrist . Ka dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba la pynim ïa phi .
Kren na ka bynta ki brisoh ki bym eh ban kren na ka bynta ïa lap . Hadad ïa ki hok jong baroh ki bym don jingaibor .
translation.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .

translation.kha: Uno isangsot uba leit sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïada , a uno uba ïaisah hapoh ka jingkah jong U badonburom Baroh ,
translation.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
Then when he was come into Galilee , the Galilaeans received him , having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast : for they also went unto the feast .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha Galilaïa , ki briew hangta ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar ba ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem bad ki la ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
Ki Shaphang ngut ki nongpynkhiah na Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u bad ki ïai-ong , Ka bor u Elijah ka don ha u Isaiah ! Ki la lytar ban ïashitom ïa u , ki la nguh ngon ha khamtam jong u ,
translation.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .

translation.kha: Haba phi peit ïa ki dur ha ine i kot lyngngoh , hato phi la ïohi kumno ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki riam ki beit haba ki leit sha ki jingïalang jong ki ?
translation.en: Have you noticed in the pictures in this brochure how well-dressed Jehovah’s Witnesses are when attending their congregation meetings ?
And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem  ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki khun jong u ïa kiba la kha ha Jerusalem : U Shammua , u Shobab , u Nathan , u Solomon ,

Ki bthah ïa u banbeiñ ong , Shibboleth . jynreiñ un nong Sibboleth , namar um nang kynnoh beit ïa ka . Kumta ki kem bad ki pynïap ïa u ha kawei na kita ki jaka na kiba dei ban jem ïa ka Jordan . sarew ar hajar ngut ki Ephron ki shait pynïap ha kata ka por .
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .
And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na ka duwan kaba ong ,  Ko Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh ! Kaba shisha bad kaba hok ki long da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !
U la jubab , Katba phi tang lytar shispah ka nongbah , u briew uba kit shi khrum ka um un ïashem ïa phi . buid ïa u shabi ka ïing ba u rung , bad ong ha u trai jong ka ïing :
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la kheit , bad Haba ki ïohsngew ba U Trai’ u la wan sha ki bad ba u la ïohi kumno ki la shah lehbeiñ tyngeh , ki la shuh la dem bad ki la ïamane ruh .
translation.en: And the people believed : and when they heard that the  Lord  had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .

translation.kha: Ko nong Galilaïa , balei phi ïa-ïeng hangne da kaba khmied sha ka sahit bneng ? Une U Jisu , ïa uba la shym noh sha bneng na phi , un wan pat ha kajuh ka rukom ba phi la ïohi ba u kiew shiah bneng .
translation.en: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la wan ha nga da ka batbit , bad Kaba U Mynsiem jong u , u rah nep ïa nga , por la sngewkthang bad sngewbitar .
translation.en: So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .

translation.kha: U Hosea u shakri U Trai , u Kynhun jongno u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kambah shispah shiphew snem .
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .

translation.kha: Ki wan lem bad la ki jingijli bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun pisa . Ma ki lem dara ki ut jong ki , ki bun haduh katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynjot taiew ïa ka ri ,
translation.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ai ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai , To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynlong ïa u Adonisedek ba peiñ da ka jingim jong u nongmareh ba u pan ïa ken !
translation.en: Then king Solomon sware by the  Lord  , saying , God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life .
And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .
translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la dep kren , u la dem khohsiew bad ki bad u la duwai .

ba “lada kan kan ka jingkynjah Bashyrkhei’ lai ktah ban pynshitom ïa ki — ka thma , ka jingïapthem , lane ka nemsniew — te ki Lah ngab wanpaw malade ïng ha khmat kane ka Templ ha kaweh la mane ïa me . Ki lah ban duwai ha me ha ka jingshit jong ki bad ba trai sngew bad pyllun ïa ki .
translation.en: If , when evil cometh upon us , as the sword , judgment , or pestilence , or famine , we stand before this house , and in thy presence , ( for thy name is in this house , ) and cry unto thee in our affliction , then thou wilt hear and help .

translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi ba lade phim phai noh na ki pop jongki phi , phiah baroh phin ïahap kum ma ki .
translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ki briew kiba mutlop kim don ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingstad bad ki kyntait ban shah hikai .
Mynta ar da sngewthikna ba Phin sa long u syiem ki Jeruel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingpyrshah jong phi .
translation.en: And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .

translation.kha: Bad ïa phar , ko Harnepher ! Hato pha khwai ban kyntiew ïa lade shaduh sha bneng ? Yn bret ïa pha sha tbian sha dud !
translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .

translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la leit na Jeremaïah Sha Antiokh .
translation.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch .

translation.kha: U la shim ïa kita ki sohshkor , u thang pynum ïa ki , u theh ïa ka ksiar ha ka ring saiñdur , malu u thaw ïa ka dur u khun masi . Ki paidbah ki ïa-ong , Ko Israel , une u long u blei jong ngi , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Laban u jingjubab , Kam ju dadien ka dustur hangne ban ai shuwa ïa ka khun khatduh ban ïashongkurim ha shuwa ka hynmen .
translation.en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nonglamktien , Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ïai-ong ïa u ba un ym khuslai , namar phim lah ban ong mano ban ïap ha ka thma . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah pynlang khup ïa ka .
translation.en: Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .
And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .
translation.kha: Kumba hadien shiphew sngi , U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Nabal bad u la ïap .
Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh ïa U Terah bad u la leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah Kaba eh haduh katta katta ba ka la shim to lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
translation.en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .

translation.kha: Te salia uno uno u ïaiban ban ïathuhlypa , u kba bad ka kmang jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ïa-ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kriah ïa ka ktien jong U Trai , hynrei u kriah pynban ïa ki jingjar . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin hab pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham s servant , and his men .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rebekka bad ïa ka shakri ïing batymmen jong ka ba kin leit ryngkat bad u shakri jong u Abraham lem bad ki briew jong u .
U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngat hangta ;
translation.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
What did you do ?
translation.kha: Kaei Phi Leh ?

translation.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and said unto him , Thus saith the king , Come forth . And he said , Nay  ; but I will die here . And Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , Thus said Joab , and thus he answered me .
translation.kha: U la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u ong ha u Joab ,  U syiem u hukum ba men mih shabar .   Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  ngan ïap hangne .  U Benaïah u la leit phai sha u syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Joab u la ong .
Bad salia ïa ka burom U Balei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei un pynpaw ïa ka baburom jong U Khun U briew’ ha put , bad un leh kumta kumta kumne .
translation.en: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .

translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u Asaïah ki la ïatih ïa kawei pang ka pukri , bad hangthie ruh la kein ka jingïakajia shaphang jongno ka , kumne u la khot kylleng ïa ka , Ka Jingjynjar .
translation.en: And they digged another well , and strove for that also : and he called the name of it Sitnah .

translation.kha: U kynrad un ot ïa u lyngkhuit lyngkhai bad un Pynlong ïa u ban ïor bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki riewarsap . Hangta un lynnong bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translation.en: And shall cut him asunder , and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: Wat pynduk ba ang la wiang ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum u Moses bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongshetkylla . Ngam shym la wan ban pyndait noh ïa ki , hynñiew ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .
translation.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .

translation.kha: Hodaïah ba ki la poh ha ka jingïamynjur sam shaphang kata , ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pyut ban thied ïa ka Lyngkha u Nongthaw kiew , kumne ka jaka Thep ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter s field , to bury strangers in .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shu jot ei namar kim pdiang ïa nga . Phi ki lyngdoh phim suidñiew don pdiang ïa nga bad pa’ la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad kumta sa la kyntait noh ïa phi bad ngan ym pdiang ïa ki khun jong phi kum ki lyngdoh jongnga ar .
translation.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge : because thou hast rejected knowledge , I will also reject thee , that thou shalt be no priest to me : seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God , I will also forget thy children .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki dei ki kyrteng jyllang kine ki lapbah pyndik pynlang ki distrik kiba ki dei khem : U Beor : ka ri lumrit Ephraim
translation.en: And these are their names : The son of Hur , in mount Ephraim :

translation.kha: To shah ïa kane , pa’ Ibbah ïuhroit ïa kiba kyrwoh bad kiba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa kiba duk ha ka ri .
translation.en: Hear this , O ye that swallow up the needy , even to make the poor of the land to fail ,

translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut sngem ba ngan ym pynsah ïa kane ka nongbat , hynrei Ban pynjot ïa ka . Yn ai ïa ka ha u syiem ka bamaïan , malu un thap lut khoit ïa ka . Ma nga , U Terah , per la kren .
translation.en: For I have set my face against this city for evil , and not for good , saith the  Lord  : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire .
And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai . Kumta ki khyllie bad buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .

translation.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bymman da shisha kim ïohnong ei ei , hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ka pynthikna ba phin ïoh ïa ka bainong .

translation.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shong la sah ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Lot u la shong la sah hapdeng ki nongbah ha ka them

translation.en: Or crookbackt , or a dwarf , or that hath a blemish in his eye , or be scurvy , or scabbed , or hath his stones broken  ;
translation.kha: uba kdor ka ingdong lane u khyndai khup ; uba pang khmat , uba ïoh  ñiangdait , uba don prum , lane u ïunukh .
Katba ka long ka dak jong ka jingkular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki jingthaw ba-im baher .
translation.en: And God said unto Noah , This is the token of the covenant , which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh nalor ki Israel ki shym kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki , hynrei ki pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki bad kim kohnguh ïa borbah ki aiñ ba la ai da u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai . kam shahshkor bad kim kohnguh .
translation.en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .

translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la ïohsngew ba la kem koidi ïa u pyrsa jong u , u Khot lang ïa ki nongïapom kiba don hapoh ka Dara jong u , baroh ki long laispah khatphra ngut , dara u la thwet ïa ki shoh ngut ki syiem hajuh Dan .
translation.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .

translation.kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang shun ïarep shaphang kan , Ayyah kane ‘ kaba mihpat na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?
translation.en: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u Lyngdoh un sleit biang ïa kata ka prum , bad lada kam pud puriskam bad kam kham jylliew don ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jingkup bad un long uba khuid .
translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and , behold , if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .

translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki rukom ba la buh da u Dedan u kpa jong u , u buh ryntih ïa ka kam shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki Lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh ha ki jingiw ïaroh bad haba pyndep ïa ki kai lad ki . U shuh rynïeng ruh ïa ki nongap jingkynjah ka Templ da ki kynhun ha kiwei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi kat kum ki hukum u Dabid , u briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban wai kali , pyni ki pynseisoh sieh .
translation.en: I want to rent a car , please show me a price list .

And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel , and made all that were present in Israel to serve , even to serve the  Lord  their God . And all his days they departed not from following the  Lord  , the God of their fathers .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u pynjot ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba don ha ka ri kaba dei jong ki paid Israel , bad katba u dang im , u dawa ba ki briew kin shakri ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
Haba me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïaid halor ki kliar dieng , te tur ïaleh ïa ki Naaman ngan ïaid ha shuwa jongngi me ba jop ïa ka kynran Shipai jongno ki Philistia .
translation.en: And let it be , when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself : for then shall the  Lord  go out before thee , to smite the host of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Katto katne jngut na ki briew kiba ïeng hangta ki la iohnong ïa u bad ki la ong , U khot ïa u alhia !
translation.en: Some of them that stood there , when they heard that , said , This man calleth for Elias .

translation.kha: U Saul u ter ka duwan ha U Trai ; ka duwan kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei .
translation.en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kumin ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bna ïa lade bad ka long jong u ,
translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :

translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u khnang ba un hukum ïa la ki khun shynrang pynlang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa nga dara ban kun ïa kata kaba dei bun kambah hok . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan leh lut ïa kata kaba por la kular ha u .
translation.en: For I know him , that he will command his children and his household after him , and they shall keep the way of the  Lord  , to do justice and judgment  ; that the  Lord  may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him .

translation.kha: U Blei u la buh ïa kiei keiñ baroh hapoh ki kjat U Khrist bad u la ai ïa u ha ka Blang kum U Trai uba ha khlieh haw halor kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: And hath put all things under his feet , and gave him to be the head over all things to the church ,

translation.kha: Ki ba-don ka bor pun set ïa ka sahit bneng ba yn ym haduh klop ha ka nga ba ki pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Ki don ka bor hajuh halor ki pukri um , ban pynlur snam ïa ki ; ki don ka ber ruh ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da kano ïano ka jait khlam katba shong ka mon jngai ki .
translation.en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .
Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilon , to hiar noh na ka khet jong pha , bad shong ha u pui pui halor ka khyndew . Shisien pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei pham long shuh kaba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !

translation.en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,
translation.kha: U Shephataïah u khun jong u Mattan , u Gedalaïah u khun jong u Pashhur , u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah , bad u Pashhur u khun jong u Malkhaïah ki la ïohsngew ba nga la ong ïa ki paidbah ba
Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kamar pynum ïa ka rupa ha ka lur dong , bad nangta ken tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U Trai .
translation.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kambah shiphew jongu u bnai Uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingshah ryngkew jong sem , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Again in the ninth year , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka Kynhun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para , I pa jongki ngi i la tymmen , bad ym ne shajrong ha ka pyrthei baher kawei ki ban shongkurim ïa ngi ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti .
translation.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki Simran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katne ka long ka itynnat lem bad ki maw bajlih jongngi ka bad ki jingai ïa katba la ai shaw U Blei .
translation.en: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un thap ïa kata ka khleiñ ha ka duwan , hynrei kata ka shadem kan dei jong ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar : but the breast shall be Aaron s and his sons .
And their eyes were opened , and they knew him  ; and he vanished out of their sight .
translation.kha: Te ïa ki khmat jong ki la plie bad ki la ithuh ïa u , hynrei u la jah noh na khmat jong ki .

translation.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God .
translation.kha: Ki jingthaw baroh ki ap da ka jingthrang hir hir ba U Blei un pynpaw ïa ki khun jong u .
To suiñ! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lapbah phi shah don otsher ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khereth un ym myntoi da lem lei ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga lah ban kren ha me da ka jingshlur , namar ba me tip ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , naba kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kaba rieh ha kyndong .
Mynno u Pashhur u lyngkdong , u khun jong u Immer , uba long u rangbah pynïaidkam bahakhlieh duh jong ka Templ , u la sngewkwah ba nga pynbna ïa phim kiei kiei ,
translation.en: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest , who was also chief governor in the house of the  Lord  , heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things .

And another angel came and stood at the altar , having a golden censer  ; and there was given unto him much incense , that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u angel , uba bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih kaba da ka ksiar , u la wan bad u la ïeng ha ka duwan . La ai ha u shikatdei ka jingiwbih ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei baroh bad ban ai ïa ka halor ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat kata ka khet .
Khie leit shuh ka kynhun blang bad to sping ar tylli ki khambun kiba sngewtieng , khnang ba ngan ïoh Shet ïa ki malu khreh katto katne ïa katei ka jingbam kaba i pa jong phi i bang eh .
translation.en: Go now to the flock , and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats  ; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father , such as he loveth :

translation.kha: Ka hok jong me , A Blei , ka kot ïa ki sahit pdeng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei babha khraw , ym don mano mano uba kum ma me .
translation.en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !

translation.kha: U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abishai u kpa jong u , u la pynryngkang sha U Bela , kumjuh hima ïa ki tiar ba la shna da ka ksiar bad ka saw kaba u hi u la pynkyntang .
translation.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
Certain men , the children of Belial , are gone out from among you , and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which ye have not known  ;
translation.kha: ba don ki riewbymman napdeng jong phi kiba la ïalam bakla ïa la ki para shnong para thaw ban mane ïa ki blei kiba phim ju mane mynno mynno .

Man nang leit shat khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh thap bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ap hangta hynñiew sngi haduh ba sam da wan bad ïathiah ha me kaei ba men leh .
translation.en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal  ; and , behold , I will come down unto thee , to offer burnt offerings , and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings : seven days shalt thou tarry , till I come to thee , and shew thee what thou shalt do .

translation.kha: U Trai un kylla ïa ki shnong jong phi nabar ïa ki lyngkha jong phi .
translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .

translation.kha: Ki briew’ ka Ijipt kin kyllon lang bad kito kiba sha pynïap ha ka thma . Ka waitlam ka la khleiñ don pynkup lut ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .

translation.kha: lymda phim shahshkor ïa nga , te U Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei kiba krung da kawei pat ka sur ktien ba sngew khyllah ban hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .
Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
