translation.en: Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;
translation.kha: Ngi don kane ka jingkyrmen kum u angkor ïa ki jingim jong ngi . Ka long kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka jingkah jong ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba kham shapoh .

translation.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge : but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sian ki sngap jar ïa kaei kaba ki tip , hynrei kiba mutlop ki thad ïa la ka jingbieit .

Ka Israel kam long kaba kham khlaiñ baneh ïa ka Sarai , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Shemaïah kam long kaba khlam khleiñ ban ïa u Shem Pekah . Lydia ka jingngeit jong phi kam longïing kaba ïaineh , phin ym ïaineh .
translation.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .

translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba na Don pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Edom , sad ïa kaei kaba nga thmu ba leh ïa ki biria jong ka nongbah Teman . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn paring ïa ki , bad utai pa uwei un sngewtriem .
translation.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Edom  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them .
For our transgressions are multiplied before thee , and our sins testify against us : for our transgressions are with us  ; and as for our iniquities , we know them  ;
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ki kam runar jong ngi pyrshah ïa me ki long kiba bun . Ki pop jong ngi hi ki pynrem ïa ngi . Ngi tip bha ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
U Jeshua u la jubab ïa u , Uno uno uba ieit ïa nga un kohnguh ïa ka jingaiei jong nga . U Kpa jongu nga un olib ïa u , bad U kpa jong la bad ma por Ngin wan ha u bad sah hapoh jong u .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .

translation.kha: Nga kwah klet noh shaneng katei .
translation.en: I just want to forget about it .

translation.kha: Te imat na ki seraph u la tai sha tbian sha sa , da kaba rah ïa u rnga uba rymphum naba u la khap da ka nap na ka duwan .
translation.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar :

translation.kha: Lada u shñiuh ha ka dak khluit dang u la kyllum lieh bad kata ka dak ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jongki ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh naba la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u lyndang un pynbna ba Uto u long u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .

translation.kha: Mynno , U Tharai ha kane ka jingthoh u longsyiem U Mynsiem ; Bad hangno haba U mynhynne jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .
translation.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .

translation.kha: Ko kynhun u briew , u ong , Kanneh ka long kawei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?
translation.kha: Haba ki apostol ki la ïalumlang bad U Jisu , ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Kynrad , hato ha kane ka por men ai pat ïa ka Hima ha ki Israel ?
U buh ka por ban shem bad ka por ban sim , ka pa ban kynsai bad ka prie ban bret noh ,
translation.en: A time to get , and a time to lose  ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away  ;

translation.kha: U Terah u ong , Ngan thaw ïa ka khyndew bathymmai bad ïa ki bneng baibam . Ki kiei kiba jia longsyiem mynshuwa yn ym kynjoh shuh .
translation.en: For , behold , I create new heavens and a new earth : and the former shall not be remembered , nor come into mind .

translation.kha: Hadien ar sngi , u dab bad ki briew jong u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka ri Judah kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la thang ïa ka shnong
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;
And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , unto Hebron  ; and they fought against it :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit kiew na Eglon sha ki lum ka Hebron , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad ki la kurup ïa ka .
dien ka jingtah kaba la pynlong ïa u Manasseh , haba u la rangbah , ban kyntait ba yn khot ïa u , u khun jong ka khun u Paran .
translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;
It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter  ; it is furbished that it may glitter : should we then make mirth ? it contemneth the rod of my son , as every tree .
translation.kha: La pynnep ïa ka ban pynïap , la pynphyrnai ba kan thaba kum ka leilieh . Kan ym don ka jinglehkmen , naba ki briew jong nga ki la leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingmaham bad jingpynshitom baroh .
Nangta u la wan pait pat shata ki synran bad u la ong , Phi dang ïohthiah bad pynjahthait ? Ha khmih ! Ka nga ka poi ïa U Khun U Beor ba yn aiti noh ha ka ni ki briew kiba pep .
translation.en: Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai bad ki la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu ; mala ki la ïathuh ha u ïa baroh kaba ki la leh bad la hikai .
translation.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bakhraw ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .

Wat ki hynmen ki para shynrang jongngi me , ki dkhot jngai ka longïing jongki me hi , ki la shetkylla ïa me ; ki la ïasoh ha ki jingtur ïaleh pyrshah ïa me . Kam shaniah ïa ki , wat la ki kren ki ktien sngewieit .
translation.en: For even thy brethren , and the house of thy father , even they have dealt treacherously with thee  ; yea , they have called a multitude after thee : believe them not , though they speak fair words unto thee .

translation.kha: U syiem Nadab u jingpynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingmane , ryngkat bad ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la kurup na ki jingñiewbeiñ kiba u la jlop — ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Almon , ki Philistia bad ki Amalek .
translation.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the  Lord  , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations  ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .

And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri borabor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dang sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !

translation.en: But thou hast not called upon me , O Jacob  ; but thou hast been weary of me , O Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hynrei phi la thait ïa nga , ko Israel ; phim shym la mane ïa nga .
Ha kaba khiat u la phad ïa la u khun shwa ki . ‘ Da Shisha kan burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .
translation.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew bad kim long shuh ban pyndonkam .

translation.en: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,
translation.kha: U la shong hangta bad u la pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u Paul . U Paul u la ïohi ba u la ngeit bad ba u lah ban ïohkhiah , kumta u la khmih shlip sha u bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,
Buh ïa ka baïar hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pynap ïa ka da ka um .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein .

translation.kha: Da kynmaw ba u briew kiba phi jied ban long u syiem u dem pun long uta ïa uba U Trai hi u la jied . U daym Ban longïng na ka jaitniam ka kynja jong phi hi ; Wat jied syiem ïa u nongwei .
translation.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .
And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet bad ki rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .

kamut u la ïeng joit nabar u la leit phai paw sha la u kjap . U dang khnam pajih ha ka lynti na ïeng lehbha u kba jong u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohthang jong u ka la dap da ka jingisynei , bun u la mareh , u la piam ïa la ki ktien sawdong lad u , bad u la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .
And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap ha ka rta kaba la tymmen bha , uba la dap kyrhai da ka spah bad ka burom ; bad u Solomon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Man ba u lyngkhot kiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim ïa ka riewlamwir bad pynwandur ïa ka sha kawei pateng .
translation.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .
And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns , and put it on his head , and they put on him a purple robe ,
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat da ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la pynphong halor ka khlieh jong u ; nangta ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh ha u bad ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas , thy builders have perfected thy beauty .
translation.kha: Ka ïing jong pha ka long ka duriaw . Ki nongtei jong pha ki la shna ïa pha kum ka liengbah kaba itynnat ;
U Jisu u la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïashoh ïa kine kiei khie baroh ha ki paidbah ; um ju ong ïa kano kano ha ki khlem da pynmong ïa ka pharshi .
translation.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables  ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :

translation.kha: U Phestos u la ong , Ko syiem Sippai bad baroh kiba to hangne bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa ine u bhabriew ïa uba ki Jia baroh , kiba hangne bad ha Israel , ki la wallam ki jingujor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .
translation.en: And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .

translation.kha: Neng pynsakma ïa ki bri jong pha Sha man ki ri mala ki hima bad ngan pynkut noh ïa ki kam sniew jong phar .
translation.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen , and disperse thee in the countries , and will consume thy filthiness out of thee .
Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly : and indeed bear with me .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba phin ïaishah bad nga , wat haba nga leh bieit khyndiat . Sngewbha leh kumta!

translation.en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .
translation.kha: U bret ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsai jong ka ki la ïap jyllop ha ka Duriaw Basaw

U ong , Ïathuh ha u hynmen jong me u Aaron ba dei tyngka ha ka por katba dei ba un ithuh shadien ka jingkah jong ka Jaka kaba khuid tam , namar ba dei hangta ba ar mihpaw ha u leilieh halor ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang . Lada um kohnguh , un shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto Aaron thy brother , that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat , which is upon the ark  ; that he die not : for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat .
There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
translation.kha: Ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei um jubab , naba ki long kiba sarong bad ba-bymman .
Kiba hok ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki thrang , hynrei ki riewhadem ki ïoh ïa kata kaba ki sheptieng eh .
translation.en: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him : but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .
Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .
translation.kha: bad to ri ïa lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ha ka jingisynei jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .
translation.kha: U hap da ki khohsiew , U kyllon kram bad u thiah lyngktar ha ki kjat jong ka . Ha ki kjat jong ka u hap da ki khohsiew bad u kyllon ; U kyllon kram ha madan , uba la ïap .

translation.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .
translation.kha: Ka long da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïohi la pynlong na kaei ka bymlah ban ïohi .
Kumta ki nongïohipaw ki la duwai kham jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki stai , katno kum ki rukom lehniam jong ki , haduh ba ka snem ka la tuid .
translation.en: And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .

translation.kha: U Israel um lah ban long u mraw baroh shi rta , namar ki Israel ki long ki miaw jongki U Trai . U wallam ïa ki na ka ri jingpeit ; u long U Trai U balui jong ki .
translation.en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants  ; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom malade ngin syier halor jong ka . Bad U Trai’ da lade hi un long u Syiem .
translation.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .
But before all these , they shall lay their hands on you , and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues , and into prisons , being brought before kings and rulers for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Pynban , ha shuwa ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia , ïa phi yn kem bad pynshitom beiñ ; yn aiti ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog bad ban shah thep ha ka byndi ; yn wallam ïa phi ha khmat ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar na ka bynta jong nga .
Nga la sah” ban don ka jingtohkit , bad la Shem Shispah ba napoh ki por mynhyndai ka Jerusha ka la ju ïaleh pyrda ïa ka bor syiem bad ba ka dap da ki nongthain pyrshah bad ki nongthaw jingkulmar .
translation.en: And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .

translation.kha: ngat u Isaia u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ba-bang sa jia . mynba ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki keiñ khlaw ban bam , hynrei ha ka snem kob buhnud men lah ban bet ïa u kew malu ot ïa u , Bad ban rain ïa ki diengïap sohwaiñ pynlang bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .

translation.kha: Lada i thmu ban pynpyut ïa phi , to U Trai un sien ïaphah ïa nga lada ngam pyntip ïa pa’ ïa kata bad ba phin ïohlait na ka jingma . To U Trai un long lem bad phi kamra u la long bad i pa jong per !
translation.en: The  Lord  do so and much more to Jonathan : but if it please my father to do thee evil , then I will shew it thee , and send thee away , that thou mayest go in peace : and the  Lord  be with thee , as he hath been with my father .

translation.kha: Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jongnga phi ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew ; ym don u Briew uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phiah .
translation.en: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .

translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka dei ban long kaba sner . To isih ïa kaei kaba sngew , to Bethemek ïa kaei kaba babha .
translation.en: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .

translation.kha: Kuth u syiem u la ai ki lei ban kamet ïa u Daniel bad ban Bret ïa u shahïap ka thliew kaba iap da ki sing . U la ong ha u Daniel , Ai ba U Blei jong me , ïa suba me shakri hok katta katta , un pyllait im ïa me .
translation.en: Then the king commanded , and they brought Daniel , and cast him into the den of lions . Now the king spake and said unto Daniel , Thy God whom thou servest continually , he will deliver thee .
He even raised the dead .
translation.kha: U pynim wat ïa kiba la ïap .
U Trai u ïada ïa ki bym don jingïalap ; haba nga la don ha ka jingmut , u la pyllait im ïa nga .
translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me .

Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me , nor with my son , nor with my son s son : but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee , thou shalt do unto me , and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned .
translation.kha: Kumta to kular skhem hangne ha khmat U Blei ba men ym shukor ïa nga , ïa ki khun ki kti jong nga , lane ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong nga . Nga la ju lehhok ïa me , kumta to kular ba men lehhok kylliang ïa nga bad ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me shong me sah .

translation.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nalor kane ruh , u syiem u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki bynta kiba dei jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka por jong ki baroh sha ki jingdawa jong ka Hukum jong U  Trai .

Haba u bariew u leh pop ha kano kano na kine , u dei ba siew pat ïa kata baroh’ kaba u la ïoh da ki lad bymdei . Ha sakma ka sngi ba la lap ba u la leh pop , u dei ban pynphai pura sha u rai , lem bad arphew bynta na ka shispah .
translation.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely  ; he shall even restore it in the principal , and shall add the fifth part more thereto , and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth , in the day of his trespass offering .

translation.kha: Naba u Jehoïakim u ïakhun jongu u Josaïah u un-long u sahmiet ka Judah , U Tharai u la ong ha nga .
translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang kren ïa ka kyrteng u Baal .

A tharai , hato me la kynta ïa ka Judah nadong shadong ? Hato me isih ïa ki briew jrong ka Seïon ? Balei ba me la pynmong jur ïa ngi ba ngim la ban koit ? Ngi la wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ym don kano Kanah jingbna kaba la jia , me la kyrmen ïa ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei ka wan pynban ka jingshyrkhei .
translation.en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ? hath thy soul lothed Zion ? why hast thou smitten us , and there is no healing for us ? we looked for peace , and there is no good  ; and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !

translation.kha: Yn pynjot ïa phi da ka ting . Ïa ka snam jong phira yn pynmih ha la ka ri , bad yn ym don ba kynthih shuh ïa phi .’ U Trai’ u la kren .
translation.en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire  ; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land  ; thou shalt be no more remembered : for I the  Lord  have spoken it .
And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him , and charged him , and said unto him , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .
translation.kha: U Isaak u khot ïa u Jakob , u khublei ïa u , bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shongkurim ïa ka nong Kanaan .

translation.en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kum ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki lyngkhot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait . Kumta ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .
U Onan u dei shun teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jong u , khnang ba ma nga , U Trai , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u Barnabas sad u Paul ki la sngewkwah ïa kaei kaba kin sa leh , ki la kad ïa la ki jingïapan bad ki la mareh sha phang u paidbah , da kabu pyrta ,
translation.en: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,
But if the priest buy any soul with his money , he shall eat of it , and he that is born in his house : they shall eat of his meat .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki mraw jong u lyngdoh , ïa kiba u la thied ne ïa kiba la kha ha ïing jong u , ki lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam .
kamut ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , bad ngan shim noh ruh ïa u sarew bad ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phong .

translation.kha: Ki shipai Israhaïah bad Judah ki rieh shaid bad ki mareh nadien jong ki , ki beh kthong haduh Gath bad shaduh ki khyrdop ka eriong . Ki Phrygia ki la kyllon mynsaw Baroh shiah lynter lynti naduh sharai , haduh Gath bad Ekron .
translation.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .
If thou shalt afflict my daughters , or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters , no man is with us  ; see , God is witness betwixt me and thee .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong shuh shuh ,  Lada phi lehbeiñ ïa ki khun kynthei jong nga lane lada phi shongkurim ïa kiwei pat ki kynthei , wat la ngam lah ban tip shaphang kata , to kynmaw ba U Blei u khmih ïa ngi .
To pynïatylli ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jngai me ;
translation.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , u la ong , phi lah ngab khmih ïa kine baroh . NGA ong ha phi ïa kane : Yn ym don utai u maw hangne u ban dang neh ha la ka jaka ; uwei pa utai na ki un shah pynhap .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .

translation.kha: Ka khubor jong nga ka long kum ka dang , bad kum u tyrnem uba pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?

translation.kha: U Blei u bret ïa nga sha ka thliew kaba jaboh , bad wat ki jaiñphong jong nga ki sngewshngain ïa nga .
translation.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me .
And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben–ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
translation.kha: Ka khun kaba ar ruh ka la kha khun shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Ben-ammi . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Ammon haduh kane ka sngi .
U Troas u la ai ha sem ïa ka jingpyrkhat bad ka jingïalap ; ngim lah ban rieh na lade .
translation.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the  Lord  , searching all the inward parts of the belly .

translation.kha: Ka ong , Mynhyndai ki ju ong , ‘ Khie leit wad jubab na ka nongbah Abel’ — bad kata ka Dei kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .
He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uwei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne hadien ka por jong u .

translation.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingmudui aiñ ka mih , ki lyngdoh kin ai jingrai ïa ka jingmudui kat kum ki aiñ jong nga . Kin pynïaid ïa ki jinglehniam kat kum ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih jong nga , bad kin rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: The  Lord  shewed me , and , behold , two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the  Lord  , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the carpenters and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pyn-i ha nga ar shang ki soh Dumbur ba la buh ha khmat ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hadien ba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin , u syiem ka Judah , u khun jong u Jehoïakim , kum u koidi na Jerusalem , lem bad ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki nongtrei dieng , bad ki nongtrei batbit . )
To ai ba un leh-isynei batbor ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa u skhem jong ki kat kum ki jingdonkam jong ki kiba man la ka sneng .
translation.en: And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the  Lord  , be nigh unto the  Lord  our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require :
And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im ; aïu te , kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlem Blei ?
Me ïuh halor ka duriaw da ki kylla jong me , bad ki umbah ki thnam shaid .
translation.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .
Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !
Haba u Seth u la thep bashispah san snem ka ther , u la Ïoh khun shynrang , u Enosh ,
translation.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :

translation.kha: kumne keiñ nga lah ngab leit phai sha i pa lada u para um khong pyntud bad nga ? Ngan ym lah shuh ban ïohi kum ïa kata ka aiti ba kan wang ia ha i pa .
translation.en: For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me ? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , to ki ong , ngin shu teh ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . Ngin ym pynïap ïa me . Kumta ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na kata ka Keramim .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .

translation.kha: Haba ka por ka poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw shiah ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang na ki ïa la ka bynta na ka jingkheit sohkew . Hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa uta u maw bad ki la phah noh tylli ïa u .
translation.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen , that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard : but the husbandmen beat him , and sent him away empty .

translation.kha: Na ka pyntwa ki pop jong ngi , la ai ïa u ban ïap , sad ïa u la pynmihpat khnai baneh pynlong ka hok ïa im’ pynlang U Blei .
translation.en: Who was delivered for our offences , and was raised again for our justification .

translation.kha: Kim kah sngewthuh batylli ba ki la shahjop ; kim lah shemphang ïa kaba la jia .
translation.en: O that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !
Then she arose with her daughters in law , that she might return from the country of Moab : for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the  Lord  had visited his people in giving them bread .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa la ki briew da kaba ai ha ki ka jingot kaba bha ; kumta ka la khreh ban mihnoh na Moab lem bad la ki pyrsa kurim .
Ki la buh jingmut ïa kane mala ki la sngewbha eh . Da Shispah , kaei kaei baroh kaba u syiem u la leh ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki paidbah .
translation.en: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them : as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people .
So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki aiti noh ïa kita ki koidi bad ïa ki mar lute ha ki paidbah bad ki nongïalam jong ki ,

translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .
translation.kha: U Jisu Khrist u long ujuh mynhynnin , mynta bad sha ki bymjukut .

bad ibha ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U Trai , u Obadaïah u la shim bad pynrieh ïa ki shapoh ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ha ki krem , da ka pjiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun kiba Sawphew ngut ha kawei kawei ka kynruh , bad u la pynbiang jingbamsap bad um ïa ki . )
translation.en: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the  Lord  , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets , and hid them by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water . )
And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngkha .
Haseroth jingim don bor ban bam bad ban dih ?
translation.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink ?

translation.kha: Lada um pyndep ïa Kin ki kamram ha ka , u dei ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ka khlem da thret ei ei .
translation.en: And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha lad nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , badno ngan shim noh ruh ïa u saiwul malade ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phang .
translation.en: Therefore will I return , and take away my corn in the time thereof , and my wine in the season thereof , and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi bad mane ruh tang ïa u . Ïaineh ha u bad kular skhem tang ha ka Kyrteng lad u .
translation.en: Thou shalt fear the  Lord  thy God  ; him shalt thou serve , and to him shalt thou cleave , and swear by his name .

translation.kha: U la leit shai u Rangbah lyngkhot , bad u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synñiang kiba ha Damaskos , Khnang ba dalade un lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ïa ka lyngki jong U Trai , un haka ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïapait biang hapdeng ki briew namar kine ki ktien .
U ong ha ka , Khlieh leit phai pat sha la ka kynthih , bad long ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .

And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .
translation.kha: u la phah khot ïa u bad u ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me ban smai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ban ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad nga la maham ïa me ba lada me leh kumta , men ïap da shisha . Hato mem shym la mynjur ïa ka bad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?
bad ki pukni ki ap don ïoh puh ïa ka metïap jong u .
translation.en: He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .

translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki hap leit sha ki Philistia ban phah thaw ïa ki nar lyngkor , ki mohkhiew , ki sdie , bad ki rashi jong ki ;
translation.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .

translation.kha: Hobab u Jethro u la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , u la kmen bad u la ong ,
translation.en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the  Lord  had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .

translation.kha: U la ong , Lada phi Kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud da kaba leh ïa kata kaweh nga ñiew ba ka long kabu dei , bad da kabu sumar ïa ki praw jrong nga , ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi da kano kano ka jingpang kaba nga la pynngat ha ki nongot Ijipt . Nga long U Trai uba pynkhiah ïa phi .
translation.en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .

translation.kha: La pynnep ïa ka ban pynïap , la pynphyrnai ba kan lehbha kum ka leilieh . Kan ym don ka jinglehkmen , uba ki briew jong nga ki la leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingmaham malade jingpynshitom baroh .
translation.en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter  ; it is furbished that it may glitter : should we then make mirth ? it contemneth the rod of my son , as every tree .

translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un mihpaw , da kaba wan ha ki lyoh ha ka bor bhabriew bun ka burom .
translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew ha ka jingïohmap ka la pynpyut ïa nga da ka jingtriem bad sngewpang , ka jingpang kum ka jong ka kyntiap ha ka por suh kha .
translation.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain : pangs have taken hold upon me , as the pangs of a woman that travaileth : I was bowed down at the hearing of it  ; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei naba la shuh ñiew ha ka jingkheiñbriew , kata , naduh uba arphew snem shaneng , u dei ban sleit shad nga ïa kane ka dor ba la thuh .
translation.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingkhem ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym shym la hiarpateng na u Arnon um bit ban wan sha ka reng ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U Tlai , lym kumta un shah pynjot thiaw kum u khor bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Eleasar da u Maaseïah .
translation.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .

And the messengers came again , and said , Thus speaketh Ben–hadad , saying , Although I have sent unto thee , saying , Thou shalt deliver me thy silver , and thy gold , and thy wives , and thy children  ;
translation.kha: Hadien ki nonglamktien ki wan biang sha u Ahab bad kawei pat ka jingdawa na u Benhadad ;  Nga la phah ktien sha me ba men aiti noh ha nga ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me , bad ïa ki kynthei bad ki khun jong me .
Ki bri ki ïa-ong ba kano ka ri kan long kum ka ri shyiap ha kabu ki briew lymne ki mrad kin im , bad ba ïa ka yn ai noh sha ki nongai Bithynia . Hynrei ïa ki lyngba yn sa thied pat ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And fields shall be bought in this land , whereof ye say , It is desolate without man or beast  ; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .

The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u pynkyntang ruh ïa ka bynta kaba hapdeng ka phyllaw , kata ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u kñia hangta ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh jingïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba kata ka duwan rnong ka rit than eh na ka bynta baroh kine ki jingainguh .

translation.en: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran — uta uba kyrteng u Judas Iskariot — u la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ,
Namar ngi tip uei tur uba la ong , Ngan sa pynhiarkput , ngan siaw Kylleng ; bad uba la ong ruh , U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .

translation.kha: Wat shim ïa la ka para ne hynmen kynsi kum kawei na ki tngen jong me katba ka tnga Jong me , ka dang im .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .
That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jong kito ki bym pat ngeit , bad phim donkam ban shaniah hano hano na ka bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .

Kynsan U Trai u phah ïa ka ding , bad ka ba-im duh ïa ka jingkñia ainguh lane bad ïa ki byndi bakhleiñ baroh ha ka dil . Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadait lep haduh khyndew .
translation.en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .

How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Balei ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ? Ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei ki bymshisha . Nga la bsa ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin da kdang , hynrei ki la leh awria , bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki bad ki nuti .

U Joseph hajuh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha ka sheng Bethlehem ha Judia , ka jaka ha kaba la khap ïa sahmiet dabi . U Joseph u la leit shata Namarba u la long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid .
translation.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )

translation.kha: Kine ki longïng ki kyr-ang jong ki Nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai
translation.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,

translation.kha: U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u diengduh ban thang ding bad shi pyntha jongnga u ban pynlong bleithaw . Da shi beit u pynmeh ding ban pynsyaid ïa lade bad shet kpu ; da kawei patan ka shi bynta u shna blei malade manla ïa ka .
translation.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .

translation.kha: Mynta te , ma phi bad ka Dorbar to pha ktieh sha u rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom ban ïalamwir ïa u Paul sha Phin , da kaba leh mynleh ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingkit kaba thikna shaphang jong u . Hynrei ngin long kiba la khreh ngab pynïap ïa u ha shaw ba un poi Hangne .
translation.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .

translation.kha: Nangta u wanlam ïa ki khum shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shkor kamon jong ki , ha ki tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ki jatkmie ba sha kamon Jong ki . ngat u Messaïah u tah ïa ka snam kaba sah ha baroh sawdong ka dil .
translation.en: And he brought Aaron s sons , and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear , and upon the thumbs of their right hands , and upon the great toes of their right feet : and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .

translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Susah kane ka long kai kaba ngin leh , ïada U Blei u shah .
translation.en: And this will we do , if God permit .

translation.kha: Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :
He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun u dei uba lamler . Uno uno uba pynphriang ïa ka jinglorni u dei uba bieit .

translation.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .
translation.kha: Bad ki paidbah ki la wan na ki shnong kiba sawdong ka Jerusalem , ki da wallam ïa kito kiba pang lane kiba don mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ki ; bad la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
U ïaleh nabar u angel bad u la jop . U la ïam bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa tymmen jong im u Jakob bad u la ïaring bad u .
translation.en: Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;

translation.kha: Susah u ISAIAH u la long uba kham shlur hir u ong , Ïa nga la shem da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la pang ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .
translation.en: But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .

translation.kha: Nangta un bujli da kiwei pat ki maw ha ka jaka kita uba la weng ino , badno yn sa ñiad astor thymmai ïa kita ki kynrup .
translation.en: And they shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones  ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .

translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa ka jingdih ha ka ri , hynrei ki nadong Ijipt kim Shimham la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jongnga u .
translation.en: He sent darkness , and made it dark  ; and they rebelled not against his word .
A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban ieit bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka por ïa ka jingsuk .
Bad kumta baroh kiba sah na u bynñiaw ken wei shuh nga , baroh ki Jentil ïa uba nga la khot ban erlangthari ki jong nga .
translation.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .
Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Jerikho , ka Beth Hoglah , ka Emek Kesis ,
Ym don uno uno uba ïoh burom lymne u long uba sngewrit ; ki briew kiba meng ki don ha ka lyngki sha ka jingjot .
translation.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .

translation.kha: bun haba ki la wan ha U Jisu , ki la ioh ïa uta u briew uba ju don shibun ki ksuid hapoh jong u . U la shong hangthie , u la Phong jreiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bad baroh ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .

translation.kha: Te ki lum kin um hapoh jong u kum ka bthing ha ka dong , kin noh shat ki jaka them kum ka um batuid arsut ïa u lumrit .
translation.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him , and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .

translation.kha: Un krenbeiñ ki kyntien ha ph da kaba ma phi bad baroh ka longsyiem phin ïohlait im .’
translation.en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .

translation.kha: Haba kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ang , ngin dei ki khuid lad said ka kynthei mraw , hawei jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translation.en: So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .
And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong syiem ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Josaïah u syiem ka Judah , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim .
Ngi la ïohsngew ba katno katne ngut kaba la leit na ka kynhun jong ngi bakha la pynpyiar bad pynkhuslai ïa phi da kaei kaba ki la ong ; pynban , ktien shym la ïohpdiang kan kano ka jingbthah na ngi .
translation.en: Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :
The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .
translation.kha: Uwei u don ha ka phang bashatei jong ka khim , u da phai sha Mikhmash , bad uwei pat ha ka phang bashathie , u da phai sha Geba .
Nga phah nongpynïaid pun ong ïa ki , Nga ïangat leh ka kam badonkam bad ma lah ban leit hiar shata . Ngan ym shah ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam tang namar ba leit ïashem ïa pa .
translation.en: And I sent messengers unto them , saying , I am doing a great work , so that I cannot come down : why should the work cease , whilst I leave it , and come down to you ?

translation.kha: Hato ngam dat ka hok ban leh ïa phi ki paid Jerusalem’ ïa kaei kaba u nongthaw khiew u la leh ïa ka dewbyrtha ? Phi don ha ki kti jong nga kum ka dewbyrtha ha ki kti u nongthaw khiew .
translation.en: O house of Israel , cannot I do with you as this potter ? saith the  Lord . Behold , as the clay is in the potter s hand , so are ye in mine hand , O house of Israel .
I am a stranger and a sojourner with you : give me a possession of a buryingplace with you , that I may bury my dead out of my sight .
translation.kha: Nga long u nongwei uba im hapdeng jong phi ; die ïa nga khyndiat ka jaka ba ngan ïoh ban tep ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him , Why hast thou served us thus , that thou calledst us not , when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites ? And they did chide with him sharply .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Ephraim ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Balei phim shym khot ïa ngi haba phi la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian ? Balei phi leh kumne ïa ngi ?  Ki la khñium tyngeh shaphang kane .

Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor kiei kiei kiba ïadei sad ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima-patsha , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah ban tip) kaei kaba dei ïa-ban kuna .
translation.en: Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :

translation.kha: U diengduh shiah u jaboh , ‘ Lada phi kwah shisha ban pynong ïa na u syiem jong phi , te ale wan nabar riehtngen hapoh ka syrngiew jong nga . Lada phim kwah , ka ding sa klang na ki tnum shiah jong nga bad bam duh ïa ki dieng Kedar ka Lehsbun .’
translation.en: And the bramble said unto the trees , If in truth ye anoint me king over you , then come and put your trust in my shadow : and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Saul u la long u syiem ki Israel , u la ïaleh ïa Baroh ki nongwan jongngi u kylleng : ki paid Moab , Amana , Edom , ki syiem ka Sebah , bad ki Philistia . Man kaba u ïaleh u jop .
translation.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel , and fought against all his enemies on every side , against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines : and whithersoever he turned himself , he vexed them .

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrsiew bad ka jingkhuslai ki wan hap halor jong ki . Ki ïohi ïa ka bor jongno me , ko Trai , ki ïeng khlieh wai krung da ka jingtieng , tad haduh ba ki brai jong me ki la ïaid lait sha shiliang — ki briew kiba me la pyllaitluid na ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them  ; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone  ; till thy people pass over , O  Lord  , till the people pass over , which thou hast purchased .

translation.kha: kumta u la phah shiphew ngut ki samla shynrang bad ka hukum ban wait sha Karmel , shun pud ïa u Nob , bad ban ai ka jingkhublei na u .
translation.en: And David sent out ten young men , and David said unto the young men , Get you up to Carmel , and go to Nabal , and greet him in my name :

translation.kha: Ka Assyria Kan ym lah da lei lei ban pyllait im ïa sem , bad ki Kulai thma kim lah banbeiñ ïada ïa ngi . Ngin ym ong shuh ha ki bleithaw jong ngi ba ki long U Blei’ jong ngi . A Trai , me pyndum jingisynei ha kita ki bym don uno uno sha babha ki lah ban phai .
translation.en: Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .

translation.kha: Haduh katno nga kaweh ba ngan kop hangno ngan shem ïa u , ban tip) kumta ngan leit shano ba u don .
translation.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !

translation.kha: U Jiw u la mynhynne na kata ka jaka bad u la leit phai pat sha la shngain ; ki synlar ki bud ïa u .
translation.en: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country  ; and his disciples follow him .

translation.kha: Hib la tim ïa ngi , ngi kyrkhu ; haba la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi ïaishah ; haba la rkhiebeiñ ïa ngi , ngi pynphai kylliang da ki ktien kiba jem .
translation.en: And labour , working with our own hands : being reviled , we bless ; being persecuted , we suffer it :

translation.kha: khnang ba phin ïoh Kam kyntien biang ïa kata ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jngai phi ki la shnong shisien . Un pynmanbha malade un pynroi ïa phi kham bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .

translation.kha: U syiem Hiram jong ka Troas u pha ka kynthup ki nongkheiñ sha u Dabid ; u pynbiang ïa u ki dieng sawdong Kedar bad ki misteri tieng bad ki jingsmai mut ban tei Ïing ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .

translation.kha: Lada u kpa jong u um anna hynmen ne lai shynrang lane ki kñi , u kur uba ïajan eh bad u un ïohktah ïa ka , sad un bat ïa ka kum la ka jong ka nongkynti . Ki Eliel ki dei ban kohnguh ïa kane ka aiñ kumba nga , U Trai , nga la hukum ïa me .
translation.en: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it : and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Kumta te , Phim long shuh u mluh hynrei u khun . Bad nongdih ba phi long u khun jong U , U Blei un ai ha phi baroh kat kaba u don na ka bynta la ki khun .
translation.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .

translation.kha: U ïalam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju don ha ki nongbah ka Judah , malu ha kylleng jong ka ri u la jingsngewsih ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju ai jingkñia . U la pyntwa ruh ïa ki duwan ba la pynryngkang sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la ter da u Joshua , u lytar ka nongbah , bakha don shaw kadiang jong ka khyrdop biah kaba ki ju rung sha ka nongbam .
translation.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .

translation.kha: U Blei u khiew ba ki bariew kin im ka jingim kaba kmen ha pyrthei .
translation.en: God wants people to enjoy life on earth .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha kito na phi kiba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei paw ; na la ong ïa kane mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngoh kaba ar ïa phi , hynriewphew ngan ong bajrong Myntan ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka por ba nga wan yn ym don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom .
translation.en: I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :

translation.kha: U ïing pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u kynhun jong u Shammah uba shi para dara u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .

translation.kha: U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Daberath u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïap jong u Hadadeser .
translation.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga bitar ïa kito ki nongwei kiba synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki paid Judah ki long ki jong nga , bad ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan sumar ïa ki . Kin long ki kulai thma badonbor jong nga .

translation.en: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven , and hath founded his troop in the earth  ; he that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tei ïa ka ïing jong u ha ki bneng , bad halor ka khyndew u buh ka jingtei jong ka sahit bneng . U khot ïa ki um ka duriaw bad u theh ïa ki ha sla pyrthei . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  !

Hynrei ka por kan Nakon haba ki paid Jeruel sa shisien patan kmen phai sha U Trai U Bel jong ki ; mala shat umbiah hiarpateng na u Dabid u syiem jong ki . Nangta kin sheptieng ïa U Trai bad kin sa ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai babha ki jong u .
translation.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return , and seek the  Lord  their God , and David their king  ; and shall fear the  Lord  and his goodness in the latter days .

translation.kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki malu kurim ïa ki na ki liang baher .
translation.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?

translation.kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhyllah kine wan shwa Jerusalem ban mane ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u .
translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka nemsniew ka la khamtam jur , bad ka la saphriang ïa ka ri baïar kawei , u Joseph u la plie ïa kita ki ïing kynshew jingbam baroh , bad u la die kew ha ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .
And it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people ; there shall they be called the children of the living God .
translation.kha: Bad ha kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki la ong , ‘Phim dei ki briew jong nga .’ Hangta yn khot ïa ki , ki khun jong U Blei ba-im .

translation.en: And the people spake against God , and against Moses , Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? for there is no bread , neither is there any water  ; and our soul loatheth this light bread .
translation.kha: Ki la khñium ,  Balei phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt ban ïap ha kane ka ri shyiap ha kaba ym don bam lane ka um ? Ngim sngewlah shuh ban bam kum kane ka jingbam !

Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To jing ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban otsher syntiat ïa “kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynti kaba biang eh ba ngin rupa kiew dara katba kumno ki jait shnong kiba ba-don hangta .’
translation.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewlem shad palat ban leit phai ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa Kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho sad ban ym wang phai tad ynda ki ñiuhtmoh jongki ki , ki la san biang .
translation.en: When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
And Elijah said unto her , Fear not  ; go and do as thou hast said : but make me thereof a little cake first , and bring it unto me , and after make for thee and for thy son .
translation.kha: Wat khuslai  u Elijah u la ong ha ka .  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei nyngkong shet ïa u kpu uba rit na kaei kaba pha don bad wanrah ïa u sha nga , bad nangta sa shet ïa kaba sah na ka bynta jong pha bad ïa u khun jong pha .

Me ieit ïa kaei katba dei bad me isih ïa ka bymkhuid . Namarkata U Blei! , U Blei jong me , u la jied ïa me mala u la ai ha me ïa ka jingkmen ka jingpyndonburom kaba khamtam khroh banbeiñ ïa kaba u ai ïa ki paralok jong me .
translation.en: Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity  ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat tim ïa u briew uba kyllut lane wat buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jynthut halor uta . Tiengburom ïa nga ; nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Then answered I , and said unto him , What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u diengpynïeng sharak ?

Uta u paidbah u ïawan shaei u Manasseh bad u ong , Ngi la leh pop hato ngi la kren pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ïa phi ruh . Mynta to duwai ha U Trai ba un sping noh ïa kine ki bseiñ . Kumta u Moses u la duwai na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translation.en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .

translation.kha: U Salm u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong , bad nangta u leit bad ïathuh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .

translation.kha: hynrei katno ka jingkhlaiñ Kaba khraw ka don ha ka met jongnga u , bad katno ka bor kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !
translation.en: Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .

translation.kha: katai ka kmie jong u thah bad jong u thah stang ,
translation.en: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it ?

translation.kha: Bad Mynta nga ai ha Phin ka hukum kaba thymmai ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa eiei .
translation.en: A new commandment I give unto you , That ye love one another  ; as I have loved you , that ye also love one another .
Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la wallam ha ka jingsuk ïa ngi sha ka hima jong U Khun ba-ieit jong u .

Ka jingtep ka phet khrew , ka pyllut kumno u bseiñ , katba ka kynhun shipai u nongshun ka Wan tur . Ki tur ïaleh ïa ka da ki sdie , kum ki rangbah kiba pom ïa ki dieng sad kiba pynjot ïa ka khlaw barben .
translation.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent  ; for they shall march with an army , and come against her with axes , as hewers of wood .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ba u Elijah u la mihpaw , bad sa kiwei pat ki ong ba uwei na ki nonghiarpateng na mynbarim u la mihpat .
translation.en: And of some , that Elias had appeared  ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .

translation.kha: U Joseph u jop , Syiem kyndon , ngiam lah ; hynrei U Blei un ai ka jingbatai kaba ai jinghun .
translation.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , It is not in me : God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace .

translation.kha: U Dabid u pynbynta ïa ki Lebi ha ki lai kynhun kat kum ki kur jong ki : Gershon , Kohath , bad Merari .
translation.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

translation.kha: A Trai U Nongsynshar , at buh ïa ka jingmane jong nga ha me ; nga la shaniah ha me naduh ba nga ïan samla .
translation.en: For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .

translation.kha: Mynta ba phi tip ïa kane ka jingshisha , katno kiba kmiesan phin long lada phi pynjyrngam ïa ka !
translation.en: If ye know these things , happy are ye if ye do them .

translation.kha: Ki kamra ap phira lai tylli baroh arliang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynran hapdeng jong ki , bad ka kamra rung baroh ki la khong ki jingthew kiba katjuh kum kito ibha ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Ka khyrdop barhem shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translation.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .

translation.kha: Kumba ka pukri ka pynneh sngew ïa ka um jong ka , kumta ruh ka Jeroham ka pynneh ïa ka jingsniew jong ka . Nga iohsngew ïa ka jingleh jubor malu ka jingpynjot shapoh ka nongbah , ka jingpang bad ki jingmong ki long baroh bakha nga ïohi .
translation.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters , so she casteth out her wickedness : violence and spoil is heard in her  ; before me continually is grief and wounds .

translation.kha: U thri u ong , Ngam shym la phah ïa Kine ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei kad la katta ki leit la ka leit . nongbam shym la ai kano kano ka khubor ha ki , hynrei pynban ki Kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: I have not sent these prophets , yet they ran : I have not spoken to them , yet they prophesied .
Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ba u patsha un ïohsngew ïa ka jingbna wer wer ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka ri , bad U  Trai  un shah ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .
Man ka sngi na ka boitha hynñiew sngi men ai u langsohmoh , u malai kyrtong , bad u langbrot kum ki jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Baroh ki daym Ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .
translation.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .

translation.kha: Nga tip Haduh katno ka jingtbit jongnga ki nongtei dieng jong phi , kumta to phah ïa nga ki dieng Kedar , ki dieng Kseh-Sypress , bad ki dieng ïa-shahskhor tylli na Lebanon .
translation.en: Send me also cedar trees , fir trees , and algum trees , out of Lebanon : for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon  ; and , behold , my servants shall be with thy servants ,

translation.kha: Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka jingstad , bad lada phi kynti ïa ka , phi hi Phin shem jynjar .
translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki dang nud hi ban otsher kiew sha kata ka ri lum , wat la ka Synduk ka jingïathong U Trai lymne u Moses kim shim mih na ka jaka shang dara .
translation.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .

translation.kha: Pynkup ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynkhleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: U Kiriath um shym la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis . U la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha , nabar ban ïathuh ïa ka khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka keiñ ha ka jingshad briew , khnang ban pynteh ba ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna kan ym pynduh noh ïa ka bor jngai ka .
translation.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the gospel : not with wisdom of words , lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect .

translation.kha: un mihnoh na kata ka ïing bad un khang ïa ka khyndew sngi .
translation.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days :

translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki long ki bym don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kynja , dara ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .
translation.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .

So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .
translation.kha: Kumta ki sop da ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ïa ki syngkai jong ki bad ki tyllai sawdong ïa ki ryndang jong ki , ki leit sha u Ahab bad ong ,  U shakri jong phi u Benhadad u kyrpad ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .  U Ahab u jubab ,  U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U long kum uba shi para bad nga !
Ka long hain katto Katno por ba ki Ammon ki leit ïalang thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the children of Ammon made war against Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewlalot badno kita kiba leh byrtong , kiba awria bad ki nongpynïap briew , kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
translation.en: For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .

translation.kha: U Trai u tip mynno ki mynsiem jong ngi ki shah pynlwet ha ka byndi ;
translation.en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth ,

translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki kwah ïa ki kabu kum ka sakhi , bad ki Grik ki wad ïa ka jingwad .
translation.en: For the Jews require a sign , and the Greeks seek after wisdom :

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki wan phai pat ban ïaleh sa ïa kiwei ki Benjamin kiba dang sawa , dara ki pynïap lat ïa ki baroh — ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , nabar ki jingri jingdum ruh . Ki thang lut khoit ïa ki shnong Baroh kiba don ha kata ka thain .
translation.en: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin , and smote them with the edge of the sword , as well the men of every city , as the beast , and all that came to hand : also they set on fire all the cities that they came to .
Yea , the hind also calved in the field , and forsook it , because there was no grass .
translation.kha: Ka skei kmie hapoh ka lyngkha ka iehnoh ïa la i khun ba dang kha namar bym don phlang .

Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki nongrit sarong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Balaam Beer ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phang bashathie . Kanneh ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jat Simon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohthiah jong ki .
translation.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Jehud . Ha kane kwah ka por ka nongbud Libnah mad ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time .

translation.kha: U ong ruh ha u Aaron , Aïu kine ki briew ki la leh ïa phi , haduh ba phiah la pynlong ïa ki ban leh ïa ka pop naba ishyrkhei kat Kanneh ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , What did this people unto thee , that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them ?

translation.kha: Kane ka long khia jingthmu na duh ba sdang , ba u Blei u la pynkhreh , ka tngen kad long “ka nongiarap jngai u kum ka jinglong sumar ka ba biang .”
translation.en: This is what was intended , since God provided a wife to be “a helper for him , as a complement of him .”

translation.kha: Phi pynleit jingmut kyrpang ïa ki katto katne ki sngew , ki bnai , ki aïu , nabar ki snem .
translation.en: Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .

translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng ksiar , bad kita kiba don ki suda ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha to . Na bran ïa ki ha ka ding , bad wan mih da i'u u khun masi .
translation.en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
translation.kha: Phi long kiba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba die ha ka ïew die doh , khlem da kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .
Lane lehse phim tip ba u bynriew uba pynïasoh ïa la ka met bad ka nuti u long kawei ka met bad ka ? Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shai kdar , Baroh ar kin ïalong kawei ka doh .
translation.en: What ? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body ? for two , saith he , shall be one flesh .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por katto katto ngut ki phraphew ki la wan sha U ju bad ki la ong ha u , Me dei ban phet noh nangne bad leit shawei patan , namar u Jehoïada u kwah Ban pynpei ïa me .
translation.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees , saying unto him , Get thee out , and depart hence : for Herod will kill thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei to tip mynta ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïaid ha Shuah jong phi kumta ka ding kaba bam lud . Un jop bad pyndem ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , ba phi lah ban beh krad bad pynjot ïa ki kloi kloi , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: Understand therefore this day , that the  Lord  thy God is he which goeth over before thee  ; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them , and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the  Lord  hath said unto thee .
And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ngut ki tnga na ka bynta u syiem Joash , bad ki kha ïa u , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .

Ka jingïaleh hapdeng ki kynjoh ïaleh kiba ïajah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul Bad kito ibha ïashah ïa u Sabad ka la neh slem bha . Katba u Dabid u nang khlaiñ nangto khlaiñ , ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong u ki la neng tlot nang tlot .
translation.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynstep phin ieh ïa ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai . U la jingïashoh ïa ki jingkhñium jong phin pyrshah ïa u — ho-oid , pyrshang ïa u , namar ngi te ngi shu kohnguh ïa ki jingbit jong u .
translation.en: And in the morning , then ye shall see the glory of the  Lord   ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the  Lord  : and what are we , that ye murmur against us ?
For it is written , He shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee :
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un hukum ïa ki angel jong u ban sumar bha ïa me .’

Hynrei naduh ba sem sangeh ban ai jingkñia ha ka Shem jong ka ïeng bad I sangeh ban theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ngim shym don ei ei shuh , bad ki briew jong ngi ki ïap ha ka thma bad na ka jingïapthngan .
translation.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .

translation.kha: U ïeng ha ka jaka ïong jong ki syiemsad , dara pynbang ka jutang bad U Trai ban khongdong ïa u , ngab sumar ïa ki Aiñ bad ki hukum jong u , da ka angnud bad mynhynne jong u baroh bad ban leh ïa ki jingshisha kiba ïadei bad ka jutang kumba la thoh ha ka Lehkmen . Bad baroh ki biria ki kular baneh bat ïa ka jutang .
translation.en: And the king stood by a pillar , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul , to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book . And all the people stood to the covenant .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synran ïa ka pharshi ba hikai ïa ki ba ki dei banbeiñ ïaboi borabor ban ym noh mynsiem da lei lei ruh .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;

translation.kha: Mano ba khang ïa ki khyrdop ban bat ïa ka duriaw haba ka bthuh na ka kpoh jong ka khyndaiphew ?
translation.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it brake forth , as if it had issued out of the womb ?

translation.kha: Ngan pynpaw phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Ashbath ha ka ri jong phira bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbet jongngi phi .
translation.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh hapdeng ki kynhun ïaleh kaba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul malade kito kiba ïajah ïa u Dabid ka la Neah slem bha . Katba u Daberath u nang khlieh nang khlaiñ , ki nongïaleh pynshisha jong u ki la nang tlot nang sleit .
translation.en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .
In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps , and finished them in the seventh month .
translation.kha: Ki jingai ki sdang ban poi ha u bnai uba lai bad ki ïai kynton ha ki saw bnai kiba bud .

translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the  Lord  hath promised : for we have sinned .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïamih ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri lum , ki da ong ,  Mynta te ngi la kloi ban leit sha kata ka jaka ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha ngi . Ngi phla ba ngi la leh pop .

Ïa ki jingkñia la bam da baroh ki Israel naba la wan phai na ka jingshah jingkraw bad da baroh kito naba la iehnoh ïa ki rukom mane blei thala jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri bad kiba la wan ban mane ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel .
