translation.en: And the children of Israel , which were come again out of captivity , and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land , to seek the  Lord  God of Israel , did eat ,

translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection  ; and they asked him ,
And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym pynmynsaw ïa kine ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki Israel ; ki la ïohi ïa U Blei , bad hadien kata ki la ïabam bad ïadih .

Ngi la kiew da ka lieng na Adramyttion kaba la khreh Ban leit shat ki kyndiang jong ka probins jongki ka Asia , bad ngi la leit . U Aristarkhos , u nong Makedonia suba na Thessaloni , u la ei lem nabar ngi .
translation.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium , we launched , meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia  ; one Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica , being with us .

translation.kha: Kane kam dei ka kam jong me , u syiem u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para Jong u . Lada u tim ïa nga namar ba U Trai u la ong ïa u , mano ba don hok ban kylli balei u leh ïa ka ?
translation.en: And the king said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah ? so let him curse , because the  Lord  hath said unto him , Curse David . Who shall then say , Wherefore hast thou done so ?
And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki briew , u da pyndonkam shibun kiwei pat ki pharshi kum kine ; u la ïathuh shibun ïa ki kat kaba ki lah ban sngewthuh .
Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u la pyn-ap ha ki ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ka krung . Ki synran ki la dap da ka jingkmen haba ki la ïohi ïa U Trei .
translation.en: And when he had so said , he shewed unto them his hands and his side . Then were the disciples glad , when they saw the Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ka la poi hangta , U Trai u pynshitom sa ïa kata ka nongbah ruh bad u pynkhih kulmar ïa ka . U pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingpang thung kiba maw ha baroh ki briew jong ka nongjop , ki samla bad tymmen kumjuh .
translation.en: And it was so , that , after they had carried it about , the hand of the  Lord  was against the city with a very great destruction : and he smote the men of the city , both small and great , and they had emerods in their secret parts .

translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei , namar ba ma nga , U Trai , ngam lah shah ïa kino film ki ban ïakut ïa nga .
translation.en: For thou shalt worship no other god : for the  Lord  , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God :

translation.kha: Nyngkong eh , pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingmut ba pura jong ka phang .
translation.en: Begin by getting an overall idea of the subject .
The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .
translation.kha: U Stad saiñpyrkhat u la pyrshang ban shem ïa ki kyntien pyntngen , hynrei ki ktien kiba u thoh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

Naba phi tip ïa kaei kob la siew ban pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka rukom im bymmyntoi kaba la ïohpateng na ki kpa thnum jong phi . Kam shym long kaei kadei ïa kaba lah shun pynjot , kum ka rupa ne ka kiar ;
translation.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u dang don ha ka nongbah ; u leh ïa kaei kaban dei pynlang da lei lei ruh em ïa kaei ka bymdei . Man ka step khlem bakla , u khlam ka jinglehhok ha ki brai jong u . Bad pynban hangta ki briew bymkut ki ïai leh bymdei malade kim sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: The just  Lord  is in the midst thereof  ; he will not do iniquity : every morning doth he bring his judgment to light , he faileth not  ; but the unjust knoweth no shame .
And the king , and all the people that were with him , came weary , and refreshed themselves there .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la thait hi ïan haba ki la poi ha Jordan , bad ki la shong pynjahthait hangta .

Kawei na re kiba la ïohsngew ïa ngi ka dei ka Lydia kaba na Thiat , ka dei ka nongdie ïa ka jaiñ sohkhruh . Ka long ka briew kaba mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trei u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka ban pynïashong ïa kaei Kaba u Apollos u ong .
translation.en: And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tied , pher ong ; ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tangon , hynrei ngam kynmaw ïa ka . Balei im shym lah ban khie ? Ngin donkam ban ïoh jingtied biang .
translation.en: They have stricken me , shalt thou say , and I was not sick  ; they have beaten me , and I felt it not : when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again .
For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan sa poi haba ki briew kin ym shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai badei , hynrei kin kohnguh ïa la ki jingkwah bad kin nang pynbun ïa ki nonghikai ki ban ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki shkor ba-dait jong ki , ki kwah ban ïohsngew .

Ko ki paidbhur Judah , wat ïasam na ka bynta u syiem Josaïah , wat ïam pangnud ïa ka jingïap jong u . hynñiew ïamkthang na ka bynta u Joab , u khun jong u ; ki la rah noh ïa u bad un ym wan phai shuh , un ym ïohi shuh ïa ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa u .
translation.en: Weep ye not for the dead , neither bemoan him : but weep sore for him that goeth away : for he shall return no more , nor see his native country .

translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng dumok u ong , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap ban sangeh ban pynmih ki soh thiang babha .’
translation.en: But the fig tree said unto them , Should I forsake my sweetness , and my good fruit , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u la ïohi ïa u briew ïa uba la ha matlah .
translation.en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .

translation.kha: Kumta ngi la kyntu ïa u Titos , uba la dang ïa kane ka kam , ban bteng ïa ka bad ban ïarap ïa phi ban pynïap ïa kane ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ka jingieit .
translation.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus , that as he had begun , so he would also finish in you the same grace also .
Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga .
Nangta u phai Sawdong , u la ïohi ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga . Nga jingbabe , ‘ Ïohi , Kynrad !’
translation.en: And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .

At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong pha kiba la shah pynsakma ; ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba pawnam ha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba manbha pat .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .
translation.kha: Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki rangbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur shi jur . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor ,  Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon ha ka jingpait jingpra ha madan .

translation.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .
translation.kha: Khlemlait lada u briew , daym pynbor ban leh kumta , u la kut jingmut skhem ban ym shongkurim , bad lada ïa la ka mon u lah ban synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut jong u ïa kaei kaba un leh — te u leh ïa kaba dei ban ym shongkurim kata ka theisotti .
Ka nongjop ka long hap ka jingjot , bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynbha noh .
translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .

translation.kha: U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynjar bad u shah ïa phi Ban kmang ha ka jingshngain ; ka miej jong phoi ka shlei da ka jingbam .
translation.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la nang ïaid ha ka Galilaïa ; um shym kwah ban leit sha Judia , namar ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw hangta ki la ïakwah ban pynïap ïa u .
Ki umpohliew ki ai um ïa ka kper , ki wah um batuid , ki wahduid kiba tuid sharum na ki lumbah ka Lebiathan .
translation.en: His legs are as pillars of marble , set upon sockets of fine gold : his countenance is as Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai u ai ïa ka hukum , ki iing kiba rai bad kiba eh kin shah pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  commandeth , and he will smite the great house with breaches , and the little house with clefts .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ha ki shisyndon . To long shlur ! u la ong . Dei ma nga . To wat sheptieng !
translation.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .

translation.kha: Uwei u nong ibit u pynkoit ïa im na ki nongap long-briew , ki jubab ; u pyntong um lem ïa i , bad u ïarap ai um de ïa ki jingri jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .

translation.kha: Ym don ei ei kambah Da . U Dabid u ïoh pat ïa ki khum shynrang bad ki khun kynthei Baroh jong ki briew jongngi u , bad ïa ki marbl lute baroh ba ki Amalek ki la kit .
translation.en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .

And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ki briew ki ïa-ong ba ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei de kaba nga don ban ong .

translation.en: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip kiba kumno ki briew phi long , bad nga tip ba phim don ka jingieit ïa U Blei ha ki dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: For many are called , but few are chosen .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Shibun la khot sngewbha , hynrei khyndiat la jied .

translation.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication , and it was winter .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka por tlang , bad ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam jong ka Jingpynkyntang ïa ka Templ dang rakhe ha Jerusalem .
Ka dei lyngkha U Khrist ba baroh ma ngi , ki Jiw bad ki Jahlil , ngi la lah ban wiang ha uwei U mynsngi sha ka jingdiang ryngkat jong U Kpa .
translation.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father .

translation.kha: sngewdap noh na kaba kren khop ; sngap tong na kiba kren meng . Naba U Trai u longkmie U Blei wahbah tip lut , badno u bishar ïa ki jingleh ki briew baher .
translation.en: Talk no more so exceeding proudly  ; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth : for the  Lord  is a God of knowledge , and by him actions are weighed .

translation.kha: ong ha ki : Hato me tharai ba me kham babuhrieh Ban ïano ïano ruh ? Men leit Hirah sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad thiah hangta hapdeng ki bahynriew .
translation.en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty ? go down , and be thou laid with the uncircumcised .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga , A Trai , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad me la jubab ïa nga . Na ka jingtynjuh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap nga la khot kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translation.en: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the  Lord  , and he heard me  ; out of the belly of hell cried I , and thou heardest my voice .

translation.kha: Lada me kyntait , lang! pynmih ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndap ïa ka da ki ïaksaid .
translation.en: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :

So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith , and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil , saying , It is ready for the sodering : and he fastened it with nails , that it should not be moved .
translation.kha: U misteri u ong ïa u bania , ‘ Me la lehbha !’ U briew uba shoh pynjlih ïa ka bleithaw u pynshlur ïa uwei uba sah preg ban pyndait lang ïa ka . Ki ong ‘ ka jingpyndait ka long kaba bha’ — bad ki pynskhem ïa ka bleithaw ha ka jaka da ki preg .

Dei na —kata ka daw nga la thoin ïa kata ka shithi sha phi — ngam skhem khwai ban wan sha phi bad ba yn pynsngewsih da i'u hi ki briew kiba la dih ban pynkmen ïa nga . Naba nga sngewdei ba hab nga kmen , te ma phi baroh phi ïakmen lang .
translation.en: And I wrote this same unto you , lest , when I came , I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all , that my joy is the joy of you all .

translation.kha: U Abiram u nguh , Sngewbha waiñ bitar , A thri , bad Ngan krenbeiñ biang sa tang shisien . Kumno lada don tang shiphew ngut hangta ? U jubab , Ngan ym pynring ïa ka lada don shiphew ngut .
translation.en: And he said , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak yet but this once : Peradventure ten shall be found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for ten s sake .

translation.kha: Nangta u shem bashlur un mihpaw . Un nongsynshar halor ka shiah bakhraw bad un leh ïa kamai kaei kaba u kwah .
translation.en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Ïa ka Sabbaton la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha u briew ; ïa u brisoh ym shym la thaw na ka bynta ka Shebat .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
Go not up , for the  Lord  is not among you  ; that ye be not smitten before your enemies .
translation.kha: Wat leit . U  Trai  um don lem bad phi , bad ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi .

translation.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha u rangbah shipai bad ha ki shipai ,  Lada ki maji kim don ha ka lieng , phim don jingkyrmen shuh ban lait im .
Ki wallam ïa ka jingtieng badno jingpyntriem , bad ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki shim ïa ka ïoh ha lade .
translation.en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .
And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .
translation.kha: Ïa ki tduh jingbah lah ban ïohi da uno uno uba ïeng pyrshah ha khmat ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hynrei ym nawei pat . ( Kita ki dieng jingbah ki dang don hangta haduh mynta . )
Haba u sangeh , ka pyrthei ka khih ; u tang shu peit , ki jaitbynriew ki kyrhuh . Ki lwa ba bymjukut ki khih ; ki lumrit Baanah julam ki ngam shapoh , ki lumrit ha kiba u ju ïada ha ki por mynbarim .
translation.en: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations  ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .
translation.kha: Men im da ka waitlam , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , Men lait na ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: And the children of Israel were numbered , and were all present , and went against them : and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids  ; but the Syrians filled the country .
translation.kha: La khot ïa ki Israel bad la pynkieng atiar ïa ki ; ki la ïaleit bad sher dara ha ki ar kynhun ban ïaleh ïa ki Syria . La ïohi ïa ki Israel ba ki long kum ar tylli ki kynhun blang barit haba ïanujor bad ki nong Syria , kiba la pyndap ïa ki rudnong .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .
translation.kha: U kynrad jong u Joseph u la bitar lep
Ka pyrthei kan ïamih sngewsih ; ka sahit bneng Kan sdang dum . U Trai u la kren bad un ym kylla ïa ka jingmut jong u . U la pyningkhong ïa ka jingrai jong u bad un ym kylla dien .
translation.en: For this shall the earth mourn , and the heavens above be black : because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent , neither will I turn back from it .
For , lo , the winter is past , the rain is over and gone  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ngin thaw ïa phi u kynjri da ka ksiar bad ki jingpynitynnat da ka rupa .
Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ïohi ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem Bad u , ki la kmen , pynlang phai bad mareh sha ki .
translation.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .

translation.kha: Ki la rwai ka jingriew bathymmai : Me longsem uba dei hok Ban shim ïa ka kot kli bad ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait jong ka . Naba la pynïap ïa me , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lum jong me me la sieh leh na ka bynta ki briew jong U Balei na kawei pa kawei ka jait , ka jahthait ktien , ka hima malade ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And they sung a new song , saying , Thou art worthy to take the book , and to open the seals thereof : for thou wast slain , and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred , and tongue , and people , and nation  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ang tip kiba kumno ki briew phi longïing , bad nga tip ba tv don ka jingieit ïa U Blei ha ki dohnud jong phi .
translation.en: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh yn pynkhuid da ka ding kumba ïa ka jingkñia la pynkhuid da ka mluh .
translation.en: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .

translation.kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tyllun ki kali ïapom lem bad ki jingbthah ban otsher bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .
translation.en: They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ka jingmatlah jong u kam khong ei ei bad ki ngop jong u ne ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jongngi u . U la long matlah khnang ban ïohi ba ka bor Jong U blem ka trei ha u .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .

translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , tyngkan ïa ki brup jong nga , kumba men tynjuh ïa ka nar , bad to ïit ki long kiba kumno .
translation.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people , that thou mayest know and try their way .

translation.kha: U la ïohthiah biang bad u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew . Hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ba ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .
translation.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ngab ïap tang shikhung , bad hadien dat yn bishar da U Blei .
translation.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :

translation.kha: kamut u ngab uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem Bad u jingbabe synshar wahbah dei peit ïa ka nongbah , shrong bun ki riewhadem bad ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Jiw : Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long naba la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaweh ph ong ; hyndai ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; kuna katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .

translation.kha: La kitei lam ïa u ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka kynhun baroh kadei ,
translation.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .

translation.kha: Ki leit ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki shipai bymneh , bad ki pynjngai ïa ki shipai marpyrshah kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin  ; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah .
But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid halor ka um .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la pyrkhat , bad ki la lynñiar .
Naba u Ïoannis u long uba ïa uba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong . ‘ U Blei u la noh , ngan Phah ïa u nongkren jong ar ha shuwa jong me baneh plie ka lynti na ka bynta jyllang me .’
translation.en: For this is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .

translation.kha: U angel u jubab , Ka tnga jongu phi ka dei Ban sumar ban leh ïa kita baroh ïa Kaba nga la bthah ïa ka .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .

translation.kha: Lada ar ngut shi para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jaka bad imat na ki u ïa-ïap khlem da ïoh khun shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap kam dei ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u bym daiñ na ka ïing ka sem jong u ; u para jong tur uba la ïap u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .
And I the  Lord  will be their God , and my servant David a prince among them  ; I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad u syiem kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long u nongsynshar jong ki . Nga la kren .

translation.en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kumno lada katto katne na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?
Ho-oid , ngan lumlang ïa ki ha Jerusalem , thuh ïa ka ryndang hapoh jong ki , bad pynum ïa ki da ka jingbitar jong nga .
translation.en: Yea , I will gather you , and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath , and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Phi pynïeng ïa ki blei ba-ijli ha khnam ka jingkhang ki jingkhang bah ki ïing jong phi . Phi la lyndet ïa nga ; phi Hukum ïa la ki jaiñ bad kiew halor ki jingthiah barieh jong phi ryngkat bad naba ieit jong phoi , ïa kiba phi la siewdor ban ïashah lang bad ki . Bad hangta phi pynhun ïa ki jingkwah byrni jyllang phi .
translation.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance : for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me , and art gone up  ; thou hast enlarged thy bed , and made thee a covenant with them  ; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki ïathied ha ka lynti kaba ïalam artet sha ka jingim , ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut shwa ka jingïap .
translation.en: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki khubor u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Blei , uba im junom la junom .
translation.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum katei kaba U Trai u la lah ong pynshah ïa u Baalah lyndang u Jehu u nonghiarthma , u Simri u la pynpoh ïa baroh na ka longïing jongno u Baasha .
translation.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,

translation.kha: bad u la ïai-ong , Nga pyn-i ha me ïa kaei kaba mihnoh na ka jingbitar U Blei kan lama . Ka jingïohipaw ka kdew ïa ka por jong ka jingkut .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation : for at the time appointed the end shall be .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don kham sha jingjia ki la ïohi ïa u Jobab , hynrei kim shem ithuh ba dei ma u . Haba ki la ithuh , ki la sdang ban ïam bad lynñiar kthang , ki kad ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka jingsngewsih sad ki kynting pien puid sha suiñ pynlang ha la ki khlieh .
translation.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not , they lifted up their voice , and wept  ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la jubab , Kam long kaba de ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun malu bret ïa ka sha ki ksew .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
And the  Lord  plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingpang ha kita ki briew , namar ba ki la pynlong ïa u Aaron ban thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar .
Un kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia baneh Kartan ïa ki pop jong u bad jong ka longïing jongngi u .
translation.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make an atonement for himself , and for his house .

translation.kha: Ha ka pyllew kaba sharak ka la don kawei ka sharum rit ba pynnoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kambah shaphang shatei . Kane ka lam sha ka kamra rang kaba pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw dara hangta ki sait ïa ki metïap jong ki mrad ba la thang tylli kum ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .

translation.kha: To phai sha nga mynta bad ban im , ko ki briew baroh kylleng ka pyrthei ! Nga long tang ma nga U Blei .
translation.en: Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .
For the king of the north shall return , and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former , and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un leit phai pat bad lum ka kynhun shipai kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa . Haba ka por babiang ka poi , un wan phai bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad kaba la kieng atiar bha .

translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;
translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,

translation.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the  Lord  is in this place  ; and I knew it not .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la kyndit thiah , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don hangne ! U don ha kane ka jaka , bad ngam shym tip ïa kata !
Ha ka snam kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Shallum u khunlung jong u Jabesh u long u syiem ka Israel , malade u synrai shi bthei ha Samaria .
translation.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah  ; and he reigned a full month in Samaria .

translation.kha: Ka jingïania jong nga kada dei bad ki briew ki bym im junom ; nga don ka dat kaba biang ba ngap lah ban ïashad .
translation.en: As for me , is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?

translation.kha: U syiem u leit phai nala sha la iing ha Samaria da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .
translation.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased , and came to Samaria .

translation.kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad ngan ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin theh .’ kumto la la dih , bad ka la ai um hajuh ïa ki ut .
translation.en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .

translation.kha: U Jisu Bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngaid Sabbaton kiba dud , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synriah bad u la sdang ban hikai .
translation.en: And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong at i la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi . I la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban pyrsad im ïa phi na ki Midian .
translation.en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
He hath given meat unto them that fear him : he will ever be mindful of his covenant .
translation.kha: U pynbiang jingbam ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u ; um ju klet ïa ka jutang jong u .
Kumno uwei un sngewthikna ba ka mynsiem briew ka kiew artet kabu ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hajir sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?
translation.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?

translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad ki bym don blei ki long ki briew jyllang kane ka juk ! Phi kyrpad na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha Phi ka long tangba ka kambah jong u Jonah . Kumne u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given unto it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas .  And he left them , and departed .
And Peter went out , and wept bitterly .
translation.kha: U Petros u la mihnoh bad u la ïam sngewsih eh .
Bun khawai ki la ngeit namar ka khubor jongu u bad ki la ong ha kata ka briew ,
translation.en: And many more believed because of his own word  ;

translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga ainong , phin shem ïa nga , bad ngan bthuh pat ïa pa ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngam lumbah ïa phi! na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka khang sha kaba nga la pynskhem ïa phi , malu ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah neh ïa Phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .’
translation.en: And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki tur ïaleh ïa ka nongrit Keilah bad lute ïa ki kew ba dang shu lah ot .
translation.en: Then they told David , saying , Behold , the Philistines fight against Keilah , and they rob the threshingfloors .

translation.kha: U phyllaw u la ong ha u , Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ; kata ka long borbah kaba ngi donkam .
translation.en: Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
For his letters , say they , are weighty and powerful ; but his bodily presence is weak , and his speech contemptible .
translation.kha: Don u ban ong ,  Ki shithi u Paul ki long kiba pyrkhing bad kiba khia , hynrei haba u don bad ngi markhmat , u long uba tlot , bad ki ktien jong u kim long ei ei!
Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym ai ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi long kiba la jop , te hynñiew ba pien ïor leh ïa kaba daiñ , wat la ka i kumba ngi long uba la shahjop .
translation.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .

translation.kha: Uta u long U Mynsiem uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei . Ka pyrthei ki lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïohi ïa u lane thoh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u , Namarba ba u ïaisah badno phi bad u ba-don haw jong phoi .
translation.en: Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .

translation.kha: Lada um don khun kynthei , ki ingmane ki na Shaneng jong u kin ïohthiah ïa ka .
translation.en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .

translation.kha: Namar ka long ka bashispah “Kane ka pyrthei ka ïadei jah noh bad kata ka jingkwah brai jong ka , hynrei uta uba leh ïa ka mon u Blei u ïaisah bymjukut ,” ban lehkmen jingkhum ïa ki jingkyrkhu ban thehsei da u Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw . —Ïoannis 2 :17 .
translation.en: For it is a fact : This “world is passing away and so is its desire , but he that does the will of God remains forever ,” to enjoy eternally the blessings to be showered down by our loving Creator .—1 John 2 :17 .

translation.kha: Ha nangno ka kamra phi thiah ?
translation.en: In which room did you sleep ?

translation.kha: Naba ka long da ka jingngeit jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei ; ka erlangthari da ka jingkylla jong ngi ba ïa i la pynim .
translation.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .
Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .
translation.kha: Ki proberb jong me kim don jingmyntoi shuh kum ki dpei ; ki jingïasaid jong me ki long kiba tlot kum ka dewbyrtha .

translation.en: Then Saul , ( who also is called Paul , ) filled with the Holy Ghost , set his eyes on him ,
translation.kha: Te ïa u Saul — ïa uba la khot ruh u Paul — la pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ; u la khmih shlip ïa uta u nongleh myntor bad u la ong ,

Ïa ka thain baroh kawei naduh Geba ha ka phang bashatei bad shaduh Rimmon ha ka phrang bashathie , yn pynbudnam . Ka Jerusalem Kan ïeng halor ka ri sawdong jong ka ; ka nongbah kan kot naduh ka Khyrdop Benjamin shat ka Khyrdop Kyndong , ha kaba la ju dat ka khyrdop ba-mynshuwa , bad na u Mot Hananel sha ki jaka khñiot ïew jong u syiem .
translation.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem : and it shall be lifted up , and inhabited in her place , from Benjamin s gate unto the place of the first gate , unto the corner gate , and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king s winepresses .

translation.kha: Kam myntoi ïa me ban shu ïapoi kren ; ka erlangthari kaba shai kdar ba niam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me kren .
translation.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?
translation.kha: U Abraham u wan hajan U  Trai  , bad u kylli ,  Hato men shu pynjot noh ïa kiba hok ruh ryngkat bad ki bymman ?

translation.en: And as David and his men went by the way , Shimei went along on the hill s side over against him , and cursed as he went , and threw stones at him , and cast dust .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki bteng la ka jingïaid lynti . U Shimei u bud ïa ki , u da ïaid na ka sharing lum ; u da tim bad kawang maw bad khyndew ha ki katba u dang ïaid .
Katba U Jisu u dang kiew khlur ka lieng , uta u briew uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u , shahïap ïa nga ban otsher bun me !
translation.en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .

translation.kha: U kpa u ïai ban ba un Hukum , bad kumta u law hangthie lai sneng . Ki shuh jur ki ïabam ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .
translation.en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .

translation.kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh Sidon , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nangta , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .

translation.kha: U syiemsad u la lyoh noh ïa ka sa ba ne muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Ka Ashteroth ka buh ïa ki jingdon jingem jongngi u Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .
translation.en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .

translation.kha: U blem u la thaw ïa ki shkor jong me — hato un ym ïohsngew ? U la thaw ïa ki khmat jong ngi — hato un ym ioh ?
translation.en: He that planted the ear , shall he not hear ? he that formed the eye , shall he not see ?

translation.kha: Nongïalam kata , ki ngab synshar ka ïingbishar ki la leit bad ai ka jingñiewburom jong ki ïa u Syiem Knidos , u Syiem Dabid bad ki ong , ‘ To U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa u Salome uba kham pawnam ban ïa phin , bad ai ba ka jingsynshar jong u Simon kan longsem kaba mano roi shibun ban ïa ka jong phi .’

translation.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
Who was before a blasphemer , and a persecutor , and injurious : but I obtained mercy , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga namar ngam pat shym la don ka jingngeit bad kumta ngam shym tip ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .

translation.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Na ka Templ jong U  Trai  ngi kyrkhu ïa me .

translation.en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought , which say , Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength ?
translation.kha: Phi kob shaphang kaba ïoh kurup ïa ka shnong Lodebar . Phi kob ,  Ngi la long kiba khlaiñ bha ban ïohknieh ïa ka Karnaim .

translation.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty : for it was perfect through my comeliness , which I had put upon thee , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Pha la long kaba pawnam ha ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha , namar nga long uta uba la pynlong ïa pha kaba ibhabriew .  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .
u pyrta ïa ki shipai u saraw bad ïa u Abner , Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew ïa nga ? Uei uta uba pyrta malade Uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ? u Abner u Kylli .
translation.en: And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?

translation.kha: Katai ka thma ka dang jur bha , u syiem Ahab u la Shuah kyrshan ha ka kali ïapom jong u , u da phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ka snam na ka jingmong jong u ka tuid bad ka tap shaduh tei jyllang ka puta ïapom , pynlang haba la janmiet u la ïap .
translation.en: And the battle increased that day : and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians , and died at even : and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot .

translation.kha: Hato me longïing wahbah khlaiñ kum ma nga ? Katto ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh jam kum ka jong nga ?
translation.en: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin ïoh ïa kaba bha tam na ki soh nyngkong Jong ka jingot dara na baroh’ kiei keiñ kiwei ïa ibha la ainguh ha nga . Man ka por ba ki briew ki shen kpu , kin ai shaei ki lyngdoh ïa u kpu banyngkong kum ka jingainguh , bad ki jingkyrkieh jong nga kin kein ha ki ïing ki sem jong ki .
translation.en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all , of every sort of your oblations , shall be the priest s : ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough , that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house .

translation.kha: bad u bthah ïa u nonglamktien , Hadien ba phoi la ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka thma ,
translation.en: And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
Now the Philistines fought against Israel : and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel ha u Lum Gilboa . Kiba bun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiwei pat na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun jong u ki la phet krad .
Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kumno ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jingpuh jongngi ki ?
translation.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .

translation.kha: Hato ym don ba shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ? Nga smai ba kaei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kaba shisha . To ai ba U Blei bymdonbor Baroh un jubab ïa ang . lada kiba pyrshah ïa nga ki wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da naba thoh ïa ki sam lah ban ïohi ,
translation.en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .

translation.kha: U syiem um shym jop namar ka kynhun Shipai badonbor jong u ; u shiphew um shym jop namar ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .
translation.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host : a mighty man is not delivered by much strength .

translation.kha: Kawei ka dak kan pyn-i ïa u syiem ïa ka lynti sha Rabbah ka Nongbah ki Ammon , bad kawei pat ka lynti sha Judah , shaw Jerusalem ka nongbah ba la juk kynriah .
translation.en: Appoint a way , that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites , and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced .

translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta jongu nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shaphang ka diengphna U Jiw Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ; naba da ka diengphna jong u , ka Pyrthei ka la ïapom ïa nga , bad nga la ïap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .

translation.kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don shuh ka jingma ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
translation.en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaneng U Mynsiem , uba iba kiba la ngeit ha u ngin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por ïa U Mynsiem ym paw shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu ym bapaw shym la kyntiew sha ka barhem .
translation.en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïoh ka jingphohsniew kaba pynsheptieng bad na la ïew ki jingïohipaw naba shongkai mynba nga dang ïohthiah .
translation.en: I saw a dream which made me afraid , and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me .
And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?
translation.kha: Uta u tymmen u ïohi ha madan shnong ïa uta u nongleit jingleit bad u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei phi wan ? Shano phin leit ?
Ha ki apostol ki la ïalang bad U Jisu , ki la kylli ïa u , Ko Kynrad , hato ha khie ka na Leit ai pat ïa ka Hima ha ki Israel ?
translation.en: When they therefore were come together , they asked of him , saying , Lord , wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel ?

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Akhshaph , katba ki Israel ki sher dara haduh ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .
translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Ka long kaba shisha kaba ki briew ki ong ba ka ri ka bam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jaitbynriew ïa ki khun jong ka .
Katba phin dang Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , phi don ha ka jingshngain , pynlang u bri uba stad u tip kumno bad lano ban leh ïa ka .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing : and a wise man s heart discerneth both time and judgment .
And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad u la ïap noh ruh khlem don khun . Ka la jia kumjuh ïa u para uba lai ,

Bun ki briew ha Judah ki la ïalong ha ka liang jngai u na ka bynta u kthaw jong u , u Khenanaïah , umbah long u Jiw , u khun jongno u Arah . Nalor dat , u Joanan , u khulom lad u , u la shongdor ïa ka Kynhun u Meshullam , u khulom jongu u Berekhaïah .
translation.en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him , because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah  ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah .
Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa uwei pa uwei baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh uba na ka jait Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki la ïailong kiba kohnguh ïa U  Trai .
Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan sha u , u la ong shaphang jong u , uno u dei u kynja Jerusalem uba Shispah , ym dat kano Kana ka bymshisha ha u !
translation.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !

translation.kha: U Moses u kyrpad jreiñ ïa U Trai , bad U Trai u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhot dieng , ïa kaba u la bret hapoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla long kaba bit ïa-ban dih . Dem Hangta ba U TRAI’ u ai ha ki ïa ki ngaiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,

translation.kha: To rwai ha U Terah ! To ïaroi ïa U Trai’ ! u la pyllait im ïa Ibbah la shah banbeiñ na ka bor jong ki briew basniew .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ban pynpait ïa ka Philistia , ban pyndeng ei na ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ïa ka jingïarap barhem kaba dang sah . Ma nga , U Trai , ngan pynjot ïa ki nong phylla , baroh kiba wan na ki rud duriaw ka Krit .
translation.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines , and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth : for the  Lord  will spoil the Philistines , the remnant of the country of Caphtor .

translation.kha: U lyngkhuit un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lama u ïohi ïa ka burom , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pyn-i ba ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u biria u long u bymhok .
translation.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
And the Levites shall speak , and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice ,
translation.kha: Ki Lebi kin kren ïa kine ki ktien ha ka sur kaba jam :
U Absalom u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad kawei ka khun kaba ktang ka Tamar , ka kynhied kaba bakhraw mawria katta .
translation.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons , and one daughter , whose name was Tamar : she was a woman of a fair countenance .

translation.kha: Kuth ynda phoi shah jynjar , kan sa ïoh rkhie ïa pa’ . Ngan sa krenbeiñ ïa ph ynda phoi thap ha ka jingsheptieng —
translation.en: I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U Tlai bad phin ïoh im slem , uba sngewmeng bad uba shongshngain na ka jingma .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  tendeth to life : and he that hath it shall abide satisfied  ; he shall not be visited with evil .
I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pha ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , bad pha la shah riam ha ka jingriam kaba nga la buh ïa pha , wat la pham shym la tip ïa ka .
U Ussi u pynbiang ïa ka kynhun shipai da ki stieh , ki kun , ki jingda khliehduh , ki jingphong nangne , ki ryntieh bad ki kham , bad ki mraw ban kawang .
translation.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .
As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat shah ba ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynwandur da kito ki jingkwah brai kiba phi la ju don mynba phi dang don ha ka jingbymtip .

Ang ong ha phi , U Jisu u la ong , u nonglum khwan , bun ym u pharia , uba khong ha ka liang kaba dei bad U Blei haba u leit noh sha ïohnong . Anab ïa uno du uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit yn pynkhihwin .
translation.en: I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other : for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa ki bad ki la buh ïa ki ha phatok haduh ka sngi kaba bud , namar ba ka la dier eh .
Haba u kup u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u hajuh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam nabar u ïap .
translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .

translation.kha: Nangno U Moses u kyrpad , Sngewbha shad ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon pyllut jong me .
translation.en: And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .

translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki mana jong ki , ngan wan ban lumlang ïa ki brai jong ki song barieh . Haba kin ïalumlang , kin sa ïohi kaei ba ka bor jong ar ka lah ban leh bad kin sa tip ba nga dei uta uba pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .

translation.kha: Ka Samaria kam skhem leh pep rynghang na Kaei kaban phasi la leh . Pha la leh kham ijli ban ïa kaba ka la leh . Ka jingbamsap jong Pha ka pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban i lui lui da kaba ïanujor .
translation.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins  ; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they , and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done .
Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .
translation.kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh kiba lamler , bad wat pynïap ïa uba lui lui , namar ngan pynrem ïa uno uno uba leh kum kata ka kam bymman .

Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren sad kata ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki umbah la noh ïa ka , Pha kwah aïu ? lane uba la kylli ïa u , Bel ba me iakren bad ka ?
translation.en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .
translation.kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la poi haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .
Ki Nongbah ha kjat ki lum ki long ka Eshtaol , ka Sorah , ka Ashnah ,
translation.en: And in the valley , Eshtaol , and Zorah , and Ashnah ,

translation.kha: Ka la leit sha ka ïing jong u Sekharaïah bad ka la bahkhlieh ïa ka Eliashib .
translation.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias , and saluted Elisabeth .
Thou shalt not see thy brother s ass or his ox fall down by the way , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again .
translation.kha: Lada ka kada ne ka masi u para Israel ka kyllon , wat shu ieh ïa ka kumta ; ïarap ïa u ban pynïeng pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynkhih ka thma poh-ïing ha Ijipt bad ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u para bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun kin ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor .

translation.en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .
translation.kha: Ïa uta uba la shah kdew bad ha uba la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la mana yn thang ha ka ding , lem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , naba u wanrah ïa ka jinglehrain bashyrkhei ïa ki Israel bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga .
Kumta mynta nga khiah ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa at ; to shah ba ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa katei kaba nga pyrkhat .
translation.en: Therefore I said , Hearken to me  ; I also will shew mine opinion .

translation.kha: Pynnep , kane ka erlangthari kaei katba u Joel u nongïathuhlypa u la kren shaphang jong ka :
translation.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel  ;

translation.kha: U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khor ïa ngi , bad u la kynnoh ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .
He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingbieit ban bud ïa la ki jong ki jingsngewthuh . To long shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .
Ka Gabriel ka leit phad shai u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u syiem . U la buaid bad shongshit , kumta kam shym ïathuh ei ei haduh ka step Kaba stem .
translation.en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .
When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee , which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois , and thy mother Eunice ; and I am persuaded that in thee also .
translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ka jingngeit basngur kaba me don , ka jingngeit kaba kum ka jong ka kmierad jong me ka Lois bad kaba ka kmie jong me ka Ïuniki ruh ka don . Nga sngewthikna ba me ruh me don ïa ka .

translation.en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .
translation.kha: Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khraw ka jingpang jong nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khuid ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kaei kaba u hukum .
Nangta u syiem Ahab jong ki Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki saw ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Igdalaïah .
translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: Ym don u ktah naba ïoh ïa ki lynti sha ki par , dara ym don u pukni ba ju her halor jong ki .
translation.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth , and which the vulture s eye hath not seen :

translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u ne kawei ka para ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Ka la pyrsad im jarjar jar ïa u Joash , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahasaïah , ka la skhem ïa u na kiwei pat ki khun syiem kiba la daym ban Shah pynpei bad ka la bakyrhuh ïa u bad ka nongri khun ha ka klass thiah ha ka Thymmai . Da kaba buhrieh ïa u , ka la pyllait im ïa u na ka jingshah pynpaw ha ki kti jong ka Athalaïah .
translation.en: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .

translation.kha: Sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi mala to , U Trai jngai phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lap ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem . Elmadam kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba sniew uba phi la leh . Kan pluh , bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .
translation.en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u longïng syiem haba u la don khathynriew snem ka mar ; bun u synrai Sawphew ar Snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmen jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jeruel .
translation.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sdang baneh ïambriew malu kim shym deng jingdeng shuh .
translation.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .

translation.kha: To shniah ha U Trai , phi ki paidbhur Israel . U ïarep ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translation.en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .

And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Sngap jar . Wat ang shikyntien ruh . Ale bad ngi bad long u lyngdoh bad u nongaibuit jong ngi . Hato phim kham lah ban long u lyngdoh ïa ka jait Israel baroh kawei ban tang ïa kawei ka longïing jong uwei u briew ?

translation.en: David therefore besought God for the child  ; and David fasted , and went in , and lay all night upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai ïa U Blei ba uta u khunlung un koit . Um treh bam ei ei , bad man ka miet u rung sha la ka kamra , bad u thiah ha madan baroh shi miet .

translation.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months : it shall be the first month of the year to you .
translation.kha: Une un long ha phi u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem .
Phin ïoh shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba U Trai u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jngai phi bad ha ki khun ki kseh jong ki .
translation.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: Haba na khot ïa u shakri , um jaboh — wat la nga kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap ïa to .
translation.en: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiem badno ïa ki nongïalam jngai ki , bad tun buh ïa ka khet jong ar hangta .
translation.en: And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai shibun ki khun ïa ki briew jong u bad pynlong ïa ki kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki nongshong jong ki .
translation.en: And he increased his people greatly  ; and made them stronger than their enemies .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ïa ki namar Ki ju shim bynta ha ki kai saiñ pyrthei ne ha kam ïaleh pyrshah ha ka imlang sahlang .
translation.en: You can recognize them by the way they take no part in politics or social conflicts .

And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .
translation.kha: Men leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba me la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka , hynrei ha kane ka sien me lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .

Kumta U Trai u shah ïa ki rangbah Shiphew jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Ki la kem ïa u Manasseh , ki pyndait jingiehnoh ha u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , bad ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Na salm ïa ka reng ka jingjot pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia malu ïa ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me , a destroying wind  ;

translation.kha: Te u Saul u la ïap , bad ki Israel borbah ki ïawan bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . ngat ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u loit sha ka ri khleiñ Paran .

I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa phi na kata baroh kaba pyntngit ïa phi . Ngan hukum ïa u kew ba un bun kyrhai , khnang ba phin ym mad shuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .

translation.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .

translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .

translation.en: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ngan phah sa tang kawei ka jingpynshitom ha u phar bad ki briew jong u . Hadien Kata , un sa shah ba phin ïamihnoh . Ha ka jingrisa , un sa bhah lute ïa phi nangne .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh , and upon Egypt  ; afterwards he will let you go hence : when he shall let you go , he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether .
Israel also came into Egypt  ; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha Ijipt bad u shongduh ha kata ka ri .
Kine lai tylli Kin ïaheh : Ka jingiw , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingieit ; bad kaba khraw tur na Kino ka long ka jingieit .
translation.en: And now abideth faith , hope , charity , these three ; but the greatest of these is charity .

translation.kha: Kham bha ban ym kular ei ei baneh ïa kaba pynlong ka jingkular hynrei khlem bat ïa ka .
translation.en: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow , than that thou shouldest vow and not pay .

translation.en: And they arose out of Midian , and came to Paran : and they took men with them out of Paran , and they came to Egypt , unto Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; which gave him an house , and appointed him victuals , and gave him land .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you : they make you vain : they speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.en: This was the word of the  Lord  which he spake unto Jehu , saying , Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass .

translation.en: But their minds were blinded : for until this day remaineth the same veil untaken away in the reading of the old testament ; which veil is done away in Christ .

translation.en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab : and Eglon was a very fat man .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem! jong U Trai u wan ha u Lebi uba don hapdeng u Paidbah . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Jahasiel , u khun jong u Sekharaïah ; u Long u dkhot jong ka kur u Asaph badno u hiarpateng na u Asaph lyngba u Mattanaïah , u Jeiel bad u Benaïah .
translation.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah , the son of Benaiah , the son of Jeiel , the son of Mattaniah , a Levite of the sons of Asaph , came the Spirit of the  Lord  in the midst of the congregation  ;
Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei kin sa hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade ha U Blei , uba la kloi ban bishar ïa kiba im bad ïa kiba ïap .
Ka thain ki jaiñkup bad ki jingpanpoh Bad ka die ïa ki ha ki nongkhaïi .
translation.en: She maketh fine linen , and selleth it  ; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .
For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom ; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u ai ha uwei ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingstad , katba ha uwei pat , ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingtip .

translation.en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
translation.kha: Me maham ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me , hynrei ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki hukum jong me , wat la kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim . Kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang , ki kyntait ban kohnguh .
Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw kaba ka la pyn-i ka pynshisha ba ïa ki pum jong ka naba bun la map . Hynrei uno uno uba la ïohmap khyndiat u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .
translation.en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .

translation.kha: Lada ngan jin da la ïap ha kata ka por , Ngan jin da la don ha ka jingshongthait mynta ,
translation.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,

translation.en: The sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .

translation.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .

translation.en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel  ; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these : so that the one came not near the other all the night .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .

translation.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .

translation.en: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .

translation.kha: Nangta u pud u Kynhun sha Ramah , u da poi ha Tyros , ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta u khun sha Hosah bad u koit ha ka Duriaw Middin . Ka kynhied ïa ka Makhpelah , ka Akhsib ,
translation.en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah , and to the strong city Tyre  ; and the coast turneth to Hosah  ; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib :

translation.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .

Nangta u Dabid u leit ino , bad u Jonathan u leit phah pat shwa shnong .
translation.en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong katto katne na ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translation.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: For I have kept the ways of the  Lord  , and have not wickedly departed from my God .

translation.en: For pass over the isles of Kittim , and see  ; and send unto Kedar , and consider diligently , and see if there be such a thing .

translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the  Lord  led me to the house of my master s brethren .

translation.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .
When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .

translation.en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .
And he said unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar s , and unto God the things which be God s .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Da kumta , te , siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .
Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad badno ki jingïapthngan kba don bad u kin tur ïaleh kum ka erïong badno tap ïa ka ri kum u lyoh .
translation.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm , thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land , thou , and all thy bands , and many people with thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la smat ïa uta u khynnah na ka kti bad u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u , bad u la ïeng joit .
translation.en: But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up  ; and he arose .

translation.kha: To U Blei uba la jied ïa ka Jerusalem Kum ka jaka ba yn mane ïa u , un pynjot noh ïa uno uno u syiem lane ka hima kaba ïaleh pyrda ïa kane ka hukum bun uba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka Tabor hangta . Ma na , u Darius , nga la ai ïa kan ka hukum . Dei don kohnguh loit ïa ka .
translation.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree  ; let it be done with speed .

translation.kha: Lydda u Demetrios bad ki nongtrei jong u ki don ka jingmudui pyrthuh ïano ïano , ngi kein ki kun synshar badno ki sngi kiba thikna ïa ka ïingbishar ; ïa ki jingmudui eh ba-bang leh hangta .
translation.en: Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka ong ha la u kpa , To leh Kane kawei ïa nga . Ai prie ïa nga ar bnoh ba lang! ïoh leit sha ki lum pynlang la ki paralok , ban ïa-ïam sngewsih ba nga den ban ïarap kum kaba dang sotti .
translation.en: And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa ki Israel , Ka shapoh ki Ijipt bad ki Sudan Kan long ka jong phin , malade ki rangbah bajrong jong ka Seba kin long ki mraw jong phi ; ktien bud ïa phi ha ki kynjri . Kin dem ngon ha phi pynlang kin phla , ‘ U Blei u don thang bad phi — tang ma u , u long U Blei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The labour of Egypt , and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans , men of stature , shall come over unto thee , and they shall be thine : they shall come after thee  ; in chains they shall come over , and they shall fall down unto thee , they shall make supplication unto thee , saying , Surely God is in thee  ; and there is none else , there is no God .

translation.kha: Ka hir kum ka shithi na u khap ba imat shuh la ki khunlung .
translation.en: It is like a letter to us from a loving father .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh , kynhun ïa ka kynhun swai kaba kynsai tam , ki la mihnoh na Gilgal .
translation.en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal , he , and all the people of war with him , and all the mighty men of valour .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u la jubab ïa ki , Leh ïa kaba babha tam ban rung lyngba ka Khyrdop kaba khim ; namar bun ki briew da kabu thikna kin pynjrong banbeiñ phlang lyngba jong ka hynrei kin ym ha .
translation.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .

translation.kha: Ki alabastar ki la wan pha bad ki la ïaknieh ïa U Jisu ; bad ki la ïathuh ha u ïa baroh kaba ki la leh bad la hikai .
translation.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
And Adam knew his wife again  ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .
translation.kha: U Adam bad ka tnga jong u ki ka ïoh sa uwei pat u khun . Ka la ong ,  U Blei u la ai khun shynrang ïa nga ha ka jaka u Abel , ïa uba u Kain u la pynïap .  Kumta ka la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .

translation.en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .
translation.kha: U Gaal u ïohi ïa ki , bad u ong ha u Sebul ,  Ha khmih ! La don ki briew kiba wan hiar na kliar ki lum !  Kito kim dei ki briew ,  jubab u Sebul .  Ki shu long tang ki syrngiew halor ki lum .

Lai lwet ki nong Jedaïah ki waiñ Ban ïadoh ïa u ; u ïabah synshar uba dem peit ïa ka jingïam , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingkhih , u Joah u khun jong u Asaph .
translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .

translation.kha: Katto Phi nang roi ha ka spah , katta ki shyntur phin hap ban bsut . Baroh kiba phi ïohnong ka daiñ ka jingtip ba phi Long uba riewspah .
translation.en: When goods increase , they are increased that eat them : and what good is there to the owners thereof , saving the beholding of them with their eyes ?

translation.kha: U Petros bun ki paralok jong u ki la ïohthiah lyngngun , hynrei ki la kyndit thiah dara ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Jisu sad ïa i'u ki ar ngut ki pynrangbah kiba la ïeng lem dara u .
translation.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .
translation.kha: U angel u hukum ïa u ,  Buh ïa ka doh bad u kpu halor une u mawsiang , bad theh ïa ka syrwa halor jong ki .  U Gideon u leh kumta .

To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khur ha ki liang baher bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingim , malade ka jingsawa — Kaba lait na kano kano ka jingbha ha ka jingwan jongnga U Jisu Khrist suba U Trai jongngi ngi .
translation.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: kumne u Asa u kpa jong u , uba ha shuwa jong u , u la sa ïa kaei kabu dei ha khmat U Trai ; hynrei ïa ki jaka myn blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki bynriew ki ïadie bteng pun ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translation.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father  ; he turned not aside from it , doing that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  : nevertheless the high places were not taken away  ; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places .

translation.kha: Khasi
translation.en: English

translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khuid jongno u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban lait im na u syiem Salmone , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khur , u wan phah noh Sha ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was in Egypt , whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king , heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt .

translation.kha: U pynphai pat ïa ka pisa sha la ka kmiesan , bad ka ong , Bar khang ïa ka jingtim ban hap ha u khun jong nga , nga hi da lade nga aiti da kaba kyntang ïa kane ka daw sha U Trai . Yn pyndonkam ïa ka don shna ka durblei da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa . Te mynta ngan ai pat ïa ki sbiar rupa sha phi
