translation.en: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother , his mother said , I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the  Lord  from my hand for my son , to make a graven image and a molten image : now therefore I will restore it unto thee .

translation.kha: U Shabeh bad u Salmunna ki don ha Kore lem bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai baroh jong ki jyrthiaw ka ri shyiap , tang kumba hajan hajar ngut ki dang sah ; shiah lakh afi hajar ngut ki shipai ki la shah pynïap .
translation.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .
And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
translation.kha: bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa ha trai jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .

translation.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban kñia ainguh ïa u jingri uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynrei yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular .

U misteri u ong ïa u bania , ‘ Me la lehbha !’ U briew uba shoh pynjlih ïa ka pynlwet u pynshlur ïa uwei Uba praw preg ban pyndait lang ïa ka . Ki ong ‘ ka jingpyndait ka hir kaba bha’ — dara ki pynskhem ïa ka bleithaw ha ka jaka da ki preg .
translation.en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith , and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil , saying , It is ready for the sodering : and he fastened it with nails , that it should not be moved .

translation.kha: U ong ïa u Sabad , Men leh aïu da uto u diengduh ? Me ïarwai nga dei u ksew ? Bad u pyut da ki jingtip ki beit jrong u halor u Dabid .
translation.en: And the Philistine said unto David , Am I a dog , that thou comest to me with staves ? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai nongbishar u ong ha ki , Ki ktien jong phi ki long Ibbah bakla , bad ki jingïohipaw jong phi ki long kiba lamler . Nga long pynshisha ïa phi! .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Suk uta suba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suk kito kiba shahshkor! ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jongno ka jingiathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kambah la thoh ha kane ka kitab ! Nobah ka por ka la ïan hajuh baroh kine kiei kiei kan sa jia .
translation.en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , phiah long ki sakhi jong nga ; nga la jied ïa phi ban long u shakri jongnga nga , khnang ba Phon tip ïa nga bad jait ha nga bad sngewthuh ba nga long tang ma nga U Blei . Nalor jong nga ym don uwei pat u blei ; u bym pang ju long bad u ban nym long .
translation.en: Ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , and my servant whom I have chosen : that ye may know and believe me , and understand that I am he : before me there was no God formed , neither shall there be after me .
A foolish son is the calamity of his father : and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping .
translation.kha: U khun uba mutlop u lah ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha la u kpa . Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrop .
Ha khih ka kynsi , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop wahbah tap-matlah .
translation.en: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban kheiñ sut hajuh phi ai ram ïa u nongthain , ym haba phi ai ram ïa la u para Israel , ba kumta U Trai U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu kat ïa kaba phi kun ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohrung .
translation.en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury  ; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it .

translation.kha: Dang pateng pynrangbah ha ka step Sngi U Trai ki kynthei ki la kitei shad ka jingput ki da rah ïa ki musla kiba ki la pynkhreh .
translation.en: Now upon the first day of the week , very early in the morning , they came unto the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared , and certain others with them .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , ibha jrong bad uba khlaiñ . “Phi la long khraw rahah katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka siat bneng , bad ka bor jong phi ka ïar ba-halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .
And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga .
Ka Jesebel mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor , ka ong ïa u Ahab , U Nongthaw u la ïap . To khie leit mynta bad shimti ei ïa ka briew sohwaiñ Kaba um shem treh ba-bang die ha phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned , and was dead , that Jezebel said to Ahab , Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give thee for money : for Naboth is not alive , but dead .
And David sware unto Saul . And Saul went home  ; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la kular ba un leh kumta . Nangta u Saul u leit phai sha ïing , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai biang sha la ka jakarieh .
hynmen haba u la sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingdap u Amnon , u la shlei da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa u Absalom u khun jong u .
translation.en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u khun uba la kha ha ka rukom briew u la pynshitom beiñ ïa uta uba la kha namar U Mynsiem U Blei ; bad ka long kumjuh mynta .
U angel u la ong ha ka , To kam sheptieng , ko Mei ; U Blei u la sngewbha ïa pha .
translation.en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei ki ibha u Pekahaïah u la bor la buh jingthoh ha Ka Hanes Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  u ban ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ban ïa-ïoh bynta lang . Kin ïa-im ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad kan long ka jong ki junom .
Haba u Jakob bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki sdang ban mih , ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw ka la wan hap ha ki briew kiba don ha ki sheng ba-marjan , bad kim shym la beh satia ïa ki .
translation.en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .
translation.kha: Shibun kin iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ha kata ka por ; kin ïashetkylla iwei ïa iwei pat bad kin isih iwei ïa iwei pat .
Kiba riewspah bad ibha duk ki don ïa kane kajuh , U thri u pynlong ïa ki baroh ar .
translation.en: The rich and poor meet together : the  Lord  is the maker of them all .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi la Long ki mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U Trai u la ïapyllait ïa moi da ka borbah jong u .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :

translation.kha: U Jephthah u phah nonglamktien biang sha u syiem Ammon
translation.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .
translation.kha: Bad u Samuel u ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa shisien ngin pynbna ïa u Saul kum u syiem jong ngi .

translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka dem ngon ha khyndew bad ka ong ,  Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shakri jong u .

translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka bor ban bishar lane ban pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phi ar ngut ?
ka bai shut sdie bad ka Da imat ïa ki dien tyndung ka long shi sbiak rit , bad ka bai tih nar lyngkor lane shut mohkhiew ka long ar tylli ki sbai rit . )
translation.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks , and for the coulters , and for the forks , and for the axes , and to sharpen the goads .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar per ong : Ka long kaba shisha kaba ki briew ki nong ba ka ri ka ïam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jingpyniwbih ïa ki khunlung jyllang ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;

translation.kha: U Ktien u la long u tyllong jong ka jingjam ; bad kane ka jingim ka la wanrah ka jingkhaïi ïa u bynriew .
translation.en: In him was life  ; and the life was the light of men .
And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , phin sa shadkmen ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban long khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Te phin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga pyn-i ïa la ka jingbitar pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong nga .
Ko Pa , u duwai , Ko Pa jong na ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa Kanneh ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynbun ym ïa kiei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa Kaei kob me khoh .
translation.en: And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .

translation.kha: Na ka boitha kane ka pyrsa , thaw san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dien ban long da ka ksiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta kine ki rishot .
translation.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .

translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa nga ktang shahjop dara shah pyndait . Ai ba kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa por kin shahshkor pynlehrain bad shah pynjyrngam .
translation.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul  ; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt .
And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohi ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki dem khrup .

translation.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed : but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded .
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar ; bud ïa ka bad phin lait im .
Ka iaka sawdong jong ka Naphtuh ka dei jong ka jai Manasseh , hynrei ka shnong Tappuah , ha khappud , ka dei ka jong ki Kynhun ki ksiew u Abram .
translation.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim  ;
Moreover he called for a famine upon the land : he brake the whole staff of bread .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah  nemsniew sha ka ri jong ki bad u la shim noh ïa baroh ka jingbam jong ki .
Ki paid Israel ki ïambriew na ka bniat jong u bad ki tep ïa u , kumba U Trai u la kren lyngba u shakri jngai u , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And they buried him  ; and all Israel mourned for him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet .

translation.kha: Ha kaba kum kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u la kumta pang bad u la jan ïap . U duwai , bad U Trai u ai ha u ïa ka ki ba un sa khiah patiaw .
translation.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death , and prayed unto the  Lord  : and he spake unto him , and he gave him a sign .

translation.kha: U Daniel jong U Blei kiba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Jeruel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .
translation.en: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la shoh ïa ki da ka jingpang , bad ki la ïaw .
translation.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land , died by the plague before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka kynthei ha ka jingkhang ka la shohbeiñ samthiah palat katba ka dang ia kew bad ka ïohthiah , kumta u Rekhab bad u ba-pnah ki eriong shapoh .
translation.en: And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .
The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .
translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong u baroh yn pynjot ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

translation.en: And said unto them ,  Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi thiah ? Khie joit bad duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .

Lada uta u bariew u long uba duk bad um kotbor haw mawria , un khulom na ka bynta ka jingpynkhiah tang nawei u jinglyngkhuit kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat , kaba long ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U Trai na ka bynta u Lyngdoh . Un wanrah ruh tang shi kilo u purew ba la khleh Bad ka umphniang Olib pun pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh bam-im bad sa kumba shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang Olib .
translation.en: And if he be poor , and cannot get so much  ; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved , to make an atonement for him , and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering , and a log of oil  ;

And an angel of the  Lord  came up from Gilgal to Bochim , and said , I made you to go up out of Egypt , and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers  ; and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit na Gilgal sha Bokhim bad u ong ha ki Israel ,  Nga la shim ïa phi na Ijipt bad wallam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga la ong , ‘ Ngan ym pynkheiñ lano lano ïa ka jutang jong nga bad phi .

Kumta u Moses u rieh ïa la u diengthang shajrong , bad U Trai u phah ïa u pyrthuh bad ïa u phria , mala ka leilieh ruh ka la tied ïa ka khyndew . U Trai u phad ïa u phria uba jhur , lem bad ka leilieh kaba thaba .
translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the  Lord  sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground  ; and the  Lord  rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
Giving thanks unto the Father , which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light :
translation.kha: Ai ba yn pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ka jingkhlaiñ baroh kaba wan na ka bor badonburom jong u , khnang ba phi lah ban shah ïa kiei kiei baroh da ka jingïaishah . Bad da ka jingkmen to ainguh ïa U Kpa , uba la pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ban ïoh ïa la ka bynta na kaei kaba U Blei u la tyngkai na ka bynta ki briew jong u ha ka hima ka jingshai .

translation.en: And this also is a sore evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go : and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind ?
translation.kha: Hato kam dei kumta ? Ngi leit kumba ngi wan . Ngi trei , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer bad aïu ngi ïoh ?
U Moses u Iohi ba u Ïaroh u la pyllait ja ïa nia ki paidbah kat shuh ba ki la pynkhlemrain ïa lade ha khmat ki nongshoh-nar jong ki .
translation.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked  ; ( for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies : )

translation.kha: Hynrei , ka don ka khubor babha .
translation.en: But there is good news .

translation.kha: Wat leit sha Beersheba ban mane Blang . Wat pyrshah ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Bethel kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit shaw Galilaïa — ïa ki briew jong ka la tim ba kin shah ringmraw .
translation.en: But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .

For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you  ; and evil will befall you in the latter days  ; because ye will do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba hadien ka jingïap jong nga , phin sa leh ïa ki kam bymman bad kyntait ïa kaba nga la hikai ïa phi . Bad ha ki sngi ki ban wan ka jingjynjar kan ngat ha phi , namar ba phin pynbitar ïa U  Trai  da kaba phi leh ïa kata kaba u la adong .

translation.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha kaba sah ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang bad ka tnga kaba bunktien .

translation.en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u don ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la lumlang ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ba wanrah ïa u kew ban shoh .
Bad pynban Phin sngewsarong ban ong ba phi long ki nongsah shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phi shaniah ha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .

translation.kha: Kim ia sngewtmang balei ba ki la shahjop ; kim lah shemphang ïa kaba la jia .
translation.en: O that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !

translation.kha: Un Wanlam ïa ki ha u lyngdoh , u ban kñia shuwa ïa ka bai na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka Pop . Un khyrwait ïa ka ryndang jong ka khlem da pyntbit ïa ka khlieh na ka ,
translation.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest , who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first , and wring off his head from his neck , but shall not divide it asunder :

translation.kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ïa ka shkor kumne jong u .
translation.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .

translation.kha: Nangta ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri ki pyrshang ban pyndkoh mynsiem bad pyntieng ïa ki Jiw bad ban khanglad ïa ka jingjai .
translation.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,

translation.kha: Nga la jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka jingat Shelah jong me mala ïa kata ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan bthuh ïa u kwah lyngba ka khmut jong me bad u larkam ha ka shimet jong me , bad ban ïalam pat ïa me na kajuh ka lynti ba me wan .
translation.en: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears , therefore I will put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .

translation.kha: Naba ki kpa tymmen jong ph ki leit sha Ijipt , ki ïadon baroh tang hynñiewphew ngat ; hynrei mynta U Blei u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng .
translation.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons  ; and now the  Lord  thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïathuh aïu ha phi ? u Eli u kylli . Wat buhrieh ei ei na nga . U Blei un pynshitom jur ïa phi lada phim ïathuh lut ha por kat ïa katba u la ong .
translation.en: And he said , What is the thing that the  Lord  hath said unto thee ? I pray thee hide it not from me : God do so to thee , and more also , if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee .

translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kiew ha ka sut kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh , ba la suh lang ha ka sut kaweh ar . Kita ki kyrwoh ki ïaphai marpyrshah .
translation.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .

translation.kha: Bad shaphang ka Jeshaïah , U Trai’ u ong , ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jesreel hi .’
translation.en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .

translation.kha: Te U Blei u pynpeit ïa ki khmat jngai ka , Bad ka la ïew ïa ka pukri um . Ka la leit ban pyndap um ïa kata ka pla snieh bad ka la ai um ïa uta khynnah ba un tiduh .
translation.en: And God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water  ; and she went , and filled the bottle with water , and gave the lad drink .

translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban Ong ha u Nabal : U Dabid u phah ka ïakhublei ïa phoi , ko paralok jong nga , lem bad ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ph , ïa ka longïing jong phira bad ïa baroh’ kiba dei ki jong phi .
translation.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee , and peace be to thine house , and peace be unto all that thou hast .

translation.kha: Suk kito kiba sngewthait ; kine ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular !
translation.en: Blessed are the meek : for they shall inherit the earth .

translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la long shlur bad u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u sha ka Them Mluh . Hangta ki la ïaleh bad ki pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ,
translation.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself , and led forth his people , and went to the valley of salt , and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .

translation.kha: khadar tylli ki dur sing ki to ha ki mawkynroh , uwei uwei ha ka thew jong khawai pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kano ha kawei pat ka hima .
translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu batskhem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaban la pynïap ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synñiang U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u , Hangno me kwah ïa ine ban leit pynlang ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka jingïakhaïi Mem Ka jingleh ?
translation.en: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
Who can utter the mighty acts of the  Lord  ? who can shew forth all his praise ?
translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh ? Mano ba lah ban ïaroh ïa u kumba dei biang ?
Ïa u , u dien tangon u long u lyngngeit phlangïap sad u rkhie haba ki biria ki kawang kop ïa u ,
translation.en: Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .

translation.kha: Ka leit rah ïa u kew sha shnong bad ka pyn-i ha la ka kiaw kurim haw katno ka la lum . Ka la ai ruh ha ka ïa kata ka jingbam kaba sah tam .
translation.en: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit sha ka them , bad hangta ang ïuh ïa ka burom U Trai , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka harud ka wah Khebar .
translation.en: Then I arose , and went forth into the plain : and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  stood there , as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar : and I fell on my face .

translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U kper Bakhlem Thiat . Kumba nga la hukum ïa phi , bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat hynñiew sngem lynter ha u bnai Abib , namar daym ha uta u bnoh ba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep . Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , as I commanded thee , in the time of the month Abib : for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt .
Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .
translation.kha: Peit beit sha khmat da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka khlieh ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring thee , and thy king which thou shalt set over thee , unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known  ; and there shalt thou serve other gods , wood and stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un leit rah ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi sha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba ma phi lane ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim pat ju poi ; hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei kiba da u dieng bad da u maw .

translation.en: Blessed is he that waiteth , and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ïaineh tad haduh ba ki shihajar laispah laiphew san sngi ki kut noh !
U Trai u ïaheh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: To kynmaw ba u briew umbiah bet tang khyndiat ki syiem un ïoh ot ruh khyndiat ; uta uba bet shibun ki symbai un ïoh ot shiah shibun .
translation.en: But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .

translation.kha: Ki la set ïa ki shyntur jongno ki sing , ki la pynlip ïa ki ding kiba klang , ki la lait im na kaba shah pynïap da ka waitlam . Ki la long kiba tlot , hynrei ki la kylla erlangthari kiba khlaiñ ; ki la long kiba khlaiñbor ha ka thma badno ki la jlop ïa ki kynhun shipa nongwei .
translation.en: Quenched the violence of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , out of weakness were made strong , waxed valiant in fight , turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ïa me uba mutlop bad eh dohnud kum ma ki .

translation.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :
translation.kha: hynrei ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba bit ban mihpat na ka jingïap bad ban im ha ki pateng ban wan kin ym shongkurim shuh .
ne ban kylli ïa U Blei , Da kumno ka pop jong nga ka ktah ïa me ? Nga ainong Aiu na kaba khleiñ leh pop ?
translation.en: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?

translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym kren shaneng kata hano tam ruh ; hawei katba u nang lei ïa ki shun ym ïashoh , katta ki nang ïathuh .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u phet noh , da ka jingsynran lem ka longïing jong u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , loit noh ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shad ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And the king went forth , and all his household after him . And the king left ten women , which were concubines , to keep the house .

translation.kha: ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U Troas U Blei jong phi u pyningkhong bad phi malu ban pdiang ïa ki ktien ba la thop ha ka ,
translation.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka dei ka pyrthei kiba ïap , shata kaba ngan sa dem ban thiah ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: If I wait , the grave is mine house : I have made my bed in the darkness .

translation.kha: Ha lad ka step kaba bud jongnga ka jingkhawai , u Job u ju khie dang step bad u ai ïa ki jingkñia na ka bynta iwei pa iwei na ki khun jong u ban pyndih ïa ki . U ju leh ïa kñia borabor ñiar u pyrkhat ba ïoh iwei na ki i leh pop da kaba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei khleh poi pyllait .
translation.en: And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .

translation.kha: bad na ka bynta ki tyrha ki tar baroh kiba ki nong-ohdur ki dei ban shna . Mynta mano pat ba mon Ban ai kylluid mynhynnin shai U Trai ?
translation.en: The gold for things of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers . And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: U Jakob u sah ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .

translation.kha: Ki nongjop kiba mynta ki khong ha ka jingjynjar kin sa dap da ki paidbah kumba ka Jerusalem shisien ka ju thep da ki langbrot ba la wanrah kum ki jingkñia ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta ki sianti ïa ngi da ki khnam na ka kynroh , bad katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem kynrad ki la shah pynap ; u Uriah ruh , u Rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants  ; and some of the king s servants be dead , and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .

translation.kha: Ka kada ka phai ktien , Hato ngam dei kajuh ka kali ha kaba phi la ju shong baher shi rta haduh Myntan ? Hato nga la ju bor kumne ïa phin ? Em , u Jubab .
translation.en: And the ass said unto Balaam , Am not I thine ass , upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day ? was I ever wont to do so unto thee ? And he said , Nay .

translation.kha: U shoh-ïap ïa ka duriaw kum ka um kaba thliem bad u pynlong ïa ka ba tud tyrtho kum u khiew umphniang .
translation.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot : he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment .

translation.kha: Kine ki jingbuhbeit rynsan kin tat kumjuh ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi .
translation.en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .

translation.kha: U Jehoba , u khwan jngai ka Seruïah , bad kiwei pat ki jingbabe synshar jong u Dabid ki la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka pung , ha kaba baroh ki la ïashong , kawei ka kynoi ha kawei ka liang jongngi ka pung bad kawei pat ka kynum ha kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah , and the servants of David , went out , and met together by the pool of Gibeon : and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side of the pool .
And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .
translation.kha: Shim khat-ar kilo u  purew bad shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .

Lashai ka sngi ka dei ka jingkhie mihngi bnai thma u Dabid u jubab dara de dei ban ïashong bam ryngkat malade u syiem . Hynrei lama ka long kaba biah ïa phi , ngan kitei noh ban riewhok ha ki bri haduh la shi sngi janmiet .
translation.en: And David said unto Jonathan , Behold , to morrow is the new moon , and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat : but let me go , that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ka sngi ïa kaba na la kren sa wan da shisha .
translation.en: Behold , it is come , and it is done , saith the Lord  God   ; this is the day whereof I have spoken .

translation.kha: Ngi la lytar lumrit ïa ka ri ki Khereth ha ka pyntwa kaba shathie jong ka Judah pynlang ïa ka ri jong ka jait u Kaleb , bad im la thang ruh ïa ka Shishak .
translation.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites , and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah , and upon the south of Caleb  ; and we burned Ziklag with fire .

translation.kha: Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang ban pynjam ïa kaei ba ka long ka jingpalat , bad la thmu ba kan neh haduh ka jinghun uta u nonghiarpateng jong u Abraham , ha uba la pynlong ïa ka jingkular . Ïa ka Hukum la aiti da ki Angel , lem bad u Briew uba ïeng kum u kthang .
translation.en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .
Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things , though ye know them , and be established in the present truth .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïai pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang kine kiei kiei , wat la phi la tip lypa bad phi ïeng skhem ha ka jingshisha kaba phi la ïohpdiang .

translation.en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
translation.kha: Wat buaid da ka waiñ , ha kaba kan pynjot ïa phi ; pynban , to long kiba la pyndap da U Mynsiem .

translation.en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,
translation.kha: bad ka jaiñspong , ki tupia , ki patlun ,
Ki longsyiem jong ka kur Merari ki ïuh khat-ar tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Reuben , Gad , bad Sebulun .
translation.en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka parabangeit ka la shongkurim ïa u briew u bymngeit bad u mynjur ban ïaishong bad ka , kam dei ban pyllait noh ïa u .

Haba nga leit shai ki lyngkha , de ïohi ïa ki met jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pynsep ha ka thma ; haba ang leit sha ki shnong , ang ïohi ïa ki briew kiba ïapthngan . Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki trei la ki kdew , hynrei kdor tip ïa kaei ki leh .
translation.en: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword ! and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine ! yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .

And Samson lay till midnight , and arose at midnight , and took the doors of the gate of the city , and the two posts , and went away with them , bar and all , and put them upon his shoulders , and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Samson u thiah tang haduh shiteng synñia . U khie nangta bad u bat khak ïa ka khyrdop shnong bad u rat syndon ïa ka — ki jingkhang , ki shawkad , u nar-khang bad baroh . U bah ïa ki ha la ka tyrpeng bad u rah ïa ki baroh artet lynti sha kliar jong u lum uba marpyrshah ïa ka Hebron .
bad u Elisha u ong ha u ba un pynkhreh pun sieh . U syiem u leh kumta , bad u Elisha u buh ïa la ki kti ha ki ktha u syiem .
translation.en: And he said to the king of Israel , Put thine hand upon the bow . And he put his hand upon it : and Elisha put his hands upon the king s hands .

And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee : and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years , according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him .
translation.kha: U dei ban da ïapynbeit bad uta uba thied ïa u , bad ïakheiñ ïa ki snem naduh ka por ba u la die ïa lade haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan bad ïa ka bai pyllait kin buh dor kat kum ka jingdon jong kita ki snem , ha ka nongrim jong ka bainong u nongbylla .

Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bniat kiba ïalap ? Aïu ki kyrmen don pyndep ? Lada ka longïing ka shisha , kumba don kiba mana , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , balei ïa kito ki bynriew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ?
translation.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Tiras , ngan longsyiem U Blei jong ki , bad u syiem kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long u nongsynshar jong ki . Nga la kren .
translation.en: And I the  Lord  will be their God , and my servant David a prince among them  ; I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Lada ki briew khah kata ka ïing ki pdeng sngewbha ïa phi , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jngai phi kan neng ; hynrei lada kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phira , to sping nong pat ïa ka jingbuhrieh jongki phi .
translation.en: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .

translation.kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u khep uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la khyllad ; ka dei ka Snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .

translation.kha: Jamynrei ma nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi kaba la ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt , ngan pynlong ïa phi ban sah biang ha ki ïingjaiñ , kamar phi la lai mynba nga waiñ shaw phi ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And I that am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles , as in the days of the solemn feast .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh ban shngiam bad u lai jngut ki rangbah bad ban tan nong ïa to na ka pung shuwa ba kan ïap .
translation.en: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .

translation.kha: nongïam pat ju nang ïa kano Kano ka jingstad , bad ngam tip ei ei shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: I neither learned wisdom , nor have the knowledge of the holy .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ph hap ban shahshitom haba phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , katno kba kmen phi long ! Wat pyrshing ïano ïano , bad wat khuslai .
translation.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness  sake , happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror , neither be troubled  ;
Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai noh sha Judia .

translation.en: And as for me also , mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity , but I will recompense their way upon their head .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym isynei ïa ki , Ngan leh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma ki , ki la leh ïa kiwei .

translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Destroy him not : for who can stretch forth his hand against the  Lord s  anointed , and be guiltless ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ,  Phim dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u . U  Trai  un pynshitom shisha ïa uta uba pynmynsaw ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u .

translation.en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .
translation.kha: U shongkurim ïa ki wat haba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki Israel ban ym ïashongkha khleh bad kine ki briew , namar kin pynlong ïa ki Israel ban mane ïa kiwei ki blei .

Ka pop ka la wan sha ka pyrthei lyngkha uwei u briew , nabar ka thup jong u ka la wallam ryngkat bad ka ïa ka jingïap . Ka jingmih ka long , ba ka jingïap ka la pur shat u bynriew baroh Naaman uwei pa uwei u la leh pop .
translation.en: Wherefore , as by one man sin entered into the world , and death by sin ; and so death passed upon all men , for that all have sinned :
A Bible was needed that was easy to understand .
translation.kha: La donkam ïa ka Baibl kaba suk ban sngewthuh .
U la shym ïa uwei na ka longïing jong u sahmiet , u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u , bad u la pynphong ïa u ban smai ban erlangthari uba ïan skhem . U la rah koidi ïa ki rangbah bakhlem
translation.en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban pynpait ïa u khra ha khmat jong ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit bad nga
translation.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee ,

translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymngeit .
translation.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
Shimei the son of Elah , in Benjamin :
translation.kha: U Shimei , u khun jong u Ela : ka ri Benjamin

Ha khmih kumno ki syntiew khlaw ki synran : ktem syiem treh lane thain jaiñ na ka bna ïa lade . hynne nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon ha ka spah jong u baroh um smam la ei ki jaiñ ibha jingitynnat kat uwei na kine ki syntiew .
translation.en: Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
And ye shall seek me , and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart .
translation.kha: Phin wad ïa nga , bad phin shem ïa nga namar ba phin wad ïa nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: They break in pieces thy people , O  Lord  , and afflict thine heritage .
translation.kha: Ki pynlwet ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; ki banbeiñ ïa kito kiba long ki jong me .

translation.en: In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong me baroh , ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka Templ jong me ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge , and said , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them : and I will be with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u kren ha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad u ong ha u ,  Long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut , namar me men ïalam ïa ki Israel sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , bad ngan don ryngkat bad me .
U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la long bad nga ha kata ka por , bad ïa nga la ker sawdong da baroh ki kynhun jongnga nga .
translation.en: When the Almighty was yet with me , when my children were about me  ;

translation.kha: umbah hain lai kynta , ka tnum jong u , ka bymtip ïa kaba lah jia , ka la wan rung shapoh .
translation.en: And it was about the space of three hours after , when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .

translation.kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kan shit — bun ka Long kumta .
translation.en: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .
And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang jam ha U  Trai  , ki da ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , namar ngi la iehnoh ïa me , U Blei jong ngi , bad ngi la mane ïa ki Baal .
Mynba khie leit sha la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap Shuah ïa phi , hynrei phi dei ban pynmong katjuh ki maw-it .
translation.en: Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .

translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phira bad phi la sheng la sawa hangta ,
translation.en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;

translation.kha: Namar Mynta ngi im shisha , Lada phi ïeng snem ha ka ha U Trai .
translation.en: For now we live , if ye stand fast in the Lord .

But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato don nongïathuhlypa hangne da uba ngi lah ban kylli na U  Trai  ?  U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki kynhun u syiem Joram u jubab ,  U Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat u don hangne . U dei u nongïarap jong u Elijah .

translation.en: And gathered them out of the lands , from the east , and from the west , from the north , and from the south .
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi bad u la wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri nongwei , na mihngi bad sepngi , na shatei bad shathie .

translation.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ka jingtbit ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh ba la ju trei da ki nong-ohdur , ki nongthawdur , bad ki nongsuh nongthain ïa ka linen kaba ni ; ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait jaiñ . Ki nang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh , bad ki long ruh ki nongpruid dur kiba tbit .
U Asaïah u Long syiem hajuh u la ni khunbynriew snem ka thma ; bad u shihajar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerahmeel .
translation.en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U buh ïa baroh ki lapbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba kylluid ha ka khrup ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,

translation.kha: Naba lada ka jingai U Blei ka shong ha ka Hukum , te ka jingaiei kam shong shuh ha ka jingjar jong u . Pynban ka long namar ka soskular jong u ba U Blei u la ai ïa sakma ka jingai Sngewbha ha u Amraphel .
translation.en: For if the inheritance be of the law , it is no more of promise : but God gave it to Abraham by promise .
The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me .
translation.kha: Ïa ka shithi kaba phi la phah , la pynkylla ktien bad pule ha nga .
Baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , ryngkat bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki ïeng hangno ha ka Telem .
translation.en: And all Judah stood before the  Lord  , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Joah u la ïeng hajar ka metïap lad u Amasa dara u pyrta , Uno Un ibha ha ka liang jong u Joab bad u Dabid , to un bud ïa u Joab !
translation.en: And one of Joab s men stood by him , and said , He that favoureth Joab , and he that is for David , let him go after Joab .

translation.kha: U syiem un ïai don ha ka bor katba ka jingsynshar jong u ka dang long kaba khiah , kaba hok , bad kaba biang .
translation.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .

translation.kha: Bad da ka jingkynrum jong ka tngaw jong u , u la buh katto katne ka pisa na ka bynta ïa lade bad u la ai ïa kaba sah baroh ha ki apostol .
translation.en: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
And Moses said , The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen  ; and thou hast said , I will give them flesh , that they may eat a whole month .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Hangne nga ïalam ïa ki hynriew lakh ngut ki briew , bad me , me ong ban men ai doh ïa ki ka ban biang haduh shi bnai ?
Nangta leit sha u syiem bad ïa-ong ha u ïa kaei kaba nga bthah ïa phi ban ong . Nangta u Joab u la iathuh ha ka ïa kaei ban ïong .
translation.en: And come to the king , and speak on this manner unto him . So Joab put the words in her mouth .

translation.kha: Ale wan bad ïarap ïa por ban tur ïabah ïa ka Gibeon , namar ba ki briew jong ka ki la ïasuk bad u Joshua malu ki Jeruel .
translation.en: Come up unto me , and help me , that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .
And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death  ; and his deadly wound was healed : and all the world wondered after the beast .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki khlieh jong uta u mradkhlaw ka i kumba ka la shah pynmong jur , hynrei ka jingmong ka la ïohkhiah . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la sngewphylla bad ka la bud ïa uta u mradkhlaw .

Haba ki syiem kiba shah synlar ha u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki la pynlong ka jingïasuk bad ki bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong ki . Bad ki Syria ki la sheptieng ban ïabeh biang ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel , they made peace with Israel , and served them . So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more .
And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went , and stood to view afar off : and they two stood by Jordan .
translation.kha: bad sanphew ngut na ki nongïathuhlypa ki la bud ïa ki sha ka Jordan . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la sangeh harud wah , bad ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïeng kham pajih .

ïalam ïa ki barben ar ngut sawar shnong bad lynthem maw ïa ki haduh ba kin da ïap . Kata ka Briew ka dei pun ïap namar ba kam shym la kyang ba-bang ïoh jingïarap , wat la ka don hapoh shnong , bad uba u Shaneng pateng u dei ban ïap namar u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka , bad kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman nongpang jong phi .
translation.en: Then ye shall bring them both out unto the gate of that city , and ye shall stone them with stones that they die  ; the damsel , because she cried not , being in the city  ; and the man , because he hath humbled his neighbour s wife : so thou shalt put away evil from among you .

translation.kha: Khie otsher suk , u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u la wait noh sha Khroh .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Go in peace . So he arose , and went to Hebron .

translation.kha: Hynrei mano mano ba leh pop khnang , la ki dei ki thynrang ne ki nongwei , ki longïing kiba la rem ba kim ñiewkor ïa U Tharai , bad ki dei ban shah pynïap ,
translation.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: To ai ba U Trai hi , uba long ka tyllong jngai ka jingsuk jongno ngi , un ai ha phi ka jingsuk ha ki por baroh malade ha ka jingimat jong Phin baroh . U Trai un long lem bad phira baroh .
translation.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means . The Lord be with you all .

translation.kha: U Dabid u kulai ïa u samla uba la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor , Me den suba na-ei ? U jubab , Nga dei u nong Ahimelekh , hynrei at shong ha ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , Whence art thou ? And he answered , I am the son of a stranger , an Amalekite .

translation.kha: Lada , namarkata , ngi ong ba ngi don ka jinglehhok bad u , pynban , ha kajuh ka por ngi ïada ha ka jingdup , ngi lamler da ki ktien jong ngi bad ha ki kam jong Ngi .
translation.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :
And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jong phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha trai uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem uba ïong synñia u tap bad na uba ka ding kaba rhem ka klang shaduh suiñbneng .

Ha dat ka miet U Trai u la mihpaw ha u sad u ainong , Nga long U Blei jong u kparad jong me u Abraham . Wat sheptieng , nga don ryngkat bad me . Ngi kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me babe ki khun ki ksew namar ka jingkular jrong nga ïa u sharak jong nga u Abraham .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .
And to the others he said in mine hearing , Go ye after him through the city , and smite : let not your eye spare , neither have ye pity :
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U Blei ba u ong ha kita kiwei pat ki briew ,  Bud ïa u sawdong ka nongbah , bad pynïap . Wat tyngkai ïano ïano , wat sngewsynei ïano ïano .
Hynrei U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la jied ïa de wat shuh ban kha ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga ban shakri ïa u .
translation.en: But when it pleased God , who separated me from my mother s womb , and called me by his grace ,
So she caught him , and kissed him , and with an impudent face said unto him ,
translation.kha: Ka kynrup trait ïa uta u samla , ka doh ïa u , ka peit shlip ha ki khmat jong u , bad ka ong ,

Hynrei u Joseph u ong , U khun jong nga um lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi ; u hynmen jong u , u la ïarep , bad u sah sa dang marwei . Kaei kaei ka lah ban ngat ha u ha lynti . Nga dei u briew babha la tymmen , bad ka jingsngewsih kaba phin pynjah ha nga kan sa pynïap ïa de .
translation.en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
And the child Samuel ministered unto the  Lord  before Eli . And the word of the  Lord  was precious in those days  ; there was no open vision .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki sngi , haba uta u khynnah Samuel , u shakri ïa U  Trai  hapoh ka jingïalam u Eli , don tang khyndiat eh ki khubor na U  Trai  ; bad ñiar eh ban don ki jingïohipaw .
U Joram uba na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh Bad ïohsngew katto katne ki shnong bad u la khop kyrteng ïa ki Ki shnong u Jair .
translation.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
And I made an ark of shittim wood , and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first , and went up into the mount , having the two tables in mine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la thaw kawei ka synduk kaba da u dieng Akasia bad nga la shtah ruh ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba nyngkong , bad nga leit rah ïa ki shalor uta u lum .
Lada phi kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei Jong phi bad leh kat ïa kaba u hukum , un pyningkhong ïa pa ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall establish thee an holy people unto himself , as he hath sworn unto thee , if thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , and walk in his ways .
Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .
translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai dak ïa u paidbah :  U briew uba ngan doh u long uta uba phi kwah . To kem ïa u !
Kumjuh , ka Hima ki ïeng ka long kumne . Katto katai ki nongtong dohkha ki bret ïa ka jar jongki ki thah ka duriaw bad ki ïoh bun jait ki dohkha .
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net , that was cast into the sea , and gathered of every kind :

And they took two princes of the Midianites , Oreb and Zeeb  ; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb , and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb , and pursued Midian , and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb ; ki la pynïap ïa u Oreb ha u Mawsiang Oreb bad ïa u Seeb ha ka Thliew khem um sohwaiñ jong u Seeb . Ki bteng ban beh kthong ïa ki Midian bad ki wallam ïa ki khlieh jong u Oreb bad u Seeb sha u Gideon , uba don mynta sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .

Hadien ba ki paidbah ki la mihnoh na ka jingïalang , ïa u Apostol bad u manbha la bud da kiba bun ki Jiw bad da kiba bun ki jingtylli kiba la kylla shad ka niam ki Jiw . Ki apostol ki la kren ha ki bad ki la pynshlur ïa ki ban ïai im ha ka jingai lad U Blei .
translation.en: Now when the congregation was broken up , many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas : who , speaking to them , persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh , namar u la long uba riewspah shibun .
Ka pyrthei kam shyiap long kaba bha na ka bynta jong ki ! Kum ki nongphetwir ki shnong kyllan ha ki ri shyiap bad sha ki lum , ki da shnong ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew kba don ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: ( Of whom the world was not worthy : ) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la bitar ïa u Shalman , malu u la nong ha u , namar ba me la ni khnang ban pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïaphet bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , nga kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me bad ngan ai ha imat na ki rangbah synshar jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .
And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u Moses ,  Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin shahshkor ; hynrei ngi sheptieng ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi , ngin ïap .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter : for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land .
translation.kha: kin ai shibun ka dud kaba un dih kat kaba u donkam baroh . Ho-oid , khyndiat ngut kiba lait im kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri kin don ka dud bad ka ngap ban bam .
Hadien ba ki to shynrang jong u ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu ruh u la leit ; pynban , um shym la leit ha kaba paw , hynrei ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kito ki nongïathuhlypa kim don shuh .
translation.en: Your fathers , where are they ? and the prophets , do they live for ever ?

translation.kha: Shahshkor ko Jerusalem ! Mynta ka sngi phin jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad knieh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jingriewblei kiba kham khriat bad kham donbor ban ïa phi . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , dara ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .
translation.en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,

translation.kha: Khynñiuh u Joahas u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u , Hato phi ïeng na ka bynta u Baal ? Haseroth phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno uno uba ïaksaid na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shuwa ka step . Lada u Baal u dei u blei , ieh un ïada hi ïa lade . Ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .

And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .
translation.kha: Katba u rangbah synshar u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , u ong ha u ,  Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u syiem un jop bad phi ruh ka bha ba phin leh kumjuh .

translation.en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread : for there was no bread there but the shewbread , that was taken from before the  Lord  , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u lyngdoh u ai ha u Dabid ïa uta u kpu bakyntang , namar u kpu uba u don , u dei uba la ainguh ha U Blei , ïa uba la weng noh na ka miej bakyntang , bad ba la bujli da u kpu uba dang lah shet .

translation.en: ( Psalm 104 :15  ; 1 Corinthians 6 :10 ) Godly principles benefit us by teaching us to guard not just our actions but also our thoughts .
translation.kha: ( Salm 104 :15 ; 1 Korinth 6 :10 ) Ki aiñ jong U Blei ki pynmyntoi ïa ngi da kaba hikai ïa ngi ban phikir ïa ki jingleh bad ki jingpyrkhat jong ngi .

translation.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening  ; and , lo , in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , kata ka paro ka wan phai pat sha u , ka da wanrah ha la ka shyntur ïa u sla dieng Olib ba dang shu kheit . Kumta u Noah u tip ba ka um ka la rngad .
Ngan pynkylla ïa ka Babilon sha ka ahor ktieh , bad ki dih kin shong hangta . Ngan ïar ïa ka Babilon da u synsar u ban sar lut khoit ïa kai kaei baroh . Neng , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translation.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern , and pools of water : and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha u Manasseh ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkheit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ai ba buhnud kan Kwah hir longïng ïa ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khnam ïa ka jingai don pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .
translation.en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka prut kaba byrsaw-lieh ka mih ha ka jaka haw shñiuh , ka dei ka jingpang ñiuhtmoh .
translation.en: And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore  ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .

translation.kha: Kainan ka bynta ka kynrup ïa ka ri lum , ki kjat lum ha ka phrang sepngi , ka Them Johanan bad ki kjat lam jong ka , ka sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi bad ka ri rkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka ri ka la ju long ka ïing jong ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translation.en: In the mountains , and in the valleys , and in the plains , and in the springs , and in the wilderness , and in the south country  ; the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Canaanites , the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites :

translation.kha: Ki la ba-don sawdong jong at ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jongki U Trai !
translation.en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .

translation.kha: Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shemphang ki ki shun jong ki ?
translation.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?

translation.kha: Sin kumta ma u bad ki Israel baroh ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai shawei shaei Jerusalem da ka jingrisa kmen dara ka jingpynsawa ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the  Lord  with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .

translation.kha: U Solomon u don sarew hajar tyrnem ki sem ïa ki kulai ring kali , bad khat-ar hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai .
translation.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .
As we said before , so say I now again , If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received , let him be accursed .
translation.kha: Kumba Ngi la ong mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ong biang ïa ka : Lada uno uno u ïalap ha phi ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata kaba phi la pdiang , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok !

Ki rangbah kiba trei ïa ka kam ki long uba da sngur hok . La peit bniah halor jong ki da ki saw ngut ki Lebi : u Jahath bad u Obadaïah na ka kur Mearah , bad u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam na ka kur khoh . ( Ki Lebi ki dei ki nongtem nongput batbit ba . )
translation.en: And the men did the work faithfully : and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah , the Levites , of the sons of Merari  ; and Zechariah and Meshullam , of the sons of the Kohathites , to set it forward  ; and other of the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .
And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad ha ki bad da ki kyntien babun u la kyrpad ïa ki , da kaba ong ,  To pynim ïa lade na ka jingpynshitom kaba wan ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !

Ngan phah ïa pha sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad ki briew kiba shong ha ki por mynbarim . Neng pynphong ïa pha ba phan shong ha Katai ka pyrthei kaba shapoh ka khyndew napdeng ki jingjot bymjukut , ban ïadon lang bad kiba ïap . Namarkata phan ym lah shuh ban shon ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im .
translation.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;

translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa kano Kanaan ka kim shyntur bad na ka bynta kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,
translation.en: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death , and he be to be put to death , and thou hang him on a tree :

translation.kha: Katba ka Pyrthei ka dang sah , kan don ka aïom bet bad ka aïom ot . Kan don ka jingkhriat bad ka jingdih , ka lyiur bad ka baje , ka sngi badno ka miet .
translation.en: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa nga u la ong ha nga ba ngan rah ïa ka jingthiah bad ban ïaid .

translation.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus  ; Thou hast chastised me , and I was chastised , as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke : turn thou me , and I shall be turned  ; for thou art the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa ki paid Israel ba ki ong ha ka jingsngewsih , ‘ A  Trai  , ngi la long kum u mrad uba khlem shah hikai , hynrei me la hikai ïa ngi ban kohnguh . To wallam pat ïa ngi ; ngi long kiba la kloi ban wan phai pat sha me , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: When did Jehovah’s Witnesses have their modern-day start ?
translation.kha: Mynno la sdang ïa ka seng Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka por ba mynta ?

U Trai u ong , Ko Israel , nga la kwah ban pdiang ïa phai kum u khun jong nga bad ai ha pha ïa ka ri kaba pynkmen , ka ri kaba itynnat tam ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Nga la Kwah ïa pha ban khot pa ïa at bad ban ym phai shuh da lei lei na nga .
translation.en: But I said , How shall I put thee among the children , and give thee a pleasant land , a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations ? and I said , Thou shalt call me , My father  ; and shalt not turn away from me .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei khie kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , baroh’ ki kam skul jong u pynlang ki thma jong u , la bhah jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , and his might that he shewed , and how he warred , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem , and saw not the king s face .
translation.kha: U Absalom u la shong ar snem ha Jerusalem khlem ïohi ïa u syiem .

Mynba nga dang khmih , la buh ïa ki khet ha la ki jaka . utai uba la im junom u la shongduh halor kawei na ki khet . Ki jaiñ jong u ki la long babha lieh kum ka ïor , bad u shñiuh jongnga u , u long kum u saiwul nylla . Ïa ka khet jong u , la bthuh halor ki shalyntem ding , kaba la klang da ka ding ,
translation.en: I beheld till the thrones were cast down , and the Ancient of days did sit , whose garment was white as snow , and the hair of his head like the pure wool : his throne was like the fiery flame , and his wheels as burning fire .
Of the sons of Izhar  ; Shelomith the chief .
translation.kha: U Ishar , u khun uba ar jong u Kohath , u don u khun , u Shelomith , u khlieh jong ka kur .
halor ki syiad jong ki nabar u phah ïa ki baroh sha ka duwan . U thang ïa ka khleiñ halor ka duwan ,
translation.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burnt the fat upon the altar :

translation.kha: Nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ïaryngkat badonbor jong U Trai bad U Mynsiem jong u , u la ïalam bad pynslem ïa nga hapoh ka them ha kaba ka madan ka iap da ki shyieng .
translation.en: The hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and carried me out in the spirit of the  Lord  , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones ,

And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka jaka ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .

translation.en: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me ? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him , who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
translation.kha: Balei ba nga sngewsih haduh katta katta ? Balei ba nga sngew jynjar sat ? Ngan buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Blei , bad sa shisien pat ngan ïaroh ïa u , U nongpynim jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .
un uno uba ïohi ïa ka jingjop un ïohpdiang ïa kñia na nga : Ngan long U Blei jyllang u , bad un long u ïakhun jong nga .
translation.en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things  ; and I will be his God , and he shall be my son .
He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Yn tep ïa u kumba tep ïa u kada , un sa shah ring bad bret ïa u shabar ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .
Ha ka sngi ba la ïadat , u Herod u la phong ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khep lad u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .
translation.en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .

translation.kha: Baroh ka jingri khim jngai phi tista long lehnoh-ei , namar ka khyndew jong phi kan ym pynmih jingong jingtep bad ki diengkhap kin ym seisoh .
translation.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain : for your land shall not yield her increase , neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei babha u Jehoïakim u la kuna , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u bad ki kam bymman kiba u la imat , la buh jingwoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah . U Jehoïakhin u khuid jong u , u hir syiem ha ka Jaka jong u .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Mynta me la shadong Ban ïasaid bad U Blei’ , u la ïajubab ïa me . U ainguh ïa me , bad kumta nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka jubab ha me . Minnith to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .

translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïakynduh ïa kiwei pat ki Apostol wai noh tang ïa u Jakob , u par lad U Trai .
translation.en: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord s brother .

translation.kha: Bad kumta to pyntngen iwei ïa iwei pat bad to ïalap aiwai ïa iwei pat , kumba phi! leh mynta .
translation.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .

translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka ong ha u , Ko kynrad ! Phi ding kynmaw mo ïa la ? Ngi dei kato ka briew kaba phi ïohi kaba ïeng hangne kaba duwai ha U Trai .
translation.en: And she said , Oh my lord , as thy soul liveth , my lord , I am the woman that stood by thee here , praying unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaweh hapdeng jongngi “kata ka them bad kynhun ïa ka jaka ïaduna baroh sawdong ka Medeba .
translation.en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;

translation.kha: U Dan un synshar ïa la ki briew , Kin erlangthari kum kiew ki jait Jeruel .
translation.en: Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .
Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?
translation.kha: Hato ym don u ban jubab ïa kane ka jingkren bieit baroh ? Hato kaba kren bunktien ka pynksan ïa u briew ?

translation.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , U  Trai  un phai pyrshah ïa u bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
bad ha Hades , ha kaba u la don ha ka jingtem bakhraw , u la khmih shajrong bad u la iohi ïa u Abraham , sha jngai bah , bad ïa u Lasaros ha syndah jong u .
translation.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingmihpat kiba ïap : Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ? U la ong ,
jynreiñ na la ong , ‘ Wat tyngeh ïa kita ki briew .
translation.en: Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingtrei jong sem lem bad U Blei , namarkata , ngi kyrpad ïa phi kiba la jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingaiei U Blei ban ym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka .
translation.en: We then , as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain .

translation.kha: Haba u syep Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jied , u shongsah na kaba tei khup ïa ka Ramah bad iaineh ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .

translation.kha: Me ïohi ïa nga mynta , hynrei mem ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , at la jah noh !
translation.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .

translation.kha: Kumta kita ki shiphang ngut ki hynmen shynrang ar kmienah jong u Joseph ki la ïaleit sha jingtep banbeiñ thied kew ,
translation.en: And Joseph s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt .

translation.kha: Kam leit hangta ha ka por janmiet , Bad ha ka step babud yn ïalamwir ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad yn buh haw ka jingpeit jyllang u Ahasaïah , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u shem . Kan ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewieit eh ïa ka ba un phah khot ïa ka da ka kyrteng .
translation.en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .

translation.kha: Haba u Joseph um sngewkhia on shuh ïa la ka jingsngew ha khmat ki shakor jrong u , kumno u la praw ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym shym don me mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki hynne shynrang jong u .
translation.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , un sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , nabar nangta u kah ban rung sha ka jaka Shong dara ; hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .

translation.kha: Phin ym ïor ïa ki dur , ki diengphna , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka law Hall .
translation.en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .
And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap ïa ka da ka um .
