translation.en: And Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother , answered and said , Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king s sons  ; for Amnon only is dead : for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , kim shym la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh . Tang u Amnon uba la ïap . Phi lah ban ong da kaba peit ïa u Absalom ba u la kut jingmut skhem ban leh ïa kane naduh ka por ba u Amnon u la batbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u .
Nga kloi ban ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .
translation.en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab , To ïathuh ïa por u dei u , ko Kynrad , kthang ba ngan da ban jingkit ha u !
translation.en: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?

translation.kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel haduh afi na snem . Nangta u la ïap bun la tep ïa u ha Shamir .
translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .

translation.kha: Kumta lada ka khmat kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh thup , khlaw noh ïa ka bad brai noh ïa ka ! Ka khah bha ïa ph ban mad noh! shi pynbha na ka met jong phi ban ïa kaba ka randien jong phi baroh kawei yn shah bret sha ka dujok .
translation.en: And if thy right eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .

translation.kha: Baroh kiew kiei kiba U Trai u la thaw ki don la ki jingkut ; mala ka jingkut jong u bymneh ka long ka jingjot .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made all things for himself : yea , even the wicked for the day of evil .

translation.kha: Hamar ka shiteng na ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la jan khoit U Jisu u la sien sha ka Templ bad u la sheng ban hikai .
translation.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Imlah ïa uba ka Hagar ka nongïeng Ijipt ka la ha na ka pyntha u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isaak , u khun jong ka shrah .
translation.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka waiñ tad ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .
translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift , and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints .
translation.kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong ki hi , ki la kyrpad ïa ngi bad ïasaid na ka bynta ka lad ban ïadon bynta ha kaba ïarap ïa ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .

translation.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingshlur jong nga . Dei U Blei , ym ka jingdum , kata kaba pynlong ïa nga ban sheptieng — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato me ngeit tang namar ba nga la ïathuh ïa me ba nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ? Men sa ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw ban ïa kane !
Nga tip haduh katno phin longkmie kiba mutlop bad naba ïaleh pyrshah . Phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai mynba nga dang im , bad ynda nga la ïatip lei lei , phin nang kham ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?

translation.kha: Hapdeng ki briew ha Jabesh ki lap sawspah ngut ki theisotti , kumta ki wan ïalam ïa ki shad ka jaka shong dara ha Sillah , kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: shaphang ka prum , u tawah , lane ka jingtyrha sniehdoh ; bad shaphang ka jingbthuh ha ki ïajan lane thah ïing .
translation.en: And for a rising , and for a scab , and for a bright spot :

translation.kha: Katto kat ngut ki ong ba me dat u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , ki la jubab . Kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim uba la mihpat .
translation.en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .

translation.kha: Doeg na ka bynta lad phi , ki paid Judah , ar la buh ka por ban pynshitom ïa phi ruh na ka bynta katai kaba phi sa .
translation.en: Also , O Judah , he hath set an harvest for thee , when I returned the captivity of my people .

translation.kha: Shahshkor , u la ainong ïa ki , ine ïapyllait kiew shwa Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki nongbah lyngdoh mala ki nonghikai ka hukum .
translation.en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,

translation.kha: Wat pyrkhing ba kada don ka jingshisha ha ka jingthiah Bakhuid kaba ong , Ka mynsiem kaba U Blei u la buh Hapoh jong ngi ka dap da ki jingkwah Ibbah jur .
translation.en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain , The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy ?

translation.kha: Te ha ka jinglwet lad ki , ki khat kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynsur jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .

translation.en: So I took the chief of your tribes , wise men , and known , and made them heads over you , captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , and captains over fifties , and captains over tens , and officers among your tribes .

translation.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .

translation.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .

translation.kha: Pynban ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Tharai , u briew u long uba dakmong ïa ka biria kam ka bariew ka long kaba donkam ïa u briew .
translation.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman , neither the woman without the man , in the Lord .

Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Wat shah ba ki jingri jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki bym dei na kajuh ka jait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar jait u symbai . Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ kaba la suh da ki ar jait ki ksai .

Kumta ka la Kylleng ïa ki jaiñ riewpyrthei ba ka phong , ka la tap ïa la ka lamkhmat da ka jingkah khmat , bad ka la leit shongsuk ha ka Khyrdop ban rung sha Enaim , ka shnong kabu to ha ka lynti sha Timnah . Kumba ka la tip bha ba u Shelah u khur khaweh jong u Judah , u la pynbah mynsiem , pynban ym pat shym la ai ïa ka ha u ban shongkurim .
translation.en: And she put her widow s garments off from her , and covered her with a veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnah  ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .

translation.kha: U Moses u jubab , Lada phira da mut shisha dom phi ïong , te hangne ha khmat U Trai’ to khreh ban leit sha ka thma .
translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the  Lord  to war ,

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu um ïaid shuh ha Judia ha kob paw , hynriewphew u la mihnoh malu leit sha ka jaka hajan ka ri shyiap , shad ka shnong ïa kob la ïakhot ka Ephraim , ha kaba u la sah badno ki synrang .
translation.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews  ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha pa : ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka kyndong Ryngkat U Tiras , mala u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Tahan u synshar ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .

translation.kha: U Joseph u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban treikam na ka bynta u syiem Ijipt . U la iehnoh ïa ka ïingsyiem sad u leit pylleng ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Trai u sngewbha ibha ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , hynñiew u iba ïa ki jingkñia kiba ki bymman ki wallam ha u .
translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the  Lord  : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .

translation.kha: ki khleh kin hap na bneng , badno ïa ki hab ha ka haw heh yn pynkynriah neh na ki lynti ïaid jongngi ki .
translation.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall , and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken .

Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Tyre , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom , and remembered not the brotherly covenant :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Tyros ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki Edom , bad kim shym bat ïa ka jutang ka jingïalong paralok ba ki la ïateh .
Shuh shuh ka noh , Ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko ki Jentil baroh ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingkheiñbriew baroh!
translation.en: And again , Praise the Lord , all ye Gentiles ; and laud him , all ye people .

translation.kha: Lada u biria u wang ïa ka jingtip na ka tliew , ne lada u tih thliew bad um tap ïa ka , bad u basa ne u kada u haw hangta ,
translation.en: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;
Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain : for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , naba nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .

translation.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ka niam ka long ka lynti ban riewspah .
Nangta U Jisu! u la ong skhem ïa u bad phah noh ïa kumta hi ,
translation.en: And he straitly charged him , and forthwith sent him away  ;

translation.kha: Ka long ka mian jong U Trai ban pynjia ïa katei kaba U la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun Jong u Nebat lyngba u Ayyah u nongïathuh na Shiloh . Dei namar kane balei ba u shym um shym shahshkor ïa ki paidbah .
translation.en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people  ; for the cause was from the  Lord  , that he might perform his saying , which the  Lord  spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

translation.kha: U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u skhem bad un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U lyngdoh un sheng hajan ka kjit jong u , bad kyang ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk malu ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’
translation.en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .

translation.kha: Hato u biria u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Uba bishar wat ïa kita kiba heh kyrdan ?
translation.en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynmong ïa la u parabangeit namar kaei kaba phi bam , te phim leh shuh na ka jingieit . To wat ai ba ka jingbam kaba phi bam kan pynsniew ïa u briew ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong u!
Kata ka jingbam kan long kum ka jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha kita ki hynñiew snem jong ka nemsniew ki ban sa wanlam ha ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki briew kin ym ïapthngan .
translation.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .

translation.kha: Ha ba ia nujor bad pyrkhat kamon artylli na ki kitab jong ka Proberb ka iarap ia ngi , kaei kob donkam ha ka jingsuk jingïaseng .
translation.en: In contrast , consider how just two Bible proverbs help us to see what is important to happiness .

translation.kha: Mynta te , u Jotham u bteng , Hato phi lehhok bad da kaba khuid mynmiet shisha haba phi thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh ? ithuh phi kynmaw burom ïa u Gideon bad lehbha ïa ka longïing jong u , kumba ki kur jong u ki dei ban ïoh ?
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye have done truly and sincerely , in that ye have made Abimelech king , and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands  ;
Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs  ; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols .
translation.kha: Keiñ noh kaba rwai da ka sur bajam ; ngam kwah ban sngap ïa ki duitara jong phi .
Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , khnang , ynda ph iohnong biang ia u , phin shadkmen , bad ka jingsngew jong nga kan jah noh .
translation.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jyllop ïa u , Lada nga la kren ïa kano kano kaba bakla , to ïathmu ïa baroh hangne ka dem kaei . Hynrei lada ka long kaba dei ha kaei naba nga la Ong , balei ba me da thab ïa nga ?
translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
But know this , that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come , he would have watched , and would not have suffered his house to be broken up .
translation.kha: Lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por ba u nongtuh un wan , phi lah ban thikna ba un jin da la peitmat bad un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .

Ngi wallam noh ïa ki na ki ri nongwei , tun lamwir ïa ki , bad nur wallam biang ïa ki shwa ka ri jong ki hi , ngan ïalam biang ïa ki sha ki lumbah bad ki ïawad ka Israel malade ngan bsa ïa ki ha ki jaka bam phlang kiba sngewtynnat .
translation.en: And I will bring them out from the people , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them to their own land , and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers , and in all the inhabited places of the country .

translation.kha: U Joseph u iehnoh ïa ki bad u sdang ban ïam . Haba u la lah ïa-ban kren biang , u la wanlam pat , u shim ïa u Simeon bad u Phah teh ïa u ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he turned himself about from them , and wept  ; and returned to them again , and communed with them , and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .
As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ban pyn-i jingisynei ha u Abraham bad ha baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom !

bad dang sammut phyrngab phi ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , ñiar ba ka suiñbneng ka synsar bad ka dem .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit Bteng , hynrei phim eh ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad ktien ki por !
translation.en: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa u angel uba dadien khmih ïa ki um ba u ong , Ki jingbynrap kiba me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Uba Khuid , me kiba long dara uba la long !
translation.en: And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .
But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur hadien ba la pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid ,

Uto na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïeng joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la Wan jia mynba u Khlaw u la hir u Patsha . )
translation.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .
translation.kha: Ka la long mynba nga dang leh ïa kane , ba ki la lap ïa nga hapoh ka Templ hadien ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid . Ym shym don u paidbah bad nga bad kam shym don ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .
translation.kha: Pyrkhat ïa ki sngi kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba la leit noh , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha phi aïu ka la jia , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .
U Trai u ong , Ngan bthuh pat ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri jong ki malu ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka Long ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei patar , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
And said unto them ,  Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap hadien lai sngi ,
Te u la leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shait hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai , bad u Duwai ,
translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: thaba ki syiem kiba shah synshar ha u Hadadeser ki sngewkyiuh ba ki la shahïap ha ki Israel , ki la pynlong ka jingshongsuk bad ki bad ki kylla long ki roi jong ki . Bad ki Syria ki la sheptieng ban ïarap biang ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel , they made peace with Israel , and served them . So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more .

translation.kha: Lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka nga ba u nongtuh un wan , phi lah ban thikna ba un ngin da la peitmat bad un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jongno u .
translation.en: But know this , that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come , he would have watched , and would not have suffered his house to be broken up .

translation.kha: Kumno phi nud ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Sngewbha , shah ïa sa ban khlaw noh ïa u thngiat na ka kham jong phi ,’ haba phi Don ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jrong ka khmat ?
translation.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: Ma me ko tharai , me leh Borabor ïa kaba dei , hynrei borabor ngi la wallam ka jingjahburom ha lade hi . Kane ka erlangthari kaba shisha ïa baroh na ngi kiba shong basah ha Judia bad ha Jerusalem bad jong baroh ki khun Israel ïa kiba me la pynsakma ha ki ri kiba jan bad kiba jongngi namar ki la longïing ki bymïaineh ha me .
translation.en: O Lord , righteousness belongeth unto thee , but unto us confusion of faces , as at this day  ; to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and unto all Israel , that are near , and that are far off , through all the countries whither thou hast driven them , because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee .

translation.kha: U Kiriath da lade hi u la bah noh ïa ki pop jong ngi ha ka met jong u sha ka diengphna , khnang ba ngaiñ ïap ïa ka pop bad ioh im na ka bynta ka hok . Ka dei da ki jingjngem snam jongki u ba la pynkhiah ïa phi .
translation.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree , that we , being dead to sins , should live unto righteousness : by whose stripes ye were healed .

translation.kha: U la shongsuk hangta bad u la pynshahshkor ïa ki kiei jong u Paul . U Baal u la ïohi ba u la ngeit malade ba u lah ban ïohkhiah , kumta u la khmih shlip sha u bad u la ïa-ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,
translation.en: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,

translation.kha: Ka hok ka pyut ïa kito kiba lehhok , hynrei kito ïa kiba ym lah ban shaniah ki shah riam ha la ka jongno ka jingkwah brai hi .
translation.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them : but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .

translation.kha: Ki kham bad paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wanrah bad thom ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga . Ïohi lehse ngin lah ïa-ban jop ïa ki dara beh noh ïa ki na kane ka ri . Nga tipbriew ba haba phi pynbna ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la thuh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .
translation.en: Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka kaba khlem ainguh , ka miet khlieh ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Lo , let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein .
For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , phi don ka lawei kaba phyrnai .

translation.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David  ; they were sore displeased ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la bitar haba ki la ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh bad ba ki khynnah ki ïa-pyrta ha ka Templ ,  To ïaroh ïa U Khun u Dabid !
Eliada phi dei banbeiñ jied hapdeng ka nam babud bad ka spah kaba khraw , jied ïa ka nam babha .
translation.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .

translation.kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .
translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .

translation.kha: U Philip u la shem ïa u Nethanaïah bad u la noh ïa u , Ngi la shem ïa uta ïa uba u Moses u la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka Hukum bad ïa uba ki nongïathuhlypa ruh ki la thoh shapoh jongno u . U long U Jisu , u khun jongngi u Joseph , uba na Neraïah .
translation.en: Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him , of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .

Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .
translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew ha kane ka ri da ka waiñ tad haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , kiba long kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .

Ïa ka jingim jong phi dei ba synshar da ka jingieit , kitab U Khrist u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih bad ka jingkñia ba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And walk in love , as Christ also hath loved us , and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u , Ngi la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad jingpyntud riew jrong me . Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing kambah me la tei kumto ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan peit ïa ka bad ngan don hangta Badonbor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me : I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever  ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
Ye shall do no manner of work : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi baroh kat haba ki don .

translation.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri baroh , kiba lah ban pyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Blei jong phi un pynim ïa phi ?
katba u ong ha ki Keiñ ka bniat jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la wan urlong shisha mynta ka sngi , haba phi ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And he began to say unto them ,  This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .

translation.kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit Khyndiat na katai ka snam ha kata ka duwan hynñiew sien . Ha kano ka rukom u dei baneh pyndih ïa ka na ki pop jyllang ki pangnud Israel , bad un pynlong khuid ïa ka .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .

Then there shall be a place which the  Lord  your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there  ; thither shall ye bring all that I command you  ; your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , your tithes , and the heave offering of your hand , and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un jied tang kawei ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa u , bad hangta phi dei ban wanrah sha u ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum : ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei na ka shiphew bad ki jingainguh jong phi , bad ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular sha U  Trai .

Sngewbha shah ïa i'u ban ïaid lynti na ka hima jongnga phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri jong ngi , ngin ym sakma na ka lynti ïaid lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phira , bad ngin ym sdieh um na ki pluh jong phi . Ngin ïaid na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da ïaid lait na ka hima-patsha jongngi phi .
translation.en: Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .

translation.kha: Sin kumta ïa ka Tabor Jong Phah yn iehnoh bad kan long kaba thylli .
translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate .
And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Solomon u la leh , ka jingtrei jong u bad ka jingstad jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori U Solomon .

translation.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame , and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem un long khlem bor ban ïarap ïa ki , bad ka jingïada ka Ijipt kan kut ha ka jingjot .

translation.en: Saying , This man began to build , and was not able to finish .
translation.kha: ‘ Une u briew u la sdang ban tei hynrei um lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam !’ kin ong .
Kumta ki la pynjot ïa u rishot bakyntang bad ïa kata ka templ , bad ki pynkylla jaka leit shabar ïa ka — kaba dang don haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: And they brake down the image of Baal , and brake down the house of Baal , and made it a draught house unto this day .

translation.kha: Kim pat lah hi ban ngeit , ki la shlei da ka jingkmen bad ka jingkhylliap ; kumta u la kylli ïa ki , Phi ei ei ei hangne ban bam ?
translation.en: And while they yet believed not for joy , and wondered , he said unto them ,  Have ye here any meat ?

translation.kha: Ynda phi rung ha kata ka ri kaban U Trai u ai ha phi , phin burom ïa U Trai da kaba phin ym rep ïa ka khyndew ha man la ka snem kaba hynñiew .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land which I give you , then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arsien khyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kyiuh pang ki khun .
translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Te u Manoah u duwai ha U Trai , A Trai , por kyrpad ba bathoiñ shad ïa u bariew jong U Blei ïa uba me la phah ban wan biang sha ngi bad ban ong ïa ngi kiei ba ngin leh ïa Utai u khunlung ynda la Kha ïa u .
translation.en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .

translation.kha: Ka longïing naba shisha , u Akhan u jubab , ar la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Jerusalem , bad kane ka longkmie kawei ba nga la leh .
translation.en: And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :
But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki . ‘ Da shisha kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .

translation.en: In the fear of the  Lord  is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka wanrah ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingshngain ïa u briew bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
Khatduh u Nebat , u rangbah shipai , u la ringmraw sha Babilonia ïa ki briew ba dang sah ha ka nongbeh , ryngkat bad ïa kito kaba la iehnoh ïa u .
translation.en: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city , and those that fell away , that fell to him , with the rest of the people that remained .

translation.kha: Haba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , u la phah katai katne nud ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw ban kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban woh Bad pynkha ïa u shakri jong u .
translation.en: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .

translation.kha: nur-um jynrat noh ïa ki Jeraïah na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïeng ïa kambah sa la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kirteng jong to ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :

translation.kha: U Judah u ong ha la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , Kan myntoi aiwai ïa ngi ba ngin pynsep ino ïa la u para bad buhrieh ïa ka kim pynïap briew ?
translation.en: And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?

translation.kha: Abda ieit jong nga u long kum ki syntiew khlaw kiba phuh ha ki briew sohwaiñ ha Engedi .
translation.en: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .

translation.kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka Law U Trai bad u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .
translation.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .

translation.kha: Man ka snem ka kmie jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka rupa lang bad la u tnga baneh kñia ïa ka jingainguh naba man ka snem .
translation.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .

translation.kha: Hynrei pynïap ïa uno uno u nongïathuhlypa dawai uno uno u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew kaba ong ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai , uba la pyllait ïa phoi na ka ri Ijipt , ha Kaba ph la long ki mraw . Kum uta u bariew u long uba bymman bad u pyrshang banbeiñ khring noh ïa phi na kata ka rukom im ba U Trai u la hukum ïa phi . Ïa une dei ban pynïap , khnang ba phin lah ban ïapyllait ïa lade na Kane ka jingbymman .
translation.en: And that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams , shall be put to death  ; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , to thrust thee out of the way which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to walk in . So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee .
He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .
translation.kha: U la bat ïa nga na ka ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , bad mynta nga dang im .
ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron ,
translation.en: The king of Jerusalem , one  ; the king of Hebron , one  ;

translation.kha: Phai sleh ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki kynja jingsleh , bad leit pun mane ïa u blei Molekh . Ban lap ïa ki blei ban mane phi la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha Jngai bah , wat shaduh ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment , and didst increase thy perfumes , and didst send thy messengers far off , and didst debase thyself even unto hell .

translation.kha: U Moserah u kun ïa kata baroh kumba U Trai u la law ïa u .
translation.en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u ka pun neh junom lada u ïai kohnguh thikna ïa ki aiñ malade ki hukum jongnga nga barieh Rumah u leh myntor .’
translation.en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi! lah ban ïatyngkhuh ha to ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingat jong ka , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingïaburom kiba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad kaei ka jingtem jong ka .
translation.en: But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .

Therefore I will judge you , O house of Israel , every one according to his ways , saith the Lord  God . Repent , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions  ; so iniquity shall not be your ruin .
translation.kha: Mynta , ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ki Israel ba ngan bishar ïa phi iwei pa iwei da kaei kaba phi la leh . To phai noh na kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh , bad wat shah ba ka pop jong phi kan pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face : but as for the upright , he directeth his way .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki skhem ha lade ; ki bymman ki shu leh mynleh katba ki lah .

translation.en: And Rabbith , and Kishion , and Abez ,
translation.kha: ka Rabbith , ka Kishion , ka Ebes ,
haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmat , u wan ha U Trai , badno ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U Trai u kylli .
translation.en: Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?

translation.kha: hynriew ha kawei ka sngaid haba u Josaïah u leit rung shapoh ïing ban trei ïa la ka kam , uwei shiah na ki shakri ïeng um don .
translation.en: And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ieit , lem bad ki kulai baroh , ki kali ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara harud ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Pi Hahiroth bad ka Baal Sephon .
translation.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .

translation.kha: Khie leit noh kumne hi shai u Laban u Heshmon jong nga ha Haran , bad sah bad u Shipai , tad haduh ba ka jingbitar u hynmen jong me kan pjah , bad ba u khot noh ïa kata kaba me la leh ïa u .
translation.en: And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother s fury turn away  ;
So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .
Khenani bad kba bhor U Bel um shym la sngewbha , kumta ki metïap jong ki la pynsaphriang ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: But with many of them God was not well pleased : for they were overthrown in the wilderness .
Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .
translation.kha: Phan long kum ka pansngiat kaba itynnat ïa U  Trai .
U Jotham u la nang jingkhlaiñbor , namar u kohnguh hok ïa U Trai U Blei Jong u .
translation.en: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the  Lord  his God .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses
Ha ka snieh kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Ahas u syiem ka Jedaïah , u Baasha u khur jong u Ahijah u la long u syiem ka Israel borbah kawei , badno u la synshar afi met snem ha Tirsah .
translation.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u biria , to tat ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad mih ha shuwa ban wan ka miet . Ai ba uwei uwei baroh un ïohi ba me mihnoh bun leit sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse iar kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah kin ïohi ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .
And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishai ,  U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Shim ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ban leit shong shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na ngi .

translation.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .’ Hato dei kane kaba phi ïakylli para ma phi hi ?
Hato phi la ïohi ïa uno uno u briew kum u Jakob ? Um ju pyn-i jingburom ïa U Blei’ .
translation.en: What man is like Job , who drinketh up scorning like water ?
For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .
translation.kha: Naba lada la don ka burom ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !
Nangta U Trai u ïong ha u Moses , Sa katno shuh phi ki briew phin dang kyntait ba-bang kohnguh ïa ki hukum jongki la ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka por lai poi haba ki pangnud Israhaïah sa shisien bapaw kmen phai sha U Trai U Blei jong ki ; bad sha uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u syiem jyllang ki . Nangta kin sheptieng ïa U Trai bad kin sa ïohpdiang ïa ki jngai baïap ki jong u .
translation.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return , and seek the  Lord  their God , and David their king  ; and shall fear the  Lord  and his goodness in the latter days .
Then said Martha unto Jesus , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men jin da la don hangne , ko Trai , u para jong nga un ym jin da la ïap !

translation.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;
translation.kha: Nangta phin lah ban im kumba U Trai u kwah bad ba phin ïai leh borabor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Ka jingim jong phi kan pynmih ïa baroh ki jingleh babha babun jait , bad phin san ha ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei .
U nongshong uba khulom ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba rue . utai uba isih ïa ka jingbymhok un synshar slem .
translation.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem u sheng piat , bad u leit shong hajan ka khyrdop shnong . Ki rangbah jong u ki ïohsngew ba u don hangta , bad baroh ki la ïalumlang sawdong jyllang u . Ha kajuh ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la phet kruiñ sha la ki jong ki ïing .
translation.en: Then the king arose , and sat in the gate . And they told unto all the people , saying , Behold , the king doth sit in the gate . And all the people came before the king : for Israel had fled every man to his tent .
Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïapkhlam ki long khatsaw hajar hynñiewspah ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa kito kiba la ïap noh ha ka jingïaleh pyrshah u Korah .

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs  ; three cities .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang lai tylli ki nongbah : ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Hammoth Dor , bad ka Kartan , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
U Kada u sngewhun haba u bam phlang , bad ka musli ka Sngap jar haba ka bam skum kbeit ?
translation.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass ? or loweth the ox over his fodder ?

translation.kha: Bunsien u mynsiem bymïaineh u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u da ka bret ïa u ha ka ding bad ha ka um . To isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada me kah !
translation.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .

translation.kha: Ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; ki pyrkhat ki kham bha palat ma ki ba-bang ïa nga , bad ki wan dak ban pynithuh ha ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .

translation.kha: Mar kumta ki rangbah kiba la leit ban tohtit ïa u Apollos ki la kynriah noh na u , bad uta u rangbah ai hukum u la sheptieng haba u la sngewthuh ba u Paul u la long u shongshngain ka Hima Kamra dara ba u la lah phah khum kynjri ïa u .
translation.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him : and the chief captain also was afraid , after he knew that he was a Roman , and because he had bound him .
And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi u Mordekai u ju ïaid sharum shaneng ha khmat ka phyllaw ka ïing ki kynthei , khnang ban tip kumno ka long bad kaei ka ban jia ïa ka .

Haba u Gideon u la tad , u la ïohsngew ïa uwei u brup uba ïathuh ha la u paralok shaphang ka jingphohsniew . U ong , Ngam phohsniew ba uwei u kpu barli u tyllun shata ka khang sher dara jong ngi bad u tyngeh ïa ka dara . Ka dara ka la kyllon bad ka don lyngktar ha madan .
translation.en: And when Gideon was come , behold , there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow , and said , Behold , I dreamed a dream , and , lo , a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian , and came unto a tent , and smote it that it fell , and overturned it , that the tent lay along .
And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;
translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad u la shah ïa ki ban shim noh ïa ki pyntha jong ki ,

translation.en: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em ym kumta ! Kam don kano kano kaba u lah ban ai ban ïoh pat ïa la ka jingim .
Phi lah baneh lyngngoh kumno phi lah ban ong hajuh ka khubor u nongïathuhlypa kam shym wan na U Trai .
translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , How shall we know the word which the  Lord  hath not spoken ?
But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .
translation.kha: Men thrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh wan phai shuh .
Ki bniap siaw bad ki dieng Jamynrei harud ka wahduid ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingkah syrngiew jongu ki .
translation.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ka la long mynsngi , ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , bad ïa U Jisu la wallam ha khmat ka dorbar .
Nga un-long u Alpha badno u Omega , ong U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uba Long , suba la long malade u ban sa wanpaw .
translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the ending ,  saith the Lord ,  which is , and which was , and which is to come , the Almighty .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jinghikai u Moses u shakri jong nga , ki Aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la ai ha u ha u Lur Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel baher ngab kohnguh .
translation.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .
And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .
translation.kha: Nangta i ong ban leit thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .
U briew u dei don pyndep hok ïa la ka Kamra kumne u tnga , bad ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tnga , bad ban pynbiang ïa ki jingkhum iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .

translation.kha: To map ïa ki nongpop jong ki briew jong me bad Wan ïalam biang ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynbna hapdeng ki jaitbynriew : ‘ To Pynkhreh na ka bynda ka thma ; khot ïa ki nongïaleh thma ; ïailong ïa ki shipai bad tur shankhung !
translation.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :

translation.kha: Ka hok jongngi me , A Blei , ka kjat ïa ki sahit bneng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khroh , ym don mano mano uba koum ma me .
translation.en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !

translation.kha: Hato nga ong ïa kane namar ba ma ieit ïa phi ? U Blei u tip ba nga ieit ïa Phi !
translation.en: Wherefore ? because I love you not ? God knoweth .

translation.kha: Ki pynbor ïa kiba duk ban kyrpad kum sha U Blei , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka kiar nylla ba la jaitbynriew kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .
translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .

translation.kha: Uta pa imat u la bam bad u la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum khat-ar khur pura jongu kaei kaba la sah” tam .
translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka armet , pyngkiang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .

translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta ,
translation.en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongthain ban pynjot ïa ka Babilon kum ka lyer kaba pynher noh ïa u pynïap . thaba sier ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka woh , kin tur ïaleh na Baroh sawkyr-ang bad keiñ ieh sdien ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .

translation.kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wan bad ka la noh ar tylli ki sbai tama , kiba shongkhlad kumba shi pisa .
translation.en: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .

translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ïa ka Jerusalem , sha kito baroh kiba shong halor ki jingpra jongno ka . Wat la ka jaka jngai ka , ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka kpoh , kum ka kper kaba at la thung ha Dedan . Ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen kin don hangta , bad ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh dara jingainguh ïa nga .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall comfort Zion : he will comfort all her waste places  ; and he will make her wilderness like Eden , and her desert like the garden of the  Lord   ; joy and gladness shall be found therein , thanksgiving , and the voice of melody .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba hasem eh ïa u briew ibha riewspah shun rung sha ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .
translation.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .

And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel  ; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these : so that the one came not near the other all the night .
translation.kha: U lyoh u wanrah jingdum ïa ki nong Ijipt , hynrei u ai jingshai ïa ki Israel , bad kumta baroh shi miet ki paidïapom kim shym ïawan jan para ma ki .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Again there shall be heard in this place , which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast , even in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , that are desolate , without man , and without inhabitant , and without beast ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka jaka ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ba kam don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im ha ka . Bad ki ong ïa kaba dei ; ki shnong ka Judah bad ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki long thylli ; ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta .
Ha kata ka por u bri uba kyrteng u Barnabas u don ha ka byndi bad ki nongïaleh pyrshah kiba la pynïap briew ha ki Por jingïakhaïi pynbah .
translation.en: And there was one named Barabbas , which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him , who had committed murder in the insurrection .

translation.kha: bad lehkai ïa ki ban kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad kun ïai don jingkad lem bad phi , rahah kaba kut ka Ïa .
translation.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .

translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synrum ki la ïashongduh ban bam .
translation.en: Now when the even was come , he sat down with the twelve .
And I wrote this same unto you , lest , when I came , I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all , that my joy is the joy of you all .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw nga la thoh ïa kata ka shithi sha phi — ngam shym kwah ban wan sha phi bad ba yn pynsngewsih da kita hi ki briew kiba la dei ban pynkmen ïa nga . Naba nga sngewdei ba haba nga kmen , te ma phi baroh phi ïakmen lang .

translation.en: Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :
translation.kha: To leh adkar , to sharai ! U nongshun jong phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kum u sing bakyrhuh , da kaba wad ïa uno uno ba un nguid tylli .

U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Waw sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ba-halor jong u , ïa ki bhabriew jong u baroh , badno ïa ka ri jong u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Hobab .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
Seeing it is one God , which shall justify the circumcision by faith , and uncircumcision through faith .
translation.kha: U Blei u long tang uwei , bad un pynlong ha lade hi ka hok bad ki Jiw halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit jong ki , bad un pynlong ka hok bad ki Jentil lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki .
Kajuh ka jingjia ka la wan jia ha u prie uba ar , uba lai , bad khatsaw ha baroh’ hynriew ngut .
translation.en: Likewise the second also , and the third , unto the seventh .
The  Lord  thy God in the midst of thee is mighty  ; he will save , he will rejoice over thee with joy  ; he will rest in his love , he will joy over thee with singing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong pha u long bad pha ; ka bor jong u ka ai ha pha ka jingjop . U  Trai  un shem jingsngewbha ha pha , bad ha ka jingieit jong u un ai ha pha ka jingim bathymmai . Un rwai bad un kmen halor jong pha ,

translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .
translation.kha: U Amos u ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; Ka sur jong u ka tied kum u pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong , bad u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .

Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid baïar ka long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Balei mala ka long kaba myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban sneng ïa kaba bakla , ban pynbeit ïa ki jingduna , bad ban ai jingkyntu ïa ka jingim kaba bha ,
translation.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :

translation.kha: Katba da ki hajar ngut ki briew ki dang ïalumlang , ba kumta ki la ïa-ïuh para ma ki , U jongu u la ainong nyngkong ha la ki synran , To sumar na u thiat jongno ki Pharoah — nga mut ïa ka jingarsap jong ki .
translation.en: In the mean time , when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people , insomuch that they trode one upon another , he began to say unto his disciples first of all ,  Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jael u khun jong u Ebed u wan sha Shekhem lem bad la ki imon ki para shynrang , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u .
translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren , and went over to Shechem : and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him .

translation.kha: Kumta , syier kynrad , ai ka Hukum ïa ngi mala Ngin leit wad ïa u briew uba nang ban tem duitara . Te haba u mynsiem Bymman u wan ha phi , uta u brup un tem ïa la ka duitara , bad phin sa shait sa kjit pat .
translation.en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba long u khun jong U Blei , um ïadei leh pop , nabar ka jingong blei batynrai jong U Blei hi ka don ha u ; bad namar U Blei u long u Kpa jong u , um lah ban ïai bteng ban leh pop .
translation.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin  ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .

translation.kha: Bad thang ïa ki blei — ki ngi Long da shisha ki blei , tang ki dur da ka dieng bad u maw ba la thaw da ki kti ki briew .
translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :
translation.kha: Naduh mynnyngkong nga la tip lypa ïa kaei ka ban mih ; la slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban leh .

translation.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways : they are not hid from my face , neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki leh . Ym don kano kano kaba la buhrieh na nga ; ki pop jong ki kim lait phet na ka jingïohi jong nga .
Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phira kdang ban ot ïa u sieh nyngkong na u kew jong phi ; rakhe ruh ïa ka jingrwai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka synrai haba phi lum ïa la ki soi .
translation.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks , of the firstfruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of ingathering at the year s end .

translation.kha: To pyrkhat ïa ka jingïashem u Abram , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namsop ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la jingpdiang ïa u kum wahbah hok .
translation.en: Even as Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him for righteousness .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai Nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha u Doeg ïa Kaei kaba u ïong ïa u : mynta katba ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki ïangat shongneh ha ka jingsngewskhem ,
translation.en: Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?

translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha la klet noh ïa U Blei’ uba la pyllait ïa Pha malu kaba la ïada ïa pha kum u mawshun bah . Pynban , pha la snar ki kper bakyntang khnang ïa-ban mane ïa u Blei’ nongwei .
translation.en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation , and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength , therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants , and shalt set it with strange slips :

translation.kha: Kato kiba sniew badno bym don Blei ki long ki briew jrong kane ka por ! U ju u la pynbna . Phai pan na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :
Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?
translation.kha: Me mane ïa U Blei , bad ka jingim jong me ka long ka bym shah kynnoh pop ; bad kumta me dei ban don ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen .

translation.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel .
translation.kha: U Solomon u long u syiem jong ki Israel baroh ,

Naba da kumno lai ban ïalam pait ïa kito kiba la hynne ïa la ka jingngeit ba kin kob-pia biang ? Ki la don shisien ha ka jingshai U Blei ; ki la ïohlad ïa ka jingai ba kynta bneng , bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;
translation.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened , and have tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,

translation.kha: kti bakha shna bleithaw baroh Kin shah lehbeiñ ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .
translation.en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .

translation.kha: U brup uba la shah Josabad kum u masi , lane uba la lud ïa la ka longïng shaneng ym dei ban kynrup hapdeng ki brai U Trai .
translation.en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Yn ym don ki ban hiarpateng ïa ki brisoh kiba khlem blei , badno ka thiang kan bah duh ïa ki ïinglieng ba la twa da ka jingbamsap .
translation.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .

translation.kha: To leh ïa kane , ba ki briew kiba pynmeng kin ym shah pynïap ei , bad kumta phin ym kit Pop ba Dei ma phin kiba la pynïap ïa ki ha —kata ka ri ba U Trai u ai ha phi .
translation.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .

translation.kha: U syiem Syria u khuslai jingot shibit shaneng kane ; u la khot ïa la ki pynrangbah pynïaid sad u kylli ïa ki , ino napdeng jngai phi uba long ha ka liang jong u syiem ka Israel ?
translation.en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing  ; and he called his servants , and said unto them , Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel ?

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïasngew shaphang ka jingshna lehrain jong pha ; baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u shipai u ïa-ban halor ti pat , bad baroh ar ngut ki kyllon ha ïadon .
translation.en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .

translation.kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang bad ban buh ïa ka ha ka khyrdop ka Templ .
translation.en: And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jong nga , ni ïa kita kiei kiei hi kiba pa’ bishar ïa kiwei! Hato phi pyrkhat phin lait na ka jingsuh U Blei ?
translation.en: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?

translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la kun pop , u Saul u jubab . Ngam shym kohnguh ïa ka suda U Trai bad ïa ki jingsneng pyn-i jong phi . Ang la sheptieng ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad nga la lai ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: And Saul said unto Samuel , I have sinned : for I have transgressed the commandment of the  Lord  , and thy words : because I feared the people , and obeyed their voice .

translation.kha: U Saul u jubab , Ki briew jong la ki la shem ïa ki na ki Amalek . Ki la buh ïa ki lumlang bad ki masi kiba kynsai kur ban ainguh kum ka jingkynjah ha U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad ïa Kiba sah ngi la pynduh lum khoit .
translation.en: And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .

translation.kha: Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shah ïalaw noh bad kyang long ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Ki Midian , ki Amalek , badno ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki la saphriang ha ka them kum ka kynhun ki puit , bad ki la dat bun Bah ki ut kat ki symboh shyiap ka rud duriaw .
translation.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude  ; and their camels were without number , as the sand by the sea side for multitude .
And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken  ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?
translation.kha: Ym kumta da shisha ! Pynban , phi ong ha u , ‘ To pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da    jong me bad shakri ïa nga katba nga dang bam bad dih ; hadien kata me lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam jong me .’

Bad ïa Aner kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi kiba lama ki lyngdoh la ai ïa ki da ka Hukum ba kin lum kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na ki paid Jerusalem’ , kata ka lama , na la ki briew , wat haba ki bhabriew jong ki ruh ki hiarpateng na u Abiram .
translation.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the office of the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is , of their brethren , though they come out of the loins of Abraham :

translation.kha: Wan bad de na ki lumbah ka lawbah , ko ka nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebiathan . Wan khih na klet u lum Amana , na u lym Senir bad u Lum Hermes , ha kaba ki sing bad ki baje ki shong .
translation.en: I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .

translation.kha: U Petros u la sdang ban kren : Mynta nga sngewthuh ba ka long kiba shisha ba U Blei u ñiup kumjuh ïa uno uno barhem .
translation.en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :

translation.kha: Nangta u Sabad u la shaphang ïa U Trai mala u ong , Mynta kumno ngan kah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U thri ?
translation.en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?
Behold , O  Lord  , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?
translation.kha: Ha khmih , A  Trai  , ha ka jingkordit jong nga , ha ka jingjynjar sat ka mynsiem jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka pait ha ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Ka don ka jingpynïap ha ki lynti bah ; wat hapoh ïing ka don ka jingïap .
Ha kwah ka armet , pynryngkang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jngai ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .

translation.kha: Lada nga phah ïa ki sha ïing Khlem bsuh ïa ki , kin ïapler kaba ki dang ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki , ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .
translation.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .
It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory . I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .
translation.kha: Nga dei ban sngewsarong , wat la kam wanrah jingbha ei ei . Hynrei ngan kren mynta shaphang ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingpynpaw ba la ai ha nga da U Trai .

Kiba duk nabar ki bym don jingpynhiar ki phet shwa me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki erïong bad ka jakarieh tngit na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh khem ka pynïong tlang ,
translation.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .
translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane , u Ananias u la kyllon ïap ; bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la sngewshyrkhei .

Mynta ko Amasaïah , me la iap ïa ki Edom , bad me dap da ka jingsarong . To sngewhun bad la ka wir bad shong khrup ha ïohnong . Balei me pynkynroi jingkulmar ka ban wanrah tang ïa ka jingpynjot ha me bad ha ki briew jong me ?
translation.en: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up : glory of this , and tarry at home : for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?

translation.kha: U Mushi u don lai jrut ki khun shynrang : u Mahlah , u Eder , bad u Jeremoth .
translation.en: The sons of Mushi  ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .
Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei bad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew ki jong U Blei hi .

Ka sner kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ka longïing ka sngi ka jingpyndep ïa ka jingshitom kaba man ka snem banbeiñ weng ne ïa ki pop ki briew . Wat bam ei ei ruh em ha kata ka sngi ; ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U Trai .
translation.en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement : it shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall afflict your souls , and offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: NGA ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , bad nangta sa wan ban ïarap ïa Phi . Ym don u blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sakhi jong nga .
translation.en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .
And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .
translation.kha: Nga la long tang ma nga hi uba la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , hynrei ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ïamareh bad leit rieh .

translation.en: The church that is at Babylon , elected together with you , saluteth you  ; and so doth Mark my son .
translation.kha: Ka Balang kaba ha Babilon , ïa kaba la jied ruh da U Blei , ka phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha phi , bad kumjuh ruh u Markos u khun jong nga .

Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh sanphew ngut ki don hangta , malade ki don kumba lah hajar ngut ki ngab dara ki kynthei phalor tnga ïohnang , kiba khmih ki ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .
translation.en: Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .

translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait baneh shahshkor ïa ka jingiw katba duk , ïa ka jingkyang jingïarap jong phi hi yn ym don ba ïohsngew .
translation.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor , he also shall cry himself , but shall not be heard .

translation.kha: Dei ha ka jingngeit ba kine ki briew baroh ki la ïap . Kim shyiap la ïohpateng ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba U Blei u la kular , hyndai na sha jngai ki ïohthiah ïa ki bad ki pdiang jingsngewbha ïa ki , bad ki la pynbah paidbah ba ki la lama ki nongwei bad ki sohshnong ha kano ka pyrthei .
translation.en: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .
Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God  ; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled  ;
translation.kha: To sumar ban ym phai dien noh na ka jingaiei U Blei . Wat ai ba uno uno un long kum u jingthung uba kthang , uba san bad uba pynjynjar da ka bih jong u .

translation.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongpeit phatok u la ïathuh ha u Paul ,  Ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ka hukum ban pyllait noh ïa me bad ïa u Silas . Te phi lah ban mihnoh , bad leit ha kaba suk .
U Jeshua u la ong ha u , Ym khong uwei ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ïohi ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .

translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin ïai im ha ka pop! ba ka jingjanai U blem kan nang khraw ?
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?
And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u mihnoh , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , bad hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Isaak u kpa jong u .
Ki Baroh ki la kem ïa u Sosthenes , uta u nongïamareh jong ka syn-iang , bad ki la shoh ïa u ha khmat jong ka jingsynshar . Hynrei kata kam Shim pynsalia Wat khñiot pajut ïa u Gallio .
translation.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes , the chief ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . And Gallio cared for none of those things .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lumrit bad ki lumbah , ki diengsoh bad ki khlaw ;
translation.en: Mountains , and all hills  ; fruitful trees , and all cedars :

translation.kha: Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To ngin ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban lytar syntiat ïa —kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynnong kaba biang eh ba ngin leit kiew bad kiba kumno ki jaiñjot shnong kiba don hangta .’
translation.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .
translation.kha: Kumta te , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan leh : Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki briew jong nga ban bam bad ka bih ban dih .
Em , ka long pynban da ka bor ka jong U Blei ba de beh noh ïa ki kynhied , mala kan ka pynshisha ba ka Ahimaas jongki U Blei ka la da wan ha phi .
translation.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils , no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you .

translation.kha: Kum te ki dieng baroh ki ong ha u diengthang shiah , ‘ Ale wan malade long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .

translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingmynjur u samla uba kyrteng u Saul .
translation.en: And cast him out of the city , and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man s feet , whose name was Saul .

translation.kha: U Troas u la ong , Lada kim ngeit ïa me lynti kim ha pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane sa pynngeit ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .

translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ki brisoh , U briew u ban wan hadien jong nga u erlangthari uba kham khrawbor ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bieit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki jingaiti jong u .
translation.en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  I pa jong ngi , u shakri barit jong phi , i dang im bad i shait i khlaiñ .  Bad ki la dem khohsiew bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .
Hadien ba nga la poi , len sa ai ïa ki shithi jingpynithuh sha iba kiba Phi la mynjur , bad ban phah ïa ki ban leit rah ïa ka jingai jong phi shaw Jerusha .
translation.en: And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka punkhun biang bad ka la kha ïa uwei patan u khun shynrang , la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Onan .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and she called his name Onan .

translation.kha: bad ki pukni ki ap ngab ïoh puh ïa ka metïap jongngi u .
translation.en: He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam Israel baroh ki shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap briew .
translation.en: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ki shipai Jeruel kiba u Amasaïah um shym la shad ba kin sien shiah ka thma bad u ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Judia hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Beth Haron , ki la pynjop lai hajar ngut ki ngab , bad ki la kynrup shibun ki miej lute .
translation.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back , that they should not go with him to battle , fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Beth–horon , and smote three thousand of them , and took much spoil .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingïaphet , kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah ba khlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei sad ngan tyrpeng ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashaniah hangta .
translation.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
