Then Esther the queen answered and said , If I have found favour in thy sight , O king , and if it please the king , let my life be given me at my petition , and my people at my request :
translation.kha: Ka Esther , ka mahadei ka jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad barit jong nga , ka jingkwah jong nga ka long ba ngan lah ban im bad ba ki briew jong nga ruh kin im .
Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Katno kiba bieit phi long , katno phi long kiba suki ban ngeit ïa kaei kaei borbah kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong !
translation.en: Then he said unto them ,  O fools , and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken :

Looking to the future , the Bible tells of a “new heavens and a new earth that we are awaiting according to [God’s] promise , and in these righteousness is to dwell .”—2 Peter 3 :13  ; Isaiah 65 :17 .
translation.kha: Haba ngi peit ïa ka lawei , ka Baibl ka ïathuh shaphang “Ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka khyndew kiba thymmai , katba kum kata ka jingkular jong u ( Blei ) ngi ïakhmih lynti , ha kiba ka hok ka shong sah” . —2 Petros 3 :13 ; Isaïah 65 :17 .
U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun bad u la ïap ha ka rta ka khyndaispah laiphew snem .
translation.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Aaron , “Men ym ïoh ka jingdon jingem kum ka jingïohpateng bad ym don kano kano ka bynta na ka ri Israel Ban ai ha me . Tang ïa nga U Trai , me donkam .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them : I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .

translation.kha: nongthaw u la shim syang lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la nongtuh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong , Une u long ka met jongngi nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi . To sa ïa Kanah ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translation.en: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u Joshua , Ngin leh ïa kamai kaei baroh kaba me la ong ïa ngi bad ngin leit kat shaba me Pha ïa ngi .
translation.en: And they answered Joshua , saying , All that thou commandest us we will do , and whithersoever thou sendest us , we will go .

translation.kha: Nahum shym la shahshkor ïa me , A thri U Blei jong I , mynba me la ong ïa me ban im katba kumto ki daiñ bakha me la ai ha ngi lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong me .
translation.en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God , to walk in his laws , which he set before us by his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: Phi erlangthari ba la tim ! Phi khot Kaba bha ïa kaba sngur bad Kaba sniew ïa kambah bha . Phi pynphai ïa ka jingdiang sha ka jingkhaïi bad ïa ka jingshai shiah ka jingdum . Phi pynlong kaba thiang ïa kaba kthang bad kaba kthang ïa kaba thiang .
translation.en: Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !

Thus saith the  Lord  , which giveth the sun for a light by day , and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night , which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynbiang ïa ka sngi ban pynshai mynsngi , ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban pynshai mynmiet . U pynkhih ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ïa ka ban kyrhuh ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
Kine ki dei ki brisoh kiba la kyntait ïa U Blei bad kiba ngeit ba um lah ba leh ei ei ïa ki .
translation.en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?

translation.kha: Te U Trai u kylli ïa u Kain , Shano u Abel u para jong me ? U te u jubab , Ngam tip . Hato dadien ma na u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai nga la buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kum ka por ha kaba lang! ni ïa kane .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .
Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .
translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka por ba ïa kane ka pyrthei yn bishar ; mynta ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .
U Blei u la ong ruh ha u Noah ban thaw ïa ka ïinglieng kaba kah , dara ban wallam ïa la ka ïing ka sem bad ki mrad ba Laiphew jait hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: God also told Noah to build a huge boat , called an ark , and to take into it his family and every sort of animal .

translation.kha: sngewbang , ko Syiem Kynrad , shah ïa nga ban nguh sa tang kawei , ka briew ka ong . To ong u jubab .
translation.en: Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .

translation.kha: Kumba ha kata kiaw ka para u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khup jongngi u Baladan , u ïohsngew ba u syiem Jeshaïah u la kumta pang , kumta u phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingtieng sngewbha .
translation.en: At that time Berodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah : for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick .
And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hangta ngi la shem katto katne ngut ki parabangeit bad ngi la sah bad ki shi taïew . Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem ki la ïathuh ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Kim shym burom ïa ki shyieng u syiem Edom da kaba thang haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .
Ko khun u biria , u la ong , to krai ïa-pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u mala borbah kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kan shah pynshitom .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :
And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep duwai , ka jaka ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ka la khynñiuh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei da ka jingshlur .
La ni ki jlih kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , ki raïot niam kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka ri ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit ban kamet laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , sad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki kyrdoh .
translation.en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .

translation.kha: To ngin pynlong ka jingteh kular ba kan don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jongngi ngi dara ki jong phi .
translation.en: And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Baroh na phiah phin phet noh bad phin iehnoh ïa at , naba ka Jingthoh bakhiah ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ka kynhun langbrot yn pynsakma .’
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered .

translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ngi kit halor ki met baïap jong ngi ïa ka jingïap U Jisu , khring ba ka jingim jong u ruh kan paw ha ki jingsawa jong ngi .
translation.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body .
Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign .
translation.kha: U Joash u la long u syiem ka Judah haba u la don hynñiew snem ka rta .
Ka jingpynkut pynlang ki jingkhublei shimet
translation.en: Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .
And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u jubab ,  Ai ïa nga lai sngi ba ngan pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam . Nangta sa wan pat .  Kumta kita ki briew ki leit noh .
Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Jakob u dang siat syrwa jhur , u Iso u la woh na kaba behmrad .
translation.en: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :

translation.kha: Nongthaw U Jisu u la khyrdep sha bneng , U la ud jylliew , badno u la ïai-ong ha iathuh u briew , Ephphatha . Kaba mih , To blei !
translation.en: And looking up to heaven , he sighed , and saith unto him ,  Ephphatha ,  that is ,  Be opened .

translation.kha: Phi kwah ban wan shong bad la ?
translation.en: Do you want to come sit by me ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka ktien u Blei ka hikai ba mangi ngi longsyiem ka Mynsiem , ba ka myn ka dei shisha mangi , ha ka met bad ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bun baroh ka jinglong jongngi hi .
translation.en: Rather , God’s Word teaches that you are a soul , that your soul is really you , with all your physical and mental qualities .
But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .
translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki hap leit sha ki Philistia ban phah shut ïa ki nar lyngkor , ki mohkhiew , ki sdie , bad ki rashi jong ki ;

translation.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots , with mighty men , and with all men of war , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ha ka miej jong nga kin bam baroh katba lah na ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai jong ki bad na ki shipai bad ki nongïaleh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Moses told it unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata kaba u Moses u la ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang u Aaron , bad ha ki Israel baroh .
Ka khlieh jong nga ka king , pynlang nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Nga la khmied lynti ïa ka janmiet Ban wan , hawei kam shym wallam ei ei Hynrei tang ka jingtriem .
translation.en: My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .
And as he thus spake for himself , Festus said with a loud voice , Paul , thou art beside thyself  ; much learning doth make thee mad .
translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ïasaid da ïa lade ha kane ka rukom , u Phestos u la pyrta ha u ,  Me la lamwir , ko Paul ! Ka jingstad bakhraw jong me ka la pynlamwir ïa me !
Ha ka janmiet shuwa ba un wanpaw , nga la sngur ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai kaba jur . Haba uta u briew u la poi ha ka step kaba bud , U Trai u ai ha de pat ïa ka bor ban kren .
translation.en: Now the hand of the  Lord  was upon me in the evening , afore he that was escaped came  ; and had opened my mouth , until he came to me in the morning  ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no more dumb .

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki sarong bun pynshitom beiñ ïa kiba duk ; pyngngad ïa ki ha ki jingriam bakha ki la shrong .
translation.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa Kaba tam la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jedaïah , kiba la pynmong ïa ka ha kaba phah shla ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ka Tep . Katba u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .

Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement : it shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall afflict your souls , and offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ka long ka sngi ka jingpyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba man ka snem ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Wat bam ei ei ruh em ha kata ka sngi ; ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai .
Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaka manla blei jong Phi kaba ha ki lum , ngan pynpra ïa ki duwan thrang jingbeh jongki phi , sad ngan bret ïa ki metïap jong phira phalor ki bleithaw jong phi kiba la kyllon .
translation.en: And I will destroy your high places , and cut down your images , and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols , and my soul shall abhor you .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ruh ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa kane ka nongbah mala ïa u syiem jong ka . ktem shym la iehnoh thew uwei jin , Hynrei ki la pynap ïa uei pa uwei u briew uba don ha ka . Ki la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba ki la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered it also , and the king thereof , into the hand of Israel  ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain in it  ; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .
Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;
translation.kha: Bad balei kam shym la long kumta ? Namar kim shym la shaniah ha ka jingngeit hynrei ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Bad kumta ki la jynthut ha  U maw jong ka jingjynthut
Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki bynriew jong nga ; kin ïamane malu kohnguh ïa nga . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi kam dei kob pynshong nongrim ha ka jingbakla lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ngab shukor ïano ïano .
translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :

translation.kha: Haba uno uno u throsh , te nga ruh nga sloit ; haba Uno uno u hap ha ka pum , la pynpyut ïa nga da ka jingkthang mynsiem .
translation.en: Who is weak , and I am not weak ? who is offended , and I burn not ?

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U Mynsiem u la Shimiet ïa nga . Hangta ha bneng la khong ka khet bad la ne uwei uba shong halor jong ka .
translation.en: And immediately I was in the spirit : and , behold , a throne was set in heaven , and one sat on the throne .

translation.kha: Ki jingot jong nga , ong U Tlai , kim long kum ki jongnga phi , bad ki lynti jong nga ki ïapher na ki jong phi .
translation.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .
Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .
translation.kha: Te ngan jin da la ïohthiah kum ki khun syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba dang shu kha .

translation.en: And laid them down at the apostles  feet : and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need .
translation.kha: bad ai ïa ka ha ki apostol ; bad ïa ka pisa la ïasam ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingdonkam jong u .
Ha kawei ka sngi haba ki hynmen shynrang jyllang u Joseph ki leit ïalam bam phlang ïa ki jingri jong u khop jong ki sha Shekhem ,
translation.en: And his brethren went to feed their father s flock in Shechem .
Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I have done one work , and ye all marvel .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la leh ïa kawei ka kambah , bad baroh phi ïa-sngewlyngngoh .

Lane tharai kawei ka briew kaba don shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa ka duh noh kawei na ki — kaei ba kan leh ? Ka thang ïa ka sharak , ka sar ïa la ka ïing , bad ka khmih biang biang kylleng kylleng haduh ba kan da Shema ïa ka .
translation.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?
Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , Jehu departed not from after them , to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth–el , and that were in Dan .
translation.kha: Hynrei u pyrthuh bud ïa ka pop jong u syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ha kaba mane ïa ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la pynïeng ha Bethel bad ha Dan .
Ka jingshai ka sngi ka phyrnai eh ïa ki nongleh ba-bymman , bad ka khanglad ïa ki na ki kam leh jubor .
translation.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden , and the high arm shall be broken .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la leit sha Hebron , u da ïalam Bad u ïa ki ar ngut ki tnga jong u : Ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
translation.en: So David went up thither , and his two wives also , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail Nabal s wife the Carmelite .

translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïeng hajan jong u , katba ka kynhun ki shipai ïada syiem ki Dang ïadei na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai Kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïadie ,
translation.en: And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , to ong ïa ki nongtih Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Jeraïah . Ong ha ki : ‘ Ka waitlam ka la Khloi ban pynjot ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kumno ka leilieh .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :

translation.kha: Phi dei ban ai sngewbha sha U Blei ha Jerusalem ïa baroh ki khiew ki pynlong ïa kiba la ai ha phi ban pyndonkam ha ki jingshakri ha ka Templ .
translation.en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
For I am a man under authority , having soldiers under me : and I say to this man , Go , and he goeth  ; and to another , Come , and he cometh  ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
translation.kha: Ma nga ruh , nga long u briew hapoh ka iktiar jong ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kham halor , bad nga don ruh ki shipai hapoh jong nga . Nga hukum ïa une uwei , ‘ Khie leit !’ bad u leit ; bad nga hukum ïa utai uwei , ‘ Ale !’ bad u wan ; bad nga hukum ïa u mraw jong nga , ‘ Leh ïa kane !’ bad u leh ïa kata .
Bad pynban u dei U Balei uba la pynrieh ïa ki — ngam lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingpynkoit jongno ki bymman .
translation.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
translation.kha: Da kumno u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingim ? Da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la long kiba kham bitar ban ïa kito kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïarap suki ha ka jingshngain , khlem Kanaan kane ka jingbam baneh ri pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .

translation.kha: bad pynkyllon ïa ki shem bad pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki . Neng pynkylla khongpong ïa ki kila ïapom Bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ; ki kulai kin ïap , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ïa-pihuin para ma ki .
translation.en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen  ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them  ; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïoh ïa ka jingjop un ïohpdiang ïa kan na nga : Ngan long U Blei jong u , bad un long u khup jong nga .
translation.en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things  ; and I will be his God , and he shall be my son .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngap u Jesse u ong ha u Dabid , Shim shiphew kilo Un u krai sdieh sad kine ki kpoh shiphew tylli , mala leit rah kyrkieh ïa ki sha ki hynmen jong phi ha ka jaka sher dala .
translation.en: And Jesse said unto David his son , Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves , and run to the camp to thy brethren  ;

translation.kha: Ki baroh ki khot ïa u , ‘ Mynta me la sleh kumba long ma ngi ! Me lama uwei na ngi !
translation.en: All they shall speak and say unto thee , Art thou also become weak as we ? art thou become like unto us ?

translation.kha: Ki leit snar shapoh bad ki shem ïa kata ka paitlieng na ïing ha ka jingthiah bad ïa ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlain jong kata .
translation.en: And when the messengers were come in , behold , there was an image in the bed , with a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster .
Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .
translation.kha: Wat kular ban kitkhlieh na ka bynta ki ram jong kiwei pat .

translation.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka hukum :  Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa ki bad ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .

translation.en: Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .
translation.kha: Mynta khie leit sha la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi , hynrei phi dei ban pynmih katjuh ki maw-it .
Te ïa ki khmat jong ki la plie bun ki la ithuh ïa u , hynrei u la jah noh na khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And their eyes were opened , and they knew him  ; and he vanished out of their sight .
His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u ,  Mynta te me kren shai kdar , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher .
Khenani jar uba shahshkor ïa nga un shongksuid kynjai . Un lait na ki jingem khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .

translation.kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka na , I pa jong ngi i la thymmai , bad ym don shynrang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki shun shongkurim ïa ngi ba ngin ïew khun ïor ktien .
translation.en: And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :

translation.kha: U Samuel u pynïap utai u khunlangbrot bad u thang tylli ïa u kumno ka jingkha ainguh ha U Trai . Hangta u duwai ha U Trai ngab ïarap ïa ki Israel , bad U Trai u jyllop ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translation.en: And Samuel took a sucking lamb , and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the  Lord  : and Samuel cried unto the  Lord  for Israel  ; and the  Lord  heard him .

translation.kha: Ki Israel lem bad ki nongïalam jyllang ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jongnga ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka jyntang U Trai , da kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba bah ïa ka . shongkhet na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jyllang ki ka phai sha u Lum Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u Lum Ebal . U Messaïah u Shakri U Trai u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka por ïa ki ngab iohpateng ïa ka jingryngkhiang .
translation.en: And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u Manoah na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dan . Ka tnga jong u kam pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :
translation.kha: Ho-oid , wat ha ki shakri jong nga , baroh shynrang bad kynthei , ngan theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha kita ki sngi , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga .
Gera Phim paw shemphang ? u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka Assyria yn pynïoh ha ka thma , hynrei ym da ka bor briew . Ki nong Assyria kin phet ïap na ka thma , bad ïa ki samla shynrang jong ki yn pyningkhong mirr .
translation.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword , not of a mighty man  ; and the sword , not of a mean man , shall devour him : but he shall flee from the sword , and his young men shall be discomfited .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop napdeng ki briew jong nga yn pynïap ha ka thlim — ïa kito baroh kiba ong ‘ U Blei un ym shah ïa kano kano ka jingem ngab woh ïasan jong ngi .’
translation.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword , which say , The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us .

translation.kha: Pynban kaba ki Jeruel ki nang shah pynkhyllem beiñ , katta ruh ki kad ïaroi bad ki at saphriang kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving  ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me ; ngan ai ka jingkñia ïa me bad ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka wan na U  Trai  !
U Terah u ong ïa ki Israel , La slem bah nga la ïatih lympat kaei ka ban sa jia ; nongkit kynsan nga pyntong ba kan jia .
translation.en: I have declared the former things from the beginning  ; and they went forth out of my mouth , and I shewed them  ; I did them suddenly , and they came to pass .
For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngewskhem ba yn ym don uno uno uba awria , uba long jakhlia , lane uba kwah lalot (naba ka jingkwah lalot ka long hi ka rukom mane bleithaw) u ban ïoh bynta ha ka Hima jong U Khrist bad jong U Blei .
Uwei ha Kaei ka tduh , bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong kata ka jingtap . U pyndait lang ïa ki kumto ba ki long lang sad kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: One cherub on the end on this side , and another cherub on the other end on that side : out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof .

And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka jait Lebi , ban ïatreilang bad ïarap ïa me katba me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .
translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad kiba kum kita ki briew .

translation.en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?
translation.kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ding . Haba ki tduh ki la ing lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la kylla rnga , hato phi lah ban shna ei ei na ka ?

wahbah u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynrei ba kuna pynmih pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la Shim khyndiat ka um , u la thew ïa la ki kti ha khmat u paidbah , bad u la ong , Ngam don jingïakhih na ka bynshet ka jingïalap jong Une u brup ! Kane ka dei ka jingleh lad phi !
translation.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .

translation.kha: Ka Milkah ka ïoh ïa kine ki phra ngut ki khun na u Nahor , u para u Abram .
translation.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham s brother .
When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
translation.kha: Yn ym don u ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phi lada phi ïaid kum uba stad , bad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .

translation.en: Son of man , when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously , then will I stretch out mine hand upon it , and will break the staff of the bread thereof , and will send famine upon it , and will cut off man and beast from it :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  lada ka ri ka leh pop bad kam ïaineh ha nga , ngan kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pynduh ïa ka jingpyndap jingbam jong ka . Ngan phah ïa ka  nemsniew bad pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .
Me dei ban pynïapher ïa kata kaba long ka jong U Trai na kata kaba ia ban pyndonkam Baïap , ïa kata kabu khwai na kata ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean  ;

translation.kha: ‘ Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpyndep ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shaneng jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynshitom kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka jaka .’ Kumta shem ïa ka met jong u Joram , u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jongno u , bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U Terah .
translation.en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .
Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
translation.kha: lane ban leh myntor , lane ban ïakren bad ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap .

translation.en: Yet say ye , Why ? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father ? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right , and hath kept all my statutes , and hath done them , he shall surely live .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Balei ba u khun un ym shahshitom namar ki pop jong u kpa jong u ?’ Ka jubab ka long ba u khun jong u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha . U la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad u la bud biang biang ïa ki , bad kumta un im da shisha .
Ka dohnud jong sa ka long bad ki nongai hukum jongno ki Israel , Lem mala u paidbah uba tyrwa mon sngewbha da kaba kmen . Ïaroh ïa U Trai’ !
translation.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel , that offered themselves willingly among the people . Bless ye the  Lord .
Moreover all the chief of the priests , and the people , transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen  ; and polluted the house of the  Lord  which he had hallowed in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nalor kane , ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew ki bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki ha kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ , ïa kaba U  Trai  da lade hi u la pynlong kaba kyntang .

translation.en: Take heed , regard not iniquity : for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction .
translation.kha: Da sumar ban ym phai sha ka jingbymman ; ïa ka jingshah shitom jong phi la phah ban pyllait ïa phi na ka .

translation.en: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office ,
translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin pyndonkam haba ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ,

Ha kata hi ka miat u Saul u phah Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban khmih sisa ïa ka ïing u Dabid bad ban pynïap ïa u ha ka step kaba bud . Ka Mikhal , ka tnga u Dabid , ka Maham ïa u , Lada Phim phet myntoi ka miet , lashai ka sngi phin long uba la ïap noh .
translation.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David s house , to watch him , and to slay him in the morning : and Michal David s wife told him , saying , If thou save not thy life to night , to morrow thou shalt be slain .
And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , bad katba u dang ïaid , ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la sdang ban bud ïa u .  To isynei ïa ngi , ko khun u Dabid !  ki la pyrta .

Kumta haba U Blei u la phah noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga shata ki ri nongwei , nga ïai-ong ha ka , ‘ Pha lah ban pyn-i haduh katno pha shaniah ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa uei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jongnga pha .’
translation.en: And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .
For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .
translation.kha: Me la khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki ban pyrkhat beit ; wat shah ïa ki ban jop halor jong nga mynta .

translation.en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Hato U  Trai  u la kren tang lyngba u Moses ? Hato um shym la kren lyngba jong ngi ruh ?  U  Trai  u la ïohsngew aïu ki ong .
Dei hangta ba ki la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka Saul ka tnga jong u ; hangta ruh ki la tep ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka ka tnga jong u ; bad dih hangta ba nga la tep ïa ka Leah .
translation.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife  ; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife  ; and there I buried Leah .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong nga kan long lem bad phi baroh ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus . Amen .
He which testifieth these things saith ,  Surely I come quickly .  Amen . Even so , come , Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Uta uba ai ïa ka jingphla jong u ha kane baroh , u ong ,  Ho-oid da shisha ! Nga wan kloi !  Ai kan long kumta . To wan , Trai Jisu !
U pynbynta ïa ki lashai ngut ki rangbah ha ki para kynhun , bad u ai ha ti uwei u briew kawei ka turoi bad utai u khraw uba don ka dongmusa hapoh jong u .
translation.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies , and he put a trumpet in every man s hand , with empty pitchers , and lamps within the pitchers .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong por , to long uba stad , bun ngan Long uba kmen ; ngan don ka jubab ïa ine uno ibha kem daw ïa to .
translation.en: My son , be wise , and make my heart glad , that I may answer him that reproacheth me .

translation.kha: Shuh shuh , lada uno uno u bam ïa ka doh jongnga kane ka jingngeit hadien ba u la ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , la ka dei kaba na u briew ne na u mrad , ïa u ruh yn ym ñiad shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .

translation.kha: Jingkhot ïa ki ïoh bad ki lawbah jong nga baïar . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kin thung ïa ki jingthung jong ki ha ka jingsuk . Ki bri shawei jong ki kin pynmih ki sohwaiñ , ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad u lup un don kyrhai . Ngan ai ïa kine ki jingkyrkhu barabor ha ki briew jong ka hima jong nga kiba ïangat lait im .
translation.en: For the seed shall be prosperous  ; the vine shall give her fruit , and the ground shall give her increase , and the heavens shall give their dew  ; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .

translation.kha: bad ki bniap thiah bad ki shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha ka ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen malade ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .
translation.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki paid ka Judah ban leh ïa ka mon jong U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad hukum jong u .

translation.en: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
translation.kha: Haba ki apostol ki la tip shaphang kata , ki la phet sha ki nongbah Lystra bad Derbe kiba ha Lykaonia , bad sha ka thain ba-marjan .

translation.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban pyntngit ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh

translation.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin  ; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning .
translation.kha: Shim shi song u Hissop bad wieh ïa u ha ka pliang kaba don ïa ka snam jong uta u mrad , bad tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shawkad bad ha u bim ha khlieh ka jingkhang ïing jong phi . Uwei ruh um bit ban mih shabar na ïing haduh mynstep .

Khie kaba ngi ïohi mynta ka long kamon ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka jingkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . Kaei kaba nga tip mynta ka longïng tang katto katne ; nangto Kan sa longkmie kaba dap pura — kaba dap pura kum ka jingtip jong U Blei ïa nga .
translation.en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .
And truly the Son of man goeth , as it was determined : but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed !
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba U Blei u la thmu , hynrei a katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa u !
Halor ki diengkhap ba don hajan , ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki bad ki rwai .
translation.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .

translation.kha: U la ter Haneng ïa ka dil ha U Trai bad u la ai ki jingsuh thang sad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U la duwai , bun U Trai u la jubab ïa u da kaba phah ïa ka ding na bnoh ngab thang ïa ki jingainguh halor ka duwan .
translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the  Lord   ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .
But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .
translation.kha: hynrei ka ktien jong U Trai ka ïaineh junom .  Kane ka ktien ka long ka Khubor Babha ïa kaba la pynbna ha phi .
( Ka la long ka snem kaba saiñ naduh ba la ringmraw ïa u syiem Jehoïakhin . )
translation.en: In the fifth day of the month , which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin s captivity ,
Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him ?
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba donbor , bad da u ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .
translation.kha: Wat tieng ïa ki , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka bynta jong me .’

translation.en: And he said unto me ,  My grace is sufficient for thee : for my strength is made perfect in weakness .  Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities , that the power of Christ may rest upon me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jubab jong u ka la long :  Ka jingaiei jong nga ka long baroh kaba me donkam , naba ka bor jong nga ka khraw tam dei haba me tlot .  Nga kmen eh , namarkata , ban sngewsarong ha ki jingtlot jong nga , khnang ban mad ïa ka jingïada ka bor jong U Khrist halor jong nga .
Ïaroh ïa U Terah uba la pyllait im ïa phi na u Pharaoh bad na ki nong Ijipt ! Ïaroh ïa U Trai uba la pyllait im ïa une u paidbah na ka jinglongmraw !
translation.en: And Jethro said , Blessed be the  Lord  , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh , who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .

translation.kha: Ko TRAI’ , iwei uba katba ma me hapdeng ki blei ? Uei kew uba koum ma me , uba phylla ha ka jinglongkhuid ? Uei uba lah ban leh ki kambah bad ki iphylla kum ma me ?
translation.en: Who is like unto thee , O  Lord  , among the gods ? who is like thee , glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?

translation.kha: Mynba u Abiathar u khun jong u Anammelekh u la lait pui bad ithuh ïasoh bad u Dabid ha Keilah , u la rah ïa ka ephod lem bad u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah pynlwet namar ki briew jong nga ki la shahskhor pynlwet ; nga ïam sngewsih ; nga la shaïong jur .
translation.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt  ; I am black  ; astonishment hath taken hold on me .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki lieng , kiba na Tiberias , ki la wan nang ha ka ryngkew hajan ka kajuh ha kaba ki paidbah ki la bam ïa u kpu hadien ba U Trai u la ainguh .
translation.en: ( Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread , after that the Lord had given thanks : )

translation.kha: Nga hi nga la pyrkhat ba nga dei ban leh ïa katei kaei baroh kaba nga ha pyrshah ïa ka jingthmu U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
translation.en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .

translation.kha: Nga da khah eh ba phin long kiba lait na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ïa-ban pynbhabriew ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel un long u Sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha kum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngan kylli jingkylli ïa i pa . Lada ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha , ngan sa phah ktien ïa phi .

Haba ki la pdiang ïa ka shithi jong u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anab , ki thuh ïa ki khlieh jongnga ki ha ki shaphang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .
And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi sha ka jaka jong ki Japhlet haduh ka jaka jong ka Beth Haron kaba Sharum . Nangta u suh sha Geser bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .

Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynhap slap ha ka khyndew jong phi ha ka aïom kaba biang , ha ka por synrai bad ha ka por pyrem , khnang ba phira ïohlum ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka jingmaïan Olib na ka bynta jong phi hi , pynlang ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingiw jong phi .
translation.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .
Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba leh borabor ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed  ; and he reared up altars for Baal , and made a grove , as did Ahab king of Israel  ; and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
translation.kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ïa kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot ; u la tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal bad thaw ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , kumba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la leh . U Manasseh u la mane ruh ïa ki khlur .

translation.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early , and gone forth , behold , an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots . And his servant said unto him , Alas , my master ! how shall we do ?
translation.kha: Kum lashai dang step phyrngab , u shakri jong u Elisha u khie , u mih shabar ïing , bad u ïohi ba ki shipai Syria lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki ba ki la kerkut ïa kata ka shnong . U leit phai sha u Elisha bad u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , ngi la ïap ! Ngin leh kumno ?
U briew uba alhia u shong hapoh ïing ; u ong ba u sing u eh ban eh ïa u lada u mih shabar .
translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us : and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip kaei ka jingieit : U Khrist u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi . Ngi ruh , namarkata , ngi dei ban ai ïa la ki jingim na ka bynta ki parabriew !

translation.en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .
translation.kha: Ym don u shakri uba lah ban long u mraw jong ki ar ngut ki kynrad ; un isih ïa uwei bad un ieit ïa uwei pat ; un kohnguh ïa uwei bad un ñiewbeiñ ïa uwei pat . Phim lah ban shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ka spah .
Man ka sngi nga la don bad phira ban hikai ha ka Templ , bad phim khim la Kem ïa nga . hynriew ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki dei ban urlong shaid .
translation.en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and ye took me not : but the scriptures must be fulfilled .
Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .
translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti ka jingshisha bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .
Haduh don napdeng lad phi ba skhem jynjar ? U dei ban duwai . Hammoth kein kiba kmen ? U daym ban Reu ïaroh .
translation.en: Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .

translation.kha: Hobah kata ka sngi ka wan bad ïa ka Ijipt la pynim , ngan phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha ki liengbah ban pynkhih ïa ki Briew ki bym poi pyrkhat jong ka Sudan , bad kin sngewtriem . Kata ka sngi ka la jan wan !
translation.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid , and great pain shall come upon them , as in the day of Egypt : for , lo , it cometh .
The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee , from me : if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right  ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .
translation.kha: Kumta te to ngin ïakhlad noh . Jied ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri kaba me mon . Me leit shawei , bad nga ngan leit shawei pat .

translation.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren  ; and Joseph s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit kaba ar u Joseph u la pynithuh ïa lade ha la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u syiem ka Ijipt u la ïoh jingtip shaphang ka longïing jong u Joseph .

translation.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude , and as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of mighty thunderings , saying , Alleluia : for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum u paid uba bun , kum ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , kum ki jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Naba U Trai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh jong ngi , u long U Syiem !
U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung naba ïa-pynthait , ba kin slap ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
translation.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
And the  Lord  said unto me , Cast it unto the potter : a goodly price that I was prised at of them . And I took the thirty pieces of silver , and cast them to the potter in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .  Kumta nga la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa — ka jingkheiñ kaba khraw kaba ki la pyrkhat ba nga la shongdor — bad buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
Berakah ki la ïalyngngoh shikatdei eh ! Ki la dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da nong , A katno kiei kiei kiba phyllad ngi la ïohi ha kane ka Sngi !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .

translation.kha: Kumno kew ngan hir uba jingkhlaiñbor haduh katta dik ? u Hasael u kyrhai . Ngam long ei ei ruh em ! U Elisha u phai ktien , U Trai u la pynpoi ha nga ba men sa long u syiem ka Syria .
translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .

So Gad came to David , and told him , and said unto him , Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land ? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies , while they pursue thee ? or that there be three days  pestilence in thy land ? now advise , and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me .
translation.kha: u Gad u la leit sha u , ban ïathuh ïa u ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano kata ka ban long ? Lai snem ka  nemsniew ha ka ri jong phi , lane lai bnai kaba phet ïap na ki nongshun jong phi , ne lai sngi ka jingïapthem ha ka ri jong phi ? Mynta to pyrkhat , bad ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jubab ba ngan leit rah sha U  Trai .

translation.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel  ; and they were also both of them his wives .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shongkurim ïa ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad mynta ka Abigail ruh ka la long ka tnga jong u .
Hato ki long ki Hebru ? Nga mad ar Long . Hato ki longïng ki Israel ? Nga ruh nga un-long . Hato ki long kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham ? Nga pajut nga longkmie .
translation.en: Are they Hebrews ? so am I . Are they Israelites ? so am I . Are they the seed of Abraham ? so am I .

translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingkyrmen , un pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen baroh dara ka jingsuk kaba long da ka jingngeit jong phira ha u , khnang ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan ïai san da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Katto katei ngut ki rangbah ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Saul , Bad u phah khot ïa u .
translation.en: And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingleh thombor yn ym ïohsngew shuh , ka jingjot kan ym don shuh ioh ki pud jongno pha ; ngan ïada bad kyrshan ïa pha kum ka kynroh : Phan ïaroh ïa nga namar nga la pyllait ïa pha .
translation.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land , wasting nor destruction within thy borders  ; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation , and thy gates Praise .
And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,
translation.kha: Hynrei lehse don uba kum bakla khlem da mut khnang ha kaba sumar ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha u ,  Ngi baroh ngi la tlot na ka jingthngan , hynrei i pa jong phi i la byrngem ïa ngi bad ong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’
Ladan phi rkhiebeiñ ïa ki briew kiba nur , phi ñiup ïa U blang uba la thaw ïa ki . Phin shah pynshitom lada phi leh sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .
translation.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .

translation.kha: Ha ki kynroh jongngi pha , ko Jeruel , nga la buh ïa ki nongap pharia ; mynsngi ne mynmiet ngin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U Trai ïa ki kylluid jrong u , dara kin ym Shah ba un klet ïa ki .
translation.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .
translation.kha: Haba nga la sngew kumba ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad ha ka Templ bakhuid jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .

Nangta pat u lyngdoh un pynbang sa ïa ka jingkñia ñiar ka pop , pynlang un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa Uta u jingri namar ka jingainguh thang ,
translation.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongshoh-nar jong im’ ki la afi noh ïa u ban rah pynïap , bad ïa u la sahnarphna .
translation.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death , and have crucified him .
The king of Aphek , one  ; the king of Lasharon , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Aphek , ka Lasharon ,

translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .
translation.kha: Ha khmat ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw , kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khet da saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kiba don ki khmat sha khmat bad shadien .
U buhrieh ïa lade ha ki shnongrit , da kaba apthap ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba la lui . U syntiat ïa ki lanot Jong u , ki bym don nongïarap ,
translation.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka jing-jngai ïa ka jingïarap , namar ba U Trai u la wallam ïa ka jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh kamet , ïa ki ngor jongnga phi yn pynjop da u kew , bad phin ïoh umdih shibun bha ka waiñ haduh ba phim la shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .
translation.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .
Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Ahab u syiem Israel , ka ri Moab ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

U la kynjri noh nongtuh bad tih ïa kawei pateng ka pukri . Ym shym don jingïakajia shiah ïa kata , kumne u khot kyrteng ïa ka , Ka jingkhanglad . U ong , Myntan te U Trai u la ai jinglaitluid ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha Kane ka jaka , bun ngin sa nang roi ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u jong , Ko Jerusalem’ , la slem bah me la kynjat ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntu ban kohnguh ïa na bad Mano ïa de . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki blei ka jingkharoi .
translation.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , ki la kylli , lano kane kan wia ? Bad kaei ka ban jia khnang ban pyn-i ba ka nga ka la poi ïa ka ba kan jia ?
translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?

translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha Jerushah na ka bynta ka jingïarwai Niam .
translation.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kheiñ leit dara tur ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , bad pynjot luin khoit kat kambah ki ei . Waw pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynïap lut ïa ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi sad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kada baroh .
translation.en: Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .

translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri Kanaan bad u la pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ki rai jong ka ri .
translation.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan , he divided their land to them by lot .

translation.kha: kumta ki biria ki ïarap , khlem da shuh banbeiñ kaei . Kin ym lah ban kyntoit shuh katba ka sahit bneng ka dang ïaishah ; Kin ym la ban khih shuh lano lano na ka jingïohthiah jong ki .
translation.en: So man lieth down , and riseth not : till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .

translation.kha: Wat kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha ka pyrthei , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang ki pynjot , bad ki nongtuh ki prong bad ki tuh .
translation.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth , where moth and rust doth corrupt , and where thieves break through and steal :
And he said unto his people , Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we :
translation.kha: Une u ong ha la ki briew ,  Kine ki Israel ki la ïaroi palat , bad ki la ïakhlaiñ eh ruh , bad ki long ka jingma ïa ngi .

translation.en: Know ye not , that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey , his servants ye are to whom ye obey ; whether of sin unto death , or of obedience unto righteousness ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba haba phi pyndem ïa lade kum ki mraw ban kohnguh ïano ïano , ha ka jingshisha , phi long ki mraw jong u kynrad uba phi kohnguh — lada ka long ka pop , kaba ka jingmih ka long ka jingïap , lane ka jingkohnguh , kaba ka jingmih ka long ka jingïasuk bad U Blei .

translation.en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel , ban lap la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki da u Moses .
Wat ym long ka jingshyrkhei ïa nga ; me long ka jaka shngain jong nga haba ka jingjynjar ka woh .
translation.en: Be not a terror unto me : thou art my hope in the day of evil .

translation.kha: Ka por kan pah , bad ka la lai long mandriek , haba ïa Phi baroh yn sa pynsakma , uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka ïing , bad kan shah iehnoh tang marwei . Hynrei ngam long shisha marwei , namar U Kpa u long lem bad nga .
translation.en: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .

translation.kha: Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphrang . Leit sha ri lum Amor sad shwa ki jaka kiba marbl mala ka — sha ka Them Jordan , sha ki ri lum dara ri dem , sha ka jaka kaba shathie bad sha ka rud duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha ka ri Kana bad nangta sha lyndet ki Lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .
translation.en: Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .
The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself , God , I thank thee , that I am not as other men are , extortioners , unjust , adulterers , or even as this publican .
translation.kha: U Pharisi u la ïeng kyrpang la ka jong hi bad u la duwai , ‘ Nga ainguh ïa me , a Blei , ba ngam long uba lalot , u bymhok , lane uba klim , kum uno uno uwei pat . Nga ainguh ba ngam long kum utai u nonglum khajna hangtai .
Haba ngi shahshitom , ngi dei ban shong marwei ha ka jingïaineh bajar jar ;
translation.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him .

translation.kha: Haba u ïabuaid u tip ba u Saul u la pynkhreh ban tur ïalaw ïa u , u la ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh , Elam Hangno ïa ka ephod .
translation.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .
Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pha dei ban shahshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba jakhlia bad kiba ijli kiba pha la leh .  U  Trai  u la kren .
To U Balei un kyrkhu ïa uba uba wan ha ka kyrteng jongno U Trai ! Na ka Templ jong U Trai ngi kyrkhu ïa me .
translation.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .
I say then , Have they stumbled that they should fall ? God forbid : but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles , for to provoke them to jealousy .
translation.kha: Nga kylli te : Haba ki Jiw ki jynthut , hato ki hap sha ka jingjot jong ki ? Em , ym kumta ! Namar ki la leh pop , ka jingpynim ka la wan sha ki Jentil , ban pynlong ïa ki Jiw ban bishni ïa ki .

translation.en: But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa nga ; U Blei jong nga u ïada ïa nga .

“Nga ma lah ban leh ei ei da la ka jong ka tam ; la bishar tang kat kaba U Blei u ainong ïa nga , kumta ka jingbishar jong nga ka long kaba hok , namar ba ngam pyrshah ban kuna ïa kaei kaba nga mano , hynriew ïa kiei kaba uta babha la phah ïa sa u mon .
translation.en: I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just  ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .

translation.kha: bad phi dei ban kup ïa u briew uba thymmei ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei kaba pynnep ïa lade ha ka jingim kaweh pahara katba long kaba beit nabar kaba khuid .
translation.en: And that ye put on the new man , which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness .

translation.kha: Ki jia ki la kyrshan ïa Kanah ka jingmudui bad ki la ong ba kane baroh ka long kaba shisha .
translation.en: And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .

translation.kha: Kane kan erlangthari ka kaban ïa pa ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha .
translation.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony .
And it came to pass in the third year , that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba lai , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u leit ïakynduh ïa u Ahab u syiem Israel .
hynñiew sngi lynter phin ïabam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin pynphong ïa ka Jingkhawai Madan ban pyndonburom ïa U Troas .
translation.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u ki la ïeng , hynrei kim shym mudui ïa u ïa kano kano na ki nang runar kiba nga la pyrkhat ba kin leh .
translation.en: Against whom when the accusers stood up , they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed :

translation.kha: hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Etam ba kin manbha biang . Ma nga , U Tiras , nga la kren .
translation.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days , that I will bring again the captivity of Elam , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , nga pyrkhat ba ki briew kiba la ringmraw sha Babilonia ki long kum kine ki soh Dumbur kiba bha , kan lehsbun ïa ki da ka jinglehsbun .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Like these good figs , so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good .
I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod s judgment hall .
translation.kha: u la ong ,  Ngan sa bishar ïa me ynda poi ki nongmudui jong me .  Nangta u la ai hukum ban buh ïa u Paul ha ka jingap phira hapoh ka jaka sah jong u lyngskor .

Sa Shisien pat u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew nguh ki rangbah . U la leit kiew ïa u lum , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , sad u la ïasaid , Ko briew jong U Blei , to isynei ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga . To pyllait ïa ka jingim lad ine !
translation.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la rai ïa ka jingrwai bad ki la leit nala sha u lum ki Olib .
translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .

translation.kha: bun hadien katai u la im sa phraspah snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translation.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , ka um basngur kan tuid na Jerusalem , shiteng na ka shad ka Duriaw Baïap bad kawei pat ka shiteng sha ka durblei Mediterranian . Kan thad baroh shisnem , ha ka aïom ba-rkhiang sad ha ka Aniam baieit .
translation.en: And it shall be in that day , that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem  ; half of them toward the former sea , and half of them toward the hinder sea : in summer and in winter shall it be .

translation.kha: Pynshlur ïa nga ba kren ïa ka jingshim ha ki para baroh , namar ka jingmynjur jong nga ka long ha ki jingbishar jong me .
translation.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth  ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .

translation.kha: Kumta ki tep khynwin noh ïa ki pukri baroh kiba ki shakri jong u kpa jong u , u Abraham ki la tih mynba u Abraham u dang im .
translation.en: For all the wells which his father s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped them , and filled them with earth .
The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew basniew kim lah sngewthuh kum ïa kita kiei kiei .
Ki borbah ki la kum ïa u Sosthenes , uta u nongïalam jong ka synagog , bad ki la shoh ïa u ha khmih jong ka ïingbishar . Khynñiuh kata kam shym pynsalia wat khyndiat ruh ïa u Gallio .
translation.en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes , the chief ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . And Gallio cared for none of those things .

translation.kha: Ki Hall ap pharia lai tylli baroh rmiang ka lynti ïaid , ki kynruh hapdeng jong ki , pynlang ka kamra rung baroh ki la don ki jingtynjuh kba katjuh kum pli kiba ha ka khrawbor kaba shat mihngi . Ka khyrdop barhem shi lynter ka la longkmie arphew sanphew mitar bad ka pyngkiang Khat-ar mirr shiteng .
translation.en: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side  ; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate : the length thereof was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .

translation.kha: to tip skhem ba U Trai U Balei jong phi un ym Beh shuh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Pyndep , kin long ka jingmynsaw ïa phiah kum ka shangkhawiah lane ka tliew bad kabu pang shikatdei eh kum ka jingtep ha ka ingdong jong phi lane ki sieh ha ki khmat jong Phin . Bad kane kan ne dak haduh ba ym don shuh imat ruh napdeng jong phi uba dang lehse im ha kane ka ri kaba bha ïa kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi! .
translation.en: Know for a certainty that the  Lord  your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you  ; but they shall be snares and traps unto you , and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes , until ye perish from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .

For our rejoicing is this , the testimony of our conscience , that in simplicity and godly sincerity , not with fleshly wisdom , but by the grace of God , we have had our conversation in the world , and more abundantly to you-ward .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ba ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynskhem ïa ngi ba ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei , bad khamtam eh ba ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi , la pynïaid da kata ka jingkhuid bad ka jingsngur kaba na U Blei , da ka bor ka jingaiei U Blei bad ym da ka jingstad briew .

translation.en: And Michal Saul s daughter loved David : and they told Saul , and the thing pleased him .
translation.kha: Ka Mikhal ka khun u Saul pynban ka ïapmat ïa u Dabid , bad haba u Saul u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewbha .

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Make the men sit down .  Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .
translation.kha: Pynshong ïa ki briew ha madan ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki . ( La don shibun u phlang hangta . ) Kumta ki briew baroh ki la shong ha madan ; ki la don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah .
Ki pynbna ïa ka sngi shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah , bad ai ha u nongbat ka iaki shong bajahburom .
translation.en: They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .
And this is the thing that ye shall do , Ye shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman that hath lain by man .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa baroh ki shynrang , bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ka bym dei shuh ka theisotti .

translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , bad u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
Phim ju kwah ïa ka jingai jingmut lem jong nga lane shahshkor haba la pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .
When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi , he asked his disciples , saying ,  Whom do men say that I the Son of man am ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka thain hajan ka shnong Kaisaria Philippi , ha kaba u la kylli ïa la ki synran ,  Ki briew ki ong ba U Khun U Briew u long uei ?
Ïa Uei pa uwei yn pynjahburom , mala ïa Baroh ibha sarew yn pynjot .
translation.en: And the mean man shall be brought down , and the mighty man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled :

translation.kha: U dang ïaid ha lynti najan ka dong ha kaba shong kawei ka kynoi . U dang ïaid lyngba najan ïing jongu ka
translation.en: Passing through the street near her corner  ; and he went the way to her house ,
And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation , in all the wealth which God shall give Israel : and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever .
translation.kha: Te yn pynkordit ïa me bad men peit da ka jingsngewpihuiñ haba me ïohi ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha kiwei pat ki briew jong ka Israel , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na ka ïing jong me u ban im tymmen .
Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei dara pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ïa ki nongsngap jongu me . Wat ai ïan ïaduna na ki ba-bang ibeiñ ïa me .
translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God , it is evident : for , The just shall live by faith .
translation.kha: Tangba ym shym la pynksan ïano ïano ruh da ka Hukum ha U Blei  , namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Tang uta ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
Ngi la shim ïa ka pisa kaba la nguh ha ka Templ badno im’ la aiti ha ki nongïatrei bad ki nongkhmih ba-halor .
translation.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers , and to the hand of the workmen .

Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hato une u dieng sohwaiñ un im bad san ? Hato u pukni uba nyngkong un ym rat ïa u na ki thied , phut noh ïa ki sohwaiñ , bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat bad shah ïa ki ban ïapstai ? Kam da shim shibun eh ka jingkhlaiñ lane ka hima bakhlaiñbor ban rat ïa ka .
Ibbah ibieit ki dei ban im ha ka bhah pahai , bad ki mraw kdor dei ban synshar halor ki briew badonburom .
translation.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool  ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
And again , whom should I serve ? should I not serve in the presence of his son ? as I have served in thy father s presence , so will I be in thy presence .
translation.kha: Nalor kata baroh , ïano pat ngan shakri , lada ym dei ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga ? Kumba nga la shakri ïa i pa jong phi , kumta mynta ngan shakri ïa phi .

translation.en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong u briew ki lah ban long ka umpohliew ka jingstad , kaba jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba sngur kum ki wahduid batuid .

Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongshong jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor Halor jongki nga , hynne , ka Pyrthei ka de ban tip) ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na —kata ka haka barli ba ar leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga . Ale , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka iaki .
translation.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .

translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ainong , To rai pangnud jong nga pynlang u Jonathan u Kynhun jong nga . La kdew ïa u Jonathan .
translation.en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .

translation.kha: Kainan ki shalyntem ki long Kumjuh koum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong per .
translation.en: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Haba to lap nongtong ïa ki Ishmael , ka lama kamra lap ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ri shyiap . Haba nga ïohi nyngkong ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka long kumba ïohthiah ïa u soh Dumbur Uba ih nyngkong ha ka aïom . Hynriew long ki la wan sha u lum Peor , ki la ïasdang ban mane ïa u Baal , bad tang katei katne por ki la kylla longsem kiba isaitmet kum kita ki blei ba ki ieit .
translation.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness  ; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time : but they went to Baal–peor , and separated themselves unto that shame  ; and their abominations were according as they loved .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , ‘ wahbah ki hynñiewphew snem jong ka Babilonia ki la khoit , ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga na ka bynta jongki phi bad bat ïa ka kylluid jongno nga ïa-ban wallam pat ïa phi sha ïohnong .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .

They say , If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man s , shall he return unto her again ? shall not that land be greatly polluted ? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers  ; yet return again to me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , bad ka iehnoh ïa u bad ka long noh ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , um dei ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane kan pyntngit lut ïa ka ri . Hynrei , ko Israel , pha la lah don shibun ki nongleh-ieit , bad mynta pha kwah ban wan phai sha nga !
