U Jisu u la ong ïa kane katba u dang hikai ha ka synagog ha pawnam .
translation.en: These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .

And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive , and brought them unto the top of the rock , and cast them down from the top of the rock , that they all were broken in pieces .
translation.kha: bad ki la ïohkem sa shiphew hajar ngut . Ki la ïalam ïa ki koidi sha ka kliar uwei u mawsiang ha ka nongbah Sela bad ki bret ïa ki , ba kumta la pynïap ïa ki ha ki mawsiang kiba don sha trai .

ki ïa-pihuin , ïabuaid , ki don jingkhawai jingdih kyiad , bad leh ïa kiwei kiei kiei kiba kum kine . Nga maham ïa phi mynta kumba nga la maham mawshun ; ba Kita kiba ïai leh ïa kine kiwei kiei kan ym ïohkynti ïa ka shem U Blei .
translation.en: Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past , that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .
I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingjynjar kaba mynta , nga pyrkhat ba ka kham bha ïa u briew ban sah kumba u long .
U Abraham u la ainong , ‘ Ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki don u Moses dara ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ; ki hynmen ki la shynraiñ jyllang me ki dem don shahshkor ïa kaei naba ki ong .’
translation.en: Abraham saith unto him , They have Moses and the prophets  ; let them hear them .

translation.kha: To ai ha ki ïa kine ki jinghikai , khnang ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .
translation.en: And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingsarong , katba ba-beit ki kren-ïa shaba palat ; ki ktien jong bakha stad ki ïadon ïa ki .
translation.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .

translation.kha: Mynta nga la ai ba phin jied nongpang ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim . iada Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la wan jia ha phi , bad phi shong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew sha uba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynsakma ïa phi , phin sa kynthup ïa ka jingwad ba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when all these things are come upon thee , the blessing and the curse , which I have set before thee , and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath driven thee ,
And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand  ; and they came unto Balaam , and spake unto him the words of Balak .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïalam jong ki Moab bad ki Midian ki rah bad ki ïa ka jingsiew na ka bynta ka jingtim , ki la leit sha u Balaam bad ki ai ha u ïa ka khubor na u Balak .

translation.en: The nakedness of thy son s daughter , or of thy daughter s daughter , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover : for theirs is thine own nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ksiew ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa me .

translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .
translation.kha: Hangta halor u Lum Sinai ha ka ri shyiap , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh jong ki .

Ka pukri ha kiba u Ishmael u la brup ïa ki batip jrong kita ki rangïapom kiba u la pynpoh ka long kaba heh bha Kaba u syiem Asa u la tih mynba u la shah tur ïaleh ha u Baasha , u syier ka Ishmael . U Ishmael u la pyndap ïa tala ka pukri da ki metïap .
translation.en: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men , whom he had slain because of Gedaliah , was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain .
And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el , that went not out after Israel : and they left the city open , and pursued after Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha Ai u la leit beh ïa ki Israel , bad ki la iehnoh rynghang ïa ka nongbah , khlem don mano mano ban ïada ïa ka .
Haseroth phim tip ba ka met jong phira ka long ka jaka shong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba shong hapoh jyllang phi bad ïa uba la ai ha phi da U Blei ?
translation.en: What ? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you , which ye have of God , and ye are not your own ?

translation.kha: Bad ngi la kyrdem ba un dei ma u uta u ban sa wanrah ban pyllaitluid ïa ki Israel ! Nalor kata baroh , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba ka la jia .
translation.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .
Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven , that one of these little ones should perish .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng um kwah ba iwei ruh na kine kiba rit in jah noh .

Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak pynlang wad ïa ka Jerusalem . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew naba sngewhun ha biar bad kiba sngewskhem , kiba nong ha lade , ‘ U Trei um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane kawei .’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .
And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shaniah ha U  Trai  ; bad namar kane , U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa u bad u la pdiang ïa u .
Nga la leh pop da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew uba lui lui ban ïap ! u la ainong . Ko ïadei aïu sakma bad ngi ? ki la jubab . Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !
translation.en: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .

translation.kha: Ha Kawei nga ong ( ma nga da lap hi , ym dei U Trai ) : Lada u parabangeit u don ka tnga ka bymngeit bad ka mynjur ban ïashongduh bad u , um daym baneh pyllait noh ïa ka .
translation.en: But to the rest speak I , not the Lord : If any brother hath a wife that believeth not , and she be pleased to dwell with him , let him not put her away .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban thied ne die khlem don kane ka shab , kaba long , ka kyrteng jong u khrawbor lane u dat jingkheiñ uba ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jongngi u .
translation.en: And that no man might buy or sell , save he that had the mark , or the name of the beast , or the number of his name .
The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ka waitlam kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khnam ne waitsum kaba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .
Ki pynlwet ïa ki briew jong me , A Trai ; ki baneh ïa kito kiba long ki jong me .
translation.en: They break in pieces thy people , O  Lord  , and afflict thine heritage .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bim , U Josis u la nong ïa u Simon Petros , Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me khampoh ieit ma me ïa nga ban ïa kaba kine kiwei ki ieit ? Ho-oid , ko Trai , u la jop , me tip ba nga ieit ïa me . U ijuh u la ong ha u , To satar ïa ki khunlangbrot jong nga .
translation.en: So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my lambs .

translation.kha: U Trai u tip lada phi un-long uba ïakheiñ . Bad um sngewngiah ïa kata ; bad nangta u lah ban ym pynsamthiah ïa u .
translation.en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .

translation.kha: Nob katba nga dang don bad Phi , to la kut jingmut ba-bang klet ïa kiei kiei baroh lait tang ïa U Jisu Khrist bad khampoh ïa ka jingïap jong u hiar ka diengphna .
translation.en: For I determined not to know any thing among you , save Jesus Christ , and him crucified .
For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .
translation.kha: Naba ngim ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei pyrshah ïa ki bor bymman ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng , ki nongsynshar , ki bor synshar , bad ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka juk ba-dum .
Wat sheptieng , u Elisha u jubab . Ngi don hasem bun ha ka liang jyllang ngi don ïa kaba ki don ma ki .
translation.en: And he answered , Fear not : for they that be with us are more than they that be with them .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ki nguh ba ngin leit sha ki , te ngin leit , namar Katai kan long ka dak ba U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor Jong ki .
translation.en: But if they say thus , Come up unto us  ; then we will go up : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into our hand : and this shall be a sign unto us .

translation.kha: Ang la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar barben kaba sniew ba la leh da ki paid ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki syiem malu ki jingïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nonghiarthma jong ki .
translation.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Shilhim Dabid u lumlang ïa ki Nongïalam baroh lad ki Jeraïah , bad ïa barben ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translation.en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .

translation.kha: Mynshuwa sa la don lem bad ki , at la ri khyrdong ïa ki da ka bol ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrtong kabu me la ai ha nga . (Nga la ïada ïa ki , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki ibha la jah noh , lait tyngkan u briew uba la dei ban jah — khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .
translation.en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u ong , U Trai u tip ba ma nga bad ki kynhun ki khashor jngai nga ngim don jingrem ha ka jingpynpoi ïa u Abner .
translation.en: And afterward when David heard it , he said , I and my kingdom are guiltless before the  Lord  for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner :

translation.kha: kumta ka mareh stet shiah u , bad ka ong , Ha kham ! U brup uba la wan sha nga ha kato ka sngi u wanpaw biang ha nga .
translation.en: And the woman made haste , and ran , and shewed her husband , and said unto him , Behold , the man hath appeared unto me , that came unto me the other day .

translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don hangno mynta ka sngi uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong kano ka jutang , pynban uba pynngeit ïa lade ba kaei kaei kan ym jia ïa u wat la u ïaid mon da ka dohnud kaba mutlop . Ka jingmih na kata kan long ba phi baroh phin jat taïew , kiba bha’ bad ibha sniew Khmut .
translation.en: And it come to pass , when he heareth the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , I shall have peace , though I walk in the imagination of mine heart , to add drunkenness to thirst :
And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Phin ïohi ïa nga ba nga siew kylliang ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka na ka bynta ka jingsniew baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan phai sha nga bad ngan wan phai sha phi .

translation.en: And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat ksiar na ka khlieh u blei Molekh , u bleithaw ki Ammon kaba khia kumba laiphew san kilo bad kaba don u mawkordor ha ka . U Dabid u la shim ïa u mawkordor bad u buh ïa u ha la ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ki mar lute na ka nongbah
U Abraham u la kynriah nala na Mamre sha ki bynta bashathie jong ka Kanaan bad u la shongsah la law hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka shuh .
translation.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .

translation.kha: U syiad Solomon Bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalumlang ha khmat ka Synduk ka jinghun bad ki kynha ainguh da bun bah ki langbrot malade ki masi — bun katta Iso bym lah ñiew shuh .
translation.en: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .

translation.kha: La beh noh! ïa u na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , bad ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ka la long kumto u parad . U la shong la sah Bad ki kada khlaw , u la bam phlang kum u masi dab pynlang u la thiah ha ka kajuh bym don jingkah khulom kano kano ka ba-bang ïadih ïa u na ka umjer . Ha kaba khatduh u la pdiang ba U Blei hakhlieh tad Eh u synlar ïa baroh ki hima ki bhabriew bad u lah shun ai ïa ki ha uno uno umbiah u ïaid .
translation.en: And he was driven from the sons of men  ; and his heart was made like the beasts , and his dwelling was with the wild asses : they fed him with grass like oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven  ; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men , and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will .

translation.kha: Balei u daym ban ïap ? u Jonah u jubab . U la leh aïu eh ?
translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father , and said unto him , Wherefore shall he be slain ? what hath he done ?
But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,
translation.kha: U Johanan bad baroh ki nongïalam ka kynhun shipai kiba don bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa ka kam runar kaba u Ishmael u la leh .
U la pynkylla ïa ki wah jong ki sha ka snam bad pynïap ïa baroh ki dohkha jong ki .
translation.en: He turned their waters into blood , and slew their fish .

translation.kha: Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki rangbah kiba la bam-im ka la long san hiar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthah bad ki khynnah .
translation.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men , beside women and children .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym ieit , um ithuh ïa U Blei , naba U Blei u long ka jingieit .
translation.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God  ; for God is love .

translation.kha: To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba nga ino , namar U Trai un pynlah ïa me pun shemphang ïa ka baroh .
translation.en: Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .

translation.kha: Ki lynti bah ki long kiba ma shibun ba ym don uba ïaid ba ïeng ha ki . Ïa ki jingteh kular la pynkheiñ malade ïa ki jingïakut ym shym burom . Ym kein shuh ka jingïaburom ïaineh ïano ruh .
translation.en: The highways lie waste , the wayfaring man ceaseth : he hath broken the covenant , he hath despised the cities , he regardeth no man .

translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jongu ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka thnum jong ka khylliap ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh marwei .
translation.en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi to na ki Saddusi ki la wan shiah U Jiw bad ki la kam ba ki brisoh kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection , and asked him ,

translation.kha: U Hotham u to jong u , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Sophah , u Imna , u Shelesh , bad u Amal .
translation.en: And the sons of his brother Helem  ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la nguh ha nga ba wat la ka Israel ka la phai noh na u , ka la lah pynsah ba ka long Kaba khim bha ban ïa ka Joïada ka bymïaineh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka nongbah , ki ïathied sha ka Tabeel , shrong pynlang ki jingtem jingput ki thawdur bun ki turoi .
translation.en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the  Lord .
And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki Jiw u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

Bun ba-eh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu! u la khong ha Bethania , kumta ki la leit shatai , ym Teng namar jong U Jisu hynrei ban ïohi ruh ïa u Lasaros , ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpatlada na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus  sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh u la paw ruh ha nga — wat la nga long kum uta uba la kha khlem biang por .

translation.en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la dih khyndiat ka waiñ , u la buaid , u law ïa la ki jaiñ bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh la ka ïingjaiñ .

Ngi la ai ha phi ïa ki hukum bapyrkhing ngab ym hikai ha ka Kyrteng jong ine u briew , u la nguh ; hyndai peit kaei kabu phi la leh ! Phi la pynphriang ïa ka jinghikai jngai phi kadlieng ka Jerusalem , bad phoi kwah ban pynlong ïa ngi kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingtep jong u !
translation.en: Saying , Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name ? and , behold , ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine , and intend to bring this man s blood upon us .
And now I have sent a cunning man , endued with understanding , of Huram my father s ,
translation.kha: Nga phah sha phi u nongshna jingshna uba stad bad uba tbit bha , uba kyrteng u Huram .

Khynñiuh u briew wahbah shaniah ha ka jingngeit jong u , ym ha ki kam jong u , badno uba ngeit ha U Blei uba pynbna ïa kiba la rem , ban long uba lui ih , ka long ka jingngeit jong u ba U blem u pdiang khnang pun pynlong hok ïa uta u briew bad u hi .
translation.en: But to him that worketh not , but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly , his faith is counted for righteousness .

translation.kha: Bad phi hima phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban leh .
translation.en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
And they were filled with madness  ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla bad ki la sdang ban ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki ïa kaei ba ki lah ban leh ïa U Jisu .
Pha la dei baneh ym ïeng ha ka jakarieh ba ïasam ki lad ban kem ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynjia jyllang ki .
translation.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .

If I have found favour in the sight of the king , and if it please the king to grant my petition , and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them , and I will do to morrow as the king hath said .
translation.kha: Lada ma phi ko syiem phi lehsbun ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha kawei pat ka jingkhawai la shai ka sngi ba ngan pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi . Ha kata ka por ngan sa ong ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga kwah .

translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the  Lord  led me to the house of my master s brethren .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la batskhem ïa la ka kular ha u kynrad jong nga . U  Trai  hi u la ïalam beit ïa nga sha ki kur ki jait u kynrad jong nga .
Ïa ka ïing jong u yn thup ha Israel kum ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah lalot juti .’
translation.en: And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .
And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .
Mynmiet ki thiah khulom Don ei ei ban Tap nalor jyllang ki , kim don ei ei ban ïada na ka jingkhriat .
translation.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , namar ba u la ïap , ka bapop kan ym donakor shuh halor jong u ; bad mynta u im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei .
translation.en: For in that he died , he died unto sin once : but in that he liveth , he liveth unto God .

translation.kha: Pyndait ha ka , met kyrdon ki mawkordor , u Rubi , u Tahpenes , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrduh kaban nyngkong ;
translation.en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .
And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
translation.kha: Ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh , ka khyndew ka pynmih shikatdei eh ki jingthung , ïa kiba u Joseph u lum bad kynshew ha ki nongbah .

Nangta men wait ktieh sha u Lum jyllang U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba ne ka khang sher dara jong ki Phrygia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh Shong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba dang waiñ hiar na ka iba kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da put ïa ki thawdur , ki ksiang , ki shathie , bad ki kanjari . Kynton sa ïashoh bad ïarisa .
translation.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :

And he said , Well  ; I will make a league with thee : but one thing I require of thee , that is , Thou shalt not see my face , except thou first bring Michal Saul s daughter , when thou comest to see my face .
translation.kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan ïateh kular bad phi tang ha kawei ka kyndon : phi dei ban wallam ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u Saul sha nga haba phi wan ïakynduh ïa nga .
Nimrah U Blei u la ong , ‘ To burom ïa la u kop bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ pynlang ‘ Uno uno uba tei ïa la u khop lin ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .’
translation.en: For God commanded , saying , Honour thy father and mother : and , He that curseth father or mother , let him die the death .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Ïohi ïa la ka kmie bad ïa u Simran ïa uba u ieit ba ki ïa-ïeng hangtei ; te u la ong ha la ka kmienah , Une u long u khun jong phi .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother ,  Woman , behold thy son !

And David and his men went up , and invaded the Geshurites , and the Gezrites , and the Amalekites : for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land , as thou goest to Shur , even unto the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki ju leit hiarthma ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur , ki Girsi , bad ki Amalek , kiba la ju shong ha kata ka thain naduh mynhyndai . U ju leit lute ïa ka ri jong ki haduh Shur , baroh shi lynter lynti haduh ka ri Ijipt ,

translation.en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .
translation.kha: Naba don shibun ki daw baïapher balei ba ki briew kim lah ban shongkurim : katto katne , namar ba la kha ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki briew ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; bad kiwei pat kim shongkurim na ka bynta ka Hima ki bneng . Ai ba uta uba lah ban pdiang ïa kane ka jinghikai un leh kumta .
Nga la kylli ïa ki : Kine ki jaka bajrong sha kiba phi ithuh ki dien kiei ? Kumta la khor ïa kine ‘ Ki Jaka bajrong’ naduh kata ka por .
translation.en: Then I said unto them , What is the high place whereunto ye go ? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day .
And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba ngi ong ïa phi .

U Trai barabor Baroh u jong ha nga , Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynkhlad kum ka briew’ shongsaiñ na katba la khiat ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïaineh ïano kato pha lah katba dang to ka por .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .

Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;
translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang u syiem uba synshar ïa ka hima kaba u Dabid u la synshar bad shaphang ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , kata , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lem bad phi .
Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha kawei na ki templ jong ki bad wahbah ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka templ jong u Dagon u beit jongngi ki .
translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
And Abraham said of Sarah his wife , She is my sister : and Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .
translation.kha: Hadien , katba u dang shong ha Gerar , u la ong ba ka tnga jong u , ka Sarah ka dei ka para jong u . Te u Abimelekh jong ka Gerar u la phah ban wallam ïalam ïa ka Sarah sha u .

U Tabeel , u Oholah , bad kiwei pait ki nongtrei ïa kiba U Tlai u la ai ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang , kiba tip ban trei ïa ka kam baroh kaba ïadei bad ka jingtrei ïa ka Ïingjaiñ katba kyntang , ki dei ban shna ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the  Lord  put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the  Lord  had commanded .
Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .
translation.kha: Haba u rangbah shipai bad ki shipai kiba bad u , kiba la ïa-ap ïa U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa u jumai bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ong ,  Da shisha u la long U Khun U Blei !
Ko khun u brup , u la ong , khmih shaneng shathie . To kren pyrshah ïa kaba shathie bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka khlaw Jong kaba shathie .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the south , and drop thy word toward the south , and prophesy against the forest of the south field  ;

For in very deed , as the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , which hath kept me back from hurting thee , except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me , surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa phi . Hynrei nga smai da U Blei uba im jong ki Israel ba lymda phi la pynkloi ban ïashem bad nga , baroh ki briew jong u Nabal kin jin da la ïap lut kat ban da mih ka step !

translation.en: While on earth , Jesus fed the hungry , healed the sick , and restored life to the dead !
translation.kha: Mynba u don ha ka pyrthei , u Jisu u la pynkdang ïa kiba thngan , pynkhiah ïa kiba pang bad pynmihpat ïa kiba la ïap !

translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kwah ban kem ïa u ; kumta to wan sha ka ri jong ngi , bad ngin pynthikna ba phi ïohkem ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïaid na khmat jong u , bad u pynbna ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei uba dap da ka jinglehsbun bad jinglehisynei , uba suki ban bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .

translation.en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .
translation.kha: Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ha kawei ka shnong , to phet sha kawei pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba phin ym pat lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam jong phi ha baroh ki shnong jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Khun U Briew un wan .

U jin uba khup ki jaiñ linen u la ong , Ha kata ka per , u Mikhael , u angel umbah khraw , uba ïada ïa ki briew’ jong me , un mihpaw . Nangta kan anna ka por ki jingjynjar , kaba kham sniew tam naduh ba ki jaitbynriew ki mih . Hobab tala ka per ka wan , baroh ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong me kiba ïa ki kyrteng jongu ki la thoiñ ha ka kitab ka jongngi U Blang yn pynim .
translation.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up , the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people : and there shall be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time : and at that time thy people shall be delivered , every one that shall be found written in the book .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong pat ha ki , To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi . Kumba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga , kamut ruh por phah ïa pa’ .
translation.en: Then said Jesus to them again ,  Peace be unto you : as my Father hath sent me , even so send I you .

translation.kha: Ki sing , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh badno ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;
translation.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u , Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u Wan , un sa iathuh ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka prum katba byrsaw-lieh ka mihngi ha ka khak hap shñiuh , ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore  ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .
And he said ,  Lord  God of Israel , there is no God like thee , in heaven above , or on earth beneath , who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :
translation.kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , ym don U Blei uba kum ma me ha bneng shajrong ne ha khyndew shapoh ! Me bat ïa ka jutang bad me pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha la ki jong ki briew kiba kohnguh ïa me naduh ka mynsiem .
Hangta ki la tynjuh bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , ong U Bel , wat la ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ha ki sawphew snem .
translation.en: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .

translation.kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar sangeh kita ki jingker , u kot naduh kaei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .
So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynsah uwei ruh , bad nangta ki kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
lada nga la phai noh! na ka lynti kaba daym lane shah ban pynthame ïa lade da kaba sniew , lada ki kti jong nga ki bit da ka pop ,
translation.en: If my step hath turned out of the way , and mine heart walked after mine eyes , and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands  ;
For thou writest bitter things against me , and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .
translation.kha: Me wanrah ïa ki jingujor bakthang pyrshah ïa nga , wat ïa kaba nga la leh mynba nga dang khynnah .
U ijuh u la kyiuh shai u lum dara hangthie u la shong bad la ki synran .
translation.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .
And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Siph ki wan sha u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u dang rieh ha u Lum Hakhilah ha tduh jong ka ri khlaw Judia .
kumno ki iitkhmat jongki ki shah kylliang ? Maki pajut kim sngewkynduh jingktah .
translation.en: How did their glasses get swapped ? Even they themselves didn't understand it !

translation.kha: Kaba , lada um tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka met jong U Trai hajan u bam ïa u kpu Bad dih na ka khrai , u khulom ïa ka jingbishar ha lade hi katba u dang bam bad tiduh .
translation.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .

translation.kha: ha ka jinglong riewblei pynlang ïa ka jingïadei parabangeit ; bad ha ka jingïadei parabangeit pynlang ïa ka jingieit .
translation.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness  ; and to brotherly kindness charity .
Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .
translation.kha: Nangta u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok u ong ha u Joab ,  Shah ngan leit sha u syiem bad ka khubor babha ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u na ki nongshun jong u .
Nangta u leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ïathuh : Ki shakri jong phi ki la shim ïa ka pud kob don ha ka Templ , bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki ngab kiba dei kham ïa ki jingshna pynbha .
translation.en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said , Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house , and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord .
And it shall come to pass , that the man s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you .
translation.kha: Te u diengduh jong uta u briew ïa uba nga la jied un khie lung . Da kumta ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingïaikren khñium jong kine ki Israel pyrshah ïa me .
bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jrong ki Jiw bun ha ki hukum briew ibha wan na ki bhabriew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingsuki .
translation.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynta ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jiw ?

U Jisu u la ïohi katno u la long uba stad ha ka jingjubab jong u , bad kumta U la ong ïa u , Mem long jngai na ka Hima U Blei . Hadien kane , ym don shuh mano mano ba nud ban kylli kitab kitab ki jingkylli ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly , he said unto him ,  Thou art not far from the kingdom of God .  And no man after that durst ask him any question .
Because thou hast made the  Lord  , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation  ;
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa U  Trai  u nongkyrshan jong me , ïa U Bahakhlieh Tam u nongïada jong me ,

Khmih sha nga ! ka pyrthuh sha ti pa uwei uba ïaid lynñiar isih . Ym don myn mano ba don ka jingtap kum ka jong nga , ka Jingpang kaba U Trai u la wallam halor jong nga ha ka por ka jingbitar jong u .
translation.en: They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers  bosom .

translation.kha: Ki don khyndaiphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Syria . U Jehu u thoh ka shithi nabar u la phah ïa ki kopi jong ka sha ki nongsynshar jongki ka nongbah , shaw ki riewpawkhmat , bad shwa ki nongrim ïa ki khun ki ktieh jong u Ahab .
translation.en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria . And Jehu wrote letters , and sent to Samaria , unto the rulers of Jezreel , to the elders , and to them that brought up Ahab s children , saying ,
Millions of families earth wide have found the guidance provided in the book The Secret of Family Happiness to be a real benefit .
translation.kha: Ha satlak ka pyrthei da ki million , ki briew ki la shem da shisha ka jinghun na ka kot kaba ha ka ktien Phareng ka ba kyrteng u shabi jong ka longïng longsem ka ba kmen .
Ka sur ka la krong biang na bneng , ‘ Wat ñiar bymkhuid ïa Kane kano Kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .’
translation.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .

translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u la pat bad u la slap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lyoh , Une u erlangthari U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself  ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew hi ka pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san bad ban seisoh ; nyngkong u speh balung u mih , hadien ka kop , bad khatduh ka kop ba-dap da u symboh kew .

translation.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate , and thy neck is an iron sinew , and thy brow brass  ;
translation.kha: Nga la tip ba phin pynshisha ba phi long kiba mutlop , kiba pyneh kum ka nar bad ka rnong bym lah ban pynkdor .

Ka la long la kham janmiet jongnga ka Sngi U Trai , bad ki synrap ki la ïalumlang hapoh ka kamra kaba la khang skhem , namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Nangta U ju u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki . To ka jingsah kan erlangthari lem bad phi , u la ong .
translation.en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .

translation.kha: Wat tat ïaleh pynshah ïa ki hynmen ki par jong Phin hi , ki paid Israel . Khie ïaleit noh shaei iing phi baroh . Kaei kaba Jia ka long kaba sa mon . Baroh ki la nongshong ïa ka hukum U Trai bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .
Not as Cain , who was of that wicked one , and slew his brother . And wherefore slew he him ? Because his own works were evil , and his brother s righteous .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kum u Kain ; u la long jong u Basniew bad u la pynïap ïa u Abel , u para jong u . Balei u Kain u la pynïap ïa u ? Namar kiei kiei kiba u la leh da lade hi ki la long ki bym dei , hynrei kiei kiei kiba u para jong u , u la leh ki la long kiba dei .

Pynban , lada ki briew na Makedonia kin wan bad nga bad kin shem ba phim pat long kiba la kulai , katno kan long ka jingpynlehrain ïa ngi — khlieh da kren ïa ka jinglehkmen ïa phi — naba ngi la shongkhia katta ïa phi!
translation.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki bteng la ka jingïaid lyndang . U Shimei u bud ïa ki , u da ïaid na ka sharing lum ; u da tim bad kawang maw bad khyndew ha ki katba u tang ïaid .
translation.en: And as David and his men went by the way , Shimei went along on the hill s side over against him , and cursed as he went , and threw stones at him , and cast dust .

translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la ïaid lyngba khie ka ïingjaiñ bad ring Teng shisien shapoh ka Jaka Bigthana Tam , um shem la skhem ïa ka snam ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jong ka snam , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta lad i .
translation.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew umbiah ïathiah shongkha bad ka parad .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast . And all the people shall say , Amen .

And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , la wan poi u nongwankai ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uta u riewspah um kwah ban pynïap ïa uwei na ki jingri jong u ban khreh bam ïa uta u nongwan ; pynban , u la shim ïa i khunlangbrot jong uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongwankai .
Me la shah ïa ka lyer ban beh noh ïa at ; me la kynting ïa nga ha ka erïong suit .
translation.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith : as it is written , The just shall live by faith .
translation.kha: Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : Ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U briew uba beit bad U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .

translation.en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?
translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ai ïa U  Trai namar ka jinglehbha jong u baroh ïa nga ?
bad u la kyrpad rit ïa u , Ka khun rit jong nga ka pang jubor . To sngewbha ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ka , khnang ba kan khia pynlang ïoh im .
translation.en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .

translation.kha: U Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , ki peit sah ïa ka shyllangmat jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad ma mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar ba-bang mihnoh na ka Thymmai . U pynkloi ban mih shabar , namar U Trai u la pynïapmat ïa u .
translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .

translation.kha: U nongpop u ia ïa-ban leh shispah tukri ki kam shyntur bad u dang im . O ! ho-oid , nga tip ïa kaei ba ki ong : Lada phi kohnguh ïa U Blei , kiei kiei baroh kin bit ken biang ,
translation.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him :

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki ijuh ki la ïakren para ma ki , Shano ba un sa loit ba ngi ïeng ym shem ïa u ? Hammoth un leit shaei ki shnong jong ki Grik ha kaba ki briew jongngi ngi ki sah , bad ban khwai ïa ki Grik ?
translation.en: Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?

translation.kha: A Trai Nongsynshar , to peit ainguh borabor sha ki briew jong me ki Israel bad u syiem jong ki , dara to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki ha man ba ki ïakyrpad jingïarap na me .
translation.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant , and unto the supplication of thy people Israel , to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee .
Let your will take place , as in heaven , also on earth .”
translation.kha: Long ka mon jong me ha ka khyndew kumba ha bneng .”

U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ammon bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u bun u jop ïa ki . Nangta u pynbor ïa ki Ammon ban siew ïa u ka khajna man ka snem haduh ut snem kumne : lai hajar sawspah kyllum ka rupa , shihajar ton u kew , bad shisien ton u batylli .
translation.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .

And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la tlot na ka jingthngan ha kata ka sngi , namar u Saul , da ka jingsmai kyntang , u la ai hukum :  Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam kano kano ka jingbam mynta ka sngi ha shuwa ba ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga .  Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .
Nga long u nongwei uba im khappud jong phi ; die ïa nga khyndiat ka jaka ba ngan ïoh ban thep ïa la ka tnga .
translation.en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you : give me a possession of a buryingplace with you , that I may bury my dead out of my sight .
To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :
translation.kha: Bad ynda u la kut jingmut ban pynpaw ïa la U Khun ha nga , khnang ba nga lah ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha shaphang jong u ha ki Jentil , ngam shym la leit wad buit nano nano ,
U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner : Balei u Abner u dei ban ïap khem u bieit ?
translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do ? he will come and destroy the husbandmen , and will give the vineyard unto others .
translation.kha: Kaei te , kaba uta u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ?  la kylli U Jisu .  Un sa wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki briew bad ai noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .
Baroh ki riewngeit ha lumrit badno Ikoniom ki ïakren baheh shngain u Titos .
translation.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh u la ong ha ki , Nga dei Ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei ha kiwei pat ki shnong ruh , namar kata ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la phah ïa ang ban leh .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also : for therefore am I sent .
Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .
translation.kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh ! To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor . Ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .
Ki jingpynkheiñ : pa haka ban bat kaweh ha la ka kti , hynrei phi lah ruh Ban shem ïa ki ha ki ïingsyiem .
translation.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings  palaces .

Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah , and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .
translation.kha: Hynrei khyndiat na phi phin lait na ka jingïap bad leit phai na Ijipt sha Judah . Nangta kiba lait im kin tip ki ktien jongno ki la wan jia shisha , ki jong nga ne ki jong ki .
Ki la tyngkhuh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang ban ïakren shaïong kane , Aïu kane ‘ ka mihpaw na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?
translation.en: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .

translation.kha: Khnang ban pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew babun ba nga long uba khuid , ngan salm pat ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri baroh kiba ki shong ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: When I have brought them again from the people , and gathered them out of their enemies  lands , and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations  ;
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , and the love of God , and the communion of the Holy Ghost , be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ka jingieit jong U Blei bad ka jingïasyllok jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kin long lem bad phi baroh .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynïap briew ; ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn wallam sha ka jingbishar .’
Ha ka snem kaba lai jongu ka jingshna kerkut , ka Samaria ka kyllon ; kane ka dem ka snoh kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Hakhlieh , bad ka snem kambah khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .
translation.en: And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .

translation.kha: Haba u Mesha u la sngewkyiuh ïa kano , u la sngewhun .
translation.en: And when Moses heard that , he was content .

translation.kha: Da sumar ban ym shah ïa ki jingbamsap ban shukor ïa phi , lane ka shad ban ïalam kata ïa phi .
translation.en: Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka mon jong U Tiras ba u shakri jong u un san kum u jingthung uba ksai ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyndong . Um don main ne jingitynnat ban pynlong ïa ngi ïa-ban dabor ïa u . Ym don kano kano kob ngin ibha ïa u , ym to kano Kane ka ban khring ïa ngi sha u .
translation.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la skhem ïa ki shyieng jongki u Shaul bad u Jonathan , bad u la lumlang ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki khyndew jngut ki rangbah kiba la shah phasi .
translation.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son  ; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged .

translation.kha: Te yn map ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki , namar iwei pa iwei ki la don bynta ha ka jingbakla .
translation.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel , and the stranger that sojourneth among them  ; seeing all the people were in ignorance .

But as for thee , stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it .
translation.kha: Hynrei me pat , Moses , men sah hangne bad nga , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Hikai ïa ki ha u paidbah ba kin sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki .’
Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jongno nga da ka jingpang , wat ha khnai hi ka meeting Ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :

translation.kha: U patsha u kylli , Kaei kaba me kwah ?
translation.en: Then the king said unto me , For what dost thou make request ? So I prayed to the God of heaven .

translation.kha: Lada isangsot uno u kylli ïa Phi balei ba phi lyoh ïa u , ong ha u ba u kynrad u donkam ïa u .
translation.en: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat ha ka jingbun briew , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
Thaw ar tylliat ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpra ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da uba yn bah ïa ka .
translation.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ïa ki balang !

translation.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and burn them upon the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , weng noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki snier , ïa u dohnud , bad ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi . Hato ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyllait ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?
Mynmiet nga thrang ïa me da ka angnud jong de baroh ; haba me bishar ïa ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka , baroh kin tip kaei ka long ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night  ; yea , with my spirit within me will I seek thee early : for when thy judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness .

translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna , katba nga dang thoin ïa kane , ba men leh ïa kaei katba por kyrpad — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat khnam palat ïa kane .
translation.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .

translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong ki yn lute bad ïa ki ïing jong ki yn pynjot . Keiñ ym shong ha ki ïeng babha ki tei lane dih ïa ka ïew na ki bri sohwaiñ naba ki thung .
translation.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty , and their houses a desolation : they shall also build houses , but not inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , but not drink the wine thereof .

translation.kha: Nangta ki pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Israel , da kaba buh ïa ki ha ka khim khait . kat katne na ki Israel ki rieh ha ki krem pynlang ha ki thliew , lane hapdeng ki mawsiang lane ha ki Thliew bad ki pukri um ;
translation.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , ) then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .

translation.kha: Wat ïa-wohnia para ma phi , ko parabangeit jong nga . Uno uno uba wohnia ïa u parabangeit ne bashabar ïa u , u wohnia ïa ka Politics bad u bishar ïa ka . Lada phi bishar ïa ka Hukum , te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , Hynrei uwei uba bishar ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .

translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong ryngkat hapdeng jong ki , uba kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang lane ïa kano kano ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U Trai hangno hangno lait tang ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , yn ym ñiew thuh ïa u kum uwei na ki Briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: Ki jingbabe ka Judah ki jubab , Ngi leh ïa kata namar ba u skhem u un-long uwei na ngi . Balei kane kan pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka bynta ka bam jong ngi dawai um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .
translation.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?

translation.kha: Me ioh ban peit iaka .
translation.en: Did you get a good look at her ?

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la ïeng kyrpang la ka jong hi malu u la ïarwai , ‘ Ngi ainguh ïa me , a Blei , ba ngam long uba nalor , u bymhok , lane uba klim , kum uno uno uwei pat . Nga ainguh ba ngam long kum Ittai u nonglum khajna hangtai .
translation.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself , God , I thank thee , that I am not as other men are , extortioners , unjust , adulterers , or even as this publican .

Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?
translation.kha: Ka khubor jong nga ka long kum ka ding , bad kum u tyrnem uba pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki mawsiang .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ïa ka Sabbaton la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha u briew ; ïa u briew ym shym la thaw na ka bynta ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong me kan ym long shuh u Abram , hynrei u Abraham , naba nga pynlong ïa me u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .

Namar ba ken ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno tam lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrismas ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymtip u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U blang . Ka snam jongngi u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban sharati ïa U Blei uba im .
translation.en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
At the same time , saith the  Lord  , will I be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan wan haba ngan long U Blei jong ki jait Israel baroh , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .
Nga ju ai ïa u ki jaiñkup ba la thynrang da u saiwul uba la Ïohi na ka kynhun langbrot jong nga hi . Nangta te u ïaroh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud jong u baroh .
translation.en: If his loins have not blessed me , and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep  ;

translation.kha: Ainong ïa u ngab meng ha nga katba ka shongdor haba phi daiñ ïada ryngkat , ba ngan ïohkynti ïa ka kumno ka khak tep .
translation.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .

translation.kha: Men shi peit bad men ioh kamon ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .
translation.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .

translation.kha: U Gideon u jubab , Lada me sngewbha ïa nga , ai ha nga kato katai ka jingpynshisha ba me dei da shisha U Trai .
translation.en: And he said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me .

translation.kha: U syier Saul , ki hynmen jong phi , malu baroh kiwei ki Israel ki don ha ka Ia Elah , ki dang ïaleh thma ïa ki Philistia .
translation.en: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel , were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .

translation.kha: U Jehoram u la don phraphew ar snem ka ita mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem . Ym don mano mynshem ba sngewsih haba u ïarep . Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .
translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .
And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :
translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u kylla duk bad u die mraw noh ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .
kiba la pang ha ka burom ba kynja bneng bad ki la ïakren bun U Jisu shaphang ka rukom ha kaba shen un sa pyndep ïa ka jingmut jong U Blei da kaba ïaphah ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki ruh ki kuna kumin , bad u leit noh bad u la lap ïa kata ka metïap u nongïathuhlypa ha lynñiar bha , lem bad ka kada bad u rang kiba dang ngin hajan jngai ka . U sing um shym la bam ïa dat ka metïap lymne patar ïa ka kada .
translation.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way , and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase : the lion had not eaten the carcase , nor torn the ass .

translation.kha: Hynrei don ki bym smam shahshkor ïa u Moses , dara ki la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba bud kata kaba sahit ka la boi ksang bad ka sma iwjit , bad u Moses u la bitar ïa ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .
Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Samaria ki ïai bteng ban thaw ïa la ki bleithaw , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jaka mane kiba ki Israel ki la tei . Kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka la thaw ïa ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah ha kiba ki shong ki sah :

translation.en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,

UBA luin u thad ïa kaba la buhrieh , hynrei phi lah ban buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha uba lah Ban buhrieh .
translation.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .

translation.kha: Haba u Hosah , u paralok bajan jong u Dabid , u la ïakynduh ïa u Absalom , u la pyrta , To u syiem un im slem ! To u symboh un im slem !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hushai the Archite , David s friend , was come unto Absalom , that Hushai said unto Absalom , God save the king , God save the king .

Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark  ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki tymmen , ki samla shynrang , ki samla kynthei , ki longkmie bad ki khynnah rit . Hynrei wat ktah kti ïa uno uno uba don ka dak ha ka shyllangmat jong u . Sdang nangne na ka Templ jong nga .  Kumta ki la sdang na ki nongïalam kiba ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .
ki briew kiba sngewtynnad ha kaba leh kam sniew bad kba lehkmen ha ki kam bymman ki bym don jingot ,
translation.en: Who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the frowardness of the wicked  ;
But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
translation.kha: Ka jingwan U Khun U Briew kan long kum kaei kaba la jia ha ka por u Noah .

Ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la sngewlyngngoh ban ïoh kumno u Petros malu u Ïoannis ki la long kiba shlur bad ban tip ba ki long ki riewpaidbah ki bymnang bymstad . Ki la sngewthuh te ba ki la long ki nongsynran jong U Jisu .
translation.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled  ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .
And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong shuh shuh ,  Shah ngan pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un ai noh ha nga ïa ki sohshkor ba phi la shim .  ( Ki Midian kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )

Nangne u Jisu u la shngiam ïa ki syn tylli ki kper bad ar tukri ki dohkha , u la khmied shaei bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synran jong u baneh i ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .

translation.kha: U Trai u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la sa ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang pun pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?

translation.kha: Haduh mynnin u Balaam u la tip ba U TRAI’ u kwah ïa u ba un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel , kumta um shym leit wad shuh ïa ki tam ki shin kumba u la leh mynshuwa . U la phai la ki khmat shaphang ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Benjamin bad u Hasshub ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba longkmie ha khmat ki ïohnong jong ki . U Sakharaïah , u khum jong u Maaseïah Bad u ksiew jong u Benaïah , u thet ïa ka pyntwa kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house . After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house .

translation.kha: Ha dat ka sngi kaweh nyngkong , phin shim ïa ki soh naba kynsai , ïa ki tnat dieng thlia , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba ngon sla , bad sdang ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U Trai U Blei jongnga phi .
translation.en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .
Who are they among all the gods of these lands , that have delivered their land out of my hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ?
translation.kha: Mynno na ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri uba la ju pyllait ïa la ka ri na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerusalem ?

translation.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .
translation.kha: Bad ki la ong shibun kiwei pat ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa u .

translation.en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la ïeng bad u hangta , bad u la pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U  Trai .
Mynba U ijuh u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la wanlam sha u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synrum bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .
translation.en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .

translation.kha: La kem ïa u mala la ïalam ïa u sha u Joshua .
translation.en: And the king of Ai they took alive , and brought him to Joshua .

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , ko parabangeit , lada nga tang bthei ban ïarap ba ka jingotsher ka longïing kaba donkam , balei te ba nga dang shah pynshitom beiñ ? Lada kata ka la long kaba shisha , te ka jingïalap jong nga ïa ka diengphna U Khrist Kan ym long haka jingeh ei ei .
translation.en: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?
translation.kha: Phi don ki khmat — hato phim lah ban ïohi ? Phi don ki shkor — hato phim lah ban ïohsngew ?

Khynnah ban pyntreikam ïa ki aiñ ba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u ijakhlia u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la shem ha ka Templ , u syiem Josaïah u la weng nala na Jerusalem bad ki boitha ka Judah ïa baroh ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongbatai kupar , malade ïa barben ki phai ïing , ki Bealoth , bad ki tiar mane bieit thala .
translation.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits , and the wizards , and the images , and the idols , and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem , did Josiah put away , that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi lah ban kum jynrat katai katjuh u kew lem bad ki .
translation.en: But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .

translation.kha: U Saul u tat ka duwan ha U thri ; ka duwan kaba nynkong kaba u la tei .
translation.en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .
And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .
translation.kha: ka kharai kaba jylliew ha ka nongbah Akasia ; bad ngan pynshitom ïa phi baroh .

translation.en: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .
Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land , that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness .
translation.kha: Ha ka ri baroh kawei ngan pynsangeh ïa ka jingleh jakhlia , kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh ki kynthei ban ym leh awria kumba ki la leh .

translation.en: And David was afraid of God that day , saying , How shall I bring the ark of God home to me ?
translation.kha: Te u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U Blei bad u ong ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad nga mynta ?

Nga la jied ïa u bhabriew umbiah shong Basaw shaphang mihngi ; lang wallam ïa u shun tur ïajah na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh halor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka ktieh , kum u nongot khiew uba nguh ïa ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ki ïakynduh ha ri lum Ephraim . U syiem Abijah u kiew shad u lum Semaraim bad u pyrta sha u Jeroboam malu ki Israel : Shahshkor ïa de ! u ong .
translation.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which is in mount Ephraim , and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel  ;

translation.kha: kiba ong ïa ki ba ki den ban phai pat sha me . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa me na ka por shaw ka por , ba katkum me shad ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop bad syiar ïa ki . Ha ka jingeh jong ki , ki khot ïa me na ka bynta ka jingpynhiar , bad me jubab ïa ki na bneng . Ha ka jingisynei bakhraw me phad ki nongïalam ïa ki kiba pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .
Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :
translation.kha: Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong ka jingshah pynshitom bakhatduh namar ki pop jong ka .

translation.en: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul was come in very deed .
translation.kha: u phah ïa ki nongsyntiat , bad u shem ba u Saul u la wan shisha hangta .
kti katba mareh stet kim shym lah ban phet ; ki shipai kim shym lah ban mlien . Ha ka phangpdeng Bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis , ki jngut bad ki kyllon .
translation.en: Let not the swift flee away , nor the mighty man escape  ; they shall stumble , and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: Ïalang ban myn Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bniat uba hynñiew ; wat bah ei ei mala wat trei kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :
How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
translation.kha: Mynno kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien ba la otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .
U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phiah ïa ki shaei jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynim briew bad ki la lane duh ïa ka nongbah jongngi ki .
translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,
