U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad laiphew nud ki khun kynhied . U pynshongkurim ïa la ki khun kynther shabar na ka kur ka jait , malade u wanrah pah laiphew ngut ki samla kynthei nabar ka kur ka jait la jong ba kin shongkurim bad ki Kynhun shynrang jong u . U Ibsan u ïalam ïa ki Israel iehnoh snem ,
translation.en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .

translation.kha: wiat burom ïa ki rukom im jong ki briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Bela ba Phon ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Ang isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .
But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation  ;
translation.kha: Pynban , to long kiba khuid ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , kumba U Blei uba la khot ïa phi u long uba khuid .
U Trai u ong ; To khashor ïa nga , phi kaba kwah don ïoh jingim , phi kba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . patlun halor u mawsiang na umbiah phi la wan , ka par maw na kaba la tih ïa phi .
translation.en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .
For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed thee out of the house of servants  ; and I sent before thee Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ; nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ; nga la phah ïa u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Miriam ban ïalam ïa phi .
Na jingkyrpad ïa me ba trai pyllait ïa de na ka ktah u Ono u bymman jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ba-bang ïaleh bad pynïap luin ïa ngi baroh , wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh .
translation.en: Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .

So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .
translation.kha: Kumta u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynshong ïa u Solomon halor u khashor jong u Syiem Dabid bad ki la synran ïa u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon .

Nga thoh sha u thiat , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïadon lang . To U Blei uba long U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba un-long U Nongpynim jong ngi un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: To Titus , mine own son after the common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour .
Fear thou not  ; for I am with thee : be not dismayed  ; for I am thy God : I will strengthen thee  ; yea , I will help thee  ; yea , I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad me ! Nga long U Blei jong me — wat ai ba kano kano kan pynsheptieng ïa me ! Ngan pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ bad ngan ïarap ïa me ; ngan ïada ïa me bad ngan pynim ïa me .
Phim ïaryngkat bad wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba ri tam jong ki Assyria bad pynban ph khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi! ïa ki nang ïapom nabar ki ba-shiphew shong kulai .
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

translation.kha: Lydda phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei shiah phin ym ïoh jingshun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba phi kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wat lada phim ngeit ïa nga , phi la dei ban ngeit ïa ki kam jong nga , khnang ba phi lah ban tip shi syn tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U Kpa .

translation.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
translation.kha: Me pynlong ïa ki umpohliew ban tuid sha ki them , bad ïa ki wah ba kin tuid hapdeng ki lum .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of Shiloh unto us , that , when it cometh among us , it may save us out of the hand of our enemies .

Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , naduh kaba nyngkong eh me long U Blei . Me long U Blei jong nga , uba khuid bad uba bymjukut . A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga bad u nongïada , me la jied ïa ki nong Babilonia bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba khlaiñ khnang ba kin lah ban pynshitom ïa ngi .
Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u pyrthuh lem bad u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u purew lak Bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,

translation.kha: U Trai u long u nongshukor uba donbor jong ki , bad un ïadoh ïa ka kam jong ki marpyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: For their redeemer is mighty  ; he shall plead their cause with thee .
Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel  ; for they might not be seen to come into the city : and a wench went and told them  ; and they went and told king David .
translation.kha: U Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar , bad u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok , ki dang ap hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel , kaba ha rudnong jong ka Jerusalem , namar kim nud ban rung shapoh ka nongbah ïoh don ba ïohi ïa ki . Kawei ka shakri kynthei ka ju leit ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba jia , bad ki pat ki ju leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid .
Bad mynta ngi longïing ki mrad ha ka ri ba me la ai ïa ngi , kane ka ri baseisoh ka ai jingbam ïa ngi .
translation.en: Behold , we are servants this day , and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof , behold , we are servants in it :
And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded thee , and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments  ;
translation.kha: Lada me shakri hok ïa nga kumba leh u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum ïa me ,

Ha baroh ki jylla , Hangno hangno ba la pynbna paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u Syiem , la don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shahjingit , ki ïam bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki Phong jaiñ khain bad thiah ha u dpei .
translation.en: And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .
And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .
translation.kha: Ka Bethania ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad shibun ki nong Judia ki la wan ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ban pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u para jong ki .
Hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la ïalam pynlang u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis bad u la ïalam ïa ki Sha u lumbah uba jrong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .
translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,

translation.kha: Ki lama kba bymnang haduh jaka katta ; ot ïa ki kum ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynthait ïa ki kumto ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka Jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .
translation.en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .
And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith , wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons , which followed him .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa u hynñiewphew tylli ki sbai rupa na ka templ jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang , bad da kata ka pisa u la wai shi kynhun ki riewdakaid ban ïasoh bad u .
“lada u briew u ïathiah shong bun kano ïano ka mrad , ma u bad kata ka mrad ki dem ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .

translation.kha: Hato u bariew u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynriewphew u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmynthi ei ei !
translation.en: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?

translation.kha: Da pyrkhat ibha aïu phira leh , bad katno kaba phi leh kan long bol .
translation.en: Ponder the path of thy feet , and let all thy ways be established .

But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei khie joit bad ïeng . Nga la paw ha me ban thung ïa me kum u shakri jong nga . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kiwei pat ïa kaba me la ïohi ïa nga ha kane ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaba ngan pyn-i ha me ha ka ban sa wan .

Lada uno uno u para Israel uba shong marjan bad ph u kylla duk dara um ia shuh ban kyrdan hi ïa lade , ph dei ban ïarap ïa u kumba phi leh ïa u nongdie , khnang ba u lai ban ïailong u Parmenas jong phoi .
translation.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor , and fallen in decay with thee  ; then thou shalt relieve him : yea , though he be a stranger , or a sojourner  ; that he may live with thee .
Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .
translation.kha: Me bat ïa la ka kular , me la ïalam noh ïa ki briew kiba me la pyllait im ; da ka bor jong me , me la btin ïa ki sha ka ri kaba kyntang jong me .
Hynrei de tip kiba kumno ki biria phi long , bad nga thup ba phim ne ka jingieit ïa U Blei ha ki dohnud Jong phira .
translation.en: But I know you , that ye have not the love of God in you .
And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Dinah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngoh ïa ki katto katne ki kynthei Kanaan .

translation.en: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .
translation.kha: Ka la wan ha u paidbah na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka tduh ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon .

translation.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
translation.kha: Na bneng , ha kaba me shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kaei kaba u kyrpad ïa me ban leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei kin tip ïa me bad kohnguh ïa me kumba ki paid Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan long ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa me .
ïa ki syiem jongnga ka Elam , ka Goiim , ka bajakhlia malu ka Ellasar , ki san nguh ki syiem pyrshah ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar  ; four kings with five .

translation.kha: Dei U Blei uba pynïaid ïa ka jingim jyllang ki jingshoh jong u ; ka jingim jongu uwei pa ti ka Don hapoh ka bor jongngi u .
translation.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .

translation.kha: phiah ïathuh ha ki Shaphang ka par mynba ki Israel ki la jam ïa ka Jordan halor ka dewryngkhiang .
translation.en: Then ye shall let your children know , saying , Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .

translation.kha: Kumta u Sorek bad u Abiathar ki bah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang shai Jerusalem bad ki sah hangta .
translation.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem : and they tarried there .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat shyiap wang Hirah na u lum hynrei u la sah slem hangta , ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Aaron , bad ki la ong ha u , nym pyntip satia ka la jia aïu ïa ine u Mushi , uba la ïalam ïa ine ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa moi .
translation.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount , the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron , and said unto him , Up , make us gods , which shall go before us  ; for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .

And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: ( Haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wan bad ki la ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Khyrdop Pdeng , kaba kynthup ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Samgar Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad kawei pat ka Nergal Sareser . )
Kumjuh u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha Ijipt bad ki ïalumlang ïa ki nongïalam bhor jong ki Israel .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Ong ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka syntuid ka Jutang ba ieid ki poi ha ka wah , ki dei ban ïaid ha ki um bad ban ïeng hajan ka rudwah .
translation.en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkynjah pyrshah kob jur ïa kine ki briew bad u la phah ba ngaiñ pynjot thiaw ïa ka Shemida .
translation.en: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  hath sent us to destroy it .

translation.kha: Ki kur u Gershon ki dei ban shongduh kamar-tama shaphang sepngi shadien ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiemsad hi , kane ka daym kaei kaweh nga , U Trai U Blang ki Israel , nga ong : pynshaitbor ïa kiei kaba la thah ha ka Kitab ,
translation.en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , thus shall ye say to him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , As touching the words which thou hast heard  ;

translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa Kino ki jingïapan Lyngdoh : ka jingdeng syiem , ka ephod , ka barandi , ka sopti ba la suh pynpur itynnat , ka jaiñspong , bad ka jaiñ panpoh . Kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u khnang ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And these are the garments which they shall make  ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba la tip bah ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Judah ; malu u Moses um shym kdew ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .

translation.kha: Ki pyrshang ban shem lano ka por kan long bad kynum tud wan . Kane ka la long ka por sha kaba U Mynsiem U Khrist uba ba-don ha ki u kdew , ha kaba ïathuhlypa ïa ki jingshah shitom Ibbah U kyrshut un hap ban shah bad ïa ka burom ka ban sa bud .
translation.en: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .

translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa ki nongwei kiba shongsuk ha ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land , ye shall not vex him .

translation.kha: U Shimri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elealeh , bad u long syiem ha ka khak jong u . Kane ka jai ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jongngi ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah .
translation.en: And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Kumta u Akhaïa u ïa-ong ha ki rangbah synshar jongno u , Ha khih ! Une u bhabriew u lamwir ! Bel phi wan ïalam ïa u sha nga ?
translation.en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?

And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the  Lord  will come to meet me : and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee . And he went to an high place .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga pat ngan leit peit la U  Trai  un ïakynduh ne em ïa nga . Ngan sa ïathuh ha phi kat ïa kaba u pynpaw ha nga .  Kumta u la leit marwei sha kliar jong uwei u lum ,

translation.en: Nevertheless we , according to his promise , look for new heavens and a new earth , wherein dwelleth righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ap ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular : Ïa ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ïa ka khyndew kaba thymmai , ha kaba ka hok kan don .

translation.en: And I went unto the angel , and said unto him , Give me the little book . And he said unto me , Take it , and eat it up  ; and it shall make thy belly bitter , but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey .
translation.kha: Nga la leit sha uta u angel bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ban ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli kaba rit . U la ong ïa nga ,  To shim ïa ka bad to bam ïa ka ; kan sa kylla jew ha ka  nierbah jong me , hynrei ha ka shyntur jong me kan long kaba thiang kum ka ngap .

translation.en: Glory and honour are in his presence  ; strength and gladness are in his place .
translation.kha: Ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem ki ker sawdong ïa u , ka bor bad ka jingkmen ki dap ïa ka Templ jong u .
Un wallam ruh ar tylli ki pakor ne ki lyngdkhur , kawei na ka boitha ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkynjah jingeh thang .
translation.en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .

translation.kha: U riewbymman u ainong ha lade , U Blei um sngew ei ei ! u la khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad un ym ïohi ïa nga da lat lei !
translation.en: He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .

translation.kha: Shisyndon uta u briew u la ha ban iohsngew , bad la weng nong ïa kata kaba Teh ïa ka jinglah krenbeiñ jong u , bad u la sdang ban kren khlem kano kano ka jingeh .
translation.en: And straightway his ears were opened , and the string of his tongue was loosed , and he spake plain .

translation.kha: Katno per kmen ba nga eh ban shaniah ha phi nadong shad !
translation.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .

translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lyngktar phin ïabam ïa u Kpu bakhlem thiat , bad ha ka Sngi kaba hynñiew phin pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynshitom ïa U Troas .
translation.en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ynda u Sillah u phai ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u Buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita barhem kiba u Samuel u la ïashoh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .
translation.kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa uwei pat , ‘ Bad ma phi — sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane hangne ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ to thoh phraspah .’
U la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ainong ha ka Jeraïah , Ko Israel bymïaineh , to ïan pat sha nga . Nga long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad ngan ym bitar ; Ngan ym bitar ïa pha Shi junom .
translation.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north , and say , Return , thou backsliding Israel , saith the  Lord   ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you : for I am merciful , saith the  Lord  , and I will not keep anger for ever .
( Proverbs 1 :8 ) Jehovah requires a wife to care for her family lovingly .
translation.kha: ( Proberb 1 :8 ) U Jehobah u kwah ïa ka tnga ban sumar sukher ïa la ka ïing ka sem da ka jingieit .
Haba U Jisu u la poi , u la shem ba la lai tep ïa u Ellasar saw sngi mynshuwa .
translation.en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .
And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt bad u la long u briew uba khraw ha ki ktien bad ki kam .

translation.en: And Sarah died in Kirjath–arba  ; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan : and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her .
translation.kha: Ka la ïap ha Hebron ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Abraham u ïam sngewsih namar jong ka .

translation.en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Moab . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynjot tang ha kawei ka miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka tap ïa ka ri Moab .
Hynrei lada ne ei ei kaba duna ha kita ki jingri , “lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano ïano ka jingkñia , phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U Trai U Blei jongnga phi .
translation.en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them , weeping all along as he went : and it came to pass , as he met them , he said unto them , Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam .
translation.kha: Te u Ishmael u la leit noh na Mispah ban ïakynduh ïa ki , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Haba u la wan ha ki , u la ong ,  Sngewbha wan shapoh ban khmih ïa u Gedalaïah .
Bad ki paidbah ki la wan na ki shaneng kiba basawdong ka Jerusalem , ki da wallam ïa kito naba pang lane kiba don mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ki ; sad la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .

translation.kha: khnap ba u bri uba shakri ïa U Blei un haw ban long Uba bit pura sad uba la biang bha pun sa ïa baroh ki jait kam ibha bha baroh .
translation.en: That the man of God may be perfect , thoroughly furnished unto all good works .

translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno ki lyoh ki por ha ka sahit bneng , ka jingtrei jong ka jingtbit bakhraw jong U Blei ?
translation.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge ?

translation.kha: Kumno re kumno , la don babe ki briew kiba la ïoh ïa ki ba ki leit pynlang ki la ïatip shisyndon ba ki un-long kiew ; kumta ki la ïaleit na baroh ki shnong bad mareh na ryngkew bad ki la poi ha ka jaka shuwa ïa U Jisu bun ki synreit .
translation.en: And the people saw them departing , and many knew him , and ran afoot thither out of all cities , and outwent them , and came together unto him .

translation.kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Paul banbeiñ shongsah bad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor .
translation.en: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not , when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: ( Mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , bad ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , u la iehnoh ïa ki rishot , ka dabor tama , ki kali tan , bad katto katne tylli kiwei pat ki jingkynshew ka Templ . )
U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Shtah ar tylli ki jingïohmap kum kito kiba mynshuwa , bad sam sa thoh ha ki ïa ki ktien kiba la don ha ki mawlyngkniap kiba nyngkong , ïa kiba me la pynpait .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
He shall see of the travail of his soul , and shall be satisfied : by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many  ; for he shall bear their iniquities .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingim ba la shahshitom , un ïoh pat ïa ka jingkmen ; un tip ba um shym la shahshitom lehnoh-ei . U shakri ba la aiti lut jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha , un shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong kiba bun bad na ka bynta jong u ngan map ïa ki .

translation.en: And Saul took him that day , and would let him go no more home to his father s house .
translation.kha: U Saul u bat ïa u Dabid ban ïaisah bad u naduh kata ka sngi bad um shym shah ïa u ban leit phai sha la ïing .
Ki khup jong me ïoh ki la har pop pyrshah ïa U Blei , bad kumta u pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei ïa ki .
translation.en: If thy children have sinned against him , and he have cast them away for their transgression  ;

translation.kha: Kam shyiap pat biang ïa u ïa-ban leh thup kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit hasem jngai shuh Shuh bun u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khur jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , nabar u la mane ïa u Baalgad .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .

translation.kha: U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew bahynñiew kim lah sngewthuh koum ïa kita kiei kiei .
translation.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .

translation.kha: Pynïap , ma phi hi phi ïaleit bymkhuid Ïwei ïa iwei pat bad ïalute wai ïa iwei pat , wat ïa la ki jong ki bakhraw!
translation.en: Nay , ye do wrong , and defraud , and that your brethren .

translation.kha: Kaba sngewshyrkhei bad kiba sngewkyndit ka la jia ha kane ka ri :
translation.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land  ;
And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and forgat the  Lord  their God , and served Baalim and the groves .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa u bad mane ïa ki bleithaw Baal bad Asherah .

Ka tdem jong ka ding kaba pynsaja ïa ki ka kiew shajrong junom la junom . Ym don jingtngen mynsngi ne mynmiet ïa kito kiba mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka tare jong u , ïa uno uno kaba don ïa ka shab jong ka kyrteng jong u mawkyrdon .
translation.en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever : and they have no rest day nor night , who worship the beast and his image , and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name .

Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong kata ka jingbitar shla bad ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai ha ka khmut jong me bad u bnoh ha ka shyntur jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .
kumta ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u . Hynrei ki la sngewsheptieng ïa u paidbah , uba la ñiew ba U Jisu! u dei u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .

Em , u Gehasi u jubor . Hynrei u kynrad jong to u la phah ïa ang ba ïalang myntan ar ngut na ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka ri lum Ephraim ki la wan poi , bad u kwah ïa phi ban ai ha ki lai hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa bun ar riam ki jaiñ-jin ba-ieit .
translation.en: And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .
Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter : for thy heart is not right in the sight of God .
translation.kha: Mem don bynta lane ïoh bynta ha ka kam jong ngi , namar ka dohnud jong me kam long kaba beit ha khmat U Blei .
Kaei kaba ngan kylli na phi ban bor ïa ktien ki briew ? Pynlyngki ïa ki kynoi jong ki ! Pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym lai ban sumar ïa ki khunlung jong ki !
translation.en: Give them , O  Lord  : what wilt thou give ? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .
My son , if sinners entice thee , consent thou not .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongkamsniew ki pynshoi ïa phi , ko khun jong nga , wat kohnguh .
Kumta uwei na ki briew hangta u la ong ha u , Ha khmih’ , ka kmie malu ki par Shaneng Jong me ki ïa-ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ba ïakren bad me .
translation.en: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .

translation.kha: ïa u saphron , u kalamus , ïa ka siasia , lane ka jingiwbih kaba bun jat . Ka mirr bad ka alos ki mih hangta lem bad ki jingsleh kiba iwbih tam .
translation.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko Trai , por kyrpad ïa me , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa la ka bor Bad leh kumba me la kular haba me ong ,
translation.en: And now , I beseech thee , let the power of my Lord be great , according as thou hast spoken , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka ksem jong u ka sma .
translation.en: His fart smelled .

translation.kha: Bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban wallam ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u don ha ïing lem bad katto kat lwet ki tymmen ki sa kiba dang Wan jngoh ïa u . Shuwa ba u nonglamktien jong u syiem un peh , u Elisha u noh ha kita ki thom ki san , Uto u nongpynïap u la phah briew ban pynïap ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shiah ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wan nadien jong u .
translation.en: But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?

translation.kha: nabar u ong ha ki , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Ngam la wan ïam ïa phi na Ijipt nabar nga la phlait ïa phi na ki nadong Ieit badno na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynshitom beiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: And said unto the children of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought up Israel out of Egypt , and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all kingdoms , and of them that oppressed you :

translation.kha: Hynrei u Elisha u ong , ithuh ngiam smam la don hangthie ha ka Mynsiem haba u brisoh u Hiar na ka puta ïapom jongki u banbeiñ ïashem ïa me ? Kane kam dei ka por ban pdiang ïa ka lyngka bad ki jaiñ , ki brisoh olib malu ki bri sohwaiñ , ki langbrot bad ki masi jlan ki shakri !
translation.en: And he said unto him , Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee ? Is it a time to receive money , and to receive garments , and oliveyards , and vineyards , and sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and maidservants ?

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kob u la Pynlong ban neh junom .
translation.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .
Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , phi la tip lypa ïa kane . To sumar ïa lade , namarkata , ba phin ym shah ïalam bakla da ki jingpynbakla ki briew ki bym bat aiñ bad phi hap noh na ka jaka ba la shongshngain kaba phi don .

translation.en: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ha ka synagog ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar .

Ngan waiñ sha Phi bad pyllew im ïa phi . ngan pynjot ïa ki jingïambriew baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei kun ym pynjot ïa phi! . Ngan ym shait ïa phi ban leit khlem shah pynshitom ; hawei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan long u bym leh shiliang . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krensih .
translation.en: For I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to save thee : though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee , yet will I not make a full end of thee : but I will correct thee in measure , and will not leave thee altogether unpunished .

translation.kha: Lada nga la kwah ban sngewbang , ngan ym jin da la longkmie uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei ngan ym kob shajrong , namsop ngam kwah mano mane ban don ka jingpyrkhat ba kham halor ïa nga ban ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi ba nga leh lap u la ïohsngew ïa naba nga nong .
translation.en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leit sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïada , uno uno uba ïaisah hapoh ka jingkah jong U Badonbor Baroh ,
U kyang , Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada u Elihu um shah khra khlieh shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut !
translation.en: Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .

translation.kha: Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Adithaim u la wan poi . U la long u riewdum lad ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingiw jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi pynrieh ( kata , ka sngi shuwa ka sngap Sabbaton ) , kumta u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur shuh u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .
translation.en: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah katba tbit kiba trei ïa ka kam ki mih na la ka jingtrei ,
translation.en: And all the wise men , that wrought all the work of the sanctuary , came every man from his work which they made  ;
The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka ;
U Solomon u long u syiem jongu ki Israel baroh ,
translation.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel .
And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbud jong nga namar ba u dei u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
Naba ngi long baroh ki nongïoh bynta bad U Khrist lada ngi batskhem haduh kaba khot ïa kata ka jingsngewskhem ka ngi la don naduh kaba pdang .
translation.en: For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end  ;

translation.kha: A Tlai , U blei jong ngi , ngi la wallam lang ïa kane ka spah baroh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng bakynjah jong me , hynrei kane baroh ka la wan na me bad ka long ka jongno me .
translation.en: O  Lord  our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own .
His heart is as firm as a stone  ; yea , as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud maw jong u kam ju don jingsheptieng , kaba eh tasam kum u mawtylliat .

translation.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingpyrta da kaba kmen ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki briew jong U Blei :  Ka borbah jong U  Trai  ka la leh ïa ka !
ki jingshoh , ki iar-ryngkuh kiba ïawad pyn-at shadem , dara u syiem ha khmat ki briew jong u .
translation.en: A greyhound  ; an he goat also  ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .

translation.kha: Ko khun , haba phi sangeh ban shah hikai , shen phin iehnoh noh ïa kaei kaba phi la tap mihnoh .
translation.en: Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .
But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Antiokh , nga la pyrshah ïa u ha kaba paw , namar ba u la bakla shai .
U Ephraim u don hajuh uwei u khun ibha kyrteng u Rephah , uba ki khur ki ksiew jong u ki long kumne harum : u Resheph , u Telah , u Tahan ,
translation.en: And Rephah was his son , also Resheph , and Telah his son , and Tahan his son ,

translation.kha: Phi lah thied lypa ka ticket jong phi ?
translation.en: Have you already bought your ticket ?
Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him : and he was perplexed , because that it was said of some , that John was risen from the dead  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Herod , u nongsynshar ka Galilaïa , u la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , u la kulmar jingmut , namar katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la mihpat .
Haba U Blei u ai ha ka lyer ïa ka ni jong ka , bad ba u kheiñ ïa ka jingheh jong ka duriaw ;
translation.en: To make the weight for the winds  ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .
And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and turned his name to Jehoiakim . And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .
translation.kha: U Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim u para jong u Joahas kum u syiem ka Judah bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la ïalam sha Ijipt da u Neko .
Hynrei ngan pyn-i ïa la ka bor bad ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri Ijipt da kaba leh hangta ïa kiei khie kiba shyrkhei . Hadien kata un sa shah ba phin leit .
translation.en: And I will stretch out my hand , and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof : and after that he will let you go .
And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha , ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ;  hynrei wat ki ksew ki ïabam ïa kiba sah tam kiba hap na ka miej u kynrad jong ki .
Nga la khmih ïa kiwei pat ki jop hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Neng la shem Uei u briew na ki shajan ngut uba nga lah ban burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh ka kynthih .
translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .

translation.kha: Naba nga la ïohpdiang na U Trai ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai pdang ha phi : Ba U Trai Jisu , ha kata ka miet ha Kaba la shetkylla ïa u , u la shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ong , une u long ka met jong nga , na ka bynta jong phi . To har ïa kñia baneh kynmaw ïa nga .
translation.en: And when he had given thanks , he brake it , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body , which is broken for you : this do in remembrance of me .

translation.kha: Ka Esther ka phah sha u Mordekai ïa kane ka jubab :
translation.en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer ,
Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :
translation.kha: ki kynthei bad ki khynnah jong phi , ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um ïa phi ,

translation.en: And David said unto Achish , If I have now found grace in thine eyes , let them give me a place in some town in the country , that I may dwell there : for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Akhish ,  Lada phi long u paralok jong nga , ai jaka ïa nga ha kawei ka shnongrit ba ngan ïoh shong hangta . Bah , kam donkam ïa nga ba ngan sah ryngkat bad phi ha kane ka nongbah .
Ktien ki la pynkthang mynsiem ïa u ISAIAH bad ïa ka Rehob .
translation.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah .
Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga namar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad namar ki bleithaw da kiba la pyntngit ïa ka .
kumta por la kyntait noh ïa u bad ai ha u nongsynshar nongwei . Un sa Ainong ïa uta u dieng ïa kaei kabu u dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong u .
translation.en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .

translation.kha: Un leit ha shuwa jong U Trai , uba khlaiñ bad uba khrawbor kum u Eliashib u nonghiarthma . Un pynïasuk pat ïa ki kparad bad ki khun ; un pynphai pat ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh sha ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiba hok ; un pynkhreh ïa ki bri jong U Tlai na ka bynta jong U .
translation.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .
But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba ieit ban mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa lade ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba kren ïa ka ktien U  Trai .
U Trai Nongsynshar da lade un kyrshan ïa nga — uno te , uba lah ba-bang pynshisha ba nga long uba la shait pynum ? Baroh ki nongmudui jong nga kin jah noh ; kin jah kum ka jaiñ ba la smam khñiang .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .

translation.kha: Nangta ki siaw ïa ngi da ki khnam na ka kynroh , bad katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem kynrad ki la shah pynïap ; u Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phin u la shah pynpaw .
translation.en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants  ; and some of the king s servants be dead , and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
Ngam pynkut mynta ïa ka bor jong ka Assyria khashor jong phi bad ngan pyndkut ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa phoi .
translation.en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien jong kata ka jutang ba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses baneh pynlong mala ki Israel ha ka ri ki Moab ; kane baroh ka la long ka jingbynrap shuh shuh halor kata ka jutang kaba U Trai u la pynlong bad ki ha u Lum Sinai .
translation.en: These are the words of the covenant , which the  Lord  commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .

translation.kha: To phet noh na Babilonia ! Phah ngab mlien im ! Wat ai ba yn shait pynïap na ka bynta ka pop jong ka Babilonia . Nga mynta nga sting kliang mala pynshitom ïa ka kumba ka dei hok .
translation.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul : be not cut off in her iniquity  ; for this is the time of the  Lord s  vengeance  ; he will render unto her a recompence .

translation.kha: Phah ïa ka jingshai jong me malade ka jingshisha jrong me ; to ai ba kin ïalam ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga shat Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong me , bad sha ka Templ jong me , ha kaba me shong .
translation.en: O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me  ; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: Kiei kita ki biria kiba la jingsngewsih ïa ka on jong U Blei Bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ? Baroh kito ïa ibha la ïalumlang noh na Ijipt da u Moses ?
translation.en: For some , when they had heard , did provoke : howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses .
And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Hynrei hamar ba un sa ai artat ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang ,  Phi dei shisha u Iso ?  U ruh u jubab ,  Nga dei !
Hato nur ïai ap hapoh ba kin da sngap jar ? Ki shwa ïeng hangto khlem don ei ei Shuh ban noh .
translation.en: When I had waited , ( for they spake not , but stood still , and answered no more  ; )

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to wat duh jingkyrmen , mano mano ruh na phi . Lai la ka kam , ba nga long ryngkat bun phi .
translation.en: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :

translation.kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka jingkylli .
translation.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .

translation.kha: ‘ Em ,’ kiba stad ki la jyllop , ‘ kam don shibun ban ngap ïa pa’ Bad ïa Ngi ruh . Khie leit sha dukan malu thied khyndiat na ka bynta ïa lade .’
translation.en: But the wise answered , saying , Not so  ; lest there be not enough for us and you : but go ye rather to them that sell , and buy for yourselves .

translation.kha: Bad u la Beh noh ïa ki shabar ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat .
He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi la long kiba ngeit ?   Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,  ki la jubab .
U khynnah u saitlah ban jait iau nonghikai .
translation.en: The student refused to obey his teacher .

translation.kha: Ai ba ki khnam jong ki keiñ matlah khnang ba kin ym ïohi ; mala ai ba kin dem hapoh ki jingjur jong ki ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .

translation.kha: Myntan to shahshkor ïa Kanneh ka jingïam , ma phi ki syiem ; to ioh jinghikai na kane , phi ki nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Be wise now therefore , O ye kings : be instructed , ye judges of the earth .

translation.kha: Hadien katto-katne katne par u syiem Serksis u la pynkiew kyllan ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Heman sha ka kyrdan myntri rangbah . U Hammon u dei u khun jong u Hammedatha , naba nonghiarpateng na u Agag .
translation.en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , and advanced him , and set his seat above all the princes that were with him .

translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba-don . Ai ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingkrenbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ïa ki . Kumta to duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki bariew jongnga ngi katba wai im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .

translation.kha: myntor , ha kaba ïadei sad ka jingtep kiba ïap : Hato phim patar ju pule ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha Phi ? U la ong ,
translation.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .
translation.kha: U long uba shaniah ha U Blei , uba la jied ïa u ban leh ïa kane ka kam , kumba u Moses u la long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong u ha ka ïing U Blei .

translation.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u rangbah shipai u la tuklar bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na ngi .

translation.en: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .
translation.kha: Ko rangbah , nga ïohi ba ka jingleit jong ngi da ka lieng nangne sha khmat kan long kaba ma ; kan don ka jingjulor bakhraw ïa ka jingkit bad ïa ka lieng , bad ka jingduh ruh ïa ka jingim .
Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad to la wan sha ka pyut ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad lang! leit shata U kper .
translation.en: I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .

translation.kha: Kin ym longïing shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei ktang trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong ïa kaei kaba ki mut .
translation.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .

translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot ha ka kajuh naba kyntang ha kaba la ju pynkup ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingkñia nabar ka thup malade ïa ki jingïania ainguh thang . U dei ban leh ïa kane nabar ba ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpalat , kumba long ka jingkñia namarba ka pop , ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh , bad ka long kaba khwai bha .
translation.en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering , in the holy place : for as the sin offering is the priest s , so is the trespass offering : it is most holy :

translation.kha: Ma ba bat ïa ki rishot kiba jingkyrshan ïa ka khyndew ? Manoah ba bsuh ïa u mawdong jong ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof  ;
Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ba men pyllait ïa nga na ka kti u Iso u hynmen jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ban ïaleh bad pynïap lut ïa ngi baroh , wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh .
Neng ai ïa me ki jingkynshew na ki jaka ba-dap , bakynjah ; te manna tip ba nga long U Tlai , bad ba U Blei ki Israel u la khot ïa me da ka kyrteng .
translation.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness , and hidden riches of secret places , that thou mayest know that I , the  Lord  , which call thee by thy name , am the God of Israel .

Let thy servant , I pray thee , turn back again , that I may die in mine own city , and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother . But behold thy servant Chimham  ; let him go over with my lord the king  ; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee .
translation.kha: Nangta shah ba ngan leit phai pat sha ïing bad ban ïap hajan ka jingtep jong i mei bad i pa jong nga . Une hangne u Shimham , u khun jong nga , u ban shakri ïa phi ; shim ïa u bad phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ; bad leh na ka bynta jong u katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
Kut u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh pun skhem bad u lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban ter noh ïa nga na ka pang shuwa ba ngan ïahap .
translation.en: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .

translation.kha: Haseroth me ïohi ïa kiei kiei kumba ngi ïohi ?
translation.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh ? or seest thou as man seeth ?

translation.kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai u la seng nongrim ïa ka saihon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba shahshitom kin shem ka jingtasngeng hangta .
translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .

translation.kha: Me pyllew im ïa re kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong .
translation.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .

translation.kha: Dei namarba kata ba U Trai u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kam bit ïa uno uno na ki , lane ïa uno uno u nongwei babha wan shon hapdeng jong ki , ban ba-im ïa kan kano ka dohkha kaba dang don snam ha ka .
translation.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel , No soul of you shall eat blood , neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood .

translation.kha: U Jakob u phah ïa u Judah ban at leit sha khmut ban ino ïa u Joseph ban wan ïakynduh bad u ha Goshen .
translation.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph , to direct his face unto Goshen  ; and they came into the land of Goshen .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te ba U Khun U Briew u ni ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban Kartah ïa ki pop . Kumne u la ïong ha uta u briew ba la ïapshiliang ,
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )
When the Philistines took the ark of God , they brought it into the house of Dagon , and set it by Dagon .
translation.kha: nangta ki leit rah ïa ka sha ka templ u blei jong ki , u Dagon , bad ki buh ïa ka ha syndah u mot jong u .
Ki shim ïa ka jaka kaba bha tur na ka bynda ïa lade , Ïa ka bynta u nongïaleh , la ai ha ki . Ki la kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki praw U Trai Haba ki nongïalam jongnga ki Israel ki ïalum sia jaka .
translation.en: And he provided the first part for himself , because there , in a portion of the lawgiver , was he seated  ; and he came with the heads of the people , he executed the justice of the  Lord  , and his judgments with Israel .

translation.kha: Lymne ba u Herod u shem ïa u , uba la re , nia u la phuh biang ïa u shat im’ . Kim shym don kano kano kaba une u brup u la leh Kaba u dei ban ïap .
translation.en: No , nor yet Herod : for I sent you to him  ; and , lo , nothing worthy of death is done unto him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khor ïa la ki synran sha lade bad u la ong , Ang isynei ïa kine ki briew , Naamah ki la ïadon bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei ngab bam . Ngam kwah ban phah napoh ïa ki khulom da bsa ïa ki , naba ki haka Ban ïapler ha ka lynti jong ki sha la ïing .
translation.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said ,  I have compassion on the multitude , because they continue with me now three days , and have nothing to eat : and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way .

translation.kha: Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat nala na Israel kum ïa uta u nongjapan briew , khnang ba phin manbha .
translation.en: Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .

translation.kha: Namar ka long ka bymsuidñiew kat kum ka jinglum , bad lada un uno u bam ïa ka , ngan ym pyngkiang ïa kata ka jingiaseng .
translation.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day , it is abominable  ; it shall not be accepted .

translation.kha: Kumba shi taïew shadien ba u la kren ïa kine kiei kaei , U Josis u la ïalam lem malade u ïa u Petros , u Ïoannis bad ïa u Jubab malu leit sha u lum ban dulir .
translation.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .

translation.kha: ka Elon , ka Timnah , ka Ekron ,
translation.en: And Elon , and Timnah , and Ekron ,
O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
U ong ïa la u shakor , Kaei leit peit shaphang ka duriaw . U Shakri u leit bad u wan phai bad u ong , ngim ïohi ei ei . Hynñiew sien u Elijah u ong ïa u ban leit bad ban peit .
translation.en: And said to his servant , Go up now , look toward the sea . And he went up , and looked , and said , There is nothing . And he said , Go again seven times .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ym don mynshem mano ba lah don batai , te uta uba kren ha ki thylliej baphyrnai u dei ban sngap jar ino bad kren tang ha put bad ha U Blei .
translation.en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .

And Saul disguised himself , and put on other raiment , and he went , and two men with him , and they came to the woman by night : and he said , I pray thee , divine unto me by the familiar spirit , and bring me him up , whom I shall name unto thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u riam pher ïa lade da kaba phong da kiwei pat ki jaiñ , bad ynda la dum ma u bad ar ngut na ki rangbah jong u ki leit sha kata ka kynthei .  Wad jingtip na ki mynsiem na ka bynta jong nga bad to ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka ban sa jia ,  u ong ha ka .  Khot ïa uta u mynsiem jong uta u briew uba nga khot kyrteng .
To kmen bad to sahkynmaw jyrngam ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bathymmai kob nga pynlong lai dap da ka jingkmen , bad ki briew jong ka kin skhem sngewbha .
translation.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .

translation.kha: Ki long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la pynlong ki khun lad u ïa ki bad u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u ha ki ; u la pynlong ki jutang bad ki bad u la ai ïa ki ka Law ; ki don ka jingmane bashisha ; ki la ïoh ïa ki jingkular U Blei ;
translation.en: Who are Israelites ; to whom pertaineth the adoption , and the glory , and the covenants , and the giving of the law , and the service of God , and the promises ;

translation.kha: Ym don jingwoh ba-im ba lah ba-bang ïohi ïa ka , ym don , kdew ka sim naba her .
translation.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi bad rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Ye also , as lively stones , are built up a spiritual house , an holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To wan kum ki maw ba-im , bad to shah ïa lade ba yn pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ ba kynja mynsiem , ha kaba phin shakri kum ki lyngdoh bakhuid ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ba kynja mynsiem bad ba pdiang hun ha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist .
mala U blem u ïakynduh ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u , Neng la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan badno nga la kñia uwei u masi ktung bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .
translation.en: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .

The Spirit of the Lord is upon me , because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor  ; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives , and recovering of sight to the blind , to set at liberty them that are bruised ,
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Trai u long ha nga , namar ba u la jied ïa nga ban wallam ka khubor babha ha kiba duk . U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ka jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi bad ka jingpynïoh ïa ka jingimat ha kiba matlah ; ban pyllait ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ

Phai sha ka mynnor , sha kata ka por shuwa ban khia ïa phi , ter shi ter haduh kata ka par mynba U Blei u la sloit ïa u briew ha ka pyrthei . Wad ha ka pyrthei barben kiwei . Hato kaei kaei naba khraw kat Kanah ka la ju jia mynshuwa ? Don mo u briew uba la ju ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei kaba kat kane ?
translation.en: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before thee , since the day that God created man upon the earth , and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other , whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it ?

translation.kha: Lada film kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei’ ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab , bad lada phim ñiew ïa ka kyrteng kaba phria bad kaba khraw jong U Trai U Blei jong phi ,
translation.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;
And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

translation.en: Ye call me Master and Lord : and ye say well  ; for so I am .
translation.kha: Phi khot ïa nga ‘ U Nonghikai’ bad ‘ U Trai’ , bad ka long kaba dei ba phi leh kumta , namar kata ka dei kaei kaba nga long .
Na ka jait Gad ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Ramoth ha Gilead , lem bad ki pyntha phrung jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jaka ) , ka Mahanaim ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Mahanaim with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: Bad ngi la ïohi bad ïathaw ha kiwei ba U kput u la phah ïa la U du ban long U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world .

translation.kha: A Trai , me long U Blei uba pynshitom ; to pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong me !
translation.en: O  Lord  God , to whom vengeance belongeth  ; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth , shew thyself .

translation.kha: Ha ka khim Mikhmash , na kaba u Jonathan u hap ban ïaid lyngba Ban poi shata ka jaka Sher dara ki Philistia , don ar tyllep ki mawlong baheh kiba sohkhruh sohkhram , uwei uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jongu ka khim : ïa uwei la khot u Boses sad ïa uwei pait u Seneh .
translation.en: And between the passages , by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines  garrison , there was a sharp rock on the one side , and a sharp rock on the other side : and the name of the one was Bozez , and the name of the other Seneh .

translation.kha: lem bad katto katne ki nongbeh bad ki nongriam kiba don hapoh ki phut sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .
translation.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
translation.kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ,  Nga ainguh ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .
translation.kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba shim ktien uwei na uwei bad pynbna ïa ki kum ka khubor jong nga .
Te ïa ka law kaba mynshuwa la buh sharud , namar ba ka long kaba tlot bad ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .

translation.kha: Phan sa ïoh khun shynrang , bad phan khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ïalam , ñiar U Trai u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingiw sngew jynjar jong pha .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .

translation.kha: nga ïai-ong , ‘ Mynta phi la poi ha ri lum Amor , kaba U Trai U balui jong ngi , U Blei jong ki kjap tymmen jrong ngi , u ai ha moi . Peit ïa ka hangtai . kiei wait kam kynti ïa ka kumba u la hukum . Wat leh tud , bad Wat sheptieng .’
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  thy God hath set the land before thee : go up and possess it , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath said unto thee  ; fear not , neither be discouraged .

translation.kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na Kaba sa pop bad ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .
translation.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .

translation.kha: Nalor na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew kiba ïalam ïa u Ban pynïap briew , ban kliar , bad baneh leh ïa kiwei kiwei ki kam bajakhlia ; ban lute , ban lamler , Bad ban kren sniew ïa kiwei .
translation.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingïakhih jingman , ka jingshahjop , mala ka jingkulmar jingmut ha ka Them ka Jingïohipaw , bad U Tiras U Nongsynshar Badonbor Barukh u la phad ïa ka ha me . Ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongkhap jong ngi la tiew pynkhyllem , bad ki jingkyang ban ïew jingïarap ki la sawa hapdeng ki Lum .
translation.en: For it is a day of trouble , and of treading down , and of perplexity by the Lord  God  of hosts in the valley of vision , breaking down the walls , and of crying to the mountains .

I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang khmih ïa ki reng , nga la ïohi ïa ka reng kaba rit , kaba mih napdeng kiwei pat . Ka la tar ïa ki lai tylli ki reng kiba la don lypa hangta . Kane ka reng ka la don ki khmat briew bad ka shyntur kaba kob sarong .
U Mysia u la phiah ïa ki nongkren na Kadesh sha u syiem Edom . Ki ong , Kane ka khubor ka wan na ki para kur jong phi , kiba na ka jait Israel . Phin thup ïa ki jingeh kiba im la shah ,
translation.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom , Thus saith thy brother Israel , Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us :
And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land , ye shall not vex him .
translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa ki nongwei kiba shong ha ka ri jong phi .
Gera kata kam dei kaba ki la leh baroh . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ki pynkhiah ïa ka Sabbaton , kaba nga la pynskhem .
translation.en: Moreover this they have done unto me : they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day , and have profaned my sabbaths .

translation.kha: Ngi la shem ïa Une u briew ba u long ka jingpynwit kaba shyrkhei ; u sdang ïa ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki jia ha kylleng jong ka pyrem malade u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhied kaba na Nasareth .
translation.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :

translation.kha: Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis lanot ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lieng mano ba ïathuh ïa u syriem ba u slap un sa haduh ?
translation.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?

translation.kha: U Samuel u Ong , Kumba ka tiensyiem Jong me ka la pynlong ïa kiba bun ki kmie ban duh khun , kumne myntan ka kmie jong me tista long khlem khun . Bad u pom lyngkot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka kharai ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong por , Shahshkor ïa nga bad wat kliang ïa ki ktien jngai nga .
translation.en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
It shall not be quenched night nor day  ; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever : from generation to generation it shall lie waste  ; none shall pass through it for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Kan ing mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad ka tdem kan kiew na ka junom . Ka khyndew kan sah lehnoh-ei na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad yn ym don shuh u ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .

Hadien ba la kem ïa u , ïa u Peor la thep ha phatok , ha kaba la aiti ïa u ngab ap phira da ki saw thylliej ki kynhun babha kawei kawei ka don saw ngut ki shipai . U Herod u la thmu ïa-ban bishar ha khmat u paidbah hadien ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: And when he had apprehended him , he put him in prison , and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him  ; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people .

translation.kha: Sa syier u Dabid u kylli na U Trai , uba jaboh , Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ba-bang tad ïaleh ïa ki na kawei ka liang , najan ki dieng Balsam .
translation.en: And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .

translation.kha: Da tynjuh ïa kiei kiei baroh : Rat ïa kaei kaban bha
translation.en: Prove all things ; hold fast that which is good .
And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .
translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka bor jong ki rangbah bymman bad kiba leh jubor . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Balah ngi ïadon lang ha lyngkhuh ba ngi ïateh song ïa u kew , ha kaba ka song jong nga ka khie joit bad ka ïeng beit . Ki song jongnga phi patar ki tawiar sawdong ïa ka song jong nga , bad ki ïanguh ïa ka .
translation.en: For , behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and , lo , my sheaf arose , and also stood upright  ; and , behold , your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .

translation.kha: Hobab u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ia , u Seneh na kaba theh kut ïa ka Ramah bad iehnoh ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .
But Samson s wife was given to his companion , whom he had used as his friend .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka tnga jong u la ai sha u briew uba la shong synran ïa u ha ka jingkyntiew kurim .

translation.en: The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .
translation.kha: bad baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki rudwah jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong bad yn sa rong noh .
Shimei ïa katba la kham rangbah ba kin long kiba adkar , kiba tipbriew bad kiba synshar ïa biar ; kiba skhep ha ka jingngeit , ka jingbeit sad ka jingïaishah jongngi ki .
translation.en: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .

translation.kha: U Trai um ju bitar shen , hynrei u long uba khrawbor bad um ju shah ba kiba shah rai pynrem kin lait khlem shah pynshitom . Nangno ha Kaba U Trai u ïaid , ki erïong ki khiew ; ki lyoh ki long ki pui pyut ba la pynmih da ki kjat jong u !
translation.en: The  Lord  is slow to anger , and great in power , and will not at all acquit the wicked : the  Lord  hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm , and the clouds are the dust of his feet .
And thou shalt speak my words unto them , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear : for they are most rebellious .
translation.kha: Men ong ha ki ïa kaei ba nga bthah ïa me ban ong , lada ki sngap ne kim sngap . Kynmaw ba ki long ki nongïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: Then I beheld all the work of God , that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun : because though a man labour to seek it out , yet he shall not find it  ; yea further  ; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .
translation.kha: bad phin ym lah da lei lei ban sngewthuh aïu U Blei u leh . Wat haba phi pyrshang tyngeh ruh , phin ym shem da lei lei . Ki briew kiba stad ki lah ban kam ba ki tip , hynrei kim tip .
Hynrei to kiar ei na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynslem ïa lade ïa ka jingimat riewkhlaw .
translation.en: But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh bakyrpang sha nga . Kane ka bynta jong u mrad ba la kñia ka dei ka jong me .
Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba ar la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa U Tharai U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kiba u hukum , bad ïaineh ha u .
translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael , all their days .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u bitar ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria bad u khun jong u , u Benhadad ban jop ïa ki Israel na ka por sha ka por .
hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kdang kumta ka me .
translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .

O Lord , according to all thy righteousness , I beseech thee , let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem , thy holy mountain : because for our sins , and for the iniquities of our fathers , Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us .
translation.kha: Me la ïada ïa ngi ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta te to wat bitar shuh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka long ka nongbah jong me , u lum bakyntang jong me . Baroh ki briew ha ki ri ba-marjan ki khmih beiñ ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong me namar ki pop jong ngi bad ka jingbymman ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh .

translation.en: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .
translation.kha: Ngi la long ki nongshun jong U Blei , hynrei u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong u lyngba ka jingïap U Khun jong u . Mynta ba ngi long ki paralok jong U Blei , katno tam ba yn pynim ïa ngi da ka jingim U Khrist !

translation.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool : he openeth not his mouth in the gate .
translation.kha: Ki jingkren kiba stad ki long kiba jylliew katta katta ïa u briew uba bieit ban sngewthuh . Um don ei ei ban kren haba ïa ki kam badonkam la ïatainia .

translation.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters  ; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more , nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa ki jingri jong me ha man la ki jaka dih um . Yn ym don shuh ki briew ne jingri ban pynjngut pat ïa ka um .
Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynïap laispah hynriewphew jrut ki rangbah jrong u Aben kiba na ka jait bymman .
translation.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin , and of Abner s men , so that three hundred and threescore men died .

translation.kha: U brup uba bahkhlieh ïa la ka jingshun u dei uba lamler . Uno uno Uba pynphriang ïa ka jinglorni u dei uba bieit .
translation.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .
And the sons of Gomer  ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gomer ki long ki briew jong ka Ashkenas , ka Riphath , bad ka Togarmah .
Ïa ki kpu jongki ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , mala mynta ki kmie jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .

translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ! Kato ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka jingtah khmat ki phyrnai ryntih da ka jingieit . U sngewkyiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang bakha hiar sha trai ki lum Gilead .
translation.en: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .

translation.kha: Ka Ktien “ksuid” kamut un uno uba kren lamler shaphang kiew pat .
translation.en: The word “devil” means someone who tells wicked lies about another person .

translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba sih noh , ka dei ka jingiw kaban pynïap ; hynrei ha kito kiba la pynrem , ka long ka jingiwbih kaba wallam jingim . Uei keiñ , uba kah ban leh ïa katba kum kata ka kam ?
