translation.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?

translation.kha: Ko khup u briew , u la ong Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot jong ka ri Isaia ki ong : ‘ U Abraham u long tang uwei u briew , sad u la ïor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . ngi ïadon bun ngut , kumta mynta ka ri ka dei ka Jong ngi .’
translation.en: Son of man , they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak , saying , Abraham was one , and he inherited the land : but we are many  ; the land is given us for inheritance .
For this thing I besought the Lord thrice , that it might depart from me .
translation.kha: Lai sien nga la duwai ha U Trai shaphang kane bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ban weng noh ïa ka .
ki kylli na U Trai , Dang don haw mano mano ? U Trai u jubab , u Saul u don hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .
translation.en: Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllait ïa ka paro ban tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , kata ka paro kam shym lap jaka ban dem .

Nangno sa ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U TRAI’ nongbanbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam ïa u shakri jong nga u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia shad ken ka jaka , bad un bsuh ïa ka khet jong u halor kine ki maw uba me la tep , bad un pyiar ïa ka ïingjaiñ syiem halor jong ki .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .

And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan jied ïa u lyngdoh u ban kohnguh ïa nga bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai ha u ki khun ki ksiew ki ban ïai shakri ha khmat u syiem uba la jied jong nga .

translation.en: And the saying pleased me well : and I took twelve men of you , one of a tribe :
translation.kha: Nga la sngewdei ïa kata ka jingai jingmut ; kumta nga la jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait .
Ïa ka Hasason yn pynjakhlia ri shyiap junom , ka jaka ha kaba tang ki myrsiang Kin im . Yn ym don mano mano shuh ban shong ban sah biang hangta . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la klun .
translation.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons , and a desolation for ever : there shall no man abide there , nor any son of man dwell in it .
Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phai ïa la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :

translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Kin sa tip ruh ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba ngan ïoh shongduh hapdeng jong ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

Nga kyrpad ïa phira , ko ki paw jong nga , kum ki jingshoh bad ki nongphetwir ha kane ka pyrthei ! wai aiti noh ha ki jingkwah barli jong ka doh , kiba un-long borabor ha ka jingïaleh thlim pyrshah ïa ka mynsngi .
translation.en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;
Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?
translation.kha: Kito kiba pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ki jingthmu jong ki na U  Trai  , kin jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh bad ki pyrkhat ba yn ym don ba ïohi ïa ki lane tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .

Ma nga ruh , por lama u briew hapoh ka iktiar jong ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakha kham halor , bad nga don mad ki shipai hapoh jong la . Nga hukum ïa une uwei , ‘ Khie leit !’ mala u leit ; bad nga hukum ïa utai uwei , ‘ Ale !’ bad u wan ; bad por hukum ïa u mraw jong sa , ‘ Leh ïa kane !’ bad u leh ïa kata .
translation.en: For I am a man under authority , having soldiers under me : and I say to this man , Go , and he goeth  ; and to another , Come , and he cometh  ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
And the  Lord  appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him , I have heard thy prayer , and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wanpaw ha u Solomon mynmiet . U ong ha u ,  Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad nga la pdiang ïa kane ka Templ kum ka jaka ha kaba yn ai ïa ki jingkñia ha nga .

translation.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .
translation.kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka song kum ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , khnang ba yn pdiang ïa phi . Uta u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton .
Wat mane ïa U Trai U Bel jong phi kamar leh kita ki briew .
translation.en: Ye shall not do so unto the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki Briew bad ïa ki nongïalam jongnga ki , bad ki la wallam ïa ka khajna jong ki mala ki pyndap ïa ka synduk da ka .
translation.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced , and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end .
Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,
translation.kha: Ynda haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Jisu . Katba U dang duwai , la plie ïa ka bneng ,
Nga phla ïa baroh kaba por la leh , bad me la jubab ïa nga ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .
translation.en: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me : teach me thy statutes .

translation.kha: Kumno te ba khung shemphang ba ngam shym kren ha phi shaphang u kpu ? To sumar ïa lade na u thiat ki Pharisi mala ki Saddusi !
translation.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?

translation.kha: (Nga tip haduh katno kine ki briew ki longsem kiba mutlop .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :

translation.kha: Da kumne u Jisu u wan ïalam Hynñiew jngut ki khun shynrang jngai u sha u Samuel . Bad u Samuel u ong ha u , Em , U thri um Shim la jied ïano ïano na kine .
translation.en: Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .

translation.kha: Ki Briew na Baroh ki hima , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki jingïambriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kan ym shah ban tep ïa ki .
translation.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .

translation.kha: Kiba sah jong ki Lebi , ka kur Merari , ka la ïohpdiang na ka jaka jong ka jait Sebulun synsar tylli ki nongbah : ka Jokneam , ka Kartah ,
translation.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka Long syriem kumin ka um kaba jaw jrop shi kjap ha ka sngi ba slap .
translation.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .

translation.kha: Ale bun bam ïa ka dohkha jongnga ki syiem , ki nongïalam shipai , bad jong ki shipai , ka dohkha jong ki kulai bad ki nongshong jongno ki , ka doh jong ki briew baroh , ki miaw bad kiba laitluid , kiba rit bad kiba khraw !
translation.en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings , and the flesh of captains , and the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses , and of them that sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and bond , both small and great .

translation.kha: Heldai khyndiat per , U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham ; u khot ïa u , Abraham ! Bad u Amram u Jobab , Oi , nga hangne !
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that God did tempt Abraham , and said unto him , Abraham : and he said , Behold , here I am .
None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .
translation.kha: Ngan map noh ïa ki pop ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .
Ita u briew u la jubab , To ïathuh ïa nga u dei uei , ko kynrad , khnang ba ngan lah ban ngeit ha u !
translation.en: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?

And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Em , kata kam da pher eh ; lada nga la ïoh ka jingsngewbha jong phi , to pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha jong nga . Ban ïohi ïa ka khmat jong phi ka long ïa nga hi kumba ïohi ïa ka khmat U Blei , mynta ba phi la leh jan ïa nga katne .

Bad U Tharai u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem , Ngan shimti na ka bynta jong phira bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin khap siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa phira . Ngan pynrngad ïa ki tyllong um jong ka Bethania bad ngan pynlong ïa ki wah jong ka ban tyrkhong .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will plead thy cause , and take vengeance for thee  ; and I will dry up her sea , and make her springs dry .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U Trai , ka jingweng kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot Shaneng kiba mihsnam ka rta , baroh ki dat ban long ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phiah la snar sha ka ri kaba bha , phi la kdang bad sngewhun , bad nangta phi la sngewsarong bad klet noh ïa por .
translation.en: According to their pasture , so were they filled  ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted  ; therefore have they forgotten me .

translation.kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglong basngur shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sneng bakhadduh ,” U Jisu u la ong : “Te ia kane ka gospel jongnga ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh , ia kaban long ka jingphla ha ki kyntu bynriew baroh’ ; ynda katkum kein kan jia kata kaba khup .” Matthaïos 24 14 .
translation.en: Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu la hajir na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babit , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la pynïap da ka jinglehisynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khleiñ u nongsharai . Kumta u la sawdong ban hikai bun kiei kiei ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .
But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano ba me leit . Nga tip kumno me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
Ha ka ktien Hebru “Gilead” ka mut “Ka Sakhi ba Kynther .”
translation.en: In Hebrew , “Gilead” means “Witness Pile .”

Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ïa u Ahimelekh u nong Hit bad ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) ,  Mano napdeng jong phi ar ngut ban leit bad nga sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ?   Ma nga ,  u Abishai u jubab .
A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha tun ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba ei ki khun ryñiot !
translation.en: And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !

translation.kha: “Nga tharai , u Simon u la jubab , un long uta Uba la ïohmap kham Bun . Me ong kaba dadien , U Jisu u la ong .
translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .

translation.kha: Me ong Kaba dei U Trai u la ong , bad nga dang khmih ban ioh ba ki kyntien lad ang ki wan urlong shisha .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Thou hast well seen : for I will hasten my word to perform it .

translation.kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la Wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baroh kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Ngan Wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpu Thummim jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .
translation.kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïaineh .

translation.en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .
translation.kha: Ki don u syiem uba synshar halor jong ki , uba long u angel uba khmih ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka long u Abaddon ; bad ha ka ktien Grik ka long u Apollyon ( kaba mut u  Nongpynjot  ) .

Bud ïa u sha ka ïng ba un rung malade ong ïa u trai jyllang ka ïing : ‘ U nongïoh u ong , Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin ïabam na ka beit ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ? ’
translation.en: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;
translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban thaw ïa ki jingrwai , kumba u Dabid u la thaw , bad tem ïa ki ha ki duitara .
U bteng nangta sha ka phang mihngi haduh Gath Hepher bad Ethkasin , da kaba phai ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti sha Rimmon .
translation.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;
I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .
translation.kha: Ngan leit lang bad me sha Ijipt , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . U Joseph ruh un don ryngkat bad me ynda me ïap .

translation.en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .
translation.kha: Na kawei ka por sha kawei pat phi pynjahburom ïa nga bad phim don ka jinglehrain haba phi krenbeiñ ïa nga .
Khenani kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa katei kaba U Trai u don ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la lumlang ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ba wahbah ïa u kew ban shoh .
translation.en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .

translation.kha: Ki kham ngon paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong ar . Ïoh lehhok ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad beh ei ïa ki na khnai ka ri . Nga tip ba haba Phin pynbynta ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingshem , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .
translation.en: Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist
Te u syiem Hesekaïah u kylli , Khie ka tai ban pynshisha ba nga lah ban leit sha ka thalab ?
translation.en: Hezekiah also had said , What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Naba U Kpa u ieit ïa U ju bad u pyn-at ha u ïa baroh kambah ma u hi u leh . Un pyn-i ha u wat ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw kba un leh ban ïa kane , bun baroh phin sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: For the Father loveth the Son , and sheweth him all things that himself doeth : and he will shew him greater works than these , that ye may marvel .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa ka tnat u Loit !
translation.en: Remember Lot s wife .

translation.kha: U leh pop marpyrshah ïa U Trai’ , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong uba ha shuwa jong u , u syiem jahburom u khun jong u Nob , uba la ïamareh ïa ki Israel ngab leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: U Isaak u la im shispah phraspah snem ,
translation.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years .

translation.kha: U la pynlut la ka jingim ha kaba ïasyllok bad U Blei , sad hadien kata u la jah noh , namar U Blei u la shim noh ïa u .
translation.en: And Enoch walked with God : and he was not  ; for God took him .

translation.kha: Ki briew katba la ap synrum ïa ki sniang ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba ia jia , kumta ki la phet noh bad ki la pynphriang ïa ka kherub hapoh ka shnong bad ha ki bakwah ri jingriew .
translation.en: When they that fed them saw what was done , they fled , and went and told it in the city and in the country .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad synreit hajuh ngut ki shipai ïadie kjap . U la buh bun tylliat ki kloi na ka bynta ki siewspah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ïa kiba sah u la pyndkoh .
translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .
Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :
translation.kha: U syiem Manasseh u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei kiba kham sniew ban ïa kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la leh , bad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki briew jong ka Judah ban leh pop .

translation.en: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it : fear not , nor be dismayed : for the  Lord  God , even my God , will be with thee  ; he will not fail thee , nor forsake thee , until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ha u Solomon u khun jong u ,  To long uba sngewskhem bad uba kut jingmut . Sdang ïa ka kam bad wat ai kano kano ruh kan pynsangeh ïa me . U  Trai  U Blei , uba nga shakri un don bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me , hynrei un don ryngkat bad me tad haduh ba men pyndep ïa ka kam kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ jong u .

translation.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women  ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them .
translation.kha: Kita ki nongpynkha khun ki jubab ,  Ki kynthei Hebru kim long kum ki kynthei Ijipt ; ki kha suk ïa ki khun , bad katba ngin da poi ma ngi , ki la lah kha .
Lada uwei na ki u kyllon , uwei pat u kah ban khyllie joit ïa u . Hynrei “lada uno uno u don marwei bad u kyllon ; ka long kaba sangsot tad , namar ym don mano me ban ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth  ; for he hath not another to help him up .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong I ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid long ma u !
translation.en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
The little chambers thereof , the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , and the windows to it round about : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
translation.kha: Kum ma ki , ka ruh ka la don ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh ba la pynitynnat , ka kamra rung , bad ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong . Ka lynter jong ka baroh ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang jong ka khat-ar mitar shiteng .

translation.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
translation.kha: U shim jingkheiñ ïa baroh ki shynrang Lebi kiba la don laiphew snem lane tam . Baroh ki don laiphew phra hajar ngut .
Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa u na Galilaïa , ki la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .
translation.en: And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
For I speak to you Gentiles , inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles , I magnify mine office :
translation.kha: Nga kren mynta ha phi ki Jentil : Katba nga dang long u apostol sha ki Jentil , ngan sngewsarong ha ka kam jong nga .
Ha kane kajuh ka rukom ki brisoh ka Israel kin hap ban ap snem khlem ki syiem ne ki nongïalam , khlem jingkynjah lane riew ïamkthang , khlem bleithaw lane dulir ban pyndonkam ha kaba khan blei .
translation.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king , and without a prince , and without a sacrifice , and without an image , and without an ephod , and without teraphim :

And it grew , and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and the roots thereof were under him : so it became a vine , and brought forth branches , and shot forth sprigs .
translation.kha: U jingthung u la speh bad u la long u dieng sohwaiñ uba lyngkot bad uba pyiar kylleng . Ki tnat ki san shajrong sha u pukni , bad ki thied ki suh jylliew . La tap ïa u dieng sohwaiñ da ki tnat bad ki sla .
Nga lah wan .
translation.en: I am coming .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang ha la ka shang bad da ki ba-eh bun ka longsyiem jong u .
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country , and among his own kin , and in his own house .

translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ka ba ka dei ban ap lem ïa nga khlem da leh nuti lane klim ; bad ha kane ka por kan ïai ap ïa ka .
translation.en: And I said unto her , Thou shalt abide for me many days  ; thou shalt not play the harlot , and thou shalt not be for another man : so will I also be for thee .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u la ong ha u Moses , Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki oh , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pungsum , bad pynkhih ïa ki jakoid ba kin pyndap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Don na phi kiba la ju long kumta . Hynrei la pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop ; la pynkyntang ïa phi sha U balui ; la pynksan ïa phi Bad U Blei da U Jisu Kiriath uba U Trai bad da U Mynsiem U Blei jyllang ngi .
translation.en: And such were some of you : but ye are washed , but ye are sanctified , but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and by the Spirit of our God .
Then said they unto him , What shall we do unto thee , that the sea may be calm unto us ? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong ka la nang jur ha kata ka por , kumta ki maji ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ïa me ban pynsangeh ïa ka  erïong ?

translation.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land , which I sware to give unto your fathers ,
translation.kha: ‘ Na kane ka pateng bymman , yn ym don uwei ruh u ban ïoh leit rung ha kata ka ri kaba seisoh ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Buh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka bynta ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano hano ha uwei pat . Ngan pule na ka bynta u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba la thoh bad ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .

translation.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land  ; but they could not : for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous against them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki maji pat , ki la pyrshang ban ïaleh ban pynpoi ïa ka lieng sharud duriaw , da kaba king katba don ka bor jong ki . Hynrei ka  erïong ka la nang jur , bad kim poi shuh shano shano ruh .
Kiba hok ki don khwai ban bam , hynrei ki bymman ki shngain borabor .
translation.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .

translation.kha: Suit u nongïam Ijipt u pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongap langbrot , ki jubab ; u pynlong um lem ïa ngi , bad u ïarap ai um de ïa ki jingri jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .

translation.kha: U buh ïa “kata ka jingbam baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ki khun shynrong jong u , bad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingiw kaba kyrpang sha U Trai .
translation.en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka Balang ka long ka met U Kiriath , kaba pyndap pura ïa u , uba da lade hi u pyndap pura ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kylleng ki jaka .
translation.en: Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .

translation.kha: To map ïa ki bapop jong ngi , naba ngi map ïa uwei pa Uei babha imat bakla ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’
translation.en: And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
To teach when it is unclean , and when it is clean : this is the law of leprosy .
translation.kha: Kine ki aiñ ki batai shai kumno yn leh haba kaei kaei ka long ka bymkhuid bad haba ka la long khuid .
Ki shalyntem ki thaba kum ki mawkordor , bad kawei pa kawei ka shalyntem ka don sa kawei pat ka shalyntem kaba ïasnohlang ha ka liang ka “mon .
translation.en: And as for their appearances , they four had one likeness , as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel .

translation.kha: ( Isaia 2 :4 ) U Blei un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingleh bymkohnguh badno ki jingjynjar baroh .
translation.en: ( Isaiah 2 :4 ) God will bring an end to all injustice and suffering .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la iehnoh ïa u Paidbah ; ki synran ki la keiñ halor ka lieng ha kaba U Jisu u la lah shong , bad ki la ïalam ïa u bad ki . Kiwei ki lieng jin ki la don hangta .
translation.en: And when they had sent away the multitude , they took him even as he was in the ship . And there were also with him other little ships .

translation.kha: Susah u la ong ha ki , Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka weng ba la plie bad ki angel jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,

translation.en: And he brought also the brasen altar , which was before the  Lord  , from the forefront of the house , from between the altar and the house of the  Lord  , and put it on the north side of the altar .
translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ka don hapdeng ka duwan bathymmai bad ka Templ , te u Ahas u pynkynriah noh ïa ka sha ka bynta bashaneng jong ka duwan bathymmai .

translation.en: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .
translation.kha: Ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa u Lum Hermon , ka Salekah , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh ki pud jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , bad shiteng jong ka Gilead haduh ka ri jong u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon .
Ha shuwa kane , ïa ka Hebron la khat ka nongbah jong U Arba . ( U Arba u la long uba khraw tam nongap ki Anakim ) . Mynta ka anna ka jingsuk ha ka ri .
translation.en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba  ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .

translation.kha: Kine ki nonghikai balamler ki long kiba shlur bad kiba kyr-eit , bad kim pyn-i jingñiewburom ïa ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ; pynban ki krenbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness , and despise government . Presumptuous are they , selfwilled , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities .
Then Peter , turning about , seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following  ; which also leaned on his breast at supper , and said , Lord , which is he that betrayeth thee ?
translation.kha: U Petros u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi hadien jong u ïa uta uwei pat u synran , ïa uba U Jisu u ieit — uta uba la shong shaniah ha U Jisu ha ka jingïabam miet bad uba la kylli ,  Ko Trai , uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa me ?

translation.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol ki la khot lang ïa ka kynhun riewngeit baroh kawei bad ki la ong ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh klet ïa ka jingïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei khnang ban pynïaid ïa ka kam pisa tyngka .
Mynba u ïangat kren , nga la kyllaiñ ha madan khlem tipbriew . Khynñiuh u la batbor ïa nga , u la khyllie pynïeng ïa nga ,
translation.en: Now as he was speaking with me , I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground : but he touched me , and set me upright .

translation.kha: Thoh ha u ruh jong ka balang ha Philadelphia : Kane ka longïing ka khubor na uta uba khuid nabar uba shisha . U don u shabi jrong u Dabid , Bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang , ym don uba lah ban khang ïa ka , bad haba u khang ïa ka , yn ym don uba lah ban plie ïa ka .
translation.en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write  ; These things saith he that is holy , he that is true , he that hath the key of David , he that openeth , and no man shutteth  ; and shutteth , and no man openeth  ;

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki lyngdoh kiba tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kaba bud jong ka kynroh : Ki lyngkhuit kiba dei na ka jaka Sidon ka Jerusalem ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bur ;
translation.en: And after him repaired the priests , the men of the plain .
Likewise the second also , and the third , unto the seventh .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka jingjia ka la wan jia ha u para uba ar , uba lai , bad khatduh ha baroh hynñiew ngut .
Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynoi khunlangbrot jong phi , bad phin phin long ki mraw jong u .
translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .

translation.kha: Naba u ong ha u Dabid Phibi la leh ïa katba dien , bad nga la leh bakla . Phi la lehbha shikatdei eh ïa nga , katba nga pang nga la leh khih katne kaba sniew ïa phi !
translation.en: And he said to David , Thou art more righteous than I : for thou hast rewarded me good , whereas I have rewarded thee evil .
Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth , and it abideth .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaineh jong me ka ïaisah sha ki pateng bynriew baroh ; me la buh pynskhem ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka neh .
kiba sping kabu ïa ki riewkhuid mala ibha knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nala kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyieng !
translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .
translation.kha: U Petros u la leit kylleng kylleng , bad ha kawei ka sien u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki briew jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .
U la plie namar jong ngi ïa ka lynti kiba thymmai , ka lynti kaba im , lyngba kata ka jingkah — kata ka long , lyngba ka met jong u hi .
translation.en: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;

translation.kha: Men thrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh wan phai Shuh .
translation.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .

translation.kha: babha ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa ki briew bakha bha malade rah pynrem ïa kiba lui lui sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U Trai’ u la krung ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ki duriaw-bah ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka shnong jong phi , ka Tyros , la pynjot ; ki ïing bad ka kadlieng jong ka ki don ha ka jingjot . Kumba ki liengbah jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ha ki tymmen ki san kiba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u ,  Hato phi la dei ban ïawan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um shym tam ïa ki syiem kiba la synshar ha Israel ha shuwa jong u .

Ha ka sngi baryngkhiang jong ka Jingkhuid Niam U Kpu Bakhlem thiat , ki synran ki la wan shuh U ijuh bad ki la kylli ïa u , Haneng me khih ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingïohipaw Niam Ka Jingtylli na ka bynta jong me ?
translation.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?
But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlot . Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban u la ïoh ïa baroh ki jingri kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri kiba khlaiñ .
U riewsniew um don ïa ka lawei — ym don ei ei ba un peit sha khmat .
translation.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man  ; the candle of the wicked shall be put out .

My father made me swear , saying , Lo , I die : in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan , there shalt thou bury me . Now therefore let me go up , I pray thee , and bury my father , and I will come again .
translation.kha: ‘ Shuwa ba i pa in ïap , i la pynsmai ïa nga ba ngan leit tep ïa i ha ka jingtep ba i la pynkhreh ha Kanaan . Kumta shah ba ngan leit tep ïa i pa , bad hadien kata ngan sa wan phai pat .’

translation.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ïathuh ha phi — U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi ïa kaei ba un sa leh .

ha kajuh ka kynsi ba ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ka rupa , ka tama , ka nar , ka rem , bad ka tin la buh ha ka ding ban saiñ ïa ki . Ka jingbitar bad jingaibor shla jngai nga kin pynum ïa ki bania ka lumlang ding ka pynmih ïa u mawthew ba pynmih ïa ki .
translation.en: As they gather silver , and brass , and iron , and lead , and tin , into the midst of the furnace , to blow the fire upon it , to melt it  ; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury , and I will leave you there , and melt you .
And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la shah pynbaptis , u la wan kiew noh na ka um . Nangta ïa ka bneng la plie ha u , bad u la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem jong U Blei uba wan hiar kum ka paro bad ka da wan shong halor jong u .
Baroh kaba U Kaba jong nga u don ka long ka jong nga ; na “kata ka daw nga la ong ba U Mynsiem un shim ïa kaei kaba nga ai ha u bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .

But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .
translation.kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kylliang bad wat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïoh ka bainong kaba khraw , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh . Naba u long uba bha ïa u bymsngewnguh bad ïa uba bymman .

translation.en: The depth saith , It is not in me : and the sea saith , It is not with me .
translation.kha: Ki jingjylliew jong ki duriaw-bah bad ki duriaw-rit , ki ong ba ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hangta .

translation.en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .
translation.kha: U nongshun u la kurup ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut . Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .
Ki mradkhlaw ki kitei sha la ki krem .
translation.en: Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry , with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .
translation.kha: Nga la siang pynitynnat ïa ka jingthiah jong nga da ka jaiñ linen bun rong na Ijipt .
Kumta uta uba ïahiar shapoh u longsem ita ujuh kaba leit kiew shaneng , shajrong bad sha lyndet ki bneng , ban pyndap ïa ka pyrthiew baroh khawai da ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
translation.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things . )

translation.kha: Uta naba khot ïa phi un ai ïa kata , namar u long uba ïadih .
translation.en: Faithful is he that calleth you , who also will do it .
If any man defile the temple of God , him shall God destroy ; for the temple of God is holy , which temple ye are .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u pynjot ïa ka templ jong U Blei , U Blei un pynjot ïa u . Naba ka templ jong U Blei ka long kaba khuid , bad phi hi phi long ka templ jong u .

translation.en: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .
translation.kha: U Araunah mar ïa-ïohi ba u Syiem Dabid u wan , u la iehnoh ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad u dem rit , bad la ka khlieh kaba kynduh ha madan .

translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his saltness , wherewith will ye season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and have peace one with another .
translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha ; hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingbang jong ka , kumno phi lah ban pynbang pat ïa ka ?  To don ïa ka mluh jong ka jingïalong paralok hapdeng jong phi , bad para ma phi , to im hapdeng ka jingsuk .
Ka turoi bakhraw kan sawa , bad un phah ïa ki angel jongki u sha ki sawlyer jong ka pyrthei , pun kin lumlang ïa ki briew kiba la lngaid jong u na kawei ka tduh jong ka pynrieh sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ki ka par baroh kawei ka met jong nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh kiba ka ri Ijipt ka la ïoh lehkmen ki la kut , bad ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki la sdang , kumba u Joseph u la lah ong .

Kane ka dei ka jingbatai kambah la ai ha ar : U khrawburom uba saw u dei ka hylla kaba saw ka ban don ha ka pyrthei dara kan long kaba phira na kiwei! pat ki hima . Kan pynlwet ïa ka pyrthei baher Kawei bad tud kyrdem ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus he said , The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth , which shall be diverse from all kingdoms , and shall devour the whole earth , and shall tread it down , and break it in pieces .

translation.kha: To kylla-kaba-mut , te , na kane ka jingthmu bymman jong me , bad duwai ha U Trai ba un map ïa me na kaba pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kane .
translation.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .

translation.kha: Dang pha phyrngab man ka step baïar ki briew ki la leit sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .
translation.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
Thy men shall fall by the sword , and thy mighty in the war .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah jong ka nongbah , ho-oid wat ki rangbah bakhlaiñ tam , yn pynïap ha ka thma .
Bad u la wan poi sha Damaskos slem bun ka kun na ki rangbah lyngdoh ïa-ban kem ïa baroh kiba mane ïa me .
translation.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .
That the saying might be fulfilled , which he spake ,  Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane khnang ba ïa kaei kaba u la lah ong kan urlong shisha :  Ko Pa , ngam shym la duh noh wat uwei ruh na kita ïa kiba me la ai ha nga .  )

translation.en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
translation.kha: Shet ïa nga kum kato ka jingbam bang kaba nga ju sngewtynnat , bad wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh shuwa ba ngan ïap .

translation.en: Behold , the eyes of the Lord  God  are upon the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth  ; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga khmih ïa kane ka hima Israel kaba pop , bad ngan pynjot ïa ka na sla khyndew . Hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .

translation.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai noh ïa nga ha ki briew kiba sniew .
Bakhraw kiba kum kita ki un-long tang ka syrngiew jong kiei kiei ha ka lawei ; ka jingshisha ka long U Khrist .
translation.en: Which are a shadow of things to come ; but the body is of Christ .

translation.kha: Te mynta , ma nga , U Trai , nga ong ba phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglaitluid ïa la ki to Israel . Kumta te , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jinglaitluid ban ïap da ka thma , ka jingpang , bad ka jingïapthngan . Ngan pynlong ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ban sngewshyrkhei ïa kaei kaba nga bor ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi biang ba u Elkanah pynlang kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki leit biang sha Shiloh ban kynsha ka jingainguh kaba men ka snem ha U Trai , bad ban ai ka jingkohnguh kyrpang ba u la kyllum .
translation.en: And the man Elkanah , and all his house , went up to offer unto the  Lord  the yearly sacrifice , and his vow .
And I will make Jerusalem heaps , and a den of dragons  ; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ka thup ki jingpra , ka jaka ha kaba ki myrsiang ki shong ; ki nongbah ka Judah kin kylla ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong ba sah .

Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kyllaiñ Kane ka ri khlaw . Namar ba phi la khnai pynshisha ïa ar , yn ym don nawei ruh na phi babha la palat arphew snem ka rta u ba ïohbor sha kata ka ri .
translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,

translation.kha: ‘ Kine ki briew Ibbah la shad khot bylla khatduh ki la thir tieng shu kynta ,’ ki la ong , ‘ katba ïa im la buh ha ka kam baher shi sngi ha ka jingshit ka snieh — pynban me siew ïa ki kyiuh kumba me la thret ïa ngi !’
translation.en: Saying , These last have wrought but one hour , and thou hast made them equal unto us , which have borne the burden and heat of the day .

translation.kha: Ym don na kino kino ki rangbah nongsynshar bakha na kata ka jaka Ibbah la tip saihon ba nga la longing bad kaei kaba nga la leh . Haduh kata ka por , ngam pat shym la ong ei ei ïadon ïano ruh na ka para Jiw jong nga — ki lyngkhuit , ki nongïalam , ki pynbah synshar , lap ma mane ruh u ban ïashim bynta ha ka kam .
translation.en: And the rulers knew not whither I went , or what I did  ; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews , nor to the priests , nor to the nobles , nor to the rulers , nor to the rest that did the work .

translation.kha: San ngut na ki , ki la long kiba bieit , bad san ngat kiwei pat ki la longsyiem kiba stad .
translation.en: And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .

translation.kha: Ynda u Abda u la wan phai shwa Siklag , u phah ai bynta na kata ka marjan lute shat ki paralok jong u , ki nongïalam ka Judah , bad ka khohruh , Kane ka jingai sngewbiang ïa phin na ka jinglute ba ngi la shim na ki nongsuhjaiñ U Trai .
translation.en: And when David came to Ziklag , he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the  Lord   ;

translation.kha: Kumta haba U balui u la phah noh ïa per na ka ïing u kpa Jong nga sha ki ri nongïoh , nga nguh ha ka , ‘ Pa lah ban pyn-i haduh kattne phai shane ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa iwei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jong pha .’
translation.en: And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .

translation.kha: Lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pynjrong ban khring noh ïa phi na U Trai U Blei jongu phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki ngor .
translation.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha Phin ïa kane , U Jisu u la bynrap , ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju pdiang sngewbha ha la ka shnong .
translation.en: And he said ,  Verily I say unto you , No prophet is accepted in his own country .

And to love him with all the heart , and with all the understanding , and with all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbour as himself , is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices .
translation.kha: Bad u briew u dei ban ieit ïa U Blei da ka dohnud jong u baroh bad da ka jingmut jong u baroh bad da ka bor jong u baroh ; bad u dei ban ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba u ieit ïa lade . Ka long kaba kham donkam ban kohnguh ïa kine ki ar tylli ki hukum ban ïa kaba ai jingainguh da ki mrad bad kiwei ki jingkñia sha U Blei .

Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bun ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi! sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pyningkhong ïa phi ba phin kam lynti ïa la ka khlieh bad phna phong ka jaiñ ïajan , malade phin long kum ki kmie ki kpu kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kane long kaweh kthang haduh kabu kut .
translation.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .

translation.kha: Katba phi ki Lyngdoh pa nang ïabun , katta phi nang kun nongpop pyrthuh ïa nga ; dara kumta kun pynkylla ïa ka burom jong phi sha ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: As they were increased , so they sinned against me : therefore will I change their glory into shame .
Let such an one think this , that , such as we are in word by letters when we are absent , such will we be also in deed when we are present .
translation.kha: To ai ba kum uta u briew un sngewthuh ba kam don ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba ngi thoh ha ki shithi jong ngi haba ngi don sha jngai bad ïa kaei kaba ngin leh haba ngi don markhmat bad phi .

translation.en: Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,
translation.kha: Ngi la pynlut kham bun ka por hangta , tad ynda ka la long kaba ma ban bteng ïa ka jingleit da ka lieng , naba mynta ka Sngi ka Jingsiewspah ka la dep . Kumta u Paul u la ai ïa kane ka jingai jingmut ha ki :
U Blei u la leh ki kaweh kiba kham phiah lyngba u Paul .
translation.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul :

Is it not wheat harvest to day ? I will call unto the  Lord  , and he shall send thunder and rain  ; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great , which ye have done in the sight of the  Lord  , in asking you a king .
translation.kha: Mynta ka dei ka aïom rang ryngkhiang , ym dei ? Hynrei ngan duwai , bad U  Trai  un phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap . Haba kane ka wan jia , phin sa sngewthuh haduh katno phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba phi pan syiem na u .
Hynrei Shen ka lyer kaba jur — kata kaba la khot ka lyer jingpynlehnoh-ei — ka la Beh na ka dewlynnong .
translation.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .

translation.kha: Haba ka jingmaïan ka la poi , U Jisu u la don hangta marwei ; bad tah kane ka por ka lyngba ka la ni jngai ha ka duriaw , ba la kynting shane shatai da ki jingat phyllung , namar ba ka lyer ka la beh pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .

translation.kha: U la shem ba u Jakob u la khunlung ïa la u kpu bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Asa u shim lut ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar barabor kiba ïan sah ha ka templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ban rah ha la ki rangbah synshar sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , u khun jong u Abarim dara u ksiew jong u Hesion , lema bad kane ka khubor :
translation.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and delivered them into the hand of his servants : and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad , the son of Tabrimon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,

translation.kha: ki la leit ïaleh tmoh pyrshah ïa ki san ngut kiwei pat ki syiem : u Bera jongngi ka Sodom , u Birsha jong ka Gomorrah , u Shinab jong ka Admah , u Shemeber jong ka Seboiim , bad u syiem jong ka Bela ( lieng Soar ) .
translation.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom , and with Birsha king of Gomorrah , Shinab king of Admah , and Shemeber king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela , which is Zoar .
The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !

Bad nga la ïohi ïa kiba ïap , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ïeng ha khmat jong ka khet . Ïa ki kitab la slap , Bad nangta la plied sa kawei pat ka kitab , ka kitab jong kiba im . Ïa kiba ïap la bishar kat kum katei kaba ki la leh , Rumah la bah jingthoh ha ki kitab .
translation.en: And I saw the dead , small and great , stand before God  ; and the books were opened : and another book was opened , which is the book of life : and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books , according to their works .

translation.kha: Pynban ïa ki briew jong ka Thebes la rhah noh sha ka jinglongmraw . Ha kawei pa kawei ka kyndong jong ka lynti bah ïa ki khun jong ki la tied pynïap . Ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki la ïalam noh ha ki kynjri bad la pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongkurup .
translation.en: Yet was she carried away , she went into captivity : her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets : and they cast lots for her honourable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .

translation.kha: Haba ki riewngeit ki la ïohsngew ïa kata , baroh ki la ïashad lang ha ka jingduwai sha U Bela : Ko Kynrad bad ko Nongthaw ïa ka bneng , ka pyrthei , bad ka dur , bad ïa baroh kaba dat ha ki !
translation.en: And when they heard that , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord , and said , Lord , thou art God , which hast made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all that in them is :

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , kito kiba kwah ïa u Ophir ki la jop ; u Tibni u la ïaphah bad u Omri u la long u syiem .
translation.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath : so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .
And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka nong Magdala bad ka Mari ka kmie u Josis ki la khmih bad ïohi hangno ba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lah ban kiew na ka jingduk ban long u syiem jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban leit na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long uba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka jingaibuit , um long uba kham bha kum u samla uba duk hynrei uba shemphang .
Mynta , nga thung ïa me u lat Halor ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Uwei pat u bariew , uba la long u synran , u la ong , Ko Kyntait , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit phai bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .
translation.en: And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification .
translation.kha: Pynban , ma ngi baroh , ngi dei ban pynsngewbha ïa ki parabangeit jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki , khnang ban tei ïa ki ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .
translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
U Trai u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Uto uno uba tem ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie un shah pynïap ; u la kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death : he hath cursed his father or his mother  ; his blood shall be upon him .

translation.kha: Ngi la ai ha phi ïa ki hukum bapyrkhing ba-bang ym hikai ha ka kyrthat jong une u briew , u la ong ; hynñiew peit kaei kaba phi la leh ! Phi la pynphriang ïa ka jinghikai jong phi kylleng ka Jeruel , bad phi kwah ban pynlong ïa ngi kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u !
translation.en: Saying , Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name ? and , behold , ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine , and intend to bring this man s blood upon us .

When thou shalt besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them : for thou mayest eat of them , and thou shalt not cut them down ( for the tree of the field is man s life ) to employ them in the siege :
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaleh ban knieh ïa kano kano ka shnong , wat pom ïa ki diengsoh jong ka , wat lada phi kerkut slem ïa ka . Bam ïa u soh , hynrei wat pynjot ïa ki diengsoh , naba kim dei ki nongshun jong phi .
Bad ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingsyiem haduh ka sngi ba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken : and he was there when Jerusalem was taken .
And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
translation.kha: Ïa ki um la kad arliang , bad ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba kita ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha baroh arliang .
Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular skhem ba-bang ai ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob ; bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka nongkynti jyllang phi hi . Nga long U Trai .’
translation.en: And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob  ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the  Lord .
And Samuel said , What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears , and the lowing of the oxen which I hear ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u kylli ,  Balei te , ba nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingpah ki masi bad ki langbrot ?
Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ñiut umbah la leh kum u paramarjan ïa u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?
translation.en: Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?

translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi uba long u kpa un ai ïa la u ïakhun da u maw haba u pan ïa u kdup ?
translation.en: Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?

translation.kha: Thaw ruh ar tylliat ïa ki shrong ksaiñ ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold  ;

translation.kha: To pynkyntang ïa ki sha lade da kata ka jingshisha ; ka ktien jong me ka long ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Sanctify them through thy truth : thy word is truth .

translation.kha: Suk kito naba ïanguh tad haduh ba ki shajrong laispah laiphew saiñ sngi ki kut noh !
translation.en: Blessed is he that waiteth , and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days .

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la pynriewspah ïa la ka longïng da kaei kaba phi la Shim da kaba leh jubor , bad Phin la pyrshang banbeiñ pynlong ïa la ka ïing kaba lait na ki jingpynmynsaw bad jingmad !
translation.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !
Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashabar jong u lane pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kaba u phong .
Ki briew ki ïai-ong ha nga , Hangno kito ki jingbyrngem kiba U Trai’ u la pynlong pyrshah ïa ngi ? To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !
translation.en: Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .

translation.kha: U Blei u phuh ïa u slap ban ai um ïa ka khñiot ; u lah ban phah ïa u ban pynsum ïa ngi , lane ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u .
translation.en: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Namar pha la klet ïa nga bad pha phai dadien ïa nga , phan sa shahshitom na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children s of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïapher ïa ki jingri jong ki Israel na ki jong ki nong Ijipt , bad kumta yn ym don wat kawei ruh ka jingri ki Israel ka ban ïap noh .
Un bat ïa ka jingïakynduh ba u la pynlong bad u Abraham bad ïa ka Kular bad u Isaak .
translation.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham , and his oath unto Isaac  ;

translation.kha: u khun jong u Serug , u khun jong u Rah , u khup jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Shelah ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .
translation.kha: Ka ryntieh u Jonathan ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka waitlam u Saul ka long ka bym don jingisynei , Ka pynkhyllem ïa kiba khlaiñbor , ka da pynïap ïa ki nongshun .
Mano ba la rai haduh katno kan heh ? Mano ba ring ksai halor jong ka ? Hato me tip ïa ki jubab baroh ?
translation.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof , if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it ?

translation.kha: hynñiew haba ki Jiw ha Thessaloni ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul u la ïalap ïa ka kti U Blei ha Beria ruh , ki la ïawan sharati bad ki la sdang ban pynkhih badno pynbunkam ïa u paidbhur .
translation.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne nga , Kaba u Sennakherib bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang don ha Lakhish , u Pha ïa kñia ka khubor sha u Hesekaïah bad sha ki pyllut Judah kiba ïalang don bad u ha Jerusalem :
translation.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem , ( but he himself laid siege against Lachish , and all his power with him , ) unto Hezekiah king of Judah , and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngi dei kiei bad balei ngi ïalap paidïapom ïa ki jingngeit jong ngi ?
translation.en: Who really are we , and why do we publicly share our beliefs ?
When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem–melech , and their men , to pray before the  Lord  ,

translation.en: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .

translation.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour  ; and love no false oath : for all these are things that I hate , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .

Ha ka sngi kaba khyndew ïalumlang ban mane blem , malu wat treikam ei ei .
translation.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work .

translation.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la bynta jaka ïa ki jaitbynriew ; u la buh hangno ki briew kin shong . U la ai uwei u blei ïa kawei kawei ka jaitbynriew ,

translation.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .
And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .

translation.en: But what saith it ? The word is nigh thee , even in thy mouth , and in thy heart : that is , the word of faith , which we preach ;

translation.kha: U khublei jongnga da ki khmat jongu .
translation.en: He thanked me with his eyes .

translation.kha: Haba uba bieit u phoi , u pynpaw kumne kumta ba yn tip . Ki biria kiba sian kim patiaw ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .
translation.en: A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .

U ong ruh ba phi! thmu ban pynlong ïa put u syiem
translation.en: Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .

translation.kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wan sha Israel , bad ki ïathuh kumno U Trai U Blei jongki ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta katai kaba ki nongmih bamaïan ki la leh ïa ka Templ jongu u . )
translation.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .

translation.en: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,

translation.en: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names : for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar  ; and to Hananiah , of Shadrach  ; and to Mishael , of Meshach  ; and to Azariah , of Abed–nego .

translation.kha: Ki briew na baroh ki hylla , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , malu ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki mawtylliat jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep ïa ki .
translation.en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .

translation.en: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta , ko por jong nga , sngewbha ïa-ban leh ïa kane na ka byndi U Trai ; khem u para ha u khriat , to pynkmen ïa nga !
translation.en: Yea , brother , let me have joy of thee in the Lord : refresh my bowels in the Lord .

translation.kha: Mynno na ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri babha la ju pyllait ïa la ka ri na u patsha jongngi ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynong ïa phi ba pyrkhat ba U Trai’ u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerahmeel ?

translation.en: And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .

translation.en: Prove all things ; hold fast that which is good .

ki khyllai bad ka khlei kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai kad jngai u dohnud .

translation.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the  Lord  of all your tithes , which ye receive of the children of Israel  ; and ye shall give thereof the  Lord s  heave offering to Aaron the priest .

translation.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts , not to meditate before what ye shall answer :

translation.en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .
