translation.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .

translation.kha: Ha ki hukum jongki u Sargon , u patsha jongu ka Assyria , u rangbah ai hukum bahakhlieh tam jong ka kynhun shipai Kaisaria u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashdod ka nongbah Philistia .
translation.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod , ( when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him , ) and fought against Ashdod , and took it  ;
Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim un ïoh ïa ka .
Nga ai jingsuk ïa baher , ïa kiba hajan bad ïa kiba sha jing-jngai ! Ngan pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: I create the fruit of the lips  ; Peace , peace to him that is far off , and to him that is near , saith the  Lord   ; and I will heal him .

translation.kha: Ka ri ka don ha ka jingjynjar haba u syiem jong ka u dei u samla bad ki nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh shi miet .
translation.en: Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !

translation.kha: baroh kiba mane bleithaw kyang shah pynlehrain , baroh ki plie ki den-um ngon ha khmat jong U Trai .
translation.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .

And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam ïa u Joash shabar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ ba pynïaid ïa ka jinglong syiem . Nangta ïa u Joash la pynsleh syiem bad la pynbna kum u syiem . Ki paidbah ki thab ïa la ki kti bad ki ïarisa ,  Im slem ko syiem !

translation.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there , neither his disciples , they also took shipping , and came to Capernaum , seeking for Jesus .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba U Jisu ne ki synran jong u kim don hangta , ki la kiew ha kita ki lieng bad ki la leit sha Kapernam ban wad ïa u .

translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .
translation.kha: Nangta u mihnoh bad u wan ïalam sa hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem wat kiba kham sniew ban ïa u , bad ki wan shongsah hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la kut , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang . Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew kiba sniew jong kane ka por .

translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .
translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jia , khnang ba ngin lah ban ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don uba la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong ïa kata .

translation.en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei jong me lane ki aiñ jong ka hima , ïa u dei ban pynshitom mardor : da ka jingïap lane da ka jingringmraw lane da kaba knieh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lane da ka jingset byndi .

translation.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki Edom kim shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka hima jong ki , ki Israel ki la phai noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka lynti .

translation.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men , whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , out of every tribe a man :
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kiba u la jied ,
Baroh ka la jia ruma u Joseph u la lah ong .
translation.en: But he hanged the chief baker : as Joseph had interpreted to them .

translation.kha: Nga la skhem ïa kaei kaei kaba kham khnang ban ïa ka jingdap — ka kynoi kaba longïing kum ka jingriam . Ka jingibieit ba ka ai ïa phi kan jam ïa phi kum ka balang , bad ki kti jong ka sawdong jong phi kin bat ïa phi Kum u kynjri . U briew uba pynkohnguh ïa U Blei u Lah ban lait , hynrei kan kumta ïa u nongpynjot .
translation.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .

translation.kha: Te kaba kut kan poi ; U Khrist un jop noh thiaw ïa ki bor mynsiem , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor , bad un aiti ïa ka Hoham ha U Blei’ umbah U Kaba .
translation.en: Then cometh the end , when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God , even the Father ; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power .

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel u la theh kynroh ïa ka Shong Shekhem kabu ha ri lum Ephraim bad u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shnong Penuel .
translation.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .

translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi ki long ki shiphew ngat ki syiemsad ki bym pat shym la sdang pun synshar , hynrei ki ban sa ïoh ka iathuh ban synshar Kum ki syiem tang shi kynta bad u mradkhlaw .
translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings , which have received no kingdom as yet  ; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast .

translation.kha: Hangne ka don kaei kadei ka shyieng kaba nga la ïohi ha ka pyrthei : Ki bynriew ki lah ban bat tang shipor ïa la ka pisa haba ki kah ïa-ban donburom ïa ka ,
translation.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .

translation.kha: Ma pa te , kiba bam tang ki jarjar — balei phi bishar ïa la u parabangeit ? Susah ma phi kiba bam ïa kiei ktieh baroh — balei phi pynbit ïa la u parabangeit ? Baroh na ngi , ngin hap ban ïeng ha khmat U Blei! ban shah shrah da u .
translation.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .

translation.kha: U syiem bad ki ngab synshar ki la sngewtynnat ïa kata ka jingai jingmut , bad u syiem u la leh ïa kaei kaba u Memukan u la ai jingdam .
translation.en: And the saying pleased the king and the princes  ; and the king did according to the word of Memucan :
That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
translation.kha: Me ai ha u ïa ka jingjahthait na ki sngi ka jingjynjar haduh ban da tih ïa ka tliew ban ngat u bymman .
Ha ki jaka babha jong ki nongjop , ki Langbrot kin bam phlang Bad ki blang samla kin shem ka jaka bam pynphalang .
translation.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner , and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat .

translation.kha: Lada phi har kumta , U Trai un khie bitar ïa phi . Un khang khop ïa u slap , bad ka khynwin jongki phi kan tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin ym mih shuh . Te phin sa ïan shen hangta , wat la kata ka khyndew kaba u ai ha phi ka long kaba seisoh .
translation.en: And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .

translation.kha: bad shi kilo u phetwir lem bad iwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
translation.kha: U Judas bad u Silas , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
Na ka bynta jong ki u kynmaw ïa ka jutang jong u , bad Namar ka jingieit bakhraw jongno u , u la kli jingmut .
translation.en: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .

And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka la phah khot ïa u Barak u khun jong u Abinoam na ka nongbah Kedesh kaba ha Naphtali bad ka ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha me ïa kane ka hukum : ‘ Shim shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali bad Sebulun bad ïalam ïa ki sha u Lum Tabor .

translation.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel  ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum ïa baroh ki nongwei baroh kiba shong basah ha Ri Israel ban ïalumlang , bad u pyntrei ïa ki . Katto katne na ki , ki shna ïa ki mawkynroh ban tei ïa ka Templ .
Wat kwah rhah ïa ka ïing u paramarjan jong phi ; wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong u , lane ïa ki mraw jong u , lane ïa ki masi jong u , lano ïa ki kai jong u , lane ïa kaei katei ruh kaba dei ka jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s house , thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s wife , nor his manservant , nor his maidservant , nor his ox , nor his ass , nor any thing that is thy neighbour s .
Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .
translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . To sngap ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .
Ki la klim bad pynnep bri — Kaba klim bun ki bleithaw bad ka jingpynïap ïa ki khun kiba la kha na ka pynbha jong sa . Ki kñia ïa ki khun jong nga ha ki bleithaw lad ki .
translation.en: That they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands , and with their idols have they committed adultery , and have also caused their sons , whom they bare unto me , to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .
And there was a man of mount Ephraim , whose name was Micah .
translation.kha: Shisien la don u briew uba kyrteng u Mikah , uba shong ha ri lum Ephraim .

U ong ha lade , Ngan ai ïa ka Mikhal ha u Nadab : ngan pyndonkam ïa ka Ban riat ïa u , pynlang un sa shiah pynïap ha ki Philistia . Kumta ha ka sien kaba ar u Samuel u ong ha u Dabid , Leit sa long u pyrem kurim jong nga .
translation.en: And Saul said , I will give him her , that she may be a snare to him , and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Wherefore Saul said to David , Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit kiew na Ekron sha ki lum ka Hebron , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Bad ki la kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , unto Hebron  ; and they fought against it :

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kyntait ïa ka jingïathmu jong U Blei na ka byndi jong ki hi bad ki la kyntait ba-bang Shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .
translation.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .

translation.kha: Thung lada phi la sngapjar ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jin da la tuid ha phi kum ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingot kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung kiba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .
translation.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :

translation.kha: U patsha u ong ïa u ban rai ïa ki nabar pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem’ bad ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .
translation.en: And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit kiew ïa u Lumlang Sinai , bad u lyoh u klop ïa uta u lum .
translation.en: And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .

translation.kha: Em kynrad , ngap shym buhnud ka la jubab . Ngam shym dih ! Nga jynjar saiñdur bad nga ïan duwai bun khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad dang pathaw phyrngab ph ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , namar ba ka suiñbneng ka saw bad ka dum .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jingweng ka sngewbishni da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , hynrei phim lah Ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad kine ki por !
translation.en: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?

translation.kha: Ki briew ki pynkynriah ïa ki mawpud ban kurup jaka shuh ; ki tuh ïa ki langbrot bad buh ïa ki ha la ki jong ki kynhun jong ki .
translation.en: Some remove the landmarks  ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .
And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them  ; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Balaam ,  Wat leit bad ki , bad wat buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel , namar ki don ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga .

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Rise up , Balak , and hear  ; hearken unto me , thou son of Zippor :
translation.kha: bad u Balaam u kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ale , ko Balak u khun jong u Sippor , Bad sngap aïu nga don ban ong .
Kumno ngin pynshitom ïa u ? Phi ap khmih ïa ka kabu ban tur ïaleh ïa ar ,
translation.en: But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?
I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot khoit ïa ki .

Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa Uta u jingruma , Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong ïa phi ! U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u meeting , bujli ïa nga . U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .

translation.kha: dei ma u , kaba pynjlan ïa ngi ban shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaban khlem kynthup ïa ka hukum ba la thoin hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka hukum ba la thok ka wallam ïa ka jingdap , hynrei U Mynsiem u ai jingim .
translation.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .
And there were set there six waterpots of stone , after the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three firkins apiece .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki don ki aiñ shaphang ka jinglehniam haba sait pynkhuid , bad na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu la don hynriew tylli ki khra-maw buh um , uwei uwei u ngiam kumba shispah litar ka um .
To duwai ha U Tiras ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kyllum ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donkam ban dang sah shuh hangne .
translation.en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka jingpynjot ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kan long kaba da shyrkhei haduh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad sheptieng .
U Isaïah u duwai ha U Trai , bad U Trai u pyningkhong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Ahas .
translation.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
Let a little water , I pray you , be fetched , and wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree :
translation.kha: Shah ngan wanrah khyndiat ka um ba phin ïoh sait ïa ki kjat jong phi ; phi lah ban shong jahthait ha trai jong une u dieng .
Men shu peit sad men ïohi kumno ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .
translation.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel was there , according to the vision that I saw in the plain .
translation.kha: Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ kaba pyn-i ïa ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka haba nga don harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jong u ba kata ka prum ka long kumjuh bad kam shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .

Kin pynjot thiaw ïa pha pynlang ïa ki bariew kiba khoh ki kynrup jong pha ; yn ym pynsah wat uwei ruh u miaw ha ka jaka ba u don , namar ba pham shym ithuh ïa ka por mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa pha !
translation.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee  ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another  ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .

translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki lane nabar ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .
Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap ba ngan ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .
U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asekah , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Bethsur distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kabu bud haduh ka jingtap u Dabid , ka pung pynlang tare sah shipai .
translation.en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .

translation.kha: Ïa ka waitlam jong u yn tap da ka snam bad ka khleiñ jyllang ki , kum ka snam bad ka khleiñ jongki ki langbrot bad ki blang ïa kaba la kñia . U Troas un pynlong ïa kane ka jingkñia ha ka nongpang Borabor ; un pynhieng ïa ken ka jingpynïap bakhraw ha ka ri ki Edom .
translation.en: The sword of the  Lord  is filled with blood , it is made fat with fatness , and with the blood of lambs and goats , with the fat of the kidneys of rams : for the  Lord  hath a sacrifice in Bozrah , and a great slaughter in the land of Edom .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jong , Da kumta , te , siew Sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Bel .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar s , and unto God the things which be God s .

And the king said , And where is thy master s son ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he abideth at Jerusalem : for he said , To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father .
translation.kha: Shaei u Mephibosheth u ksiew jong u Saul , u kynrad jong me ?  u syiem u kylli ïa u .  U sah ha Jerusalem ,  u Siba u la jubab ,  namar ba u la sngewthikna ba ki Israel mynta kin pynïoh pat ha u ïa ka hima jong u Saul , u kparad jong u .
Wat kyntait ïa nga mynta ba nga la tymmen ; kam iehnoh ïa nga myntri ba nga la tlot .
translation.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age  ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .

Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .
translation.kha: Ïarap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U  Trai  un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u la leh ïa phi hangne . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai sha kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: O  Lord  God , to whom vengeance belongeth  ; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth , shew thyself .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei uba pynshitom ; to pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong me !
Baroh kiba ju ïaid narud ki lyngkha jong phi ki la ïohi ba kumno ba la san jrong bad ba la iehnoh khlaw ïa ki , hynrei Ngan shah ba phyrnai wer biang ha ki .
translation.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled , whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ki borbah kin ïarah ïa la ki sdien , kin pynlang ïa ki dieng khadar kiba itynnat bad kin kren ïa ki ha ka ding .
translation.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .

translation.kha: Ka longsyiem da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïuh la pynlong na kiei ka bymlah ban ïohi .
translation.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .

And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold , Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him , with a couple of asses saddled , and upon them two hundred loaves of bread , and an hundred bunches of raisins , and an hundred of summer fruits , and a bottle of wine .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la jam kham sha khmat na ka kliar lum , u la ïakynduh kynsan ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Mephibosheth , uba la don bad u shi jur ki kada kiba kit arspah tylli ki kpu , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , shispah tylli ki rynjup soh ba dang shu kheit , bad kawei ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain .
translation.kha: Shisha , ka niam kam pynriewspah palat ïa u briew , lada u sngewhun bad kaei kaba u don .
Ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatsan ba u Asaph u long syiem .
translation.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .

translation.kha: U Timothi , u para nongïatrei jong nga , u phah ïa phi ki jingkhublei ; bad kumjuh ruh u Lukios , u Jason , bad u Sosipater kiba longïing ki para Jiw .
translation.en: Timothy my workfellow , and Lucius , and Jason , and Sosipater , my kinsmen , salute you .

translation.kha: U Abib u jubab , Don sa utai , u Mikaïah u khun Jong u Ithlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u , namar um ju ïathuhlypa ïa ka ba shaphang jong nga , badonbor ka dei tangba ïa kaba sniew suda . Phim dei Ban ong kumta ! U Joseph u jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , Micaiah the son of Imlah , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .

translation.kha: Nangta , kumba U Trai u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk ba nga la thaw — badno ki dang don hangta naduh kata ka por .
translation.en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .
translation.kha: Ki la phai stet sawdong hynrei kim shym la ïohi ïano ïano pat ; tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
Pynban , un ong , ‘ Ngam dien u nongïathuhlypa . Nga long u nongrep — nga la rep ha ka khynñiat baroh shi bta ka jingim jong nga .’
translation.en: But he shall say , I am no prophet , I am an husbandman  ; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , de hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba beit . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba shukor ïa u . Wat lehbeiñ ne banbeiñ ïa ki nongwei , ki khunswet , ne ki riewkynthei , bad wat pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ha kane ka jaka kaba khiah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute ye judgment and righteousness , and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor : and do no wrong , do no violence to the stranger , the fatherless , nor the widow , neither shed innocent blood in this place .
Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still : remember the  Lord  afar off , and let Jerusalem come into your mind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u kiba don ha Babilonia :  Phi la lait na ka jingïap ! Mynta to leit ! Wat ap ! Wat la phi don jngai na ïing , pyrkhat shaphang jong nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad kynmaw ïa ka Jerusalem .
Ha kata ka ri ba phiah ïohkynti , pynjot ïa ki jaka baroh ha kiba ki briew ki mane ïa ki Blei jong ki ha ki lum kiba jingsarong , ha ki lumrit , bad hapoh ki dieng kiba jyrngam .
translation.en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places , wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods , upon the high mountains , and upon the hills , and under every green tree :

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ha kawei ka sngur haba u Joseph u leit rung shapoh ïing ba-bang trei ïa la ka kam , aiwai ruh na ki sharak Ïing um don .
translation.en: And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei u briew u la wan rung shahïap bad u la ong ha ki , To shahshkor ! Ki briew kiba pa la buh ha bymdei ki don ha ka Templ , ki da shuki ïa ki paidbah !
translation.en: Then came one and told them , saying , Behold , the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple , and teaching the people .

translation.kha: Kenan ka long kaba la leh da U Trai ; A haduh katno ka long kaei kaei kaba iphylla !’
translation.en: This was the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
And Solomon s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour , and threescore measures of meal ,
translation.kha: Ki jingbam ba U Solomon u donkam man ka sngi ki long san hajar kilo u  purew bad shiphew hajar kilo ka jingbam ;

translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ka jingkhrew , da ka khieshoh , da ka jingat thung , bad da ka jingshit kyr-ang ; un phah ruh ïa ka jingryngkhiang , ki lyer khluit , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi haduh ba phin da ïap .
Bad ym don uno uno uba la ju leit kew sha bneng lait tang U Khun U Briew , uba la wan hiar na bneng .
translation.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Mihnoh na kane ka Jaka bad leit shemphang mihngi , malu leit rakhe ïa lade hajan ka wahduid Kiriath , kaba shiah jongngi jong ka Jordan .
translation.en: Get thee hence , and turn thee eastward , and hide thyself by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .

translation.kha: Pynjngai ïa lade na kum kata ka briew , wat ju leit tur sha jan ka jingkhang ka ïing jong ka .
translation.en: Remove thy way far from her , and come not nigh the door of her house :

translation.kha: Aiñ me pyrkhat ba me jingibeiñ Bad krenbeiñ ? Me la leh bymsuidñiew ïa nga , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel .
translation.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .
translation.kha: Nga la klet noh kaba kumno ka jingkhiah bad ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen ki long .

translation.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now , I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ,  Nga shong hangne ha ka ïing ba la tei da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei pat la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
Ki briew na ki ri bajngai ki la ïohi Kaei ba nga la leh ; ki da sheptieng bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Kumba ki la ïalumlang baroh bad ki ïawad .
translation.en: The isles saw it , and feared  ; the ends of the earth were afraid , drew near , and came .

translation.kha: Ha kaei ka sngi katba ngi dang ïaleit sha ka jaka mudui , kawei ka shakri samla kaba la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlah ïa ka ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka ban sa wan , ka la ïakynduh ïa ngi . Ka la kamai bun ka pisa na ka bynta ki trai jong ka da kaba batai kupar .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as we went to prayer , a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us , which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying :

translation.kha: Ngan shah katto katne ngut na ki ban wai im na ka thma , ka nemsniew , bad na ki jingpang , khnang ba hangta hateng ki jaitbynriew kin sngewthuh haduh kano kiba ijli ki long ki jingleh jong ki bad kmen pyngkiang ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence  ; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad ïa u Horem bad u Elieser ki ar ngut ki khur shynrang jong ka . ( U mawshun u la ïa-ong , Ang long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwei ; kumta u la jer kylleng ïa uwei na ki u Heshmon .
translation.en: And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :

translation.kha: Ki pynkhih ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sneng , Naamah la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam ryngkat bad u .
translation.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u don ha ka jingdih ; u ïadait ha ka bad um tip shano u leit , Namarba ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa u .
translation.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .

translation.kha: myntor , ko Job , ïasuk noh bad U Blei bad sangeh noh na kaba pynlong ïa u kum u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .

translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong shaphang u syiem uba synshar ïa ka hima kaba u Dabid u la synshar bad shaneng ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , kata , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah nong kum ki koidi lem bad phi .
translation.en: Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;

translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad kiba kum kita ki briew .
translation.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .

translation.kha: U ong ha la u kpa , Pa , ym dei kumno . Une uba nyngkong ; buh ïa ka kti kamon jongnga phi ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , Not so , my father : for this is the firstborn  ; put thy right hand upon his head .

translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingsneng ba don ha ka Baibl lai wanrah ka jingman ha ka jingshong kurim bad ha jinglehburom ïalade . —1 Kordit 6 :18 .
translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) Applying God’s counsel found in the Bible also promotes happiness in marriage and self-respect .—1 Corinthians 6 :18 .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khereth . Hato len smat noh shi lyngkhot na ka kun U Khristan bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka nuti ? Kam lah ban long!
translation.en: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .

translation.kha: Hangne ha khmat U Trai un thang ïa kata ka jingiwbih , ba-halor ka ding bad ka tdem jong kata ka jingiwbih kan kah ïa ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang ktang ba un ym ïohi ïa ka bad u ïaw .
translation.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the  Lord  , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony , that he die not :
Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .
translation.kha: Uei u ban ym pyndonburom ïa me , u syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ? Me dei hok ban ïoh ka pyndonburom . Ym don mano mano uba kum ma me hapdeng ki riewstad baroh jong ki jaitbynriew lane napdeng uno uno u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: So we boiled my son , and did eat him : and I said unto her on the next day , Give thy son , that we may eat him : and she hath hid her son .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la shet ïa u khun jong nga , bad ngi la bam ïa u . Ha ka sngi kaba bud , nga ong ha ka ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong ka , hynrei ka la buhrieh ïa u !
Da satar bha te , ban ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Sawdong ïa ka khiat , la don arphew saw thyllah kiwei patan ki khet , ha kaba la shongneh arphew saw jrut ki nongsharai balang kiba la riam da kaba lieh malade phrung ki pansngiat ksiar .
translation.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .
Therefore did my heart rejoice , and my tongue was glad  ; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope :
translation.kha: Bad kumta la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen , bad ki kyntien jong nga ki dap da ka jingkmen . Bad ma nga , la nga long tang u briew , ngan ym khuslai ha ka jingkyrmen ,

translation.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
translation.kha: Nangta shim ïa uwei na ki riewdonburom uba don ka kyrdan ba-halor eh ban pynriam ïa uta u briew da kine ki jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kulai lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah . Ai ba uta u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki nang ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’

translation.en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u dieng uba la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad nga la kdiah ïa u , ban pyndam noh ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki jaitbynriew baroh .

Me hir U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , Naba Ngim ia leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jong kane ka kynhun shipai babun paid kaba tur ïaleit ïa moi . Ngim tip) kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi pei sha me na ka bynta ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .

translation.kha: Ka trai duriaw ka paw tyngkreiñ bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , haba U Tiras u kyntur ïa ki nongïeng Jong u , dara u kyrhuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord  ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .
translation.kha: Nga long ka shakri jong U Trai ,  ka Mari ka la ong ,  ai kan long ha nga kumba me la ong .  Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
translation.kha: Ïa u jingthung baroh ïa uba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng um shym la thung , yn rat noh ,  la jubab U Jisu .
To khia joit , ko Jerusalem bad tyngshaiñ khim ka sngi ; ka barim ka jong U Trai ka tyngshaiñ ha phi !
translation.en: Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .

translation.kha: Kumjuh u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u ne ha ka jingpeit u Josis , bad um shym pynkhuslai ei ei shuh ïa lap lait tang ka bah ba u ju bam .
translation.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .

translation.kha: Ka jingkren jongu ki briew ka la sdang ngab kiew , bad ki la sdang ïa-ban pyrkhat la u Ïoannis lehse u lah ban dei U Massah .
translation.en: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not  ;

translation.kha: Ka un-long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ki hikai ïa ki aiñ ba la thaw da ki briew kumba ki dei ki Aiñ U Blei !’
translation.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
And the  Lord  appeared unto Abram , and said , Unto thy seed will I give this land : and there builded he an altar unto the  Lord  , who appeared unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abram bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ngan ai ha ki khun ki ksiew ong me .  Nangta u Abram u la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , uba lah mihpaw ha u .
Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei bymdonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .
translation.en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki shngiam ha lade ïa ki jingri bad ïa ki marbl ki mata ba ki Ïoh kurup na ka nongbah , kitab U Trai u la Law ïa u Joshua .
translation.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves , according unto the word of the  Lord  which he commanded Joshua .
But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Tang mar ïabna ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka la ai hukum ban pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem Judah .
Pynban U Trai u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U khlaiñ ban sngewlem ïa phi namarba u long borabor umbah leh ïa kaba dat . Suk kita uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki ha U Trai .
translation.en: And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .
And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei uwei baroh un tare shane shatai kum u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum ka um , bad ki metïap jong ki kin pyut ha khyndew .

translation.en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kiba la ngeit ha u kin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por ïa U Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu ym pat shym la kyntiew sha ka burom .

translation.en: And David said to him , Canst thou bring me down to this company ? And he said , Swear unto me by God , that thou wilt neither kill me , nor deliver me into the hands of my master , and I will bring thee down to this company .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ïa u ,  Men ïalam ïa nga sha kito ki nonglute ?  U jubab ,  Ngan leit lada phi kular ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga lane aiti ïa nga ha u kynrad jong nga .
Nga la ong ha phi ba nga longïng U thri U Blei’ jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki phai jong ki Amor , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim skhem la shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .

Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren , our children as their children : and , lo , we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants , and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already : neither is it in our power to redeem them  ; for other men have our lands and vineyards .
translation.kha: Ngi long na kajuh ka jaitbynriew kum ki para Jiw jong ngi . Hato ki khun ki kti jong ngi kim long kumjuh kum ki jong ki ? Hynrei ngi la hap ban pynlong mraw ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi . Ïa ki katto katne ki khun kynthei jong ngi , la lah die ïa ki kum ki mraw . Ngim donbor ei ei namar ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ la shim noh na ngi .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother ,
translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi —
U khamtam ïa phi ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um haw ban pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .
For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ba une U Jisu uba na Nasareth un sa pynkyllon ïa ka Templ bad pynkylla ïa ki rukom kiba la wan sha ngi lyngba u Moses !
U ai jingbam ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Who giveth food to all flesh : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong U Blei ki shahskhor sad shah ïitbniah da ki jingbanbeiñ bun jingjynjar bashyrkhei ,
translation.en: Again , they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .

translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei Ban pynlut ïa ka bainong jrong Phi bad ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na borbah .
translation.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .

translation.kha: Uno ine uba len ïa ka jingshisha u tiduh jingkulmar , hynñiew uta uba pyn-i markhap u trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk .
translation.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un longsyiem uba im thah lane u bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , naba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la die noh ïa ki hok jong u kum u hynmen .
translation.en: Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
And the sixth angel sounded , and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God ,
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la put ïa la ka turoi . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat U Blei .

translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , uba shi para bad u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah , kumta u Kaleb u ai ïa ka Akhsah ha u ban shongkurim .

Hynrei u Moses u la ïasaid dara U Trai U blem jongno u , pynlang u la ïong , Ko Trai , balei ba men bitar haduh katne ïa la ki jong ki briew , kiba me la pyllait na ka ri Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw bad da ka bor ?
translation.en: And Moses besought the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people , which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power , and with a mighty hand ?

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la woh ha ka waiñ bym bha’ , bad ba la thoh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng . Nangta u la ramhah shalor ha ki rmiang shynraiñ U Jisu bad u la ong , To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka jingphla !
translation.en: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki tymmen , ki samla shynrang , ki samla kynthih , ki longkmie bad ki khynnah rieh . Hynrei wat khie kti ïa uno Une uba don ka dak ha ka jinglehshitom jong u . sdang nangne na ka Templ jong nga . Kumta ki la sdang na ki nongïalam Ibbah ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark  ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .

translation.kha: ha naba u namsop u dung ha u klongsnam jongu u . U long kum ka sim kaba uta ruma sha ka jar — um shym tip ba ka jingjam jong u ka don ha ka jingma .
translation.en: Till a dart strike through his liver  ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .

translation.kha: ‘ Kane ka long kawei ka pun jia ïa ka bamaïan — kan ngam bad kan ym lah khie shuh , namar ka jingpynjot ba U Trai un wallam ha ka .’ Ki ktung jrong u Jeroham ki kut hangne .
translation.en: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink , and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her : and they shall be weary . Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .

translation.kha: ngi baroh me la haw sha padun , bun nga la sngewkwah ïa ka sur kiba kren ha nga ha ka ktien Kherub , ‘ Saul , Saul ! balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa ang ? Me pynmong ïa lai da kaban ïaleh pyrshah , kumba u masi dab u kynjat pyrshah ïa u dieng jong u kynrad jong u .’
translation.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice speaking unto me , and saying in the Hebrew tongue ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa uwei u angel jong U Tlai uba shong khashor u khwai basaw . U la shiteng hapdeng katto katne thylliej ki dieng Martl ha ka them , bad hajan jong u la don sa kyiuh pat ki kulai — kiba synsar , kiba thohbroin , bad kiba lyoh .
translation.en: I saw by night , and behold a man riding upon a red horse , and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom  ; and behind him were there red horses , speckled , and white .

But my words and my statutes , which I commanded my servants the prophets , did they not take hold of your fathers ? and they returned and said , Like as the  Lord  of hosts thought to do unto us , according to our ways , and according to our doings , so hath he dealt with us .
translation.kha: Lyngba ki shakri jong nga ki nongïathuhlypa nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham , hynrei ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la shahshitom ïa kaba mih nangta . Nangta ki la kylla-kaba-mut bad ki la pdiang ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la lah pynshitom ïa ki kumba ki dei ban shah bad kumba nga la kut jingmut ban leh .’
Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad un smat khynñiat ka snam bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka jatkmie kamon jong u .
translation.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering , and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :

translation.kha: Ka Hukum ka pynjem ïa ka jingbitar U Blei ; hynrei hangno hangno ka ha bym don ka Hukum , ym don ka jingkhynñiuh ïa ka hukum .
translation.en: Because the law worketh wrath : for where no law is , there is no transgression .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki brisoh , Bnai long uba stad , phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Troas . Ban shemphang , phi dei ïa-ban phai noh na kaba sniew .
translation.en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .

translation.kha: ( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Asa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jongki u Joab . U Amasa u dei u Kynhun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun jongu u Nahash bad ka para jongu ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )
translation.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .

And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .
translation.kha: Ha ka step jong ka sngi kaba lai , la don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la paw halor u lum , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi kaba sawa jam . Baroh ki briew kiba don ha ka jaka sher dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And Joab said unto the man that told him , And , behold , thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground ? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver , and a girdle .
translation.kha: U Joab u jubab ,  Lada me la ïohi ïa u , balei men shym pynïap ïa u ha shen ? Nga da lade hi ngan jin da la ai ha me shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad uwei u panpoh .
Ka jingiw jong kine ki jingkylla ka longïing kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta te , da shisha ma nga , U Tharai nongsumar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan sa siew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingaibor jong me , ka jingriam jongki me bad ka jingisih jong me ïa ki briew’ jong nga . Keiñ sa tip ba nga pynshitom ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will even do according to thine anger , and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them  ; and I will make myself known among them , when I have judged thee .

Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the  Lord  of all your tithes , which ye receive of the children of Israel  ; and ye shall give thereof the  Lord s  heave offering to Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom phi ruh phin wanrah kumjuh ïa ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na baroh kaba shiphew ba phi ïohpdiang na ki Israel . Phin ai ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai  ha u Aaron u lyngdoh .
Lada phi ïa pluh Baibl Bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , lehse phi ju pule lypa shuwa ban sdang ka jingïasyllok .
translation.en: If you are studying the Bible with one of Jehovah’s Witnesses , you likely try to review the material in advance of each study .

translation.kha: Ki Amor ki beh da ka bor ïa ki briew na ka jait Dan sha ka ri lut bad kim shah ïa ki banbeiñ wan hiar sha ri thor .
translation.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain : for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley :

translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lap kham Heth kiba la shah ñiew ki long hynriew hajar pyrshah ngut .
translation.en: And the pillars of the court round about , and their sockets , and their pins , and their cords , with all their instruments , and with all their service : and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden .

translation.kha: Teng leh ïa pha khlem ka jingñiewkor bad tap ïa Phah da ka jakhlia . Ki bynriew kin khmih ïa phai ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei .
translation.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee , and make thee vile , and will set thee as a gazingstock .
For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïaleh thma , bad ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga .

Naba ngi longïing ki kynhun jong U blei , ngin ïohrung ïa ki jingkyrkhu Kiba u buhai na ka bynta ki briew jong u , bad ngin ïohkynti ruh lem bad U khriat ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la lah buh na ka bynta jong u ; naba lada ngi ïadon bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom U Khrist , jing ïoh ruh ban ïadon boitha ha ka barhem jong u .
translation.en: And if children , then heirs ; heirs of God , and joint-heirs with Christ ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together .

translation.kha: Kumta to ai ba Ngin ym man thait ha kaba lehbha ; nongmareh lada ngim duh bor noh , ka jer sa poi ha kaba ngin lat ïa ka jingit .
translation.en: And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .
translation.kha: Ïa ka khubor la phah sha ka Jesebel ,  Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .

Ngan pynkhie da ka tdem ban pynshitom ïa phi ñiar ka jingpynïap jingot jong phi , bad dalade phi wad jingïada da kaba ïalumlang ha la ki sheng , nur pham ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah hapdeng jong phi bad phin ïahap pyndem ha ki nongshoh-nar jong phi .
translation.en: And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .
Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki jingat phyllung ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynpaw kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa kiba U Blei u la buh lypa ïa ka jaka kaba dum tliw tliw junom .
namar U Blei u ba-thurmur borabor hapoh Jong ph , ban pynbang ïa phi kiba ei ka mon bad babha haka ban nongshong ïa ka jingthmu jong u hi .
translation.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .
They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame  ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
translation.kha: hynrei un wanrah jingjahburom ïa kito kiba isih ïa me , bad ki ïing ki riewbymman kin jah noh .

Ki dang ïaphai leh hi ïa la ki rukom barim haduh Kane ka sngi . Kim shym Mane ïa U Trai lane kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba u la ai ha ki kynhun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa umbiah u pynkyrteng u Israel .
translation.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners : they fear not the  Lord  , neither do they after their statutes , or after their ordinances , or after the law and commandment which the  Lord  commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel  ;

translation.kha: bad balei phiah khuslai shaphang ki jaiñ ? Khmih kum ki taïew ki san : kim trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynda ïa biar .
translation.en: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :

Hynrei ka Rakhel kam shym ïoh khun na u Jakob , kumta ka la bishni ïa la ka hynmen , bad ka ainong ha u Jakob , Ai khun ïa nga , lane nur-um ïap noh .
translation.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister  ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
translation.kha: Ki bniap shiah bad ki dieng Jamynrei    harud ka wahduid ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong ki .
Me dei ban haei ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban pynkheiñ ïa phi da ki jingai jingmut bad ngan ïai kruiñ ban pynshahthngan ïa phi .
translation.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief .
And he went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold therein , and them that bought  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh ïa ki nongkhaïi da kaba ong ha ki ,
Nangta un kñia ïa kawei na kita ki paro lane ki lyngdkhur
translation.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves , or of the young pigeons , such as he can get  ;

But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban u la thiah ha ka khyrdop ïingsyiem lem bad ki nongap phira jong u syiem .
Katba u Moses u dang rahah shajan ïa la ki kti , ki Israel ki jop , hynrei haba u pynhiar shapoh ïa la ki kti , ki Amalek ki jop .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .

And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand , and for a memorial between thine eyes , that the  Lord s  law may be in thy mouth : for with a strong hand hath the  Lord  brought thee out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe kan long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong phi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong phi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ban ïai kren bad ïai puson ïa ka Aiñ U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla uba kyrteng u Ïutikhos u la shong ha ka jingkhangïit , bad katba u Paul u dang kren , u Ïutikhos u la shoh samthiah jur , kat haduh ba u la ïohthiah lyngngai bad u la hap na ka mala kaba lai sha madan . Haba ki la rah ïa u , u la ïap .

Ko syiem Agrippa ! ?(Nga lah ban kruiñ ha me da ka jingshlur , namar ba me kop ïa kine Kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , naba kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kaba rieh ha kyndong .
translation.en: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .

But Paul said unto them , They have beaten us openly uncondemned , being Romans , and have cast us into prison  ; and now do they thrust us out privily ? nay verily  ; but let them come themselves and fetch us out .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Ym shym la shem ïa ngi kiba la shah pynrem na kano kano ka kam runar , pynban ki la sympat ïa ngi ha khmat u paidbah — bad ngi dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom ! Nangta ki la thep ïa ngi sha ka byndi , bad mynta ki kwah ban phah noh jar jar ïa ngi . Ka bym lah long ! Ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ki dei ban wan hi da lade hangne bad pyllait ïa ngi .
Me kop ba ngam shym har pop! , bad ba ym don uwei ruh naba lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .
translation.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
And it was told Saul , saying , Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u don ha Naïoth kaba ha Ramah , kumta u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban kem ïa u .
U Rephah u jubab , Ai ïa nga lai sngi ba ngan pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam . Nangta sa wan pat . Kumta kita ki briew ki leit noh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .

translation.kha: U ruh u ithuh ïa ka , bad u ïai-ong , ïa-ïoh , ka dei ka sotti jong u ! U mradkhlaw aïu re u la pynpoh ïa u . Ïa u Joseph u khun jong nga la tar lyngkhot lyngkhai !
translation.en: And he knew it , and said , It is my son s coat  ; an evil beast hath devoured him  ; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces .

translation.kha: haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan ïa kaba U Trai U Blei Jong phi u la ai ha ki . Hadien ba u la pynïoh ïa ka jingshongshngain ïa ki jait Israel baroh , te phi lah don wan phai pait bad shongsah hangne ha ka ri jong phi ha ka Phan mihngi jongngi ka Jordan ïa kaba u Moses , u shakri U Trai , u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given your brethren rest , as he hath given you , and they also have possessed the land which the  Lord  your God giveth them : then ye shall return unto the land of your possession , and enjoy it , which Moses the  Lord s  servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: Nangne nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa khwai pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ngut ki angel lam bad ingiew tylli ki khlam , kiba long kiba khatduh , namsop ki long ki jingpynpaw Kiba khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translation.en: And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .

translation.kha: Ynda uta u shakri u la lup ïa ki , u la kren ha ki ïa kijuh ki ktien .
translation.en: And he overtook them , and he spake unto them these same words .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta u skhem ïa ailad hi , kane ka dei kaei kaban ma nga , U Trai U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : To shahshkor ïa kaei naba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ,
translation.en: And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;
Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por u la long bymmyntoi shuh ïa me , hynrei mynta u long uba myntoi ïa me bad ïa nga .

“lada un uno u kwah ban kob sarong , u dei ban kob sarong ba u ithuh bad ba u shemphang ïa nga , namar ka jingbeit jong nga ka long kaba neh , badno nga leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba dei . Kine ki long kita kiei kiei Ibbah pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this , that he understandeth and knoweth me , that I am the  Lord  which exercise lovingkindness , judgment , and righteousness , in the earth : for in these things I delight , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingmad ka pynlah ïa ka rta jongnga Phin kumjuh ruh ka pynïoh ïa ka shapoh bad ka burom .
translation.en: Length of days is in her right hand  ; and in her left hand riches and honour .

And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,
translation.kha: U Moses u kyrpad jur ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhot dieng , ïa uba u la bret hapoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla long kaba bit ban dih . Dei hangta ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .
U Jisu u la peit sawdong bun u la ïohi ba u paidbhur byllien u la nang ïan sha u , kumta u la ong ha u Philip , Nangno ngi lah ban thied jingbam ka ba dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew bhor ?
translation.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip ,  Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?

translation.kha: Haneng ba phi lah ban long ki khun jong U kpu jong phi naba ha bneng . Namar u pynphong ïa ka sngi katba u la thaw ban tyngshaiñ ha ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumwei , bad u ai plung ha kito kiba kuna ïa kaweh bha malu ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba snep .
translation.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .

translation.kha: Um don jingsngewbha banbeiñ pynlong ïa ngi ban sngewsih lane ban pien .
translation.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men .

translation.kha: Kum u khlieh jong ka ïing u dei ban long u banyngkong ha ka ban ïaphah ban hikai ïa ki shaphang U Blei! pynlang ki jingthmu Jong U .
translation.en: He takes the lead in helping his family to learn about God and His purposes .
Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang : ‘ Phin ym ïohrung da lei lei ha ka ri sha ka jaka ha kaba ngan ai ka jingjahthait ïa phi .’
lehse ïa ki kam jong phi baroh da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Let all your things be done with charity .

translation.kha: Ka la ïap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rangbah ba-dap da ka jingbrai kiba don ka jingthrew jakhlia la kum ki kada badno ki khashor .
translation.en: For she doted upon their paramours , whose flesh is as the flesh of asses , and whose issue is like the issue of horses .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,

Da la ki bleithaw ïa nga ki pynbitar , ïa ki blei jong ki , ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ngam lah shah . Kumta nur pyndem da kito ki bym dei ka jaitbynriew ban pynbitar ïa ki , ngan kynshi ruh ïa ki da ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit katba kine ym kah shah .
translation.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God  ; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities : and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people  ; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la Wan sha U Jisu bad ki la ong ha u , Me dei ban phet noh nangne bad leit shatei patar , namar u Herod u kwah pun pynap ïa me .
translation.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees , saying unto him , Get thee out , and depart hence : for Herod will kill thee .

translation.kha: Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh pun leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaweh dien bad kob bha , un ym ïarap ; un im da shisha .
translation.en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .

translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa u katba u dang thait bad noh mynsiem . Un sa sheptieng ; bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ken phet krad . Ngin pynpaw tang ïa u syiem ,
translation.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed , and will make him afraid : and all the people that are with him shall flee  ; and I will smite the king only :
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .
translation.kha: lane bad la ka hynmen kynsi ne ka para kynsi .
Nga don hangne ha ka pyrthei tangba shipor ; wat buhrieh ïa ki hukum jong me na nga .
translation.en: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shim kabu ïa uwei pat . Ki apil ken ym brup ïa ki rangbah , bad ki riewkhraw kmen ym barhem ïa kaba halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the people shall be oppressed , every one by another , and every one by his neighbour : the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient , and the base against the honourable .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por ki Jesreel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa —kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongwan , ki la shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , Bad ki la bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam shiah jong ka .
translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing  ; and he called his servants , and said unto them , Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel ?
translation.kha: U syiem Syria u khuslai jingmut shibun shaphang kane ; u la khot ïa la ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Uno napdeng jong phi uba long ha ka liang jong u syiem ka Israel ?

translation.en: And unto the children of Gershon , of the families of the Levites , out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs  ; two cities .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki kynhun jong ki Lebi , ka kur Gershon , ka ïohpdiang ar tylli ki nongbah na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Mihngi : ka Golan ha Bashan ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) bad ka Beeshterah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Take me up , and cast me forth into the sea  ; so shall the sea be calm unto you : for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la jubab ,  Bret noh ïa nga sha ka duriaw , bad kan sa long jai jai . Nga tip ka dei ka jingleh bymdei jong nga ba phi la ngat ha kane ka  erïong kaba jur .

translation.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;
translation.kha: U pynbiang shibun ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad shibun ka rnong haduh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .
Kaba shane ha u briew u bym lah ban shaniah ha ka par ka jingjynjar ka long kumba pyrshang ban kha jingbam da ka bniat kaba la khih ne ïaid da ka kjat kaba dkoh .
translation.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth , and a foot out of joint .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym dei tang ki jingthang kiba ud ; ma I ruh kiba don ïa U Mynsiem kum ki jingai banyngkong jong U Blei , ngi ïa-ud hapoh lade hi , katba ngi dang ap ïa U blang ba un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u bad ban pyllaitluid phar ïa ngi .
translation.en: And not only they , but ourselves also , which have the firstfruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for the adoption , to wit , the redemption of our body .
And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sngewïahap bad ki la ïasoh bad u Paul bad u Silas ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa kiba bun ki kynthei kiba pawkhmat bad ka kynhun bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Through the tender mercy of our God  ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,
translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba jemnud . Un pynlong ïa ka step baphyrnai jong ka jingpynim ban mih ha ngi
Haba U Blei u ai ha ka lyer ïa ka bor jong ka , bad ba u kheiñ ïa ka jingheh jong ka duriaw ;
translation.en: To make the weight for the winds  ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .

translation.kha: Un wallam lang ïa ki kpa bad ki khun sa shisien ; lym kumta tun hap ban wan bad pynjot ïa ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children , and the heart of the children to their fathers , lest I come and smite the earth with a curse .
Send them away , that they may go into the country round about , and into the villages , and buy themselves bread : for they have nothing to eat .
translation.kha: To phah noh ïa ki briew , bad ai ba kin leit sha ki lyngkha kiba hajan bad ki nongrit khnang ba kin thied ei ei ïa lade ban bam .
U king ïa ka duriaw kum ka um kaba thnam bad u pynlong ïa ka ba kan pyrthei kum u khiew umphniang .
translation.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot : he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment .

translation.kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba ngan leit ïatih ïa u ba phi kein hangne ?
translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .

translation.kha: hynrei phin ym beit , naba phim dih ki langbrot jongno nga .
translation.en: But ye believe not , because ye are not of my sheep , as I said unto you .

translation.kha: Nangne shym la kylliang sopti woh ha ka por miet , lymne mano moi na ki paralok jongki nga , lin ki shakri lad ang , lymne ki nongap pharia jong nga . Susah ma ngi baroh ngi ba-bang ïa ki tarajur ïaheh ha ka kti .
translation.en: So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
Then cometh he to Simon Peter : and Peter saith unto him , Lord , dost thou wash my feet ?
translation.kha: U la wan ha u Simon Petros , uba la ong ha u ,  Hato men sait ïa ki kjat jong nga , ko Trai ?

translation.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .
translation.kha: Katba u dang khynnah , don ki briew ki ban sumar ïa u bad pynïaid ïa ki kam jong u tad haduh ban da poi ka por ba la buh da u kpa jong u .
To shah ngan ïathuh ïa phi haduh katno nga la trei shitom na ka bynta Jong phi , bad na ka bniat ki brai ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei pat baroh ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .
translation.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .

translation.kha: Jaban haba ang la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tyllai ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew , U Jisu u la kylli , katno tylli kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ? Hynñiew , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalumlang bad ki wan sher dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sher dara ha u Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  hath proclaimed unto the end of the world , Say ye to the daughter of Zion , Behold , thy salvation cometh  ; behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
translation.kha: Ba U  Trai  u la pynbna shaduh ka pyrthei baroh :  To ong ha ki paid ka Jerusalem ba U Trai un wan ban ïada ïa phi un wallam bad u ïa ki briew kiba u la pyllait im .
Khie leit sha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingkhynñiuh ïa ka pisa ba ki lyngdoh kiba thum ha ka kyrdoh jong ka Templ ba ki la ïohlum na ki briew .
translation.en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the  Lord  , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :
There dwelt men of Tyre also therein , which brought fish , and all manner of ware , and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na ka nongbah Tyros ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem , bad ki wanrah dohkha bad baroh ki jait mar sha ka nongbah ban die ha ki briew jong ngi ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
U la jubab ïa ki : Mynta ngan ai ïa phi u kew bad ka wieh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad phin long kiba la sngewhun . Kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym ñiewbeiñ shuh ïa phi .
translation.en: Yea , the  Lord  will answer and say unto his people , Behold , I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith : and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :

translation.kha: kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh ; baroh ki long arphew ar hajar arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut .
translation.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u hukum ïa ki briew baneh rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum ka jingjahburom ïa U Trai U Blei jyllang ki , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jutang .
translation.en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .
Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me don ka bor halor jong nga tang namar ba la ai ha me da U Blei . Kumta u briew uba aiti noh ïa nga ha me u long uba la rem na ka pop kaba kham khraw .
U Trai u la ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Lada phi banbeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , Phin ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki ; hynrei ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jinglehsbun ïa kiba tduh ka long ka kam jong ka jingmeng .
translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang bakha shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduh .
translation.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year  ;
