translation.kha: Ko Job , hato men sngewmong lada nga krong ? Ngam lah shuh ban shu sngap jar .
translation.en: If we assay to commune with thee , wilt thou be grieved ? but who can withhold himself from speaking ?

translation.kha: Haba ki Kylli ïa me shano ki dei ban leit , ïathuh ïa ki ba por la lah ong : Ïa ki katto katba ngut la tim ban ïap da ka jingpang — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiaw pat la tim ban ïap ha ka thma — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap na ka jingïapthngan — kata ka dei sha kaba kin lytar ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban shahïap ring noh kum ki kyiad — kata ka dei sha kaba kin saw !
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .

translation.kha: Ang la Long ki khmat ïa kiba matlah , bad ki kjat ïa kiba dkoh .
translation.en: I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .

translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki paid Amalek namsop ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Jephthah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ko Joppa , phi la bakla . U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew .
translation.en: Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .

translation.kha: Thep noh ïa la ka waitlam ha ka jaka jong ka , U Jisu u la ong ha u . Baroh kiba shim ïa ka waitlam kin ïap da ka waitlam .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .

Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balui lui , haduh ba ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la leh ïa kane nalor ba u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah sha ka jingmane bleithaw da kaba pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la don bad phi , naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .

Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka nang dara u shem ba u shñiuh uba hangno um pat kylla lieh , badno ba kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jngai ka hynriewphew ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :

Yea , they made their hearts as an adamant stone , lest they should hear the law , and the words which the  Lord  of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets : therefore came a great wrath from the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: bad ki pynlong ïa ki dohnud jong ki , kiba eh kum u mawsiang . Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la phah lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im slem bah , nga la bitar shikatdei eh .
haba u Hiram u leit jingjaw ïa kita ki shnong , um manna ïa ki .
translation.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him  ; and they pleased him not .
Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki turoi . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki jingtem ksai .

translation.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side the river : and he had peace on all sides round about him .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kaba sha sepngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , naduh Tiphsah kaba ha Ïuphratis haduh shaphang sepngi ka nongbah Gasa . Baroh ki syiem kiba sha sepngi jong ka Ïuphratis ki la hap hapoh jong u , bad u la don ha ka jingïasuk bad ki ri ba-marjan baroh .

Namar U Khrist da ailad hi u la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingsuh da kaba pynlong kawei ka jaitbynriew ïa ki Jiw bad ki Jentil . Da ka set jong u hi , u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynjri kaba pynkyllaiñ ïa ki bad kaba pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun .
translation.en: For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;

translation.kha: U riewbymman u ioh ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah shun sngewthuh ïa ki jingisih U Blei ; u jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki nongshoh-nar jong u .
translation.en: His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ïai-ong ha u Joshua , kiew ïa u sum jong me ha ka Ai ; nga ai ïa ka ha me . U Joshua u sa kumba la baheh ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai  ; for I will give it into thine hand . And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city .

translation.kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri .’
translation.en: But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .

translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kyndit ïa U Khun u kyndat jin ïa U Kpa ; Uno uno umbah pdiang ïa U Khun u don ïa U Kpa mad .
translation.en: Whosoever denieth the Son , the same hath not the Father : ( but ) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .

translation.kha: Burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha u bnai Abib , ibha dei ha kawei ka mem jong uta u bnai ba u la pynkoit ïa phi na Ijipt .
translation.en: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the passover unto the  Lord  thy God : for in the month of Abib the  Lord  thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night .

translation.kha: U Petros u la shimet kyrpang ïa U khrud pynlang u la sdang ban mai ïa u , U Blei un ym shah ïa kata , ko Trai ! u la ong . Kata kan ym jia da lei leilieh ha me !
translation.en: Then Peter took him , and began to rebuke him , saying , Be it far from thee , Lord : this shall not be unto thee .

translation.kha: Um ju shukor lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa Kiei kaba u nongshim rhem u buh bynda ; u bsa ïa kiba shngain bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngdoh .
translation.en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi la pynbiang kam ba kyang leh ha ka Templ . Ki nongtrei kiba don jingtbit ha ki jait kam baroh ki thrang ban ïarap ïa me , bad baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki don hapoh ka lei jong me .
translation.en: And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .

translation.kha: Ngan longkmie ryngkat Bad phi ; ngan long U Blei jongnga phi , bad phin long ki briew jong por .
translation.en: And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .
Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .
translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah , u jop ïa ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajar ngut na ki .
Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la ai suda ha u Benaïah , uba la leit bad pynïap ïa u Adonijah .
translation.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; and he fell upon him that he died .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong , La pyndep ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang Bad uba kut . Ha uno uno uba sliang ngan ai ïa ka hok ban dih na ka umpohliew jongno ka um ka jingim khlem da siewdor ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , It is done . I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end . I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely .

translation.kha: Haba u Imri u ïohi ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon , u leit sha ka kut kaba shapoh jong ka ïingsyiem , u thang ïa ka ïingsyiem da ka ding mala u la ïap ha ki thylliej ding .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Zimri saw that the city was taken , that he went into the palace of the king s house , and burnt the king s house over him with fire , and died ,
For I will not contend for ever , neither will I be always wroth : for the spirit should fail before me , and the souls which I have made .
translation.kha: Nga ai ka jingim ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan ym mudui sah ïa ki lane bitar ïa ki junom .
Nain syiem ïa u Arbad hangno hangno ha kaba u don , bad ngin tur ïaleh ïa u ha shuwa ba un tip Kiei kaba jia . Ma u lane uno uno na ki rangbah jong u kin ym wai im .
translation.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found , and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground : and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one .

translation.kha: To kmen , ko pyrthei bad sahit bneng ! ïathiah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai u long u syiem .
translation.en: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice : and let men say among the nations , The  Lord  reigneth .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khim shaiñ ha u da ka jingieit bad u la ong , Me donkam tang kawei kaei kaei . Khie leit pynlang die ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men ïoh ïa ka spah ha banyngkong ; nangta sa wan bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .

translation.kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdon kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la poi Haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa ki briew , kitab u la khamtam ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .
translation.en: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah bad jingñiewkor na khawai lada phi Tertios na ka bynta kaba bha ; lada phi trei na ka bynda kaba sner , phi leh ïa kaba bakla .
translation.en: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah ki don ka jingriew kaba ki rwai : Ngi erlangthari tlot ba ngi bah ki jingsait bakynsha ; Dagon bun bah ka synrai ba-bang pynkhuid . Kumjuh ngi lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh Mynta ka sngi ?
translation.en: And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .
O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Balak u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban leh ïa phi bad kumno u Balaam u khun jong u Beor u la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la jia ha lynti na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia sha Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei bad phin shem ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ban pyllait im ïa phi .
Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup bad ïa ki jingthung jingtep jongngi phi , bad phin ïapthngan . Kin ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u kew , ka saiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi , lane ki langbrot ; bad phin ïap .
translation.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .

translation.kha: Ha kane Kajuh ka per ki Philistia ruh ki hiarthma ïa ki shnong kaba ha ki kjat lum kiba shaphang sepngi dara ïa ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ki la ïohsngew ïa ki nongbah jong ka bthah Shemesh , ka Aijalon , malu ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongbah jongnga ka Soko , ka Timnah , bad ka Gimso lem bad ki nongrit lad ki , bad ki shongdor hangta .
translation.en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .
And all the people that came together to that sight , beholding the things which were done , smote their breasts , and returned .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang hangta ban khmih ïa kata baroh , ki la ïohi kaei kaba la jia , baroh ki la ïaleit phai sha ïing , ki da tied ïa la ki shadem ha ka jingsngewsih .

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation , and came out , and blessed the people : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the people .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad haba ki mih shabar , ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ na ka jingdon U  Trai  ka paw ha u paidbah baroh .
U shim lut ïa Baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Salome u la thaw .
translation.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .
translation.kha: bad baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei .

Naba nga sdang ap khmih , sa Uei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syriem kum u ïakit , hynrei ha ka met jngai u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sim , bad u don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum umbiah don ka bor .
translation.en: After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .

translation.kha: Nadab nga noh ha Phin ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , ‘ U la ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong kiba leh kam runar ,’ ka dei ban urlong shisha shaphang jong nga , namsop kaei kaba la thoiñ shaphang jong nga ka wiang jia shisha .
translation.en: For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .

translation.kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka mut . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bun rah ïa u syiem malu ïa ki nongbah pynsynjor jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki , Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba at la don bun phi , naduh ka sngi naba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,

translation.kha: Nangta ar ngut na ki , ki leit rung shapoh ïing , mala u nongïathuhlypa samla u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlei u Jehud , bad u ong ha u , U Trai , U blei ki Israel u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syier jongu ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .
translation.en: And he arose , and went into the house  ; and he poured the oil on his head , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I have anointed thee king over the people of the  Lord  , even over Israel .

translation.kha: Kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ki la ïakhreh malu u . Ki la long u Moses malu u Elijah ,
translation.en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :
And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi biang sa shisien ha Jerusalem . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka Templ , ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan ha u
woh ngeit ïa nga , namarkata , lada ngam leh ïa kiei kai kiba U Kpa jong nga u kwah ïa nga ban leh .
translation.en: If I do not the works of my Father , believe me not .

translation.kha: Jaban kumta ki briew ka Jerusalem kin ïohknieh ïa kaei kaba tang sah jong ka ri Edom bad ïa ki jaitbynriew barben kiba shikhung ki hir ki jong nga , ong U Trai , u ban pynlong ïa kane ban jia .
translation.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .

And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki jingiwbih , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah ban pyrkhat .
Shuwa ba un wan long briew U Jehoïakim u la pyndonkam ïa u Jisu kum u “rangbah nongtrei” ha kaba thaw ïa kiei khie baroh kiba Don ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
translation.en: Jehovah used the prehuman Jesus as his “master worker” in creating all other things in heaven and on earth .

translation.kha: bad haba u shym da ka Templ , u smai da ka bad da U Blei , uba dat Haneng ;
translation.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .

translation.kha: U ramhah uba kyrteng u Ishbibenob , umbiah rah ïa u meng rnong uba khia kumba lai kli shiteng bad uba kieng ka waitlam bathymmai , u la pyut ba u lah ban pynïap ïa u Sabad .
translation.en: And Ishbi–benob , which was of the sons of the giant , the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight , he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David .

translation.kha: Ki ïohi ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ba ki ïashad bad ki ïarisa , lem bad ïa u Samuel uba u ïalam na khmat . Nangno U Mynsiem U Blei u wan hiar tyllep ha ki rangbah jongngi u Saul , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa .
translation.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David : and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as appointed over them , the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul , and they also prophesied .

And it came to pass , that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the  Lord  their God , for which the  Lord  their God had sent him to them , even all these words ,
translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa ki paidbah baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha ki .

translation.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation , that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble , by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God .
translation.kha: U ïarap ïa ngi ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei kiba don ki jingjynjar babun jait , da kaba pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka lad jingïarap kaba ngi hi ngi la ïohpdiang na U Blei .

translation.en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jentil , ki Jentil ki dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .

translation.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall , and escaped his hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pynhiar ïa nga ha ka shang na ka jingkhangïit kaba ha ka kynroh bad la pyllait im ïa nga na u .
To pynkhiah ïa kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , to pynkhiah ïa kito kiba shitom na ki jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad to beh noh ïa ki ksuit . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumin to ai ei .
translation.en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .

translation.kha: Kine ar ngut ki ïabah , ki la shym ïa ka met U Jisu bad ki la sop ïa ka da ki jaiñjot linen lem bad ki musla kat kum ka rukom ki Jiw hato pynkheiñ ïa ka met shuwa ban thop .
translation.en: Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ar ngut ki ngab kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translation.en: Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .

translation.kha: Wat trep shalor jngai ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh thang da ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bameh , bad wat theh halor Jong ka ïa ka jingkohnguh kaba da ka wieh .
translation.en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran jongu u , shah ïa ki khynnah ban waiñ ha per , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long na ka bynta kum kine .
translation.en: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , u Syiem u la mane ïa U Trai da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha ka duwan rnong ; u la phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad ïaryngkat thlia ba-halor jongnga ka .
translation.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .

translation.kha: bad u lyngdoh un ïalam ïa u shabar ka dik shong dara , bad un khim bha ïa u .
translation.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;

Behold , I will bring a fear upon thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts , from all those that be about thee  ; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth  ; and none shall gather up him that wandereth .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingma ha phi na ki liang baroh . Baroh phin phet krad . Uwei pa uwei un phet ïap namar la ka jingim , bad yn ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam lang sa shisien ïa ki shipai .

Ngan Shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa wer kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad Kiba dap da ka pop . Ngan shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha katba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei len ym shah ïa ki ban wanpaw pait pat sha ka ri Israel . Te phin tip ba per long U Troas .
translation.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingïapher kaba shai kdar hapdeng ki khun U Blei bad ki khun u Soitan : Uno uno u bym leh ïa kaei kaba dei lane u bym ieit ïa la u hynmen u para um long u khun U Blei .
Ha ka per shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kyntu .
translation.en: And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
But I have made Esau bare , I have uncovered his secret places , and he shall not be able to hide himself : his seed is spoiled , and his brethren , and his neighbours , and he is not .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la sloit lut ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso bad pynpaw ïa ki jakarieh jong ki , te ba kin ym lah buhrieh shuh . Ïa baroh ki briew ka Edom la pynjot . Khlem pynsah shuh ïa uwei ruh .
ka Jarmuth , ka Lakhish ,
translation.en: The king of Jarmuth , one  ; the king of Lachish , one  ;

translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis . Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bad ka jingsngewkhuslai ki la wan ha u ,
translation.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy  ;

translation.kha: U Rephaim u synshar ha Jerusalem bad u nang khraw ha ka bor kum u syiem . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiad , malade u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerahmeel , ka nongbah kaba U Trai u la iaid na ki jaka baroh jongnga ka Israel kum ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u Rehoboam ka dem ka Naamah , na ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .

translation.kha: Te kumta kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khñiang ? u briew u long eiei ha ki khmih U Blei ?
translation.en: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?

translation.kha: lade ka long ban pynshlur ïa kiwei , ngi dei ban leh kumta . Uno uno uba ïalam bad kiwei u dei ban leh ïa said da ka jingkylluid mynmiet ; a uno uba don ka iktiar u dei ban trei shitom ; uno uno uba pyn-i ka jingsbun ïa kiwei u dei ban leh da kaba kmen .
translation.en: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .

translation.kha: U la ong ha u Moses , Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam khah shuh ban ïohi ïa me ! Ha ka sngi ba nga ïohi ïa me , men ïap !
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongpang myntor jongno u Paran ki la leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u ding mutlop hi kumba u long . Kumjuh U Trai u la lah ïa-ong , u Pharaoh u la kynjai ngab shahshkor ïa u Moses malade u Aaron .
translation.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
Go ye therefore , and teach all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father , and of the Son , and of the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Kumta , khie leit , sha ki briew baroh kylleng bad pynlong ïa ki , ki synran jong nga : To pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Kpa , U Khun , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,

translation.en: After him repaired the Levites , Rehum the son of Bani . Next unto him repaired Hashabiah , the ruler of the half part of Keilah , in his part .
translation.kha: Kine ki Lebi ki tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : U Rehum u khun jong u Bani u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ; U Hashabaïah , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud na ka bynta ka distrik jong u ;

U Hananaïah , u khun jongnga u Meshelemaïah bad u Hanun , u khun bahynriew jong u Salaph , u Tei ïa ka bniat kaba bud , ka jingkynrei naba ar jrong ki . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah u te ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph , another piece . After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tmain nong Samaria jong nga ki la ïamane ïa U Blei halor une u lum , hynrei phi ki Jiw phin ong ba ka Jerusalem ka dem ka jaka ha kaba ngi dei ban mane ïa U Bela .
translation.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain  ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !
translation.kha: hynrei u dem shapoh ban peit ïa ki bneng bad ïa ka khyndew .
Kumta U Jisu u la ong biang , Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshim : Nga long ka jingkhan jongu ki khunlangbrot .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi! ban kynmaw ïa ki kti ïa kiba la kren lah sloit Bah da ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ïa ka lei na U Trai’ bad U Nongpynim ïa kaba la ai ha phin da ki apostol .
translation.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets , and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour :

translation.kha: Don ka maïan , ka Karmel , ka Siph , ka Juttah ,
translation.en: Maon , Carmel , and Ziph , and Juttah ,

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ki syiem jongno me , ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh Ko shym la sorkar ïa ka Hukum jong me . Kim shym la sngap ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham jngai me .
translation.en: Neither have our kings , our princes , our priests , nor our fathers , kept thy law , nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies , wherewith thou didst testify against them .
And hallow my sabbaths  ; and they shall be a sign between me and you , that ye may know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka Sabbaton ka sngi kaba khuid , ba kumta kan long ka dak jong ka jutang ba ngi la thaw , bad kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynpang ïa u Noah baneh shahshkor ïa ki jingmaham U Bel shaphang kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ïa kiba um shym lah ban ïohi . U la nongshong ïa U Blei bun u la thaw ïa ka ïinglieng ha kabu ma u bad ka longïing jong u ki la ïohlait im . Da kane , la pynrem ïa ka pyrthei , bad u Noah u la ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka hok kob wan da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: By faith Noah , being warned of God of things not seen as yet , moved with fear , prepared an ark to the saving of his house  ; by the which he condemned the world , and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith .
Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , bad ha kata ka snem u ïoh ot shispah shah ïa kaba u la bet , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .
translation.kha: Nyngkong ha Damaskos bad ha Jerusalem bad nangta ha ka Judia baroh bad hapdeng ki Jentil , nga la ïalap ba ki dei ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pop jong ki bad ban phai sha U Blei bad leh ïa kiei kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .

Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong de ka long ka pukri um , bad ba ki khmat jong nga ka pulom ki ummat , ktang ba nga lah banbeiñ ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki bynriew jongu per kiba la shah pynïap .
translation.en: Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !

translation.kha: U ruh u leh pop pynshah ïa U Tiras mala u bud ïa ki jinglah Bymman jrong u Syiem Jehoram , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel sin : but he walked therein .
For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit sha kawei pat ka nongrit .

translation.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase , before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison .
translation.kha: bad nga la ai ïa ki ha u Barukh , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Nga la ai ïa ki ha u ha ka jingïadon lang u Hanamel bad ki sakhi kiba la soi ïa ka dulir thied jaka bad ki rangbah kiba ïashong ha ka phyllaw .
Ngi don khat-ar ngut shai la , ki khun jong ujuh u kpa . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba ïathaw u dang don ha Kanaan bad i pa .’
translation.en: We be twelve brethren , sons of our father  ; one is not , and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan .

Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong nga da baroh kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad ngan ym pynjah kumto .
Ki nongwei ki de mynshem ha khmat jong to ; ibha ki ïohsngew ïa nga , ki kohnguh .
translation.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me : as soon as they hear , they shall be obedient unto me .
The Lord then answered him , and said ,  Thou hypocrite , doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall , and lead him away to watering ?
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa u ,  Me uba arsap ! Uno uno na phi un law ïa la u masi dab lane ïa la ka kada na ka sem bad ïalam shabar ban ai um ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

Mynta shim Hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad kitei sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un duli na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jubab ïa ka jingjai jong u nabar ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kumba ka dei hok ïa me . Mem shyiap la kren ïa ka jingshisha shapoh jong nga dom u la leh .
translation.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .

translation.kha: katne katba ngut ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei! kan wan . Ka jubab jrong u ka un-long , Ka Hima U Bela kam wan ha ka rukom kum kaba lah ban ïohi .
translation.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :

translation.kha: Naba lada ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , te ïa U Khrist ruh ym Shimham la pynmihpat .
translation.en: For if the dead rise not , then is not Christ raised :

translation.kha: Ko Pa , u la ong , Lada me mon , shim nong na nga ïa ken ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka mon jong nga , pynban , ïa ka mon jong me yn pyndep .
translation.en: Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ïa phoi u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoïada , nabar mynta phi long u jingbabe pynïaidkam ha ka Templ . Ka dei ka kamram Jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa uwei u riewlamwir babha leh mynsaw ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei ban buh ha ki kynjri lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba da ka nar .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit pat sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïohi ïa uba ïapshiliang ka kti .

Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka long kaba ishyrkhei ; Gaal Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar shla jong ki , Nob ka long kaba shyrkhei katta katta . Kylleng ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Bad hapdeng ki briew jong ka ngan pynsakma ïa ki .
translation.en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .

translation.kha: Mynta , to thung ïa me u lat halor ka ri jingtep .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U khun uba bieit u pynsngewsih ïa la u kpa bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .
Declare this in the house of Jacob , and publish it in Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah :

translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
U mynsiem bymkhuid u la lynñiar , u la pynring kyrshut jur ïa u khynnah , bad u la mihnoh . U khynnah u la i kum uba ïap , bad baher ki la ïa-ong , U la ïap !
translation.en: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him : and he was as one dead  ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong U Blei ïa ngi , nga kyrpad ïa phi : To aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia ba-im sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang ha ka jingshakri ïa u bad ka jingpynsngewbha ïa u . Kane ka long ka jingmane bashisha kaba phi dei ban ai .

To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynhied ka Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa kiba tlot , kiba babniah ïa kiba duk , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka koidi !
translation.en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .
And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the  Lord  had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , u la kmen bad u la ong ,
U Jisu u la kren ïa kan shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kaba la ngeit ha u kine ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka Por ïa U Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu! ym pat shym la kyntiew sha ka burom .
translation.en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )

And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito ki por kiba ka la klet ïa nga mynba ka thang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a second son .
translation.kha: Ka Silpah ka kha sa uwei pat u khun ïa u Jakob ,

translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .
translation.kha: Ym don jingbuh pud ïa ka jingdih waiñ ; u syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih katba ki sngewkwah .

translation.en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor jong u .

translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill  ;
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka khyndew ; u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingsangsot jong ki ,

Mynta , lang law noh ïa ki kynïan na ki ïa-rkhie Jong phi bad pyllait noh ïa phi . Lada phi kwah ban leit sha bamaïan ryngkat bad nga , phi lah pun leh kumta , bad ngan sumar ïa phi . Hynriew lapbah phim kwah ban leit , Phin lah ban ym leit . Phi don ïa ka ri baroh kawei ban jied , phi lah ban saw shang shano ba phi kwah .
translation.en: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand . If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come  ; and I will look well unto thee : but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear : behold , all the land is before thee : whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .

translation.kha: Mynno nga pynbna ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka Edom bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uei u briew bad u mirr hangta . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba sah shrah , na ka nongbah Teman haduh ka nongbah Dedan , bad ki briew kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom , and will cut off man and beast from it  ; and I will make it desolate from Teman  ; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword .

translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kawei kaba U Mynmiet u ong ha ki balang !
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .

translation.kha: Bad to ai ba U Trai un pynpra ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban shongksuid ibiang bad ban don la ka longkmie . Kumta ka Naomi ka doh khublei ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sdang ban ïam bad ki ïai-ong ha ka ,
translation.en: The  Lord  grant you that ye may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . Then she kissed them  ; and they lifted up their voice , and wept .

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi ; nga pynshoh ïa ka ïarwai bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jngai nga ka long U Trai Badonbor Baroh !
translation.en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .
translation.kha: Katba ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki pynshahshkor ïa u Stephan , ki la bitar shla bad ki la kyr-iat bniat ïa u ha ka jingbitar .
Hynrei tun pynshitom ïa ki bynriew kiba ainguh ba-bang mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli . ngam pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .
The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang :  Nga isih ïa ka jingsarong ki briew ka Israel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh kiba don ha ka , ha u nongshun .
Kumta u Joshua u phah katno katto-katne ngat ki rangïapom kiba mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar ba la shah kyntait la tep pahara hangta , bad ka rupa ha trai .
translation.en: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .

translation.kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong shaphang u syep uba syier ïa ka hima kambah u Dabid u la synshar bad shang ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , katai , ki ba-bang ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lak Bad phi .
translation.en: Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;

translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim , pynban , u la phah ïa u Lebiathan u khun jong u Akhbor bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah shaei Ijipt ban wallam ïa u Uriah .
translation.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt .
And , behold , a woman , which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years , came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment :
translation.kha: Ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingmihsnam bajur la khat-ar snem , ka la wan na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka rmiang jong ka jaiñkup jong u .
nangno anna kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jyllang kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingibieit !
translation.en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ka khana : beh , ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , namar ngi la ïohsngew shaphang U Tlai U Blei jong phira . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha Ijipt
translation.en: And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,

translation.kha: Ki shipai na Arbad ki ap phira ïa ki kynroh lad pha , bad ki Rangbah na Gadmon ki ap phira ïa ki mot jong Pha . Ki wah ïa ki stang jong ki ha ki kynroh jong pha . Ki long ki jingbabe kiba pynitynnat ïa pha .
translation.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about , and the Gammadims were in thy towers : they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about  ; they have made thy beauty perfect .

translation.kha: Ngi Ïohi ïa ka jingieit jong u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la thaw .
translation.en: We see his love in all that he has made .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u ba la lap ïa u Dabid malade ki nongbud jong u , pynlang u ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , Shahshkor , ko rangbah Benjamin ! Hato phi pyrkhat ba u Abda un ai ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ ha phi baroh , bad pun thung ïa phi ki pynbah nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ?
translation.en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him , Hear now , ye Benjamites  ; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards , and make you all captains of thousands , and captains of hundreds  ;

translation.kha: Kito kiba im ka jingtim kaban ba ki ïoh jingsuk bad jingjahthait ha ka jingïap .
translation.en: He shall enter into peace : they shall rest in their beds , each one walking in his uprightness .

translation.kha: Nga sngewsih bad de phong da ki jaiñ-jin khain , bad la shong hangne ha u pui pui , ba la shonshab .
translation.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .

translation.kha: To wat shah shukor , phi ki phlangïap ba-ieit jong nga !
translation.en: Do not err , my beloved brethren .

translation.kha: Khie kabu ka la kuna ka long ban theh ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih ha ka met! jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa nga na ka bynta ban tep .
translation.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body , she did it for my burial .

translation.kha: Um dei ruh ban pyntngit ïa ka jaka kyntang da kaba mih sharak jongu ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u sha nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . NGA hir U Trai .
translation.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .
For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;
translation.kha: Mynta ngi lah ban ainguh ïa U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi ainguh ïa u na ka bynta ka jingkmen kaba ngi don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u namar jong phi .
Nangta u Elkanah u leit phai sha la ïohnang ha Ramah , hynrei u khynnah Samuel u sah ha Shillong bad u shakri ïa U Trai ha ka jingïalam u Eli u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house . And the child did minister unto the  Lord  before Eli the priest .

translation.kha: Balei te ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong por ? Balei ba me la lai ïa kane ka Kam bymnang ? Me la pynlong ïa u Uriah ban shah pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah ïa ki Ammon ban pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !
translation.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingkwah brai ka jingnang samla , mala ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ka hok , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , bad ka jingsuk , lem bad wer katba da ka dohnud basngur ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai’ na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .
Go your ways : behold , I send you forth as lambs among wolves .
translation.kha: Khie leit ! Nga phah ïa phi kum ki khunlangbrot hapdeng ki suri .

translation.en: The voice of joy , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride , the voice of them that shall say , Praise the  Lord  of hosts : for the  Lord  is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever : and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the  Lord . For I will cause to return the captivity of the land , as at the first , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kine ki jaka phin ïohsngew biang ïa ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jinglehkmen bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïabam khawai shongkurim . Phin ïohsngew ba ki briew ki ïarwai katba ki wallam ïa ki jingainguh thang sha ka Templ jong nga ; kin ïa-ong ,   ‘ To ainguh ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , namar u long uba bha bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .’ Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka ri kaba roi kyrhai kumba mynshuwa . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
To U Trai U Blei jong im’ un don ryngkat bad ngi , kumba u la don rynsied bad ki kpa Thummim jong ngi ; to un ym iehnoh ïa sem lane lyndet ïa ngi ;
translation.en: The  Lord  our God be with us , as he was with our fathers : let him not leave us , nor forsake us :
God came from Teman , and the Holy One from mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and the earth was full of his praise .
translation.kha: U Blei u wan biang na Edom ; U Blei bakhuid u wan na ki lumrit ka Paran . Ka burom jong u ka dap ïa ki bneng , bad ka pyrthei ka dap da ka jingïaroh ïa u .

bun to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , da kaban den ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïatim , haba me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .
And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Bad shaphang ka Jesebel , U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jesreel hi .’

translation.en: Let thy mercy , O  Lord  , be upon us , according as we hope in thee .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan long ha ngi , A  Trai  , kumba ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me .
Lane da u shniah ban ngiah ïa ki ktien jong nga ha u maw pynlang ban thoh ïa ki khnang ba kin law junom .
translation.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever !

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa Katai ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kmen shakri , sad hadien kata ki khuid ki ksiew jrong me ktang mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’
translation.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .

translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba ma nga , U Trai , na la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong ha per , Ko khum u briew , to sngi ïa kawei kaweh ngan ong ha me . Haba la tei ïa ka duwan , me dei ban pynhieng ïa ka da kaba Thang ki jingkñia hajir lad ka bad da kaba synreit halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad ba la kñia .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it , to offer burnt offerings thereon , and to sprinkle blood thereon .
Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , la kynthup lang hapdeng ki Lebi . )
Hynriew bnai kynjoh , u la pyn-i ïa ki spah jong ka ïingsyiem jongngi u ha ka jingryntih bad jingkhraw jongu ka .
translation.en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .
Which was the son of Melea , which was the son of Menan , which was the son of Mattatha , which was the son of Nathan , which was the son of David ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Melea , u khun jong u Menna , u khun jong u Mattatha , u khun jong u Nathan , u khun jong u Dabid ,

translation.en: Therefore the princes said unto the king , We beseech thee , let this man be put to death : for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people , in speaking such words unto them : for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah synshar ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ,  Ïa une u briew dei ban pynïap . Da kaba u kren kumne , u pynlong ïa ki shipai ha ka nongbah ban duh noh ïa ka jingshlur , bad u leh kumjuh ïa uwei pa uwei baroh ba dang sah ha ka nongbah . Um shym pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ki paidbah ; u kwah tang ban pynmong ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .
translation.kha: Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , bad ka khyndew ka nguid ïa ki nongshun jong ngi .
Ïa ki nongjapan phin jong ka Templ la pynïabynta ha ki kynhun kynhun kat kamon ki longrynïeng , bad la pynthymmai ïa ki kam ha ka Tabeel kumba long lem kiwei pat ki Lebi .
translation.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the  Lord .
Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem  ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech :
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Abimelekh bad ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban ïashun iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane Blei! , bad thew treikam ei ei .
translation.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work .
And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .
translation.kha: ( Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw kiba nga ïohi harud ka wah Khebar ) .

Pynïap ïa u , smat khyndiat ka snam jong u , bad theh ïa ka ha ki shkor kamon lad u Haron bad ki kynhun shynrang jong u , ha ki tmier kamon jong ki , bad ha ki jatkmie kamon jong ki . Synreit ïa ka snam kaba sah , sawdong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .
Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .
translation.kha: Te ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka jingïohipaw , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bneng :
Kaei kaba nga mut , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ka long kane : Ka por kam Don shuh , bad naduh mynta ki rangbah kiba la shongman ki dei ban im kumba kim shym la sohkhram ;
translation.en: But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;

translation.kha: Ma phi pat phi ïa-ei kumno ? u la kylli ïa ki . Phi ïa-ong ba nga long uei ? U Petros u la jubab , Me long U Messaïah .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  And Peter answereth and saith unto him , Thou art the Christ .
And the  Lord  discomfited Sisera , and all his chariots , and all his host , with the edge of the sword before Barak  ; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot , and fled away on his feet .
translation.kha: Haba u Barak u tur ïaleh lem bad la ka kynhun shipai , U  Trai  u buh ïa u Sisera ha ka jingshaïong jingmut lem bad ki kulai ïapom bad ki rangbah jong u baroh . U Sisera u hiar na la ka kali ïapom bad u phet ïap da ka kjat .
Nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh , u samla u la Jobab . Sa kaei pateng ba nga donkam ban leh ?
translation.en: The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?

translation.kha: ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïeng biang bad ban pynthikna ba yn sumar ïa ka jingïateh lok .
translation.en: That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .

translation.kha: Ha la kwah jur sa shisien , U Jingsuk u la leit sha ka jingtep , ka long ka krem ba la khang da u mawkhang .
translation.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .

translation.kha: Kut ang la ïathuhlypa main u la bthah ïa nga . Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ka la rung ha kita ki randien , bad ki la khie im bad ki la ïeng jait . Ki la ïakhun baheh na ki kat ban pynlong ka kynhied shipai .
translation.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up upon their feet , an exceeding great army .

And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation  ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
translation.kha: Lum ïa kane ka jingainguh na ki Israel , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kane ka khajna ka long ka jingsiew na ka bynta la ka jingim , bad ngan kynmaw ban da ban ker ïa ki .

Ha ka snem kaba bud , ki ïawan sha u , bad ki ïa-ong , Kynrad , ngin ym buhrieh ïa ka jingshisha na phi ba ki pisa jrong ngi baroh ki la lut , bad ba ki jingri jingdup jong i ki la dei ki jongu phi . Ngim don ei ei shuh ban ai ïa phi lait noh sa tang ki met jong ngi bad ki lyngkhot jong ngi .
translation.en: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him , We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent  ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle  ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :
And Shaalabbin , and Aijalon , and Jethlah ,
translation.kha: ka Shaalbim , ka Aijalon , ka Ithlah ,

Nga duwai ba ki baroh kin ïalong kawei . Ko Pa ! To ai ba kin ïalong ha ngi , kamar me long ha nga nabar ma nga ha me . To ai ba kin ïalong kawei , khnang ba ka pyrthuh kan ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: That they all may be one  ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .

translation.kha: Kumta ha u bnai ba ar jong ka snep hadien ba ki la wan pat shat ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki kdang ban ïatrei . U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad kiwei patiaw ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingsuh , borbah kiba shah ringmraw katba la wan phai pat Sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha ka jingtrei . Ïa baroh ki Lebi kiba la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Khrist u im hapoh jong phi! , U mynsiem u long ka jingim na ka bynta jong phi namar la pynlong ka hok phangpdeng jong phi bad U Blei .
translation.en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .

Haba ki la leit noh , u Amasaïah bad u Jonathan ki wan mih na kata ka pukri bad ki la leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid . Ki la ïathiah ha u ïa kaei kaba u Abihail u la pynkhreh pyrthuh ïa u bad Ong , To pynkloi bad jam ïa ka bhah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after they were departed , that they came up out of the well , and went and told king David , and said unto David , Arise , and pass quickly over the water : for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you .

translation.kha: ka Kibsaim , bad ka Beth Horon , lem bad ki pyntha jlang jong ki .
translation.en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs , and Beth–horon with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: U Jonah u la ong Shuah shuh ïa ki ba u la phet na U Trai . Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei , bad ki la ong ïa u , Kata ka longsyiem kiei kawei kaba sngewma ban leh !
translation.en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid , and said unto him , Why hast thou done this ? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the  Lord  , because he had told them .
And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , ki paralok jong nga , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym lah hadien ban leh ïa kano kano kaba kham sniew .

translation.en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kheiñ kor bha ïa kano kano ka sngi , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , uno uno u ban bam ïa kaei kaei , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno uno uba kyntait ban bam ïa kino kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai bad u ainguh sha U Blei .
To kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba la mihpat na ka jingïap , wahbah la hiarpateng na u Daberath , kumba la hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba por ïarap .
translation.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :

translation.kha: Kumta me baroh ar ngut ki shong bad ki ïabam ïadih lang . Nangta u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ha u , Sngewbha Shimiet noh hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translation.en: And they sat down , and did eat and drink both of them together : for the damsel s father had said unto the man , Be content , I pray thee , and tarry all night , and let thine heart be merry .
And his servants spake yet more against the  Lord  God , and against his servant Hezekiah .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba kham sniew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei bad ïa u Hesekaïah , u shakri U  Trai .
Ki shim ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum U Trai bad ki leit lyngba ïa baroh ki shnong ka Judah , da kaba sakhi ïa ka ha ki briew .
translation.en: And they taught in Judah , and had the book of the law of the  Lord  with them , and went about throughout all the cities of Judah , and taught the people .

translation.kha: U Trai u wan mih na ka jaka bakhuid jong u ; un wan hiar dara ïaid ha kliar jong ki lwa .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .

translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , ryngkat Bad ki tnga malade ki khun jong ki , ki ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And all Judah stood before the  Lord  , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .

translation.kha: Ngam shym thab ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nongri khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki khunlung shi lynter lynti shaw ka ri kaba me la kulai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ?
translation.en: Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew kiba na Sheba bad Dedan bad ki nongkhaïi na ki sneng jong ka Pynïap kin kylla ïa me , ‘ Hammoth me la lumlang ïa ka kynhun shipai bad tur ïaleh khnang ban lute bad pynjot ? Haduh me thmu ban nongdih noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki jingbrai bad ïa ki jingdon jingem , nabar phet nala pat bad kito ki mar lute baroh ?’
translation.en: Sheba , and Dedan , and the merchants of Tarshish , with all the young lions thereof , shall say unto thee , Art thou come to take a spoil ? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey ? to carry away silver and gold , to take away cattle and goods , to take a great spoil ?

translation.kha: Te U Blei u la kren ha u Moses bad u la ong , Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And God spake unto Moses , and said unto him , I am the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ka jingjanai jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ka jingieit jong U Blei bad ka jingïasyllok jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kin lama lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , and the love of God , and the communion of the Holy Ghost , be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: Kam shahskhor ïa u shakri uba iphylla , uba duk bad uba kyrduh , la u dei u para Ishmael dawai u nongwei uba shong ha ki shong jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy , whether he be of thy brethren , or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates :

translation.kha: Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki Don hapoh ka jingsah kerkut ; ym dat mano mano ba lah ban leit liengbah sha ki . Ïa ki briew baher jong ka Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .

translation.kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong Ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bakhiah jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka op jong u hi .
translation.en: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan , ka sngem haba U Trai un leh , ka sngi jong ki lyoh bad jinglwet ïa ki jingñiewbeiñ .
translation.en: For the day is near , even the day of the  Lord  is near , a cloudy day  ; it shall be the time of the heathen .

translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad ha ki khlaw jong ka Lehab kim pat wiang na ka bna ka jingkñia sha U Blei jong ngi , bad ki dieng Jong ka ki khyndiat eh ban pynmeh ïa ka ding .
translation.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Nangta u Sharon un leit thring shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , un law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh Ibbah u la kup shuwa ba un leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Hooid Tam , bad un buh ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall put off the linen garments , which he put on when he went into the holy place , and shall leave them there :
In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel , twelve years : six years reigned he in Tirzah .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba laiphew wei jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar khat-ar snem . Ha ki hynriew snem kiba nyngkong u la synshar ha Tirsah ,

translation.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Kumta haba phi ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti bah . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da ïoh ka jingsiew ba-pura .
U la ïap ha ka rta kaba la thymmei bha , uba la ïap kyrhai da ka spah bad ka burom ; dara u Simeon u khwan jongnga u , u long syier ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Phi kiba arsap ! A katto ka long kaba dei hato u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shapoh jong phira !
translation.en: Ye hypocrites , well did Esaias prophesy of you , saying ,

translation.kha: Lehse u angel u lah ban wan ïarap ïa u — uwei na ki hajar ki angel jong U Blei , uba pynkyiuh ïa ki briew ïa ki kamram jong ki .
translation.en: If there be a messenger with him , an interpreter , one among a thousand , to shew unto man his uprightness :

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki bneng bad ka pyrthei kiba long mynta la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban ïoh pynjot da ka thiang . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka pyntha ka sngi haba ïa ki briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .
translation.en: But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha ki , Pyntngit ïa ka Telem . Pyndep ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam ! Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .

Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew u dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba tang ma ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïabam bad ka jingïadih bad ka jinglehsngewbha ïa lade . U lah la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kane katba u trei ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrthei .
( Wah ki la shynrang jong u hi kim shym la ngeit ha u . )
translation.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him .

translation.kha: ka Jerusalem , ka Hebron ,
translation.en: The king of Jerusalem , one  ; the king of Hebron , one  ;
For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
translation.kha: naba ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh kam don jingmut ei ei katba u briew uba ai ïa ka u dang im ; ka treikam tang hadien ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: I opened to my beloved  ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself , and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him , but I could not find him  ; I called him , but he gave me no answer .
translation.kha: Ngan sah halor u lum ka mirr , u lum ka jingiwbih , tad ynda ka lyer step ka beh bad ba ka jingdum ka jah noh .
Ha kata ka por , ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Iddo , ki kdang ban krung ha ka kyrtong U Blei ki Israel ha ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then the prophets , Haggai the prophet , and Zechariah the son of Iddo , prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel , even unto them .

translation.kha: hynrei haba phi ïaboi , pa’ dei ban jait bad ban ym artatien da leilieh lei . Uno uno Uba artatien u Long kum ka jingat phyllung ha ka duriaw-bah ïa kabu la beh bad ba la pynstad kynting da ka lyer .
translation.en: But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .

translation.kha: U syiem Jehoash u khot ïa baroh ki nongñiah jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kumta u pynlong ïa ngi don sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbat jong u bad shahskhor jynjar ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka thma . Kum ka ding ka jingbitar jong u ka meh pylleng ka Israel , hynrei ngim ju tip aïu ka jia ; jingtem shngiam ïoh jinghikai satia ei ei na ka .
translation.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger , and the strength of battle : and it hath set him on fire round about , yet he knew not  ; and it burned him , yet he laid it not to heart .

translation.kha: pyntud bad kiwei ki jingriewblei ïa kiba u Ashurbanipal bakhraw malade badonbor , u la pynkynriah ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki bad pynsah ïa ki ha ka nongbah Shammua bad shawei shaei ha ka probins jong ka ïapyllait sngi .
translation.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .

translation.kha: Naba ujuh uba la ong , Wat klim , u la ong ruh , Wat pynïap . Wat lada phim shym kylla , phi la long nongpynkheiñ law lada phoi pynkup briew .
translation.en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .

Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .
translation.kha: Lada ka kti lane ka kjat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to ot noh bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti lane ka kjat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki kti bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka ding bymjukut .
Ha Kata ka miet U Trai u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ïong , Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsakhi na ka bynta jong nga hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ba-bang leh khmut ruh ha Rum .
translation.en: And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .

translation.kha: woh la nga long uba lui lui , baroh kaba nga lah ban leh ka long tyngka ban kyrpad ïa ki jingisynei U Blei u nongbishar lad nga .
translation.en: Whom , though I were righteous , yet would I not answer , but I would make supplication to my judge .
Neglect not the gift that is in thee , which was given thee by prophecy , with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery .
translation.kha: Wat leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingai ba kynja mynsiem kaba don ha me , ïa kaba la ai ha me mynba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren bad ki nongsharai balang    ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong me .
Lehse ngin duwai ha U Trai bad phai pat na ki lyntait bymman jong ki , ñiar U Trai u la byrngem ïa kane ka jingbhabriew da ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei .
translation.en: It may be they will present their supplication before the  Lord  , and will return every one from his evil way : for great is the anger and the fury that the  Lord  hath pronounced against this people .

translation.kha: ieid U Blei u la dep ïaring bad u Abraham , u iehnoh ïa u .
translation.en: And he left off talking with him , and God went up from Abraham .

translation.kha: U la sah” ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ban lum na ki briew baroh katjuh ban biang ban shna pynbha ïa ka Templ man ka snem . U ong ïa ki ban lai kloi , hynrei ki Lebi ki pyntud ,
translation.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites , and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah , and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year , and see that ye hasten the matter . Howbeit the Levites hastened it not .

translation.kha: Ki phet ïap , bad u Arsa lem bad ki kynruh jong u ki beh kthong ïa ki shuh Gera . Te bun na ki nongot Sudan ki la ïaphah haduh ba ka kynhun shipai kam shym lah shuh ban lum patiaw Bad ïaleh . Ki la shah pynsum lin ha U Trai bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ka kynhun shipai ka la ïoh rah bun ka jinglute .
translation.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar : and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves  ; for they were destroyed before the  Lord  , and before his host  ; and they carried away very much spoil .

translation.kha: Te u Samson u rwai , Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , shihajar ngut to pynïap ; Da ka shyieng tyngkong jong ka kai , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .
translation.en: And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .
For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .
