translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen na ka bynta ki Israel , kiba khraw tam na ki jaitbynriew . To rwai ïa ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh jong phi , ‘ U  Trai  u la pynim ïa la ki briew ; u la pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’

translation.en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm , thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land , thou , and all thy bands , and many people with thee .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad bun ki jaitbynriew kiba don bad u kin tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong bad tap ïa ka ri kum u lyoh .
Bad man ba ki briew kiba don ki mynsiem bymkhuid ha ki , ki la ïoh ïa u , ki dat khrup ha khmat jong u bad ki lynñiar , Me un-long U Khun U Blei !
translation.en: And unclean spirits , when they saw him , fell down before him , and cried , saying , Thou art the Son of God .

translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong , Nga u Jakob , u shakri bakohnguh jong phi , nga pyntip ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso ba nga la shong la sah bad u Laban , bad nga la pynslem ban wan phai haduh Mynta .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :
And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , bad U Trai u la trei lem bad pynshisha ba ka jingïalap jong ki ka la long kaba shisha da ki kambah kiba ki la leh .]
Ka dei ngab long kaba sawdong , bad kaba la khylliap ar stet , ka jrong arphew ar sentimitar bad kaba ïar phraphew ar sentimitar .
translation.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled  ; a span shall be the length thereof , and a span shall be the breadth thereof .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba kaba bha kam im hapoh jong nga — kata , ha ka jinglong ba kynjai doh jong at . Naba wat la ka jingkwah ba leh ïa kaba bha ka don hapoh jong nga , ngam da ban leh ïa ka .
translation.en: For I know that in me ( that is , in my flesh , ) dwelleth no good thing : for to will is present with me ; but how to perform that which is good I find not .
If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit  ;
translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngam shym la leh kaba bymman ; bad ngam ju pyrshang ban shukor ïa kiwei .
Kata ka dei ka khubor kaba U Trai u la ai mynshuwa shaphang ka Moab .
translation.en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning Moab since that time .

translation.kha: Kaba ïa-lamler kin ym ïew rung ha ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: Liars will not enter God’s Kingdom .
These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them : thus were all these cities .
translation.kha: Na ka ri ba ki Israel ki la ïoh , la ai ha ki Lebi sawphew phra tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki .
Waw ruh ar thylli ïa ki shrong ksai ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold  ;

translation.kha: U Hegai u la itynnat ïa ka Esther , bad ka la ïor ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u . Um shym pyndem ha kaba ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynjia briew bad ki jingbam bakyrpang . U ai ïa ka , ka jaka babha tam ha ka ïing ki kynthei bad buh hynñiew nongput ki samla kynthei ba la jied kyrpang na ka ïingsyiem ban Sikhri ïa ka .
translation.en: And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .
And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .
translation.kha: U la ong ha u Moses ,  Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam kwah shuh ban ïohi ïa me ! Ha ka sngi ba nga ïohi ïa me , men ïap !
Haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka jingidiaw ka la tap ïa ka khamtam jong u baroh kawei , bad u la leit noh da ka jingsngewnguh , namar u la long uba riewspah’ haduh katta katta .
translation.en: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .

translation.kha: Nga long uba kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingshim .
translation.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?
And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God , and in the law , and in the commandments , to seek his God , he did it with all his heart , and prospered .
translation.kha: U la long uba jop , namar baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta ka Templ lane ha kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum , u la leh ha ka mynsiem kaba ïaineh tylli bad aiti lut ha U Blei jong u .

Baroh ki khuri dih jingdih jong u Solomon ki long uba la shen da ka ksai , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra hajuh jong ka khlad Lebanon ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym lama kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .
translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki la long kiba mutlop bad ki la Mano ïa ki bleithaw u Baal kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la khwai ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart , and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them :
Then said Jesus ,  Father , forgive them  ; for they know not what they do .  And they parted his raiment , and cast lots .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Pa , to map ïa ki ! Kim tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .  Ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki hi da kaba kynting sbai .

translation.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khun nyngkong jong u , bad u Heth — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
Ko khun jong nga , haba U Trai u pynbeit ïa phi , da shahjop bha , bun shim ïa ka kum ka jingmaham .
translation.en: My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :

translation.kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngap ; nga ïng ha khmut ki bri bad nga kyrpad jingaibor .
translation.en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .

translation.kha: ngan kynmaw ïa la ka kulai ha phi bad ha ki mrad baroh ba ka jinglehisynei um da lei laiñ ruh kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw im barabor .
translation.en: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad  ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban long uba stad , hynrei lada phi shukor ïano ïano , phi leh la kum u bieit . Lada phi shim klop , phi pynjot ïa la ka jinglong jingim .
Hynrei bad kiba pung U Blei um shym la sngewbha , kumta ki metïap jyllang ki la pynsngap ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: But with many of them God was not well pleased : for they were overthrown in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ki la leit lyngba ki thain ka Phrygia bad Galatia namar U Mynsngi Bakhuid um shyiap la shah ïa ki ban ïarep ïa ka khubor ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia , and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia ,
Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi ,

translation.en: And he took the rulers over hundreds , and the captains , and the guard , and all the people of the land  ; and they brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king s house . And he sat on the throne of the kings .
translation.kha: bad nangta ma u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad ki nongap phira ha ïingsyiem ki synran ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ïingsyiem , bad bud sa u paidbah baroh . U Joash u rung lyngba ka Khyrdop Phira bad u shong ha la ka jaka ha ka khet .

translation.en: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong phi . Phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi haba nga pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri Ijipt .
U la dawa Heth phi tharai ba ki ktien ki lah ban Shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit bun ka borbah ki shipai ? Mano phi tharai u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria ?
translation.en: I say , sayest thou , ( but they are but vain words ) I have counsel and strength for war : now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?

The gold for things of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers . And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: bad na ka bynta ki tiar ki tar baroh kiba ki nong-ohdur ki dei ban shna . Mynta mano pat ba mon ban ai kylluid mynsiem sha U  Trai  ?
Lada phi ïohi ba ka kada jong u ka kyllon namar ba ban ka jingkit , ïarap ban pynïeng pat ïa ka ; wat shu ïaid lait .
translation.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ba kynja bneng ka long kaba laitluid , bad ka dei ka kmie jong ngi seiñ .
translation.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .

translation.kha: U blei um erlangthari kum ki briew , naba kren lamler ; Um long kum u briew uba kyllan la ka jingmut . Kat kaba u kular , u pyndep ; U kren , dara la pyndep ïa kata .
translation.en: God is not a man , that he should lie  ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?

translation.kha: U Paidbah’ u dei ban ñiad ba u lyngkhot u long umbiah khuid , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U Trai ; nga long uba khuid , bad at pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh  ; and he dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa ka Gilead ha ka kur jong u Makhir , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .

Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kpa u la kwah ? Uta uba kham san , ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Nga ong ha phi : Ki nongrim khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rang shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha shata jong Phi .
translation.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .

translation.kha: U Blei u la har ïa kata ha ka jingstad bad jingïohi jong u barieh ïa kaei kaba u la thmu , bad u la pynpaw shynna ha ngi ïa ka jingthmu ba la buhrieh ïa kaba u la lah thmu lypa baneh pyndap da U Khrist .
translation.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :

translation.kha: Ka iaki jong ki ka ïarep nud Maham bad kynthup ïa ka bashaniah baroh — baroh ka hima u Og , u syiem Bashan , bad ruh baroh’ hynriewphew tylli ki shnong jong u Jair ha Bashan .
translation.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um haka ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei une u syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la hajar noh mynta na ka diengphna , ngin thwet ha u !
translation.en: He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .

translation.kha: Ngi la jam ïa ka duriaw da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Kilikia bad Pamphylia , bad moi la poi sha Phira , ha Lukia .
translation.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .

translation.kha: Un hir uba khraw , mala yn khiat ïa u , U Khun jong U Blei hakhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pyningkhong syiem ïa u , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen lad u , u la long ,
translation.en: He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :

translation.kha: Te ngan longing ïalam biang ïa ka sha ri shyiap ; hangta len khroh biah ïa ka da ki ktien ieit .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her .

translation.kha: U Trai badonburom Baroh u la ong , To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba jia ! Khot ïa ki nongïambriew pun woh , ïa ki kyntiap Ibbah ria ki jingrwai ïapbriew .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Consider ye , and call for the mourning women , that they may come  ; and send for cunning women , that they may come :
Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
translation.kha: Namar kata , phin ïoh ïa kaba phi pan kwah , bad ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa phi .

translation.en: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :
translation.kha: Ki Jentil kim don ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei haba ki leh da ka jingsngewthuh ha lade ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , ki long ka hukum ïa lade , wat la kim don ka Hukum .
U Solomon u khun jongu u syiad dab u la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima-patsha Jeraïah , bad U Trai U Blei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa u bad pynlong ïa u uba khlaiñbor shikatdei eh .
translation.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom , and the  Lord  his God was with him , and magnified him exceedingly .

translation.kha: Hato ka sim kan shu ngat ha ka jingriam lymda la pynap jingriam ïa ka ? Hangto ka shangkhawiah ka ju bsiat hi lymda ngat ei ei ha ka ?
translation.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth , where no gin is for him ? shall one take up a snare from the earth , and have taken nothing at all ?
For there were many in Judah sworn unto him , because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah  ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ha Judah ki la ïalong ha ka liang jong u na ka bynta u kthaw jong u , u Shekanaïah , uba long u Jiw , u khun jong u Arah . Nalor kata , u Jehohanan , u khun jong u , u la shongkurim ïa ka khun u Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah .
Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kum ruh U Blei! u hikai ïa ki briew khatsan ba bha tam ka jingkam ban im .
translation.en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .
Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .
translation.kha: To kmen , ko Israel , namar u Nongthaw jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jong phi !

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when your children shall say unto you , What mean ye by this service ?
translation.kha: Haba ki khun jong phi ki kylli ïa phi , ‘ Ka mut aïu kane ka jinglehniam ?’

translation.en: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ka la kham shai shuh shuh , ba uwei pat u lyngdoh uba pher u la paw , uba syriem ïa u Melkhisedek .

translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha kata ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban ñiew ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .
To leh ïa kaba bha kam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan babha ha khmat U Blei , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , uta uba Sakhi beit ïa ka khubor jyllang ka jingshisha U Bel .
translation.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .

translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Likhi ki ni ka longsem tang ban shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :

translation.kha: Kin to ki bri ha Jerushah mala shalor u Lum Seïon ki ban lait im , namsop U Trai’ Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kane .
translation.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .

And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym risa , lane kren shikyntien ruh tad haduh ba un da ai hukum .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la phah da ki bseiñ ba-dap da ka bih hapdeng kita ki briew , bad bun ki Israel ki la shah puh bad ïap .
Hadien sakma baroh ki leit noh sha la ïing , bad u Dabid u la leit sha la ïeng Ban pynlut katto katne por bad ka longïing lad u .
translation.en: And all the people departed every man to his house : and David returned to bless his house .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tyrwa ïaleh u ha uto u khynnah , bad u ino ïa u ba leit rah ïa ki baroh sha sheng .
translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .

translation.kha: Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jrong nga . U long wahbah khak , Bad un im , ong U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe , according to the working of his mighty power ,
translation.kha: bad katno ka jingkhraw eh long kata ka bor kaba trei ha ngi kiba ngeit .

translation.en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba hok , A  Trai  , bad ba me la pynshitom ïa nga namar me long uba ïaineh .
Ka Seïon ka la sting na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U Trai un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U Trai’ un pynum ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .
translation.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .
Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .
translation.kha: To long u nongaplangbrot ïa la ki briew , A  Trai  , ki briew kiba me la jied . Wat la ki shong saphred ha ka ri khlaw , ka don ka jaka baseisoh sawdong jong ki . To ai ba kin leit bad bam na ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka Bashan bad ka Gilead , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa la slem bah .

translation.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not , lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ , who is the image of God , should shine unto them .
translation.kha: Kim shym la ngeit , namar ba ïa ki jingmut jong ki la kah dum da u blei basniew jong kane ka pyrthei . U khang ïa ki ba kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ha ki , ka jingshai kaba mihnoh na kata ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka burom jong U Khrist , uba long ka dur jong U Blei .
Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Ïoannis u la Iohi ïa U Jisu ba u wan sha u , bad u la ong , Ha khmih , U Khunlangbrot jongki U Blei , uba kit noh ïa ka pop jong ka pyrthei !
translation.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
Draw thee waters for the siege , fortify thy strong holds : go into clay , and tread the mortar , make strong the brickkiln .
translation.kha: To tong ïa ka um ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingshah kerkut , bad to pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kut jong pha ! To ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha ban shna ïa ki maw-it , bad to pynkhreh ïa ki tiar shna maw-it !
Pynkup ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba itynnat ba ki ju sa hajan ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kumta ba phin ym leh pop pyrshang ïa U Trai U blei jongno phi .
translation.en: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Kine ki aiñ ki pait shai Kamon yn leh haba katei kaei ka longïing ka bymïap bad ibha ka la long khuid .
translation.en: To teach when it is unclean , and when it is clean : this is the law of leprosy .
Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .
translation.kha: U la kylli ïa ki ha ka por aïu ba u khun jong u , u la kham ïohbor , bad ki la jubab ,  Mynhynnin ha ka por shi baje nohphai sngi mynba ka jingshit na u ka la iehnoh .
Ot na sha kamon bad na sha kthang , pha ka waitlam banep ! Ot na sha kano kano ka phang ba pha phai .
translation.en: Go thee one way or other , either on the right hand , or on the left , whithersoever thy face is set .
So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .
translation.kha: U Eliphas , u Bildad bad u Sophar ki la leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa ki ban leh , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u Job .

Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki khuslai , kumta nga ong ha ki bad ha ki nongaikam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , woh sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kumno U Trai u un-long uba khraw bad Uba shyrkhei , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew ka ri jongu ph , ki khun jong phi , ki tnga jong phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .
translation.en: And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , U Blei ki Ishmael , nga maham ïa phi ban ym shahshkor ïa lade ban shat shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa katba im hapdeng jong phi lane da kino kino kiwei pat kiba kam ba ki haw ban ïathuh lympat ïa ka lawei . Wat ym pynleit jingmut satia ïa ki jingsngew jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .

translation.kha: Na ka daw jongu u paidbah , ktien shym la lah ban ïalam ïa uta u briew Sha u . Kumta ki la weng ïa ka jingsop na ka tnum ïingjaiñ hamar ka jaka ba U Jisu u don . Babha ki la dep weng ïa ka jingjop ïit , ki la pynher ïa uta u Briew shapoh , u da shiah ha ka jingthiah jongngi u .
translation.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .
With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la pynshoi ïa u da ki jinglehieit jong ka , bad u la ngat ha ki ktien jali ja-um jong ka .
Pynban phi , phi long kiba ïaid khor , ki bym dei hok ban long ki bynriew jong u , ka jaitbynriew kaba pop bad kaba shukor .
translation.en: They have corrupted themselves , their spot is not the spot of his children : they are a perverse and crooked generation .

translation.kha: Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingjop kun ai ïa ka hok ngab shong ha synduk jong na ha ka khiat jong nga , kumba sa ruh to la jop bad mynta nga shong ha syndah U Kpa jongnga nga ha ka khet jong u .
translation.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .

translation.kha: Naduh mynsiem dei dang ki Lebi ki ban sumar ïa ka Jingpynïoh bad kin kitkhlieh nadong shadong ïa ka . Kane ka long ka hukum katba ïaineh pynlang kaba teh ïa ki khulom ki ksiew jong phi pateng la pateng .
translation.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .

translation.kha: Wat shim ïa la ka Para ne hynmen kynsi kum kamai na ki tnga jngai me katba ka tnga jong me , ka dang im .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .

translation.kha: Ha ka snep kiba shaphang ar jong ka jingsyier u Ussaïah u Syiem ka Judah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah u Long u syiem ka Israhaïah , bad u synshar arphew sner ha Samaria .
translation.en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned twenty years .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Persis bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la lah wan na Jesreel ki la ïam sawkyr-ang ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .
translation.kha: Nangta ki mynsiem ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka jaka kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Ka Armageddon .
Ki briew kin shong kin sai hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrni shuh da ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .

translation.kha: Ïa u Josis la ai ha kawei ka meng , bad ïa ki hynmen jong u ha kamai pat . Ki nongtih Ijipt ibha ïabam hangta ruh ki shon kyrpang , namar ki kheiñduh poh ban ïashong bam pyllut bad ki Hebru .
translation.en: And they set on for him by himself , and for them by themselves , and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him , by themselves : because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews  ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .

translation.kha: Tangba ym shym la pynksan ïano ïano ruh da ka Hukum ha U blang , namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Tangba uta ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
translation.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God , it is evident : for , The just shall live by faith .
And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka ktien U Blei ka la ïai saphriang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka la nang kiew bad nang kiew , bad bun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka jingngeit .

Kin ïambriew namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jong ngi u la ïap !’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Khnang ba U Blei un sngap ïa ki jingdie jngai phi , phiah dei ban ïaleit ban im katkum ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .

And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synreit ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ki bad ïa ki jaiñ jong ki sha U  Trai .
Hato u skud lane ka umjer ki don u kpa ?
translation.en: Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?

translation.kha: U jin u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaban shata phyrnai sngem bakha , bad kaba wan mih na ka khet jngai U Blei bad ka jngai U Khunlangbrot
translation.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .

translation.kha: Ngi pynshlur ïa phi ba phin ïai Bteng ba pule shaphang U Bel , baneh ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing hasem malu ki phlangïap jongno phi shaphang kiei kiba phiah pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da pud ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .
translation.en: We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .

translation.kha: Ko ïalam ïa phi sha ka pyrthat kba ïap ; ka lynti ba ka ïaid ka dem ka lynti sha ka jingpah .
translation.en: Her feet go down to death  ; her steps take hold on hell .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ba ki synran jong u ki dong ïaleh shitaiew ha ki boitha , namar ki dang king pyrshah ïa ka lyer , kumto katto katne por hapdeng per bad hynriew baje mynstep u la wan sha ki , da kaba ïadih halor ka um . U la don jingmut Ban ïaid najan jong ki ,
translation.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing  ; for the wind was contrary unto them : and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them , walking upon the sea , and would have passed by them .
Then shall we know , if we follow on to know the  Lord  : his going forth is prepared as the morning  ; and he shall come unto us as the rain , as the latter and former rain unto the earth .
translation.kha: To ngin ïai pyrshang ban tip ïa U  Trai . Da shisha un sa wan sha ngi kum ka step phyrngab , shisha kum u slap pyrem uba ai um ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: Or have found that which was lost , and lieth concerning it , and sweareth falsely  ; in any of all these that a man doeth , sinning therein :
translation.kha: lane da kaba thok shaphang kano kano ba ka la jah noh bad u smai ba um shym shem pat ïa ka .
Nga longïng uba kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?

translation.kha: A Trai , nga la jingsngewsih ïa kai ba me la leh , bad ar la dap da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha ki Por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw kiba me la ju leh . To lehnoh-ei , wat long me bitar .
translation.en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .
Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed  ; but his father was a Greek :
translation.kha: U Paul u la nang leit sha Derbe bad Lystra , ha kaba uwei u Khristan uba kyrteng u Timothi u shong u sah . Ka kmie jong u , kaba long ruh ka Khristan , ka long ka Jiw , hynrei u kpa jong u , u long u Grik .
U angel U blem u la kren ïa nga ha ka jingkynshew bad u ong , ‘ ïakob !’ ‘ O nga la jingjubab .
translation.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .

translation.kha: Ka jar baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat katba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la sngewshyrkhei .
translation.en: And great fear came upon all the church , and upon as many as heard these things .
And he said , Behold , I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation : for at the time appointed the end shall be .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pyn-i ha me ïa kaei kaba mih na ka jingbitar U Blei kan long . Ka jingïohipaw ka kdew ïa ka por jong ka jingkut .

translation.en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me bad ba me long uba tbit bad me don ka jingtip bad ka jingstad .

translation.en: For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .
translation.kha: Dei ma ngi , ym ma ki , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingotsher kaba shisha , naba ngi mane ïa U Blei da U Mynsiem jong u bad ngi lehkmen ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu . Ngim buh ïa kano kano ka jingshaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar .

Kumta te , ko ki pansngiat jong de , namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong U Blei ïa ngi , nga kyrdoh ïa phi : To aiti ïa lade kumne ka jingkñia ba-im shaei U Blei , ba la pynkyntang ha ka jingshakri ïa u bad ka jingpynsngewbha ïa u . Kainan ka long ka jingmane bashisha kaba phi dei ban ai .
translation.en: I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .

translation.kha: Ka la jhieh ba katba u Pekah u long syiem ba u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u kurup ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ijon , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka Janoah , ka Kedesh , dara ka Hasor , bad ki ri jongnga ka Gilead , ka Galilaïa , bad ka Naphtali , bad u rakhe koidi ïa ki briew shat Assyria .
translation.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and took Ijon , and Abel–beth–maachah , and Janoah , and Kedesh , and Hazor , and Gilead , and Galilee , all the land of Naphtali , and carried them captive to Assyria .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trai u la pynkyrpang ïa ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nahath kum u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam u pynlong ïa ki ban ieh khong ïa U Trai bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban bor ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .
Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong me kim tip satia ba men pynshitom ïa ki . A  Trai  , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kin jynjar da ka jingpynshitom kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me ieit ïa la ki briew .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .
translation.kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba ngan sa leh ka long ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .
Ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ka jingïaineh jong u ka long bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us : and the truth of the  Lord  endureth for ever . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uwei pat na ki synran jong u , u Andriw , uba long u por jong u Sihon Petros , u la ong ,
translation.en: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter s brother , saith unto him ,

And David said unto all the congregation of Israel , If it seem good unto you , and that it be of the  Lord  our God , let us send abroad unto our brethren every where , that are left in all the land of Israel , and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs , that they may gather themselves unto us :
translation.kha: Nangta u pynbna sha baroh ki paid Israel ,  Lada phi ai ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi bad lada ka dei ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to ai ba ngin ïaphah nonglamktien sha kiwei pat ki para ri jong ngi bad sha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ha ki shnong jong ki , bad ïathuh ïa ki ban ïalumlang hangne bad ngi .

U Isaïah u jubab , U Trai un sa ai ïa ka dak ban pynshisha ba un batip ïa la ka kular . Mynta , hato Men Jedidah ïa ka syrwiang ha ki mawkyrdon ban jam shiphew jam sha khmat ne ban loit shiphew jam shadien ?
translation.en: And Isaiah said , This sign shalt thou have of the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do the thing that he hath spoken : shall the shadow go forward ten degrees , or go back ten degrees ?

translation.kha: La ai ha ki ka jingkitkhlieh ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad ïa ka Templ , bad ban ïaphah ïa ki bahaïing jong ki , ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Horon , ha ka jingmane ha ka thalab .
translation.en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ( Na ka bynta ki Pharisi , khmut ruh na ka bna ki Jiw baroh , ki Bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa thymmai jong ki : ktem ju bam lymda ki sait ïa la ki kti ha ka kynsi naba daiñ ;
translation.en: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
Whose leaves were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all  ; under which the beasts of the field dwelt , and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation :
translation.kha: Ki sla jong u ki la long kiba itynnat , bad u la don kyrhai ki soh ha u ban bsa ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ki mradkhlaw ki la pynjahthait hapoh jong u , bad ki sim ki la thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman in the city , which was a sinner , when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee s house , brought an alabaster box of ointment ,
translation.kha: Ha kata ka shnong , la don ka briew kaba la im ka jingim kaba dap da ka pop . Ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan bam ha ka ïing jong u Pharisi , kumta ka la wallam ïa ka dabi alabastar kaba la dap da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih
Haba nga pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlwait kyrkhoit Shuah , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrjaw .
translation.en: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .

translation.kha: Me la khang ïa ki jingmut jyllang ki don pyrkhat beit ; Wat shah ïa ki ban jop halor jong nga mynta .
translation.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , te , kaei kaba me pyrkhat ? Hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ban sieb khajna sha u Patsha ka hima rem , ne kam long ?
translation.en: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?

translation.kha: U Joseph u hukum ïa u shakri balieh ha ka ïing jong u , Pyndap ïa ki byrni jongngi kine ki brup da ka jingbam , katba ki lah ban kit , pynlang thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei na ki ha khlieh ka byrni jong u .
translation.en: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man s money in his sack s mouth .

translation.kha: Nangta , ban pyn-i nuksa ïa ka jingshan kerkut , buh ki kharai , ki kynton khyndew , ki jaka Sher dala Bad ki tiar pynpait kynduh baroh sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And lay siege against it , and build a fort against it , and cast a mount against it  ; set the camp also against it , and set battering rams against it round about .

translation.kha: Ki Kanaan bad baroh kiba hapoh ka ri kin sa ïohsngew ïa kano . Kin sa kerkut ïa ngi , bad kin sa pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ïa ngi ! Bad nangta aïu men leh ban ïadait ïa la ka burom ?
translation.en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round , and cut off our name from the earth : and what wilt thou do unto thy great name ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki met jong ki la leit rah sha Shekhem , ha kaba la tep ïa ki ha ka jingtap kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka pisa na ka jahthait Hamar .
translation.en: And were carried over into Sychem , and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh . Ki don saw ngut ki pynbah hangne kiba la shym jingsmai .
translation.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;

Namar ba u Esra u don ïa ka jingkyiuh U Trai U Blei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u peiñ . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u Esra u la mih na bniah ban saw shaei Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki Israel kiba kynthup ïa ki lyngkhuh , ki Lebi , ki nongbat nongthaw ka Templ , ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ki nongtrei .
translation.en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .
And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?
translation.kha: Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bha . Me long uba dap da kiba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler !
bad hadien ba u la bam jingbah , u la ïohbor patan . U Saul u la sawa katba katba sner bad ki parabangeit ha badonkam .
translation.en: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki briew ka Israel kin ïohknieh ïa kaei kaba dang sah jong ka ri Edom bad ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba shisien ki long ki jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  , u ban pynlong ïa kane ban jia .

Nangta nga la ïohthiah ïa uwei pat u angel uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jongu ka Khubor Baasha ïa-ban pynbna ha ki brisoh ka pyrthei , ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kyntang briew .
translation.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,

translation.kha: Nga la kular ba ngan shah ïa phi ban shnong hangtei , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ïoh ïa kata , laitluid tong u Kaba Bad u Joshua .
translation.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein , save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .
And it came to pass , that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child  ; and they called him Zacharias , after the name of his father .
translation.kha: Haba u khunlung u la dap shi taïew , ki la wan ban otsher ïa u , bad ki la mut ban kyrteng ïa u , u Sekharaïah , kaba bud ïa u kpa jong u .
Lada Phin siew kylliang ïa katba bha da kaba sniew , da lei lei phin ym lah ban beh ïa kaba sniew na ka ïing jong phi .
translation.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .

translation.kha: Na ka jait u Merari ki mih ki longïing jong u Hadlai bad u Moses .
translation.en: And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof , and the pillars thereof , and sockets thereof ,

translation.kha: haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki shahjop ha ki nongshun jong ki nabar ba ki la lai nongpop pyrshah ïa me , mala nangta ki phai pat sha me bad wan sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaban sngewrit ha me na ka bynta ban ïoh jingmap , to shahjop ïa ki na bneng .
translation.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee , and shall turn again to thee , and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlaw ; bad kun pynïap ïa uwei pa wai uba ïaid lynti na ka .
translation.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit kam Sangeh noh sheng ; bad ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingïaineh jong ka kim haduh noh .
translation.en: Beareth all things , believeth all things , hopeth all things , endureth all things .
For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
translation.kha: Ka shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing jong ka lane ha ki jaka shong kiba jrong tam ha ka shnong ,
shem khat-ar kilo u pyrthuh bad shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .
translation.en: And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka lyer ba U Trai nongsynran u hukum ïa ka ba kad wan na Baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha keiñ ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .
And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him  ; and straightway he will send him hither .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei phi leh ïa kata , ong ïa u ba U Kynrad u donkam ïa u bad ban pynphai mar mar pat ïa u .
Phi lah ban sngewhun mynta , hynrei kum ha kane ka por ha ka sniew ka baneh wan , phin hir ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen namar yn ym ba-don sohwaiñ ba phin ïohlum .
translation.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled , ye careless women : for the vintage shall fail , the gathering shall not come .
And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Namar ba nga la leh kumta , u Moses u la kular ïa nga ba ki khun ki kti jong nga bad ma nga , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thikna kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba nga la ïuhkjat .

translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki jingrwai ha ka ïingsyiem kin kylla long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa shah bret noh ha ka jingjar jar .

translation.kha: ki dkhiew : ki dei kiba tlot , hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;

translation.en: Their wings were joined one to another  ; they turned not when they went  ; they went every one straight forward .
While we look not at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen : for the things which are seen are temporal ; but the things which are not seen are eternal .
translation.kha: Naba ngi pynleit jingmut , ym ha kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi , hynrei ha kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi . Kata kaba lah ban ïohi ka neh tang shipor , hynrei kata ka bym lah ban ïohi ka neh junom .

translation.en: But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u khynnah Samuel u ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  , u da phong da ka sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .
U Jisu u la ïong ha ki , Phim long Shuah kiba kham ei jingmut ngab ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Are ye also yet without understanding ?

And he said , Hearken ye , all Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem , and thou king Jehoshaphat , Thus saith the  Lord  unto you , Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude  ; for the battle is not yours , but God s .
translation.kha: U Jahasiel u ong ,  Ko syiem bad baroh ma phi u paid Judah bad Jerusalem , U  Trai  u ong ba phim dei ban rit mynsiem ne sheptieng ban ïeng pyrshah ïa kane ka kynhun shipai ba bun paid . Ka thma ka shong ha U Blei , ym ha phi .
Bad hajuh uno uno u shakri ïa U khriat ha kane ka rukom , u pynsngewbha ïa U Blei sad la pyngkiang da kiwei pat .
translation.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .

translation.kha: Ym anna mano mano ha Ijipt , uba riewspah ne uba tduh , uba donnam ne u bym donnam , uba lah banbeiñ tyrwa ban ïaphah .
translation.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt , which the head or tail , branch or rush , may do .
And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .

Hynrei to tiengburom ïa U Khrist ha ki dohnud jong phi! , bad pyndonburom ïa u kum U Trai . To long kiba la kloi ha ki por baroh ban ai ka jubab ïa uno Uno uba kyrmen ïa phi ban batai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba don ha phi ,
translation.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts : and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear :
For I will defend this city , to save it , for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
translation.kha: Ngan ïeng namar kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .’

Mynba ka dei ka ngiam rang ryngkhiang , ym dei ? Hynrei ngan duwai , bad U Trai un phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap . Haba kane ka wan jia , phin sa sngewthuh haduh katno phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai mynba phi pan syiem na u .
translation.en: Is it not wheat harvest to day ? I will call unto the  Lord  , and he shall send thunder and rain  ; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great , which ye have done in the sight of the  Lord  , in asking you a king .
And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng    jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
Ngin kyntait ïa ki ri barieh ban pynim ïa ka jingim jongu phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba ang iau ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .
translation.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .

translation.kha: U hi da lap um dei ka jingshai ; u la wiang ban ïathuh shaphang ka jingshai .
translation.en: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
So Job died , being old and full of days .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha .

translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to cut Israel short : and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  u la sdang ban pynrit ïa ka jingheh jong ka ri Israel . U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u la hiarthma ïa baroh ka ri Israel kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan
Kumta ngan ter ïateh ïa ph kum u sing . Kum u iakata ngan apthap ha ki lynti ïaid jong Phin .
translation.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :

translation.kha: Lehse U Trai U balui jong pa’ un kylla ka jingmut bad un kyrkhu ïa phi da ki jingthung bakyrhai . Te phin la Ban ainguh ha u da u khiew bad ka saiñ .
translation.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent , and leave a blessing behind him  ; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the  Lord  your God ?

translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , Pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymkut briew ! phah ruh phan pyrshang ban lait phet na ki nongshun jyllang pha .
translation.en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .
And the Syrians had gone out by companies , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid  ; and she waited on Naaman s wife .
translation.kha: Ha kawei na ki jingleit thombor pyrshah ïa ki Israel , ki Syria ki la ringmraw ïa kawei ka khynnah rit Israel , kaba la long ka shakri jong ka tnga jong u Naaman .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth  ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air  ; for it repenteth me that I have made them .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa u da ka jingbabe , kat haduh ba u la ong ,  Ngan pynduh khoit ïa kine ki briew kiba nga la thaw , bad ruh ïa ki mrad bad ki sim , naba nga la sngewsih ba nga la thaw ïa ki .
Da kumta u Heh u la pyndkoh pyndam ïa ka jingmane ïa u Baal ha Israel .
translation.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .

translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïeng hangta ban pynsngaid ïa put . Kum kiwei pat ki la ong ha u , Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong uta u brisoh ? Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata . Em , ngam dei , u la ong .
translation.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .

translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u ïohi ïa ki khun u Jehoba , u kylli , Kiei ktien ki khynnah ?
translation.en: And Israel beheld Joseph s sons , and said , Who are these ?

translation.kha: Naba U Trai u la Law ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki , Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . Lada ngan sien pyllut bad phi waiñ tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa phi . Law noh Mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng jong phi , bad nur sa rah ngan leh kumno ïa phira .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .

translation.kha: Ha kaba bud ïa ka sah jong U Trai , u nongïathuhlypa u kren pynjyrngam ïa ka jingnguh : Ko reng , duwan ! Kane ka long kaba U Troas u ong , ‘ U khunlung ïa Uba yn Khot kyrteng u Josaïah , yn sa kha ha ka longïing jong u Dabid . Un sa pynïap ha pha ïa ki lyndum bakha shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thala , bad un thang ïa ki shyieng Briew halor jong pha .’
translation.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the  Lord  , and said , O altar , altar , thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , a child shall be born unto the house of David , Josiah by name  ; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee , and men s bones shall be burnt upon thee .
Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka khmat namar ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’
Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan khar na weng . Lada une une u baibam ïa un u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka dih jong nga , ïa kaba ang ai khnap ba ka pyrem kan ïoh im .
translation.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah bad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki suk ki saiñ .
Um bit ban bam ïa ka doh jongnga uno uno u kparad uba shu ïa-ïap hi , lane uba la shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw ; —kata kan pynjrong ïa u , u bymkhuid . Nga long U Terah .
translation.en: That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: badno u ong , Ko Simri kynrad , to klet ino ïa ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh ha katai ka sngi kambah phi la iohnong ïa ka Jesreel . wat buhnud ei ei pyrshah ïa nga lane pyrkhat Shua shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: And said unto the king , Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me , neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .
Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Syria ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih ba bun jong pha . Ki la ai ïa ki mawkordor Emerald , ki jaiñ bajngum , ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsai , ki Koral , bad ki mawkordor Rubi kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: And they went their way , and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met  ; and they loose him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa u khun kada ha ka lynti bah , ba la teh ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing . Katba ki dang law noh ïa u ,

translation.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families : and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid :
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba lai la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun . Ka jaka kaba ki la ïohpdiang ka kot haduh Sarid .

translation.en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .
translation.kha: To long kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un wan . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa la ka khyndew ban pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem .
Kiei kiei bhor ki neh haduh kane ka sngi Namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong me .
translation.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .

translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh bah , wanrah u purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kylla u purew lem bad uwei u mai lyngraw ; ar kilo u purew lem bad u langbrot ;
translation.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased  ; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa lade yn pynkhraw .
Ki Arab bad ki nongsynshar ka ri Hadadeser ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar khaïi jong pha da ki khunlangbrot , ki langbrot , bad ki phalang .
translation.en: Arabia , and all the princes of Kedar , they occupied with thee in lambs , and rams , and goats : in these were they thy merchants .

translation.kha: U shipai ha ka jingtrei minot u kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa la u rangbah shipai bad kumta um ïakhleh bad ki kam ha ka jingim kaba ïadei lang .
translation.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life ; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier .
And all the people departed every man to his house : and David returned to bless his house .
translation.kha: Hadien kata baroh ki leit noh sha la ïing , bad u Dabid u la leit sha la ïing ban pynlut katto katne por bad ka longïing jong u .

Wat ai ban hap u slap ne ka umjer shalor ki lum Gilboa ; Ai ba ki lyngkha jong ka kin ïalong shrah ! Naba ki stet jong kiba shlur ki kein hangta ha ka jingïaburom ; ïa ka seisoh u Saul ym shym la shut phyrnai shu da ka umphniang .
translation.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew , neither let there be rain , upon you , nor fields of offerings : for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away , the shield of Saul , as though he had not been anointed with oil .

translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong u Daberath ki la pynïoh ïa ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phah ktah sha u ban wan phai dara ki ïabah synshar jong u Baroh .
translation.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .
And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai hapoh ka Hima ki bneng .

translation.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei bad ki khot kyrpad ïa u ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?
translation.kha: namar ka spah kam neh junom . Ym don wat ki hima ruh ki ban neh junom .
badno ngim shitrhem ong ïa khie namar ba nga la shah leh klet , naba nga la nangto banbeiñ sngewlehrain ha kaei kaba nga don .
translation.en: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong ruh , To U Trai un khmih ba-halor jong ngi haba ine la ïakhlad iwei na iwei pat . Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ruh ka Mibsan .
translation.en: And Mizpah  ; for he said , The  Lord  watch between me and thee , when we are absent one from another .

And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
translation.kha: Na ki jingkñia ainguh kiba da u masi ne ka langbrot , ki lyngdoh ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka tyrpeng , baroh ar ki ngab , bad ka  nierbah .

translation.en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la thew ïa ka , kito kiba lum kham bun kim shym ïoh tam , bad kito kiba lum kham khyndiat kim shym ïoh duna ; man la u briew u lum tang katba u lah ban bam .
Ki syiem ha ka Hukum naba U Trai u la ai lyngba u Moses , ba ka la hukum ïa ki Israel ban shongkha ban sah ha ki jakarieh bashipor ha ka por jong ka jingïakhaïi Madan Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And they found written in the law which the  Lord  had commanded by Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :
And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la poi , u Samuel u ïohi ïa u Eliab u khun jong u Jesse bad u ong ha lade ,  Une uba ïeng hangne ha khmat U  Trai  da shisha u dei uba U la jied .
To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ba-dap pura keiñ long ki jong phira lyngba ka jingtip jongki ph ïa U Blei bad ïa U Jisu U Trai jongngi ngi .
translation.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God , and of Jesus our Lord ,
And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :
translation.kha: Namar ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dinah ka para jong ki , ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la phai ktien ïa u Shekhem bad u Hamor u kpa jong u da ka buit shukor .

translation.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions , and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u leit ha khmat u syiem ka Ijipt , U Blei u la ai ha u ka akor kaba pynsngewbha bad ka jingstad ; bad u syiem u la pynlong lyngskor ïa u Joseph halor ka ri bad ka longïing syiem .
U ong ba nang wanrah ei ei kaba bha haba u pyrkhing don Bud ïa ka moi U Blei .
translation.en: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki baroh , Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , un bah ïa la ka diengphna man ka sngi , bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: And he said to them all ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross daily , and follow me .

translation.kha: Phi twa ïa ka nongbah jong U Blei , ka Jerusalem’ , ha ka nongrim jong ka jingpynïap briew bad ka jingbishar bymhok .
translation.en: They build up Zion with blood , and Jerusalem with iniquity .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah ñiew ha ka jingkheiñbriew , kata , naduh ibha arphew snem shaneng , u dei ban siew sha nga ïa kane ka dor ba la buh .
translation.en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Pynban , hajan lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la phet nep sha u Akhish , u syiem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .
So I took the evidence of the purchase , both that which was sealed according to the law and custom , and that which was open :
translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa baroh ar tylli ki kopi ka dulir thied jaka — ka kopi ba la shon muhor kaba don ka jingïakut bad ki kyndon , bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor —
Kumta u nongrah khuri pynrangbah u ong , Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga , la don uwei u dieng sohwaiñ ha khmat jong nga , uba don lai tukri ki tnat .
translation.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , In my dream , behold , a vine was before me  ;
But for his kin , that is near unto him , that is , for his mother , and for his father , and for his son , and for his daughter , and for his brother ,
translation.kha: lait noh kiba ïadei jan eh , kum ka kmie , u kpa , u khun , ka khun , u hynmen u para ,
Nangta u briew suba shitom na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh u la wiang sha u , u la dem khohsiew ha lamkhmat jong u , bad u la ong , Ko Kynrad , lada me moi , me lah ban pynlong khuid ïa nga .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .

translation.kha: Pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bol bad phin ïoh jingjop ; wat leit tad thma khlem da don ka Dura pynkhreh .
translation.en: Every purpose is established by counsel : and with good advice make war .

translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong phi da ki maw tylli ; bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ;
translation.en: Thou shalt build the altar of the  Lord  thy God of whole stones : and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  thy God :

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,
translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei paila u para jong uta umbiah la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka dei ba leit ha khmat ki nongïalam shnong sad ban ïai-ong , ‘ U sa kynsi jong nga um treh ban pynneh ïa ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um myn ban pyndep ïa la ka kamram .’
translation.en: And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .
The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbah jong pha ka long ka kut mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta phi ong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba lah ban pynhiar ïa nga sha tbian ?’
U Blei u la ïohi ïa katei kaba ki la leh ; u la ïuh ba ki la iaineh ïa ka jingsuk bymman jong ki . Kumta u la kylla jingman Bad um shym la pynshitom ïa ki kumba u la ong ban ar .
translation.en: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way  ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them  ; and he did it not .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi dei ban synshar da ka jingtied , kamra U Khrist u la ieit ïa ngi nabar u la pait ïa la ka jingshim na ka bynta jong ngi kamon ka jingainguh ba-iwbih bad ka jingkieng ba pynbhabriew ïa U Blei! .
translation.en: And walk in love , as Christ also hath loved us , and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour .

translation.kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la leit hiar na Katai ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïada loit na kawei ka Hul .
translation.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kaba u Jehoïakim u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haduh mynta . Dei namar kata ba ïa kata jaka la dang ïai khot ka Them Jingjynjar . Da kumta U  Trai  um shym da bitar shla shuh .

translation.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and enquired of him : and he described unto him the princes of Succoth , and the elders thereof , even threescore and seventeen men .
translation.kha: u la ïohkem ïa uwei u samla uba na Sukkoth bad u kylli ïa u . U samla u la thoh na ka bynta u Gideon ïa ki kyrteng jong ki hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh jong ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la sop da ka rnong , bad u kieng ïa u sum rnong ba tawah ha ka tyrpeng .
U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jyllop , Uta uba la lehbha ïa u . U Jisu u la jubab , Te , ma me khie leit bad leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .

translation.kha: Ka jinglorni kam lah ban set ïa kabu bashyrkhei . Kiar na ki briew kiba batynrai palat .
translation.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .

translation.kha: Ka dei ïa u banbeiñ long kham khraw Kaba ma nga , nur un-long kham rit .
translation.en: He must increase , but I must decrease .

translation.kha: Ki la lade ïa u Adonibesek hangta badno ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba u Lot u mih na Sodom , ka ding bad u kynta ki la iphuh na bneng bad la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .

translation.kha: Nangta U tharai u ong ha u Moses , Kane ka longïing kata ka ri ba ar la kular ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , sad u Jakob ba-bang ai ha ki khunlung ki ksiew jong ki . Nga la shah ïa me ban ïohi ïa ka , hynrei ngan ym shahïap ba men leit sharati .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , This is the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , saying , I will give it unto thy seed : I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes , but thou shalt not go over thither .
Woe to Ariel , to Ariel , the city where David dwelt ! add ye year to year  ; let them kill sacrifices .
translation.kha: Ka duwan U Blei , kaba long ka Jerusalem hi , kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ka nongbah ha kaba u Dabid u la sher dara kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ai ba sa kawei ne ar ki snem kin wan bad leit , ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai bad ki Jingkhawai Niam ,

Baroh ki paidlang Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeremoth ïa uba yn ioh tep donbor , namar u long tyngka ma u hi ïa uba U Trai , U Blei’ ki Israel , u sngewbha .
translation.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .
And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .
translation.kha: U kpa mar kumta hi u la pyrta ,  Nga don ka jingngeit , hynrei kam da biang . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don shuh shuh !
Namarkata don kiba ïai-ong : ‘ Ym u bhabriew u don ka mynsiem ka ba iaid lait na ka jinglah ?’
translation.en: Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’

translation.kha: Ki seh ïa u na ka kali ïasam jong u , ki Buh ïa u ha ka kali ïapom kaba ar kaba u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Jehudi bad Jerusalem ki ïambriew Namar ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .
And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .
translation.kha: ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa U Trai , haba u la ong ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad mihnoh kyrkieh na Jerusalem , namar ki briew hangne kin ym pdiang ïa ka jingsakhi jong me shaphang jong nga .’
Hangta un kynting sbai da ki ar tylli ki maw , uwei na ka bynta U Trai malu uwei pat na ka bynta u Asasel .
translation.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats  ; one lot for the  Lord  , and the other lot for the scapegoat .

translation.kha: Haba la tep , ka un-long kaba ijli bad naba tlot ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long kaba jynthut bad kabu khlaiñ .
translation.en: It is sown in dishonour ; it is raised in glory : it is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power :

translation.kha: Te mynta , ka por ka poi haba ngan phah ïa ki briew ban theh nong ïa ka mawbah kum ka waiñ . Kan pynthylli ïa ki khra buh waiñ dara pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will send unto him wanderers , that shall cause him to wander , and shall empty his vessels , and break their bottles .

translation.kha: Bad u Samuel u ong ha ki , Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa Shisien ngin pynbna ïa u Shaul kum u syiem jong ngi .
translation.en: Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .

translation.kha: namar kim pat shyiap la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingkñia ïa ki syn hajar jrut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .
translation.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongtuh bad ki briew bym don Blei ki im ha ka jingsuk , wat la u blei jong u long tang ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .

translation.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .
translation.kha: To pynkloi ban wan shuwa ka tlang . U Ïubulos bad u Pudens bad u Linos bad ka Klaudia bad kumjuh ruh kiwei pat ki parabangeit baroh ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong ki .

Hynrei mynta , ha khmih , ka la long sawphew san snem naduh ba U Trai u la ong ïa kata ha u Moses . Kata ka la long mynba ki Israel ki Dang ïasaid lyngba ïa ka ri shahjop , bad U thri , kumba u la kular , u la ri pynim ïa nga .
translation.en: And now , behold , the  Lord  hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years , even since the  Lord  spake this word unto Moses , while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness : and now , lo , I am this day fourscore and five years old .
Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .
translation.kha: Pynkloi ! mareh ! ngan ym lah ban leh ei ei tad haduh ba men da poi hangta .  Namar ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongrit la ai kyrteng ka Soar .

translation.en: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba la wah hapoh ka Templ la pynkad arliang .

translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U  Trai  ; rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! ïaroh ïa u , phi kiba ïaid lynti ha duriaw ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingthaw baroh ka duriaw ! Rwai , phi ki ri bajngai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .

translation.en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  ngan buh ïa me kum u nongap phira na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingmaham kiba nga ai ïa me .
Hynrei u Jisu u la jubab , Ngin dei ban leit sha kiwei nongrit ha kine ki thain . Nga dei ban ïalap ha ki ruh , namar dih na kata ka daw ba nga la wan .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Let us go into the next towns , that I may preach there also : for therefore came I forth .

translation.kha: U Abram u la shong la sah ha ka ri Kanah , bad u Khot u la shongsuk la sah hapdeng ki nongbeh ha ka them
translation.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .

translation.kha: U phah ki nonglamktien sha u Abimelekh ha Arumah ban ong , U Gaal u khun jong u Ebed bun ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u ki la wang sha Shekhem , sad kin ym shah ïa phi ban wan rung shapoh ka nongkhap .
