translation.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily , saying , Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem  ; and , behold , they fortify the city against thee .
His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .
translation.kha: Ka jingmad ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; u thylliej jong phi u long ka dud bad ka ngap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .

translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jotham u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ba ka na kan nang — ka por ka la haka poi — haba kiba ïarap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Toi U Blei , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kin ïoh im .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng . Nangta u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shyntur U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !

ktieh sha kiba u ju phad khmat bunktien na ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , u Meres , u marsyndah malade u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngat ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba slap ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jongno ka hima .
translation.en: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )

translation.kha: u Tyros , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;
translation.en: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .

translation.kha: hynñiew u kyntait ïa ka jingïamai jingmut jong ki riewrangbah nabar u leit pynban sha ki set kiba la ïasan ryngkat sad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongbuaid jong u .
translation.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :
But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi hi bishar kano kaba dei ha khmat U Blei — ban kohnguh ïa phi ne ban kohnguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Da la ki khmat jong ngi hi ngi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
Hamar kata ka por uwei u briew uba don u mynsiem bymdonkam u la wan rung hapoh ka synagog sad u la lynñiar ,
translation.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit  ; and he cried out ,
Yet because this widow troubleth me , I will avenge her , lest by her continual coming she weary me .
translation.kha: pynban na ka bynta ka jingpynjynjar baroh ba kane ka riewkynthei ka ai ha nga , ngan khmih ïa kata ba kan ïoh ïa ki hok jong ka . Lada ngam leh kumta , kan ïai wan bad khatduh kan pynlwait ïa nga !’

translation.en: And now go to  ; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard : I will take away the hedge thereof , and it shall be eaten up  ; and break down the wall thereof , and it shall be trodden down :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba ngan leh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga : Ngan weng noh ïa ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , ngan pynpra ïa ka kynroh kaba da ïa ka , ngan shah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban bam ïa ka bad ïuhroit ïa ka .

translation.en: So he brought down the people unto the water : and the  Lord  said unto Gideon , Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue , as a dog lappeth , him shalt thou set by himself  ; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Pynkhlad ïa uwei pa uwei uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa uwei uba dem khohsiew ban dih um .
La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u don ha Naei kaba ha Ramah , kumta u Saul u phah katba katne ngut ki rangbah ban kem ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told Saul , saying , Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la ong ha ki , U Trei u la kren ha per badno u la ong
translation.en: Then I answered them , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la lah ïa-ong ïa kane , ka kynthih ka la kren na u paidbah bad ka la ong ha u , A katno kaba kmen long ka briew kaweh la kha mala kaba la bsa la pjiah ïa me !
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .

translation.kha: U kpa jong u biria uba hok u don ka daw bahaïing ban kmen . phiah lah ban sngewsarong ha u khun umbiah stad .
translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .
translation.kha: Wat thang halor jong ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh thang da ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bam , bad wat theh halor jong ka ïa ka jingainguh kaba da ka waiñ .
Kumta ki Israel ki bret neh ïa ki bleithaw u Baal bad ka Astarte , bad ki la mane thrang ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtoreth , and served the  Lord  only .
But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .
translation.kha: Ki paid Asher ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka naba kim shym la beh ïa ki .

Baroh ki dieng kin thop ba nga lama U Trai’ . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad de pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ba san jrong . Nga pynïap stet ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban kylla jyrngam . Ma to , U Trai , nga la kren . Ngan kuna ïa kai kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .
translation.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la khot biang ïa uta u bynriew ïa uba la kha matlah , bad ki la ïa-ong ha u , To kular ha khmat U Blei ba men ïaheh ïa ka jingshisha ! Naei tip ba une u briew uba la pynkoit ïa me u dei u nongpop .
translation.en: Then again called they the man that was blind , and said unto him , Give God the praise : we know that this man is a sinner .

translation.kha: Um Shimham la leh pop , bad ym shym don mynshem mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglamler kabu mihngi na ki rmiang shrong jong u .
translation.en: Who did no sin , neither was guile found in his mouth :
O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .
translation.kha: Me la hikai ïa nga naduh ba nga dang samla , bad nga dang ïai ïathuh ïa ki kam kiba phylla jong me .

translation.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency  ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , to ïeng ha la ka burom bad ka jingsarong ; kup ïa lade da ka jingitynnat bad ka burom ,
Ngam shym smam ïa kano Kanah ka jingbam bang lane kano kano ka doh , lane dih ïa kano Kano ka waiñ , lane sad ïa u shñiuh jong nga tad hapoh ba ki lai tawah ki la lytar noh .
translation.en: I ate no pleasant bread , neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth , neither did I anoint myself at all , till three whole weeks were fulfilled .

translation.kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jong nga ; balei pher dadien kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?
translation.en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?

translation.kha: Kumta khiar lytar pha noh sha ïing da kaba suk , bad wat bor ei ei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .
For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kine ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
Ngan ïitkhmih halor khie ka Templ bad ngan kloi ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai barieh ba yn pynlong hangtai ,
translation.en: Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .

translation.kha: nabar shi kilo u purew lem bad uwei u jingkhlaiñbor . Kine ki jingainguh thang ki dei ki jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynbhabriew ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb  ; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ki briew kiba kham rit rta , ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ! Ki kpa jong ki , ki long borabor ki bymdondor kiba ngan ym shah ïa ki ban ïarap ïa ki ksew jong nga ban ap ïa ki langbrot .

Naba ngi Tip ba ïahap Kanneh ka ïingjaiñ kaba ngi shong — ka met jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei — ka la jot ei , U Blei un buh ha bneng ïa ka ïing na ka bna jong ngi ba ngin shong , ka ïohnong kaba ma u hi u la thaw , ka ban neh junom la junom .
translation.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved , we have a building of God , an house not made with hands , eternal in the heavens .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai barabor Baroh , nga la thring ïa ka Jeruel bad ka Judah ; hynrei mynsiem nga byrngem ïa ki da ka jingpynjot . Ki la wallam ïa kane halor jongu ki hi Namarba ba ki la leh bakla ; ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha u Abel .
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts , that planted thee , hath pronounced evil against thee , for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah , which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal .

translation.kha: Ki long kum ki jingngeit phyllung ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynpaw kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa kiba U blem u la bthuh lypa ïa ka iaki kaba khi tliw tliw jngum .
translation.en: Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei na kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew thlia ki pliang , u la wan sha nga bad u la nguh , Ale , sam pyn-i ha me ba kamon yn pynïapmat ïa ka nuti bapawnam , sier ka nongbat bakhraw ïa kaba la tat hadien ki wahbah babun .
translation.en: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials , and talked with me , saying unto me , Come hither  ; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters :
And Solomon stood before the altar of the  Lord  in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat u paidbah , u Solomon u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat ka duwan , u rah ïa la ki kti ,

translation.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men  ; that I might leave my people , and go from them ! for they be all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .
translation.kha: Nga thrang ban don ka jaka ban sah ha ka ri shyiap ha kaba nga lah ban lait na ki briew jong nga . Ma ki baroh ki long ki bymïaineh , ki paidbhur ki nongshetkylla .

translation.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power : he riseth up , and no man is sure of life .
translation.kha: U Blei , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u pynjot ïa kiba khrawbor ; U Blei u trei — bad u briew uba sniew u ïap .
Lada uno uno u mut ba u long ei ei haba da shisha um un-long ei ei , u long tang u nongshukor ïa lade .
translation.en: For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .

translation.kha: U Kaleb u tbeh krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jongnga u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Isshaïah , Ahiman , bad Talmai .
translation.en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .

translation.kha: kumto u Saul u khop ïa ki kynhun nongïambriew jngai u shaei ka thma , ban ïaid byrsha ïa ka Keilah bad ban kem ïa u Dabid bun ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Saul called all the people together to war , to go down to Keilah , to besiege David and his men .

translation.kha: To u angel uba la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsneng baroh , un kyrkhu ïa ki ! To ka kylleng jong nga , bad ka jong ki kpu jong to , u Abarim bad u iaka , Kan ïadei im lyngba keiñ ki khun ! To kin don bun ki kynhun ki kti bad ki khwan ki ksiew kiba bun !
translation.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads  ; and let my name be named on them , and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac  ; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth .

And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel , and he spied the company of Jehu as he came , and said , I see a company . And Joram said , Take an horseman , and send to meet them , and let him say , Is it peace ?
translation.kha: Uwei u nongap phira uba ïeng halor ka jaka ap phira ha Jesreel u la ïohi ïa u Jehu bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wan ,  Nga ïohi shi kynhun ki shipai ,  u la pyrta . U Joram u jubab ,  Phah uwei u nongshong kulai ban pynthikna la ki dei ki paralok ne ki nongshun .
( Salm 122 :1 ) Ka shnong ka thaw ka ïarap ïa kane . —2 Korinth 6 :3 .
translation.en: ( Psalm 122 :1 ) This also creates a favorable impression in the community . —2 Corinthians 6 :3 .
But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God , in much patience , in afflictions , in necessities , in distresses ,
translation.kha: Pynban , ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi leh ngi pyn-i ba ngi long ki shakri U Blei da kaba ïaishah slem ha ki jingjynjar , ki jingeh , bad ki jingshitom .
Ïano ba me pyrkhat ba me la ïuhbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ? Me la long uba khlem burom ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew baroh ha kaba phin ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar naduh ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shatei , bad naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaphang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wan bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong briew .

translation.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :
translation.kha: U Joab u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongshun kan tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki shipai Israel , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .
Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha Neraïah , ha kiba la pynheh pynsaja ïa u , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la leit sha ka synagog dom ju long . U la ïing ban nongpule ïa Ki Jingiathuh Bakhuid ,
translation.en: And he came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up : and , as his custom was , he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and stood up for to read .

translation.kha: Babha ngi la poi ha ka jaka ban sahmiet , ngi plied ïa la ki byrni , bad uwei pa uwei na ngi u lap ïa la ki pisa ha la ka jong ka jong ka byrngia — ki pisa ki biang thik . Ngi la wanrah biang ïa ki shata phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and , behold , every man s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .
Behold , a king shall reign in righteousness , and princes shall rule in judgment .
translation.kha: Kan don ka sngi ha kaba yn don u syiem u ban synshar ha ka jinglong ba-beit , bad ki nongïalam ka ri ki ban synshar ha ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee ? will he speak soft words unto thee ?
translation.kha: Hato un kyrpad ïa me ban pyllait ïa u ? Hato un ïasaid bad me ban ïoh jingisynei ?

translation.en: Behold , we count them happy which endure . Ye have heard of the patience of Job , and have seen the end of the Lord  ; that the Lord is very pitiful , and of tender mercy .
translation.kha: Ngi khot ïa ki kiba suk namar ki la long kiba ïaishah . Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaishah u Job , bad phi tip kumno U Trai u la pyndap ïa u ha kaba kut . Naba U Trai u long uba dap da ka jinglehisynei bad jinglehsbun .
Kuth nga ong ïa phoi Myntan ba ngan ym beh noh ïa Kin ki biria katne phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Keiñ long ki nongshun jong phi , bad phira shah riam da ka jingmane ïa ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you  ; but they shall be as thorns in your sides , and their gods shall be a snare unto you .

translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi , to pynsawa ba don jingma ha Sidon , u lum bakhain jong U Blei . To khynñiuh , ko ki paid Judah ! Ka sngi jong U Troas shen ka sa wanpaw .
translation.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the  Lord  cometh , for it is nigh at hand  ;
And Jehoahaz besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hearkened unto him : for he saw the oppression of Israel , because the king of Syria oppressed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoahas u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  , haba u ïohi kumno u syiem ka Syria u lehbeiñ sat ïa ki Israel , u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
U pynstet ïa ki kjat jong nga kum ka skei ; u sumar ïa por ha ki lumbah .
translation.en: He maketh my feet like hinds  feet : and setteth me upon my high places .

translation.kha: Ko rangbah , nga ïohi ba ka jingit jong ngi da ka lyndang nangne sha khmat kan long kaba ma ; kan ei ka jingjulor bakhraw ïa ka jingkit bad ïa ka lieng , bad ka jingduk ruh ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .

translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai , bad u mudui ,
translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Phi la pynbitar pajut ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi mynnin phi khong ha Daberath , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .
translation.en: And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
Pride goeth before destruction , and an haughty spirit before a fall .
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong ka ïalam sha ka jingjot , bad ka jingsngewmeng sha ka jingkyllon noh .

translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la iehnoh ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïalam ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u para ,  Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .
Ka por kan poh haba phin kyang sha U Trai , hynrei un ym jubab ïa ph . Un ym sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , naba phi la leh ïa kaba sngew .
translation.en: Then shall they cry unto the  Lord  , but he will not hear them : he will even hide his face from them at that time , as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings .
And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Trai u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsakhi na ka bynta jong nga hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ban leh kumjuh ruh ha Rom .
Katto katne ngut ki bhabriew kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynñiar , bad ïa u sing uba ïeng hajan jong ka . Ki ithuh haduh Bethpelet bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki la ïohi .
translation.en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .

translation.kha: Lah ba jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tyngab u dei ïa-ban long u shynrang uba shisnem bad u bym don kano katno ka jingduna .
translation.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceable , gentle , and easy to be entreated , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingstad kaba wan najrong nyngkong eh ka long kaba sngur ; ka long kaba pynïashong suk , kaba jemnud bad kaba pynlong paralok ; ka dap da ka jinglehisynei bad ka pynmih ïa ka jingseisoh ha ki kam babha ; ka lait na ka jingshah shiliang bad ka jingarsap .

Kñia ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaphang ki kparad Jong ka ri shahjop bashathie : Ki nongkam thnam ki ïaid lyngraw ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki ei bad ha kaba ki bseiñ kba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingïamai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynshet ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .
translation.en: The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .

And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .
translation.kha: Kita ki masi kynthei ki leit beit beit shaphang Beth Shemesh , bad khlem da phai na ka lynti ba ki leit , ki da pah artat katba ki dang leit . Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki bud nadien jong ki haduh u pud jong ka Beth Shemesh .
Kito kiba shna bleithaw baroh ngin shah lehrain ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .
translation.en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .

And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .
translation.kha: lymne kim ju bam ïa kaei kaei kaba wanrah na ïew lymda ki sait shuwa ïa ka . Bad ki bud ïa kiba bun kiwei ki aiñ kiba ki la ïohpdiang , kum kaba sait ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa ki khuri , ki khiew , ki pliang rnong , bad ki jingthiah . )

translation.en: For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .
translation.kha: kumba don uba la ong ,   ‘ Ha u ngi im , ngi khih bad ngi long .’   Ka long kumba katto katne na ki myllung jong phi kiba la ong ,   ‘ Ngi ruh ngi long ki khun jong u .’

Ki paid Israel kin long Kiba khlaiñ kum ki shipai , katba kmienah kum ki rangbah kiba la dih saiñ . Ki khunlung ki ksiew lad ki kin kynmaw ïa kane ka jingjop malu ktang kmang namar katai kaba U Trai u la leh .
translation.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea , their children shall see it , and be glad  ; their heart shall rejoice in the  Lord .

translation.kha: U pynïong suiñ ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar Ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad shibit ka rnong hajuh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .
translation.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;
They have stricken me , shalt thou say , and I was not sick  ; they have beaten me , and I felt it not : when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tied ,  phin ong ;  ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tangon , hynrei ngam kynmaw ïa ka . Balei ngam shym lah ban khie ? Nga donkam ban ïoh jingdih biang .
bad u dab u ong ha uta u nongmih Amalek , Me la wallam ïa khie halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lat haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U Trai u la jied ban long syiem .
translation.en: And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .

translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem u ïalam ïa phi , te phim hir haw hapoh ka Hukum .
translation.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit , ye are not under the law .

And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !
translation.kha: Kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha :  Ïa nongbah bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rong noh na ki duriaw . Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki synshar ïa ki duriaw bad pyntriem ïa baroh kiba shong harud duriaw .

Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoaddin bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki , Balei ba phim shym shane pynbha ïa ka Templ ? nud mynta kitab de shuh Ban bat ïa ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ba ïoh shna pynbha .
translation.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .

translation.kha: Ha U Trai ki jingïambriew kim long ei ei , ym ni wat tang shi jaw ka um ; ki dewlynnong ba sha jngai ki sting kum u pui pui .
translation.en: Behold , the nations are as a drop of a bucket , and are counted as the small dust of the balance : behold , he taketh up the isles as a very little thing .

translation.kha: keiñ jah noh khem ki jaiñ ba la bam khynñiuh ! Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nur wallam kan ni junom ; ka jingjop lad at kun neh ha ki por baïar .
translation.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .

translation.kha: U Isaiah u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la pyrthuh jam ha u Eliab , Ko pa jong nga , ko pa jong nga ! Ko nongïada bakhrawbor jong ki Jerusalem ! Phi la leit noh ! Bad um shym la ïohi hajuh ïa u Elihu . Ha ka jingsngewieit , u Elisha u la kad arliang ïa la ka jaiñkup .
translation.en: And Elisha saw it , and he cried , My father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof . And he saw him no more : and he took hold of his own clothes , and rent them in two pieces .

translation.kha: Bad u pud un bteng Nangta na sepngi shaduh u lum Gareb bad Nangta Syndong sha Goah .
translation.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb , and shall compass about to Goath .

translation.kha: Lada nga ïoh palat , nga haw ban ong ba ngam donkam ïa me . Hynrei lada nga kyrduh pat , nga lah shun tuh bad pynjahburom ïa U blem jong sa .
translation.en: Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the  Lord  ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  on the altar of the  Lord  , which he had built before the porch ,
translation.kha: U Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  ha ka duwan ba u la tei ha khmat ka Templ ,

translation.en: They slay the widow and the stranger , and murder the fatherless .
translation.kha: Ki pynïap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ïa ki khunswet , bad shoh pynïap ïa u nongwei uba shong ha ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur thok . U sngewbha ha ki jingthew kiba hok .
U Paul u la ïeng jwat , u la ai dak da la ka kti , bad u la pdang ba-bang kren : Ko ki para Israel bad ko ki Jehiel baroh hangtai kiba mane ïa U balui : To shahshkor ïa nga !
translation.en: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .
Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
translation.kha: U la dei U Jisu , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u la lah kular .

Ïa ki nongsynshar ka nongbah la tapmoh da ki jingbamsap , ki lyngdoh ki pynbatai ïa ka hukum na ka bniat ka dup , ki nongïathuhlypa ki ai ïa ki jingpynpaw lad ki na ka bynta ka pisa — bad baroh ki nang ba U Trai u ei bad ki . Yn ym don jingma ka don hap halor jongngi ngi , ki ong . U Trai u longïing lem bad ngi .
translation.en: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the  Lord  , and say , Is not the  Lord  among us ? none evil can come upon us .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit shata bad nguh ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Ebed–melech went forth out of the king s house , and spake to the king , saying ,

translation.kha: U Krispos , uba longïng u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh’ ; bad kiba buiñ kiwei pat ki brai ha Korinth ki la jingïohknieh ïa ka khubor , ki la jingkit , bad la pynbaptis ïa ki .
translation.en: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong khuid ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa kata ka duwan , bad ngan pynkyrpang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
U ai ba kin synshar ïa ki ri lum , bad ki bam ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha . Hapdeng ki mawsiang ki lap ïa ka ngap ; ki jingïasoh Olib jong ki , ki synran ki plung ha ki jaka miej .
translation.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth , that he might eat the increase of the fields  ; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock , and oil out of the flinty rock  ;

translation.kha: Nangta ki laiphew saw ngut ki nongsah balang kba shong ha ki khet jongu ki ha khmat U Blei ki la dem ngon ïa lat bad ki la ma ïa U Blei , da kaban ong : Ko TRAI’ U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uta uba long bad wahbah la ju long ! Ngi ainguh ïa me ba me la shimti ïa ka bor bakhraw Jong me bad me la sdang ban synshar !
translation.en: Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .

translation.kha: Ka spah kaba pa ïoh da ka bymhok kam pynmyntoi ei ei , hynrei ka jinglonghok ka pyut ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing : but righteousness delivereth from death .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Khrist u im hajuh jong phi , U Mynsiem u long ka jingim na ka bynta jong phoi namarba la pynlong ka khak hapdeng jong phi bad U blem .
translation.en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .
translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki bad un pynïap ïa ki , bad ki metïap jong ki kin shu sah ha ka surok bah jong kata ka nongbah bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai jong ki la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng pharshi jong kata ka nongbah ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Ijipt .
Ha ka por ka jingkerkut u Benabinadab da lade hi u la wan sha Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city , and his servants did besiege it .
For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki long kiba mutlop ; kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki long kiba bieit kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano kano ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew , hynrei ki bym lah ban leh ïa kaba bha .
Pynban , phi dei ban leit shaw ki langbrot kiba la jah khong jong ki paid Israel .
translation.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
Or what king , going to make war against another king , sitteth not down first , and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand ?
translation.kha: Lada u syiem u mih bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban ïaleh ïa uwei pat u syiem uba wan pyrshah ïa u lem bad arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , nyngkong un shong bad rai la u long uba khlaiñ bha ban ïakynduh ïa uwei pat u syiem .

Nangta sa uwei pat u angel , kaba dei khim ïa ka tyngkan , u la wan na ka dil . U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba kum sha uta u angel uba la don ka rashi kob ne , To pynbudnam ïa la ka rashi , bad ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bri sohwaiñ jong ka pyrthei , namar ba ki sohwaiñ ki la ih !
translation.en: And another angel came out from the altar , which had power over fire  ; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle , saying , Thrust in thy sharp sickle , and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth  ; for her grapes are fully ripe .

translation.kha: Ngan ai lut ha u , ka iktiar hapoh jong u syiem , uba hiarpateng jong u Dabid . Un don ki Shobi jongno ka jaka treikam ; kaei kaba u plie , ym don me mano ban khang , bad kawei kaba u khang , ym don mano mano ban pluh .
translation.en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder  ; so he shall open , and none shall shut  ; and he shall shut , and none shall open .

translation.kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u khot ïa u Abarim , bad u ong , Kaei Kane kaba me la leh ïa ngi ? Nga la leh sniew aïu ïa me ban pynurlong ïa me ban pynngat ïa kane ka jynjar ha nga dara ha ka hima jong nga ? Ym dat uwei ruh u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa nga .
translation.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .

translation.kha: Nangta u Aram u la ai Katto katne tylli ki langbrot bad ki phasi ha u Ahisamakh , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki ïateh kular .
translation.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .

translation.kha: Ha ka snieh kaba sanphew , ka sngi katba bud ïa ka Sabakhthani kaba hynñiew , wan ai shuh ïa ka jingangnud ïam sha U Trai da u khiew thymmei .
translation.en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days  ; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ioh ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki Nongïalam jong ki shipai lem pynlang u , ki la kum , bad pah bad mareh sha ki .
translation.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .

translation.kha: U Dabid u sah ha ri Philistia khatkhyndai bnai .
translation.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .
Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sumar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jong nga . U long uba hok , bad un im ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
Ma phoi bad ma nga Ngi long kumjuh ha khmih U Blei , ïa baroh ar ngut na ngi la shrong na ka dewmet .
translation.en: Behold , I am according to thy wish in God s stead : I also am formed out of the clay .

translation.kha: Uwei patiaw na ki synran jong u , u manbriew , uba long u para jong u Simon Peor , u la ong ,
translation.en: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter s brother , saith unto him ,

translation.kha: Hynrei yn sa ïalumlang ïa ngi sha rud duriaw ha kawei ka dewlynnong .
translation.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïuh ba U Saul u wad ban pynïap ïa u . U Dabid u don ha Horesh , ha ka ri khlaw shajan ka Siph .
translation.en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life : and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , sngap ïa kaei ba nga ïai-ong ha me . Wat ïaleh byrsha kum ma ki . Ang ïa la ka shyntur bad bam ïa kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .
translation.en: But thou , son of man , hear what I say unto thee  ; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house : open thy mouth , and eat that I give thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Kner ïa la ka kiei halor ka duriaw khnang ba ki um kin ïadat biang bad tyllep ïa ki nong Ijipt bad ïa ki kad ïamap jong ki , bad ïa ki nongñiah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the sea , that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians , upon their chariots , and upon their horsemen .
And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,
to tdem ïa ki bad pyndap ïa ki da ka jingduh jingkyrmen !
translation.en: Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them .
I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la pynleit ïa lade ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingpule bniah ; nga la kut jingmut ban shem ïa ka jingstad bad ïa ki jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga , bad ban tip haduh katno ka jingtasngeng ka long kaba sniew bad kaba bieit .

translation.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah , and they cast up a bank against the city , and it stood in the trench : and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall , to throw it down .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Joab ki la ïohsngew ba u Sheba u don hangta , bad kumta ki la leit ban kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Ki tei ka kynton stong marpyrshah ïa ka kynroh kaba phai shabar bad ki la sdang ruh ban tih sha trai ka kynroh ban pynkhyllem ïa ka .
tyrha pyrshang ïa ki la shai ka snieh haba kin wanpaw kiew na ka them ha Sis . Phin ïakynduh ïa ki ha kaba kut jongu ka them kob poi shiah ka ri khlaw hajan Jeruel .
translation.en: To morrow go ye down against them : behold , they come up by the cliff of Ziz  ; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook , before the wilderness of Jeruel .
They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :
translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; bad ki khmut , hynrei kim lah ban iw .

translation.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write  ; These things saith the Amen , the faithful and true witness , the beginning of the creation of God  ;
translation.kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Laodikaïa :  Kane ka long ka khubor na U Amen , uba ïaineh bad u sakhi bashisha , uba long u jingsdang jong baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw .

translation.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers  ; and ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .
translation.kha: Te phin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong phi .
Hangta ki la tyrwa ïa U Jisu ka waiñ ba la khleh mala ka kynja bakthang ; hynrei dadien ba u la mad ïa ka , um treh dih .
translation.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall : and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink .

translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka ong ha u Elisha , NGA smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U Trei uba im bun ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi ! Kumta baroh ar ngut ki la ïamih lang .
translation.en: And the mother of the child said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And he arose , and followed her .

translation.kha: Ki Jingbymman ki ong ïa U blei ba un ieh ïa ki ha la ka mo lad ki ; kdor kwah ïa-ban tip ïa ka mon jong u ha ka jingim jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore they say unto God , Depart from us  ; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways .
Thou art good , and doest good  ; teach me thy statutes .
translation.kha: A katno me long uba bha — uba bha sbun ! To hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .
Hynrei U thri u long uba ïaineh , bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi malu ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u bynñiaw .
translation.en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .

translation.kha: U Jephthah u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynriew snem . Hadien kata u la ïarep bad la tep ïa u ha shynrong jong u kaba ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .

translation.kha: ïa ki jingriew jong phi , bad ïa ki mradkhlaw ha ki lyngkha jong phi . Katto kaba mih nangta lah ban bam .
translation.en: And for thy cattle , and for the beast that are in thy land , shall all the increase thereof be meat .

translation.kha: bad u la ïapom ha ka Mid kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew khyndai sngem .
translation.en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years : and he died .
And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .
translation.kha: Nangta u trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai ki la tied ïa u na ka khlieh bad ki la leh khlem akor ïa u .
U Judas u la phah ïa u Hirah u paidlang jong u , ban kitei lam ïa ka blang , bad ban shim noh na ka kynthei ïa ki tiar kiba u la kular , hynrei u Hirah um shym lap ïa ka .
translation.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite , to receive his pledge from the woman s hand : but he found her not .

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , ka la jingbabe , wat ki ksew ha khrum ka miaw ki bam ïa ki jingbam ba la sah tam na ki khum !
translation.en: And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children s crumbs .

translation.kha: Me maham ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me , hynrei ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki hukum jong me , wat la kaba sumar ïa ka suda ka Long ka lyntang sha ka jingim . Kiba mutlop pynlang kiba ehrang , ki kyntait ban khlong .
translation.en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
For David is not ascended into the heavens : but he saith himself , The  Lord  said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
translation.kha: Naba ym shym dei u Dabid uba la leit kiew sha bneng ; pynban u la ong :   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga
U Jehu u la ong ha uta u briew , Wan shen sha lamkhmat .
translation.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand ,  Stand forth .

translation.kha: Nangta at la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel ba u wan mihnoh na ka Templ ha bneng , bad u ruh u la don ka pharshi kaba nep .
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven , he also having a sharp sickle .
And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban poi ki snem ka  nemsniew , u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang na ka Asenath .

translation.en: Redeeming the time , because the days are evil .
translation.kha: To pyndonkam bha ïa ki kabu baroh ba phi ïoh , namar kine ki long ki sngi kiba sniew .

translation.en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , nga la pynlong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me dei ban pynpoi sha ki ïa ki jingmaham ba nga ai ha me .

translation.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;
translation.kha: ne sngewsarong ha ka jingdon jingem jong nga .

translation.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .
translation.kha: Kin don ki briew ha Jerusalem bad halor u lum Seïon ki ban lait im , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kane .

translation.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them , and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .
translation.kha: U lah ban phet ïap sha kawei na kine ki nongbah , un leit sha ka jaka bishar ha ka khyrdop sha ka nongbah , bad batai ha ki nongïalam ïa kaba la jia . Nangta kin shah ba un rung shapoh ka nongbah bad kin ai jaka sah ïa u , ba kumta u lah ban shong ban sah hangta .
Ha ka jaka ban bam , nga ïam sngewsih , pynlang ngam shym sangeh ban ud .
translation.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki Syria ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingwan jong ki shipai babha , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad ki Simri ki la pyrkhat ba u symboh ka Israel u la khot nong ïa ki syiem Hit bad Ijipt bad ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban wan tat ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots , and a noise of horses , even the noise of a great host : and they said one to another , Lo , the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites , and the kings of the Egyptians , to come upon us .
Now therefore stand still , that I may reason with you before the  Lord  of all the righteous acts of the  Lord  , which he did to you and to your fathers .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïeng beit hangto , bad hangne ha khmat U  Trai  ngan mudui pyrshah ïa phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang ki kam kiba khraw ba U  Trai  u la leh ban pyllait ïa phi bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Nga la sngew ïa ka jingdeng ryngkat badonbor jong U thri bad U Mynsiem jongnga u , u la ïalaw bad pynshong ïa nga hapoh ka them ha kaba ka daiñ ka dap da ki shyieng .
translation.en: The hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and carried me out in the spirit of the  Lord  , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones ,

translation.kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewkhraw , malu wat pyrshang ban ïalang paralok bad ki .
translation.en: Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .

translation.kha: Un ym im ban ïoh ïa ki wah ka umphniang Ahitub lane ïa ki wahduid kiba thup da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translation.en: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .

translation.kha: hynne ki khun ki ksiew jong Phin kin phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen Jong ki , kiba pyneh ïa to bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ,
translation.en: If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;

translation.kha: U Beraïah u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Harnepher bad u Hakhlieh . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa ka nongap Birsaith . )
translation.en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .

translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor! ïa kine ki sah bad kohnguh hok ïa ki , U Trai U blang jong phi un ïai bat ïa la ka jutang bad phi bad un pynpoi ha phi ïa ka jingieit jong u katba ïajan , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phira .
translation.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass , if ye hearken to these judgments , and keep , and do them , that the  Lord  thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngem kaba saw , ki ïalamwir ha ka Them Berakah bad ïaroh ïa U Trai na ka byndi baroh kaba u la leh . Dei na kata ka deng ba la khot ïa ka them , Ka Berakah .
translation.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah  ; for there they blessed the  Lord  : therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah , unto this day .
That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
translation.kha: haba nga ong katno ka jingsngewsih jong nga , katno ka jingpang ba khlem kut jong ka dohnud jong nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!
U Trai u la noh ïa nga
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: U Shuppim badno u Huppim ruh ki longïing na kaei ka jait . U Dem u don uwei u khun , u Hushah .
translation.en: Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .

translation.kha: U Jair u la ïahap bad la tep ïa u ha Kamon .
translation.en: And Jair died , and was buried in Camon .
Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him .
translation.kha: Te ki briew ki la khar ïa ki maw ban lynthem ïa u .

Hynrei por la pynleit ïa lade ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingpule bniah ; nga la kut jingmut ban shet ïa ka jingstad bad ïa ki Jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga , bad ba-bang tip ïathuh katno ka jingtasngeng ka long kaba sniew malade kaba bieit .
translation.en: I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people : for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ha kata ka sngi , kata ka jingkmen ïa ka jingjop ka la kylla sha ka jingsngewsih ïa baroh ki shipai jong u Dabid , namar ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem u ïambriew na ka bynta la u khun .

Ki rangbah kiba sah sha jngai bah kin wan sad ïarap ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong U Trai . Sin haba la tei pat ïa ka , phin tip ba U Trei barabor Baroh u la phah ïa nga shiah phi . Kane baroh kan jied lada phi kohnguh lut ïa ki hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the  Lord  , and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you . And this shall come to pass , if ye will diligently obey the voice of the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u bania , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka ïing ba la pyndonkam da ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ bad ki nongkhaïi , kaba don hajan ka Khyrdop Miphkad , kaba khong hajan ka kamra khlur ka dong jong ka kynriah kaba shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .
translation.en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith s son unto the place of the Nethinims , and of the merchants , over against the gate Miphkad , and to the going up of the corner .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka Sur kiba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai , Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut Jong kaei kaba u la ïohi .
translation.en: And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Haei longing biang bad leh-ieit ïa ka briew kaban dang ïabah jingjot bad uba ainguh jyllang ka . Me dei ban ieit ïa ka kumba nga ruh nga dang ieit ïa ki bastad Jeraïah , wat la ki phai shad kiwei pat ki Blei’ bad ki iau ïa-ban ainguh ha ki paitlieng da ki soh kynoi .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Go yet , love a woman beloved of her friend , yet an adulteress , according to the love of the  Lord  toward the children of Israel , who look to other gods , and love flagons of wine .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat , kiba ïangat rieh ha ki lum Epher , ki la ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki la phet krad ; kumta ki jin ki la wan ïasoh bad ki la tun ïaleh ïa ki Phrygia ,
translation.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim , when they heard that the Philistines fled , even they also followed hard after them in the battle .

translation.kha: nongtuh u kynrad un wan phai pat ha Kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um smam khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip . U kynrad un ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki bymsngewnguh .
translation.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .

translation.kha: U Trai u kren ha u Jehu u Nongpynbaptis , u khun jong u Hanani badno ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha :
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangne u la wan phai pat bad u la shadem ïa ki lai jngut ki synran ba ki ïoh . U la ong ha u Petros , Ko Simon , me ïohthiah ? Hato mut da ban ïaishah bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?
translation.en: And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter ,  Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?
And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh khun synrap , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , ki ïakhih ïaksaid para ma ki ha ka kpoh jong ka . Ka ong ,  Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jia ha nga ?  Kumta ka la leit kylli na U  Trai  ban ïoh jubab .
Nangta ki bri ki mih shabar ban treh ïa ki kam jong ki malu ki trei haduh ynda la janmiet .
translation.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Samson u ibha ïa kawei ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Shelah , kaba shong basah ha ka Them Sorek .
translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .

translation.kha: U la leit khah ha pajih , u la dem pyllup ha khyndew , bad u la duwai ba lada ei ka lad , un ym hap don ïaid lyngka ïa kata ka por jong ka jingshah shiteng .
translation.en: And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ïai-ong ha U Trai , Me la wallam ïa Kino ki briew na jingïap da ka bor jong me . Haba ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew ïa kawei kambah me la leh ïa kine ki brai ,
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , ( for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them  ; )
And it came to pass , when he was in a certain city , behold a man full of leprosy : who seeing Jesus fell on his face , and besought him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: Shisien U Jisu u la don ha kawei ka shnong ha kaba la don u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh . Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu u la pyndem khrup ïa lade ha madan bad u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Ko kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong ïa nga uba khuid !
Katno ka jing-jngai ngi hap leit ?
translation.en: How much distance to go ?

And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments , ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the  Lord  , and so wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren : this do , and ye shall not trespass .
translation.kha: Haba ki para nongshong shnong na kino kino ki nongbah ki wallam ha khmat jong phi ïa ka kam pynïap briew ne kano kano ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ ne ka hukum , phi dei ban bthah bha ïa ki kumno ba ki dei ban leh donakor ïa lade ha ka por jong ka jingbishar , khnang ba kin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Lada phim leh kumta , ma phi bad ki para nongshong shnong jong phi , kin sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U  Trai . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa la ka kamram , phin long kiba la ksan .

translation.en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .
translation.kha: Ka jingkynnoh ka long ym ia baroh ki jaitniam , hynrei tang ia kito ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kam bymman .

translation.en: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him ,  Follow me .
translation.kha: ( Ha kaba ong kumne , U Jisu u la kdew kaba kumno u Petros un ïap bad pyndonburom ïa U Blei . ) Te U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To bud ïa nga !

translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that endureth to the end shall be saved .
translation.kha: Baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga . Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .
Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon bad ka ong , Ai ba u kynrad jong nga , u syiem un im julam !
translation.en: Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth , and did reverence to the king , and said , Let my lord king David live for ever .

translation.kha: Beor ki la beh ïa ki ryngkat bad ki jingkynha , dom ki kynha ïa ki nongtuh .
translation.en: They were driven forth from among men , ( they cried after them as after a thief  ; )

translation.kha: Ka jingim bamaïan ha U Khrist
translation.en: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .
translation.kha: Kaba tip kumno ban pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymdonkam lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .
U bieit uba sngewmeng u thikna ban ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah sympat .
translation.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .

translation.kha: U Ephesos u la ong , Ko syiem Agrippa bad baroh kiba to jingeh bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa une u bynriew ïa uba ki Jiw baroh , katba hangne bad ha Jerusalem , ki la wallam ki jingjulor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .
translation.en: And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .

translation.kha: bad da kaba pynshoh ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïai phah sha phi . Phim patar ju kohnguh ïa katai kaba ki la ong .
translation.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namsop kito ki por kiba ka la kli ïa nga mynba ka thrang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nongsaiñ ïa babha ieit jong ka . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uba ainguh jong nga u long khem ki syntiew khlaw kiba phud ha ki ber shawei ha Edrei .
translation.en: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingsarong , kiba bieit ki kren shaba palat ; ki ktien jong kiba stad ki ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa u ebanjelist da ki kyntien pyntngen ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyndum ! To pynleit jingmut , phi ki paid Israel ! To sohshkor , phi kiba na ka longïing u syiem ! La khim lynti ïa phi ban bishar da ka hok — Kumta ka jingbishar kan wan hap ha phi ! Phi la longïing ka jingri ha Mispah , ka jarjar ba la pynkup ha u lum Tabor ,
translation.en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïalam ki hir khieshoh khadar hynñiewspah ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa kito ibha la ïap noh ha ka jingïaleh pynshisha u Kore .
translation.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun nongshniah ki la wanlam mih na ka nongbah bad ki la ïaleh ïa ki kynhun jong u Joab ; katto katne na ki nongbah pynïaidkam jong u Dabid ki la shah pynïap , bad kumta shwa ka la long ïa u Ujuh .
translation.en: And the men of the city went out , and fought with Joab : and there fell some of the people of the servants of David  ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ngi mynjur ïa kata . U Trai un long u shithi pangnud jong ngi .
translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , The  Lord  be witness between us , if we do not so according to thy words .

translation.kha: Nangta ha Peor , ki briew jongu U Blei ki la ïashongsuk ha ka jingkmen ïa u Baal , bad bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki blei bym don jingim .
translation.en: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .
Go up into Gilead , and take balm , O virgin , the daughter of Egypt : in vain shalt thou use many medicines  ; for thou shalt not be cured .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong ka Ijipt , khie leit sha Gilead bad wad ïa ka dawai ! Ki dawai jong pha baroh ki la pynshisha ba kim myntoi ei ei ; ym don ei ei ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa pha .
Naba ka Hima U Blei kam erlangthari tang ha kaba kren hynrei ha ka kun .
translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word , but in power .
The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .
translation.kha: Baroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong nga bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jong ki .
U Solomon u long u syiem jong ki Jerusalem’ baroh ,
translation.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel .

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki ïathuhlypa jong phi lane ïa une uno uba kam ba u lah ban ïathiah lymda ïa la lawei , la ka long da ki jingphohsniew jlan da kaba khot ïa ki mynsaw jong kiba ïahap lin da ka myntor . Ma ki baroh kim ong ïa pa’ ban pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia .
translation.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets , nor to your diviners , nor to your dreamers , nor to your enchanters , nor to your sorcerers , which speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon :

translation.kha: Lada u nongsynshar u shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingot riewlamler , baroh ki rangbah synrai kin sylla longïng ki riewthombor .
translation.en: If a ruler hearken to lies , all his servants are wicked .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ai hati sei bynta jong ka ri ha ki longrynïeng jongu ka jait Gamad kumne ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad , even unto the children of Gad according to their families .

translation.kha: kin mynsaw bad kine ïa-ïap ha ki lyntait bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .
translation.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga shadem hajuh ba bun na ki rangbah Jiw ki la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei na Adadah , Ammon , bad Moab .
translation.en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod , of Ammon , and of Moab :

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ïa ki sakhrai jong u , ‘ To khum ïa u Bad kti bad kjat , bad bret ïa u shabar ha kabu dum . Hangne un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniah .’
translation.en: Then said the king to the servants , Bind him hand and foot , and take him away , and cast him into outer darkness  ; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
Now Joab was over all the host of Israel : and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites :
translation.kha: U Joab u long u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel ; u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih ïa ka kynhun ïada ïa u Dabid ;

translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long u Messaïah !’ bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .
U symboh ka Babilonia u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U to ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang khim ka briew kaba suh kah .
translation.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba pha kwah ? U Jisu u la kylla ïa ka . Ka la jubab , To kli ïa nga ba keiñ ki khun shynrang jong nga kin shong ha ka kular kumne bad ka liang kadiang jong me lehbha men long u Syiem .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  What wilt thou ?  She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .
Israel was holiness unto the  Lord  , and the firstfruits of his increase : all that devour him shall offend  ; evil shall come upon them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long tang ka jong nga hi ; pha long ka jingdon bakyntang jong nga . Nga la phah ka jingshitom bad ka jingpynjot ha uwei pa uwei uba pynmong ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

To imat ïa U Trei U Blei lad phira , kthong bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khun ki kiaw jong phi phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa bymman jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translation.en: That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .

translation.kha: Ki sai ngut ki shym Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad rakhe hajuh ka khlem ha Makkedah .
translation.en: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u balui uba lieh bteng . Ïa u nongshong kulai la ai ktung ka Jingïap , bad ka Hades ka dud syndah nadien . La ai ha ki ka bor hajir shipawa na ka pyrthat , ban pynïap da ka tdam , ka nemsniew , ka khlam , bad da ki mraw .
translation.en: And I looked , and behold a pale horse : and his name that sat on him was Death , and Hell followed with him . And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth , to kill with sword , and with hunger , and with death , and with the beasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Khasi
translation.en: English

translation.kha: Ha iar ki sngi shiphew ngut ki nongwei kin wan shwa uwei u Jiw bad ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ban ïoh bynta ha ka lawei jong phi , namsop ngi la lah ïohsngew ba U balui u don bad phi .’
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations , even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew , saying , We will go with you : for we have heard that God is with you .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Phi ki paid Israel , phi! la leh pop pynshah ïa per bad ïong ïaleh ïa nga . Hynrei mynta , to phai paw sha nga !
translation.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted .
Again , I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Nga la tip ruh balei ba ki briew ki trei shitom ban jop : Ka dei namar ba ki bishni ïa kiei kiei kiba ki paramarjan jong ki , ki don . Hynrei ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .
Kane ka longsyiem kumno ba u Mosah u la pynbynta ïa ka ri shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerikho bad ka Jordan mynba u don ha ki pyntha ka Moab .
translation.en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , bad u la tip ba uta u briew u la pang la slem bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u ,  Me kwah ban ïohkhiah ?
Pung ki briew ki la kyndeh ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . hynriew u la pyrda kham jam Shuh shuh , Ko Khun U Dabid , to hynrei ïa la !
translation.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .

translation.kha: Kat kumba U blei u kren ïa ka jingbishar , ka jingkular jong nga ïa phiah kam long kabu Ho-oid bad kaba Em .
translation.en: But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .

translation.kha: Ulla kaba seh ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dadien ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .
I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
translation.kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga don ka jingtip bad ka bor pyrkhat kaba khlaiñ .

translation.en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito ki briew kim shahshkor , bad ki ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom kiba rim jong ki .
Nga la bsuh ka por ïa ka ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki briew jong ka Anathoth , bad haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym khong mano mano ruh na ki u Ban lait im .
translation.en: And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .

translation.kha: Ki dkhat kin thaw ïa ki skum jongno ki , kin kwah pylleng sad pynmih ki khun , bad sumar ïa ki hangta . Ki pukni kin ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei pat .
translation.en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .

translation.kha: Hangta ma u Bad u Jonadab ki la saw shapoh ban ai ki jingkhia bun jingainguh thang sha u Baalgad . U la pyn-ap phar ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbthuh ïa ki : Phi dei ban pynsep ïa keiñ ki briew baroh ; du uno na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un shihajar ïa ka da la ka jongnga ka jingim !
translation.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .

translation.kha: Hato mem tap ? U la kylli ïa at . Em , ngam tipthuh , ko lapbah , nga la jubab .
translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God , wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat ?
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kaba khuid bad ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei , katba phi dang ap khmih ïa ka Sngi jong U Blei bad phi leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynlong ïa ka ba kan wan kloi — ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ki bneng yn thang duh noh bad yn pynjot , bad ïa ki metbneng yn sa pynum ha ka jingkhluit .

translation.en: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work , that have the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the  Lord  , to repair the breaches of the house ,
translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban ai ïa ka pisa ha ki rangbah kiba dei khmih ïa ka jingshna pynbha ïa k Templ .
Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ? Ki la ïohi lut ïa kai kiwei . Ym don kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki .
translation.en: And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .

translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka nguh ïa u Samson , Haduh mynba phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa at kumno yn haka ban khim ïa phi . U jaboh , dalade phi thain ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong ar hynñiew tyllai dara phi pynskhem ïa ki da ki sngur ïingjaiñ , ngan long uba tlor bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .

translation.kha: Ki shwa umdih khatsan tylli ki diengsoh da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka balang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
But ye , O mountains of Israel , ye shall shoot forth your branches , and yield your fruit to my people of Israel  ; for they are at hand to come .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki lumbah ka Israel ki dieng kin sei biang ki sla bad pynmih soh na ka bynta jong phi , ki briew jong nga , ki Israel . Phi la jan ban wan noh sha la ka ri .
Kane ka la pynkmen shibun ïa u lyngdoh , kumta u shngiam ïa ki tiar bakyntang bad u leit lem mala ki .
translation.en: And the priest s heart was glad , and he took the ephod , and the teraphim , and the graven image , and went in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: Kumta u pyrta u la shim ka rai halor U Jisu ïa kaba ki la pan .
translation.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required .

translation.kha: Ym dat mano mei ruh uba la ïohi ïa U Blei . U Khun ba mudui jong u , uba long kumjuh kum U Blei dara ibha don ha syndah lad U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .
translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew ha ka sneng kaba hynriew khnang ba kan pynmih bam kyrhai na ka bynta ar snem .
translation.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year , and it shall bring forth fruit for three years .

translation.kha: Mynta ngan pyntong ka jutang bad phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ,
translation.en: And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;

translation.kha: Ngi don ïa ka hok kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleh bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .
translation.en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,
Passing through the street near her corner  ; and he went the way to her house ,
translation.kha: U dang ïaid ha lynti najan ka dong ha kaba shong kawei ka kynthei . U dang ïaid lyngba najan ïing jong ka

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more , neither bereave thy nations any more , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh mynta kan ym long shuh kaba bam briew bad kaba knieh noh na ka ïa ki khun jong ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

U Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . Kumba U Trai u la bthah ha u Moses , ki dei ban pdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki , ïa ka bhah jongnga ki jingainguh ba la thang ha ka duwan sha U Trai U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ngi la pynlut katto katne per hangta , ngi la khreh ïa la ki tiar ki tar bad im’ la leit noh sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And after those days we took up our carriages , and went up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnat ha ka rukom kaba khuid bad kaba donburom ,
translation.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;
I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga long u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh ka kren skhem ba ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha

translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
