translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkloi !’ u la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah ti jong u bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .
Ha ka por ka jingkerkut u Nebukhadnessar da lade! hi u la wan sha Jerusha ,
translation.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city , and his servants did besiege it .
Kerioth is taken , and the strong holds are surprised , and the mighty men s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki shnong bad ki kut yn kurup . Ha kata ka sngi ki shipai jong ka Moab kin sheptieng kum ka briew kaba suh kha .

translation.en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .
translation.kha: Nga long u dieng sohwaiñ , bad phi long ki tnat . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha nga , bad ma nga ha u , un seisoh shibun ; naba phim lah ban leh ei ei khlem ma nga .

translation.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast : seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan , ka sngi ha kaba ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba neh hynñiew sngi ka sdang ; ha kata ka por dei ban bam tang ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat .
Wah la u Jehoash u la ithuh ïa la ki hynmen , ki pat kim shym la ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: And Joseph knew his brethren , but they knew not him .
Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
translation.kha: Wat ym smai da ka khlieh jong phi , naba phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynïong ïa iwei i shñiuh .

Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh ka nongpang Rabbah , mala kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka . Te kan don ki jingkhynwin ha ka sngap ïaleh thma , bad ka jingïalumlang kabu jur kumta ka erlangthari .
translation.en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it shall devour the palaces thereof , with shouting in the day of battle , with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind :
Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . And he said , Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days ?
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u sngewthuh ïa kane ba ka mut ba kan don ka jingsuk bad jingshngain shi jingim jong u , kumta u jubab ,  Ka khubor ba me la ai ïa nga na U  Trai  ka long kaba bha .

translation.en: For they all made us afraid , saying , Their hands shall be weakened from the work , that it be not done . Now therefore , O God , strengthen my hands .
translation.kha: Ki pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa ngi ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam . Nga la duwai ,  Hynrei mynta , A Blei , pynlong khlaiñ ïa nga !

translation.en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .
translation.kha: Ki khot lang arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngi . Nalor kine , ki nongshong shnong ka Gibeah ki lumlang hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang kiba treikam da kadiang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u tbit ban kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u  ñiuhkhlieh .
Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Kane ka long kumno Kan jia ha wer kiba kyndon ka spah na ka bna ïa lade hynmen ki bym riewspah ha ka jingkhmih jong U Blei .
translation.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God .
We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei jong ki Jiw kim don hok ban bam na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kaba la buh halor ka duwan jong ngi .
Ki la leit sharati namar dih hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Tharai ka don , ha kob u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai , u la pynrngad ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .
And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el :
translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud u phai shaphang ka Hannathon , bad u kut ha ka Them Iphtahel .
Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingat jong phi kin pynheh ban treikam . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kiba yn sa ai ha pa’ haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;

translation.kha: bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh , u Benaïah bad u Jahasiel kin put ïa ki tuklar borabor ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translation.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God .

translation.kha: U shrak u pynmih ïa ka bashabar dara u khang ïa ka jingkhang . Ka Tamar ka kup ïa ka sopti jynsur Kaba jongu kti , ka jwat jaiñ ba ju rupa da ki khun shem kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim ha kito ki sngi .
translation.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .

translation.kha: Ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka kynduh ka nongbah la pynkup itynnat da ki jaitniam maw bakordor baroh . U maw nongmih uba nyngkong u la long u maw Jashar , uba ar u maw Sapphir , uba lai u maw Agate , uba saw u maw Emerald ,
translation.en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper  ; the second , sapphire  ; the third , a chalcedony  ; the fourth , an emerald  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , phiah long ki nongsakhi Jong nga ; nga la jied ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , khnang ba phin tipbriew ïa nga bad ngeit ha nga bad sngewthuh ba nga longsyiem tangba ma nga U Blei . Nahaliel jong na ym don uwei pat u blei ; u bym pat ju long bad u baneh nym long .
translation.en: Ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , and my servant whom I have chosen : that ye may know and believe me , and understand that I am he : before me there was no God formed , neither shall there be after me .

Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
translation.kha: te ma phi baroh phi dei ban tip , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki dei ban tip , ba une u briew u ïeng hangne ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah kran da ka bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth — ïa uba phi la sahnarphna bad ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
Haba u ioh ïa u nongshun ba u wan poi , u set ïa ka tarajur ba kham ïa uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;

Let people serve thee , and nations bow down to thee : be lord over thy brethren , and let thy mother s sons bow down to thee : cursed be every one that curseth thee , and blessed be he that blesseth thee .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki jaitbynriew kin long ki shakri jong me , bad ki briew kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . To men synshar halor ki kur ki jait jong me baroh , bad to ai ba ki khun ki ksiew ka kmie jong me kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . Ai ba kito kiba tim ïa me kin long kiba la tim bad ai ba kito kiba me kyrkhu kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ki shynrang bad ki kynthei jongno kane ka juk ki ïashongkurim ,
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  The children of this world marry , and are given in marriage :

translation.kha: Ki radbah synshar jong u ki kit ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom sha Jerusalem , bad la thet ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem , and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïew ïa ka burom U Blei lada pha ngeit ?
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?

translation.kha: Ngan ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ duk jong nga yn pyntngit , haba ki jingsakhi kin rung sha ka bad kan pynpyut ïa ka .
translation.en: My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .

translation.kha: Nahath U Trai u phah ïa ka ding kaba meh , nabar ka bameh duh khoit ïa kita ki arsien sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wanrah ïa ki jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha Israel : Ki briew jong nga ki la pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .
Ki shim ïa ka ri ki Amor baroh nadong Arnon shaphang shathie haduh Jabbok shaphang shatei , bad naduh ri shyiap shaphang mihngi haduh Jordan shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and from the wilderness even unto Jordan .

translation.kha: namar ba U Blei jong ngi u long shispah ka ting kiba bam haw .
translation.en: For our God is a consuming fire .
And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sdang ban ïambriew bad kim shym deng jingdeng shuh .

Baroh keiñ kiei kiba u Jeroboam UBA Ar u la ar , ki thma bashabar jong u , dara kumno u pyneh pang ïa ka Damaskos bun ka Ramath shaei ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , and all that he did , and his might , how he warred , and how he recovered Damascus , and Hamath , which belonged to Judah , for Israel , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Te U Trai u jubab , Em . Lada uno uno ruh u pynïap ïa me , yn sa pynïap hynñiew ki mynsiem ha ka jingpynkheiñ . Kumta U Trai u buh ka ki ha u Kaiwan ban maham ïano ïano ba ïashem ïa u ban ym pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain , vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold . And the  Lord  set a mark upon Cain , lest any finding him should kill him .

translation.kha: Hobah u Abram u la dap khyndaiphew khnai sngem ka rta , U Troas u la mihpaw ha u dara u ong , Nga longkmie U Blei Badonbor Bakhraw . Kohnguh ïa nga bad ïa-ai leh ïa kaba dih .
translation.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .

And they spake unto him , saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them , and answer them , and speak good words to them , then they will be thy servants for ever .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Lada phi kwah ban shakri bha ïa kine ki briew , ai ïa ka jubab kaba biang ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki , bad kin ïai shakri hok ïa phi .

translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .
translation.kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi bad wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi .

translation.en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai ,  u dohkha uba heh u la nguid ïa u Jonah , bad u la don hapoh u dohkha lai sngi lai miet .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had , Put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh :
translation.kha: U ong ha u shakri jong u , uba la rangbah bha , uba peit halor baroh kiba u don ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga bad pynlong ka jingsmai .
Kiba ïa ki ñiut la lumrit bad la thrang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta kajuh hi kan jied ha kambah Kuth ka Ïa :
translation.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u don ha Naïoth kaba ha Ramah , kumta u Saul u phah Katto katne ngut ki lapbah ban kem ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told Saul , saying , Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah .

translation.kha: U Bam Mynta ia u Soh Apple .
translation.en: He is eating an apple .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïatip ka plie shiteng ha U Blei ; ym don ka jingtip kaba kah ïa ka na ka jingïohi jongu u .
translation.en: Hell is naked before him , and destruction hath no covering .

translation.kha: U long Kum u dieng uba mih hajan ka wahduid bad uba ki thied ki ksam sha ka um . Um sheptieng haba ka jingshit ka suiñbneng ka wan , Naamah ki sleh jongnga u ki sah jyrngam ; um don jingkhuslai haba ym dat slap ; u ïai pynmih soh .
translation.en: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters , and that spreadeth out her roots by the river , and shall not see when heat cometh , but her leaf shall be green  ; and shall not be careful in the year of drought , neither shall cease from yielding fruit .

translation.kha: Me la kren ïa nga , bad nga la ïashukor ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien . Nga long u jong me , A Trai U Blei bymdonbor Baroh , bad kumta ki ktien jong me ki la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jrong de da kaweh kmie bad ka jingsngewmeng .
translation.en: Thy words were found , and I did eat them  ; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart : for I am called by thy name , O  Lord  God of hosts .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki jingïathuhlypa ba ïalam bakla ki la kut . Nga pyllait im ïa ki bhabriew jong nga na ka bor jong phi , kthang ba phin tip ba na longïng U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity , nor divine divinations : for I will deliver my people out of your hand : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: hynrei lada ka leh kumta , ka dem ba shong khring ino rue ka dei ban ïasoh pat bad la u tngen bad u tnga um dei ban pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga .
translation.en: But and if she depart , let her remain unmarried , or be reconciled to her husband : and let not the husband put away his wife .

translation.kha: U ïaiban u dei u khun jong u Jesse , uba dei u nong Ephrath na Bethlehem kaba ha —Judah . U Jesse u don phria ngut ki khun shaneng , bad ha ka por ba u Saul u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .
translation.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .
But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .
translation.kha: Hynrei dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ha ka hukum U Blei , u ksaiñ u la bam ïa u jingthung , bad u la ïap noh .

translation.en: Ye are all the children of light , and the children of the day : we are not of the night , nor of darkness .
translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ki briew jong ka jingshai , kiba long ki jong ka sngi . Ngim dei ki jong ka miet lane jong ka jingdum .
To ai ba baroh kiba pyrshah ïa nga mala kiba ïaleh ïa nga yn pynshitom kumto ïa ki briew bymman bad ki briew bymhok .
translation.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .
And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam , that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Rehoboam , u syiem Shishak jong ka Ijipt u la leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .
translation.kha: U nong Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai kaba don shi million ki rangbah bad laispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ki tur shaphrang haduh Mareshah .
Ngan pyntngen ïa phi ha Jerusalem , kumba ka kmie ka pynsngaid ïa la i khun .
translation.en: As one whom his mother comforteth , so will I comfort you  ; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Asasaïah u la ïap malade la ter ha ka iaka thap syiem hynrei namar ka jingpang jong u ym shym la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Khenani khyndiat ki symbai u la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bah , bad ki jingthung ki la pynmih symboh ; katto katne ki la pynmih shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad khawai pat laiphew tylli .
translation.en: But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .

translation.kha: Katba ki dong ei hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka per kren jong u kup Lebi , kumta ki loit sha u bun ki kylli , Me leh aïu hangne ? Manoah ba wallam ïa me shane ?
translation.en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?

translation.kha: Phi la pynkupbor ruh ïa U Trai U Blei jong pa’ mynba phi dat ha Taberah , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .
translation.en: And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
But if ye will not hear it , my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride  ; and mine eye shall weep sore , and run down with tears , because the  Lord s  flock is carried away captive .
translation.kha: Lada phin ym shahshkor , ngan ïam ha kaba jar jar namar ka jingsarong jong phi ; ngan ïamkthang eh , bad ki ummat jong nga kin tuid namar ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la shah ring noh kum ki mraw .

Markylliang yn thop ïa phi da ka jinglehrain ha ka jaka ka burom . Phi ruh phin ïadih bad ïaid sheng sheng . U Trai un pynlong ïa phi ban dih na la ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , Bad ka burom jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory : drink thou also , and let thy foreskin be uncovered : the cup of the  Lord s  right hand shall be turned unto thee , and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory .

translation.kha: Ha uta uba da ka bor jong u kaba ter ha ngi u lah Ban leh kham palat ban ïa kaba I pan , lane dak ïa kaba ngi pyrkhat ;
translation.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,

translation.kha: Ha ka proberb ba-mynshuwa , u bynriew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka pita , bad ki khum jongki u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
But all their works they do for to be seen of men : they make broad their phylacteries , and enlarge the borders of their garments ,
translation.kha: Ki leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki . Peit ïa ki jingteh  sai snieh kiba don ki jingthoh bakhuid ïa kiba ki teh ha ki shyllangmat bad ki ksang ti jong ki , bad khmih haduh katno ki long kiba heh ! Khmih ruh katno kiba jrong ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki jaiñkup jong ki !
Na ki jingkieng ainguh kiba da u malai ne ka langbrot , ki lyngngeit ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka tyngeh , baroh ar ki ngab , bad ka nierbah .
translation.en: And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .
translation.kha: Lada ngi kohnguh hok ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un sngewbha ïa ngi .’

translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .

Ko shym , phi de don tip ba ngi la wait sha ka pun jong ka Judah bad shem ba ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bakwah la dang shna biang da ki maw baheh bad da ki bim dieng ba la pyndait ha ka kynroh . Ïa ka kur la pyntrei ha ka jingkam kaba biang bah bad ka dang ïaid shang .
translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .

translation.kha: “Lah kaba jingkynthih ka ja suda ha ba bad ka jingsuk , ban ia ka ing kaba dap da ka jingkhawai lem bad ka jingialeh .”
translation.en: “Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble .”

translation.kha: Hangno ki don mynta , ki plie jong ka Hotham bad ka Arpad ? Hangno don ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim ? Hato don du isangsot uba pyllait ïa ka Gemaraïah ?
translation.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim ? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand ?
And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance , and deliver them into the hand of their enemies  ; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies  ;
translation.kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki briew kiba lait im bad aiti ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong ki , ki ban jop ïa ki bad lute ïa ka ri jong ki .

Nangta ki pha dat bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Entappuah ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la jop ïa ki ynda ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .
translation.en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa u Belshassar , u syiem ka Babilonia , la pynïap ;
translation.en: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain .

translation.kha: Ki jingïabujli ïa u Apelles , umbah ïa ka jingïaineh ha U Khrist la pynshisha . Ki jingkhublei ïa Aner kba na ka longïing jong u Aristobulos .
translation.en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ . Salute them which are of Aristobulus  household .

translation.kha: U la pyrta , Ko Jisu ! U Khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !
translation.en: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant , saying , When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan , ye shall stand still in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ba ynda ki poi ha ka wah , ki dei ban ïaid ha ki um bad ban ïeng hajan ka rudwah .
hynrei u angel u la ong ha ki , To wat sheptieng ! Nga don hangne lem bad ka khubor babha na ka bynta jong phi , ka ban wanrah ka jingkmen kaba khraw ha ki Briew baroh .
translation.en: And the angel said unto them , Fear not : for , behold , I bring you good tidings of great joy , which shall be to all people .

translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka Jingkhawai Maim , pynsngewthuh ha ki khun shynrang jong phi ba phi leh ïa kane baroh namar kaei kaba U Trai u la leh ha phi mynba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the  Lord  did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: dih —kata keiñ balei ba ma ngi hi ngi sngewsarong shaphang jong phi ha ki balang jong U Blei . Ngi sngewkthang shaphang ka rukom kaba phi ïaineh ban shah dara ban ngeit lyngba baroh ki jingpynim buiñ sad ki jingshahshitom kiba phi ïohmad .
translation.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingshan u Joash u khun jongnga u Ahasaïah kum u syiemsad ka Judia , u Jehoïada u khun jong u Jehu u long u syiem ka Israhaïah , bad u synshar khathynñiew Snem ha Samaria .
translation.en: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned seventeen years .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U Trai la pynkhih pyrshah ïa ka Judah da kaei kaba u Syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam shym la duh noh .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .
The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .
translation.kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wan sha Jerusalem , bad ki ïathuh kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta kaei kaba ki nong Babilonia ki la leh ïa ka Templ jong u . )

U Trai u wan na u Lum Sirion ; u mih kum ka sngi ha Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Phareng . Shiphew hajar ki angel ki don ryngkat bad u , bad ka dang kaba meh ha ka kti kamai jong u .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .

translation.kha: Ki Nongïalam jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lyntait baher kumto ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snar haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ban ktah ïa ki .
translation.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .

translation.kha: Kuth U Jisu u la leit phai pat bad ki shai Nasareth , ha kaba u la kohnguh ïa ki . Ka kiei jongki u ka la kynshew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh hapoh la ka dohnud .
translation.en: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .

translation.kha: hynrei u den shapoh ban peit ïa ki bna badno ïa ka kheiñduh .
translation.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !

translation.kha: U ong ha u Balak , Tei ïa nga hangtai hynñiew tylli ki duwan , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi ktang sad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli lada don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha Mispah , ki shem ba ym don uwei ruh na Jabesh ha Gilead kiba la don hangta ;

Kaba mih na kata , ka long ba ym khong shuh ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Nethanel malade ki Jiw , kiba la sha otsher bad ki bym shym la shah otsher , ki riewkhlaw , ki riewdum , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid ; hynrei U Khrist u longïng baroh , U Khrist u long ha baroh .
translation.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , Barbarian , Scythian , bond nor free : but Christ is all , and in all .

translation.kha: Kumta ki sharati ki la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Absalom bad ki la pynkup ïa u Amnon . Baroh kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki kdew halor ki hajir jong ki malu ki la phet krad .
translation.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king s sons arose , and every man gat him up upon his mule , and fled .

translation.kha: Sa shisien u la duwai , Bad ka suidñiew ka la theh nala ïa la u slap nabar ka khyndew ka la pynmih ïa ki jingthung .
translation.en: And he prayed again , and the heaven gave rain , and the earth brought forth her fruit .
Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to pynshitom ïa kito ki riewbymman ! To kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom !
shet ïa nga kum kato ka jingbam bang kaban nga ju sngewtynnat , bad wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda to la dep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingkyrkhu basawbthuh shuwa ba ngan ïap .
translation.en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la thung ban ai ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad sha U Blei , bad kumta U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi u dei ruh ban don ei ei ban ainguh .

translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha jong ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa shibun ki hima , ki pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki ban sah kynjah ,

U syiem ka Syria un lytar phai pat bad lum ka kynhun shipai kaban kham khraw ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa . Haba ka por jingbang ka poi , un wang peiñ bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khrong bad Kaba la kieng atiar bha .
translation.en: For the king of the north shall return , and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former , and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches .

translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la leit sha Kapernam , ka shnong ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la shithi ïa u pynbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .
Woe unto them that join house to house , that lay field to field , till there be no place , that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth !
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim . Phi thied bun tylli ki ïing bad ki lyngkha ban bynrap shuh shuh ïa kito kiba phi la don lypa . Shen yn ym don jaka ïano ïano pat ban shong ban sah bad tang ma phi hi phin shong ha ka ri .
Ka long kaba bha ba yn lah ban lehse ïa ka jingshai ryntih jongnga ka sngi .
translation.en: Truly the light is sweet , and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun :

translation.kha: ngan pynlong ïa me uba slem kum u maïan , umbah eh kum u diamond ; wat sngewbishni ïa kito ibha ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Naba U Blei um shym la Phah ïa la U Khun sha ka pyrthei ba un long u nongbishar jongngi ka , hynrei , ba un long u nongpynim jong ka .
translation.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world  ; but that the world through him might be saved .

translation.kha: U Trei u la pynkhih mynsiem ïa Uei pa imat ban trei ha ka Templ : U Segub , u lat ka —Judah ; u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ki briew Baroh kiba la wanpaw phai na ka jingshah ringmraw . Ki la sdang ban trei ïa ka Templ jong U Trai Badonbor Berakah , U balui jong ki ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people  ; and they came and did work in the house of the  Lord  of hosts , their God ,

translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Daniel ( ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar ) , Hato me lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba to pynsngew bad Aïu ka kit jingtim ?

translation.en: Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh my Lord , wherewith shall I save Israel ? behold , my family is poor in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father s house .

translation.kha: A Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jongnga ki Israel , uba shong ha ka khet shajrong ki khapbrip , me marwei me long U Blei , babha synshar ïa baroh ki hima jongu ka pyrthei . Me thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .
translation.en: O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , that dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth : thou hast made heaven and earth .

Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynñiew ngan pynum ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong la junom . Kumta u ong U Trai uba pynim ïa pha .
translation.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .

translation.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .

translation.kha: Nangta ka pyrta , Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan ! U khie joit bad u pyrkhat , Ngin pynsynjor sad pyllait war , kumba mynshuwa . Um shym thup ba U Troas u la hynne ïa u .
translation.en: And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .
The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbah ; kan long tang ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .
Kumba ma nga ngam dei jong ka pyrthei , ma ki kim dem jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: They are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .

translation.en: Only rebel not ye against the  Lord  , neither fear ye the people of the land  ; for they are bread for us : their defence is departed from them , and the  Lord  is with us : fear them not .

translation.en: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .

translation.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan , Tell me what thou hast done . And Jonathan told him , and said , I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand , and , lo , I must die .

translation.en: And they shall pass through it , hardly bestead and hungry : and it shall come to pass , that when they shall be hungry , they shall fret themselves , and curse their king and their God , and look upward .

So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .

translation.en: So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .

translation.en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city , to finish the transgression , and to make an end of sins , and to make reconciliation for iniquity , and to bring in everlasting righteousness , and to seal up the vision and prophecy , and to anoint the most Holy .

translation.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .

translation.en: Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .

translation.en: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim , and came unto the house of Micah .

translation.en: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place , and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar : and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places , even out of the meadows of Gibeah .

translation.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
For these two years hath the famine been in the land : and yet there are five years , in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest .

translation.en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,

translation.en: And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .

translation.en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .

translation.en: Why did you sleep ?

Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khubor sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pynbna ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Wat buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiuh ! Ïa ki bleithaw jong Babilon la buh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !
Uno uno kiba ïangat lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Hasael , un shah pynap ha u Joah , bad uno uno uba lait im na ka jingshaniah pynpoh ha u Jehu un shah pynïap ha u Elisha .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay : and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay .
Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .

translation.en: Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .

translation.en: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .

translation.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–serah , which is in mount Ephraim , on the north side of the hill of Gaash .

translation.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick , and the Lord shall raise him up  ; and if he have committed sins , they shall be forgiven him .

translation.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .

translation.en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .

translation.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .

translation.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: U la tied ïa ka um da ka kjap jongngi u Eliashib , bad u ong , Hangta U Trai , U Blei’ jrong u Elijah ? Nangne u la tied biah ïa ka um , bad ka la kad arliang , bad u la ïaid shata jingïailong .
translation.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .
The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .

translation.en: Thou , O king , art a king of kings : for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom , power , and strength , and glory .

translation.en: But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice , and said unto them , Ye men of Judaea , and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem , be this known unto you , and hearken to my words :

translation.en: Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .

translation.en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .

translation.en: Ho , every one that thirsteth , come ye to the waters , and he that hath no money  ; come ye , buy , and eat  ; yea , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .

translation.kha: Ka jinglonghok ka la nang duna katta katta ba uno uno kiba kiar na kaba leh bymman u shem ïa lade ba u long u lanot jong ka kam runar . U Trai u la ïohi ïa kane , Bad ka la pynsngewrem ïa u ba ym ni shuh ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: Yea , truth faileth  ; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey : and the  Lord  saw it , and it displeased him that there was no judgment .
I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkhuslai shaphang jong phi ! Hato ka lah ban long ba baroh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi ka la shu long lehnoh-ei ?

Ha kata ka por wat ïa ki baje ha ki tyllai teh jyllang ki kulai yn thoin da ki kyntien Ba la pynkyntang shaw U Trai . Ki khiew shet ha ka Templ kmen long kiba kyntang kum ki jingdiang ha khmied ka duwan .
translation.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .
Whom God hath raised up , having loosed the pains of death : because it was not possible that he should be holden of it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , da kaba pyllaitluid ïa u na ka bor jong ka , namar ka long ka bym lah long ba ka jingïap kan bat ïa u .
Ngi la sngew kumba la rai pynrem ïa ngi don ïapom . Hynrei kane ka la jat khnam ba ngi dei banbeiñ shaniah , ym ha ngi hi , hynrei tang ha U blei keiñ , uba pynmihpat ïa naba ïap .
translation.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God which raiseth the dead :

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u Syiem Kynrad , kumta ruh ai un don ryngkat bad u Salmunna , bad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar jong u kaba kham roi banbeiñ ïa ka jong phi .
translation.en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .
And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies . Furthermore I tell thee that the  Lord  will build thee an house .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ka jaka na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad nga la pynshong pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin shongduh shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki la rung ha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh pyrshah ha ki briew kiba runar , hynrei kane kan ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me bad ban ai ha me ki nonghiarpateng .
Hynrei haba me ai pat ha ki ïa ka jingpyrsad jongki me , la thaw ïa ki ; me ai ka jingim bathymmai ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit , they are created : and thou renewest the face of the earth .

translation.kha: Khmih shiah nga ! nga la dap phraphew san sniew ka Mid bad nga dang shait dang khlam mynta kumba nga la long mynsaw u Moses u la phah ïa at . Nga dang shait tdong khlaiñ Bha ban leit ïateh thmu ne na ka bynta kano kano .
translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .

translation.kha: Ha u bthei Abib , u bnai ha uba phi la mihnoh na ka ri jingïap , rakhe ïa Ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Balaam Thiat ha ka rukom kaba nga la hukum ïa phi . Ha ki hynñiew sngi jongnga kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , wat bim ïa uno une u ksew ba la khleh thiat . Wat ju wan mane ïa de khlem da wallam kano kano ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread : ( thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days , as I commanded thee , in the time appointed of the month Abib  ; for in it thou camest out from Egypt : and none shall appear before me empty : )

translation.kha: Ki kynhun jong u briew suba bha kin long kiba donakor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ktieh jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u Paul u la khot lang ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhlad bad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Makedonia .

Ki jaitbynriew dara ki syiem kin sumar ïa pha , kumba ka kilomitar ka sumar ïa la ki khwan jong ka . Phan sa tipbriew ba nga U Trai , la la pyllait ïa pha , ba U Blei Bakhrawbor ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles , and shalt suck the breast of kings : and thou shalt know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
And he heard the words of Laban s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father s  ; and of that which was our father s hath he gotten all this glory .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohsngew ba ki khun shynrang jong u Laban ki ïa-ong ,  U Jakob u la shim lut baroh kat kaba dei ka jong i pa jong ngi . U la ïoh lut ïa ka spah baroh na kaei kaba i pa jong ngi i don .
A Trai , nga lah shun ïohi ïa ki khun jong ki ba ki shah tbeh kthong bad shuh pynïap .
translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .

translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem , Me la dien ïa-ban pduh san ne Hynrei sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura shalor ki Syria ; hyndai myntan Man jop ïa ki tang lai sien .
translation.en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .

And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u para jong uta uba la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka dei ban leit ha khmat ki nongïalam shnong bad ban ong , ‘ U para kynsi jong nga um treh ban pynneh ïa ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um mon ban pyndep ïa la ka kamram .’

U Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa baroh ki Rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynoi shipai , kat kumta ki kur jong ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïeng ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kaba shispah ngut . Kanneh ka kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba arphew snem ne Kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki lama ki shipai ba la jied , kiba la Khloi ban ïaleit thma , kiba tbit ba-bang pyndonkam ïa ki sum malade ki stieh .
translation.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .

translation.kha: Ken ym hap shu baneh khadar diengïap sha lut sha wah ne thoh ding na khlad , namar ki don ki tiar ïapmat ba la iehnoh , ban thang ding . Kin kurup bad lute ïa kito kiba la kurup bad lute ïa ki , U Terah Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: So that they shall take no wood out of the field , neither cut down any out of the forests  ; for they shall burn the weapons with fire : and they shall spoil those that spoiled them , and rob those that robbed them , saith the Lord  God .
And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death , and he be to be put to death , and thou hang him on a tree :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa kano kano ka kam runar bad na ka bynta kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,
Uwei na ki rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ïa ki , ba u nongsynshar u kwah don tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewkmen .
translation.en: And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u kiew ïa ka khep u Dabid u kpa jong u ïa kaba U Blei U Trai u la seng . U la long u syiem umbiah jop , bad ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .

translation.kha: Ki lyndum ki Long kum ka kynha ki nongkit kiba apthap ïa u briew . Wai ha ka lynti shaei ka jaka bakynjah ha Shekhem ki pynïap briew . Bad ki leh ïa kane kaba sniew baroh da kaba tmoh ialap !
translation.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man , so the company of priests murder in the way by consent : for they commit lewdness .
And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
translation.kha: U Hadad u ïoh ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para jong ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .
Un wanrah ïa u ha u lyngdoh , u ban shim shi kham na u kum ka dak ba la ainguh sha U Trai , bad un thang ïa u ha ka duwan kum ka jingkhia jingaiti bam . Ka long ka jingkhia ban pynkhuid ïa ka pop .
translation.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it , even a memorial thereof , and burn it on the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u ka ban neh junom lada u ïai kohnguh thikna ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh kumba u leh mynta .’

bad u la ong , Mynta te , Kino baroh ki la long iwei u paid bynriew bad ki ïakren kawei ka ktien ; kane ka dei tang ka jingsdang jong katei kaba kin sa leh . shane shen kin lah ban leh ïa kane kano kat kaba ki thum !
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , the people is one , and they have all one language  ; and this they begin to do : and now nothing will be restrained from them , which they have imagined to do .
And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together , saying , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found the piece which I had lost .
translation.kha: Haba ka shem ïa ka , ka khot lang ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong ka , bad ka ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka pisa kaba nga la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’

translation.en: Wherefore remember , that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh , who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands ;
translation.kha: Phi ïa kiba la kha kum ki Jentil — ïa kiba la khot  ki bymotsher  da ki Jiw , kiba ïa lade pat ki khot  kiba la otsher  (kaba thew ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ha ki met jong ki) — to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi la long mynshuwa .
Khatduh u Nebukhadnessar , u rangbah shipai , u la riewkhraw sha Babilonia ïa ki briew ba dang sah” ha ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ïa Kito kiba la mihnoh ïa u .
translation.en: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city , and those that fell away , that fell to him , with the rest of the people that remained .
Mountains , and all hills  ; fruitful trees , and all cedars :
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lumrit bad ki lumbah , ki diengsoh bad ki khlaw ;

Ha ki paid Israel ki ïohi ïa ka tyngkan ba ka wan khih na bneng mala ba ka jingshai ka ïadep ha ka Templ , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïahiar ïa U namar ka jingbha bad ka jingieit bymjukut jyllang u .
translation.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .
translation.kha: Ki thylliej jong ki , ki long ki khnam kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathuh lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ka jingriam ïa u .
U ïai-ong , ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,
translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,

And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,
translation.kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shithi sha u Jehoram , kaba ong kumne harum :  U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem shym bud ïa ki nuksa u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa jong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u kparad jong me .
Ngam shemphang kaei kaba nga leh ; namar ngam imat ïa kamai kaba de kwah ban kun , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa kaei kambah nga isih .
translation.en: For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .

translation.kha: Bad kumjuh une u briew uba tlot , u parabangeit ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap , un jot noh! namar kata ka jingtip jong phi !
translation.en: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish , for whom Christ died ?

translation.kha: Da lwa lei kun ym ïadon bad ki ha ki jingïaphylliew jingmut barieh jong ki . Da lei lei ngan ym ïasyllok lang bad ki ha ki jingïakynduh jong ki , naba haba ki Khie pyniaid ki pynïap ïa ki briew , bad ki pynshad ïa ki masi shaneng kum ka jinglehkai sngewbha .
translation.en: O my soul , come not thou into their secret  ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .
Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel : for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears :
translation.kha: Ym shym la don ki kamar ha Israel , namar ki Philistia ki la kut jingmut ban ym ailad ïa ki Hebru ban shna ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Blei jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u , te ngan pynshitom ïa kata ka jaitbynriew da ka thom , ka jingïapthngan nabar da ka jingpang tad shuh ba ngan da shad ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khoit ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U Trai u dkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa u hukum ïa la u para nongïathuhlypa ban shoh ïa u .
translation.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the  Lord  , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man refused to smite him .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba hynne ka jingïap jong nga , phin sa sa ïa ki kam bymman bad kyntait ïa kaba nga la hikai ïa phi . Doeg ha ki sngi ki ban wan ka jingjynjar kan ngat ha phi , namar ba phin pyntngit ïa U Trai da kaba phi leh ïa kata kaba u la adong .
translation.en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you  ; and evil will befall you in the latter days  ; because ye will do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands .

translation.kha: U Shalman u la kyntu thoh nabar u sngewthuh ba dadien U Blei uba la kren ïa u ha ka jingphohsniew . Nangta u la leit sha Israel pynlang u la ïeng ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ka jong U Trai dara u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U Trai . Hadien “kata u la ai ka jingkhawai ïa baroh ki rangïapom synlar jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon awoke  ; and , behold , it was a dream . And he came to Jerusalem , and stood before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and offered up burnt offerings , and offered peace offerings , and made a feast to all his servants .

translation.kha: Ai ba ka dohnud ba la pait jong phi kan pynkhaw-eit ïa ka jingsngewsih jong phi! ; kaba kad ïa ki jaiñphong jong phi kam biang . To wan phai pateng sha U Trai U Blei jong phi . U long uba sbun bad uba dap da ka jingisynei ; u long uba ïaishah slem bad uba bat ïa la ka kular ; u long borabor uba kloi ban karta bad ym ban pyndem .
translation.en: And rend your heart , and not your garments , and turn unto the  Lord  your God : for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repenteth him of the evil .

translation.kha: Ïa ka ksiar bad ïa ka phong la phriang ha ka ding , bad ïa ka dohnud jong u briew la phrang da U Trai .
translation.en: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the  Lord  trieth the hearts .
Be wise now therefore , O ye kings : be instructed , ye judges of the earth .
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor ïa kane ka jingmaham , ma phi ki syiem ; to ïoh jinghikai na kane , phi ki nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then went up Moses , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel :
translation.kha: U Moses , u Aaron , u Nadab , u Abihu , bad hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , ki ïaleit kiew ïa uta u lum ,

translation.en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory  ; and his disciples believed on him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leh ïa kane ka kambah kaba nyngkong ha Kana ha Galilaïa ; hangta , u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u .

translation.en: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee : behold , mine Angel shall go before thee : nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them .
translation.kha: Mynta khie leit , ïalam ïa u paidbah sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la ïathuh ïa me . Kynmaw ba u angel jong nga un ïalam ïa phi , hynrei ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynshitom ïa kine ki briew namar ka pop jong ki .

translation.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place , according to the commandment of David , and Asaph , and Heman , and Jeduthun the king s seer  ; and the porters waited at every gate  ; they might not depart from their service  ; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Asaph jong ki Lebi ki don ha la ki jaka ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem Dabid : u Asaph , u Heman , bad u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u syiem . Ki nongap phira ha ki khyrdop ka Templ kim shym donkam ban mihnoh na ki jaka ba ki ap , namar kiwei pat ki Lebi ki pynkhreh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ki .
Naba ki kynthei ibhabriew ha ki por ba la leit noh ki la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U blei , ki ju pynsngewbha ïa lade da kaba pynkohnguh ha la ki tnga .
translation.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also , who trusted in God , adorned themselves , being in subjection unto their own husbands :
In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed : then he wrote the dream , and told the sum of the matters .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong kaba u Belshassar u long u syiem ka Babilonia , nga la phohsniew bad nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet . Nga la thoh ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad kane ka dei ka jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohi ha kata ka miet :

translation.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more , neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more , neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ka ri kan ym shahshkor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba krenbeiñ ïa ka , lane ïohi ki kynja bynriew kiba peitbeiñ ïa ka . Ka ri kan ym knieh shuh ïa la ki khun na ka jaitbynriew . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar , nga la kren .
Kumta ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khrist , bad la pynïasoh iwei bad iwei pat kum ki dkhot bapher jong kawei ka met .
translation.en: So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .

translation.kha: Wat mih shabar ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh phi ïapom , namar la pynkyntang ïa phiah da ka bymshemphang pynsleh jongki U Trai . Kumta ki la leh kumba u Moses u la ong .
translation.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
What then ? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for ; but the election hath obtained it , and the rest were blinded
translation.kha: Kaei pat te ngin ïa-ong ? Ki paid Israel kim shym la shem ïa kaei kaba ki ïawad . Ka la long tang ka kynhun kaba rit kaba U Blei u la jied , kaba la shem ïa kata ; kiba sah na kita ki la set kyllut ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bha ïa nga ïa baroh kaba nga don ban ong .
Bad u Ïoannis u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla : Nga la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paralok na banyngkong , bun u shongsah halor lad u .
translation.en: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .

And they came , both men and women , as many as were willing hearted , and brought bracelets , and earrings , and rings , and tablets , all jewels of gold : and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba kwah kumta , kynthei bad shynrang , ki ïawan rah ïa ki jingpyndait ba la oh-shrong , ki sohshkor , ki sati , ki kpieng , bad ki jingdeng ksiar kiba har rukom , bad ki pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai .
U dei U Blei uba shim ïa ka um na ka khñiot bad pynkylla ïa ka sha ki jingjaw jong u slap .
translation.en: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof :

translation.kha: Ma sem pynban , ngi long ki traishnong jong ka bnoh , bad ngi ïa-ap hir longsem ïa U Nongpynim , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ban wan na weng .
translation.en: For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .
translation.kha: Slem katno u la long kumne ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u .  Naduh ba u dang rit ,  u la jubab .

U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban peit ïa ka kdew ha ka Tabeel . Ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba la bynshet ha ki da u syiem Dabid bad ban thap ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ai sha U Trai kat kum ka Aiñ u Moses . Ki la peit ruh ïa ka jingdup jingtem bad ïa ka jinglehkmen .
translation.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the  Lord  by the hand of the priests the Levites , whom David had distributed in the house of the  Lord  , to offer the burnt offerings of the  Lord  , as it is written in the law of Moses , with rejoicing and with singing , as it was ordained by David .
His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kan sa kylla pui pui .
Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ioh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym ne mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng Jong phi , lane napdeng ki jingiw jong phi! .
translation.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .

translation.kha: Bun ïa uno uno u dieng u bym pynmih u soh uba bha la ju khet ne pynlang bret hapoh ka ding .
translation.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .

translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilon u la Pynlong syiemsad ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Josaïah u syier ka Ïuodia , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u ïakhun jong u Jeshaïah .
translation.en: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta kita ki rangbah san ngut ki mihnoh bad ki leit sha ka shnong Laish . Ki ïohthiah kumin ki briew hangta ki ïashong shngain , kumba erlangthari ki nong Sidon . Ki long kiba ïashongsuk bad ki briew kiba jar jar , kim don jingïania badno badno ; ki don lut kat kaba ki donkam . Ki shong kham jngai na ki nong Sidon Bad kim pynïadei bad kiwei ki briew .
translation.en: Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .

translation.kha: Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibit , Bad un pynmih ki jat jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .
translation.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people , which prophesy out of their own heart  ; and prophesy thou against them ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , khmih ïa ki kynthei hapdeng ki briew jong me kiba pynlong ki jingïathuh lypa . To kren pyrshah ïa ki
Te ki Israel ki rwai ïa Kanneh ka jingrwai : Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jongu phi! , Da ka jingjaw ngin pynhieng sngewbha ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :

translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jongnga U Blei kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ha ka Hima jong U KA jongnga ki . To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki khor !
translation.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
Yea , they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils ,
translation.kha: Ki la ai ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei kum ki jingkñia ha ki bleithaw jong ka Kanaan .
Mynta , A Trai U Blei! jong ngi , pynkoit im ïa ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me longsem U Blei! .
translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .

translation.kha: Ka ri kaba seisoh ka kylla long ka ri shyiap , ki nongbah jong ka ki la don ha ka jingjot namar ka jingaibor shna jong U Trai .
translation.en: I beheld , and , lo , the fruitful place was a wilderness , and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the  Lord  , and by his fierce anger .

translation.kha: Ka lah ba-bang long kum , hynrei ka hir kaba kham bha ban don tang khyndiat , bad ka jingpalei jingmut , ban ïa kaba bakmen shi lynter da ki kti baroh ar tylli , da kaba pynryngkang ban kumin ïa ka lyer .
translation.en: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .

translation.kha: kaei kob phi la ong ka long ka jingñiewbeiñ , hynrei nga tip Kumno ngan jubab ïa phi .
translation.en: I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .

translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa ka ri baroh jongngi ki nong Sidon , kiba shong ha ka ri lum hapdeng ki lumrit Lebanon bad Misrephoth Maim . nur beh noh ïa kine ki briew katba ki Israel ki nang tur sha kham . Me de ban pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki Israel , kumba nga la hukum ïa me ba leh .
translation.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth–maim , and all the Sidonians , them will I drive out from before the children of Israel : only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance , as I have commanded thee .

translation.kha: Doeg u la ong ha ki , Nga ïathuh ha ph ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ki ruh jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .

translation.kha: Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei . La khet ïa u dieng ha khlaw ; la jhur da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,
translation.en: For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .

translation.kha: La don ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .
translation.en: And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .

translation.kha: Haba ka la poi ha ïit , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka , Ka longsem kumno , ko khun kynthah jong nga ? Ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei Baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynshet jongno ka .
translation.en: And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
Why did he bring the bag ?
translation.kha: Balei u wanrah ia ka pla ?
Hynrei la katta ruh , ka dang don katto katne ka jinglehbha ha phi . Phi la weng baroh ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kaba ki briew ki mane , bad phi la pyrshang ngab bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
translation.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee , in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land , and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .

translation.kha: Kumta phin sumar bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba im ha ka pyrthei kiba im u don katto katne ka jingmane ; u ksew suba im u kham bha ban ïa u sing ba la ïap .
translation.en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .

translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u leit sha Ramoth ,
translation.en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa kine ki jingtim borbah ha ki nongshun jongnga phi , uba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .
And the children of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth , and Aroer ,
translation.kha: Ka jait Gad ka tei biang ïa ki shnong ba la ker da ki kut : Dibon , Ataroth , Aroer ,

translation.en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .
translation.kha: Khie joit lashai mynstep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi bad pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kynsan halor ka nongbah . Nangta haba u Gaal bad la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa phi , tied tyngeh ïa ki kat kaba phi lah !
To kynmaw ba U Trai un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei , la u mraw ne uba laitluid , namar ka kam babha ba u 3 .
translation.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth , the same shall he receive of the Lord , whether he be bond or free .

translation.kha: Ki bhah ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar hapdeng jngai kita ki dur soh baroh sawdong , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Nga la thung ïa me pun ïarap ïa u shakri jong nga u Israel , ki briew kiba nga la jied . Nga la ai ha me ka burom bakhraw , wat la im shym la ithuh ïa nga .
translation.en: For Jacob my servant s sake , and Israel mine elect , I have even called thee by thy name : I have surnamed thee , though thou hast not known me .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ki hima borabor ngin ïaroh ïa me bad yn sheptieng ïa me ha ki nongbah jong ki hima bashyrkhei .
translation.en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee , the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee .

translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong , Ai ba kin ngat bad sahkut ha ki jingkhawai jong ki ; ai ba kin khyllung , ai ba kin shah pynshitom!
translation.en: And David saith , Let their table be made a snare , and a trap , and a stumblingblock , and a recompence unto them :
Now Jacob s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .
translation.kha: Ka pukri u Jakob ka la don hangta , bad U Jisu , uba la thait na kata ka jingleit , u la shongthait harud kata ka pukri . Ka long kumba shiteng sngi .
Kane ka jingïohipaw ka la long kum kaba nga la ïohi mynba U Blei u la woh ban pynpait ïa ka Jerahmeel , bad kum kaba nga la ïoh harud ka wah Khebar . Nangta nga la dem pyllup ïa put ha ka khñiot .
translation.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city : and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar  ; and I fell upon my face .

And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .
translation.kha: U la kynriah noh nangta bad tih ïa kawei pat ka pukri . Ym shym don jingïakajia shuh ïa kata , kumta u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jinglaitluid .  U ong ,  Mynta te U  Trai  u la ai jinglaitluid ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha kane ka jaka , bad ngin sa nang roi ha kane ka ri .
Ynda uta u khlong u la san , ka leit ïalang ïa u shata ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Moses , Namar , ka ong , nga la sei ïa u na ka um .
translation.en: And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u na Israel uba shong marjan bad phoi u kylla duk bad um lah shuh ban kyrshan hi ïa ailad , phi Dei ban ïarap ïa u kumba phoi lai ïa u nongtrei , khnang ba u lah ban ïailong u paramarjan jrong phi .
translation.en: And if thy brother be waxen poor , and fallen in decay with thee  ; then thou shalt relieve him : yea , though he be a stranger , or a sojourner  ; that he may live with thee .

And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :
translation.kha: Hato dei u Joab uba la ai buit ïa pha ha kane baroh ?  u la kylli ïa ka . Ka jubab ,  Nga smai da kata baroh kaba kyntang , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba ym don kano kano ka lad ban kiar na kaba jubab ïa ka jingkylli jong phi . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Joab , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi uba la bthah ïa nga ïa kaei ngan leh bad ïa kaei ngan kren .
Kumta ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nongtong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka ïinglieng ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .

translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah thup ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki para lem bad kita baroh naba kitei ontep ïa u kpu jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .

translation.kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki sharati kynthei ban pyrta na ka jaka kaba jrong tur ha kata ka nongbah :
translation.en: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,

And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .
translation.kha: Em ,  u Gehasi u jubab .  Hynrei u kynrad jong nga u la phah ïa nga ba dang myntan ar ngut na ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka ri lum Ephraim ki la wan poi , bad u kwah ïa phi ban ai ha ki lai hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa bad ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .

Mynta u Samuel u la ïap , bad baroh ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u hi , ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah ba-eh lute ïa ki nongri ksuid bad ki nongkren bajrong baroh’ na Israel .
translation.en: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
