translation.kha: Nalorkata ong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U Trai , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ïa-ban ong ha phi ba phyrnai shat ïa ki bynriew Jong u ban leit , khnang ba kin ieh Ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Hynrei haduh myntoi Phim shyiap shahshkor! .
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .

translation.kha: bad baroh ar ngut ktien ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïapynlong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei .
translation.en: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .

translation.kha: bad u shong ha ka jaka ba u ju shon hajan kynroh . U Abner u shong hajan jongno u , bad u Joktan ha pyrshah jong u .
translation.en: And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .

For this cause also thank we God without ceasing , because , when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us , ye received it not as the word of men , but as it is in truth , the word of God , which effectually worketh also in you that believe .
translation.kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka daw balei ba ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei . Haba ngi la wallam ha phi ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , phi la ïohsngew bad pdiang ïa ka , ym kum ka khubor na ki briew hynrei kum ka khubor jong U Blei , kaba long shisha kumta . Naba U Blei u trei ha phi kiba ngeit .

translation.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;
translation.kha: Bad ban ïaroh bad pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  man ka step bad man ka janmiet ,
moi ki Kherub ki ïaphai markhmat shalor kata ka jingot , bad ki thapniang baïapher jong ki , ki kah ïa ka .
translation.en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high , and covered with their wings over the mercy seat , with their faces one to another  ; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims .

translation.kha: Ki la prut im ïa por shapoh ka thliew bad ki la shang ïa ka da u maw .
translation.en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me .

translation.kha: Ha kaba pynkut noh , to long kiba khlaiñ ha U Trai bad ha ka bor ka jingïalang jong u .
translation.en: Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .

translation.kha: Ka ong , mynhynne ki ju ïong , ‘ Khie leit wad jubab na ka nongbah Adbeel — bad dat ka dei kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .

translation.kha: Doeg kumta , ko ki paralok jong nga , katba phi dang ap ïa kata ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong phi ban long kiba khlem thombor bad kiba khlem shah kyntiew pop ha khmat U Blei Bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .
translation.en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .

translation.kha: Kaei katai kaba jia lane kaba lah ban jia ka la lah jia mynsaw . U Blei u pynlong ïa kajuh ban jia bad ïai jia .
translation.en: That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .

translation.kha: U paidlang u nong , Mynta ngi tip balei U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingjai ban ïaid ryngkat , hynñiew ka don tang ka jingdoh ,
translation.en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .
And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
translation.kha: Katno kiba suk ki long kito ki bym don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
Haba ki jingthung ki la san malade ki kop sohkew ki la sdang mih , te ki ñiut pajut ki la paw .
translation.en: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .

translation.kha: Ki Amon bad ki Moab ki tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Edom bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad hadien kata , ki ïaphai pyrshah por ma ki ha ka jingïaleh bashyrkhei .
translation.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir , utterly to slay and destroy them : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir , every one helped to destroy another .
The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
translation.kha: Ka bainong ban lehbha ka lam sha ka jingim ; hynrei ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pop shuh shuh .
Kaba ïuh uba la ong , Wat klim , u la ong ruh , Wat pynïap . Wat lade phim shym klim , phi la long nongpynkheiñ hukum dalade phi pynïap briew .
translation.en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .

translation.kha: ka kharai kaba jylliew ha ka nongbah Asekah ; dara Ngan pynshitom ïa phi baroh .
translation.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .
And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the  Lord  !
translation.kha: bad u ïakren khñium :  Kan jin da la kham bha lada ngi la ïap ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  lem bad kiwei pat ki para Israel .
ki sih shabar ïa u rishot bakyntang Uba don hangta bad ki ryngkat ïa u .
translation.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .
And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .
translation.kha: Hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei dieng bad ki blei maw ïa kiba la thaw da ka kti briew , ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ban ïohsngew , ban bam lane ban sma .
lapbah ar la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mut hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —
translation.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :

translation.kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllew ïa ki bri jong nga .
translation.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?

translation.kha: Neng la long ryngkat bad me shano shano ba me loit , bad de la kjap ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me katba me ïasaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam khem ki nongïalam bakhraw tam ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee , and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ , that we might be justified by faith .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ka Hukum ka synshar ïa ngi tad haduh ba U Khrist u la wan , khnang ba yn lah ban pynksan ïa ngi ha U Blei da ka jingngeit .
Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei ban pyndonkam da u sawar uba jngum , umbah sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u sai ksah , pynlang da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translation.en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .

translation.kha: Ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba nga hi da lade nur-um wad ïa ki langbrot jong nga bad sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , will both search my sheep , and seek them out .

translation.kha: Me dei baneh pynïapher ïa kata kaba longsyiem ka Jong U Trai na kata kaba lah ban pyndonkam paidbah , ïa kata kaba khuid na kata ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean  ;

translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit lyngba ïa ki shnong , ki la ai ha ki pansngiat ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba ki apostol nabar ki nongsharai balang ha Jerusalem ki la rai , bad ki la bthah ïa ki ban ïanguh ïa kita ki jingbymngeit ryntih .
translation.en: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban ïa-bta , bad ki kjat , hynñiew kim lah ba-bang ïaid ; kim lah banbeiñ pynmareh sur jingsawa .
translation.en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Sebulun : u Sered , u Elon , bad u Jahasiel .
translation.en: And the sons of Zebulun  ; Sered , and Elon , and Jahleel .

And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews ? And they understood that the ark of the  Lord  was come into the camp .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingrisa bad ki ong ,  Sngap ïa kata ka jingrisa baroh ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ! Ka mut aïu kata ?  Haba ki shem ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la poi ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ,

Na la ai ïa ka shithi ha u Elasah u khun jong u Shaphan bad ha u Gemaraïah u khwan jongngi u Hilkaïah , ïa uba u Sedekaïah u syiemsad ka Judah u phah shwa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Baalah . Ka ong :
translation.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan , and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah , ( whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying ,
And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines , he was afraid , and his heart greatly trembled .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Philistia , u la sngewsheptieng ,

translation.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time , who should walk after their own ungodly lusts .
translation.kha: Ki la ong ha phi ,  Haba ki sngi bakhatduh kin wan , kin mih ki briew ki ban krenbeiñ ïa phi , ki briew kiba ïaid katba kum ki jingkwah brai bymriewblei jong ki hi .

translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong u briew uba bha kin long kiba donbor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

translation.en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
translation.kha: Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Jason bad ïa kiwei pat ban siew ïa ka pisa kaba donkam ban ïohlait , bad nangta ki la pyllait ïa ki .

translation.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long kum ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka por ba phi ïohi ïa ki , phin kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumta phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon bad ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
U la pyntwa ruh ïa u mot ha Pynlwet bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .

When thou art come unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt possess it , and shalt dwell therein , and shalt say , I will set a king over me , like as all the nations that are about me  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta , phin sa ïa-pyrkhat ban don noh u syiem kumba ïalong lem ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong phi .
Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad syn ? Hato kan ym ïapstai haba ka lyer mihngi ka shoh ïa ka ? Hato kan ym ïapstai Hangta ha kaba ka san ?
translation.en: Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .

translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ïa u syiem ka ibieit , Nga la pynlong skhem ïa me khring ban pyndonkam ïa me ba pyn-i ïa ka tam jong nga malu ban pynphriang ïa ka nam jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .

translation.kha: A Trai , ngan im na ka bynta jong me , bad Teng ïa me hi ; to pynkhiah ïa nga bad ai ngan im .
translation.en: O Lord , by these things men live , and in all these things is the life of my spirit : so wilt thou recover me , and make me to live .

translation.kha: hynriew lada kino map ïa kiwei , te U Kpa jong phi un ym map ïa ki jingpalat kiba phi la imat .
translation.en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .
For thou art my lamp , O  Lord  : and the  Lord  will lighten my darkness .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko  Trai  , me long ka jingshai jong nga , me beh noh ïa ka jingdum jong nga .

translation.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice , and all guile , and hypocrisies , and envies , and all evil speakings ,
translation.kha: To bret noh na lade , namarkata , ïa ki jingsniew baroh ; ïa ka jingshukor lane ka jingarsap lane ka jingbishni lane ka jingkren sniew .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ka Jesreel , u la bthah ïa nga ban hukum ïa ki ban ïathuh ïa ki shym jong ki ba U Trai u la lah ong :
translation.en: And command them to say unto their masters , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say unto your masters  ;

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar um ju har ei ei khlem da pynpaw ïa ka jingimat jong u ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Surely the Lord  God  will do nothing , but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad u ïathuh ha u syier bad U syiem u ong , Lada u don tang marwei , u wanrah ka khubor bakha . Uta wahbah mareh u nang jan nang jan .
translation.en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba Lah ban siew pat sha u , kumta u la pyndam noh ïa ki ramhah jong ki baroh ar ngut . Uno na kine , te , u ban ieit kham bun ïa u ?
translation.en: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?

translation.kha: Ki dei ki nongjapan ?
translation.en: Are they Japanese ?

translation.kha: Nga thaw ïa ka jingiaseng bad ïa ka jingdiang ; nga wanrah ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingjot . Ma nga , U Trai , ar leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: I form the light , and create darkness : I make peace , and create evil : I the  Lord  do all these things .

translation.kha: U shñiuh jong u , u la un-long uba lieh kum u saiwul lane kum ka ïor , bad ki khmat jongno u ibha klang kum ka tyngkan ;
translation.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool , as white as snow  ; and his eyes were as a flame of fire  ;

And Saul said unto him , Why have ye conspired against me , thou and the son of Jesse , in that thou hast given him bread , and a sword , and hast enquired of God for him , that he should rise against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Balei ma me bad u Dabid me ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha u katto katne ka jingbam bad ka waitlam , bad ba me kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u ? Mynta u la phai pyrshah ïa nga bad u da ap ïa ka kabu ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga !
Kumta u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet nabar ki rieh shakor ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .
translation.en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .

translation.kha: Ïa ki thuh jingbah lah ban ïohi da eit uno naba ïeng pyrshah ha khmat ka Jaka Kaba Pynkyntang Tam , hynrei ym nawei pat . ( Kita ki dieng jingbah ki dang don hangta haduh mynta . )
translation.en: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .

translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyllait ba u long uba riewpyrthei ? Lada um synrai ïa la u thylliej , ka jinglong riewkynthei jong u kam minot bad u shukor ïa lade .
translation.en: If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .
translation.kha: U lah ban buhrieh arsap ïa la ka jingisih , hynrei baroh kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bymman ba u leh .

translation.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u Bel , u blei ki nong Babilonia , bad ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u kiba shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew kin ym mane shuh ïa u .  Ki kynroh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .
Te ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai : Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jong phi , Da ka jingrwai iing pdiang sngewbha ïa ka .
translation.en: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :

translation.kha: Haba u Simon Petros u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , u la dem khohsiew ha khmih U Jisu bad u la ong , Kheiñ leit noh na nga , ko Trai ! Nga long u briew uba pah !
translation.en: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus  knees , saying , Depart from me  ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .

translation.kha: Katba ki ding don ha ka miej ban ïapom , U Josis u la ong , Nga Ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa la — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .
translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .

translation.kha: Nangta u ïathuh ïa ar ba U Trai , U Blei ki Isaia , u la ong , bakyrhuh , me ong , ‘ Nga la ngiah ! U Trai u la ba ïa ka jingsngewsih halor ki jingjynjar jong sa . Nga la thait na kaban shu ud , bad ngam shem kano kano ka jingjahthait !’
translation.en: Thou didst say , Woe is me now ! for the  Lord  hath added grief to my sorrow  ; I fainted in my sighing , and I find no rest .
And they passed on and went their way  ; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah , which belongeth to Benjamin .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaid lait ïa ka Jebus bad ki ïai bteng ha ka lynti jong ki . Ka la sep sngi haba ki wan poi ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
Bad namar ba phiah don hapoh kita ki pud , ngim shym la jam palat ïa ki mynba i la wan sha phi , da kaba wanrah ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphrang U Khristan .
translation.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure , as though we reached not unto you : for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ :

translation.kha: U ong ha la u kpa , Pa , ym dei kumto . Une uba nyngkong ; bhah ïa ka kti kamon jongki phi ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , Not so , my father : for this is the firstborn  ; put thy right hand upon his head .
And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat bad la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynïap ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha Kir .

translation.en: I speak as to wise men ; judge ye what I say .
translation.kha: Nga kren ha phi kum ki briew kiba sngewthuh ; to bishar hi da lade ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
Wat bthing ïa ki , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïaduna ïa me . Ma la , U thri nga la kren !
translation.en: Be not afraid of their faces : for I am with thee to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jephthah , u shipai bashlur na Gilead u dei u khun jngai ka nuti . U kpa jong u , u Gilead
translation.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour , and he was the son of an harlot : and Gilead begat Jephthah .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , U Trai un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt don wan kum ki skain na ki sahnar kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Neiel , bad ïa ki Assyria ban Wan kum ki ngap na ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .

translation.kha: ïohthiah ïa ki sahmiet bad ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah malade ïa uwei pa uwei umbah shong ba sai ha Jerusalem bad rung sha kine ki khyrdep , ngab shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translation.en: And say unto them , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , ye kings of Judah , and all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki . ‘ Da Shishak kin burom ïa u khur jong nga ,’ u la ainong .
translation.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u long uba hok , namar ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang jong nga . Ki samla shynrang bad kynthei jong nga ki la shah ringmraw noh .

translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki Pharisi , ki la kylli te ïa u Ïoannis ,  Lada mem dei u Messaïah lane u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynbaptis ?

translation.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei , u im ha U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
Ki khun : “Phi ki khun to kohnguh ia la ki kmie ki kpa ha U Trai .” —Ephesos 6 :1 .
translation.en: Children : “Children , be obedient to your parents in union with the Lord .”—Ephesians 6 :1 .
He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Katno phi don kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih .  Haba ki la shem , ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  San tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ruh .

translation.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria , and drave the Jews from Elath : and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day .
translation.kha: ( Ha kajuh ka por , u syiem ka Edom u ïoh pat ïa ka nongbah Elath , bad u beh krad ïa ki nong Judia kiba sah hangta . Ki nong Edom ki shongsah ha Elath , bad ki dang sah hi hangta . )

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saith  ; Behold , I will punish the multitude of No , and Pharaoh , and Egypt , with their gods , and their kings  ; even Pharaoh , and all them that trust in him :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa u Amon , u blei jong ki Thebes , ryngkat lang bad ka Ijipt bad ki blei bad ki syiem jong ka . Ngan shim noh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa baroh kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u ,
Da ki ïabam bad ki jingphylla Ibbah la pynsngewshyrkhei ïa ki Nongshun jong ngi , me la pynkdang ïa ka ber pynlang ka barabor jong me ban wallam ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs , and with wonders , and with a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with great terror  ;
Greet Mary , who bestowed much labour on us .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa ka Mari , kaba la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .
La kha ïa nga shuwa ki ïa-ïuh , mynba ki ñiuhlieh kim pat don .
translation.en: When there were no depths , I was brought forth  ; when there were no fountains abounding with water .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri baseisoh , Ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynring ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .
translation.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .

translation.kha: Khie leit suk leit sai , u Elihu u ong . Bad u Naaman u leit noh . U la leit dang khyndiat ka jingjngai ,
translation.en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .

translation.kha: phiah ki nongbah phi erlangthari kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to Shahshkor mynta ïa kaei kaweh nga ong .
translation.en: Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .

translation.kha: man ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndih , Hynrei um sngap ïa ki . Nga dei u jia , u batip , bad ngam da ban dem ha u Haman . Kumta ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Haman , bad ki pyrkhat la un lah ban shah ïa kan ka jingleh u Moladah .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba phim shym duh noh ban pdiang wat tang ïa kawei ka jingkyrkhu , katba phi dang ap khmih lynti ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

Nangta ki briew ki la ïai-ong , To ngin leh ei ei Shaphang u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka kherub jong U Blei’ . To ngin wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei katba u ong .
translation.en: Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .
And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand , and put it upon Joseph s hand , and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen , and put a gold chain about his neck  ;
translation.kha: U syiem u law noh na ka shynriah ti jong u ïa ka sati kaba don ka muhor syiem bad u pyndeng ïa ka ha ka shynriah ti jong u Joseph . U pynkup ruh ïa u da ka jaiñ linen bani , bad u pyndeng ïa u kynjri ksiar ha ka ryndang jong u .

Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na siat pdeng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbamsap bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingmeng .
translation.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .

translation.kha: Phin mynjur , namarkata , ba ngam shngiam la long ka jingbankhia ïa phi . Hynrei don ki ban ïa-ong ba nga la long kiba sahit , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .
translation.en: But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .

translation.kha: hynrei ki jubab , Ngi la pynbang ka jingkular bakyntang jong ngi ha ki ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei’ ki Israel . Mynta ngim la ban pynmynsaw ïa ki .
translation.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation , We have sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel : now therefore we may not touch them .
Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ba-mutlop la ai ki kyrdan ba don iktiar katba ïa kiba riewspah la leh bymsuidñiew .

A Trai , to khmih ïa ngi na banyngkong , ha kaba me shong ha ka jingkhuid bad ka burom Jong me . hangto kata ka jingsngewkhia bakyrhuh jong me ïa ngi ? Hangno kata ka ba jong me ? Hangno kata ka jingibieit bad ka jingsngewlem jong me ? Wah leh bymsuidñiew ïa ngi .
translation.en: Look down from heaven , and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory : where is thy zeal and thy strength , the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me ? are they restrained ?

translation.kha: U la ai jingtah ruh katno ka ksiar nylla kan leit ha kaba pyndonkam ban shna ïa ki pjah , ki pynbang , bad ki khiew , bad kattne ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha kaba shna ïa ki phlangïap ,
translation.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin  ; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver :

translation.kha: U Jakob u kamar-tama ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .

translation.kha: Kumta ba ka jingkmen jong ngi sha phi kan ym khih lano lano ; ngi tip ba kumba phi ïoh bynta na Us ki jingshahshitom jong ngi , kumjuh ruh phi ïoh bynta lem na kata ka jingïarap kaba I ïapynbiang .
translation.en: And our hope of you is stedfast , knowing , that as ye are partakers of the sufferings , so shall ye be also of the consolation .

For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .
translation.kha: U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki Syria , kiba la jop ïa u . U ong ,  Ki blei jong ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lah ban ïarap ïa nga ruh .  Kane ka la wanrah jingpynjot ïa u bad ha ka hima jong u .

kumta u ïalam ïa la ki briew , u pynïakhlad ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , Bad ki rieh apthap ha ki lyngkha . Haba u ïuh ïa ki briew ba ki mih shabar na ka nongbah , u la mih na la ka jakarieh ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And he took the people , and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field , and looked , and , behold , the people were come forth out of the city  ; and he rose up against them , and smote them .

translation.kha: lymda pa’ thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh kita kum u nongthaw kulmar .
translation.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Lashai dang step pynrangbah , khie leit ap ïa u Pharaoh katba u dang leit sha ka wah , bad ïathuh ha u ba U Trai’ u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jongno nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh  ; lo , he cometh forth to the water  ; and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .

translation.kha: U Petros , kaba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la jubab ïa ki , Ko nongïalam jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :
translation.en: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,

translation.kha: Lada phi leh bashisha kumba nga la hukum , te ki Kynhun ki kseh u Dabid kin ïailong syiem . Bad ma ki , lem Bad ki rangbah synshar jongki ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin ïai bteng banbeiñ ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop jong kane ka ïingsyiem ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai .
translation.en: For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .

translation.kha: Kin pynrem ïa u sha ka jingïalap dara ngin aiti ïa u ha ki Nethanel , ki ban briew ïa u , kin sympat ïa u , nabar kin shaphrang ïa u ; hynrei hain lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translation.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa u , Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ? Uta u briew u la jubab , Ka kirteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Paidbah’ — im ïadon sian !
translation.en: And he asked him ,  What is thy name ?  And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .
Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .
translation.kha: Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew ; ym don u briew uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the  Lord  : Thou sayest , Prophesy not against Israel , and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong . Me bthah ïa nga ban sangeh kaba ïathuhlypa , ban sangeh kaba kren lamwir pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Israel .

translation.en: And one of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite : therefore I chased him from me .
translation.kha: U Joïada u dei u khun jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh , hynrei uwei na ki khun jong u Joïada u la shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u Sanballat na ka shnong Beth Horon , kumta nga la pynlong ba u Joïada un mihnoh na Jerusalem .
Ka kti kamon jong me , A tharai , ka long kaba khraw eh ha ka ni ; ka pynlwet thiaw ïa u nongshun .
translation.en: Thy right hand , O  Lord  , is become glorious in power : thy right hand , O  Lord  , hath dashed in pieces the enemy .

translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katai ngut ki dkhot jongngi ka balang .
translation.en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets , and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te ïa ki samla shynrang jong ka yn pynïap ha ki surok bah jong ka nongbah , bad ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot ha kata ka sngi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Ang ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshlei ka sngi ; nga ïeng ha khmat ki briew bad nga kparad jingïarap .
translation.en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
Then they willingly received him into the ship : and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went .
translation.kha: Nangta da kaba kmen ki la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng , bad kumta hi ka lieng ka la poi ha ryngkew ha ka jaka sha kaba ki thmu .

Naba haba ki la shah kyntait , ïa u bynriew la pynkylla na kaba long ki nongshun U Blei sha kaba longkmie ki paralok jong u . Kaei ka ban long te , hato la pdiang ïa ki ? Kan hir ka jingim ïa kiba la ïap!
translation.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world , what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead ?

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi kan kham skhem da kaba ïuh ïa ka khang ba khot ka Bethel .
translation.en: You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .

translation.kha: Ka ngam jong me ka longsyiem kaba khraw , bad ki briew kin nong junom , ‘ U Trei Nongsynshar u long U Blei halor ki Jeriel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jyllang nga ha ki nga barabor .
translation.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God over Israel : and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee .

translation.kha: Nga la ïakheiñ ha ka jingngeit , wiat lehbha na ong , La pynlwet khuid ïa nga ,
translation.en: I believed , therefore have I spoken : I was greatly afflicted :
Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .
translation.kha: U la ñiew ba ka jingshah krenbeiñ na ka bynta U Messaïah ka long kaba kham kordor bun shah ban ïa ka spah baroh jong ka ri Ijipt , naba u khmih lynti ïa ka bainong ka ban sa wan .
U Manoah u jubab , Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai baburom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jong phi ki la urlong .
translation.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?

translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab ba u para um lah ban ïoh ïa i pa ; namar lada u kun kumta , i pa in ïap .
translation.en: And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .

And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .
translation.kha: Kham hadien , u Joab bad ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la wan phai na kaba leit lute , ki da wanrah shikatdei ka mar lute bad ki . Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid hangta ha Hebron , namar u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
Ha ki jaka mane blei thala , ha ki lum , bad hapoh ka jingriew jrong ki dieng baroh , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad thang jingbuaid .
translation.en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .

translation.kha: Ki phah ruh ïa ki dur khnai kba da ka ksiar , uwei na ka pyntwa kamai kawei ka nongbah ba la synsar da ki san jrut ki syiem Philistia , ki shnong ba la ker kynroh bad ki bym shyiap la ker kynroh . Uta u mawbah ha ka lynghoh u Joshua uba ha Beth Sheresh , ha Uba ki buh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang , u dang don hangno kum u sakhi haduh kane ka sngi ïa kadei kiba la jia .
translation.en: And the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fenced cities , and of country villages , even unto the great stone of Abel , whereon they set down the ark of the  Lord  : which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua , the Beth–shemite .
Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .
translation.kha: To ai ba ma phi , ki briew jong u , phin ïailong kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba phi leh ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God , where is the garrison of the Philistines : and it shall come to pass , when thou art come thither to the city , that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery , and a tabret , and a pipe , and a harp , before them  ; and they shall prophesy :
translation.kha: Nangta men leit kiew sha u Lum jong U Blei ha Gibeah , ha kaba don ka jaka sher dara jong ki Philistia . Ha ka jaka rung shapoh shnong , men ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba dang wan hiar na ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum , ki da tem da put ïa ki duitara , ki ksing , ki sharati , bad ki kanjari . Kin sa ïashad bad ïarisa .
Nga da khiew eh ba ki briew kiba pynhiarkput ïa phi kin leit borbah shi lynter lynti ; ai ba kin na ïaid bad pynthohbria ïa lade!
translation.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you .

translation.kha: ( Kine ki lum ar tylli ki don shaei jingbei ka wah kyrdan ha ka ri ki Kanaan katba shong ha ka Them Jordan . Ki anna shaphang sepngi , ym da jngai na ki diengsoh kyntang ha Mamre Ashan ka shnong Gilgal . )
translation.en: Are they not on the other side Jordan , by the way where the sun goeth down , in the land of the Canaanites , which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal , beside the plains of Moreh ?

translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki ni ka long katto katne ki jingïania shaphang ka niam jong ki Bad shaphang u briew uba ktung U Jisu , naba la ïahap ; hynrei u Paul u ki ba u ding im .
translation.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .

translation.kha: Nga ithuh ïa u briew uba ngeit ïa kaba khatsan snem mynshuwa la rong noh shuh ka bneng kaba jrong tam ( ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne u la ïoh ïa ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba thup ) .
translation.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago , ( whether in the body , I cannot tell ; or whether out of the body , I cannot tell : God knoweth ; ) such an one caught up to the third heaven .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ithuh u Paidbah , Da kane phiah tip ba dei U Trai uba la phah ïa nga ïa-ban leh ïa Kino kiew kiei baroh , bad ba ym dei da ka mon jong la ba ar la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the  Lord  hath sent me to do all these works  ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .

And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .
translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba hap hapoh u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Dabid bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . Ki Syria kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .

Hynñiew haba u Moses u leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U TRAI’ , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaitniam . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïateh ha ki Jesreel ïa kata baïar ïa kambah la hukum ïa u ban kren ,
translation.en: But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba ïathuh lypa ïa ka jingsuk lah ban ithuh ïa u kum u nongïathuhlypa uba U Trai u la phah shisha haba ki jingïathuhlypa jong Utai u nongïathuhlypa kin urlong pahara .
translation.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace , when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , then shall the prophet be known , that the  Lord  hath truly sent him .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba shen ngan sa iehnoh ïa kane ka met babit kumba U Jisu Kherith U Trai jongngi Ngi u la ïathuh shai ha de .
translation.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle , even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me .

translation.kha: U Trai u pyn-i ha nga ar shang ki soh Dumbur ba la buh ha khmat ka Templ . ( Kane ka longkmie hawei ba u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin , u syiem ka Judia , u khun jong u Jehoïakhin , kum u koidi na Jerusalem , lem bad ki nongïamareh ka Judah , ki nongtrei dieng , bad ki nongtrei batbit . )
translation.en: The  Lord  shewed me , and , behold , two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the  Lord  , after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , and the princes of Judah , with the carpenters and smiths , from Jerusalem , and had brought them to Babylon .

translation.kha: Ngan long ïa ki paidlang Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki syntiew ; kin isaitmet slem kum ki dieng ha Libnah .
translation.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .
translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki bad un pynjot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .

Pynban me la bud ïa ka jinglehhok jong ki syiem ka Israel bad me la ïalam ïa ki bri ka Ïuodia malu Jerusalem sha ka jinglong bymïaineh shuh ha U blei , Rumah u Ahab bad ki nongmih bujli jrong u ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingmaïan . Me la pynpoh woh ïa la ki para shynrang , kaba longkmie ki rangbah kiba kham bha baneh ïa kaba me long .
translation.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Uta u dpei un sa her kum u pui pui uba ni ha ka ri Ijipt baroh , bad kat haba u hap un pynmih ki tohjaw kiba kylla prum ha u briew bad ha u mrad .
Nangta u Petros u la wan sha U Jisu bad u la kyllan , Ko Trai , lada u hynmen u para jong nga u ïai ni pop pyrsad ïa nga , haduh katno sien to dien ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?
translation.en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka reng ba U Trai Nongsynshar u hukum ïa ka ba kan wanpaw na baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha kine ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .

translation.kha: ka linen kiba ni ; u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la suhjer da u shñiuh blang ;
translation.en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,

translation.kha: U Gedalaïah u la ong ïa ki , Nga ai ïa phi ïa la ka ktien ba kam donkam ïa phoi ban bymsheptieng ban pynmeh ha ki nong Babilonia , to shongduh ha kane ka ri , to sakhrai ïa u syiem ka Babilonia , bad barieh kan bha ïa phi .
translation.en: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying , Fear not to serve the Chaldeans : dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you .
Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :
translation.kha: bad tei ïa ka ïing jong me halor ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyoh kum ki kali ïapom bad me shong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
U Petros u la pyntud ïa ka jingkhang kaba baher , bad ka shakri kaba kyrteng ka Rhoda ka la wan ban peit uei uba tied .
translation.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .

translation.kha: Mano ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh ? u Ahab u kylli . U nongïathuhlypa u la jubab , U Trai u ong ba ki shipai samla hapoh ka hukum jong ki lat jong ki tawiar kin leh ïa kata . mian ban ai lawlynnong ïa ka kynhun kaba kongsan ? u syiem u kylli . Ma me , u nongïathuhlypa u la jubab .
translation.en: And Ahab said , By whom ? And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces . Then he said , Who shall order the battle ? And he answered , Thou .

translation.kha: Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jong de da ka jingpang , wat ha kaei hi ka met ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .
translation.kha: A katno pha long kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan urlong shisha !

translation.en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad knieh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .

Ang la ong ha lade ba ki kliar jong phi , ko Kynrad , kin pynshngain ïa nga , namar ba u sahmiet u long kum u angel jong U Blei bad u lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba babha na kaba sniew . To U Trai U Blei jong phi un long lem bad pa’ !
translation.en: Then thine handmaid said , The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable : for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad : therefore the  Lord  thy God will be with thee .
As the  Lord  commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua  ; he left nothing undone of all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki hukum jong u ha u Moses u shakri jong u , u Moses u la ai ïa kita ha u Joshua , bad u Joshua u la kohnguh ïa ki . U la leh ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: When she was brought forth , she sent to her father in law , saying , By the man , whose these are , am I with child : and she said , Discern , I pray thee , whose are these , the signet , and bracelets , and staff .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang shah sei kumta , ka la phah ktien sha la u kthaw kurim :  Nga la punkhun na uta u briew uba long u trai kine ki tiar . Peit ïa ki bad khmih ki dei ki jongno — kane ka muhor bad u ksai jong ka bad une u diengduh .
U Mikaïah u nguh Shua : Mynta sngap ïa kawei kaba U Trai u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U Trei ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , jingset bad baroh ki angel lad u kiba ïeng harud jong u .
translation.en: Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka shang , bad wanrah ïa ki shaei nga ha ka por ba me Kñia ïa uta u masi lyngngun pynlang ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
For ye say , Where is the house of the prince ? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked ?
translation.kha: Phi kylli ,  Hangno ka don ka ïing jong u briew bakhraw mynta , u briew uba leh ïa kaba sniew ?
ban klim , ban lalot , bad leh baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew ; ka jingshukor , ka jingbymdon-burom , ka jingbishni , kaba kren sniew shaphang kiwei , ka jingsarong , bad ka jingbieit —
translation.en: Thefts , covetousness , wickedness , deceit , lasciviousness , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , foolishness :
Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban long uba sngewrit bad sah duk ban ïa kaba long uba meng bad ïoh bynta na ka jinglute jong ki .

translation.en: Now when Festus was come into the province , after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien ba u Phestos u la poi ha ka probins    , u la leit na Kaisaria , sha Jerusalem ,
U Trai u la pyntip ha at ïa ki jingthmu sngi Kiba ki nongshun jongno to ki la thaw pyrshah ïa ang .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .
And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son :
translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsynei ïa u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ,
pynthylli noh ïa u mawkhang ! U Jisu u la hukum . Ka Martha , ka bymneh uta uba la ïap , ka la jubab , Kam sa don ka jingsma iwtung , ko Trai . La lah thup ïa u la saw sngi .
translation.en: Jesus said ,  Take ye away the stone .  Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .

translation.kha: Te mynta kñia ka longsem kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïong : Nga ai ïa ka ri ki nong Ijipt sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Un lute bad pynjot lut badno rong noh ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Ijipt kum ka than ïa ka kynum shipai jong u .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey  ; and it shall be the wages for his army .

translation.kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ioh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki jat lum shaphang sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Jesreel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bad Semaraim ; ki briew jong ka Benjamin kine shimet ïa ka Gilead .
translation.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .

translation.kha: To ka jingtei U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi kan longsyiem lem bad phi barben . Amana .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: To wan sha U Trai , u mraw uba im uba la kyntait da u brup kum u bymmyntoi hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .
translation.en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,

translation.kha: Ïa borbah kaba u la kynshew yn pynjop ; ka ding ïa kaba ym shym la pynmeh da ki kti briew ka trep ïa u bad ïa baroh ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him  ; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka long kaba bha shibun ïa phi ban ïarap ïa ang ha ki jingjynjar jong nga .
translation.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done , that ye did communicate with my affliction .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jongu ar bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong me haba ki phai khmat shaei Kanneh ka jaka bad ki duwai . Na ka ïing jong me ha bneng to shahskhor ïa ngi bad to Kartah ruh ïa ngi .
translation.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .
And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba kren ka kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map .

Ko ki lapbah Israel ! ki la pyrta . To ïarap ! Dan une u briew umbiah saw kylleng kylleng da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa uwei pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel , ïa ka Hukum u Moses , bad ïa kane ka Templ . Badno myntor u la wan ïalam wat katto katei ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pynngat ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !
translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .

translation.kha: Dem ngon ha khmat uta Uba khuid haba u wanpaw ; to khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , phoi ka pyrthiew baroh !
translation.en: O worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness : fear before him , all the earth .
Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew bym lah shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïalang lok bad ka pyrthei ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno uno uba kwah ban pynlong lok bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa lade u nongshun jong U Blei .
Ki pop jong ki , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa at , bad kumta nur pyndam noh ïa me malade ïa ka longïing jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Jeroboam .
translation.en: Behold , I will take away the posterity of Baasha , and the posterity of his house  ; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

translation.kha: Kynrad , phi la kylli ïa moi , ‘ Phi dang don kpa ne phi dang ni para shynrang shuh ?’
translation.en: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?

translation.kha: Lada i pa jongnga phi i shem ba ngam don lang ha ka miej bam , ïathuh ïa i ba nga la pan jingbieit na phi ban leit sha la ïing ha Bethlehem , namar ba ka dei ka por jong ka jingkñia ainguh ba shisien shisnem hangta ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga baroh .
translation.en: If thy father at all miss me , then say , David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city : for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family .

translation.kha: Phi la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingjam jong nga borbah , malade ‘Phim mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa pa .
translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki la duwai ,  A Trai , me tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , kumta pyn-i ha ngi uno na kine ar ngut uba me la jied
hangto ngi la Shem ïa ka liengbah kob thmu ban otsher sha Phoenisia , kumta im la ïakiew ha ka bad ngi la leit noh .
translation.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phoenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .

translation.kha: Hynrei Myntan ngan lup ïa ki bad pynshitom ïa ki . Shen shen Kin sa kyrthat ha ka jingpang , haba u patsha ka Assyria u baïaineh ïa ki .
translation.en: Yea , though they have hired among the nations , now will I gather them , and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes .

translation.kha: Hynrei mar ïa pynmih ïa ki briew shabar , U Jisu u la rung shab ka kamra jongno ka khnai bun u la batbit ïa ka kti jong ka , bad ka la khie joit .
translation.en: But when the people were put forth , he went in , and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .

translation.kha: To U Trai un ainong ïa phi namar kaei katba phoi la leh . Ai ba Phon ioh ka bainong kaba pura! na U Trai U Blei ki Israel , sha wahbah phi la wang ïa-ban ïoh jingïada .
translation.en: The  Lord  recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the  Lord  God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .

translation.kha: Bad to Khmih ïa ki jingdonkam jong iwei ïa iwei patiaw , ym thiang ïa la ka jong .
translation.en: Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .
Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?
translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa u , u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , kumno shaphang une u briew ?
Ïa Kane ka jingsleh iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba rem bad ïa ka pisa shun ai ha Ibbah duk .
translation.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .

translation.kha: U Absalom u la phet krad bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Ammihud , u syiemsad Geshur bad u la Hukum hangamei lai snem . U Dabid u la ïambriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u khun jong u ;
translation.en: So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki bymman , ki samla shynrang , ki samla kynthei , ki longkmie bad ki khynnah rit . hynriew wat ktah ktha ïa uno uno ibha don ka dak ha ka shyllangmat jong u . Sdang nangne na ka templ jongnga nga . Kumta ki la sdang na ki nongïalam kiba ngin Hangta ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark  ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .

And as touching the dead , that they rise : have ye not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spake unto him , saying , I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ?
translation.kha: Mynta , na ka bynta kita kiba la ïap ki ban sa mihpat : Hato phim pat ju pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ïa ka bynta kaba dei shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing ? Hangto la thoh ba U Blei u la ong ïa u Moses , ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’
Kumta shisyndon u la phiah ïa u nongap phira thang bad ki hukum ban khlam ïa ka khlieh jongno u Ïaineh . U nongap phira u la mihnoh , u leit sha ka bakhyndai , bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis ;
translation.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner , and commanded his head to be brought : and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,

translation.kha: Pynban phim mon ban wan sha nga khnang ba phin ieh ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: And ye will not come to me , that ye might have life .

translation.kha: U Dabid u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lum ha khmih U Trai — baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei haba jan kut artat ka pyrem , ha kaba sdang ka aïom ot bapli , haba la pynnep ïa ki .
translation.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Mynta ka jingpynim ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u dei uba hiarpateng jong u Abraham .

Nga da lade hi nga la smai ba kane ka nongkhap Bishar kan long ka jingïohi ba-itriem bad ka ri shispah ; ki brisoh kmen rkhiebeiñ ïa ka bun kin pynbam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim . Baroh ki nongrit ba-hajan kin don ha ka jingjot junom . Ma nga , U tharai , nga la kren .
translation.en: For I have sworn by myself , saith the  Lord  , that Bozrah shall become a desolation , a reproach , a waste , and a curse  ; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , kabu kut ka la jan ïa kito kiba pynkhuid ïa lade na ka jingmlien ba-pnah , kiba ïasaid paidbah ha ka kynhun sha ki kper bakynjah , bad kito kiba bam-im ïa ka dohksah sniang , dara ïa ka doh khnai Bad khawai patar ki jingbam ba-ijli .
translation.en: They that sanctify themselves , and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst , eating swine s flesh , and the abomination , and the mouse , shall be consumed together , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U syiem Abishag u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbud u ïabuaid . U Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jrong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u ita ka ri ka mutdur ïa ka jingsngur Haduh shiphew snem .
translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .

translation.kha: Nga jubab , Ka step ka wan , hynrei ka miet kan wan biang . lymda phi kajuh ban kylli baklang , sa wan pat bad kylli .
translation.en: The watchman said , The morning cometh , and also the night : if ye will enquire , enquire ye : return , come .

translation.kha: U bang bha ba leh ïa ka jingsniew bad u bthuh katto katai ha ka shyntur jong u ban sngewkyndit ïa ka jingbang jongu ka .
translation.en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u Saul u pynbynta ïa u paidïapom jong u ha ki lai kynhun , bad ynda mynstep ki tur sha ka jaka shong dara ki nongshun bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Ammon . Ha ka por shiteng sngi ki la lai pynïap ïa ki . Kiba lait im ki phet ïap , marwei mawthew ha la ka lynti .
translation.en: And it was so on the morrow , that Saul put the people in three companies  ; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch , and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day : and it came to pass , that they which remained were scattered , so that two of them were not left together .
And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Rephaïah , u khun jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

Kane ka kitab ka long ka jingbuh jingwoh ïa ki jingïohi kiba U Jisu Khrist u la pynap . U Blei u la ai ha u ïa kane ka jingpynpaw khnang ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kawei kaba de ba jhieh shen . U Khrist u la pynlong ïa kine kiei kiei ngab tip da u shakri jong u , u Ïoannis da katba phah ïa la u angel shata u ,
translation.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him , to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass  ; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John :

translation.kha: katkum ïa phi yn rah ne kum ki koidi . Ki nongïaleh jong phi kin shahthngan haduh ba-bang ïap , bad ki riewpoh ken ïap thynrang .
translation.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .

translation.kha: Un wanlam ïa uta u masi sha ka jingkyang ka jingïoh , un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad un pynpaw ïa u hangta ha ka jingdon rijied U Trai .
translation.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord   ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock s head , and kill the bullock before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la kynmaw pun pyni jingisynei ha u Abraham malade ha barhem ki khum ki ksiew jong u junom !
translation.en: As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .

translation.kha: Ngam shym long uba la pynrem ; ngam shym la leh lud ei ei . Nga long uba lui lui bad lieh na ka pop .
translation.en: I am clean without transgression , I am innocent  ; neither is there iniquity in me .

translation.kha: U blang , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u pynngat ïa kiba khroh ; U Blei u trei — bad u briew uba sniew u ïalap .
translation.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power : he riseth up , and no man is sure of life .
And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew uba ki kjat bad ki kti jong u ki la sieb u la wan sha U Jisu ,

translation.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us , so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ngi ïoh bynta na ki jingshah shitom babun jong U Khrist , kumta ruh , lyngba U Khrist , ngi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingïarap bakhraw jong U Blei .
hynrei ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid halor ka um . Ka dei ka rngai ! ki la pyrkhat , bad ki la lyndang .
translation.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :
Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pyrkhat briew , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh . Nga la pynmutlop ïa u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , khnang ba nga lah ban leh ïa kine ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ,

translation.en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .
translation.kha: bad ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa u kew , bad ki sohwaiñ , bad ki soh Olib .

Napdeng ki lyngdoh babha shnong ha ki nongbat ba la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew u Aaron , lane ha ki jaka phlang kiba dei jong kine ki nongbah , la to ki rangbah ba kitkhia ban sam ïa ka jingbam sha ki shynrang baroh’ ha ka Long ki lyngkhuh bad shad aiwai pa uwei uba ei kyrteng ha ka kur ki Loit .
translation.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests , which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities , in every several city , the men that were expressed by name , to give portions to all the males among the priests , and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha u , To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im bad aïu ki dei ban leh .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the mountains shall drop down new wine , and the hills shall flow with milk , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters , and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the  Lord  , and shall water the valley of Shittim .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki lumbah yn tap da ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki masi yn shem ha uwei pa uwei u lum ; yn don kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki wahduid baroh ha Judah . Ka wahduid kan tuid na ka Templ jong U  Trai  , bad kan ai um ïa ka Them Akasia .
Uba klim u ap ïa ka por janmiet ba kane wan ; u tap ïa la ka iitkhmat khnang ban ym don mano myn ba lah ban Iohi ïa u .
translation.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me : and disguiseth his face .

Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ki jait bad ki kur jong ki Israel ban wan sha u sha Jerusalem khnang ban leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  na ka Seïon , ka Nongbah u Dabid , sha ka Templ .

Ngan pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nong Ijipt bad ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsngewskhem jrong ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ban ïarap ïa ki , bad kin leit ban kulai na ki nongleh byrtong bad Kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap ban ïoh jingdam .
translation.en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .

translation.kha: lada ka long ban shakri , ngi dei ban shakri ; lada ka long ban hikai , me dem ban hawei ;
translation.en: Or ministry , let us wait on our ministering : or he that teacheth , on teaching ;

translation.kha: La pyllait noh ïa kita ki saw ngut ki angel ; na ka bynta kane hi ka kynta Jong kane hi ka sngi jong a hi u bnai bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pyndap noh shi bynta na ka la bynshet jong u Briew baroh .
translation.en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki suda ha u Eleasar , u Joshua , bad ha kiwei pat ki nongïalap jong ki Israel :
translation.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Nga la rai ba U Blei u tynjuh ïa ngi , ngab pyn-i ïa ngi ba ngim long kham bha ban ïa ki mrad .
translation.en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men , that God might manifest them , and that they might see that they themselves are beasts .

translation.kha: Hynrei shem ka lyer kaba jur — kata kaba la khot ka lyer Shatei-lam-mihngi — ka la beh na ka dngong .
translation.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .

translation.kha: U puta ïaleh ïa ki khlem riej bad u pynïap shibun na ki . Nangta u saw Bad u sah ha ka krem mawsiang ha Etam .
translation.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter : and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam .
And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
translation.kha: U Krispos , uba long u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kiwei pat ki briew ha Korinth ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki la ngeit , bad la pynbaptis ïa ki .

Men ïap ha kaba suk , bad kamar ki briew ki thang jingpyniwbih haba ki tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong me , kiba long ki syiem ha shuwa jong me , ha kajuh ka jingkam kin thang ki jingiwbih na ka bynta jong me . Kin ïambriew namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jong ngi u la ïapom !’ Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .
Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Philistia bad ki Arab ki shong ki sah hajan ka jaka ha kaba katto katne ngut ki nong Sudan ki la shongduh harud ka duriaw . U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Jehoram .

Ki dang ïadih ïa kiei kiei ngab kurup bad ïabynta , Kawei lane ar ngut ki kynthei na ka bynta uwei ti u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Sisera , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka ryndang jong ka syiem .
translation.en: Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?

And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod .
translation.kha: Teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem bad ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba ka jingdeng shadem kan shong halor u panpoh bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod .
Ïa ka jingkhroh bad ïa ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam shapoh ka nongbah .
translation.en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingma , te , ba kane ka kam lad ngi kan budnam . Ym tang Katai , hynrei ka don ruh ka jingma ba ka templ Jong ka phai artylli kad ym don jingmut ei ei shuh sad ba ïa ka jingkhraw jong ka yn pynduh — ka plie ba la mane da uwei pa uwei ha Asia Bad ha ka pyrthei bhor !
translation.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .

translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nuksa ïa phi , ba phna leh kumba nga la leh ma nga ïa phira .
translation.en: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ki Israel kim smam shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U Trai bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki kpa jong ki , ki la khlong ïa ki hukum jong U Trai , hynrei kane ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sheng ban leh kumta .
translation.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .

translation.kha: Hynrei to phai mynta bad to ïasaid bad U Blei Badonbor Baroh ;
translation.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;
For he clave to the  Lord  , and departed not from following him , but kept his commandments , which the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U long uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad um ju leh bymkohnguh ïa u , hynrei u husiar ban bat ïa ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses .

translation.en: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy , ) neither wist they what to answer him .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ba ki ïohthiah ; kim shym la lah ban khyllie ïa la ki khmat . Bad kim shym la tip ïa kaei ban ong ïa u .

translation.en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark  ;
translation.kha: U la ap sa hynñiew sngi , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste  ; and he said , I have sinned against the  Lord  your God , and against you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot kyrkieh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa phi ruh .

translation.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean  ; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba u briew u bymkhuid u ktah ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa kata u long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
U Trai u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban ïasheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .
translation.en: And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .
Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
translation.kha: Hato phim pat shym la ïakren bad ki briew kiba leit jingleit ? Hato phim tip ïa ki jingïathuh ba ki wanrah ?

translation.en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei kiei baroh ; nga ñiew ïa ka baroh tang kum ka synrum , khnang ba ngan ïoh ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynïasoh pura bad u . Ngam long shuh uba don ka hok ka jong nga hi , ka bynta kaba nga ïoh da kaba kohnguh ïa ka hukum . Nga mynta , nga ïoh ïa ka hok kaba la ai da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist , ka hok kaba wan na U Blei bad kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit .

translation.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,
translation.kha: Ynda ki la wan poi ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lut ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
Kata ka briew ka kha ïa u khun shynrang bad ka ai kyrteng ïa u , u Samson . Uta u khunlung u la nang satang bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translation.en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .

translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka pliang , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei haw jong ka .
translation.en: And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :

translation.kha: Ha ka pat kaba bud U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And in the morning came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .
