translation.kha: Um bit ban bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , lane uba la shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw ; kata kan pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai .
shemphang ka jait Dan u ong , U Dang u dei u Song samla ; Na Bashan u mih kynsi .
translation.en: And of Dan he said , Dan is a lion s whelp : he shall leap from Bashan .

translation.kha: U ainong , Na u nongbam wan mih ka jingbam ; Na uba khlaiñ wei mih kaba Tang . Hadien lai sngi ruh kim shem lah ban batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Out of the eater came forth meat , and out of the strong came forth sweetness . And they could not in three days expound the riddle .

Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .
translation.kha: Pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka jaka mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ki jingmih baroh ba phi la ïoh ot bad ïa ka kam jong phi baroh .
Kumta te , U Trai u iehnoh katto katne ki jingbhabriew ha ka ri ban tyngkreiñ ïa ki Jeruel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;

translation.kha: Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me , u Joab u ong . U ramhah sa tyllai ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jongki u Asahel katba u tdong im , haba u ding sdien ha u dieng Sning .
translation.en: Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba katto katne nguh ki rangbah ba la phah da u Jakob keiñ poi Haneng , u Peres u la ïabam nur bad ki parabangeit Jentil . Hynrei shadien ba kine ki rangbah ki la nang , u la kynriah noh dara um shym ïapom lang shuh Bad ki Jentil , namar u la sheptieng ïa kito bakha ha ka liang naba otsher ïa ki .
translation.en: For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
translation.kha: Katto katne pat , ki la pdiang ïa u bad ki la ngeit ha u ; kumta u la ai bor ha ki , ban long ki khun U Blei .
Ko Ninebeh , pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbeit bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan pyrshang ban mlien phet na ki nongshun jong pha .
translation.en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .

translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad , ki sim , malade ki dohksah kin im ha ka jingsheptieng ïa phi . La buh ïa ki thah ka bor jongki phi .
translation.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth , and upon every fowl of the air , upon all that moveth upon the earth , and upon all the fishes of the sea  ; into your hand are they delivered .

translation.kha: Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? ithuh kan dei tang ban ïoh ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewskhem , ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jong nga ha ka jingjahburom ?
translation.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?

translation.kha: Neng la pynslem ïa ki nongaikam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki , Phi la banbeiñ ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi ! Nga la khot ïa ka jingïalang paidbah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh bad nga ong ,
translation.en: Then I consulted with myself , and I rebuked the nobles , and the rulers , and said unto them , Ye exact usury , every one of his brother . And I set a great assembly against them .
After two days was the feast of the passover , and of unleavened bread : and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft , and put him to death .
translation.kha: Ka la long mynta ar sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wad ka lad ban kem jar jar ïa U Jisu bad ban pynïap ïa u .

Bad wohnia ïa baïar ki briew la pynjrong ki nongpop na ka daw jong ka jingbymkohnguh lad uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom yn pynsaja ïa ki baher bad U Blei na ka daw jong ka jingkohnguh jong uwei u briew .
translation.en: For as by one man s disobedience many were made sinners , so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous .

Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .
translation.kha: Ym don kino kino ki bleithaw jong ki jaitbynriew kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka suiñbneng da lade hi kam lah ban pynhap slap . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar me long uta uba leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

Ko nongbah Sidon , pha long kaba la jahburom ! Ki jingsiew jong ka duriaw-rit bad ba-dum ki la kyntait ïa pha bad ki ïa-ong , Ngam ju don kino ‘Phim ki khun . Ngam ju pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun shynrang ne ki khun kynthei .
translation.en: Be thou ashamed , O Zidon : for the sea hath spoken , even the strength of the sea , saying , I travail not , nor bring forth children , neither do I nourish up young men , nor bring up virgins .
Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee , and awake that shall vex thee , and thou shalt be for booties unto them ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ba phin tip ïa ka , phi kiba la jop ïa kiwei phin don ha ka ram ïa lade bad shah pynbor ban siew ïa ka sut . Ki nongshun kin wan bad pynkyiuh ïa phi . Kin thombor ïa phi !
Ki briew jong ngi ki dei ban nang ban pynlut ïa la ka par ha naba leh babha , khnang ba ki lah ban pynnep ïa ki jingdonkam bashisha ; kdor dei ban im ka jingim ka bymlarkam .
translation.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .

translation.kha: Katba katne ki la long kiba bieit , ki shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki sad namar ka jingsniew jong ki ;
translation.en: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .

translation.kha: Ïa Un uno u rangbah lyngdoh la jied napdeng ki parabriew , bad la thung ban shakri ïa U Blang na ka bniat jong ki , ban ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ka jingainguh na ka boitha ki pop .
translation.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit bad buh u nongap phira , bad ong ïa u ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .
To ai ba ka jingaiei malade ka jingsuk ba-dap pura kin long ki jong phi lyngba ka jingtim jong phi ïa U balui bad ïa U Jisu U Trai jongnga me .
translation.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God , and of Jesus our Lord ,

translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynbna ba u long U Rangbah lynghoh ha ka rukom longsem lynghoh jong u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec .

Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .
translation.kha: Sah hangne baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por mynstep ngin sa wad la un shim jingkitkhlieh ne em na ka bynta jong phi . Lada ka long kumta , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U  Trai  Uba im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingkitkhlieh . Mynta to thiah bad sah hangne haduh mynstep .
bad ki la lynñiar jam haba ki la ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej dieng kiba la bam mad ïa ka : Ym patar ju don kawei pat ka nongbah kum kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !
translation.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning , saying , What city is like unto this great city !

translation.kha: Ki la long ki bymïaineh ha nga , bad kumta ngan pynlong ka ri khlaw ïa ka ri . U Trai Nongshun u la kriah .
translation.en: And I will make the land desolate , because they have committed a trespass , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka paw ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abram da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wiat na ka jingem jop . ”
translation.en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”

translation.kha: Ki kyntait ban wan phai sha nga , bad kumta ki dei ban leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Assyria kin synshar halor jong ki .
translation.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .

translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u long kiba ngap da ka jingjanai mala umbah jemnud . Un pynlong ïa ka step baphyrnai jong ka jingpynim ban miaw ha ngi
translation.en: Through the tender mercy of our God  ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,
He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïoh spah da kaba kheiñ sut bad shim kabu ïa ki briew , ka spah jong phi kan leit sha uwei pat uba lehsbun ïa kiba duk .
bad ki ïakhun shynrang jong u kin ai noh pat ïa kaei kaba u la tuh na babha dukan .
translation.en: His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , bad u kpa jong u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tipthuh kumno ban thaw ïa kiei kiei na ka ksiar , ka shoh , ka rnong , ka nar , u mawthew bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei pynlang ki jaiñ kiba jngum , sngewthuh , bad kiba rong saw , bad ka linen . U lai pun thir ïa bun jait ki jingdih bun u lah ba-bang bud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ Susah kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jngai phira kiba tbit bad kito kiba la trei na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpu jong phi .
translation.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .
All who put their faith in Jesus can have their sins forgiven and receive everlasting life .—1 Timothy 2 :5 , 6  ; John 3 :16  ; Romans 5 :18 , 19 .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba don jingngeit ha u Jisu kin ïoh map na ki pop bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :18 , 19 .
Nangta na la ai ha ki ïa ki aïu ki bym longïing kiba bha , bad ïa ki hukum ki bym lah ban wanrah jingim .
translation.en: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good , and judgments whereby they should not live  ;

translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , dara ym don jingkut ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki . Ka ri jongnga ki ka dap da ki kulai , bad ym ne jingkut ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .
translation.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka nongbah sha u Ahab u shem ka Israel dara ong ,
translation.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city , and said unto him , Thus saith Ben–hadad ,

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka dak ka sah kohnguh , pynlang kam shym pun satia , Hynrei ka stang ha ka rudnong , Kata kam dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid , namar ka dei tang ka shongkai na kata ka dak ing ding .
translation.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark  ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .

translation.kha: bad kumta u la kylli ïa U Trai kaei ba un leh . Hynrei U Trai um smam jubab ei ei ïa u , la ha ki jingphohsniew , lano da u Urim bad u Thummim , lane da ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when Saul enquired of the  Lord  , the  Lord  answered him not , neither by dreams , nor by Urim , nor by prophets .

translation.kha: U Boas u kylli ïa u briew uba pynïaidkam , Katai ka theisamla ka dei mano ?
translation.en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this ?

translation.kha: Naba u Petros u la jubab . Ko Trai , lada dei shisha ma me , hukum ïa nga ban woh sha me halor ka um .
translation.en: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .

translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka khait Lebi , ban ïatreilang bad ïarap ïa me katba me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .

translation.kha: U Trai u don ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba Shong ha ka ri . To sngap , ko Israel , ïa kaei kob u ong : Ym don jingïaineh ne ka jingieit ha ka ri , Bad ki briew kim jingpdiang ïa nga kum U Blei .
translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye children of Israel : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land , because there is no truth , nor mercy , nor knowledge of God in the land .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jrong ka Israel , at don ban ong . len pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa ka jingkem bad ka jingshitrhem bad ki jingsawa bakmen jong ki jingïarwai shongkurim . Ki briew hangno kin im banbeiñ ïohi ba kane ka jia .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,
translation.kha: Don ka Arab , ka Dumah , ka Eshan ,
Ki la skum ïa ka , ki ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem , pynlang hangta ha ka khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .
translation.en: So they laid hands on her  ; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king s house , they slew her there .
And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
translation.kha: Bad to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong nga ba U Blei un ai ha nga ïa ka khubor haba nga la kloi ban kren , khnang ba nga lah ban kren shlur bad pynpaw shai ïa ka jingmaïan ka gospel .

translation.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang jong ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew ngut baroh , bad u Petros u la ïeng ban kren .

translation.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
translation.kha: Ngan long shlur bad ngan kren tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil ban kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktien bad ki kam ,
Kin sa tip ba nga long U Trei , bad ki jingmaham jong nga kim shym long ki jingbyrngem lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .

translation.kha: Lada ka kada ne ka masi u para Ishmael ka kyllon , wat shu ieh ïa ka kumto ; ïarap ïa u ngab pynjngai pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ass or his ox fall down by the way , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again .

translation.kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nongshna ïa phi , ba phin leh kumba nga la leh ma nga ïa phi .
translation.en: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym kren shaphang kata hano hano ruh ; hynrei katba u nang hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh , katta ki nang ïathuh .

Shispah ngut ki Lebi ki shimti ban trei shapoh jong ki : u Eliel , Asasaïah , Nahath , Asahel , Jerimoth , Josabad , Eliel , Ismakhaïah , Maham , bad u Benaïah . La leh ïa kane baroh hapoh ka bor jong u syiem Hesekaïah bad u Ahasaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translation.en: And Jehiel , and Azaziah , and Nahath , and Asahel , and Jerimoth , and Jozabad , and Eliel , and Ismachiah , and Mahath , and Benaiah , were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother , at the commandment of Hezekiah the king , and Azariah the ruler of the house of God .

translation.kha: U syiad Dabid u pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingmane , ryngkat bad ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew naba u la jop — ki Edom , ki Joab , ki Amam , ki phylla bad ki Eliakim .
translation.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the  Lord  , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations  ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan nabar rung sha kata ka ri ba U tharai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , pynngat katno katne tylli ki miej bakha heh , ñiad astor ïa ki ,
translation.en: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , that thou shalt set thee up great stones , and plaster them with plaster :

translation.kha: Phi dei ban ïabam kyrkieh ïa ka , namar phi dei ban riam na ka pyntwa ban kitei jingleit , lem bad ki juti ha ki jat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka ktha jongki phin . Ka dei ka Jingkhawai Maim Ka Jinglait ngab pyndonburom ïa la , U Trai .
translation.en: And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .
I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka pyrthei ,
Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym neh mynsiem nongmareh at Shahasumah na ka bynta jong phin ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong pa barieh .
translation.en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah sner , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .
translation.kha: Nga pynrem ïa ki namar ka rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , bad nga la pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ki ri nongwei .
Mynba u dat ha ka pyrthat , u Jisu u la pynkdang ïa kiba tnga , pynkhiah ïa kiba pang bad pynmih ïa kiba la ïap !
translation.en: While on earth , Jesus fed the hungry , healed the sick , and restored life to the dead !

translation.kha: Ym skhem hadien Kata , u Ahithophel u ong ha u Asahel , Shah ngan jied khat-ar hajuh ngut ki rangbah , bad ha kane ka miet ngan mih ban leit thwet ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Let me now choose out twelve thousand men , and I will arise and pursue after David this night :

translation.kha: U paralok lad de uba ba-don ha ka jingleit u la dang shu wan poi ha ka ïing jong nga , dara ngam shym don jingbam ei ei na ka bna jong u !’
translation.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me , and I have nothing to set before him ?
Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka Wah Ïuphratis bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngkot hapoh ka thliew ha ki mawsiang .

translation.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .
translation.kha: Kum ka um na ka jaka den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Ninebeh !  Sangeh ! Sangeh !  ka jingpyrta ka sawa — hynrei ym don mano mano ba phai dien .

translation.en: And the incense altar , and his staves , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan thang jingiwbih bad ki jingbah ïa ka ; ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ; ïa ka jingiwbih ; ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ;

translation.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :
translation.kha: Wat pynleit jingmut ha kaei kaei baroh kaba ki briew ki ong — phi lah ban ïohsngew ba u shakri jong phi u ibeiñ ïa phi ,
Nga thok sha phi , ko ki Kynhun jongno to , namar ïa ki pop jong phi la map na ka bynta U Khrist .
translation.en: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name s sake .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki longïing jongnga ka kdew Kohath ki ïohi katto katno ki nongbah na ka iaki jong ki Ephai .
translation.en: And the families of the children of Kohath , the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath , even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim .

And as soon as the commandment came abroad , the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn , wine , and oil , and honey , and of all the increase of the field  ; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly .
translation.kha: Tang mar ïa-ai hukum , ki paid Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki , kiba kynsai tam na u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ka ngap , bad kiwei de ki jingmih na ka lyngkha , bad ki wanrah ruh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong kiei kiei kiba ki don .

translation.en: Then were the king s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month , and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king s lieutenants , and to the governors that were over every province , and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language  ; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king s ring .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la khot ïa ki sekretari jong u syiem bad u la pule ha ki ba kin bud ïa ka jingpynbna bad ong ïa ki ban pynkylla ktien sha baroh ki jait ktien bad rukom thoh ba la pyndonkam ha ka hima bad ban phah sha baroh ki nongsynshar , ki lat bad rangbah synshar . La pynmih ha ka kyrteng jong u syiem Serksis bad shon muhor da ka sati jong u .
U Trai u ong , Ngan pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ka lup ki jingpra , ka jaka ha kaba ki myrsiang ki shong ; ki nongbah ka Judah kin kylla ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong ba sah .
translation.en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps , and a den of dragons  ; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate , without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Dan ki jingdih san nguh ki rangbah kiba tbit na baroh ki longïing ha ka joit bad ki phah ïa ki na ki shnong Soh bad Eshtaol ryngkat bad ki jingbthah ba kin leit syntiat ïa ka ri . Irad ki poi ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Mikah .
translation.en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba atiar ïa ka ieid jong me lane u bymkohnguh ïa kano Kana na ki hukum jong me un shah pynïap . To long naba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem .
translation.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him , he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected , and is nigh unto cursing  ; whose end is to be burned .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka pynmih ïa ki shiah bad ïa ki ñiut , kam dondor ei ei ; ka don ha ka , ka jingma naba U Blei un tim bad pynjot da ka ding .

translation.en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to slay Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and dwelt in the land of Midian : and he sat down by a well .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharaoh u ïohsngew ïa kata , u pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u Moses ; hynrei u Moses u la phet ïap , bad u leit shong noh ha ri Midian .
Ki Song , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh malade ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;
translation.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;

translation.kha: Ngi pang ha ka ïaduna jong ngi hi bad ngim lah ban ïohi bha lyngba ki ummat lad ngi ,
translation.en: For this our heart is faint  ; for these things our eyes are dim .

translation.kha: Naba U Trai u la ong ha u mawshun , Mynta men sa ïuh aïu ngan bor ïa u Pharaoh . Ngan pynbor ïa u ban shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit . Ha ka jingshisha , len pynbor ïa u ban biah noh ïa ki na ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .

translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat jong ki Baïap , kim shym la lah shun khem rupa ïa u ha kano kano , kumto ki la sngapjar jar , ki da lyngngoh ha ka jingjubab jong u .
translation.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .

translation.kha: Na ka pyntwa kane ka jingrem nga phah ha phi ïa u tikmie , uba long u khur ba-ibieit bad batynrai jong nga ha ka jingim kum uba bieit . Un pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ki nongring kiba nga bujli ha ka jingim kaba thymmai ha U Khrist Jisu bad kaweh nga hikai ha ki balang baroh kiba don kylleng .
translation.en: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy , who is my beloved son , and faithful in the Lord , who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ , as I teach every where in every church .
For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and shall be joined unto his wife , and they two shall be one flesh .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Namar kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïalong kawei bad la ka tnga , bad ki ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .
Kaba ïoh ïa ka jingstad ka long kawei kaei kabu donkam tam ba Phi dei ban lai . Nalor kaei kaei baroh kaweh phi ïoh , to ïor ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha u syiem ,  Ki jingphohsniew baroh ar tylli ki mut ïa kajuh . U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba un sa leh .
Haba ki briew jong me kyang kylli kaei kane ka jingmut ,
translation.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee , saying , Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these ?

translation.kha: Kim shym la ïai ha nga nud la ka dohnud , hynriew pynpdang ki bret ïa laiñ ha madan bad ïalam pynrngad kumba leh kiba mane blei thala . ibha ki duwai ban ïoh ïa u kew bad ka waiñ , ki ot pynsum ïa lade kum babha mane blei thalab . A khah kato ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah !
translation.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart , when they howled upon their beds : they assemble themselves for corn and wine , and they rebel against me .

translation.kha: u ino ha ki , Ïalam bad phi ïa ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar jong nga ; pynshong ïa u Solomon , u khun jyllang nga halor u khashor jong nga , bad synran ïa u shathie sha ka Mluh Gihon ,
translation.en: The king also said unto them , Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule , and bring him down to Gihon :
And the east border was the salt sea , even unto the end of Jordan . And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan :
translation.kha: Ka pud kaba shaphang mihngi ka dei ka Duriaw Baïap , artet haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka Jordan ka tuid sha ka . Ka pud kaba shaphang shatei ka sdang nangta ,

Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron , Kane ka longsyiem kaei kaba U Troas u la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u ong , ‘ Baroh kiba shakri ïa nga ki dei Ban burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong la ha la ki briew’ .’ hynne u Haron u shu sngap lade .
translation.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
The  Lord  bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pyndiaw ïa ki jingthmu ki jaitbynriew ; um shah ïa ki ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong ki .
Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki khun synrap shynrang .
translation.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .

translation.kha: Jehoaddin ba U Jisu u la lah Ong ïa kane ka jingduwai , u la mihnoh bad la ki synran Bad kitei sha shiliang ka wahduid ba la khiat ka Kidron . Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu! bad la ki synran ki la rung shapoh .
translation.en: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , bad haba kan sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot ktung ïa u , u bamaïan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .
translation.kha: To ïam bad to ud , ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki Kedar ki la kyllon ; ïa kito ki dieng badonburom la pynjot ! To ïam bad to ud , ko ki dieng Sning jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaw kaba rben la khet noh !

Nga la ong ïa ki ba bathoiñ ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba por la ong .
translation.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .

translation.kha: namar men ym ino ïa na ha ka pyllait kiba ïap ; men ym shah ïa u shakri baïaineh jong me ban phut hapoh ka jingtep .
translation.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .

translation.kha: U Ahas u Long syiem haba u la dap arphew snem ka rta , mala u synran pynkhihwin snem ha Jerusalem . Um shym la bud ïa ka nuksa babha jong u kpa bymman jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban u la ni ïa kai ka bym pynsngewbha ïa U Trai bad u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem Jeriel .
translation.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem : but he did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , like David his father :
And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .
translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ïohi . Nga la jubab ,  Ka kot kli baher ha ka lyer ; ka don khyndai mitar ka lynter bad saw mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .
Haba u Petros u la leit shaei Jerusalem , kito kiba ïashah ba dei ban otsher ïa ki Jentil ki la wohnia ïa u , da kaba ong ,
translation.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,
Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins    jong ka Asia ki la don hangta ; ki hi ki dei ban wan ha khmat jong me bad buh ïa ki jingmudui jong ki lada ki don ei ei pyrshah ïa nga .
Ha man ba riew ka turoi ki pah sngewshyrkhei ; ki lah ban iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poi hajuh , bad ki sngur ïa ka sur hukum jongu ki rangbah shaei .
translation.en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ha u bad ha u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ïa ka sap ban hikai ïa ki buit treikam ha kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he , and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa baroh’ kaba u Don , bad u la shim ïa ka jingrang u shakri . U kylla long u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .
translation.en: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :

translation.kha: Kin treh ïa ka kam kat kaba jingdonkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga nabar kin pyndep ïa ki ruma na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ka kynhun baroh khawai .
translation.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue , and put thereon the dishes , and the spoons , and the bowls , and covers to cover withal : and the continual bread shall be thereon :

translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u kñia ïa uto u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia Naamah ka pop na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka longïing jong u ,
translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :

translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ngut ki nongtei kin wan sha uwei u Jiw bad ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ban ïoh pynbha ha ka lawei jong phi , namar ngi la lah iohnong ba U Blei u don malu phi .’
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations , even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew , saying , We will go with you : for we have heard that God is with you .
And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh ki la sdang , uwei hadien uwei pat , ban ai daw . Uba nyngkong u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha bad nga dei ban leit bad khmih ïa ka ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’
Kumta wat sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U thri U Blei jong phi u don shlip dara phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .

translation.kha: U Joash u phah khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad u sah ïa ki ban kynshew ïa ki pisa ba siew ha naba ïadei bad ki jingkñia ha ka Thep , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingsiew ba dei na ka bynta ki jingkñia ba ju leh bad ka pisa ba ai kum ki jingtieng sngewbha .
translation.en: And Jehoash said to the priests , All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the  Lord  , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at , and all the money that cometh into any man s heart to bring into the house of the  Lord  ,

translation.kha: Nangne ki la ïalap ïa ka kti U Trai ha u bad ha baroh Kiwei pat katba ha ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .

translation.kha: Uta u bhabriew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ , un khi lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah ban wan rung sha ka jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shong shabar ka ïingjaiñ jong u Hynñiew sner lynti .
translation.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .
Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh sha ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ïa-im ha ka jingsuk . Bad U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .
Me mut me dei uei ? Me don hok aïu ban shna ka jingtep ïa lade ha ka sharing mawsiang ?
translation.en: What hast thou here ? and whom hast thou here , that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here , as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high , and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock ?

translation.kha: ym tang bad ki kpa jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi baroh mad ibha dang im haduh mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba U Trai u long uba khraw , kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For I know that the  Lord  is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .

translation.kha: U Asa u ïadie ha U Trai U Blei jong u , A Trai , me lah Ban ïarap ïa ka kynha shipai kaba tlot da kaba sut kum kaba khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi mandriek , Ko Trai U Blei jong i'u , namar ba ngi shaniah ha me , bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la mih ban ïaleh pyrda ïa kane ka kynhied shipai kaba bun . A Trai , me longkmie U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban jop ïa me .
translation.en: And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .

And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write  ; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God , and the seven stars  ; I know thy works , that thou hast a name that thou livest , and art dead .
translation.kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Sardis :  Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba don ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei bad ki hynñiew ki khlur . Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha leh ; nga tip ba pha don ka nam babha ba pha long kaba im , wat la pha la ïap !

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joram , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoram u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .
translation.kha: Nga tip ,  ka la jubab ,  ba un sa mihpat ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
U Saul u lumlang ïa ki kynoi shipai jong u bad u peit bniah ïa ki ha Telem : la don ar lakh ngut ki shipai na Jerusalem bad shiphew hajar lwet na Judah .
translation.en: And Saul gathered the people together , and numbered them in Telaim , two hundred thousand footmen , and ten thousand men of Judah .
And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u Boas u hukum ïa ki nongtrei ,  Shah ïa ka ban tam wat na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katto katne ki kew na ki song bad ieh ïa ki ba kan ïoh tam .

translation.en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places : how are the mighty fallen !
translation.kha: Halor ki lum ka Israel ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ïap ! Kiba shlur tam na ki shipai jong ngi , ki la kyllon !
Kumta phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad kiba kum kita ki bynriew .
translation.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them .
And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïa-ban kham jur shuh shuh ,  Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki briew ha baroh kylleng ka Judia . U la sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi hangne .
Bad kane ka dei ka jingmut jong ka : Ka dak jingkheiñ , U Blei u la kheiñ ïa ki sngew jong ka hima jongno phi! bad u la wallam ïa ka sha ka jingidiaw ;
translation.en: This is the interpretation of the thing : MENE  ; God hath numbered thy kingdom , and finished it .

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki lapbah ngin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shait .
translation.en: Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
And Rephah was his son , also Resheph , and Telah his son , and Tahan his son ,
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don ruh uwei u khun uba kyrteng u Rephah , uba ki khun ki ksiew jong u ki long kumne harum : u Resheph , u Telah , u Tahan ,
Haba ki nong Ieit kin ïohi ïa pha , kin tharai ba pha dei ka tnga jong nga , bad kumta kin pynïap ïa nga bad shah ïa phah , ban im .
translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , when the Egyptians shall see thee , that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me , but they will save thee alive .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah syier ki buh ïa ka kot kli ha ka kamra u Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki leit sha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , bad ki la ïathuh ïa baroh ki kiei ha u syiem .
translation.en: And they went in to the king into the court , but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe , and told all the words in the ears of the king .
Stand therefore , having your loins girt about with truth , and having on the breastplate of righteousness ;
translation.kha: Kumta to ïeng ba la pynkhreh , da ka jingshisha kum u panpoh ba la pyndait ha ka syngkai jong phi , da ka hok kum ka jingda shadem jong phi ,

To ïashukor ïa ki jingud jong nga ; ym don mano mano ban pyntngen ïa to . Ki nongshun jong nga ki kmen ba me la ïalam ka jingjot halor jongngi la . To wallam ïa ka sngi kaba me la kular ; to pynlong ïa ki nongshun lad nga ban shahshitom kumta ma por .
translation.en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .

And Reuben said unto them , Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him  ; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .
translation.kha: Shu bret ïa u ha kane ka pukri hangne ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei wat pynmynsaw ïa u .  U ong kumta namar ba u mut ban pyllait im ïa u na ki , bad ban phah pat ïa u sha la u kpa .
Na la thaw ïa u nongshoh-nar , uba pyrsad ïa ka ding bad shna ïa ki thiaw tdam . Nga la thaw ruh ïa u shipai , uba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ïapom ban pynpoh .
translation.en: Behold , I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire , and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work  ; and I have created the waster to destroy .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban da thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat , ba kin ym ïap . Kenan ka long ka hukum kaba ma ki bad ki khulom ki ksiew jong ki , ki dei ban bud jingkhum la julam .
translation.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city :
translation.kha: Lada ka la pur , un hukum ba dei ban weng noh ïa ki maw ha kiba la bit bthuh bad bret noh ïa ki sha ka jaka theh ñiut shabar shnong .

translation.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
( Ha kajuh ka por , u syiem ka Eden u ïoh pat ïa ka nongbah Elath , bad u beh krai ïa ki nong Judia kiba sah hangta . Ki nong Edom ki shongsah ha Elath , bad ki tdong law hi hangta . )
translation.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria , and drave the Jews from Elath : and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day .

translation.kha: Kumta to iehnoh ïa u briew barim jong phiah , uba pynlong ïa phi ban im kumba phi la ju im — u briew uba rim uba la nang pynjot da ki jingkwah brai bashukor jong ka .
translation.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man , which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts ;

translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab , Nga la shemphang , namarba nga pyrkhat ïoh phin lngaid jubor ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .
translation.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .
By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted : but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka khraw haba kiba hok ki kyrkhu ïa ka ; hynrei ka nongbah ka jot noh da ki ktien jong ki bymman .

Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tylli ki mynsiem ki leit nep sha ki Syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa ki na ka bynta ka thlim ha ka Sngi kaba khraw jong U Blei’ Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .

translation.kha: A ki long kaba la dem ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ïeng pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa ki yn pynbud nep . Nga la kwah ban pyllait im ïa ki , hynrei ka jingumsnam Jong ki ïa sa ka long kaba thyllah .
translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .

translation.kha: Hobah ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong me , u Hophni bad u Hananaïah kin ïap ha kajuh ka sngi , kane kan pyn-i ïa me ba baroh kaba nga la klun kan urlong .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , that shall come upon thy two sons , on Hophni and Phinehas  ; in one day they shall die both of them .

translation.kha: Kine baroh ar — ka kynrad bad une u maw pynsah jingkynmaw ki long ki jingpynkynmaw . Ngan ym jem palat ïa kane ka kynton ban ïaheh pyrshah ïa me , bad me pajut men ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton bad ïa une u maw pynsah kynmaw ban ïaleh marpyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee , and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me , for harm .

translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki Ki jong ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor dat ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kñia ka jingngeit ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa uwei pa uwei baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh uba na ka jai Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki la ïapynlong kiba ïanguh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .

Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men , whom he had slain because of Gedaliah , was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain .
translation.kha: Ka pukri ha kaba u Ishmael u la bret ïa ki metïap jong kita ki rangbah kiba u la pynïap ka long kaba heh bha kaba u syiem Asa u la tih mynba u la shah tur ïaleh ha u Baasha , u syiem ka Israel . U Ishmael u la pyndap ïa kata ka pukri da ki metïap .

translation.en: And he shall pass through Judah  ; he shall overflow and go over , he shall reach even to the neck  ; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land , O Immanuel .
translation.kha: Kin sar lyngba ka Judah ha ka jingshlei um , da kaba kiew haduh tyrpeng bad tap lin ïa kaei kaei baroh .  U Blei u long lem bad ngi ! Ki thapniang jong u ba la pyiar shabar ki ïada ïa ka ri .

Hynrei lada la tip ba uto u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah tun , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u , u dei ban uba da kaba ai ïa uta uwei pat da u masi kyrtong uba im , bad un ïoh ma u ïa uta kiba ïap .
translation.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in  ; he shall surely pay ox for ox  ; and the dead shall be his own .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah hynñiew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit sha Baal Perasim bad hangta u la jop ïa ki Philistia . U ong , U Trai u la sar pangnud lin ïa ki nongshun jngai nga koum ka jinglehisynei um . Bad kumne ïa kata ka jaka la khot Baal Perasim .
translation.en: And David came to Baal–perazim , and David smote them there , and said , The  Lord  hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me , as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim .
And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kumta u kyrkhu ïa ki ha kata ka sngi , u da ong ,  Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa ki kyrteng jong phi haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’   Da kumta u la buh ïa u Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .
U Trai u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhyllem jong phi bad u la bitar lep , bad kumta da kaba sngewkhia u ong ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of your words , and was wroth , and sware , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khoit sngewbha ïa la u paramarjan ban wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingsngew , ba la ker sawdong da ki byrni sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .

translation.kha: Ngam sheptieng , ngan ïan kren beit namar nga tip ïa la ka dohnud .
translation.en: Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .

translation.kha: Kum ka dak ka jingsngewdiaw , teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad ding ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .
Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u hukum ïa ki nongïalam

translation.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death  ; and found none .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban wad ki sakhi pyrshah ïa U Jisu khnang ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem kano kano ruh .

Lada uno uno u briew u ñiah prum , lin u mih tohjaw , litar u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka lah baneh kylla shwa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , dien ïa-ban leit ïalamwir ïa u ha lyngdoh uba na ka longïing jong u Aaron .
translation.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :
And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .
translation.kha: Bunsien u mynsiem bymkhuid u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u da ka bret ïa u ha ka ding bad ha ka um . To isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada me lah !

translation.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Caesarea  ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la sah sa phra ne shiphew sngi lem bad ki bad nangta u la leit sha Kaisaria . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la shong ha ka kamra bishar bad u la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa u Paul .

Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki bhabriew jong ka Ïuodia bad ka Jerusalem ba nga sleit ki jingthmu bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki bad nga khrew ban pynkhamti ïa ki . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh ban im ka jingim ba-beit da ka pop — ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki bad ïa kiei kiei bakha ki leh .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .

translation.kha: Nga kynti ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynïan ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ban sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kai , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingtngen ban sharak .
translation.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;

translation.kha: Khie saw shiah ki dkhot jngai ka kur Rephaïah bad ïakren bad ki . Hangta wallam ïa ki sha kawei na ki klass ha ka Templ bad tyrwa wat ïa ki khathynñiew .
translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .

translation.kha: Hangne ki don shuh ki proberb u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki briew ha ka ïingbishar u Hesekaïah u symboh Judah .
translation.en: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïashah shongkha bad ïano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .
translation.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga kwah shun ïadih ïa phi ha ka jinglanot lyndang artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , hadien ba nga la sngewhun ban sah shipor ha ka jingweng khmih ïa Phin .
translation.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .

translation.kha: Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki la wan sha u ha ka Templ , bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple  ; and he healed them .

translation.kha: Ki tih shaduh ki Shillong jong ki bhah , bad ki wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh .
translation.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
Commanding his accusers to come unto thee : by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things , whereof we accuse him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lusias u la ai hukum ba ki nongmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul kin wan ha khmat jong me . Lada me kylli ïa une u briew , me hi me lah ban tip na u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi mudui ïa u .

translation.en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
translation.kha: Kim dondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .
U Saul um sngewtynnat ïa kan , pynlang u bitar lep . U ong , Ïa u Dabid ki ai nam da ki phew hajar , hynrei ïa nga pat tang da ki hajar . Kin sa pynlong syiem ïa u hadien nangne !
translation.en: And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka Jerusalem ka long ba la tim ! Ka Judah ka dang khyllem ! Kano katno kaba ki kren lane ki leh ka longïng pynshisha ïa U Trai ; ki ibeiñ khlem buhrieh ïa U Blei hi .
translation.en: For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen : because their tongue and their doings are against the  Lord  , to provoke the eyes of his glory .
But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: hynrei uno uno ïa uba la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
Kane ka long mynta ka leit kaba sa ba to wan jngoh ïa phi . Kiba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ïa kano kano ka jingmudui dei ban pynsdien da ka jingpynshisha da ki ar ngut ki sakhi ne tam ïa kata .
translation.en: This is the third time I am coming to you . In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la tliew ïa ka jingijli hapdeng kita ki ar tylli ki khyrdop nabar ka long sanphew milimitar .
translation.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without , an hundred cubits eastward and northward .

translation.kha: U pynrangbah shaei u la ïohi ïa kaei ka la jia , Bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong , Da shisha u la longkmie u briew uba bha !
translation.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man .

translation.kha: U syiem Anab u la jubab , Ïathuh ïa u syiem Benhadad ba u shipai bashisha u kob hadien jong ka thma , ym ha shuki jong ka .
translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off .
And it came to pass that night , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Nathan , saying ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u ong ha u Nathan ,

Ngan phah ïa ki nongrwai don pynjot ïa ka Babilonia koum ka lyer kaba pynher ei ïa u phlangïap . haba kata ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka wan , ktang tur ïabeh na baroh sawdong bad kin ieh syllen ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .

Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .
Pi rupa sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .
translation.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ki ut jongngi ki dara ïa baroh ki jingri jong ki ! lang pynsakma sha ki liang baroh ba kito ki briew katba la khak lyngkot ïa la ki shñiuh , bad ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ki na ki liang bhor .
translation.en: And their camels shall be a booty , and the multitude of their cattle a spoil : and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners  ; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ynda ki jingriewblei ki ïalumlang , ngan pyndih ïa me ha ka jar jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka pan sha ryngkew .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .
And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga ; ka la sdang kynjat shai .   Em , ngan ym pyllait , lymda me kyrkhu ïa nga ,  ong u Jakob .

translation.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins , exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads , all of them princes to look to , after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea , the land of their nativity :
translation.kha: Ka nang ngam nang ngam ha ka jinglong bajakhlia jong ka . Ka ïapmat ïa ki durbriew jong ki rangbah shipai ka Babilonia ba la ohdur ha ka kynroh bad ba la airong da ka rong saw baphyrnai , lem bad ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki bad ki jaiñspong ba-itynnat ha ki khlieh jong ki .
U ryndang ha bank da kaba riam kum u nongap .
translation.en: He entered the bank disguised as a guard .

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Balei phi thik ? khie joit bad duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translation.en: And said unto them ,  Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .

translation.kha: Kan biang tang uwei u suki ban rai pynrem ïa u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka kam palat ; la kumno Kamon , ar ngut ki sakhi ki dei ïa-ban pynmeng ba u briew u leh kam sniew .
translation.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin , in any sin that he sinneth : at the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall the matter be established .
And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un mih , u la khot ïa ki shiphew ngut ki shakri jong u bad u la ai ha ki kawei kawei ka sbai ksiar bad u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Khmih aïu phi lah ban kamai da kane katba nga dang leit jingleit .’
U Abraham u la ïatip ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew synran snoh ka rta .
translation.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .

translation.kha: Haba ka Leah ka sngewthuh ba ka la woh ban ïoh khun , ka la ai ïa ka mraw jong ka , ka Sheleph ha u Jakob kum ka tnga jong u .
translation.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing , she took Zilpah her maid , and gave her Jacob to wife .

translation.kha: “Wat leit jngoh Bunni eh ïa u pawnam jong phi , u lah ban sngewngiah ïa phi bad isih pynbna ïa phi! .
translation.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour s house  ; lest he be weary of thee , and so hate thee .
And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully : over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler , and Shimei his brother was the next .
translation.kha: bad ki buh ïa ki jingai baroh bad kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hangta ban shngain . Ki thung ïa u Lebi uba kyrteng u Konanaïah ban peit bad ki pynlong ïa u para jong u , u Shimei kum u nongïarap lem jong u .
Ha kawei ka por phi la long jngai eh na U Blei bad phi la un-long ki nongshun jong u namarba jong ki kai kiba sniew kiba phi la leh bad pyrkhat .
translation.en: And you , that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works , yet now hath he reconciled
Should it be according to thy mind ? he will recompense it , whether thou refuse , or whether thou choose  ; and not I : therefore speak what thou knowest .
translation.kha: Te naba me pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u leh , hato me khmih lynti ïa u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ? Ka rai ka long ka jong me , kam dei ka jong nga ; ïathuh ïa ngi mynta kaei kaba me pyrkhat .
Nangno u Hiram u phar ïa Kanah ka khubor harum sha u Salmone : ?(Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong me , bad por kloi ban leh ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynban ïa ki dieng Kedar dara ki dieng Kseh .
translation.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .

translation.kha: Hangta ngi la shem katto katne thut ki parabangeit bad moi la Hukum bad ki sia taïew . Da ka bor jrong U Mynsiem ki la ïathuh ïa u Paul Ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .

And also I have withholden the rain from you , when there were yet three months to the harvest : and I caused it to rain upon one city , and caused it not to rain upon another city : one piece was rained upon , and the piece whereupon it rained not withered .
translation.kha: Nga la khang ïa u slap haba ki jingthung ki dang donkam eh ïa u . Nga la pynhap slap ha kawei ka nongbah , hynrei ym ha kawei pat . U slap u la hap ha kawei ka lyngkha hynrei kawei pat ka lyngkha ka la tyrkhong .

translation.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling , and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud eh jong ka sut    kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli ha rmiang jong ka jaiñ ka sut kaba ar .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai , phi ki jingshoh ba-im baroh ! To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord

translation.kha: Ka met jong u ka ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kane sa kylla pui pait .
translation.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka saiñ bathymmai dei ban thew ha ki lei snieh bathymmai !
translation.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbatai kaba la ai ha nga : U mradkhlaw uba saw u dei ka hima kaba seh ka ban don ha ka pynrieh malade kan long kaba pher na kiwei pat ki hima . Kan pynlwet ïa ka pyrthei baroh kadei dara kan kyrdem ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus he said , The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth , which shall be diverse from all kingdoms , and shall devour the whole earth , and shall tread it down , and break it in pieces .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kad ki lama kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban ïahap ai jingïohknieh ïa ka jingmih .
translation.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .

translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki katjuh
translation.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: Nangta la khie ka thma kaba shyrkhei , bad u Abner bad ki Israel ki la shispah ha ki rangïapom jong u Dabid .
translation.en: And there was a very sore battle that day  ; and Abner was beaten , and the men of Israel , before the servants of David .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynmiet , ‘ Wat pynïap briew ; ïa uno une uba leh kumta yn wallam sha ka jingbishar .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :

If thou sayest , Behold , we knew it not  ; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ba kam dei ka kam jong phi , hynrei U Blei u tip bad u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi . U ïai ap khmih ïa phi ; u tip . Un ainong ïa phi kat kum kaei kaba phi leh .

translation.en: And if ye will receive it , this is Elias , which was for to come .
translation.kha: bad lada phi mon ban ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ki , u Ïoannis u long u Elijah , uba ïa ka jingwan jong u la ïathuhlypa .

translation.en: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .
translation.kha: Lada phi ngeit , phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai .
Ai ha uno uno uba pan na phi ïa kano kano , malu haba uno uno u shim ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong phi , wat pan shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .
translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon u la pynlong u lat jong kata ka jaka . Kumta ki la leit noh sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin lait na ki nong Babilonia . Ha lynti , ki la sangeh ha Shimham , kaba hajan Bethlehem .
Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaweh synrai halor ki syiem jyllang ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .

translation.kha: Da kaba kynting sbiak , ki paid Israel ki ai ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki pyntha phlang ha ki Lebi , kumba U Trai u la hukum lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot len ïa baroh san nud ki syiem Philistia bad kylli ïa ki , Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka syndah ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel ? Leit rah ïa ka sha Gath , ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha kup , kawei paw ka nongbah ki phylla .
translation.en: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .

translation.kha: Mynta to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong na .
translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .

translation.kha: Uei eit uba wan na ka nongpang Bosrah ha Edom ? utai une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïadat ryngkat ha ka bor bad jingkhlaiñ ? U dei U Trai , uba donburom ban pyllait im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop jong u .
translation.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .
When on earth Jesus cured the sick , fed the hungry , and calmed storms .
translation.kha: Mynba u Jisu u don ha pyrthei u pynkoit ïa kiba pang , u pynkdang ïa kiba thngan bad u pynjaijai ïa ki eriong .

Ha ka sngi Sabakhthani ainguh ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka Mid bad ki bym don kano ïano ka jingduna lem malade ar kilo u pura ba la khlaiñ bad ka umphniang Olib kamon ka jingainguh bam , bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translation.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot , and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and the drink offering thereof :

translation.kha: Nangta U TRAI’ u la kren ha la .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kynhun shaei , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .

translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la Bah noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khamtam jong pa’ , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jong phi , yn ym don mano mano u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong Phi haba phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .

translation.kha: Phin ym sheptieng haba phi thiah , bad phin ïohthiah suk barhem shi die .
translation.en: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong , Te law hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad lashai ngan phah pat ïa phi . Kumta u Uriah u la sah ha Jeremaïah ha kata ka sngi badno ha ka sngi kabu bud .
translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashapoh jong u lieng pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kambah u phong .
translation.en: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?

translation.kha: Ong ïa ki , ‘ I pa jong nga i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingat kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita , i pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phoi da u shabuk !’
translation.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .

translation.kha: To rhah ha U Trai , bad to ïaroh ïa u ! Pynbna man ka sner ïa khubor ibha ba u la pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  , bless his name  ; shew forth his salvation from day to day .

translation.kha: Uno eit uba bameh ïa ka khlei jongngi u mrad ïa uba wanlam kum ka jingainguh bam Sha U Trai yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki bariew jongu U Blei .
translation.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast , of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people .

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban thoh lang ïa ki Pleïades , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba teh ïa u Orion ?
translation.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?
And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .
translation.kha: U Mikah u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno phi wan ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u Lebi na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih hangno ba ngan shong ngan sah .

translation.en: My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kum kiba ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Trai ka burom , phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki rukom kiba pher na kaei kaba ïohi ïa ki na shabar .
U Simon Petros u la jubab , Ko Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! To sait ruh ïa ki kti bad ïa ka khlieh jong la hati .
translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .

translation.kha: U khynnah u la nang san bad nang khraw ha ka met bad ka mynsiem . U la shong la sah ha ka ri shyiap tad haduh ka sngi ba u la paw paidbah ha ki paid Jeriel .
translation.en: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel .

And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh na kiba lait im na ki jaitbynriew kiba la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin leit shata man la ka snem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem bad ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

nga longïing u nongshoh-nar jong me dara u nongshun jong ka wah Nile jongnga me . Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt baroh kawei kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi , nguh ka nongbah Migdol ha ka phlang bashatei haduh ka nongbah Aswan ha ka phang bashathie , baroh shi lynter Haduh u pud ki Sudan .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I am against thee , and against thy rivers , and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate , from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .

translation.kha: Ïa ka bor malu ka burom U Trei yn ïohi naduh na sha jingïohi . Ka ding bad ka tdem ki pyndei ïa ka jingbit jong u . U kren , bad ki katei jong u ki meh kum ka ding .
translation.en: Behold , the name of the  Lord  cometh from far , burning with his anger , and the burden thereof is heavy : his lips are full of indignation , and his tongue as a devouring fire :

translation.kha: U Joseph u la nang ïathied noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang jong u mot Eder .
translation.en: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .

translation.kha: Ki keiñ ha kane ka kitab ki long iar uba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel mynba ki don ha ka ri khleiñ sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan . Ki ïadait ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suah , hapdeng ka shaneng Paran ha kawei ka liang malade ki shnong Tophel , Lehab , Haseroth , Bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .
translation.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .

translation.kha: Pi la pynduh ïa ki khlaw ka Lebanon ; mynta yn pyndkut ïa phi . Phi la pynïap ïa ki mrad ha ka ; mynta ki mrad kin pyntriem ïa phi . Kane kan jia Namar ki kam pynïap ba phi la leh bad namar ki kam leh jubor pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyut bad ki nongbah jongnga ka .
translation.en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee , and the spoil of beasts , which made them afraid , because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .
translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa phi kumba U Kpa u ieit ïa nga ; to ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .
