translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki wah , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pung-um , bad pynmih ïa ki jakoid ba kin pyndap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
U Jisu u la kiew halor kawei na ki lieng — kaba lama ka jongnga u Simran — bad u la kyrpad ïa u ngab khiat tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shong ha ka lieng bad u la hikai ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .

And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel , and said unto them , Why are ye come out to set your battle in array ? am not I a Philistine , and ye servants to Saul ? choose you a man for you , and let him come down to me .
translation.kha: U Goliath u ïeng bad u byrthen ïa ki Israel ,  Phi ïaleh aïu hangto , pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ? Nga , nga dei u Philistia , phi ki mraw u Saul ! Jied uwei na ki rangbah jong phi ban ïaleh bad nga .
Ka sngi kaba shyrkhei ka wan ; ym don ïano kano kawei pat ka sngi kaba lah ban nujor bun ka — ka nga ka jingmihnoh mynsiem na ka bynta ki bhabriew jong per , hynrei kin laitluid im .
translation.en: Alas ! for that day is great , so that none is like it : it is even the time of Jacob s trouble  ; but he shall be saved out of it .
But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .
translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ïa ki met ba kynja doh jong phi da ka jingdon U Mynsiem jong u hapoh jong phi .

Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai , buh ïa ka ha kata ka kali , bad thep ha kamai ka jingduk kaba ha syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka jingainguh namar ki pop jong phi . Pyllait ïa ka kali ha ka lynti jong ka bad ieh kan leit hi .
translation.en: And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kynthah na ka bynta u Haron u lyngdoh bad ïa ki kynhun shynrang jrong u .
translation.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .
Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Lasaros , uba sah ha Bethania , u la pang . Ka Bethania ka dei ka shnong ha kaba ka Mari bad ka Martha ka para jong ka , ki shong ki sah .

translation.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .
translation.kha: Ngan lum ïa kiba sah na ki briew jong nga na ki ri kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri . Kin ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun briew .

translation.en: And if he shall come in the second watch , or come in the third watch , and find them so , blessed are those servants .
translation.kha: A katno kin long kiba kmen lada u shem ïa ki ba ki long kiba kloi , wat haba un wan ha ka por shiteng synñia lane wat kham dier ruh !
Ka shispah baroh kaba U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka dei ka jong ine bad Jong ki khun jong ngi . To leh katba U Blei! u la bthah ïa phi .
translation.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .

translation.kha: Haba phi shong baibam bad u briew uba donburom , da buh jingmut ba u long uei .
translation.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee :

translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ka aiñ jong U Trai , U Blei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Jerusalem’ baneh leh pop .
translation.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa ka pop lada ngam shym la leh hapdeng jong ki ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don une uno uwei pat uba la ju leh ; kumba ka long , ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba to la bor , bad ki shrong ïa to bad ïa U Kpu jong nga .
translation.en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .

translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel naduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei haduh Beersheba kaba shaphang shathie , khmut ruh nadong ri Gilead kob shaphang mihngi , ki la ïawanlang . Ki ïalumlang kum kawei ka kynhun ha khmied U Trai ha Mispah .
translation.en: Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was gathered together as one man , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , with the land of Gilead , unto the  Lord  in Mizpah .
This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy , and scall ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki aiñ shaphang ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ;

translation.en: For finding fault with them , he saith , Behold , the days come , saith the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem jingduna bad ki briew jong u haba u ong ,  Ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , haba ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ruh .
Lada me kyntait biang ba-bang shah ïa ki ban ithuh ,
translation.en: For if thou refuse to let them go , and wilt hold them still ,

translation.kha: Ka sner ka mih lem bad ka jingshit kyr-ang malu ka thang ïa u jingthung ; u syntuid jong u , u hap noh , bad ka jingieit jongno u ka jah noh . Ha kajuh ka rukom ïa uba riewspah yn pynjot noh! katba u dang Don ha ka kdew jong u ba u ba-thurmur .
translation.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat , but it withereth the grass , and the flower thereof falleth , and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth : so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u sa shisien , sad lada kata ka prum ka la pur , un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid ; ka dem ka jinghap ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: And if the priest see that , behold , the scab spreadeth in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a leprosy .
And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house  ; and the man stood by me .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ïeng ha syndah jong nga hangta , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga shabar ka Templ bad ong :

translation.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la khie dang step phyrngab , u shim ïa uta u maw ïa uba u la syngkhlieh , bad u thung ïa u ban sah jingkynmaw . Nangta u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u ban pynkyntang ïa u sha U Blei .

translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , the prophets say unto them , Ye shall not see the sword , neither shall ye have famine  ; but I will give you assured peace in this place .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga tip ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa ki briew ba yn ym don ka thma kane ka jingïapthngan , namar me la kular , ki ong , ba kan don tang ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong ngi .
Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki lei jongki at , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong per , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka Tabbath — ki la kham Jedidah ban mane ïa ki balaitluid .
translation.en: Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .

translation.kha: kiba la sohkhram ïa ki kynthei Moab , ka Orpah bad ka Ruth . Kumba shiphew sneng hateng ,
translation.en: And they took them wives of the women of Moab  ; the name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other Ruth : and they dwelled there about ten years .

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hateng jong ngi , U Trai un pynneh ba ngin bat ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynpang ïa ki kamram jong ki sha me mala ïa la ki jingïakhih na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei Kim bit ban pyndih ïa ki thir kiba khuid ha ka Jaka Kyntang , lane ïa ka duwan . Lada ki leh kumta , ïa ki bad ïa me yn pynïap noh .
translation.en: And they shall keep thy charge , and the charge of all the tabernacle : only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar , that neither they , nor ye also , die .

translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki rangbah ha Israel ki ïalumlang na ka pyntha kawei ka jingthmu — ban tur ïaleh ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city , knit together as one man .

Now it came to pass , when Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai , and had utterly destroyed it  ; as he had done to Jericho and her king , so he had done to Ai and her king  ; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel , and were among them  ;
translation.kha: U Adonisedek , u syiem ka Jerusalem , u ïohsngew ba u Joshua u la kurup bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka Ai bad u la pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka , kumba u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa u syiem jong ka . U ïohsngew ruh ba ki nong Gibeon ki la ïasuk bad ki Israel bad ba ki shong hapdeng jong ki .

Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ba kin Bam . Ki la jubab , Baroh Kaba ngi don ki long san tylli ki kper bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hato phi kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad thied jingbam na ka bynta un u paidbah ?
translation.en: But he said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they said , We have no more but five loaves and two fishes  ; except we should go and buy meat for all this people .

translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ; ki la klet ïa baroh katba me la leh ; ki la kheit napoh ïa ki ïabam kiba me la leh . Ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki la ïaid u nongïalam ban ïam biang ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei me long U balui uba maphi ; me long uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingtieng , uba suki ban bitar . Ka jingisynei jong me ka long kabu khraw ; mem shitrhem iehnoh ïa ki .
translation.en: And refused to obey , neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them  ; but hardened their necks , and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage : but thou art a God ready to pardon , gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and forsookest them not .

translation.kha: Ka pop bad ka jinglehrain ki ïaid lang! . Pynjah noh ïa ka burom jong phi , bad phin ïoh ïa ka jingiashah krenbeiñ ha ka jaka jong ka .
translation.en: When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .

translation.kha: kamut ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Gasa , bad kan thang duh ïa ki khup jong ka .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof :

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïarwai jingrwai bad ki la leit noh shat u lum ki Olib .
translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad ki pynsleh syiem ïa u ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not : so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .
translation.kha: Kita ki nongleh myntor ki pyrshang ban pyndonkam ïa ki buit myntor jong ki ban pynmih mait , hynrei kim lah . Bad kat shaba leit don tang ki mait suda .

Ha kiwei bapaw ki nongbah ha kiba ki lyngdoh ki shang , la kyrshan jingïarap ha khie da kiwei ki Lehbha : u Jehoaddin , Miniamin , Jeshua , Shemaïah , Amaraïah , bad u Shekanaïah . Ki sam ryntih ïa ka jingbat sha ki Para Lebi kat kumno ki kamram jong ki , bad ym kat kum ki kur .
translation.en: And next him were Eden , and Miniamin , and Jeshua , and Shemaiah , Amariah , and Shecaniah , in the cities of the priests , in their set office , to give to their brethren by courses , as well to the great as to the small :

translation.kha: Dannah ba phi la pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu kum U Trai , to im ha u .
translation.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord , so walk ye in him :
For , behold , the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts , doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff , the whole stay of bread , and the whole stay of water ,
translation.kha: Mynta u Trai , U  Trai  Badonbor baroh un sa shim noh na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kaei kaei baroh bad ïa uwei pa uwei ba ki briew ki shaniah . Un shim noh ïa ka jingbam bad ka um jong ki ,
hynrei u mawshun u ïa-ong ha U Trai , Me la wallam ïa kine ki briew na Ijipt da ka bor jong me . Haba ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa kino ki briew ,
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , ( for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them  ; )

translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai ka Ijipt ki pyrta , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ki shet Jong phi nabar puta sha ka thma !
translation.en: Order ye the buckler and shield , and draw near to battle .

translation.kha: Ladan uno uno na phi u thmu ban tei ïa ka jaka ap phira , nyngkong u shong bad u kheiñ ïa ka jinglut , ban khem la u don bun ka pisa ban pyndep ïa ka kam .
translation.en: For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?

translation.kha: Wat ym shukor phi ïa lade hi , ym don ma mano suba ñiew baieit ïa U Blei . U briew un ot ïa kaei kaba u bet .
translation.en: Be not deceived ; God is not mocked : for whatsoever a man soweth , that shall he also reap .

translation.kha: Ka ong ha u , Lada phi la kutlad ha U Tlai , leh ïa nga kumba pa la kular ïa-ban leh , nia U Trai u la ai ha phi ba phin pynhiarkput ïa ki Ammon , ki nongshun jong pa’ .
translation.en: And she said unto him , My father , if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the  Lord  , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth  ; forasmuch as the  Lord  hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies , even of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kabu bhah tam ka jong nga , nangta , ban thaw ka lad na ka bynta lad phi ïa-ban kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei ha ki por baroh hadien ka jingïap jongnga nga .
translation.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno la buh rit ïa kita kiei kiei . Ki lyngdoh ki rung shapoh ka bynta kob ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ mano ka snoh ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ,
translation.en: Now when these things were thus ordained , the priests went always into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the service of God .
Therefore David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go and smite these Philistines ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go , and smite the Philistines , and save Keilah .
translation.kha: Kumta u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ?   Ho-oid  U  Trai  u jubab .  Tur ïaleh ïa ki bad pyllait im ïa ka Keilah .
ngan kynmaw ïa la ka kular ha phi bad ha ki mutdur baroh ba ka jingshlei um da lili lei ruh kan ym pynïong shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im bhor .
translation.en: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki Simran jong u , u la mihnoh na kata ka jakarieh bad u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong kiba hajan hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .

translation.kha: Wat klet lano lano ïa kine ki hukum ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And these words , which I command thee this day , shall be in thine heart :
Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei , hynrei kam pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un paw , ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .

translation.en: For their power is in their mouth , and in their tails : for their tails were like unto serpents , and had heads , and with them they do hurt .
translation.kha: Naba ka bor jong ki kulai ka don ha ki shyntur jong ki bad ruh ha ki tdong jong ki . Ki tdong jong ki , ki long kum ki bseiñ ba don ki khlieh , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynmynsaw ïa ki briew .
Wat ki nonglute kiba la shah sahnarphna bad u ki la ïakren beiñ ïa u ha khah ka rukom .
translation.en: The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .

translation.kha: U Uri u jubab , Ki rangbah Israel bad Judah ki don jngai ha ka thom , bad ka Syndong ka Jutang ka don bad ki ; u Jubab u rangbah nongai hukum ïa nga bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jrong u ki ïashad ha madan . kumne nga eh ngab shu leit sha ïing , ban ba-ima ban dih , bad ban thiah bad la ka tnum ? Ka long kaba kyntang ïa nga , nga smai ba ngan ym leh ïa kambah kum kata ka kam !
translation.en: And Uriah said unto David , The ark , and Israel , and Judah , abide in tents  ; and my lord Joab , and the servants of my lord , are encamped in the open fields  ; shall I then go into mine house , to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? as thou livest , and as thy soul liveth , I will not do this thing .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei sad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew ki jong U Blei hi .
translation.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngkhot ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ka jaka ha kiba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shyieng briew .
Balah kiei kiei kiba u Maaseïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sneng kaba to , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da shong nabar ki nonghikai jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ïa ki bad Kylli jingkylli .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga ong ïa Phi , te , ar ïong ïa baroh : To khmih bha !
translation.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .
And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta ki la ïawan sha u Petros .  Da shisha me long uwei na ki ,  ki la ong .  Nalor baroh , ka rukom kren jong me ka pynpaw ïa kata !
Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la Long kiba kham bit ban ïa kito Kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïap suki ha ka jingthngan , khlem Kano kano ka jingbam banbeiñ ri pyndam ïa ki .
translation.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .

translation.kha: Ki hynmen u Joseph te ki la bashngain ïa u , hynrei u kpa jong u , u ïai puson shaphang katai baroh .
translation.en: And his brethren envied him  ; but his father observed the saying .
If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .
translation.kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka la shun ïa nga nyngkong .

translation.en: I will smite them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ka jingïapthem bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki , hynrei ïa me ngan pynlong u kpa ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki !
Hynriew ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jong kata ka beit jong ka ri .
translation.en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . .  , hynrei uta uba leh ka mon jong u Blei u iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .
Naba uno uno uba kyntait ïa U ju u kyndit ruh ïa U Kpa ; uno ine uba pdang ïa U Khun u khong ïa U Kpa ruh .
translation.en: Whosoever denieth the Son , the same hath not the Father : ( but ) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .

translation.kha: Me la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki lyntait ïaid kiba ïalam sha ka jingim , bad ka jingdon ryngkat jong me kan pyndap ïa sa da ka jingkhem .’
translation.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life  ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .

translation.kha: Ha ki Ïwei badno ki Jentil kumjuh por la ai ka jingïam da ka jingsngewkhia ba ki dei ban phai sha U Blei na ki pop jong ki bad ban ngeit ha U Jingsuk uba U Troas jyllang ngi .
translation.en: Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .
I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with he goats .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki ban shah pynïap , kum ki khunblang , ki blang , bad ki langbrot shynrang . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
Ynda hajan nga pynshitom ïa ki briew namar ki pop jong ki bad pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , te kin sa tip ba nga longsem U Trai .
translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed .

translation.kha: Ïeng la ïoh katne katne ka jakarieh Lieng lehbha ngi la ïaid shaphrang shathie Jong ka dewlynnong kiba rit jong ka Kauda . Hangta da kaba eh , ngi la lah ban pynskhem ïa ka lieng rit .
translation.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :

translation.kha: U Troas u ong , Ki briew Jong ka Moab ki la ïa-ai imat pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynsum da shisha ïa ki . Kin shym burom ïa ki shyieng u syiem Amon da kaba tdong haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :

translation.kha: U Trai u ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba un da ïoh pynim lut ïa baroh .
translation.en: For indeed the hand of the  Lord  was against them , to destroy them from among the host , until they were consumed .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la kylli jingkylli ïa u , Me longsyiem u syiem jong ki Jiw ? U Jisu u la jubab , Kumjuh me ong hi .
translation.en: And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him ,  Thou sayest it .

translation.kha: NGA la ar ïa kane namar ba ki la lah kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aïu jong nga , ki la pynngeit ïa ka Sabbaton , malade miej ïa kyntu ki bleithaw babha ki kput tymmen jong ki , ki la shakri .
translation.en: Because they had not executed my judgments , but had despised my statutes , and had polluted my sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers  idols .
And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass , which the  Lord  shall lay upon him , it shall be with tabrets and harps : and in battles of shaking will he fight with it .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u shoh bad u ïai shoh ïa ki , ki briew jong u pat kin ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki ksing bad ki duitara . U Blei hi da lade un ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria .
Pynban , ki Israel kim shym beh noh ïa ki briew jong ka Jashar mala Mahlah ; ki ding shongsah ha Israel .
translation.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .

translation.kha: Naba bat ïa kine ki ar tylli ki dieng na tduh ha tduh ha ka kti jong me ba kin i kum uwei u diengthang .
translation.en: And join them one to another into one stick  ; and they shall become one in thine hand .

translation.kha: Ka bneng nabar ka pyut kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga Kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .

translation.kha: U syiem u phad shna pajut ka klet kaba heh . Shimei bynta jong ka la sap da ka bniat dor , malu ïa kaba Hukum jong ka la sop da ka kseh kaba nylla .
translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .

translation.kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wanrah bad ka la noh ar thylliej ki sbai tama , kiba shongdor kumba syang pisa .
translation.en: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .

translation.kha: ( Ha ka jingjyrsieh , U Jisu da lade um shym la pynbaptis ïano ïabna ; tang ki synran jong u ki la leh . )
translation.en: ( Though Jesus himself baptized not , but his disciples , )

translation.kha: “lada u briew u die ïa ka Ïing ha ka shongneh ba la ker kynroh , u don hok ban thied bapaw ïa ka hapoh shisnem naduh ka sngi ba u la die ïa ka .
translation.en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city , then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold  ; within a full year may he redeem it .

translation.kha: Ka pa kan poi haba phin kyang sha U Trai , hawei un ym jubab ïa phi . Un ym sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , naba phi la leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: Then shall they cry unto the  Lord  , but he will not hear them : he will even hide his face from them at that time , as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings .

translation.kha: U Ebron bad ki bhabriew jongnga u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Them Jehoaddin baroh shi miet ; ki jam ïa ka wah Judah , malade shadien ba ki la ïadih baroh shi step ha ka stait naba bud , ki la wan nang biang ha Mahanaim .
translation.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .

translation.kha: Ka jingïapthngan kan kyllon lada ym don ka jingïalam . Ha ka jingbun ki nongaibuit don ka sngewshngain .
translation.en: Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .

translation.kha: Hynrei un jaboh , Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ-jin ruh kumjuh . Wat pynhieng ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !
translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .

translation.kha: Ki la leit sha u Philip ( uba dei na Bethsaida kaba ha Galilaïa ) bad ki la ainong , Ko Tangba , ngi kwah ban Ïohi ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingshisha ka long ka thma , jingsniew , jingïapthngan , jingsngap ban kdew tang katto kattne .
translation.en: Today’s realities are war , crime , hunger , sickness , aging—to mention just a few .

translation.kha: Kin ki dat ki khat-ar ngut kiba u la jied : U Simon ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa u , u Peor ) ;
translation.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter  ;

And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :
translation.kha: Te nga la ong ïa ka kur Rekhab ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Phi la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong phi u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa baroh ki jingbthah jong u , bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: And they shall see his face  ; and his name shall be in their foreheads .
translation.kha: Kin ïohi ïa ka durkhmat jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong u yn thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
hynriew U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la aiti ïa u ha ngi , malu i'u la pynïap ïa u , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki Briew jong u baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  our God delivered him before us  ; and we smote him , and his sons , and all his people .

translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .

translation.kha: Bad ar ngut ki rangbah bamatlah kiba shong harud lynti ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u ïadoh nangta , kumta ki la sdang ban pyrta , Ko U u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
translation.en: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .

translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shah ïa u , kumta u Paul u la ïng halor ki mawkyrdon bad u la ai dak da ki kti jong u ha u paidbah ban sngap jar . Habor ki la sngap jar , u Paul u la kren ïa ki ha ka ktien Hebru :
translation.en: And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,

translation.kha: Kut ha ka step kaba buiñ u dabi bad ki briew jong u ki mihnoh dang step phyrngab ban sien blei sha ka ri ki Philistia , hynrei ki Philistia ki leit kiew sha Jesreel .
translation.en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines . And the Philistines went up to Jezreel .
But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .
translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi kiba kohnguh ïa nga , ka bor jong nga kaba pynim kan kiew halor jong phi kum ka sngi bad kan wallam jingkhiah kum ki kjat sngi . Phin long kiba laitluid bad bakmen kum ki khun masi ba la pyllait na ka sem .

translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :
translation.kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Hushai : ka thain Asher bad ka shnong Bealoth
U Ussaïah u la ïarap bad la tep ha ka jaka tep syiem hynrei namar ka jinghap jong u ym shym la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u hir symboh ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ngim long ki briew kiba phai dien bad kiba jot noh . Pynban , ngi don ka jingngeit bad la pynim ïa i'u .
translation.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition  ; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul .

translation.kha: Lada u put ha ka lyngkha jong ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong u , na ka un lum ïa ka jingot ka jingïarap ; lada u beit ha ka lyngkha U Mynsiem , na U Mynsiem un lbong ïa ka jingot jong ka jingïam bymjukut .
translation.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .

translation.kha: U la ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u sahmiet Dabid bad ïa kiba la buh ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David s spears and shields , that were in the temple of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ma me , ko Trai , men longïng u syiem junom la jyrngam .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Haba sakma ka sngi ka wiang , ïa ki nongbah kiba la ïada bha yn hynne bad yn ieh ha ka jingjot jingpra kum ki nongbah kiba ki Hiar bad ki Amor ki la iehnoh mynba ki phet ïahap na ki paid Israel .
translation.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough , and an uppermost branch , which they left because of the children of Israel : and there shall be desolation .

translation.kha: Phi hap ban leit ïawad hi kat namarba phi lap , hynrei phi dat ba shna katjuh ki maw-it .
translation.en: Go ye , get you straw where ye can find it : yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .

translation.kha: Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan klop ïa ka sahit bneng bad pyndum ïa ki khlur . Ka sngi kan buhrieh shaei lyndet ki lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai .
translation.en: And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .

translation.kha: Te , kaei pang ? Nga ong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie bad ai ha phi ïa u kpu , namar ba phi dei u paralok jongu u , pynban un khie joit sad ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei baïar kaba phi donkam namar ba phim lehrain ban ïai pan .
translation.en: I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .

translation.kha: Ka por ka nang ! Ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong pha kiba la shah pynsakma ; kun pynurlong ïa pha kaba pawnam ha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngan pynlong ïa pha naba Manoah pat . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .
And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .
translation.kha: bad haba u smai da ka Templ , u smai da ka bad da U Blei , uba don hangta ;
Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asa naduh kaba nyngkong haduh kaba kut la pahuh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Jehoïada Bad Ka Israel .
translation.en: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka thain hajan ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon .
Nangta u syier ka Ijipt u la phah pyllait ïa u ; u nongsynshar ki jaitbynriew u la pyllait ïa u .
translation.en: The king sent and loosed him  ; even the ruler of the people , and let him go free .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U Trai , u dohkha uba heh u la ngut ïa u Jonah , bad u la don hapoh u dohkha lai sngi lai marwei .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang krung ïa kane , u nongpynim u la Wan na ka ïing u rangbah synshar . Ka khun jong me ka la ïaw , u la ong ha u Ïaroh ; wat pynshitom shuh ïa u nonghikai .
translation.en: While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead  ; trouble not the Master .

translation.kha: U la ïapyrshang wat banbeiñ pyntngit ïa ka thalab , bad ngi la kem ïa u . Ïeng la kwah ban bishar ïa u kat kum ka hukum jong ngi .
translation.en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple : whom we took , and would have judged according to our law .

translation.kha: Ka jubab Kaba jem ka tem ïa ka jingbitar , hynrei kaba khor ka pynkhie bitar .
translation.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath : but grievous words stir up anger .

translation.kha: U Ieh u khmied shajrong bad u pyrta , Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga ? Ar ne lai ngat ki rangbah synran ha ka ïinglieng ki peit shai u na ka jingkhangïit ,
translation.en: And he lifted up his face to the window , and said , Who is on my side ? who ? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs .

translation.kha: Kieng ki long kita ki aiñ shaphang ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ;
translation.en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy , and scall ,
And he said unto them , Depart yet for three days , then come again to me . And the people departed .
translation.kha: Sa wan biang hadien lai sngi bad ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jubab jong nga ,  u phai ktien . Kumta ki leit noh .
Nga la shem ba um shitrhem la leh kaei kaei naba u dei ban ïap lane ban shah set byndi ; ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka dei bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka hukum jong ki hi .
translation.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .

translation.kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade , namarkata , hapoh ka Ki badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .
translation.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :

Then ye shall answer them , That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord   ; when it passed over Jordan , the waters of Jordan were cut off : and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever .
translation.kha: phin ïathuh ïa ki ba ka um jong ka Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka jam ïa ka wah . Kine ki maw kin ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki paid Israel shaphang kaei kaba la jia hangne .
Te u Ïalam u la wait noh na Mispah ban ïakynduh ïa ki , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Haba u la wan ha ki , u la ong , Sngewbha wan shapoh Ban khmih ïa u Gedalaïah .
translation.en: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them , weeping all along as he went : and it came to pass , as he met them , he said unto them , Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam .

translation.kha: To waiñ phai , phi kiba shah ringmraw kiba mynta phi la anna ka jingkyrmen ; to wan phai sha ka jaka jong phi kaba shngain . Mynta nga ong ïa phi ba ngan sawphew pat ar shah ïa phi da ka jingkyrkhu na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la shahshitom .
translation.en: Turn you to the strong hold , ye prisoners of hope : even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa bad ka kmie jong u ki ong ïa u , Balei phin da leit sha kito ki phylliew bymngeit ban ïoh ïa ka kurim ? Hato phim lah ban shem ïa ka theisamla na la ka kur ka jait , hapdeng ki briew jrong ngi baroh ? Hynrei u Samson u ong ha la u kpa , Kane ka dei kaba nga kwah ba phin pynïong na ka bynda jong nga . Nga itynnat ïa ka .
translation.en: Then his father and his mother said unto him , Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren , or among all my people , that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines ? And Samson said unto his father , Get her for me  ; for she pleaseth me well .
And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers , wherewith they that were burnt had offered  ; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar :
translation.kha: Kumta u Eleasar u lyngdoh u la shim ïa ki khiew buh ding bad u phah shoh pynstang ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan .

Ym don mano ma ba thang ïa ka sharak bad thup ïa ka da ka shnong lane buh ïa ka ha khrum jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki tang wan rung .
translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .

translation.kha: Ym don napdeng ki Anakim kiba dang sah ha ka ri Israel ; pynban , tang katto katne , la iehnoh ha Gasa , Gath malu Ashdod .
translation.en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .
translation.kha: bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh ar ngut , un hap wan bad ong ha phi , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ Nangta phin sngewlehrain bad wan ban shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh .

U Trai un pynpang ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , bad un wallam ki jingpyut halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingjam ba la ka-por ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jongnga ki jinglehkai U tharai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :
And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba bad ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban ïap .

translation.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :
translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingsuk , hynrei ka jingïapait .
La pynsleh bad la pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh pop , hynrei mynta kdor don Shuah , bun ngi shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not  ; and we have borne their iniquities .

translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima u Soitan ka phira ha ki kynhun , kan ym lah ban Neah , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi sha ka jingkut .
translation.en: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .

As they gather silver , and brass , and iron , and lead , and tin , into the midst of the furnace , to blow the fire upon it , to melt it  ; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury , and I will leave you there , and melt you .
translation.kha: ha kajuh ka rukom ba ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ka rupa , ka tama , ka nar , ka sisa , bad ka tin la buh ha ka ding ban saiñ ïa ki . Ka jingbitar bad jingbitar shla jong nga kin pynum ïa ki kumba ka lawar ding ka pynum ïa u maw ba pynmih ïa ki .

Ki Lebi ki daiñ ban ïng ïada sawdong ïa u syiem , lem bad ki waitlam jong ki , kiba ki la sei , bad ki dei ban don ryngkat bun u syier Kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba pyrshang ban rung shapoh ka Tep u dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand  ; and whosoever else cometh into the house , he shall be put to death : but be ye with the king when he cometh in , and when he goeth out .
For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the gospel : not with wisdom of words , lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect .
translation.kha: U Khrist um shym la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis . U la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad ban ïathuh ïa ka khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka ktien ha ka jingstad briew , khnang ban pynthikna ba ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna kan ym pynduh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .

translation.en: For he spake , and it was done  ; he commanded , and it stood fast .
translation.kha: Haba u la kren , ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong ; ha ka hukum jong u baroh ka la paw .

translation.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
translation.kha: Balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh hynrei uba kyrpad ïa ka jingisynei ?
Ngan pyningkhong ïa me kum ka kynroh da ka rnong thylli ha ka jingïadei malu ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me , hynrei ngin ym jop ïa me . Ngan long nabar me ban ïada ïa me bad sumar pynni ïa me .
translation.en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la wanpaw ha u hangta , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashlur bad bakhlaiñ !

Bad ki jaitbynriew kan tip ba ki Isaia ki la shah ringmraw namar ki pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga . Nga la pah noh na ki bad nga la shiah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ba-bang pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma .
translation.en: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity : because they trespassed against me , therefore hid I my face from them , and gave them into the hand of their enemies : so fell they all by the sword .
For with God nothing shall be impossible .
translation.kha: Naba ym don kano kano kaba U Blei um lah ban leh .

U lyngdoh un hukum ba dei ban pynmih lwet napoh ïing ïa ki tiar ki tar borbah shuwa ba un leit khmih ïa kata ka jingbthuh ; lymda kumta , yn pynbna ba baher kabu don ha kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid . Nangta un sa leit snar shapoh ïing malade un khmih Bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest go into it to see the plague , that all that is in the house be not made unclean : and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house :

translation.kha: ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh kaba jhieh , bad ïa ka jingkah pyrda ;
translation.en: And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki kyntu ka long ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrduh ha ka kynhun jong ki , kaba nga hi ruh nga da kwah eh ban leh .
Hynrei ktien phai sha U Blei , u Nongthaw jong ki , kiba ai jingkyrmen ïa ki ha ki kyndit kiba dum .
translation.en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;

translation.kha: Ngi pang ha ka dohnud jong ngi hi nabar ngim lah ban ïohi bha’ lyngba ki pep jongki ngi ,
translation.en: For this our heart is faint  ; for these things our eyes are dim .

translation.kha: Me tap ïa ka jingbymtip Jong me da ka jingshukor ; Me long kum ki doktor ki bym lah ban pynkoit ïatan ïatan .
translation.en: But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .
The paths of their way are turned aside  ; they go to nothing , and perish .
translation.kha: Ki paid nongkhaïi ki jah lynti ha kaba wad um ; ki ïaid ruma bad ki ïap ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Te , to peit ! Ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .

translation.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell , to the sides of the pit .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynban , la pynhiar ïa me sha ka bynta kaba jylliew tam jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait koum ken ïa kaba la ramhah da Une uno na ki syiem Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynsngi ki nongbishar ki synshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;

translation.kha: Ha kaweh ka sngi , katba u Moses u ïangat shongthait Harhas kawei ka pukri , hynñiew nud ki khun kynthei jong u Jethro , u lyngdoh ka milian , ki ïakwah tong um ban pyndap ïa ki shyngoid ba kin ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot malu ki blang jong u khop jong ki .
translation.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .
Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad , ieh ngan sah ma nga hangne kum u mraw jong phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shah ïa u ba un leit phai bad la ki hynmen .

Ko ki shakri , to kohnguh ïa ki kynduh jong phi ha keiñ kiew baroh , ym tang haba ki ïohi ïa phi namar ba phi khoh ban ïoh pynsngewbha ïa ki ; hynrei to leh ïa ka da ka pangnud bashisha namar ka jingsheptieng burom lad phi ïa U TRAI’ .
translation.en: Servants , obey in all things your masters according to the flesh ; not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but in singleness of heart , fearing God :

translation.kha: U Blei u pynjia ruh ïa u Reson u khun lad u Eliada ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon . U Reson , u la phet ïap na la u kynrad , u Hadadeser u syiem ka Sobah , bad u la long u nongïalam ïa kawei ka kynoi ki riewrunar .
translation.en: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :

translation.kha: U Jakob bad la ka longïing longsem ki la ïamihnoh na Bethel , bad haba ki la jan poi ha Ephrath , ka na ka la poi ba ka Rakhel ka kha khun , bad ka la don ha ka jingsngur kha kaba shitom .
translation.en: And they journeyed from Beth–el  ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .

translation.kha: Hato phi la ju tip ba don uno uno na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ne uwei u Pharisi kaba ngeit ha u ?
translation.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him ?

translation.kha: Ki kren ki ktien bym don jingmut bad pynlong ki jingkular lamler bad ki jingïateh kular bymshemphang . Ka hok ka kylluid long bymhok , ka neng san Kum ki ñiut ba long bih ha ka lyngkhuh ba la dem lur .
translation.en: They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .

translation.kha: Neng tduh ban tei ka Tubal kaba khlaw , namsop U Blei jong ngi u kham khrup pun ïa uno uno imat pat u blei .
translation.en: And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long tang naba shu jia ryngkhat , dara um shym da ñiut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah ban pait sha ka jaka kiba ngan jied na ka bynshet jong phi , bad hangta un shongneh .
translation.en: And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .

translation.kha: umbah ka jingthiah bakhadduh ka ong , Mano bapop ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Mano ba lah shun ai jingmut ïa u ? Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka jingmut U Khrist .
translation.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .

translation.kha: Haba ki Kanaan kiba shong ha kata ka ri ki ieh ïa kita ki briew kiba ïambriew ha Atad , ki ïa-ong , Kane ka rukom ïambriew ki nong Ijipt kob da sngew lung mynsiem shaid ! Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka Abel Misraim .
translation.en: And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .
And he sighed deeply in his spirit , and saith ,  Why doth this generation seek after a sign ? verily I say unto you , There shall no sign be given unto this generation .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ud jylliew bad u la ong ,  Balei ba ki briew mynta ki kwah ban ïohi kambah ? Em , nga ong ïa phi ! Yn ym ai kum kata ka jingpynshisha ha kine ki briew !

translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingisih jong ki , ka ing suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u  purew u lah long ban shet .

translation.en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .
translation.kha: Haba u Gideon u ïohsngew shaphang ka jingphohsniew jong uta u briew bad ba ka mut kumno , u dem khohsiew khrup bad u mane ïa U  Trai . Nangta u leit phai pat sha ka jaka sher dara ki Israel , bad u ong ,  Khie joit ! U  Trai  u ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ka kynhun shipai jong ki Midian !

Katba ki thylliej dieng ki dang kiew shajrong na ka duwan , u Mahlah bad ka tnga jong u ki ïohi ïa u angel U Trai ba u kiaw sha bneng ha ki thylli ding . U Manoah hangta u sngewthuh ba uta u briew u dei u angel jong U Trai , bad ma u lem nabar ka thngan jong u ki dem khrup ha khyndew . Kim shym ïohi hajuh ïa u angel .
translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife . Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kñia ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ,’ u la ong ha lade ; ‘ ngan pynpra ïa ki thiar jong per sad shna ïa kiba kham heh , ha kaban ngan kynshew ïa u kew jong sa bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki mar jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , This will I do : I will pull down my barns , and build greater  ; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods .
And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

Kum u Moses u rah ïa la u diengthew , bad U Trai u la pynlong ïa ka lyer na shaphang mihngi ban beh ha Katai ka ri baroh shi sngi Bad baroh shi miet . Ynda mynstep kata ka lyer mihngi ka wan set ïa ki puit .
translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  brought an east wind upon the land all that day , and all that night  ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .

translation.kha: Kumta da kumno nur shem ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?

translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa —kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa uta u briew .
translation.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .

translation.kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynthei sum jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ban shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u Sikhri jongnga u Abraham , bad ki ïatim lang baroh .
translation.en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ibha la ïaid ha khmat jong U Ujuh sad kito kiba la bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta , To ïarep ïa U khun u Dabid ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kylleng jong U Trai ! To ïarah ïa U Blei! !
translation.en: And the multitudes that went before , and that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna to the Son of David : Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord  ; Hosanna in the highest .
And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Ishmael ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isaak , u khun jong ka Sarah .
Sumar ban ym klet ïa ka jutang ba U Trai U Blei jong phiah u la pynlong bad phi . Kynhun ïa ka lawbah jongno u ban ym Thaw na ka bynta ïa biar ïa kano kano ka durblei ,
translation.en: Take heed unto yourselves , lest ye forget the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he made with you , and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the  Lord  thy God hath forbidden thee .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la dep kren , u Saul u ong , Hato dien ma phoi shisha , ko Dabid u khun jong at ? Bun u la sdang don ïam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .
And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ïa u Joshua

translation.en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?
translation.kha: haba ki rieh ha la ki krem ne haba ki dem ban ap ha la ki krem ?
Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki , Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban shuh ïa lade ha ka jaka jong U blei .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shang jngai , lin lada phim tip uei u trai jong ka , ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong pa . Ynda u trai u wan wad ïa ka , ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee , or if thou know him not , then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house , and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it , and thou shalt restore it to him again .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u , bad kam shym dei ka sien banyngkong . Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , wat ai ba u Syiem Kner un kynnoh ïa nga lane ïano ïabun na ka un-long jong ang . Ngam tip ei ei shaphang kane !
translation.en: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him ? be it far from me : let not the king impute any thing unto his servant , nor to all the house of my father : for thy servant knew nothing of all this , less or more .

translation.kha: Yn thet ïa u kumba tep ïa u kada , un sa Shah ring bad bret ïa u shalor ki khyrdop ka Jerusha .
translation.en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U ong ïa u Dabid , manna leh aïu da uto u jingduh ? Me tharai nga dei u ksew ? Bad u pyrta da ki jingtim ki blei jong u halor u Dabid .
translation.en: And the Philistine said unto David , Am I a dog , that thou comest to me with staves ? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods .

translation.kha: U la ïathuh ïa im kumno ba u la ïohi ïa u angel Uba ïeng ha ka ïing jong u , bad uba la ong ha u , ‘ Phah ïasnoh ïano sha Joppa bad leit shem ïa u brisoh kiba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros .
translation.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house , which stood and said unto him , Send men to Joppa , and call for Simon , whose surname is Peter  ;
And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud ki bor synshar ka Hima Rom ki la phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad ka hukum ,  Pyllait noh ïa kito ki briew .

translation.en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished , and I will cause my fury to rest upon them , and I will be comforted : and they shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it in my zeal , when I have accomplished my fury in them .
translation.kha: Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga haduh ba ngan da sngewhun . Haba kane baroh ka jia , phan sa sngewthuh ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren ïa pha namar nga la bitar shla ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong pha .
U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros , Nga ong ha me ba mynnin ka miet , ha shuwa ba u shijur un kynjoh , men ong lai rupa ba meng ithuh ïa ang .
translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
translation.kha: Lada phan jin da la tip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! Hynrei mynta pham lah ban ïohi ïa ka !
Babha ka khubor shaphang ka jingjop ki Israel ka la poi ha u Jabin u Syiem ka Hasor , u pah ktien shaw u Jobab u syiem ka Madon , shad u syiem ka Shimron nabar u syiem ka Akhshaph ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la krong ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la khynwin jlang . Uei une ? ki briew ki la kylli .
translation.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?

translation.kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la lytar sha lyngkha sad u lap ïa ki mandriek , babha u la wanrah Sha ka kmie jong u ka Lai . Ka Rakhel ka ong ïa ka Leah , Ai lem kato katne ki mandriek jong u ïakhun jong pha .
translation.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .

translation.kha: To ong ha ki jaitbynriew baroh , U Trai u long u syiem ! Ïa ka pyut la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka malade ym lah ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .
translation.en: Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
Be honest .
translation.kha: Iathuh hok .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehu u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki Kam shlur jong u , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu , and all that he did , and all his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit bad babuhrieh ïa ki hajan ka Ïuphratis .
translation.en: So I went , and hid it by Euphrates , as the  Lord  commanded me .
Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :
translation.kha: Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , bad ka la long ruh da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrthei barim la pynjot .
U Pharaoh u jubab , Duwai na ka bynta jongngi ar la shai . U Moses u ong , Ngan leh kumba phi ong , ba phan ïoh ïatip ba ym ne mian mano ruh uba kum U Trai’ U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the  Lord  our God .
Wherefore she said unto Abraham , Cast out this bondwoman and her son : for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son , even with Isaac .
translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka la ïohi ïa ki , bad ka ong ha u Abraham ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka . U khun jong kane ka briew um dei ban ïoh bynta ei ei ïa ka spah ka phew jong me , kaba u khun jong nga , u Isaak u dei ban ïohpateng .
Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit bad ki lumbah Ngan pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang bad ki dieng . Ngan pynbakla ïa ki them wah shiah ki khak shyiap bad pyntyrkhong ïa ki pukri um .
translation.en: I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .

translation.kha: Long ka mon jong me ha ka khyndew kumba ha bneng .”
translation.en: Let your will take place , as in heaven , also on earth .”

translation.kha: u khlong ïa ka ksiar na ki jingkhang ka templ bad ïa ka ksiar kaba u hi u la tap ïa ki shawkad jingkhang , bad u phah lut ïa ka sha u Sennakherib .
translation.en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the  Lord  , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid , and gave it to the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Ki long baroh kba la ïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtap jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïatip . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïap ha ka thma bun ki jingtep jngai ki , ki ker sawdong ïa u lum jingtep lad ka . Pynïeng shisien ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .
translation.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .
Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Phi bam ïa ka doh kaba dang bit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynïap briew . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
U Judas bad ki rangbah jongki ki Jesreel ki la pynïap ïa ki , wat la katto katne ki ïohlad ban shem iaka lait im hapoh ki kynroh Shong malu ba ki khlam shah pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .

translation.kha: Kin sa thang duh ïa ka , ryngkat bad ki ïing ki sem hangno haneng ha kiba ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kob thang ki jingbuaid ha u Baal halor ki tnum ïohnong bad da kaba ha ïa ka waiñ jong ki jingainguh sha kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: And the Chaldeans , that fight against this city , shall come and set fire on this city , and burn it with the houses , upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal , and poured out drink offerings unto other gods , to provoke me to anger .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Saul , u Dabid u wan phai na ka jingit jong u ïa ki Amal bad u sah ar sneng ha shalyngka .
translation.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had abode two days in Ziklag  ;

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang ïa uta u briew kumno u la ïoh imat pat . U la ïathuh ïa ki , U la theh khyndiat ka ktieh ha ki khmied jong nga ; nga la bta khmat , mala Myntan sa la imat .
translation.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .

translation.kha: Mar kamet hi ka khynnah ka la leit phai kloi kloi pat sha u syiem bad ka la dawa , Nga kwah ïa phi ban ai mynta hangne ha ka pleng , ïa ka khlieh u Onan u Nongpynbaptis !
translation.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh pop pyrshah ïa la u ïapbriew , U Blei u lah ban ïadait na ka bna jong u ; ishyrkhei mano ba lai ba ïasaid na ka bynta u briew uba leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai ? Hynrei kim shym sngap ïa la u kpu , naba U Trai u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .

translation.kha: Kainan kin kitkhlieh ïa ki tiar pynïeng Ïingjaiñ , ïa ki diengkhap , ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , bad ïa ki tiar pyndait jongngi ka baroh . Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki kam baroh kba ïaid bad kine ki tyrha ki tar .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u pom mar kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kyndon shynrong ïa ki dieng pyrshah ïa ka kut baskhem . Ki wiang ding ïa ka , lem bad ïa ki briew hapoh jong ka , bad barabor ki briew jong Kata ka kut ki la ïalap — kumba shihajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei .
translation.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .
And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki shakri ban pynspong ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta , bad nangta ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U  Trai  u dang ïeng hangta .

translation.en: Let us make a little chamber , I pray thee , on the wall  ; and let us set for him there a bed , and a table , and a stool , and a candlestick : and it shall be , when he cometh to us , that he shall turn in thither .
translation.kha: To ngin shna kawei ka kamra halor tnum ïing , ngin buh kawei ka jingthiah , kawei ka miej , kawei ka shuki , bad kawei ka sharak hapoh jong ka , bad u lah ban sah hangta man ba u wan jngoh ïa ngi .

Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka longsem kaba ishyrkhei ; Bad erlangthari ba la thom ïa ka jingbitar shlei jrong ki , Naba ka un-long kaban shyrkhei katta long . Kylleng ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Gaal hapdeng ki briew jong ka ngan pynsakma ïa ki .
translation.en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u angel uba hynñiew u put ïa la ka tur , te U Balei un pyndep ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u , kumba u la pynban ha la ki sharak , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: Don shikhung ki jaiñ ktien kiba pher ha ka pyrthei , pynban ym Don na ki , kiba Khlem jingot .
translation.en: There are , it may be , so many kinds of voices in the world , and none of them is without signification .

translation.kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit baïaineh ha uba u la jied , ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .
translation.en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .

translation.kha: To Burom ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long tang marwei da shisha .
translation.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed .
For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity .
translation.kha: Palat ïa shisien , haba nga donkam jingïarap ha Thessaloni , phi la phah ïa ka sha nga .

translation.en: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare  ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .
translation.kha: bad siat ïa nga da ki khnam na baroh sawdong — ki khnam kiba sam lyngba ki pynmynsaw ïa nga : bad wat la katta ruh um pyn-i jingisynei .

To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynthei ka Samaria , kiba nang sngewsyiad kum ki maw ba la bsa bha Jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa katba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kba tduh , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka kyr-iat !
translation.en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .

translation.kha: U la ong , U Serubbabel u la buh ïa ka Nongrim jong ka Templ , bad un pyndep ïa ka jingtei . Haba kane ka khia , ki briew’ Jong nga keiñ tip ba dei ma at kaba la Phah ïa me sha ki .
translation.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house  ; his hands shall also finish it  ; and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you .

translation.kha: Ka shem ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elishama ; u syiem u kiaw ban tip shaphang ki khampoh jong u Elisha .
translation.en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .

translation.kha: Ka Leah ka ïajubab , Hato pham pat sngewhun ba pha la knieh noh ïa u tnga jong ar ? Mynta pat pha pyrshang ban shim sa ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong nga . Ka Rakhel ka ainong , Lada phan ai ïa nga ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong phad , pha lah ban thiah bad u Jakob Mynta ka moramot .
translation.en: And she said unto her , Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son s mandrakes also ? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son s mandrakes .

translation.kha: hadien ba U Trai u la jop ïa u Sihon u syiem Lem uba shongkha ha Hebron , dara ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , uba synshar ha ki shnong Ashtaroth bad Areli .
translation.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites , which dwelt in Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei :

translation.kha: Ki mih na Babilonia ha ka sngi bathngan jongnga u bnai banyngkong , mala da ka jingïarap U blang , ki poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai uba San .
translation.en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him .

translation.kha: Ki suh ki thain ïa ka ephod da ka jaiñ-jin linen kaba ni ; da u saiwul uba jingdum , uba sawbthuh , pynlang uba rong saw ; bad da u sai ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the ephod of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
Is any man called being circumcised ? let him not become uncircumcised . Is any called in uncircumcision ? let him not be circumcised .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba la lah otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban pyrshang ban weng noh ïa ki dak jong ka jingotsher ; lada u briew uba khlem otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban shah otsher .

translation.en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .
translation.kha: Ka burom U Blei ka la phet na Israel ,  ka ong ,  namar ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei .

Lada me la leh ïa kaba daiñ , bathoiñ jingïam da la phuh samrkhie ; hynrei namar ba me la sa ïa kaba sniew , ka pop ka apthap ha ka jingkhang Jong me . Ka kwah ban synshar ïa me , hynrei me dei ban iap ïa ka .
translation.en: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him .

translation.kha: Ngi la leit marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da ka jingeh bakhlaiñbor ngi la Nakon sha ka jaka ba la khot , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , ka bymlah da jngai na ka shongneh Lasaïa .
translation.en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .

translation.kha: Hato phiah pyrkhat ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingaibor jong U tharai ? U Trai’ da lade hi u ong ha nga ban turoi ïaleh bad pun pynpait ïa ka .
translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .

translation.kha: Nga ïa-ong ha phi , U Jisu u la pynban , U Ïaineh u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta kaba rit dak ha ka Hima U Blei u long uba kham khrum ban ïa u Ïoanna .
translation.en: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .

translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , la phai Ktien u pynbah synshar , to wan bad nga shuwa ba u khun jongno nga un ïap .
translation.en: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .

translation.kha: Kum ka dak ka jingpynkynmaw , teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .

translation.kha: U Joab u phah ïa u Judah ban nang leit sha khmat ban ong ïa u Joseph ban ïan ïakynduh bad u ha Gosan .
translation.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph , to direct his face unto Goshen  ; and they came into the land of Goshen .

translation.kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada phi erlangthari bymhok phyrnai kyllan kynsan .
translation.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah , naba mynta la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the flanks , and the caul that is above the liver , with the kidneys , it shall he take away :
translation.kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .
U Trai u long wahbah bha ; u ïada ïa ki briew jong u ha ki por ka jingjngem ; u ri sumar ïa kito kiba phai sha u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is good , a strong hold in the day of trouble  ; and he knoweth them that trust in him .

translation.kha: Jamynrei kiwei pat ki kren biria ïa ki riewngeit , da kaba ong , Kine ki briew ki la buaid !
translation.en: Others mocking said , These men are full of new wine .
Ephraim is joined to idols : let him alone .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingshoh bieit ki bleithaw . Ai kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti .
Ïa ka sleh jong u baroh yn pynpait ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translation.en: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .

And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa u paidbah ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synran ki la leh kumta .

translation.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk bad ki paid Israel ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Hib ki shong . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .
Ha kamai ka sngi katba u Jakob u dang shet syrwa jhur , u Iso u la wang na kaba behmrad .
translation.en: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :

translation.kha: Haduh katno phin pynshlei , ko ki briew bym don jingngeit ? Nga la thaw Kiei kawei ka thymmai bad kaba pher , kaba phira kum ka briew kaba ïada ïa u briew .
