translation.en: How long wilt thou go about , O thou backsliding daughter ? for the  Lord  hath created a new thing in the earth , A woman shall compass a man .
Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice : and let men say among the nations , The  Lord  reigneth .
translation.kha: To kmen , ko pyrthei bad sahit bneng ! Ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u long u syiem .

translation.en: I pray thee , forgive the trespass of thine handmaid : for the  Lord  will certainly make my lord a sure house  ; because my lord fighteth the battles of the  Lord  , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days .
translation.kha: Sngewbha map ïa nga , ko kynrad , na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi u syiem , bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ruh , naba phi ïaleh ïa ki thma jong u ; bad phin ym leh kano kano kaba sniew katba phi dang im .

translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
translation.kha: Bad kum u shakri jong U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .

translation.en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko khun jong nga , long uba stad bad pynleit jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .

bad la shaneng ha ki ïa kine ki kam : baneh ïapra ïa ki lyngdoh katba iohpateng na u Aaron bad ïa ka jingmane ha ka Tabor , pun sumar ïa ki phyllaw bun ïa ki kamra jong ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;
translation.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;
Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli , nangta leit bad kren ha ki paid Israel .

U Blei Bakhuid bad u nongpynim ki Israel u ong ïa uta uba shah ibeiñ , ïa uba la isih da ki jyrthiaw bad uba long u shakri jong ki nongshniah : Ki syiem kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad kin ïeng ban pynjop ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki ; ki khun symboh ruh kin ïohi ïa tala , bad keiñ dem khup ban pyndonburom ïa me . Kane kan jia namar U Trai u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jongki ki Israel u bat ïa la ki kular .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .
And God appeared unto Jacob again , when he came out of Paddan–aram , and blessed him .
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la wan phai na Mesopotamia , U Blei u la mihpaw biang ha u , bad u la kyrkhu ïa u .

translation.en: Circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , an Hebrew of the Hebrews ; as touching the law , a Pharisee ;
translation.kha: La otsher ïa nga haba nga la don shi taïew ka rta . Nga long u Israel naduh ba la kha ïa nga , na ka jait Benjamin , u Hebru uba nylla . Ha ka liang kaba sumar ïa ka hukum ki Jiw , nga la long u Pharisi , bad nga la long uba shitrhem katta katta haduh ba nga la pynshitom ïa ka balang .

translation.en: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ïa ki ,  To sumar bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka kwah hynrei ka doh ka tlot .
Hynrei to kiar noh na ki jingjia ba-bieit bad ba khlup jingmut ; me tip ba ki kut ha ka jingkajia .
translation.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .

translation.kha: U Tom u ai ia ka ïashongkha jong u ha I tymmen kynthei .
translation.en: Tom gave his seat to an elderly lady .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïong ïa per ban rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki ar nongput ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki Israhaïah :
translation.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel ,

translation.kha: Haba ki la jlan poi ha Jerusalem , hajan ki shnong Bethphage bun Bethania , ki la wanpaw sha u lum ki Oholiab . U Jisu u la dum phah ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jong u bad kine ki jingbthah :
translation.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .
translation.kha: Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki la shakri ïa ki blei Baal bad Astarte .

translation.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the  Lord  continually .
translation.kha: U Aaron un sumar bad buh ryntih ïa kita ki sharak ha u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , bad un khmih ba kin meh man ka por ha khmat U  Trai .

U Tlai u ong , Ang bitar ïa kito ki nongwan kiba synshar ïa ki briew jong na , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki paidbhur Judah ki long ki jong nga , bad ma nga , U Trei Badonbor Baroh , ngan sum ïa ki . Kin hir ki kulai thlim badonbor jong nga .
translation.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .
translation.kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa u Dathan bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;
Ha said ka por U Jisu u la wan poi na Galilaïa bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .
translation.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi baroh ! Ki don ki jingshyrkhei , ki sawlep , Bad ki jingriam kiba ap ïa phi .
translation.en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , are upon thee , O inhabitant of the earth .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ki briew jngai u , To ïeng ha ka khang ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lynti ïaid kiba mynbarim bad hangtei ka don ka shrak babha kad . To ïaid ha ka , bad phiah im ha ka jingsuk . Hynrei ki ainong , Em , ngin ym leh !
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .

translation.kha: Hynrei u angel u ong , Haei leit bad ktien ki briew , hynrei kren dang ïa kiba nga ong ha me ban kren . Kumta u Balaam u la otsher ryngkat bun ki .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .
O  Lord  , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !
translation.kha: A  Trai  , katno slem nga dei ban pyrta jingïarap ha shuwa ba men shahshkor , ha shuwa ba men pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingleh jubor ?

Ko Israel , na kwah ba phin tip ba ngam shym leh ïa kano baroh namar jong phi . Nga kwah ba phin da sngewlehrain bad sngewjahburom ïa kaei kaba phi la leh . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: Not for your sakes do I this , saith the Lord  God  , be it known unto you : be ashamed and confounded for your own ways , O house of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen bashisha ban ïashem biang bad kiba ieid ba thoin babha la ïap .—Ioannis 5 :24 , 29 .
translation.en: A real hope of being reunited with your dead loved ones . —John 5 :28 , 29 .

translation.kha: Nangta phin lah ban im Rumah U Trai u kwah bad ba phyrnai ïai leh borabor ïa katai kaba pynsngewsih ïa u . Ka jingim jong phi kan pynmih ïa baïar ki jingleh babha babun jait , bun phin san ha ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei .
translation.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;

translation.kha: U Jiw u la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa kine kai kiei baroh ha ki bajaipdeh ; um ju ong ïa kano kano ha ki khlem da pynbunkam ïa ka pharshi .
translation.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables  ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :

translation.kha: Ko Pa ! Me la ai ïa ki ha nga , bad nga khiew ïa ki ba kin don bad nga ha kaba nga don , khnang ba ki da ban ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga , ka burom ïa kaba me la ai ha nga ; naba me la ieit ïa ar ha shuwa ban pynbang ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am  ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .

translation.kha: Ngan ym thong ïa pha , ne pyn-i jingaiei ei ei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha na ka bynta ki kam ba-ijli kiba pha la lai , kumta phan sa tip ba nga un-long U Trai .
translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare thee , neither will I have pity : but I will recompense thy ways upon thee , and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba jingkit bad suba shuh pynbaptis , yn pynim ; ïa uno uno u bymngeit , yn pynrem .
translation.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved  ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .

translation.kha: Ka jingsneng malade ka jingpynbeit ki long kiba bha ïa ki khynnah . Lada u khynnah u ïoh leh katba u mon , u pynlehrain ïa la ka kilomitar .
translation.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .

But in the last days it shall come to pass , that the mountain of the house of the  Lord  shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills  ; and people shall flow unto it .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba tyllep ïa ki lumrit baroh . Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun kin wan tuid sha u ,

translation.en: It was foursquare  ; they made the breastplate double : a span was the length thereof , and a span the breadth thereof , being doubled .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba sawdong bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap . Ka don arphew ar sentimitar ka lynter bad arphew ar sentimitar ka jingïar .
Wat na ka Sudan kaba shwa jngai , ki briew jong nga kiba la sakma keiñ wallam ki jingainguh sha nga .
translation.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants , even the daughter of my dispersed , shall bring mine offering .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane ka jinglah barieh : Ngi baroh ngin ym ïap , hynrei haba ka turoi bakhatduh tista sawa , ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur ha kaba shikhyllipmat . Naba haba ka turoi lai sawa , ïa kiba ïap yn pynmihpat , ba kin ym ïap shuh da lei lei , pynlang ïa im’ barabor yn pynkylla dur .
translation.en: In a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trump : for the trumpet shall sound , and the dead shall be raised incorruptible , and we shall be changed .
The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingsuk , bad uwei pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .

Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm , ‘ Ai ba ka ïing jongno u kan kylla hir kaba thylliej ; ai ban ym don mano mano bashong hapoh jong ka .’ La thoin ruh , ‘ Ai ba uwei pat un shim ïa ka jaka jong u ha ka jingshakri .’
translation.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .

translation.kha: U Jisu te u la ong ïa ki Simran jong u ba baroh’ ki briew kin phiah ha ki kynhun kynhied malu shong halor u phlang bajyrngam .
translation.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .

translation.kha: lane peit shlip ha ka khyndew , pynpdang kan ym ïohi ei ei hyndai ka jingjynjar bad ka jingdum , ka jingdum kaba pyndkut shai kaba la beh ïa ki .
translation.en: And they shall look unto the earth  ; and behold trouble and darkness , dimness of anguish  ; and they shall be driven to darkness .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Syria yn sa iehnoh junom . Kin long ka iaki pynbamphlang ïa ki langbrot bad ki phasi , bad ym Don mano mian ba beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken : they shall be for flocks , which shall lie down , and none shall make them afraid .

translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki khuid shen yn sa pyllaitluid ïa ki ; kin im ka jingim kaba jlan pynlang kin ïoh ïa ka jingdam kat kaba ki donnam .
translation.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed , and that he should not die in the pit , nor that his bread should fail .

translation.kha: wiat la phi kam ba phiah mane ïa U tharai , phim shitrhem mut kumba phi ong .
translation.en: And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .
translation.kha: U wan phai biang sa shisien bad u la shem ba ki synran ki ïohthiah ; kim lah ban khyllie ïa ki khmat jong ki .
U tei ïa ki duwan ba-thala ha ka Thymmai , ka jaka kaba U Trai u la ong ba dei ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: And he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , of which the  Lord  said , In Jerusalem will I put my name .

translation.kha: U Joab u la otsher , bad ka kylli , Phi dei u Joab ? Ho-oid , nga dei , u jubab . Kyndit , sngap ïa nga , ka ong . Nga sngap keiñ , u jubab .
translation.en: And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .

translation.kha: Ka jingsdang ïa ka jingïakajia ka longkmie Kum ka jingbthei jingnang jong ka den-um ; pynsangeh ïa ka ha shuwa ba kan ïadie sha khmat .
translation.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water : therefore leave off contention , before it be meddled with .
In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;
translation.kha: Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia jong U Khrist la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ïa ki pop jong ngi la map ei .
Te kumta , ka Hukum hi ka un-long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka long kaba khuid , kaba dei bad kaba ba .
translation.en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .

And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee , or if thou know him not , then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house , and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it , and thou shalt restore it to him again .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shong jngai , lane lada phim tip uei u trai jong ka , ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi . Ynda u trai u wan wad ïa ka , ai ïa ka ha u .

translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kaba kum ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng satlak ka pyrthei . Me la beh noh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki blei jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la pyllaitluid na Ijipt ban long ki jong me hi .

translation.en: Not of works , lest any man should boast .
translation.kha: Namar dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba ïa phi la pynim da ka jingngeit . Kam dei na ka jingmih na ki kam jong phi hi , hynrei ka long ka jingai U Blei , khnang ba uno uno un ym lah ban kren sarong shaphang kata .

translation.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces , and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire , and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate : for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot , and they shall return to the hire of an harlot .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw bakordor jong ka baroh yn pynpait lyngkhot , baroh kaba la ai sha ki nuti ka templ yn pynjot ha ka ding , bad ki durblei jong ka baroh kin long ka kynton ba la shu ieh . Ka Samaria ka la lum ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta ki jinglehniam ba pynseisoh , bad mynta ki nongshun jong ka kin rah noh ïa ki na ka bynta ki nuti ka templ shawei pat .
Ki Bymman ki wanlam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang banbeiñ pynjah ha ki brisoh kiba bha .
translation.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
The salutation of Paul with mine own hand , which is the token in every epistle : so I write .
translation.kha: Da ki kti jong nga hi , nga thoh ïa kane : Ki jingkhublei na u Paul . Kane ka dei ka rukom ba nga soi ïa kawei pa kawei ka shithi ; kane ka long kumno nga thoh .
Bad kumno shaphang ki Hynñiew tyllun ki kpu na ka bynta ki seh hajar jrut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?
translation.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
Special schooling is provided for those who devote their full time to the Kingdom-preaching work so that they can ‘ fully accomplish their ministry .’ —2 Timothy 4 :5 .
translation.kha: La pynkhreh ïa ki skul bakyrpang na ka bynta kito kiba trei pura ïa ka kam ïalap khnang ba kin lah ban “pyndep ïa la ka kam nongïalap .”—2 Timotheus ( Timothi ) 4 :5 , Baibyl Khasi Katholik .
Palat ïa shisien , haba de donkam jingïarap ha Thessaloni , phi la phah ïa ka sha por .
translation.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity .

translation.kha: Da U Trai uba im , U Blei lad phi , to smai ba u syiem u la phah wad ïa phi ha baroh sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba Un uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim dat ha ka ri jong u , u Ahab un dala na uta u nongsynshar banbeiñ shym ba phi long u bym lah Ban shem .
translation.en: As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynmen ha ki khyndiat sngi yn sa pynïap ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: For John truly baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence .
Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : for thou exceedest the fame that I heard .
translation.kha: ngam shym la ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki ïathuh ïa nga tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi da lade hi . Ngam shym pat ïohsngew wat tang shiteng na ka jingstad jong phi . Phi kham stad shuh shuh ban ïa kaba ki briew ki ong .
Ki riewsniew ki anna pynpdang ki briew jong nga ; ki apthap kum ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar pun riam ïa ki sim , hynrei kiba pynap ïa ki jingriam jong ki ban riam ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u la ïohi ïa u briew’ ïa uba la kha matlah .
translation.en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , to leit sha ka kamra jong phi , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad duwai sha U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .

Haba phi lum ïa u kew mala phi kum peit shi song ha lyngkha , wat leit den Shu ïa u ; ih ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ka mana jong phi baroh .
translation.en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .
And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them , and they stood upon their feet  ; and great fear fell upon them which saw them .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi shiteng , ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ba ai jingim ka la wan na U Blei bad ka la rung ha ki , bad ki la ïeng joit ; bad baroh kiba la ïohi ïa ki , ki la sngewtriem .
Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei suba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ?
translation.en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
Therefore Eli said unto Samuel , Go , lie down : and it shall be , if he call thee , that thou shalt say , Speak ,  Lord   ; for thy servant heareth . So Samuel went and lay down in his place .
translation.kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  Khie leit thiah biang , bad lada u khot biang ïa phi sa shisien , sa ong , ‘ To kren , ko  Trai  , u shakri jong me u sngap .’   Kumta u Samuel u leit biang sha la ka jaka thiah .

Ki ïong ha u , Kana ka dadien ka kabu jong phi ! U Trai u la ïathaw ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bol jngai pa’ bad phi lah pun lai ïa u kat kaba phi kwah . U Dabid u Por sor sher bad u ot shi lyngkhot na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingtip u Saul .
translation.en: And the men of David said unto him , Behold the day of which the  Lord  said unto thee , Behold , I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand , that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee . Then David arose , and cut off the skirt of Saul s robe privily .

translation.kha: Ki la don baroh khat-ar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And all the men were about twelve .

translation.kha: Tang khyndiat ki bhabriew kine loit im , bad ka Israel kan long kum u dieng Ophel na kaba la kheit lut ïa ki soh Olib laitim noh ar ne lai tylli ibha ha klun eh , lynti khyndiat kiba la iehnoh ha ki tnat kiba shapoh . Nga , U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
translation.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it , as the shaking of an olive tree , two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough , four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof , saith the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: badno kamet U tharai Nongsynshar Badonbor baroh , u ong , Kan don ka jingsynran mala ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbeh . Wat ïa ki nongjop yn khat ban ïam na ka bynta kiba ïap lem pynlang kito ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .

translation.kha: U Trai un leit Rah ïa phoi bad ïa u syiad jong phi sha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba ma phi lane ki kpa tymmen jong pa kim pat ju poi ; hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei kiba da u dieng bad da u maw .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring thee , and thy king which thou shalt set over thee , unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known  ; and there shalt thou serve other gods , wood and stone .

translation.kha: Me la ïohi ne em Kumne u Ahab u la pynrit ïa lade ha khmih jong sa ? Namar ba u la kuna kumne , sam ym pynjot ïa u katba u dang im ; kuna lama ha ka pateng u khun jong u , ba ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ka long Jong u Ahab .
translation.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me ? because he humbleth himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days : but in his son s days will I bring the evil upon his house .

For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .
translation.kha: Shisha kumba u symbai u khie lung bad u san , U  Trai  Nongsynshar un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ïaroh ïa u .

Nga la pynlong ïa u syiem Ijipt ba un pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im , hynrei ma u badno ka kynhun shipa jong u baroh kin Shah pynpyut bad keiñ thiah ha ka jingjahthait lam bad baroh kiba khlem otsher kiba ïap ha ka thma , U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living : and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead .
translation.kha: Uba hok u lait na ka jingjynjar ; pynban u bymman u hap ha ka .

translation.en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .
translation.kha: Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Uwei pa uwei na phi u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Petros ;  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa U Khrist .

Nangta u Eli u ju kyrhai ïa u Elkanah bad ka rnga jong u , badno u ïa-ong ha u Elkanah , To U Trai un ai shuh ki khwan ïa phi na Kane ka briew ha ka jaka Utai uba phin la aiti sha u . Hadien kata ki sa loit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .

translation.kha: U la kitei lyngba ka shnong ha naba la ïashem ïa u da ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah kiba pang jingthohlieh .
translation.en: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynban , katno kaba kmen long kito kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka !
Ainong ïa uwei pa uwei baïar katba kum ki kam jong u , kthang ba ki briew jong me kin kohnguh ïa me ha ki por baroh Kaba ki dang im ha kane ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kba tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .

translation.kha: Ki Judia ki pyrta jam , bad hapoh ka jingialang u Abijah , ki tur ïaleh ; U Blei u pynliem ïa u Joab bad ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel .
translation.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout : and as the men of Judah shouted , it came to pass , that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .
And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :
translation.kha: Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U  Trai  u kren — ba ngan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la leh ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khun marwei na nga ,

U Jeriel u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u thohbroin . Ha ka snem kaba sawspah ba u dab u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit shaphang ka pateng longïing jong ki kynhun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , bad la shem ba ki shipa bapawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gad .
translation.en: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .

translation.kha: Ngan ieh hangta ïa ki brisoh ibha sngewrit bad kiba kun , ki baneh waiñ sha nga na ka bynta ka jingpyiar .
translation.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: iada u Joseph u la wan sha ïing , ki leit rah sha u hapoh ïing ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .
translation.kha: Haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingainguh bynrap dei ban pynbun kat ban ïabiang .
Lada kum kita kiei kiei ki jai , hato phin leit ramhah ïa ki ban pynbeit da ki briew ki bym don Nongrim ha ka balang ?
translation.en: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life , set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church .

translation.kha: Ka jubab , Imna , ngan ithuh ryngkat bad phi , ishyrkhei phin ym ïoh burom ei ei ïa ka jingjop , namar U Trai un aiti ïa u Sisera ha ka kyntiew . Kumta ka Deborah ka leit bad u Barak sha Kesis .
translation.en: And she said , I will surely go with thee : notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour  ; for the  Lord  shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman . And Deborah arose , and went with Barak to Kedesh .
And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .
translation.kha: Ki la ïai duwai lynñiar bad kumba lamwir haduh palat shiteng sngi ; hynrei ym shym don jingjubab , ne ïohsngew ïa kano kano ka sur .

Naba ka paw ha nga ba U Balei u la ai ïa ka jaka bakhatduh tam ha im ki Apostol , khem ki briew kiba la rai pynjyrngam ban shah ïap ha khmat u paidbah kum ka jingthadrong ha khnam ka pyrthei bhor kaba dadien jong ki angel bun jong u bynriew .
translation.en: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last , as it were appointed to death : for we are made a spectacle unto the world , and to angels , and to men .
But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up  ; and he arose .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u khynnah na ka kti bad u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u , bad u la ïeng joit .
Ki briew jongngi pha kiba la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ïong ha Phah , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’
translation.en: The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kynta .
U paidbah babun u la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup ha lynti katba kiwei pat ki la khyllad da ki tnat dieng bad ki la dien ïa ki ha lyndang .
translation.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way  ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un leh-isynei ïa phi . Un wan ïalam pat ïa phi napdeng kita ki jaitbynriew sha kiba u la pynsakma ïa phi , bad un pynbha pat ïa phi .
translation.en: That then the  Lord  thy God will turn thy captivity , and have compassion upon thee , and will return and gather thee from all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath scattered thee .
Thus did your fathers , when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei kaei ba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh haba nga la phah ïa ki na Kadesh Barnea ban leit swar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Some remove the landmarks  ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki pynkynriah ïa ki mawpud ban kurup jaka shuh ; ki tuh ïa ki langbrot bad buh ïa ki ha la ki jong ki kynhun jong ki .
Hynrei uei uba lah ban ïai ap ïa ka sngi haba un wan ? Uei uba lah Ban lait im haba un jaw ? Un long kum ka sabon basboh bha , kum ka ding kaba phrang ïa ka nar .
translation.en: But who may abide the day of his coming ? and who shall stand when he appeareth ? for he is like a refiner s fire , and like fullers  soap :

translation.kha: Hynrei u Salu badno ki ngab jong u ki pynïasoh im ïa u Agur , bad kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun masi Bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynjai tam , bad ïa kano kano kaba kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa Kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .
translation.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .
And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki un long kum ka jingkah na ka lyer bad ka jaka ban rieh na ki  erïong . Kin long kum ki wahduid kiba tuid ha ka ri shyiap , kum ka jingkah syrngiew u mawsiang bah ha ka ri shrah .

translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt  ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha kata ka sngi ha kaba nga la btin ïa ki bad la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Kim shym ïaineh ha kata ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki , bad kumta ngam shym shahshkor shuh ïa ki .
U Solomon bad baroh ki paid Israhaïah ki la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep hynñiew snieh . La khong u paidbah kaba bun naduh ka Khim Hamath na shawei hapoh ka khappud Ijipt na sahit .
translation.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days , and all Israel with him , a very great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt .
Dan shall judge his people , as one of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Dan un synshar ïa la ki briew , Kin long kum kiwei ki jait Israel .
U nongrep suba la trei shitom u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bynta ka nyngkong na ka jingot .
translation.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits .
Then said I , Lo , I come ( in the volume of the book it is written of me , ) to do thy will , O God .
translation.kha: Te nga la ong , ‘ Nga hangne , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me , A Blei , kumba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka kitab ka Hukum .’

translation.en: Moreover he put out Zedekiah s eyes , and bound him with chains , to carry him to Babylon .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat u Sedekaïah bad la teh ïa u da ki kynjri ban rah ïa u sha Babilonia .
Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh bad u la ino , Phi thup ba ki nongshukor jong ki pynngeit blei ki dabor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki anna ka ieid ba-pyiar .
translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh haka ïa-ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane para ngut ki sakhi .’
translation.en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .

And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes , there met him two possessed with devils , coming out of the tombs , exceeding fierce , so that no man might pass by that way .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan sha ka thain Gadara ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , la ïashem ïa u da ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la wan mih ïa ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Kine ki rangbah ki la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki bad ki la long kiba itriem shikatdei ba ym don mano mano ba nud ban leit na kata ka lynti .

translation.en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .
translation.kha: Ki riewsniew ki don hapdeng ki briew jong nga ; ki apthap kum ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar ban riam ïa ki sim , hynrei kiba pynap ïa ki jingriam jong ki ban riam ïa ki briew .

translation.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki hynmen ha Ijipt , ha ka bynta kaba bha tam hajan ka nongbah Rameses , kumba u syiem u la hukum .

translation.en: But when he seeth his children , the work of mine hands , in the midst of him , they shall sanctify my name , and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall fear the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba phin ïohi ïa ki khun kiba ngan ai ha phi , te phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel . Phin sa burom ïa nga bad phin ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa nga .

translation.en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ïa ki ar ngut shi para kiba long ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang tong dohkha ha ka duriaw da ka jar .

translation.en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khun shynrang ba ka Leah ka la kha na u Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka Leah ki long laiphew lai ngut .

translation.en: And the servants also of Huram , and the servants of Solomon , which brought gold from Ophir , brought algum trees and precious stones .
translation.kha: ( Ki rangbah jong u syiem Hiram bad ki jong u syiem Solomon kiba wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ki wan kit ruh u dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawkordor .
‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïaheh shongnia bad la ka para ne bad la ka para ar kmang .’ Bad u Baïap baroh un jyllop lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Baalis bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdon , bad u Barsillai u leit phai noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .

translation.kha: Wah ju ong , O ! balei mo kiei keiñ ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynnor ? Kam long ka jingkylli kaba shemphang .
translation.en: Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .

translation.kha: Ki nongshong ka Samaria ki la sheptieng , Kumno ngi lah ban pyrsa ïa u Jehu , ki la ong , naba wat u syiem Joram lymne u syiem Ahasaïah kim lah ?
translation.en: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , Behold , two kings stood not before him : how then shall we stand ?

translation.kha: Balei ba me shukor ? hato me pyrkhat ba ki jingshukor jong me kin longïng jingmyntoi ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God ? and talk deceitfully for him ?
And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Nangta kan shim por pat sa laiphew lai sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam . Kam dei ban ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba khuid lane rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad ynda la kut ka por pynkhuid ïa ka .

Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bun u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlam anna khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki Lah ban don ki khun ïa kba yn ñiew kum ki khun jongki uta u briew uba la ïarep .’
translation.en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .

translation.kha: Naba ka la pynjot sbun ki rangbah bad ka la long ka sier jongnga ka jingïap kiba bun kiba ym haka ñiew shuh .
translation.en: For she hath cast down many wounded : yea , many strong men have been slain by her .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong ba kynta brai yn pynkut bad ïa ka jinglehmeng ki briew yn pynjot . Ki leilieh kin jah noh plain , bad tang ïa U Tharai yn kyntiew burom ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish .

translation.kha: Haba u sing u kyrhuh , uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingtieng ? Haba U Tiras Nongsynshar u kren , uei uba da ban lait khlem pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u ?
translation.en: The lion hath roared , who will not fear ? the Lord  God  hath spoken , who can but prophesy ?

translation.kha: phiah don borabor ki bariew naba duk lem bad phi , hawei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .
translation.en: For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .

translation.kha: hynrei ki shynrang bad ki kynthei uba bit ban mihpat na ka jingïap nabar ban im ha ki pait ban wan kin ym shongkurim haw .
translation.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :

translation.kha: U la jubab , Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba de don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la Ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .
translation.en: And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .

translation.kha: Naba u Gideon u ong ha U Blei , wai bitar ïa la ; shah tun tynjuh sa tang shisien . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban pyrshang sa Shisien da une u shñiuh langbrot . Ha kane ka sien , ai ba u sngewthuh langbrot un rkhiang , bad ba ka khyndew bapaw tud jhieh .
translation.en: And Gideon said unto God , Let not thine anger be hot against me , and I will speak but this once : let me prove , I pray thee , but this once with the fleece  ; let it now be dry only upon the fleece , and upon all the ground let there be dew .

translation.kha: Ka bha bha Kanah .
translation.en: This is very good .
And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ,  Nga u Jakob , u shakri bakohnguh jong phi , nga pyntip ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso ba nga la shong la sah bad u Laban , bad nga la pynslem ban wan phai haduh mynta .

Ka khet ka anna hynriew kyrdon ban kiew shajrong ïa ka , ka don ka dur u sing uwei uwei ha ki tduh jongu kawei pa kawei ka kyndon . Ba baroh ka long khat-ar tylli ki sing . Hadien jong ka khep la ni ka dur khlieh jong u khun masi dab , bad ha syndah kawei pa Kaei na ki ar tylli ki jingbat kti don ka dur jngai u sing . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha Kaei pat ka hima .
translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps : there was not the like made in any kingdom .
And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kynthei kiba nang ban thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , bad ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .

translation.en: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit , u la rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba u Saul u don , bad u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u .  Ko Saul , u para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  U Trai u la phah ïa nga — U Jisu hi , uba la mihpaw ha me ha ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa me da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong por ki long kiba mutlop ; kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki long kiba bieit Kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano Kanah ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew , hynrei ki bym haw ban leh ïa kaba bha .
translation.en: For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong phi ka ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , phi im kumba U Mynsiem u ong ïa phi ban leh — lada , shisha , U Mynsiem U Blei u don hapoh jong phi . Uno uno u bym don ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khrist , um long u jong u .
dien ma por uba la kren bad ba la khot ïa u ; nga la ïalap ïa u shabar pynlang la ai ha u ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: I , even I , have spoken  ; yea , I have called him : I have brought him , and he shall make his way prosperous .

And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house , of which the  Lord  said to David , and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
translation.kha: U la buh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa u Dabid bad ïa u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka dei ka jaka ba nga la jied na ki ri baroh jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta , bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,
u khun jongki u Kainan , u khun jong u Arphaksad , u khun jngai u Shem , u khun jongnga u Noah , u khun jongnga u Helek ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Cainan , which was the son of Arphaxad , which was the son of Sem , which was the son of Noah , which was the son of Lamech ,

translation.kha: Ki la woh Sha Bethsaida , ha kaba katto katne thut ki briew ki la ïalamwir ha U Jehu ïa u bri uba matlah , dara ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ktah ïa u .
translation.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .

translation.kha: Men sa ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangta men ïoh ka jingshlur ban tur ïajah . Kumta u Gideon bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit khar shai ka tduh jong ka jaka sher dara Jong ki nongshniah .
translation.en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .

translation.kha: U Abishai , babha ka kmie jong u , ka Seruïah , u Ong ha u syiem , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi shah ïa i u ksar ban tei ïa phi! ? Shah ngan leit hangtai bad khrai ïa ka khliehduh jong u !
translation.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king , Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? let me go over , I pray thee , and take off his head .

translation.kha: Hynrei lehse don uba kum lud Khlem da mut khnang ha kaba sumar ïa kine ki jingbet ryntih kiba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,

translation.kha: Kenan ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki briew bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ki la khulom ïa ka khajna jong ki bad ki pyndap ïa ka synduk da ka .
translation.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced , and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end .

translation.kha: Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ainong ba ki la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïathaw ha ki ba u im .
translation.en: And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .

translation.kha: Phin pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong Kiba Mahlah bad pyllaitluid ïa kito kiba shong ha ki ïingbyndi ba-im .
translation.en: To open the blind eyes , to bring out the prisoners from the prison , and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house .
The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge  ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki long borabor kiba thrang bad ba kloi ban shah hikai .
‘ Ngim dei ki nongsyntiat ,’ ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngin dei kiba shida .
translation.en: And we said unto him , We are true men  ; we are no spies :

translation.kha: uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ba ngan ïoh Long U Balei jong phi . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Asa u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki skhem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jakarieh jongngi u .
translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Leit bad ïaheh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dat uta u ban teh ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan shong .
translation.en: Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :

translation.kha: Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka Don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka set U jongu hangta .
translation.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .

translation.kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tad ynda u dep tei pat ïa ka Jerusha , malu pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha kaba ka pyrthei barabor kawei ka ïaroh .
translation.en: And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .
She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .
translation.kha: Kan long ka pansngiat ka burom ha phi .
Ka Leah ka don ki khmied ibha i-lub , katba ka Rakhel pat ka long i-lub bad kaba bhabriew .
translation.en: Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .
And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ u la lap ïa ki briew kiba ïadie ïa ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki paro , bad ki nongïapeiñ pisa ruh ki ïashong ha ki miej jong ki .
Ka Esther ka jubab ,
translation.en: Then answered Esther , and said , My petition and my request is  ;

translation.kha: U tip ïa kaei kambah u leh ! U phah ka jingjop . U phah ïa ki jingbyrngem ban pynshitom ïa ki briew Ibbah sniew bad kito ibha ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki nongbah ka Israel yn pyndeng khong , kumta ba ïa ki duwan jong ki bad ki bleithaw) jong ki yn pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai , ïa ki duwan jingiwbih jong ki yn pynpra lyngkhot lyngngai , malade ïa ki jingtei jongki ki barieh yn sa pynjot napoh .
translation.en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste , and the high places shall be desolate  ; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate , and your idols may be broken and cease , and your images may be cut down , and your works may be abolished .

translation.kha: Don sa kaei kaei kawei patar kaba nga la ïohi , ka nongshna kaban bha shaphang kumno ïa ka jingstad la ñiew ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :

Then Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , was astonished for one hour , and his thoughts troubled him . The king spake , and said , Belteshazzar , let not the dream , or the interpretation thereof , trouble thee . Belteshazzar answered and said , My lord , the dream be to them that hate thee , and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies .
translation.kha: Ha kane , u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar , u la sngewsheptieng katta katta ba um lah ban ong ei ei . U syiem u la ong ha u ,  Ko Belteshassar , wat ai ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka khubor jong ka kin pynsheptieng ïa me .  U Belteshassar u la phai ktien ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kwah ba ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai ïa ka kan dei ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad ym ïa phi .

Baroh ki jingkheiñbriew kin shakri ïa u , bad kin shakri ïa u khulom bad u khun ksiew jong u kad ïaheh ba ka por lai wan ïa ka hima jong u hi ban kyllon . Te ka jaitbynriew jong u kan shakri ïa ki jaitbynriew badonbor bad ïa ki syiem bakhraw .
translation.en: And all nations shall serve him , and his son , and his son s son , until the very time of his land come : and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba don U ti , u don ïa kano ka jingim ; uno Une u bym don U Khun U Blei , um don ka jingtem .
translation.en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .

Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity  ; yea , thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity  ;
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym rung shapoh ka nongbah jong ki briew jong nga ban risa beiñ halor ki jingshah shitom jong ki bad ban kurup ïa ka spah jong ki ha ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: We having the same spirit of faith , according as it is written , I believed , and therefore have I spoken ; we also believe , and therefore speak ;
translation.kha: Ka jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la kren namar nga la ngeit .  Ha kajuh ka mynsiem jong ka jingngeit ngi ruh ngi kren namar ba ngi ngeit .
Da husiar ban ym shah ïalam bakla noh na U tharai ban mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: Take heed to yourselves , that your heart be not deceived , and ye turn aside , and serve other gods , and worship them  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kiba banbeiñ ïa pha ban ïa-pynïap para ma ki ; kin shu buaid ha kaba pynïap briew bad ha ka jingbitar . nongthaw u bynriew baroh un tip ba nga erlangthari U Trai’ , uta uba pynim ïa pha bad uba pyllew ïa pha . Kin tip ba to long U balui bakhlaiñbor jong ki Jesreel .
translation.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh  ; and they shall be drunken with their own blood , as with sweet wine : and all flesh shall know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .

translation.kha: Phi pan ïa u syiem bad ki nongïalam , hynrei mynta kum ki lah ban pyllait im ïa ka ri ?
translation.en: I will be thy king : where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities ? and thy judges of whom thou saidst , Give me a king and princes ?
And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .
translation.kha: Haba ka Rebekka ka ïohi ïa u Isaak , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,
Kana ka lama ka jingmut jong ka pharshi : U symbai u long ka ktien U Blei .
translation.en: Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .

translation.kha: Ki la kmen namar kata ka jingjai jai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingma bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka kadlieng kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet  ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .
Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .
translation.kha: Phi la ïadon bad nga ha baroh ki jingshah tynjuh jong nga ;
U la shim hima shibun ka rnong na Betah bad na bahryntieh , ki nongbah kiba la synshar da u Hadadeser .
translation.en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .
When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
translation.kha: Haba nga la pyndep ïa kane ka kam bad ba nga la dep aiti sha ki ïa baroh ka pisa ïa kaba la dep pynmih na ka bynta jong ki , ngan sa mih ban leit sha Spain bad wan khmih artat ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti shata .
pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kmen dup long kiba khuid janai bad ïa uno une ne kiei kaei kaba pynbuaid ïa ki yn pynkynroi da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .

translation.kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la ithuh sha lyngkha bad u lap ïa ki mandriek , kiba u la wanrah sha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Ka Rakem ka ong ïa ka Leah , Ai lem kato kattne ki mandriek jong u khun jyllang Phah .
translation.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .

translation.kha: Ki turoi ïalap kum ki khla-ka-wait ; ki kiew ïa ki kynram kum ki shipai . Ki baroh ki ïatur beit shuh khmat bad kim phai sha kadiang ne kamon
translation.en: They shall run like mighty men  ; they shall climb the wall like men of war  ; and they shall march every one on his ways , and they shall not break their ranks :

translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la pyngngad , bad u la tip aiñ u khun khatduh jong u , u la har ïa u ,
translation.en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Consider ye , and call for the mourning women , that they may come  ; and send for cunning women , that they may come :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba jia ! Khot ïa ki nongïambriew ban wan , ïa ki kynthei kiba rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew .
Men ehrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh Wan phai shuh .
translation.en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .

translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u ong , Te kumta , shah ngan ïohi katto katto ngut ki briew jong nga bad phi . Jamynrei u Jakob u ong , Ym da donkam ba-bang leh kumta namar na khwai tang ban Ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong pa .
translation.en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .
translation.kha: Ngam don jingsuk , jingjahthait , bad ki jingjynjar jong nga kim don jingkut .
Haba u Judah bad ki hynmen ki para jong u ki la Wan sha ïing u Jakob , ki shem ba u dang don hi hangta .
translation.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph s house  ; for he was yet there : and they fell before him on the ground .

translation.kha: hato phim pat shym la ïakren bad ki bynriew Kiba longing jingleit ? Hato phim tip) ïa ki jingïathuh ba ki wahbah ?
translation.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u shim noh ïa ki na u , bad u nguh u dem ïa u haduh madan .

translation.en: For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong :  Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ki nongwei .

Haba sakma ka por ka pra , ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa ka jingïathuhkhana jong Phi kum ka nuksa ïa ka jingpynjot , bun kin rhah ïa khnai ka jingrwai sngewsih ïa ka jingshem jongu phi : La pynjot taïew ïa ngi ! U Trai u la shim noh ïa ka ri jong im’ bad u la ai ïa ka sha tun kiba la kyrkhu koidi ïa ngi .
translation.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngim tipthuh kumno pat ba mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah lad u . Khloi ïa u ; u la biang ka rta , bad u lah ban jubab da lade hi !
translation.en: But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .

translation.kha: wai shna ïa ka jingnguh katba don ki kyrduh kiba kiaw shata ka ; lada phiah leh kumta , phi pynnep khleh akor ïa lade haba phi kiew ïa ki .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon .

translation.kha: Uta u kpu u dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei ban smam ïa u ha ka iaka ka kynoi , naba uta u long ka pyntwa kaba kynjai eh na ki jingsuh bam ba la kñia sha U Tlai na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah : but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him .
translation.kha: U Amasa u la leit khot ïa ki , hynrei um shym poi ha ka por ba u syiem u la buh .
malu u Ia , uba na ka shnong Jakarieh u Long ruh uwei na ki lyngdoh Jong u Dabid .
translation.en: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David .

translation.kha: ibha U Khrist u la ïaid lyngba kane ka ïingjaiñ dara rung tang shisien shapoh ka Joah Bakyntang Tam , um shym la shim ïa ka snam ki blang bad ki maw ktung ban ainguh kum ka jingkylla ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jongki ka snam , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingim bymsuidñiew na ka bynta jongu ngi .
translation.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .

translation.kha: Pdeng ka thma u Syiem Jehosadak u la shah siat da ki khnam u nong Ijipt . U praw ïa la ki shakri , Rah noh ïa nga ; Nga la mynsaw jreiñ !
translation.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah  ; and the king said to his servants , Have me away  ; for I am sore wounded .
If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;
translation.kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba kyrduh , uba duk palat ban ïoh thied jaiñ thied nep ,

U angel jong u khun sahmiet jongnga ka hima Persia u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga haduh arphew wei sngi . Nangta u Mikhael , uwei na ki jin rangbah , u la wan ban ïarap ïa nga , namar nga la shah iehnoh marwei hangta ha Persia .
translation.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days : but , lo , Michael , one of the chief princes , came to help me  ; and I remained there with the kings of Persia .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngem ka khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Shimei Sered , ha u Nisan , u bnai baryngkhiang , u Haman u la hukum ngab kynting sbai ( la Khot ïa ki , purim ) banbeiñ shym ïa ka sngi bad u bnai babiang ban pyntreikam ïa “kata ka jingsylla jong u . La rai baneh pyntreikam ha ka sngi kiba khatlai jong u Adam , u bnai uba khar .
translation.en: In the first month , that is , the month Nisan , in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus , they cast Pur , that is , the lot , before Haman from day to day , and from month to month , to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar .
And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Mynta hangne , kane ka briew kaba hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllait ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
lait tang kawei ka nga la pyrsad dam haba la ïeng ha khmat jong ki : ‘ Ïa la la bishar da ma phi ha kñia ka snieh naba nga beit ba kiba ïap kin sa mihpat .’
translation.en: Except it be for this one voice , that I cried standing among them , Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day .
And the king said , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Ahimaaz answered , When Joab sent the king s servant , and me thy servant , I saw a great tumult , but I knew not what it was .
translation.kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  U syiem u kylli . U Ahimaas u jubab ,  Kynrad , haba u Joab u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u phah ïa nga , nga ïohi ïa ka jingkhihwin kaba jur , hynrei ngam tip ka dei kaei .
Phi la ong ïa kiei ktien kiba shyrkhei shaphang jong nga , ong U Terah . Hynñiew phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba sem la ong shaphang jong me ?’
translation.en: Your words have been stout against me , saith the  Lord . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee ?

translation.kha: Wat tim ïa u briew uba kyllut lane kdew Buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jynthut Hamor iathuh . Tiengburom ïa ar ; nga lama U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut te ki la batai ha ki ïa kaei kambah la jia ha kata ka lynti , bad ba kumno ki la tah ïa U Troas mynjur u la kdiah ïa u kpu .
translation.en: And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .

translation.kha: Ka jingïatyllilang bad ka jingïatreilang ka pynlah ïa ngi ban lumlang kulai kloi ïa ki jingïalap bun ïa ki nongtrei ha ka por ba donkam .
translation.en: The unity that we enjoy as an organization and the experience we have gained in working together enable us to mobilize quickly in times of need .
So Absalom fled , and went to Geshur , and was there three years .
translation.kha: U Absalom u la phet krad bad u la leit sha u Talmai , u khun jong u Ammihud , u syiem Geshur bad u la sah hangta lai snem . U Dabid u la ïambriew slem na ka bynta u Amnon u khun jong u ;

translation.en: And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?
translation.kha: Kan myntoi aïu da kaba ong ha ki ,  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi ! To phong syaid bad to bam bha !  — lada phim ai ha ki ïa ki jingdonkam jong ka jingim ?

Bad I la phah ïa u tikmie , u parabangeit jong i'u uba ïatrei lem bad ngi na ka bynta U Blei ha kaba ïalaw ïa ka Khebar Babha shaneng U Khrist . Ngi la phah ïa u ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi bad ïahap ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ,
translation.en: And sent Timothy , our brother , and minister of God , and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ , to establish you , and to comfort you concerning your faith :

translation.kha: Haba ki khop ïa ar , kun jubab ïa ki ; haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar , ngan long ryngkat bad ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad ngan pyndonburom ïa ki .
translation.en: He shall call upon me , and I will answer him : I will be with him in trouble  ; I will deliver him , and honour him .

translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei paw ki la ïa-ong , U briew uba shongksuid um lah ban kren kumne ! Kumjuh u ksuid u lah ban ai jingïoh imat pat ïa ki briew kiba matlah ?
translation.en: Others said , These are not the words of him that hath a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind ?

translation.kha: Da lei lei U Trai un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba U Trai u la pynlong syiem ! To ngin ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khiew um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit neh .
translation.en: The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .

translation.kha: U Solomon mynta u un-long u symboh .
translation.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u da ka jingpang bad ka jingïa-umsnam . Ïa u lehbha lapsan bad u phria , ryngkat bad ka ding bad u kyndok , ngan theh nong ha u bad ha ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kiba ïasah liang nabar u .
translation.en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood  ; and I will rain upon him , and upon his bands , and upon the many people that are with him , an overflowing rain , and great hailstones , fire , and brimstone .

translation.kha: Pynban , kumba la nong ha katba katne ki jaka ha ki Jingthoh bakynjah : U briew u long aïu , A Blei , ba Men pyrkhat ïa u , tang uba kyntu briew , ba lad shitaiew ïa u ?
translation.en: But one in a certain place testified , saying , What is man , that thou art mindful of him ? or the son of man , that thou visitest him ?
Which when they had taken up , they used helps , undergirding the ship  ; and , fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands , strake sail , and so were driven .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntiew ïa ka , bad ki la teh katto katne ki tyllai sawdong ïa ka lieng . Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki lah ban tyngkhuh sha ka jaka kaba don shyiap jngai na ka rud duriaw jong ka Libya , kumta ki la pynhiar ïa ki jaiñ pynshah lyer bad ki la shah ïa ka lieng ban shah kit da ka lyer .
Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki kitei tur pyrshah ïa ki kynum shipor Bethmeon bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrsad ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U Trai u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka longkmie ka jaitbynriew katba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jingtipbriew kabu ïa ka ktieh jongki ka phim tip .
translation.en: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .

translation.kha: Kim sumar ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki la khyllem , lymne ba ki teh pat ïa ki kynroh , bad kumta ym lah ban ïada ïa ka Jeruel haba wan ka tdem ha ka sngi ka jrong U tharai .
translation.en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps , neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kine ki sawphew snem ki jaiñkup jyllang pa kim shym man rim badno ki kjat jong phira ruh ki shym at .
translation.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .
And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .
translation.kha: Don uba la ïathuh ha ka Tamar ba u kthaw kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .
‘ Tei ïa ki ïohnang bad shongduh . Thaw ki kper mala bam ïa kaei kaba phi thung hangta .
translation.en: Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;
I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long kata ka jingkhang . Uno uno uba rung shapoh da nga un ïoh im ; kin ïohrung shapoh bad mih shabar bad shem ïa ka jaka bam phlang .
ngat u Phestos , hadien ba u la ïakren bad ki nongai jingot jong u , u la jaboh , Me la apil sha u Pahath , kumta Sha u Patsha men leit .
translation.en: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Caesar ? unto Caesar shalt thou go .
Send me also cedar trees , fir trees , and algum trees , out of Lebanon : for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon  ; and , behold , my servants shall be with thy servants ,
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ka jingtbit jong ki nongot dieng jong phi , kumta to phah ïa nga ki dieng Kedar , ki dieng Kseh-Sypress , bad ki dieng Kseh-Juniper tylli na Lebanon .

Ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa kine ki jingïohpdiang lyngdoh : ka jingdeng shadem , ka Ebed , ka barandi , ka slap ba la suh pynpaw itynnat , ka jingïohpdiang , bad ka jaiñ panpoh . Kin suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynraiñ jong u khnang ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And these are the garments which they shall make  ; a breastplate , and an ephod , and a robe , and a broidered coat , a mitre , and a girdle : and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother , and his sons , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: U shongkurim ïa ki ki haba U Trai u la hukum ïa ki Israel don ym shongkha khleh bad kine ki brisoh , nabar kyang pynlong ïa ki Israel ban mane ïa kyiuh ki blei .
translation.en: Of the nations concerning which the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall not go in to them , neither shall they come in unto you : for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods : Solomon clave unto these in love .
But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , u la leit noh na kata ka jaka , bad bun ki briew ki la bud ïa u . U la pynkhiah ïa kito baroh kiba pang
Kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl , kine ki aiñ ki ïarep ïa ngi ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew manbriew , ban burom ïa kiwei , nabar ban long kiba sbak bad ibha leh hok .
translation.en: These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .
And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , bun na ki briew , kynthup ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki sdang ban ujor pyrshah ïa ki para Jiw jong ki .

to phlait im ïa kiwei , da kaban knieh kynthet ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pah , to isynei da ka jingsheptieng , hynriew to da isih ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki hi , kiba la bit tngit da ki jingwoh brai bapop .
translation.en: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
translation.kha: Te , nga kyrpad ïa phi , ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkmen jong nga da kaba don kijuh ki jingpyrkhat , kiba ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingieit , bad kiba don kawei ka mynsiem bad ka jingmut .

translation.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone , and salt , and burning , that it is not sown , nor beareth , nor any grass groweth therein , like the overthrow of Sodom , and Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the  Lord  overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath :
translation.kha: Ki lyngkha kin long shrah bad kin ym seisoh shuh , naba kin dap da u kyndok bad ka mluh suda ; yn ym thung ei ei hangta , bad wat u ñiut ruh , un ym mih hangta . Ka ri jong phi kan long kum ki shnong Sodom bad Gomorrah , kum ka Admah bad ka Seboiim , ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pynjot mynba u bitar shla .

translation.en: For it is better , if the will of God be so , that ye suffer for well doing , than for evil doing .
translation.kha: Naba ka kham bha ban shahshitom haba leh ïa kaba bha , lada kane shisha ka long ka mon U Blei , ban ïa kaba leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Blei u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan .

U shakri uba la ïohpdiang San hajuh tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ai ïa kiwei ki sa hajar . ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga san hajar tylli ki shabi ,’ u la ong . ‘ Ha khmied ! Kino hangne sa san hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’
translation.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .
Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .
translation.kha: Nga la kren palat ïa kaba nga dei ban kren .
Ha shuwa ba ka por jong u kan kut , un ïapstai noh , un ïapstai noh kum ki tnat bun ktang ym jyrngam biang .
translation.en: It shall be accomplished before his time , and his branch shall not be green .
And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak , saying , Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; and a calf and a lamb , both of the first year , without blemish , for a burnt offering  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa uwei u  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , uwei u khun masi uba shisnem , bad uwei u khunlangbrot uba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang ,

translation.en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u pyn-i shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , ba ïa ka lynti sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ym pat lah ban plie , katba kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .
translation.kha: To sngap noh na ka jingïam jong phi bad to ñiad noh ïa ki ummat jong phi . Baroh kiba phi la leh na ka bynta ki khun jong phi kin ym long lehnoh-ei ; kin wan phai pat na ka ri u nongshun .

translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .
Teng pynkoit ïa me na ka kun jongki ki rangbah bymman sad kiba leh jubor . Ma to , U Trei , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .
If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki Israel ki ïakajia , bad ki leit sha ka ïingbishar , ki nongbishar kin rai pynksan ïa uba hok bad pynrem ïa uba leh palat .

translation.en: And Joseph said , Give your cattle  ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Lada phim don pisa shuh , wallam ïa ki jingri jong phi ; te ngan ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad kita ki jingri .
