translation.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years : and Terah died in Haran .
translation.kha: U Terah u la ïap hangta ha ka rta kaba arspah san snem .
Hato don mano myn ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki duh kiba Sikhri ïa u ? Hato don kano kano ka jaka kaba ka jingshai U Blei kam lah ban tyngshaiñ ?
translation.en: Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .
translation.kha: un pynshlur ïa phi bad pynshaitbor ïa phi ban ïai leh bad kren ïa kaei kaba bha .

translation.en: And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .
translation.kha: U Joab u la hukum ban put ïa ka turoi ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel .
U Trai U Blei jyllang phi un pynlong ïa phi katba kohnguh suda , haneng ba phin ieit ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad ba phin ïasheptieng ha kata ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will circumcise thine heart , and the heart of thy seed , to love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , that thou mayest live .

translation.kha: kamut phi la kylla long ka nuksa ïa kiba ngeit baroh ha Makedonia bad ha Akhaïa .
translation.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia .

So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me .
translation.kha: Hadien habud phin sa shem da kaba suk lada nga lah lehhok . Haba phin wan ban khmih ïa ka bainong jong nga , lada nga don ki blang ki bym thohbria bad ki bym thohbroin , lane kino kino ki khunlangbrot ki bym ïong , phin tip ba nga la tuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath , even they shall keep the watch of the house of the  Lord  about the king .
translation.kha: Ki ar kynhun kiba lait ban wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki dei ban ïeng ap phira ha ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .

Ki rangbah nongsynshar jong u ki buh ïa ka tat jong u ha ka kada ïapom bad kit ïa ka sha Jerusalem , ha kaba la Thep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Ki briew ka Judah ki la jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah , bad pynslem syiem ïa u .
translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo , and brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own sepulchre . And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father s stead .
And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks , that , behold , every man s bundle of money was in his sack : and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money , they were afraid .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang pynthylli ïa la ki byrni , uwei pa uwei u lap ïa la ka pla pisa ha ka byrni jong u ; bad haba ki la ïohi ïa ka pisa , ma ki bad u kpa jong ki u Jakob ki la ïasheptieng .
U balui hi da lade u la buh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ba-bang kham ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met uba donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :
Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves  ; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the  Lord  spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire :
translation.kha: Mynba U  Trai  u kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha u Lum Sinai , phim shym la ïohi ïa kano kano ka dur .

translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Katno phi la bakla ! Bad phi tip balei ? Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid lane ïa ka bor jong U Blei .

Lyngba u Elieser u para jong u Gershom u don ka jingïadei Bad u Shallekheth . U Elieser u dei u kpa jong u Rehabaïah , uba dien u kpa jong u Jehoash , u kpa jong u Jehoram , u kpu jong u Sikhri , u khop jongngi u Shelomith .
translation.en: And his brethren by Eliezer  ; Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomith his son .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kylla diengïap ha ki maw ba la ohdur hajan jingsleh , u la leit biang shai u Eglon , bad u ino , Susim Kynrad , nga don ka khubor Beraïah na ka bniat jong phi . Kumta u syiem u hukum ïa la ki shakri , Ieh ïa ngi tang baroh ar ngut ! Bad baroh ki la ïamih shabar .
translation.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ïalam dara me katto katne nongput ki nongïam jong ki Israel , bad leit shaei shuwa jong u paidbah . Rah ruh ïa u diengduh da kaba me la shoh ïa ka wah Nain .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .

translation.kha: U Benhadad : ki nongbah Arubboth bad Sokoh mala baroh ka ri Hepher
translation.en: The son of Hesed , in Aruboth  ; to him pertained Soco , and all the land of Hepher :

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngewbha to ïasah mem mynta hati , ba nga lah ban ïoh tipthuh aïu pat U Trai un ong ha nga .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray you , tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the  Lord  will say unto me more .

translation.kha: Nangta u Job u jubab ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then Job answered the  Lord  , and said ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh bapop , bad na ka pynbha kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynïoh Bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynther katba punkhun ha Gilead .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :

translation.kha: Mynba ki ding samla , ki shong ki sah ha Ijipt , ki la duh noh ka jinglong sotti bad ki kila long ki nuti .
translation.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt  ; they committed whoredoms in their youth : there were their breasts pressed , and there they bruised the teats of their virginity .

translation.kha: Naba U Massah u la ino , ‘ U Trai kaba U Blei jong phin un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la pha ïa nga , bad un long uwei na ki briew jong phi hi . Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u ong ïa phi Ban leh .
translation.en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you .
He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him .
translation.kha: Lada ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba bha , yn ñiewkor ïa phi , hynrei lada phi wad ïa ka jingjynjar , kata ka long kaei kaba phin ïoh .

translation.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , lada shah ïa uta u trai ban siew da ka kuna , ban pyllait im ïa u , u dei ban siew dep ïa ka dor kaba dei ban siew .
Hynrei u Petros u la lang ïa sakma , Ko kynthei , ngam ju ithuh ïa u !
translation.en: And he denied him , saying , Woman , I know him not .

And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Na kane ka jingkerkut , ka jingkyrduh bam ha ka nongbah ka la long kaba jur katta katta kat haduh ba kawei ka khlieh kada ka shongdor phraphew ki sbai rupa , bad arspah gram ka eit paro    ka shongdor san sbai rupa .

Hynrei um shym bhah ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlor . Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban u la ïoh ïa barieh ki jingri kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri kiba khlaiñ .
translation.en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .

translation.kha: Ki dieng ki la ïadep da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la bam ei ei na ka namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingairam ka jong u Saul .
translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .

translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane blem ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai umbiah hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Mamre ha kaba ai burom ïa U Trai hynñiew sneng lynter , bad wat trei Kanah katno ka ki .
translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :

translation.kha: Ngam pat shitrhem la thop hi ba u dei ma u , hynrei U blang , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis da ka um , u la ïai-ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïor ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar malade u shongsah ha u brai ; u dei uta , uba pynbaptis da U Mynsngi Bakhuid .’
translation.en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkien u nongthaw kyiuh , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .
translation.en: And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .

translation.kha: Kumta myntor U Trai , U Blei ki Ishmael , uba la pyllait ïa u Abraham na ka jingjynjar , u ong , Ko ki briew jong na , phin ym shah pynlehrain thuh , bad ki khmat jong phi kin ym i-blad shuh da ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , who redeemed Abraham , concerning the house of Jacob , Jacob shall not now be ashamed , neither shall his face now wax pale .

translation.kha: Naba i'u ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki , To wan kiew shane ! Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang khmih , ki la keiñ shata bneng ha u liewlong .
translation.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha uta u briew , wiang shane sha khmat .
translation.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand ,  Stand forth .

translation.kha: U Kain mala la ka tnga ki la ïoh khun shynrang bad ki la kyrteng ïa u , U iehnoh . Nangta u Kain u la tei ka nongbeh bad u la kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kylleng u khun jong u .
translation.en: And Cain knew his wife  ; and she conceived , and bare Enoch : and he builded a city , and called the name of the city , after the name of his son , Enoch .

translation.kha: Ïa kane Baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .
translation.en: And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka long ka umpohliew jong ka jingim ha kiba stad , hynrei kaba pyrshang shun ai jinghikai ïa kiba mutlop ka lama tang ka jingpynlut kai ïa ka por .
translation.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it : but the instruction of fools is folly .

translation.kha: Uwei pa nawei u lat uba don ha ka kam ha shuwa jong nga , u la long ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju daiñ sawphew ki pisa rupa shuh sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki sharati jong ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam shym ai kumta , namar nga burom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .

translation.kha: Phi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ngab leh ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh . Ngim shym la hir kiba Jedidah mynba sem la don malade phi .
translation.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
Ye shall dwell in booths seven days  ; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths :
translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki dei ban shong hynñiew sngi ha ki ïingtrep ,
Ngin hap ban shah ïa ki ba kin im namar ka ïakular jong ngi ; lada ngim leh kumta , U Blei un pynshitom ïa ngi .
translation.en: This we will do to them  ; we will even let them live , lest wrath be upon us , because of the oath which we sware unto them .

translation.kha: Phi la shem ïa ki jakarieh ha kaba ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ki donkam ïa ka jingshna pynbha . Phi la leit khmih ïa ki ïing baroh ha Jerusalem bad phi la pynkhyllem Katto katne na ki ban ïoh ki mawjam ban sha pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki briew Jong ki jaitbynriew baroh yn lumlang ha khmat jong u . Nangta un phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun , wohnia u nongaplangbrot u pynïakhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .
translation.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations : and he shall separate them one from another , as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats :

translation.kha: Kumta to kieng myntoi ïa ka jingkhein atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phin lah ban ïeng ïabah pyrshah ïa ki bor ïaleh u nongshun ; bad hadien ba ka jingïaleh ka la ngut , phin dang ïeng skhem ha ka nongrim jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .

translation.kha: “Nga har ïa kane Khnang ba Baroh na Kaei ka tduh jongki ka pyrthei shah kawei pat ka tduh kan pyntip ba sa longsyiem U Trai bad ym don uwei pat U Blei .
translation.en: That they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is none beside me . I am the  Lord  , and there is none else .

translation.kha: Un longsem u briew uba khraw ha khmut U Troas . Um dei don dih kano kano ka waiñ lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem bakhatduh ,
translation.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .
And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam long tang kumta ; ngi lehkmen na ka bynta kaei kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba mynta u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong U Blei .
Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymneh ha ka ri shyiap nabar tynjuh ïa U blei ;
translation.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la nguh , Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kynrad ! Kata ka la biang ! u la jubab .
translation.en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .

Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .
translation.kha: Mar kumta , u khot kyrkieh ïa u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong u , bad u hukum ïa u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn ong ba ka kynthei ka la pynïap ïa nga .  Kumta u samla u dung lyngba ïa u , bad u la ïap .
Kine ki long ki khun ki ksuid na u Shimham , u Ham , bad u Jogbehah , ki khun shynrang jong u Noah . Kine para nongput ki la ïoh khuid shynrang hadien kata ka jingsleh um .
translation.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor! ïa ki , ki la pyrshah , longkmie ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing lad u ! Ki la ni ïew na ka bynda jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Jerusalem’ , ïa ngin ithuh noh sha ïinglieng ! To ai ba u Rekhab un khmied hi ïa lade !
translation.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .

translation.kha: La donkam ïa ka Baibl kaba suiñ ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: A Bible was needed that was easy to understand .

translation.kha: Phin mane ïa ki blang pynkharoi da kaba ïathiah shongkha hapoh ki dieng bathngan jong phi ; pa’ ai ïa la ki khun kum ki jingkñia Hapoh ki synrang mawlynnai harud ki phud wahduid .
translation.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree , slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks ?
And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
translation.kha: Wat mih shabar ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh phi ïap , namar la pynkyntang ïa phi da ka umphniang pynsleh jong U  Trai .  Kumta ki la leh kumba u Moses u la ong .
Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki dong kiba shaneng jong ka jingdeng shadem ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold , and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .
And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad u shah ba ki Philistia kin synshar ïa ki sawphew snem .
Bad U Terah u ong ha kito ki nongwei kiba la pynïasoh bad ki briew jong u , Kiba ieit ïa u bad kiba shakri ïa u , kiba sumar ïa ka Sabakhthani bad kiba bamatlah ïa ka jutang jong u .
translation.en: Also the sons of the stranger , that join themselves to the  Lord  , to serve him , and to love the name of the  Lord  , to be his servants , every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and taketh hold of my covenant  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jongki u , Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa phi u shahshkor ïa nga ; du uno suba kynjat ïa phi u kyntait ïa nga ; Bad uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga u kyntait ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: He that heareth you heareth me  ; and he that despiseth you despiseth me  ; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa la ka kmie bad ïa u synran ïa uba u ieit ba ki ïa-ïeng hangta ; te u la ong ha la ka kmie , Une u long u khun jong phi .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother ,  Woman , behold thy son !

translation.kha: Kumta u Sadok bad u Ahijah ki bah biang ïa ka syndah ka Jutang shat Jeroham bad ki sah hangta .
translation.en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem : and they tarried there .

translation.kha: Ha U Khrist ju , la pynjop ïa ngi lakam bad u , ba ngin ïoh synshar lem bad u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: wiat la kum ki apostol jong U Kiriath ngi lah ban dawa na phi . Hynrei ngi la Long kaba jai jai mynjur ngi la don bad phi , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa ki khun lad ka .
translation.en: But we were gentle among you , even as a nurse cherisheth her children :

translation.kha: Ka jingrisa ka buddien ïa ki nongpop kylleng , hynrei ki briew kiba hok kin ïoh bainong da ktieh kiei kiba bha .
translation.en: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .

translation.kha: Ïa kiba ngeit yn ai ka bor ban leh ïa ki kaweh : Kin beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; ktang kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher ;
translation.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe  ; In my name shall they cast out devils  ; they shall speak with new tongues  ;
And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa ki shakri jong phi , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , bad un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jong u .

translation.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions : for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto .
translation.kha: khnang ba yn ym don mano mano na phi ban phai dien noh namar kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ . Phi hi phi ïatip ba kiba kum kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ ki long ka bynta jong ka mon U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi .
Shisien shisnem , la buh ïa kaei ka sngi ban pynkhuid bha nadong shadong .
translation.en: At least once a year , a day is set aside to do a major cleaning .

translation.kha: U Dedan u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka thain jong ka Engedi , ha kaba u la sah ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: And David went up from thence , and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi .
And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
translation.kha: Me hi men ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ka ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
Harud ki wah ka Babilon ngi la shong ; hangta ine ïam haba ngi kynthrong ïa ka Shisien .
translation.en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
And many among them shall stumble , and fall , and be broken , and be snared , and be taken .
translation.kha: Kiba bun kin jynthut ; kin kyllon bad kin shah pynlwet . Yn pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingriam .
dalade um lai kumta , un kit hi ïa la ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .

translation.kha: Ki rang bahryntieh ki long ki rangbah kiba shlur tam jong ka Kedar , hynrei tang khyndiat na ki yn iehnoh , nga U Trai U Blei ki Jeriel , nga la kren .
translation.en: And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .
Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
translation.kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .

Bad U Trai u la ong ïa ki bariew ka Jerusalem , Ngan shithi na ka bynta jong phi bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin hap siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa phi . Ngam pynrngad ïa ki tyllong um jong ka Babilonia bad ngan pynjrong ïa ki wah jong ka ban tyrkhong .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will plead thy cause , and take vengeance for thee  ; and I will dry up her sea , and make her springs dry .

translation.kha: Uto na ki , uba kyrteng u Katba u ong , Ngan ai ïa ka khun jongngi por ka Akhsah baneh shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha Kaba kurup ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .
translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .

translation.kha: Lada Un uno u thop ïa phi na kawei ka ngab , ai ba un thab sa ïa kadei shiah ; lada eit uno u shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong Phi , ai ba un shim ruh ïa ka sopti-poh jong phi .
translation.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other  ; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also .
And the servants of Saul told him , saying , On this manner spake David .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki ïathuh ha u Saul ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong ,
Namar ba u pynbuh khong ïa ki jaka mane bleithaw thala bad ki duwan jingiw na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Jehoïada , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hapoh ka jingshlur jong u .
translation.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .

translation.kha: Na ka jait u khot ki mih ki longïing jong u Ammiel , u Isaïah , u Hebron , malade u Ussiel .
translation.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri ki pyrshang ban pynduh mynsiem bad pyntieng ïa ki Jiw bad ban khanglad ïa ka jingtrei .
Ngan ai ha u ïa ka ibit kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki jingtrei jongki u , namar ka kynhun shipai jyllang u ka twa na ka bynta jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , to la kren-ïa .
translation.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it , because they wrought for me , saith the Lord  God .

For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee , and the spoil of beasts , which made them afraid , because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
translation.kha: Phi la pynduh ïa ki khlaw ka Lebanon ; mynta yn pyndkut ïa phi . Phi la pynïap ïa ki mrad ha ka ; mynta ki mrad kin pyntriem ïa phi . Kane kan jia namar ki kam pynïap ba phi la leh bad namar ki kam leh jubor pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongbah jong ka .

translation.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes , even to Ben–hail , and to Obadiah , and to Zechariah , and to Nethaneel , and to Michaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u phah ïa kine ki rangbah synshar ban hikai ha ki nongbah ka Judah : u Benhail , u Obadaïah , u Sekharaïah , u Nethanel bad u Mikaïah .

translation.en: Either his uncle , or his uncle s son , may redeem him , or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him  ; or if he be able , he may redeem himself .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynmen ki para jong u lane u kñi jong u lane u bakha jong u lane uwei na ki kur bajan jong u , u lah ban thied biang ïa u ; lane lada u la ïoh kynshew haduh ban da biang , u hi u lah ban thied biang ïa la ka jinglaitluid .
Kumjuh u la Pha sa uwei pat u mraw ; hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa une ruh , ki da leh pynjahburom ïa u , bad ki la phah nala thylli ïa u .
translation.en: And again he sent another servant : and they beat him also , and entreated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .

translation.kha: Ki mraw kin ïaid kad hangta , malade ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma ki . U mrad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangtai bad un wad jaka shongthait .
translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .

translation.kha: Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïawad ? Lane hato Phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga Ban ong ha phi shapoh kane ? Kato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , sam ym leh kumta!
translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .

translation.kha: ka khmat namsop ka khmat , ka bnai namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , ka kjap namar ka khait ,
translation.en: Eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Abda u phet na Naïoth kaba ha ramhah bad u leit sha u Jonathan . Kaei kaban nga la leh ? u kylli . Ka kim sniew aïu nga la leh ? Ka kam palat Aïu nga la leh ïa i pa jong phi ba i da thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translation.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?

translation.kha: ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki paid Judah ; ngan pyllait im ïa ki paid Israel . Ngan kein ka jingsngewkhia ïa ki bun ngan wallam pat ïa ki baroh sha ïing . Kin long kum kba ngam pat ju kyntait ïa ki . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki ; sam jubab ïa ki jingrwai jong ki .
translation.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them  ; for I have mercy upon them : and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the  Lord  their God , and will hear them .

translation.kha: Lada don u para Israel uba kyrhuh ha katno kano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U Trai’ U Blei jong phin u ai ha phi , kam khim mynsiem bad waiñ kyntait ïa-ban ïarap ïa u ;
translation.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :

translation.kha: U angel uba jingsuk u la leit bad u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jngai u ha ka pyrthei . Ki prum kiba shyrkhei bad kiba tyrha ki la Mih ha kito bakha la don ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ha kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u .
translation.en: And the first went , and poured out his vial upon the earth  ; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast , and upon them which worshipped his image .

translation.kha: Nga la wan ba ki khun shynrang kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki , ki khun kynthei ïa-pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki , ki pyrsa kurim kynther pyrshah ïa ki kiaw kurim jong ki ;
translation.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father , and the daughter against her mother , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .

translation.kha: Kiba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba wan mih bad ki ong ha u , Pyni ïa ngi kumno ngaiñ ïohrung Shabeh ka nongbah bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translation.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , ‘ Ngi dei ki shakri Jong U Blei ka banyngkong bad ka khynwin , bad ngi tei pat ïa ka Templ kaba lah dep tei pynlang pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat buiñ snem mynshuwa da u syiem bakhrawbor ka Israel .
translation.en: And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .

Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :
translation.kha: ngan jynrat noh ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïing ïa kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

Hynrei ma phi! , phiah long ki jong U Blei , ko ki khun jong nga , bad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , namar U Mynsiem uba don ha phi , u long uba kham donbor ba ïa u mynsiem ha kito kiba un-long na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .

translation.kha: Ïa ki rmiang jong ki shisnem la tap da ki khmat .
translation.en: As for their rings , they were so high that they were dreadful  ; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four .

translation.kha: Te lada uno Un u kylli ïa u , ‘ Kiei kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phiah ?’ Un jingbabe , ‘ Nga la ïoh ïa ki ha ka ïing u paralok .’
translation.en: And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .

translation.kha: Ita uba ai ïa ka jingphla jong u ha kane baroh , u ïai-ong , Ho-oid da shisha ! Nga wanpaw kloi ! Ai kan long kumta . To wan , Trai Jingsuk !
translation.en: He which testifieth these things saith ,  Surely I come quickly .  Amen . Even so , come , Lord Jesus .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngew jong u mana long ha ki kulai bakhlaiñbor ; lymne ka jingkmen jong u ha ki Shiphew bashlur ;
translation.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynphong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , ruma u Jotham , u ïakhun jong u Gideon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tdem ïa ki .
translation.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .

translation.kha: Mynta ki thiah khlem don batip ha ki lynti bah , ïa ki durkhmat jongngi ki la pynïong ha ka jingpah ; ka sniehdoh jong ki , ka tyrkhong kum ka diengkhap , ka la sti halor ki shyieng Jong ki .
translation.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .
translation.kha: Ki da sngewsih kthang eh namar u la lah ong ba kin ym ïohi shuh ïa u . Bad kumta ki la ïaleit bad u sha ka lieng .

translation.en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam don Blei .

U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u bhabriew , me ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ? Khmih ïa kito kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki paid Israel ki leh stong , ban eh noh ïa ar sha jongngi bad kham sha jngai na ka jaka bakhuid jong per . Men dang ïohi shuh ïa Kiei kiei kiba kham pynjahburom ban ïa Kanah .
translation.en: He said furthermore unto me , Son of man , seest thou what they do ? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here , that I should go far off from my sanctuary ? but turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations .
Then were the men exceedingly afraid , and said unto him , Why hast thou done this ? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the  Lord  , because he had told them .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la ong shuh shuh ïa ki ba u la phet na U  Trai . Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei , bad ki la ong ïa u ,  Kata ka long kaei kaei kaba sngewma ban leh !

U syiem u la klet ïa ka jingshakri pahuh ba u Jehoïada , u kpa jyllang u Sekharaïah u la ai ïa u , bad u la phah pynïap ïa u Sekharaïah . shwa ba u Sekharaïah un ïarap , u pyrta , Ai ba U Trai un ïohi ïa kawei kabu phi leh bad un pynshitom ïa phi !
translation.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him , but slew his son . And when he died , he said , The  Lord  look upon it , and require it .

translation.kha: Ka jinglum ka longsem ka jingriam — ka pynngat ïa kito kiba U Troas u pisa .
translation.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .

translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la dap pynkhihwin khathynñiew snem ka rta , U Trai u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong , Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Kohnguh ïa nga bad ïai leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .

translation.kha: Wat buaid da ka waiñ , ha kaba kan pynjot ïa phi ; pynban , to long uba la pyndap da U Mynsiem .
translation.en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
And with them , by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men : for they had many wives and sons .
translation.kha: Ki ïoh shibun ki tnga bad ki khun , haduh ba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki lah ban pynmih laiphew hynriew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
U Rehoboam u Jubab , Ai ïa nga para sngi ba sam pyrkhat ïa ken ka kam . Nongthaw sa wan pat . kamut kita ki briew ki leit noh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .
In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .
translation.kha: Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong nga junom .  Kumta u ong U  Trai  uba pynim ïa pha .
Shen phin sa lah ban leit ïalap ryngkat malu kiwei pat ki para bat jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka shnong jong phin .
translation.en: In time , you may qualify to begin preaching with the local congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka nongbud Soan ki dei ki bieit ! Ki briew kiba stad tad jong ka jingïap ki ai ka jingai jingmut ba khlem pyrkhat bha ! Kumno ki nguid ban ïathuh ïa u syiem ba ki dei ki nongmih bujli ïa ki riewstad hyndai bad ïa ki Syiem ?
translation.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools , the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish : how say ye unto Pharaoh , I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings ?

translation.kha: Phi ktang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U Trai ! Kato slem phin ïai talain ïa ka ? Khie leit pha nong sha ka jingsop , kamar-tama hangta bad shongthait !’
translation.en: O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .

translation.kha: A katto-katne ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa Phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pynpra lieh , kiba pynitynnat ha kaba shalor hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki mihpat bapyut ha kaba shapoh .
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .
translation.kha: Da lei lei U  Trai  un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem ! To ngin ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khiew um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit noh .

Ka Rakhel ka ong ha la u kpa , Wat bitar ïa nga , ko kynrad , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi! , nga dang poi bnai . U Laban u la Wad , hynrei um khim la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .
translation.en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab , ‘ Ïateh ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , bun da la ka Mynsiem baroh , da la ka jingkhlaiñ baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh’ ; malu ‘ Ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’
translation.en: And he answering said , Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy strength , and with all thy mind  ; and thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran katba ki ïalang ïabam . U la kriah tyngeh ïa ki , namar kim syiem la don jingbymngeit bad namar ka jingmutlop palat ïa ka ban ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .
translation.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne .
translation.kha: U Khunlangbrot u la leit bad u la shim ïa ka kot kli na ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet .
Phin sa shah ïa kajuh ka jingpyndem kum ki riewkyrpang ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi malu pynlong ïa phi ban siew na ka bynta ka jingsniew ba phi har .
translation.en: And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .
Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Let me now choose out twelve thousand men , and I will arise and pursue after David this night :
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien kata , u Ahithophel u ong ha u Absalom ,  Shah ngan jied khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah , bad ha kane ka miet ngan mih ban leit thwet ïa u Dabid .
Susah haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa Kanah ka hukum : Wat leit noh na Israel , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba nga la ïathuh , ka jingshai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la pynkulmar .
translation.en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .

Should ye not hear the words which the  Lord  hath cried by the former prophets , when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when men inhabited the south and the plain ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa ha ka por mynba ka Jerusalem ka dang manbha bad dap da ki briew bad mynba dang don bun ki briew kiba shong basah ym tang ha ki shnong sawdong ïa ka nongbah hynrei kumjuh ruh ha ka phang bashathie bad ha ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi .
U pynim ïa ki na iba uba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .

translation.kha: Nga la pynkhamti ïa pha , hynrei kam shym wanrah kano nangno ka jingbha ; phan ym da la shait ïa nga ban pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba jingshyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .
translation.en: In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .

translation.kha: ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jaiñ jong u bad batip khah ïa u .
translation.en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .

translation.kha: Lada u bariew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jngai u , baroh ar ngut ktien ïap khlem khun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pyneh burom ïa la u hynmen .
translation.en: And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba dap da ki sohwaiñ . Katba ki nang manla , katta ki kada tei kham bun ki Eri . kabu ka ri jong ki ka nang pahuh , katta ruh ki kai pynitynnat ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang ba ki mane .
translation.en: Israel is an empty vine , he bringeth forth fruit unto himself : according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars  ; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images .

translation.kha: Nangta uta u rangbah ai lawlynnong u la thoh ïa ka shiah kumne :
translation.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner :

And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ? that thou shalt answer , For the tidings  ; because it cometh : and every heart shall melt , and all hands shall be feeble , and every spirit shall faint , and all knees shall be weak as water : behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me balei ba me ud , ïathuh ïa ki ba ka long na ka daw ka khubor kaba la ïohpdiang . Haba ka wan , ki dohnud jong ki kin dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki kti jong kin noh kyrwep , ka jingshlur jong ki kan duh , bad ki khohsiew jong ki kin kyiuh . Ka por ka la poi ; ka long hangne .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .
translation.kha: Te ngan lah ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .

translation.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish , and a ram out of the flock without blemish .
translation.kha: Haba me la dep ban leh ïa kata , shim ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot lud , baroh ar na ki , ki bym don kino kino ki jingduna , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
Ki shakri jngai u ki la leit sha ka ha Khlem bad ki ong ha ka , U Dabid u la phah ïa sem ban shim ïa phi sha u ban long ka tnen jong u .
translation.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel , they spake unto her , saying , David sent us unto thee , to take thee to him to wife .

translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren na u liewlong , Une u long U Khun jong nga , uba nga la jied — shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .

translation.kha: Naduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jongki u bnai ibha nyngkong haduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong uta u bnai , phi ym ïapom ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translation.en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even , ye shall eat unleavened bread , until the one and twentieth day of the month at even .

translation.kha: ki briew ki khoh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiarap myntor bad ki kylli , Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ? Lada ngi phah ibiang ïa ka sha ka jaka jong ka da-ei ngin phah jingkad bad ka ?
translation.en: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , What shall we do to the ark of the  Lord  ? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place .
Even all that the  Lord  hath commanded you by the hand of Moses , from the day that the  Lord  commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations  ;
translation.kha: Bad lehse hadien habud ka kynhun kam lah ban leh lut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , u lah ban ïarap ïa kita kiba shah pynshoi , namar ma u hi u la shah pynshoi bad shahshitom .

translation.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even unto this day , rising early and protesting , saying , Obey my voice .
translation.kha: Haba nga wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , nga la maham kyntang ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga la ïai maham ïa ki briew tad haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .
translation.kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun ïapom jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ïa ka nongbah Ar ha Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki lum ka Arnon bashaneng .
Kynsan U Trai u phah ïa ka ding , bad kata ka tdong ïa ki hangta ha khmat jong U Trai hapoh ba kin da ïarap .
translation.en: And there went out fire from the  Lord  , and devoured them , and they died before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba haka noh , ka dei ka jingweng kabu pynïap ; hynrei ha Kito kiba la pynim , ka long ka jingiwbih kob wallam jingim . Uei keiñ , uba lah ngab leh ïa kabu kum kata ka kam ?
translation.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?

translation.kha: Hato u sing u ju kyrduh ha khlaw lymda u la lap ei ei ban kynran ? Hato u sing samla u ju byrngem ha la skum lymda u la ïohkem ei ei ?
translation.en: Will a lion roar in the forest , when he hath no prey ? will a young lion cry out of his den , if he have taken nothing ?
And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ïap tang shisien , bad hadien kata yn bishar da U Blei .

translation.en: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei uba khlaiñ bam , da synshar bha ïa lade .

translation.en: For if the woman be not covered , let her also be shorn : but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven , let her be covered .
translation.kha: Lada ka briew kam tap ïa la ka khlieh , ka lah ban khapnoh ïa la u shñiuh . Bad namar ba ka long kaba ikhlem-akor ïa ka briew ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ne khap ïa la u shñiuh , ka dei ban tap ïa la ka khlieh .

translation.en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .
translation.kha: Bad khlem da pynpaw ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei , man ka sngi la ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .
Ko Pharisi Baaltamar ! To pynkhuid nyngkong ïa kaei katba Shobab jrong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !
translation.en: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Asa u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Ha kata ka sngaid ngan pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba nga la kren marpyrshah ïa ka ïing u Eli , nud kaba sdang haduh naba kut .
translation.en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house : when I begin , I will also make an end .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , baroh ki kam skul jong u bad ki thma jong u , la buh jingbthuh ha Ka Histori jongu Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , and his might that he shewed , and how he warred , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: To thep ïa ki dkhot doh babha kynrei tam — ki tyrpeng bad ki kjat — pynpdang ïa u ruh da ki kyrkhoit shyieng ba la jied .
translation.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it , even every good piece , the thigh , and the shoulder  ; fill it with the choice bones .

translation.kha: U Trai u phah ïa u angel babha pynap ïa ki shipai badno ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria . Te u patsha u leit pha pat sha Assyria ha ka jinglehrain . Ha Kawei ka sngi ibha u dang don ha ka templ jong U Blei jong u , kattne katei na ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pynïap ïa u da la ki waitlam .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent an angel , which cut off all the mighty men of valour , and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria . So he returned with shame of face to his own land . And when he was come into the house of his god , they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword .

translation.kha: Nalor sakma ka dem ban long kaba la shongkurim tang shisyndon bad donnam ha ki nang babha : Ka briew kaba la pynsan pynbiang bha ïa la ki Kynhun , kaba pdiang ïa ki nongwei ha ka ïing jong ka , kaba imat ïa ki Kam rit na ka beit ki pansngiat , kaba ïarap ïa ki briew kiba khong ha ka jingjynjar , bad kaba aiti ïa lade ha kaban leh ïa kambah bha .
translation.en: Well reported of for good works ; if she have brought up children , if she have lodged strangers , if she have washed the saints  feet , if she have relieved the afflicted , if she have diligently followed every good work .
In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga la wan ha me ban ïoh jingïada ; wat shah da lei lei ba ngan shahjop !
kaei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ka Mano bad kohnguh ha ïa la u jong u plie , ishyrkhei ine ngin mano bad kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi junom la junom .
translation.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the  Lord  our God for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Jehoaddin u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalum ïa ki Israel shipai Snem .
translation.en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .

translation.kha: U shim jingkheiñ ïa baroh ki shynrang Lebi kiba la don laiphew snep lane tam . Baroh ki Don laiphew phra khar ngut .
translation.en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh kawei .
U Gad u la leit sha U Dabid , u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong , bad u kylli , Kano men jied ?
translation.en: So Gad came to David , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Choose thee

translation.kha: Hynrei u hynmen jong ka Rebekka bad ka kmie jong ka ki ong , Ai ba ka Rekem lai sah shuwa bad ngi shi taïew ne laiphew sngi , bad hynne kata ka lah ban leit .
translation.en: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten  ; after that she shall go .

( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .
translation.kha: U Hiram jong ka Tyros u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksiar ruh , katba u donkam . Ynda la dep tei ïa ki , u Syiem Solomon u ai ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka thain Galilaïa .
ban ong ha ki paid Israel , Jadon ïa ki nongbah jakarieh kiba nga la hukum ha u Moses ba-bang ïathuh ha phi .
translation.en: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :

translation.kha: U Judas bad u Siloam , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur badno ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
translation.en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .

translation.kha: Kumta Lada ka khmat kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , khlaw noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh ne syang bynta na ka met jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei yn shiah bran sha ka dkoh .
translation.en: And if thy right eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw bad uba ryñiot , u pyrshah ban shen pipa da ka jingbymlah ; thew ki nongïalap bad ki lyngdoh ki thoh ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .

translation.kha: Ngan pyntieng kynsan ïa ki nongshun jong pa’ . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit katba Phi nang tur sha lamkhmat .
translation.en: And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u la haka ong ha u Moses , U Pharaoh un ïaw kyntait ban shahshkor ïa phi khring ba nga eh ban leh khamtam bun ki kambah jong ar ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei malu ba U mynsngi U Blei u shongduh hapoh jong phi !
translation.en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?
And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki leh palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh .
sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun bad phi lah ban sngewhun borabor ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shahskhor lehrain .
translation.en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .

translation.kha: Nga ong ïa kane namar ngi don ka jingsngewskhem ha U Blei lyngba U Khereth .
translation.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward :

translation.kha: Ïa nga la thaw ha kob sdang eh , ha kiba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei tud sdang .
translation.en: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ka Assyria u ïoh jingtip ba u patsha u la mihnoh na Lakhish bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka nongbeh Libnah ka don marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban twad jingtim na u .
translation.en: So Rab–shakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ki jingjubab bastad jong u .
bad thang ïa ki blei — ki bym long da shisha ki balieh , tang ki tuh da ka Dieng bad u maw ba la thaw da ki ki ki briew .
translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .

translation.kha: Ha lyndet ka jingkah kaba ar la don ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaba la khot ka Jaka kaba ktang Tam .
translation.en: And after the second veil , the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all  ;
I wish you'd quit throwing things at me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin sangeh kawang tiar ha nga .

translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .
translation.kha: haduh ba u patsha un pynshong pynsah pat ïa phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai sohwaiñ bad yn don ki kew ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phin im . Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ba phin pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ym don uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei lymda kha pat ïa u .

Kine ki long ki ktien u Amos , u khunlangbrot na ka shnong Tekoa . Ar snem shuwa u jumai , mynba u Ussaïah u long u syiad ka Judith , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Israhaïah , U blei u la pynpaw ha u Amos ïa kine ktieh kiei Baroh shaphang ki Israel .
translation.en: The words of Amos , who was among the herdmen of Tekoa , which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel , two years before the earthquake .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u pynlyngkhuit ïa la ki rangbah ba kim dei ban ktah kti ïa u Saul . U Saul u ïeng joit , u mihnoh na ka krem , bad u longing noh .
translation.en: So David stayed his servants with these words , and suffered them not to rise against Saul . But Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi ki ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka dei kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U tharai , nga la krensih .
translation.en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .
And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ki  rang bahryntieh ki long ki rangbah kiba shlur tam jong ka Kedar , hynrei tang khyndiat na ki yn iehnoh , nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la kren .

translation.en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
translation.kha: Kata ka ri ba phin sa ïohkynti kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , haba phi bet ïa u symbai , phi hap ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha ;

translation.en: And humbled not himself before the  Lord  , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself  ; but Amon trespassed more and more .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym long uba pynrit ïa lade bad phai sha U  Trai  ; u kham long uba pop ban ïa kaba long u kpa jong u .
Kumta U Trai u kutlad ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria bad u khun jongnga u , u Henadad ban jop ïa ki Israel na ka por sha ka por .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael , all their days .

translation.kha: Ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohi kumno u Pethor bad u Ïoannis ki la long katba shlur bad ban tip ba ki Long ki riewpaidbah ki bymnang bymstad . Ki la sngewthuh te ba ki la long ki nongsynran jong U Jisu .
translation.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled  ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .

translation.kha: U la jied ïa u Jehosabad na ka bynshet ïa lade , ïa ki paidlang Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .

translation.kha: U Barnabas u la long u briew uba Bha , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingngeit , mala bun ki briew la wallam sha U Tlai .
translation.en: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Haba ïa u Lebi ym pat shyiap la kha , hynrei u la long , khim ban shwa ong , ha ka jingsawa u kper thlim jong u , u Abraham haba u Malkhiel u la ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .

translation.kha: u rung shapoh ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Heldai kata u ong , Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad thet ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u sahmiet .
translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ba ki synran jong u ki dang ïaleh shitom ha ki babit , namar ki dang king pyrshah ïa ka lyer , kumta katto katne prie hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep u la wan sha ki , da ka ïaid halor ka um . U la don jingmut ban ïaid isih jong ki ,
translation.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing  ; for the wind was contrary unto them : and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them , walking upon the sea , and would have passed by them .

translation.kha: U hajuh u mih na Jesreel ngab ithuh sha Semar . Ha lynti , ha ka khang ba la khet Ka Jaka Sah ki Nophah longsem ,
translation.en: And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,

translation.kha: Long naba sbun , bad pher manbha . Ïarap ïa kiwei , malu yn ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .

translation.kha: Bad ka doh jongno ki kynja ba-im kam long kajuh ka jaiñ ; u bynriew u don kawei ka jait doh , ki mrad da kawei pat , ki jah da kawei , bad ki dohkha da kawei pat .
translation.en: All flesh is not the same flesh : but there is one kind of flesh of men , another flesh of beasts , another of fishes , and another of birds .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phyrnai jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad tyngeh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jingñiewbeiñ kiba kham khriat bad kham donbok Ban ïa Phin . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .
translation.en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,

translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa naba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkñia ieit Thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynraiñ jngai u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , badno u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translation.en: And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .

translation.kha: Te ki Briew jong ki shiah baher kin khot ïa phi kiba skul , Naamah ka ri jong phi kun long ka jaka kaba bha ban shong ban sah .
translation.en: And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kaba lah jia ha ki apostol .

translation.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city , and no city shall escape : the valley also shall perish , and the plain shall be destroyed , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ka ban lait na ka jingpynjot ; ki ri them bad ki ri thor kin shah pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Shah ba ngan mat ar tylli kiei ktieh ; to mynjur ïa ki , bad ngan nongmih pyrshang shun buhrieh na me : to syngkhlieh noh ban pynshitom ïa nga , bad wat khñiot ïa nga da ka jingsngewkmen .
translation.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me : and let not thy dread make me afraid .

translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Phrygia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun katba bashispah ngut bad ibha shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki brai jong u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Ahikam .
translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .

translation.kha: U jongu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “ka sngew kyndit ia kan , namar ka por ka la khia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jingbang tat kin ioh sngaid ia ka jingtynrah jong u badno kin ia mih noh .” —Ioanis 5 :28 , 29 ; Ki Kam 24 :15 .
translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out .”—John 5 :28 , 29  ; Acts 24 :15 .
For I know that in me ( that is , in my flesh , ) dwelleth no good thing : for to will is present with me ; but how to perform that which is good I find not .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba kaba bha kam im hapoh jong nga — kata , ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong nga . Naba wat la ka jingkwah ban leh ïa kaba bha ka don hapoh jong nga , ngam lah ban leh ïa ka .
Harhas jong Kaei pa kawei ka surok pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh sdien .
translation.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place , and hast made thee an high place in every street .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , ym kein uwei pat kum ma me ; im thup borabor ba me Long tang ma me marwei U Blei! .
translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

translation.kha: Ha ka Snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Joram naba ar u sahmiet ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Amasaïah u long u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .
Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,
translation.kha: Katba baroh ki paidbah ki dang shahshkor ïa u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,

U Besalel u shna ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah kawei-na-kaba-shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewspah hynñiewphew sentimitar ka pynbiang , bad hynriewphew hynriewspah sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half was the length of it , and a cubit and a half the breadth of it , and a cubit and a half the height of it :
But the  Lord  was with Joseph , and shewed him mercy , and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad kyrkhu ïa u , ba kumta u nongap byndi u la sngewbha eh ïa u .
Da ka bor bakhraw jong u , U Trai u la maham ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lynti ba ki briew ki la bud . U ong ,
translation.en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,

translation.kha: Katba dang Pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Messaïah ha u babha , ki peh ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei Ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nongri Moab ban ïasnohlang malade ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym burom ïa U Khun um burom ïa U Kpa suba la phah ïa u .
translation.en: That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .

translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki long kum u ribon bakhatduh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba phi kren . Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translation.en: I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?

translation.kha: U angel uba ar u la bud ïa uba nongdih , u da Ong , Ka la kyllon ! Ka bapyllun Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Ka la pynlong ïa ki bhabriew baroh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ kaba khor jong ka jingkyiuh brai khlem akor !
translation.en: And there followed another angel , saying , Babylon is fallen , is fallen , that great city , because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication .

translation.kha: Don U Troas uba ai ïa ka jingstad ; na u ka wan ka jingtip nabar ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: For the  Lord  giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .

translation.kha: Ka kti U Trai kan sa Wan ha me myntri ; men sa matlah bad men ym ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngap shipor . Mar kumta hi u Elumas u la sngew ba u lyoh khyndew uba ïong u la tap ïa ki khmat jongu u , bad u la ïaid kylleng da kaba pyrshang ban wad ïano ïano ban ïabam ïa u na ka kti .
translation.en: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness  ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .
After the number of the days in which ye searched the land , even forty days , each day for a year , shall ye bear your iniquities , even forty years , and ye shall know my breach of promise .
translation.kha: Phin shah jynjar sawphew snem namar ka pop jong phi , kawei kawei ka snem na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi na kita ki sawphew sngi ba phi la pynlut ha kaba swar ïa ka ri . Te phin sa sngewthuh ka long kumno haba nga ïeng pyrshah ïa phi !

Lada phalang sngap jar ha ka por kum kane , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , bun kin lait im , ishyrkhei phan ïap , badno ka longïing u kpa jyllang pha Kan kut noh . Pynban mano ba lah ban tap — lehse ka dei na ka bynta ka por kum kane ba la pynong mahadei ïa Phah !
translation.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?

translation.kha: Haoid hynñiew sngi ki Sarai bad ki Israel ki shong ha la ki jaka sher dara marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat . Ha ka sngap kaba hynñiew , ki sdang ïa ka jingïaleh , malade ki Israel ki pynïap da ki spah hajar ki Syria .
translation.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days . And so it was , that in the seventh day the battle was joined : and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day .

translation.kha: Mynta , khie leit ! Ngan ïarap ïa me ban kren , malu ngan ïathuh ïa me aïu men ïong .
translation.en: Now therefore go , and I will be with thy mouth , and teach thee what thou shalt say .
And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
translation.kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lai , u la ong ïa ki ,  Hato phi dang ïohthiah bad dang shongthait ? Ka la biang ! Ka kynta ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U Khun U Briew yn ai noh mynta ha ka bor jong ki briew kiba pop .
Ki jingpynnang : phi lah ban bang kawei ha la ka kti , hynrei phi lah ruh don shem ïa ki ha ki ïingsyiem .
translation.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings  palaces .

translation.kha: U syiem un ym suidñiew ïa u blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la shakri , bad ruh ïa u blei ba ki kyntiap ki iktiar . Ha ka jingbishar un ym suidñiew ïa uno uno u blei , namar un pyrkhat ba u kham khraw ban ïa isangsot uno na ki .
translation.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers , nor the desire of women , nor regard any god : for he shall magnify himself above all .
And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps : there was not the like made in any kingdom .
translation.kha: Ka khet ka don hynriew kyrdon ban kiew shajrong ïa ka , ka don ka dur u sing uwei uwei ha ki tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyndon . Ba baroh ka long khat-ar tylli ki sing . Hadien jong ka khet la don ka dur khlieh jong u khun masi dab , bad ha syndah kawei pa kawei na ki ar tylli ki jingbat kti don ka dur jong u sing . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .
Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod ba kin Ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel , kumba U Trai’ u la hukum ïa u Mysia .
translation.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  um pat ju la kren bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .

translation.en: This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :
translation.kha: U long ma u , uba la ïadon lem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ha ka ri shyiap ; u la don lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lem bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , bad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ban ai pateng ha ngi .
Wat kwah rhah ïa ka ïing u paramarjan jong phi ; wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong u , lane ïa ki mraw jong u , lane ïa ki masi jongno u , lane ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei ruh kaba dei ka jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s house , thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s wife , nor his manservant , nor his maidservant , nor his ox , nor his ass , nor any thing that is thy neighbour s .
But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
Te u Dabid u la pyntngen ïa ka Bathsheba ka tnga jong u . U la ïathiah shongkha bad ka ; nabar ka la kha khun shynriah , ïa babha u Daberath u la ai ktung u Solomon . U Trai u la ieit ïa u khynnah ,
translation.en: And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife , and went in unto her , and lay with her : and she bare a son , and he called his name Solomon : and the  Lord  loved him .

translation.kha: Ki den ban pynbiang ïa ki Kamra jong ki sha me bad ïa la ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka ïinglieng , hynrei kim bit ban pyndei ïa ki tiew kiba khuid ha ka Jaka Kyntang , lane ïa ka rangli . Lada ki leh kumta , ïa ki bad ïa me yn pynpaw noh .
translation.en: And they shall keep thy charge , and the charge of all the tabernacle : only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar , that neither they , nor ye also , die .

translation.kha: To ngin pyrkhat ktah uwei ïa uwei pat , ban ïarap uwei ïa iwei pah , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingïa-ieit bad ban lehbha .
translation.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :
And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .
translation.kha: To ai ha ki ïa kine ki jinghikai , khnang ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .
wat pyneh ïa la ka doh , kumba ki kop tymmen jongki phi ki la long hir ki la ïaleh pyrsa ïa U Blei , kumba ki la longkmie ha —kata ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap haba ki la tynjuh ïa U .
translation.en: Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :

translation.kha: Ngi sngewkmen haba ngi long kiba malu hynrei phi longsem kiba khlaiñ . Bad kumta ngi duwai ruh ba phin long kiba janai .
translation.en: For we are glad , when we are weak , and ye are strong : and this also we wish , even your perfection .

translation.kha: Lada u dei u nongsynshar uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa khawai na ki hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: When a ruler hath sinned , and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  his God concerning things which should not be done , and is guilty  ;

translation.kha: Uta kaba set bad iathuh babha ai um kdor long ei ei da shisha . Dei U Blei uba kongsan , namar u pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san .
translation.en: So then neither is he that planteth any thing , neither he that watereth ; but God that giveth the increase .
And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .
