translation.kha: Ka Athalaïah ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu mar ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem .

Ki lyngngoh , kiba shakri ïa U Trai hateng ka duwan bad ka bakwah rung ka Templ , ki dei ban ïam Bad ïamudui : To isynei ïa la ki briew , A Trai . To wat ai ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewsang ïa ngi da kaba ong , ‘ Hangno U Blei jong phin ?’
translation.en: Let the priests , the ministers of the  Lord  , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , Spare thy people , O  Lord  , and give not thine heritage to reproach , that the heathen should rule over them : wherefore should they say among the people , Where is their God ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Isaia ki la bor pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ki la shang ban sharai ïa ki Baal .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :

translation.kha: Ki la don ruh katto katne tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynta kine bad u la ong ïa ki synran ban sam ïa ki ruh .
translation.en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .

translation.kha: Ishod ki peh ha Jeraïah , ki la sdang ïa ka kam .
translation.en: So he went with them . And when they came to Jordan , they cut down wood .
I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet , nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum u briew . U la wan sha nga , ba la ker sawdong da u lyoh , bad u la leit sha uta uba la im junom bad la ai sngewbha ha u .
U Maaseïah u jaboh , Nga dei ba-bang leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki ïawan sha por ban tip ïa ka ma U Blei .
translation.en: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :

translation.kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Me ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki ong ? Ho-oid nga ïohsngew , la jubab U jongu . Phim pat la ju pule ïa khie ka Jingthoh bakhadduh ? ‘ Me la hikai ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ban ai ki jingïaroh bajanai .’
translation.en: And said unto him , Hearest thou what these say ? And Jesus saith unto them ,  Yea  ; have ye never read , Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kumno lada katne katai na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato khie ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?
translation.en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?

translation.kha: U apostol Paulos u la ong ha kadei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha phi yn pyniasngew tngen lem ia nga bad Phi , da la ka jingbymngeit jingngeit . . . ka jong phi ruh malu ka jong nga de .”
translation.en: The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit ba-ieit jongnga ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ieit ïa phi malade ba u la jied ïa phi ban long ki lad u hi .
translation.en: Knowing , brethren beloved , your election of God .

translation.kha: Pynban ka jingkyrmen ka Wan phai haba nga kynmaw ïa kane kawei :
translation.en: This I recall to my mind , therefore have I hope .
Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ; ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong u .
U Reuben , U Simeon , U Lebi , U Judah ,
translation.en: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jesreel ki kyang jar , Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa i'u ! Ki jingmong jongngi ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !
translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingshai sha ki jaka ba-dap tliw kum ka jingïap .
translation.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .

translation.kha: U Jeshua u la jubab ïa ki , Ka kynta ka la poi mynta ïa U Khun U Briew ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bur kaba khraw .
translation.en: And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .

translation.kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumto ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Syria kiba naphang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis bad buhai ïa ki hapoh ka jingai hukum u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shiphang u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sobah .
translation.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Keturah .
Bad lehbha ki la bam Bad dei , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpanpoh ïa ki hi .
translation.en: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?
But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ïa kaei kaba hapoh ki khuri bad ki pliang jong phi ha kiba duk , bad kiei kiei baroh kin long kiba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phi .

Nga long u kpu suba im uba la wiang hiar na bneng . ïada uno du u bam ïa une u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka thoh jyllang nga , ïa kiba at ai khñiang ba ka pyrthuh kan ïoh im .
translation.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .

translation.kha: Ka aiñ ka tlot bad kam myntoi ei ei , bad ym ju don ka jingbishar khak . Ki bri uba snem ki ïor ïa kaba kham bha ban ïa kiba hok , malu kumta ïa ka jingbishar hok la pyngngad .
translation.en: Therefore the law is slacked , and judgment doth never go forth : for the wicked doth compass about the righteous  ; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth .
Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei kan don . Hangne ka don ka duwan ha kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ki jingainguh thang .

Wat la u syiem Jehosheba u shong u sah ha Jerusalem , u leit borabor sha ki briew , na Beersheba shaphang shathie shaw kaba kut jong ka ri lum Ephron shaphang shatei , khnang ban khot pat ïa ki briew sha U Trai , U blang lad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .

translation.kha: U sdang da ka jingkren bieit bad u Kut ha ka jinglamwir .
translation.en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .

And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .
translation.kha: Wah ïa kata ka pyrda na ki jingpyndait kiba don hapoh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba don ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap buh ïa ka sha lyndet ka pyrda . Kata ka pyrda kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam .

translation.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller : as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki la knieh bad la rah noh kum ka jinglute .
Ki Israel ki ïaleh kumta , don kiba lum kham bun , kiwei pateng ki lum kham khyndiat .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so , and gathered , some more , some less .
Everything done at a branch contributes to the orderly accomplishment of the preaching work . —1 Corinthians 14 :33 , 40 .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba la leh ha ka tnad treikam ka wanrah ïa ka jingryntih ha ka kam ïalap . —1 Korinth 14 :33 , 40 .

translation.en: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u namar ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh . To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ba-halor tam jong u .
Ai ba kin pyrta jam katba ki ïahiar ïa U Blei , sad ki waitlam banep ha ki ktah jong ki
translation.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth , and a twoedged sword in their hand  ;

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka hukum ka long kaba bha lada pyndonkam ïa ka kumba dei .
translation.en: But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully ;

translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ïa u da ka ñianglartham haba u pan ïa ka pyrkhing ?
translation.en: Or if he shall ask an egg , will he offer him a scorpion ?
Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one .
translation.kha: San sien la shoh ïa nga laiphew khyndai thri da ki Jiw ; lai sien la sympat ïa nga da ki nong Rom ; bad shisien nga la shah lynthem maw .

translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings , which have received no kingdom as yet  ; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki bym pat shym la sdang ban synshar , hynrei ki ban sa ïoh ka iktiar ban synshar kum ki syiem tang shi kynta bad u mradkhlaw .

translation.en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingmut ba-bieit jong u ki la ïalam bakla ïa u ha kaba u don sha lyndet ka jingïarap . Un ym pdiang ha lade ba ka bleithaw ba u bat ha ka kti jong u kam long satia ka blei .

translation.en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;
translation.kha: Katba dang pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Moses ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nong Moab ban ïasnohlang bad ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .
translation.kha: Kawei ka kupar ka wan kumjuh ha baroh , bad kane ka long kaba bakla kum kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , bad kynsan kynsan ki ïap .
Ka jingmaham jong me ka paw da kiei kaba me kren ; me ïapyrshang ba-bang buhrieh ha lyndet ki ktien sian jong me .
translation.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .

translation.kha: Ïalam ar thylli ki masi dab ; ai ba ki nongïohipaw jong u Baalgad kin shimet uwei , pynpei ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga hati ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei patiaw u masi Dabid .
translation.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :

translation.kha: U dieng Seeb u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynda shun syier ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam ba-bang pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translation.en: But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.kha: U diengkhap umbiah plung um pynmih u soh uba sngewieit , lymne u dieng uba swai ïa u seh uba bha .
translation.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit  ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .

And now will I shew thee the truth . Behold , there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia  ; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all : and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia .
translation.kha: Bad kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ïa me ka long kaba shisha .  U angel u la ong ,  Sa lai ngut ki syiem kin synshar halor ka Persia , yn bud sa uba saw , u ban kham riewspah ban ïa baroh kiwei pat . Haba u la khlaiñbor bha bad riewspah eh un kob ïa ka hima Gris .
Ïa ki bymman la pynrem da ka jingleh jubor jong ki hi ; ki kynjat ban leh ïa kaei kaba de .
translation.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them  ; because they refuse to do judgment .
And we have sent with them our brother , whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things , but now much more diligent , upon the great confidence which I have in you .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi phah ïa u parabangeit jong ngi lem bad ki ; ngi la tynjuh ïa u bunsien bad ngi la shem ïa u ba u long borabor uba thrang ban ïarap . Bad mynta ba u la don haduh katta ïa ka jingshaniah ïa phi , u nang kham thrang shuh shuh ban ïarap .
Mynta , A Trai U Bel jong im’ , to ïapyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khnang ba barabor ki Hima ka pyrthei kin tip) ba tang ma me hi , U Trai , me long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , I beseech thee , save thou us out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  God , even thou only .

translation.kha: Ka la long lai snem haduh ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem don ïoh jingmihpat na u Petros , bad nga la sah bad u ar taïew .
translation.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter , and abode with him fifteen days .
And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .
translation.kha: bad nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk .

translation.en: And Jahzah , and Kedemoth , and Mephaath ,
translation.kha: ka Jahas , ka Kedemoth , ka Mephaath ,

Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jongno u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka syntiew ka Jutang U Trai . Kumta ki khyllie badno buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .
translation.en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
And they , continuing daily with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread from house to house , did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart ,
translation.kha: Na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat ki ju ïakynduh kum ka kynhun hapoh ka Templ , bad ki ïabam jingbam lang ha ki ïing jong ki , ki da bam da ka dohnud kaba kmen bad kaba sngewrit ,

translation.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ailad ba ngan ïoh doh ïa la ki khun ksiew bad ki khun kynthei jong nga . Kato ka long ka kam bieit ban leh !

translation.en: His troops come together , and raise up their way against me , and encamp round about my tabernacle .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ; ki tih ïa ki kharai ban rieh bad ki kerkut ïa ka ïingjaiñ jong nga .
U Jubab u ïapmat ïa ka Rakhel , kumta u ong , Ngan trei hynriew snem na ka bynta jong phi , lama phi shuh ba ngan sohkhram ïa ka Rakhel .
translation.en: And Jacob loved Rachel  ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .

translation.kha: Nangta u Tattenai , u lat , u Sephath Bosenai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki la leh thiah ruma u patsha u la hukum .
translation.en: Then Tatnai , governor on this side the river , Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , according to that which Darius the king had sent , so they did speedily .

translation.kha: Katba ka jingïaleh ka dang bteng phangpdeng ki kynhun jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïashoh ïa ka longïing jong u Saul , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .

translation.kha: Don u ban ong , Nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano . Ho-oid , hynrei ym barieh kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa phi . Nga lah ban ong ba ar eh ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa kano kane ban pyntong ïa nga u mraw jong ka .
translation.en: All things are lawful unto me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but I will not be brought under the power of any .

translation.kha: Shimei ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jngai phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba pa’ ne ha ïing bad ïahap phi ïaid ha lynti , long phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phin ktah .
translation.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .

translation.kha: Kin long babha pawnam hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , uwei pa ti uba ïohi ïa ki un tip ba ki long ki brisoh ïa kiba nga la kyrkhu .
translation.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles , and their offspring among the people : all that see them shall acknowledge them , that they are the seed which the  Lord  hath blessed .

And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .
translation.kha: Nangta sa khot bad buh da ka kynhun shipai kaba ka jingbun paid ka long kat kato kaba la phai dien noh na phi , buh katjuh ka jingbun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki .  U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur bad bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki .

translation.en: So there was a division among the people because of him .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng u paidbah namar U Jisu .

translation.en: Why did you tell him to go ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ong ia u ban leit noh ?
U Jiw u la jubab , Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingsma : Ym don uba haka ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U balui lymda kha patiaw ïa u .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la ïap shabar ka nongbah , khnang ban pynkhuid ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .

translation.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo , to the top of Pisgah , that is over against Jericho . And the  Lord  shewed him all the land of Gilead , unto Dan ,
translation.kha: U Moses u leit kiew na ri them Moab sha u Lum Nebo haduh kliar jong u Lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi na Jerikho , bad nangta U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei : ka ri Gilead shaduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei ;
Phin ïoh ïa ka jingbam baroh kaba phi kwah .
translation.en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle , that thou mayest eat and be full .
How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
translation.kha: Kumno te ba phim shemphang ba ngam shym kren ha phi shaphang u kpu ? To sumar ïa lade na u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi !
Uno uno uba pyrshah ïa ka bor kambah synshar , u pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la lawlynnong ; bad uno uno uba leh kumta un wallam ka jingbishar pynrem halor lade hi .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .

translation.kha: dalade U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jrong phi , te ithuh kaba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ïa ki met ba kynja doh jongnga phi da ka jingdon U Mynsiem jong u hajuh jongnga phi .
translation.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jliah kumta khnang ba u Abimelekh bun ki rangbah ka Shekhem , ibha la pynshlur ïa u banbeiñ pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon , kin siew na ka bynta ka kam sniew jong ki .
translation.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come , and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother , which slew them  ; and upon the men of Shechem , which aided him in the killing of his brethren .

translation.kha: Ngan saw lang pynlang me sha Ijipt , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . U Joseph ruh un don ryngkat bad me ynda me ïaphah .
translation.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .

translation.kha: Me la ïohi ne em Kumne u Ahab u la pynrit ïa laiñ ha khmat jong nga ? Nalor ba u la leh kumne , ngan ym pynjot ïa u katba u dang im ; kan long ha ka pateng u khun jongno u , ba ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ka longsem jong u Ahab .
translation.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me ? because he humbleth himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days : but in his son s days will I bring the evil upon his house .
And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , leit sha ki paid Israel bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa me ba men ong .

Ha ka sneng kaba phraphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Simri u la syiar khyndew sngi ha Tirsah ïa ka Israel . Ki shipai Eliel ki kerkut ïa ka nongpang Gibbethon ha Philistia ,
translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah . And the people were encamped against Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines .

translation.kha: U Paul u la ïai-ong , NGA ïeng ha khmut ka kamra kotbah ka jong u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar ïa nga . Ngam shym leh Kanaan kano kaba bakla ïa ki Jiw , kamra me hi me tip bha .
translation.en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
And herein do I exercise myself , to have always a conscience void of offence toward God , and toward men .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ïaleh katba lah ban ïoh ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid kdar ha khmat jong U Blei bad ki briew .

translation.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki synran jong me kim bud ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , hynrei pynban ki bam da ki kti bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ?

translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la shahshitom ha ka doh , phi ruh phi dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa lade da kajuh ka jingpyrkhat kaba u la don ; namar uno uno uba shahshitom ha ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pop .
Ka kynhun ka la niam ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la Duwai bad buh ïa la ki kti ba-halor jong ki .
translation.en: Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  ha u paidbah :  Ngan long ryngkat bad phi — kata ka long ka jingkular jong nga .

U la ïathuh ruh ïa ka jingphohsniew ha la u kpa , bad u kpa jong u , u la mai ïa u , Ka jingphohsniew aïu kambah kum kata ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ka kmie jong me , ki hynmen shynrang jong me , bun ma nga ngin ïawan mala nguh ïa me ?
translation.en: And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him , and said unto him , What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïathied na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , u da leit shaphang ka bynta Bashti jong ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Abram journeyed , going on still toward the south .

translation.kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long : U Syiem jong ki Jiw .
translation.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u Kynhun jong u Amos , u buh jingthoh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki kam ba u syiem Isaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .

translation.kha: Rieh ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar dei ha kane ka sngi ba la la ïalam noh ïa ki jait jong ph na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pang phi dei ban Rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka jingïakhaïi Maim .
translation.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .

translation.kha: Me ai ïa ka ha ki , nabar ki bam ïa ka , me pynbiang jingbam , bad ki sngewhun .
translation.en: That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .
And he overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .
translation.kha: Ki suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki jingker , bad ki pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban batskhem ïa kita ki diengkhap . Ïa kita ki diengkhap ruh la suit da ka ksiar .
Hato kin pyndonkam ïa la ki waitlam jingmut bad ïai pynïong ïa ki jaitbynriew khlem jingisynei ?
translation.en: Shall they therefore empty their net , and not spare continually to slay the nations ?

translation.kha: Hynrei dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ha ka hukum U Blei , u ksaiñ u la bam ïa u jingthang , bad u la ïap noh .
translation.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day , and it smote the gourd that it withered .
And Arphaxad begat Salah  ; and Salah begat Eber .
translation.kha: U Arpakhshad u dei u kpa jong u Shelah , uba dei u kpa jong u Eber .

Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa lade hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phira u pyrkhat ba u long umbah stad da ka jingthew jongu ken ka pyrthuh , u dadien ban long uba beiñ khnang ba un hir Uba stad da shisha .
translation.en: Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .
For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
translation.kha: Ma nga , shisien nga la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad nga la ïap .

translation.en: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ? or who shall bemoan thee ? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Mano ban isynei ïa phi , ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , bad mano ban ïam sngewsih halor jong phi ? Mano ban sangeh kham slem ban kylli phi long kumno ?
Hynrei u Joshua u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym risa , lane kren shikyntien pajut tad haduh ba un da ai hukum .
translation.en: And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kiba hynñiew Jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U Trei u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Me tip kaei ban leh ; mem dei ban shahskhor ïa u ban ïap da kaba suk .
translation.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom , and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace .
And the second took her to wife , and he died childless .
translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad nangta sa uba lai .
Ha kata ka sngi , na Ijipt shaduh u pun ka ri Ijipt , U Trai un ïam ïa uwei pa imat na ki briew jong u , kum wahbah pynkhlaiñ ïa u kew na u stait .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt , and ye shall be gathered one by one , O ye children of Israel .

And when he came to the den , he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel : and the king spake and said to Daniel , O Daniel , servant of the living God , is thy God , whom thou servest continually , able to deliver thee from the lions ?
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hangta , u la khot jam da ka jingkhmih lynti ,  Ko Daniel , u shakri jong U Blei uba im ! Hato U Blei uba me shakri hok katta katta u la lah mo ban pyllait im ïa me na ki sing ?
Naamah ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balaitluid lui jong u hi , ngi ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .
translation.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .

translation.kha: Shata phi dei shun leit rah ïa ki jingainguh thang bun ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi , bad ïa ki jingainguh jong phi , ïa ki jingai Sngewbha ba phi kular ïa U Trai , ïa ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phira , nabar ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
translation.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , and your tithes , and heave offerings of your hand , and your vows , and your freewill offerings , and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks :

translation.kha: Ka kuna jong U Trai ka la long lem bad ki , bad kiba bun ki briew ki la ngeit malu ki la phai sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta uta u shakri u buh ïa la ka ktha hapdeng ki lbong jong u Ephraim , u kynrad jong u , bad u pynpang ka jingsmai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u Abraham u la praw ïa u .
translation.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .

translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei naba phi ong .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha u , Kane ka long Kiei kaba U Trai u ong , ‘ Namar ba me la phah ki nonglamktien pun kylli na u Baalsebub , u blei ka Ekron — i main ym don beit ha Israel banbeiñ kylli — men ym ïohkhiah ; men ïap !’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron , is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word ? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
Then saith Jesus unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ha kane hi ka miet phi baroh phin ïaphet noh bad iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ki langbrot jong ka kynhun yn pynsakma .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïalam lang bad me ïa ki shipai baroh bad leit kiew sha Ai . Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ïa u syiem ka Ai ; ki briew jong u , ka nongbah jong u , bad ka ri kan long ka jong me .
Hynrei naduh ka por ba ka burom ka mih babiang , u kylluid long u bymïap .
translation.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him , he shall be unclean .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u syiem ka long kum ka jingkyiuh u sing , hynrei ka jingsngewbha jongngi u ka long kumta u plung ba pdiang hun .
translation.en: The king s wrath is as the roaring of a lion  ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .

translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki biria ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingïakut ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Heber , ïa ki shyieng bad ki kynther , khnang ba a uno hajuh un ym don u para jait Israel kum u mraw .
translation.en: That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .

translation.kha: Nangta , Thaw ar tylliat ki kyrjaw kiar bad buh ïa ki ha ka bynta ba shwa trai jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ka tduh bashapoh hajan ka Ebed .
translation.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .
Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel ba kin wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh . Pdiang ïa kino kino ki jingainguh kat kiba uno uno u mon ban ai .

translation.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynpaw ha ki por baroh ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingkhraw tam eh ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingieit ïa kaba u la pyn-i sha ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you , and ye shall bear the sins of your idols : and ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki ar ngut shi para — ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh awria bad ka pop jong ka jingmane bleithaw . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

U Dabid u ïohknieh shihajar tylli ki kali ïamap jong u , khyndew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai , bad arphew hajar nguh ki shipai ïaid khet . U buh ki kulai kat ban biang na ka bynta shyiap thylli ki kali ïapom bad u pynduh noh ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïathiah shongkha biang malade ka tnga jong u , bad ka la armet badno ïoh khun shynrang . Ki khot kyrteng ïa u , u Beraïah , namar ka jingjngem ka la ngat ha ka longïing jong ki .
translation.en: And when he went in to his wife , she conceived , and bare a son , and he called his name Beriah , because it went evil with his house .

translation.kha: Ka jingaibor hok kan long u sai-thew na ka bynta ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok tista un-long u sai-sawar jong ka . U phria un sar noh ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shane , bad ki jingshlei kine pynjot ïa ki jingbymkohnguh jong phi .
translation.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .

translation.kha: Kaba kynthup ïa ka ri ki Kheiñ , ki Kenis , ki Hammon ,
translation.en: The Kenites , and the Kenizzites , and the Kadmonites ,

And it came to pass , as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses  anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la poi hajan kata ka jaka sher dara na kaba u ïohi ïa uta u khun masi bad ïa ka jingïashad jong kita ki paidbah , u Moses u bitar lep . Hangta ha trai u lum , u lynthaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap kiba u rah haduh ba ki da pait .
Ngan pyn-i ha phira ïa ka bor jongu nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga ïalumlang ïa phi nabar wallam pang ïa phi na ki ri baroh’ sha kiba la pynslem ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .
And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
translation.kha: Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki jaiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na kiba duk kiba la buh bynda na ka bynta ki ram . Ha ka templ U Blei jong ki , ki dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki la shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .
Te , nga kyrpad ïa phi , ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkyrmen jong na da kaba don kyntang ki jingpyrkhat , babha ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingtied , Bad kiba don kawei ka Mynsiem bad ka jingmut .
translation.en: Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Pynban katba ki Israel ki nang shah pynshitom beiñ , katta ruh ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang saphriang kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: That the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la shah pynïap naduh ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ,

translation.en: Which were cut down out of time , whose foundation was overflown with a flood :
translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba ka por jong ki kan wan , ki la shah rong noh da ka jingshlei .

translation.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
translation.kha: Baroh ki kut jong pha kin long kum ki diengsoh Dumbur bad ki soh Dumbur ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap beit hapoh ka shyntur jong pha !

Katto katto nguid ki nonghikai na ka skul jong ki Epikuri badno ki Stoik ki la ïatainia ruh bad u . Katto katto-katne ngut na ki , ki la kylli , Aïu une u sarong ibit u pyrshang ban kren ? Kiwei pud ki jubab , U i kumba u kren shaneng ki blei nongwei . Ki la ong ïa kane namar ba u Paul u la ïalap shaphang U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .
translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da phong jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , bad baroh — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .

Da shisha phi tip ba haba phi pynjam ïa lade kumno ki mraw Ban kohnguh ïano ïano , ha ka jingshisha , phi lama ki maw jong u kynrad babha phi kohnguh — lada ka long ka pop , kabu ka jingmih ka long ka jingïap , lane ka jingbymkohnguh , kaba ka jingmih ka longïng ka jingïasuk bun U Blei .
translation.en: Know ye not , that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey , his servants ye are to whom ye obey ; whether of sin unto death , or of obedience unto righteousness ?

translation.kha: Lada ngan Jin da la ïap ha kata ka por , ngan jingsan da la anna ha ka jingïohthiah mynta ,
translation.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,
But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth , and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un beh noh ïa ki riewbymman na ka ri , bad rat dyngkhong ïa ki nongpop na ka kum ïa ki jingthung na ka khyndew .
Ma phi , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jyllang phira , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangtai lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .
translation.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .

translation.kha: Babha u Benhail u la kop ba ïa ka law la lah soi , u la leit Sha ïeng . Ha ka kamra kaba Shaneng jong ka ïeng jong u la don ki jingkheit babha phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta , kumba u la ju ïai sa , u la dem khohsiew ha ki jingkhangïit ba la plie bad u duwai sha U Blei kad sien shi sngi .
translation.en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed , he went into his house  ; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem , he kneeled upon his knees three times a day , and prayed , and gave thanks before his God , as he did aforetime .
And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .
translation.kha: U paidbah babun u la bud ïa u ; hapdeng jong ki , la don katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ki jingri ïa ka jingbam jong ki bad u bsa ïa ki khun tyngab haba ki pah .

translation.en: So we can be confident that God’s Kingdom will soon bring an end to all such problems .
translation.kha: Te ngi lah ban shaniah skhem ba shen ka Hima jong U Blei kan pynkut ïa kum kita ki jingeh baroh .

translation.en: And they crucified him , and parted his garments , casting lots : that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , They parted my garments among them , and upon my vesture did they cast lots .
translation.kha: Ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad nangta ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki da kaba ïakhalai .

lang ïalam ïa pa sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong nga , ngan ai ha phi ka jingkmen ha ka ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang ïa ki jingjia kiba phi ai ha ka jingnguh jong nga . Ïa ka ïng jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri bhor .
translation.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .

translation.kha: Phi ha ban kñia ainguh ïa u jingriew uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynrei yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa Kanah kano ka jingkular .
translation.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .
And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u wan phai , u la kurup ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Hasor ka long kaba khlaiñ tam na kito ki hima baroh . )
Kita kiba baieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynrei kim shym la rah tam ïa ka umphniang bad ki ,
translation.en: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :

translation.kha: Bad ka Hagar ka la ïuh khun shynrang na u Abram , bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Imlah .
translation.en: And Hagar bare Abram a son : and Abram called his son s name , which Hagar bare , Ishmael .

translation.kha: Ka longïing lad me kan long kum ka longïing u syiem Jeroboam u khun lad u Nob , bad kum ka longïing u syiem Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , nalor ba me la pynkhih bitar ïa de da kaba ïalam ïa ki Eliel ban leh pop .’
translation.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah , for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger , and made Israel to sin .
Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .
translation.kha: U Thomas ( ïa uba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) u la ong ha la ki para synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh bad u Nonghikai , ba ngin ïa-ïap ryngkat bad u !

translation.en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
translation.kha: Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki dap , ka slap .
Nangta ka Silpah ka la kha ïakhun shynrang ïa u Joab .
translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a son .

translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la pyn-i dak ïa u bad u la ong , Kylli ïa u ba u kren shang jrong .
translation.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .

translation.kha: bad ka la ong ha ka sur kaba ïam , Pha long ka kynthei kabu la kyrhai na baroh ki kynthei , bad longïing ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba pham sa kha !
translation.en: And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jngai u halor jong ki pynlang ba un duwai na ka bynta jongki ki , hynrei ki synrang ki la mai ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Then were there brought unto him little children , that he should put his hands on them , and pray : and the disciples rebuked them .

translation.kha: Kine ki kyndon ki ibit ibiang ïa u Hamor malu ïa u Shammah u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor s son .

translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh la buh jingteh naba ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei ktieh shym la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :

translation.kha: A Trai U Blei jong ki kper thymmei jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long uba donbor bad uba khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?

translation.kha: Kin suh ïa ka ephod da u saiwul uba jyrngam , uba ïasngewthuh , bad uba rong saw , u sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translation.en: And they shall make the ephod of gold , of blue , and of purple , of scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cunning work .

translation.kha: La katta ruh , u la pynlong ka jingkular bad nga . U ong , ‘ Phin sa dat u khun jong u ban synshar ha ka jingsuk , namar ba ngan ai ha u ka jingsuk na ki nongshun jongu u baroh . Ka kyrteng jong u kan long u Samson , ñiar ha ka jingsynshar jong u ngan ai ha ki Israel ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain .
translation.en: Behold , a son shall be born to thee , who shall be a man of rest  ; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about : for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngur kaba khatduh bad kaba khrong dak eh jong ka Jingkhawai Mamre , U Jisu u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam , Uno uno uba sneng u dei ban ïan sha nga , bun uno uno babha ngeit ha nga u daiñ ban dih .
translation.en: In the last day , that great day of the feast , Jesus stood and cried , saying ,  If any man thirst , let him come unto me , and drink .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , baroh ki nongwei kaba tur ïaheh ïa pha kin shah beh noh kum ïa u pui pui , bad ki kynhun shipai bashyrkhei jong ki kin her kum u phangpdeng .
translation.en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .

translation.kha: Ki ñiup ïa ki syep bad ki krenbeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-bang . Ym don ka kut kaba lah baneh pynsangeh ïa ki — ki kyndon ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .

translation.kha: To U thri un ai ki khup ha phi — ïa phi bad ïa ki khunlung ki ksiew jong phi !
translation.en: The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .
He will eat .
translation.kha: Yn sa Bam ma u .

Ki nong Babilonia ki la tei ïa ki kynton kerkut sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban kurup ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa ka nongbah ban hap ha ki Ki jong ki . Me lah ban ïohi ba baroh kaba me la krai ka la ainong shisha .
translation.en: Behold the mounts , they are come unto the city to take it  ; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans , that fight against it , because of the sword , and of the famine , and of the pestilence : and what thou hast spoken is come to pass  ; and , behold , thou seest it .
And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him , and he halted upon his thigh .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la mih haba u Jakob u mihnoh na Peniel , u da ïaid dkoh namar kata ka skhep .
U mawkordor u la thoh ïa ki shithi ha ka kyrteng u syiad Serksis , bad u shon ïa ki da ka muhor syiem . La leit rah da ki nongthoh kulai kiba shong ha ki kulai bastet na ki sem kulai syiem .
translation.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus  name , and sealed it with the king s ring , and sent letters by posts on horseback , and riders on mules , camels , and young dromedaries :

translation.kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah jrong ki , baroh ki ïap lymne bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lem ban ïashim pynbha ha kano kano kaba jhieh ha kane ka pyrthuh .
translation.en: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin waiñ sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U tharai Badonbor Baroh bad ban mudui na ka bynta ka jingryngkhiang jong u .
translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ki sohwaiñ la khñiot ha ka jaka jingthoh waiñ shabar ka nongbam , bad ka Snam ka la mynhynne na ka jaka khñiot waiñ ha ka jingshlei kamra laispah kilomitar ka jingrang bad la jan ar mitar ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: And the winepress was trodden without the city , and blood came out of the winepress , even unto the horse bridles , by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs .

translation.kha: To ïatih ïa ka nongbah Seïon , ha khmih , u Syiem jong pha u wanrah sha pha ! U long ibha sngewrit bad u shong khlur ka kada bad halor u khun kada .
translation.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion , Behold , thy King cometh unto thee , meek , and sitting upon an ass , and a colt the foal of an ass .

translation.kha: Ki Jeruel ki long ka jaitbynriew ka bym don ka bor sngewthuh ; kim ne siat ka jingstad .
translation.en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .
( Psalm 26 :12 , footnote  ; 111 :1 ) These gatherings create an opportunity to meet and associate with Witnesses from other congregations or even from other lands .
translation.kha: ( Salm 26 :12 ; 111 :1 ) Kine ki jingïalang ki plie lad ban ïakynduh bad ban ïa kren-ïa khana bad ki Nongsakhi kiba na kiwei ki balang ne na kiwei pat ki jaka .

translation.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :
translation.kha: Wat ïabam ha ka miej u briew uba khapnap lane uba kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when I heard these words , that I sat down and wept , and mourned certain days , and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , nga shong bad nga ïam . Bun sngi nga la sngewsih bad ngam shym bam .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto the woman , and said unto her , Behold now , thou art barren , and bearest not : but thou shalt conceive , and bear a son .
translation.kha: U angel U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ka bad u ong ,  Pham shym la lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei shen phan sa punkhun bad phan ïoh ïa u khun shynrang .
Ka jingbitar u briew kam lah ban jop ïa ka jingthmu bahok jong U Blei .
translation.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God .

translation.kha: Don kiba khim , bad kawei ki pyntbit ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ne ïa la ki bakha kynthei .
translation.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .

translation.kha: dien hynriew thlia ki mawkyrdon Ban kiew sha ka khoit bad ka don ka jingïuhkjat kaba la pyndait ha ka , ba la sop da ka ksar . Ki don ki jingshan kti ha barabor arliang jong ka khet , bad ka dur u sing ka ïeng ha kamai kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And there were six steps to the throne , with a footstool of gold , which were fastened to the throne , and stays on each side of the sitting place , and two lions standing by the stays :
And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I come in peace .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ban thep byndi ïa u , bad ban ai kpu bad ka um ïa u haduh ba ngan da wan phai suk .

translation.en: And another also said , Lord , I will follow thee  ; but let me first go bid them farewell , which are at home at my house .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew u la ong ,  Ngan bud ïa me , ko kynrad ; hynrei nyngkong shah ïa nga ban leit bad khublei ïa ka longïing jong nga .
longïng katba ka long , u Ahimaas u ong biang , Nga kwah ban leit . Khie leit , u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh brup na ka lynti kaba na ka Them Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa uta u mraw .
translation.en: But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .

translation.kha: Pha la un-long hima ka nuti ïa ki nong Babilonia , kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .

translation.kha: Ki shithi ki ong : Pynban ïa ka sngi pun shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah baroh bad ai ïa u Naboth ka jaka Kaba donburom .
translation.en: And she wrote in the letters , saying , Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people :

translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei , U Jisu u la jaboh ; to leh ïa kane bun men im .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Thou hast answered right : this do , and thou shalt live .

translation.kha: kat u Dabid bad ki paidbah baher ki ïashad da ka bor borbah ban jingeh ïa U Blei . Ki ïai bad ki tem ïa ki jingtem — ki duitara , ki ksing , ki shakuriaw , bad ki tyrso .
translation.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .
And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me kam long shuh u Jakob . Me la ïaleh bad U Blei bad ki briew , bad me la jop ruh ; kumta ka kyrteng jong me kan long noh u Israel .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu , and all that he did , and all his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehu u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kam shlur jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
Hynrei ka kynthei kan ïohlait im ha ka par ba ka kha khup , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingneit bad ka jingkheit bad ka jingkhuid , lem bad ka jingdon akor .
translation.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .

translation.kha: Ki thyllah jong ki , ki longsem ki khnam kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathaw lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan Jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ka jingrem ïa u .
translation.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .

translation.kha: To wat shah ba yn shukor . Ki phlangïap kiba sngi ki pynjot ïa ka jingjrong babha .
translation.en: Be not deceived : evil communications corrupt good manners .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong ïa nga , ba de la pynïap shibun eh ki briew badno ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kamet , Namarba ba nga la pynmih shibun ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jongno u .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .

translation.kha: Pynïeng dei ma at uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rai ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynne kim shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
And they began to be sorrowful , and to say unto him one by one , Is it I ? and another said , Is it I ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la khih jingmut bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien uwei pat ,  Da shisha , mem shym mut ïa nga , hato ym dei kumta ?
Bad da bhor ka spah bakyiuh jong u lyngba U Kynther Jeshua , U Blei jong por un pyndap ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh .
translation.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Mynta , lada khong ma mano ba la pynsngewsih ïano ïano , um shym la ni ïa —kata ha nga hynriewphew ha phi baroh — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (sa ong ïa kane namar ngam khoh ban da imat tyngeh halor jong u .)
translation.en: But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .

O my God , incline thine ear , and hear  ; open thine eyes , and behold our desolations , and the city which is called by thy name : for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses , but for thy great mercies .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ngi , A Blei ; to khmih sha ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjynjar kaba ngi don bad ïa ka jingshah shitom jong ka nongbah kaba kit ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Ngi duwai ha me namar ba me long uba dap da ka jingisynei , ym namar ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei .

translation.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khat-ar ngut kiba u la jied : U Simon ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa u , u Petros ) ;
Pynbiang ïa ki shipai jong ki baroh ! Mait ïa ki ! Ki biria ka Babilonia ki la kordit ! Ka por ka la poi ïa ki ban shah pynthnam !
translation.en: Slay all her bullocks  ; let them go down to the slaughter : woe unto them ! for their day is come , the time of their visitation .
But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka iktiar ha ka khyndew ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad leit sha ïing !

translation.en: What then ? are we better than they ? No , in no wise : for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles , that they are all under sin ;
translation.kha: Haba kumta , hato ma ngi ki Jiw ngi don ha kano kano ka bynta kaba kham bha ban ïa ki Jentil ? Ym kumta! Nga la lah pyn-i ba ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki long kumjuh baroh hapoh ka bor jong ka pop .

Haba U Trai u ïasam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba khluit , kaweh tyrkhong , kim syiem la shahshitom na ka jingsuhsieng . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mih na u mawsiang na ka bna jong ki ; u pynpait ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka ñiah nala .
translation.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .

translation.kha: Haba U Jeshua u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan shad u , u la ong shaphang jong u , Une u dei u kynja Israel umbah Shisha , ym don kano kano ka bymshisha ha u !
translation.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !

translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa ka tnga u loit !
translation.en: Remember Lot s wife .

translation.kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha kata ka duwan mala khyndiat ka bymnang pynsleh , bad synreit ha u Yiron bad ha ki jaiñkup jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bun ha ki jingap jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin hir kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .

translation.kha: Ki khlur ki ïaleh na sahit bneng ; Katba ki sdang ïadat shat shiliang ka sahit bneng , Ki la ïateh pyrshah ïa u Sisera .
translation.en: They fought from heaven  ; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u leh kumta ; ki skain da ki kynhun bah ki wan rung hapoh ïing jong u Pharaoh bad hapoh ïing jong ki rangbah synsar jong u . Ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka julor ha kita ki skain .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did so  ; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants  houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the  Lord  , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Te ki briew ka Ijipt baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki Israel ki la shaniah ha phi ko ki nong Ijipt ban ïarap ïa ki , hynrei phim long kham bha ban ïa u dieng uba tlot .
Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka per jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kaba ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .

translation.kha: Nga thoh shai phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi iathuh ïa u uba la long naduh kambah mynnyngkong . Nga thom sha ph , ko ki khun samla , namar phi la jrop noh thiaw ïa U u Basniew .
translation.en: I write unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I write unto you , young men , because ye have overcome the wicked one . I write unto you , little children , because ye have known the Father .
The king of Hormah , one  ; the king of Arad , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Hormah , ka Arad ,

translation.en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Wat la phi bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im , namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;
translation.kha: Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki duwai sha me , ki da phla haduh katno ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ki A  Trai .
Wat pyrshang ban kren tipbriew ha uba bieit ; um lah ban ïaroi ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .

translation.kha: Pyntrei ba ïa kane ka kitab ka Hukum dei ban pule borabor ha ka jingmane jong me . Puson ïa ka mynsngi bad mynhyndai , bad pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la thoh ha ka . Te men sa mawbah Bad long Uba ioh .
translation.en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth  ; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night , that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein : for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous , and then thou shalt have good success .

translation.kha: U don ruh shibun ngut ki shakri bad u la long u briew bariewspah tam ha ka ri Mihngi .
translation.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jong ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun ; ki khur kin phai ïakhleh pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynsep ïa ki .
translation.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jonah u ong ha u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u , Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang shat ka jaka shem dara ki Philistia . Hynrei u Jonathan um Shimham ïathuh ha la u Kpa , u Saul
translation.en: Now it came to pass upon a day , that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over to the Philistines  garrison , that is on the other side . But he told not his father .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jongngi ngi ki la leh pum , hyndai mynta kim don shuh , bad ngi shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop! jong ki .
translation.en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not  ; and we have borne their iniquities .

translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la kad ïa la ki jreiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , ki la buh wiang ïa la ki jingkit halor ki kali jong ki bad ki la leit phai sha kata ka Nongbah .
translation.en: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .

translation.kha: kumta ïa phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ki nongmareh jong phi kin shahthngan haduh ban ïap , bad ki riewpaidbah kin ïap thynrang .
translation.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .

translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ieh . Nga la jubab , Ka kot kli bashabar ha ka lyer ; ka don khyndai mitar ka lynter bad seh mitar shit ka pyngkiang .
translation.en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .

translation.kha: na ka bna ka jingpynsleh lyngdoh ïa kiba ïapyrshang na u Aaron . Ha ka sneng ba yn pynkyntang ïa u , un ai kum ka jingainguh sha U tharai shi kilo u purew ( Kaba ïaryngkat bad ka jingsuh bam ba man ka sngi ) , shiteng ha ka par mynstep bad shiteng ha ka por jingneit .
translation.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer unto the  Lord  in the day when he is anointed  ; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual , half of it in the morning , and half thereof at night .

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , U Trai u pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem bad ka bor , bad u ai ha nga ka jingsngewthuh ïa ka jingbishar hok bad ka jingshlur shun ïathuh ha ki paid Israel kiei ki long ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the  Lord  , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban kren ha ki lyngdoh , ki khun u Aaron , bad ong ha ki ba uno uno na ki um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka por ba lehniam haba don uba ïap napdeng ki briew jong u ,
U Trai u long u nongai bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long ibha janai , bad bahok ; U Blei jong phi u long uba ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba khak bad kaba beit .
translation.en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .

translation.kha: Ko khun u brup , u la ong , to sngewsih ïa ka kupar kaba ap ïa u syiem ka Tyros . Ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar la nong : Shisien me la long u nuksa jong ka jingjanai . Katto uba stad bad naba bhabriew me la long !
translation.en: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre , and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .
And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
translation.kha: Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jong nga da ka jingpang , wat ha kane hi ka met ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .
Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khroh katno katno , kaba don ki aiñ kiba hok kat kito kiba nga la hikai ïa phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And what nation is there so great , that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law , which I set before you this day ?

Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?
translation.kha: Ki dang ïawad ïa kiei kiei ban kurup bad ïabynta , Kawei lane ar ngut ki kynthei na ka bynta uwei uwei u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Sisera , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka ryndang jong ka syiem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , waters rise up out of the north , and shall be an overflowing flood , and shall overflow the land , and all that is therein  ; the city , and them that dwell therein : then the men shall cry , and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl .
translation.kha: U ong :  Ha khmih ! Ki um ki la nang shlei na shatei bad kin tuid stet kum ka wah ba la shlei um . Kin tap ïa ka ri bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka , ki nongbah bad ki briew kiba im hangta . Ki briew kin pyrta jingïarap ; baroh kiba ha ka pyrthei kin ïamkthang .

translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .
translation.kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san snem ka rta bad nga dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta kumba nga la long mynba u Moses u la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ bha ban leit ïaleh thma ne na ka bynta kano kano .
Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba ei ka jingumsnam . Kito kiba lama trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki khlam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingieit ,
translation.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
For a servant when he reigneth  ; and a fool when he is filled with meat  ;
translation.kha: u mraw uba kylla long syiem , u bieit uba u ïoh ban bam ïa baroh kat kaba u kwah ,

translation.en: And Jesus came and spake unto them , saying ,  All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan hajan bad u la ong ha ki ,  La ai ha nga baroh ka bor ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
Namarba nga dong sah ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U Trai ba lada un ïalang biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan ma ïa u ha Hebron .
translation.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .

And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :
translation.kha: Man ka sngi , khlem pep , phi dei ban ai ïa ki lyngdoh ha Jerusalem ïa kaei kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ba ki donkam : ki masi lyngraw , ki langbrot , lane ki khunlangbrot ban kñia kum ki jingainguh sha U Blei jong ka Bneng , lane u kew , ka mluh , ka waiñ , lane ka umphniang Olib .

translation.en: Mother Earth .
translation.kha: Mei mariang .

translation.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp , the name of the one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad : and the spirit rested upon them  ; and they were of them that were written , but went not out unto the tabernacle : and they prophesied in the camp .
translation.kha: Ar ngut na kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam , u Eldad bad u Medad , ki sah ha ka jaka shong dara bad kim shym la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ . Hangta ha ka jaka shong dara , kata ka bor mynsiem ka wan ha ki , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people , and hast sinned against thy soul .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki buit jong phi ki wanrah ka jinglehrain ha la ka longïing ; da kaba pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew babun phi la wallam tang ka jingjot ha lade .
Haba phi ïeng ha khmih u syiem , wat pyrshang banbeiñ shon ju ïa u pynlang kun mynleh kum uba pawkhmat .
translation.en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king , and stand not in the place of great men :
For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :
translation.kha: Phi hi phi la ju long mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong U Trai , phi long ha ka jingshai . Kumta phi dei ban im kum ki briew kiba don ha ka jingshai ,

translation.en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Kin ïeng joit ha ki thapniang kum ki pukni ; kin mareh bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïaid bad kin ym sngewthait .
‘ Buh ïa ka waitlam ! Ngan bishar ïa me ha ka jaka ba la kha ïa me , ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .
translation.en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath ? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created , in the land of thy nativity .
Peter then denied again : and immediately the cock crew .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong biang  Em  — bad mar kumta u syiar u la kyn-ih .

translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .
translation.kha: Mynta to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong nga .
Nga la weng ino ïa ki pop jong phi kum ïa u liewlong . To wan phai patan sha nga ; nga erlangthari uta uba la pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: I have blotted out , as a thick cloud , thy transgressions , and , as a cloud , thy sins : return unto me  ; for I have redeemed thee .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ainong ha ki , Haba phi duli , to ong ïa Kanah : ‘ Ko Kpa : Ai ba ka kyr-ang jong me kan hir kaba la pynbun ; ai Ban wan ka Hima Jong me .
translation.en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .

translation.kha: A Tharai me la shahshkor ïa nga , bad ïa nga la shukor . Me long uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa nga , malade me la jop ïa at . Erastos pa utai u rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; ki krenbeiñ ïa nga barabor shi sngi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast deceived me , and I was deceived : thou art stronger than I , and hast prevailed : I am in derision daily , every one mocketh me .
And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban leit rah ïa ka sha i pa jong phi ba in bam bad in sa ai ïa phi ka jingkyrkhu jong i shuwa ba in ïap .
hynne U Jisu u kyntait ban jubab wat tang shikyntien , kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa u lyngskor .
translation.en: And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .

translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha uta u paidbah , Haneng u long uta u briew uba U Trai u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jyllang ngi . Baroh u paidbah u risa , To un im slem u Syiem !
translation.en: And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel : none went out , and none came in .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khyrdop Jerikho la khang khop bad la ap phira ban ym ïohrung ki Israel . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban rung shapoh lane mih shabar ka nongbah .
Bad U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jinglah jong ngi , shen un pynlwet ïa u Soitan hajuh ki khet jong phi . To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu suba U Tiras jong ngi kan long lem dara phi .
translation.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .

translation.kha: Pynbiang , namar u paidbah , kim haka ban shem lynti ban rah shapoh ïa u . Kumta ki la ïabah ïa u sha tnat ïing , ki la law ïa ki jingsop ïing bad ki la pynhiar shapoh ïa u ha ka jingteh hamar pdeng jong ka kynhun ha khmat U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude , they went upon the housetop , and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus .
I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .
