translation.kha: Nga ong ha lade ba nga dei ban kren , ba ma phi kiba la kham rangbah phi dei ban ïasam lem ïa la ka jingstad .

translation.en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Jakob ,  Khie leit sha Bethel bad shongsah hangta . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa nga , U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me mynba me dang phet ïap na u Iso u hynmen jong me .
Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma ang , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi dei ban kuna ïa kijuh ki pop kiba ki kpa Jong ph ki la leh bad ba phi ïabud nongsaiñ ki bleithaw jong ki ?
translation.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?
And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ong ha la u kpa ,  To leh kane kawei ïa nga . Ai por ïa nga ar bnai ba ngan ïoh leit sha ki lum bad la ki paralok , ban ïa-ïam sngewsih ba nga dei ban ïap kum kaba dang sotti .
phan sa panpoh bad phan kha ïa u khun , bad phan kyrteng ïa u , U Ujuh .
translation.en: And , behold , thou shalt conceive in thy womb , and bring forth a son , and shalt call his name JESUS .

translation.kha: To leh ïa ki kambah na ka bynta jong nga , A Trai , kam me la leh ha ki sngi mynba me la wallam ïa ine na ka ri jingïaphet .
translation.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la buh ïa kano kum ka aiñ bad la ju bud ha Isaia hynne kata .
translation.en: And it was so from that day forward , that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day .

translation.kha: U la ïalam noh ïa ki paid Israel na ibit ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: And brought out Israel from among them : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Ïa kata borbah kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba Dang praw .
translation.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .

translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ju wan ban ïaleh thma , hynrei ha man ki jingïaleh , u Dabid u kham jop ïa ki ban ïa uno uno u rangbah shipor jongki u saiwul . Kumta u Dabid u la pawnam shibun .
translation.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth : and it came to pass , after they went forth , that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul  ; so that his name was much set by .

translation.kha: Mynmiet to klun ha ki bad to ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïong ha ki : Uwei-pa-uwei pa uwei u Israel uba la ai ïa la ka dohnud ha ki thliew bad shah ïa ki ban ïalam ïa u sha ka pep bad nangta uba wan ngab kylli na u nonghiarthma , un ïoh ka jubab na nga — ka jubab kaba ki bleithaw jong u ki dei hok ban ïoh !
translation.en: Therefore speak unto them , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to the prophet  ; I the  Lord  will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols  ;
Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; wad biang biang ha-ei u don , bad uei uba la ïohi ïa u hangta . Nga tip ba u long uba sianti bha .
Nga la kren kum u ibieit , ko Terah . Aïu ngan jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang ban ino ei ei shiah .
translation.en: Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .

translation.kha: U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la bynshet jaka ïa ki jaitbynriew ; u la buh hangno ki briew kin shong . U la ai uwei u blei ïa kawei kawei ka jyrthiaw ,
translation.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta men khmih Leit ka shen jam ba nga shim , hynrei men ym buddien ïa ki pop jong por .
translation.en: For now thou numberest my steps : dost thou not watch over my sin ?

translation.kha: Nabal ka jingieit ïa ka spah ka un-long ka thymmei jongngi ki jait jingsniew barieh . Dagon kiba da kwah eh ba-bang ïoh ïa ka haduh ba ki la ïadat sakma na ka jingngeit bad ki pait dohnud na ki jingsngewsih baburom .
translation.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki jinglong myntor bad jingkhan jongki phad baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki kah ban long jingïarap katto katjuh ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .
translation.en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
And Jacob s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God s stead , who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sngewbitar ïa ka Rakhel bad u ong ,  Ngam lah ban shim ïa ka jaka U Blei . Dei ma u uba khang ïa pha ban ïoh khun .
U Abraham u la ujor ha u Abimelekh shaphang ka pukri um ïa kaba ki shakri u Abimelekh ki la knieh bor .
translation.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech s servants had violently taken away .

translation.kha: Te ka jingshoh kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Tabor bad ka ïawad shaphang ka jaka kaba halor ine ki jingshoh .
translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .

translation.kha: Pyndait ïa la ki tiensyiem ! u la hukum , malade ki la ar kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pynliat ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah jong u , da kaweh ieh shadien ïa ki arsien ngut lem bad ki jingkit jingbah .
translation.en: And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .
And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïeng hajan jong u , katba ka kynhun ki shipai ïada syiem ki dang ïaid na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïaid ,

translation.en: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :
translation.kha: Ki parabangeit baroh kiba don hangne ki ïasnohkti lang bad nga ha kaba phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha ki balang ha Galatia :
Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa uba na Shiloh , u ïakohnguh ïa u marwei ha lynti kaba ha rong .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :
Envy thou not the oppressor , and choose none of his ways .
translation.kha: Wat ju kwah ban long kum ki briew ba leh jubor lane pyrshang ban leh ïa kaba ki leh ,
U briew uba bam-im ïa kiei kiei baroh , um dei ba peitbeiñ ïa uta u im bam ; katba uta uba bam tang da ki jhur um dat ban bishar ïa uta uba bam ïa kaei kaei ruh ; naba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not ; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth : for God hath received him .

translation.kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki liewlep ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingiwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong bad kiba ïar namar ka jingkahtngen jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat ! Kaba mih nangta , ki khunlung kynthei jong Phi ki ïaleh jingaiti , bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong phi ki ïalam .
translation.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .

translation.kha: Uta u briew uba pang u la jubab , Ko Kner , ngam don mano mano hangne ban leit buh ïa de ha ka pungsum haba la pynkhreh ïa ka um ; katba nga dang pyrshang ban Hiar ha ka , wai pat u poi nyngkong ha ka .
translation.en: The impotent man answered him , Sir , I have no man , when the water is troubled , to put me into the pool : but while I am coming , another steppeth down before me .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah byllien na Galilaïa sad Apollos , na Jerusalem , Judia dara na ka ri ha kawei pat ka liang jngai ka Jordan ki la stem ïa u .
translation.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .

translation.kha: Bad mynnin , phi ki briew kiba riewspah , to shahshkor ïa nga ! to ïalum bad to lynñiar ïa ki jinglanot ki shun ïan hap ha phi !
translation.en: Go to now , ye rich men , weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you .

translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , Uba itynnat , da ka jingpynjynjar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpdiang jong ki ding baroh ha Oded , ka kper U Blei .
translation.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
And they talked together of all these things which had happened .
translation.kha: bad ki dang ïakren para ma ki shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia .

Hynrei ym dei tang ki jingthaw kiba ud ; ma ngi ruh kba don ïa U Mynsiem kum ki jingaiei banyngkong jong U Blei , ngi ïa-ud hapoh lade hi , Katba ngi ding ap ïa U Blei! ba un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u bad ban pynïatylli pham ïa ngi .
translation.en: And not only they , but ourselves also , which have the firstfruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for the adoption , to wit , the redemption of our body .

translation.kha: Kin phai noh na kaba shahshkor ïa ka jingshisha nabar kin pynleit jingmut ha ki puriskam kai .
translation.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam un-long kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Abimelekh bad kuna bam umdih ïa ki rangbah ka Shem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang duh ïa u Abimelekh .
translation.en: But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .

translation.kha: Kine ki Dei ki khun shynrang ba ka Leah ka la khaïi na u Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka lei ki long laiphew lai ngut .
translation.en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , sangeh noh kaba rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam kum ki riewthala . Phi la phai lyndet na la U Blei bad phi la long ki bymïaineh ha u . Ha baroh kawei ka ri phi la die ïa lade kum ki nuti ha u blei Baal bad phi la ieit ïa u kew uba phi pyrkhat ba u la siew na ka bynta jong phi !
U Saul ruh u lytar pha sha la ïit ha Gibeah . Katto katne ki lapbah kaba khlaiñ ryngkat bad ki nongpdem kiba U Blei u la kwah ïa ki dohnud jong ki , ki la leit lang bad u .
translation.en: And Saul also went home to Gibeah  ; and there went with him a band of men , whose hearts God had touched .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïeng shakri ha eiei u lum badno ki Israel ha eiei pat u lum , hapdeng jong ki don katai ka Them .
translation.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side , and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side : and there was a valley between them .
So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u para jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynïap ïa u Asahel u hynmen u para jong ki ha ka thma ha Gibeon .

Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la phah ïa u Timothi . Ngam lah Shah shuh , kumin nga la Pha ïa u ban tip shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi . Da shisha kam lah ban long ba u Ksuid u la pynsleh ïa phi bad ba ka kdew jong ngi baroh ka la long kaba lehnoh-ei !
translation.en: For this cause , when I could no longer forbear , I sent to know your faith , lest by some means the tempter have tempted you , and our labour be in vain .

translation.kha: Da ka bud ïa ki jingleh jali jong ki jaitbynriew kiba U Trai u la biah noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shajrong , U Manasseh u la kun pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , after the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u ïong ïa u mraw jngai u na Sudan , khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaweh me la Iohi . U mraw u la nguh bad u la mareh bran .
translation.en: Then said Joab to Cushi , Go tell the king what thou hast seen . And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab , and ran .

translation.kha: Nga thnum ban pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh ba la pushara liewlep , baneh pynkhynñiuh ïa ka , bad ban pynpei baher ïa ki maw nongrim . Kan khyllem malu pynïap ïa phi baroh . Te uwei imat barieh un tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar , and bring it down to the ground , so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered , and it shall fall , and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Dang pateng phyrngab la phah noh ïa moi shi para bad ïa ki kada jong ki .
translation.en: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their asses .

translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïamareh pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , Namar U Trai’ u la jlop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .

translation.kha: La ka long ha ka por balyngkot lane ha ka por basngur , u Paul u la jubab , ka jingduwai jong nga ha U Blei ka long ba ma me bad baroh kiwei pait kiba sngewdap ïa nga ha kane ka sngi ki lah ban long kum ma nga — lait noh , da shisha , ïa kine ki kynjri !
translation.en: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Dan , to phai khong bad phet ! To rieh ! Ngan pynjot ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , namar ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: Flee ye , turn back , dwell deep , O inhabitants of Dedan  ; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him , the time that I will visit him .

translation.kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bhah da kijuh ki tiar daiñ ban pyndait ha ka Ephod haneng ba kan ïalong kawei ka lyngkhot bad ka .
translation.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it , shall be of the same , according to the work thereof  ; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .
translation.kha: Ki khmat ki long kum ka sharak ïa ka met . Lada ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei kan dap da ka jingshai ;
Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me ; me longïing tang ma me uba ngi kaweh .
translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .

translation.kha: Ka um ïa kaba ngan ai ha u kan long ha u ka mohkhiew ka ban pynïoh ïa u da ka um kaba ai jingim bad ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjop ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong to . Ngan pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Asasaïah badno na ki jingkit kiba ki don ban bhah .
translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .

translation.kha: uta u briew uba pang u la jubab , Ko Kynrad , ngam don mano mano hangne banbeiñ leit bthuh ïa nga ha ka pungsum haba la pynkhreh ïa ka um ; katai nga dang phyrngab ban hiar ha ka , uwei pat u poi nyngkong ha ka .
translation.en: The impotent man answered him , Sir , I have no man , when the water is troubled , to put me into the pool : but while I am coming , another steppeth down before me .

translation.kha: Ka la wan ha u paidbah na shadien jong U Jehu bad ka la ktah ïa ka tduh ka jaiñkup jongngi u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon .
translation.en: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .

translation.kha: Lada phi pynliat ïa ka por ha kaba thiah , phin long uba tduh . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh kyrhai ka bameh .
translation.en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih jong nga ka la jan pynmatlah ïa nga ; ki kti malade ki kjat jong nga ki la rit kum ki syrngiew .
translation.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow , and all my members are as a shadow .

translation.kha: u Elishama , u Jehoïada , bad u Eliphelet .
translation.en: And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphelet .
And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah lane uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa .

Shu kylli ïa ki , bad kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngi la wan ha ka sngi jingkhawai , pynlang u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phiah ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa naba phi lah ha ngi ki shakri jong phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phi , u Dabid .
translation.en: Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .
For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but cast them down to hell , and delivered them into chains of darkness , to be reserved unto judgment  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ki angel kiba la leh pop , hynrei u la bret ïa ki sha dujok , ha kaba la khum kynjri ïa ki ha ka jingdum , da kaba ap ïa ka Sngi ka Jingbishar .

translation.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow  ; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth .
translation.kha: Wat sarong shaphang kaba lashai . Phim tip aïu kan jia hapdeng mynta bad hadien .
Ïathuh ïa kito ki pangnud Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , ngan ym lah shah shuh ïa khie ktien kiba ijli ba ki leh .
translation.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious , even to the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O ye house of Israel , let it suffice you of all your abominations ,

translation.kha: Ym don u kbeit uba ïohi ïa ki lynti sha ki par , bad ym don u skei ba ju her halor jongngi ki .
translation.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth , and which the vulture s eye hath not seen :

translation.kha: bad ïa ka jingïohi jong ki la pynïoh pateng . U Jisu u la matlah jur ïa ki , Wat ïathuh ïa kane tam hano hima !
translation.en: And their eyes were opened  ; and Jesus straitly charged them , saying ,  See that no man know it .
Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .
translation.kha: U sngewtynnat ha ka kynhun paralok bad ki briew kiba bymman bad u ïaid sawdong bad ki nongpop .
malade kumta U Trai u ong ba ki khun kynthei u Sarephath ki lah ban ïashongkurim bad uno uno umbah ki “mon , hynrei dang hapoh ka jait jong ki hi .
translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .

translation.kha: U Rhesa u syiem ka Syria malu u Pekah u syep ka Israel ki tat ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kerkut ïa ka , hynrei kim shym lah ban jop ïa u Ahas .
translation.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war : and they besieged Ahaz , but could not overcome him .

translation.kha: U Abiram u ong , Na kyllum .
translation.en: And Abraham said , I will swear .

translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka Haman bad Sobah bad u kerkut ïa ka nongbah Palmyra ha ka ri shylliah .
translation.en: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah , and prevailed against it .

translation.kha: Ki dang ïawad ïa kiei kiei ban kyrpang bad ïabynta , Kawei lane ar nongput ki kynthei na ka beit uwei wai u shipai , ka jaiñ baremdor na ka bynta u Shisha , bad ki jaiñ ba la thain itynnat na ka bynta ka jingrang jong ka syiem .
translation.en: Have they not sped ? have they not divided the prey  ; to every man a damsel or two  ; to Sisera a prey of divers colours , a prey of divers colours of needlework , of divers colours of needlework on both sides , meet for the necks of them that take the spoil ?

translation.kha: ki kyrmen na U Trai , Dang don shuh mane mano ? U Tlai u jubab , u Saul u ei hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .
translation.en: Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof .
translation.kha: Ka Jordan ka dei ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ka jait Reuben . Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — hynrei nga longsyiem u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei khem shitom ngai , nga la don bunsien ha byndi , nga la shah sympat kham bun , bad nga la junom sha ka jingïap khlam bunktien .
translation.en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .

translation.kha: Baalis ba me buh ïa nga shapoh u nongap phira ? Me pyrkhat ba nga dei u mrad kynsha ka duriaw ?
translation.en: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me ?
So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .
translation.kha: Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ïohi ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem bad u , ki la kmen , bad phai bad mareh sha ki .
Kito ki bleithaw baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israel na nga , hynrei da ka jubab lad nga , na kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .
translation.en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .

translation.kha: U Aaron u la khlong , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad maïan sha pdeng ki bri ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïew ba ka khlam ka la haw sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u rnga ding bad u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translation.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .

translation.kha: Kin Don ki briew ha Jeroham dara halor u lem Seïon ki shun lait im , namar U tharai Badonbor Baroh u la thew ban pynjia ïa kan .
translation.en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant , and they that escape out of mount Zion : the zeal of the  Lord  of hosts shall do this .

translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng shakor ksiar , ïa ki sharak Jong u , ïa ki ring jong u baroh , bad ïa ka umphniang ïa ki shad jrong u ;
translation.en: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof , even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof , and the oil for light ,
For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .
translation.kha: Wat la ka la long ha ka jingtlot ba u la shah pynïap halor ka diengphna , dei da ka bor U Blei ba u im . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lem ïa ka bor U Blei ha ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka Leah , bad ka la punkhun bad ka kha ïa u khun uba san ïa u Jakob .
Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah , naba Mynta la pynsep ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .

translation.kha: Mynta , A Tiras U Balei jong ngi , pyllait im ïa Ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jingkheiñbriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynkdor ïa lade da ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai malade ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long Ibbah khuid . Hynrei lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sner kiba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .
translation.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .

translation.kha: To kren-ïa ïa-pyrshah ïa u , bad ïathuh ha u ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long u nongshun lad u .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynstep phin ïohi ïa ka jingshai batynrai jong ka jingdon jingset U Trai . U la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong phi pyrda ïa u — ïa-ïuh , pyrshah ïa u , namar moi te ine shu kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jongno u .
translation.en: And in the morning , then ye shall see the glory of the  Lord   ; for that he heareth your murmurings against the  Lord  : and what are we , that ye murmur against us ?
And this shall be a sign unto thee , that shall come upon thy two sons , on Hophni and Phinehas  ; in one day they shall die both of them .
translation.kha: Haba ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong me , u Hophni bad u Phinehas kin ïap ha kajuh ka sngi , kane kan pyn-i ïa me ba baroh kaba nga la kren kan urlong .
U har ïa Kaei kiba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , hynmen um long kamon u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Sabad ; pynpdang , u leh ïa kaei kaba u Joash u kparad jong u , u la leh .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .

translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingieit kaba U Mynsiem u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong , Ngin ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga .
translation.en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .

translation.kha: Ka jingïambriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .
translation.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka sha ka Templ .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , Micaiah the son of Imlah , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab ,  Don sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u , namar um ju ïathuhlypa ïa kaba bha shaphang jong nga , borabor ka dei tang ïa kaba sniew suda .   Phim dei ban ong kumta !  U Jehoshaphat u jubab .

translation.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew ngut ki nongai jingmut , ngi phah ïa phi ban wad jingtip ïa ki jinglong jingman ha Jerusalem bad Judah khnang ban ïohi kumno ïa ka Hukum U Blei jong me , ïa kaba la bynshet ha me , la kohnguh .
Ïa ka mih dei Ban buh ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad u kpu ainguh uba kyntang u dei ban don halor jong ka borabor .
translation.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway .

translation.kha: ( U Og u longkmie u syiem uba khatduh na ki Rephan . Ka jingthiah jong u , kaweh la shna da u nar , ka long Saw mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka pynryngkang , katne kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom . Dang lah ïa-ban ïohi ïa ka ha ka nongbud Berakah jong ki Ammon . )
translation.en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants  ; behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron  ; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof , and four cubits the breadth of it , after the cubit of a man .
Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
translation.kha: Ki hima kiba khlaiñbor ki don ha ka jingkhynwin ha ka jingsawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw , kum ka jingphaloh jong ki jingat phyllung kiba khraw .
Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa Kanah , ki la kdang ban ïambriew bad kim shym deng jingdeng shuh .
translation.en: And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba me iehnoh namar ba me kynmaw ïohnang eh , hynrei balei pud me tad ïa ki blei ïing jong nga ?
translation.en: And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?

translation.kha: Hadien kane baroh , don dang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kane keiñ ba la thaw ïa u brup .
translation.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .

translation.kha: Kumba Ngi la ong mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ong biang ïa ka : lada Une uno u ïalap ha phi ïa ka bishar kaba pher na kata kaba phi la pdiang , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok !
translation.en: As we said before , so say I now again , If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received , let him be accursed .

translation.kha: Ban ngeit ka long ban sngewskhem ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kyllan , ngab sngewthikna ïa kiei kiei kiba ngim ha ban ïohi .
translation.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for , the evidence of things not seen .
But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah bha .

Nalorkata u kyrmen ïa u , Phai dang don sha ki khun shynrang ? U Jesse u jubab , Don sa Teng uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot . Bthah ïa u ban wan shane , u Solomon u nguh . Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um pat wan .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .

translation.kha: Ong ïa ki Israel ba ma nga , U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpu tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u ISAIAH bad u Jakob , u la phah ïa me sha ki . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong nga junom la jongno ; kamut ruh ki pdang bynriew ki ban dang wan ki dei ban khot ïa per .
translation.en: And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you : this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me ka ri khlaiñ junom la junom , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba sa long U Trai .
translation.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh marwei .

Nangta nga ai jin ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U Trai U Balei Jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka ri kaba sha mynhyndai na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pat , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangbah jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ïa-ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
translation.en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .

translation.kha: U ong ruh , U Bela u la ai khun ïa per ha ka ri ba nga shah jynjar ; katkum u la khot kyrteng ïa u khun ba ar , u Hapharaim .
translation.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim : For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction .

translation.kha: bad ha ka jingdon jong u ha ka myn , u la leit bad ïarep ha ki mynsiem kiba la shat khum .
translation.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison  ;

translation.kha: Ngam da shah shuh ïa ki na ngut kiwei patiaw ki nongpynjot , Ibbah la isih ïa nga , bad nga la beh noh ïa ki baroh hapoh shi bnai .
translation.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month  ; and my soul lothed them , and their soul also abhorred me .

Likewise when the  Lord  sent you from Kadesh–barnea , saying , Go up and possess the land which I have given you  ; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God , and ye believed him not , nor hearkened to his voice .
translation.kha: Bad haba u hukum ïa phi na Kadesh Barnea ban leit kam kynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la ai ha phi , phi ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa u ; phim shym shaniah bad kohnguh ïa u .
Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha , U Jisu u la jubab , Ym don uba lah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei khlem da kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem! .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia , the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul , and brought him to the judgment seat ,
translation.kha: Haba ïa u Gallio la pynlong u lyngskor jong ka Akhaïa kaba ha ka hima Rom , ki Jiw ki la ïalumlang hangta , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbishar .
Lada ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , sad u shñiuh hangta u lum stem bad stang , kata ka dem ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad un pynbna ba uta u biria u long u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall see the plague : and , behold , if it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair  ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .

translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la loit sha ka ha Karmel malu ki ong ha ka , U Dabid u la pah ïa ngi ban shim ïa Phin sha u Ban long ka tnga Jong u .
translation.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel , they spake unto her , saying , David sent us unto thee , to take thee to him to wife .
Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phi dei ban long kiba ïai pynkhreh , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta kaba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .
Kut u Sa u shim rupa bad ksiar na ka jingkynshew jong ka baphylla bad ka ïingsyiem bad phah sha Demetrios , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :
translation.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the  Lord  and of the king s house , and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .
translation.kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud ha kti ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .
Mynno na ki phai baïar jong kine ki ri uba la ju pyrsad ïa la ka ri na u patsha jong ngi ? Te Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ba-bang pyrkhat ba U Trai u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerusalem ?
translation.en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands , that have delivered their land out of my hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ?
Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .
translation.kha: Haba shah khñiot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khñiot , hynrei ka jingurlong jong ka jingkhmih lynti ka pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen .

‘ Nga la Iohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynbudnam kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka Jaka .’ Kumta shim ïa ka met jong u Joram , u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jong u , bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U Trai .
translation.en: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem , Sngap jar bad Mihnoh na une u briew !
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid nabar baroh ki rangbah jongngi u ki la jem Sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Baalis bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , dara u Barsillai u wait phai noh shad ïing .
translation.en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .

translation.kha: Kuth u Akhshaph u ai ha u ïa ka sheng Siklag , bad na kane ka daw ka Siklag ka long noh! ka jong ki syiem Judah naduh kata ka por .
translation.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day .
Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit  ; through deceit they refuse to know me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki ïalam bakla ïa la ki paralok , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ; ki la hikai ïa la ki thylliej ban lamler bad kin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingleh pop jong ki . Ki leh ïa kawei ka jingleh jubor hadien kawei pat , bad kawei ka jingleh shukor ka bud ïa kawei pat . U  Trai  u ong ba ki briew jong u ki kyntait ïa u .

translation.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
translation.kha: Kan ym tip ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .

translation.en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la ong , ‘ Namar kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga , bad ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’

translation.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka hok ba-pura ban rung sha ka Hima bymjukut jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi .

translation.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof , like a roaring lion ravening the prey  ; they have devoured souls  ; they have taken the treasure and precious things  ; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki long kum ki sing kiba kyrhuh halor ki mrad kiba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew , ki shim ïa ka pisa baroh bad ki jingdon jingem kat kaba ki lah ban ïoh , bad da kaba pynïap briew ki pynsah riewkynthei ïa kiba bun .
U bat synshar ïa ki por bad ki aiu ; u pynlong bad u weng ïa ki syiem ; long ma u , uba ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :

translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha don ha ka jingshah tuh ïajah ! Ka bor ka Ban kynther ïa phar ka la waiñ . To thuh briew ha ki jingïada ! To pharia ïa ka lynti bah ! To pynkhreh ïa ka thma !
translation.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba dien ban don hapoh ka Hima yn brai noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bynthiew .
translation.en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng , Hynrei kane ka lama kaba jem ïa U Trai ïa-ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab .
translation.en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .
But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
translation.kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah ban pynjot , bad ki nongtuh kim lah ban prong bad tuh .
Wat ainguh da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi! kynha ïa uno uno u jingri ha nga . Wat pynsah haduh mynstep ïa ka dohksah kñia ba la pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven  ; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning .
To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .
translation.kha: U la kam ba u long uba khraw , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u .  Une u briew u long kata ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaba la khot ‘ Ka Borbah’ ,  ki la ong .
un shim ïa u kyiuh thang jingiwbih ba la pynpyut da u rnga ding barhem na ka duwan bad ar kham ka jingiwbih , bad un wanrah ïa ki sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam .
translation.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the  Lord  , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil :

translation.kha: kumta haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki la ïa-ong , u la mynhynne na Judia bad u la leit phai shai Galilaïa ; ha ka lynti jong u shata u la dei ban ïaid lyngba ka Samaria .
translation.en: And he must needs go through Samaria .
And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba phim shym la tei . Mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym thung , bad ki soh Olib na ki dieng kiba phim shym thung .’
Ha uwei uwei na ki , thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , ba kin ïingjaiñ na ka bynta ki khaw-eit jai Israel .
translation.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet  ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .

translation.kha: Saw ngut na ki rangbah ba kham pawkhmat jong ka Hima Bashatei , u Asaraïah u khup jong u Jehohanan , u Berekhaïah u khun jong u Meshillemoth , u Jehosadak u khur jrong u Shallum , bun u Amasa u khun jong u Hadlai ruh ki ïaleh marpyrshah ïa ki jingleh ka kynhun shipai .
translation.en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim , Azariah the son of Johanan , Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth , and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum , and Amasa the son of Hadlai , stood up against them that came from the war ,

translation.kha: Kynsan u apostol jong U Trai u la ngin hangta , bad ka jingshai ka la lehbha Hapoh ka kamra byndi . U angel u la pynkhih ïa u Petros na ka tyrpeng , u la kyrsiew ïa u , bad u la ong , Pynkloi ! Khie joit ! mar kumta hi ki kynjri ki la hap na ki kti jong u Petros .
translation.en: And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran , Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donkam Ban im dawai shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynshet ka met jong phi .
translation.en: And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .

translation.kha: kumta kita ki briew ki leit wad phlangïap kyllan ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .
In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
translation.kha: khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat jong u baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ngi .
Uta uba kren ha ki thylli kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha bahryntieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .

translation.kha: U Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim u para jong u Joahas kum u syiem ka Judah bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la ïalam sha Ijipt da u Neko .
translation.en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and turned his name to Jehoiakim . And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .

translation.kha: Kam long ka pop ban ym kular ei ei ha U Trai ,
translation.en: But if thou shalt forbear to vow , it shall be no sin in thee .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki Israel ki jop ïa ki Philistia , ki da ïalaw shi lynter lynter naduh Mikhmash haduh Ashkelon .
translation.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon : and the people were very faint .
And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u Isaak um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kanaan .
Hynrei uno uno naba kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong u , u un-long uta uba ïa ka jingieit ïa U Blei la pynjanai da shisha . Dei da Kane ba kumno ngi la ban sngewskhem ba ngi long ha U Blei! :
translation.en: But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .

And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .
translation.kha: Pyndait ïa la ki waitlam !  u la hukum , bad ki la leh kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pyndait ïa la ka waitlam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah jong u , da kaba iehnoh shadien ïa ki arspah ngut lem bad ki jingkit jingbah .
Borabor kiba riewspah ki ïakynduh ïa ki paralok kiba thymmai , hynrei kiba tun kim da ban bat ïa kiba khyndiat jrut kiba ki don .
translation.en: Wealth maketh many friends  ; but the poor is separated from his neighbour .
As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Nga long U Blei Uba im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Karmel u ïeng hajrong tam ïa ka duriaw , kumta kan long ka jingkhlaiñ jong uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .

translation.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .
translation.kha: U wan poi ha ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka set blang kiba harud lynti , bad u rung shapoh ban leit shabar   . Ka jia ryngkhat ba ka dei kajuh ka krem ha kaba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki rieh kham shapoh jong kata ka krem .

translation.en: For while one saith , I am of Paul ; and another , I am of Apollos ; are ye not carnal ?
translation.kha: Haba uwei na phi u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ,  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos  — hato phim dang leh kum ki riewpyrthei ?
Ki paid Israel bakha lait im kin ym leh kano kano ka bym dei ïano ïano , kine ym ïathuh lamler , lymne pyrshang ban shukor . Kin manbha mala shongshngain , kin ym sheptieng ïano ïano .
translation.en: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity , nor speak lies  ; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth : for they shall feed and lie down , and none shall make them afraid .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid , To ai ba U Trai U Blei ki Jeraïah un long u Sakhi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha kum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kob buid ngan kylli jingkylli ïa i pa . dalade ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha , ngan sa phah ktien ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;

translation.kha: U mai ïa ki jaitbynriew — hato un ym pynshitom ïa ki ? U long u nonghikai jong ngi baroh — shano un ym ne jingtep ei ei ?
translation.en: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jongu uno a u jait mrad uba shu ïap hi ne uba la shah pynïap ha u mradkhlaw ym dei ban bam , hynrei lah banbeiñ pynbunkam na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthmu .
translation.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself , and the fat of that which is torn with beasts , may be used in any other use : but ye shall in no wise eat of it .
And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron , and in the hands of his sons  ; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Buh ïa kine baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ha ki kti ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ong ba kin pynkyntang ïa ki kum ka jingainguh kyrpang sha nga .
Ki la sngewsyiad bad mutlop bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba nga wer , kumta nga la pynjot ïa ki , kumba pha tip bhah .
translation.en: And they were haughty , and committed abomination before me : therefore I took them away as I saw good .

translation.kha: La phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki la leit shaw Antiokh , ha kaba ki la lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh jong ki phlangïap bad ki la ai ha ki ïa ka shithi .
translation.en: So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :

translation.kha: Khynñiuh namar ba kynjai than ka jingleh awria , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban don la ka jong ka tngaw , bad kawei pa kawei ka briew ka dei ban don la u jong u tnga .
translation.en: Nevertheless , to avoid fornication , let every man have his own wife , and let every woman have her own husband .
And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .
translation.kha: Haneng ka Synduk la don ki kherub kiba long ka dak ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar halor ka jaka ha kaba la ju map ïa ki pop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nadong shadong .

U Trai u la ïathuh ha u ba ka tnga u Jeroboam kan wan buid jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Susah U Trai u bthah ïa u Asaïah aïu ban nguh . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka brisoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .

translation.kha: U Samuel u pynpei aiwai u khunlangbrot nabar u thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingkñia ingiew ha U Trai . Nangta u duwai ha U Trai ban ïarap ïa ki Israel , Bad U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translation.en: And Samuel took a sucking lamb , and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the  Lord  : and Samuel cried unto the  Lord  for Israel  ; and the  Lord  heard him .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingma ha phi na ki liang baroh . Baroh phin phet krad . Uwei pa uwei un phet ïan namar la ka jingim , bad yn ym don shiah mian mynshem ngab wallam pur sa shisien ïa ki shipai .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring a fear upon thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts , from all those that be about thee  ; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth  ; and none shall gather up him that wandereth .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kai kaba u syiem Josaïah u la leh la Buh jingthoh ha Ka Hoshaïah Ong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat klet ïa kaei kaba per hikai ïa phi , kynmaw borabor ïa kai kaba nga ïathiah ïa phi banbeiñ leh .
translation.en: My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :

translation.kha: Lai snieh shadien “kata ka jingïateh lok , ki Israel ki sa pyntip ba kine ki briew ki dei shisha kiba shong basah hajan .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them , that they heard that they were their neighbours , and that they dwelt among them .

translation.kha: Bad hadien ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei kaei barieh kaba ki Jingot Bakhuid ki ong Shaphan jrong u , ki la pynhiar noh ïa u na ka diengïap bad ki la buh ïa u ha ka jingtep .
translation.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .
But my covenant will I establish with Isaac , which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan bat ïa la ka jutang bad u khun jong me u Isaak , ïa uba ka Sarah kan sa kha ha me kum ha kane ka aïom ha ka snem ka ban wan .

translation.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .
translation.kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali sha Kedesh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la leit bad u .
Ym kein uei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la sngewthuh balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u .
translation.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .

translation.kha: Wai pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleiñ baneh shnat kum kane na ka bynta ïa lade . Ñiew ïa ka ba ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba la pynkyntang sha nga .
translation.en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make , ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof : it shall be unto thee holy for the  Lord .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Adonijah u la sheptieng ïa u , bad ba u bat sah ïa ki reng kiba ha ki khongdong jong ka duwan , u da ong , nongking eh , nga kwah ba u Syiem Solomon un shai ha sa ba un ym phah pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: And it was told Solomon , saying , Behold , Adonijah feareth king Solomon : for , lo , he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar , saying , Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword .

translation.kha: ngiam ong ba ka kular jong U Blei kam skhem la treikam ; namar ym baroh’ ki paid Jerusalem’ ki longkmie ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :

translation.kha: Shimei ïa ki jingaiei kiba me la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ha khmih ki nongsakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah ba shaniah , kiba ha ba-bang sakhi ïa kiwei umdih .
translation.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .

translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh , u samla u la jaboh . Sa katai pat ba nga donkam ban leh ?
translation.en: The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?
Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  To bsuh noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka jingsop jong ka ! Me tharai ba ngan ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ?
Kumta U Jisu u la shim ïa u tyngka marwei na u paidbah , U la buh ïa la ki shympriah kti ha ki shkor jong uta u briew , U la wieh , bad U la ktah ïa u thylliej jong uta u briew .
translation.en: And he took him aside from the multitude , and put his fingers into his ears , and he spit , and touched his tongue  ;

translation.kha: Te U Abiram u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Sheshbassar bad u la mane ïa U Trai , U Blei Bymjukut .
translation.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .

translation.kha: Ngi kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ ba u Moses u ai ha im’ , ka spah kordor dak jongno ka jyrthiaw jong sem .
translation.en: Moses commanded us a law , even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob .

And when she came to the man of God to the hill , she caught him by the feet : but Gehazi came near to thrust her away . And the man of God said , Let her alone  ; for her soul is vexed within her : and the  Lord  hath hid it from me , and hath not told me .
translation.kha: hynrei haba ka la wan ha u Elisha ka la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u bad ka la bat ïa ki kjat jong u . U Gehasi u la mut sa ban khynñiat ïa ka sharud , hynrei u Elisha u ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka . Mem ïohi ba ka khuslai jur ? Bad U  Trai  um shym ïathuh ei ei shaphang kata .
katai kita kiba stad ki la rah ïa la ki jingtieng ba la pyndap da ka jingman na ka bynta ki sharak jong ki .
translation.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .

translation.kha: lin phim pait ju pule ha ka Hukum u Maaseïah ba man la ka sngi Sabbaton ki lyngdoh hapoh ka Templ ki pynkheiñ shisha ïa ka aiñ sngi Sabbaton , pynban Kim shah pynrem ?
translation.en: Or have ye not read in the law , how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath , and are blameless ?

translation.kha: Kumba te , balei mynta phi Kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaban buh ka jingkit halor ki met jrong ki parabangeit ïa kaba ym don ki kpa thnam jong ngi lymne ma me hi kiba Lah ban kit ?
translation.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?

translation.kha: u la sdang ban beh kthong ïa u Abner , u da mareh beit beit sha u .
translation.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner  ; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .

translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ka Maakah , ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan syiemsad , namar ba ka la thaw ïa ka bleithaw bajai jong ka Asherah ka blei jingkharoi . U Asa u pynkyllon ïa ka bleithaw bad u thang ïa ka ha ka them jong ka wah Kidron .
translation.en: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove  ; and Asa destroyed her idol , and burnt it by the brook Kidron .

translation.kha: Nangta rah ïa ki shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad buh ïa ki ha khmat ka syndah ka Jutang , ha kaba nga ïashem bad me .
translation.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you .

translation.kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlieh da pud kum ka jinganna da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingainguh da ki rmiang shyieng kiba phla ïa u kum U Trai .
translation.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba pynhieng ïa phi ban kyrkhoit ba ngi long ki ba-bieit kum ki masi ?
translation.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?

translation.kha: Te u syiem u la phah ïa u Jehudi ban leit shim ïa ka kot kli . U la leit shim na ka kamra u Elishama badno u la pule ïa ka ha u syier bad ha baroh ki rangbah synshar Kiba ïeng sawdong jong u .
translation.en: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll : and he took it out of Elishama the scribe s chamber . And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king , and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king .
For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U  Trai  kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .
Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka bor jongno ki ngab bymman bad kiba leh jhur . Ma to , U Trai , por la kren .
translation.en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .

translation.kha: U ijuh u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ïa-ong ha ki , Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipa hadien phin sa ïohi ïa per .’ Hato dei Kanah kaba phi ïakiew para ma phi hi ?
translation.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?

translation.kha: Naba katba phi sdang ïabam , phi ïabam shuwa ïa la ka jong ka jingbam miet , te don kiba la thngan katba kiwei ki lah da buaid .
translation.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper : and one is hungry , and another is drunken .

translation.kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynhied samla jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ba shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u shakri jong u Abraham , bad ki ïakhmih lang baroh .
translation.en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta Jong phi kiba Kohnguh ïa nga , ka bor jong nga katba pynim kan kiew halor jongno phi kum ka sngi bad kan wallam jingïohthiah kum ki jat sngaid . phiah long kiba laitluid bad bakmen kum ki khun masi ba la pyllait na ka sem .
translation.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .

translation.kha: Yn ym don sing hangamei , ym don ki mutdur bashyrkhei ki ban ïadat na kata ka lynti . Kito ïa kiba U Tiras u la pyllait im kin ïaid sha iing na kata ka lynnong .
translation.en: No lion shall be there , nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon , it shall not be found there  ; but the redeemed shall walk there :

translation.kha: To un kmen ïa ka jingrwai jongki nga , namar ka jingkmen jong nga ka wan na u .
translation.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet : I will be glad in the  Lord .
And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the  Lord  : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki , bad u la ai ha kawei pa kawei na ki jait kiba sah jong ki Israel shi bynta jong ka ri .
Nga ïathied ha ka lynti ka hok , nga bud ïa ki lynti ka jinglehhok ,
translation.en: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :
And his deeds , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Josaïah u la leh — ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  , ka jingkohnguh jong u ïa ka Hukum , bad ïa ka histori jong u naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut — la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah .
Bad u Nathan u bynrap , Nangta , Kaba phi ïalang ïakren bad u Syiem dab , ngan wan rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka khan jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .
And he doeth great wonders , so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men ,
translation.kha: Une u mradkhlaw uba ar , u la leh ki kambah kiba khraw ; u la pynlong ïa ka ding ban wan hiar na bneng sha ka pyrthei ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh .

Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka nongbah kaba sarong katta Katta ïa la ka bor bad kaba pyllait ba ka khong ha ka jingshngain . Ki bynriew jong ka ki pyrkhat ba ka nongbah jong ki ka long kambah khraw tam ha ka pyrthei . Katno kan long ka jaka kaba kynha , ka jaka ha kaba ki mawkyrdon kin pynjahthait ! Uwei uwei baroh uba ïaid lyngba jong ka un kynrad den ha ka jingpyntieng .
translation.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly , that said in her heart , I am , and there is none beside me : how is she become a desolation , a place for beasts to lie down in ! every one that passeth by her shall hiss , and wag his hand .
Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
translation.kha: Ki skain kiba ïap ki lah ban pyniwtung ïa baroh ka jingiwbih hapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingmutlop ka lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingstad kaba khraw tam .
wai lada ki khot ïa nga U Blei jong ki nabar ki kam ba ki dei ki Briew jong nga bad ba ki tip ïa nga ,
translation.en: Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .

translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judia u leit sha ka ïinglieng jong u nongpynkhiah tymmen bad u bam u thah bad u .
translation.en: So he went back with him , and did eat bread in his house , and drank water .

translation.kha: Ki bleithaw jyllang ka Nibhas sad Tartak ; bad ki briew ka Sepharbaim ki kñia ïa la ki khun kumin ki jingainguh thang ïa ki blei Amram bad Anammelekh .
translation.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak , and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech , the gods of Sepharvaim .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kambah ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïaishah bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ha ka jingïabam lang malade ha ki jingduwai .
translation.en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Josis u la sngewbang jar bad um ong shikynta mad . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli biang ïa u , Hato me long U Messaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?
translation.en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?

translation.kha: Pi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha ti umbah rit tur na kine ki nongbam jong nga namar ba u dien u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .

translation.kha: U Eliab , u Pilat bad u Sophar ki la ar ïa kaei ba U Trai u la bah ïa ki baneh leh , bad U Trai u la Jobab ïa ka jingduwai jyllang u .—Job .
translation.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .

translation.kha: Kin phai noh na kaba shahshkor ïa ka jingshisha badno kin pynleit jingdam ha ki puriskam kai .
translation.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .

translation.kha: U ieit ïa ki briew jong ngi malu u hi da lade u la tei ka synlar na ka boitha jong ngi .
translation.en: For he loveth our nation , and he hath built us a synagogue .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa u Gog : Haba kata ka por ka la poh , men sa sdang pyrthuh ïa ka buit sner .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :

translation.kha: Katba bud ka un-long , lada uno uno uba bah ïa u kpu lane dei na ka khuri jong U Trai ha ka rukom kaba pynkhlaiñbor ïa U , ma u ne ma ka ki long kiba la pynrem ha ka pop pyrshah ïa ka met dara ïa ka snam jong U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread , and drink this cup of the Lord , unworthily , shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord .
And came even before the king s gate : for none might enter into the king s gate clothed with sackcloth .
translation.kha: Um shym la rung shapoh namar ym don uba lah ban rung shapoh ha ki jaiñ khain .

translation.en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And he took it , and did eat before them .
translation.kha: ïa kaba u la shim bad bam ha khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
translation.kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .
Ki shipai ki la thaw ïa ka pynsat da ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la pynphong halor ka khlaiñ jong u ; nangta ki la pynkut ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh ha u bad ki la wan shat u bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns , and put it on his head , and they put on him a purple robe ,

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong me kan kham phyrnai baneh ïa ka jingshaïong ka sngi ha ka por shiteng sngi , bad ki kynta ba-dum tam jong ka jingim kin phyrnai kum ka step phyrngab .
translation.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .

translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :24 ) Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki nongaplangbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang . —Proberb 27 :23 .
translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :24 ) Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
For neither did his brethren believe in him .
translation.kha: ( Wat ki para shynrang jong u hi kim shym la ngeit ha u . )
U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Hapharaim bad Manasseh ba sha Seng , Da shisha phi ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phira ïoh Shua shuh nonglur ka shi bynta .
translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :
And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone , where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa u Ksuid , uba la shukor ïa ki , la bret sha ka pung ka ding bad u kyndok , ha kaba la lah bret ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler , bad kin shah pynkordit mynsngi bad mynmiet junom la junom .

translation.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hushai u ïathuh ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u la ai ha u Absalom bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai .

U phah ïa ki nonglamktien shad kylleng ki bynta jong ka jaka ki Mnason ban khot ïa ki baneh bud ïa u . U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Asher , Sebulun , bad ki Naphtali , mala ki ruh ki la wan ba ïasoh bad u .
translation.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh  ; who also was gathered after him : and he sent messengers unto Asher , and unto Zebulun , and unto Naphtali  ; and they came up to meet them .

translation.kha: U Elijah u leit shuh u Baïap pynlang ong , Sa katto-katne slem ba phin pynbeit ïa ki jingmut jyllang phira ? Lada U Trai u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baal u daiñ U Blei , mano ïa u ! Hynñiew u bajaipdeh u la Shua sngap jar .
translation.en: And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .
And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; bad baroh ki la dih na ka .
Haba u Samuel u la tymmen , u rain nongrahbor ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ha Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Samuel was old , that he made his sons judges over Israel .

translation.kha: Ngan jongu da kaba nongbuaid eh ïa ki Hukum jong me , namar men ai shuh hajuh ka jingshemphang ïa nga .
translation.en: I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart .

translation.kha: Pynphong ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Yiron u hynmen jong me bad ha ki Kynhun shynrang jong u . ngat pynkupbor ïa ki bad pynkyntang da kaba pynsleh ïa ki da ka umphniang Olib , khnang ba ki haka ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito kiba lute ïa ka kin shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kwah . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .
Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sniew lane ban siew kylliang ïa u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh .

translation.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  : because he hath said , The river is mine , and I have made it .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt kan long kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  Namar me la ong ba ka wah Nile ka dei ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka ,
Bad u ju bynrap , Ba ngan jin da la longsem u nongbishar ! Te uno uno uba don ka jingïakajia lane ka jingtip ïa kano kano u lah baneh wanlam sha nga , bad len ai ha u ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: Absalom said moreover , Oh that I were made judge in the land , that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me , and I would do him justice !

translation.kha: Me tip kaei ban leh ; mem dei ban shahskhor ïa u ba-bang ïap da kaba suk .
translation.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom , and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace .

translation.kha: Em shym la ai ka jingbymman Olib na ka bynta ka khlieh jong nga , hynrei ka la thap ïa ka khliehduh jong nga da ka jingsleh ba-ibieit .
translation.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .

translation.kha: Nabal don ha Jingthoh bakhyndai la ong ïa kane shaphrang ka sngi kaba hynñiew : U Blei u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew na ka kur Jong u baroh .
translation.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim don jingman satia ; ki im bad ki ïap thang bad ka jingkthang ha ki dohnud .
