translation.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul , and never eateth with pleasure .

translation.kha: Sa kano ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki parad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman Jong ki briew jong ngi , ki briew Ibbah ïong , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .’
translation.en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , that dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth : thou hast made heaven and earth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba shong ha ka khet shajrong ki kherub , me marwei me long U Blei , uba synshar ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei . Me thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .
U Laban u ong ha u Jakob , Kane ka kyndon maw ka long ka jingpynkynmaw ïa ngi baroh ar ngut . Namar kata , la khat kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Gaal .
translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;

And Saul s son had two men that were captains of bands : the name of the one was Baanah , and the name of the other Rechab , the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite , of the children of Benjamin : ( for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin :
translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u don ar ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba long ki nongïalam ïa ki kynhun lute , u Baanah bad u Rekhab , ki khun shynrang jong u Rimmon , uba na Beeroth , hapoh ka jait Benjamin . ( Ïa ka Beeroth la ñiew kum ka bynta jong ki Benjamin .

Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki daiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na naba duk kiba la buhai bynda na ka bynta ki ram . Ha ka templ U Blei jong ki , ki dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki la shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .
translation.en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven  ; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days :
translation.kha: U Moses u rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad kumta ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka la dum ngaiñ lai sngi lynter .
Hadien ka por kaban jlan u kynrad jong eit ki shakri u la wan pat dara u la peiñ jingkheiñ na ki .
translation.en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh , and reckoneth with them .

translation.kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong ki hi , ki la kyrpad ïa im bad ïasaid na ka bynta ka lad ban ïadon pyntha ha kaba ïarap ïa ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .
translation.en: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift , and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints .

translation.kha: Kum u la pyrshah , ‘ Ko Kpa Ephraim ! To sngewtynnat ïa to , bad phah ïa u lashai ban wieh ïa ka shaniah ti jong u ha ka um khyndiat bad pyntngen ïa u thylliej jong nga , namar la ei ha ka jingshem bakhraw ha kane ka ding !’
translation.en: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue  ; for I am tormented in this flame .

Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym thaw ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nongri khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki khunlung shi lynter lynti shaduh ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ?

translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , kin shitom namar kata ka jingbymïaineh jong phi , tad haduh ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .

translation.en: Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , and Rabbah  ; two cities with their villages :
translation.kha: Don ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) bad ka Rabbah : ar tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .
translation.kha: bad phin long kiba kmen lada phin kynmaw ïa ki bad phi lah ban kren ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok jong nga , katba phi dang ap ïa kata ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong phi ban long kiba khlem thohbria bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat U Blei bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .
U thoh bha ha ka Examination .
translation.en: He wrote well in the examination .

translation.kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat pat !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ba-bang peit pat , bad nga la khum ïa u .
translation.en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong bun u la ïohi ba u paidbah byllien u la on wan sha u , kumta u la ong ha u Philip , Hangno ngi lah ban thied jingbam ka ïa-ban dap ban bsiat ïa kine ki Briew baroh ?
translation.en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip ,  Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?

translation.kha: U weng noh na ka kam ïa ki lyngdoh ibha ki sahmiet —Judah ki la pynkyntang ban ai jingkha halor ki iba ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baïar ki lyngdoh kiba ai jingbna sha u Baal , shata ka sneng , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .
translation.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .
Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .
translation.kha: Da ka jingpynbaptis , ïa ngi la btep bad u , bad ngi ïadon bynta bad ka jingïap jong u , khnang ba , kumba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap da ka bor jong ka burom U Kpa , kumta ruh ma ngi , ngi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .

translation.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures , behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures , with his four faces .
translation.kha: Katba nga nang peit ïa kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw , nga la ïohi saw tylli ki shalyntem ba ki hiar ha ka khyndew , kawei kawei marsyndah bad ki .
Ki khmat ki long kum ka sharai ïa ka met . Lada ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met Jong phi borbah kawei kan dap da ka jingshai ;
translation.en: The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ,

translation.en: And Jesus answered him , saying ,  It is written , That man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U briew um lah ban im tang da u kpu .’
Namar ba ngi don ïa kan ka jingkyrmen , ngi lama kiba shlur bha .
translation.en: Seeing then that we have such hope , we use great plainness of speech :

And the  Lord  smelled a sweet savour  ; and the  Lord  said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man s sake  ; for the imagination of man s heart is evil from his youth  ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong ka jingkñia ainguh ka la pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , bad U la ong ha lade ,  Lano lano ruh ngan ym buh ïa ka pyrthei hapoh ka jingtim namar kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ; nga tip ba naduh ba ki dang samla , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki long kiba sniew . Lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , kumba nga la leh ha kane ka sien .

translation.en: Yet they went in unto her , as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot : so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah , the lewd women .
translation.kha: Ki leit phai bad ïai leit sha kine ki nuti . Ki leit biang sha ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ; kito ki kynthei barunar .

translation.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come , he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab , which is in the border of Arnon , which is in the utmost coast .
translation.kha: Haba u Balak u ïohsngew ba u Balaam u la wan , u leit ïakynduh ïa u ha Ar , ka nongbah kaba harud ka wah Arnon ha ka khappud Moab .
( Naba ki Saddusi ki ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap Bad ba ym ne ki angel lane ki mynsiem ; ishyrkhei ki Persis ki ngeit ïa Kine baroh lai tylli . )
translation.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .

translation.kha: namar ki la ïaheh byrsha ïa ki hukum jong U blei Badonbor Baroh malade ki la kyntait ïa ki jingbah jong u .
translation.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
And thine elder sister is Samaria , she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand : and thy younger sister , that dwelleth at thy right hand , is Sodom and her daughters .
translation.kha: Ka hynmen jong pha , ka dei ka Samaria ha ka phang bashatei , ryngkat bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ka para jong pha lem bad ki nongrit jong ka , ka dei ka Sodom ha ka phang bashathie .
Te U Josis u la jubab , Khie leit noh , ko Soitan ! Ka Jingthoh bakhadduh ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Tlai U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u hi !’
translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto him ,  Get thee hence , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .

translation.kha: Da ka jingpynïap , ïa ngi la btep bad u , bad ngi ïadait bynta bad ka jingïap jongngi u , khnang ba , kumba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap da ka bor jongki ka bud U Kpa , kumta ruh ma ngi , moi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .
translation.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .
Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him , and would have killed him  ; but she could not :
translation.kha: Kumta ka Herodias ka buhnud pyrshah ïa u Ïoannis bad ka la kwah ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kam shym la lah namar u Herod .
kumto u Amram u kynriah noh ïa la ka dara , bad u wei shong wan sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre ha Hebron , bad hangta u tei ka duwan ha U thri .
translation.en: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: nabar U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi kotbah ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pait .
translation.en: For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .

translation.kha: Ïa me , ko khun jong nga , yn khot u nongïathuhlypa jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Hano Eh . Men leit ha shuwa jong U Trai ban pynkhreh ka lynti na ka bniat jngai u ,
translation.en: And thou , child , shalt be called the prophet of the Highest : for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways  ;

translation.kha: bad ka Astarte ka ai ïa kane ka kherub ban lytar rah pah sha u Mordekai :
translation.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;

translation.kha: Naba ka Jingot Bakhuid ka ong , U Blei u pahuh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u . Ka long kaba shai , da shisha , ba ki ktien kiei ki baroh kim kynthup ïa U Blei hi , uba buh ïa ktieh kiei baroh’ hapoh U Khrist .
translation.en: For he hath put all things under his feet . But when he saith all things are put under him , it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , To ngeit ïa nga , ko ka briew , ba ka par kan poi Haba ki briew ktang ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .

translation.kha: U ebanjelist U Trai u la wan biang bad kyrwep ïa u ha ka sien kaba ar bad u ong , Khie joit bad bam , lymda kumta men shitom ha ka jingïaid lynti .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  came again the second time , and touched him , and said , Arise and eat  ; because the journey is too great for thee .

translation.kha: Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun nuti bad hikai ïa u kumno Ban barew ; u la long u nongbam briew .
translation.en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Jobab ïa u , Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka kun pun bishar lane ban pynbeit ïa ka jingdon jingem pynpdang jong phi ar ngut ?
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?

translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phiah ka long kum ki khait , ki ar thylliej ki skei synrap kiba bam jingbamsap hapdeng ki thiaw lili .
translation.en: I rose up to open to my beloved  ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa ka iitkhmat jongngi u hapoh ba u Hasael u la kem peiñ . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat thup .
translation.en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .
It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
translation.kha: Ngi burom ïa U Blei namar kaei kaba u la buhrieh ; ngi burom ïa ki syiem ïa kaei kaba ki batai .
Kim khong bniat ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u ai , ba ki long kiba bieit tasam bad kiba eh dohnud .
translation.en: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :

translation.kha: lada me maham ïa u briew basniew , bad um shym Sangeh na kaba leh jop , un ïap hi kum u nongpdem , hynrei ïa ka jingim jongno me yn pyllait .
translation.en: Yet if thou warn the wicked , and he turn not from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .

translation.kha: Nalorkata nga ong , A Trai Nongsynshar , to ken noh ! Kumno ki Briew jong me ki da ban lait im ? Ki hir kiba rit bad ibha tlot main katta !
translation.en: Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kiba la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’

Nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum ka sur kaba wan napdeng ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kaweh la ong , Sei gram u kew na ka bynta ka bainong shiah sngi , bun lai kilo u barli na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi . Hynrei wat pynjot noh ïa ki tieng Olib bad ïa ki bri shawei !
translation.en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say , A measure of wheat for a penny , and three measures of barley for a penny  ; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine .
Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .
translation.kha: Wat ïathuh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ha Gath shaphang ka jingshahjop jong ngi ; wat ai ba kin ïohi ba phi ïam . Ko ki briew ka Beth Leaphrah , pyn-i ïa ka jinglyng-a jong phi da kaba kyrsum ha u pui pui !
Katba u dang mudui , ka durkhmat jong u ka la kylla dur , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla lieh byrni .
translation.en: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .

translation.kha: ki jingput ki la ang , bad ïa shibun ki briew lad U Blei kiba la ïap la pynïapmat .
translation.en: And the graves were opened  ; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose ,
Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Lada nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha , phin sa pynïap ïa nga , bad lada nga ai jingmut ïa phi , phin ym shahshkor satia .
Ma phi kiba jingartatien na u ïakob , u sharati lad U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Jeraïah , ïa uba U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei! u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .

translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei kaba long tang marwei , ka me don mano moi baneh sumar ïa ka , ka la buhai ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei bad ka ïai duwai malade pan na u ïa ka jingaibor mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translation.en: Now she that is a widow indeed , and desolate , trusteth in God , and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day .

translation.kha: U Tom u shoh shwa ngiah .
translation.en: Tom hit me first .

translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ong , Ko khup u briew , leit shwa ki paid Israel bad ïong ha ki ïa Kaei kaba nga ong ïa me ba men ong .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .

translation.kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman babha phi pynlong ki long kiba shakuriaw kumto ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba Don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
translation.en: They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba ïa-pyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
ka Amam , ka Shema , ka Mahlah ,
translation.en: Amam , and Shema , and Moladah ,

translation.kha: Leit nongkit bniah shaphang kata ; bad lada ka long kabu shisha ba la ar kum ïa kata ka mana pyrman ,
translation.en: Then shalt thou enquire , and make search , and ask diligently  ; and , behold , if it be truth , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought among you  ;

translation.kha: sa shi bynta na ka la bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , bad kiba kamar-tama shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi kin ïng ap phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyntang jong kiwei ki nongap phira .
translation.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .

translation.kha: kiba ïateh lakam bad pa ki la shukor ïa Phin ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki brisoh kiba ïasuk bad phi , mynta ki la jop ïa phi . Kito ki paro kiba ju ïabam plain bad phi , ki la pynap jingriam ïa phi ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ Shano kato ka jingïa-umsnam baroh ba u don ?’
translation.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïajubab ïa ki , Katno phi la bakla ! Bad phi tip balei ? Ka longsyiem namar ba phim tip ïa ki Jingot Bakhuid lane ïa ka bor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?

translation.kha: Kata ka khubor na U Trai pyrthuh ïa u Baalah bad ïa ka longïing jong u la ai da u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa namar ki pop ba u Baasha u la ni pyrshah ïa u Trai . U la pynkyiuh bitar ïa U Trai ym dang namar ki kam bymman ba u la leh , kumba u syiem Jeroboam u la leh ha shuwa jong u , hynrei ruh namar ba u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Jeroboam .
translation.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the  Lord  against Baasha , and against his house , even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the  Lord  , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands , in being like the house of Jeroboam  ; and because he killed him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Shibboleth bad u Geshem ki phuh khubor sha la , da naba ai jingmut ba kan ïakynduh bad ki ha kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Madmannah Ono . Kane ka la long ka buit sianti jong ki ban pyrshang ngab buh ïa nga ha ka jingma .
translation.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me , saying , Come , let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono . But they thought to do me mischief .
That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang U  Trai  hi u long U Blei — ym don uwei pat .
U Moses u leh kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .

translation.kha: U la long ma u , uba la ai ki jingtieng sngewbha ha u bynriew ; u la thung katto katne ngut ban long ki apostol ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïathuhlypa ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïalap ; ïa khawai pat , ki nongsharai balang bad ki nonghikai .
translation.en: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;

translation.kha: Da kynmaw ba u brai Uba phi jied ban long u syiem u de ban Long uta ïa uba U tharai hi u la jied . U dei ban long na ka jait ka kynja jong phi hi ; wat ieid syiem ïa u nongwei .
translation.en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .
I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ym ïap ; hynrei ngan im bad ngan pynbna ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul , and bind them for a sign upon your hand , that they may be as frontlets between your eyes .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kine ki hukum bad ñiewkor ïa ki . Teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi kum ka jingpynkynmaw .
Ïa une u khunlung nga la pan na u , bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la pan .
translation.en: For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :

translation.kha: U Joseph um sngewtynnat haba u ïohi ïa u kjap jong u ba u buh ïa la ka kti kamon ha ka Khlieh u Ephraim ; kumta u bat ïa ka kti u kpa jyllang u Ban pynkynriah ïa ka na ka khleiñ u Ephron sha ka khlieh u Manoah .
translation.en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim , it displeased him : and he held up his father s hand , to remove it from Ephraim s head unto Manasseh s head .
Cain , Gibeah , and Timnah  ; ten cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Kain , ka Gibeah , bad ka Timnah : shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .

translation.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki la ujor ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi leh ïa kane ha ngi ?

translation.en: And all the people shall hear , and fear , and do no more presumptuously .
translation.kha: Te uwei pa uwei un sa ïohsngew ïa kata bad un sngewsheptieng , bad yn ym don shuh uba nud ban leh kumta .

translation.en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and unto all the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u thoh ïa ka Hukum U Blei bad u ai ïa ka ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .

Kin ïaleit pyrshah ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , lam bad ki nongbud jong u ïa kiba u la khot , u la jat , bad kiba ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa ki , namar ba u dei U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem jong ki Syiem .
translation.en: These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .

And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him  ; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him , Make this fellow return , that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he be an adversary to us : for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master ? should it not be with the heads of these men ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia ki bitar ïa u Akhish , bad ki ong ha u ,  Phah un leit noh sha ka jaka kaba phi la ai ïa u . Wat shah ba un leit bad ngi sha ka thma , ïoh u phai pyrshah ïa ngi katba ngi dang ïaleh . Naba na-ei un ïoh ka lad kaba kham bha ban pynsngewbha biang ïa la u kynrad ? Hato ym dei da ka jingïap ki briew jong ngi ?
kumta ki bynriew ki ïap , khlem lah shuh ban khie . Kin ym la ban kyndit shuh Kaba ka sahkut bneng ka dang ïaishah ; Kin ym lah ban khiew thuh lano lano na ka jingïohthiah jong ki .
translation.en: So man lieth down , and riseth not : till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .

translation.kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïadon lang ha ka jingïasyllok bajan sad ki la ïadem ïa la ki jingjrong jingtim iwei ïa iwei pait .
translation.en: And all that believed were together , and had all things common  ;

translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la ong ha u rangbah synshar , Krit ha ngi da ka ktien Aramaik . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . wiat kren-ïa ha ka ktien Hebru ; Baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïa-shahskhor .
translation.en: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh , Speak , I pray thee , unto thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and speak not to us in the Jews  language , in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ka jingïap ka la wan da uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ka wan da uwei u briew .
bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U Trai u tip ba ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba stad ki long ki bymdondor ei ei .
translation.en: And again , The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise , that they are vain .

translation.kha: Kumta u jubab ïa u syiem , Ai hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong . Hukum ïa ki jingkieng syiem ban pyndeng ha u kulai jong phi .
translation.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :

translation.kha: Nangta u hawei u ïaheh ha u Sadok bad u Abiasaph , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut katba u la ai ha u Absalom bad ha ki nongïalam jongnga ki Israel , Bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u Iphtahel u la ai .
translation.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .
And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .
translation.kha: Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewsih , bad ïa u briew uba la leh ïa kaba kum kata kaei kaei la dei ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong phi .
Ïa ngi la pyndonburom bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroh . La ñiew ïa me kum ki nongshukor , pynban ngi kren ïa ka jingsma ;
translation.en: By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;

translation.kha: Ko Peullethai , wat babuhrieh ïa ki jingbakla ba la kun ïa nga ! Wat ai ba ka jingkhot jongnga nga ïa ka jingshisha , yn pynsngap jar !
translation.en: O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka Kper ha kata ka jaka ha kaba la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha sakma ka kper la don ka jingtep kaba thymmai ha kaba ym pat shym la tep ïano ïano .
translation.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat mynta , ong U Trai , kylla-kaba-mut da bashisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew .
translation.en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u phah ïa ka bor ka jingbakla shun trei ha ki khnang ba kin thwet ïa kaei ka bymshisha .
translation.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :
Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ïa ngi ban ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym buh ki bri sohwaiñ lane thied ïa ki . U la hukum ïa ngi ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ , khnang ba ngin don ha kane ka ri ha kaba ngi im kum ki nongwei .
Ka jingthew , ïa phi la thew ha ki tarajur bad la shem ba phi duna palat ;
translation.en: TEKEL  ; Thou art weighed in the balances , and art found wanting .
And he will take the tenth of your seed , and of your vineyards , and give to his officers , and to his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na u kew bad na u sohwaiñ jong phi na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar Aiñ bad kiwei ki rangbah synshar .

Uwei na ki Shakri jong u Nongbah u ong ha ka Gabriel ka tnga jong u Nabal , Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la phah katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynne u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kamai kaba nga ong ; pynsaphred jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ïai-ong ha phi .
translation.en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .
The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .
translation.kha: U la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei , hynrei baroh kiwei pat , ki la long kiba sniew ha khmat U Blei , bad ka jingleh jubor ka la saphriang kylleng .
Ki shipai ki la leh ïa kaba la hukum ïa ki . Ki la shym ïa u Paul bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha kata ka miet haduh Antipatris .
translation.en: Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka ktien U Blei ka la nang phriang bad nang roi .
translation.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied .
Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .
translation.kha: Baroh ki pyrshang ban shem sngewbha bad ki briew kiba khraw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad kito kiba lah ban pynsngewbha .
Kumne ki la kem ïa ki bad ki la buh ïa ki ha phatok haduh ka sngur kaba bud , namar ba ka la dier eh .
translation.en: And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abram u ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , kan myntoi aïu ka kyang jongno me ïa nga haba ngam don khun ? U nongïoh patan jong ang u dei dang u Eleasar uba na Damaskos .
translation.en: And Abram said , Lord  God  , what wilt thou give me , seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiwei ki synran , ki la ïohi ïa u Paidbah’ babun sawdong jong ki bad katto Katno na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïania bad ki .
translation.en: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .
translation.kha: Haba kumta , phi dei ne phim dei u syiem ?  Ka Jesebel ka jubab ,  To khie joit na jingthiah , lehkmen bad to bam . Ngan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka bri sohwaiñ u Naboth !

ïakmen ha khmat U Trai ryngkat mala ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phoi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki sngwthuh , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi . Lem ïa kane ha kata ka iaka mane Blei .
translation.en: And thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates , and the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are among you , in the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to place his name there .

translation.kha: Naba ym don khubor jingïathuhlypa ka la ju wan tang na ka mon u briew , hynrei ki briew ki la longsyiem hapoh ka jingpynïaid jongno U Mynsiem Bakhuid katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .
translation.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: To long uba mutlop ! To long uba matlah ! To long uba buaid khulom kano Kanah ka waiñ ! To ïaid sheng sheng khlem dih wat tang shi lip !
translation.en: Stay yourselves , and wonder  ; cry ye out , and cry : they are drunken , but not with wine  ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .

translation.kha: hynñiew haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u khun , ki la jong ha lade , ‘ Une u long u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin pynïap ïa u , bad ngin ïoh ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u !’
translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?
translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba jah noh , ka dei ka jingiwtung kaba pynïap ; hynrei ha kito kiba la pynim , ka long ka jingiwbih kaba wallam jingim . Uei keiñ , uba lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam ?

Ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , U Trai u ong , Ko ki jingïathuhlypa , ka sngi jong pa’ ka la jaiñ kut noh ; ka sngi ka la jan wai na ka bynta jong phi . Namar ba phi ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong ang , phin ym don shuh ki jingïohthiah don ïathuhlypa , bad Phin ym lah ban ïathuh lytar ei ei .
translation.en: Therefore night shall be unto you , that ye shall not have a vision  ; and it shall be dark unto you , that ye shall not divine  ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Elieser u khun jong u Dodabahu , na ka shnong Mareshah , u la maham ïa u Jehoshaphat bad ong ,  Namar ba phi la ïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah , U  Trai  un sa pynjot ïa kaei kaba phi la tei .  Bad ki liengbah ki la shah pynjot bad kim shym la lah ban ïaid duriaw .

translation.en: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria : and Ahab his son reigned in his stead .

translation.en: That the  Lord  appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon .

ha kaba u tawiar sanphew sepngi jong ka Baalah shai ka ri lum jong ka Edom , ter ter sha ka phrang bahakhlieh jong u Lum Jearim ( lane Khesalon ) , thret sha Beth Shemesh , bad ter ter lyngba ka Timnah .

translation.en: For they fled from the swords , from the drawn sword , and from the bent bow , and from the grievousness of war .

translation.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair  ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang ïa u Baïap baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses u ong , Sngap mynta , phi ki nongïaleh pyrshah ! Hato ngi hap Pynmih um na une u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi! ?
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?

And David rose up early in the morning , and left the sheep with a keeper , and took , and went , as Jesse had commanded him  ; and he came to the trench , as the host was going forth to the fight , and shouted for the battle .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Dabid u khie dang step phyrngab , u ieh ïa ki langbrot ha uwei pat u nongsharai , u rah ïa kata ka jingbam , bad u leit kumba u Jesse u la bthah ïa u . Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .

translation.en: Saying , Surely blessing I will bless thee , and multiplying I will multiply thee .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit bad leh kumta Rumah U Trai u la lei ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went away , and did as the  Lord  had commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .

Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .

translation.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .

translation.en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .

And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet , and toward her children which she shall bear : for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness , wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates .

translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .

And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ïakynduh ïa kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngdoh bad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , kiba thied bad kiba die , kiba ai kylliang bad kiba shim kylliang , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk .

translation.en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?

U Samuel u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong , mala ngat u leit bad ïathmu ha U tharai .
translation.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .
And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and put water there , to wash withal .
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad u pyndap ïa ka da ka um .

translation.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .
translation.kha: Kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shukor ïa phi ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki briew kiba ïasuk bad phi , mynta ki la jop ïa phi . Kito ki paralok kiba ju ïabam lang bad phi , ki la pynap jingriam ïa phi ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ Shano kato ka jingstad-buit baroh ba u don ?’

Ki kpa ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jongnga ki ; ki kmienah kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki ïakhun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki khiew kurim kin long pyrda ïa ki byrsha kurim kynthei jong ki bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei ïa-pyrshah ïa ki kyiuh jong ki .
translation.en: The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
And she said , I pray you , let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now , that she tarried a little in the house .

Lada kata ka kynthei kam la ban ai ïa u khunlangbrot , kan Wanlam ar tylli ki lyngdkhur ne ar tyllep ki paro , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang nabar kaei pat na ka bynta ka jingkynha ainguh namar ka pop nabar u lyngdoh un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka , bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid .
translation.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb , then she shall bring two turtles , or two young pigeons  ; the one for the burnt offering , and the other for a sin offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for her , and she shall be clean .
When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki wan ha ka bor , baroh ki lehkmen , hynrei haba ki briew kiba sniew ki synshar , ki briew ki buhrieh ïa lade .
U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum Katai ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba ïa-pyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
translation.en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi ; naduh ka por ba la kha ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi . Wat sheptieng ; phi long u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ieit .
U Trai u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: The word which came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: ‘ U Trei u la nong ha U Trai jong la : To shong hangne ha ka liang ka mon jong nga tad haduh ba sam buh ïa ki nongshun jongnga me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
translation.en: The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool ?

translation.kha: U blem u la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pyllait im ïa phi! ha ka rukom kob phylla , nabar ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin im .
translation.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban bam ïa ki met jong ki shipai sad dih ïa ka snam lad ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei , ïa ki baroh yn pynsep ruma pynïap ïa ki langbrot shynna ne ki khunlangbrot ne ki blang ne ki masi dab kiba sngaid .
translation.en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bullocks , all of them fatlings of Bashan .
And the voice spake unto him again the second time ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la kren biang ha u ,  Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .

translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !
translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kaba la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .

translation.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot ,  Ngan ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito kiba dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynjot kito kiba dei ban shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah kin pynjot iwei ïa iwei pat .
Pynban , kumba la Ong ha katto katne ki jaka ha ki Jingthoh bakhuid : U Briew u long aïu , A Blei , ba men pyrkhat ïa u , tang uba kynja briew , ba trai suidñiew ïa u ?
translation.en: But one in a certain place testified , saying , What is man , that thou art mindful of him ? or the son of man , that thou visitest him ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshai ka sharak yn ym ïohi shuh da lei Lai ha pha ; ïa ka na u nongleitkurim bad ka nongleitkurim yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ki nongkhaïi jong pha ki la long babha donbor tam ha ka pyrthei baroh , bad da ka Mynta balamler pha la shukor ïa ki briew baher jong ka pyrthei !
translation.en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee  ; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee : for thy merchants were the great men of the earth  ; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived .

translation.kha: U syiem Saul , ki hynmen jrong phi , bad baroh kiwei ki Israel ki don ha ka Them Elah , ki daiñ ïaleh sma ïa ki Philistia .
translation.en: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel , were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la ïakren , kumta u la kyllan ïa ki , Balei ba phi ïakren para ma phira shaphang ka jingbymdon jingbam ei ei ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !
translation.en: Which when Jesus perceived , he said unto them ,  O ye of little faith , why reason ye among yourselves , because ye have brought no bread ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka snoh , ki jingrkhie ha ka ïingsyiem kin kyllaiñ long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa sha brai noh ha ka jingjar jar .
translation.en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .

translation.kha: U Isaak u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , bad ha kata ka snem u ïoh ot shispah shah ïa kob u la bet , namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translation.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .

translation.kha: Ka la long ka erïong kaba jur tam ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha ka histori jong ka baroh .
translation.en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .

translation.en: He said ,  Bring them hither to me .

translation.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Rehoboam u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Jedaïah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Ym shem la leh da U Blei , uba la khot ïa phi! .
translation.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew , Kem im ïa ki . Ki la kem ïa ki , bad u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . Baroh ki ïan sawphew ar ngut , bad ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei ruh na ki .

translation.en: A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty  ; but a fool s wrath is heavier than them both .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the great trumpet shall be blown , and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria , and the outcasts in the land of Egypt , and shall worship the  Lord  in the holy mount at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kanneh ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong ha u : ‘ Ki khun ki ksew jong me kin shang ha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba kin erlangthari ki mraw bad kmen shah lehbor haduh sawspah snem .
translation.en: And God spake on this wise , That his seed should sojourn in a strange land  ; and that they should bring them into bondage , and entreat them evil four hundred years .

translation.kha: Nga longsem U Trai ; ym don ti pait U Blei , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkhlaiñ ba me donkam , wat la ngim Shim la ithuh ïa nga .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  , and there is none else , there is no God beside me : I girded thee , though thou hast not known me :

translation.kha: U la tei ïa ka katba kum ki jingbthah ba u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel , kumba la thop ha ka Hukum u Moses : Ka duwan ba la te da ki maw ki bym shym la shtah da ki tiar nar . Halor jong ka ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia ha U Trai , bad ki la ainguh ruh ïa ki jingainguh ïakhlaiñ .
translation.en: As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .
And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi , pynban , ka long kaba dei hok , namar ba ngi ïoh ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban ïoh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka bym dei .
Bad U Trai u la ong shuh , Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba ken ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . pynphong ïa ki ban sngewkynjah ïa ki kam pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .

translation.kha: Ki sngi ka jingjop jong pha kin kut noh . Ma nga , U Trai , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong phai , kham palat ban ïa ka sngi bad u bnai .
translation.en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .

translation.kha: Kumta u kynrad u la Ong ha u shrak , ‘ Kaei leit sha ki lynti Bah ha rudnong bad sha ki lynti khim bad ïawer ïa ki briew ban wan shapoh khnang ba ka ïing jong nga kan dap .
translation.en: And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka lynti baheh phasi la tei ki iaki ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kane kano ka nuti .
translation.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;

But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim pyndem , te ïa kane ka nongbah yn aiti noh sha ki nong Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phin ym lait im na ki .

Ka khyndew Baroh ha kaba pher ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar nadong ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shatei , bad naduh ka wah Ijipt shaïong mihngi haduh ka duriaw-bah Mediterranian shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .
And am no more worthy to be called thy son : make me as one of thy hired servants .
translation.kha: Ngam long uba dei ba yn khot u khun jong phi ; to ñiew ïa nga tang kum uwei na ki nongtrei wai jong phi .
don ai ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki Israel . Wallam ha u Moserah bad u Aaron kawei ka masi lud rong saw ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ïa kaba ym pat shym la pyntreikam ,
translation.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying , Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring thee a red heifer without spot , wherein is no blemish , and upon which never came yoke :
And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
translation.kha: Lada phi shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lem ïa u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkha jong u .
Pynkup , ki Israel kim shym thang ïa kano kan na ki nongbah kiba la tei halor ki lumrit , lait tang ka Hasor , kaba u Joshua u la thang .
translation.en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength , Israel burned none of them , save Hazor only  ; that did Joshua burn .
And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
translation.kha: Bad ka hukum kaba dei ban wallam jingim , ha nga , ka la wallam ka jingïap .

kumta u la khot shapoh ïa u bad u la ong , ‘ Kaei kane kaba nga ïohsngew shaphrang jongno me ? To ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhih kaba pura ïa ka jingpynïaid jong me ïa ka jingdon jingem jong nga , namar men ym da shuh ban long u sordar jong nga .’
translation.en: And he called him , and said unto him , How is it that I hear this of thee ? give an account of thy stewardship  ; for thou mayest be no longer steward .

translation.kha: U pynim bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel na kaba shiah pynïap ha ki sing .
translation.en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .
Behold , I waited for your words  ; I gave ear to your reasons , whilst ye searched out what to say .
translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor bha katba phi dang kren bad nga ap katba phi dang sei ïa la ki jingkren bastad .
Me lah ban long uba bunkam , hynrei U Trai un shim ïa me bad bret noh ïa me sharud .
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  will carry thee away with a mighty captivity , and will surely cover thee .

translation.kha: Dei ma la uba la kren bad ba la khot ïa u ; per la ïalam ïa u shabar bad la ai ha u ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: I , even I , have spoken  ; yea , I have called him : I have brought him , and he shall make his way prosperous .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , Kumta u la ong ha ki , Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade! ha ki kynïan kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pait kan ym kein slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lin ka longïing kabu phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kamai ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .
translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :

translation.kha: Nga la long kum u dieng uba ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki umjer .
translation.en: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .

translation.kha: Ym don ka umpohliew kiba pynmih ïa ka um kaba thynrang Bad ïa ka um kaba kthang na kajuh ka tyllong .
translation.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter ?

translation.kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki nongaplangbrot baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh Shuah .
translation.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;

translation.kha: Ka jingieit Kam sangeh noh shiteng ; bad ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingïaishah jong ka kim duh noh .
translation.en: Beareth all things , believeth all things , hopeth all things , endureth all things .

translation.kha: Habor iwei na ki , u la ïohi ba u la ïohkhiah , u la wan phai pat , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Sur bajam .
translation.en: And one of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , and with a loud voice glorified God ,

translation.kha: Ki khun jong ki , ki mareh dara ki ïalehkai kum ki khunlangbrot
translation.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock , and their children dance .

I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .
translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin kren ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Naba u briew uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kham kor ban ïa uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher — lymda don uno uno uba batai ïa kaei kaba u kren , khnang ba kan long ka jingïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .

translation.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .
translation.kha: khnang ba kiwei kin ym tip ba phi shahjingit — tang U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi , un tip . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
Hynrei ym khong ba ïakren ha kaba pat , namar ba ki sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw .
translation.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews .
Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,
translation.kha: Te katto katne ngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,

translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
translation.kha: To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga sa hynñiew snem .

U Jisu! u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab , Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongshniah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam Shim la wan ban khot ïa ki biria babha donburom , hynrei ïa kaba la shad kyntait .
translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .

translation.kha: nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran , Bad kumta nga nong ha phi ïa-ban ym khwai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donbok ban im lane shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynta ka jemnud jong phi .
translation.en: And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .
Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Haba uno uno u kyllon , hato un ym ïeng pat ? Lada uno uno u bakla lynti , hato un ym wan phai pat ?
Peit beit shiah kham da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka Khlieh ha ka jingleh .
translation.en: Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .
He spake , and the locusts came , and caterpillers , and that without number ,
translation.kha: U la hukum , bad ki puit ki ïawan da ki million bad ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki ;
Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa phiah ki Moab ! Phi kiba mane ïa u Khemosh , phi la jot ! U blei jngai phi u pynïapher ïa ki shynriah , Bad ïa ki kynthei u pynlong ki mraw jong u syiem Amor .
translation.en: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .
And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .
translation.kha: Ki Midian ki long kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki Israel , bad ki paid Israel ki rieh ïa lade na ki ha ki krem bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain ha ki lumrit .

translation.en: And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen  ;
translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ha ka jaka ha kaba ka lynti kaba hiar sha u lum ki Olib , ki paid synran jong u kiba bun bah ki la sdang ban ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa u ha ki sur bajam na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba khraw baroh kiba ki la lah ïohi :
To pynkyntang ïa ki sha lade da kata ka jingshisha ; ka ktien jong me ka long ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Sanctify them through thy truth : thy word is truth .
And I will dash them one against another , even the fathers and the sons together , saith the  Lord  : I will not pity , nor spare , nor have mercy , but destroy them .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan lynthaw ïa ki kum ïa ki khra uwei pyrshah ïa uwei pat , uba tymmen bad uba samla kumjuh . Ym don ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingsngewlem , lane ka jingisynei ka ban pynsangeh ïa nga na kaba pynïap ïa ki .

Ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam sha nga , ‘ Wat la ki pop jong ngi ki pynmeh ïa ngi , to ïarap ïa moi , A Trai , kumba me la kli . Nga la pei dien noh na me bun bunsien ; ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: O  Lord  , though our iniquities testify against us , do thou it for thy name s sake : for our backslidings are many  ; we have sinned against thee .
Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kin shah pynshitom .

translation.en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki bitar ; u peit bitar ha ka jingisih bad ki jah noh ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh junom .
Naduh kata u Judas u la khmih ïa ka lad kaba biang ban arphew nep ïa U Jisu ha ki .
translation.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him .
For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki ong shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .
Ha ka Sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi dei baneh ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :
And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife , and hath not taken her ? let him go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her .
translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep ïatehktien ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka .’
Kumta u Jehoshaphat u kai roi bad nang khapbrip .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .
Yea , the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times  ; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming  ; but my people know not the judgment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ki thring ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban wan phai ; ki lyngdkhur , ki lyntait , bad ki throsh    ki tip lano ka dei ka por ban leit noh shawei . Hynrei , ko ki briew jong nga , phim shym tip ïa ki aiñ da kiba nga synshar ïa phi .
wai tuh lane shukor lane lamler .
translation.en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .
Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .
translation.kha: Namarba U Jehobah u “mon ba ki briew baroh kin ioh lait im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” —1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 .

Lada u syiem u mih bad ki laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban ïaleh ïa uwei pateng u Syiem uba wan pyrshah ïa u lem bad synreit hajar ngut ki rangbah , nyngkong un shongsuk bad rai la u long Uba khleiñ bha ban ïakynduh ïa uwei pang u syiem .
translation.en: Or what king , going to make war against another king , sitteth not down first , and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand ?

translation.kha: Uwei paw u angel , babha beit ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih kaba da ka ksiar , u la wan mala u la Ïeng ha ka jingnguh . La ai ha u shikatdei ka jingiwbih ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei baroh bad banbeiñ ai ïa ka halor ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat sier ka khet .
translation.en: And another angel came and stood at the altar , having a golden censer  ; and there was given unto him much incense , that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne .

translation.kha: Ma nga hi tun sah ha Mispah bad ngan erlangthari u nongmihkhmat jong phi haba ki nong bamaïan kin wan shane . Khynñiuh phi lah ban lat bad kynshew ïa ka waiñ , ki soh , bad ka bymshemphang Olib , malade ban shong ban sah ha la ki shnongrit ba phi don .
translation.en: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us : but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil , and put them in your vessels , and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .

And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden : and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen  ; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u ïeng ha ka jingbitar , u mih na ka kamra bad u leit shabar sha ki kper ka ïingsyiem . U Haman u ïohi ba u syiem u la kut jingmut ban pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta kane , kumta u sah hangta ban kyrpad ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
translation.kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phi la lum nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .  Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .

translation.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .
translation.kha: Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim tyngshaiñ shuh .
buh ïa ka reng ka jingainguh thang ha khmat ka jingkhang lad ka ïingjah .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .

translation.kha: U kpa bad ka kumwei jong u kim pyntip ba kñia baroh ka dei na U Terah , naba U Trai u wad ka lad ba ïabah ïa ki Pisidia . Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the  Lord  , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines : for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel .
But if ye be led of the Spirit , ye are not under the law .
translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem u ïalam ïa phi , te phim long shuh hapoh ka Hukum .
ka ri Nathanael baroh kawei ; ki ri Abraham bad Manasseh ; ka ri Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Middin shaïong sepngi ;
translation.en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,

translation.kha: Dei kata beiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai badonbor na ka bynta jong Phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ba pynlong ïa phi! kiba mala ïa ka jingim kaweh u la khot ïa phi ban im . Ai ba un pynpdang da ka ni jong u ïa ka jingkwah jyllang Phin baroh na ka pynbha ka jingbha bad ban pyndep ïa ka jingtriem ka jingngeit jongki phi .
translation.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :

translation.kha: dara ai ïa kane ka hukum ha u Shelishiyah u lynghoh , ha u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ha u Akhbor u Kynhun jong u Mikaïah , ha u Shaphan , u Sekharaïah ka ïingbishar , bad ha u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,

translation.kha: U Trai u kylla noh la ka jingmut bad u ïai-ong , Kaei kaba phira la ïoh kun ym jia .
translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : It shall not be , saith the  Lord .
The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came , and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha U Jisu ki la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ïa ka kambah na ka bynta jong ki , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
Ki ïamareh nabar ki ba-ha-ïing jongngi ka , ki la ïasngew haduh kattne U Trai u la long ka jingbha kaba phylla ïa ka , bad baroh ki la sahkynmaw lem bad ka .
translation.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her  ; and they rejoiced with her .
According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman jong ki , bad nga la phai noh na ki .
Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Trai u la ai ha Ngi : ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa Phin ka jingshlei na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrem ka lah ban laiñ im .’
translation.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .

And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ong ïa ka tnga jong u Samson ,  Khroh ïa u tnga jong pha ban ïathuh ha ngi ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip . Lada pham lah , ngin wiang ding ïa ka ïing u kpa jong pha bad ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Pha ruh pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnang ban lute ïa ngi , hato kam long kumta ?

Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la ba-eh ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara , Bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations , and their countries ,
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , bad pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki , ki bym don briew ,

translation.en: And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
