translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong pha la pynjot bad la iehnoh kynjah — hynrei mynta kan rit eh na ka bynta kito ki ban wan ban shong hangta . Bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa pha ha ka jingjot yn pynkynriah jngai na pha .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David  ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei nong Kanaan kaba shong ba sah ha kata ka thain ka la wan sha u .  Ko khun u Dabid !  ka la pyrta jam .  To isynei ïa nga , ko Kynrad ! Ka khun jong nga ka don u ksuid bad ka don ha ka jinglong bashyrkhei .
‘ Wat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , naba nga U Trai U Blei jong phi ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kylleng Jong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain : for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .

translation.kha: Baroh kba shaniah ha ki bleithaw , kiba khot ïa ki dulir ki blei jong ki , yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom .
translation.en: They shall be turned back , they shall be greatly ashamed , that trust in graven images , that say to the molten images , Ye are our gods .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen ïa u dieng uba la kheit ; u lah baneh im pud bad un khie lung .
translation.en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
translation.kha: Katba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki dang mihnoh , U Jisu u la kren shaphang jong u ha ki paidbah ;  Haba phi leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , kaei kaba phi khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Ïa u sla phlang ba la pynkhun ha ka lyer !
To ai ba kito kiba bajar kin pyrkhing shaphang kine kiei kai ; to kin pyrkhat shaphang ka jingieit baneh U Trai .
translation.en: Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the  Lord .
Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew kin ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki .

kumto keiñ u Joshua u throsh lut ïa ka kheiñduh ha Ijipt na ka bynta u syiem . La pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei u nong jingïaphet ban die ïa la ki lyngkha namar ba ka nemsniew ka la jur palat ; bad baroh ka khyndew ka kylla long ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh  ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them : so the land became Pharaoh s .
For whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Arise , and walk ?
translation.kha: Hato ka kham suk ban ong , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong me ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ To ïeng joit bad to ïaid ?’
U Trai U Blei um Lah shah ïa kino Kine ki nongïarap pynshisha ; u pynsamthiah ïa kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingbitar jong u , u siew ïinglieng ïa ki .
translation.en: God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .

translation.kha: U Ïuodia u ong ha la ki hynmen ki para shynrong , Ka myntoi aïu ïa ngi ba ngin pynïap noh ïa la u para nabar buhrieh ïa ka Kam pynjop bariew ?
translation.en: And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?

translation.kha: U buhrieh ïa u bnai bapyllun hadien ki lyoh .
translation.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it .
Where did you come from ?
translation.kha: Naei phi wan ?
U Mynsiem bakhatduh u la ïa-ong ha u Philip , khie leit shaw jan ka kali kloi bad bud mar jan ïa ka .
translation.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .

translation.kha: Balei me ino ba ka dei ka para lad me , bad shah ïa sa ban shim ïa ka kumta ka tnga jyllang nga ? Kane hangne ka tnat jong me ; shim noh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .
translation.en: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhlaiñ ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi shaniah ha U Trai , ph Long shnong .
translation.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .

translation.kha: Um shym la pynphetwir ei ei hapdeng jongngi ngi bad ki ; u la ïamap ïa ki pop jong ki namar ba ki la ngeit .
translation.en: And put no difference between us and them , purifying their hearts by faith .

Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ka tnga jong me kan long ka nuti ha ki lynti bah , bad ïa ki khun jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka khyndew jong me yn phiah bad sam ha kiwei pat ; bad me ïa lade men ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blei . Bad ki paid Israel da shisha kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’

translation.en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .
translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u ong ,  Balei me la pynngat ha ngi ïa ka jynjar kaba kum kane ? U  Trai  mynta un pynngat ïa ka jynjar ha me !  Te ki briew baroh ki lynthem maw ïa u Akhan haduh ba un da ïap ; ki lynthem maw bad ki thang ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .
translation.kha: Lada ki kohnguh ïa U Blei bad shakri ïa u , kin pynleit ïa ka jingim jong ki ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingmanbha .

translation.en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .
translation.kha: Ale , bam na ka jingbam jong nga , bad dih na ka waiñ ba nga la khleh .

translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .

Haba u Abiathar u la wan poi ha Hebron , u Joab u ïalam ïa u khlam sharud ha ka khyrdop , kumba u kwah Ban ïakren jar jar bad u , bad hangta u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh . Bad kumta la pynïap ïa u Abner namar ba u la pynïap ïa u Asahel , u para u Joab .
translation.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly , and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died , for the blood of Asahel his brother .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Asnoth , u khun jongngi u Seth , u khup jong u Adah , u khun jong U Blei .
translation.en: Which was the son of Enos , which was the son of Seth , which was the son of Adam , which was the son of God .

translation.kha: kumto u Petros u la ai ha ki ka jingïateh bniah ïa kaei kaba la jia naduh kaba shadong hi .
translation.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning , and expounded it by order unto them , saying ,

translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong pa u ai ha pa’ , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleit kiba jlih jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangamei .
translation.en: When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .

Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
translation.kha: Ka long kumta bad phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namar phi long ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mynta phi long ki jong u , uta ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .
Pynban U Trai u la ïohsngew ïa ki haba ki kyang , bun u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :

translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ïa me uba mutlop bad eh buhnud kum ma ki .
translation.en: Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .

translation.kha: Ki sngi ki ïaid khlem don jinglehkmen , ki ïathied kham stet ban ïa ka latai jong u nongthain jaiñsem .
translation.en: My days are swifter than a weaver s shuttle , and are spent without hope .

translation.kha: U syiem la u itynnat ïa ka palat ban ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , malu palat ban ïa kiwei patar , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha bad ka jingsngewieit . U buh ïa ka pansngiat syiem ha ka khlieh jong ka bad pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka lad ka Bashti .
translation.en: And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .
For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the  Lord  had given them .
translation.kha: Ki la leit haduh ka Them Eshkol bad ki la ïohi ïa ka ri , hynrei ynda ki la wan phai ki la pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew na kaba leit rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .
Nga la jied ïa u Besalel , u khulom jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah ,
translation.en: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :

translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh na ka jait Lebi kiba la iap shi bnai bad kham heh ïa ibha u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ñiat shi kur shi kur da ka hukum U Trai ki long arphew ar hajar ngut .
translation.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
I say again , Let no man think me a fool ; if otherwise , yet as a fool receive me , that I may boast myself a little .
translation.kha: Nga ong pat : wat ai ba uno uno un ñiew ïa nga uba bieit . Hynrei lada phi pyrkhat kumta , la kumno kumno to pdiang ïa nga kum uba bieit , khnang ba ngan don ei ei ban sngewsarong .
Ki Assyria kin khynwin haba kin ïasngew ïa ka sur U Trai bad sngew ïa ka bor Jong ka jingpynshitom jong u .
translation.en: For through the voice of the  Lord  shall the Assyrian be beaten down , which smote with a rod .

translation.kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki briew jngai phoi .
translation.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Sakharaïah , u khun jongu u Ussi , u khun jong u bujli ,
translation.en: The son of Zerahiah , the son of Uzzi , the son of Bukki ,
The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .
Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kiei ka pun jia , ki la kylli , Hato ngaiñ pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jong i'u , ko Kynrad ?
translation.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?
Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !
translation.kha: Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka pukri um , bad ba ki khmat jong nga ka umpohliew ki ummat , khnang ba nga lah ban ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki briew jong nga kiba la shah pynïap .
Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Solomon la wan kit na Musri bad na kiwei pat ki ri .
translation.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .

translation.kha: La katta ruh , phi lah ban pynïap bad bam ïa ki jingri jong phi kat shaba phi shnong phi sah . Phi lah ban bam kat kumba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa phi . Baroh na phi , kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translation.en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee : the unclean and the clean may eat thereof , as of the roebuck , and as of the hart .

translation.kha: Kiba bun na kiba ngeit ki la ïawan , ki da phla ha kabu paw bad ki da pynpaw ïa katei kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .
And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
translation.kha: Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba la pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kular bun kiei kiei kiba kham bha ban ïa ka snam u Abel .
Sa katno nga dei ban ïohi ïa ka thma kaba nang jur bad ïohsngew ïa ki jingsait jong ki turoi ?
translation.en: How long shall I see the standard , and hear the sound of the trumpet ?

And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne , even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill  ; and all the firstborn of beasts .
translation.kha: bad man la u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt un ïap , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u syiem u ban ïoh ïa ka khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong ka mraw kaba tylliat kew . Kiba kha nyngkong na ki jingri baroh ruh kin ïap .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Mary .  She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni  ; which is to say , Master .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko Mari !  Ka la phai sha u bad ka la ong ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Rabboni !  ( Kane ka mut  Ko Nonghikai ! . )
Ngi thoh ïa khnai khnang ba ka jingkyrmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew U Blei hangne ki phah ïa ki jingai khlei , khamtam kito kiba na ka ïingsyiem jong u Patsha .
translation.en: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar s household .

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïaleit ïa u , Ha-ei ka Sarah ka tnga jngai me ? U jubab , Ka don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .

translation.kha: U Kisleb u ong , nur ai ïa ka ïakhun jong nga , ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba ïohknieh ïa ka Kiriath Shear .
translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .

translation.kha: Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , bad ka la long umdih da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrta baroh la pynjot .
translation.en: Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :

I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad nga lumlang ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba nga long uba khuid .
Ki lyngdoh ki long kum ka kynruh ki nonglute kiba Akhshaph ïa u bri . Wat ha ka lynti shuh ka jaka bakhlaiñ ha Shekhem ki pynïap briew . Gera ki leh ïa Kanah kaba snier borbah da kaba thuh lypa !
translation.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man , so the company of priests murder in the way by consent : for they commit lewdness .

translation.kha: wah la nga la pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jingñiewbeiñ , pynban ha ki Jaka katba jngai eh ktien kynmaw ïa de . Ma ki bad ki khun jong ki kin maji im bad kin wan phai lang shat ïing .
translation.en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .

translation.kha: U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ong , Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dat ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u Kynhun jong nga ha ka jingbymlongkhuid . Bad u Judah um shngiam ïathiah shongkha shuh bad ka .
translation.en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .
And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew uba mih tdem bad ka dongmusa kaba mehding ki paw kynsan bad ïaid napdeng kita ki lyngkhot doh .
U ong ruh , Rah shajrong ïa ka lama U Trai ! U thri un ïapoi ïalang ïa ki Amalek junom !
translation.en: For he said , Because the  Lord  hath sworn that the  Lord  will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .

translation.kha: Haba ka jingsuk ka la wan , ki leh pop biang , bad me shah biang ïa ki nongshun ban khup ïa ki . Pynban ki kawei-na-kaba-shiphew badno kynrad ïa me ban pynim ïa ki , ha bneng me ïohsngew , bad na ka na sha ka por me pyllait ïa ki ha ka jingisynei bakhraw jong me .
translation.en: But after they had rest , they did evil again before thee : therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them : yet when they returned , and cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies  ;
Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .
translation.kha: Bad ngam shym ong ïa kane namar ba nga la shah leh klet , naba nga la nang ban sngewhun ha kaei kaba nga don .

translation.en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah , in the sepulchre of Kish his father : and they performed all that the king commanded . And after that God was entreated for the land .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la tep ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad u Jonathan ha ka jingtep jong u Kish , u kpa jong u Saul , ha Sela ha ka ri Benjamin , ki da pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba u syiem u la hukum . Bad hadien kata , U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki na ka bynta ka ri .
Yn ym don u ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phiah lada phi ïaid kum uba stai , sad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .
translation.en: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .
translation.kha: Uta u long U Mynsiem uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei . Ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u , namar ba u ïaisah bad phi bad u don hapoh jong phi .
Hynrei ma me , A Trai , me long U blei bashisha , me long U Blei uba im bad u syiem bymjukut . Haba me bitar , ka pyrthei ka khynñiuh ; ki jaitbynriew kim lai shah ïa ka jingbitar jong me .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is the true God , he is the living God , and an everlasting king : at his wrath the earth shall tremble , and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation .

translation.kha: Ngan pynong ïa me kum ka kor khlur , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai banep . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bun pynlwet ïa ki ; ki lehbor kin lutphut kum u pui pui .
translation.en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .
And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land  ; ye shall throw down their altars : but ye have not obeyed my voice : why have ye done this ?
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ïateh jutang bad ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Phi dei ban pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki .’ Hynrei phim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa phi . Phi la leh pynban ïa kaba pyrshah !

translation.en: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .
translation.kha: Nga bud beit ïa ka lynti ba u jied , bad ngam ju sakma sha kadiang ne kamon .

translation.en: To subvert a man in his cause , the Lord approveth not .
translation.kha: haba ïa ka jingbishar hok la pynkylla khongpong ha ka ïingbishar , u tip .
U Jisu u la jubab , Un long uwei na phi ki khat-ar ngut , uta u ban wieh ïa u kpu jong u ha ka pliang bad nga .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .

translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaweh jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi barabor ngi tip ba phim eh ban ïania mala uno du uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .
translation.en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .

translation.kha: tieng ïa uta u lanot baroh utai ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiw lad kane ka jingainguh ka pynkohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar : it is a burnt offering unto the  Lord  : it is a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki hukum , Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat thoh ; wat ikwah ïa kiei kaba dei jong kiwei pat — ïa phim baroh , nabar kino kino kiwei pat , la kynthup lang ha kawei ka hukum , Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba ïa lade .
translation.en: For this , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not kill , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness , Thou shalt not covet ; and if there be any other commandment , it is briefly comprehended in this saying , namely , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not , and wells digged , which thou diggedst not , vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not  ; when thou shalt have eaten and be full  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïing kin dap da ki mar kiba bha kiba phim shym la leit buh hangta , bad kin don ki pukri kiba phim shym la tih , bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Olib kiba phim shym la thung . Ynda U  Trai  u ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri bad phi ïoh kat ïa kaba phi kwah ban bam ,

translation.en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .
translation.kha: La pyllait noh ïa kita ki saw ngut ki angel ; na ka bynta kane hi ka kynta jong kane hi ka sngi jong une hi u bnai bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pynïap noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bynriew baroh .

Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la Lah jia ha u , bad u la ong , Mynta ar tip ba ka long katba shisha ! U Trai’ u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyllaitluid ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herodias bad na kaei Kiei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khih lynti ba kan jia .
translation.en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .

translation.kha: U syiem Syria u ïaleh thma bad ki Israel , u ïasyllok bad la ki rangïapom pynïaidkam bad jied ïa ka jaka shun pynïeng ïa ka jaka sher ayu jong u .
translation.en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel , and took counsel with his servants , saying , In such and such a place shall be my camp .

translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u peiñ ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh kiba u Samuel u la ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha tala ka sngi .
translation.en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;
translation.kha: U la plie namar jong ngi ïa ka lynti kaba thymmai , ka lynti kaba im , lyngba kata ka jingkah — kata ka long , lyngba ka met jong u hi .
Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka khong palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U balui u ïatip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïapom , hynrei me mem Tip ïa ka .
translation.en: It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?

translation.kha: ki ieh ka jingjot dara ka jingpynjot shano shano ba ki sien .
translation.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways :
And when the  Lord  saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba u Moses u wan kham hajan , u khot ïa u napdeng kata ka  lawlynnong , bad u ong ,  Moses ! Moses !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi ! Nga don hangne .

shadien khappud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa phi ka mut aïu kane ka jingroi , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndem ïa la ka borbah , U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba im’ la long ki mirr .
translation.en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :

translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha ki rangbah jong u , Ïa ngin leit hiar dara tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia mynmiet , ïong lute ïa ki haduh ban da kynjat shawei , bad ngin pynpei lut ïa ki baroh . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam , ki jubab . Hynrei u lyngdoh u ong , To ngin da kylliang shuwa na U Blei .
translation.en: And Saul said , Let us go down after the Philistines by night , and spoil them until the morning light , and let us not leave a man of them . And they said , Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee . Then said the priest , Let us draw near hither unto God .
Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .
ki ai ruh khyndiat ki soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ar rynjup ki soh kismis . Ynda u la dpei smam , u la ïohbor biang ; naba um shym la bam la dih ei ei la lai sngi pura .
translation.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs , and two clusters of raisins : and when he had eaten , his spirit came again to him : for he had eaten no bread , nor drunk any water , three days and three nights .

translation.kha: pynlong ïa la ka dohnud kaba beit , ko Job . Phai sha U Blei .
translation.en: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;

translation.kha: ki rangbah bashlur tam ki leit sad shim ïa ki batip jong u Saul malade jong ki khun jongki u , bad ki wanrah ïa ki sha Jabesh . Ki tep ïa ki hangta hapoh u dieng Sneng , bad ki shahjingit hynñiew sngi lynter .
translation.en: They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

translation.kha: To leh ïa kane , ba ki briew’ kiba shida kin ym shah pynïap ei , bad kumta phin ym klet pop ba dei ma phi kiba la pynïap ïa ki ha kata ka ri ba U Tharai u ai ha phi .
translation.en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .

Sheba , and Dedan , and the merchants of Tarshish , with all the young lions thereof , shall say unto thee , Art thou come to take a spoil ? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey ? to carry away silver and gold , to take away cattle and goods , to take a great spoil ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na Sheba bad Dedan bad ki nongkhaïi na ki shnong jong ka Spain kin kylli ïa me , ‘ Hato me la lumlang ïa ka kynhun shipai bad tur ïaleh khnang ban lute bad pynjot ? Hato me thmu ban knieh noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki jingri bad ïa ki jingdon jingem , bad phet noh pat bad kito ki mar lute baroh ?’
Hato ki jia te ki don ha kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban ïa ki Jentil ? Lano hato don kano kano ka dor ha ka jingotsher ?
translation.en: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?
And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud men shim ïa u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ai ïa u kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . To pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u ha kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .
Ha ka ri lum don ka Shamir , ka Jattir , ka Sokoh ,
translation.en: And in the mountains , Shamir , and Jattir , and Socoh ,

And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki nong Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Israel . Ong ha ki :   ‘ Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynjot ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kum ka leilieh .
Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka phah kiei sha u Dabid ban ïathuh ïa u .
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .
And I heard a voice from heaven , as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of a great thunder : and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps :
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , bad kum ka jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Ka sawa kum ka sur jingtem ba la tem da ki nongtem kiba tem ïa la ki duitara .

Haba ki rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki Nongap phira jongki ka Tabeel ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la pyrta jam , Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u ! U pyllait u la ïa-ong ha ki , Shim noh ma phi ïa u , te , bad saphriang ïa u . Ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynmeh ïa u .
translation.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .

translation.kha: Ki briew bakha shemphang ki long borabor kiba thynrang bad ba kloi ban shah hikai .
translation.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge  ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Tiras , ko mynhynne jong nga ! A Trai , U Blei jong nga , katno me longsem naba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem bad ka brup ;
translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .

translation.kha: Me tip , A Tlai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki kop tymmen jong ngi ki la kun . Ki sngi jong im ki long kumta ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .
translation.en: For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .

Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you , of them shall ye buy , and of their families that are with you , which they begat in your land : and they shall be your possession .
translation.kha: Phi lah ruh ban thied ïa ki khun jong ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi . Kum kita ïa kiba la kha ha ka ri jong phi ki lah ban long ka jingïohkynti jong phi ,
La thoh ïa ki na ka bynta jong me pajut ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok , kiba kjit ha uta uba la pynmih na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jyllang moi .
translation.en: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;

translation.kha: Da kaba buid ïa ki jingleh ba-ishyrkhei jong ki jaitbynriew kiba U Tiras u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki bynriew jong u ki tur shaphrang , U Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , after the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phira , ko ki paralok jong nga , phi la tip lehbha ïa kane . To sawar ïa lade , namarkata , ba phin ym shah ïalam bakla da ki jingpynbakla ki briew ki bym bat aiñ bad phi hap noh! na ka khang ba la shongshngain kaba phi don .
translation.en: Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .

translation.kha: Ngi lah eh , da shisha , ban shaniah ha kum kito kiei kiei . Lymda uno uno u pyrkhat ba u kah ban shaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar , nga don ka daw ka kham khraw ban sngaid kumta .
translation.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :

translation.kha: Te kaei kaba u Jeremaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong , ka la urlong pahara : Ki la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa , ka tat-dor kaba ki paid Israel ki la mynjur ban siew na ka bynta jong u ,
translation.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying , And they took the thirty pieces of silver , the price of him that was valued , whom they of the children of Israel did value  ;

translation.kha: Da ka bor Bakhraw ki apostol ki la sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong U Terah Jisu , bad U Blei u la theh ki jingkyrhuh ba-don kyrhai ha ki baroh .
translation.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .

translation.kha: Ym ne ma mano haneng hangno , ym ba-don kdew ki nongsharai jong ki hima nongwei , kiba la ngeit ba uno uno u nonghiarthma un Lah ban rung lyngba ki khapbrip ka Jesreel .
translation.en: The kings of the earth , and all the inhabitants of the world , would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kiba riewspah bad Kiba tuh kin ïap ha kane ka ri , ishyrkhei ym don mane mano ban tep ïa ki lane ban ïawer na ka bniat jong ki . Ym don mynshem mano u ban ot ïa lade dawai u ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong u .
translation.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land : they shall not be buried , neither shall men lament for them , nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :

translation.kha: Haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pud u suh shata Bethdagon , u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel ha ka lynti shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bthei shapoh shatei sha ka Kabul ,
translation.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,

translation.kha: Ha uwei uwei na ki , thoh ïa ka kyr-ang jong wai na ki khun shynrang Jong u Jehosabad , ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel .
translation.en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet  ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .

translation.kha: Me long baroh kaba nga kwah , A Tlai ; nga kular ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Thou art my portion , O  Lord  : I have said that I would keep thy words .

translation.kha: Me lah ban long uba donkam , hynrei U Tharai un shim ïa me bad bret noh ïa me sharud .
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  will carry thee away with a mighty captivity , and will surely cover thee .

I will feed them in a good pasture , and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be : there shall they lie in a good fold , and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin bam phlang da ka jingsngewshngain ha ki jaka phlang u lumbah bad ki them bad ha ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka ri Israel .

translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Balak ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

Hadad shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khur . Ki ong , Mynba i khunlung i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jongnga u i la ïap ? U la ban pynkynroi ïa lade !
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?
And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synran ïa ka pharshi ban hikai ïa ki ba ki dei ban duwai borabor ban ym noh mynsiem da lei lei ruh .
ka Sophah , ka Telem , ka Bealoth ,
translation.en: Ziph , and Telem , and Bealoth ,
And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .
translation.kha: Bad ki la ong ,  Ngim da donkam ïa kino kino ki sakhi ! Ma ngi hi ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u la ong !
Hato u slap lane ka tmier ki don u kpa ?
translation.en: Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?

translation.kha: Nga kyang jar ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei u kynjat ban shahshkor ;
translation.en: Also when I cry and shout , he shutteth out my prayer .
And to them which were in Rachal , and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites , and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites ,
translation.kha: bad Rakal ; sha ki kur u Jerahmeel , sha ki Ken ,
kumto u Adonisedek u phah ïa kane ka khubor riang sha u Hoham u syiem ka Hebron , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syier ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Ebron :
translation.en: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jongnga U Trai ha u babha : Ngan long ryngkat bad phi — kata ka long ka jingkular Jong nga .
translation.en: Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphang . Leit sha ri lum hati bad sha ki jaka kiba marpyrshah bad ka — sha ka Them Jordan , shwa ki ri lem mala ri ih , sha ka jaka kaba shaei dara sha ka rud duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha ka ri Kanaan bad nangta shad lyndet ki lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .
translation.en: Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba ha kane ka pyrthei la leh ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , and it is common among men :

translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jngai ki Jerusalem ki la pynïap ïa ki , wat la katto-katne katne ki ïohlad ban shem jaka lait im hapoh ki kynduh shong bad ba ki khlem shah pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .

translation.kha: Pha nong , ‘ Nga hir kaba riewspah bad kabu dap baïong ; nga don baroh kambah nga donkam .’ Hynrei pham tip haduh katno pha long kaba lanot bad kaba hynne ban khem ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , dara kaba matlah .
translation.en: Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :

translation.kha: Ki briew hangta ki long kiba Kham ïar jingman ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahjop ïa ka khubor da ka jingdiang barabor , bad man ka sngi ki ju pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban khmih lada kaei kaba u Paulos u ïa-ong ka long kabu shisha .
translation.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u ong ha lade , Ngan nym buhrieh na u Abraham ïa kaei kaba ngan sa leh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do  ;

translation.kha: Baroh ki la phai nala na U Blei ; barben ki la har bym dei ; ym don uno uno uba leh ïa kaba dat , ym don uwei ruh .
translation.en: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no , not one .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bneng uba khatwei , ha ka sniew kaba sawphew hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Troas u la hukum ïa u ban ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;

translation.kha: U tei ïa ki kynram na ka bynta ki nongbah ka Judah ha ka por Jong u , bad ym Shimham don thma bun bun snem , namar ba U Trai u ai ha u ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah : for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years  ; because the  Lord  had given him rest .

translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ka jingbishar hok ïa uba duk hajan u wan ha ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , la ïathuh ha u Joseph ba u kpa jong u , u pang . Kumta u ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ar ngut , u Manasseh pynlang u Ephraim , ban ïaleit khum ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold , thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
translation.kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Paul ban shong bad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor .
Bad kumta da ka jingsngewieit bajylliew kin duli na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingïadei kambah kor tam kaba U Blei! u la pyn-i ha phi .
translation.en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .
Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
translation.kha: Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka balang .
Suk kito kiba Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jrong u , kiba bor baroh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .

translation.kha: Kumta U ju u la kylli ïa u , Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ? Uta u briew u la jubab , Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Borbah’ — ngi ïadon shibun !
translation.en: And he asked him ,  What is thy name ?  And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .

translation.kha: Kiba matlah kin lah ban ïohi , bad kiba kyllut kin ïohsngew .
translation.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened , and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped .
And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , bakhraw! To ïabeh sha ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingïapyndait jong nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ba-ima ha ka jingsuk . Bad U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .

translation.kha: To ai ba re kiba sngewstad kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh jingeh ; bad ai ba ktang pynpdang ïa ki naduh ka dohnud . Ki lynti U Trai ki long kiba beit , bad ki briew kiba hok ki im da kaba bud ïa ki , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut badno ki kyllon namar ba ki suidñiew ïa ki .
translation.en: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .

translation.kha: Mar kumta U ju u la tip ba ka bor ka la mihpaw na u , kum u la phai Sawdong sha u bajaipdeh bad u la kylli , myn ba la ktah ïa ki jabieng jong nga ?
translation.en: And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said ,  Who touched my clothes ?
And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?
translation.kha: Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kum u syiem jong ngi , hynrei u la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Kumta , balei ym don mano mano ba pyrshang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?
U nongthied borabor u kynum ba ka dor ka rem eh , hynrei nangta u leit noh bad u kren sarong ba u la ïoh da kaba ïada sad .
translation.en: It is naught , it is naught , saith the buyer : but when he is gone his way , then he boasteth .

translation.kha: Ha ka ïing kaba heh don ki khiew kiba bun jait : Don na ki ïa kiba la thaw da ka mata bad ka ksiar , kiwei! pat da ka dieng sad ka ïabret ; don na ki na ka bynta ka jingdonkam kyrpang , kiwei pat baneh pyndonkam man ka to .
translation.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .

translation.kha: Ang ai-jingmut ia u Tom ba un ym pynlut por ban kuna ia kato .
translation.en: I advised Tom not to waste his time trying to do that .

translation.kha: Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem bakhia , uba im khoh jong Ngi , to sumar ïa kiei kiei kiba beh ïa kba la pynïapmat ha me .
translation.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .

translation.kha: Kim shym la pynïap ïa ki nongmane bleithaw , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa ki banbeiñ leh ,
translation.en: They did not destroy the nations , concerning whom the  Lord  commanded them :

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong u kam Shim la mihnoh na u , bad um shym la artatien ïa ka jingkular U Blei ; ka jingngeit jong u ka la pyndap ïa u da ka bor , bad u ai ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief ; but was strong in faith , giving glory to God ;

translation.kha: hynne ki ba-ha-ïing haw jong u baroh bad kiba hapoh ka ïing jong u kin longïing ka jingbankhia ïa u . Kin Sdien ha u kum ki ksew bad ki pliang kiba la wah ha u snar !
translation.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father s house , the offspring and the issue , all vessels of small quantity , from the vessels of cups , even to all the vessels of flagons .

When men strive together one with another , and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him , and putteth forth her hand , and taketh him by the secrets :
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki briew ki ïashoh , bad ka tnga jong uwei na ki ka pyrshang ban ïarap ïa la u tnga da kaba bat tyngeh na ka rain jong uta uwei pat ,

Ka la jia ba katba u Pekah u long syiem ba u tylliat Pileser , u patsha ka Asaraïah , u kurup ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ijon , ka Babel Beth Mikaïah , ka Janoah , ka Kedesh , bad ka Ishar , bad ki ri jong ka Gilead , ka Galilaïa , bad ka Arah , bad u rah koidi ïa ki Briew sha Assyria .
translation.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , and took Ijon , and Abel–beth–maachah , and Janoah , and Kedesh , and Hazor , and Gilead , and Galilee , all the land of Naphtali , and carried them captive to Assyria .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi kynmaw , ko pansngiat jong im’ , kumno ba ngi la minot bad trei shitom ! Ngi la trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ba ngin ym bniah ïa phi haba ngi la ïalap ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .
translation.en: For ye remember , brethren , our labour and travail : for labouring night and day , because we would not be chargeable unto any of you , we preached unto you the gospel of God .

translation.kha: Thung u brisoh uba stad u tip aïu kiei kiei ki kit jingmut shisha . Ka jingstad ka pynlong ïa u ban phuh samrkhie bad ka pynjah ïa ka jingnoh sngew ka durkhmat jong u .
translation.en: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .

translation.kha: Ha kaba buid ïa ka hukum jong U Trai , u nongïathuhlypa u krensih pynrem ïa ka duwan : Ko duwan , jingset ! Kñia ka long kaba U Trai u ïong , ‘ U khunlung ïa uba yn khet kyrteng u Josaïah , yn sa kha ha ka longïing jong u Dabid . Un sa pynïap ha pha ïa ki lyngdoh uba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei thalab , bad un thap ïa ki shyieng briew halor jong pha .’
translation.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the  Lord  , and said , O altar , altar , thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , a child shall be born unto the house of David , Josiah by name  ; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee , and men s bones shall be burnt upon thee .

translation.kha: bad kum u shakri jongu U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .
translation.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,

translation.kha: ha ka jaka ba kin Mane ïa U Balei uba im , ki manla ïa ki dur ba la thaw ban i kum u brisoh ne ki sim ne ki mrad ne ki kparad bapar kiba ïap noh .
translation.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man , and to birds , and fourfooted beasts , and creeping things .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ka snieh bad u bnai ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi! ki khlur baphyrnai .
translation.en: Praise ye him , sun and moon : praise him , all ye stars of light .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong ha u Pilat , Wat ym thoh , ‘ U Syiem ki Jiw ,’ hynrei pynban , ‘ Une u briew u la ong , nga long u Syiem ki jlih .’
translation.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews  ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .

translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher kham bun ba-bang ïa uno uno na phi .
translation.en: I thank my God , I speak with tongues more than ye all :

translation.kha: Naba nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad nga la bynrap , To shahshkor , ko Hananaïah ! U tharai um shym la pah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa phim ki briew ban beit ïa ka lamler .
translation.en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .

translation.kha: Ki suda kiba kumno ? u la kylli . U Jisu u la jubab , Wat pynïap ; wat kliang ; wat thoh ; wat kynnoh byndi ïabun ïabna ;
translation.en: He saith unto him , Which ? Jesus said ,  Thou shalt do no murder , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness ,

translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa uba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkhia ainguh thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynrang Jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , Bad u theh ïa ka Sdang ka duwan .
translation.en: And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .

translation.kha: U la long u Syiem ka Israel sawphew snem , u da synshar hynriew snem ha Hebron bad phraphew lai snem ha Jeroham .
translation.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years : seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka jingainguh bam-im ba u lyngdoh u wanrah , ïa borbah dei ban thang lut khoit .
translation.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt : it shall not be eaten .

translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la iohnong ïa kane , ki la kyntu snar . Uei te uba lah ban lait im ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the  Lord  had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . U Aaron u bret ïa la u diengduh ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad u kylla bseiñ .

translation.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , U Khun U Briew ruh un kyntait ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .
“Nga snur ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym kein mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga . U Trai u la khot ïa ki nongshun byrsha ïa ar na ki liang barieh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei kaei kaba jakhlia .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .

translation.kha: Ngan pynpur phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Arsa ha ka ri jong phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbat jong phi .
translation.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab , Katba im U Trai , nga kutlad ban ong ïa kaei kaba u ïathiah ïa nga !
translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .

translation.kha: U ong , ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,
translation.en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka Bishlam ka la plakhun , bad ka kham kynhun shynrang ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jinglalot jong u ym lah ban pynhun .
translation.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly , he shall not save of that which he desired .

translation.kha: Nalor nia , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka waiñ , dara umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translation.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kylla dien ha ki maw ba la ohdur hajan Gilgal , u la leit biang sha u Eglon , bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga don ka khubor barieh na ka bynta jong phi .  Kumta u syiem u hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Ieh ïa ngi tang baroh ar ngut !  Bad baroh ki la ïamih shabar .
Katba ki bri ki dang shahshkor ïa kane , U Jisu u la bteng bad u la ïathmu ïa ka pharshi ha ki . U la jan poi artat ha Jerusalem , mala ki la tharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan pang .
translation.en: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .

translation.kha: len kohnguh ïa ki aïu jong me : A thew iehnoh da lei lei ïa nga !
translation.en: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .

translation.kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada pa’ long bymdonkam pher kyllon kynsan .
translation.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .

translation.kha: U Abram u dem ngon haduh khyndew ; bad U Blei u ong ,
translation.en: And Abram fell on his face : and God talked with him , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta ngi phah ïa u bangeit jongki i lem bad ki ; ngi la tynjuh ïa u bunsien bad ngi la shem ïa u ba u long borabor uba thrang ban ïabeh . Bad mynta ba u la don haduh Iso ïa ka jingshaniah ïa phi , u nang kham thrang shuh shuh ban ïarap .
translation.en: And we have sent with them our brother , whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things , but now much more diligent , upon the great confidence which I have in you .

translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them : they also that come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban ym don pud ïa ka jingdon ki briew kiba u syiem u synshar ; haba um don shuh , ym don mano mano uba sngewnguh ïa kaei kaba u la leh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .

translation.en: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u ïap ha Ijipt haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta . Ki kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met jong u , bad hangta ha Ijipt ki buh ïa u ha ka synduk ïapbriew .
bad u la phah ha ki ïa u ïathuhlypa Uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U Trai , U Blei ki Israel : Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt .
translation.en: That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba-ijli jong pha kum ka jingaiti pham ju kynram shisien ruh ïa la ka jinglong khana — mynba pha long kiba lyngkhuit , bad ïaksaid ha la ka jong ka snem .
translation.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , when thou wast naked and bare , and wast polluted in thy blood .

translation.kha: Haba U Khrist u la shahshitom ha ka dohnud , phira ruh pa de ban pynkhleh ïa ailad da kajuh ka jingpyrkhat kaba u la don ; namar uno uno uba shahshitom ha ka doh um ïakhleh shuh bad ka pop .
translation.en: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh , arm yourselves likewise with the same mind : for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin  ;

translation.kha: To ngin ai ka jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa jongnga U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Kpa ba-dap da jongisynei , U Blei na uba ka jingïarap baroh ka wan !
translation.en: Blessed be God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies , and the God of all comfort ;
And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa ka . Ngan ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong pha wat la phan pan shiteng na ka hima jong nga .
bad yn kerkut ïa ka Jerushah kumba ki rangbah ki ap phira ïa ka lyngkha , namar ki briew jong ka ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: As keepers of a field , are they against her round about  ; because she hath been rebellious against me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la khong ruh katba katne tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynda kine malade u la ong ïa ki synran banbeiñ sam ïa ki umdih .
translation.en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .
Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .
translation.kha: Dei ma nga uba pynlong ïa ka , kaba bieit bad ngam shym ai ha ka ïa ka jingstad .
Lada ka thma ka kiei , ki lah don leit ïasuk bad ki nongshun jong ngi ban ïaleh pyrda ïa me , bad ban ïohi noh na Kane ka ri . To ngin kham ïaleh sian ngab ym shah ïa ki ba kmen nang ïaroi sha shuh .
translation.en: Come on , let us deal wisely with them  ; lest they multiply , and it come to pass , that , when there falleth out any war , they join also unto our enemies , and fight against us , and so get them up out of the land .

translation.kha: hynrei tang u pynbah lyngdoh uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumto tang shisien shisnem . U rah badno u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u jingsakhi ha U blang na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka boitha ki jop ba ki briew ki kun Khlem sngewthuh ba ki la kuna pop .
translation.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :

translation.kha: Uno du u bymneh ïa ka Hukum u Moses u shah pynsep khlem jingaiei haba la bishar pynrem halor ka sakhi jong ki ar ngut ne bun ki nongsakhi .
translation.en: He that despised Moses  law died without mercy under two or three witnesses :

But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .
translation.kha: Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid bha bad ki ïaid sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dih kyiad haduh katta katta haduh ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta katta ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ai jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .
Teng pynlong katto katne na ki , ki lyngkdong bad ki Lebi .
translation.en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la pynbynta ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kaba la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nahath , babha la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pyntwa mad ïa ka duwan , u pynjot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , bad u pynstet phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .
translation.en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ngin ïit ïa la ki lynti bad phai pat sha U  Trai .

translation.en: He that saith he is in the light , and hateth his brother , is in darkness even until now .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u don ha ka jingshai , pynban u isih ïa la u hynmen u para , u don ha ka jingdum haduh kane hi ka kynta .

translation.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood , and leave off righteousness in the earth ,
translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim , phi kiba pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok bad kiba shukor ïa ki briew ban pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki !

translation.en: I have peace offerings with me  ; this day have I payed my vows .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ki jingainguh mynta , bad nga don ki doh kñia .
U Trai u la ong , Phi ki paid Israel , phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad ïohnang ïaleh ïa nga . Hynrei Mynta , to phai pah sha nga !
translation.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted .

Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the  Lord  was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them , and because he hated them , he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Lymda kumta ki nong Ijipt kin ong ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki . Kin ong ba me la ïalam noh ïa la ki briew sha ka ri shyiap ban pynïap ïa ki , namar me la isih ïa ki .
Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka sngem jong nga u don ka jingim bymtip , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngem kaba khat .
translation.en: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gadmon , mala na ka shitrhem ka jait Manasseh , ki la khrud ïa ka thma , ki la jam ha shuwa jong kiba sah jong uta u paidbah , kumba u Moses u la bah ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: And the children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and half the tribe of Manasseh , passed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spake unto them :

translation.kha: Nga la khmied bad nga la Iohi ïa ka jingïohipaw ïa ka tare kaba i kum ka bhabriew bameh tdong . Na ka syngkai sharum , ka saw jong u ka long kum ka ding , bad na ka syngkai shaneng , u shat phyrnai kumto ka rnong ba la kyrshut phyrnai bha .
translation.en: Then I beheld , and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire : from the appearance of his loins even downward , fire  ; and from his loins even upward , as the appearance of brightness , as the colour of amber .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka thup kyrteng jongu ki khun ki ksiew u Adam . ( Mynba U Blei U la tiduh ïa ki brup , u la thaw ïa ki ha ka dur jong U hi .
translation.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam . In the day that God created man , in the likeness of God made he him  ;

translation.kha: phi dei ban thik bniah ïa dat .
translation.en: And it be told thee , and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently , and , behold , it be true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought in Israel :

translation.kha: Lada um sngewlah , un pham ïa ki nonglamktien pun ïashem ïa uwei paw u syiem , ban kyrpad ïa ki kyndon jingsuki katba u dang jing-jngai bah ha ka lynti .
translation.en: Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sendeth an ambassage , and desireth conditions of peace .

For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongbatai kupar , hynrei ki jubab kiba ki ïoh ki long ki jinglamler bad ki bym don jingmut . Katto katne ki pyrshang ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , hynrei tang ban shu ïalam bakla ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta ki briew ki sakma kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la jah . Ki don ha ka jingjynjar namar ba kim don u nongïalam .

translation.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .
translation.kha: Ym don dieng Kedar ha ka kper U Blei uba lah ban ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju don kum kita ki tnat , bad ym don u dieng ha madan uba don kum kita ki tnat , ym don u dieng ha ka kper jong U Blei uba itynnat katta katta .

Hynrei lada phiah phai pat sha na bad leh ïa kaei kaba por Hukum ïa phi , ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jaka sha kaba nga la jied ban mane ïa nga , wat la ïa phi la pynslem shwa kiba kut ka pyrthei .’
translation.en: But if ye turn unto me , and keep my commandments , and do them  ; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven , yet will I gather them from thence , and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there .
For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban leit lyngba ka thliew thyrnia .
Pa long kaba ïalamwir ! ki la ong ïa ka . Hynrei ka la ïaw ban ba ka la long kiba Shispah . Kumba ki la jubab , U dei u angel jong u .
translation.en: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .

translation.kha: U Abram u ong , Ñiuma , ka dei ka mraw jong pham bad hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong pha ; ni ïa ka katba pha sngewbit . Kumta ka Sarai ka lehbha tyngeh ïa ka kat haduh ba ka la shet ne .
translation.en: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold , thy maid is in thy hand  ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her , she fled from her face .

translation.kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la ai , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jingïambriew ki ban lute ïa pa’ bad pynjot ïa phiah . Ngan pynjot lut ïa phi ba phin ym longïng shuh ka jaitbynriew lane shun don ka ri la ka jrong . Te pher tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u Elisha ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying ,

translation.kha: Naba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u kren , Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohmap na U Blei nongbanbor .
translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
And it shall be in that day , that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem  ; half of them toward the former sea , and half of them toward the hinder sea : in summer and in winter shall it be .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , ka um basngur kan tuid na Jerusalem , shiteng na ka sha ka Duriaw Baïap bad kawei pat ka shiteng sha ka duriaw Mediterranian . Kan tuid baroh shisnem , ha ka aïom ba-rkhiang bad ha ka aïom bajhieh .

translation.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering , for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting .
translation.kha: hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga khnang ba U Khrist Jisu un ïoh pynpaw ïa ka jingïaishah slem jong u ha kaba ïadei bad nga , uba sniew tam na kiba pop , kum ka nuksa ïa kito baroh ki ban sa ngeit ïa u hadien bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

Ka Rakhel ka ong ha la u kpa , Wat bitar ïa por , ko kynrad , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi , nga dang poi bnai . U Laban u la wad , hynrei um shym la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .
translation.en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong me ka la longsyiem kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thring shajan ka ïathied . Namar ba la don kyrhai ka um , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap da ki sla bad u soh .
translation.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .
The hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and carried me out in the spirit of the  Lord  , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones ,
translation.kha: Nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  bad U Mynsiem jong u , u la ïalam bad pynshong ïa nga hapoh ka them ha kaba ka madan ka dap da ki shyieng .

translation.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong sha mihngi na wah Jordan
Nangta u kiew ha la ka kali ïapom bad u lytar shat Jesreel . U Joram um pat shym ïoh jingkoit , bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah u dang don hangta , u leit jngoh ïa u .
translation.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot , and went to Jezreel  ; for Joram lay there . And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram .
But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness , but is in danger of eternal damnation :
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ong kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map lano lano ruh , namar u la leh ïa ka pop bymjukut .
Bad u Isaiah u khun jong u Nun bad u Eliab u khun jong u Jephunneh , ar thut na i'u ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :

And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials , and talked with me , saying unto me , Come hither  ; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters :
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang , u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  Ale , ngan pyn-i ha me ba kumno yn pynshitom ïa ka nuti bapawnam , kata ka nongbah bakhraw ïa kaba la tei hajan ki wah babun .

translation.en: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la mudui ïa U Jisu shibun kiei kiei , kumta u Pilat u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato men ym jubab ? Sngap ïa ki jingmudui jong ki baroh !

U Trai u ong ïa ki Israel , Ka spah ki jingpeit bad ki Sudan kan long ka jong phi , bad ki rangbah bajrong jong ka Seba kin erlangthari ki mraw jong phi ; kan bud ïa phi ha ki kynjri . Kin dem ngon ha phi bad kin phylla , ‘ U Blei u don ryngkat nabar phi — tang ma u , u long U Blei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The labour of Egypt , and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans , men of stature , shall come over unto thee , and they shall be thine : they shall come after thee  ; in chains they shall come over , and they shall fall down unto thee , they shall make supplication unto thee , saying , Surely God is in thee  ; and there is none else , there is no God .

translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lydda kila kumjuh ia U Blei , kin jingem da la kha ia ki khun ki bajanai , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan jin da la longïng ka paro , ha kaba ki briew’ kin ioh im lah jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .
translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada tala ka prum ka pur hadien ba la pynbna ba iathuh u longsyiem uba khum ,
translation.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing  ;
To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
translation.kha: Badno phin nujor ïa nga ?  ong U  Trai .  Hato don uno uno uba kum ma nga ?

Ki kmie ki kop jong u ki la kynjat haba ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong , Ko khur jong nga , balei me la leh ïa kane ha I ? U kpa jongu me bad ma ar ngi la khuslai shikatdei eh ha kaba pyrshang baneh pud ïa me .
translation.en: And when they saw him , they were amazed : and his mother said unto him , Son , why hast thou thus dealt with us ? behold , thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei ; u la kerkut ïa nga namar ba nga long uba shida .
translation.en: The  Lord  rewarded me according to my righteousness : according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me .

translation.kha: Me la dei ban don jingisynei ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’
translation.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?

translation.kha: ngam sngewkynjah ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa laiñ mad , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namsop ba nga ieit Palat ïa phiah ?
translation.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .

translation.kha: Nga la hikai ïa phi ïa ki hukum , kitab U Trai U Blei jongno nga u la hukum ïa nga . Sumar bad bor ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit pynlang ïohkynti .
translation.en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .
And he said , Behold now , I am old , I know not the day of my death :
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Me ïohi ba nga la tymmen bad shen ngan sa ïap noh .

translation.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ngan ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ki lumbah bad jaw ummat na ka bynta ki jaka pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong , bad ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ki . Ïa ka jingsawa ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew shuh ; ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim don shuh .
U la set ïa nga ha ka ïingbyndi jongu ka jingjynjar bad ka jinglyng-a .
translation.en: He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .

translation.kha: Kane baroh ka long na ka bynta jongno phi ; bad katba ka jingïamai U Blei ka ïalang kner noh sha kiba bun ki brup , ktang ai sha ka burom U Blei khnam bun ki jingduwai ainguh .
translation.en: For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .

translation.kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pateng “ U Abraham u jingkit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule ” ba u Abram u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .
translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “ Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her . ”
