But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .
translation.kha: Phin mynjur , namarkata , ba ngam shym la long ka jingbankhia ïa phi . Hynrei don ki ban ong ba nga la long uba sianti , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .
To wiang bad bim shuh sa khyndiat , u ong , hynne um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat ka long kaei kaba u long da shisha .
translation.en: For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .

translation.kha: Ko khwan u briew u la ong , phai khmat shad ki lum ka Israel , bad to ai ïa ka khubor jngai nga ha ki .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
Therefore their goods shall become a booty , and their houses a desolation : they shall also build houses , but not inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , but not drink the wine thereof .
translation.kha: Ïa ka spah jong ki yn lute bad ïa ki ïing jong ki yn pynjot . Kin ym shong ha ki ïing kiba ki tei lane dih ïa ka waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba ki thung .
Hadien lai sngi u Jeroboam bad ki bariew baroh ki leit pat shaei u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bta ïa ki .
translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day , as the king bade , saying , Come again to me on the third day .
In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki sumar ïa ka spah jong ki , hynrei ki bymman ki duh ei ïa la ka jong haba ki por kiba eh ki wan poi .
Ïa ka jingphyrnai ksiar la ïohthiah ha ka phrang baieit , bad ka burom jong U Blei ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
But when his heart was lifted up , and his mind hardened in pride , he was deposed from his kingly throne , and they took his glory from him :
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u la long uba sarong , uba eh ryndang , bad uba runar , la weng noh ïa u na ka khet syiem bad u la duh noh ïa ka jaka badonburom jong u .

translation.en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long u paralok jong phi .

translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut ka khyndew . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .

translation.en: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel , unto the place over against the water gate toward the east , and the tower that lieth out .
translation.kha: U Palal , u khun jong u Usai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba sdang na ka dong jong ka kynroh bad ka jingtei ap phira jong ka ïingsyiem kaba haneng kaba long habar ka jaka ap phira ; U Pedaïah , u khun jong u Parosh u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka bynta kaba sha mihngi hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad ka jingtei ap phira ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hajan kata ka bynta jong ka nongbah ba khot Ophel , ha kaba ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ ki shong ki sah . )
Lada u tang shu mano bad pynsep ïa nga !
translation.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na ka jait bashaphang shatei ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,
U Dabid u ong , U Trai U Blei ki Israel u la ai ka jingsuk ha la ki briew , bad u hi un Shong junom ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: For David said , The  Lord  God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :

translation.kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? hato ym Don doktor hangthie ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong nga ym shym la pynkhiah ?
translation.en: Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?

translation.kha: To ngin ai ka jingnguh shaei U Blei badno U Kpa jong U Jisu kyrshut Uba U Trai jong ngi , U Kpa ba-dap da jingisynei , U Blei na uba ka jingïarap baroh ka wan !
translation.en: Blessed be God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies , and the God of all comfort ;

translation.kha: Te ki nongïalam shnong kin khot ïa u bun ïakren Bad u . Lada u dang kyntait ban shongkurim ïa ka ,
translation.en: Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak unto him : and if he stand to it , and say , I like not to take her  ;

translation.kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khup lad u Isaak , u kynhun jong u Abraham , u khun jongki u Terah , u khup jong u Nahor ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,

translation.kha: Kumta ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u sing . Kum u labasa ngan iahap ha ki lynti ïaid jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :

translation.kha: U ne ruh shibun ngut ki shakri malu u la long u bri bashongbriew tam ha ka ri Mihngi .
translation.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .
Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God , and of Jesus our Lord ,
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ba-dap pura kin long ki jong phi lyngba ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei bad ïa U Jisu U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
translation.kha: Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar halor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u don ka iktiar halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka balang , ka met jong u .
Abdon , Nebo , Bethaben Diblathaim ,
translation.en: And upon Dibon , and upon Nebo , and upon Beth–diblathaim ,

translation.kha: Kumta to kiar noh na ki jingmlien bajakhlia baroh mala na ki jinglong bymman baroh . To pyndem ha U blei bad pdiang ïa ka ktien kaba u la thung ha ki dohnud jong phi , kiba lah ban pynap ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness , and receive with meekness the engrafted word , which is able to save your souls .
They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa uta u briew sa shisien ,  Me ong u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me — haba kumta , me ong aïu shaphang jong u ?   U dei u nongïathuhlypa ,  uta u briew u la jubab .
Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ba-bang ïaleh thma ha Sokoh , ka shnong kaba ha Judah ; ki sher dara ha kadei ka jaka kaba ki khot Ephes Dammim , kaba napdeng ka Sokoh bad ka Asekah .
translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle , and were gathered together at Soco , which belongeth to Judah , and pitched between Soco and Azekah , in Ephes–dammim .

translation.kha: Lehse phi pyrkhat ba baroh shi katta ngi la pyrshang don ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jongu phi . Em! Ngi kren kumba U Khrist un jin da la kwah ïa ngi ban kren ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei , bad baroh kaba ngi leh , ko phlangïap ba-ieit , la leh ban ïarap ïa phi! .
translation.en: Again , think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you ? we speak before God in Christ : but we do all things , dearly beloved , for your edifying .

translation.kha: wahbah u bieit u riewkynthei , ka long kumta ka jingsam ki tieng shiah ha ka ding . Kam don jingmut ei ei .
translation.en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .

If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .
translation.kha: Lada ar ngut shi para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jaka bad uwei na ki u ïap khlem da ïoh khun shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap kam dei ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u bym dei na ka ïing ka sem jong u ; u para jong uta uba la ïap u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka .

Lada me kohnguh tylliat ïa nga , me im khah ki hukum jong nga , sad me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong nga da kambah leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kamra u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . Ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kmen synshar hadien jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Abda .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .

translation.kha: To plie ïa por ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ; ngan rupa ring shapoh bad ainguh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness : I will go into them , and I will praise the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ha ka sneng kaba khatsan Jong u bnai uba nyngkong jongngi ka snem kaba kharai jong ka jingringmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Bad Myntan , da kaba kohnguh ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jesreel , khlem da pyntip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad khie leit shim ïa u , bad khroh ïa u . Ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .
translation.kha: Kane ka long namar ki Amon bad ki Moab kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na Ijipt . Pynban , ki la siew pisa sha u Balaam ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla long ïa ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .
Uei u ban pynsniew ïa phi! lada phi shitrhem ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha ?
translation.en: And who is he that will harm you , if ye be followers of that which is good ?
And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la kren ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  hukum ïa ki synran jong me ban sngap jar !

U Trai u la ong ïa nga , Ko Jeremoth , hato uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u jingïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh u kylli ïa me , ‘ Kaei ka khubor jong U Trei ?’ Men ïathuh ha u , ‘ Me long ka jingkit ïa U Trai , bad un sa kynther noh ïa me .’
translation.en: And when this people , or the prophet , or a priest , shall ask thee , saying , What is the burden of the  Lord  ? thou shalt then say unto them , What burden ? I will even forsake you , saith the  Lord .
I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum u kpa ïa kiba duk bad nga la long ha ka liang ki nongwei haba ki shem jingeh .

translation.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched , and that burned with fire , nor unto blackness , and darkness , and tempest ,
translation.kha: Naba phim shym la wan kumba wan ki paid Israel , sha kaei kaba phi lah ban tba , sha u lum Sinai ha kaba la don ka ding kaba klang , ka jingdum bad u lyoh ïong , ka  erïong ,

translation.en: And they answered , that they could not tell whence it was .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la jubab ,  Ngim tip nangno ka la wan .
Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka nongaibuit ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u shym jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .
translation.en: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .

translation.kha: Hynriew ym kum u kpa jong u , um Shim long uba pynrit ïa lade malu phai sha U Trai ; u kham long uba pop ban ïa kaba long u kpa jongu u .
translation.en: And humbled not himself before the  Lord  , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself  ; but Amon trespassed more and more .
And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop ba uta u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un long jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .

Ko ki paid Jerusalem’ , U Trai u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jing-jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka long ka jingïapthngan kaba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jaitbynriew kaba ïa ka ktien jong ka khung tipbriew .
translation.en: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .

translation.kha: U Balaam u kuna kumta , sad u kñia uwei u mai kyrtong nabar uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan .
translation.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ki la ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki ong ,  Ïa ka Jerusalem dei ban pynjot ! Ngin ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingjot !

translation.en: Strangers have devoured his strength , and he knoweth it not : yea , gray hairs are here and there upon him , yet he knoweth not .
translation.kha: Ki shaniah ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki bad kim sngewthuh ba kane ka jingshaniah ha ki nongwei ka la bam duh noh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Ki sngi jong ki , ki la jan kut , hynrei kim shym la tip ïa kata .
Ka sngi ka la mih ïahap u Jakob u mihnoh na Peniel , u da ïaid dkoh nalor kata ka skhep .
translation.en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him , and he halted upon his thigh .
He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin , kaba na Jerusalem .

Nangta u la ïalum ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha ka ïing jong u bad u la ai ha ki katne kattne ka jingbam ban bam . Ïa u bad ka longïing jong u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar myntri ki la ngeit ha U Blei .
translation.en: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .

But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :
translation.kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  I pa i pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Sngewbha da leh husiar lashai mynstep ; rieh ha ka jaka bym don batip bad sah hangta .

Hynrei u briew suba Shaniah ha ka jingngeit jrong u , ym ha ki kam jong u , nabar uba ngeit ha U Blei umbah pynbna ïa uba la rem , ban long uba them lui , ka long ka jingngeit jong u ba U Blei u pdiang khnang ban pynlong hok ïa uta u briew bad u hi .
translation.en: But to him that worketh not , but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly , his faith is counted for righteousness .

And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised : it may be that the  Lord  will work for us : for there is no restraint to the  Lord  to save by many or by few .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u samla ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara jong kito ki Philistia ba mane blei thala . Lehse U  Trai  un ïarap ïa ngi ; lada u ïarap , ym don ei ei kaba lah ban khang ïa u ban ai ha ngi ka jingjop , kam pher la ngi don tang khyndiat ruh .
Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to ïai plied borabor na ka bynta kiei kiei barhem sha U Blei uba U Kpa .
translation.en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
translation.kha: To wan sha U Trai , u maw uba im uba la kyntait da u briew kum u bymmyntoi hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .
Kumba ha kata kajuh ka pa u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u sngewkwah ba u shem Hesekaïah u la kem pang , kumta u phah sha u ïa ka shiah bad ka jingai sngewbha .
translation.en: At that time Berodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah : for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick .
And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah hynñiew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u kylli ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ,  Kumno shaphang ki briew kiba phi la pynïap ha Tabor ?  Ki jubab ,  Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei na ki u syriem ïa u khun jong u syiem .
Ïa ka jingsngewsih Jong at ym lah ban pynjhieh ; nga pang ha ka nadong .
translation.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow , my heart is faint in me .

translation.kha: Ïa me , pynban , ka long kaba dei hok , namar ba ngi Ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi Dei ban ïoh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka bym dei .
translation.en: And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .

translation.kha: To U Blei , babha un-long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jongki ngi , un long ryngkat bad phi barhem . Amen .
translation.en: Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .

translation.kha: Bad ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad phi Hangne , namar U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam ne theh ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai sha ïing na kajuh ka lynti .
translation.en: For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .
Better is a dry morsel , and quietness therewith , than an house full of sacrifices with strife .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa u kpu ba la tyrkhong lem bad ka jingsuk mynsiem ban ïa kaba bam khawai ha ka ïing kaba dap da ki jingjynjar .

translation.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long uwei u nongsharai jong ki , bad un sumar bha ïa ki .
Ïathuh ïa kito ki paid Ishmael kiba ïalang pyrshah ba ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , ngan ym lah Shah shuh ïa kiei kiei naba ijli ba ki ni .
translation.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious , even to the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O ye house of Israel , let it suffice you of all your abominations ,

translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la thew sa ïa ka pyngkiang jong ka lynti ïawad kaba ha ka khrup . Ka la long baroh bynriew mitar shiteng malu ka jaka ba laitluid hapdeng ki khyrdop kiba rynghang ka la long san mitar .
translation.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate , ten cubits  ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits .

translation.kha: bad ki la ïohkem sa laiphew hajar ngut . Ki la ïalam ïa ki koidi shiah ka kliar uwei u mawsiang ha ka nongbah Sela bad ki briew ïa ki , ba kumne la pynjop ïa ki ha ki mawlynnai kiba ba-don sha tei .
translation.en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive , and brought them unto the top of the rock , and cast them down from the top of the rock , that they all were broken in pieces .

And honey , and butter , and sheep , and cheese of kine , for David , and for the people that were with him , to eat : for they said , The people is hungry , and weary , and thirsty , in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki la wanrah ki pliang , ki khra , bad ki jaiñkup thiah , bad ki jingbam ruh ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u : u kew , u barli , u  purew , u kew sdieh , u rymbai , u motor , ka ngap , ka ktung dud    , ka malai , bad katto katne ki langbrot . Ki tip ba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan , ki la sliang , bad ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .
Men ïai don ki khun ki kiew , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban kein junom . Ka un-long syiem jong me kan ym kut .’
translation.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .

translation.kha: Ka la long namar phim to ka jingngeit kaba biang , la jubab U Jisu . “Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ïada phi don ka jingneh kaba heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban nong ïa une u lumrit , ‘ Khie longing noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .

translation.kha: Un pynrieh ïa phi borabor kat ngab biang ban lehsbun ha ki nga baroh , khnang kiba bun kin ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ki jingai jong phi ïa kiba ki la ïohpdiang na im .
translation.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness , which causeth through us thanksgiving to God .

translation.kha: U Trai u dap da ka jingisynei bad un ym kyntait ïa ngi junom .
translation.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la noh ha nga ba Wat la ka Israel ka la phalang noh na u , ka la lah pynshisha ba ka long katba kham babha ban ïa ka Judah ka bymïaineh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .
I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ieh hangta ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kiba duk , ki ban wan sha nga na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
thaba u syiem u la lah jam sha shiliang , ïa kaba la synran da barabor ki rangbah ka Judah bad shitrhem na ki paid Jesreel , u la leit beit sha Gilgal , bad u Shimham u la leit bad u .
translation.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal , and Chimham went on with him : and all the people of Judah conducted the king , and also half the people of Israel .
After these things , and the establishment thereof , Sennacherib king of Assyria came , and entered into Judah , and encamped against the fenced cities , and thought to win them for himself .
translation.kha: Hadien kine ki jingjia , ha kaba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ïaineh ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . U kerkut ïa ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh bad u ai ki hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban pynpra ïa ka lynti lyngba ki kynroh .

Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa kita ki shipai samla kiba long hapoh ki nongai lawbah jong ki distrik , kiba ba-don arspah laiñ ar ngut baroh . Nangta u la khot ïa ka kynhun shipai Jerusalem , katba Don ingiew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba kamon kata ka briew kan ïoh jop ïa ka dohnud jyllang phi ; wat leit shnong kadlieng shabi ïaid ma ka .
translation.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways , go not astray in her paths .

translation.kha: Hato phim pat shngiam la ïakren bad ki briew kiba leit jinglah ? Katto phim tip ïa ki jingïathoh ba ki wanrah ?
translation.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way ? and do ye not know their tokens ,
Neither shall they take for their wives a widow , nor her that is put away : but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel , or a widow that had a priest before .
translation.kha: Uno uno u lyngdoh um lah ban shongkurim ïa ka briew ba la iehnoh tnga ; un shongkurim tang ïa ka theisotti Israel lane ïa ka riewkynthei jong uwei pat u lyngdoh .
Te napdeng ka erïong , U Trai u la kren ha u Job sa shisien pat .
translation.en: Then answered the  Lord  unto Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,

translation.kha: Kumjuh ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha shuwa ba u Samson un rupa sha la kamra thiah , ki briew jongu kata ka shnong ki ong ha u , Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei suba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u sing ? U Samson u Joab , Lada phim Shim la mluh da ka masi jong nga , Phin ym tip ïa ka jingjubab myntoi .
translation.en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .
All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Kpa jong nga u don ka long ka jong nga ; na kata ka daw nga la ong ba U Mynsiem un shim ïa kaei kaba nga ai ha u bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: Let Reuben live , and not die  ; and let not his men be few .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Reuben , u Moses u ong ,  Ai ba ka jait Reuben kan im , wat la ka long kaba khyndiat briew .

Na kawei ka sniew sha kaei pat , ha ka jingïaishah me la maham ïa ki . Me pyrda myn ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren , hynrei ki briew jong me ki long kyllut , kumjuh me shah ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban kjap ïa ki .
translation.en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them , and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets : yet would they not give ear : therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balei lui , khih ba ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la ni ïa kane nalor ba u ïabam ïa ki briew ka Judah sha ka jingmane paitlieng da kiba pynlong ïa ki banbeiñ leh pum pyrshah ïa U Tharai .
translation.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka duriaw , kaba u la thaw ; ka khyndew ruh , kaba u hi u la pynlong .
U la pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun bakhlaiñbor jong nga bad na kito baroh kiba shun ïa nga — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor eh ban ïa at .
translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .

translation.kha: Tharai uno du u shim ïa ka lyngkhot dohkha ba la Pynkyntang na ka jingkñia bad u rah ha ka jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñkup Jong u . Te lada u kum pynbuaid ïa la ka jaiñkup ha Une uno u kpu , ka jingbam ba la shet , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ne ka dei kano kano ka jait jingbang , hato kan pyningkhong ba la pynkyntang ruh ïa kata ka jingbam ? Haba la kylli ïa kata ka jingkylli , ki lyngdoh ki jubab , Em .
translation.en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No .

translation.kha: Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingthmu kaba nga la don pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Babilon bad ïa kaei kaba nga thum ban leh ïa ki bhabriew jrong ka . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn pynïoh ïa ki , bad baïar kin sngewtriem .
translation.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .
Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .
translation.kha: Haoid , u Blei un sa khot ia ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki kam niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .
Ngan shah ïa ka nongbah Pungsum , ka kut Bakhraw jong ka Ijipt , ban shiteng ïa ka jingbitar sylla jong na . Ngan pynjot ïa ka spaiñ jong ka Thebes .
translation.en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin , the strength of Egypt  ; and I will cut off the multitude of No .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlut hynñiew sngi ha kaba pyniwtung ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew Sngi ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .
translation.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .
Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .
translation.kha: Me tip lut ïa baroh kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , bad Lystra , ki jingpynshitom bashyrkhei kiba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u Trai u la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .
Ka pukri u Jakob ka la don hangta , bad U Jisu , uba la tait na kata ka jingleit , u la shongthait harud kata ka pukri . Ka long kumba shiteng sngi .
translation.en: Now Jacob s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid kat kumta ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki brup ki bymkohnguh . Ha ka sngi kob hynñiew u den ban pynkhuid ïa kito , kiba , hawei ba ki la sait ïa la ki daiñ bad sum ïa lade , ki kylla long kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngaid kat kum ka jinglehshitom .
translation.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .

translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kaba koum ki Ishmael , ïa ibha me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynjrong ïa ki , ki briew jong me hi . Kiei kiei kiba khraw mala kiba phylla me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki la pynïabiang ïa ka ngam jong me kylleng satlak ka pyrthei . Me la baher noh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki katba ki briew jong me ki nang ïaid shaphrang , ki briew ïa kiba me la pyllaitluid na Ijipt ban Long ki jongu me hi .
translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people , even like Israel , whom God went to redeem for a people to himself , and to make him a name , and to do for you great things and terrible , for thy land , before thy people , which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt , from the nations and their gods ?

translation.kha: Kin long kumno ki lyngkhot phlangïap , bun ka ding tista bam duh ïa ki ! Kin ym lah wat ban pyllait im ïa lade — ki thylliej dieng kin khliehduh eh na ka bynta jong ki , yn ym to ka dang kaba rhem ban pynsyaid ïa lade! .
translation.en: Behold , they shall be as stubble  ; the fire shall burn them  ; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame : there shall not be a coal to warm at , nor fire to sit before it .

translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la ïalam ïa ngi ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la pyndep ïa ka jinglehkmen ka jingpynkhuid Lem bad ki . Nangta u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngur kan long haduh kaba kut ka Por jong ka jingpynkhiah , haba yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baher ar ngut .
translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah .
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun Israel ki buh ïa ki briew ban apthap ïa ka Gibeah baroh sawdong .
U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei pat ki jingïapthngan bad u la shah ïa ki ban shem noh ïa ki pyntha lad ki ,
translation.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;
That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shong ha ka jingstad briew , hynrei , ha ka bor U Blei .
Hynrei ki synran kim shemphang ïa kano kano na keiñ kiei kiei ; ïa ka jingmut jong ki kyntien la buhrieh na ki , bad kim tip Shaphan kaei U Jisu u kren .
translation.en: And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .

translation.kha: Ka la ïam shaphang kata ha baroh kita ki hynrei sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sner kaba hynriewphew u ïathmu ha ka , ka mut une kata ka jingkyntip , naba ka ïai thlia ïa u katta main . Nangta ka ïathuh pat ha ngi ki phria .
translation.en: And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U Balaam u jubab , Nga la ïathuh ha kito ki nonglamktien ba phi la phah shata nga ,
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la thew ïa ka , kito kiba lum kham bhor kim shym ïoh tam , bad kito kiba lum kham khyndiat kim shym ïoh duna ; man la u bri u lum tyngkan katba u lah banbeiñ bameh .
translation.en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .
The Spirit of God hath made me , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga bad uba ai jingim ïa nga .
U nongmareh thong uba mareh ïa ka tang un ym lah ban ïor ïa ka phlait lymda u kohnguh ïa ki rukom pynïaid .
translation.en: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .

translation.kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kadiang jongno u , ‘ khie saw noh na nga , phiah katba hapoh ka jingtim Jong U Blei ! Khie leit noh Sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynrieh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !
translation.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
Woe unto him that saith unto his father , What begettest thou ? or to the woman , What hast thou brought forth ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno un nud ban ong ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ,  Balei phi pynlong ïa nga kumne ?
La don kyrhai eh u kew kat haduh ba u Joseph um donkam shuh ban da thew ïa u — u la long kum u shyiap ka duriaw .
translation.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering  ; for it was without number .

translation.kha: Bad kine ki jait kin ïeng ha u lat Ebal katba dang pynbna ïa ki jingtim : ka jai Reuben , ka jait Gad , ka khait Asher , ka jait Sebulun , ka jai dei , bad ka jait Naphtali .
translation.en: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse  ; Reuben , Gad , and Asher , and Zebulun , Dan , and Naphtali .

translation.kha: Ki dala Israel ki mihnoh na Rephidim , badno ha ka sngi naba Nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai naduh ba ki mih na Ijipt ki wanpaw pah ha ka ri shyiap Sinai . Ki shen dala hangta ha kjat u Lum Sinai ,
translation.en: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .

translation.kha: U Jotham u long syiem haba u la don arphew san snem ka rta , bad u synlar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jongki u ka dei ka Jerushah , ka Kynhun jong u Sadok .
translation.en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar ïa la ki briew malu u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lehbha kin khynñiuh bad ïa ki met jong kito kiba la ïap yn eh ha ki lynti kum ka synriah . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbit U TRAI’ ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïai kner ban pynshitom .
translation.en: Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

translation.kha: Ynda u la jong ïa kan , u Paul u la shim katto katne u khop , u la ainguh ïa U Blei ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la sdang ba bam .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .

translation.kha: Katno me long uba khrum ; A Trai Nongsynshar ! Ym don uwei pat umbiah kum ma me , ngi la ju tip ba dih tang ma me hi uba longïng U Blei .
translation.en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister , nor of thy father s sister : for he uncovereth his near kin : they shall bear their iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan , ne bad la ka ñiakha , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shahshitom namar kata ka kam sang .
ban shakuriaw kum u apostol ha ka tare jong u Judas , uba la iehnoh ban leit sha ka jaka Kaba u dei ban leit .
translation.en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas by transgression fell , that he might go to his own place .

translation.kha: U phlang u ïapstai sad ki syntiew ki jlop , haba U Trai u phah ïa ka lyer ban beh halor jong ki . Ki briew kim neh slem ban ïa u phlang .
translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : because the spirit of the  Lord  bloweth upon it : surely the people is grass .

translation.kha: Haba ki Philetos ki kylli mei ba la har ïa kane , ki tip ba dei u Jason suba la lai ïa dat namar ba u kthaw kurim jong u , uba na Timnah , u la ai nep ïa ka tnga jong u Hasason ha u paralok jyllang u Samson . Kumta ki Philistia ki leit bad ki thap ïa kata ka kynthei ha ban da ïap bad stong ruh ïa ka ïing u kpa jong ka .
translation.en: Then the Philistines said , Who hath done this ? And they answered , Samson , the son in law of the Timnite , because he had taken his wife , and given her to his companion . And the Philistines came up , and burnt her and her father with fire .

translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hynrei , kiwei ruh ki donkam banbeiñ ïohsngew ïa ka khublei baheh , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïoh lait im .
translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) However , others also need to hear the good news so that they too can be saved .
For the goodman is not at home , he is gone a long journey :
translation.kha: U tnga jong nga um don ha ïing ; u la leit jingleit sha jngai .

translation.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty  ; with whom , if he come shortly , I will see you .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ïa u para jong ngi , u Timothi la pyllait na ka ïingbyndi . Lada u wan kloi , ngan wan ryngkat bad u haba nga wan jngoh ïa phi .
Na kata ka khak u dabor shang bad shatai ban ïoh ei ei ban pynïap dara Ban bam .
translation.en: From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baher , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad hangta phin shrak ïa kiwei pat ki blei kiba da ka tieng bad da u maw , ki blei kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju mane mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .

translation.kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , namar ka jingpynithuh ïa ka ! to shalyntem , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki Gospel bad ki nongïathuhlypa ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka pyntha kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi! !
translation.en: Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .

translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba la leh ha ka tnad treng ka wanrah ïa ka jingtynjuh ha ka nang ïalap . —1 kyrthat 14 :33 , 40 .
translation.en: Everything done at a branch contributes to the orderly accomplishment of the preaching work . —1 Corinthians 14 :33 , 40 .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jong phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha trai uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem uba ïing synrum u tap bun na uba ka ding kaba Rehum ka rung shaduh suiñbneng .
translation.en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .

translation.kha: ?(Nga la weng noh ïa ki pop jongngi phi khem ïa u lyoh . To wan phai pat sha nga ; to long uta uba la pynim ïa phin .
translation.en: I have blotted out , as a thick cloud , thy transgressions , and , as a cloud , thy sins : return unto me  ; for I have redeemed thee .

translation.kha: U Blei u la phad ïa at kamon u nongïohipaw ban maham ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel . La katta ruh shano shano ba nga leit , phi pyrshang ngab riam ïa na kum ïa ka sim . Wat ha ka Templ U balui , ki briew ki dei ki nongsuhjaiñ jong u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways , and hatred in the house of his God .

translation.kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Bethel .
translation.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him , Beth–el .

translation.kha: Kin ïap na ki jingpang bashyrkhei , bad ym don mano mano ba jingïambriew na ka beit jongki ki lane tat ïa ki . Ki met jngai ki ngin long kum ki kynton soh khashor ka khyndew . Kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane ïap na ka jingïohpateng , bad ki met jongngi ki kin lama ki jingbam ïa ki sim bad ïa ki riewkhraw .
translation.en: They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por nga ïakyrpad jur ,
translation.en: And I besought the  Lord  at that time , saying ,

translation.kha: U nongtuh u wan dang ban ïoh tuh , ïa-ban pynïap bad ban pyndait . Ngi la wan khnang ba phna ïoh ïa ka jingriam — ka jingshem ha ka jingïap kyrhai jong ka .
translation.en: The thief cometh not , but for to steal , and to kill , and to destroy : I am come that they might have life , and that they might have it more abundantly .

translation.kha: Ynda u Jakob u la dep snoh ïa la ki khun , u thiah noh , bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons , he gathered up his feet into the bed , and yielded up the ghost , and was gathered unto his people .

translation.kha: Shah ba ngan ïaid hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi malade ban sping ïa baroh ki khunlangbrot biang bad ïa ki khongpong baroh kiba tupia bad thohbroin . Kata kan erlangthari ka bainong kaba nga kwah .
translation.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
Avoiding this , that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us :
translation.kha: Ngi da sumar ba yn ym shah kynnoh ha ki jingmudui ïa ka rukom pynïaid ïa kane ka jingai sbun mynsiem .

Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la waiñ phai na Ijipt , ki khot sngewbha ïa u shuh ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Jerusalem . tdong ka jait Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .

translation.kha: bad sa sei kilo u purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better .
translation.kha: Ym don jingartatien ba uta uba kyrkhu u kham khraw ban ïa uta uba shah kyrkhu .

translation.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the  Lord  , and hast not kept the commandment which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee ,
translation.kha: bad u la kren jam ha u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ,  U  Trai  u ong ba phi la lyndet ïa ka ktien U  Trai  , bad phim shym la leh kumba u la hukum ïa phi .

U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa sier ka prais , bad lada u shñiuh Hangne u la kylla lieh bad kata ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiuhmat , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew’ u long u bymjukut .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .

translation.kha: katsha ki ïangat ïakren , ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem ki wan poi ha ka jingkynthih Ban ïalam ïa u Haman sha ka Jingkhawai ka Ashteroth .
translation.en: And while they were yet talking with him , came the king s chamberlains , and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared .
Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together , and came to Samuel unto Ramah ,
translation.kha: Te ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel ki la ïakynduh lang , ki leit sha u Samuel ha Ramah ,
Ka kali ïapom ba la tan da ki kulai rong ïong ka la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia , ki kulai rong lieh ki leit shaneng sepngi , bad ki khuslai thohbroin ki leit sha ka ri bashathie .
translation.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country  ; and the white go forth after them  ; and the grisled go forth toward the south country .

translation.kha: Dei namar kata , nga marwei beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba nga long kumno nongïakura u bym ïa-pihuin ïa ka jingkura lad u .
translation.en: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :

translation.kha: Ynda u Aaron u la kah pynsep ïa ka stang lehse ban pynkhuid ïa ka Joah Kaba ksuid Tam , ïa kaba sah jong ka ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U Trai’ , bad ïa ka duwan , un ai sha U Trai ïa uta u langsohmoh uba dang im uba la jied na ka bynta u Asasel .
translation.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar , he shall bring the live goat :

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbishar khih la beh ino , bad ka khak kam lah ban wan hajan . Ka jingshisha ka kyllon ha ki lynnong shnong , bad ka hok kam don jaka hangta .
translation.en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .

translation.kha: Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn Thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel bhor kawei .
translation.en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura bad ban ngeit : U Khrist Jisu u la wan sha ka pyrthuh ïa ka ban pynim ïa ki nongpop , nga long uba sniew tam na ki ,
translation.en: This is a faithful saying , and worthy of all acceptation , that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners ; of whom I am chief .
And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la tymmen bha , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .
Mar kumta u la shem ïa u Simon , u para jong u bad u la ong ha u , Ngi la shen ïa u Messaïah . ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut U Khrist . )
translation.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .

translation.kha: Ki hukum , wat klim ; wat pynïap bynriew ; wat tuh ; wat ikwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong kiwei pat — ïa kine baroh , pynlang kino kino kiwei pat , la kynhied pur ha kawei ka hukum , Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me dom ïa lade .
translation.en: For this , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not kill , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness , Thou shalt not covet ; and if there be any other commandment , it is briefly comprehended in this saying , namely , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.kha: Te de la khot kyrpad ïa U Troas , Nga kyrpad ïa me , A Trai , to pyntam ïa nga !
translation.en: Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .

translation.kha: U Timothi , u para nongtrei jongno nga , u phah ïa phi ki jingïabujli ; bad kumjuh pajut u Lukios , u Jason , bad u Sosipater kiba long ki para Jiw .
translation.en: Timothy my workfellow , and Lucius , and Jason , and Sosipater , my kinsmen , salute you .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ngab ïaid ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;
translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes ,

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Ijipt kin kyllon len bad kito kiba shah pynpei ha ka thma . Ka waitlam ka la khlei Ban pynïap lut ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .

translation.kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahishahar u lait im . U la janai shah pynïap ryngkat bad kiwei , hynrei la pynkoit im ïa u da ka pynkha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kaba long ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shim ïa u lem bad ka nongsynran Jong u sha ka kamra thiah kaban don ha ka Tubal Bad ka la pynjhieh ïa u na ka Amasaïah , kumto um shym la shahshkor pynïap .
translation.en: But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .

translation.kha: woh nong ha la u pyrman ap hajuh lashai lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa u Myntan .
translation.en: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .

translation.kha: Suki suki kin pynkylla ïa ka sha ka paradais .—Jenesis 1 :28 ; 2 :8 , 15 .
translation.en: Gradually they would have made the entire earth into a paradise .—Genesis 1 :28  ; 2 :8 , 15 .

And say unto him , Take heed , and be quiet  ; fear not , neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands , for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria , and of the son of Remaliah .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban da husiar , ban long jai jai , bad ban ym sheptieng lane khih jingmut . Ka jingbitar u Syiem Resin bad ki Syria jong u bad ka jong u Syiem Pekah kam long shuh kaba don jingma ban ïa ka tdem jong ki ar tylli ki shynraiñ dieng kiba don ding .

translation.en: And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka leit sha u , bad haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kynrad , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim da kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .

translation.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people : for the cause was of God , that the  Lord  might perform his word , which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  U Blei ban pynjia ïa kaei ba u la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Kane ka long balei ba u syiem um shym la shahshkor ïa ki briew .
U Haduh u ïoh ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para jong ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem kim lah ban ngeit ïa kane , namar ki jingïateh lok kiba ki la pynlong . Hynrei kane ka jingïathuhlypa ka long ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ban maham ïa ki ba kin sa shah kurup .
haba un pyrshang ban kjit ïap na ka waitlam nar , ka ryntieh rnong kan Siat ban pynkyllon ïa u .
translation.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .
And Zelah , Eleph , and Jebusi , which is Jerusalem , Gibeah , and Kirjath  ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .
translation.kha: ka Sela , ka Haeleph , ka Jebus ( lane ka Jerusalem ) , ka Gibeah , bad ka Kiriath Jearim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki . Kane ka long ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Uno un uba shahshkor ïa ka ktien hynrei u bym pyntreikam ïa ka u Long khem u briew uba pynlut ha ka ïitkhmih pynlang ioh ïa lade kumba u longsyiem .
translation.en: For if any be a hearer of the word , and not a doer , he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass :
And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang , bad ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri na kaei kaba la sah tam .
U Othniel , u khun lad u Kenas , u para jong u Kaleb , u la ïuhkjat ïa ka nongbet ; kumta u Kaleb u la ai ha u ïa la ka khulom kynthei ban shongkurim .
translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .

translation.kha: Pynkloi ! mareh ! ngan ym lah ban leh ei ei tad haduh ba men da poi hangta . Naaman ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongrit la ai kyrteng ka Soar .
translation.en: Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .

translation.kha: Kumno keiñ ngan long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta katta ? u Hasael u kulai . Ngam erlangthari ei ei ruh em ! U Elisha u phai ktien , U Trai u la pynpaw ha per ba men sa long u syiem ka Syria .
translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .

translation.kha: Mano ba la ai ïa ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? Ka long na U Trai hi , pyrshah ïa u ba ngi la leh jop ! Ngin shym im kumba u khiah ïa ngi ban im , lane jongu ïa ki jinghikai kiba u ai ha ngi .
translation.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil , and Israel to the robbers ? did not the  Lord  , he against whom we have sinned ? for they would not walk in his ways , neither were they obedient unto his law .
But the prophet , which shall presume to speak a word in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or that shall speak in the name of other gods , even that prophet shall die .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u nongïathuhlypa u nud ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa ka khubor kaba ngam shym la hukum ïa u , u dei ban ïap namar kata ; bad uno uno u nongïathuhlypa uba kren ha ka kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki blei u ruh u dei ban ïap .’
Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jongki me ki dei ban mynjur ban ontep ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .

translation.kha: La ïai ïaroh ïa u namar kaei kaba u leh ; phi ruh phi dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: Remember that thou magnify his work , which men behold .

translation.kha: U Ahasaïah , u syiem Israel u la hap na ka jaka jngoh kai halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Samaria , bad u la mynjur jur . Kumta u phiah katto katne ki nonglamktien baneh kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei jong ka Ekron , ka Nongbah Philistia , khnang ban ïatip la un ïohkhiah ne em .
translation.en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria , and was sick : and he sent messengers , and said unto them , Go , enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease .

translation.kha: Don katno katne ka jingsngur ïa u ngeit uba ba-mutlop ban ïa uno uno uba kren khlem pyrkhat .
translation.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .

translation.kha: U Jakob u blei ktien , Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki malu , bad nga dem shwa ban pynduk shaphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiew jubor ïa ki wat tyngkan shi snoh ruh , baroh ki jingri kin ïap lut .
translation.en: And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Abraham u la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka na jngai .
translation.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .
But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla .  U briew uba kumno une u long ?  ki la ong .  Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image : and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Manasseh , he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki pynïeng ïa ka bleithaw ïa ka ban mane , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Gershom bad u khun ksiew jong u Moses , ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ïa ka jait Dan , bad ki shakri kiba hiarpateng kum ki lyngdoh haduh ka jingshah ringmraw ki briew na kata ka ri .

translation.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry , nor are given in marriage , but are as the angels of God in heaven .
translation.kha: Naba haba kiba ïap ki mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng bad kin ym ïashongkurim .

Bad u Dabid u noh ha u Abishai bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , U khun jongu nga hi u ïapyrshang ban pynïap ïa per , te balei phin lyngkot ïa une u nong Ben-ammi ? U Trai u la ong ïa u ban tei ; kumta wat pynwit ïa u , ai un ar ïa ka .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , and to all his servants , Behold , my son , which came forth of my bowels , seeketh my life : how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone , and let him curse  ; for the  Lord  hath bidden him .
And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .
translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong ki ka long ,  U Moses u la shah ïa u briew ban pyntip da ka jingthoh ïa ka jingpyllait tnga bad iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka leit phai sha u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u syiem . U la buaid bad shongshit , kumta kam shym ïathuh ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .

translation.en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .
translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh arliang , khnang ba lah ban teh skhem ïa ka .

translation.en: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger , fatherless , and widow . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
Hangta ha ka jingïohi ki Israel , u Joshua u pruid ha ki maw ïa ka jingshoh jong ka Hukum kaba u Moses u la thoh .
translation.en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses , which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ha ka jingtip shla jongngi phi , Phi la pynpoh bad pynjahburom ïa la ki paramarjan ; phi pynlong ïa ki ba ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba la buaid .
translation.en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink , that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also , that thou mayest look on their nakedness !

translation.kha: Pynban , kum u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat uba ha shuwa jongngi u , u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh thup , bad um shym sangeh .
translation.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .

translation.kha: laiphew thylli ki ut ai dud lem bad ki khun jong ki , sawphew tylli ki masi kynthei bad Shiphew tylli ki masi kyrtong , sawphew tylliat ki kada kyntiew bad shiphew thyllah ki kada shajrong .
translation.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .

translation.kha: Hynriew sngew shuwa ka Amam Ka Jinglait , U Jisu u la leit sha Bethania , ka shnong u Lasaros , u briew ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïalap .
translation.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .

translation.kha: Kata ka um ruh ka la nang hiar neng hiar , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jyllang u bnai Uba shiphew , ki kliar lbong ki la paw .
translation.en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit phai shai U Tlai , bad u ong , Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Ki la thaw ïa u blei uba da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamihnoh ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki Nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pyndik jong ki Israel , bad ki la ïawan sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .
translation.en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .

translation.kha: Kynton dap ha ki ïingsyiem jong me , bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar nabar ki briew jong me baroh . Kin longïng kiba kham sniew ngab ïa kano kano kaba ki kpa thymmei jongngi me ki la ju ïohi .’ Nangta u Moses u phai malade u mihnoh .
translation.en: And they shall fill thy houses , and the houses of all thy servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians  ; which neither thy fathers , nor thy fathers  fathers have seen , since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day . And he turned himself , and went out from Pharaoh .
I know thy works , that thou art neither cold nor hot : I would thou wert cold or hot .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha la leh ; nga tip ba pham long kaba khriat ne kaba shit . Katno nga kwah ba phan jin da la long kawei na kita !

translation.en: Be not wroth very sore , O  Lord  , neither remember iniquity for ever : behold , see , we beseech thee , we are all thy people .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa ngi , kumta wat bitar eh ïa ngi , lane bat ïa ki pop jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi junom . Ngi long ki briew jong me ; to isynei ïa ngi .
U la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la ainong ïa ka , Talitha , koum , kaba mutdur , Ko khynnah rit , nga ong ïa phah ban khie jrut !
translation.en: And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her ,  Talitha cumi  ;  which is , being interpreted ,  Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .
For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth  ; for he hath not another to help him up .
translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki u kyllon , uwei pat u lah ban khyllie joit ïa u . Hynrei lada uno uno u don marwei bad u kyllon ; ka long kaba sangsot tam , namar ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa u .

Ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba im bad kaba donbor , kaba kham nep ban ïa kano kano ka waitlam arliang syrti . Ka pei lyngba shaduh kabu ka jingim bad ka mynsiem ki ïaknieh , shaduh kaweh ki mat badno ki khleiñ shyieng ki ïakynduh lang . Ka bishar ïa ki jingkwah malu ïa ki jingpyrkhat lad ka dohnud u briew .
translation.en: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Templ jong u ! To ïarep ïa ka jingkhih jong u ha bneng !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary : praise him in the firmament of his power .
And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .
translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar ngut ha kata ka ïing — ym don mano mano ba don ryngkat .

translation.en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie noh ! Khie joit ïa lade bad ïeng ! Pha la dih ïa ka khuri ka jingpynshitom kaba U  Trai  ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phan dih ; pha dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha ban ïaid sheng sheng .
Kaei kaba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki kyrpad ka long kaba dei ; ai bynta lem na ka jingainong jingshem jong ki kad ki joit u kpa jong ki . Ai ba ka jingïohkynti jong u kan hiarpateng ha ki .
translation.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right : thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father s brethren  ; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them .
And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingjop ki Israel ka la poi ha u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor , u phah ktien sha u Jobab u syiem ka Madon , sha u syiem ka Shimron bad u syiem ka Akhshaph ,

translation.en: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi , bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ïa phi baroh yn sa pynsakma , uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka ïing , bad ngan shah iehnoh tang marwei . Hynrei ngam long shisha marwei , namar U Kpa u long lem bad nga .
U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ïohi . Nga la jubab , Ka kot kli baher ha ka lyer ; ka don khyndai mitar ka lynter mala saw mitar shiteng ka pynkdang .
translation.en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .

translation.kha: Naba ha U khriat la pynlong ïa phi katba bathoiñ khuri ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingkren bad ka jingmap baroh .
translation.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him , in all utterance , and in all knowledge ;

translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei kah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingtied : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; khawai ïa kaba ki khwan la kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka longsyiem ka Haggai , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong halor u lum Shinab .
translation.en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .

translation.kha: Kynton na phi kiba pyrshang ba pynksan ha khmat U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , phi la dkhat noh ïa lade na U Khrist . Phi longïng shabar ka jingaiei U Blei .
translation.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .

translation.kha: U blei u kyrkhu ïa u syiad uba wan ha ka kyrteng jongnga U Trai ! Ka jingsuk ha ki Bneng bad ka burom ïa U Blei !
translation.en: Saying , Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord : peace in heaven , and glory in the highest .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar na uta u lum , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawkyntang ha kiba la thoh ïa ki praw ha baroh arliang .
translation.en: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .

translation.kha: U Blei un buh khñiang ïa ki syiem kum ki koidi ha ka thliew . Un set ïa ki ha ka ïingbyndi hajuh ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And they shall be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and shall be shut up in the prison , and after many days shall they be visited .

translation.kha: Hynrei kim phai sha U Blei , u Nongthaw Jong ki , naba ai jingkyrmen ïa ki ha ki kynta kaba tad .
translation.en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Blei u ong ha u Nathan ,
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki shah kynting sha suki bad ki ngam hakpoh ki jingjylliew . Hapdeng kum kata ka jingma ki briew ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ;
translation.en: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .
Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .
translation.kha: Da kumne u Jesse u wan ïalam hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u sha u Samuel . Bad u Samuel u ong ha u ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïano ïano na kine .

translation.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki ïa-ong ,  U don ïa u Beelsebul ha u ! U dei u ksuid rangbah uba ai ïa u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .
Hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Bel u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpynnang .
translation.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei’ kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha nabar la ka para ne bad la ka para ar kilomitar .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab pur , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam Sha U Trai , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tyrnem ki khunlangbrot shynrang ibha shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :
translation.kha: Ka ktang jong uta u diengpynïeng sharak ka don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ka dur ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor . Ka dei ka mon U Blei ba U Amasaïah un shahjop , nabar ba u la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki nongot Edom .
translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear  ; for it came of God , that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom .

translation.kha: Ktah ïa u shisien bad lad ym pyrshang shuh da lei lei ; men ym klet da lwa lei ïa ka jingïalap !
translation.en: Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .

translation.kha: Namarba U Blei u la ong , ‘ To barim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kiei ,’ bad ‘ Uno uno uba tem ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kumwei u dei ban shah pynïap .’
translation.en: For God commanded , saying , Honour thy father and mother : and , He that curseth father or mother , let him die the death .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh’ uba kamai ïa lade da kaba kwah ha ka Nile un ud khuslai bad un ïam ; ki kajuh bad ki jar jrong ki kin lama ki bymmyntoi shuh .
translation.en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .

translation.kha: bad shim kynti ïa ka ri . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai , namar phi la pyndep ïa ka kamram jong phi sha U Trai bad sha kiwei pat ki par Israel . Te U Trai un pynskhem ba kane ka ri shad mihngi jong ka Jordan ka Dei ka jong phin .
translation.en: And the land be subdued before the  Lord  : then afterward ye shall return , and be guiltless before the  Lord  , and before Israel  ; and this land shall be your possession before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha khah ka por , hapoh ka jingmihsnam , ka Bashti , ka khyndai ka ai ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki kynthei .
translation.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus .

Ye shall walk in all the ways which the  Lord  your God hath commanded you , that ye may live , and that it may be well with you , and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki baroh , khnang ba phin manbha , bad ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .
Hadien ba u Solomon u la pynkut ïa kane ka jingduwai ha U Trai , u ïeng noh na iitkhmat kata ka duwan , na ka jakarieh ba u la dem khohsiew da kaba rah ïa la ki kti .
translation.en: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the  Lord  , he arose from before the altar of the  Lord  , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
And when they entered unto the heathen , whither they went , they profaned my holy name , when they said to them , These are the people of the  Lord  , and are gone forth out of his land .
translation.kha: Kat shaba ki leit , ki pynlehrain ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ba ki briew ki ïoh kynnoh , ‘ Kine ki long ki briew jong U  Trai  , pynban ki hap ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .’
Ha u , ïa phiah ruh la tei lang lema bad kiwei pat da U Mynsiem! jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .
translation.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
And Saul saw and knew that the  Lord  was with David , and that Michal Saul s daughter loved him .
translation.kha: U Saul u sngewthuh shai ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid bad ba ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ka ieit ïa u .
U Moses u la kohnguh bad u la shim
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled  ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohi kumno u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la long kiba shlur bad ban tip ba ki long ki riewpaidbah ki bymnang bymstad . Ki la sngewthuh te ba ki la long ki nongsynran jong U Jisu .

translation.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria , and carried Israel away into Assyria , and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .
translation.kha: kaba long ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea , u patsha ka Assyria u kurup ïa ka Samaria , u rah ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi , bad pynsah katto katne ngut na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne pat hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah jong ka Media .
Hynrei mynta ngan leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa de , pynban ym don uwei duh na phi uba kylli ïa nga shaei ba ngan saw .
translation.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me  ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?

translation.kha: woh ki rangbah kiba kham paw eh ki sngap jar .
