translation.en: The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .

translation.kha: uta u tnat jingsuh um dei shuh ban ïapoi shongkurim bad ka , namsop ba ka la shad pyntngit . Lada u bor kumta , kan long kaba ba-ijli ha khmat U Trai , bad kitab daym ban leh kum kata ka pop kaba sngewshyrkhei ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .
translation.en: Her former husband , which sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife , after that she is defiled  ; for that is abomination before the  Lord  : and thou shalt not cause the land to sin , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .

A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him : thousand thousands ministered unto him , and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him : the judgment was set , and the books were opened .
translation.kha: bad ïa ka wahduid da ka ding la theh noh na ka . La don bun hajar ngut ki briew hangta kiba shakri ïa u , bad da ki million ngut ki briew ki la ïeng ha khmat jong u . Ka ïingbishar ka la sdang ïa ka jingïalang jong ka , bad ïa ki kitab la plied .
Haba ka por ka la poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la pham ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa la ka beit na ka jinglum soh .
translation.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .

And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee : and yet thou hast not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in mine eyes  ;
translation.kha: Nga la shim noh ïa ka hima na kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid bad nga la ai ïa ka ha me . Hynrei mem shym long kum u Dabid u shakri jong nga , uba bud tylli ïa nga , uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , bad uba leh ïa kaba dei ha khmat jong nga .

Ki kylli , Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Jesreel baroh ka lai shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Terah ha Mispah ? ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bthing ba uno uno u bym shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )
translation.en: And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .
As for Samaria , her king is cut off as the foam upon the water .
translation.kha: Ïa u syiem jong ka yn kit noh , kum ka thalab dieng halor um .
Naba yn ym ba-don Shuah Kana kano ka jingkñia katba haw ba-bang kit khong ïa ki pop lada i'u ïa-ai leh pep hadien ba ngi la tip ïa ka jingshim .
translation.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,
Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba dang kham samla phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa kiba la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh phi dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingsngewrit , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .

Kynmaw ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , badno u Jakob , ki shakri jong me . Kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba me la pynbang bad ki ban ai ha ki ïa ki Kynhun ki ksiew kiba bun kat ki khulom ha sahit bneng , pynlang ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ïa kata ka ri baroh kaweh me la kular ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki jingkhum .
translation.en: Remember Abraham , Isaac , and Israel , thy servants , to whom thou swarest by thine own self , and saidst unto them , I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed , and they shall inherit it for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me ; ngan ai ka jingkha ïa me dara ngan kun ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka wan na U Trai’ !
translation.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving  ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the  Lord .
If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain  ;
translation.kha: Wat pynslem ban pyllait ïa uno uno uba la jan shah rai pynrem bymhok .
U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingtep .
translation.en: He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kane , ki ïadie khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrta jam , U Tharai u long U Balei ; U TRAI’ tang ma u , u long U Blei !
translation.en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .

translation.kha: Kam wanrah jingbha ïa ita i khunlung i ban sa kha , i haka noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaweh la katei nala ïa i .
translation.en: For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .
translation.kha: Katno ngi ainguh ïa U Blei ba u la pynlong ïa u Titos ban thrang kum ma ngi ban ïarap ïa phi .
U Blei u ong ha u Nongap , Neng la kut jingmut ban pynduh noh ïa ki briew baroh . Ngan pynjot thiat ïa ki namar ka pyrthei ka la jyllei da ki kam ni jubor jongnga ki .
translation.en: And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me  ; for the earth is filled with violence through them  ; and , behold , I will destroy them with the earth .
There is no fear of God before their eyes .
translation.kha: lymne ki la ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingngeit lad me kan ym duh noh . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha per , me dei ba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .
translation.en: But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .

translation.kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la Wan sha u . Ko Nonghikai , u la ong , Nga la kloi ban leit bad me kat shabi me leit .
translation.en: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .

translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Lasaros , uba sah ha Bethania , u la pung . Ka Bethania ka dei ka shnong ha kaba ka Mari malu ka Martha ka para jongngi ka , ki shong ki sah .
translation.en: Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingshlur jongngi nga kan pyllut im ïa nga , nabar yn ym dat u riewsniew u ban nud ba-bang ïakynduh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .

translation.kha: U Abda u pynïabynta ïa ki Lebi ha ki lai kynhun kat kum ki kur jong ki : Gershon , Khatduh , bad Merari .
translation.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .

translation.kha: Nga bud beit ïa ka lynti ba u jied , bad Ngam ju sakma sha kadiang ne kamon .
translation.en: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .

translation.kha: moi leit phai sha ka ri shyieng shaphang ka Duriaw Basaw , kitab U Trai u la hukum , badno ngi la pynlut por slem ha kaban ïaid sakma ha ri lum Edom .
translation.en: Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea , as the  Lord  spake unto me : and we compassed mount Seir many days .

translation.kha: U la longkmie u nongpynkhiah , bad u la tip aïu U blem u la kyllum ïa u : U Blei’ u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khup ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .
translation.en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
So the  Lord  sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed : and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha Israel , kaba neh naduh kata ka step haduh ka por kaba u la jied . Na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh ki la ïap haduh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki Israel .

translation.en: And Hazar–gaddah , and Heshmon , and Beth–pelet ,
translation.kha: ka Hasar Gaddah , ka Heshmon , ka Bethpelet ,
Wan ngin ïaleit sha ïing ngab ïabam jingdam bad ang , u ong .
translation.en: Then he said unto him , Come home with me , and eat bread .
And she yet again conceived , and bare a son  ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka la kha khun shynrang bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Shelah . U Judah u don ha Akhsib mynba la kha ïa u khunlung .
Un Pha ha phi napdeng jngai phi hi ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba koum ma nga , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: The  Lord  thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee , of thy brethren , like unto me  ; unto him ye shall hearken  ;

translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la jingïohknieh ïa kñia , u la sniew eh bad u la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban shem lad ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel . U la ïai pyrshang haduh ban da sep Sngi .
translation.en: Then the king , when he heard these words , was sore displeased with himself , and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him : and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Nga jong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Lada Phim bam ïa ka doh jong U Khun U Briew malade dih ïa ka snam jong u , phin ym don ïa ka jingtem ha lade .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .

translation.kha: Ha kato ka sngi mynba phi ïalumlang ha u Lum Sinai , pa’ la kyrpad ba phim kwah ban ïohsngew hajuh ïa ka sur U Trai , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha naba u don , namar ba phi shemphang ïoh phi ïap .
translation.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
And Me–jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border before Japho .
translation.kha: ka Mejarkon , bad ka Rakkon , kumjuh ruh ka jaka sawdong ka Joppa .

Ïa ka jingjied jong u la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingaiei jong u , ym ha kaei kambah ki la ar . Namar lada ïa ka jingjied U blang la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba ki briew ki leh , te ka jingaiei jong u kane ym long ka jingbei bashisha .
translation.en: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .

translation.kha: U Trai tang ma u hi u long U Blei ; U Blei tang ma u hi suba long ka jingïada jong ngi .
translation.en: For who is God , save the  Lord  ? and who is a rock , save our God ?
But , beloved , be not ignorant of this one thing , that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years , and a thousand years as one day .
translation.kha: Hynrei to wat klet ïa kane kawei , ko paralok ba-ieit jong nga ! Kam don ka jingïapher ha khmat U Trai hapdeng ka shi sngi bad ka shihajar snem ; ha u , baroh ar ki long kumjuh .

translation.en: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .
translation.kha: U Kylli ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shukor bad ong ba nga la bakla ? Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga long uba khlem pop .

translation.en: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .
translation.kha: Bun ki nongsakhi ki la shu sakhi lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu , hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki kim ïahap satia .
U apostol u la wan shai ka bad u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad pha ! U Trai u Long ryngkat bad pha bad u la ring eh ïa pha !
translation.en: And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .

translation.kha: Me la ai ka kun ïa u kpa jong nga ba un pynkha ïa nga , Me la pynlong ïa nga ban satang ha ka kpoh ka kmie jong to .
translation.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?

translation.kha: Jamynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah , Uno na kine ar nud ba ph kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Barabbas ! ki la jubab .
translation.en: The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingkha na ka bynta jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïingjaiñ u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kam kiba U KA jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki kren na ka bynta jong nga bad ki pyn-i ba U Kpu u la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
And thou shalt make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ka da ka dur ki kherub .

Kumne ngan ai ïa ki lyngkha jong ki ha ki trai bathymmai bad ïa ki tnga jong ki ha Kiwei pat ki rangbah . Uwei iwei bhor , wahbah ryntieh bad uba khynraw , u pyrshang ban thaw pisa da ka jingbymhok . Kam ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thoh ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others , and their fields to them that shall inherit them : for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness , from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha , myntor ap hangne ; U Troas u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Jerikho . jynreiñ u Elisha u jubab , Nga smai da ka jingïaineh slem jong nga ha U Trai uba im Bad ha phira ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi . kumta ki la longing sha Jeberekhaïah .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Elisha , tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jericho . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they came to Jericho .

translation.kha: To ïaishah aiwai ïa iwei pat , malade ïamap iwei ïa iwei bapaw ha man ba uno uno na phi u don ka jingpynduh pyrshah ïa uno une uwei pat . Phi dei ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat kitab U Trai u la map ïa phi .
translation.en: Forbearing one another , and forgiving one another , if any man have a quarrel against any : even as Christ forgave you , so also do ye .
For Adam was first formed , then Eve .
translation.kha: Naba ïa u Adam la thaw nyngkong , nangta ïa ka Im .

U Gideon u ïa-ong ha u , Kynrad , lada long ban kyrmen , balei kane ka wan jia ha ngi lada U Tiras u don rijied bad ngi ? Jia aïu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba ki kpa jong ngi ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba U Trai u ju leh — kumno u la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt ? U Trai u la iehnoh ïa i'u bad u la ioh ïa ngi ha ka jingisynei jong ki Midian .
translation.en: And Gideon said unto him , Oh my Lord , if the  Lord  be with us , why then is all this befallen us ? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of , saying , Did not the  Lord  bring us up from Egypt ? but now the  Lord  hath forsaken us , and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites .
But what I do , that I will do , that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion ; that wherein they glory , they may be found even as we .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh mynta , khnang ban khanglad ïa kito kiwei ki  apostol  ba kin ïoh daw ban kob sarong bad ban ong ba ki trei ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ngi trei .

translation.en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , u shong bad u duwai ,  Ngam long uba dei hok ïa kaei kaba me la lah leh na ka bynta jong nga , ko  Trai  U Blei , lane ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :
translation.kha: Rung shapoh lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim , namar ka khyrdop sha ka dujok ka long kaba kylluid bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba suk , bad don shibun kiba ïaid na ka .

hynrei phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga da kaba leit pait sha ka nongbah bad ïong ïa u Absalom ba mynta phin shakri hok ïa u kumba phi la shakri ïa u kpa jong u . Bad leh ïa baroh kaba phi lah ban leh pyrshah ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u ai .
translation.en: But if thou return to the city , and say unto Absalom , I will be thy servant , O king  ; as I have been thy father s servant hitherto , so will I now also be thy servant : then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel .
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : but whosoever will lose his life for my sake , the same shall save it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh ïa ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un pynim ïa ka .

Ki briew’ jong nga ki la jied ïa ki skhem . Hynrei ki la leh ïa kata ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki thung ïa ki nongriam , hynrei khlem ka jingpynskhem jongnga nga . Ki shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki pynlang ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw — na ka bynta ka jingjot jong ki hi .
translation.en: They have set up kings , but not by me : they have made princes , and I knew it not : of their silver and their gold have they made them idols , that they may be cut off .

translation.kha: Katto ki dong ïabam jingbam lang , u Ishmael bad ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah lem bad u ki la sei ïa la ki waitlam pynlang ki la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah .
translation.en: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and the ten men that were with him , and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword , and slew him , whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land .

translation.kha: Te ïa ki khmut jong ki la Plie bad ki la ithuh ïa u , hynrei u la jah noh na khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And their eyes were opened , and they knew him  ; and he vanished out of their sight .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka jylla Sobah jong ka Sior , kaba hajan ka ri Hamath , namar u Hadadeser u la pyrshang pun jop ïa ka ri kaba shaphang Haneng ka Ïuphratis .
translation.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: nabar siat ïa nga da ki khnam na baroh sawdong — ki khnam babha sam lyngba ki pynmynsaw ïa nga : bad wat la katta ruh um pyn-i jingisynei .
translation.en: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare  ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .

translation.kha: U Soitan u la kwah ban wallam jingjynjar ha ki paid Israel , kumta u la pynong ïa u Dabid baneh rai ban shim ka jingkheiñbriew .
translation.en: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .

translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , pynlang ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kambah me don ïa nga kan oh long bad ki , bad kumta nga shiah ngan ïoh longkmie bad ki .
translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .

translation.kha: ngan kñia ïa ka jingainguh da u briew ne ka briew ba mih nyngkong eh na ka ïing jong nga Ban wei tangon ïa nga , ynda sa wan phai na ka jingjop . Ngan ai ha me ïa uta ne kata ka briew kum ka jingainguh thap .
translation.en: Then it shall be , that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me , when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , shall surely be the  Lord s  , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , hadien kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , U Trai u la ai ha nga ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thom ïa kata ka jingmut .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the  Lord  gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .
Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;
translation.kha: Lymne ba u donkam ei ei kaba ngi lah ban ai da kaba trei na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long ma u hi uba ai ka jingim bad ka jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha uwei pa uwei .
Kumta uwei pa uwei uba long ha U Khereth , um ïai ai Pop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïa leh pop , um pat Shim la ïor ïa u lane iathuh ïa u .
translation.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .

translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu! shibun kiba la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki . U Jisu u la Bah noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa barben Ibbah la shitom .
translation.en: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :

translation.kha: Bad ka jingdon jongki nga ha bakhyndai , ka la ai ïa bakha bun eh ki parabangeit ban khem sngewskhem ha U Trai , khnang ba kyang nang khampoh shlur ha ki por baroh ban ïalap ïa ka khubor khlem sheptieng .
translation.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord , waxing confident by my bonds , are much more bold to speak the word without fear .

translation.kha: kiba ka kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingshakri ïa U Jisu khriat uba U TRAI’ jongki ngi .
translation.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection , and asked him ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi don na ki Saddusi ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kam ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap .
Ki pynïap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ïa ki khunswet , bad mata pynïap ïa u nongwan uba shong ha ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: They slay the widow and the stranger , and murder the fatherless .
As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .
translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
U la mih shabar ha ka por janmiet Ban ïaid kai pynngat ha ki pyntha bad u ïohi ïa ki ut ba ki dang wan .
translation.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and , behold , the camels were coming .

translation.kha: U Trai u tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat ; u tip katno ki long ki bymshemphang ha kambah pynshong nongrim .
translation.en: The  Lord  knoweth the thoughts of man , that they are vanity .
Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred : for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .
translation.kha: Mynta , halor ka jingai jingmut u Mordekai , ka Esther ka bat tang ha lade khlem ïathuh hano hano ba ka long ka Jiw .
Kumta khot ïa ki par Israel Ki briew jong U Blei bad kiba ieit da U Terah .
translation.en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .
Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba kham rit ka Mikhal .

translation.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age , even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil .
translation.kha: Ka jingbam kaba eh , ha kawei pat ka liang , ka long ïa kiba la rangbah , kiba lyngba ka jingpynmlien ki lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew .

Mynba u Jehoïakim u longkmie u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem bniah u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lah snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ba pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jongno u ; nangne u la ïeng ïalaw byrsha .
translation.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .
translation.kha: Long katba ka long ,  u Ahimaas u ong biang ,  Nga kwah ban leit .   Khie leit ,  u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh bran na ka lynti kaba na ka Them Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa uta u mraw .

translation.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .
translation.kha: Hadien kane U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha ki shnong baroh bad ki jaka ha kaba ma u , u la mut ban leit .
Ki long ki shipai ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki long ki samla shaei ba-bhabriew .
translation.en: Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la tyrpeng palat bad ki la ïai khñium ha u Massah . Ki la ong , Balei kiei ba phi wan ïalam khong ïa i'u na ka ri jingpeit ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap da ka jingsliang ïa i'u bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong i'u , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?
translation.en: And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?

translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long kumta ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka to ba phi ieh ïa ki , pher kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumin phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon dara ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
translation.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :
Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea :
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kut jingmut ba uwei pa uwei na ki un phah katba lah bor ban ïarap ïa ki parabangeit kiba shong basah ha Judia .
jynreiñ phim sohshkor satia lane pynslem jingmut . Phim iehnoh noh ïa ki jingmlien basniew ban kñia ha kiwei ki blei .
translation.en: But they hearkened not , nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness , to burn no incense unto other gods .
And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u Manoah na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dan . Ka tnga jong u kam pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: That the  Lord  called Samuel : and he answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khot , ïa u Samuel . U ruh u jubab ,  Oi , Kynrad !
U long kumno uta u briew ? u syiem u kylli .
translation.en: And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?

translation.kha: Lada don naba lait im bad uba pyllait im ïa ki khun Jong u , to khih sha ki hab ki wan sha phi . Peit haduh katno ki Long kiba sniew , bad to sngewthikna ba ka jingpynshitom kaba nga Wallam ha ka Jeroham ka longkmie kaba dei hok ,

A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .

translation.en: The chains , and the bracelets , and the mufflers ,

translation.kha: Lada nga la iathuh ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong ar , bad ïai ap , ïai rieh , shabar ka jingkthang jong ka ,
translation.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour s door  ;

translation.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion , and as a young lion to the house of Judah : I , even I , will tear and go away  ; I will take away , and none shall rescue him .

Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .
translation.kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u khot ïa u Abraham , bad u ong ,  Kaei kane kaba me la leh ïa ngi ? Nga la leh sniew aïu ïa me ban pynlong ïa me ban pynngat ïa kane ka jynjar ha nga bad ha ka hima jong nga ? Ym don uwei ruh u ban leh ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa nga .
Kin kyllon ïap sha lum sha heh . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: Thou shalt fall upon the open field : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh ngan ai ha me ,  u Soitan u la ong ,  lada men dem khohsiew bad mane ïa nga .

Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh! na ki jaka baseisoh jong ka Moab . Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot wiang ; ym don shuh mano mano ba shna ïa ka waiñ bad ban pyrthuh da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elhanan ki kyang , bad ïa ka jingkthang jyllang ki lah ban ïohpdiang shaduh sha Jahas ; ha ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha Soar , bad la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Eglaim Shallekheth . Wat ka wahduid Nimrim ka la rngad noh .
translation.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
Weep ye not for the dead , neither bemoan him : but weep sore for him that goeth away : for he shall return no more , nor see his native country .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Judah , wat ïam na ka bynta u syiem Josaïah , wat ïam pangnud ïa ka jingïap jong u . Hynrei ïamkthang na ka bynta u Joahas , u khun jong u ; ki la rah noh ïa u bad un ym wan phai shuh , un ym ïohi shuh ïa ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa u .

translation.en: And the sons of Zebulun  ; Sered , and Elon , and Jahleel .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Sebulun : u Sered , u Elon , bad u Jahlil .
U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tap ha-ei ka don , namar basbun U Jisu u la ïakynduh hangta bad la ki synran .
translation.en: And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
And it came to pass , when Joram saw Jehu , that he said , Is it peace , Jehu ? And he answered , What peace , so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many ?
translation.kha: Hato me wan ha ka jingsuk ?  u Joram u kylli ïa u . U Jehu u jubab ,  Kumno kan don ka jingsuk haba ngi dang don baroh ki jingleh byrtong bad ki jingmane bleithaw kiba ka Jesebel ka kmie jong me ka la sdang ?

translation.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .
translation.kha: Kin ïeng jngai bah na ka , namar ba ki sheptieng ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshitom jong ka . Ki ong ,  Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ! Kane ka nongbah Babilon kaba khraw bad kaba khlaiñbor ! Tang hapoh shi kynta pha la shah pynshitom !
hynrei to kiar noh na ki jingïatainia ba-bieit pynlang ba khlem jingmut ; me tip ba ki khun ha ka jingïakajia .
translation.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .
But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel u Solomon um shym la pynlong mraw ; ki la shakri ïa u kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki rangbah ai hukum , ki kapten kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai jong u .
Nga la jubab , Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet noh . Hynrei u Irijah um sngap ïa nga . Pynban , u la skum ïa nga bad ïalam ïa nga sha ki rangïapom synshar .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
I was just making sure .
translation.kha: Nga shu pynthikna .
Ym lah ban ngeit ïa ka jingphla shem mynsiem jong wahbah lamler , hynrei ka kti jong uno isangsot uba da kyrkhoit bha yn pdiang .
translation.en: A false witness shall perish : but the man that heareth speaketh constantly .
And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat por , u Abraham u la tip ba ka Milkah ka la kha phra ngut ki khun ïa u Nahor u para jong u :
sumar ïa ki jinghikai jong nga ha ki por baroh ; thoh ïa ka ha ka dohnud jong phiah .
translation.en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .

And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude , they went upon the housetop , and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus .
translation.kha: Pynban , namar u paidbah , kim lah ban shem lynti ban rah shapoh ïa u . Kumta ki la ïabah ïa u sha tnum ïing , ki la law ïa ki jingsop ïing bad ki la pynhiar shapoh ïa u ha ka jingthiah hamar pdeng jong ka kynhun ha khmat U Jisu .

translation.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .
translation.kha: Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh nam kum u nongthaw kulmar .

translation.en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .

ki tuh ha ka jingduh bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .
translation.en: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .

A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .
translation.kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jong pha kin ïap na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha ka nongbah ; shi bynta pat kin ïap da ka waitlam shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta kaba dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki sawlyer , bad ngan beh ïa ki nadien da ka waitlam .

translation.en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .

translation.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him , Their gods are gods of the hills  ; therefore they were stronger than we  ; but let us fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they .

translation.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up  ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .
translation.kha: Ka la ktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon ; bad ka la don ka jingsngewthuh hapoh jong ka ba ka ïohkhiah na ka jingshitom jong ka .

translation.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u la phah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka ri Judah kaba dawa ïa uwei pa uwei , khlem lait ïano ïano , ban ïarap kit noh na Ramah ïa ki maw bad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ban pynskhem ïa ka . Da kine ki tiar ki tar u Asa u tei pynskhem ïa ka Mispah bad ïa ka Geba , ka nongbah kaba don ha ka ri Benjamin .

translation.en: So the shipmaster came to him , and said unto him , What meanest thou , O sleeper ? arise , call upon thy God , if so be that God will think upon us , that we perish not .
translation.kha: U kapten u la shem ïa u hangta bad u ong ïa u ,  Me leh aïu da kaba ïohthiah ? To khie bad to duwai ha u blei jong me na ka bynta ka jingïarap . Lehse un sngewlem ïa ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi .
U Trai U Blei jong phi u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kino ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u la beh ei ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phiah nang tur Sha khmat .
translation.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .

Ïa ka khyndew kaba dei ka jong ki lyngdoh te um shym thied . Kim donkam ban daiñ ïa la ka khynraw namar ba ki ïoh ka baibam kaba thikna na u syiem , bad ki im da kata .
translation.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not  ; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh , and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them : wherefore they sold not their lands .
Behold , therefore I am against thee , and against thy rivers , and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate , from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .
translation.kha: nga long u nongshun jong me bad u nongshun jong ka wah Nile jong me . Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt baroh kawei kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi , naduh ka nongbah Migdol ha ka phang bashatei haduh ka nongbah Aswan ha ka phang bashathie , baroh shi lynter haduh u pud ki Sudan .

Hadien kane , u Maaseïah u te pyningkhong ïa ka kynroh bashabar ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nongbah u Nadab , na ka thuh jongno ka them hajan ka umpohliew Gihon shaphang shatei shwa ka Khyrdop sohkhia Bad ka jaka jyllang ka nongbah ba khot ka Ophel . translation.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David , on the west side of Gihon , in the valley , even to the entering in at the fish gate , and compassed about Ophel , and raised it up a very great height , and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah .
And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .
translation.kha: U la kwah ban pynkdang ïa lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei ym don mano mano ba ai ei ei ïa u ban bam .
Namarkata u hi u long umbah tlot ha kiba bun rukom , u lah ban longïing uba jemnud bad iar ki bym dat ka jingtip bad kiba leh bakla .
translation.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant , and on them that are out of the way  ; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki jingkhot umsoh na ki shohbeiñ ha ka sngi Sabtah . Kiwei pat ki dang kyntiew halor ki kai jongngi ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kaei kiei badno leit rai ïa ki shai Israel ; nga la ramhah ïa ki ban ym die ei ei ha ka sner Sabakhthani .
translation.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .

translation.kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba per la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad shnat u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .
translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;

Ïa ka ri Jong pha yn khot , Ka jingshongshngain kambah suk , naba U Trai u sngewbha eh ïa pha , bad un long kum u tnga ïa ka ri jong pha .
translation.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken  ; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate : but thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah , and thy land Beulah : for the  Lord  delighteth in thee , and thy land shall be married .
And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God , and took a great stone , and set it up there under an oak , that was by the sanctuary of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Joshua u thoh ïa kita ki hukum ha ka kitab Ka Aiñ U Blei . Nangta u la shim uwei u maw uba heh , bad u pynïeng ïa u hapoh u dieng Sning ha ka jaka kyntang jong U  Trai .
Ka jingaiei ka jongnga U Jisu Khrist kiba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi . Amen .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
Behold , we are servants this day , and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof , behold , we are servants in it :
translation.kha: Bad mynta ngi long ki mraw ha ka ri ba me la ai ïa ngi , kane ka ri baseisoh kaba ai jingbam ïa ngi .

translation.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance :
translation.kha: To leh ïa kito kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .

Nga la kylli , Ko Trai , balei ka ri ka ha ka jingjot jingpra bad ka tyrkhong kum ka ri shyiap , ba ym don mano mano ba leit jingtap lyngba jong ka ? Uei uba stad eh ban shemphang ïa kane ? Hano me la bapalat ïa ka ba u lah ban ïathuh ha kiwei pateng ?
translation.en: Who is the wise man , that may understand this ? and who is he to whom the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken , that he may declare it , for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness , that none passeth through ?
Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure , having this seal , The Lord knoweth them that are his . And , Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity .

Haba ki Paidbah’ ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingmane da ka khubor ka jingpynshlur .
translation.en: Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .

translation.kha: A kat ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa pa’ , ki nonglam lynti kiba matlah ! Phi hikai , ‘ lymda uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka ksiar shapoh ka Templ , u long naba la shah teh .’
translation.en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !

translation.kha: Lashai ka sngi ka dei ka jingkhawai mihngi bnai thymmai u Dabid u jubab bad nga dei ban ïashong bam rynsied dara u syiem . Hynrei lada ka long kaba biang ïa phi , ngan leit noh ban rieh ha ki bri haduh la shai sngi janmiet .
translation.en: And David said unto Jonathan , Behold , to morrow is the new moon , and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat : but let me go , that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even .
And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
translation.kha: U Dabid , uba shu pien tang da ka jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka bor jong u baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .
translation.kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakynduh katto katne ki rangbah jong u Dabid . U Absalom u dang shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u dang ïaid napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sahkut ha ki tnat dieng . U khashor u la mareh bad u Absalom u la shah iehnoh da kaba sdien ha shiteng suiñ .
Ngan ai ruh shibun ki khulom ki kti ïa u khun jong kata ka mluh ba kin long kawei ka jaitbynriew . U ruh u dei u khun jong me .
translation.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .

translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phin long kiba mawpud , ki briew kine peiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .
translation.kha: Nangta ha Peor , ki briew jong U Blei ki la ïasnohlang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , bad bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki blei bym don jingim .
To shahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ki Eliel ! Phi la dei ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,
translation.en: And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?

translation.kha: Ki bri sohwaiñ ki la ïapstai Bad ka um sohwaiñ ka la nang dala . Baroh bakha la long shisien kiba kmen , mynta ki sngewsih ,
translation.en: The new wine mourneth , the vine languisheth , all the merryhearted do sigh .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u bitar pynlang u pynshitom , dei u Briew uba snep uba ju lait borabor .
translation.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .

translation.kha: kum kita ki briew kin shah pynjot ha ka pynkhamti . Hato phi sngewthuh ba ka jingjot kaba kumno kan haw ban jia na U Blei ne na u syiem ?
translation.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly  ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?

translation.kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .
translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .

translation.kha: Nangta da lat hi u leit sha Raamah . Ynda u la poi ha ka pukri naba Heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel bad u Dabid ki ne bad la ïathuh ha u ba ki don ha Naïoth .
translation.en: Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .

translation.kha: Kut jingmut triang sad lama skhem , namar trai long u nongïalam jong kine ki Briew katba ki shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ïa kiba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Be strong and of a good courage : for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give them .

translation.kha: pyndeng kita ki mar kiba ngi la kurup , nga la ïohi kawei ka barandi Babilon kaba ryntih , ruma ar kilo ka sien , bad shi lyngkhot ka ksiar kaba khia palat shiteng kilo . Nga la ikwah eh ïa ki , bad nga la shngiam ïa ki . phna shem ba la Thep ïa ki hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong nga , bad ka rupa ka don ha thad .
translation.en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment , and two hundred shekels of silver , and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight , then I coveted them , and took them  ; and , behold , they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent , and the silver under it .
And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias  ; and to him said the Lord in a vision ,  Ananias .  And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .

translation.en: If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it .
Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .
translation.kha: Tang u briew uba stad u tip aïu kiei kiei ki kit jingmut shisha . Ka jingstad ka pynlong ïa u ban phuh samrkhie bad ka pynjah ïa ka jingnoh sngewsih ka durkhmat jong u .

U patsha ka Assyria u ïalam ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki kiei bad u pynshong pynsah ïa ki katto katai na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto Katno hajan ka bhah Habor ha ka distrik Haggan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah ka Media .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria , and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes :

translation.kha: Em , u Gehasi u jubab . Hynñiew u kynrad jong nga u la phah ïa nga ba dang myntan ar ngut na ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka ri lum Ephraim ki la ïan pah , bad u kwah ïa phi ban ai ha ki lai hajar tylliat ki lyngkhuh rupa badno ar riam ki jai ba-itynnat .
translation.en: And he said , All is well . My master hath sent me , saying , Behold , even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets : give them , I pray thee , a talent of silver , and two changes of garments .

translation.kha: ai Phah ong hato ki briew kiba pha pyrsad ki long ki paralok jong pha , ki jop ïa pha dara ki synshar halor jong pha ? pham don ha ka jingpang khem ka kynthei kaba kha khun .
translation.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee ? for thou hast taught them to be captains , and as chief over thee : shall not sorrows take thee , as a woman in travail ?

translation.kha: U la sngewkyiuh ba phi tang ot shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad u kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ki nongap lbong jong phi ki don bad ngi bad ngim khim pynshong ïa ki . Ym shym la tuh ïa kano kano kaba dei ka jong ki ha ki por baroh lehbha ki to ha Karmel .
translation.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers : now thy shepherds which were with us , we hurt them not , neither was there ought missing unto them , all the while they were in Carmel .

translation.kha: Phi kynruh balei nga la ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha phi ha kaba nyngkong ; ka hir namar ba per la pang .
translation.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .
And this will we do , if God permit .
translation.kha: To ngin ïa-ïaid shaphrang ! Bad kane ka long kaei kaba ngin leh , lada U Blei u shah .
Nga la ngam shaduh ki trai jong ki lumbah , sha ka ri kaba ki khyrdop ki khang junom . Hynrei ma me , A Trai U Blei jong nga , me la wahbah im pat ïa nga na ki jingjylliew .
translation.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains  ; the earth with her bars was about me for ever : yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption , O  Lord  my God .

translation.kha: Nangno u Abimelekh u khot ïa u Abraham , pynlang u ïa-ong , Kaei ken kaba me la bor ïa i ? Nga la bor sniew aïu ïa me ban pynlong ïa me ngab pynpyngngad ïa kane ka jynrat ha nga bad ha ka hima jong por ? Ym don uwei ruh u ban leh ïa kaei kiba me la leh ïa nga .
translation.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham , and said unto him , What hast thou done unto us ? and what have I offended thee , that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin ? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done .

translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong phi la buh ha ka jinglehrain ; ki la shaïong Bad shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki ktien jong nga ; ka jingwad ka kumno ki la ïoh mynta ?
translation.en: The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?

translation.kha: Nangta ka duriaw ka la aiti ïa kiba ïap jong ka . Ka jingïaiban nabar kumjuh ka pyrem kiba ïap , ki la aiti ïa kiba ïap kiba ki la bat . Bad ïa baroh la baher kat kum kai kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it  ; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them : and they were judged every man according to their works .

translation.kha: Ki nongtrei jong u Solomon bad jong u Hiram slem bad ki rangïapom na ka nongbah Biblos ki la pynkhreh ïa ki maw bad ïa ki diengsoh ban shna ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And Solomon s builders and Hiram s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .
These are the feasts of the  Lord  , even holy convocations , which ye shall proclaim in their seasons .
translation.kha: Pynbna paidbah ïa kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ha ki por ba la buh ban pynlong ïa ki .

Ki kylla long kiba khoit haba la wanrah ïa ki ha ka Eri U Trai . Kumta , shim ïa ki khiew bhah thiang jong kita ki briew Kiba la Shah pynïap namar ki pop Jong ki , shohbeiñ pynslem ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan . Kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Isaia .
translation.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .
And a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches going out of it .
translation.kha: Don kawei ka shata syntiew harum ki lai jur ki tnat kiba mih na u diengpynïeng sharak .

translation.en: Whoso sheddeth man s blood , by man shall his blood be shed : for in the image of God made he man .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew la thaw ha ka dur jong U Blei hi , kumta uno uno uba pynïap ïa uwei na ki , u ruh un shah pynïap ha uwei pat .
hynrei nalor Kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Ang long uba lui lui , da shisha U Trai’ un ym kutlad sah ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U Trai , ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi len ba phi la leh pop .
translation.en: Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .
translation.kha: U Judas tang mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai !  bad u la doh ïa u .
U Trai u kylla biang la ka jingmut bad u la ïai-ong , Kane ruh kad ym jhieh .
translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : This also shall not be , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: To rwai ka jingiw bathymmai ïa U Trai ; rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrta baroh ! ïaroh ïa u , phi kiba ïaid lynti ha tyrwa ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingthaw baroh’ ka duriaw ! Rwai , phi ki ri bajngai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister : for she is thy mother s near kinswoman .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ñiakha ; ka dei ka kur kaba ïajan eh bad u kpa jong me . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan ; ka dei ka kur kaba jan eh bad ka kmie jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la kyang jam , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .

translation.en: But and if she depart , let her remain unmarried , or be reconciled to her husband : and let not the husband put away his wife .
translation.kha: hynrei lada ka leh kumta , ka dei ban shong khynraw noh lane ka dei ban ïasuk pat bad la u tnga bad u tnga um dei ban pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga .

translation.en: And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jong u , baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pynkheiñ burom ïa la u hynmen .
kamut ka akor babha jong phi ka da ban khring ïa kiaw pat ban shahskhor ïa ka khubor ba phi ïathuh ha ki .—Mathaios 5 :16 ; 1 Phestos 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
translation.en: So your good conduct may draw others to listen to the message you tell them .—Matthew 5 :16  ; 1 Peter 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .

translation.kha: U Blei u bato bad tur pyrshah ïa nga ; u leh ïa nga kum ïa u nongshun basniew dak jong u .
translation.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me , and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .
And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
translation.kha: La don bun ki briew kiba la wan bad leit , haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh wat ban bam jingbam . Kumta u la ong ïa ki ,  To ngin ïaleit noh tang ma ngi sha ka jaka ba ngin ïalong tang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban pynjahthait shipor .
Lada phiah ïa-ai mutlop man la ka por ba phi shad pyndait , ha kawei ka sngi Phin sa shah pynlwet bad phin ym lah khie sha .
translation.en: He , that being often reproved hardeneth his neck , shall suddenly be destroyed , and that without remedy .

translation.kha: Naduh ka to ba nga la pynkoit ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam shym la shang ha ka templ ; ar la shong borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ bad kynriah na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat .
translation.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day  ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la jingïohknieh ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la sangeh noh ïa ka jingtei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah dara u leit sha Tirsah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah , and dwelt in Tirzah .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kiba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita ki syiem kiba don ha ka liang jong u ki la wan ryngkat bad la ki shipai bad jop ïa ki Raamah ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa ki Susim ha Hammon , ïa ki Emim ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ai ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai , To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynlong ïa u Adonijah ban peiñ da ka jingim jong u namar ba u pan ïa khie !
translation.en: Then king Solomon sware by the  Lord  , saying , God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba stem u Elkanah bad baroh kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki la khie ding stait phyrngab , bad hadien ba ki la mane ïa U Trai ; ki leit phai pat Sha la ïing ha ramhah . U Elkanah u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Hannah ka tnga jong u , bad U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka .
translation.en: And they rose up in the morning early , and worshipped before the  Lord  , and returned , and came to their house to Ramah : and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife  ; and the  Lord  remembered her .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Ehud ka ïeng ïateh pyrshah ïa ki —Judah , bad ka la kylla long ka hima kiba laitluid .
translation.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .

translation.kha: Nangta ka leit sha ki briew jong ka nongbah lem pynlang ka jingshem jong ka , bad ki la khrai ïa ka khlieh jongno u Sibaïah bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi khim ka tam ïa ki rangbah jongngi u ban iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , bad ki leit blei noh sha ïinglieng . Bad u Joab u la leit phalang noh sha Jerusalem sha u syier .
translation.en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïadie lynti nangta ki pynkhih ïa la ki khlieh bad ki da ther ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa U Jisu! :
translation.en: And they that passed by reviled him , wagging their heads ,

translation.kha: Tei ka skei ka la shna bha ïa U Trai U Blei jongu me ha kliar Kane ka kyntiew . Nangta shim ïa u musli kyndong uba ar bad thang tyllun ïa u kum ka jingainguh , da kaba pyndem diengthang da ki dak jong ka Asherah ïa kaba me la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: And build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God upon the top of this rock , in the ordered place , and take the second bullock , and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Khylliap , u la kylli ïa u , Hato me long tang ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha kine ki khñiot sngi ba la leit ?
translation.en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?

translation.kha: Un ai burom ïa nga , namar un shim ïa kaei ba ar ong bad iathuh ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded  ; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Ijipt la pynlehrain ; la jop ïa ki da ki briew ba na shatei . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

na ka bynta ki nongpop jong ki bad ki pop jngai ki kpa tymmen jongnga ki . Ki la ïaryngkat ki jingbuaid ha ki reng thala kiba hajar ki lum bad ki la kren sniew ïa nga . Kumjuh tun pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei hok ïa ki namar ki kada ba ki la leh mynshuwa .
translation.en: Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together , saith the  Lord  , which have burned incense upon the mountains , and blasphemed me upon the hills : therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom .

translation.kha: Katba uta u khynnah u dang wan , u mynsiem bymshemphang u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u sha madan bad u la bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring . U Jisu u la ai hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman , U la pynkhiah ïa uta u khynnah , bad U la ai pat ïa u ha u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .

translation.kha: Harod ïa ka kumba pa’ wad ïa ka ayu lane ïa kano Kane ka spah ba la buhrieh .
translation.en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;

translation.kha: Haba u nongbylla sngi , u bym de u nongaplangbrot Bad u bym dei trai ïa ki langbrot , u ïohi ïa u suri ba u wan , u iehnoh ïa ki langbrot bad u phetwir noh ; kumta u suri u kynrup ïa ki lumlang dara pynsaphred ïa ki .
translation.en: But he that is an hireling , and not the shepherd , whose own the sheep are not , seeth the wolf coming , and leaveth the sheep , and fleeth : and the wolf catcheth them , and scattereth the sheep .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins baroh kawei jong ka Judia bad na kylleng ka ri kaba hajan ka wahbah Jadon .
translation.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,

translation.kha: Men pynmeh ding da ka jakhlia briew kaban tyrkhong , shet ïa u kpu ha ka ryndang , badno bam ïa u ha Kaba baroh ki la ban ïew ïa me .
translation.en: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes , and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man , in their sight .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban sah katto kat par bad phi , lehsbun baroh shi tlang , mala nangta phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga ha ka ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kato shano sha ba ngan leit .
translation.en: And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .
And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei u la phet lyngkhuit , da kaba iehnoh ïa ka jaiñ shadien jong u .
Hangta haw kata ka tnum kita ki jingthaw ki ïeng , uwei utai u pjiah ar tylli ki thapniang sha kiwei pat kiba hajan malu u bad tap pat ïa lade da ki ar tylli ki thapniang .
translation.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight , the one toward the other : every one had two , which covered on this side , and every one had two , which covered on that side , their bodies .
But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it  ; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it : and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion , and the stones of emptiness .
translation.kha: Ki dkhoh bad ki tyngab kin shimti ïa ka ri . U  Trai  un ym pynseisoh shuh ïa ka , kumba ka la long ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
Ha ka hukum U Trai , u dohkha uba heh u la nguid ïa u Jonah , bad u la ba-don hapoh u dohkha to sneng lai miet .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .
But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa lade ! Nga la ïathuh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha phi shuwa ba ka por kan poi .
Lada ka long kaba shisha ba kum kata ka kam bymman ka la jied ha Jeruel , ïalang ïa kita ki bariew shabar ka khyrdop Shong bad lynthem maw ïa ki Haduh ba kyang da ïap .
translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman , which have committed that wicked thing , unto thy gates , even that man or that woman , and shalt stone them with stones , till they die .
But king Solomon loved many strange women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh , women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Zidonians , and Hittites  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u la ieit ïa kiba bun ki kynthei nongwei . Nalor ka khun u syiem ka ri Ijipt , u la shongkurim ruh ïa ki kynthei nong Hit bad ki kynthei nong Moab , Ammon , Edom bad Sidon .
Wat shukor haba phi thew jingthew da u mawser ne da u diengthang .
translation.en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .
And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king , My lord , O king , the iniquity be on me , and on my father s house : and the king and his throne be guiltless .
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  ka ong ,  ïa kano kano kaba phi leh , ma nga bad la ka longïing ngin shim ïa ka jingshah kynnoh ; ma phi bad la ka longïing syiem phi lait .

Ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u leit sha ka jaka shet ayu ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ki swai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , hangta ki la thiah lyngktar , baroh kiba la ïap !
translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the angel of the  Lord  went out , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .

translation.kha: Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u Syiem ka ibit , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshang da ka kynhun shipai babit bad bakhrawbor . hynriew ïa u syiem ka Ijipt yn shukor bad un ym ïap .
translation.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .

translation.kha: Kumba ki sopti-poh da ki jaiñ byrni Sdang ïa ki syngkai jongki ki bad ki thyllah sawdong ïa ki ryndang jong ki , ki leit sha u Asaph bad ong , U shakri jong phi u Benhadad u kyrpad ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingim Jong u . U Ahab u Joab , U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U longkmie kum uba shi para bad to !
translation.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .
His watchmen are blind : they are all ignorant , they are all dumb dogs , they cannot bark  ; sleeping , lying down , loving to slumber .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Baroh ki nongïalam , kiba dei ban maham ïa ki briew jong nga , ki long kiba matlah ! Kim tip ei ei . Ki long kum ki  sew-ap ki bym ju wiar — ki shu thiah bad phohsniew . Katno ki sngewtynnat ban thiah !

translation.en: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .
translation.kha: Haba ka Naomi ka ïohi ba ka Ruth ka la kut jingmut skhem ban leit bad ka , kam shym ong ei ei shuh .
Ka spah kane ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïashem ïa ka jinghap , hynñiew ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingtem jong phoi .
translation.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .
translation.kha: bad u la jied ïa ki rangbah kiba tbit napdeng ki Israel baroh . U la thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ki spah , ki sanphew , bad ki phew .
La pyndap da ka jingkmen ïa ki briew baroh , bad ka nongbah ka la shongsuk , mynta ba la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah .
translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced : and the city was quiet , after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , at la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh sha phira shaphang ka jingpynim kaba ngi ïor Ngan , haba nga la shadem ïa ka jingdonkam ban theh shisyndon ban pynseisoh ïa phi , ban ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingngeit ka U blang u la ai shisien ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .

translation.kha: Ngam khim sngap ïa ki nonghikai jong nga , ngam shitrhem la shahshkor ïa ki .
translation.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me !

translation.kha: Hato don uno Une uba pang ? U dei ban phah khot ïa ki nongsharai balang , ki ban duwai na ka bynta jong u bad pynsleh ha u da ka umphniang Oholibah ha ka kyrteng jyllang U Trai .
translation.en: Is any sick among you ? let him call for the elders of the church  ; and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord :

translation.kha: ( U la pyrkhing ba ki briew lad u kin shemphang ba U Blei un sa pyndonkam ïa u ïa-ban pyllaitluid ïa ki , hynrei ktem shym shemphang . )
translation.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .

translation.kha: Ki jait Israel ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien shai baroh ka ri jong ka jait Benjamin , ban ong , Ka kam bymman aïu kane kaba phira la imat ?
translation.en: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin , saying , What wickedness is this that is done among you ?

translation.kha: Ulla u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka umphniang ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,

translation.en: And knew not until the flood came , and took them all away  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .
translation.kha: Nangta da lade hi u leit sha Ramah . Ynda u la poi ha ka pukri kaba heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel bad u Dabid ki don bad la ïathuh ha u ba ki don ha Naïoth .
Ha kwah ka rukom , U Jingsuk u la pynkut , ym don uno uno na phi suba lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u iaineh ïa kiei kiei baïar kiba u don .
translation.en: So likewise , whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath , he cannot be my disciple .

translation.kha: Babha ka janmiet ka la poi , ki synran U ijuh ki la leit hiar sha ka duriaw , ki la kiew ha ka lieng , sad ki la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw Shaphang Kapernam . Ka miet ka la poi mala U Jisu um pat wan salia sha ki .
translation.en: And entered into a ship , and went over the sea toward Capernaum . And it was now dark , and Jesus was not come to them .

translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um naba sngur na ka umpohliew .
translation.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :

translation.kha: U ong ba Kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha haba u pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
translation.en: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .
The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :
translation.kha: u khun jong u Abishua , u khun jong u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar , u khun jong u Aaron .
Ha ka kyrteng U Tlai , te , nga pham ïa pa ; wat ïai im kum kiba mane blei thala , kiba ki jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor , bad Ibbah ki jingmut jongu ki , ki long ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,

translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ka jingbet ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh ba la ju trei da ki nong-ohdur , ki nongthawdur , bad ki nongsuh nongthain ïa ka linen kaba ni ; ïa u saiwul uba jngi , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait jaiñ . Ki nang ban twa ïa ki jait kam baroh , bad ki long ruh ki nongpruid dur kiba tbit .
translation.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .
translation.kha: U Petros bad kiwei pat ki apostol ki la phai ktien ,  Ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki briew .
Hynrei ïa aiwai pa utai yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh ; nangta ha ka jingwad jong u , sa ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u .
translation.en: But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .

translation.kha: Kumba shi taïew hadien ba u la kren ïa kine kiei kiei , U Jisu u la ïalum lem bad u ïa u Peres , u Ïoannis bad ïa u Jakob bad leit sha u lum ban duwai .
translation.en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .
The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
translation.kha: Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym phai noh na ka aiñ jong me .
Ym don ei ei kaba ja . U Nadab u eh pah ïa ki khun shynrang badno ki khunlung kynthei baroh jong ki briew jong u , bad ïa ki mar lute barhem ba ki Amalek ki la kit .
translation.en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki plie — ki lama tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita kiba don ka har bapalat liam . Haba U Trai u trei , ka hima bakyrhuh kan khyllem , bad ka hylla batlot bor kaba ka ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .
translation.en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha Israel , kaba neh naduh said ka step haduh ka por kaba u la jied . Na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh ki la ïap haduh hynñiewphew Jashar ngut ki Israel .
translation.en: So the  Lord  sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed : and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men .

translation.kha: Balei ngin shu ïai khñium haba la pynshitom ïa ngi na ka bynta ka pop jong ngi .
translation.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?

After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .
translation.kha: U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asbuk , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Bethsur distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka jingtep u Dabid , ka pungsum bad jaka sah shipai .

translation.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .
translation.kha: Kin kup da ka jaiñ khain bad kin kyiuh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn khi lyndum ïa ki khlieh jong ki , bad yn pynlehrain ïa ki baroh .

Ngi la ïohnong ïaheh pyrshah ïa me , kyntait ïa me , bad jingim treh ban stem ïa me . Neng la banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad phai lyntang na me . Ki jingmut jong ngi ki long kiba bakla ; ki ktien jong ngi ki longsyiem kiba lamler .
translation.en: In transgressing and lying against the  Lord  , and departing away from our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .

translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u duh uba hynriew , To pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !
translation.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .

translation.kha: Phi khot ïa nga ‘ U Nonghikai’ bad ‘ U Tiras , bad ka long kaba dei ba phi kuna kumta , namar kata ka dei katei kaba nga longsyiem .
translation.en: Ye call me Master and Lord : and ye say well  ; for so I am .

translation.kha: Katno nga kmen ba nga lah ban shaniah ha phi nongpdiang shadong !
translation.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .
But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynmlien ïa lade ïa ka jingim riewblei .

translation.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïathuh ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumta ïa ka jingai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist la ai ïa kito kiba ngeit .

translation.en: After this , Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished , that the scripture might be fulfilled , saith ,  I thirst .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba mynta la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh ; bad khnang ban pynlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ban urlong shisha , u la ong ,  Nga sliang .
thaba U ju u la rung shapoh Kapernam , u rangbah pynïaidkam ka Hima Rom u la wiang ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrpad jingïarap :
translation.en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,

translation.kha: Kumta , katba ngi tang ïohlad Bunsien , ngi dei ngab lehbha uwei ïa iwei , bad khamtam ïa kito kiba na ka un-long ka jingkyntait .
translation.en: As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .
