translation.kha: U briew ibha ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long koum ka sim kaba pynmih khun na ki pylleng kiba ka khlem kha . Ha ka rta ba la ih bha un duh noh ïa ka spah Jong u , bad ha kaba kut um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .
translation.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .

translation.kha: Hadien kata ki la ïashong hangta , bun ki la ïa-ap ïa u .
translation.en: And sitting down they watched him there  ;
And these went into Micah s house , and fetched the carved image , the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image . Then said the priest unto them , What do ye ?
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ki leit rung shapoh ïing u Mikah bad shim ïa ki tiar bakyntang , u lyngdoh u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïaleh aïu ?

Kata ka long balieh ba nga thoh ïa kane katba nga dang don jngai na phi ; ka long kumta ba haba de pei nur ym thap ban imat tyngam ha kaba pyndonkam ïa ka iktiar ïa ka U Trai u la ai ha nga — ka bor ïa ka ban tei ïa phi , ym ïa ka ïa-ban pynpra .
translation.en: Therefore I write these things being absent , lest being present I should use sharpness , according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification , and not to destruction .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngem ka Dinah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngoh ïa ki katto katne ki kynthei Kanaan .
translation.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .

translation.kha: U Blei u leh kumba u Mano u la kyrpad , bad u angel jong U , u wan biang sha kata ka briew katba ka sdang shong ha lyngkha . U Manoah , u tnum jong ka um shym ni lang bad ka ,
translation.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah  ; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field : but Manoah her husband was not with her .
But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , un ym ïap ; un im da shisha .

translation.en: But neither so did their witness agree together .
translation.kha: Wat la kumta ruh , kim shym la lah ban pynlong ïa ki jingïathuh jong ki kiba ïahap .

( Mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah Sha Babilonia ïa u shym ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khwan jong u Jehoïakim , bad ïa ki rangbah riewpawkhmat jong ka Jedaïah bad Jerusalem , u la iehnoh ïa ki rishot , ka donbor tama , ki kali tan , bad katto katne tylli kiwei pat ki jingkynshew ka Templ . )
translation.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not , when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem  ;
They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynban ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !

translation.en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin wan sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years , that Pharaoh dreamed : and , behold , he stood by the river .
translation.kha: Hadien ar snem kynthih , u Syiem ka ri Ijipt u la phohsniew ba u ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,

translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .
translation.kha: Nga la leh mynleh kum u bieit — hynrei phi la pynlong ïa nga ban leh kumta . Dei ma phi kiba la dei ban pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa nga . Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na kita ki  apostol  kiba kham kyrpang jong phi .

translation.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master , and the servant as his lord . If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub , how much more shall they call them of his household ?
translation.kha: Kumta uba shah hikai u dei ban sngewhun ban long kum u nonghikai jong u , bad u mraw kum u kynrad jong u . Lada ïa u khlieh jong ka longïing la khot u Beelsebul , ïa ki dkhot jong ka longïing yn khot da ki kyrteng kiba kham sniew !

translation.en: And Bath–sheba bowed , and did obeisance unto the king . And the king said , What wouldest thou ?
translation.kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon ha khmat u syiem , bad u ong ,  Pha kwah aïu ?
Ki la wanrah Khyndiat ki soh ba ki shem hangamei , bad ki la ïathuh ruh ba sakma ka ri ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi ka long kaba seisoh bha .
translation.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands , and brought it down unto us , and brought us word again , and said , It is a good land which the  Lord  our God doth give us .

translation.kha: hynrei u dem shapoh ban peit ïa ki bneng bad ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !
And Obal , and Abimael , and Sheba ,
translation.kha: ka Obal , ka Abimael , ka Sheba ,

Katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , u Lebi u khun jyllang u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u , Bud ïa por . U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .
Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynkut bad ki jingkhublei shimet

translation.en: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me buh ïa nga hapoh u nongap phira ? Me pyrkhat ba nga dei u mrad kynsha ka duriaw ?

translation.en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .
translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ei ei , ïathuh ha u , ‘ U Kynrad u donkam ïa ki ;’ bad nangta un sa pyllait ïa ki shisyndon .

Te ka jingngeit jngai nga kan tyngshaiñ ha phi kum ka Sngi mynstep , bad ki jingmong jongno phi kin sa koit kli . Ngan don ryngkat bad phi borabor banbeiñ pyllait ïa phi ; ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan ïada ïa ph ha ki liang baroh’ .
translation.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning , and thine health shall spring forth speedily : and thy righteousness shall go before thee  ; the glory of the  Lord  shall be thy rearward .
And Joab answered and said , Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .
translation.kha: Ym kumta !  u Joab u jubab .  Ngan ym pynsniew lane pynjot ïa ka nongbah jong phi !
Kine ki long ki briew uba thmu ban pynjynjar bad ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; ki dohnud jong ki , ki dap Badonbor da ka jingshet shukor .
translation.en: They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngan puson ïa ki aiñ jong me .
Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki bri kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .
translation.en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .

translation.kha: Ki shnat jong ka wah kin jingweng katba ki dang lngaid suki suki . Ki khah bad ki japung kin jlop ,
translation.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away  ; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up : the reeds and flags shall wither .
Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingshai kan don hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne por . To nang ïaid katba ka jingshai ka dang don , ba ka jingdum kan ym wan lap ïa phi ; naba uta uba ïaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano ba u leit .

translation.en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .
translation.kha: U Issakhar bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
U Dabid u ong ha u , Ko khun jong nga , nga kwah ban thew ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai U blang jong nga .
translation.en: And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi da ïohi ïa U Jisu , ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban ïa ki angel , kumta ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U Blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh . Mynta ngi ïohi ïa u , ba la pynphong pansngiat da ka burom bad da ka jingpyndonburom namar ka jingïap kaba u la shah .

Hynrei da ka jingïadei U Blei sa long kumba nga long , malu ka jingtei kaba u la ai ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kaweh ka wad , nga la hasem trei skhem ban ïa uno a uwei pat na ki apostol , wat la kam shym la long da ka jingleh jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba trei ha nga .
translation.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .

translation.kha: Ngam long uba mala dor ban ïohpdiang ïa baroh ka jingtyngshaiñ bad ka jingieit batynrai ba me la pynpaw ha de , u shakri jongu me . ?(Nga la jam ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , bad mynta pat nga la wan phai pynlang kine ar ki kynhun .
translation.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .

translation.kha: Hato Phim tip ? Hato ym shym la ïathuh slem mynshuwa ? Hato phim shym ïohsngew kumno ka pyrthei ka sdang ?
translation.en: Have ye not known ? have ye not heard ? hath it not been told you from the beginning ? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , shuwa ba uno uno un tip) shaphang ka jingshah pynïap u Jediael , phraphew ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha Shekhem , Shiloh bad Samaria . Ki la khi ïa la ki ñiuhtmoh , kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki pynmong ïa lade . Ki dang ïashim khep bad jingbei ban ai ha ka Templ .
translation.en: That there came certain from Shechem , from Shiloh , and from Samaria , even fourscore men , having their beards shaven , and their clothes rent , and having cut themselves , with offerings and incense in their hand , to bring them to the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To phan noh sha U Trei , phi baroh ki bariew kiba sngewrit , kiba ïanguh ïa ki hukum Jong u . To ar ïa kaei kaba dei , bad to pynjot ïa lade ha khmat U Trai . Lehse phira lait na ka jingpynshitom ha ka sngi hajan U Trai u pynum ïa ka jingbitar jong u .
translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  , all ye meek of the earth , which have wrought his judgment  ; seek righteousness , seek meekness : it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the  Lord s  anger .
And he said , I am Abraham s servant .
translation.kha: Nga dei u shakri jong u Abraham ,  u la sdang .
ka Gederoth , ka Bethdagon , ka Naamah , bad ka Makkedah : khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem hajuh bad ki nongrit kiba don Syndong jong ki .
translation.en: And Gederoth , Beth–dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah  ; sixteen cities with their villages :

translation.kha: Ki jingthaw baroh ki ap da ka jingthrang hir hir ba U Blei un pynpaw ïa ki khun jong u .
translation.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God .

translation.kha: U la shang la sah ha ka ïing jong u nong Ijipt kiba longïing u kynrad lad u , uba la ïohi ba U Trai u don pyllut lem bad u Joseph bad ba u la pynmanbha ïa u ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: And his master saw that the  Lord  was with him , and that the  Lord  made all that he did to prosper in his hand .

translation.kha: U Saul bad ki paralok lad u ki la leit da ka lieng na Phah , bad ki la wan poi sha Perga , ka nongbah ha Pamphylia , ha kaba u Ïoannis Markos u la iehnoh ïa ki nabar u la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .
Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ki ïa ka dur ki kherub .
( Ka don ka shnong hajan hangta ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynha Shipai . ) badno kumta yn pynlong khuid biang ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .

And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?
translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew u khunlung u la ïap bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor . Ki ong ,  Mynba i khunlung i dang im , u Dabid um ju jubab ïa ngi haba ngi kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïathuh ïa u ba i khun jong u i la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa lade !
U te u ong ha u , Wanrah kawei ka masi , Kaei ka blang , imat u lbong , kawei pa kawei na ki ka dien ban long kob lai snem ka ter , bad kawei ka paro , bad kawei ka lyngdoh .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .

translation.kha: namar kane balei bhor na phi , phi pang bad phira swai , Bad bun bah ki la ïap .
translation.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .

translation.kha: Naba U blei ha ka jingstad jong u , um shym la pynlah ïa ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstet jong ki hi . Pynïeng da Kata kaba la khat ka khubor ba-ibieit kaba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim ïa kito Kiba ngeit ïa ka .
translation.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .

translation.kha: Kito kiba me la pyllait im kin ïoh pah ha Jerusalem da ka jingkieng , da kaba rwai bad Risia da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmang junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang mynsiem .
translation.en: Therefore the redeemed of the  Lord  shall return , and come with singing unto Zion  ; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head : they shall obtain gladness and joy  ; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thynrang jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon baroh , bad ka basan baroh haduh Salekah .
translation.en: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ka ri lum kam baklang ïa ngi ; hynrei ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar-khang , na ka bynta kito kiba shang ha Beth shang bad ïa ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ka bad na ka bynta kito kiba shon ha ka Them Jesreel .
translation.en: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves ; but our sufficiency is of God ;
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ha ngi kaba ngi lah ban dawa ba ngi long kiba bit ban leh ïa kane ka kam . Ka jinglah jong ngi ka wan na U Blei ;

Ngan tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki pule jong ki Blei’ ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka Babilonia un thang ïa ki thliew jong ki ne ïalam noh ïa ki . Katba ki nongap langbrot ki dang jia ïa ki ïajan Jong ki kiba lait na ki jynreiñ , te u syiem ka Babilonia un jied pynkdor ïa ka ri jingïaphet sad nangta ki mih da ka jingjop .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .
Then shall the righteous answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , and fed thee ? or thirsty , and gave thee drink ?
translation.kha: Nangta kiba hok kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me thngan bad ba ngi bsa ïa me , lane ba me sliang bad ba ngi ai jingdih ïa me ?
U shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki nongsharai bad u pynlong ïa ki nongïalam kum kiba bieit .
translation.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled , and maketh the judges fools .
And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :
translation.kha: U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rit bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la buh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh s army was come forth out of Egypt : and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them , they departed from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka dang kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei haba ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la jam sha shiliang u pud ka Ijipt , ki la phai dien noh .

translation.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri uba peit halor ki jingdon jingem jong u Abraham , u shim shiphew tylli ki ut jong u kynrad jong u bad u leit sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .

translation.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses  ; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever .
translation.kha: Phi beh noh ïa ki kynthei jong ki briew jong nga na ki ïing ba ki ieit , bad phi lute khlem kut ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong nga na ki khun jong ki .

translation.en: For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la kwah eh ban tip haduh katno phi la ïeng ha kata ka jingtynjuh bad la phi la kloi borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah da wan bad ki briew kim shem la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha hajuh ka rukom kin lehbeiñ ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .
translation.kha: Ong phi kwah aïu ngan ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewbit ïa ka nongleitkurim , ngan ai ha phi kat kaba phi pan , tang lada phi shah ïa nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .
(Nga la ïohi ruh ba la don saw tylli ki shalyntem , baroh kiba ïasyriem , hajan uwei pa eiei Kherub .
translation.en: And when I looked , behold the four wheels by the cherubims , one wheel by one cherub , and another wheel by another cherub : and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone .

translation.kha: Ha ka shyllangmat jong ka , la thoh ïa ka kyrteng ka don ka jingmut kaba rieh : Ka Babilon Barak , ka kmie jong ki nuti baroh bad kiba ïasakma baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And upon her forehead was a name written , MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH .
Praise ye the  Lord . I will praise the  Lord  with my whole heart , in the assembly of the upright , and in the congregation .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ngan ainguh ïa U  Trai ha ka jingïalang ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa kine nalor ki jingainguh thang kiba man ka step .

translation.en: If any man have an ear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

Ha kiwei pat ki nongbah ha kiba ki lyngngoh ki shong , la kyrshan jingïarap ha kane da kiwei ki Lebi : u Eden , Miniamin , Joshua , Shemaïah , Amaraïah , bad u Shekanaïah . Ki sam ryntih ïa ka jingbam sha ki para Lebi kat kum ki kamram jong ki , bad ym kat kum ki kur .
translation.en: And next him were Eden , and Miniamin , and Jeshua , and Shemaiah , Amariah , and Shecaniah , in the cities of the priests , in their set office , to give to their brethren by courses , as well to the great as to the small :

translation.kha: Kam mut ruh ba kiba ieit ha U Khrist , kiba la ïarep ki long kiba la jot nep keiñ .
translation.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished .
But we will not boast of things without our measure , but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us , a measure to reach even unto you .
translation.kha: Pynban na ka bynta jong ngi , ki jingkob sarong jong ngi kin ym ïaid palat pud ; kan don hapoh u pud jong ka jingtrei kaba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi , bad kane ka kynthup ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee : thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt thou be any more .
translation.kha: Me la jah , jah junom , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba la ithuh ïa me ki la sngewma , sngewtieng ba kin ïadon bynta ha ka kupar jong me .

translation.en: Woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues , and greetings in the markets .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ieit ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog bad ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew .
Ki paidbah kiba la sheng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki kiba la noh ba ka dem ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei paw ki la ino , U ruh u la kren ha u !
translation.en: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
translation.kha: Lada ki briew hapoh kata ka ïing ki pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ; hynrei lada kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to shim noh pat ïa ka jingkhublei jong phi .

translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .
translation.kha: ka kynhun shipai Judia ka la shahjop , bad ki shipai ki la phet sha la ki ïing .

Dei na kata ka daw nga la thoin ïa kata ka shithi shata phi — ngam shym kwah ban wan sha phi bad ba yn pynsngewsih da ngi hi ki briew kiba la dei ban pynslem ïa nga . Naba por sngewdei ba hajan sa kmen , te ma phoi baroh phi ïakmen lang .
translation.en: And I wrote this same unto you , lest , when I came , I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all , that my joy is the joy of you all .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba den U Tiras U Blei jong phi uba ai spah ïa phi , ba un ïoh pynseisoh haduh kaei ka sngi ïa kata ka jutang ba u la pynlong bad ki kpa thymmei jong phi .
translation.en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .

translation.kha: india ki la dep Thep , u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki khun , Ynda nga ïap , tep ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep badno buh ïa ka met jong nga syndah bad ka Jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :

translation.kha: Hadien ar snem , u Absalom u la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot ha Baal Hasor , hasem ka shnong Ephraim , bad u la khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u syiem shun ïadon hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass after two full years , that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor , which is beside Ephraim : and Absalom invited all the king s sons .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ngi dat borabor ban thmu ban leh ïa kita kai kiei kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kylli ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew la kaba kum kane kaei kaei ka la ju jia mynshuwa . Ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba shyrkhei !
Jngai na kaba ki briew ki shong ki sah ; lane ba ki khet briew ki ju ïaid , ki briew ki tih ïa ki taïew ha ki par . Hangta ki trei ha ka jingkynjah marwei , da kaba sdien ïa ki tyllai ha ki thliew .
translation.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant  ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .

translation.kha: Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , me ïathuh lat ha i kat ïa kob phi ong .
translation.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants  ; and some of the king s servants be dead , and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
translation.kha: Nangta ki siat ïa ngi da ki khnam na ka kynroh , bad katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem kynrad ki la shah pynïap ; u Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .

U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka thalab . Hangta hajar jong ka khapbrip nga la ïohi arphew sa lwet ki rangbah kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Assur sad u Pelataïah u khun jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .

translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Goliath , uba na ka shnong Gath , u wan mih na ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ban kob ïa ki Israel . U jrong kumba lai mitar
translation.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath , of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span .
And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .
translation.kha: Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaba synshar halor ki syiem jong ka pyrthei .
Hynrei kdew ha Kanah ka kynti ruh , u Pharaoh u la kylla long mutlop , bad um shym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translation.en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also , neither would he let the people go .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba brup u Jonathan u leit shaw ki bri ban ïakynduh ïa U Dabid kamar u la ïakut . U ïalam ïa Uei u khynnah samla bad u ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little lad with him .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa uta u briew sa shisien , Me ong u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me — hajan kumta , me ong aïu shngain jong u ? U dadien u nongïathuhlypa , uta u bariew u la jubab .
translation.en: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .

translation.kha: Hynrei to phai mynta malu to ïasait bad U blei Badonbor Baroh ;
translation.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;

translation.kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingmane kambah khroh , nongmareh ki bhabriew jong u kiba la sngewtmang haba ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lynthaw Maw ïa u ; hynrei U Trei U Blei jngai u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .
translation.en: And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .

translation.kha: U ryndang jong phi u long kum u mot jyllang u dab , uba pyllup bun jlih , lem malu u jingdeng lyndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawkyr-ang jongno u .
translation.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .

translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im ha Judah kin roi kin san kum ki jingthung babha ngam jylliew ki thied ha ka khyndew bad pynjam soh-ot .
translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward , and bear fruit upward :

translation.kha: Nga Tip ïa ki jingkit bakhia kiba U Bela u la buh halor jong me .
translation.en: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it .

And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .
translation.kha: U Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , uba na ka jait Issakhar , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab bad u la pynïap ïa u katba u Nadab bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Philistia .
Pha long kum ka kynïan kaba ïaleh dor bad ki nongwei ha ka jaka ba ieid ïa la u tnga .
translation.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !

translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha u lapbah shipai bad ha ki shiphew , Lada ki waiñ kim don ha ka jingtong , phim don jingkyrmen shuh ban lait im .
translation.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .

translation.kha: Mynta uno uno u lah ban shong ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u — hadien ba la ber da u kyndok ban pyndap ïa ki khñiang jingpang !
translation.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his : brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit ban kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki syrdoh .
Kum ki dieng , ki bynriew jong per kin im slem . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen pura! ha kiei khie kiba ki la trei shitaiew .
translation.en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por kad wan haba ngan jied kum u syiem ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid uba khih . U syiemsad u ban synshar da ka jingstad , Bad u ïa-ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch , and a King shall reign and prosper , and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .
Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha ha kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u Dabid , u la pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la long u nongïalam ïa kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu .

U Trai u la mawbah ha u Abraham harud ki dieng kynthih jong u Matri . Katba u Abraham u dang shong ha ka jingkynjah ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka por ba daiñ shit kyr-ang mynsngi , u la khmied bad u la ïohi lai ngat ki radbah uba ïohnang hangta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day  ;
And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me long u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab ;  kiwei pat ki ong ba me long u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them .
translation.kha: Napdeng kito kiba ki paid Israel ki la pynïap , u dei u Balaam , u nongkren byrtong , u khun jong u Beor .
Ong ïa ki , ‘ I pa jong nga i la bthuh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba ktah ; ang ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita , i pa i la shoh ïa phi! da u riphin ; nga ngan suhthied ïa phi da u shabuk !’
translation.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .

translation.kha: Bad ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynban ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jaitniam na ka bynta u dabi u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la pynlong ka jong nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .
But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba peit bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew , uba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka bad ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ban klet noh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
hynne U Jisu u la Jobab , Pynban , kattne ka kmen long pli kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei mala kiba kohnguh ïa ka !
translation.en: But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .

translation.kha: Khenani U Trai u la jyllop , Ki nongïathuhlypa ki iathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyr-ang jong nga ; ngam shym phah ïa ki , lymne ma shngiam la ai kino kino ki hukum lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw kiba ki ïakren ktien shym wan na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki long Kiei ktieh ki bymdondor Ibbah ki la mutdur .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .

And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work , that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba la buh jingkheiñ katno ka dei , ki aiti ïa ka rupa ha ki rangbah kiba dei peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , bad kine ki siew bainong ïa ki misteri , ki nongtei jingtei ,
Da kumta u Saul badno lai nongput ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap lang badno ym don Uba na ki khun ki ksiew jong u kiba oh ban synshar .
translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
translation.kha: Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ba ngan dang sah . Ngan dang ïaisah bad phi baroh , ban pynsan shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,
U Moses u wanpaw ïathuh ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh bad ïa ki waiñ baroh jong U Trai , bad ki briew baroh ki ïabeh lang , Ïa kita baroh kaba U Trai u ong , ngin leh .
translation.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit sha u Ishmael u khun jong u Abarim , mala u shongman ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kaba long ka to jong u Nebaïoth .
translation.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .

translation.kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u para Jong u , uba don saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .
translation.en: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai da la ka jong ka jingim ba un wallam shibun ki rangbah ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia kum shi kynhun ki puit , bad kin pyrta da ka jingjop .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath been sore displeased with your fathers .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la bthah ïa u Sekharaïah ban ong ha ki briew ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la bitar shikatdei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,

translation.en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Naphtali u ong ,  U Naphtali u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkyrkhu da ka jingsngewbha U  Trai  ; Ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .
Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u nongbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kambah la jia ha ki Paul .
translation.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .

translation.kha: U banylla u la long u briew uba bha , kiba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingngeit , bad buiñ ki briew la wallam sha U Trai .
translation.en: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .
For thus saith the  Lord  , Thy bruise is incurable , and thy wound is grievous .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ki jingmong jong phi ki long ki bym lah ban koit , ïa ki jingmynsaw jong phi ym lah ban pynkhiah .
U tyngkhuh u long u parabangeit ba-bieit jong ngi , bad u shakri baïaineh ha ka Kam U Trai , un ïathuh lut ïa ka khubor shaphang jyllang ar , khnang ba phin tip kumin nga ïasaid shaphrang .
translation.en: But that ye also may know my affairs , and how I do , Tychicus , a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord , shall make known to you all things :
Beware that thou forget not the  Lord  thy God , in not keeping his commandments , and his judgments , and his statutes , which I command thee this day :
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; wat lyndet ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
Kumta tun phah ka dieng ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Gasa , bad kuna thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof :

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbymlehhok kaweh jia ha ka pyrthei — ka jingbymngeit kaba la pynlong da ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :
Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .
translation.kha: U shna ïa ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong jong ka , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum lad U Trai U Blei jongno ki , la pule ha ki , bad ha ki per kynta kiba bud , ki Phla ïa la ki pop bad mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la phai ktien ,  Ngi don ka hukum kaba ong ba u dei ban ïap , namar u la kam ba u long U Khun U Blei .
Kum ki sing ki i ei ei ei ban pynïap pynlang banbeiñ bam , ki ïap , bad ki khun jong ki baroh ki sakhi .
translation.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion s whelps are scattered abroad .

And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .
translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki paidbah ki leit sha ka nongbah Baalah , kata ka dei ka Kiriath Jearim , ha ka ri Judah , ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  uba shong halor ki Kherub .
Lada phi leh kumta , phin sa tip ka mudui aïu ban pyrkhing ïa U Trai bad phin sa lah ban sngewthuh shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .

translation.kha: Te u jaboh u khot ïa la ki khur shynrang nabar u ainong , Ïalumlang baroh , ba tun ïathuh aïu kan jia ïa phi ha ka olib :
translation.en: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .
And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumta , bad halor jong ka u la hiar arsut ha ka lynti nadien u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trai uwei u dieng Sning .  Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ?  u kylli .  Nga dei ,  uta u briew u jubab .

translation.en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai ! To rwai ha U  Trai  , ko phi ka pyrthei baroh !
kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ki ri Gad badno Goliath . U Saul u ding don ha Gilgal , bad ki briew bakha bad u ki la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u phah ïa kine ki rangïapom syier ban Hikai ha ki nongbah ka Judah : u Benhail , u Hodaïah , u Sekharaïah , u Nahalal bad u Maakah .
translation.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes , even to Ben–hail , and to Obadiah , and to Zechariah , and to Nethaneel , and to Michaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u ong , To , kam leilieh lei ! Haba U Trai u aiti ïa u Sebah malade ïa u Shammua ha nga , ngan sien ïa ph da ki shiah bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shympriah !
translation.en: And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .

translation.kha: U la shong la sah ha ka ïing jong u nong Ijipt uba long u kynrad jong u , uba la ïohi ba U Trai u don thang lem bad u Joseph bad ba u la pynmanbha ïa u ha kiei kaei kaba u ni .
translation.en: And his master saw that the  Lord  was with him , and that the  Lord  made all that he did to prosper in his hand .

translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki skhem , ba la riam ha ki jingshong syiem , ki shong halor ki khet jong ki ha ka kajuh synsar kew katba don shabar ka khyrdop jrong ka Samaria , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne , clothed in their robes , and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven , whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel ;
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor bashisha , ka Khubor Babha , ka la wan nyngkong ha phi , phi la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingkyrmen ba ka tyrwa . Kumta ïa ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba phi kyrmen , ïa kaba la buh sumar na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng .
Leh kumjuh haba phi lap ïa ka kada , ka jaiñkup , lane kaei kaei kaba jah kaba de ka jong u para Israel jong phi ; wat shu ieh khlem da ïarap .
translation.en: In like manner shalt thou do with his ass  ; and so shalt thou do with his raiment  ; and with all lost thing of thy brother s , which he hath lost , and thou hast found , shalt thou do likewise : thou mayest not hide thyself .

translation.kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa Kanah ka kam bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Barnabas lem bad ïa ang de , kum ka dak ba i'u ïalang baroh ki nongïatrei lang . neng la ïamynjur ba u banylla bad ar , ngin ïaroi hapdeng ki Jeriel , bad ki pat hateng ki ïew .
translation.en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
And the king answered them roughly  ; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men ,
translation.kha: U syiem um ñiewkor ïa ki jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew ,

translation.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .
translation.kha: Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong u .
Kino drama ki bym kwah ban shah hikai kan ïailong kiba khuid . Hynrei uno uno Uba sngap ïa ka jingpynbeit u long ba la ñiewkor .
translation.en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .

translation.kha: Nga la ïaineh ha ka jingngeit , ki haba sa ong , La pynlwet khoit ïa nga ,
translation.en: I believed , therefore have I spoken : I was greatly afflicted :

translation.kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ba ki briew ki ba-don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da kaba har ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translation.en: ( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
And Elisha came to Damascus  ; and Ben–hadad the king of Syria was sick  ; and it was told him , saying , The man of God is come hither .
translation.kha: U Elisha u leit sha Damaskos ha ka por ba u Benhadad u syiem Syria u pang . Haba la ïathuh ha u syiem ba u Elisha u don hangta ,
Ka jaitbynriew Israel ka un-long kum u sing uba khrawbor ; U me shongthait haka haduh ba u la lah patar bad bam lur khoit , Haduh ba un da dep dih ïa ka snam jong tun Kiba u la pynpoh .
translation.en: Behold , the people shall rise up as a great lion , and lift up himself as a young lion : he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey , and drink the blood of the slain .

translation.kha: Kumta uta u Briew u la dem khohsiew bad mane ïa U Troas .
translation.en: And the man bowed down his head , and worshipped the  Lord .

translation.kha: U syiem u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingïadon ïa ka nongbah da kaba tei bha ïa ka kynroh , kaba tei ïa ki kut halor lad ka , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh na shabar . Nalor kata , u tei pat ïa ki jingïada ba la tei ha ka jaka kaba la pyndih khyndew ha ka phangpdeng mihngi jong ka Jerusalem ha ka bynta naba rim . U phah shna ruh bun bah ki sum bad ki stieh .
translation.en: Also he strengthened himself , and built up all the wall that was broken , and raised it up to the towers , and another wall without , and repaired Millo in the city of David , and made darts and shields in abundance .

And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synran jong u ban sam ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .
Shaphang ka jingjynjar kiba mynta , nga pyllait ba ka kham bha ïa u briew ban hukum kumba u long .
translation.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .

translation.kha: Kynsan ki leh Kumta na ka jingieit , namar ki tip ba U Bel u la ai ha nga ïa ka kai ban ïadoh ïa ka jingialam .
translation.en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :

translation.kha: U Jehosheba u ong ha ki paidbah , pynkhun ïa lade , namar lashai U Trai un leh ki kambah hapdeng jongki phi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Sanctify yourselves : for to morrow the  Lord  will do wonders among you .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u leit baklang sha Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u nongbah synshar ka sorkar u la khong hangta umbiah u khun jong u , u la peiñ , ha Kapernam .
translation.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine . And there was a certain nobleman , whose son was sick at Capernaum .
And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u long lem bad u , bad u long uba jop ha kiei kiei kiba u leh . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ka Assyria bad u kyntait ban pyndem ha u .
U Trai u ong , Wat ha kito ki sner ngan ym pynjot khoit ïa ki briew jongnga nga .
translation.en: Nevertheless in those days , saith the  Lord  , I will not make a full end with you .

translation.kha: Pynkloi shun leit sha ka bad kylli la ktien kiei baroh ki bit ki baïong bad ka , u tnga jong ka , bad u khum jong ka . Ka ïathuh ha u Gehasi ba kiei ki baroh ki bit ki baklang ,
translation.en: Run now , I pray thee , to meet her , and say unto her , Is it well with thee ? is it well with thy husband ? is it well with the child ? And she answered , It is well .

translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng donburom un hikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnen jong u ki jyrngam bad khie lung bad u sdang ban sei sla , phi tip ba ka lwait ka la jan .
translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :
Wherefore glorify ye the  Lord  in the fires , even the name of the  Lord  God of Israel in the isles of the sea .
translation.kha: bad kito kiba ha mihngi kin ïaroh ïa u . Ki briew kiba im harud ka duriaw kin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom , and will cut off man and beast from it  ; and I will make it desolate from Teman  ; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword .
translation.kha: Mynta nga pynbna ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka Edom bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew bad u mrad hangta . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba sah shrah , na ka nongbah Teman haduh ka nongbah Dedan , bad ki briew kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka pyrthei ki ithuh ïa me , hyndai nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .
translation.kha: Kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kin teh kumjuh ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi .

translation.en: Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .
translation.kha: Ko syiem Ijipt , shano kito ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki lah ban ïathuh ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kiba u don ïa ka Ijipt .
Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim Jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshahjop .
translation.en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :

translation.kha: To ai ba ma phi , ki briew jong u , phyrnai ïailong kiba ïaineh ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi , pun kohnguh ïa ki aiu bad ki hukum jongnga u baroh , kumba phi leh ha kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .
But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïai ban haduh ba u Dabid ha kaba khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Absalom u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba ïabiang ïa u syiem

translation.en: He giveth snow like wool : he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes .
translation.kha: U pyiar ïa ka ïor kum ka nep bad u pynphriang ïa u thah kum ka khyndew .

translation.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa uwei u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar nylla . Shna ïa ka trai bad ka met jong u da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u kiba kynthup ïa ki shylluit bad ki sla syntiew jong ki , kin ïasoh lang kawei bad u .
Hynrei u Moses u jong ha U Blei , Ngam long ei ei . Kumno nga lah ban leit sha u Pharaoh bad ban ïalam napoh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Who am I , that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?

translation.kha: Hadien ar snem u ïap noh
translation.en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .
And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh ban leit ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .
To khem , to sngewskhem , namar ïa ka bainong bakhraw la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha ki bneng . Kane ka long da kumno la pynshitom beiñ ïa ki nongïalap kiba la im ha shaw jong phi .
translation.en: Rejoice , and be exceeding glad : for great is your reward in heaven : for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Petros bad hangta u la ïuh ïa ka kiaw kurim u Pontios ba ka thiah pang lam bad ka jingshit .
translation.en: And when Jesus was come into Peter s house , he saw his wife s mother laid , and sick of a fever .

translation.kha: U Mushi u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , bad ki la ïeng ha jat jong u lum .
translation.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
And Jesus sat over against the treasury , and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury : and many that were rich cast in much .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang shong hajan ka jaka lum jingkynshew ha ka Templ , u la khmih ïa ki briew katba ki dang pynnoh ïa ka pisa jong ki . Bun kiba riewspah ki la pynnoh shibun ka pisa ;

translation.en: Whithersoever they went out , the hand of the  Lord  was against them for evil , as the  Lord  had said , and as the  Lord  had sworn unto them : and they were greatly distressed .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki leit sha ka thma , U  Trai  u long pyrshah ïa ki , kumba u la lah ong ba un leh kumta . Ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .
Da U Tiras uba im , u Dabid u bteng biang , nga Tip ba U Trai hi un seh ïap ïa u , lane un ïap hi itynnad poi ka por ba un ïap , lane haba un ïap ha ka thlim .
translation.en: David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .
And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks , of the firstfruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of ingathering at the year s end .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phi sdang ban ot ïa u soh nyngkong na u kew jong phi ; rakhe ruh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka synrai haba phi lum ïa la ki soh .

Nangta u ong ha ki nongap kiba ïeng hajan lad u , Pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U Trai ! Ki la ïasylla bad u Abda pynlang kim shym la ïathmu ïa to ba u la phet , kad la ki la tip ïa ka baroh shi katta . Khenani ki nongap kim treh ban rai ïa la ka kti ngab pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jngai U Trei .
translation.en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him , Turn , and slay the priests of the  Lord   ; because their hand also is with David , and because they knew when he fled , and did not shew it to me . But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U buh ïa ka duwan ksiar hapoh ka Ïing , ha khmat ka pyrda ,
translation.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil :

translation.kha: ka Helkath , bad ka Rehob , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno uba thoh ïa ka waiñ thymmai ha ki lwa snieh barim , namar ka waiñ lai pynpdang ïa ki sniew , badno baroh ar , ka waiñ bad ki sneng kin sniew neh . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ thlim dem Ban theh ha ki lei sniang bathymmai .
translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
And Moses said before the  Lord  , Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u la jubab ,  Me tip ba nga long uba duna ha ka ktien ka thylliej ; kumno keiñ u Pharaoh un shahshkor ïa nga ?

Ki nongïathuhlypa kim kren ei ei Hynrei tang ki jingjur ; ki Lyngdoh ki synshar tang kumba hukum ki nongïathuhlypa , dara ki briew jong nga ktieh shem pynpaw jingpyrshah ei ei . Hynrei kin leh aïu haba Baroh ka poi shuh naba kut ?
translation.en: The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?

translation.kha: Kaei ka jynjar jongnga pha ? Ka ïajubab , Ha katne ka sngi , kane ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngim ïabam ïa u ïakhun jongu nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun Jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .
And they did so , and made them all sit down .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki synran ki la dep ,
Nangta ki la ïalam sha ki Pharisi ïa uta u briew uba la ju long uba Mahath .
translation.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind .

translation.kha: Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kum ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jinghap jong ki ?
translation.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , uno Une uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïatyngkhuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kane baroh haba nga pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrthei , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki don ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shahshitom hapoh jong ki .
Ki mata lad phar ki long na ki nongbah ka Sidon bad Arbad . Ki rangbah batbit jong pham hi ki la long ki maji .
translation.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners : thy wise men , O Tyre , that were in thee , were thy pilots .

translation.kha: Hato phim pat shemphang ? Phim kynmaw mynsngi nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki khop na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki rangbah ? kato shang phoi la ïa-pyndap ?
translation.en: Do ye not yet understand , neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .

Now when Job s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him , they came every one from his own place  ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him .
translation.kha: Lai ngut na ki paralok u Job ki long u Eliphas na ka nongbah Teman , u Bildad na ka ri Shuah , bad u Sophar na ka ri Naamah . Ynda ki la ïohsngew katno ba u Job u shah jynjar , ki ïakut ban leit bad pyntngen ïa u .
Un shim ïa me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ka ri kaba kham khraw . Men ïap hangta hajan ki kai ïapom uba me , me la sngewsarong . Me long ka jingïambriew ïa ka longsem jong u kynthih jong me .
translation.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .

translation.kha: Te ka jingbitar jong nga kan kut bad ngan long jai jai . Ngan ym batai lane bishni shuh .
translation.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest , and my jealousy shall depart from thee , and I will be quiet , and will be no more angry .

translation.kha: Ki jingsawa ba-sngewtriem kin pah ha ki skhep jong ki , bad ki nonglute kin wei kurup ïa ki haba ki dang pyrkhat ba ki shngain .
translation.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him .

translation.kha: Jamynrei pynban nga la pyrkhat isynei ïa ki . Nga la rai ban ym pynïap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them , neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ong ha u Horon bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , ñiewburom ïa ki jingkñia uba kynthih ba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , ba kumta phin ym pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrngah kaba khuid jong nga . “Nga long U thri .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko khwan u briew’ , u la ong , ïateh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros kaei kaba ma sa , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ino ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U Blei . Me ong ba Kum U Blei’ me shong ha ka khiat , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw . Me lah ban leh mynlyiur kum U Bel , isynei , em , me long uba kynja bariew , ym uba kynja blei .
translation.en: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :

translation.kha: Ishod mynstep , u leit sha said ka khyrdop shnong , bad u ong ha ki briew kiba don hangta , Nga dei ma nga uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram nabar uba la pynïap ïa u ; phim dei kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta kata . Hynrei mano ba la pynap ïa Kino baroh ?
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that he went out , and stood , and said to all the people , Ye be righteous : behold , I conspired against my master , and slew him : but who slew all these ?

translation.kha: Ki phylla ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh thma ha Sokoh , ka shnong Kaba ha Judah ; ki sher dara ha kawei ka jaka kaba ki khot Ephes Dammim , kaba hapdeng ka patrong bad ka Asekah .
translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle , and were gathered together at Soco , which belongeth to Judah , and pitched between Soco and Azekah , in Ephes–dammim .

translation.kha: Ki la pynnep shoiñ ïa ki , bad nongap u la ong ha ki , Mynta to tong khyndiat ka um bad wait rah ïa ka sha u nongpynïaid jong ka jingkhawai .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Draw out now , and bear unto the governor of the feast .  And they bare it .

translation.kha: Na u nongsharai Balang — Sha ka Kynthei bymdonbor bad sha ki khun jong ka , ïa kiba nga ieit da shisha . Bad ym de tang ma nga hi , hynrei baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingshisha ki ieit ïa phi ,
translation.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children , whom I love in the truth  ; and not I only , but also all they that have known the truth  ;

translation.kha: Ym da donhok ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit kiei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .

translation.kha: Ki khñiang kin bameh duh ïa ki dieng bad ki jingthung jong phi barieh .
translation.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume .

translation.kha: Naba u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph , Kumba phi ïohi , nga la jan ïaphah , hynrei U Blei un don ryngkat sad me , bad un sa ïalam pat ïa me sha ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold , I die : but God shall be with you , and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u syiem ha ka ktien Asrikam , To u Syiem Kynrad un im junom ! To ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phoi , bad ngin batai ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack , O king , live for ever : tell thy servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation .

translation.kha: Ko Job , shano me la “phla ïa ki pop Jong me ha U blem bad kular ban nym imat pop shu ?
translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :

translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ka lieng kad leit sha ki mawsiang , kamet ki la pynhiar saw tyllun ki ehrang na shadien jong ka lieng bad ki la duwai ïa ka jingshai ka sngi .
translation.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks , they cast four anchors out of the stern , and wished for the day .

translation.kha: katsha nga dang ni hi ha ka ïingbishar ha ka phyllaw , ka khubor U Trai ka la wan biang ha por .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the second time , while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,

translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi ha kano kano ka man . Naba ka Sngi kan ym woh tad ynda ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia malu ba uta Uba Sniew u mihpaw ïa uba la pahuh lyngka na ka bynta ka dud .
translation.en: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;

translation.kha: Kumne uta u Shakri u buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong u Abraham , u kyndiang jong u , pynlang u pynlong ka jingaimynsiem ban leh ïa kaei kaba u Ahab u la lei ïa u .
translation.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .

translation.kha: Bad ïa phi ruh , ko paralok baïaineh jong nga , nga kwah ïa phi ban ïarap ïa Kin ki kynthei ; naba ki la trei skhem lema pynlang nga pun pynsaphriang ïa ka gospel , ryngkat bad u Klemen , nabar baroh kiwei pat ki para nongïatrei lem jong nga , kiba ki kyrteng jong ki , ki don ha ka kitab jong kiba im jngai U Blei .
translation.en: And I entreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .

translation.kha: Ym don kino Phim ki bleithaw jong ki jyrthiaw kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka sngewbiang da lap hi kam ia ban pynhap slap . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , namar me long ita uba leh ïa Kino ktieh kiwei .
translation.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .

translation.kha: U syiem u lah ban ai ïa kano kano kaba u mon , kumta mihnoh na khmat jong u ; wat shong ha kaba kum kane ka jaka ba ma .
translation.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing  ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him .

That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth , which thou shalt bring of thy land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt put it in a basket , and shalt go unto the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name there .
translation.kha: iwei pa iwei na phi phin buh ha ka shang ïa u soh nyngkong hadien ba phi la lum na uwei pa uwei u jait jingthung , bad leit rah ïa ka sha ka jaka mane Blei .
Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phin im slem ; kawei Kin burom ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .
translation.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven  ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  kaei kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi kam dei u kpu na bneng ; dei U Kpa jong nga uba ai ha phi ïa u kpu bashisha na bneng .

translation.en: Assemble yourselves , and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O  Lord .
translation.kha: To pynkloi bad to wan , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong , bad ïalumlang ha ka them .’   To phah , A  Trai  , ïa ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
Ka jingleh bymman bad ka jingleh jubor ki long kum ka bam ka dih ïa ki .
translation.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .
Whither the forerunner is for us entered , even Jesus , made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi U Jisu u la rung hapoh hangta shuwa jong ngi , bad u la jia long U Rangbah Lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .

U syiem Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Tabor bad weng ei ïa ki khiew Ibbah don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa jrong na ki bynta ba shadien jong ki khiat tylli ki masi dab rnong , malade u buh ha u maw nongrim .
translation.en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paid Jeriel kim khim la sangeh ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga naduh ka por ba ki leh bapop ha Gibeah . Kumta ha Jehubbah ka thma kan lap ïa ki .
translation.en: O Israel , thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah : there they stood : the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them .
There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka met U Jisu hangta .

Kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingkhah jingmut , ka jingshahjop , bad ka jingkulmar jingmut ha ka Them ka Jingïohipaw , bad U Trai U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa ka ha I . Ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongkhap jong ngi la tied pynmih , bad ki jingkyang ban ïoh jingïarap ki la sawa hapdeng ki lum .
translation.en: For it is a day of trouble , and of treading down , and of perplexity by the Lord  God  of hosts in the valley of vision , breaking down the walls , and of crying to the mountains .

translation.kha: Mynta ai hukum ban pynrieh ïa ki jingri jong me bad ïa kiwei kiwei bapaw baroh kiba me don ha lym . U phria un hap ha ki bri nabar ki nud kiba don habar khleh jingdih , bad baroh kin ïap lwait .’
translation.en: Send therefore now , and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field  ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them , and they shall die .
And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the  Lord  above all that were before him .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  palat ban ïa uno uno na kiba ha shuwa jong u .

Phi kwah ei ei , hynne phim ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi pynpyut ; pa’ da khih eh , hynrei khung lah ban ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi ïakhana bad pa’ ïaleh thma . phim ïohi ïa kawei kaba Phi kwah , namar ba phim pan na U Blei ïa ka .
translation.en: Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .
Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Dabid u phah shaw ïa u .

Hobab uta u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u nong , Utai u dei u nongïohipaw uba la lyndet ïa ka hukum U Trai . Bad kumta U Trai u phah ïa u sing kaba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U Trai u la kren ha u .
translation.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .

translation.kha: nangta sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad kiba la pyningkhong da ka lyer ri shahïap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la jingduh noh ïa kita kiba met .
translation.en: And , behold , seven ears , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them :
Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , haba U Khrist u la dei ban wan sha kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei :  Mem kwah ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh , hynrei me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong nga .
Shano phin leit ? nga la kylli . Ban thew ïa ka Jerusalem , u la jubab , ban ïohi katno ka jingjrong pynlang ka jingïarap jong ka .
translation.en: Then said I , Whither goest thou ? And he said unto me , To measure Jerusalem , to see what is the breadth thereof , and what is the length thereof .
Her princes within her are roaring lions  ; her judges are evening wolves  ; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka ki long kum ki sing bakyrhuh ; ki nongbishar jong ka ki long kum ki suri bathngan , kiba lalot eh kat ban pynsah sa tang ka shyieng haduh mynstep .

translation.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shalmaneser u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut ,
Hynrei mynta ba i la ïap , balei ngan shahjingit ? Nga lah mo baneh pynim biang ïa i khunlung ? Ngan sa leit ha kawei ka sngi sha kaba i don , hynrei im lah da lei lei baneh wan phalang pat sha ar .
translation.en: But now he is dead , wherefore should I fast ? can I bring him back again ? I shall go to him , but he shall not return to me .

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la kylla riewspah bha , bad uwei pa uwei u burom ïa u . U don ki kamra kynsi ba la sha na ka bniat ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , ki musla , ki stieh , bad kiwei ki tiar baremdor jong u .
translation.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;

translation.kha: U Dabid u lah da poi ha ka shnong Mahanaim ha ka por ba u Absalom malade ki Israel ki la dep jam sha Shillong ka Jordan .
translation.en: Then David came to Mahanaim . And Absalom passed over Jordan , he and all the men of Israel with him .

translation.kha: Ka ong , Hangne ka don ka mluh jong nga ka Bilhah ; thiah bad ka , ba kumta kan ïoh khup na ka bna jongu nga . Da kane ka rukom ngan ïoh long kmie lyngba jong ka .
translation.en: And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her  ; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah bakyntang jong me ki longsyiem kum ka ri shyiap ; ka Jerusalem ka long ka tare kynjah ba la pynjot ,
translation.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness , Zion is a wilderness , Jerusalem a desolation .

translation.kha: Katba u dang khajna , don ki briew ki ban satar ïa u bad pynïaid ïa ki mana jong u tad khih ban da poh ka na ba la bah da u kpa Jong u .
translation.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .

translation.kha: U dei ban long uba lehsbun bad uba ieit ïa kaei kaba Bha . U dei ban longsyiem uba shihajar ïa lade , uba beit , u bakhuid , bad uba ni ryntih .
translation.en: But a lover of hospitality , a lover of good men , sober , just , holy , temperate ;
