translation.kha: Naba ki khar ïa ki shyieng bad ki tep ïa ki hapoh uwei u dieng Tamarisk uba ha kata ka shnong , mala ki jingshongthait hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: And they took their bones , and buried them under a tree at Jabesh , and fasted seven days .

translation.kha: U briew baroh un khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka kyrteng jrong pa .’
translation.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .
Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingkmen da ka khubor ka jingpynshlur .
Na phah nonglamktien ban ong ïa ki , Nga dang leh ka kam badonkam bad ngam lah don leit hiar shata . Ngan ym shah ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam tang namar ban rupa ïashad ïa phi .
translation.en: And I sent messengers unto them , saying , I am doing a great work , so that I cannot come down : why should the work cease , whilst I leave it , and come down to you ?
And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa ki rangbah kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh ka bynta ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .

translation.en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga .
Wat teh ïa ka ïing jong phi bad pynskhem ïa ka longïing tad haduh ban pynphriang ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad phi thikna ba phi lah ban kamai ha ka jingim .
translation.en: Prepare thy work without , and make it fit for thyself in the field  ; and afterwards build thine house .
Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the  Lord  an heave offering in your generations .
translation.kha: Pateng la pateng , ïa kane ka jingai kaba kyrpang dei ban ai sha U  Trai  na u kpu ba phi shet .

translation.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el . ( Now the name of the city before was Luz . )
translation.kha: Ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Bethel , kaba ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Lus . U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki . Ki la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha ka nongbah ,

translation.en: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .
translation.kha: Haba ka Martha ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan , ka la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u , hynrei ka Mari ka la sah ha ïing .
Katba u lyoh u dang neh sah hajuh , ki ruh kim kynriah na ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .

It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar ba-halor tam ban ibeiñ ïa U Blei uba im . To ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynshitom ïa kito kiba kren ha ki . Kumta duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki briew kiba lait im .
To ai ba ka jingkynrum jong phi kad pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jongki ph , bad to duli ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;

translation.kha: Ngi ong ïa kane Naaman ngi don ka jingsngewskhem ha U Blei lyngba U Khrist .
translation.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward :

translation.kha: Un shim sa ïa kamai pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u saiwul kaba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .
translation.en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka Hukum ka longïng kaba kynja mynsiem ; hynrei nga long u briew uba kynja deng , ba la die kum u mraw ha ka jop .
translation.en: For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .

translation.kha: Namar ba U Bel u la pynlong ïa nga kaba tlot bad u ngi lah leh ei ei , ki pait pyrshah ïa nga da ka jingbitar jongnga ki baroh .
translation.en: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me , they have also let loose the bridle before me .
The  Lord  taketh my part with them that help me : therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  uba ïarap ïa nga ; bad ngan ïohi ba ki nongshun jong nga ki shahjop .

translation.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u bad u la ai ha ki ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman bad ban pynkhiah ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingpang bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshitom .

translation.en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
translation.kha: u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;

translation.en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor kawei na ki lieng — kaba long ka jong u Simon — bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ñiat tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shong ha ka lieng bad u la hikai ïa u paidbah .

Kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai u la noh lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa ha ka por mynba ka Jerusalem ka dang manbha bad dap da ki bynriew bad manbha dang don bun ki briew kiba shon basah ym tang ha ki shnong sawkyr-ang ïa ka nongbah hynrei kumjuh ruh ha ka phang bashathie bad ha ki kjat lat ha ka phang sepngi .
translation.en: Should ye not hear the words which the  Lord  hath cried by the former prophets , when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when men inhabited the south and the plain ?

translation.kha: U Blei u tyrwa ha me ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me Dang kyntait ïa ka ? Neng la ïakren bad u ha ki ktieh bajhieh jai .
translation.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?
His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .
translation.kha: Ka leilieh jong u ka pynshai ïa ka pyrthei ; ka khyndew ka ïohi ïa ka bad ka khynñiuh .
Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki , Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la anna bad phi , ngat ka sngi kaba nynkong ba nga la pah ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,

translation.kha: Ka jingtur ïaleh ka la sdang ha ka Por shiteng sneng katba u Benhadad bad ki Nepheg ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïadih buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .
translation.en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .

translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Kumta te Phon Lah ban khem sha shiliang Wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa sakma ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit shok .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingsuh bam kaba dadien da u purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : sa kilo u pyrthiew lem bad uei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u pura lem bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram  ;
And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
translation.kha: U Noah , uba long u nongrep , u long u briew uba nyngkong eh ban thung ka bri sohwaiñ .
Ha ka phalang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka par lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u suhsieng shad sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .
translation.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ki la kynti ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la bud ha kylleng lait noh tang shiah ka shnong jong u bad da naba ha ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .

translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab , Nga daym uei keiñ malade khie ka longïing jong nga ba ngan oh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?
translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
And the Jews  passover was nigh at hand : and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover , to purify themselves .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan , bad bun ki briew ki la leit kiew na ki nongkyndong sha Jerusalem ban pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam .
Ko ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , ïa ki jingkynshew bakoit jong phi la lute .
translation.en: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !

translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na phi un ino ha nga , Lada kane ka long kumne , kumno U Blei un shem jingkñia badno badno ? Uei umbiah lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?
translation.en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?

translation.kha: u nguh ha lade , ‘ nur leit peiñ patar sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phai pat nabar u shem ba ka ïing ka tyllai , ka khuid , bad baroh la buh ryntih .
translation.en: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .
translation.kha: Te kumta ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jong phi , bad ngin ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .

translation.en: Each time you go to the Kingdom Hall , become acquainted with one of the elders or ministerial servants until you get to know all of them and their families .
translation.kha: Man ba phi leit sha ka Ïing Hima , pyrshang ban ithuh ïa iwei na ki rangbah balang ne nongïarap balang haduh ba phin da ithuh lut ïa ki bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong ki .

U Troas u ong , Ka dei ka mon jong nga ba un shahïap pynshitom ; ka jingïap lad u ka long ka jingkñia ban wanrah ïa ka jingmap-ei . Bad kumta un ïoh ïa la ki khun ki ksiew ; un ïoh ïa ka jingrem kaba jlan , bad lyntang jongngi u ïa ka jingthmu jongnga at yn pyndep .
translation.en: Yet it pleased the  Lord  to bruise him  ; he hath put him to grief : when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin , he shall see his seed , he shall prolong his days , and the pleasure of the  Lord  shall prosper in his hand .

translation.kha: Katba da ki hajar ngut ki briew ki dang ïalumlang , ba kumta ki la ïa-ïuh Para ma ki , U Jisu u la ong Nyngkong ha la ki synran , To sar na u thiat jong ki Pharisi — la mut ïa ka jingarsap jong ki .
translation.en: In the mean time , when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people , insomuch that they trode one upon another , he began to say unto his disciples first of all ,  Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees , which is hypocrisy .

translation.kha: Wai ai ba kan shah pyndap ha ka ri nongwei , jngai na U Trai . Balei u syiem Jesreel un wan ban pynsep ïa u thala kum ïa nga ? Balei un beh ïa nga kumba beh ïa ka bai khlaiñ ?
translation.en: Now therefore , let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the  Lord  : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea , as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains .

translation.kha: hynñiew sngi ki lyngdoh kin pyniwtung ïa ka reng bad pynbiang ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam .
translation.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it  ; and they shall consecrate themselves .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingkrenbeiñ jong ki kim lah ban pynjam ïa nga namar ba U Trai Nongsynshar u ai jingïarap ïa por . Nga pyneh ïa lade pun ïajah ïa ki . Ngi tip ba ngan ym shah pynjahburom ,
translation.en: For the Lord  God  will help me  ; therefore shall I not be confounded : therefore have I set my face like a flint , and I know that I shall not be ashamed .
How long wilt thou go about , O thou backsliding daughter ? for the  Lord  hath created a new thing in the earth , A woman shall compass a man .
translation.kha: Haduh katno phin pynslem , ko ki briew bym don jingngeit ? Nga la thaw kaei kaei kaba thymmai bad kaba pher , kaba pher kum ka briew kaba ïada ïa u briew .
Don ruh ka Libnah , ka Ether , ka Ashan ,
translation.en: Libnah , and Ether , and Ashan ,
But I have all , and abound : I am full , having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you , an odour of a sweet smell , a sacrifice acceptable , wellpleasing to God .
translation.kha: Hangne , te , ka long ka jingïohpdiang jong nga ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi la ai ha nga — bad ka la long palat ban ïa kaba nga donkam! Nga don ïa baroh kaba nga donkam mynta ha kaba u Epaphroditos u la wanrah sha nga ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh jong phi . Ki long kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih sha U Blei , ka jingkñia kaba pdiang hun bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .

Hynrei ka jingkynthoh bakynjah ka ïathuh ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kiwei ka don shiah ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumto ïa ka jingjai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist la ai ïa kito kiba beit .
translation.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .

translation.kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumba la ainong ; ki shim ar tylli ki phasi kynthei bad ki teh ïa ki ha sier ka kali , malu ki set ïa ki khun masi ha sem .
translation.en: And the men did so  ; and took two milch kine , and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home :

translation.kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki , Ko samla , pa la ïatih ei ei ? Ei ei ruh em , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Then Jesus saith unto them ,  Children , have ye any meat ?  They answered him , No .
And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times , and strength of salvation : the fear of the  Lord  is his treasure .
translation.kha: U ïada borabor ïa la ki briew bad u ai ïa ki ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Ka jingkynshew spah bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la jubab ,  Phi kiba jaipdeh bad phim kwah ban treikam , bad dei kata balei ba phi kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ïa phi ban leit bad ai ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .
Kiba matlah kin lah ban ïohi , bad kiba kylli kin ïohsngew .
translation.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened , and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped .
Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board .
translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker kan long saw mitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang ,
Pynban ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , u briew u longïng uba donkam ïa ka briew kumba ka briew ka long kaba nongkam ïa u briew .
translation.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman , neither the woman without the man , in the Lord .
Behold , I stand here by the well of water  ; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water :
translation.kha: Hangne nga don harud kane ka pukri ha kaba ki samla kynthei jong ka nongbah kin sa ïawan tong um .

Katba ngi dang shong ha kano ka ïingjaiñ kaba na kane ka khyndew , ngi ud sati da ka jingsngew ba shat banbeiñ ; kam dei ba me kiaw ban wai nep na ka randien kaba na ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah banbeiñ ïoh noh ban phan da kata kaba kynha bneng , khnang ba ïa kata kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla duriaw noh da kaba im .
translation.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .

translation.kha: Lydia U Blei u ïakhmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kane kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?
translation.en: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?

translation.kha: Wat ai por ïa ki shipai ban siat ïa ki khnam ne ksing ïa ki artatien ïaleh jong ki . Wah pyllait ïa ki samla shynrang ! Pynjot ïa ka kynhun shipai barieh kawei !
translation.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .

translation.kha: Ym bat ïa uno uno u briew naba ïapyrshang na u Aaron , u lyngdoh , suba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .
translation.en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : he hath a blemish  ; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God .

translation.kha: U Blei u ïong ha u Balaam , Wat leit malu ki , Bad wat buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Jeruel , namar ki don ïa ka jingkyrkhu jngai at .
translation.en: And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them  ; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ïong ha u Jehoash , Jied katto katne jrut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïateh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïeng ha kliar u lumlang da kaba bat ïa u diengthew ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .

translation.kha: Ïa ki rmiang jyllang ki shalyntem la tap da ki khamtam .
translation.en: As for their rings , they were so high that they were dreadful  ; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four .

translation.kha: Ki riewshlur bakhraw tam bad kito kiba ïateh na ka liang ka Ijipt , ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nong Ijipt sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki ïa-pyrta : Ki bymriewblei kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ki la Wan hiar shane malade hangne ki thoh !
translation.en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him : they are gone down , they lie uncircumcised , slain by the sword .

Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi ki Lebi ki leit rah ïa kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaidkam u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha man ba ka dap , u sekretari syiem bad u nongmihkhmat ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei shabar ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka synduk ha ka jaka jong ka . Bad kumta ki la ïohlum shibun ka pisa .
Nga khiah ban wai kali , pyndei ki dor sien .
translation.en: I want to rent a car , please show me a price list .

translation.kha: Ka la longïng palat ban ïa kaba ngi la khmih lynti! Nyngkong ki la aiti ïa lade ha U Trai ; bad nangta , da ka mon U Blei ki la aiti ïa biar ha ngi ruh .
translation.en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .

translation.kha: Ha kaba khaweh , kito kiba kwah ïa u Omri ki la jop ; u Tibni u la ïap bad u Omri u la long u syiem .
translation.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath : so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .
Then said these men , We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel , except we find it against him concerning the law of his God .
translation.kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngin ym shem kano kano da kaba ngi lah ban kynnoh ïa u Daniel lymda dei kaei kaei kaba ïasoh bad ka niam jong u .

translation.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the  Lord  to Mizpah  ;
translation.kha: U Samuel u khot lang ïa ki briew sha ka jingïalang niam ha Mispah ,

translation.en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka dak bad u shem ba u shñiuh uba hangta um pat kylla lieh , bad ba kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .

translation.en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada baroh kin wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga , ngan ym shem wat tang uwei ruh na ki ba u long uba stad .

translation.en: And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .
translation.kha: Ki nang ruh ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka por ha kaba kyntiap na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat ; hynrei kaba kham sniew , ki nang ban ïa-lorni bad pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban kren .

U bnai un sa shai phyrnai kat ka sneng , bad ka sngi kan shai phyrnai hynñiew shad ban ïa kaba ju long , kum ka jingshai jong ki hynñiew sngi ha kaei ka sngi . Kane baroh kan jia hajuh U Trai un sop spaiñ bad pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong kiba u la ai ha ki briew jyllang u .
translation.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun , and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold , as the light of seven days , in the day that the  Lord  bindeth up the breach of his people , and healeth the stroke of their wound .

translation.kha: Kumta myntor , ma nga , U Trai nongbanbor Beor , U Blei ki Israel , ngan wallam halor jong phoi ki bastad Judah bad Jerusalem ïa baroh ka jingpynjot kob nga la pynkulmar . Ngan leh ïa kane namar phim shym la shahshkor hab nga la kren ha phi , malu phim shym la jubab haba nga la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them : because I have spoken unto them , but they have not heard  ; and I have called unto them , but they have not answered .

translation.kha: To ïarieh ïa u namar ïa kiei kiew kiba khraw kiba u la leh . To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ba-halor tam jong u .
translation.en: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
And they answered , We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment , and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki jubab ,  Ngin ai ïa ki ha phi da kaba sngewbha .  Ki siang kawei ka jaiñ , bad uwei pa uwei u buh hangta ïa ki sohshkor ba u la shim .
U la khot lang ïa ki khatphra thut ki synran bad u la phad ïa ki ar ngut ar ñiut . U la ai ïa ki ka bor halor ki mynsiem bymkhuid
translation.en: And he called unto him the twelve , and began to send them forth by two and two  ; and gave them power over unclean spirits  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kambah bud , u Moses u dang pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng u paidbah , bad kumta u la bunktien naduh mynstep haduh ban da miet .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .

translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongpop kin kit hi ïa ka jingpynjahburom ; ai ba kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jrong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .

translation.kha: Ar ne lai ngut kiba ïoh ïa ka khubor U Blei ki dei ban kren , kabu kiwei pat kin bishar ïa kaei kaba ki kruiñ .
translation.en: Let the prophets speak two or three , and let the other judge .
For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Haba ki hynñiewphew snem jong ka Babilonia ki la kut , ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga na ka bynta jong phi bad bat ïa ka kular jong nga ban wallam pat ïa phi sha ïing .

translation.en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .
translation.kha: U Samuel u mihnoh na Gilgal bad u leit la ka lynti . Kiba sah na ki briew ki la bud ïa u Saul katba u dang leit ban ïasoh bad la ki shipai . Ki leit na Gilgal sha Gibeah ha ka thain Benjamin . U Saul u leit peit ïa la ka kynhun shipai , kiba don kumba hynriewspah ngut .
Ka kyrteng jong kata ka kynthei ka dei ka Kisleb . U Sur , u kpa jong ka u long u rangbah bajhieh jong kawei ka kynhun ki jait Midian .
translation.en: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .

translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki lad u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u ktien lehkmen !
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: Khmut u Pilat u la longing shabar sha ki bad u la kylluid , Phi ïamudui aïu ïa une u briew’ ?
translation.en: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?
Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?
translation.kha: Khie leit bad khmih ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Nangta ïai leit sha ka nongbah bakhraw ka Hamath bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judah bad Israel ? Hato ka ri jong ki ka kham heh ban ïa ka jong phi ?

Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki phai shajan , ki ioh ïa ka tdem kaba kiei sha suiñbneng . Ym don lad shuh ba kin lait im , naba ki Israel kiba la pui sha ka jaka byrsha mynta ki phai kylla ban ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and , behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way : and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers .

translation.kha: Te uwei pa uwei un sa sngewkwah ïa Kata bad un sngewsheptieng , bad yn ym don hajuh uba nud baneh leh kumta .
translation.en: And all the people shall hear , and fear , and do no more presumptuously .

translation.kha: Kumba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei ibha im , nga maham ïa phi ba ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan pynsynjor halor Jong phi da ka kthang ti kaba khlaiñ , da ka bor jongno nga baroh .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :
And he said , This is wickedness . And he cast it into the midst of the ephah  ; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ,  Kane ka kynthei ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jingbymman .  Nangta u ñiat ïa ka sha tbian shapoh jong ka shang bad u tap pat shapoh ïa ka jingtap .
U Joseph u ïaishong ïathiah ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kob u kpa jong u , u la shong la sah ,
translation.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: kumto u Jehoram u rupa sha Menna bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , ha kaba ka kynhun shipai Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki . Ha ka por mynleh ma u bad ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki kali ïapmat ki la ïohlum ban wai bad ki phet ïap , dara ki shipai jong u ki phut sakma sha ki ïing jong ki .
translation.en: So Joram went over to Zair , and all the chariots with him : and he rose by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him about , and the captains of the chariots : and the people fled into their tents .

And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness , and shall uncover her nakedness  ; he hath discovered her fountain , and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood : and both of them shall be cut off from among their people .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , dei ban tait noh ïa ki baroh ar ngut na la ki parabriew , namar ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingbymkhuid .
ngat ki Israel ki phah nonglamktien sha u Gihon , u syiem Amor ha Hephsibah , ban pan jingtah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jrong u sha ka ri la jong .
translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , the king of Heshbon  ; and Israel said unto him , Let us pass , we pray thee , through thy land into my place .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingim jong u ha khnai ka pyrthei , U Jehu u la Duwai bad khiat kyrpad da kob pyrta jam bad ïam ha khmat U Balei , uba ia ngab pyllait ïa u na ka jingïap . Namar ba u long uba sngewrit bad aiti lut , U balui u la shahshkor ïa u .
translation.en: Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;

translation.kha: Me la pynurlong ïa ki Israel ki briew jong me junom , Bad me , ko Trai , me la long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever  ; and thou ,  Lord  , becamest their God .

translation.kha: U Amasa u la leit khot ïa ki , Hynrei um shym tad ha ka por ba u syiem u la buh .
translation.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah : but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him .

translation.kha: Khmut u Heman u wan hakpoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u , Don ibha nga kajuh eh ban lehburom . Kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta une u briew ? U Hammath u la pynkoit ha lade , myntri ïano u syiad u khwai eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa nga keiñ .
translation.en: So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?

translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jongngi ka dorbar jong ka nongap bad u la noh , Nga ïohi ba ha ki buit baroh ma phi ki nongai Athens phi long kiba kit niam bha .
translation.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars  hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .
And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?
translation.kha: bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Me don hok aïu ba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ka jingkular ha u Abraham , u la smai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular . Namar ym don uwei ruh u ban kham khraw ban ïa u , u la pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka kyrteng haba u la pynlong ïa la ka jingsmai .

translation.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
translation.kha: U paidbah u dei ban ñiew ba u lyngdoh u long uba khuid , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U  Trai  ; nga long uba khuid , bad nga pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .
A Trai me la ai ha ngi ïa ki aiñ jong me bad me la ong ïa ngi ba-bang kohnguh biang bajrong ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim kin Sakhi ïa me , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ki don ban ong .
translation.en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
He brought them forth also with silver and gold : and there was not one feeble person among their tribes .
translation.kha: Nangta u pynmih bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel ; ki rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad baroh ki la long kiba koit kiba khiah bad kiba khlaiñ .
U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi! , malu un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kitab phira la ïohi ïa u ba u ni ha Ijipt
translation.en: The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba kwah ban riewspah ki hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ki ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki jingkwah ba-bieit bad ki jingkwah ba-pynmynsaw , kiba tan ïa ki shai ka jingbieit bad ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .

translation.kha: Hangta hi U Trai u la bitar lep ïa u Ussah bad u pynïap ïa u nalor ba u ktah ïa ka synduk . U ïan hangta ha khmat U Blei ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza , and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark : and there he died before God .

translation.kha: Haba kita ki briew ki ïew ba u syiemsad um shukor ïa ki , ki pyrshah dam , Keiñ noh ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aiwai na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Eliel , ïa ngin ïaleit noh shwa la ïing ! Ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi na ka bynta ïa lade! . Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaleh pyrshah ,
translation.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to your tents , O Israel : and now , David , see to thine own house . So all Israel went to their tents .

translation.kha: Jaban u la ïai kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid na kata ka thain .
translation.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country .

And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet noh na surok bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . U Balaam u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .
Shisyndon U Mynsiem u la pynphong ïa u ba-bang leit sha ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ngam la sai bad shon muhor ïa ka dulir , bad la sakhi ïa ka , badno la thew ïa ka pisa ha ka tharai .
translation.en: And I subscribed the evidence , and sealed it , and took witnesses , and weighed him the money in the balances .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Tharai u kyrshan ïa nga ; U Blei jong nga u ïawad ïa nga .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .

translation.kha: Phi la shem ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ki donkam ïa ka jingshna pynbha . Phi la leit khem ïa ki ïing baroh ha Israel bad phi la pynkhyllem katto katne na ki ban ïoh ki maw ba shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jyllang ka nongbah .
translation.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall .
And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart  ; for the  Lord  is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad phi .
Nga da kwah eh ba ki briew kiba pynkulmar ïa phi kin leit baroh shi lyngktar lynti ; ai ba kin nang ïaid bad pynthohbria ïa lade!
translation.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you .

translation.kha: Ki shem ha ka Hukum ka U Trai u la ai lyngba u Moses , ba ka la hukum ïa ki Israel ban shong ban sah ha ki jakarieh bashipor ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Maham Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And they found written in the law which the  Lord  had commanded by Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :
Philip , and Bartholomew  ; Thomas , and Matthew the publican  ; James the son of Alphaeus , and Lebbaeus , whose surname was Thaddaeus  ;
translation.kha: u Philip bad u Bartholomai ; u Thomas bad u Matthaïos , u nonglum khajna ; u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos bad u Thaddaïos ;
U rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun swai : U Benaïah , u khun jongnga u Jehoïada Ki lyngdoh : U Sadok badno u Abiathar
translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :

translation.kha: Haba u Haman u la mihnoh na ka jingkhawai u la kmen bad dap da ka jingsngewbha . hynne u ïohi pat ïa u mawkordor ha ka khyrdop bad um shym la ïeng lane pyn-i ïano kano ka dak jong ka jingrem haba u ïadoh nangta , u Haman u la bitar ïa u .
translation.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart : but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king s gate , that he stood not up , nor moved for him , he was full of indignation against Mordecai .
And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leit ryngkat bad ki paid Simeon , bad ki la jop ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sephath . Ki la buh ka jingtim halor ka nongbah , ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad ki la ai kyrteng ïa ka , ka Hormah .

Ka long kumne . Uwei u briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa uta ha ka lyngkha jong u . U jingthung u san malu u kylla erlangthari u tieng , dara ki bai ki jingaiti ïa la ki skum ha ki tnat jong u .
translation.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and cast into his garden  ; and it grew , and waxed a great tree  ; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it .

translation.kha: U Trai u ijli ïa kata , haba ki briew bymneh ki ai ki jingkñia ha u , khamtam paila ki leh ïa kata na ki jingthmu bymman .
translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination : how much more , when he bringeth it with a wicked mind ?

translation.kha: A Trai , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïaksaid bad me na ka bynta ki nongshoh-nar jong nga mynbarim ki don ha ka jingjyrsieh bad jingeh bajur .
translation.en: The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih sha ki mala u la kylli , Aiñ , te , kane ka jingïathuh Bakhuid ka kit jingmut ? ‘ U mut ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na borbah .’
translation.en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?
I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .

Da kob buiñ ïa ki jingai jingmut lad ki , u la ïasuk bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Jahasiel u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth ha Galatia , malu u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
translation.en: He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .

translation.kha: Bun na kito kiba la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto katne kin ïoh ka jingshem bymjukut , bad katno katto kin shuh ka jingjahburom bymjukut .
translation.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .

translation.kha: Te u Abimelekh u pynphai pateng ïa ka Sarah ha u Abraham , pynlang ha kajuh ka por u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot , ki mangi , nabar ki mraw .
translation.en: And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .
Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa lade hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u pyrkhat ba u long uba stad da ka jingthew jong kane ka pyrthei , u dei ban long uba bieit khnang ba un long uba stad da shisha .
U Judia tang mar ïapom , u la leit sha U Jisu! bad u la ïa-ong , Ko Nonghikai ! bad u la dohnud ïa u .
translation.en: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .

And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , namar jong u Joseph , U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing longsem jong u nong Ijipt , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jong u .

translation.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .
translation.kha: ( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dei u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun jong u Nahash bad ka para jong ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )
baroh keiñ kiei kiba u Nadab u la leh , la thuh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
Baalah , and Iim , and Ezem ,
translation.kha: ka Baalah , ka Iim , ka Esem ,
Kumba ka jingthaw Bakhuid ka ong , Phi la shem da put haduh katno U Bela u long uba sbun .
translation.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious .

translation.kha: u Adonijah , uba ka kmierad jong u ka dei ka jingïateh ; u Shephataïah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abital ;
translation.en: And the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith  ; and the fifth , Shephatiah the son of Abital  ;
If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
translation.kha: Mem ngeit ïa nga haba nga ïathuh ïa me shaphang kiei kiei jong kane ka pyrthei ; kumno men lah ban ngeit ïa nga , te , haba nga ïathuh ha me shaphang kiei kiei jong ka bneng ?
Yn don hi man la ka por ki Israel kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .
translation.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .

translation.kha: Ha U Khrist bad da ka jingkyntait jong ngi ha u ngi don ka jingsleh ban leit sha ka jingdon rynsied U Blei da ka jingsngewskhem baroh .
translation.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .
And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him .
translation.kha: Naduh kata u Judas u la khmih ïa ka lad kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu ha ki .

To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khuid ha ki pud baroh bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingkem , bad ka met — kaba lait na kano kano ka jingijli ha ka jingwan jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trei jong ngi .
translation.en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , waiñ salia u nongrahbor u lai baneh pynsah im tang uei i khun masi bad ar tylli ki blang ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a man shall nourish a young cow , and two sheep  ;
And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .
translation.kha: Kumta don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u kylli ïa la ki khun .  Balei phi shu ieh ïa uta u briew ? Khie leit khot ïa u ban ïabam bad ngi .

Nangta ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u Balak u la ïohi ïa ki Adrammelekh , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïapyrshah : U Amalek u long ka jaitbynriew Kaba khlaiñbor tam na baroh , Hynrei ha kaba kut un jah noh wad .
translation.en: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .

translation.kha: U Moses u leit , bad U Trai u ong ha u , Haei leit hiar bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym ngim ïa u pud ban wang khmih ïa nga ; Ladan ki leh kum , bun na ki kin ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u paidbah u la nang kyntur ïa ki , kamet u la hukum ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid . Mynsiem bakyllut bad bampong kren , u la ong , Nga hukum ïa me ban mihnoh na u khynnah bad wat ju rang shuh thah jongu u !
translation.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him ,  Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .

translation.kha: A Trai Nongsynshar , U Blei ki Israel ! nga sngew shlur ban duwai kane ka jingaiei ha me , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane baroh ha nga , u shakri jongno me , bad ba me la ong ha nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga .
translation.en: For thou , O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ? Ki la ïohi lut ïa kiei kiei . Ym to kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba meng shym la pyn-i ha ki .
translation.en: And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .

translation.kha: Kumta u Pilat u la leit shabar sha ki bad u la kylli , Pi ïamudui une ïa ja u bynriew ?
translation.en: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?

translation.kha: Pynban , palat Ban ïa kaei kiei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la ngi don ha kane ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .
translation.en: Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .
Saying , Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name ? and , behold , ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine , and intend to bring this man s blood upon us .
translation.kha: Ngi la ai ha phi ïa ki hukum bapyrkhing ban ym hikai ha ka kyrteng jong une u briew ,  u la ong ;  hynrei peit kaei kaba phi la leh ! Phi la pynphriang ïa ka jinghikai jong phi kylleng ka Jerusalem , bad phi kwah ban pynlong ïa ngi kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u !
Ki ong , ‘ Shen ngi tei pat ïa ki ïing . Ka nongbah ka long kum u khiew shet , bad ngi long kum ka doh hapoh jong u , hynrei la kumto kumno u la ïada ïa ngi na ka ding .’
translation.en: Which say , It is not near  ; let us build houses : this city is the caldron , and we be the flesh .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa u Gog :  Haba kata ka por ka la poi , men sa sdang pyrkhat ïa ka buit sniew .

translation.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands , in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ :
translation.kha: Ha U Khrist la otsher ïa phi , ym da ka jingotsher kaba la thaw da ki briew , hynrei da ka jingotsher ba la pynlong da U Khrist , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglong ba la laitluid na ka bor jong ka pop hi .

translation.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion , they shall roar like young lions : yea , they shall roar , and lay hold of the prey , and shall carry it away safe , and none shall deliver it .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki kyrhuh kum ki sing kiba la pynïap ïa ka mrad bad kiba la rong ïa ka sha ka jaka ha kaba ym don ba lah ban knieh ïa ka na ki .
Ha U Khrist bad da ka jingngeit jongu ngi ha u ngi Don ka jingshlur ban leit sha ka jingdiang ryngkat U Blei da ka jingsngewskhem baroh .
translation.en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .

translation.kha: Te u Abda u la pyntngen ïa ka Bathsheba ka tnga jong u . U la ïathiah shongkha pynlang ka ; bad ka la kha khup shynrang , ïa uba u Dabid u la ai kyrteng u Solomon . U Trai u la ieit ïa u khynnah ,
translation.en: And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife , and went in unto her , and lay with her : and she bare a son , and he called his name Solomon : and the  Lord  loved him .
And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh kin don hangne bad ba ym pat pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .
Wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud kaba rim lane knieh ïa ka khyndew ba longsem trai da ki khunswet .
translation.en: Remove not the old landmark  ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :
To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ki ha phi mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa phi hi .
Hynrei da khongpong , ngim lah ba leh ei ei khlem ki dkhot jong ka met! kiba i kham sliew ;
translation.en: Nay , much more those members of the body , which seem to be more feeble , are necessary :

translation.kha: Ryngkat malade uta u khunlangbrot uba sneng , ainguh kam shi kilo u kew ba la tylliat ni bha ba la khleh lang bad shi lynti ka umphniang Olib kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingtah .
translation.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .

translation.en: And , behold , Saul came after the herd out of the field  ; and Saul said , What aileth the people that they weep ? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh .

translation.kha: Katto katei por hadien , u Samson u leit jngoh ïa la ka tnga ha ka por ot kew , u da rah ïa ka uwei u khunblang . U ong ïa u kpa jong ka , Ngi leit thring sha kamra ka tnga jong nga . Hynrei um shym shah ba un thring shapoh .
translation.en: But it came to pass within a while after , in the time of wheat harvest , that Samson visited his wife with a kid  ; and he said , I will go in to my wife into the chamber . But her father would not suffer him to go in .

translation.kha: Haba ka bri kan sa kha khun , ka sngewsih namar ba ka kynta jong ka jingshahshitom Jong ka , ka la poi ; hynrei haba la kha ïa i khunlung , ka klet noh ïa la ka jingkhah shitom , namar ka kmen ba la kha ïa i khunlung sha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .
Make no friendship with an angry man  ; and with a furious man thou shalt not go :
translation.kha: Wat ïalong paralok bad ki briew kiba domriang , kiba khong khong .
Lada phi bet ïa ki symbai ka jinglonghok , ka jingpynjot sa mih , bad ka jingbanbeiñ jong phi ïa kiwei kuna kut noh .
translation.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .

translation.kha: U la pynpoi patan ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar mala rupa jong ka Templ katba u Nebukhadnessar u la rah na ka Templ ha Jerusalem nabar buh ha ka templ ha Babel . U Sardis u la aiti ïa kyang ki kiew ki pdiang ha u briew uba kyrthat u Sheshbassar , ïa babha u la thung kum u laiñ ka Judah .
translation.en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem , and brought them into the temple of Babylon , those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar , whom he had made governor  ;

translation.kha: Te phim don rupa banbeiñ sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan ym leh jubor ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .

translation.kha: Ki nongwankai kiba sah hangta ki ïai-ong , ‘ ngi la Pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ka Babilonia , hynrei ka la dier palat . To ngin ieh ïa ka mynta bad ngin leit phai noh sha ïing . U Blei u la pynbudnam ïa ka Babilonia da ka bor jong u baroh bun u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka .’
translation.en: We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed : forsake her , and let us go every one into his own country : for her judgment reacheth unto heaven , and is lifted up even to the skies .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi baroh ba ym don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khop sngewbha ki ba ïohmad ïa ka jingmap miet jong ang !’
translation.en: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .

translation.kha: Kumta , ko ki rangbah , to sngewnguh shlur ! Nob nga shaniah ha U Blei ba kan long thik kumba la ïathuh ha nga .
translation.en: Wherefore , sirs , be of good cheer : for I believe God , that it shall be even as it was told me .

translation.kha: Ngin ioh khup ïa ki markordor kiba lah rukom bad pyndap ïa la ki ïong da ki mar lute !
translation.en: We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :

translation.kha: A katno kiba kmen long kito ki shakri kiba u kynthih jong ki u shem ba ki dang peitmat bad kiba la kloi haba u wan ! “Nga ong ha phiah , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ki ban shong , bad un shakri ïa ki .
translation.en: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .
Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .
translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot ïa ki riewstad bad ïa ki nongleh myntor jong u , bad ki ruh ki leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki .
Hynrei ha ka snem kaba sanphew phi lah ban bam ïa u sohkew . Lydia phi leh ïa kane baroh , ki jingshoh jongki phi kin seisoh kham buiñ . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .
Therefore the  Lord  stablished the kingdom in his hand  ; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents  ; and he had riches and honour in abundance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa u Jehoshaphat ka jingsynshar baskhem halor ka hima Judah , bad baroh ki briew ki wallam ki jingai sngewbha , ba kumta u long uba riewspah bad ïoh ïa ka burom bakhraw .
Ko ki parabangeit jong na : Nga hi nga sngewskhem ba phi dap da ka jingbha , ba phi Don ka jingtip baroh , bad ba phi la banbeiñ hikai iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .

translation.kha: hangtai nga don harud kane ka pukri ha kaba ki jingkam kynthei jongngi ka nongbah kin sa ïawan tong um .
translation.en: Behold , I stand here by the well of water  ; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water :

translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ïa u Jakob , sngewbiang wan kham hajan , ba ngan da ïohktah ïa phi . Hato phi dei shisha u Iso ?
translation.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .

translation.kha: Ha man ba phi leit hakpoh ka nongrit bad la pynhieng sngewbha ïa phi , bam ïa kaei kaba la thuh ha khmat jong phi ,
translation.en: And into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you , eat such things as are set before you :

translation.kha: ma u dara ki rangïapom synshar jong u ki rai ban ot nong ïa ka jingpynshoi um shabar ka Nongbah khnang ban ïakhlad ïa ki nong Assyria ban ïoh um ianga ken poi ha Israel . Ki rangbah synshar ki ïalumlang ïa u paidbah babun banbeiñ ïamih bad ban set noh ïa baroh ki ñiuhlieh , khnang ba yn ym don um ka ban tuid sharak na ki .
translation.en: So there was gathered much people together , who stopped all the fountains , and the brook that ran through the midst of the land , saying , Why should the kings of Assyria come , and find much water ?

translation.kha: Mynba ki thir khlem don batip ha ki lynnong bah , ïa ki durkhmat jongno ki la pynong ha ka jingïap ; ka snier jong ki , ka tyllong kumto ka dieng , ka la sti halor ki shyieng jyllang ki .
translation.en: Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .

And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah kiba lait im kin buhai ha ka ri jong phi . Kin pynbamphlang ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki hangta bad thiah hapoh ki ïing ka Ashkelon . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki un long lem bad ki bad un pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat .
Wai ki nong Ijipt kin kyndit nabar khuslai haba ki tip ba ïa ka Tyros la pynïong .
translation.en: As at the report concerning Egypt , so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa ki shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethnimrah , ha kaba u la rah ïa la ki kti Bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .

translation.kha: kine ki la long ki myn jong kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei mynba u la ap da ka jingsngewskhem ha ki sngi ba u Noah u dang shna ïa ka ïinglieng jongngi u . Ki briew kiba don tyngka khyndiat ha ka ïohnang — phra ngut ha baroh — ki la lait im da ka um ,
translation.en: Which sometime were disobedient , when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah , while the ark was a preparing , wherein few , that is , eight souls were saved by water .

translation.kha: bad U Trai ruh u leh kumba u Moses u la kyrpad . Ki ksaiñ ki phet noh na u Pharaoh , na ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad na ki briew jongnga u ; wat tang uwei ruh um sah Shu .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people  ; there remained not one .

translation.kha: da ka bor jong ki kaweh dara ki jingphylla , bad da ka bor jrong U Mynhynnin jong U Blei . Bad katkum , ha ka jingleit baroh shi lyngkar lynti naduh Jerusalem sha Abimelekh , nga la pynbha pura ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .
translation.en: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .

translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u khih sahit ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh ka Judah yn pynsheptieng na ka pynbha ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa U Trai Badonbor Barukh . Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki Ban rangkynsai ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym ba-don shuh Une uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ Jong U Trai’ Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: ngan maphi noh ïa ki pah ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kob dien bad kaba bha .
translation.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .
There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .
translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei ha ka ri jong phi kaba hap khun lane kaba lyngki . Ngan pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi .

lymne ka pyrthei shalor lymne ka pyrthei sha tbian — ym don kan kano ha ki jingthaw baroh ki ban lah lano lano ruh ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingngeit U Blei kaba ha ngi lyngka U Khreh Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .
Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei lah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingringdur : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khun la kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka long ka Hagar , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong halor u lum Sinai .

translation.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh , what will he do unto those husbandmen ?
translation.kha: Mynta , haba u trai ka bri sohwaiñ u wan , kaei kaba un leh ïa kito ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .
bad u ong ha u Moses , Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te tun ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .

And the three hundred blew the trumpets , and the  Lord  set every man s sword against his fellow , even throughout all the host : and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath , and to the border of Abel–meholah , unto Tabbath .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah jong u Gideon ki dang put ïa la ki turoi , U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun ban tur ïaleh para ma ki da la ki waitlam . Ki la mareh sha Sarethan haduh Beth Shittah , haduh ka nongrit jong ka Abel Meholah hajan ka Tabbath .

translation.en: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood  ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .
translation.kha: Ym don shuh u briew uba hok uba dang don ha ka ri , ym don mano mano baïaineh bad U Blei . Uwei pa uwei u ap ïa ka kabu ban pynïap briew . Uwei pa uwei u behmrad ïa la u para shnong .
Kumta ki la tyrso ar ngut ki rangbah : U Joseph ïa uba la khot u Barabbas ( ïa uba la tip ruh kum u Joahas ) , bad u Matthaïos .
translation.en: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat kin shong hapoh ka jingïadie jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kiew nabar seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pynwan kum ka waiñ jrong ka Lebanon .
translation.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .

translation.kha: Kumta lang phah ka ding ha nongbah Teman , bad kuna thang duh ïa ki Kut ka Baasha .
translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joseph , kiba na ka shnong Merathaim , u la pan na u Pilat lada un shah ban rah ïa ka met U Jisu . ( U Joseph u la longïng u nongbud jong U Jisu , hynrei ym ha kambah paw , namar ba u la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . ) U Pilat u la ong ïa u ba u lah ba-bang rah ïa ka met , kumta u Jehosabad u la leit bad rhah noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .

translation.kha: Ka dadien ïa kane ba U Blei u la khot ïa phi , naba U Khrist hi u la shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi bad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nylla , khnang ba phin bud ha ki dieng jat Jong u .
translation.en: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :

The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .
translation.kha: U kamar u shim shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ïa ka ha ka ding . Ka ksang ti bakhlaiñ jong u ka pynkhih ïa u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .
U Jonathan u jubab , U la kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan shah ïa u ban leit sha Bakhlem .
translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :

translation.kha: Ma phi baïar kiba nga la phah sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shahshkor ïa kaei naba ma ar , U Trai , nga ong .’
translation.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la ong lypa ba U Blei un pynksan ïa ki jingtylliat ha lade hi da ka jingneh . Bad kumta ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ha u Abraham : lyngkha jong me , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: And the scripture , foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith , preached before the gospel unto Abraham , saying , In thee shall all nations be blessed .

translation.kha: Ki la ai ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei kum ki jingkñia ha ki bleithaw jong ka Kane .
translation.en: Yea , they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils ,

translation.kha: Ka tdem ka mih na ki thiaw khmut jong u , bad ka dieng ba bam umdih bad ki bna kiba lym na ka shylluit jngai u .
translation.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils , and fire out of his mouth devoured : coals were kindled by it .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Barsillai u Joab , Ngam don bun snieh Shua ban im ; balei ngan leit dara U Syiem Kynrad shiah Jerusalem ?
translation.en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?

translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw dara ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkynha ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynraiñ jrong u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka Syndong ka rangli .
translation.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,

translation.kha: U ong ha u samla wahbah rah atiar jong u , Sei ïa la ka waitsum bad dung ïarap ïa nga , kumta ba kine ki Philistia bymriewblei kin ym ïoh dung malu pynïap ïa nga . Hynrei uta u samla u la bthing eh ban imat ïa kata . Kumne u Saul u skhem ïa la ka waitbnoh bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .
translation.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through , and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . Therefore Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder  ; for they are hallowed .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh ban weng noh ïa ki khiew buh ding kiba da ka rnong na kiba sah jong ki briew kiba la shah thang bad ban bret ïa u rnga ding na kita ki khiew shaei shaei , namar kita ki khiew buh ding ki long kiba khuid .
Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba um shym la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa put na u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kdup , hynrei na ka jingsuki ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translation.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .

translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pynsat ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh arliang , khnang ba lah don teh shadem ïa ka .
translation.en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .

In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .
translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ba U  Trai  un map ïa nga haba nga synran ïa la u syiem sha ka templ u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U  Trai  un map ïa nga !
Ki ktien hok ki lama kiba lah ban pynngeit , hynrei phi krung khleiñ don jingmad .
translation.en: How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
If any man or woman that believeth have widows , let them relieve them , and let not the church be charged ; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka parabangeit ka don ki riewkynthei ha ka longïing jong ka , ka dei ban sumar ïa ki bad ban ym bankhia ïa ka balang , khnang ba ka lah ban sumar ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long marwei .

Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki la kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab lem bad u Abijah , u para jong u Joab bad u Ittai umbiah na Haggi , kiba long ki nongai lawlynnong ha la ka kynhun kynhun . Bad u syiem u ong ha la ki rangbah , Nga ruh da lat ngan leit lang bad phi .
translation.en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .

translation.kha: U Abner u leit sha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki , La slem bah phi la kwah ïa u Abda ban long u syiem lad phi .
translation.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel , saying , Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you :

translation.kha: Ki Apostol badno kiwei pat ki rynïeng ha kylleng ka Jehudi ki la ïohsngew ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .
translation.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kane ka longkmie kaei kaba ki brisoh ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pei ! Ka bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïaleh pynshah jong ngi !’
translation.en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :

translation.kha: Sin nangta u ong , Nga don hangne ka Kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u ai ha nga . Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translation.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .

translation.kha: Long kiba basbun , malu phin Manoah . Ïarap ïa kiwei , bad yn ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .

There is a man in thy kingdom , in whom is the spirit of the holy gods  ; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom , like the wisdom of the gods , was found in him  ; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father , the king , I say , thy father , made master of the magicians , astrologers , Chaldeans , and soothsayers  ;
translation.kha: U don u briew ha ka hima jong phi uba don ïa u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid hapoh jong u . Mynba u kpa jong phi u long syiem , une u briew u la pyn-i ka jingmut kaba bha , ka jingtip , bad ka jingstad kum ka jingstad jong ki blei . Bad u syiem Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong phi , u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh duh jong ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti .
U Elisha u kylli ïa u Gehasi , Te kaei nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jyllang ka ? U jaboh , Kam don khun shynrang , bun u rnga jong ka ruh u la tymmen .
translation.en: And he said , What then is to be done for her ? And Gehazi answered , Verily she hath no child , and her husband is old .
Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?
translation.kha: ( Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa u nar , khamtam u nar na shatei uba la khleh bad ka rnong . )
U la saiñ ïa ka ryntieh jong u bad u Pynlong ïa nga ka sohpdung ïa ki khnam jong u .
translation.en: He hath bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la tad na ka bynta ka jinglah ba kad shadong , bad ki briew jong U Blei hi ken long kiba nongking banbeiñ shah bishar . Lada ka sdang na ngi , kumno ka kut ha kito ki bym shym ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei ?
translation.en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God : and if it first begin at us , what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God ?
After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .
translation.kha: Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa ka .
Haba u Jehoshaphat u ïohi ïa u Benjamin u par jong u , u ong , Une seh u para Khatduh jongki phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , khun .
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shakri jong nga u pynlong ka jingbthuh lypa , haba nga phan ïa u nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , NGA pynlong ïa kito ki jingshem bad ki jingïathuh lypa ban jia Shishak . Na ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki briew kin shong biang hangta , malade ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn sa tei pat . kti ki nongbah kin ïeng na ki jingjot .
translation.en: That confirmeth the word of his servant , and performeth the counsel of his messengers  ; that saith to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be inhabited  ; and to the cities of Judah , Ye shall be built , and I will raise up the decayed places thereof :
And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .
translation.kha: U tei ka templ ïa u Baal ha Samaria , u shna ka duwan na ka bynta jong u bad u buh ïa ka ha ka templ .

translation.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .
translation.kha: U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu bad kim ñiewburom ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaiñkup ba-itynnat halor jong u bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Pilat .

translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , namar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki briew ha kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki shong ki sah nga la lah pynbna ha ki Israel ba nga ngan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt .

Ka gospel ka ïai wallam ki jingkyrkhu bad ka pa’ kylleng ka pyrthei , kumba ka la long hapdeng jong phi naduh sakma ka sngi kaba phi la ïohsngew jingsuh shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Bela bad phi la tip ïa ka kumba ka long shisha .
translation.en: Which is come unto you , as it is in all the world ; and bringeth forth fruit , as it doth also in you , since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth :
A land which the  Lord  thy God careth for : the eyes of the  Lord  thy God are always upon it , from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khmih sumar ïa kane ka ri bad u ap sumar ïa ka baroh shisnem .

Ngi thmu ba-bang pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh ba la bashrah lieh , ban pynkhyllew ïa ka , bad ban pynpaw shabar ïa ki maw nongrim . Ka khyllem bad pynïap ïa phi barabor . Te uwei uwei baïar un tip ba nga long U Tiras .
translation.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar , and bring it down to the ground , so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered , and it shall fall , and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumba u ïalam ïa ki da ka lyndang kyllaiñ lyngba ka ri shyiap kabu poi sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ki Israel ki long kiba la kieng atiar pun ïaleh thma .
translation.en: But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingshukor kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad satang tylliat ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the two sides westward .
