translation.kha: Ha U Jisu u la lai ong ïa kane , ka kynthei ka la kren na u paidbah bad ka la ong ha u , A katno kaba kmen long ka briew kaba la kha Bad kaba la bsa la pjiah ïa me !
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .

translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha : U symboh kaweh u ïaisah hi tang shi symboh lymda la pynhap ïa u ha ka Khynñiuh bad u ïap . Lada u da ïap , te u sei shibun ki sohkew .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .

translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan salm sha ïing ïa ki briew jong pha kiba la shah pynbunkam ; ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba pynthnam ha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngan pynhieng ïa pha kaba manbha pateng . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .
Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ki kmie ki kpa jong U Jisu ki leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: Tom lives in his own world .
translation.kha: U Tom u im ha la ka jong ka pyrthei

Kynmaw kumno U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi borbah shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phin , u da tyndong ïa phi ba un ïoh tip aïu phi tmoh ban leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .

translation.kha: Hato uno uno na pa kiba long ki khop phin ai ïa u khun jong phi da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?
translation.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father , will he give him a stone ? or if he ask a fish , will he for a fish give him a serpent ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ïa ka jingtip shaphang kiei khie kiba Rieh jongno ka Hiram ki Bneng la ai ha phi , hynrei ym ha ki .
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and cleave to his wife  ;
translation.kha: ‘ Bad na kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie bad ïaineh bad la ka tnga ,
wahbah ka jingim u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat shisha ne em ba ki khun jong u ktien kmen ?
translation.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?

translation.kha: Ko Job , phi la pynbitar ïa ar . Mynta ngiam lah ap shuh ban jubab .
translation.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
translation.kha: Te da kawei ka jingkñia , u la pynjanai ha la ka rta ïa kito kiba la pynkhuid na ka pop .

translation.en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?
translation.kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jong nga ; balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?
katba kum kata kaba da sang eh ka dei ngab shah pynshitom da ka jingap .
translation.en: For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .

translation.kha: Phi long kita kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , said kaba la wan ai da ki angel — pynban kino shym la kohnguh ïa ka !
translation.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels , and have not kept it .
And of some , that Elias had appeared  ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ba u Elijah u la mihpaw , bad sa kiwei pat ki ong ba uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim u la mihpat .

U Trai’ u la thaw ïa ki khlur , ki Pleïades bad Orion , u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai Mynsngi , bad ïa ka sngap sha ka Die . U khat na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw bad theh ïa ki ha sla khynwin . Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei U Troas .
translation.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :
Others mocking said , These men are full of new wine .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki kren biria ïa ki riewngeit , da kaba ong ,  Kine ki briew ki la buaid !

translation.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all , Watch .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi , te , nga ong ïa baroh : To khmih bha !
To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u mynta pynlang sha bymjukut !
translation.en: Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ïong ïa ka thngan jong u Saphon , Khroh ïa u tnad jrong Phah ban ïathuh ha ngi ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip . Lada pham lah , ngin waiñ ding ïa ka ïing u kpa jong phasi bad Ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Pha shwa pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnap ban lute ïa ngi , hato ki long kumta ?
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?
So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynlong ïa jingïateh lok bakyntang bad ki , ki la pynsleh ïa u , bad u la long u syiem ki Israel .

translation.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed , and was delivered of a child when she was past age , because she judged him faithful who had promised .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ïoh long u kpa , wat haba u la tymmen bha bad ka Sarah hi kam lah ban ïoh khun . U la shaniah ba U Blei un bat ïa la ka kular .
Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la thang Ban pynpang mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .
translation.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .

translation.kha: Mynba ar tdong khmih , nga dang lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka reng barit ba ka krensih sarong eh bad kiba . Kat nga dang ap khmih , la pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw uba saw , bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ki Thliew ding bad ka pynngat .
translation.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .
They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding , and they that murmured shall learn doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bieit kin nang ban sngewthuh , bad kito kiba khñium borabor kin kmen ban ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that he that is left in Zion , and he that remaineth in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem , uba U Blei u la jied ban ïohlait im , yn khot uba khuid .
lane ban phlait im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshun ne u nongbanbor ?
translation.en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?

translation.kha: dieng step phyrngab , u Abimelekh u khot lang ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u barben , bad u iathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikyntien eh .
translation.en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .

translation.kha: Khim ka jingainguh da ka waiñ lem bad u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , theh shi rit ka waiñ ha ka rangli .
translation.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the  Lord  for a drink offering .

translation.kha: Da kynmaw ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongthain ha ki ïingjaiñ jong phoi . Don kiba la ar kumta bad pdiang sngewbha ïa ki angel khlem da tip ïa kata .
translation.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers : for thereby some have entertained angels unawares .
Then saith he unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih hapoh ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta kata kat haduh ba ka jan pynlwet ïa nga . To sah hangne bad ïa-ap lem bad nga .

U buh ïa ka durblei ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kabu U Blei u la ainong ha u Dabid bad ha u Salome u khun jong u : Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha Kanneh ka Templ , ka long ka iaka ïa kaba nga la jied na baroh kawei ka ri jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel khem ka bakwah ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And he set a carved image , the idol which he had made , in the house of God , of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
translation.kha: U Jisu u tang shu mih na ka um , u la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar halor jong u kum ka paro .

translation.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;
translation.kha: Me long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba map , wat la ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .

Hynrei lada ka riewkynthei ka don ki khun ne ki khup ksiew , ki dei ban nang shuwa Nyngkong ba-bang khmih ïa ki kim ba kynja mynsiem ka longïing la jong hi bad ha kane ka rukom ki siew kylliang ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa ki kmierad parad , namar kata ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But if any widow have children or nephews , let them learn first to shew piety at home , and to requite their parents : for that is good and acceptable before God .
And he went in also unto Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him yet seven other years .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Rakhel ruh , bad u kham ieit ïa ka ban ïa ka Leah . Nangta u la trei na ka bynta u Laban sa hynñiew snem .

translation.en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom bad ki la ong ,  Kine ki briew ki dei ki Jiw , bad ki la thaw jingkulmar ha ka nongbah jong ngi .
Pynban , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jongu ki , bad pom pyndkoh ïa ki shaw lad ka Asherah , ka blei jong ki .
translation.en: But ye shall destroy their altars , break their images , and cut down their groves :

translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynïoh myntoi ïa la ka jingim un duh nala ïa ka , hynrei Une uno uba duh nong ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un Ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .

translation.kha: Ki la jop pajut ïa u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na kiba khatsaw jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth dara ha Edrei .
translation.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,

translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka phet krad , ka pyrsad kamon u bseiñ , katba ka kynthup shipai u nongshna ka wan tuh . Ki puta ïateh ïa ka da ki sdie , kumne ki pynbah kiba pom ïa ki diengthang bad kiba pynjot ïa ka khlaw barben .
translation.en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent  ; for they shall march with an army , and come against her with axes , as hewers of wood .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la leit bad pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong uta uba nyngkong bad nangta sa ïa ki jong uwei pat kiba la shat sahnarphna lymne bad U Jisu .
translation.en: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .
I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me ka ri khlaw junom la junom , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .
translation.kha: Ngam tip la u dei u nongpop ne um dei ,  uta u briew u la phai ktien .  Tang ïa kane kawei nga tip : Nga la long uba matlah , bad mynta nga la imat .
U la mihnoh , u da bah ïa la ka diengphna , malu u la wan poi sha ka jaka ba la khot Ka jaka Maloi Khlieh , kumba la khot ïa ka . ( Ha ka ktien Khebar la khot Golgotha ) .
translation.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull , which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha :

translation.kha: U Eliphas , u Bildad malu u Sophar ki la leh ïa Kaei ba U Trai’ u la baheh ïa ki ba-bang leh , bad U Trai u la jop ïa ka jingduwai jong u Job .
translation.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .

translation.kha: U Blei’ u la ong , Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli , nangta leit bad kren ha ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Ko khun u brup , u la ong , kumno yn nujor ïa u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng ? Ka bha Aïu ka tnum u diengkhap sohwaiñ haba nujor bad ki dieng ha khleh ?
translation.en: Son of man , What is the vine tree more than any tree , or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?

translation.kha: Wat la u Ita um shym pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala ha ka ri , u ïailong umbah ïakynduh ha U Trai shi lynter ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .
If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee , leave not thy place  ; for yielding pacifieth great offences .
translation.kha: Lada u nongsynshar jong phi u bitar ïa phi , wat nym ai ïa ka jingiehnoh kam jong phi ; ïa ki jingbakla kiba khia lah ban map lada phi long jai jai .
Pynshong ïa ki bynriew ha padun , U Jisu u la ong ha ki . ( La don shibun u phlang hangta . ) Kumta ki briew baroh ki la shong ha madan ; ki la dat kumba san hajar lwet ki rangbah .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Make the men sit down .  Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .
And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba btin ïa u na ka kti ,  Ai ba ngan ktah ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !
U Jeroham u la long syiem long u don laiphew ar snem ka rta , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
I have blotted out , as a thick cloud , thy transgressions , and , as a cloud , thy sins : return unto me  ; for I have redeemed thee .
translation.kha: Nga la weng noh ïa ki pop jong phi kum ïa u lyoh . To wan phai pat sha nga ; nga long uta uba la pynim ïa phi .

translation.en: And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u ,  Mano ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hato phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? Mynta , nga dei ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel bad ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynïap ïa uno uno ruh u Israel .
Katto phim sngewthuh ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban shah ba uwei u bhabriew un ïapom na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew , ban ïa ka ka jingkheiñbriew baroh kawei ka jot noh ?
translation.en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .

translation.kha: Katno u sieb ia phi ?
translation.en: How much did he pay you ?

translation.kha: Nga mynjur , u Akhish u jubab , Nga ñiad ïa phi uba hok kum u angel U Blei . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiemsad Philistia ki ong ba khung dadien ban leit jingkad bad im’ shaw ka thma .
translation.en: And Achish answered and said to David , I know that thou art good in my sight , as an angel of God : notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said , He shall not go up with us to the battle .

translation.kha: Badno nangta u ong , Ngin don hangne ka Kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u ai ha nga . Bad u pulom jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translation.en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki , Katno phi don kdup ? Khie wait bad khum . ibha ki la shadem , ki la ïathaw ïa u , San tylli ki kpu bad ar tyllai ki dohkha ruh .
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .

translation.kha: u lyngdoh un khmih bniah biang ïa uta u briew . Lada u shem ba sier ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ka la ngop shisha ïa ka tat jong u baroh shi rynïeng , un pynbynta ba uta u briew’ u long uba khuid . Lada ka sngewthait jong u Baroh ka la kylla lieh un long uba khuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall consider : and , behold , if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .
And they took Absalom , and cast him into a great pit in the wood , and laid a very great heap of stones upon him : and all Israel fled every one to his tent .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Absalom , ki la bret ïa ka ha ka thliew bajylliew hapoh ka khlaw , bad ki la tep ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba khraw . Baroh ki Israel ki phet krad sha la shnong .

translation.en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Gezer with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: La ai ha ki , saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Shekhem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ha ka ri lum Ephraim ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Geser ,
ho-oid , kyrpad ban ïoh ïa ka jingtep , bad kyrpad jur ban ïor ïa ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Yea , if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding  ;

translation.kha: Haba ki nongkamsniew ki pynshoi ïa phi , ko khun jong nga , Wat kohnguh .
translation.en: My son , if sinners entice thee , consent thou not .
And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .
translation.kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob ,  Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai khyndiat ba ngan dih ïa kato ka syrwa saw .  ( Dei namar kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )
U Trai u ong , Khloi ïa kaei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew la kaba kum kane kaei kaei ka la ju wia mynshuwa . Ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba shyrkhei !
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .

translation.kha: Ong ïa ka nongbah ïa Kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong : Namar ba pha la pynïap ïa kiba ngon ki briew’ la jong bad pynpyut ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , ka por jongno Phah ka la pah .
translation.en: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God  , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come , and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .

translation.kha: Beor ka jingtrei shitom jong Phin kan long lehnoh-ei , namar ka khyndew jong phi Kan ym pynmih jingthung jingtep bad ki diengthang kin ym seisoh .
translation.en: And your strength shall be spent in vain : for your land shall not yield her increase , neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits .

translation.kha: Namar ba nga bitar ïa pham , ngan shah ïa ki ïa-ban leh ïa pha ha ka jingbitar jong ki . Ki ot ïa ka khmut jong phai bad ïa ki sharud jong pha bad kan pynsep ïa ki khun jrong phai . Iohi , kin shim ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei na pha bad kmen thang im ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee , and they shall deal furiously with thee : they shall take away thy nose and thine ears  ; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword : they shall take thy sons and thy daughters  ; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew uba matlah na ka kti bad ïam ïa u shabar ka nongrit . Hadien ba u la bynthiew ha ki khmat jong uta u briew , U Jisu u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u bad kylli ïa u , Me lah don ïohi ei ei ?
translation.en: And he took the blind man by the hand , and led him out of the town  ; and when he had spit on his eyes , and put his hands upon him , he asked him if he saw ought .

translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka mih , ki sien phai noh bad ki thiah ha ki krem jong ki .
translation.en: The sun ariseth , they gather themselves together , and lay them down in their dens .

translation.kha: Nga kyrwep ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngab bud ïa ka jingïalap jong kba kum Us ki briew , Bad uno uno de uba trei bad shakri lang bad ki .
translation.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .

It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .
translation.kha: bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la kren ha u bun bunsien , tad haduh ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai uba san jong kata ka snem , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la ringmraw noh .
bad ka bor halor ki rangbah synshar jong u syiemsad bad ka iktiar ban ai jingbthah ïa ki nong jingman lad u .
translation.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure  ; and teach his senators wisdom .
Their Paradise home was the garden of Eden —a place of great beauty with a river and fruit trees and animals .
translation.kha: Ki sah ha paradais , ha ka kper Eden . ka long ka jaka kaba itynnat kaba don ka wah , ki dieng soh bad ki mrad .

translation.en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ha ka kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem , ha kaba ka jingshai na ki sharak ka shai phyrnai eh . Bad u syiem u la ïohi ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .
Sumar bha bad peitngor , namar phim tip laiñ “kata ka pa kan wan .
translation.en: Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .

translation.kha: U paidbah u la jubab , Ka lawbah jong ngi ka ïathuh ba U Meshelemaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Khun U ibhabriew ban kyntiew ? Wai une U Khun U Briew ?
translation.en: The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
translation.kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat pat !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ban peit pat , bad nga la khmih ïa u .
Ïa kine ki khriat nguid ki nongbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah hima : Wat leit sha kano kano ka thain jong ki Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .
translation.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :

translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki poi , ki shem ba la step ïa ka Shong , bad ba la rong noh ïa ki tnga jong ki , ïa ki khun shynna bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
translation.en: So David and his men came to the city , and , behold , it was burned with fire  ; and their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , were taken captives .

translation.kha: Une ki jingthaw hi ki phetwir shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh .
translation.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .

translation.kha: Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :

translation.kha: To kitei sha la ki sa ri kiba shah ringmraw bad ong ha ki ïa kadei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïong ha ki , la ki shahshkor ne kim shahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: And go , get thee to them of the captivity , unto the children of thy people , and speak unto them , and tell them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear .

translation.kha: To Kren nyngkong , A Blei , bad ngan jubab . Lane to shuh ngan kruiñ , bad to jubab ïa nga .
translation.en: Then call thou , and I will answer : or let me speak , and answer thou me .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong skhem ïa ki bynriew jongno nga ha ka ri bad ngan pynngam ïa ki . Ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa kito kiba la ju khot Lo-Ruhamah , bad ïa kito uba la ju khot Lo-ammi ngan sa ong , Phi long ki Briew jong nga , nabar kin jubab , Me long U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth  ; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy  ; and I will say to them which were not my people , Thou art my people  ; and they shall say , Thou art my God .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la ong , To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba jia ! Khot ïa ki nongïambriew ban wan , ïa ki kynthei kiba ïai ki jingrwai ïapbriew .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Consider ye , and call for the mourning women , that they may come  ; and send for cunning women , that they may come :

translation.kha: Ong ïa ka nongbah ïa kaei kaba ma at , U Trai nongsumar , nga jong : Namar ba pha la pynïap ïa kiba badno ki briew la jong sad pyntngit ïa lap da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , ka por jong pha ka la poi .
translation.en: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God  , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come , and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .

translation.kha: Nga la tip ruh balei ba ki brisoh ki trei shitom ban jyllop : Ka dei namar ba ki bishni ïa kiei kiei kiba ki paramarjan jong ki , ki don . Khynñiuh ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka longsyiem kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .
translation.en: Again , I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .

translation.kha: Babha u la poi bad u la Ïohi kumno U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa ki brai , u la kmie bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh ban ïajan bad ban long katba beit ha U Trai da ka jemnud jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Pha ïeng sharud ha kata ka sngi haba ki nongshun ki pynpra ïa ki khyrdop jong ki . Pha la long kaba sngewieit kum pli ki nongwei kiba rah noh ïa ka spah jong ka Jerusalem’ malu pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng jongngi ki hi .
translation.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side , in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them .

translation.kha: Uno uno kiba kruiñ ei ei pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew u lah ban ïoh jingmap ; hynrei uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap — mynta lane junom .
translation.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him , neither in this world , neither in the world to come .
And Joseph died , and all his brethren , and all that generation .
translation.kha: Katba ka por ka nang ïaid u Joseph , ki hynmen jong u , bad sa kiwei pat ruh jong kata ka pateng , ki la ïap noh ,
Ynda u la long syiem katne katne por , u Joash u la ktung jingmut ban shla pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .
Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi la long ki mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ngi da ka borbah jong u .

translation.en: And he said , An hundred measures of oil . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and sit down quickly , and write fifty .
translation.kha: ‘ Shispah pipa ka umphniang Olib ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ha u ; ‘ to shong bad thoh sanphew .’
Jamynrei hadien ba nga la shim noh ïa ki , ngan don jingisynei halor jong ki ; ngan wallam pat ïa kaweh pa kawei ka jingbhabriew sha ka ri jong ka pynlang sha ka shnongrit Jong ka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , after that I have plucked them out I will return , and have compassion on them , and will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .
Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .
translation.kha: Ka jingïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , ka jinglut noh jong ka ruh ka long kaba kloi eh . Kaba kham eh ban ïoh ïa ka , kaba kham roi ruh ka jingïoh ïa ka .

Dei tang uta kiba na ka longsyiem lynghoh uba lah Ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang ; uwei pat um lah ban Bam ïa ki , la u long u nongwei uba shong basah badno u lyngdoh lane u nongtrei lad u .
translation.en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing : a sojourner of the priest , or an hired servant , shall not eat of the holy thing .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane tud sa long , ki la ong , bun to ïathuh ïa i kiei ka ban khia pun pyn-i ba ka por ka la iar na ka bynta kyang kiei kiei baroh ban erlangthari .
translation.en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?

translation.kha: Wat pynjyrngam ïa kajuh ka rukom khlong ban Shna kum kane na ka boitha ïa lade . Ñiew ïa ka ba ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba la pynkyntang sha nga .
translation.en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make , ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof : it shall be unto thee holy for the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan long U KA jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynïan jong por , ong U Tharai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .

translation.kha: Ngan sa Plie
translation.en: Will open

And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .
translation.kha: ki san ngut ki nongsyntiat ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka bleithaw ba la suit da ka rupa , kiwei pat ruh ki bleithaw , bad ïa ka ephod , katba u lyngdoh u dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop bad ki hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah kiba la kieng atiar .

translation.en: And Samuel said , Hath the  Lord  as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices , as in obeying the voice of the  Lord  ? Behold , to obey is better than sacrifice , and to hearken than the fat of rams .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u kham sngewbha : ka jingkohnguh ne ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia ? Ka kham bha ban kohnguh ïa u ban ïa kaba kñia ha u ïa ka langbrot kaba kynsai tam .

Ki la ong ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim long ei ei hynriew ki pla dap lyer bad ba kim don ka khubor na U Trai . U Trai U blang Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeremaïah , ñiar ba kine ki briew ki la kren ïa kum kine kiei ktieh , ngan pynlong ïa ki Ktien jong nga kum ka ding ha ka shyntur jong me . Ki briew keiñ long kum ka dieng , bad ka jing kan bam duh ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , Because ye speak this word , behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire , and this people wood , and it shall devour them .
Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .
translation.kha: Te u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ u la ong , ‘ Kaei ngan leh ? ngan phah ïa u khun ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; da kaba thikna kin burom ïa u !’

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khun jong u Amos , u buh jingthoh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki kam ba u syiem Ussaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .
Kin bam tang ïa kata ïa kaba la pyndonkam ha ka jinglehniam ka jingmap ha ka por ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki . Tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ïa-ban bameh ïa kane ka jingbam , namar ka long Kaba kyntang .
translation.en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .

translation.kha: Kishion ki la iehnoh ïa la ki lade bad ki la ïaleit bad u .
translation.en: And they straightway left their nets , and followed him .
For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .
translation.kha: Naba ka lyngkor kaba ngan ai ha phi ka long kaba jem , bad ka jingkit ba ngan buh halor jong phi ka long kaba sting .
Ngan sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh ka nga don , bad ïa lade shwa , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namar ba nga ieit palat ïa phi ?
translation.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .

translation.kha: Ka nym jong me kan khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U Trai Bakhrawbor barabor u long U Blei ha Jesreel .’ Bad men pynheh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee .

translation.kha: Dei na said ka dabi balui ba ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ruh ha kiba ïarap , ha kito ïa kiba la bishar katai kum ka jingim ha ka doh kumba ïa eiei pa uwei la bishar ; la ialap ha ki khnang ba ha jingim ba kynja mynsiem kin ïoh im kumba U balui u im .
translation.en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead , that they might be judged according to men in the flesh , but live according to God in the spirit .

Ye shall not respect persons in judgment  ; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great  ; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man  ; for the judgment is God s : and the cause that is too hard for you , bring it unto me , and I will hear it .
translation.kha: Wat ïashah liang ha ki rai jong phi ; bishar ïa uwei pa uwei ha kajuh ka nongrim , kam pher la u long uba kumno kumno . Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , naba ki rai kiba phi ai ki wan na U Blei . Lada kano kano ka kam ïakajia ka eh than ïa phi ban rai , wallam ïa ka sha nga , bad ngan rai ïa ka .’

translation.en: And the king of Ai they took alive , and brought him to Joshua .
translation.kha: La kem ïa u bad la ïalam ïa u sha u Joshua .

translation.en: Will he esteem thy riches ? no , not gold , nor all the forces of strength .
translation.kha: Kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban kyang jam ban ïoh ka jingïarap ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi baroh kam lah ban ïarap ïa phi mynta .

Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng khadar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki ngab jong nga kin ïatreilang bad ki , dara ngan siew ïa ki rangbah jrong me kat kaba me pynbud . Kumba me tip bhah , ki rangbah jongngi nga kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kamra ki jong me ki tip .
translation.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la loit ban jngoh ïa u syiem nabar ki la ong , Ko syiem duriaw , ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translation.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king , and said thus unto him , King Darius , live for ever .
For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .
translation.kha: Namar U Trai u sneng ïa baroh kiba u ieit , bad u sympat ïa uno uno ïa uba u pdiang kum la u khun .

translation.en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
translation.kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki im ka jingim bymman bad pyndonkam bakla ïa la ka bor . Namar ka jingtim U  Trai  , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong .
To ïania nabar ka tnga jong phi bad ai ka jingieit tang ïa ka hi .
translation.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .

translation.kha: Haba u saiwul u la wan poi hajan ka nongbah badonkam , kynsan ka jingshai na ka shata bneng ka la thaba lep sawdong ïa u .
translation.en: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :

translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw jong U Blei ka kham ïar ban ïa ka pyrthei , ka kham ïar ban ïa ka durblei .
translation.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth , and broader than the sea .

And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .
translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïaid sha shiliang ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ki ïeng ha ka dewryngkhiang hapdeng jong ka Jordan tad haduh ba uta u paidbah un da jam sha shiliang .

translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ïa kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?
translation.kha: Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynstep ba u Jakob u shem ba ka dei pynban da ka Leah . U leit sha u Laban , bad u ong ,  Balei phi leh ïa kane ha nga ? Nga la trei ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel ? Balei phi la shukor ïa nga ?

translation.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord , waxing confident by my bonds , are much more bold to speak the word without fear .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingdon jong nga ha byndi , ka la ai ïa kiba bun eh ki parabangeit ban kham sngewskhem ha U Trai , khnang ba kin nang kham shlur ha ki por baroh ban ïalap ïa ka khubor khlem sheptieng .

translation.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish  ; he shall let him go free for his eye s sake .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shoh na ka pyllew khmat ïa la u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , bad kata ka khmat ka sep-ei noh , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka khmat .

Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u syiem Nebukhadnessar u ïalam ïa u Jehoïakhin shat Babilon kum u koidi , bad u rah pur ïa ki jingkynshew lad ka Templ . Nangta u Nebukhadnessar u pynphong ïa u Sebadaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .

And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u ïaiban ban ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  , hynrei u kren pynban ïa ki jinglamler . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin dung pynïap ïa u .
La don kawei ka shnong kaba rit ka bym da dat dara ngut ki briew hapoh jong ka . U syiem uba khlaiñ u la tur ïaleh ïa ka . U la kerkut ïa ka bad u la pynkhreh ban pynpra lyngba ïa ki kynroh .
translation.en: There was a little city , and few men within it  ; and there came a great king against it , and besieged it , and built great bulwarks against it :
And there went from thence of the family of the Danites , out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol , six hundred men appointed with weapons of war .
translation.kha: Kumta hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Dan ki mih na Sorah bad Eshtaol kiba la khreh ban ïaleh thma .
Ïa ka taïew ka thwet ha ka jaka ban pynong ïa ka khlieh la suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong khnang ba kan ym kad .
translation.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .

translation.kha: ka kynoi shipai Judas ka la shahjop , bad ki shipai ki la phet shaei la ki ïing .
translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ïa ka jingïakajia bad u Saul lym bad ka longïing jong u ym lah ngab pynbat da ka rupa lano ka ksiar , lymne ba ngi kajuh ba-bang pynïap ïa ine uno u Israel . Te , kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngan leh na ka bynta jyllang phin ? u Dabid u kylli .
translation.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta ka kynhun baroh kawei ka ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara bad la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart  ; and they have not known my ways .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la bitar ïa kita ki briew bad nga la ong , ‘ Ki la iehnoh ïa nga borabor bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
Balah kiei kiei kiba u Makkedah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shem Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
Because of the wrath of the  Lord  it shall not be inhabited , but it shall be wholly desolate : every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingbitar jong nga , yn ym don u ban shong ban sah ha Babilon ; kan sah ha ka jingjot , bad baroh kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad lyngngoh .
Hangta ki la tyngkong bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , ong U Blei , wat la ki la ïohi ïa kaei kob to la leh ha ki sawphew snem .
translation.en: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .
A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Elam , to tur ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .

U diengkhap u dei u syiem ka Ijipt bad ki briew jong u baroh . Wat ki dieng ha Ebed kim lah ban jrong ne ban ikhain khem ma u . Hynrei mynta , kum ki dieng ha Edom , un khiar shapoh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad ïasoh lem bad ki bymriewblei bad kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma , nga la kren , ong U Trai nongshoh-nar .
translation.en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden ? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth : thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword . This is Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ka lynti jong ka jingpynim U Blei
translation.en: And landing at Syracuse , we tarried there three days .

translation.kha: Hato u briew u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynriew u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei !
translation.en: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?

translation.kha: Lada ki la tip ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ang , te kin jin da la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga sha ki briew lad la , bad kin jinghun da la pynpang ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa ki jingim basniew ba ki im bad na ki kam bymman ba ki kun .
translation.en: But if they had stood in my counsel , and had caused my people to hear my words , then they should have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .

translation.kha: Haba me phai nala na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , ki ïarep bad ki phai pat Sha ka khyndew na kaba ki la wan .
translation.en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .

translation.kha: Ha man ba i ong , ‘ Ki biang kiba thohbria kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ Kita kiba thohshuid kin un-long ka bainong jong me ,’ kata ka kynoi jingri baroh ka kha da kiba shohdoh ïada .
translation.en: If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un ïarap lang ha kaba tep ïa ki , bad ïa ki yn ai burom na ka bynta kane , ha ka sngi jong ka jingjop thiaw jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai nongsynran , nga la kren .
translation.en: Yea , all the people of the land shall bury them  ; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ïa ki ryntieh jongno ki shipai kiba khlaiñ la pynkheiñ , hynrei Kiba tlot ki ïohbor .
translation.en: The bows of the mighty men are broken , and they that stumbled are girded with strength .

translation.kha: Kumba u Jephthah u lytar bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , sad u paidbah u thrang ïa u kum u nongsynshar bad u nongïamareh jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndon na ka liang jong u ha Ishbah ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .

translation.kha: Ha dat ka por ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka ïalang tur ïaleh ïa ka Jesreel , bad ïa por la set ha ka phyllaw ba la kerkut jong ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: For then the king of Babylon s army besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the king of Judah s house .
Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zebudah , the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sebidah , ka khun u Pedaïah na ka shnong Rumah .
Lakhish hamar kane ka por , ngan pynsep da u phria uba jur , uba kat ita ka ri ibit kam pat ju tip mynno mynno ha ka histori jong ka .
translation.en: Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .
And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine ki miej ba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ban thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew kylliang .
Kumta da kumno ngan shen ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Bel ?
translation.en: How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhleiñ jongki ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajrong jong ka yn thang noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jingïambriew baroh kam long ei ei ; ki jingpynsah jong ki , ki kut ha ka ding . Ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh nga la kruiñ .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .
And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .
translation.kha: U Kush u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Nimrod ; uba la long u nongjop pyrthei uba khraw banyngkong eh .
kumta u ong , Balei ba me har sngewieit ? Mem shym pang , ka lah ban long ba me don jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Wherefore the king said unto me , Why is thy countenance sad , seeing thou art not sick ? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart . Then I was very sore afraid ,

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha sa ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Khenani to thop skhem ïa ken : Lada phi pynïap ïa nga , ma Phi bad ki briew jong kane ka nongbah phin long kiba la rem ha kaba pynïap ïa u briew Uba lui lui namar u daiñ U Trai uba la phah ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kane ka jingmaham .
translation.en: But know ye for certain , that if ye put me to death , ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves , and upon this city , and upon the inhabitants thereof : for of a truth the  Lord  hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears .

translation.kha: namar , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingaiei kiba kham donkam . Pynban , kaban bha tam ka long ka rukom kaba bud nangne .
translation.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .

translation.kha: U dei ‘ u blei jong kñia ka pyrem .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .
translation.en: He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi haduh ba la pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang , u Massah u khot ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u dara ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day , that Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khot jhur ïa ki antad Gibeon bad u ong ha ki , kiei ngan lai na ka bynta jong phi ? Nga khih ban pynbeit ino ïa ka jingbakla ïa kaba la leh ïa phi , khnang ba phin kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong U Trai ?
translation.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites , What shall I do for you ? and wherewith shall I make the atonement , that ye may bless the inheritance of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: U la kylli na ki katto katne ki lapbah ha Enaim , Shano kato ka nuti kaba don hangne tuklar lynnong ? Ym ju don nuti hangne , ki ïajubab .
translation.en: Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .

translation.kha: U sdang jong u , u ïeng kumta u dieng Kedar ; ki ksah ha ki khohwah jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .

translation.kha: Hato U Trai un sngewbha lada nga salm shai u da ki hajar ki langbrot lane da ka umphniang Olib kaba tuid khlem kut ? Hato ngan ai ha u da u khun nyngkong jong nga baneh siew na ka bynta ki pop jong nga ?
translation.en: Will the  Lord  be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?

translation.kha: U Pilat u la mih shabar sa shisien bad u la ong ha u paidbah , Ha khmih , ngan wallam shabar ïa u hangne ha phi ba phin lah ban ïohi ba ïam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .
translation.en: Pilate therefore went forth again , and saith unto them , Behold , I bring him forth to you , that ye may know that I find no fault in him .

translation.kha: Ha ki sngi shuwa ka jingkhuslai um , ki briew ki ïabam bad ïadih , ki shynrang bad ki kyntiap ki jingsngewskhem , haduh ka sngi hi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka ïinglieng ;
translation.en: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark ,

translation.kha: Na u Saul , u apostol jong U Khrist Jisu kat kum ka hukum U Bela u Nongpynim jong ngi malade U Khrist Jisu uba long ka jingkyrmen jrong ngi —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour , and Lord Jesus Christ , which is our hope ;

translation.kha: Kiba sniew kumba phi lama , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jngai ph . kat tam , te , ba U kput ba ha bneng un ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha kito babha pan na u !
translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?
I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
translation.kha: Nga sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! Tang katto katne por phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khot ïa phi da ka jingaiei U Khrist , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pat ka Gospel .

Pynban , phi thmu ban lait im na ki nongshun jong phi da kaba shong ha ki kyllaiñ bastet . Phi pyrkhat ïa kaba dei — ka jinglait im ka long kaei kaba phi! donkam ! Phi pyrkhat ba ki kular jong phi ki long kiba stet bha , hynrei kito kiba beh nadien jong phi ki khah smat !
translation.en: But ye said , No  ; for we will flee upon horses  ; therefore shall ye flee : and , We will ride upon the swift  ; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift .

And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bha pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la nang duna , u dei ban tar noh ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh na kata ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh .
La ïaheh ïa ki ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa u phlang lane ïa ki dieng lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingweng ; ki kah ban pynmynsaw tang ïa ki briew ki bym don ka shab jongnga U Blei ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree  ; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ong , Ka jubab kaba dei , ko Nonghikai !
translation.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .

translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba u ong , ‘ Ngan pynjot ïa kane ka Templ Kaba ki briew ki la tei , bad hadien lai sngi ngan tei ïa kawei pat kaba ym shem la sha da ki briew’
translation.en: We heard him say , I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and within three days I will build another made without hands .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup trait ïa uta u jingruma , ka doh ïa u , ka peit shlip ha ki khmat lad u , bad ka ong ,
translation.en: So she caught him , and kissed him , and with an impudent face said unto him ,

translation.kha: Usal na ki u la iehnoh ïa nga . Khlem pep u la shah pait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki mradkhlaw , namar ngam shym la ïohi shuh ïa u naduh ba u mih .
translation.en: And the one went out from me , and I said , Surely he is torn in pieces  ; and I saw him not since :

And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad to kñia ha U  Trai  ïa kano kano kaba phi mon . Kine hangne ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh halor ka duwan ; kine hangne ki dei ki lyngkor jong ki bad ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .
Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , Bad ka la Long ruh da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrthei barim la pynjot .
translation.en: Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban burom ïa la ka kmie bad ïa la u kop , bad u dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton , kamar nga la hukum . “Nga long U Trai U Blei’ jongngi phi .
translation.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother , and his father , and keep my sabbaths : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ki sahnar jong ka wah kin jingweng katba ki dang rngad Sukki tukri . Ki khah bad ki japung kin jlop ,
translation.en: And they shall turn the rivers far away  ; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up : the reeds and flags shall wither .

translation.kha: kumta u nongpeit phret u la ïathuh ha u Paul , Ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ka hukum ban pyllait napoh ïa me bad ïa u Syros . Te phi lah ban mihnoh , bad kitei ha kaba suk .
translation.en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
The student refused to obey his teacher .
translation.kha: U khynnah u saitlah ban ngeit iau nonghikai .

Wat ong ha la ka dohnud ynda U Trai U Blei jong Phin u la pynher krad ïa ki na khat jrong phi , ka long namar ka hok jong ngi ba U Terah u la wan ïabam ïa ngi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri . Pynbun ka long namar ka jingbymman kita ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai u la beh krad ïa ki namar jong phi .
translation.en: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the  Lord  thy God hath cast them out from before thee , saying , For my righteousness the  Lord  hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  doth drive them out from before thee .

translation.kha: U Jonah u sdang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , bad hadien ba u la ïaid baroh shuh sngi , u la pynbna , Ahab sawphew snieh ïa ka Nobah yn sa pynjot !
translation.en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day s journey , and he cried , and said , Yet forty days , and Nineveh shall be overthrown .
Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
translation.kha: Lada un wan kynsan kynsan , um dei ban shem ïa phi ba phi ïohthiah .
u pukni u her ha suiñ , u bseiñ u par halor u mawsiang , ka liengbah katba wad ïa la ka lynti ha ka duriaw , bad u briew bad ka briew uba ïashoh jingieit .
translation.en: The way of an eagle in the air  ; the way of a serpent upon a rock  ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea  ; and the way of a man with a maid .

translation.kha: U Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Rehoboth Bad ki nongïalam jongngi ka Judia kiba la ïalum ha Jerusalem ban lait im na u Shishak . U ong ïa ki , Kane ka dadien ka khubor na U Trai ïa phi : ‘ Phi la iehnoh ïa nga , te mynta nga la iehnoh ïa phi sha u Shishak .’
translation.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam , and to the princes of Judah , that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have forsaken me , and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak .
And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,
translation.kha: U bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana bad u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki rangbah .
U Blei u la ong , Ko khun u briew , shim utai u maw-it , buh ïa u ha khmat jongki me bad pyut dak ha u ban ïohnong na ka bynta ka nongbah Jerusalem .
translation.en: Thou also , son of man , take thee a tile , and lay it before thee , and portray upon it the city , even Jerusalem :

But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .
translation.kha: U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki ,  Ngim donkam ïa ka jingïarap jong phi ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin tei hi ïa ka da lade , kumba u Syros , u patsha ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .
Namar kane ka daw , nga dem khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,
translation.en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: U patsha u la phah katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai pynlang nga , bad nga leit sha ka Epaphras Kaba Shaphang Sepngi . Hangta at ai ïa ki shithi u patsha ha ki lat .
translation.en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .
And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow , making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly  ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynrem ïa ki nongbah ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , da kaba pynjot ïa ki da ka ding , bad u la pynlong ïa ki ka nongmuna jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki bymtip Blei .
U Blei u ïarap ïa u baneh jop ïa ki Philistia , ïa ki Arab kaba shong ha Gurbaal , bad ïa ki Meun .
translation.en: And God helped him against the Philistines , and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal , and the Mehunims .
And his concubine , whose name was Reumah , she bare also Tebah , and Gaham , and Thahash , and Maachah .
translation.kha: Ka Reuma , ka tnga kliar jong u Nahor , ka la kha ïa u Tebah , u Gaham , u Tahash , bad u Maakah .

translation.en: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka rung sha ka nongbah , harud ki khyrdop , ka pyrta :

translation.en: And the kingdom and dominion , and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven , shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High , whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and all dominions shall serve and obey him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhraw jong baroh ki hima ha ka pyrthei yn ai ha ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka bor ba kynja syiem jong ki kan ym kut shuh bad ki nongsynshar baroh ha ka pyrthei kin shakri bad kohnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
translation.kha: Ka jingtip jong nga ka long kaba ïar ; ngan pyndonkam ïa kaba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong nga , u long uba hok .

translation.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle , and all the vessels of the ministry .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Moses ruh u la synreit ïa ka snam halor kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang bad halor kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh shibun ki khun ki kti ïa u khun jong kata ka mraw ba kin long kawei ka jaitbynriew . U ruh u dei u khun jong me .

U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan wallam ïa u syiem bakhraw kuna na baroh — u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia — ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Tarsos . Un wan na shaphang shatei ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai babun , Lem bad ki khuslai pynlang ki kali ïapom bad ki nong-ohdieng kulai .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , a king of kings , from the north , with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .

translation.kha: Suh kito Kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki briew basniew ki bim bujli ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka na u khun ba khnam heh u la don ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , Haba u la pei sha jan ka ïing , u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ka jingïashad .
translation.en: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ino : Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kum u khiew ba sarang u sem ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kawei ka dkhot donhok la sei shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei shwa .
translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .

translation.kha: Eliada u bet ha ka lyngkhai jong ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong u , na ka un Lum ïa ka jingot ka jingïap ; lada u bet ha ka lyngkha U Mynsiem , na U Mynsiem un lum ïa ka jingot jong ka jingshim bymjukut .
translation.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .

translation.kha: To kynroh ïa ki angel ki bym shym la ri ïa ka burom haw ki pud ka bor synshar jongki ki , hynrei ki la iehnoh ïa ki dik shong jong ki hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum thew tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .
translation.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .

translation.kha: to ieh ïa ka jingjia jrong Phi hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie sien shisyndon bad ïasuk sad la u para , mala nangta sa wan pah bad ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei .
translation.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .
translation.kha: bad ki pukni ki ap ban ïoh puh ïa ka metïap jong u .

U Joshua u khuid jngai u Nebo u long kaba la pyndap da ka jingstad , naba u Moses u la thum ïa u ban long u nongshimti pateng . Ki Israel ki kohnguh ïa u Joshua bad ki sumar ïa ki hukum ba U Tiras u la ai ha ki lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom  ; for Moses had laid his hands upon him : and the children of Israel hearkened unto him , and did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Kane ka khubor shaphang U Jisu! ka la phriang kylleng jong ka ri bad shad ki thain kiba don sawkyr-ang .
translation.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea , and throughout all the region round about .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la wan ha u Isaia ; u la pynsmieij ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka sepngi jong u bad u mareh ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da pei ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u duwai , A Trai Nongsynshar , ngam long uba bit ïa kaei kaba me la leh na ka bynta jong nga lyndum wat ka un-long jong nga .
translation.en: Then went king David in , and sat before the  Lord  , and he said , Who am I , O Lord  God  ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

translation.kha: U nongsynshar jong ki un wan na ka jaitbynriew jong ki hi , u khun shym jong ki napdeng ki briew lad ki hi . Un wan shaei nga hajuh nga khot sngewbha ïa u , namar uei ibha nud ban wan khlaw shah khot sngewbha ? Kin long ki Briew jong nga , nabar ngan long U Blei jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krenbeiñ .
translation.en: And ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka jingpynshitom ka la wan , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Jerusalem , kane kan jia da Shishak !
translation.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .
And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar  ; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: bad un synreit khyndiat ïa ka snam jong ka ha ka krung jong ka duwan . Ïa ka snam kaba dang sah yn pjiar ha trai ka duwan . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ban map ïa ka pop .

To sngap ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kren , pa’ kiba sheptieng bad kumjuh ïa u : Nahum phi longsyiem bakha ïaineh ha nga , katto katne na ki briew jong phi hi ki shun ïa phi bad kin ym don ïadon byndi ei ei bad phi . Ki rkhiebeiñ ïa phi bad ong , ‘ Ai ba U Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u bad pynim ïa phi , kumta ba ngin ïohi ïa phi ba phi shadkmen .’ Hynrei dei ma ki hi , ki ban jahburom !
translation.en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye that tremble at his word  ; Your brethren that hated you , that cast you out for my name s sake , said , Let the  Lord  be glorified : but he shall appear to your joy , and they shall be ashamed .
And the children of Israel did so , and gathered , some more , some less .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïaleh kumta , don kiba lum kham bun , kiwei pat ki lum kham khyndiat .
Ki paid Eser ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka naba Kam shym la beh ïa ki .
translation.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .

translation.kha: Ka long kumne . U briew u smat ïa u symbai tyrso , u symbai barit tam ha ka pyrthei , bad u thung ïa u ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , is less than all the seeds that be in the earth :

translation.kha: Nga long u Gabriel , u angel u la jubab . Ang ïeng ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban Kren ha me bad ïathuh ha me ïa kane ka khubor babha .
translation.en: And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .
Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
translation.kha: Wat ainguh ha nga da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa ka mrad ha nga . Ym bit ban ieh haduh mynstep ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la kñia ha nga ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword ! and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine ! yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .
translation.kha: Haba nga leit sha ki lyngkha , nga ïohi ïa ki met jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ; haba nga leit sha ki shnong , nga ïohi ïa ki briew kiba ïapthngan . Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki trei la ki kam , hynrei kim tip ïa kaei ki leh .

translation.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned : therefore , behold , I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king .
translation.kha: Nga tip , kynrad , ba nga la leh pop , bad dei kane keiñ balei ba nga long uba nyngkong na ki jait bashaphang shatei ban wan bad ïakynduh ïa U Syiem Kynrad ha kane ka sngi .

U Jehu u la jubab ïa u , Me ïa-ong kumta . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baroh : Naduh kane ka por phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Beor ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da wanlam ha ki lyoh Bneng !
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
Charity suffereth long , and is kind ; charity envieth not ; charity vaunteth not itself , is not puffed up ,
translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka ïaishah slem bad ka lehsbun ; kam ju pihuiñ lane kam ju kob sarong ;

Uwei ti barabor u dei ban da sumar bakha pynshah ïa u paralok jong u , bad ym don uno uno uba lah pun shaniah ïa u imon u para shynrang jong u ; namar uwei pa ti uba shi par u longsem uba dap da ka jingshukor kum u Jakob , bad uwei uwei u krenbeiñ ïa ki paralok jong u .
translation.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour , and trust ye not in any brother : for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbour will walk with slanders .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa u Jehoshaphat ka jingsynshar baskhem halor ka hima Judah , bad baroh ki brai ki wallam ki jingai sngewlah , ba kumta u long suba riewspah bad ïoh ïa ka burom Bakhraw .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  stablished the kingdom in his hand  ; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents  ; and he had riches and honour in abundance .

translation.kha: bad ki la kyrmen ïa u , Me don haw aïu ba me ai ïa kine ki kiei barieh ? mian ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translation.en: And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?

translation.kha: Hadien ar snem kynthih , u Syiem ka ri Ijipt u la phohsniew ba u ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years , that Pharaoh dreamed : and , behold , he stood by the river .

translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki bapop tang shisien bad na ka bynta ki por baroh , u briew uba bha na ka byndi ki nongpop , ba un oh ïalap ïa phi sha U Blei . La pynïap ïa u ha ka doh , hynrei la pynni pat ïa u ha ka mynsiem ,
translation.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :

translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ; wat lynthem ïa ki law bad ki aiñ jongnga u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi myntan ka sngi .
translation.en: Beware that thou forget not the  Lord  thy God , in not keeping his commandments , and his judgments , and his statutes , which I command thee this day :

translation.kha: Uba kum uno u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sumar baklang biang ïa ki ïoh jong nga . U longkmie umbiah hok , bad un im , ong U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Kumta u Daberath u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa uta u ksew um najan ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u bad u Ahasaïah ki mihnoh . Ym don mei mano uba la Ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baroh ki dang ïohbat lyngngai , namar ba U Trai u la pah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .
translation.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .
The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ïa uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha u ,
Nangno baroh ki Israel ki shang wanrah ibiang sha ki dom nguh tiar ïa kiba shiphew na u kew jong ki , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib .
translation.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries .

translation.kha: Nyngkong ha Damaskos sad ha Jesreel bad nangta ha ka Judia baroh bad hapdeng ki jingtylliat , ang la ïalap ba ki daym ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pop Jong ki bad ngab phai shata U Blei nabar leh ïa khie kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .

translation.kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , Naaman ma nga , U TRAI’ , nga la kyntien ïa ki .
translation.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .

translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki maji banbeiñ pynsheptieng ïa U Trai ha kaba ki la ai ka jingkñia bad kulmar ban shakuriaw ïa u .
translation.en: Then the men feared the  Lord  exceedingly , and offered a sacrifice unto the  Lord  , and made vows .

translation.kha: phin ïathuh ha ki shaphang ka por Mynba ki Jeruel ki la khim ïa ka Jordan hiar ka jingryngkhiang .
translation.en: Then ye shall let your children know , saying , Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .
But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Simon u shong u sah hangta , uba shipor u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki nong Samaria da ka jingleh myntor jong u .
U Saul u thmu shun dung ïa u Dabid ha ka kynjri , hynrei u ïaiban u kynrei , bad uta u samla u satlak ha ka kynroh . U Dabid u phet ïap bad u wai im .
