translation.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin  ; but he slipped away out of Saul s presence , and he smote the javelin into the wall : and David fled , and escaped that night .

translation.kha: Ngi dang don shibun ktieh kiew ban ong ha phi , hynrei mynta kan long palat eh ïa phi ban shah .
translation.en: I have yet many things to say unto you , but ye cannot bear them now .

translation.kha: U Terah Badonbor Bahok , U Blei ki Jesreel , u la ïong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor Kin ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba kmen shakri ïa u syiem nongkyrshan jong ka Babilonia . U Trai u la ong ba un pynphong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shrak ïa u Nebukhadnessar .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .
For they fled from the swords , from the drawn sword , and from the bent bow , and from the grievousness of war .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïaphet ban ïohlait im na ki waitlam kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa ki , na ki ryntieh kiba la khreh ban siat , na baroh ki jingma jong ka thma .

translation.en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong shuh ,  Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba kin ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . Pynlong ïa ki ban sngewlehrain ïa ki kam pop jong ki .

translation.en: And Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth , she judged Israel at that time .
translation.kha: Mynta ka Deborah , ka tnga jong u Lappidoth , ka long ka nongïathuhlypa , bad ka shakri kum ka nongbishar ïa ki Israel ha kata ka por .
Gera lada ka parabangeit ka la shongkurim ïa u briew u bymngeit bad u mynsiem ban ïaishong malu ka , kam dei ban pyllait noh ïa u .
translation.en: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .

translation.kha: U Trai un shoh ïa phi da ki jaiñjot , kam u la sa ïa ki nong Ijipt . Un pynlong ïa ka met jong phi ban dap da ka prum . Yn tap ïa phi da ka sarew , bad phin daitbuid , hynrei yn ym don jingpynkhiah .
translation.en: The  Lord  will smite thee with the botch of Egypt , and with the emerods , and with the scab , and with the itch , whereof thou canst not be healed .
Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ; ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki bym shym la shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kham jam shuh shuh ,  Ko Khun U Dabid , to isynei ïa nga !
U Trai u ong ; To shahshkor ïa nga , phiah kaba kwah ba ïoh jingim , phi kiba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u mawsiang na uba phi la wan , ka per maw na kaba la tih ïa phoi .
translation.en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , to ïaineh ha ki jingshisha Kiba me la ïoh jinghikai bad kiba me ngeit ïakem .
translation.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of , knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;

translation.kha: U Trai u la krai ban kren-ïa ïa ka kam jong u , u long umbiah la kloi ban bishar ïa ki bhabriew jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .

translation.kha: bad ki la thang lut ïa ki blei jngai ki — ki bymlah long satia ki blei , tangba ki durblei jong u dieng bad u maw ba la shna da ki kti briew .
translation.en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ph la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban diaw waiñ , bad phi la Law ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jongki nga .
translation.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .
Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jong nga u don ka jingim bymjukut , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

translation.en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jehoïakim bad ki shipai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Uriah u la lah ong , u syiem u la pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u . Hynrei u Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewtriem bad u la lait phet sha Ijipt .
Ki briew babha bha ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban Jobab . Ki briew kiba Sniew ki khlaw ban Jobab , hynrei ka wallam jingsuh .
translation.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer : but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things .

translation.kha: Haba ki paid Eliel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai na Ijipt , ki khot jingsngewbha ïa u sha ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Isaia . Thang ka jaiñjot Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .

And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .
translation.kha: Hynrei kynmaw , lada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shynrang kiba na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka bynta kaba dei ka jong ngi kan nang duna .

translation.en: And the  Lord  rejected all the seed of Israel , and afflicted them , and delivered them into the hand of spoilers , until he had cast them out of his sight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyntait ïa ki Israel baroh , u pynshitom ïa ki bad u aiti noh ïa ki sha ki nongshun barunar haduh ha kaba khatduh ban pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u .
Ka Sarah , ka tnga u kynrad Jong nga , ka la kwah khun shynrang ïa u haba ka la tymmen , bad u kynrad jong nga u la ai lut ha u kot ïa kaba u don .
translation.en: And Sarah my master s wife bare a son to my master when she was old : and unto him hath he given all that he hath .

translation.kha: Naba lada la don ka burom ha Katai kaba la ei dang shipawa , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !
translation.en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .

translation.kha: Bud ïa U Trai bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u mala sumar ïa ki sah jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .
translation.en: Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wanpaw phai pat bad ki la ïateh ha U Jisu ïa ki kiei baroh kiba ki la leh . U la ïalum ïa ki bad u , bad ki la ïaleit tang ma ki hi sha ka shnong ba la khoit , ka Bethsaida .
translation.en: And the apostles , when they were returned , told him all that they had done . And he took them , and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh ïa ki shynrang ba dang kham kup to kyntu jur ïa ki ban synshar bakha ïa lade .
translation.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban siew pat shiah u , kumta u la pyndam noh ïa ki ram jong ki bhor ar ngut . Uno na kine , te , u ban ieit kham bun ïa u ?
translation.en: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?

translation.kha: La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Ma da ka khubor jong u angel , mala ka la lyngngoh Aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingdam .
translation.en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
But Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah , and the mighty men , and Solomon his brother , he called not .
translation.kha: hynrei um shym la khot ïa u Solomon , u para jong u na ujuh u kpa lane ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , lane ïa u Benaïah , lane ïa ki nongïada jong u syiem .

U Gehasi u la on leit sha khmat , sad u nguh ïa u diengduh jong u Elisha halor u khynnah , hynrei ym don jingsawa ei ei lane kano kane ka dak ba don jingim . Kumta u la leit phai ngab ïamih ïa u Isaiah bad u ong , U khynnah um shyiap kyndit .
translation.en: And Gehazi passed on before them , and laid the staff upon the face of the child  ; but there was neither voice , nor hearing . Wherefore he went again to meet him , and told him , saying , The child is not awaked .
Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la ong ïa kane namar katto katne ki briew ki ïa-ong ,  U don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u .  )

translation.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem  ; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together , gold , and silver , and apparel , in great abundance .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Judah ki ïaleh ban ïada ïa ka Jerusalem . Kin shim kum ka jinglute ïa ka spah jong ki hima baroh — ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ki jaiñphong babun .

translation.en: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha Elim , ha kaba la don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki dieng Tlai ; bad hangta ki la ïasher dara harud um .

Wat bam kano kano ka jingbam kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ; wat bam kano kano ka snam ; wat bam kano kano ka mrad ka la khyrwait ; bad sorkar ïa lade na ka jingawria . Phin manbha lada Phin sumar ban ym ar ïa kine kiei kiei . Da ka jingkhublei babud tam jong ngi .
translation.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .

translation.kha: U la kren saraw ha khmat jong ki kumno ba u long uba riewspah , ba u ne buiñ ki khun shynrang , kumto ba u syiem u la pynkiew ïa u sha ka kyrdan ba-halor , bad kumno ba u long uba kham dumok ban ïa kiei ki rangbah synshar u syiem .
translation.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches , and the multitude of his children , and all the things wherein the king had promoted him , and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king .

translation.kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ong ha a uno na ki angel jong u , Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me . Lymne U Blei um shym la ong shngain uno uno u angel , Ngan long U Kpa u jong u bun un long u khun jong nga .
translation.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?
Therefore he lifted up his hand against them , to overthrow them in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Kumta u la ai ïa ka jingmaham kaba eh ba un pynlong ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ka ri shyiap

translation.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .
translation.kha: khnang ba phi lah ban long ki khun jong U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng . Namar u pynlong ïa ka sngi kaba u la thaw ban tyngshaiñ ha ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumjuh , bad u ai slap ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha bad ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
Sumar ban ym klet ïa ka jutang ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynlong nabar phi . Kynhun ïa ka hukum jong u ban ym thawsha na ka pyntwa ïa biar ïa kano kano ka durblei ,
translation.en: Take heed unto yourselves , lest ye forget the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he made with you , and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the  Lord  thy God hath forbidden thee .
When the host goeth forth against thine enemies , then keep thee from every wicked thing .
translation.kha: Haba phi don ha ka jaka shong dara ha ka por thma , kiar na kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
Heth me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingïailong bakhraw jong u malu khum lynñiar ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jong me ?
translation.en: Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit phalang sha u Balak bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh ban wan bad ki .
translation.en: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .
Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .
translation.kha: Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine ki hukum harum :
Ki briew bakha stad ki ïaid ha ka lynti kaba ïalam stet sha ka jingim , ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut Sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Amaraïah , u khup jong u Asaraïah , u khun jong u Meraïoth ,
translation.en: The son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,

translation.kha: Balei phoi tuh ïa ka khuri ayu u kynrad jong nga ? Ka dih kaba u ju pynmong ban dih na ka , kaba u ju pyndonkam ha ka kheiñ ka bishar ? Phi la leh ïa ka kam kaba shyrkhei .’
translation.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .

translation.kha: Te ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jngai ka jingong U Trai ka la kiew noh na ki kherub sha ka jaka rung Jong ka Templ . Te u leilieh u la sting ïa ka Tabor , bad kata ka phyllaw ka phyrnai da ka jingshai .
translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house  ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the  Lord s  glory .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi shukor ïa nga kum ki wahduid kiba ju lngaid nep ha bym ei slap .
translation.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;

translation.kha: lymda phi har ïa kane , kumba U blei u hukum , phin ym pynthut ïa lade , bad kine ki briew Baroh ki lah ban leit sha ïing hadien ba la bishar ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki .
translation.en: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar da lade un kyrshan ïa nga — Uno te , uba lah ban pynshisha ba nga long uba la shah pynrem ? Baroh ki nongmudui jong nga kin jah noh ; Kin jah kum ka jaiñ ba la bam khnai .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .

translation.kha: Ha man ba nga tap ïa ka suiñbneng da u lyoh , bad ba u simpyllieng u paw ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :

translation.kha: To ïai Trei , te , bad pyndep ïa ka kam ! To longsem kiba thrang ban pyndep ïa ka kumba phi la long ha kaba thmu ïa ka , bad to leh ïa ka da kaei kaba Phin don mynta .
translation.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will , so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have .

translation.kha: Lada u lop ïa ka bniat jong u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , u dei ban ïapyllait ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar Kata ka bniat .
translation.en: And if he smite out his manservant s tooth , or his maidservant s tooth  ; he shall let him go free for his tooth s sake .

translation.kha: Katba u Syiem Knidos u dang peit , u angel u la wan hiar na bneng bad u la ong , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng dara pynjot ïa u , hynrei iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Teh da u syrwiang nar bad rnong Sdang jong ka , bad iehnoh hangta ha ka pyntha lem bad u phlang . Ai ba ka umjer kan ïahap halor jong une u briew , malu shah ïa u ban im hangta bad ki mrad na ka bynta hynne snem .’
translation.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven , and saying , Hew the tree down , and destroy it  ; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts of the field , till seven times pass over him  ;
And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .
translation.kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewbha ïa u slap ha ka por pyrem .
‘ Tei ïa ki ïng malu shongduh . Thaw ki kper bad bam ïa kaei kaba phi thung hangta .
translation.en: Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki longsem jingkyndit , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .
For he hath put all things under his feet . But when he saith all things are put under him , it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .  Ka long kaba shai , da shisha , ba ki ktien  kiei kiei baroh  kim kynthup ïa U Blei hi , uba buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh U Khrist .
Mynta , Namar ka khubor jong I ka longïng ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jinghap , kumno ba katto katne ngut na phi ki ong ba yn ym don ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ?
translation.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead , how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jongu u bnai wahbah Nyngkong ha ka snem kiba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jongki ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , hadien ba u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut noh ïa ka jingmane blei thala , u syiem Josaïah u phah lai ngut ki rangbah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei : u Shaphan u khun jong u Asalaïah , Maaseïah , u lat ka Jerusalem , bad u Joah u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .
Ka jingbam jongno nga , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , ka long ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga bad ban pyndep ïa ka ki kaba u la ai ha nga baneh leh .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .
And it came to pass on the day when the  Lord  spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,
translation.kha: Mynba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .
Hato phi lah ban pynjyrngam ïa ka ha kiba Shna ei ei ? Hato phi eh ban shna u snar na ka , ban wah ïa kiei kiei ha u ?
translation.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?

translation.kha: U Trai u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jyllang nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga . U dei U Blei jong nga , badno ngan ïarep ïa u , U Blei! jrong u kpa jong ar , bad ngan ïai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .

translation.kha: U Mikah u ong , Mynta ba nga la don u Libni kum u lyngdoh jong nga , nga tip ba U Trai un sa pynmanbha ïa nga .
translation.en: Then said Micah , Now know I that the  Lord  will do me good , seeing I have a Levite to my priest .

And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about , and in the man s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth : so he measured the breadth of the building , one reed  ; and the height , one reed .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi ka long ka Templ , bad la don ka kynroh sawdong jong ka . U briew u la shim ïa u diengthew jong u , uba jrong lai mitar bad u la thew ïa kata ka kynroh . Ka long lai mitar ka kynjang , bad lai mitar ka jingrben .

translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi shoh ïa u bieit haduh ba u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .
kamut ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynkthang ïa ka jingtep da naba buh ïa ka muhor halor u maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ban ap .
translation.en: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la kren ha uta uwei pat , Khie mareh malu ainong ha u meeting kaba don u ksai thew ba yn sa don bun Beryl ki briew malu shibun bah ki jingri ha Jerusalem , ba kan longsyiem kaba heh katta katta ban to ki kynroh .
translation.en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :
Pack your bags .
translation.kha: Song ki tiar .

Te kumta , to jing sangeh neh na kaba ïabishar uwei ïa uwei pat . Hynrei phi dei don kut jingmut ban ym leh ïa kaei kaei lano shano ruh ka ban pynong ïa u parabangeit jong phi ban jynthut lane hap ha ka pop .
translation.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more : but judge this rather , that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother s way .
Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Mynhyndai ki ju ong , ‘ Khie leit wad jubab na ka nongbah Abel’ — bad kata ka dei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .
Blei me kylli na nga shaphang kiei kaba bha ? la Jobab U Jisu . Don tang Uwei uba bha . To synrum ïa ki hukum lada me kwah Ban rung sha ka jingim .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .

Then Zebah and Zalmunna said , Rise thou , and fall upon us : for as the man is , so is his strength . And Gideon arose , and slew Zebah and Zalmunna , and took away the ornaments that were on their camels  necks .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sebah bad u Salmunna ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Shim , pynïap hi ma phi ïa ngi . Ka dei ïa u rangbah ban leh ïa ka kam rangbah .  Kumta u Gideon u la pynïap ïa ki bad u shim ïa ki jingdeng kiba ha ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
Ki jingbuh jingthoh ïa barabor ki longïing jongnga ka jait Iskah ki don phra hynñiew hajuh ngut ki pynrangbah kiba bit na ka bna ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .

translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ba don kaw ha Ijipt ; khie leit thied kew nangta , ba ngin ym ïapthngan .
translation.en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .

translation.kha: Wah ïada kiwei kim pdiang ïa nga kum u Apostol , da shisha ma phi , phi pdiang! Namarkata ka jingrem jongki phiah ha U Trai , ma phi hi phi long ka jingpynskhem ïa ka jingshisha ba de long u ebanjelist .
translation.en: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .

translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohthang briew’ ? Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba shukor katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ban ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .
translation.en: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?

translation.kha: Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki shoh hajar ngut ki nongbah ? Kat shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?
translation.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?

translation.kha: Uno uno uba iktiar ïa la ka jong ka jingim un haw ïa ka ; uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka jingrem ha kane ka pyrthei un ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynsah kato katjuh na ki bad phah ïa ki sha ki jaitbynriew malu sha ki ri Kiba jngai ki bym pat Shim la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jrong nga lymne ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong nga : sha Spain , sha Libya bad sha Lydia , ryngkat bad ki nongrah ryntieh kiba tbit , bad sha Tubal bad shat Gris . Hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew kin Pynbna ïa ka jingkhrawbor jong per .
translation.en: And I will set a sign among them , and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , that draw the bow , to Tubal , and Javan , to the isles afar off , that have not heard my fame , neither have seen my glory  ; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles .

translation.kha: U la wan sha u langbrot , uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng harud jongnga ka wah , bad u la madiah sha u da ka bol jong u baroh .
translation.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka hukum kaba nga thoh mynta sha phi ka long kaba thymmai , namar ka jingshisha jong ka , ka la paw ha U Khrist bad kumjuh ruh ha phi . Naba ka jingdum ka la jah noh , bad ka jingshai kaba shisha ka la da tyngshaiñ .
Ka la long mynba nga dang leh ïa kane , ba ki la lap ïa nga hajuh ka Templ hadien ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid . Ym syiem don u paidbah bad sa bun kam shym don ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khatwei , ha ka snem kaba sawphew hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Trai u la suda ïa u ban ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;

translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïohpdiang ïa ka na uno uno u briew , lane ym shym la don mano ma hajuh ba la hikai ïa ka ha nga . U dei U Jiw Khrist hi wahbah la pynpaw ïa ka ha nga .
translation.en: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .

But fear not thou , O my servant Jacob , and be not dismayed , O Israel : for , behold , I will save thee from afar off , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and be in rest and at ease , and none shall make him afraid .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng , ko ki paid Israel , wat ym kyiuh . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri kaba jngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin sngewshngain , bad yn ym don u ban pyntieng ïa phi .
Ha ki dieng Jamynrei kiba don hajan i la wah ïa la ki duitara .
translation.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Lada U Bel u kem ïa me bad u wallam ïa me shiah ka jingbishar , uei uba da ban pynsangeh ïa u ?
translation.en: If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him ?

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , im kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingshisha Shaphan kito kiba la ïap , khnang ba phin ym sngewsih , kumba long kito ki bym don ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: But I would not have you to be ignorant , brethren , concerning them which are asleep , that ye sorrow not , even as others which have no hope .
What ye know , the same do I know also : I am not inferior unto you .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba me ong , nga la ïohsngew mynshuwa . Nga sngewthuh ïa kata baroh ; nga tip lut kat kaba me , me tip . Ngam long uba hapoh jong me .
U Blei u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingduwai ba balang jar hapoh ka dohnud lad ngi .
translation.en: God can hear even silent prayers said in our heart .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , uwei u briew na ka jait Lebi u shongkurim ïa ka khun jong uwei u Lebi bad ka la kha Kynhun shynrang ïa u .
translation.en: And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts , to the which also ye are called in one body ; and be ye thankful .
translation.kha: Ka jingsuk kaba U Khrist u ai , ka long ban kdew lynti ïa phi ha ki rai kiba phi shim ; naba dei ïa kane ka jingsuk ba U Blei u la khot lang ïa phi ha kawei ka met . Bad to long kiba sngewnguh .

translation.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah , and the letters of Tobiah came unto them .
translation.kha: Hapdeng kane ka por baroh , ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la ïadon hapdeng ka jingïathoh shithi bad u Tobiah .
ki baklang shaphang kiei kambah dei , namar ba lang! leit shad U Kpa bad Phon ym ïoh thuh ïa nga ;
translation.en: Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;
Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u Amasaïah u la leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut ka jingsynshar jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel
Lada phira bet ïa ki symbai ka jingbymhok , ka jingpynjot ka mih , malade ka jingbanbeiñ jong phi ïa kiwei kan kut noh .
translation.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .

translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! phi khang ïa ka jingkhang sha ka Hima ki bteng na khmied ki briew , hynrei ma phi da lade” hi phim leit rung shapoh , lymne ba Phin shah shapoh ïa kito kiba pyrshang ïa-ban rung !
translation.en: But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .
Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves , and the spoil of the cities which we took .
translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri jong ki bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .
To ainguh ïa U Tlai , Namarba u longïing uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren ha ki shisyndon .  To long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . To wat sheptieng !

translation.en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king s meat , and of the wine which he drank : so nourishing them three years , that at the end thereof they might stand before the king .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ai ruh ki hukum ba man la ka sngi la dei ban ai ïa ki da kajuh ka jingbam bad ka waiñ kum ïa ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar syiem . Hadien lai snem jong kane ka jingai jinghikai ki dei ban wan mih ha khmat u syiem .

Ki bri baroh ki la sngewkynduh ba ki la sdang ban ïa-ong para ma ki , kiei kane ? Hato ka dei ka jait jinglehkai thymmai ? une u briew u don ka bor ban ai hukum ïa ki mynmiet bymkhuid , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .
At Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .
translation.kha: Hajan ka jingtei kaba shaphang sepngi , don saw ngut ki nongap harud lynti bad ar ngut ha kata ka jingtei hi .

Hynñiew sngi ki rkhie da ka jingkieng ïa ka jingkwah Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la dap da ka jingkmen namar U Trai u la pynlong ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria ban lehsbun ïa ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei jong ki ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ lad U Blei ki Israhaïah .
translation.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta ki briew ki bym lah ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade . Ïada ïa ki hok jong baroh ki bym don jingïarap .

translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever : for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler  ; and of the house of Judah , the house of my father  ; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , u la jied ïa nga bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ban synshar junom ïa ki Israel ; u la jied ïa ka jait Judah ban pynmih nongïalam , bad na ka jait Judah u la jied ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga . Na baroh kata ka longïing ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u ban shim ïa nga bad ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , ki briew jong ka hima bashatei jong ka Israel ki ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid .

Bad ñiar ka jingïapyrshah ïa ka kane ka jingshakri jong phi ka Wanlam , badno ki ban ai donburom ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingïaineh Jong phi ha ka gospel U Khrist , ïa kaba phi ïaphla , bad ïa ka jinglehsbun jong phi ha kaba ïasam bynta lem pynlang ki bad uwei pa uwei shwa .
translation.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ , and for your liberal distribution unto them , and unto all men ;

translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngba , bad thew leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phi la lum .
translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .

translation.kha: Nangne u phah khong ïa la ki ingmane , dara katba ki dang ïakhreh mih , u ong , Wat ïakajia ha lynti .
translation.en: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them , See that ye fall not out by the way .

translation.kha: U Trai u leh kumba u Moses u kyrpad , badno kita ki jakoid kiba don hapoh ïing , ha phyllaw ïing , pynlang ha lum ruh , ki ïap lut phar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and the frogs died out of the houses , out of the villages , and out of the fields .

translation.kha: Hynrei to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga jong ha phi bad ha ki paidbah .
translation.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears , and in the ears of all the people  ;

translation.kha: U pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh u kpa jong u , sad u mane ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la manna .
translation.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :

translation.kha: Naba wat lada kata ka shithi lad nga ka la pynsngewsih ïa phira , nga te ngam sngewbang ba nga la thoh ïa ka . Ngan jin da la sngewsih haba nga la ïohi ba ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi shipor .
translation.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter , I do not repent , though I did repent : for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry , though it were but for a season .

translation.kha: Nga khih ïa phin ba phin bthuh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha U Trai ; kata ka long balamler ba ar ïadie ïakhot ïa ki ha phi mynta .
translation.en: That thy trust may be in the  Lord  , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa phi , Kane ka dei ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ki paitlieng , te wat nym bam phi ïa —kata ka jingmap , na ka bynta uto uba la ïathuh ïa Phin mala na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem —
translation.en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :

translation.kha: U kyllan , Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ? Ho-oid , me ithuh , ki jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .

But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u la leit bad u la sdang ban pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng . Ha ka jingshisha , u la ïathuh ha baroh haduh ba U Jisu um lah shuh ban rung shapoh shnong ha kaba paw paidbah . Hynrei , U la shong noh ha ki jaka kynjah , bad ki briew ki la ïawan sha u na kylleng .

translation.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki bym shym shahshkor ïa u Moses , bad ki la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba bud kata kaba sah ka la boi ksaiñ bad ka sma iwjit , bad u Moses u la bitar ïa ki .

kane ka longsem kaei kaba U Trai u la ong shaphang u patsha Assyria : ‘ Un ym ïohrung ha kane ka nongbah lane siat ïa imat u khnam pyrshah ïa ka . Yn ym don ki shipai lem dara ki stong ki ban wan hajan ka nongbah , Bad yn ym don ka kynton ba la tei ha sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shields , nor cast a bank against it .

translation.kha: Kin tur pyrshah ïa ki shnong jngai phi baroh ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jngai phi u ai ha phi , malu ki kynroh kiba jrong malade kiba skhem ha kiba ai jingshngain ïa phiah kin kyllon .
translation.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates , until thy high and fenced walls come down , wherein thou trustedst , throughout all thy land : and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki biria jong nga kim shym pyndap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ba ki la ïoh kurup ; pynbna , ki la wallam ïa ki hangne ha Gilgal ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba duna ha Kita ki jingiw , lapbah ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh Kana kano ka jingduna , phim dat ban kñi ïa ki ha U Trai U Blei jrong phi .
translation.en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Nga praw duh ba lada uno une um kohnguh ïa khnai ka hukum , dei ban sei ïa u bim dieng na ka ïit jong u , ban pynnep ha kawei ka liang , bad ngab sem lyngba ïa ka met jong u . Susah ïa ka ïng jong u ban pynlong kum ka kynton ñiut .
translation.en: Also I have made a decree , that whosoever shall alter this word , let timber be pulled down from his house , and being set up , let him be hanged thereon  ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .
Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
translation.kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki long na ka bynta jong phi , bad phi ïoh bynta ha ka jutang kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumba u la ong ha u Abraham , ‘ Lyngba ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .’

translation.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
translation.kha: Ki jait Manasseh kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Beth Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanaan ki dang shong hangta .
U Jisu u la kylli , Mano ba ktah ïa nga ? Uwei pa nawei u len ïa ka , bad u Porsius u ong , Ko kynrad , ki briew ki don sawdong jong me bad ki ïalum ha me .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Who touched me ?  When all denied , Peter and they that were with him said , Master , the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?

translation.kha: Kan wanpaw halor jong pha baroh . Kane ka long kaba kut . phah sa jot noh .
translation.en: An end is come , the end is come : it watcheth for thee  ; behold , it is come .

translation.kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jongu sem , ban ai ka burom kabu dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum kiba ngeit .
translation.en: And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;

translation.kha: U Jisu te u la phah ïa u sha ïing ryngkat bad ka hukum , wah sien phad pat sha ka nongrep .
translation.en: And he sent him away to his house , saying ,  Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .

translation.kha: ïa uwei pa utai u mot bakynjang , bad ïa ki kynjri jong kaei pa kamai ka kut .
translation.en: And upon every high tower , and upon every fenced wall ,

translation.kha: Kumno me lai ban pynlong ïa ki brai kum ka dohkha lane kum ka kynhun ki khñiang ki im dat nongsynshar ban ïalam ïa ki ?
translation.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them ?

translation.kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang kumno ka kynhun , nang dei ka Jingkhawai U Terah ba phoi ïabam .
translation.en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .
And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ,  Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phi ïa u masi dab . Duwai ha u blei jong phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang .

translation.en: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki tei ki ïing kum ka snur thapbawa lane kum ka ïingtrep u mraw uba ap phira ïa ki lyngkha .
Nga la khmied sha tnum halor ki khlieh ki kherub bad halor jong ki ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ba la shna na u mawkordor sapphir .
translation.en: Then I looked , and , behold , in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .
Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Ye shall not do so unto the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba leh kita ki briew .

translation.en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa ka duriaw bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh !
To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ïarap ïa U Blei ha ka Telem jong u ! To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u ha bneng !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary : praise him in the firmament of his power .

translation.kha: Kumta wat khwai : ‘ Nangta ka jingbam jngai nga kan wan ? lane ka jingdih jong nga ? lane ki jaiñ jong nga ?’
translation.en: Therefore take no thought , saying , What shall we eat ? or , What shall we drink ? or , Wherewithal shall we be clothed ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Manasseh bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U Trai : nur rwai ha U Trai namar ka jingjop kaba khraw jrong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa ki kulai mala ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ba ka por kan poi — ka por ka la lah poi — haba kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Khun U Blei , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kin ïoh im .
Ïeng ïohi ïa ka jingieit jong u ha kiei kiei baroh bakha u la jingaiti .
translation.en: We see his love in all that he has made .

translation.kha: U hikai ïa nga ban ïaleh thma , ba kumta nga lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He teacheth my hands to war  ; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don uwei u diengsoh Dumbur uba mih ha ka bri shoiñ jong u . U la leit khmih soh Dumbur ha u hynrei um shem ei ei .
translation.en: He spake also this parable  ;  A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard  ; and he came and sought fruit thereon , and found none .

translation.kha: bad ki kynhun ki ksiew jong u Shual ki dih u Arah , u Hanniel , bad u Risia .
translation.en: And the sons of Ulla  ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka sahit bneng .
translation.en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .

translation.kha: Ki kherub ki ïeng shaïong shathie na ka Templ hajuh u rung hapoh , bad u lyoh u thup ïa ka phyllaw kaba Shobab .
translation.en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in  ; and the cloud filled the inner court .

translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u kylli , Tharai ïa uno uno la pynpyngngad namar ba u la kthaw ïa ka metïap . Te paila u ktah ïa kano Kane na kine ki jingbam , ithuh kata kan pynlong ïa ki hati ba la pyntngit ? Ki lyngdoh ki jingjubab , Ho-oid .
translation.en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .
Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;
translation.kha: Mano ba tih nur na ka bynta u slap uba hap bad ba pynkhuid ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka  erïong bad u pyrthat ?

Phin ïap Bad ïa ki Mephaath jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane ka ri khlaw . Naaman ba phi la khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat ahor snem ka rta u don ïohrung sha katai ka ri .
translation.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nongkyllan , Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ong ïa u ba un ym khublei , namar phim lah Ban ong mano ban ïarep ha ka thnam . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kiba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .

translation.kha: Ahishahar Ïohi phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynsleh katne ïa nga .’
translation.en: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
And he said unto him , Oh my Lord , wherewith shall I save Israel ? behold , my family is poor in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father s house .
translation.kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Hynrei  Trai  , kumno ngan lah ban pyllait ïa ki Israel ? Ka kur jong nga ka long kaba tlot tam hapoh ka jait Manasseh , bad nga long uba rit tam na ki dkhot ka longïing jong nga .

translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long uba donbor bad uba khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .
Nga sheptieng ieh ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba Phon iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist — ruma ïa ka Im la shukor da ki buiñ sianti utai u bseiñ .
translation.en: But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .

translation.kha: Ka jingshun ka pynmih ïa ki jingïashongkha , hynrei ka jingieit ka klet noh ïa ki kam palat bhor .
translation.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes : but love covereth all sins .

translation.kha: haduh ba ki pud ka Kanaan ki la ïar naduh Sidon , beit beit shathie shang Gerar hajan Gasa , bad Shaphan mihngi shaduh Simon , Gomorrah , Admah , bad Seboiim hajan Lasha .
translation.en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza  ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboiim , even unto Lasha .
And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,
translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ,  Man kaba kut ka hynñiew snem , ynda poi ka snem ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kane ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
Suk kito kiba kthong ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba leh batbor ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .
I receive not honour from men .
translation.kha: Ngam wad ïa ka jingïaroh ki briew .

translation.en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .
translation.kha: U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar bad u ong ,  Khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiew ïa ki khlur ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew kat kita .
Ha ka sngi Kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ki Israel kin thup nguid kata ba nga long U Trai U Blei Jong ki .
translation.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .

translation.kha: U Trai u kren ha u Moses badno u Aaron ha Ijipt :
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,

translation.kha: U Jakob u wan poi malade la ki briew baroh ha Lusias , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .

translation.kha: Bthah ïa u Huram bad u Thummim hapoh ka jingdeng shadem , khnang ba u Aaron un rah ïa ki haba u wang ha khmat ka jingdon kaba kynha jong na . Kum ha sakma ka por , u dei ban phong ïa kane ka jingdiang shadem , khnang ba u lah ban tipthuh bad sngewthuh ïa ka mo jong nga na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim  ; and they shall be upon Aaron s heart , when he goeth in before the  Lord  : and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the  Lord  continually .

translation.kha: Neng ai hima ha me ïa Kaei kaba mem shym la pan : barben Shi rta ka jingim jong me , men to ka spah malade ka burom , kham bhor ngab ïa kata ka jong uno un uwei pait u syiem .
translation.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked , both riches , and honour : so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days .
And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark  ; for the oxen stumbled .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan sha ka jaka shoh kew ha Khidon , u masi u jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner ïa la ka kti bad u kyrshan ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .
Ïa ngi la jingkrenbeiñ sad la ñiewbeiñ da baïar ki nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , U briew uba la bet ïa u symbai baïap u long U Khun U bariew ;
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;
O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
translation.kha: A katno nga long u briew u bym don jingsuk! Uei u ban pyllait noh ïa nga na kane ka met kaba ïalam ïa nga sha ka jingïap ?
To U Blei uba U kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ïa pa’ ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be to you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kum kiba jait ha U jongu Khristan uba U Trai jongno I , U Trai ka burom , phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki rukom kiba pher na kaei kaweh ïohi ïa ki na shab .
translation.en: My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .

translation.kha: U Abarim u la smat ïa ka Sarai ka tnum jong u , bad ïa u Lot u pyrsa jong u , bad ïa ka spah ka phew baroh , bad ïa ki mraw baroh ba ki la lah ïoh ha Hanan , bad ki la ïamihnoh ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Abram took Sarai his wife , and Lot his brother s son , and all their substance that they had gathered , and the souls that they had gotten in Haran  ; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan  ; and into the land of Canaan they came .
Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid bad u leit noh ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Na kata ka daw , ïa kata ka jaka la khot U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad .
Haba ki Jesreel ki ïohi ïa u Pharaoh bad u paidïapom jong u ba ki tur sha ki , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh , bad ki kyang jam sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and , behold , the Egyptians marched after them  ; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng Jong ka ri bad sha ki thain kiba don sdang .
translation.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea , and throughout all the region round about .

translation.kha: Ki ïamihnoh don leit phai nur sha Judah , hynrei ha lynti ka ong ïa ki ,
translation.en: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was , and her two daughters in law with her  ; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .

translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta kan longsyiem ba ki kmie ki kpa ha Jerusalem’ kin bam ïa la ki khun , bad ki khun pat kin bam ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngam pynshitom ïa pha bad ngan pynsakma kliang ïa kino kino kiba dang im .
translation.en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .

translation.kha: Un pyrshah ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la khet blei , lane ïa kano Kanaan ban mano , bad un buh ïa lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung mala shongduh hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad nang ba u un-long U Blei .
translation.en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka snem kaba lai lad ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judia . Bad kumta u Bashan u long u syiem ka Israel ha ka jaka u Nadab .
translation.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him , and reigned in his stead .
And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .
translation.kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa uwei , ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa uwei pat .

Kainan ka jingong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang wad dong shuh shuh baneh pynïap ïa u ; ym tang ba u la pynkhih ïa ka hukum Shebat , hynriew ba u la ainong ba U blang hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da Kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïaryngkat bad U Blei .
translation.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .

Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ai ha u ïa ka burom , ka jaka hapdeng kiba khraw bad kiba donbor . U la aiti mon sngewbha ïa la ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem bad ki riewbymman . U la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki nongpop kiba bun bad u la duwai ba ki kin ïoh ïa ka Jingmap-ei .

translation.en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .
translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mahli bad u Mushi . U Mahli ruh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Eleasar bad u Kish ,
Hynrei U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa u saihon mala ka kynhun shipa jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki shimti ïa baroh ka ri jongno ki Amor kiba shong ha kata ka thain .
translation.en: And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .
And his brother s name was Jubal : he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ .
translation.kha: U para jong u , u dei u Jubal , u kpa tymmen jong ki nongtem jingtem baroh kiba tem ïa ka duitara bad put tangmuri .
Thung u briew u bym to jingsngewthuh un kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ki ram jrong uwei pat .
translation.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .

translation.kha: Um don hangno ; la pynmihpat ïa u , kumba u la ong . Ale hangne bad peit ïa ka jaka ha kaba u la taïew .
translation.en: He is not here : for he is risen , as he said . Come , see the place where the Lord lay .

translation.kha: Ka hima Israel ka la Kut ! Ka burom jong ka , ka la jah koum ki pansngiat syntiew ha ki khlain Jong ki nongïamareh bangeit . Ïa ki khlup basarong jong ki la pyniwbih bha , hynrei hangta ki ïathiah , ki buaid bhor .
translation.en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !

translation.kha: Me tip biang biang ïa ka jingleh bakla barhem kaba me la leh ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Trai un pynum ïa me namar kata .
translation.en: The king said moreover to Shimei , Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to , that thou didst to David my father : therefore the  Lord  shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head  ;

translation.kha: Ka Kamra rung , ki jingkhangïit , bad ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong , ki la long kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaban sha mihngi . Hangne la ba-don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khyrdop , mala ka kamra rung ka la long ha kaba kut riewarsap ka phyllaw .
translation.en: And their windows , and their arches , and their palm trees , were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east  ; and they went up unto it by seven steps  ; and the arches thereof were before them .

translation.kha: Kumta u Sheshbassar u la wan bad buh ïa ka nongrim jongngi ka ; ka jingtrei ka la ïaid nud kata ka na haduh mynnin , hynrei ym pat pyndep ïa ka Templ .’
translation.en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar , and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem : and since that time even until now hath it been in building , and yet it is not finished .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba un da ïoh pynjot lut ïa baroh .
translation.en: For indeed the hand of the  Lord  was against them , to destroy them from among the host , until they were consumed .

translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar sad ki buh ïa ki na shapoh jong ka jingnang shadem ha ki tduh kiba shiah trai jong ka , hajan ka sohpdung .
translation.en: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it , which was on the side of the ephod inward .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah Judas ki la leit ryngkat bad ki bani Sephon , bad ki la jop ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sephath . Ki la buh ka jingtim shalor ka nongbah , ki la pynjot thliew ïa ka , bun ki la ai kyrteng ïa ka , ka Hormah .
translation.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .
Salute Philologus , and Julia , Nereus , and his sister , and Olympas , and all the saints which are with them .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Philologos bad ka Julia , ïa u Nireus bad ka para jong u , ïa u Olumpas bad ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ïadon bad ki .
Pynban , ma ngi baroh , ngi dei ban pynsngewbha ïa ki parabangeit jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingbha jongnga ki , khnang ban thew ïa ki ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification .
And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba sngewtriem kum kiba u Moses u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God : for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them , and they have not known the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingsniew ba ki briew ki la leh , ka khanglad ïa ki ban wan phai sha U Blei jong ki . Ka jingmane bleithaw ka don ka jingbat bakhlaiñ ïa ki bad kim pdiang ïa U  Trai .
Ka long hangno ba u ïohi ïa ka jingstad bad u tynjuh ïa ka dor Jong ka — U ai ïa ka , ka jingmynjur jong u .
translation.en: Then did he see it , and declare it  ; he prepared it , yea , and searched it out .

translation.kha: Te phan jong ha latai , ‘ Mano ba la kha ïa keiñ ki khunlung baroh na ka bynta jyllang per ? Nga la duh noh ïa la ki khun bad Ngam lah ban ïoh khun Shu . (Nga la shah ïalam mraw bad la shah beh ei — mano ba la pynshah pynsan ïa ktien ki kynhun ? Nga la shah iehnoh marwei — nangroi kine ki khun ki la wan ?’
translation.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart , Who hath begotten me these , seeing I have lost my children , and am desolate , a captive , and removing to and fro ? and who hath brought up these ? Behold , I was left alone  ; these , where had they been ?

translation.kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ! Lada u hynmen u para jongno phi u leh pop , to sneng tyngeh ïa u , mala dalade u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .
translation.en: Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .

translation.kha: Shisha kumba u symbai u khie lung bad u syang , U Trai Nongsynshar un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew barben kin ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .

translation.kha: Balei ngan ïap ïa phi ? u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ka Israel . Khie leit bad kylli na wer ki nongïathuhlypa kiba u kpa bad ka kmie jong me ki la kylli . Em ! u Joram u jubab . U dei U Trai uba la buhai ïa Ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u shym ka Moab .
translation.en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel , What have I to do with thee ? get thee to the prophets of thy father , and to the prophets of thy mother . And the king of Israel said unto him , Nay : for the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab .

translation.kha: Ka spah kaba phi ïoh da ka bymhok kam pynmyntoi ei ei , hynrei ka jinglonghok ka pyllait ïa ka jingim jongu phi .
translation.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing : but righteousness delivereth from death .

translation.kha: Nangta ki paidlang Israel ki la leh pop pyrda ïa U Trai dara ki la sdang don shakri ïa ki Baal .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :

translation.kha: Pha dei ban shahshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei Ibbah jakhlia bad kiba ijli kiba pha la leh . U Trai’ u la kren .
translation.en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: u phah shata ïa ka kynïan babun jingset bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ki la poi ha ka nongbah mynmiet bad ki kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .

translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew ñiut ki briew kiba lah ba-bang ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .
translation.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .

translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phira , uba la pyllaitluid im ïa ph na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: hynrei kata ka ri shai kob phin sa leit bang ka dei ka ri lum bad ri them , ka ïoh um na u slap .
translation.en: But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wanrah ïa u langbrot kiba ar uba long na ka pyntwa ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki lyngdoh , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jrong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And he brought the other ram , the ram of consecration : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Khie leit sha kliar u Lum Pisgah , Bad peit baroh sawdong , shatei , shathie , sha mangi , pynlang sha sepngi . Peit bha ïa kaei kaba me iohi , namar lano lano ruh men ym ïoh rupa shaw shaïong ka Jordan .
translation.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .

translation.kha: yn ym ne uwei ruh na kine ki briew ki ban im ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri . Ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon rijied jong por , bad ïa ki kambah ba nga la leh ha Ijipt bad ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ki la tynjuh ïa ka jingïaineh jong at la bunsien bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory , and my miracles , which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness , and have tempted me now these ten times , and have not hearkened to my voice  ;

translation.kha: Nyngkong , nga jingeh ïa U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrismas na ka bynta jngai ph baroh , namar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïohsngew shaneng ka jingngeit jongno phoi .
translation.en: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , mala ka jingkhihwin ki shalyntem , kiba sawa jam kum u joit .
translation.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .

translation.kha: Saw tylli ki mradkhlaw bakhraw eh ki la mih shajrong na ka duriaw-bah , uwei Uei u ïapher na kiwei pat .
translation.en: And four great beasts came up from the sea , diverse one from another .

translation.kha: bad u la sher dara hajan ka syiemsad , kaba ki briew jong ka , ki la longïng kiba bymman sad naba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the  Lord  exceedingly .
The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .
U Dan bad u Huppim u khur Jong u .
translation.en: And the sons of Dan  ; Hushim .
I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me , and what I shall answer when I am reproved .
translation.kha: Ngan kiew ïa ka jaka ap phira jong nga bad ap ban khmih ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  un ïathuh ha nga ban ong bad kaei ka jubab ba un ai halor ka jingmudui jong nga .

translation.en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides  ; and they four had their faces and their wings .
translation.kha: Nalor ki saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang jong ki , uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki kti briew , hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .

Ha kawei ka miet , une u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ha u , Ko Rabbi , ngi tip ba me long u nonghikai ïa naba la phah da U Blei . Ym don eit uno umbiah lah ban leh ïa ki kambah kiba me leh lymda U Blei u to ryngkat malu u .
translation.en: The same came to Jesus by night , and said unto him , Rabbi , we know that thou art a teacher come from God : for no man can do these miracles that thou doest , except God be with him .

translation.kha: Ka pyrsa kurim u Elim , ka tnga u Phinehas , ka la armet , bad ka la ïajan dei ka por ba kan kha khun . Haba ka ïohsngew ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ba u kthang kurim bad u tnga jong ka ki la ïap , kynsai ka la suh kha bad ka la kha .
translation.en: And his daughter in law , Phinehas  wife , was with child , near to be delivered : and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken , and that her father in law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and travailed  ; for her pains came upon her .

translation.kha: ngat kita kiba bieit ki la ong ha kiba stad , ‘ Ai lem ha ngi ïa ka jingbymman jong phi , Namarba ki sharak jong i ki la jan kijuh .’
translation.en: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil  ; for our lamps are gone out .
And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the  Lord  hath cursed .
translation.kha: bad u ong ,  Na ka khyndew ha kaba U  Trai  u la buh ka jingtim , une u khunlung un wallam ha ngi ka jingpyntngen na baroh ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi ;  kumta u la kyrteng ïa u , u Noah .

Jaban wat leit pyrkhat ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynmihpat da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u Lah ban shim ïa keiñ ki maw bad pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka pyntwa u Abraham !
translation.en: And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kynrup ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kum ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki lyngkot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei khwai ka jait . Kumta ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .
translation.en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
translation.kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jinglaitluid kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang bah ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh thma , bad ka waitlam hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan sha khmat ka waitlam ka la hap .
Ka Ijipt kan long kaba law khlem jingïohkynti . Te phin tip ba de long U Trai . Namar me la ong ba ka wah Nile ka dei ka jong me dara ba me la pynlong ïa ka ,
translation.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  : because he hath said , The river is mine , and I have made it .
Liars will not enter God’s Kingdom .
translation.kha: Kiba lamler kin ym ïoh rung ha ka Hima U Blei .

translation.en: For we are members of his body , of his flesh , and of his bones .
translation.kha: naba ngi long ki dkhot ka met jong u .
Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa ken ka pharshi : La don shisien u briew uba riewspah uba ne ka jaka kaba la pynjam khiar ki jingthung .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , saying ,  The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully :

translation.kha: Ha ka jingijli bakhraw , kan pynjot thew ïa ki shnong jong phi , lang pynpra ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi , Bad ngan kyntait ïa ki jingkñia ainguh jong phi .
translation.en: And I will make your cities waste , and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation , and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours .
And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .
translation.kha: U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .

translation.en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumta ngan kyrkhu ïa u bad ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un long u kpa jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , bad ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
Ka Shiloah ka la kha ïa u Tubal Kain , uba dei u kamar uba shna ïa ki jai tiar baroh na ka rnong bad ka nar . Ka para jong u Tubal Kain ka de ka Naamah .
translation.en: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal–cain , an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah .
Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Dedan ki ïakylliang ïa ki jaiñ-jin na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .

translation.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,
translation.kha: Ka la long ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Patsha Tiberios ; u Pontios Pilat u la long u lyngskor jong ka Judia , U Herod u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Galilaïa , bad u Philip u para jong u , u la long u nongsynshar jong ka thain Ituria bad Trakhonitis ; u Lysanias u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Abilene ,
Ïa u briew uba trei , la siew bainong ïa u , hynrei ym shyiap la ñiew ïa ka kumta ka jingai sngewbit ; ka long kaei kaei kaba u la kamai .
translation.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sakhi da lade hi ïa ka jingtrei shitom jong u na ka bynta jong phi bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba ha Laodikaïa bad ha Hierapolis .
Neng la ban maham ïa u briew uba sniew ba u dei shun ïap , hynrei paila u sangeh na kaban leh pop! bad leh ïa kaei kaba dat bad kaba bha —
translation.en: Again , when I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; if he turn from his sin , and do that which is lawful and right  ;
