translation.kha: u khun jong u Amaraïah , u khun jong u Asaraïah , u khun jong u Meraïoth ,
translation.en: The son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,

translation.kha: Wai shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi da ki ktien ba-bieit , namar dei na kine kiei kiei ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan wan ha tun ki bymkohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .

And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms , whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms : and in that thou givest a reward , and no reward is given unto thee , therefore thou art contrary .
translation.kha: Pha long ka jait nuti kaba kyrpang . Ym don mano mano ba pynbor ïa pha ban long kumta . Pham shym ïoh jingsiew , pha siew ïa ki ! Ho-oid , pha long kaba pher .
Ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingmihsnam bajur la khat-ar snem , ka la wan na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka rkhiang jrong ka jaiñkup jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , a woman , which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years , came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment :
Neither filthiness , nor foolish talking , nor jesting , which are not convenient : but rather giving of thanks .
translation.kha: Lymne kam long kaba dei ïa phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka ktien kaba khlem akor , kren thala , ne krensih , pynban , phi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei .
Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynduh , bad ïa ka jingïakut Jong phi bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap yn pyndeng noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shahjop ne .
translation.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .
And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .
translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun , bad ka kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .

(Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka ïohrung ba ka wan na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh uba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawkyr-ang jong u , ka pynni . Ha ka dik ba ka Khlieh ka thaba , don kaei kaei katba phyrnai kum ka rnong .
translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .

translation.kha: Mynno shah ngan ai buit lem ïa phi , bad U Blei un don lem Bad phi! . Ka long kaba dei ba phin mihkhmat ïa kine ki briew ha khnam U Blei , sad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki sha u .
translation.en: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :
But it shall come to pass in the latter days , that I will bring again the captivity of Elam , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ba kin manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba la jia ,  u Dabid u la ong .  Ka kynhun shipai jong ngi ka la phet krad na ka madan thma ,  u la jubab ,  bad bun na ki rangïapom jong ngi ki la shah pynïap . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la shah pynïap .
Neng long uta umbah tip kaba kumno ka long ïa-ban shah pynsum ha U Blei .
translation.en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .

translation.kha: Ki khnam jong me ki sam lyngba ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shaei jong u haba u la woh kum ka erïong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka jingsarong kum kito Kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba tukri ha kaba rhah .
translation.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .

translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ïa-ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga namar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad namar ki bleithaw da kiba la pyntngit ïa ka .
translation.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :

translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ka ïingsyiem ba la tei da u syiem Hasael , bad lang thang duh ïa ki kut jong u syiem Benhadad .
translation.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: U shane ïa ka iba da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta shun thang jingiwbih . Ka long kaba Sdang , ka don sawphew satang sentimitar ka lynter bad sawphew san sentimitar ka jingijli bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng jongno ka ha ki shoh tylli ki dong ki ïatih lang kawei bad ka .
translation.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit  ; it was foursquare  ; and two cubits was the height of it  ; the horns thereof were of the same .

translation.kha: ‘ Mynta ka sngi phi dien ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab ha Ar .
translation.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :

translation.kha: Hynriew mynta , namar ba phiah la mane ïa ki durblei jong u Sakkuth , u Blei’ syiem lad phi , nabar ïa u Kaiwan , u blei khlem jong phi , phin hap ban kit ïa pli ki durblei
translation.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images , the star of your god , which ye made to yourselves .

translation.kha: Te u Joahas u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang samla , u ïa-ong , Ko Kynrad , pynjngai ïa ki !
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .
For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?
translation.kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u ,  Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .  Lymne U Blei um shym la ong shaphang uno uno u angel ,  Ngan long U Kpa u jong u bad un long u khun jong nga .
kumta kohnguh ïa u bad synrum ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sneng .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command thee this day .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Sharon , Khie leit sha ka duwan bad kñia ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop mala ïa ka jingainguh thang ba yn ïohmap ïa ki pep jong phi bad ïa ki pop jngai ki paidbah . Leh ïa kane ba yn ïohmap ne ïa ki pop jrong ki paidbah , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Go unto the altar , and offer thy sin offering , and thy burnt offering , and make an atonement for thyself , and for the people : and offer the offering of the people , and make an atonement for them  ; as the  Lord  commanded .
For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka long na ka bynta jong phi ; bad katba ka jingaiei U Blei ka dang kner noh sha kiba bun ki briew , kin ai sha ka burom U Blei kham bun ki jingduwai ainguh .

translation.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea , when it cannot rest , whose waters cast up mire and dirt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki riewbymman ki long kum ka duriaw kaba khih phaloh , kiba ki jingat phyllung jong ka kim ju sangeh , ki wanrah ïa ka jakhlia bad ka ktieh .
Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba u la kruiñ ha ki shaphang u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis .
translation.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist .

translation.kha: Naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh , ki pule ïa ki bynta jong ka Hukum U blei man ka sngem . Ka Jingkhawai Maham ka la long na ka bynta hynñiew sngi , bad ha ka sngi naba phra , ka la don ka jingpynkut ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba la ong ha ka lawbah .
translation.en: Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . And they kept the feast seven days  ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according unto the manner .

translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki kam jyllang ki , ngan wan ban lymbung ïa ki briew Jong ki hima baroh . Haba kmen ïawanlang , kine sa ïohi kiei ba ka bor jongnga nga ka lah ban leh bad kin sa tip ba nga dei uta uba pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .

translation.kha: u pah shata ïa ka kynran babun ryngkat bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïap . Ki la poi ha ka nongbah mynnin bad ki kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ynda ki la dep smam dup dih ha ka ïing U Tiras ha Shiloh , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngewrem jynsur sat bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang ïai ha khmat U Trai . Ha Katai ka na , u lyngdoh Eli u shong ha ka jaka jongu u ha shniah jingkhang .
translation.en: And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .

translation.kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew barabor ki leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .

translation.kha: Kin pyiar ïa la ki kti kam ki pyrshang ban jngi , hynrei U blem un pyndonburom ïa ki , bad ki kti jong ki kin ngam khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them , as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim : and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka ba-ha-ïing jong pha , ka Elisabeth . Ïa naba la ong ba kdew lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei Myntan ka la hynriew bnai ka jingpunkhun , wat la ka la long kaba la tymmen bha .
translation.en: And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingpynshisha baroh Kaba phi kwah ba U Khrist u kren ha nga . Haba u pynbat ïa phi , um long uba tlot , pynban , u pynpaw ïa la ka bor hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me , which to you-ward is not weak , but is mighty in you .

translation.kha: U Tiras u la ong ha u mawshun ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U la mynjur Ban shah ïa ki ban pyrshang ïa ka na ka pyntwa shiphew sngi .
translation.en: So he consented to them in this matter , and proved them ten days .

translation.kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A Trai , nabar nga pyrkhat shaphang ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .

translation.kha: Ha ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam Sha U Jisu shibun Ibbah la don ki kshaid hapoh jongnga ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la shitom .
translation.en: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
translation.kha: Ka la ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .
Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga Dang shu shongkurim , bad na katai ka daw ngam lah ban wanpaw .’
translation.en: And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .
They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Ki la klet ïa U Blei uba la pyllait im ïa ki da ki kam badonbor jong u ha Ijipt .
Kana long ka pansngiat ka baburom ha phi .
translation.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .
And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki leit shaduh Jordan , bad baroh shi lynter lynti ki ïohi ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki tiar ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bret katba ki dang phet ïap . Nangta ki wan phai bad ki leit ïathuh ha u syiem .

translation.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness , through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue :
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Blei ka la ai ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi donkam ban im ïa ka jingim riewblei bashisha da ka jingtip jong ngi ïa uta uba la khot ïa ngi ban ïadon bynta ha ka burom bad ka jingbha jong u hi .

translation.en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa nga bad ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khun syiem Malkhaïah , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw ïingsyiem . Ym don um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngam shapoh ha ka .
Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im bad aïu ki dei ban sa .
translation.en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki barabor , ktang ba phin manbha , bad ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .
translation.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the  Lord  your God hath commanded you , that ye may live , and that it may be well with you , and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .

translation.kha: Hato phim tip ? Phim pat ïohsngew ? U Trai u long U Blei bymjukut ; u thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh . Um ju sngewthait ne sngewlwait . Ym don uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong u
translation.en: Hast thou not known ? hast thou not heard , that the everlasting God , the  Lord  , the Creator of the ends of the earth , fainteth not , neither is weary ? there is no searching of his understanding .

translation.kha: U Asa u syiem Jehoïada pynlang u Bathsheba u syiem Israel ki don badonbor ha ka jingïaleh thma hapdeng jongu ki katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .

translation.kha: dara ka kamra kiba phai shaphang shatei ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh babha shakri ha ka duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la hiarpateng na u Sadok ; dei tang ïa kine ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Troas ban shakri ïa U .
translation.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .
Then the men of Judah gave a shout : and as the men of Judah shouted , it came to pass , that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .
translation.kha: Ki Judia ki pyrta jam , bad hapoh ka jingïalam u Abijah , ki tur ïaleh ; U Blei u pynliem ïa u Jeroboam bad ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel .
To wat haw noh ïa la ka jingsngur , te , namar ka ïalamwir bad ka , ïa ka bainong kaba khraw .
translation.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .
Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall : but the  Lord  helped me .
translation.kha: La tur ïaleh jur ïa nga bad nga la shahjop , hynrei U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa nga ,
Hadien ba ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jingïateh kulai ha Beersheba , u Abimelekh bad u Pheliks ki leit phai pat sha Philistia .
translation.en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .

translation.kha: U Syiem u shong ba-bang bishar bad u tip ïa kaba sniew haba u ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes .

translation.kha: Ynda me la ïuh ïa ka , men sa ïap noh , kumba u Onan u bymneh jong me u la ïap ,
translation.en: And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .

And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïohi ïa u lyoh tdem uba kiew shajrong na kata ka nongbah , ki Israel kiba ha madan thma ki dei ban phai kylla . Hynrei kat haduh kane ka por , ki Benjamin ki la ïoh pynïap laiphew ngut ki Israel . Ki ong ha lade ,  Ho-oid , ngi la jop ïa ki kumba ngi la leh mynshuwa .
U Blei Bakhuid lad ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa ngi — ka kyrteng jyllang u ka erlangthari U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: As for our redeemer , the  Lord  of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ai ba Ngan kohnguh jingaiei ïa ki Hukum jong me , ba ngan lait na ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop .
translation.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes  ; that I be not ashamed .
Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .
translation.kha: To phai sha nga mynta bad ban im , ko ki briew baroh kylleng ka pyrthei ! Nga long tang ma nga U Blei .

Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Aniam , uba khmih ïa ki nongtrei ba la shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Ha kane u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet shiah Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute  ; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jong Katai ka kynïan ka daym ka Kosbi . U Sur , u kpa jong ka u long u rangbah bahakhlieh jong kawei ka kynum ki joit Midian .
translation.en: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .

translation.kha: Dan namar kan ba ki Israel kim lah ban ïong ïalaw ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Ki kynran dien na ki namar ki hi ki la shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot ! Ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad phi lehniam phi pynjot thiaw ïa khie kiei kaba la hukum ïa phi ban ym shim !
translation.en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies , but turned their backs before their enemies , because they were accursed : neither will I be with you any more , except ye destroy the accursed from among you .

In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .
translation.kha: halor u lumbah bakynjang tam jong ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynmih ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng Kedar ba-itynnat eh . Ki sim kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad ïoh jingda ha ka syrngiew jong u .

translation.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh baroh , namar kata , ki dei ban sumar ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai . Lym kumta kin kit hi ïa la ka pop bad kin ïap , namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba kyntang . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki .
Kiba riewspah ki Shur bad ki lute . Ki leh bymkhuid ïa Ibbah duk bad ki shim kob ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: The people of the land have used oppression , and exercised robbery , and have vexed the poor and needy : yea , they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully .

Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !
translation.kha: Kito kiba leit sha Ijipt ban ïoh jingïarap kin jot ! Ki shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakhraw jong ka Ijipt — ki kulai , ki kali ïapom , bad ki shipai . Hynrei kim tip ban shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel , lane pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .
Haba phi ïahap pynkha ïa ki kynhied Hebru , bad phi Ïohi ba u dei u shynrang , pynïap ïa u ; hynrei lada dei ka kynthei , ai kan im .
translation.en: And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools  ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him : but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :
translation.kha: Nga la iehnoh ïa me ha Krit , khnang ba men buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei kiba dang donkam ban leh bad ban thung ïa ki nongsharai balang ha man la ki shnong . To kynmaw ïa ki jingbthah jong nga :

translation.en: And he said , Speak , I pray thee , unto Solomon the king , ( for he will not say thee nay , ) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Sngewbha kylli ïa u Syiem Solomon — nga tip un ym kyrngah ïa phi — ban shah ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka Abishag , ka theisamla na Shunem , kum ka tnga jong nga .
Syiem Kynrad , u Dabid u ong , Nga la ju sharai ïa ki langbrot i pa jrong nga . Mane ba u sing lane ka dngiem ki wan rong ïa u jinglongbriew ,
translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Thy servant kept his father s sheep , and there came a lion , and a bear , and took a lamb out of the flock :

translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ha u para jongngi phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa nga ban sei ïa u thiah na ka khnam jong phi ,’ pynban phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngngeit dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba radbah ! Nyngkong to shim noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na ka khmat jong phi , bad ngat phin lah ban ïohi shait ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jyllang u para jong phoi .
translation.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .
Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat , u syiem Judah , u Joram u khun jong u Ahab u la long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar snem ha Samaria .
bad u la ïatip ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah Khat-ar snep .
translation.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years : and he died .
And their border was toward Jezreel , and Chesulloth , and Shunem ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Jesreel , ka Khesulloth , ka Shunem ,
lada phi kumjuh ïa u bad phi samla biang biang ïa kata baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi myntor ka sngi .
translation.en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ai pisa ba-bang siew ïa ki peit maw bad ki misteri dieng bad ïa ka jingbam jingdih mala ka jingmane Olib ïa-ban phan sha ki nongbah jong ka Tyros bad shisyndon kum ka jingïatyllilang na ka bynta ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon , ban wallam lyngba ka duriaw shwa Joppa . Ïa kane baroh la leh da ka jingai jingbit u Syros , u patsha ka Persia .
translation.en: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters  ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .
But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka por ka poi bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ha ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ki briew kin mane ïa U Kpa kumba u long hi , da kaba ai ha u ïa ka jingmane kaba shisha kaba u dawa .
baneh ai ka kyrhuh ha u Rehoboam bad ha ki briew baroh jongu ki jait Judah bad Benjamin :
translation.en: Speak unto Rehoboam , the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta , phin ai ruh ar kilo u purew ba la khleh bad ka jingpawnam Olib kum ka jingiaseng bameh . Ka jingiwbih lad kaei ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai . Phin ai lang ruh bad kata ka jingkñia Shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh dih .
translation.en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn pynsngew ïa ki jingïam jong Pha . Wat leit kumto khlup tapkhlieh dawai khleh jingsopkjat kum ka dak jong ka jingïam pyndum . Wat thop ïa la ka khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaweh ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
translation.en: Forbear to cry , make no mourning for the dead , bind the tire of thine head upon thee , and put on thy shoes upon thy feet , and cover not thy lips , and eat not the bread of men .

translation.kha: Shaniah ha U Trei da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . Wat shaniah ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .
translation.en: Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .
translation.kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïingjaiñ , hangta hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la tap da ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh bad ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ba ka la ngat ïa kata ka jingpang ,
La knieh ïa ka Synduk ka jrong U Blei , bad ki khun shynrang jong u Eli baroh ar jngut , u Hophni bad u Nibhas , ki la shahskhor pynïap .
translation.en: And the ark of God was taken  ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .

translation.kha: Wat la U Blei u kren bad ïai kren , ym don uba pynsngap ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translation.en: For God speaketh once , yea twice , yet man perceiveth it not .

translation.kha: U Shalman u la pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phah mihngi jong ka nongbah , hadien ba ka tnga jrong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka ri Ijipt , ka la wan kynriang na ka nongbet u Dabid sha ka jingmih kaba u Solomon u la Tei na ka bynta jongu ka .
translation.en: But Pharaoh s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her : then did he build Millo .

translation.kha: Haba ka synrai ka la poi ha kata ka snem , ka kynhun shipai Seraïah ka la tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah mala ka Jerusalem , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïalam baroh , bad ki la samla shibun ki mar lute sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year , that the host of Syria came up against him : and they came to Judah and Jerusalem , and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people , and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus .

translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Thep . ( Ka dei klang ba ki kynthei ki ju thain ïa ki barandi kiba ju pyndonkam ha kaba maïan ïa ka Asherah . )
translation.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .
And she , being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist s head in a charger .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingaibuit ka kmie jong ka , ka la pan na u ,  To ai ïa nga mynta hangne ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ha ka pliang !

translation.en: And I will give children to be their princes , and babes shall rule over them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ïa ki briew ban shah synshar ha ki khynnah shynrang ki bym pat ïaw .
Wat ka jingim jong i kylleng i bym pat kha i ba ei hakpoh jong ka kmie ruh i long iba kordor hakhmat U Jehobah .
translation.en: Even the life of an unborn child inside its mother is precious to Jehovah .

translation.kha: Da phim ki maw , u thaw bajrong ïa ka skei ban mane ïa U Trai’ . U tih ïa ka kharai sawdong jong ka , kaba heh kat haduh ban ngiam kumba khatsaw riej ka um .
translation.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the  Lord  : and he made a trench about the altar , as great as would contain two measures of seed .

translation.kha: Jamynrei ka per ka poi bad ka la ha long mynta , haba ha ka bor jngai U Mynsiem U Blei ki briew kin mane ïa U Kpa kumba u long hi , da kaba ai ha u ïa ka jingmane kaba shisha kaba u dawa .
translation.en: But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .

translation.kha: shadien kata u Elijah u ong ïa u paidbah , Wan kham hajan shata nga , bad barieh ki la wan ïalum sdang ïa u . U shnat pynbah ïa ka duwan U Trai kaban la pra .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .
And Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u phah kylli ïa kaei kaba la jia bad la ïathuh ba na ki jingri jong ki Israel ym don satia kaba ïap . Hynrei u dang mutlop hi bad um shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
Un ym ïailong slem uba riewspah ; ym don kaba dei ka jong u ka ban nep .
translation.en: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
Yea , I think it meet , as long as I am in this tabernacle , to stir you up by putting you in remembrance  ;
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ïa kane ba ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban pynkhih ïa ka jingkynmaw jong phi ïa kine kiei kiei katba nga dang im .

translation.en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah , a captain of his , conspired against him , and smote him in Samaria , in the palace of the king s house , with Argob and Arieh , and with him fifty men of the Gileadites : and he killed him , and reigned in his room .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka kynhun shipai u Pekahaïah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah , ki ïasylla lem bad ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah na Gilead , ki pynïap ïa u Pekahaïah ha ka bynta bashapoh jong ka kynroh ka ïingsyiem ha Samaria , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
U Petros u ïangat shong habar ha ka phyllaw mynba kawei na ki shakri kynthei Jong u Rangbah lyngngeit ka la wan sha u bad ka la ong , Ma me ruh , me longïing malade U Jisu u nong Galilaïa .
translation.en: Now Peter sat without in the palace : and a damsel came unto him , saying , Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee .

translation.kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshing ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . phler ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U Blei un pynum ka jingisynei ïa phi .
translation.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .

translation.kha: Tap ino ïa kata ka miet na ka snem , bad wat ai ba yn ñiew biang ïa ka ;
translation.en: As for that night , let darkness seize upon it  ; let it not be joined unto the days of the year , let it not come into the number of the months .
And the sons of his brother Helem  ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .
translation.kha: U Hotham u para jong u , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Sophah , u Imna , u Shelesh , bad u Amal .

translation.en: And now , my daughter , fear not  ; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .
translation.kha: Ruth , mynta wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi pan ; kumba baroh ha shnong ki ïatip , phi dei ka kynthei kaba donburom .

translation.en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat .

Ki ong , Ko Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U thri . dei tang ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa Kanah . kiei mihnoh na kane ka iaka kynoi . Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei , sad phin ym ïoh shuh ïa ka jingryngkhiang jong u .
translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the  Lord  , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingkheiñ ïa ka pisa ba ki lyngdoh kiba treikam ha ka khyrdop jong ka Templ ba ki la ïohlum na ki briew .

Ngi pynlong ïaskhem ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri bad nur-um pynmanbha ïa ki . Ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa kito kiba la ju khet Lo-Ruhamah , nabar ïa iba babha la ju khot Lo-ammi ngan sa ong , Phi longïng ki briew jong nga , bad kin jubab , Me long U Bel jongki ngi .
translation.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth  ; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy  ; and I will say to them which were not my people , Thou art my people  ; and they shall say , Thou art my God .

translation.kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! Pynshahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ! ngan rwai bad tem jingtem ha U Trai , U blem ki Israel .
translation.en: Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Wat pynshitom beiñ ïa ki , Hynrei kohnguh ïa U balui jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour  ; but shalt fear thy God .

translation.kha: bad ki bhabriew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da naba shuki ïa kiwei mala shah shukor ïa lade .
translation.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .

translation.kha: u la sngewsih ba u lai thaw bad buh ïa ki ha ka pyllait .
translation.en: And it repented the  Lord  that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .

translation.kha: U Jephthah , u shipai bashlur na Gilead u dei u khun jongnga ka nuti . U kpa lad u , u Gilead
translation.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour , and he was the son of an harlot : and Gilead begat Jephthah .
By much slothfulness the building decayeth  ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u jaipdeh shaba palat ban shna pynbha ïa ka tnum ïing jong u , kan jaw um , bad ka ïing kan khyllem .

translation.en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit , wat haba u Saul u dang long u syiem jong ngi , phi la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Israel ha ka thma bad U  Trai  u la kular ïa phi ba phin ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad ban long u nongsynshar jong ki .

translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .
translation.kha: Bad ïa pha , ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade shaduh sha bneng ? Yn bret ïa pha sha tbian sha dujok !

translation.en: But the Chaldeans  army pursued after them , and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho : and when they had taken him , they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath , where he gave judgment upon him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la beh nadien jong ki bad kem ïa u Sedekaïah ha ki pyntha hajan ka Jerikho . Te ki la leit ïalam ïa u sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba don ha ka nongbah Riblah ha ka ri Hamath , bad hangta u Nebukhadnessar u la ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong u .
Hadien Kata , u la im sa sanspah snem bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonburom Baroh u ïong , Ka por ka poi haba ki briew na ki nongbam babun kin wan shad Jerusalem .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people , and the inhabitants of many cities :

translation.kha: bad u ong , Na ka khynwin ha kabu U Trai u la buh ka jingtim , une u khyllung un wallam ha ngi ka jingpyntngen na baroh ka jingtrei shitom jong im’ ; kumta u la kyrteng ïa u , u Noah .
translation.en: And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the  Lord  hath cursed .

translation.kha: lane peit shlip ha ka khyndew , pynban kyang ym ïohi ei ei hynrei ka jinglwet bad ka jingdum , ka jingdum katba pyntbit sha kaba la beh ïa ki .
translation.en: And they shall look unto the earth  ; and behold trouble and darkness , dimness of anguish  ; and they shall be driven to darkness .
And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .
translation.kha: Bad nangta kan don ka hima kaba saw , kaba eh kum ka nar , kaba pynkhynñiuh bad pynpait ïa kaei kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka nar ka pynkhynñiuh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kan pynkhynñiuh bad pynlwet ïa baroh ki hima kiba mynshuwa .

translation.en: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye , carry corn for the famine of your houses :
translation.kha: Ban pynshisha ba phi long ki briew kiba hok , uwei na phi un sah ha ka ïingbyndi ha kaba la set ïa phi , kiwei pat ki lah ban leit kit ïa u kew uba phi la thied sha ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kiba shahthngan .
Nalor ki saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw thlia ki thapniang jong ki , uwei uwei u don sawphew tylli ki kti briew , hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .
translation.en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides  ; and they four had their faces and their wings .
And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia ïa uta u briew uba don ksuid , bad ïa kita ki sniang .

Naba ka paw ha nga ba U Blang u la ai ïa ka jaka bakhatduh tam ha ngi ki Apostol , kum ki briew kiba la rieh pynrem ïa-ban shah ïap ha khmat u paidbah kum ka jingthadrong ha khmat ka pyrthei baroh kaba dei jyllang ki duh bun jong u bynriew .
translation.en: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last , as it were appointed to death : for we are made a spectacle unto the world , and to angels , and to men .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nongleh khajna u la ïeng ha pyut bad um skhem khmut la ka durkhmat sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka shadem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’
translation.en: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .

translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab , Balei ngan leh kumta ? Nga Dei ha ka liang jong uta uba la jied da U Trai , da kine ki bariew , badno da ki Jesreel baroh . Ngan kamar-tama bad phi! .
translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , Nay  ; but whom the  Lord  , and this people , and all the men of Israel , choose , his will I be , and with him will I abide .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong , Khot hajir ïa ki bri jong nga sha ïingbishar . Ki don ki khmat hynrei ki long kiba matlah ; ki don ki sharud hynrei ki long Ibbah kyllut !
translation.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes , and the deaf that have ears .

translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , phi lap ha lym ha wah ïa u briew kiba la shah pynïap , pynlang phim tip mano ba la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: If one be found slain in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it , lying in the field , and it be not known who hath slain him :

translation.kha: Bad u Isaïah u la long uba kham shijur haba u nong , Ïa nga la Shema da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la paw ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .
translation.en: But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .
And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .
translation.kha: Bad u la wan poi sha Damaskos lem bad ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh ban kem ïa baroh kiba mane ïa me .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay : and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dang lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Hasael , un shah pynïap ha u Jehu , bad uno uno uba lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Jehu un shah pynïap ha u Elisha .
mala haba uno uno u smai da ka bneng , u smai da ka khet U Bela pynlang da uta uba shongkha halor jong ka .
translation.en: And he that shall swear by heaven , sweareth by the throne of God , and by him that sitteth thereon .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phiah ki paid Eliel , phi kiba jingartatiend na u Judah : Phi smai da ka kyrteng jong U Trai bad kam ba phira mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynriewphew phim shym buh jingmut ïa khwai hima ka ktem kaba Phi ong .
translation.en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .

translation.kha: kamut u Moses u shna ïa u seiñ rnong bad u kwah ïa u ha u dieng . Kat uba shah puh bseiñ u shut sha uto u seiñ rnong bad u koit .
translation.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass , and put it upon a pole , and it came to pass , that if a serpent had bitten any man , when he beheld the serpent of brass , he lived .

translation.kha: Ki swai jong u nongshun ki rah ïa ki stieh rudnong saw bad ki pha ki sopti-poh dong saw . Ki pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ! Ki kali ïapom jong ki , ki thaba kum ka ding ! Ki kulai jong ki jam stet !
translation.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red , the valiant men are in scarlet : the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation , and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken .

translation.kha: nongap , hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U Tiras phin ong ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ U kpa tymmen jong nga u dat u nong Aram Uba ïaidwir , uba la leit ïamareh ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem shaw Ijipt ban shong ban sah . Ki ïadon tang khyndiat eh mynba ki ïada hangta , hynrei ki la man long ka jaitbynriew kob bun paidlang bad kaba jingkhrawbor .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak and say before the  Lord  thy God , A Syrian ready to perish was my father , and he went down into Egypt , and sojourned there with a few , and became there a nation , great , mighty , and populous :
Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face , and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u la ai hukum na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh kiba dei ban ai ïa u Daniel .
U Blei u ong ha u Nongap bad ha ki khun shynrang jngai u ,
translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïohthiah ïa kaei kaba i kumno ki thylliej ding kiba pur kylleng bad ktah ïa ti pa uwei u briew hangta .
translation.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop borabor ki kyrkhoit ba ki leh ïa kaban dei . Ki briew kiba riewstad ki shahshkor ïa ki jingpyn-i lem .
translation.en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Lada pha tang shu la tip ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ai bad uei uta uba pait umdih na pha , phan jin da la pan na u , bad u un jin da la ai ha pha ïa ka um kaba ai jingim .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  If thou knewest the gift of God , and who it is that saith to thee , Give me to drink  ; thou wouldest have asked of him , and he would have given thee living water .

translation.kha: wahbah la pynsleh ïa u lyngdoh , ïa ka shadem bad ka lbong jong uta u langbrot ïa uba la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh dei banbeiñ pynkyntang sha nga kumne ka jingai sngewbha bakyrpang bad kiba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :
And the sons of Japhlet  ; Pasach , and Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .
translation.kha: U Japhlet ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Pasakh , u Bimhal , bad u Ashbath .
U dei U Tlai u shun ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ban ïa-ïoh bynta lang . kin ïa-im ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kawei patar , bad kuna long ka jong ki jngum .
translation.en: And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .

translation.kha: U Laban u jubab , Ka kham bha ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phin ban ïa kaweh nga ai ha imat pat ; to sah hangne bad nga .
translation.en: And Laban said , It is better that I give her to thee , than that I should give her to another man : abide with me .
Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .

translation.en: Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .

translation.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah , Go into the land , unto all fountains of water , and unto all brooks : peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive , that we lose not all the beasts .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Obadaïah ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit ban khmih ïa baroh ki umpohliew bad ki wah ha ka ri , ban shem la ngi lah ban ïoh phlang ban pyndap bam na ka bynta ki kulai bad ki khashor ba kin ym ïapthngan . Lehse ngin ym hap ban pynïap noh na ki mrad ba ngi ri .

translation.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites , Go , depart , get you down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them : for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel , when they came up out of Egypt . So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .
translation.kha: U la phah ka jingmaham sha ki Ken , ki briew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la lehsbun ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt :  Khie leit bad iehnoh ïa ki Amalek , ba kumta ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lem bad ki .  Kumta ki Ken ki mihnoh .
Ko parabangeit , to Duwai lem na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .

translation.en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king s meat , and of the wine which he drank : so nourishing them three years , that at the end thereof they might stand before the king .

translation.en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .

translation.en: Let no man say when he is tempted , I am tempted of God : for God cannot be tempted with evil , neither tempteth he any man :

translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ngin joit bad u la leit phai pat shiah la u kpa . U dang kham pajih ha ka lynti na ïing haba u Kpa jong u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohnud jong u ka la thep da ka jingisynei , bad u la mareh , u la piam ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u , bad u la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .

translation.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul , and shall be satisfied : by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many  ; for he shall bear their iniquities .

translation.en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;

Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw . Mem shym la shim noh ïa u lyoh lane ïa ka ding uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .
Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga ; kita kiba wad ïa nga kin shen ïa nga .
translation.en: I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka klass thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .
translation.en: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .

translation.kha: Hamar ka kynta shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai lang , bad baïar ki jingthaw ba kynjri bneng ki rai da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?

translation.kha: Man ba uwei na ki Israel lane uwei na ki nongwei uba shongneh hapdeng ka kynhun ki Israel u phai noh na nga bad u mano ïa ki thliew , bad nangta u leit ban kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa , ma nga , U Trai , ngan ai ha u ïa ka jubab jong u !
translation.en: For every one of the house of Israel , or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel , which separateth himself from me , and setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me  ; I the  Lord  will answer him by myself :

translation.kha: Ki tei pynbah ha ki met jong ki brai ïa ki jingkit kiba khih dara kiba eh ban kit , pynban kim mon bad rah la ki kti banbeiñ ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa iba ki jingsait .
translation.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne , and lay them on men s shoulders  ; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers .

translation.kha: Haba ki siew ïa kane ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , kaba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad babha duk un ym ai duna .
translation.en: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .

translation.kha: U Trai u la jong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehiskaïah u syiem ka —Judah , Kumba da shisha nga long U Blang umbiah im . wai la me long kumne ka sati muhor ha ka kti khambun jong nga , ngan weng nep ïa me ,
translation.en: As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;
And the other woman said , Nay  ; but the living is my son , and the dead is thy son . And this said , No  ; but the dead is thy son , and the living is my son . Thus they spake before the king .
translation.kha: Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Em ! u khunlung uba dang im u dei u jong nga , bad uba la ïap u dei u jong pha !  Kata ka kynthei kaba nyngkong ka jubab ,  Em ! u khunlung uba la ïap u dei u jong pha , bad uba dang im dei u jong nga .  Bad kumta ki ïakajia ha khmat u syiem .

Hangno mynta ka ei ka nongbah kata kaba long koum ka krem jong ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing jingkup , ha kaban u nuti bad ka sing kyang wait Bad ki khun jong ki kin don ha ka jingshngain ?
translation.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?

translation.kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei kambah palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong pa , bun ïa ki jingmad jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
When I was daily with you in the temple , ye stretched forth no hands against me : but this is your hour , and the power of darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la don bad phi ha ka Templ man ka sngi , bad phim shym la pyrshang ban kem ïa nga . Hynrei kane ka dei ka kynta jong phi ban leh , haba ka bor jong ka jingdum ka synshar .

Haba ka jingud ka wang bad ïa ki briew la pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin lumlang ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep klang ha Amphipolis ! Ki jingdon jingem jong ki kum ka rupa malu ki jaka ha kabu ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la ïeng yn tap da ki ñiat bad ki bniap shniah .
translation.en: For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoahas u peit baroh sdang , bad ïohi katba katne ki jingtep hangta halor lum ; u sei shabar ïa ki shyieng na ki pynlang u thang ha ka kito . Ha Kanneh ka rukom u ñiewsang ïa ka duwan , u leh ïa kiei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ïathuh lypa mynshuwa eh ha ka por ka jinglehniam katba u syiem Jeroboam u dang ïeng hajan ka duwan . U syiem Josaïah u peit sawdong bad ïohthiah ïa ka jingtep jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïathuhlypa ïa kane .
translation.en: And as Josiah turned himself , he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount , and sent , and took the bones out of the sepulchres , and burned them upon the altar , and polluted it , according to the word of the  Lord  which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these words .

translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingbymshisha jong nga ka pynlong ïa ka burom U Blei da kaba pynlong ïa ka jingshisha jong u ban kham paw shawei ? Balei yn dang ïapoi pynrem ïa nga kum u nongpop ?
translation.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?

translation.kha: Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Jehohanan bad ïa kiwei pat ïa-ban siew ïa ka pisa kambah donkam ban ïakyndit , bad nangta ki la pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly .
translation.kha: Bad nga shaniah ha U Trai ba nga da lade hi , nga lah ban wan shen sha phi .
Baroh ki la bam malu ki la kdang , bad ki synlar ki la lum khat-ar thri na kaei kaba la sah tam .
translation.en: And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .

translation.kha: nonghiarthma Nga ñiew ïa U blang kum u sakhi jong nga — u tip ïa ka dohnud jongu nga ! Ka long na ka bynta banbeiñ ïaduna ïa phi ba nga la rai ban ym leit sha Korinth .
translation.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul , that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth .

translation.kha: U Asaraïah u lyngdoh ryngkat bad phetwir ngut ki lyngdoh kiba khlaiñ bad bashlur ki bud nemsniew jong u Shimham Ussaïah ban khang ïa u .
translation.en: And Azariah the priest went in after him , and with him fourscore priests of the  Lord  , that were valiant men :
Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew san snem ka rta .
Ki misteri liengbah na Ibleam ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki lieng dur ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki ïakhun jong Pha .
translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa Kanneh , katto katne jrut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka ïing jong u Jair bad ki la ong ïa u , Ka khun jong phi ka la kah ïap . Balei Phin pynshitom hajuh ïa U Nonghikai ?
translation.en: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la duwai , A U Blei jngai u parad jong la u Abraham , bad U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Isaak , to shakor ïa ang ! Me la bthah ïa nga , A Trai , ban leit phai pah sha la ka ri bad sha la ki kur ki jait , bad men pynbiang ba ktieh kiei baroh kin ïawad beit bad nga .
translation.en: And Jacob said , O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the  Lord  which saidst unto me , Return unto thy country , and to thy kindred , and I will deal well with thee :
And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u klim bad ka tnga jong u para Israel , ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shah pynïap .
Te da kawei ka jingkñia , u la pynjanai ha la ka rta ïa kito kiba la pynkhuid na ka pop .
translation.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .

translation.kha: U Joash u la long u syiem ka Judah haba u la don hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei banbeiñ khmih bha ïa u , nabar lada ka don shaid ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ,
translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh  ;

translation.kha: “Kane kuna jia ha ki namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba nga ju ïai phah sha ki lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jongnga at . Ki la kyntait Ban shahshkor .
translation.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki khun Shaneng jong u Gomer ki long ki briew jong ka Ashkenas , ka Rieh , bad ka thombor .
translation.en: And the sons of Gomer  ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .

translation.kha: Te ki nongïalam shnong kin khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u . Lymda u dang kyntait ban shongkurim ïa ka ,
translation.en: Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak unto him : and if he stand to it , and say , I like not to take her  ;

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Heber u jait Ken u pynlang la ka dara marjan ïa ka Kedesh hajan u dieng Sning ha Saanannim . U la kynriah noh na khawai pat ki jait Ken , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hobab , u kynum jong u Moses .
translation.en: Now Heber the Kenite , which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses , had severed himself from the Kenites , and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ki la jubor , phi hima phi dei na Galilaïa ? To pule minot ïa ki Jingiathuh Bakhuid bad phyrnai smam ba ym don nongïathuhlypa uba ju mih na Gedalaïah .
translation.en: And every man went unto his own house .

translation.kha: Suki pa suki un beh krad ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phiah nang tur sha kham . Phin ym lai ban pynduh lut ïa ki shisyndon , namar , lada phi leh kumta , ki mradkhlaw kmen jyllei palat Bad kin long ka jingma pynban ïa phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .

translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) malade ka nongbah kaba napdeng jong kata ka lui bad kaba kynthup ïa ka iaka pudina baroh na Medeba shaduh Gibbethon .
translation.en: From Aroer , that is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon  ;

translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kyang ki briew bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki kumne kumne .
translation.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .

translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ u la lap ïa ki briew bakha ïadie ïa ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki paro , bad ki nongïapeiñ pisa ruh ki ïashong ha ki miej jong ki .
translation.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves , and the changers of money sitting :

translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un ai ka jinghikai ïa ph . Haba ki tngen jong u ki la jingumsnam bun kiei lung bad u la sdang ban sei ki sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :

translation.kha: Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la trep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynïapmat ruh ïa phi bad U Khrismas da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U blang , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the  Lord  : and he made a trench about the altar , as great as would contain two measures of seed .
translation.kha: Da kine ki maw , u thaw biang ïa ka duwan ban mane ïa U  Trai . U tih ïa ka kharai sawdong jong ka , kaba heh kat haduh ban ngiam kumba khatsaw litar ka um .

Ka saw jingjia ryngkang ba u skhem ka Israel u la pahuh ha ka khyrdop nongbah hapoh ka jingbet jong u rangbah pynïaidkam uba dei u nongïarap ba-hajan jyllang u . U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shah ïuh hangta ha ki paidbah bad u la ïap bania u Elisha u la ïathuh lypa mynba u Syiem u la leit ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate : and the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died , as the man of God had said , who spake when the king came down to him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u la jop thiaw ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei . U la jop ïa ki syiem Jong ka ri lum , bakha ha ki sharing lum ha ka phang mihngi , bad babha ha trai ki lum ha ka phang sepngi , bad ïa kito ki jong ka ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang bashathie . Um shym la pynshisha ïano ïano , u pynïap lumrit khoit ïa ki barieh . Kane ka long kaba U Trai U Blei ki Israel u la hukum .
translation.en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills , and of the south , and of the vale , and of the springs , and all their kings : he left none remaining , but utterly destroyed all that breathed , as the  Lord  God of Israel commanded .

translation.kha: Ladan U Blei u ai ha ngi ka shapoh bad ka jingdon jingem bad to ngin lehkmen ha ki , ngi dei ba sngewnguh bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai na U Blei .
translation.en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na Sukkoth bad ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .

translation.kha: Balah te ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi shuh kane ka ri khlaw ? hato ba ngin ïap stong bad la ki jingri ?
translation.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?
And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah sha Bethania , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .

Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barakel , bun u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei borbah kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiew kiei barabor katba la don ha ka kut kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ainong ha u banbeiñ thoh .
translation.en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .

But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Jehoïada u shim ïa ka synduk , u ksam thliew ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka duwan , ha ka phang kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki lyngdoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka synduk ïa ka pisa baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .

translation.en: All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingleh bymdei ki long ka pop , hynrei ka don ka pop ka bym ïalam sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Jacob said , O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the  Lord  which saidst unto me , Return unto thy country , and to thy kindred , and I will deal well with thee :
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la duwai ,  A U Blei jong u parad jong nga u Abraham , bad U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Isaak , to shahshkor ïa nga ! Me la bthah ïa nga , A  Trai  , ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri bad sha la ki kur ki jait , bad men pynbiang ba kiei kiei baroh kin ïaid beit bad nga .

translation.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Shu pdiang ba pha la bakla bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong pha . To phla ba hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingieit ha ki blei nongwei bad ba pham shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher dara harud ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .
Kumno phi haka ban long u lem , ka lok ne ki kmang ki kpa babha ?
translation.en: How can you be a good husband , wife , or parent ?
Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
translation.kha: U Syiem u la sngewsynei ïa u , kumta u la map ïa ka ram jong u bad u la pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: But some man will say , How are the dead raised up ? and with what body do they come ?
translation.kha: Don u ban kylli ,  Kumno lah ban pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap ? Ka met kaba kumno kin don ?

translation.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .
translation.kha: Ban im slem ka long ka bainong jong kiba hok ; u ñiuhlieh u long ka pansngiat badonburom .
U Obadaïah u la jubab , Kaei kaba nga la leh ba phi kwah ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma jong ka jingshaniah pynïap noh ha u syiem Ahab ?
translation.en: And he said , What have I sinned , that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab , to slay me ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaweh kham khlaiñ shuh shuh . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , Hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kiba sngewtynnat .
translation.en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .

translation.kha: Namar kata , Phon ïoh ïa kaba phi pan kwah , malu ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa Phin .
translation.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .

translation.kha: U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynlong ïa u Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong me , u syiem uba khraw bad ai ha u ka burom bad ka jinglong shym .
translation.en: O thou king , the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom , and majesty , and glory , and honour :
And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .
translation.kha: Phin sa shah ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom kum ki riewpaidbah ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban siew na ka bynta ka jingsniew ba phi leh .
Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkang ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha . Kim khim da ni jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .
translation.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .

translation.kha: Uta ïa uba U Bela u la phah , u kren ïa ki ktien Jong U Blei’ , namar ba U Blei u ai ha u ïa ka jinghap jong U Mynsiem jong u .
translation.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God : for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada don wahbah shongkha len ha ka jingïaseng u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U Blei , Utai uba kriah u dei ban sangeh noh .
translation.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by , let the first hold his peace .

translation.kha: U la ñiew ba ka jingshah krenbeiñ na ka bynta U Messaïah ka long kaba kham kordor buiñ shah ban ïa ka spah baroh jong ka ri Ijipt , naba u khmih lyndum ïa ka bainong ka ban sa wanpaw .
translation.en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .

translation.kha: Don ka Ekron laiñ bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ka ,
translation.en: Ekron , with her towns and her villages :

translation.kha: To pynjar jar , uwei pa nawei baroh , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai , namar u wan na ka jaka shong kaba khun jong u .
translation.en: Be silent , O all flesh , before the  Lord  : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation .
Hear now this , O foolish people , and without understanding  ; which have eyes , and see not  ; which have ears , and hear not :
translation.kha: To pynshahshkor , phi ki briew kiba bieit bad ba-mutlop , kiba don ki khmat , hynrei ki bym lah ïohi , bad kiba don ki shkor , hynrei ki bym lah ïohsngew .

translation.en: Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .
translation.kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khun u briew ; kane ka waitlam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ki nongïalam ki Israel baroh . Ïa ki yn pynïap lang bad kiba sah baroh na ki briew jong nga . Tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !

translation.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngi kren borabor kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi kumta , namar u la ñiew ïa ngi kiba bit ban shaniah ïa ka Khubor Babha . Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew , hynrei , ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba tynjuh ïa ki jingthmu jong ngi .

Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap lane ai ha ngi ïa ki lyngkha bun ki bri sohwaiñ kum ka jingïohkynti lad moi , bad mynnin phi pyrshang ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim wan !
translation.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .

translation.kha: Ki khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop ki la long ki Khat-ar tylli ki malai ; ïa kiwei kawei ka khrup la shna na uwei u mawlynnai . Ka lynti bah jrong ka nongbah ka la long da ka ksiar nylla , kaba lah ban ïohi lymbung kamon ka ïit .
translation.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls  ; every several gate was of one pearl : and the street of the city was pure gold , as it were transparent glass .
But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Tyros , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrong bakynsai tam la pynjop . Nga long u syiem , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .
translation.en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .

And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tur ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .
Shibun ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , nongmareh ka khang ha kaba la sahnarphna ïa U Josis kam da jngai na ka nongbah . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktah Hebru , Latin nabar Grik .
translation.en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .

translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , kin wei ki nongshukor , ki nongïalam , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ki ba synsar ïa ki briew jong de .
translation.en: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki paidbah ïa kane ka pharshi : La don shisien uwei u briew uba don ka brai sohwaiñ , u la aiwai ha ki nongshimwai , bad nangta u la mawkynroh na ïing ban jah kham sloit .
translation.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable  ;  A certain man planted a vineyard , and let it forth to husbandmen , and went into a far country for a long time .
My bowels boiled , and rested not : the days of affliction prevented me .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la tar arliang da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingpang ; nga la ïoh ïa ka jingjynjar na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .

translation.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha , bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpang , ka jingleh thombor , bad ka thma ban pynïap ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .
translation.kha: Wat ai phlangïap    shuh ïa kine ki briew ban shna maw-it . Ieh kin leit ïawad phlangïap hi da lade .
Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka bakhia bad ki shipai Jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jong ki shiphew jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .

translation.kha: Lada un wan kynsan kynsan , um dei ban syiem ïa phi ba phi ïohthiah .
translation.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .
translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long kum ka rupa kaba kynsai ; ka jingai jingmut jong u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .

ïada u para jongngi me u lai pop pyrshah ïa me , khie otsher shata u bad pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingbakla jongki u . hynñiew bor ïa ka ha kaba wad jar , kumba tang hapdeng para ma phi . Lada u shahshkor ïa me , me la ïoh patan ïa la u para .
translation.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee , go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone : if he shall hear thee , thou hast gained thy brother .
And Jesus answering them said ,  Have ye not read so much as this , what David did , when himself was an hungred , and they which were with him  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Hato phim shym la pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?
Hib u Dabid u tip ba u Sarah u la pynkhreh ban uta ïaleh ïa u , u la ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh , Wallam hangno ïa ka ephod .
translation.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .
She dwelleth and abideth on the rock , upon the crag of the rock , and the strong place .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ka skum halor ki mawsiang kiba kynjang eh bad pynlong ka kut jong ka ïa ki kliar lum kiba nep .
