U Judah u ong , Ko kynhied , ngin ong aïu pat ha phi ? Kumno keiñ ngin ïasaid ? Kumjuh keiñ ngi la ïa-ban sait khuid ïa ailad ? U Blei u la klop ïa kaei ka kam bymman jong ngi . myntri te , baroh ngi long ki mraw jong phi , bad ym tang uta na uba la shem ïa ka khuid .
translation.en: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold , we are my lord s servants , both we , and he also with whom the cup is found .

translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem bad ka shadem jong u parad banbeiñ ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U Trai .
translation.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka Jerusalem ka long ba la tim ! Ka Judah ka dang khyllem ! Kano kano kaba ki kren lane ki ai ka long pyrshah ïa U Trai ; ki ibeiñ khlup buhrieh ïa U Blei hi .
translation.en: For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen : because their tongue and their doings are against the  Lord  , to provoke the eyes of his glory .

translation.kha: U don ka bakha , ka Esther , kabu ka kyrteng Hebru jong ka , ka long ka Hassenaah ; ka long ka jingkup ba-bhabriew , bad ka don ka rynïeng ryñiot Ba-itynnat . Ha ka jingïap noh ki kmie ki kpa jngai ka , u Mordekai u la ri bad pynheh pynsan ïa ka kum la ka jong ka khun .
translation.en: And he brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle s daughter : for she had neither father nor mother , and the maid was fair and beautiful  ; whom Mordecai , when her father and mother were dead , took for his own daughter .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki briew hangtai ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong shaphang jongu ki : Nga long u nongshun jong pham , ko saihon ; ki brisoh kin ïahiar ïa nga namar katei kaba nga sa ïa pha . Kin Ïohi tip ba ang long U Trai , haba nga pyn-i katno uba khuid nga longïing da kaba pynshitom ïa kito kiba im hapdeng jong pha .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Zidon  ; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee : and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall have executed judgments in her , and shall be sanctified in her .

translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u la shnong lane Ong ïa la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin pyntip ïa nga , napoh uba rit tam ïathuh uba khriat tam .
translation.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .

translation.kha: U la kren ha ki na u riew lyoh ; ki kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar : they kept his testimonies , and the ordinance that he gave them .

translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba ar la Pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju shongkha ha ka templ ; nga la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat phin ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar ha baroh ki liang .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .

translation.kha: khnang ba yn ym don mano Mano na phi ban phai dien noh Naaman film ki jingpynshitom beiñ . Phi hi phi ïabeit ba kiba kum kine ki nongpynshitom beiñ ki long ka bynta jong ka mane U Blei na ka bynta jongki ngi .
translation.en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions : for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto .

translation.kha: U Josis u pyndap pynkieng jingbam ïa la u kpa , ïa la ki hynmen ki para , bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing u kpa jong u baroh katba ki ïadon , haduh kiba khñiang tam .
translation.en: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father s household , with bread , according to their families .

translation.kha: To tynjuh ïa im’ shiphew sngi , u la ong . Ai ha ngi ki jhur ban Bam bad ka um baneh dih .
translation.en: Prove thy servants , I beseech thee , ten days  ; and let them give us pulse to eat , and water to drink .

And the maiden pleased him , and she obtained kindness of him  ; and he speedily gave her her things for purification , with such things as belonged to her , and seven maidens , which were meet to be given her , out of the king s house : and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women .
translation.kha: U Hegai u la itynnat ïa ka Esther , bad ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehsbun jong u . Um shym pynslem ha kaba ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew bad ki jingbam bakyrpang . U ai ïa ka , ka jaka babha tam ha ka ïing ki kynthei bad buh hynñiew ngut ki samla kynthei ba la jied kyrpang na ka ïingsyiem ban shakri ïa ka .
Hynrei phiah don ka jemnud kaba eh bad kaba kuman , bad katkum phi pynlong ka jingpynshitom ïa lade hi wat kham khraw ha ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ka jingbitar U Blei bad ki jingbrai bahok yn pynap .
translation.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Abraham , Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka longsyiem kaba khrawbor kor long .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi bad u la ïohi kumno U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew , u la kmen bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh ban ïaineh bad ban long kiba beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .

translation.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them  ; then he shall bear her iniquity .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u pyndam ïa kata hadien , un hap ban shah ïa ki jingpynshitom na ka jingbymlah ban pyndep ïa ka kular .

translation.en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel , even of all the mighty men of wealth , of each man fifty shekels of silver , to give to the king of Assyria . So the king of Assyria turned back , and stayed not there in the land .
translation.kha: U Menahem u ïoh ïa ka pisa na kiba riewspah ka Israel da kaba pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei ban noh synñiang sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa . Te u Tiglath Pileser u leit phai pat sha la ka ri .

Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shakri banbeiñ tong um ; ki leit sha ki thliew pynlang um , hynrei kim shem um ; ki waiñ phai pud bad ki khrew thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem bad shaïong jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translation.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga hukum ïa ka sahit bneng ba kan khih da ka jingingiew , ban long kaba iphylla bad kaba i lyngngoh ,

translation.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyndap ïa ka snieh jong u da ki sum pynïap dohkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king sat in his house , and the  Lord  had given him rest round about from all his enemies  ;
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la sah ha la ka ïingsyiem , bad U  Trai  u la sumar ïa u na ki nongshun jong u baroh .
Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shongduh ha ka jingstet briew , hynrei , ha ka bor U Blei .
translation.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .

translation.kha: U Gehasi u la nang leit shai khmat , bad u buh ïa u diengduh jong u Elihu hajar u khynnah , hynriew ym don jingsawa ei ei lieng kano nangno ka dak ba don jingim . Kumta u la saw phai ban ïashem ïa u Elihu bad u ong , U khynraw um shym kyndit .
translation.en: And Gehazi passed on before them , and laid the staff upon the face of the child  ; but there was neither voice , nor hearing . Wherefore he went again to meet him , and told him , saying , The child is not awaked .
And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei pa uwei u la kular bad pynskhem da kaba shim smai . U Isaak u khublei khatduh ïa ki , bad ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .

translation.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .
translation.kha: Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phi ïohi ïa uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la biang ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban phet krad . Yn ym don shuh ka kynhun shipai jong phi ka ban dang sah , lait noh sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jong u lum !

translation.en: O  Lord  , are not thine eyes upon the truth ? thou hast stricken them , but they have not grieved  ; thou hast consumed them , but they have refused to receive correction : they have made their faces harder than a rock  ; they have refused to return .
translation.kha: Da shisha U  Trai  u peit ïa ka jingïaineh . U la shoh ïa phi , hynrei phim shym pynleit jingmut ; u la pynlwet ïa phi , hynrei phi la kyntait ban ïoh jinghikai . Phi long kiba mutlop bad phim shym phai na ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pynlut kai ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai riewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .
Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki dkhiew kiba beit , khnang ba phin im Slem ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jyllang phira u ai ha phi .
translation.en: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .

translation.kha: Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U Trai un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn har ïa u .
translation.en: And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .

translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jong U Trai ha u paidbah : Ngan long ryngkat badno phi — kata ka long ka ïakular lad nga .
translation.en: Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun khatduh , bad katba ki lai jngut shi la kiba nyngkong ki sah bad u Saul ,
translation.en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .

translation.kha: Te men ym ïoh ong , ‘ Dei ma nga uba la pynpoh ïa u Abram .’
translation.en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine , lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries : and the land of Egypt shall not escape .
translation.kha: Haba u hiarthma ïa kito ki ri baroh , wat ïa ka Ijipt ruh yn ym ieh .
Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kba la sien sha ka Templ ban duwai : Uwei u la long u phraphew , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .
translation.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him ,  Thy son liveth :  and himself believed , and his whole house .
translation.kha: Te u kpa u la kynmaw ba ha kata hi ka kynta mynba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  U khun jong me un im .  Kumta ma u bad ka longïing jong u baroh ki la ngeit .
Ko ki paralok ba-itynnat , lada kane ka long kumno U Blei u la ieit ïa ngi , te ma ine , ngi dih ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .

translation.kha: Kut ki shipai ki aiti noh ïa kita ki koidi bad ïa ki marbl lwait ha ki paidbah bad ki nongïalam jong ki ,
translation.en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u ong ha la ki ïa-ïeng ha-sem bad ha kita baroh kiba don lem bad u , Bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh naba phi don ; pyndik ïa lade , bad khung da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .
translation.en: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :

translation.kha: Hynrei u la shah ïa ka jingshitom kaba la Dei hok ïa ngi , ka jingpang kaba ngi la daiñ ban shah . Baroh shi katta ngi la pyrkhat ba ki jingshitom jong u ki la long ki jingpynshitom ba la phan da U Blei! .
translation.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .

Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal : and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him , Thou knowest the thing that the  Lord  said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katto katne ki briew na ka jait Judah ki la wan ha u Joshua ha Gilgal . Uwei na ki , u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , u ong ha u ,  Phi tip kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha Kadesh Barnea shaphang jong phi bad nga ha u Moses , u briew jong U Blei .

Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katno katne nguid ki Pharisi ki la Kwah daw ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u har bakla , kumta ki la ïakhmih bniah ïa u ban ïohi lada un pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day  ; that they might find an accusation against him .

translation.kha: Mynta shim hynñiew thylliej ki masi lyngraw bad iehnoh tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad leit sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un ïamudui na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jop ïa ka jingmudui jong u bad ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kitab ka dei khak ïa me . Mem shym la kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga kumba u la leh .
translation.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynthei , khnang ba yn ym don uba leit rah Khubor sha Gath bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la leh . Kane ka long kob u Dabid u la ju leh kaba u dang sah ha ri Philistia .
translation.en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .
That the triumphing of the wicked is short , and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment ?
translation.kha: ym don u briew uba sniew uba kmen slem .
U Trai u ong , Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Merathaim bad jong ka Pekod . Pynïap bad pynjot ïa ki . Leh ïa kiei kiei barhem ïa katba nga hukum ïa phi . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod : waste and utterly destroy after them , saith the  Lord  , and do according to all that I have commanded thee .
For this is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta ïa uba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong . ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’

La thoh : U Geshem u ong ïa nga ba ka don ka hamsaïa kaba ïaid kylleng pyndeng ki jaitbynriew kaba don marjan , ba ma phi bad ka jaitbynriew Jiw phi don jingthmu ban ïaleh pyrshah bad dei na kane ka haka balei ba ph la tat pat ïa ka kynroh . U ong ruh ba phi thmu ban pynpang ïa lade u syiem
translation.en: Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .

translation.kha: Kin pyiar ïa la ki kti kumba ki pyrshah ban jngi , hynrei U Blei un pynjahburom ïa ki , bad ki kti jongu ki kmen ngam Khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them , as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim : and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands .

translation.kha: wahbah ki hynñiew snem ki la leit , la ong u syiem , Nga la khmih shajrong sha shathie bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan pha . Nga la ïaroi ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh thom Eh badno nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom ïa uta uba im junom . Un synshar junom , bad ka hima-patsha jong u kan neh ha ki per baroh .
translation.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :

translation.kha: u la ong ha u Moses , Sngap , ko kyndiah , wat pynlong ïa ngi ban shah pynshitom ñiar ka jingleh Pop ha ka jingblei .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Alas , my lord , I beseech thee , lay not the sin upon us , wherein we have done foolishly , and wherein we have sinned .

translation.kha: Ym dat Kana kano kaba u lah ban ïa-peiñ na ka bynta la ka jingim .
translation.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?

translation.kha: Hynrei un pyrkhat ïa nga , bad un pynslem ïa ka hima u Dabid junom .
translation.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed , and the throne of David shall be established before the  Lord  for ever .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u pyllew u la khot sam ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhlad bad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Makedonia .
translation.en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .

translation.kha: Kata ka sur ka la kren biang ha u , Wat ñiat bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Bel u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khoit .
translation.en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U Trai’ u la ai ha phi baroh mynba phi jingïalumlang ha uta u lym . U la Kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba sbun , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da banep ïa Kawei pat . Nongthaw u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar thylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .
translation.en: These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .

translation.kha: U Trai u skei ïa baroh ki hima bad baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki . U la pynrem ïa ki sha ka jingjot .
translation.en: For the indignation of the  Lord  is upon all nations , and his fury upon all their armies : he hath utterly destroyed them , he hath delivered them to the slaughter .

translation.kha: U la phah ka jingmaham sha ki Ken , ki bhabriew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la lehsbun ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt : Khie otsher bad iehnoh ïa ki Amalek , ba kumta ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lam bad ki . Kumta ki “Kane ki mihnoh .
translation.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites , Go , depart , get you down from among the Amalekites , lest I destroy you with them : for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel , when they came up out of Egypt . So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites .

translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ksang ti , u la buh ïa ki Ki jngai u halor jong ki , bad u la kerkut ïa ki .
translation.en: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la siang ïa ki jaiñkup ha lynti . Katba kiwei pat ki dang ïa-ot ïa ki tnat ngin ha ki lyngkha bad ki la siang ïa ki ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
He takes the lead in helping his family to learn about God and His purposes .
translation.kha: Kum u khlieh jong ka ïing u dei ban long u banyngkong ha ka ban ïarap ban hikai ïa ki shaphang U Blei bad ki jingthmu jong U .

Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la ni , kaba kyntiap ïa ka jingbthuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati malade ïa baroh ki nongbah ïa kiba u la tei , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shimiet Ka Israel
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
Thus said the  Lord  unto me  ; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , whereby the kings of Judah come in , and by the which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , khie leit bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ka Khyrdop Paidbah , kaba lyngba jong ka ki syiem jong ka Judah ki rung shapoh bad mih shabar ka nongbah ; nangta leit sha baroh kiwei pat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
Ngan shon hapdeng jong phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym pha nong na phi da lei lei .
translation.en: And I will set my tabernacle among you : and my soul shall not abhor you .

translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por u nonglamktien u wan poi bad u noh ha u Saul , Wai phai noh shisyndon ! Ki Philistia ki la wan hiarthma ïa ka ri !
translation.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying , Haste thee , and come  ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .
And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki ,
bad u ïalam ïa ki shiah Baal ha Judah khnang ban wallam nangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Bela , katba don ïa ka kyrteng U Trai Badonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jngai u ka un-long hajir ki Kherub .
translation.en: And David arose , and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah , to bring up from thence the ark of God , whose name is called by the name of the  Lord  of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims .
So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynskhem ïa ka jingtep da kaba buh ïa ka muhor halor u maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ban ap .
Phi la rah noh ïa ki briew ka Jehoïada bad Jerusalem jngai na ka ri jong ki hi pynlang miet ïa ki ha ki Grik .
translation.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians , that ye might remove them far from their border .

translation.kha: Kumta te , dei ban kup ïa lade , naba Phi long ki briew jong U Blei’ ; u la ieit bad jied ïa phi na ka bynta jong u hi , da ka jingsngewdiaw , ka jingbhasbun , ka jingsngewrit , ka jingjyrsieh , bad ka jingïohthiah .
translation.en: Put on therefore , as the elect of God , holy and beloved , bowels of mercies , kindness , humbleness of mind , meekness , longsuffering ;

translation.kha: U la ai pop pyrshah ïa U Trai palat ban ïa uno uno na kiba ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the  Lord  above all that were before him .

translation.kha: Kine ki nonghikai balaitluid ki long kiba shlur bad kiba kyr-eit , bad kim pyn-i jingñiewburom ïa ki jingthaw ba kyntu bneng ; pynban ki krenbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness , and despise government . Presumptuous are they , selfwilled , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities .

translation.kha: To ïahiar ïa U Trai , phi ki Lebi ; to ïarah ïa u , pa baroh babha mane ïa U !
translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O house of Levi : ye that fear the  Lord  , bless the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , baroh na ngi , la im erlangthari ki Jiw ne ki Jenesis , ki mradkhlaw ne kiba laitluid , la pynhiarkput ha kawei ka met da ujuh U Mynsiem , bad la ai ha ngi ïa Ujuh U Mynsiem! pun ïoh dih .
translation.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body , whether we be Jews or Gentiles , whether we be bond or free ; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit .
A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa phi , ka jingai sngewbha kaba ai ha kaba rieh ka pynjem jai ïa u .
Phan sa ïoh khuid Shaneng , bad phah khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , namar U Trei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduh sngew jynjar jong pham .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .
Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge : for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol ; and their conscience being weak is defiled .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh uba tip ïa kane ka jingshisha . Don ki briew kiba la ju myllen bad ki bleithaw ba haduh kane ka sngi haba ki bam kum ïa kata ka jingbam ki dang pyrkhat hi ïa ka kum ka jingbam kaba dei jong ka bleithaw ; ka jingïatiplem jong ki ka long kaba tlot , bad ki sngew ba la pynjakhlia ïa ki da kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: But who is able to build him an house , seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him ? who am I then , that I should build him an house , save only to burn sacrifice before him ?
translation.kha: Pynban ym don uno uno uba lah shisha ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U Blei , namar wat ka jingïar jong ka bneng kam lah ban ngiam ïa u . Kumno te nga lah ban tei ka Templ ka ban long kaba kumno kumno kaba kham heh ban ïa ka jaka ban thang jingiwbih ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Dabid u thoh shithi sha u Joab bad u phah rah ïa ka ha u Uriah .
Ki shipai samla ki la tam nyngkong . Ki nongsyntiat ba la phah da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynhun ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .
translation.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
translation.kha: Ha ka proberb ba-mynshuwa , u briew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka pisa , bad ki khun jong u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam da ki ktien kiba shongnia ïa kiba yn ym don ba wad daw , khnang ba yn ïoh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba sniew ban ïoh kren pyrshah shaphang jong ngi .

ngat u la hukum ïa u khun syiem Jerahmeel , pyntud bad u Sarai u khun jong u Asriel malu u Shelemaïah u khun jong u Abdeel , ban kamet ïa nga bad ïa u kanjari jong por u Barukh . Khynñiuh U Tharai u la buhrieh ïa ngi .
translation.en: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech , and Seraiah the son of Azriel , and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel , to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet : but the  Lord  hid them .

translation.kha: Kumta ma por , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga kylli : Hattush une u dieng sohwaiñ un im bad san ? Hato u shrong uba nyngkong un ym rat ïa u na ki thied , phut noh ïa ki sohkew , bad pynkhie ïa ki tnat bad shah ïa ki ban ïapstai ? Kham da shem shibun eh ka jingkhlaiñ litar ka hima bakhlaiñ ban rat ïa ka .
translation.en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh malu ka jingaiti lut jong u shai U Trai la buh jingthoh ha Ka Jingïap jong u Nongïalam Isaïah u khun jyllang u Amos bad ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Ngim Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness , behold , they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: Hangta hajan , la don ka kynhied bah ki sngi , kba ïapom jingbam ha ki sharing Lum . Kumta ki “ksuid” ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban shah ïa ki ban ryndang shapoh ki sniang , bad u la shah ïa ki .
translation.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .
At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the  Lord  , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid , and gave it to the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: u khlong ïa ka ksiar na ki jingkhang ka templ bad ïa ka ksiar kaba u hi u la tap ïa ki shawkad jingkhang , bad u phah lut ïa ka sha u Sennakherib .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .
translation.kha: Katba ka jingïaleh ka dang bteng hapdeng ki kynhun jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .
Ki ngab ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta ka buhnud , hynrei ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka shnong ki kyntait ban leh ïa ki kam trei kti ba la aiti ha ki da ki nongpynïaidkam .
translation.en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired  ; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynjur , kumba phi trei na ka bynta U Tiras malu ym na ka bynta ki briew .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha u ne um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki riewbymman .
translation.en: Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la eh noh : Lada me kohnguh ïa ki saiñ jong nga bad leh ïa ki kamram Ibbah nga la shaniah ha me , te men ïailong uba khmih ïa ka Templ jong na bad ïa ki phyllaw jngai ka , bad ngan shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jongno me , kumba nga shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba don ha ka jingïadon ryngkat jong nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .
Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ai ba dohnud kan kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khamtam ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .

translation.en: And he said , What is the thing that the  Lord  hath said unto thee ? I pray thee hide it not from me : God do so to thee , and more also , if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh aïu ha phi ?  u Eli u kylli .  Wat buhrieh ei ei na nga . U Blei un pynshitom jur ïa phi lada phim ïathuh lut ha nga kat ïa kaba u la ong .
Nahath katto katne ki nonghikai ka Law badno katto katto ki Pharisi ki la kren . Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa me ba me leh kaban .
translation.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered , saying , Master , we would see a sign from thee .

translation.kha: Ang sha kulai .
translation.en: I'm just asking .
Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
Uta uba shoh ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei shun shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .

translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh ki paid Israel ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,

translation.kha: U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u noh , pynlang ki nongïalam jong ki jait Jeriel ki la ai ïa kine ki bynta jong ka ri da kambah kynting sbai ban ïakren ïa U Trai ha Shiloh , ha ka jaka rung shiah ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon long U Trai . Ha Kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ka jingpynbynta ïa ka ri .
translation.en: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul , u Abner u khun jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul sha Mahanaim .

translation.en: And he went forth again by the sea side  ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit phai pat sharud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah u la wan sha u bad u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki .

translation.en: Then David and his men , which were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah , and went whithersoever they could go . And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah  ; and he forbare to go forth .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u — kumba hynriewspah ngut baroh — ki mihnoh shisyndon na Keilah bad ki ïaid sa ïaid . Haba u Saul u tip ba u Dabid u la phet noh na Keilah , u la sangeh noh ïa la ka jingpynkhreh .

translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
translation.kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum , bad ïaineh ha u .
Lai sien nga la ïarwai ha U Trai shaphang kane bad nga la khappud ïa u ban weng khong ïa ka .
translation.en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice , that it might depart from me .
And be ye kind one to another , tenderhearted , forgiving one another , even as God for Christ s sake hath forgiven you .
translation.kha: Pynban , to lehsbun bad long jemnud iwei ïa wei pat , bad to ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba U Blei u la map ïa phi ha U Khrist .
Um ju pyndonkam da u diengtied naba khia ban shoh ïa ki symbai dil ne kumin ; hynrei u pyndonkam da ki dieng uba sting kiba babiang ka jingheh .
translation.en: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin  ; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff , and the cummin with a rod .

translation.kha: Ka long naduh kata ka por ba u Dabid u la ai nyngkong eh ha u Asaph bad ki to Lebi jong u ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the  Lord  into the hand of Asaph and his brethren .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok kin kmiesan , bad kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ïa ki . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ki la trei .
translation.en: Say ye to the righteous , that it shall be well with him : for they shall eat the fruit of their doings .

translation.kha: Pha la kli kumno por la leh ïa pha mynba pha ïalang sumar , bad pha la pynbitar ïa per da kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh . Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong ki baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria jakarieh ha barabor kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba pha la bor ? U Trei Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .
And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti . And the thing pleased the king  ; and he did so .
translation.kha: Nangta sa shim ïa ka samla kaba phi itynnat tam bad pynlong ïa ka , ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .  U syiem u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , kumta u la pdiang ïa kata .
U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem ïaheh khyndew malade u la mane .
translation.en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .

translation.kha: U hukum ïa ka duriaw , bad ka rngad ! U pynlong ïa ki wah pun tyrkhong . Ki pyntha jong ka Bashan ki swai , u lumbah Karkor u kylla bthuh , badno ki syntiew jong u Lebanon ki jlop .
translation.en: He rebuketh the sea , and maketh it dry , and drieth up all the rivers : Bashan languisheth , and Carmel , and the flower of Lebanon languisheth .

Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt kim dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita kiba don ka bor bapalat liam . Haba U  Trai  u trei , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllem , bad ka hima batlot bor kaba ka ïarap kan kyllon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei u samla u la wan poi na ka jaka sher dara jong u Saul . Baana pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngew , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad sloit ïa la ka khlaw da ka khyndew . U longing sha u Dabid nabar u dem ngon da kaba barhem haduh khynñiat .
translation.en: It came even to pass on the third day , that , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent , and earth upon his head : and so it was , when he came to David , that he fell to the earth , and did obeisance .

translation.kha: Hato ngin Ong te , ba U Blei u long bymhok ? Ym kumta .
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .

translation.kha: hynrei haba pa duwai , to leit sha ka kamar jong Phin , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad duwai sha U Kpa Jong phi , ïa uba ym eh ngab ïohi . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kadei kaba pa’ leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .

translation.kha: U pynshah jong ka Assyria un ïalam lyngkhuit ïa ki koidi kiba u la kem na kito ki ar thylliej ki ri . Kiba kup bad kiba tymmen , kmen ïawad da ka kjat suda badno lyngkhuit , bad ki rain jongu ki ba khlem tap , kaba wan ka jinglehkmen halor ka Ijipt .
translation.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners , and the Ethiopians captives , young and old , naked and barefoot , even with their buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .

translation.kha: U ong , Wat burom ïa ki rukom jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; wat khih jingmut da ki jingïohi bym ju kham ïohi ha ka sahit bneng , wat la kiwei pud ki jaitbynriew ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Learn not the way of the heathen , and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven  ; for the heathen are dismayed at them .

translation.kha: uta u briew un nang lynnong ïa la ka khlieh , laitluid noh ïa ka khak bit prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrteng ïa u sa hynñiew sngem .
translation.en: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :
( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 21 :1-4 ) Te mano mano ruh ki lah ban “buh noh ha lade” barabor ban ai “katba u thmu ha la ka dohnud .” —1 Korinth 16 :2 ; 2 Korinth 9 :7 .

translation.en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don sa ar ngut ki khun shynrang nalor u Shuthelah : u Eser bad u Elead , kiba la shah pynïap haba ki la pyrshang ban tuh ïa ki jingri kiba dei jong ki traishnong jong ka Gath .

translation.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Joshua , ki paid Israel ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Mano na ki jait jong ngi kaba dei ban leit nyngkong ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan ?
Wat pyntam ei ei nangroi kaba nga hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei ei na ka . Kyndong ïa ki Law U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .

translation.kha: Ynda ki Israel ki ïan phai na kaba biah kthong ïa ki Pamphylia , ki lute ïa ka bakwah sher dara jongu ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they spoiled their tents .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Syria un kerkut ïa ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh bun kurup ïa ka . Ki shipai jong ka Ijipt kin ym ïaleh shu ; wat kiba tbit tam na ki kin ym don ka jingkhlaiñ kaba biang .
translation.en: So the king of the north shall come , and cast up a mount , and take the most fenced cities : and the arms of the south shall not withstand , neither his chosen people , neither shall there be any strength to withstand .

translation.kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khulom u brup ; kane ka khamtam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew lad nga bad na ka bna ki nongïalam ki Israel bhor . Ïa ki yn pynïap lang bad kiba sawa baroh na ki briew jong nga . Tied ïa la ka snem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !
translation.en: Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .

translation.kha: bun ki buh ïa ki jingai baroh bad jingïaleh-sngewbha hangta Ban shngain . Ki thung ïa u Lebi uba ktang u Konanaïah ban peit bad ki pynlong ïa u na jong u , u Shimei kum u nongap lem jong u .
translation.en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully : over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler , and Shimei his brother was the next .

translation.kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka miej jongngi u , ïa ki ïing hukum jong ki rangbah pynsynjor jong u , ïa ki shakri kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia Kiba u la ai ha ka Templ . Ki la pynshongduh ïa ka .
translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng kan wanrah ïa ka jinghap jong phi , hynrei salia phi long kiba sngewrit , yn burom ïa phi .
translation.en: A man s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .

translation.kha: U Tharai Nongsynshar u ong ïa u syiem Ijipt , Men shiteng ïa ka waitlam u syiem Babilon .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .

translation.kha: Phin sa kynmaw ïa ki jingsuk bymman jong phi! bad ïa ki jingbakla ba phi la leh , malu Phin sa isih ïa lade namar ki pop jong phi bad ki jingleh palat jongno phi .
translation.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways , and your doings that were not good , and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .
If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa la ka dohnud kaba beit , ko Job . Phai sha U Blei .
U Ujuh u la khmih sha ki badno u la kylli , Aïu , te , kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kit jingmut ? ‘ U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam kur na baroh .’
translation.en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?

translation.kha: katjuh katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli , Hato ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyrsad noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynta kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?
translation.en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?

And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ban kin poi sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki bad pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki baroh .

thab shuh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh khiar bad pynïadait ïa ki ha ka byndi ka sha trai jong ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng hajan ka jaka ba la suh pyntam bad haneng jong u panpoh ba la thain isaitmet bha .
translation.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .

translation.kha: Ka la wiang ha u paidbah na shadien jong U Jisu malade ka la ktah ïa ka tduh ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam Jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon .
translation.en: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingmihsnam u syiem , ki nongshong khwai ki kiew ha ki kulai syiem bad ki pynmareh ha ka jingstet bajur . Ïa ka hukum la pynban paidbah ruh ha Shna , ka nongbah ka hima .
translation.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out , being hastened and pressed on by the king s commandment . And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ha ka sngi ba u sngewkyiuh ïa ka jingkular , um Shim pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah , ka dei pun pynnep lut ïa kaba ka la kylluid . U la pynskhem ïa ka jingkular da kaba um pyrshah ei ei ha kata ka sngi ba u ïohsngew ïa ka .
translation.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day  ; then he establisheth all her vows , or all her bonds , which are upon her : he confirmeth them , because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nongthain Ijipt ïa ki jingweng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñjot jaiñsem de .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :
Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .
translation.kha: Yn ym tep ïa ki metïap jong ki , hynrei kin pyut hangta bad kin iwtung ; bad ki lumbah kin saw da ka snam .
Ka tnga jong uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingbat , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pynroi , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .
translation.en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .
And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .
translation.kha: U Joseph u long uba dap shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien khyndiat por , ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la sdang ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka .

Jaban mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban lai ïa kaei kaba ang noh . Sngewbha wat phah pat ïa nga sha ka bynda ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada pa’ leh kamet , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .
translation.en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .
Then was the part of the hand sent from him  ; and this writing was written .
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei U Blei u la phah ïa ka kti ban thoh ïa kine ki kyntien .
U Hanun u kem ïa ki nonglamktien jongu u Dabid bad u kam ïa ki ñiuhtmoh jrong ki , bad ot ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki ha ki syngkai , nabar phah nong ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved them , and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks , and sent them away .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong , ‘ lada kim Shahshkor ïa u Messaïah bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , yn ym ha ban pynngeit ïa ki wat lada uno uno un Mephaath na ka jingïap .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .

translation.kha: U la ong , lymda phi kohnguh ïa nga naduh ka dohksah da kaba leh ïa kata kaba nga ñiew ba ka long kaba dei , bad da kaba sumar ïa ki Law jong nga , ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi da kano kano ka jingpang ka ar la pynngat ha ki nadong Ijipt . Nga long U Tlai uba pynkhiah ïa phi .
translation.en: And said , If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and wilt do that which is right in his sight , and wilt give ear to his commandments , and keep all his statutes , I will put none of these diseases upon thee , which I have brought upon the Egyptians : for I am the  Lord  that healeth thee .

translation.kha: U la hukum ïa u paidbah ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khop badno u la nongtuh ïa U blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synran ki la leh kumta .
translation.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .
And say ye , Save us , O God of our salvation , and gather us together , and deliver us from the heathen , that we may give thanks to thy holy name , and glory in thy praise .
translation.kha: To ong ha u ,  Pynim ïa ngi , A Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ; lumlang ïa ngi baroh ; pyllait ïa ngi na ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba ngin sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy  ; then it was well with him : was not this to know me ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U bishar hok ïa kiba duk , bad baroh ki ïaid beit bad u . Kata ka long ka jingmut ban ithuh ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban pynshisha ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ban shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingïaroh bad ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
U Jakob u la shukor ïa u Laban da kaba um shym la ïathuh ei ei ba u thmu ban phetwir nong .
translation.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian , in that he told him not that he fled .

translation.kha: Ha khmih , ko pa jong sa , khmih ïa ka lyngdoh ka jaiñkup jong pa’ kaba nga bat ! Ngan jin da la pynïap ïa phira , hynrei pynban per shu ot noh tang ïa kane . Kane ka dei ban pynthikna ïa phi ba ngam don jingmut ei ei ban ïaleh pyrshah ne pynmynsaw ïa phi . Phi la beh mrad ïa nga ban pynïap ïa to , kdew la meng shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa pa’ .
translation.en: Moreover , my father , see , yea , see the skirt of thy robe in my hand : for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe , and killed thee not , know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand , and I have not sinned against thee  ; yet thou huntest my soul to take it .
Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .
translation.kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban neh sha ka jingim bymjukut . Kane ka long ka jingbam kaba U Khun U Briew un ai ha phi , namar ba U Blei uba U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .
Phim dei ban ong ïa nga ïa kadei ba ngan leh , U Jisu u la jubab . Ka por jong nga kam pat poi .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .

Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon , who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land , God left him , to try him , that he might know all that was in his heart .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïoh jingjop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , bad wat haba ki nonglamktien ka Babilon ki wan ban kylli shaphang ki jingjia bym ju kham jia kiba jia ha ka ri , U Blei u shah ba u Hesekaïah un leit ha la ka lynti tang ban tynjuh ïa ka jinglong jong u .
Ka Judah ka don ha ka jingïambriew ; ki nongbah jyllang ka ki la jan ïap , ki briew jongngi ka ki thiah ha madan ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ka Jerusalem ka kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: Judah mourneth , and the gates thereof languish  ; they are black unto the ground  ; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up .

translation.kha: Ki jingshah jingit kba la longsyiem ha u bnai basian , naba san , uba hynñiew , badno uba shiphew kin kylla long ki Jingkhawai Niam ka jingkmen badno ka jingshadkmen ïa ki paid Judah . Phi dadien ban ieit ïa ka jingshim bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth , and the fast of the seventh , and the fast of the tenth , shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness , and cheerful feasts  ; therefore love the truth and peace .
How long , ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?
translation.kha: A , phi ki briew kiba bieit ! Slem katno keiñ phi dang kwah ban sah bieit ? Sa katno keiñ phin dang kmen ha kaba krenbeiñ ïa ka jingtip ? Hato phim kwah ban ïoh jinghikai ?

translation.en: And slew famous kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba pawnam ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

Ha ki shnong jong ka ri lut , ha ki kjat lwa , mala ha ka Judah bashaniah shathie , ha ka ri ki Benjamin , ha ki shnongrit sawdong ka Jerusalem malu ha ki sheng ka Judah , ki nongaplangbrot sa shisien kin ñiew biang ïa la ki langbrot . Ma nga , U Tlai , nga la kren .
translation.en: In the cities of the mountains , in the cities of the vale , and in the cities of the south , and in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Dei na —kata ka haka ba U Trai un sa Hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa Kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phan jynthut ha kawei pa kawei ka jingkem ba phi skhem . Phin sa mynsaw , shahskhor riam bad phin long koidi .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .

translation.kha: Nga la jingïashoh ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jop , Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pud ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .

translation.kha: U Blei , mynkata , um shym la ai ha u Abbim ïa kano kane ka bynta jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shu mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynrei U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u bad ka jyllang ki ïakhun ki ksiew jong u . Ha ka por ba U Blei! u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular , u Abraham um pat don khun .
translation.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shisha , ba ïa ki Law la thaw , ym na ka bynta ki bhabriew ki babha , hyndai ïa ki nongpynkheiñ hukum bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba khlem Blei bun babha pop , na ka bna kito ki bymriewblei ne ki i long kiba kynoi mynhynnin , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa dara ki kilomitar , na ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na ka bynta kiba leh kam ïa-bujli , na ka bynta kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta re kiba shukor bad ibha ai jingphla lamler lane kito kiba bor ïa kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka jingjai kabu shisha .
translation.en: For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;

And the  Lord  sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , and bands of the Syrians , and bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ki kynhun kieng atiar jong ka Babilonia , ka Syria , ka Moab , bad ka Ammon pyrshah ïa u Jehoïakim ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , kumba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong u ba un leh .
Ki syiem bakhlaiñbor ki la synshar hangto bad ki la synshar ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi baroh kawei , ki da lum khajna bad ki jingmih .
translation.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river  ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them .
And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch .
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la leit na Jerusalem sha Antiokh .
Ha ki nongbah , kiba mynshuwa bad ibha la jan ïan ki lynñiar , hynrei U Blei um patiaw ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translation.en: Men groan from out of the city , and the soul of the wounded crieth out : yet God layeth not folly to them .

translation.kha: ki bat ïa kaweh pang bashabar jong ka niam jong ki , hynrei kin kyntait ïa ka bor bashisha jongnga ka . To kiar noh na kiba kum kita ki briew .
translation.en: Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki shabi lad ka Hima ki bneng , kaei naba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha weng , bad katai kaba me shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ïa ka ha bneng .
translation.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’

translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .
U la saw lyngba eit ki thain bad u la pynshlur ïa ki brup da ki khubor kiba Bun .
translation.en: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,

translation.kha: To ngin sngewskhem , te , bad leit sha ka khet U Blei , ha kaba don ka jingaiei . Hangta ngaiñ ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei sad ngin shem ïa ka jingïamai ka ban ïarap ïa ngi ha ka por ba ngi donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .

translation.kha: Naba u Daberath u la ong shaphang jong u , ‘ Nga la ïohi ïa U Troas ha khmat jongnga nga ha ki por baroh ; u ei hajan jong nga , bad ngan ym don ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: For David speaketh concerning him , I foresaw the Lord always before my face , for he is on my right hand , that I should not be moved :

translation.kha: Ar nguh ki rangbah Kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn ieh shadien .
translation.en: Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .

translation.kha: Un wanrah ïa ki ha u lyngdoh , u ban kñia Shua ïa ka sim na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Un khyrwait ïa ka ryndang jyllang ka khlem da pyndkut ïa ka khlieh na ka ,
translation.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest , who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first , and wring off his head from his neck , but shall not divide it asunder :

translation.kha: katto kaba kham sniew kan long ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui uba dong ïoh ha la ka jong ka ïohnang ! Mynta nur-um pynhiarkput ïa phi namar ka jingpynïap ïa u bad ngan pyndam ïa phi na sla khyndew !
translation.en: How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed ? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand , and take you away from the earth ?

translation.kha: Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaba heh . Ngin shem ïa u brup ibha tukri u bym la siew ïa ki ram jongno u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki juti , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .
translation.en: That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?

translation.kha: Ki jahthait Ephraim malade Manasseh ki la leit baneh tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Betharbel , kaba ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Lus . U thri u la ïarap ïa ki . Ki la phah ïa ki nongpynïaid sha ka nongbah ,
translation.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el . ( Now the name of the city before was Luz . )

translation.kha: Ma me , ko Esra , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstet kaba U Blei jongnga me u la ai ha me , manna thung ki nongsynshar bad ki nongbishar ki shun syier ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi kiba im da ka Hukum jong U Blei jong me . Me Dei ban Hikai ïa kat ka Hukum ha uno uno u bymnang ïa ka .
translation.en: And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God  ; and teach ye them that know them not .

translation.kha: ( Ekesiastis 9 :5 ) U Jisu u la hikai ba ia kiba iap yn sa pynmihpatlada ka mynsiem u briew ka im jongno , yn ym bunkam don pynmihpat ia u .
translation.en: ( Ecclesiastes 9 :5 ) Jesus taught that the dead will be resurrected —an unnecessary action if humans had an immortal soul .
And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
translation.kha: Ka ong ruh , ‘ Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’
Kana ka bynta ba-bang , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia la thang , ka long ruh ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng ha ki met tyrnem ki dong ki long kham jrong ban ïa kiwei ha ka bynta ba-halor .
translation.en: So the altar shall be four cubits  ; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns .

translation.kha: U Soitan u la wieh nia la U Blei u donhok ne em ban synshar bad la ka jingsynshar jong u ka pynmyntoi ne em ïa la ki khun ki khar .
translation.en: Satan questioned whether God rules in a worthy way and in the best interests of His subjects .
And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ong ,  A katno phi long kiba bieit !

Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew ryngkhat u shem ïa ka jingpynkynmaw ba la bakyrhuh hapoh ka lyngkha . U tap pat ïa ka , bad u kmen haw katta katta ba u sien bad die ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la don , malu nangta u longing pat bad thied ïa kata ka lyngkha .
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field  ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .
Forbearing one another , and forgiving one another , if any man have a quarrel against any : even as Christ forgave you , so also do ye .
translation.kha: To ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat ha man ba uno uno na phi u don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa uno uno uwei pat . Phi dei ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat kumba U Trai u la map ïa phi .
Hamar kata ka por uwei u biria uba don u mynsiem bymkut u la wanlam rung hapoh ka synagog bad u la lynñiar ,
translation.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit  ; and he cried out ,
Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .
translation.kha: Nga la kren kum u bieit , ko  Trai . Aïu ngan jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang ban ong ei ei shuh .

translation.en: And he said , Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign : howbeit the kingdom is turned about , and is become my brother s : for it was his from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Phi tip ba nga la dei ban long syiem bad ba uwei pa uwei baroh ha Israel u khmih lynti ïa kata . Hynrei ka la jia long da kumwei pat , bad u para jong nga u la long syiem namar ka dei ka mon U  Trai .

Nangta u phah ïa u angel ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem ; hynrei u kylla ïa kaweh u mut bad u ong ha u ebanjelist , Keiñ noh ! Kato ka la biang ! U bishar u ïeng hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
translation.en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it : and as he was destroying , the  Lord  beheld , and he repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .

translation.kha: Uei uba ïng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ïa ki bymman ? Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga pyrshah ïa ki nongleh sniew ?
translation.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?

translation.kha: U Trai un ym map kum ïa uta u briew . Hynñiew ka jingbitar shla jongngi u kan miat lep pyrthuh ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baïar ïa naba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin nong ha u haduh ba U Trai un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translation.en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .

translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u don ka jingiw jong ka mirr ibha u dem halor ka syiemsad jong nga .
translation.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs , and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell . Arise , my love , my fair one , and come away .

translation.kha: U Trai u jong , Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynjot ïa ki kali ïapom .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :

translation.kha: Ki kparad tymmen jong ngi ki la don bad ki ïa ka ïingjah ka Jingdon Ryngkat U blang , ha ka ri shyiap . La thaw ïa ka kat kumba U Blei u la nguh ha u Maaseïah ban thaw ïa ka , kat kum ka dur ïa ka la pyn-i ha u Moses .
translation.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .

translation.kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa ailad malade ka la kyntiew shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .
translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .

translation.kha: Nangta u Eleasar un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong ka bun un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien da la ka shynriah ti sha ka pynong jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :
translation.kha: To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa phi .
U tharai u khop ïa ka kynoi shipai Sudan mynbarim u Asa bad ki kynhun shipor jong ka Judia ki uta ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: So the  Lord  smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah  ; and the Ethiopians fled .

translation.kha: Wat la katta , shibun kin bud ïa ki lynti bahakhlieh jong ki ; bad namar kaei kaba ki sa , kiaw kin kren sniew ïa ka Lynti jongno ka jingshisha .
translation.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways  ; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of .

translation.kha: Te phin kynmaw ïa baroh ktien kiei kiba jahburom kiba phi la har bad kumno phi la pyntngit ïa latai . Phin sa isih ïa lade namsop kiei kiei kiba sniew baroh bakha phi la leh .
translation.en: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings , wherein ye have been defiled  ; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .

translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Jakob ba u Joseph u khuid jong u , u wan jngoh ïa u , u pynheh katai lah ban shongsah ha la jingthiah .
translation.en: And one told Jacob , and said , Behold , thy son Joseph cometh unto thee : and Israel strengthened himself , and sat upon the bed .

translation.kha: Bad Mynta phi thmu sa ban pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kynthei jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Katto phim tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei jongnga phi ?
translation.en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?

translation.kha: Kuth u Judas u la rupa shwa kata ka kper , u da ïalam bad u ïa ka kynhun ki shipai Rom , pynlang katto-katne katne ki nongap pharia jong ka Thep ïa bakha la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh pynlang ki Pharisi ; ki la long kiba la Kieng atiar bad ki la rah ïa ki sharak bad ki dongmusa .
translation.en: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .

After the doings of the land of Egypt , wherein ye dwelt , shall ye not do : and after the doings of the land of Canaan , whither I bring you , shall ye not do : neither shall ye walk in their ordinances .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im ki briew ha ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi ruh shisien phi la shong , ne ïa ki jong ki briew ha ri Kanaan , sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
U Jisu! u la jubab ïa ki , To kein ka jingngeit ha U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Have faith in God .

translation.kha: Phi long barabor ha ka dohnud jong la ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngem kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . Namar Phin baroh phin la ïoh bynta lem bad nga ha kan ka lad kambah U Blei u la ai ha nga , mynta hab nga don ha byndi mala ruh haba to la long laitluid ban ïada ïa ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa ka .
translation.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phad sha ki synlar bad u la ong ha ki ha kob rieh , A katno phi long kiba donbok ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba Phin ïuh !
translation.en: And he turned him unto his disciples , and said privately ,  Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see :
And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .
translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai eh , ka phyrnai haduh katta katta ïa ngi ban khmih ïa ka ; bad ïa ka sahit bneng la sar pynkhuid da ka lyer .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey  ; and it shall be the wages for his army .
translation.kha: Te mynta kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga ai ïa ka ri ki nong Ijipt sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Un lute bad pynjot lut bad rong noh ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Ijipt kum ka bainong ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la ai ïa kñia ka khublei ha u Sekharaïah :
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  of hosts came to me , saying ,
Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Arimathaïa u la wan poi . U la long u riewdonburom jong ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi Pynkhreh ( kata , ka sngi shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton ) , kumta u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur sha u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .
translation.kha: ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia , bad ki Amalek — kumjuh ruh shi bynta na ka jinglute kaba u la kurup na u Hadadeser .
Hato phim lah ban ïohi ba dadien U blem babha la leh ïa kane ? U la buh ïa ka jingriam ban kem ïa nga .
translation.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me , and hath compassed me with his net .
And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kynton ñiut ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki im . Kan long kaba shyrkhei ban peit ; yn ym don mano mano ban sah hangta , bad baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka kin sngewshyrkhei .

translation.en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la wan sha U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , lada u hynmen u para jong nga u ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , haduh katno sien nga dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u shakri U  Trai  , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .
Kim lehbeiñ satia ban ïai pynbitar ïa nga . Ki ai jingkylla sha ki Blei’ thala ha ki kper bakyntang bad thang jingiwbih ha ki duwan ba-halor .
translation.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ban ktien biang , Ngim shah ! Bad ki la wan mih Bad ka kynum ïasam kaba khlaiñ ban tur ïabeh ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkyndit shikatdei eh da ka jingsheptieng ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaweh ha kamon kano kano ka Nongbah kiba don la u syiem ; ka kham heh ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewbieit kiba tnat .
translation.en: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .

translation.kha: Ko nongïoh , ki synran ki la jingjubab , dang shen ki briew hangta ki la kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me , bad haduh me tmoh ban leit phai sharati ?
translation.en: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?

translation.kha: U la ong , U Serubbabel u la buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , bad un pyndep ïa ka jingtei . Haba kan ka jia , ki brisoh jrong nga kin tip ba dei ma nga uba la phah ïa me sha ki .
translation.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house  ; his hands shall also finish it  ; and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you .
We who are Jews by nature , and not sinners of the Gentiles ,
