translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , la kha ïa ngi kum ki Jiw bad ym kum  ki Jentil bapop  kumba la khot ïa ki .

Ha Kaei ka sngi ka la phah khot ïa u Barak u khum jong u Abib na ka nongbah Kedesh kaba ha Naphtali bad ka ong ha u , U Trai , U blang ki Jerusalem , u la ai ha me ïa kane ka hukum : ‘ Shim shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali bad Shebuel badno ïalap ïa ki sha u Lum Tabor .
translation.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali , and said unto him , Hath not the  Lord  God of Israel commanded , saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor , and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun ?

Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses  ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for thy handmaid , and for the young man which is with thy servants : there is no want of any thing .
translation.kha: wat la ngi don la u phlang bad ki jingbam ïa ki kada jong ngi , kumjuh ruh u kpu bad ka waiñ na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa kane ka tnga kliar jong nga bad ïa une u shakri jong nga . Ngi don lut kat kaba ngi donkam .
Hynrei lymda kumta , kin ïap ha ka jingbymtip bad ryngkang ïa ka wah sha ka pyrthei kiba ïan .
translation.en: But if they obey not , they shall perish by the sword , and they shall die without knowledge .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai , phi ki shem baroh ! A to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh !
translation.en: O praise the  Lord  , all ye nations : praise him , all ye people .

translation.kha: U shym ïa ka khlem , ïa ka dongnai , ïa ka khleiñ baroh kambah sop ïa ki doh jem , ïa ka bynshet kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud , ïa ki khyllie ba sop khlieh , bad ïa ka kjat-dien kamon .
translation.en: And he took the fat , and the rump , and all the fat that was upon the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and their fat , and the right shoulder :

translation.kha: Ynda u la poi , u rung shaphang ïing bad u shim khawai ka tari . U shim ïa ka met ka tnga kliar jong u , u ot ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot , bad u phuh ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei na ki khat-ar jait ki Eliel .
translation.en: And when he was come into his house , he took a knife , and laid hold on his concubine , and divided her , together with her bones , into twelve pieces , and sent her into all the coasts of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka bynta kaban halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei pa kawei ka pipa .
translation.en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .

translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ruh hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang lait tang ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha u Lum Sinai , mynba U Trai u pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel katba ki dang wan mihnoh na ri Ijipt .
translation.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone , which Moses put there at Horeb , when the  Lord  made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .
Cretans and Arabians , we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God .
translation.kha: ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam Jiw , bad katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Krit bad na Arabia — pynban baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien jong ngi shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei u la leh !

translation.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One  ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :
translation.kha: Hato ym don u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynshitom beiñ ? Ki la pynïap ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kiba slem bah mynshuwa ki la pynbna ïa ka jingwan jong u shakri bahok jong u .
Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me Kan long ha ngi , A Trai , kumba ngi pahuh ïa ka jingkmen jong ine ha me .
translation.en: Let thy mercy , O  Lord  , be upon us , according as we hope in thee .

translation.kha: Kaba la tip ka long ba ha kawei pa kawei ka nongjop U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la matlah ïa la ba ka byndi bad ki jingjynjar ki ap ïa nga .
translation.en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :
translation.kha: Bad da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim hi ba kamet jongu mynta ka la iap , ha ka por ba u la dap shispah snem ka rta , lane ïa ka plakhun jong ka Sarah .
wah ïabeit ïa ki blei thala ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pyni ïa phi namar kim dei katba shisha .
translation.en: And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .

translation.kha: Me dei don pynpeit ïa ki khat jong ki bad pynkhie ïa ki na ka jingdum shad ka jingiaseng , bad na ka bor jong u Soitan sha U Blei! , Haneng ba da ka jingngeit jong ki ha ar kin ïuh ka jingmap noh ïa ki pop Jong ki Bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka hapdeng ki briew bakha la jied jongki U Blei .’
translation.en: To open their eyes , and to turn them from darkness to light , and from the power of Satan unto God , that they may receive forgiveness of sins , and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me .
And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u Elijah u ong ïa u paidbah ,  Wan kham hajan sha nga ,  bad baroh ki la wan ïalum sawdong ïa u . U shna pynbha ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba la pra .
Ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u briew babha la kurup da ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ? Ki Briew kiba riam kumta ki shong ki sah ha ki ïingsyiem !
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings  houses .
And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .
translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses na uta u lyoh .
U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baher kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .

translation.kha: U la ong , Ki rangbah Jiw ki la ïakut ngab kyrpad ïa me lashai ka sngi ban ïamareh ïa u Paul sha ka dorbar , da kaba kun mynleh ba ka Dorbar ka kwah ban ioh ka jingtip naba kham thiang shaphang jrong u .
translation.en: And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .

translation.kha: ‘ Pynkloi , phet Ban lehse im !’ ki ong . ‘ Mareh kum u kada khlaw ka ri shyiap !’
translation.en: Flee , save your lives , and be like the heath in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Te u Abraham u leit rung jingkyrkieh sha la ka ïingjaiñ bad u ong ha ka Seraïah , Kloi kloi , rim shi byrni u purew uba ni , khleh pynlang sa shet kpieng .
translation.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah , and said , Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal , knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth .

translation.kha: Kumba da shisha u jong ha kawei pateng ka beit : ‘ lad ym shahïap ïa u shakri baneh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtap .’
translation.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .

translation.kha: Katba phi dang im , ma Phi bad ki khun ki kyiuh jong phi , phoi dei ban tiengburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong Phin , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba na ai ha phi , khnang ba phiah lah ban im slem ha kata ka ri .
translation.en: That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit ban bam ha ka ïong jong uwei na ki Pharaoh kiba kham pawkhmat ; malu ki briew ki la khmih bha ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .

translation.kha: Ngam la pynpyut ïa ki bneng bad pynkdang ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ; por ong ïa ka Jerusalem , ‘ “Phi long ki briew jong nga ! Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jingïakhaïi jrong ang , bad nga ïadon ïa phi da ka ksang ti jongki nga .’
translation.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth , and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and say unto Zion , Thou art my people .
And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them : but they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin nym shaniah shuh ha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Ka kupar ki nong Ijipt kan pynkynmaw ïa ki Israel kumno ka la long kaba bakla ban shaniah ha ki . Te ki Israel kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
Ngi ioh jingtngen naba im thop ba U Blei u don jingsngew haba im jynrat .—Salm 2 :8 .
translation.en: Comfort from knowing that God feels for us when we suffer . —Zechariah 2 :8 .

translation.kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti da kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pah jyllang im , bad ym tang ïa ki pop jong Ngi , hynriew ruh ïa ki ngop jong ki briew baroh .
translation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .

translation.kha: Naba U Trai u long U Blei bakhlaiñbor , u Syiem uba khrawbor halor ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  is a great God , and a great King above all gods .

translation.kha: U Blei! uba khuid ki Israel , U Trai uba pynim ïa phoi u ong , Ban pynim ïa phi , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shaei pyrsa ïa ka Babilon ; ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdep ka nongbah , bad ki jingrisa Jong ki briew jrong ka keiñ sylla jingïam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .
And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel  ; and he said , Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and have not hearkened unto my voice  ;
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u ong ,  Kane ka jaitbynriew ka la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban sumar . Namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga ,

translation.en: And the second angel sounded , and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea : and the third part of the sea became blood  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la put ïa la ka turoi . Ïa kaei re kaei kaba i kum u lumbah uba khraw uba mehding la bret sha duriaw .
Nga la shongsuk ha la ka ïing syiem , da kaba lehkmen ïa ka jingmanbha bakhraw .
translation.en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house , and flourishing in my palace :

translation.kha: ieid u la dep , u ong ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U tharai ,
translation.en: That Moses commanded the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , saying ,
Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jinghikai u Moses u shakri jong nga , ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la ai ha u ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh ban kohnguh .
‘ Ka jingtem U Bel kan hap ha uta u bhabriew Uba pynkyllaiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Hynrei don ki riewkai Kiba ong , Kumno da kum une u briew u lah ban lehbha ïa ngi ? Ki ibeiñ ïa u Saul bad kim shym wanrah ïa u kano kano ka jingai sngewbha .
translation.en: But the children of Belial said , How shall this man save us ? And they despised him , and brought him no presents . But he held his peace .
For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?
translation.kha: Kumno ngan lah ban shah ïa ka lada kane ka jingjot ka wan hap ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki shah pynïap ?

translation.en: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word s sake , immediately they are offended .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khubor kam ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingeh lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , tang kumta hi ki phai dien noh .

To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un pynbang ïa uta u briew ba un isynei ïa phi , khnang ba un pynphai sha phira ïa u hynmen u para jong phiah , bad ïa u Benjamin de . Ïa nga shimet te , lada per dei ban duh ïa la ki khun , ieh ngan mat duh ïa ki .
translation.en: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may send away your other brother , and Benjamin . If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba hynñiew u wan phai bad u nguh , Nga ïohi khyndiat u lyoh u bym da heh palat ïa ka kti briew ba u kiew na ka duriaw . U Elijah u hukum ïa u shakri bad ong , Khie ithuh sha u syiem Ahab malade ong ïa u ban shong ha ka kali ïap pynlang ban leit phai noh shai ïohnang shuwa ba u slap un pynsangeh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , that he said , Behold , there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea , like a man s hand . And he said , Go up , say unto Ahab , Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down , that the rain stop thee not .

translation.kha: Ngan ym ïap ; hynrei kun im bad nur pynbna ïa kawei kaba U Trai u la leh .
translation.en: I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kenan ka hir ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pyningkhong bad ki , ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga hapoh ki dohnud jong ki bad thoh ïa ki ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki .
translation.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days , saith the Lord , I will put my laws into their hearts , and in their minds will I write them  ;

And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work made he them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba tbit tam napdeng kita kiba trei ki shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki shna ïa ka na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen bani , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ha kiba la suh pynpur itynnat da ki dur jong ki Kherub .
Sa dang shipor ka pyrthei kan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , hynrei phin ïohi ïa nga ; pynlang namar ba na im , phi shwa Phon ïoh im .
translation.en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .

And command thou the people , saying , Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau , which dwell in Seir  ; and they shall be afraid of you : take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore :
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kine ki jinghikai : ‘ Mynta phin ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri lum Edom , ka ri ki kur ki jait jong phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .
U Trai u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki bhabriew ki khoit kyrteng ïa ka shok hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Bered Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïwei Ïa Ang .
translation.en: Wherefore the well was called Beer–lahai–roi  ; behold , it is between Kadesh and Bered .
And if a soul sin , and hear the voice of swearing , and is a witness , whether he hath seen or known of it  ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ki Jingkñia namar ka Pop ki donkam na ka bynta kine ki jingleh . Lada uno uno u shah khot da ki bor ba-halor ban ai sakhi ha ka ïingbishar bad um ïathuh ei ei ïa kata kaba u la ïohi ne u la ïohsngew , u dei ban kit hi ïa kaba mih nangta .

translation.en: I go the way of all the earth : be thou strong therefore , and shew thyself a man  ;
translation.kha: Ka por jong nga ban ïap ka la wan . To long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut skhem , bad leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u hukum ïa me ban leh .
bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar ton u kew mala saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib man ka snem pun bsa ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Moses , u briew’ jongnga U Blei! , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .
translation.en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .

translation.kha: Ko Pa , u duwai , Ko Pa jong nga ! Bahok ki kiei ki longïng kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me kwah .
translation.en: And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u leit shalor u lut ki Olib da kaba ïam ; u ïaid da ka kjat suda bad u tap ïa la ka khlieh kum ka dat ka jingsngewsih . Baroh kiba bud ïa u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la ïam ruh .
translation.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .

translation.kha: U shakri um shym don shibun shun siew ïa ka ram jongu u , kumta u syiem u la hukum ba ïa uta Dei ïa-ban die mraw noh , ïa ka tnaw bad ki khun jong u bad baroh kiba u la don khnang shun siew ïa ka rim .
translation.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .
( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka ktien Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Paul u la bteng :
Ki jait Hadad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Joïada , Bad ki jait dei ki ïatei don ha ki lynnong . Ki jait Asher ki shongduh harud ka duriaw , Ki ïai don harud ka Duriaw .
translation.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki la jubab , Ngin leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai nep ïa ka jaka bad ngin pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram . Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bun pynpang ïa ki nongïalam ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban slap ïa ka kular kaba ki la lah khlei .
translation.en: Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .
Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki lur ïa ki lyngkha jong ka jingsniew bad ki bet ïa ka jingbymman kum u symbai ; mynta ki ot da ka jingbymman bad ka jingsniew .

translation.en: Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka don ki khmat kiba i-ieit , katba ka Rakhel pat ka long i-lub bad kaba bhabriew .
Nangta sem la jingkhublei ïakhlad iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ngi la leit kiew ha ka lieng katba ma ki , ki la sien phai shaei ïing .
translation.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship  ; and they returned home again .
But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Dei ka jingbhasbun kaba nga kwah , ym ïa ka jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Lada phi la tip kaei ka jingmut jong kane , phin ym da la pynrem ïa ki briew ki bym shym shah pynrem ;

translation.en: When thou beatest thine olive tree , thou shalt not go over the boughs again : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .
translation.kha: Haba phi la dep kheit ïa ki soh Olib shisien , wat leit kheit shuh ïa kito kiba dang sah ; kita ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .
Neng long U Trai uba la Thaw ïa phi ; naduh ka por ba la kha ïa phi , de la ïarap ïa ph . Wat sheptieng ; phi long u shakri jongnga nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ieit .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .

translation.kha: Kumba ngan lah ban shah ïa ka lada kane ka jingrisa ka wan hap ha ki briew jong to , Bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki shah pynïap ?
translation.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U Trai la pynshitom .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,

translation.kha: Da thmu bha bad phna ïoh kyrhai ; lada phi leh kyrkieh palat phin Nimrim dap biang .
translation.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .

translation.kha: U Baalah u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad u ti pynskhem ïa ka Ramah khnam ban ym shiah ïa ka leit ka wan sha Judah .
translation.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

translation.kha: Bad hain said ki la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ! Ka long ka bym lah long ban ïalam bapaw ïa ki ïa-ban kylla-kaba-mut beiñ , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U blem bad pynlehrain ïa u ha khmat ka pyrthei .
translation.en: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument , neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin  ; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff , and the cummin with a rod .
translation.kha: Um ju pyndonkam da u diengtied uba khia ban shoh ïa ki symbai dil ne kumin ; hynrei u pyndonkam da ki dieng kiba sting kiba biang ka jingheh .

translation.en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap .  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah pynbaptis ,  u la ong ïa ki briew ,  bad U Blei un map noh ïa ki pop jong phi .

translation.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa ka jingïathuhkhana jong phi kum ka nuksa ïa ka jingpynjot , bad kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsih ïa ka jingshem jong phi :  La pynjot thiaw ïa ngi ! U  Trai  u la shim noh ïa ka ri jong ngi bad u la ai ïa ka sha kito kiba la ring koidi ïa ngi .
Shata ka long ba kumno ïa ki Ijipt yn pynlwet hapdeng kaba khlem otsher kiba la shah pynpoh ha ka thma .
translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised , and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .
translation.kha: Kum u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ; um shym la iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman .

U la ong , Ko Trai , lada me sngewbha shisha ïa nga , na kyrpad ïa me ban wan ryngkat bad ngi . Kynsan ki briew ki long kiba jingmutlop , hynrei map ïa ka jingbymman badno ka pop lad ngi , bad pdiang ïa ngi kum ki bhabriew ki jong me hi .
translation.en: And he said , If now I have found grace in thy sight , O Lord , let my Lord , I pray thee , go among us  ; for it is a stiffnecked people  ; and pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for thine inheritance .

translation.kha: U la ai hukum ïa ka Duriaw Saph mala ka rmiang ; u ïalam ïa ki briew jong u sha shiliang halor ka khyndew ba-rkhiang .
translation.en: He rebuked the Red sea also , and it was dried up : so he led them through the depths , as through the wilderness .

translation.kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim shym lah ba biah noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha kito ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki ding ïaishong hangta .
translation.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
We will go three days  journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the  Lord  our God , as he shall command us .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , kumba u la hukum ïa ngi .

U la saw phai pat shai u Elasah lym dara baroh ki rangbah jong u bad u ong , Mynta at tip ba ym don uno uno u bieit hynrei tang U Blei ki Eliel ; kum sngewbha , ko kynrad , pynhieng ïa ka jingai sngewbha na nga .
translation.en: And he returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him : and he said , Behold , now I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel : now therefore , I pray thee , take a blessing of thy servant .

translation.kha: Pynban , kane ka long kaei kaba u Jeiel u nongïathuhlypa u la kruiñ shaphang jong ka :
translation.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel  ;

Command Aaron and his sons , saying , This is the law of the burnt offering : It is the burnt offering , because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning , and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it .
translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingainguh thang . Ïa ka jingainguh thang dei ban ieh halor ka duwan baroh shi miet , bad hangta ka ding ruh ka dei ban ïai meh .

Katba ki dang leit lyngba ïa ki shnong , ki la ai ha ki phyrngab ïa ki jingbeh ryntih ba ki ebanjelist bun ki nongsharai balang ha Jeruel ki la rai , bad ki la bthah ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa kita ki jingbuhbeit rit .
translation.en: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ko ïakhun jongki nga , shahshkor ïa nga , shimet ktah ïa kaei kaba ang hikai ïa phoi , bad phin im slem .
translation.en: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ : for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth ; to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingngeit baskhem ha ka Gospel ; ka long ka bor U Blei ban pynim ïa baroh kiba ngeit , nyngkong ïa ki Jiw bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
Uta uba soi ïa la u parabriew kat haduh ba un da ïap u dei Ban shahskhor pynïap .
translation.en: He that smiteth a man , so that he die , shall be surely put to death .
Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw kum ka jinglehburom ïa ka Esther bad khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar bad nongpynïaidkam . U la pynbna shuti ha ka hima baroh kawei bad ai ki jingai sngewbha kiba shongdor kum ïa u syiem .
Ha ka proberb jingngeit-ba , u briew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka paila , bad ki khun jong u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .

translation.kha: Nga peit ïa kane , sa la pyrkhat shaphang jong ka , bad nga oh ka jinghikai na ka :
translation.en: Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it , and received instruction .

translation.kha: Ki la kop borabor , lada ki mon ban phla , ba naduh kaba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kabu pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharoah .
translation.en: Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .

translation.kha: iahap para sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — un phah khrai khlieh ïa phi ! Nangta un sa sdien ïa ka met jong phi ha u dieng , bad ki sim kin bim ïa ka doh jyllang phi .
translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .
translation.kha: U Elijah shisha u wan shuwa ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  bad un pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh .
Te ka khubor kaba wang na mihngi bad na shatei kan pynsheptieng ïa u , bad un ïaleh da jingbitar shla , da kaba pynïap shibun ngut ki briew .
translation.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him : therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy , and utterly to make away many .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ïai-ong , Haba ngan ïam pat ïa ki biria sha ka ri jong ki , sa shikyntien pat kin ong ha ka ri —Judah bad ki shynrong jong ka , ‘ To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa u lum bathngan jong ka Jerusalem , ka jaka bakhuid ha kob u shong .’
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof , when I shall bring again their captivity  ; The  Lord  bless thee , O habitation of justice , and mountain of holiness .
A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban kylla ri khlaw mluh namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong hangta .

U Moses u la ïa-ong ha u Jehoahas , Jiw katto katba ngut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïaleh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïohnong ha kliar u lum da kaba bat ïa u jingduh ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .

translation.kha: Na kane ka daw U Blei u la kyntiew eh ïa u sha ka bakwah kaba jingkhroh tam eh , bad ai ha u ïa ka kyrteng kaba kham khraw ban ïa kan kano kamai pat ka kylleng .
translation.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :

translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei shuh ban lyndet ïa U Trai da kaba pynïap ïa ki mrad jong ki ha Lum ha Wah la kum ba khia ainguh ïa ki sha ki ksuid . Ki paid Jesreel ki dei ba-bang jrem ïa kane ka aiñ pateng la pateng .
translation.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils , after whom they have gone a whoring . This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations .
And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there . And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  A Trai , wat bitar ba ngan kren biang . Kumno lada don tang laiphew ngut ?  U ong ,  Ngan ym leh ei ei ïa ka lada nga shem laiphew ngut hangta .

translation.en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Akhish u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ha khmih ! Une u briew u lamwir ! Balei phi wan ïalam ïa u sha nga ?

Uwei-pa-uwei na ki shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal , Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la Pha kattne katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlei Lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ïuhbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .

translation.kha: To ïa-ïam bad to kyang haba phi! ïohsngew ïa kane . Phi kiba shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , ñiar baroh ki nongkhaïi kyang ïap !
translation.en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ka shithi kaba lyngkhuit da ka jingïarap u Silas , ïa uba nga ñiad khim u para Khristan baïaineh . Nga kwah ban pynshlur ïa phi bad ban ai ïa ka jingpule jong de ba kane ka dem ka jingaiei bashisha jong U blang . To ïeng skhem ha ka .
translation.en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .

Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw ,  Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Haman na ka bynta ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
Kumjuh u Shual u kylli ïa U Blei , Hangto ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki phylla ? Hato men ai ha ngi ka jingap ? Hynrei U Balei um shym jubab ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And Saul asked counsel of God , Shall I go down after the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel ? But he answered him not that day .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylla pat ïa ka kot kli , u la ai pat ïa ka ha u shakri , bad u la shong . Baroh ki briew ha ka synagog ki la peit shlip sha u ,
translation.en: And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .
For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world , what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead ?
translation.kha: Naba haba ki la shah kyntait , ïa u bynriew la pynkylla na kaba long ki nongshun U Blei sha kaba long ki paralok jong u . Kaei ka ban long te , haba la pdiang ïa ki ? Kan long ka jingim ïa kiba la ïap!
Khim ka diengïap , ka ding ka lip nong ; khlem ka jinglorni , ka Jingïakajia ka ngut noh! .
translation.en: Where no wood is , there the fire goeth out : so where there is no talebearer , the strife ceaseth .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Lada kim ngeit ïa me lane kim lah pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane kan pynngeit ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ki briew jong ka Judah , ïa ka pop jong phi la thoin da u khulom nar ; la mluh jylliew halor ki dohnud jongno phi da u diamond banep bad la khuid halor ki Dong jong ki duwan jong phi .
translation.en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond : it is graven upon the table of their heart , and upon the horns of your altars  ;

translation.kha: Kynton kiba la ju long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïing jong nga ki la klet noh ïa per ; ki shakri kynthah ki leh ïa nga kum ïa uba kim ithuh bad u nongwei .
translation.en: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Buh jingthoh ïa ki shyieng ba la kha nyngkong baroh jong ki Israel naduh kiba shi bnai lane kham heh , Bad ñiew ïa ki kirteng jong ki .
translation.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Kumba u Mosah u la kyntiew ïa u seiñ rnga ha u dieng ha ka ri shyngkub , ha Kajuh ka rukom ka dei ïa U u U bri ba yn kyntiew shngain , ba uno uno Uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .

They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters  ; and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre , to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa , according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ai pisa ban siew ïa ki misteri maw bad ki misteri dieng bad ïa ka jingbam jingdih bad ka umphniang Olib ban phah sha ki nongbah jong ka Tyros bad Sidon kum ka jingïabujli na ka bynta ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon , ban wallam lyngba ka duriaw sha Joppa . Ïa kane baroh la leh da ka jingai jingbit u Syros , u patsha ka Persia .
U Philip u la rung ha ka synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kriah shlei nabar ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynngeit ïa ki shaphang ka Shim U Balei .
translation.en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Nangta ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da ki poh jat jong ki .
translation.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .
Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him , talk ye of all his wondrous works .
translation.kha: Rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; ïathuh ïa ki jingphylla kiba u la leh .
Haba ki la dep na kiba rkhiebeiñ ïa u , ki la law noh ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh bad ki la pynjop pat halor jong u da ki jaiñ jong u hi . Nangta ki ïalam noh ïa u pun sahnarphna .
translation.en: And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nongtuh la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka longïing ka bym haka hir ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la ia .
translation.en: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la jia ha Bethania kaba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ha kaba u Ïoannis u la pynbaptis .
Pynban haba ar la krung haduh katta ruh , phim shym shaniah ha U thri ,
translation.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the  Lord  your God ,

translation.kha: Wat la ym don kew ba dang sah , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ , ki diengsoh thombor , ki diengsoh Langbrot , bad ki diengsoh Olib kim pat shym pynmih shuh , pynban naduh mynta ngan kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea , as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .

translation.kha: Da ki jingsmai ba bunsien u la ong ha ka , Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha kano kano kaba pha pan , wat haduh shiteng ka hylla jong nga !
translation.en: And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .

Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Balei ba me la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba kane ka Templ kan long kum ka Shiloh bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah yn pynjot bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta ?  Nangta ki briew ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga .
Ong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa kito ki puriskam bad re ki thup bajrong lad ka jinghiarpateng , kiba pynmih tang ïa ki jingïania ; kim ïadih ei ei bad ka jingthmu U balui , ïa ka lah ban kop da ka jingbet .
translation.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies , which minister questions , rather than godly edifying which is in faith : so do .

translation.kha: Ki paidbhur ki tang shu ieh ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba u sheng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïing , ki dem khrup .
translation.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .

translation.kha: namar ngan ai ha phi ki kyntien bad ka jingstad kiba ym don na ki nongshun jong phi babha lah ban kyntait Lane ïa-pyrshah ïa kaei katba phi Ong .
translation.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom , which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist .

translation.kha: Shaneng bad kynthei u la thaw ïa ki , U la kyrshut ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki , Ki Briew . )
translation.en: Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .
translation.kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la leit sha lyngkha bad u lap ïa ki mandriek    , kiba u la wanrah sha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Ka Rakhel ka ong ïa ka Leah ,  Ai lem katto katne ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha .
La bhah ïa u ha ka jingtep lem bad ki bymnang , la tep ïa u sad kiba riewpaidbah , wat la um shym la leh Kano kano ka kai bymman litar um shym la shukor ïasnoh ïano .
translation.en: And he made his grave with the wicked , and with the rich in his death  ; because he had done no violence , neither was any deceit in his mouth .

translation.kha: Me tap ïa ka jingbymtip jong me da ka jingshukor ; Me long kum ki doktor ki bym eh don pynkoit ïano ïano .
translation.en: But ye are forgers of lies , ye are all physicians of no value .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ot ei ïa ki angkor malade ki la shah ïa ki ba ngin ngam ha ka duriaw , mala ha hajuh ka por ki la pynkylluid ïa ki tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki bthah . Nangta ki la kyntiew ïa ka jaiñ pynshah lyer ha ka pyntwa ba sha khmat jongki ka lieng khnang ba ka kyntu ka lah banbeiñ beh ïa ka lieng sha khmat , pynlang ngi la ïadei ngeit sha ka ryngkew .
translation.en: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .

translation.kha: Kum ki dieng , ki briew jong nga kin im slem . Kin ïoh ban lehsbun pura ha kiei kiei kiba ki la trei shitom .
translation.en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .
Behold , the  Lord  thy God hath set the land before thee : go up and possess it , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath said unto thee  ; fear not , neither be discouraged .
translation.kha: nga ong , ‘ Mynta phi la poi ha ri lum Amor , kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u ai ha ngi . Peit ïa ka hangtai . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka kumba u la hukum . Wat leh tud , bad wat sheptieng .’

Nga da lade hi nga la pynkhih ïa u syriem ban leh ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ang bad buh beit ïa kiei kiei . Ngan pynbeit ïa ka lynti baroh ba u leit . Un tei biang ïa ka nongbah jong nga , ka Jerusalem , bad un pyllait ïa ki briew ba shah setkut byndi jong nga . Ym don ba la shim wai ïa u ne ba la pynbam klop ïa u ban leh ïa kane . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: I have raised him up in righteousness , and I will direct all his ways : he shall build my city , and he shall let go my captives , not for price nor reward , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , kynsan ki la ïohi shi kynran ki nong Ishmael kiba wan ïaid lynti na Gilead sha Joppa . Ïa ki ut jong ki la pynkit ïa ki musli mluh bad ki jingiw .
translation.en: And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and , behold , a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .

translation.kha: Susah mynta ngi long ki mirr ha ka ri ba me la ai ïa ngi , kane ka ri baseisoh kaba ai jingbam ïa ngi .
translation.en: Behold , we are servants this day , and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof , behold , we are servants in it :

translation.kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong phi .
translation.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kriah ha ka jingbitar lep jong nga pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong pynlang khamtam pyrshah ïa ka Edom . Da kaba shadkmen bad da kaba leh ibeiñ , ki thup ïa ka ri jong ar bad shimet kynti ïa ki jaka phlang jong ka .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .

translation.kha: Ym ni uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba lai ïa kaba babha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .
translation.en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .

They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings , and eat it  ; but the  Lord  accepteth them not  ; now will he remember their iniquity , and visit their sins : they shall return to Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa ki jingkñia sha nga bad ki bam ïa ka doh kñia . Hynrei ma nga U Trai , ngam sngewbha ïa ki , bad mynta ngan kynmaw ïa ki pop jong ki bad pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata ; ngan phah biang ïa ki sha Ijipt .
Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad ïai kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God , and keep his charge , and his statutes , and his judgments , and his commandments , alway .
And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Phi ïakwah ban shong ban sah hangne katba kiwei pat ki Israel kin leit sha ka thma ?
U shakri u ngeit ïa ka jingbishar jong ka Baibl bad ïa ka hukum baneh ïalap ïa ka khubor bapra , malade u long uba stad ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiei ki jong u Khrist ha pyrthat .
translation.en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .

translation.kha: Kata ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop ka la ainong ha u Petros , Katto me ruh mem de uwei na ki synran jong Ittai u briew ? Em , ngam dei , la jubor u Petros .
translation.en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .

translation.kha: Nangta u Nahath u leit phai nong sha ïing . U Troas u la pynngat ka jingshitom bajur ha u khunlung ba ka tnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .
translation.en: And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .

And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaba sngur mynsiem , bad ki duwai ha me da kaba phai khmat sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , sha kane ka nongbah kaba me la jied , bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la ïohkhiah , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah nabar u la shadong baneh ïadait .
translation.en: And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka Khyrdop bahakhlieh shwa ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop , bad ka la don kajuh ka jingneh kum kito kiba ha ki kynroh kiba shabar .
translation.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate : and he measured the south gate according to these measures  ;

translation.kha: Lada phi wan pei ha ka shnong kaba ki briew kim khot sngewlah ïa phi lap kim sngem ïa phi , mynno na ka Bad kyntiew noh ïa u pajih pui na ki katjuh jong phin . Kata kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki !
translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
If a brother or sister be naked , and destitute of daily food ,
translation.kha: Tharai don ki parabangeit shynrang bad kynthei kiba donkam jaiñ bad kim don ka bam kaba biang ban bam .
Ong mad ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki khi na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun riat jong ki , bad ban wan ïalam ïa u Kpa jong phi bad ki .
translation.en: Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .

translation.kha: Da U Mynsiem Bakhuid me la kren lyngba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong ngi , u shakri jong me , haba u la ong , ‘ Balei ba ki Jentil ki bitar Shelah ; balei ki briew ki tiduh ïa ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?
translation.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said , Why did the heathen rage , and the people imagine vain things ?

translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap ar la pynum ïa ka jingisynei ïa kito ki Briew kiba la laiñ na ka jingïap . Haba ki paid Israel ki la thrang ban ïuh ïa ka jingjahthait , nga la paw ha ki na sha jngai bah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness  ; even Israel , when I went to cause him to rest .

translation.kha: Wat ong , Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa nga ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba u la leh !
translation.en: Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
And he said unto them ,  This is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la pynmih na ka bynta kiba bun , ka snam jong nga kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang U Blei .
Me thaw ïa ki jingshitom threw bad me leh ïa kiei kiew babha khrawbor ; me ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki briew ki leh , bad me ainong ïa ki kat kum ki jingleh jongno ki .
translation.en: Great in counsel , and mighty in work : for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men : to give every one according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings :

translation.kha: U Moses u la shim ïa kita ki diengduh baroh bad u la pynum ïa ki ha ki Israel . Ki la ïohi ïa kaba la jia , bad iwei pa uwei u nongïalam u la rim noh ïa la u jong u jingdoh .
translation.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .

translation.kha: Ka beiñ ka khyndew jong uwei pa uwei u Israel kan sah ha ka jait jong u .
translation.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe : for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers .

translation.kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki shitaiew bad por khem ïa ki ha said ka khuri , malu nga la ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .

translation.kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U TRAI’ un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka khunlangbrot lane kawei ka masi jong phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait khnang ban Pyndonburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .

translation.kha: ( Ym don mano mynshem ba lah ïa-ban pynkheiñ ïa u nard , khamtam u nar na shatei uba la khleh malu ka rnong . )
translation.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?

translation.kha: u Absalom u ju ong , Khmih , ka aiñ ka ha ka liang jong me , hynrei ym don Mano mano u ba ïitkhmih ïa u shym ban sngap ïa ka kam jong me .
translation.en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki wanlam na ka ri bashatei , ka jaitbynriew bakhrawbor na jngai bah ; shibun ki syiem ki pynkhreh ïa ka thma .
translation.en: Behold , a people shall come from the north , and a great nation , and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Un tap ïa me da ki thapniang jong u ; men long shongneh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u ; ka jinglong baïaineh jong u kane ïadat bad kyrshan ïa me .

translation.en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us , to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .

translation.en: And Boaz answered and said unto her , It hath fully been shewed me , all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband : and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother , and the land of thy nativity , and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore .

translation.kha: u la tei ïa ka pyrthei halor ki um bajylliew ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.en: Behold , all his fellows shall be ashamed : and the workmen , they are of men : let them all be gathered together , let them stand up  ; yet they shall fear , and they shall be ashamed together .
But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .
translation.kha: Wat ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka mane Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .

translation.en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid , and said unto him , Why hast thou done this ? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the  Lord  , because he had told them .

translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria–maacah , and out of Zobah .
Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .

Mynta te , ko Oholibah , khie ka long kaei ka ma ar , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha pha . Pha la thait ïa re ki nongleh-ieit , hynne nur pynlong ïa ki ngab bitar ïa pha bad nur-um wallam ïa ki ban ker sawdong ïa pha .

translation.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .

translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki rwai ki jingrwai jong ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom bad ki jingsngewnguh ïa iathuh uba shong ha ka khet , bad mane ïa uta uba im jongu la junom .
translation.en: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne , who liveth for ever and ever ,
But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the  Lord  withal .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw , ïa u soh baroh dei ban pynkyntang kum ka jingainguh ïaroh ïa nga , U  Trai .

Ha Kawei pa khawai ka shong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phin sha ka slipar kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong at , ang la pynïap ïa ki khup jong pa nabar kitab shym shongsah ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .
translation.en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .

translation.kha: ha ka ita kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jeruel . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin , kabu na Jerusalem .
translation.en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
God is my strength and power : and he maketh my way perfect .

translation.en: And cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee : for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jonah u la Kohnguh ïa U Trai bad u la leit shaei Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh haduh main katta ba ka la shim nga lai sngem ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
translation.en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .

translation.kha: U Asaraïah bad kiwei pat ki lyndum , ki peit sah ïa ka shyllangmat jong u syiem da ka jingsheptieng , bad mar mar ki tan jubor ïa u shabar ban mihnoh na ka Templ . U pynkloi ban miat shabar , namar U Trai u la pynkhyllem ïa u .
translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest , and all the priests , looked upon him , and , behold , he was leprous in his forehead , and they thrust him out from thence  ; yea , himself hasted also to go out , because the  Lord  had smitten him .

translation.kha: Leit ba U Terah u ai ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , U Trai u ïarap ïa uta u nongïalam bad u pyllait im ïa ki bynriew na ki nongshun jongnga ki katba uta u nongïalam u dang im . U Tharai u sngewsynei ïa ki namar ba ki la ud ha ki jingshitom bad jingshah banbeiñ jong ki .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  raised them up judges , then the  Lord  was with the judge , and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge : for it repented the  Lord  because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing , la ka heh ne ka rit , ka kynting sbai ban tip ïa kano ka khyrdop ka kitkhlieh .
translation.en: And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .

translation.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :

translation.en: And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .

Naei la iohnong ba u ino , ‘ Ngi pynjot ïa kane ka Templ kaba ki briew ki la tei , pynlang hadien lai sngi ngan tei ïa kawei pat kaba ym shym la shna da ki briew’
translation.en: We heard him say , I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and within three days I will build another made without hands .

translation.kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi . La slem bthah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kambah ïaheh ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim batip . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane Kohnguh ïa per .
translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: A Trai U Blei ki Israel , balei ken ka la jia ? Balei ba ka jait Bethmeon kan sa jah noh na Israel ?
translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
Son of man , set thy face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,

ma u lem bad ki briew jrong u baroh ki la sheptieng .

Kumta ym don uwei pajut na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .
translation.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .

translation.en: At that time Merodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah : for he had heard that he had been sick , and was recovered .

translation.en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .

Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .

translation.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches  ; with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .

translation.kha: Mynta , ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ki Israel ba sam bishar ïa phi Ïwei pa iwei da kaei kaba phi la leh . To pha noh na katba sniew baroh kaba phi leh , bad wat shah ba ka pop jong phi kan pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore I will judge you , O house of Israel , every one according to his ways , saith the Lord  God . Repent , and turn yourselves from all your transgressions  ; so iniquity shall not be your ruin .

translation.kha: U Syiem Sabad u ong , Ngam dei ban pyn-i ïa ka jingneh ka jingialang paralok ïa u Hanun , kumba u Nahash , u kpa jong u , u la imat ïa nga . Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewmeng jongki u . Haba ki la poi ha Ammon ,
translation.en: Then said David , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , as his father shewed kindness unto me . And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father . And David s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ka jaka ka ïar naduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang bashathie hajan ka Edom , shaduh Baalgad ha ka phang bashatei ha ka them jong ka Lebanon shaphang shatai jrong u Lum Hermon . U Joshua u la ïaleh thma slem mala ki syiem jyllang Kanneh ka thain , hynrei u la kurup ïa ki baroh bad u pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .

translation.kha: U kñia ïa la ki khun shynrang ha ka Them Hinnom kum ki jingainguh thang . U leh ïa ki jingkhan bun ki jingleh myntor bad u wad jingmut na ki nonghikai kupar bad ki nongleh byrtong . U leh pop palat marpyrshah ïa U Trai bad u pynjhieh ïa ka jingbitar jong U .
translation.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom : also he observed times , and used enchantments , and used witchcraft , and dealt with a familiar spirit , and with wizards : he wrought much evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .

translation.en: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .
translation.kha: Ka leit rah ïa u kew sha shnong bad ka pyn-i ha la ka kiaw kurim haduh katno ka la lum . Ka la ai ruh ha ka ïa kata ka jingbam kaba sah tam .
Ha kata ka sngi , wat ki meeting shynrang bad kynthei kiba kut bakhiah kin kyllon na ka jingsliang .
translation.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst .

translation.kha: Haba ki la khie thiah ha ka step kaba bud , ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ka um , da kaba pyntong ïa ka ba kan saw Kum ka snam .
translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone upon the water , and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood :

translation.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; as Moses commanded .

translation.en: Where the word of a king is , there is power : and who may say unto him , What doest thou ?
