ha ki kjat jong u Dabid , malade ka ong ha u , Sngewbha , ko kyndiang , to sngem ïa nga ! Ai ngan suit pop ma at .
translation.en: And fell at his feet , and said , Upon me , my lord , upon me let this iniquity be : and let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak in thine audience , and hear the words of thine handmaid .

translation.kha: U Trai nongbanbor Baroh u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa ken , u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom , bad ym khong mano mano ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?
And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren , and went over to Shechem : and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gaal u khun jong u Ebed u wan sha Shekhem lem bad la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u .

translation.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jong nga , namar nga kyrmen ba U Blei un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi baroh bad ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .

translation.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .
translation.kha: Te u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam Israel , ki ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
Nga , nga long u dieng sohwaiñ bashisha , bad U Kpa jong de u long u nongsumar brisoh .
translation.en: I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .
And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw kaba hajan Damaskos , bad nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynsleh ïa u Hasael kum u syiem ka Syria ;

translation.en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . Hear now , O house of Israel  ; Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh kam long kaba dei .’ To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki Israel . Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki lynti jong nga kiba nga leh ïa kiei kiei kim long kiba dei ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .

translation.en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u la ïasoh lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit u Ahithophel .
Kam shym pat bneng ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u longing kham jingaiei shuh shuh bad u sngewjahburom ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baalis .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .
Thou shalt not commit adultery .
translation.kha: Wat klim .

translation.en: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them .
translation.kha: Nga la ring ïa ki sha nga da ka jingsngewieit bad ka jingieit . Nga la rah ïa ki bad pyndei ïa ki ha ka ngab jong nga . Nga la dem sha ki bad nga la bsa ïa ki .
U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew : Teng pyn-i dak sha ki jingpyniwbih , bad kin wallam ïa ki khun jong pha sha ïing .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles , and set up my standard to the people : and they shall bring thy sons in their arms , and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders .

translation.kha: Pyndep , um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki hynrei u kohnguh ïa kaei kiba U Trai u la hukum ha ka Aiñ u Moses : Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sngi ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ki khuid ktien daiñ ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la sa da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sngew kaba u hi u la leh .
translation.en: But the children of the murderers he slew not : according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , wherein the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers  ; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndep da ki .
translation.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .

Then there was a famine in the days of David three years , year after year  ; and David enquired of the  Lord . And the  Lord  answered , It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he slew the Gibeonites .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Dabid , la don ka  nemsniew kaba jur kaba la neh haduh lai snem lynter . Kumta u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  shaphang kata bad U  Trai  u ong ,  U Saul bad ka longïing jong u ki long kiba rem ha ka jingpynïap briew ; u la pynïap ïa ki paid Gibeon .

translation.en: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
translation.kha: Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .

translation.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :
translation.kha: Haduh ngi baroh ngin wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jong ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin long ki briew kiba rangbah bha , kiba kot shaduh ka rynïeng ka jinglong rangbah pura U Khrist .

translation.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in meteyard , in weight , or in measure .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïano ïano da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingthew thok , ha ka pruh , ha u mawthew , ne ha ka jingbun .
Da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa ka jingpynim jong me ,
translation.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,
If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga , kumba nga la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Kpa jong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .

translation.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence , which they of that place which the  Lord  shall choose shall shew thee  ; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee :
translation.kha: Kin ai ïa la ka jingrai jong ki , bad phi dei ban leh kumba ki ong ïa phi .

translation.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross , having slain the enmity thereby :
translation.kha: Da ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pynduh thiaw ïa ka jingïashun jong ki ; da ka lynti jong ka diengphna u la pynïasoh lang ar ki jaitbynriew ha kawei ka met , bad u la wallam pat ïa ki sha U Blei .
Katba ka dang don ka sngi , ngi dei ban trei ïa ka nang jong uto uba la phah ïa nga ; ka miet ka wan hab ym don uba da ban trei .
translation.en: I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .

Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .
translation.kha: U ai ha u Hathakh ïa ka kopi jong ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynmih ha Susa , kaba hukum ïa ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw . U Mordekai u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ka sha ka Esther , ban batai ha ka ïa kaei kaba long , bad ban ong ïa ka ban ïasaid bad u syiem bad kyrpad ïa u ban don jingisynei ïa ki briew jong ka .
To pan na U Trei ïa u slap ha ka pyrem jong ka snieh . U dei U Trai uba phah ïa ki lyoh slap bad ïa u lap praw , da kaba pynjyrngam ïa ki lyngki na ka bynta uwei pa utai .
translation.en: Ask ye of the  Lord  rain in the time of the latter rain  ; so the  Lord  shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .
But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem bad ban bat ïa ka junom la junom .
naba hajuh kiba ïap ki mihpat , kin long kamon ki angel ha bneng pynlang kin ym ïashongkurim .
translation.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry , nor are given in marriage , but are as the angels of God in heaven .

translation.kha: U Shion bad ki ïakhun shynrang jong u : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul , u khun ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
translation.en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman .
Then said I , O my lord , what are these ? And the angel that talked with me said unto me , I will shew thee what these be .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ïa u ,  Ko rangbah , kine ki kulai ki mut aïu ?  U la jubab  Ngan pyn-i ïa phi aïu ki kit jingmut .
ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la thain da u sngewthuh biang ;
translation.en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ka nongbah Seïon , ha khih , u Syiem jong pha u wan sha pha ! U long uba sngewrit bad u shongkha halor ka kada bad halor u khun kada .
translation.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion , Behold , thy King cometh unto thee , meek , and sitting upon an ass , and a colt the foal of an ass .

translation.kha: Gaal U Jisu u la pynkut , To shahshkor! , te , lada phi don ki shlip !
translation.en: Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop jong phi ,  u la ong ,  naba ka Hima ki bneng ka la jan !

translation.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
translation.kha: Ka ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka long ka kper barieh , ka kper ba la ker kynroh , ka umpohliew bym dei paidbah ;
Kumta ki la sdang ban leit da ka lieng tang ma ki hi sha ka jaka kynjah .
translation.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately .
And there he found a certain man named Aeneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .
translation.kha: Hangta u la shem ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ainias , uba la pang ïapshiliang bad u bym shym la lah ban khie na ka jingthiah la phra snem .

translation.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof , and the oppressed in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: To pynbna ha kito kiba shong ha ki ïingsyiem ha Ijipt bad Ashdod :  Ïalumlang ha ki lum sawdong ka Samaria , bad peit ïa ka jingkhynwin kaba khraw bad ka jingbymman ba la leh hangta .

translation.en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .
translation.kha: To khie leit sha uwei u briew ha ka nongbah ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  bad ïathuh ha u : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong , ka por jong nga ka la poi ; ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ïing jong me !’

translation.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph , which he had said unto them : and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him , the spirit of Jacob their father revived :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ïathuh ha u ïa kata baroh kaba u Joseph u la ong ïa ki , bad haba u ïohi ïa ki kali ba u Joseph u la phah ban kit ïa u sha Ijipt , u kyndit bynriew .
Hynñiew sngi ki lyngdoh kin pynshngain ïa ka duwan bad pynbiang ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam .
translation.en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it  ; and they shall consecrate themselves .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng Jong ka ephod ba ngin ïing na ka pyntwa ki khat-ar jait Israel . Ha khnai ka stang u Aaron un kit ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng khnang ba ma nga , U Trai , ngan ïai kynmaw ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the  Lord  upon his two shoulders for a memorial .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga longsem umbah khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u sharai jong nga u Jakob .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .

translation.kha: hynrei u la jubab , Pi ïaleh aïu , da kaba ïam kumne nabar pynthait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ? Nga la kloi ym tang ban shah khum ha Israel hynrei kam ban ïap ruh hangta na ka bynta U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: Then Paul answered , What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart ? for I am ready not to be bound only , but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus .

Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said , Hear me , my brethren , and my people : As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and for the footstool of our God , and had made ready for the building :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ïeng ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong ,  Ko ki para ri jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga . Nga la kwah ban tei ka ïingshong neh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ka jingïuhkjat jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Nga la pynkhreh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa u ,

Khot lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ïa ki nongmane jong u baroh , mala ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh . Uwei ruh um dei ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia ainguh Kaba khraw ha u Baal , malu Uno Un uba jah un shah pynïap . ( Kane ka long ka buit sianti ha ka bujli jong u Jehu da kambah u mutdur ban pynïap lut ïa ki nongïam ïa u Baalath . )
translation.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .

translation.kha: Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidïapom ban lynthem maw ïa pha , malade kin ot lyngkhot ïa phad da ki waitlam jong ki .
translation.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .

translation.kha: Ngi tah sha phi tang ïa kabu phi lah ban nongpule bad sngewthuh . hynriew wat lada phi sngewtmang ïa ngi mynta tang katto katne , nga kyrmen ba phin poh sha Katai ka jingsngewthuh kaba pura , khnang ba ha ka Snem jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong Ngi phin ïoh sngewsarong ïa me kumba ngi sngewsarong ïa phi .
translation.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .
Yea , when they had made them a molten calf , and said , This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt , and had wrought great provocations  ;
translation.kha: Ki la thaw bleithaw ha ka dur jong u khun masi bad ong ba u dei u blei uba la ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ! Haduh katno ki la pynjahburom ïa me , Ko  Trai  !

translation.en: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite , they and their men .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ishmael u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah , u Seraïah u khun jong u Tanhumeth , ki khun shynrang jong u Ephai na Netophah , bad u Jesanaïah na Maakah ki la leit bad la ki rangbah sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah .
namar u la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim , bad u la jan ïap na ka bynta ka kam U Khrist , khnang ba un ai ïa nga ka jingïarap , kaba ma phi da lade phim lah ban ai .
translation.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u pynïasoh lang ïa lade bad ki mynsiem jong im ban Pynbna ba ngi longsyiem ki khun jong U Blei .
translation.en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit , that we are the children of God :
Praise ye the  Lord . Praise the  Lord  , O my soul .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga !
uto u Philistia u sdang ban ïaid sha khmat sha u Dabid lem bad u nongrah atiar wahbah ïaid ha shuh jong u .
translation.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David  ; and the man that bare the shield went before him .

Unto this day they do after the former manners : they fear not the  Lord  , neither do they after their statutes , or after their ordinances , or after the law and commandment which the  Lord  commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki dang ïai leh hi ïa la ki rukom barim haduh kane ka sngi . Kim shym mane ïa U  Trai  lane kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba u la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa uba u pynkyrteng u Israel .
U Trai u la krai ha nga :
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: “Nga pynrem ïa ki namar ka rukom ba ki im Bad ki imat , bad nga la pynsakma ïa ki kyrteng ki ri nongwei .
translation.en: And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .

translation.kha: Kumta da sumar kumno phi im . Wat im kum ki brai kiba ba-bieit , hynrei , kum ki briew kiba stad .
translation.en: See then that ye walk circumspectly , not as fools , but as wise ,

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Seïon ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ki Ong , Ka jingbitar U Bela ka longsem kum ka ding kaweh meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un laitim im na ka ding kaba kum kata ?
translation.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?

translation.kha: Ka sngew , u bnai bad ki khlur kin lwet jin . Ka sahit bneng kan jah noh kum ka ïingbasa ba la kli , bad ba ki khlur kin hap kum ki salia na u ngin sohwaiñ bad u dieng Dumbur .
translation.en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved , and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll : and all their host shall fall down , as the leaf falleth off from the vine , and as a falling fig from the fig tree .

Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U  Trai  na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong kane ka Kitab . U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ngi namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la leh ïa kaei ba kane ka Kitab ka ong ba dei ban leh .
Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki buid bad ki la leit bad u .
translation.en: And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .

translation.kha: U Abraham u wan hajan U Trai , bad u kylli , Hato men Shuah pynjot noh ïa kiba hok ruh thang bad ki bymman ?
translation.en: And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?

translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka shnong hangta kaba ha khmih jong phi ; haba phi rung shapoh , phin shem ïa u khunlung kada uba la theh ha uba ym patar ju don bajrong halor jong u . To loit bad wallam ïa u shane .
translation.en: Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ki paid Israel , nga da pyrkhat ïa ki briew ka Susanna kumba sa leh ïa phi . Nga la wallam ïa ki nongtih Philistia na Krit bad ïa ki nong syriem na Kir , kumba nga la wallam ïa ph na Ijipt .
translation.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me , O children of Israel ? saith the  Lord . Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt ? and the Philistines from Caphtor , and the Syrians from Kir ?

translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun ba-ieit jong ar : To ai ba U Blei! uba U Kpa sad U Khrist Ujuh uba U Trai jngai moi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei , bad ka jingsuki .
translation.en: To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka aïu ot , bun ka bhah ka don ha ka jingshlei um . Haba u paidbah u la mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ban jam ïa ka Jordan , ki lyngdoh ki la leit ha shuwa jong ki , ki da bah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Hamar ba ki lyngdoh ki ïuh ha ka wah ,
translation.en: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan , and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water , ( for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest , )

translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin phai paw shai U Trai , bad kohnguh da ka dohnud jong phi baroh’ , malade da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki Hukum jong u kiba nga ai ha phi myntoi ka sngew ,
translation.en: And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;

translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki khong ha ka jaka naba ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar ki la ïapynbiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities and their villages .
And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .
translation.kha: U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u la kyllaiñ da ki jaiñsop ïa kiba ïap , bad da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khmat jong u .  To law noh na u ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad ai ba un ïaid .
To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Seïon , La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! Ngi dei ban iohnong ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïing jyllang ngi la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .
Thou didst march through the land in indignation , thou didst thresh the heathen in anger .
translation.kha: Me thom sawdong ka pyrthei ha ka jingbitar ; ha ka jingbitar shla me ïuh halor ki jaitbynriew .
Ka kmie jong u ka pynbuh briew ïa u bad ka nong Joppa .
translation.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Haba u Messaïah u la wan phai na ka jinghap ïa ki Edom , u wanrah ïa ki paitlieng jong ki lem dara u , u pynïeng ïa ki , u la manna ïa ki , pynlang u thang jingiwbih ïa ki .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites , that he brought the gods of the children of Seir , and set them up to be his gods , and bowed down himself before them , and burned incense unto them .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u lat uba don ha ka kad ha shuwa jyllang nga , u la longkmie ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju dawa arphew ki pisa rupa syang sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakuriaw jongnga ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam syiem ar kumto , namar nga baburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .

translation.kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa la ki briew ban sdang ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba ïaid ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai .
Ym kumta ! u Joab u jubab . Ngan ym pynsniew lane pynïoh ïa ka nongbah jong phi !
translation.en: And Joab answered and said , Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai palat ban ïa uno uno na babha ha shuwa jongu u .
translation.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the  Lord  above all that were before him .
And he also had made savoury meat , and brought it unto his father , and said unto his father , Let my father arise , and eat of his son s venison , that thy soul may bless me .
translation.kha: U ruh u la shet ïa ka jingbam kaba bang bad u leit rah ïa ka sha la u kpa . U ong ,  Ko pa , sngewbha , to khie shong bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh ba nga la wanrah ïa phi , ba phi lah ban ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .

translation.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee  ; and what I see , that I will tell thee .
translation.kha: Ngan leit bad ngan ïeng hajan i pa ha kata ka jaka ba phi rieh , bad ngan ïakren bad i shaphang jong phi . Lada nga shem ei ei , ngan sa ïathuh ïa phi .

translation.en: And Saul said to David , Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him : for thou art but a youth , and he a man of war from his youth .
translation.kha: Em ,  la jubab u Saul .  Kumno men lah ban leit ïaleh ïa u ? Me long tang u khynnah , katba ma u , u la long u shipai ha baroh ka jingim jong u !

translation.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof , and will slay all the princes thereof with him , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïap ïa u nongsynshar ka Moab bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ka ri .
Kumta mem long sha uta uba leh ïa kane katai kaei ; pynap , ka daiñ ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .
translation.en: Now then it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .

translation.kha: Te U Troas un ong ha la ki briew , ‘ sharai kito ki blei khrawbor ha kiba phi shaniah ?
translation.en: And he shall say , Where are their gods , their rock in whom they trusted ,

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan la don ka jingkhie joit kaba jrut ; u angel U Trai u la wan hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u maw , bad u la shnong khlur jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka jaka ngan pynpulom ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong ki briew ka Judah dara ka Jerusalem . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma . Ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ki jah bad ha ki mradkhlaw koum ka jingbam .
translation.en: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki nongïalam jongnga phi kiba mynba , kiba la kren ha phi ïa ka khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumno ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit jong ki .
translation.en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .
translation.kha: To ïaineh bad ka tnga jong phi bad ai ka jingieit tang ïa ka hi .

Nga la sneng ïa ki Rangbah , nga la tei ïa ki , shoh ïa ki bad pajut ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Hangta nga la pynbang ïa ki ban syiem ha ka ktung U blei ba kim dei shuh ba ma ki ne ki khun jong ki ktien shongkha khleh bad ki nongwei .
translation.en: And I contended with them , and cursed them , and smote certain of them , and plucked off their hair , and made them swear by God , saying , Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons , nor take their daughters unto your sons , or for yourselves .
That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :
translation.kha: ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynlong bad phi bad ban pdiang ïa ki ktien ba la thoh ha ka ,
U Trai u ong , Ki longsyiem ki brisoh jong nga kin ym shrak ïa na . Bad kumta u la pyllait im ïa ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki baroh .
translation.en: For he said , Surely they are my people , children that will not lie : so he was their Saviour .

translation.kha: U syiem Hanun bad ki Almon ki sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong ïa u Dabid u nongshun jongngi ki , kumta ki siew laiphew saw hajar kilo ka rupa ban wai ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah kali ïapom na ka Mesopotamia baïaineh bad na ki jylla Syria jong ka Maakah bad Sobah .
translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David , Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia , and out of Syria–maacah , and out of Zobah .

translation.kha: dat tieng mynta ba nga pynurlong ïa ki ; ym don ei ei kum kane kaba la jia ba-mynshuwa . Lada ka la jia , Phon jin da la kam ba ph la dep tip) luin shaphang khnai .
translation.en: They are created now , and not from the beginning  ; even before the day when thou heardest them not  ; lest thou shouldest say , Behold , I knew them .

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , u nongtrei sorkar u la lah ba pynjai jai ïa u paidbah . Ko para nong Ephesos ! u la ong . Uwei pa uwei u tip ba ka nongbat Ephesos ka dei ka nongsumar ïa ka baphylla jong ka Artemis bakhraw bad ïa u mawkyntang Uba la hap na sahit bneng .
translation.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people , he said , Ye men of Ephesus , what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana , and of the image which fell down from Jupiter ?

translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew sa kyllaiñ lada ym don ka jingïalam . Ha ka jingbun ki nongaibuit Don ka jingtasngeng .
translation.en: Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .

translation.kha: Ki nong Gasa ki shem ba u Samson u ni hangta , kamut ki kerkut ïa said ka bakwah bad ki ap ïa u baïar shi miet ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da kaba pyrkhat ha lai , Ngin ap haduh ban da kynti shai , shun nangta ïong sa pynsep ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told the Gazites , saying , Samson is come hither . And they compassed him in , and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , In the morning , when it is day , we shall kill him .
And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .
translation.kha: U angel U Blei u la kren ïa nga ha ka jingphohsniew bad u ong , ‘ Jakob !’ ‘ Oi’ nga la jubab .

translation.en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Mynta kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ?

“Phi pynïeng ïa ki blang ba-ijli ha khmat ka jingkhan ki jingkhang bah ki ïeng jong phi . Phi la lyndet ïa nga ; phi law ïa la ki jaiñ Bad kiew halor ki jingthiah baheh jong phiah ryngkat bad kiba ieit jong phi! , ïa kiba phi la siewdor ban ïathiah nur-um bad ki . Bad hangta phi! pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
translation.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance : for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me , and art gone up  ; thou hast enlarged thy bed , and made thee a covenant with them  ; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi ino , ‘ Kaei kob U Trai u leh kam long kaba dei .’ To shukor ïa nga , phoi ki Israel . Hato phira pyrkhat ba ki lynti jong nga kba nga leh ïa kiei kiei kim long kiba dei ? Ka dei ka lynti jongnga phi ka bym long kiba dei .
translation.en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . Hear now , O house of Israel  ; Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?

translation.kha: Ka Delilah nangta ka kynoi thiah ïa u , ka shim ïa ngi ki kynthrong khynñiuh jong u , bad ka thain hynñiew thylli ïa ki . Ka pynskhem ïa ki da ki sleit ïingjaiñ nabar ka pyrta , Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wei ! jynreiñ u khie joit bad u praw pynsynjor ïa la u sngewnguh na kata ka jingthain .
translation.en: And she fastened it with the pin , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awaked out of his sleep , and went away with the pin of the beam , and with the web .

At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong nga , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pat ha nga . Ki rangbah synshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jong nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pat ha nga ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem , bad wat ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba mynshuwa .
Haba u Paul u la wan , ki Jiw kiba la woh na Jeruel ki la ïeng sawdong ïa u bad ki la sdang ban buh shibun ki jingmudui kiba khia pyrshah ïa u , ïa kiba kim lah ban pynshisha .
translation.en: And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .
Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki Israel kim dei shuh ban wan sha jan ka Ïingjaiñ ïoh ki wallam ha lade ïa ka jingshah pynshitom da ka jingïap .

U Mynsiem jong U Trai u long ha nga , namar ba u la jied ïa nga ban wallam ka khubor babha ha kiba hep . U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ka jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi Bad ka jingpynïoh ïa ka jingimat ha kiba Mahath ; ban pyllait ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ
translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me , because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor  ; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives , and recovering of sight to the blind , to set at liberty them that are bruised ,

translation.kha: Ki khmih jong u kiba saw snam , badno u don ki jingmong khlem daw .
translation.en: They that tarry long at the wine  ; they that go to seek mixed wine .

translation.kha: U Blei u leh kumba u Manoah u la kyrpad , bad u angel jong U , u wan biang sha kata ka briew katba ka dang shong ha lyngkha . U Manoah , u tnga jyllang ka um shym don lang Bad ka ,
translation.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah  ; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field : but Manoah her husband was not with her .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew uba kyrduh , ar ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jyllang phi un ym tip shaphang kata .
translation.en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :

translation.kha: U Shibboleth , u Tobiah , u Geshem bad kba sah na ki nongshna jong ngi , ki la ïohsngew ba ngi la lah pyndep ïa ka jingtei ïa ka kynjoh bad ba ym don Shuh ki jinglait thliew ha ka , wat la ngim pat Shimham la pynïeng ki khyrdop ha ki jaka baneh shnong ïa ki .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when Sanballat , and Tobiah , and Geshem the Arabian , and the rest of our enemies , heard that I had builded the wall , and that there was no breach left therein  ; ( though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates  ; )

translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .
translation.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: U tnga uba ieit u sumar bha ïa la ka tnga , da ka jingieit bad da ka jingsngewthuh .
translation.en: A loving husband treats his wife with tenderness and understanding .

translation.kha: U bajanai un kylla dum , bad ka sngi kan ym tyngshaiñ shuh , namar U Trai badonburom Baroh un long u syiem . Un synshar ha Jerusalem halor u Lum Seïon , bad ki nongïalam jong ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .
translation.en: Then the moon shall be confounded , and the sun ashamed , when the  Lord  of hosts shall reign in mount Zion , and in Jerusalem , and before his ancients gloriously .

translation.kha: U shane ïa kita ki jingbuh da ka dien akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .

And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .
translation.kha: U la tih ïa ka khyndew bad u la weng ïa ki maw na ka ; u la thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kynsai . U la tei ka jaka ap phira ban khmih sumar ïa ki , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ban ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ . U la ap ïa ki sohwaiñ ban ih , hynrei uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ u long uba jew .

Namar kano , ngan pynïap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong me bad tun pynïap ïa ki ïakhun ki kiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pyndih khoit ïa ka longïing jong me ; kumba sar lwet ïa ka jakhlia .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .

And the children of Israel , which were come again out of captivity , and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land , to seek the  Lord  God of Israel , did eat ,
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingkñia la bam da baroh ki Israel kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw bad da baroh kito kiba la iehnoh ïa ki rukom mane blei thala jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri bad kiba la wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .
To ïohmap ïa ka pep jongki ki ; hynrei “lada men ym map , nga kyrpad ba bathoiñ weng noh ïa ka kyrteng jongngi nga na kata ka kitab ha kaba me la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong u paidlang jong me .
translation.en: Yet now , if thou wilt forgive their sin―  ; and if not , blot me , I pray thee , out of thy book which thou hast written .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por u —Joshua u la leit Bad u pynduh khoit ïa ka jait ka kynja ki Ramath ba la khot kyrteng ki Anakim kiba shong basah ha ka ri lut — ha Hebron , Debir , Anab , malade ha baroh ka ri lum jong ka Judah bad ka Israel . U Joshua u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki .
translation.en: And at that time came Joshua , and cut off the Anakims from the mountains , from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab , and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel : Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .

translation.kha: Mynta , na ka beit kita uba la ïaw ki ban sa mihpat : Hato phim bapaw ju pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ïa ka bynta kaba dei shaphang ka lawlynnong kaba ing ? Hangto la tah ba U Bela u la ong ïa u Messaïah , ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Ahab , U Blei jrong u Isaak bad U Balei jong u Jakob .’
translation.en: And as touching the dead , that they rise : have ye not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spake unto him , saying , I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ?
And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying ,  All hail .  And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Kynsan U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .  Ki la leit sha u , bad ki la bat ïa ki kjat jong u , bad ki la mane ïa u .
Pynban , na ka bynta u Dabid u kpa jong me , ngan ym leh ïa kñia katba me dang im , hynrei ha ka par jingsynshar u khwan jong me .
translation.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father s sake : but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son .

translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi baneh duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlong bad to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bakha ïa ph ban rung sha ka jingjam tang da kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tyrnem ki khmat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka dujok ding .
translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .

translation.kha: U Ïaineh u la phong da ki jaiñ-jin ba la shna na ki shñiuh ut , bad u pynhapoh snieh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jongki u ka la longïng da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .
translation.en: And John was clothed with camel s hair , and with a girdle of a skin about his loins  ; and he did eat locusts and wild honey  ;

translation.kha: Ym Don uba shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u Nonghikai jong u ; ym don u mraw uba kham khrum ban ïa u kyndiang jong u .
translation.en: The disciple is not above his master , nor the servant above his lord .
Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;
translation.kha: Wat klet ïa ka jutang U Blei , kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom ,
Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Nathan , u nongshetkylla , Nga shong hangne ha ka ïinglieng ba la tei da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei pah la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translation.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now , I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Libnah shaei Lakhish , ki kerkut ïa ka , mala ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , unto Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it :

translation.kha: Kumta kita shi para ki ïashun ha khmat jong u , ha ka miej marsyndah ïa u Jakob kat kum ka ot jrong ki naduh uba nyngkong haduh uba khatduh . Haba ki ïohi kumno ki ïashong bam , ki shu ïa-peit lyngngoh para ma ki .
translation.en: And they sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth : and the men marvelled one at another .

translation.kha: U Trai un tim ïa ki shnong bad ki lyngkha jong phi .
translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city , and cursed shalt thou be in the field .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang , badno kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?
translation.en: And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?

translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paulos , La shahskhor ïa me ban kren na ka bynta ïa latai . U Paul u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ïasaid da ïa lade kumne :
translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :

translation.kha: Ki Midian ki long kiba khem khlaiñ ban ïa ki Israel , bad ki paid Ishmael ki rakhe ïa lade na ki ha ki Keramim bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain ha ki lute .
translation.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab , Pynban , katno ka kmen long iar Kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka !
translation.en: But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .

translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap nga la pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa kito ki briew kiba la lait na ka jingïap . Ha ki pyntud Israel ki la thret banbeiñ ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait , nga la paw ha ki na sha jngai bah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness  ; even Israel , when I went to cause him to rest .
But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , ‘ A me uba bieit ! Ha kane hi ka miet men hap ban iehnoh ïa la ka jingim ; te mano ban ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba me la buh na ka bynta ïa lade ?’
U Trai u la ïong , Ka sngi ka wan ha kaba ka jingkhraw jong ka Israel kan poi sha naba kut , bad ïa ka spah jong ka yn buid da ka jingduk .
translation.en: And in that day it shall come to pass , that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean .
And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .
translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shynrang ba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .

translation.en: And if thy right hand offend thee , cut it off , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .
translation.kha: Lada ka kti kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , to ot noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh ïa kawei na ki kti jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka leit sha dujok .
Nangta u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U Trai bad u ïong , Mynta kynum ngan lah ban Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ?
translation.en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :
translation.kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa U  Trai bad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .

Ka jingai jingsumar man ka por na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki kynthei ka ne shisnem — ki jingkhem met da ka umphniang mirr na ka bynta hynriew bthei bad da ka jingmane balsam sa hynriew bnai . Hadien kata , ïa kawei pa kawei ka apil yn ïalum kawei hadien kawei sha u syiem Seir .
translation.en: Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )

translation.kha: U Jingsuk u la ong , Kane ka long ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la pynmih na ka bynta kiba buiñ , ka sner jyllang nga naba pynskhem ïa ka Jutang U Blei .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many .

translation.kha: U Joab u phla ïa la ki kti sad u bsuh ïa ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim , wat la u long uba kham rit , bad ïa ka kti sdang ha ka khlieh u Manasseh , uba khim san .

translation.kha: U Blei u kular ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Hima jong u .
Ka dei ka jingshetkylla , ko Ahasaïah ! U Joram u kyang jam , katba u dang pynphai sarong ïa ka kali ïamap jong u bad u phet ïap .
translation.en: And Joram turned his hands , and fled , and said to Ahaziah , There is treachery , O Ahaziah .

translation.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .

translation.kha: Nga la klet noh kaba kumno ka jingkhiah nabar ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen ki un-long .
translation.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .

translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives , the disciples came unto him privately , saying , Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign of thy coming , and of the end of the world ?

translation.en: Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .

translation.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :

translation.en: Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .

translation.en: Now therefore hearken , O Israel , unto the statutes and unto the judgments , which I teach you , for to do them , that ye may live , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  God of your fathers giveth you .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba don jingmut sngi , hynrei u ngeit ïa kito kiba sa ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the  Lord  : but such as are upright in their way are his delight .

translation.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .

translation.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron s head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ïa ki shyieng jrong ki syiem bad jong ki rangbah synshar ka Judah , kumjuh ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh , jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad jong kiwei pah ki briew kiba la sheng la sah ha Jerusalem , yn khlong khong na ki jingtep jong ki .

Ka jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka durkhmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynïap ïa ka jingshemphang jong phi .
translation.en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them  ;
translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad kawei pat ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ki la ïohpdiang lypa ïa ka ri kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha ki ; ka don ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .

translation.en: ( Psalm 119 :97-100 ) Yet , true Christians do not respect God’s standards merely to benefit themselves .

Ha baroh kawei ka ri phi! la die ïa put kum ki nuti ha u blei Baal bad phin la ieit ïa u kew uba phi pyrkhat ba u la siew na ka bynta jong phiah !
translation.en: Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .

I have taught thee in the way of wisdom  ; I have led thee in right paths .

translation.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :

I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .

translation.en: For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .

translation.en: And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,

translation.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .

translation.en: Surely after that I was turned , I repented  ; and after that I was instructed , I smote upon my thigh : I was ashamed , yea , even confounded , because I did bear the reproach of my youth .

translation.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .
translation.kha: kumta u thang jingkñia da ki mrad bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u theh ïa ka jingainguh waiñ bad ka snam jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok ha ka .

ki la leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki san ngut kiwei pat ki syiem : u Bera jong ka Sodom , u Shisha jong ka Gomorrah , u Sibaïah jong ka Admah , u Shemeber jong ka Seboiim , bad u syiem jong ka Bela ( lane Soar ) .
translation.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom , and with Birsha king of Gomorrah , Shinab king of Admah , and Shemeber king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela , which is Zoar .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la kiew hiar kawei na ki lieng — kaba long ka jong u Simon — bad u la ïakyrpad ïa u ban ñiew tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shongkha ha ka lieng mala u la hikai ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .
The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,
translation.kha: Hangta halor u lum , U  Trai  u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .

translation.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion  ; they , they are thy lot : even to them hast thou poured a drink offering , thou hast offered a meat offering . Should I receive comfort in these ?
translation.kha: Phi shim ïa ki maw kiba jlih nangta bad mane ïa ki kum ki blei . Phi theh ïa ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh ïa ki bad wallam sha ki ïa ki jingainguh kew . Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha da kine kiei kiei ?
Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U Trai U Blei jongki phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .
translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .
Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngan khi ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad ngan ieh lyndum ïa ki .
to long Kiba sngewnguh ha kiwei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U balui u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .

translation.kha: ba u Hanamel , u khun jong u kñi jongnga nga , u Shallum , un wan sha nga bad ka jingkyntip ban thied ïa ka lyngka jong u ha Anath ha ka thain Benjamin , ñiar nga long u ba-beit bajan tam bad ba nga don ka hok ban thied ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: Behold , Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee , saying , Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth : for the right of redemption is thine to buy it .

translation.kha: Ko khun u brai , u la ong , to ong ha u syiem jong ka Ijipt bad ha ki briew jong u baroh : Katno ka jingkhrawbor jngai me ! Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa me ?
translation.en: Son of man , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , and to his multitude  ; Whom art thou like in thy greatness ?

translation.kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , badno ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bakhlaiñ jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka sur jong u hi .
translation.en: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
And take double money in your hand  ; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks , carry it again in your hand  ; peradventure it was an oversight :
translation.kha: Rah pisa ar shah bad phi , namar phin hap rah biang ïa kito ki pisa ïa kiba la buh pat ha khlieh ki byrni jong phi . Ka lah ban long tang ka jingbakla .
Ha ka jingïadei mala ka Judia , la kumin kumno nga la ïap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka bynta U Blei . La pynjop ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jong u ,
translation.en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .
translation.kha: Nga , nga long u kpu ka jingim ,  U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki .  Kito kiba wan sha nga da lei lei kin ym thngan ; kito kiba ngeit ha nga da lei lei kin ym sliang .
Kumne u Aaron u rhah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki kshaid ki ïamih bad ki Tap lin ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai un pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam badonbor bad bashyrkhei jongngi u ban pynshitom ïa u Elnathan , uta u Ïakjakor uba khih bad uba khyrwait , bad ban pynïap ïa uta u mrad kynsha suba im ha ka duriaw .
translation.en: In that day the  Lord  with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent , even leviathan that crooked serpent  ; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea .

translation.kha: Hynrei , ko Trai Badonbor Baroh , me tyngam hok ïa ki briew ; me tip kaei kaba don hapoh ki dohkha bad ka jingmut jong ki . kumto shahïap kan ieh ba me pynsaphred Hamor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kiei jong me .
translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .

translation.kha: Bad da baroh ka shab bakyiuh jong u lyngba U kyrshut Jisu! , U Blei jong nga un pyndih ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi barieh .
translation.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Mynba kiba na ka longïing jong u ki la iohsngew shaphang kata , ki la leit ban smat ïa u , namar ki briew ki la ïa-ong , U la lamwir !
translation.en: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .

translation.kha: Phin skhem ïa ki balaitluid jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa pynlang ïa ki blei jyllang phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrthei , Kam don shuh ha khmat jong nga !
translation.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ki la khie dang mynstep phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom — dei tang ha kane ka sngi ba ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka hynriewphew sien .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat klim .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery .

translation.kha: Ngan sngewbha ha kaba kun kiei kiei kiba bah na ka bynta Jong ki , bad ngan buhai pynskhem junom ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .

translation.kha: Kumta khie ithuh bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u loit Hirah sha ka Wah Nahaliel . Rah bad me ïa u diengduh ïa uba la pynkylla beiñ , malu ap ïa u harud wahbah .
translation.en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .

translation.kha: U Amasa um shym don jingïada na ka thliem kaba u Joppa u slap ha kamai pat ka ktah jong u , bad u Joab u la dung ïa u na ka khlup , bad ki snieh jong u ki mih shaid ha madan . U ïap ha shen , bad u Joab um donkam ban rud biang sa shisien . Nangta u Joab nabar u Abishua , u para jong u ki la leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translation.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab s hand : so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground , and struck him not again  ; and he died . So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trei Jingsuk u la lah kren bad ki , ïa u la shim noh sha bneng bad u la Shong ha ka jar kamon jngai U Blei .
translation.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them , he was received up into heaven , and sat on the right hand of God .

translation.kha: hynne lapbah baroh kin wan Bad ïeng ha khmat Jong nga , lang! ym shem wat tang uwei ruh na ki ba u long uba stad .
translation.en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  U briew uba la bet ïa u symbai babha u long U Khun U Briew ;
Lada phi ïoh spah da kaba kheiñ sut bad shim kabu ïa ki briew , ka spah jong phi kan leit sha uwei paw kaba lehsbun ïa kiba duk .
translation.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewlehrain ïa baroh kaba nga la ong bad nga kylla-kaba-mut ha u pui pui bad u dpei .
Ym Don uno uno uba lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei khlem ka jingngeit , naba uta umbah wan shai U Bel u dei ban don ka jingngeit ba U Blei u don , bad ba u ainong ïa kita kiba jar ïa u .
translation.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .

translation.kha: U Judas u khun lad u nong u long uba la pyndap da ka jingstad , naba u Moses u la thung ïa u ban long u nongshimti pateng . Ki Israel ki kohnguh ïa u Joshua bad ki sumar ïa ki law ba U Trai u la ai ha ki lyngba u Mesha .
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom  ; for Moses had laid his hands upon him : and the children of Israel hearkened unto him , and did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba leh ïa kaba bha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .

U Jabin u kein khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar , bad u la synshar ïa ki Israel da kaba banbeiñ bad lehbor Haduh arphew snem . Nangta ki pyntud Isaia ki la Kieng jam ha U Terah ban ïew jingïarap .
translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron  ; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Namar ki khlem la niewkor ia ki jinglehsbun jongno U Blang , u Adam bad ka Im ki la saitlah .
translation.en: Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .

translation.kha: Lada daiñ u Rangbah Lyngdoh uba leh jop bad da kumta u wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ha ki paidbah , un ai ïa u masi lyngraw u bym Don kano kano ka jingda bad un kñia shat U Trai Naaman ka pop jong u .
translation.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people  ; then let him bring for his sin , which he hath sinned , a young bullock without blemish unto the  Lord  for a sin offering .
The king of Eglon , one  ; the king of Gezer , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Eglon , ka Geser ,
Long ba la tim ïa u briew uba tei ïa la ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynjuh pynïar ïa ka da ka jingleh bymhok ; uba pynlong ïa la ki por shnong shun trei khlem kam , bad u bym siew pang ïa ki .
translation.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;

translation.kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u dat pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka long ka jingleh bieit ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka na ha ki kam bymmyntoi .
translation.en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga : To da husiar na kito kiba pynlong ki jingïapait bad kiba pynkulmar ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew bad kiba ïaid pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïoh . To kiar na ki !
Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam shai ka ïing u nongbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki rangbah lyngngoh , ki rangbah nongñiah Bad ki nonghikai jongu ka sah” .
translation.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .

translation.kha: Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la tei da u sahmiet Akhish , U Trai un pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien . Bad ka syrngiew ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .
Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban shim noh shajrong ïa u , u la ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki rangbah kiba u la jied kum ki apostol jong u .
Hynrei lada katai ka jingkynnoh ka long kaba shisha bad ym don sabut ban pyn-i ba kata ka briew ka long kaba dang sotti ,
translation.en: But if this thing be true , and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel :
Yea , thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised , and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ba kumno ïa ki Ijipt yn pynlwet hapdeng kiba khlem otsher kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la Lah ïarap . U la khot ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la kylli ïa u la U ju u la lah ïap la slem .
translation.en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
And the  Lord  shewed me four carpenters .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga saw ngut ki nongtrei kiba don bad ki tyrnem .

Hynrei kumno kin lah ban khot kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta ka jingïarap lada kim shym la ngeit ? Bad kumne ngin lah ba-bang ngeit salia kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Bad kumno ki lah ban ïohsngew paila ïa ka khlur ym shym la pynbang ?
translation.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed ? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard ? and how shall they hear without a preacher ?

The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .
translation.kha: U Hanun bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew mitar , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .

translation.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another  ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be .
translation.kha: Kita ki kherub kin ïaphai markhmat , na shiliang sha shiliang ka jingtap bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa kata ka jingtap .

translation.en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingjot ha me . Ngan sar noh phar ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong me , la u samla bad tymmen kumjuh .

Ki dieng kin sei ïa u soh , ki lyngkha ken pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad uwei pa uwei un shongshngain ha la ka ri . Ynda haba nga dkhat ïa ki kynjai kiba teh ïa ki briew jong nga bad nga pyllait ïa ki na kito kiba pynlong mraw ïa ki , te Kin sa kop ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit , and the earth shall yield her increase , and they shall be safe in their land , and shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have broken the bands of their yoke , and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them .

translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki kseh jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
He is a merchant , the balances of deceit are in his hand : he loveth to oppress .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long bymhok kum ki nong Kanaan ; ki sngewtynnat ban shukor ïa ki nongthied da ki tarajur bymhok .
Ki kynoi ki de ban nang ban sngap jar bad da ka jingsngewrit baroh .
translation.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .

translation.kha: Nangta u wan ïalam shiah khnam ïa ka longïing jong u Sabdi shaw khmat , uwei hadien uei , bad la kam ïa u Akhish , u khun jong u Karmi bad u ksiew jong u Sabdi .
translation.en: And he brought his household man by man  ; and Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , was taken .

translation.kha: U bhabriew uba bha un ioh jingkynduh . Ki ktah u riewdonburom ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .
translation.en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngew jynjar sat . Hynrei U  Trai  u khot pat ïa pha bad u ong :
( Ephesos 5 :18 , 19 ) Ym ju shim bai rang lane jingkynshew Matthaïos 10 :8 .
translation.en: ( Ephesians 5 :18 , 19 ) Admission is free , and no collections are taken .—Matthew 10 :8 .
And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,
translation.kha: Ki la jop ruh ïa u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na kiba khatduh jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei .

U la khmih shaiñ ïa u angel ha ka jingsheptieng bad u la ong , Ka dei kaei , ko Kynrad ? U angel u la jubab , U Blei u la sngewbha ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me , sad u kloi ban jingbabe ïa me .
translation.en: And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .
And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka sien kaba lai ,  Hynrei kaei ka kam runar kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban shem ïa kano kano kaba u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap ! Ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .
translation.kha: Ki kti jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynta kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .

U Trai u la Ong , Yn ym don na ki hima ba-marjan kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long bapaw kum ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ngab pynmong ïa ki Israel . Bad kin tip ba ma sa , nga long U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta jong phi . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads  ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la lute ïa ka jingkynshew jong ka baroh . Ka la ïohi ïa ki , ba ki rung sha ka Templ hi , ha kaba U  Trai  u la lah khang ïa ki Jentil ban leit .

translation.en: Iron is taken out of the earth , and brass is molten out of the stone .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ka nar na ka khyndew ; bad ki pynum ïa ka rnong na ki maw .

translation.en: And when Uriah was come unto him , David demanded of him how Joab did , and how the people did , and how the war prospered .
translation.kha: Haba u Uriah u la wan poi , u Dabid u kylli ïa u la u Joab bad ki kynhun shipai ki bit ki biang , bad kumno ka jingïaleh ka long .
Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ban ym ïohi shuh ïa kata kaba dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong kiba lui lui .
translation.en: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nonglum khajna u la Ïeng ha pajih bad um shym khmied la ka khamtam sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka skhem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’
translation.en: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .

But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :
translation.kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , ne ki khun jong phi , ne ki mraw jong phi , ne ki jingri jong phi , ne ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong phi .
Un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad un synreit ïa ka da la ka shynrong ti ha lamkhmat kata ka jingtap , bad nangta un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translation.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward  ; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times .

translation.kha: La to ka pop ha ka pyrthei shwa ba yn ai ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei hangno ha bym don ka hukum , ym don jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .
translation.kha: Mynta ,  U Trai  ha kane ka jingthoh u long U Mynsiem ; bad hangno haba U Mynsiem jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .
To ïajah ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi , bad to mane ha u lum bakyntang jongki u ! U Trai’ U Blei jong ngi u long uba khwai .
translation.en: Exalt the  Lord  our God , and worship at his holy hill  ; for the  Lord  our God is holy .
And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki parabangeit Jiw ki la sdang leh kum ki khawpud ryngkat bad u Petros ; bad wat u Barnabas hi ruh u la liat lang ha ka jingleh khawpud jong ki .

translation.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .
translation.kha: Ka jaka ka ïar naduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang bashathie hajan ka Edom , shaduh Baalgad ha ka phang bashatei ha ka them jong ka Lebanon shaphang shathie jong u Lum Hermon . U Joshua u la ïaleh thma slem bad ki syiem jong kane ka thain , hynrei u la kurup ïa ki baroh bad u pynïap ïa ki .

Uno uno uba wanrah ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kum ka jingainguh thang ha U Trai u dei ban wallam lym bad katai ka jingri shai kyllon u pyrthiew ba la khleh bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib khim ka jingainguh bim , lem nabar shi lem ka wiang .
translation.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .

translation.kha: kumta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .
translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .

translation.kha: Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab ka jutang ha kaba la thoh ïa ki hukum U Trai bad u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u Paidbah’ ; ki ruh ki ïa-ong , Ïa kita baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum , ngin leh , bad ngi kohnguh .
translation.en: And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .

translation.kha: bad u ïarisa u nongai Mediterranian , umbiah ha kata ka por u don khyndaiphew ar snem ka rta , u la nongdih ïa ka bor syiem .
translation.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom , being about threescore and two years old .

translation.kha: Phin sa long uba stad , bad ka jingot jong phi kan ai jingkem ïa phiah .
translation.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
And his brethren envied him  ; but his father observed the saying .
translation.kha: Ki hynmen u Joseph te ki la bishni ïa u , hynrei u kpa jong u , u ïai puson shaphang kata baroh .
