shahïap ïa at ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba ang ïalap ha phi kam long kaba na ka synrai u Briew .
translation.en: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !
translation.kha: To ïambriew na ka bynta kata ka hima , phi kiba shong marjan , phi baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingpawnam jong ka . To ong , ‘ Ka jingsynshar bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka bor jong ka kam don shuh .’

Ki long ki briew jong U Blei’ ; u la pynong ki khun jong u ïa ki bad u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u ha ki ; u la pynlong ki jutang bad ki bad u la ai ïa ki ka Hukum ; ki don ka jingmane Birsha ; ki la Ïoh ïa ki jingkular U Blei ;
translation.en: Who are Israelites ; to whom pertaineth the adoption , and the glory , and the covenants , and the giving of the law , and the service of God , and the promises ;
And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ; because thou hast obeyed my voice .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrkhu ïa ki kumba nga la kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me — baroh namar ba me la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga .
Wah ha ka jingshitom jong na , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .
translation.en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
The quiver rattleth against him , the glittering spear and the shield .
translation.kha: Ki atiar kiba ki nongshong jong ki , ki rah ; ki sawa bad ki thaba ha ka sngi .
U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym don uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phan !
translation.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka ha kba ki Kynhun ki ksiew u Isaak ki mane Blei yn sa pynjot noh . Ïa ki iaka kyntang jong ki Israel yn sa iehnoh ha ki jingjot . Ngan salm ïa ka longrynïeng syiem jong u syiem Jeroboam shaw ka jingkut .
translation.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate , and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste  ; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword .

translation.kha: Bad kumjuh nga ong ha phi baroh : ïa katai kaba pa’ khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ha bneng , mala ïa kaei kaba phi shat ha ka pyrthiew yn shah ha bneng .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
translation.kha: Ka rah ïa ka ïing bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
Kumba u nongriam bai u pyndap ïa ka ruh jong u da ki sim , ki la pyndap ïa ki ïing jyllang ki da ka jinglute . Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki longïng kiba donbor malade kiba riewspah ,
translation.en: As a cage is full of birds , so are their houses full of deceit : therefore they are become great , and waxen rich .
And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah ong ïa kane , u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Lasaros , to mihnoh !
Mei ïadep kren ïa kine ki ktien , ka khyndew ha kaba u Dathan dara u Abiram ki ïeng ka la kad arliang
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :
Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gold , or the temple that sanctifieth the gold ?
translation.kha: Ko ki bieit bamatlah ! Kano kaba kham donkam , ka ksiar lane ka Templ kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka ksiar ?

Ha ka sngew kaba bud , u la sei ar tylli ki sbai saw bad u la ai ïa ki ha u trai ïing . ‘ To sumar ïa u ,’ u la ong ïa u trai ïing , ‘ bad ynda nga wan phai na kane ka lyntang , ngan sieb ïa me ïa kano kano kaba me pynlut halor jong u .’
translation.en: And on the morrow when he departed , he took out two pence , and gave them to the host , and said unto him , Take care of him  ; and whatsoever thou spendest more , when I come again , I will repay thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u pynïap dara u pynim pat ; u pynhiar ïa ki briew sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , dara u pynkhyllew pah ïa ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  killeth , and maketh alive : he bringeth down to the grave , and bringeth up .

And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof , wherewith they minister about it , even the censers , the fleshhooks , and the shovels , and the basins , all the vessels of the altar  ; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers  skins , and put to the staves of it .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap Sinai U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses

translation.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .
translation.kha: Hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep U Jisu u la wan sha ki synran , da kaba ïaid halor ka um .
Hynrei mynta , ki briew kiba kham rit rta , ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ! Ki kpa jong ki , ki long borabor ki bymdondor kiba ngan ym shah ïa ki ban ïapra ïa ki ksew jrong nga ban ap ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .

translation.kha: Husiar ïa kawei kaba phiah ong bad ri ïa la ka jingim . Uba kren tukri u pynjot ïa lade .
translation.en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life : but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction .

translation.kha: To kynmaw katno kaba khraw ka bol jong U Blei! ; u dei u nonghikai uba khraw tam na baroh .
translation.en: Behold , God exalteth by his power : who teacheth like him ?
And the daughter of any priest , if she profane herself by playing the whore , she profaneth her father : she shall be burnt with fire .
translation.kha: Lada ka khun jong u lyngdoh ka ïaid nuti , ka pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa ; yn thang ïa ka haduh ba kan da ïap .
Da kaba bud ïa ka jingsuk jong u kba jong u , u Jehoïakhin u la kuna pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .

translation.kha: bad u la jubab , Ïa ka jingtip ïa kiba rieh jongngi ka Hiram U Bela la ai ha Phin , hynrei ha kiwei pat ka wan ha ki pharshi , khnang ba ki lah ban peit hynrei kim ïohi , dara shahshkor hynriew kim shyieng .
translation.en: And he said ,  Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God : but to others in parables  ; that seeing they might not see , and hearing they might not understand .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki , Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïathuh ha phi mynba nga dang don lem bad phi : Kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dien baneh urlong shisha .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .

translation.kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang khong , ki synran ki la wan ha u malu ki la ong , Ka por ka dier palat , bad khie ka dei ka jaka kynjah .
translation.en: And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :

translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew bym lah shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïalang lok bad ka pyllait ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno Uno umbiah kwah ban pynlong lur bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa lade u nongshniah jong U Blei .
translation.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .

translation.kha: U Jehu u khot ngan ïa ki briew jong ka Samaria , bad u ong , U syiemsad Ahab u la shakri ïa u blei Baal khñiot , hynrei nga sam shakri ïa u hasem bun .
translation.en: And Jehu gathered all the people together , and said unto them , Ahab served Baal a little  ; but Jehu shall serve him much .

But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day , the loss of children , and widowhood : they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries , and for the great abundance of thine enchantments .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka shikhyllipmat , tang ha kawei ka sngi , kine baroh ar tylli kiei kiei ki wan jia . Wat hapdeng ki kam myntor baroh ba pha pyndonkam , phan duh noh ïa la u tnga bad ïa la ki khun .

Shishak ïa ka jingïapyndait jyllang nga bad ki jingduwai jngai ki briew jngai me haba ki phai khmat sha kane ka jaka bad ki duwai . Na ka ïing jong me ha bna to shahskhor ïa ngi bad to map ruh ïa me .
translation.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .

translation.kha: Haba u Isaia u la poi , u la leit marwei shapoh ka kamra bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïatip halor ka jingkhiah .
translation.en: And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi la Long khlei U Khrist . Phi la erlangthari ki nongwei bad phim shyiap la dei ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei . Phim shem la don bynta ha ki jutang , kiba la pynsngewrem nongmih ha ki jingkular jong U Blei sha ki briew jong u , mala phi la im ha kane ka pyrthei khlem jingkyrmen bad khlem U Blei .
translation.en: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :

translation.kha: ?(Nga don ka jingpynbaptis banbeiñ ïohpdiang , bad katno de sngewkhia mynsiem tad ïaheh ba sa da kut noh !
translation.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with  ; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished !

translation.kha: lymda une eit u leh pop khlem pyntip da naba kum klet baneh wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba long kyntang shat U Trai , un wallam ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat shad U Trai da u khunlangbrot ne u langsohmoh u me Don kano kano ka jingduh . Ka jingpynsah dor ïa u kan long kumba la buh .
translation.en: If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :

translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki paid Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait Israel baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki Israel ki kylli , Haduh ïa ngi , kum kane ka kam runar ka la jia ?
translation.en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?

translation.kha: Da shisha phin sa sngewthuh ïa Kaei kiba ngan sa ong , ko ki pynphalang jong nga , namar phi baroh phi tip ïa ka hukum . Ka hukum ka synshar halor ki briew tang haba ki dang im .
translation.en: Know ye not , brethren , (for I speak to them that know the law ) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki parabangeit ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u , u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha shnong . Ha ka sngi kaba bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha Derbe .

translation.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand ; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki kam babha ki paw shai kdar , bad wat ïa kito ki bym da paw shai ym lah ban buhrieh .
Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u paidïapom u la sngewphylla ïa ka rukom naba u la hikai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :

translation.kha: Na ka jaka ba u synshar , u khmih shapoh halor baroh Kiba shong ha ka pyrthuh .
translation.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .

translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïingjaiñ ; Wallam ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ! Buh ïa ka kam lad phi ïa-ban pynshisha ba phi long ha kaweh dien !
translation.en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .

translation.kha: Ym don jingïapher hapdeng u briew uba bet dara u biria uba ai um ; U Blei un ai bainong ïa uwei pa uwei katjuh khim ka kam kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one : and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour .

translation.kha: Ki la duh noh ïa baroh ki jingsngew jong ka jinglehrain ; ki pynlapmiet ïa lade ha ki kam thala bad ki leh ïa baroh ki jat kam sniew khlem salia .
translation.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .

translation.kha: Kaei ba ki la ïohi ha ka ïing syiem ? Ki la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym don kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki ha ki ïing jingkynshew .
translation.en: Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
And Joseph said unto them , That is it that I spake unto you , saying , Ye are spies :
translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ong , phi dei ki nongsyntiat ,  u Joseph u jubab .

translation.en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh ngi tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .
bad hawei ba u la bam jingbam , u la ïohbat pat . U Saul u la sah Katto katne sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Damaskos .
translation.en: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingkñia namar ka jingleit palat ïa ka pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala hajar ki lut , pynlang hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng Uba kah syrngiew , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad u thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .

translation.kha: Ki Ahiman ki la sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong nongshun ïa u Daberath , kumta ki la Pha wai arphew hajar ngut ki shipai Syria na Bethrehob bad na Sobah , khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah na Tob , bad ïa u syiem Maakah lymne bad shihajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob , and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and of king Maacah a thousand men , and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men .

translation.kha: Hib uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Ijon , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kambah harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkhlaiñ ïa u ryndang jong u , bad u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel siaw snem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .

translation.kha: Ka pansngiat kan long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U TRAI’ ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Josaïah .
translation.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba ki nongkamsniew ki pynshoi ïa phi , ko khun jong nga , wat kumjuh .
translation.en: My son , if sinners entice thee , consent thou not .

translation.kha: Phi ki nongthain phylliah ph tip bha shibun ba haba nga la mihnoh na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïahap ïa ka Khubor Babha , phi dei tang ma phi ka balang ïa-ban ïarap ïa nga ; pa dei thiang ma phira kiba la shim bynta ha ki jingïoh nabar jingduh jong nga .
translation.en: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .

They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bym don jingisynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki shong ha ki kulai jong ki . Ki la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem .

U Trai u la ong , myntor , ko khum u briew , ngan shim noh na ki ïa ka Templ bakhraw kaba la long ka jingweng bad ka jingkmen jong ki , kaba ki sngewtynnat ïa-ban khmih sad ban leit jngoh . Bad ngan shem noh! ïa ki khun shynraiñ bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength , the joy of their glory , the desire of their eyes , and that whereupon they set their minds , their sons and their daughters ,

translation.kha: U lehkai ïa nga ban ïaleh thma , ba kumno nga lah ban pyndonnam ïa ka ryntieh kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He teacheth my hands to war  ; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .

translation.kha: Nangta U TRAI’ u ainong ha u Moses , Khie sien sha u Paran . Ang la pynmutlop ïa u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , khnang ba la lah ban ar ïa kine ki kambah hapdeng lad ki ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :

translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba phin ïaishah nabar nga , wat ïahap sa leh ba-beit khyndiat . Sngewbha leh kumta!
translation.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly : and indeed bear with me .

translation.kha: Me dei ban leit pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa at , bad men pynïoh ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga u Isaak napdeng ki kur ki jahthait jong nga .
translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my country , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son Isaac .

And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ka ,  Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don hapoh jong pha ; Phan sa kha ar jait ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki . Kawei kan kham khlaiñ ban ïa kawei pat , Kaba ha shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .
Kumta u Moses u thoh ïa ka Judia U Blei bad u ai ïa ka ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai , mala ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .
translation.en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and unto all the elders of Israel .
But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit , dividing to every man severally as he will .
translation.kha: Hynrei dei tang uwei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem uba leh ïa kane baroh ; ha ka mon jong u , u ai ïa ka jingai bapher ha uwei pa uwei .
Ka Rebekka ka don Hangne ; to Shim bad ïasam ïa ka . Ai ba kan long ka tnga jong u Kynhun u kynrad jong phi , kam U TRAI’ hi da laiñ u la kren .
translation.en: Behold , Rebekah is before thee , take her , and go , and let her be thy master s son s wife , as the  Lord  hath spoken .

translation.kha: Bad kumba shi kyntait haduh , sa uwei pat u briew u la ban julam , Ym don kano kano ka jingartatien ba a u briew u la don lem bad U Jisu , naba ma u hi umdih u long u nong “Gilead” !
translation.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed , saying , Of a truth this fellow also was with him : for he is a Galilaean .

translation.kha: U Judas u la long u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong ngi , nabar la lah jied ïa u ban ïadon bynta lem ha ka kam jong ngi .
translation.en: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .

translation.kha: bad ki la tim ïa U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jngai ki . Jamynrei kim shym la phai noh na ki lynti basniew jong ki .
translation.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .
translation.kha: U ruh u ong ,  Nga mynjur ïa kata , tangba tang uta uba shim ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga ; kiwei pat ki lah ban leit noh .
Kumta ki la sien nadien jong u ryngkat bad ki Briew jong ki bad lap ïa u hajan ka pung kaba heh ha Gibeon .
translation.en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .

translation.kha: Da la ka ktien hi nga thoh ïa kane : Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .
translation.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .
And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang suh kha , uwei na ki u pynmih shabar ïa la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata ka kti , ka teh ïa ka da u  saisaw , bad ka ong ,  Une u dei uba mih nyngkong .

Hynñiew ine pat ngi dang ïai sharak ïa U Tharai U Blei jong ngi bad ngim shym pat iaineh ïa u . Ki lyngkhuit kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , bad ki Lebi ki ïarap laiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :

translation.kha: Haba ka Leah ka sngewthuh ba ka la wia baneh ïoh khuid , ka la ai ïa ka mraw jong ka , ka Silpah ha u Jakob kum ka tnga jong u .
translation.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing , she took Zilpah her maid , and gave her Jacob to wife .

translation.kha: Bad tun ïailong kiba kmen , namar at tip ba da ki jingjai jong phi bad da ka jingïarap kaba wan na U Mynhynnin jong U Jisu Khrist , ïa nga yn sa pyllaitluid .
translation.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer , and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: ‘ Wat tuh .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou steal .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren pat ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: kito kiba bam ïa ka doh jongngi nga bad ba dih ïa ka snam jongnga nga ki ïaisah ha nga , bun ma nga ha ki .
translation.en: He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .
translation.kha: Mynta , ka long kaba bha ban don kum kata ka jingsngewtynnat kaba khraw lada ka jingthmu ka long kaba bha — kane ka long kaba shisha borabor , bad ym dei tang haba nga don ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies , and that seek him with the whole heart .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba bud ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba kohnguh ïa u da la ka dohnud baroh .

translation.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Yn ym don na ki hima ba-marjan kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long pat kum ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban pynmong ïa ki Israel . Bad kin tip ba ma nga , nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki ; hynrei to ïai kynmaw aïu U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .

Hobab u la poi ha Galilaïa , ki briew klang ki la pyngkiang sngewbha ïa u , namar ba ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerushah bad ki la ïohi ïa kiei ktien barieh kiba u la leh ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: Then when he was come into Galilee , the Galilaeans received him , having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast : for they also went unto the feast .
And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Abraham bad ha u Isaak , bad ngan ai ïa ka ruh ha ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me .

translation.en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u la poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah ba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .
Kaei kaba per mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma Phin da ka jingngeit jongnga nga bad ma nga da ka jong phi .
translation.en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .

translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet , kata ka Parosh ka wanrah phai pat shai u , ka da wanrah ha la ka shyntur ïa u sla dieng Olib ba sdang shuh khep . Kumta u Noah u thop ba ka um ka la rnong .
translation.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening  ; and , lo , in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .

translation.kha: U Trai u Thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi , u bnai dara ki khlur da ka sur kren jong u .
translation.en: By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .
Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  U dei u Elijah .  Kiwei ki ong ,  U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum uwei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jong ki por ba-mynshuwa .
( Katno kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Sabad , u khum jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Shimeath , bad u Jehosabad , u khup jong ka nong Moab kaba kyrtong ka Shimrith ) .
translation.en: And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .
Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi kiba thngan mynta ; yn pyndap ïa phi ! Suk ma phi kiba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !

translation.en: And again he sent another  ; and him they killed , and many others  ; beating some , and killing some .
translation.kha: U trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw , ki la pynïap ïa u ; bad ki la leh ïa kiwei pat kiba bun ha kajuh ka rukom , da kaba shoh ïa ki katto katne ngut bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
La don u briew ha Kaisaria naba kyrteng u Kornelios , uba long u rangbah shipai ha ka kynhun shipai ka Hima Rom ba la khot Ka Kushan shipai Italian .
translation.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
And he was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem jong ki Israel ki briew jong u , mynba ki jait bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki ïalumlang .
Khie otsher Bad khor ïa u tnga jong Phah , U Jisu u la jong ïa ka , bad sa wan biang .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Go , call thy husband , and come hither .
And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynjot ïa ki kali ïapom .
Me u nongsynshar uba bymman bad bymkhuid jngai ki Israel , ka sneng jong me , ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom ba Kuth , ka wiang .
translation.en: And thou , profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day is come , when iniquity shall have an end ,
Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :
translation.kha: U Khrist u synshar hangta halor baroh ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng , ki bor synshar , ki bor , bad ki kynrad ; u don ka kyrteng kaba kham hajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki kyrteng kiba don ka bor ha kane ka pyrthei mynta bad ka ban sa wan .
Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kaei , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum , Kem ïa uto u briew ! Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka longïng kumba ïarap ïathuh ba um lah pynkhun thuh ïa ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba kren ka kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno uba kren kiew kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map .
translation.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .

translation.kha: Ki briew jongngi nga ki la bet ïa u kew , hyndai ki la lum ïa ki ñiut ; ki la trei shitom , hynñiew kim shym ïoh ei ei na ka bynta kata . Naaman ka jingbitar shla jong nga ki jingthung jong ki kim shym long .
translation.en: They have sown wheat , but shall reap thorns : they have put themselves to pain , but shall not profit : and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the  Lord .
For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;
translation.kha: Namar U Khrist da lade hi u la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingsuk da kaba pynlong kawei ka jaitbynriew ïa ki Jiw bad ki Jentil . Da ka met jong u hi , u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh kaba pynïakhlad ïa ki bad kaba pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun .
Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baher , khlem da pynsan uwei ruh , bad nangta ki kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translation.en: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong sha ïa kiei kaba u Isaiah u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong , Ma u da lade hi u la shim ïa ki jingshitom jong ngi bad u la bah noh ïa ki jingpang jong ngi .
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .

translation.kha: Ki mynsaw bymman ki la mihnoh na kiba pung ki brup da kaba lynñiar jam , malu ïa kiba bun kiba pang ïapshiliang bun kiba dkoh la pynkhiah .
translation.en: For unclean spirits , crying with loud voice , came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies , and that were lame , were healed .
He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
translation.kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha khyndew bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong nga ha ki mawria .

translation.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me , yea , four which I know not :
translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba phylla eh ïa nga ba ngan shemphang :

translation.en: And Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite , which was of Bahurim , hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Shimei u khun jong u Gera , na ka jait Benjamin kaba na Bahurim , u la pynkloi ban leit sha ka Jordan ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Dabid .

translation.en: And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ai ha ki Lebi ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew baroh ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga . Kane ka long ka jingsiew ïa ka jingshakri jong ki ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .
U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsynei ïa u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son :
Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :
translation.kha: Mynta shah ngan ai buit lem ïa phi , bad U Blei un don lem bad phi . Ka long kaba dei ba phin mihkhmat ïa kine ki briew ha khmat U Blei , bad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki sha u .
U Trai u leh ïa kane namar ba u Dabid u la leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad um ju lyndum ïa katno kano na ki hukum jong u , lait noh tang ha ka ki kaba ïadei bad u Uriah u nong Hit .
translation.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life , save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .

The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa phi u lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u Jehoïada , bad mynta phi long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka Templ . Ka dei ka kamram jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa uwei u riewlamwir uba leh mynleh ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei ban buh ha ki kynjri lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba da ka nar .

pynlang ki briew jong ki , ktien ong , Ïa ngin kiew ïa u lym jong U Trei , sha ka Templ jongu U Blei ka Israel . Un hikai ïa ngi kaei kaba u kwah ïa moi ban leh ; ing ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la ieid . Naba ka jingsuki jngai U Trai ka wiang na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: And many people shall go and say , Come ye , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for out of Zion shall go forth the law , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ha kham haduh katno U Kpa u la ieit ïa me ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long katba khraw katta katta! ba ïa ngi la khoit ki khum U Blei — bad kumta , ha ka jingshisha , ngi long . dem kane ba balei ka pyrthei kada ithuh ïa ngi : Kam pat la ithuh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Behold , what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us , that we should be called the sons of God : therefore the world knoweth us not , because it knew him not .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ki dkhot jong ki balang ha Judas kim pat hajuh ïa nga markhmat .
translation.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jngai me , ba ka dei hi ka kmiesan jongnga me .
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .
Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Jehu u Nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Hanani bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha :

Hobab ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongrit , sngewma ai ïa ki rangbah jongnga nga katto katne ki kpu . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang beh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .
translation.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .

translation.kha: bad nangta ki haw lat ïa ka ha ki katto katne ki jingkhiah basniew bad ki kut ha ka jingbymdon ei ei shuh banbeiñ ai pateng ha la ki khup ki kti .
translation.en: But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .

translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli , Nangno kine ki Briew ki wan pynlang kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ? U Hesekaïah u la jubab , Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai babha , na Babilon .
translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .

Therefore it shall come to pass , that as all good things are come upon you , which the  Lord  your God promised you  ; so shall the  Lord  bring upon you all evil things , until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the  Lord  your God hath given you .
translation.kha: Hynrei kumba u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha phi , kumta ruh un pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingbyrngem .
Baroh shi jingim jngai nga , sa la kitkhia ïa ki .
translation.en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )

And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him , Turn , and slay the priests of the  Lord   ; because their hand also is with David , and because they knew when he fled , and did not shew it to me . But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ki nongap kiba ïeng hajan jong u ,  Pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  ! Ki la ïasylla bad u Dabid bad kim shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba u la phet , wat la ki la tip ïa ka baroh shi katta .  Hynrei ki nongap kim treh ban rah ïa la ka kti ban pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .
Hadien katto katei por , u Benhadad u shym ka Syria u la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shaei Jong u baroh kaweh pyrshah ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah Samaria .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host , and went up , and besieged Samaria .

translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshlei ïa ka pyrthuh da ka um ban pynbud noh khor ïa ki kynja ba-im baroh . Baroh Kat babha Don ha ka pyrthei kmen ïap .
translation.en: And , behold , I , even I , do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven  ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un thuh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh hynñiew Sngi .
translation.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :

translation.kha: To leh kaba bha tam ban ïarap ïa u Kenas u riewsaid bad ïa u Apollos ba kin sdang ïa ki jinglanot jong ki , bad khmih ba kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kba ki nongkam .
translation.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently , that nothing be wanting unto them .

translation.kha: Ïa nga la tar arliang da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingpang ; nga la ïoh ïa ka jingjynjar na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translation.en: My bowels boiled , and rested not : the days of affliction prevented me .

translation.kha: U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñ eh ba baroh kba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .
translation.en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi la long khlem U Khrismas . Phi la long ki nongwei Bad phim shym la dei ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei . kino shym la don bynta ha ki jutang , kiba la pynshong nongrim ha ki jingkular jong U Blei sha ki briew jong u , bad Phin la im ha kane ka pyrthei khlem jingsngur bad khlem U Blei .
translation.en: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :
Behold , I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me .
translation.kha: Nga tip ki jingmut pyrshah aïu phi don .
A un long ha phi u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem .
translation.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months : it shall be the first month of the year to you .

translation.kha: Ynda la kut kita ki hynñiew snem , ka la wan phai sha Israel bad ka la leit shata u syiem don kyrpad ïa u ban pynphai baklang sha ka ïa ka ïohnang bad ka khynñiuh jong ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seven years  end , that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines : and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land .

translation.kha: Ym don kaei kaei ïa kiba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynrong ha ki khat jong u . Bad ka Dei sha u ba ngi dei ngab ai jingkheit ïa put .
translation.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .

translation.kha: Nangta u la mudui jam , Ko Trai U Blei jongnga nga , balei me la leh kat kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ïa kane ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehniam shibun ïa-ban sum ïa nga , bad myntor me pynïap ïa u khun jongngi ka !
translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?

translation.kha: Kata ka khubor ïa kaba la pynbna da ki angel ha ki kpa tymmen jngai ngi ka long kaba shisha , bad uno uno u bim shym bud ïa ka lane u bym shym khunlung ïa ka u shiah pynshitom ruma ka dei hok ïa u .
translation.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhluit ka jingtur jong ki , ki pynïap ïa la ki nongsynshar . Ki syiem jongnga ki , ki shait pynsep uwei hadien uwei , Hynrei ym don na ki uba khot kyrpad ïa nga ban ïoh jingïar .
translation.en: They are all hot as an oven , and have devoured their judges  ; all their kings are fallen : there is none among them that calleth unto me .

translation.kha: Mynta , kad pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga pita ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
translation.en: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .

But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth , shall he live ? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned : in his trespass that he hath trespassed , and in his sin that he hath sinned , in them shall he die .
translation.kha: Hynrei lad u briew uba hok u sangeh ban lehbha bad sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew baroh , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki briew kiba sniew ki leh , hato un ïai im ? Em , yn ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha kaba u la leh . Un ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u bad ki pop jong u .
U Jisu u la Jobab , Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ainong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me bad Shakri tang ïa u !’
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jingsuk myntor babha phi pyndonnam bad tun iehnoh ïa pa khlem ki nongkren byrtong .
translation.en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand  ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :

translation.kha: U Trai u pham sa kawei pat ka khubor sha u Ahas :
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  spake again unto Ahaz , saying ,

translation.kha: Kuth lada ka hima jong u Soitan ka don ki kynhun kiba ïajah kaei ïa kadei pat , kumno kan neh ? Phibi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid nabar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha at ka bor ban leh kumta .
translation.en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .

translation.kha: Nangta la khot shapoh ïa u Paul , dara u Tertullos u la sdang ban ai ïa ka jingmudui jong u ïa u Petros kumne duh : Pheliks badonkam ! Ka jingïalap bastad jong me ka la nongrah ha ngi ïa ka por shongsuk kaba kham slem , bad ïa shibun ki jingpynbeit thymmai kiba donkam la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ka ri jyllang Ngi .
translation.en: And when he was called forth , Tertullus began to accuse him , saying , Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness , and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence ,

translation.kha: Ka ryntieh u Ioannis ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka thnam u Saul ka long ka bym don jingaiei , Ka pynkhyllem ïa kiba khlaiñ , ka da pynap ïa ki nongshoh-nar .
translation.en: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .

translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba kine kiei kiei kin ym jia ha ka prie tlang !
translation.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .

translation.kha: Ki sylla long kiba khuid ibha la wan ïa ki ha ka duwan U Trai . Kumta , shim ïa ki khiew buh ding jong kita ki briew kiba la shahïap pynïap namar ki Pop jyllang ki , shoh pynkmen ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan . Kan hir ka jingmihsnam ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki jingker Ibbah pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translation.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .

translation.kha: Mem ne ei ei ban ar ïa ki nongsynshar bymhok , kiba pynlong ïa ka jingbymkhuid ngab ksan ,
translation.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee , which frameth mischief by a law ?

translation.kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongïambriew bad u pynlong ïa ki ban kata ha ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .
translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee , and set darkness upon thy land , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlip ïa baroh ki jingshai jong ka bneng , bad ngan pyndum ngaiñ ïa ka pyrthei jong me ha ka jingdum , ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga la kren .
Ki khun kynthei jongu phi kan hap shna ki jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongshet jinglwet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u .
translation.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .

translation.kha: Thet ki kti .
translation.en: Wash your hands .

translation.kha: Te , to ngin wait sha u shabar ka bakwah shongduh dara ban ioh bynta lang ha ka jingshah lehrain jong u .
translation.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .

translation.kha: U Elisha u khoit ïa u Girsi , bad u ong ïa u pun khot ïa ka kmie jong u khynnah . Haba ka la wan shapoh , u ong ha ka , Une u khun jongki phi .
translation.en: And he called Gehazi , and said , Call this Shunammite . So he called her . And when she was come in unto him , he said , Take up thy son .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , U Jisu u la ïong ha ki , dei ma de !
translation.en: But he saith unto them ,  It is I  ; be not afraid .

translation.kha: Ki Nong Babilonia ki kem ïa ki briew da ki khwai , la kumba ki dih ki dohkha . Ki ring ïa ki na ki jar bad ki risa da ka jingman ïa ka jingïoh jong ki !
translation.en: They take up all of them with the angle , they catch them in their net , and gather them in their drag : therefore they rejoice and are glad .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kmie ka la ino , Em ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei ban long u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And his mother answered and said , Not so  ; but he shall be called John .

translation.kha: Kumba te , phim long Shuah u mraw hynrei u khun . Bad narud ba phi longsem u khun jrong U , U Blei un ai ha phi baroh kat kaba u don na ka bynta la ki khun .
translation.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .

translation.kha: malade lada eit uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban hir nongking , u dei ban un-long u mraw jong baroh .
translation.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had , Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .
translation.kha: hynrei mynba u dang im , u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang ba u la ïoh na kiwei pat ki tnga jong u . Nangta u phah noh ïa kine ki khun shynrang sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi , jngai na u khun jong u , u Isaak .

translation.en: Then said they , What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him ? They answered , Five golden emerods , and five golden mice , according to the number of the lords of the Philistines : for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .
translation.kha: Ka jingai sngewbha aïu ngin phah ïa u ?  Ki briew ki kylli . Ki la jubab ,  San tylli ki dur jong u thung kiba da ka ksiar bad san tylli ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u syiem Philistia . Ïa kajuh ka khlam la pynngat ha phi baroh bad ha baroh san ngut ki syiem .
Kumta u Amasaïah u la phah noh ïa ki kynhun shipai ba la shimet wai bad u ong ïa ki ban leit noh sha ïing . Ha kane ki la leit sha ïing , ki da bitar tynneng ïa ki briew ka Judah .
translation.en: Then Amaziah separated them , to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again : wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah , and they returned home in great anger .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , namarkata , ba phin pyrthuh bud ïa ar .
translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you , be ye followers of me .

translation.kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jyllang U Trai , ha ka Templ jong U Blei’ jong ngi .
translation.en: Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,

translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka pyntwa ki saw hajar ngut ki briew , U Jisu u la kylli , katno thok kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalam ? Hynñiew , ki la jyllop .
translation.en: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
Behold , he taketh away , who can hinder him ? who will say unto him , What doest thou ?
translation.kha: U shim kaei kaba u kwah , bad ym don ba lah ban khang ïa u . Ym don uba nud ban kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ?
Me la ai ka bor ïa u kpu jong nga ba un pynkha ïa per , Me la pynpang ïa nga ban san ha ka kpoh ka kiei jong nga .
translation.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?

translation.kha: Men saw brup , bad lute ïa ki bynriew katba shong ha ki nongbah kiba shisien ki don ha ka jingjot . Ki un-long kiba la lumlang na ki jaitbynriew , bad mynta ki ba-don la ki jingbrai bad ki jingdon jingem , bad ki shong ha ki lad bah ka pynrieh .
translation.en: To take a spoil , and to take a prey  ; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited , and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations , which have gotten cattle and goods , that dwell in the midst of the land .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam lama kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Ahisamakh badno tista bam duh ïa ki pynbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding lai mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang ruh ïa u Abimelekh .
translation.en: But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .

Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .
translation.kha: Shu kylli ïa ki , bad kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngi la wan ha ka sngi jingkhawai , bad u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phi ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa kaba phi lah ha ngi ki shakri jong phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phi , u Dabid .

translation.en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour s landmark , which they of old time have set in thine inheritance , which thou shalt inherit in the land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it .
translation.kha: Ynda phi ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan jong phi ïa uba la thung naduh mynbarim .

translation.en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem don khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki lah ban don ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew kum ki khun jong uta u briew uba la ïap .’

translation.en: And they said , The Lord hath need of him .
translation.kha: U Kynrad u donkam ïa u ,  ki la jubab , bad ki la ïalam ïa u khun kada sha U Jisu .

translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
Hato phim tip ba ka met jong phi ka long ka jaka shong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba shong hapoh jong phi bad ïa uba la ai ha phi da U Blei ?
translation.en: What ? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you , which ye have of God , and ye are not your own ?

translation.kha: Nga long ithuh uba im ! Nga la ïap , hawei mynta nga im junom la junom . Nga don ka bor halor ka jingïap nabar ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: I am he that liveth , and was dead  ; and , behold , I am alive for evermore , Amen  ; and have the keys of hell and of death .

translation.kha: Kam wan halor jong pha baroh . Kane ka long kaba kut . Phan sa jot noh .
translation.en: An end is come , the end is come : it watcheth for thee  ; behold , it is come .

translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa ka miet , bad ha ka jingdum baroh ki mradkhlaw ki mih shabar .
translation.en: Thou makest darkness , and it is night : wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .

translation.kha: Ang hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , nalor phim pat khim kob ïa ka . Bad wat haduh mynta kine pat long kiba kotbor ïa ka , namar Phin dang im Rumah im ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .

translation.kha: Namarkata lada , ka balang baroh kawei ka ïaseng lang bad baroh ki sdang ban kren da ki thylliej bapher — bad lada ki riewpaidbah lane ki bymsngewtynnat ki rung hapoh , hato kin nym ong ba pa’ la ïalamwir ?
translation.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place , and all speak with tongues , and there come in those that are unlearned , or unbelievers , will they not say that ye are mad ?

translation.kha: Teng kyrkhu ïa ki kynhun Israel kiba daym na ka jait Judah , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong nga kaba ha ki lumbah . Ki briew ba la jied jong la , kiba shakri ïa nga , kin shongsah hangta .
translation.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains : and mine elect shall inherit it , and my servants shall dwell there .

And when they went , I heard the noise of their wings , like the noise of great waters , as the voice of the Almighty , the voice of speech , as the noise of an host : when they stood , they let down their wings .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki thapniang haba ki her ; ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , kumba khynwin ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ; kum ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Haba ki sangeh na kaba her , ki khylliap ïa la ki thapniang ,

Ka jingïamai sngewlah aïu ïeng phah ïa u ? Ki briew ki kyllaiñ . Ki la jubab , San tylli ki dur jong u thung kiba da ka ksiar bad san tylli ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u Syiem Pamphylia . Ïa kajuh ka khlam la pynngat ha phi baroh bad ha baroh san ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: Then said they , What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him ? They answered , Five golden emerods , and five golden mice , according to the number of the lords of the Philistines : for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .

translation.kha: U Blei’ jong ngi u long suba ba-dap da ka jingisynei bad uba jemnud . Un pynlong ïa ka mynstep bapyrkhing jong ka jingpynim ban miej ha ngi
translation.en: Through the tender mercy of our God  ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,

translation.kha: Ki ïong , Ko Ussaïah ! Phim ne hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U Trai . Dei tyngka ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kaei . Khie mihnoh na kane ka jaka kyntang . Phai la pynsngewrem ïa U Trai U Blei , bad phin ym ïoh Shua ïa ka jingkyrkhu jongki u .
translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb  ; and if thou wilt not redeem it , then thou shalt break his neck : and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem .
translation.kha: Ïa u khun kada ba la kha nyngkong baroh phin bujli da u khunlangbrot . Lada phim kwah ban bujli ïa uta u khun kada , phi dei ban pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Phi dei ruh ban pyllait ïa u khun nyngkong jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And also that nation , whom they shall serve , will I judge : and afterward shall they come out with great substance .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba teh mraw ïa ki , bad haba kin ïamihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei , kin da kit ruh shibun ka spah .
U la khum ïa nga ha ki kynjri ; nga long u kyiad u bym don kano ïano ka jingkyrmen banbeiñ lait phet .
translation.en: He hath hedged me about , that I cannot get out : he hath made my chain heavy .

translation.kha: U pynkylluid ïa la ki briew , mala u pynlong ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . umbah khuid bad uba khrawbor u long ma u !
translation.en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
Today , Jehovah is preparing millions of people for life in the future Paradise on earth .
translation.kha: Mynta ruh U Jehobah u dang ïai pynkhreh da ki phew lak ngut ki briew ban ïoh im ha paradais .

translation.en: The  Lord  maketh poor , and maketh rich : he bringeth low , and lifteth up .
translation.kha: U pynduk ïa ki katto katne bad u pynriewspah ïa kiwei pat ; U pynrit ïa ki katto katne bad u pynkhraw ïa kiwei pat .
Ïa Ngin ïaleit sha ki beiñ , u Jonathan u jubab . Kumta ki ïaleit lang .
translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , Come , and let us go out into the field . And they went out both of them into the field .
Cast in thy lot among us  ; let us all have one purse :
translation.kha: Ale bad ïoh bynta lang bad ngi , bad ngin ïasam ïa kaba ngi ïoh lute .

translation.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïaid na ka lynti kaba lait na kaba sniew ; te khmih shano ba phi leit — ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .

Ha ka step kaban brup , dadien ba u Pashhur u la pyllait ïa nga na ki kynjri , ang la ong ha u , U Trai um shym kyrteng ïa me u Pashhur . Ka kyrteng kaweh u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngur nga ai ba phin jied napdeng kaba bha mala kaba snep , napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap .
translation.en: See , I have set before thee this day life and good , and death and evil  ;
Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki leit sha shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , da kaba pyrshang ban lait phet lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
Bad u bhabriew u kham kor bun shah baneh ïa ka langbrot ! Kumta te , ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban ïarap ïano ïano ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , phin hi phi tip ba ka jingwan jingjaw jong ngi ïa phi kam shym la long kaba sep-ei .
translation.en: For yourselves , brethren , know our entrance in unto you , that it was not in vain :
And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem , and to hinder it .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïasylla lang ban wan bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad thaw jingkulmar ,
Man ka por ba ki longing shai ka tdam , U Trai u long pyrshah ïa ki , kumba u la lah ong ba un leh kumta . Ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .
translation.en: Whithersoever they went out , the hand of the  Lord  was against them for evil , as the  Lord  had said , and as the  Lord  had sworn unto them : and they were greatly distressed .
And the king of Egypt said unto them , Wherefore do ye , Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pharaoh u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Phi mut kumno da kaba pynlong ïa ki briew ban leh klet ïa la ki kam ? Ong ïa ki ban leit sha la ki kam ki kam !
Kam la ki nongkit tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah poi lypa ha ki nongbah ka jingïaphet , ka Soh bad ka Hanes ,
translation.en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .
And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
translation.kha: Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki ri nongwei , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Namar dat , ko kynrad , ieh ngan law ma nga hangne kum u mraw jongno Phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shait ïa u ba un leit phai badno la ki hynmen .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .
translation.kha: Kynsan la don ka jingsawa na sahit bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingbeh ka lyer bajur , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei ha kaba ki la ïashong .
Kito uba la ïohsngew tyngkong ïa ka Khubor Babha kim syiem ïohpdiang ïa dat ka jingjahthait , namar ba kim skhem la ngeit . Ki don , te , kiwei pat ïa kiba la shah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka .
translation.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein , and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief :

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shiphew jong ki , ki tur jubor sha iitkhmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shyiap .
translation.en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingshitom jong kita ki sngi kan long kaba kham sniew , ban ïa kaei kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei haduh ka por ba mynta . Lymne yn ym don shuh hadien kum kata kaei kaei .
Hynrei ki Israel ki ong , Balah jing pynpang ka jingïateh lok bad phi ? Ka lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi sah hajan .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?
If thou therefore wilt worship me , all shall be thine .
translation.kha: Kane baroh kan long ka jong me , te , lada me mane ïa nga .

Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki brai kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . To khashor ïa ki jingmudui jong ki ! Ki jingkyang jong kito kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki la poi sha ki sharud jong U Blei , U Trai Badonbor Barukh .
translation.en: Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .
Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
translation.kha: kim don ka jingïatiplem ; kim bat ïa la ki kular , bad kim pyn-i jingsbun lane jingisynei ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .
translation.kha: Naba ki sngi ki wan ha kaba ki briew kin ong , ‘ Katno kiba donbok long ki kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung , ki bym ju bsa ïa ki !’
Arod , Siphmoth , Eshtemoa ,
translation.en: And to them which were in Aroer , and to them which were in Siphmoth , and to them which were in Eshtemoa ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Ananias u la leit , u la rung shapoh ka ïohnang ha kaba u Saul u don , bad u la buh ïa la ki kti hiar jong u . Ko Saul , u para jong nga , u la ïong , U Trai u la pham ïa nga — U Jisu hi , uba la mihpaw ha me ha ka lynti katba me dang wan shane . U la phah ïa nga khnang ba men ïoh imat pat bad ban pyndap ïa me da U mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: And Ananias went his way , and entered into the house  ; and putting his hands on him said , Brother Saul , the Lord , even Jesus , that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest , hath sent me , that thou mightest receive thy sight , and be filled with the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam dep dih , u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u la teh jin ïa ka kada na ka bynta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah , uba leit noh ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had eaten bread , and after he had drunk , that he saddled for him the ass , to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back .

translation.kha: Lada phi de ki jong U Khrist , te , Phi long ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham Bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .

translation.kha: iakata don kiba ong : ‘ Ym u briew’ u don ka mynsiem ka ba iaid lait na ka jingiap ?’
translation.en: Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To wan , phi kiba sliang — hangne ka don ka um ! To wan , phi ki bymlah don pisa — thab ïa u kaweh bad bam ! To wan ! thad ïa ka wieh bad ka dud — phin ym hap siew ei ei !
translation.en: Ho , every one that thirsteth , come ye to the waters , and he that hath no money  ; come ye , buy , and eat  ; yea , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .

translation.kha: Haba ïa u Gallio la pynpang u lyngskor jongu ka Akhaïa kaba ha ka hima rhem , ki Jiw ki la ïalumlang hangta , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la ïalang ïa u sha ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia , the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul , and brought him to the judgment seat ,

translation.kha: Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khihwin . Khenani Hapoh jrong kajuh ka khyndew , Baroh ka long ba la pra bad ba la phret .
translation.en: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
And the Father himself , which hath sent me , hath borne witness of me . Ye have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his shape .
translation.kha: Bad U Kpa , uba la phah ïa nga , u ruh u phla na ka bynta jong nga .
Ka Tam ka la leit phai patiaw sha la ïing , ka law noh ïa ka jingkah khmat , bad ka phrang wiang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei .
translation.en: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .

translation.kha: U Dabid u na ïai bteng la ka lyngki jong u lem mala sawspah ngut ki rangbah ; kita arsut ngut kiwei pat , nalor ba ki la Thiat eh , kim da shuh ban jam shat shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shadien .
translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .

translation.kha: nongthaw u Soitan u la bang hapoh u Judas , ïa babha la khot u Iskariot , uba long nawei na ki khaw-eit ngut ki synran .
translation.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .

translation.kha: Wanlam ar ngut ki rangbah ba lah ban shaniah , u Uriah u lyngdoh dara u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeberekhaïah , ban long kum ki sakhi .
translation.en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record , Uriah the priest , and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah .

translation.kha: U Trai un shoh ïa phira da ka jingkhrew , da ka khieshoh , da ka jingat thung , bad da ka jingdih kyrteng ; un phah ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu , ki lyer khluit , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi Haduh ba phin da ïap .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .

translation.kha: Te phoi la jubab , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Terah . Hynrei mynta ngin loit tur , kumba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thom , u da kharai ba ka Long kaba jem ba-bang leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .

translation.kha: Thaw shiah sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ka bynta Kaba sha man jong ka bynta kaba ha iitkhmat jong ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng hajan ka jakarieh ba la suhjer pyndait bad haneng jong u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .
translation.en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .

translation.kha: U Blei um shym pynmynsaw ïa kine ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki Israel ; ki la ïohi ïa U Blei , bad hadien Katai ki la ïabam bad ïadih .
translation.en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kiba ong , To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kob shrak ïa U Trai ! Ho-oid shisha ! U Mynhynnin u jubab . Kin Ïohi shongthait na ki jingtrei khim jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingshakri jrong ki , ki leit lak bad ki .
translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .

translation.kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki kseh jong me hi yn sa ïalam noh bad baneh pynlong ki ïuh ban shrak ha ka ïingshong jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Uwei u rangbah uba na ka jait Benjamin u la mareh na ka madan thma shuh Shiloh bad u la poi Haneng ha kajuh ka sngi . Bnai pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih u da kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad u sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew .
translation.en: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army , and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent , and with earth upon his head .

translation.kha: U Trai u ijli ïa kata , haba ki brai ba-bymman ki ai ki jingkñia ha u , khamtam lada ki leh ïa kata na ki jingthmu bymman .
translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination : how much more , when he bringeth it with a wicked mind ?

translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba phan kham lieh im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw Teng ñiar ba pha don ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .
I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .
translation.kha: Nga buh ki mawlynnai ha pha — ki khadu bad ki kpieng .
Pynlong ïa nga ban khongdong ïa ki hukum jong me , nabar ha ki nga shem ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments  ; for therein do I delight .
So then after the Lord had spoken unto them , he was received up into heaven , and sat on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trai Jisu u la lah kren bad ki , ïa u la shim noh sha bneng bad u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

Te lada ki sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba ki la ni , sa batai ïa ka jingïathmu jong ka Templ ha ki : Ïa ka jingpynduh jong ka , ïa ki khyrdop jingrung bun jingmihnoh jongu ka , ïa ka dur jong ka , ïa ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh sad ïa baroh ki aiñ . To thoh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta jong ki ktang ba ki lah ban ïohi kumno ïa ki kiei baroh la buh ryntih bad ba lah ba pyndep ïa baroh ki aiñ .
translation.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done , shew them the form of the house , and the fashion thereof , and the goings out thereof , and the comings in thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the laws thereof : and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and do them .

translation.kha: La don bun ki briew kiba la wan badno leit , haduh ba U ju bad ki synran jong u kdor don por shuh kdew pun ba-im jingbam . Kumta u la ong ïa ki , To ngin ïarieh noh tang ma ngi sha ka jaka ba ngin ïalong tang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban pynjahthait shipor .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron , saying , Ye have killed the people of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka kynhun baroh ka la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ka ong ,  Phi la pynïap katto katne ngut ki briew jong U  Trai .
Kumta Mynta nga kwah ïa pa ban shahshkor ïa nga ; to shait ba ngan ïathuh ha pa’ ïa kawei kaba nga pyrkhing .
translation.en: Therefore I said , Hearken to me  ; I also will shew mine opinion .

translation.kha: Ladan phi thet ïa nga ka duwan kaba da u maw , Wat ti ïa ka da ki maw ba la shniah , nalor lada phi pynïaid nar ha kita ki maw , kim un-long kiba bit ba ngan pyndonkam .
translation.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .

translation.kha: Kam shym la wei phai , hynrei ka shu her kylleng ïakylliang haduh ba ka um tud da rngad .
translation.en: And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .

translation.kha: Haba u byr-ïe ïa ki rishot kiba bat ïa ka suiñbneng , ki khih bad ki khynñiuh da ka jinghiarpateng .
translation.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof .
And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga la sheptieng , namar nga pyrkhat ïoh phin knieh jubor ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .
U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa une hi U Jisu na ka jingïap , bad ngi barieh ngi long ki sakhi ïa kaei ka jingbishar .
translation.en: This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph , but forgat him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongrah khuri um shym la pyrkhat ei ei shaphang u Joseph — u la klet noh ïa kaei kaei baroh shaphang jong u .
U Joab u tip ba u Syiem dabi u kynmaw ieit haduh katta katta ïa u Absalom ,
translation.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king s heart was toward Absalom .

translation.kha: wahbah ka la shatai , u la khot ïa la ki synran shaw u bad u la jied khaw-eit ñiut na ki , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , ki apostol :
translation.en: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;

translation.kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha janai jong nga ki dei ban pynsuhthied ïa lade , lym kumta kun pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .

translation.kha: U Trai u kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron ha Ijipt :
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,
And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , kiba don baroh ha ka ri Babilonia   .

translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net , that was cast into the sea , and gathered of every kind :
translation.kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Katto katne ki nongtong dohkha ki bret ïa ka jar jong ki hapoh ka duriaw bad ki ïoh bun jait ki dohkha .
