Ki lyngdoh kiei den ban khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ba biah .
translation.en: Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa U Blei namar ka jingtipbriew jong phi , bad namar kaei kaba phi la leh ha kane ka sngi ha kaba khang ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynïap briew bad na kaba pynhiarkput da lade hi .
Katba ka dang leit shim ïa ka , u la ong , Bad sngewbha wanrah de Khyndiat u kpu .
translation.en: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her , and said , Bring me , I pray thee , a morsel of bread in thine hand .

translation.kha: Ha ka per ba la leit phim shym la ithuh ïa U Blei , kumta phi long ki mraw jong ki jingshoh ki bym dei ki blei .
translation.en: Howbeit then , when ye knew not God , ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods .

translation.kha: U la ai kajuh ka hukum ïa uba ar , Uba prie , bad ïa kita barabor kiba khmih ïa kita ki kynhun jingriew , Phi den ban ino kumne ha u Iso haba phi ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh  ;
translation.kha: Lada kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la pur ha ka met jong u naduh khlieh haduh kjat ,

translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u , ba nga U  Trai  nga ong ïa u , ‘ Hadien ba me la pynïap ïa u briew hato men shim ruh ïa ka khyndew jong u ?’ ïathuh ruh ha u ïa kaei ba nga ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka jaka ba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth , kin jliah ruh ïa ka snam jong me !’
U Petros u la kren bad ong ïa U Jisu , Ko Nonghikai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin jingaiti noh lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei ïa me , kawei ïa u Mesha , nabar kawei ïa u Elijah .
translation.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .

Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity , which he hath given thee under the sun , all the days of thy vanity : for that is thy portion in this life , and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun .
translation.kha: To lehkmen ha ka jingim bad ka briew kaba phi ieit , katba phi dang im ka jingim ka bymmyntoi kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi ha kane ka pyrthei . Lehkmen ïa kawei pa kawei ka sngi bymmyntoi jong ka , namar kata baroh ka long kaba phin ïoh na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong phi baroh .
Nangta U Trai u la pyn-i ha nga sien ngut ki nongtrei bakha don bad ki tyrnem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shewed me four carpenters .

Them did Moses the servant of the  Lord  and the children of Israel smite : and Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Kine ki ar ngut ki syiem ki la shahjop ha u Moses bad ki paid Israel . U Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ha ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad ha shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kput kaba lah ban pynjngai ïa ki — ki kynton ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka malade ki knieh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .
Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos , they came to Perga in Pamphylia : and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Paul bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit da ka lieng na Paphos , bad ki la wan poi sha Perga , ka nongbah ha Pamphylia , ha kaba u Ïoannis Markos u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
Da shispah nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud ki briew jongki nga , bad na la ïohi ruh kumin ki nongmih Joppa ki pynsamthiah beiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .

translation.kha: Ko khun u bariew , u ïa-ong , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Tlai Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Ishmael : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
But now I go my way to him that sent me  ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ngan leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban ym don uwei ruh na phi uba kylli ïa nga shaei ba ngan leit .
Ngan ai ïa me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad kin sa longïing ka jaitbynriew kaba khroh . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pyndonnam ïa ka kyrteng jongu me , ba kumta men sa longkmie ka jingkyrkhu .
translation.en: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee , and make thy name great  ; and thou shalt be a blessing :

translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la pynïap ïa u Hodaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon u la pynjrong u la jong kata ka jaka . Kumne ki la leit noh sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin lait na ki nong Baalah . Ha lynti , ki la sangeh ha Shimham , kiba hajan Bethnimrah .
translation.en: Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .

translation.kha: haba ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha ka ri sha lyndet ka Damaskos , ong U Tlai , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Blei bymdonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , saith the  Lord  , whose name is The God of hosts .

And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynïap , kiba u la leh khlem ka jingtip u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balui lui kiba kham bha ban ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Judah .
Ko rangbah , ka khyndaiphew ka shongdor tang sawphew tylliat ki sbai rupa — sa long aïu kata hapdeng jong me ? To tep ïa la ka tngen Hangne .
translation.en: My lord , hearken unto me : the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver  ; what is that betwixt me and thee ? bury therefore thy dead .

In those days there was no king in Israel : and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in  ; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ym don syiem ha Israel . Ha kita ki sngi ki Dan ki dang wad jaka la ka jong ban shong ban sah namar kim pat shym la ïoh la ka jaka hapdeng ki jait Israel .
U Reuben u ong ha ki , Ngam shngiam la ong ïa phi ban ym Ktah kti ïa u lai , hynrei Kino shym sohshkor . Kumta I hap shahshitom kylla mynta namar kata ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: And Reuben answered them , saying , Spake I not unto you , saying , Do not sin against the child  ; and ye would not hear ? therefore , behold , also his blood is required .

translation.kha: To wan phai noh Sha U Trai U Blei jong phi , ko bastad Israel . Ka pop jong phi ka la pynlong ïa ph ban jynthut dara kyllon .
translation.en: O Israel , return unto the  Lord  thy God  ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .

translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , uba la san ryngkat bad ki jingthrang dara ki la kjap ïa ki .
translation.en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .

translation.kha: Hangno u don U Trai , kiba da ka bor jong u , u la leh ki kam bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da kad arliang ïa ki um ka duriaw bad ïamareh ïa ki briew jong u lyntang ki um kiba jylliew , ban ïoh ïa ka nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade ? Ha ka jingialam U Trai , ki kjap jong ki , ki long skhem kum ki kulai khlaw , bad kim ju jynthut .
translation.en: That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
Mental Cleanness : If we fill our minds with clean , pure thoughts , our conduct will also be clean .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat : Lada ngi pyndap ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi da kiei kiei kiba khuid , ka jinglong jong ngi ruh kan long kaba khuid .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ud jylliew Bad u la ong , Balei ba ki briew myntoi ki kwah ba-bang ïohi kambah ? Em , nga ong ïa phi ! Yn ym ai kum dat ka jingpynshisha ha kine ki briew !
translation.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit , and saith ,  Why doth this generation seek after a sign ? verily I say unto you , There shall no sign be given unto this generation .

translation.kha: A Trai , kato slem nga dei ïa-ban pyut jingïarap ha shuwa ba man shakor , ha shuwa ba men pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingleh jubor ?
translation.en: O  Lord  , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !
And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u duwai .
Kaei ka jingujor jyllang pha ? Balei pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ?
translation.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me ? ye all have transgressed against me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u jubab , Nga don ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia ïa uba ph la pynnep ha ka Them Elealeh ; ka don ha lyndet ka ephod , kaba la sop da ka jaiñ . lymda phi kwah ïa ka , to shim — dei tang ma ka , ka atiar hangne . Ai ïa ka ha sa , u Dabid u ong . Ym don hangno hangno ka wallam kaba kham bha !
translation.en: And the priest said , The sword of Goliath the Philistine , whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah , behold , it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod : if thou wilt take that , take it : for there is no other save that here . And David said , There is none like that  ; give it me .

translation.kha: Ha ki khongdong ha man ki surok beh ki brup jong pha ki kyllan nala na ka jingkhot ; ki long kum ka skei kaba la ngat ha ka jar jong u nongbeh mrad . Ki la mad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translation.en: Thy sons have fainted , they lie at the head of all the streets , as a wild bull in a net : they are full of the fury of the  Lord  , the rebuke of thy God .

translation.kha: U Troas u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynrangbah ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .
Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the  Lord  , and with your children s children will I plead .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  ngan buh biang ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan wanrah ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
Ka pyrthei kan orpait bad kan kad .
translation.en: The earth is utterly broken down , the earth is clean dissolved , the earth is moved exceedingly .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ka lawbah hi ka long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka un-long ka khur , kaba dei bad kaba bha .
translation.en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .

translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki la khi ïa la ki khliehduh bad ki la khapnoh ïa la ki ñiuhtmoh . Ïaroh ki la pynmong ïa la ki kti , bad uwei pa uwei u phong ïa ki jaiñ khain .
translation.en: For every head shall be bald , and every beard clipped : upon all the hands shall be cuttings , and upon the loins sackcloth .
And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ha kaba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .
Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da ñiut khnang , phi dei ban Wanlam kawei ka blem kaba shisnem ka thet kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translation.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .
Hear now , O Joshua the high priest , thou , and thy fellows that sit before thee : for they are men wondered at : for , behold , I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH .
translation.kha: Kumta to pynshahshkor , ko Joshua , me uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh , to pynshahshkor , phi ki para lyngdoh jong u , ma phi kiba long ka dak jong ka lawei babha : Ngan pynpaw ïa la u shakri , ïa uba la khot U Tnat !

translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba baroh ki briew na shaphang shatei ka Israel ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .

Hadien , ki khap tmain jong ngi katba la ïohpdiang ïa ka ïingjaiñ na ki kpa jong ki , ki la bah ïa ka lem bad ki hajan ki la leit bad u Joshua Bad shimti ïa ka ri na ki jaitbynriew ibha U Blei u la eh katsha ki nang tur sha khmat . Bad ka la don hangta haduh ka por jong u ïabuaid .
translation.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles , whom God drave out before the face of our fathers , unto the days of David  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh , bad hadien lai sngew ki la Nakon ha ki nongbah ha kaba kine ki Briew ki shong : Ka Gibeon , ka Shephirah , ka Beeroth bad ka Kiriath Jearim .
translation.en: And the children of Israel journeyed , and came unto their cities on the third day . Now their cities were Gibeon , and Chephirah , and Beeroth , and Kirjath–jearim .

translation.kha: Ong ïa ki briew ban kynjah sha jngai na ki ïingjaiñ jong u khor , u Dathan , bad u Abiram .
translation.en: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .
For they went and served other gods , and worshipped them , gods whom they knew not , and whom he had not given unto them :
translation.kha: Ki la shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei ba kim ju mane mynno mynno , bad ïa kiba U  Trai  u la adong ïa ki ban mane .

translation.en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .
translation.kha: Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — hynrei nga long u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei kham shitom palat , nga la don bunsien ha byndi , nga la shah sympat kham bun , bad nga la jan sha ka jingïap kham bunsien .
Bam ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad wat pynsah ei ei hajuh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up  ; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow : I am the  Lord .
Remember , I pray thee , who ever perished , being innocent ? or where were the righteous cut off ?
translation.kha: Pyrkhat pat mynta . Jer ïa kawei ka sien mynba u riewhok u ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long ha kaba bam bad kaba dih , hynrei ka long ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingkmen kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ai .
ban sharati kum u apostol ha ka khak jongngi u Judas , umbiah la iehnoh ban saw shuh ka jaka kaweh u dei ba leit .
translation.en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas by transgression fell , that he might go to his own place .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Samaria yn pynshitom namar ka ïaheh pyrshang ïa nga . Ki briew jong ka kin ïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki khlong yn bret sha ïan , ïa ki kynthih naba punkhun yn patar .
translation.en: Samaria shall become desolate  ; for she hath rebelled against her God : they shall fall by the sword : their infants shall be dashed in pieces , and their women with child shall be ripped up .

translation.kha: Ka long ka bymlahlong ianga .
translation.en: That's impossible for me .
I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
translation.kha: Nga tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki dang don , hynrei ki pynsamthiah ia nga .

translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .
translation.kha: Uta uba kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
Kumta te , U Tiras u iehnoh katto katne ki jingtipbriew ha ka ri ban tyngkreiñ ïa ki Israel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;

translation.kha: Namar ba u syiemsad Ahas u la leh pop , U Trai U Blang jong u , u la Shah ïa u syiem ka Syria ban jop ïa u bad ban ring koidi bun buh na ki Judia sha Damaskos . U Trai’ u la shah mad ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Remalaïah , ban jop ïa u Assos bad pynïap shi Jutang bapar khashor ki shipai Jedaïah kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tmain jongngi ki u la shah ïa kane ban jied , namar ki briew ka Judah ki la kyntu nep ïa u .
translation.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .

translation.kha: ka da pyrta jam ha ki khyrdop nongbah bad kat haba ki briew ki lumlang :
translation.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jrong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki thnum ki san .
translation.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .

translation.kha: ( Deuteronomi 32 :4 ; Job 12 13 ; .—Isaiah 40 :26 ; 1 Ioannis 4 :8 ) Ka Baibl ka ïathuh ruh ïa ngi , ba U blang u longkmie uba isynei , uba sbun , uba ïamap ei , uba kylluid Mynsiem , bad uba ïaishah slem .
translation.en: ( Deuteronomy 32 :4  ; Job 12 :13  ; Isaiah 40 :26  ; 1 John 4 :8 ) The Bible tells us that he is also merciful , kind , forgiving , generous , and patient .
For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
translation.kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat sah lymda ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .
Lada nga dei ban sngewsarong , ngan sngewsarong shaphang kiei kai kiba pyn-i haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translation.en: If I must needs glory , I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities .

translation.kha: Ki khun , ïai kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , naba kata ka long kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Children , obey your parents in all things : for this is well pleasing unto the Lord .
Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied uwei u khra khyndew . U la ong ruh ïa nga ban ïalam katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh ba la tymmen ,
ngan bat ïa ka kular ka nga la pynlong bad u Nadab u kpa jong me mynba nga la ong ha u ba ïa ka Israel yn synshar dorbar da ki khun ki ksiar jong u .
translation.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel .

translation.kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na Baroh , uba tyllep ïa ki lynter baroh . Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun kin wan tuid sha u ,
translation.en: But in the last days it shall come to pass , that the mountain of the house of the  Lord  shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills  ; and people shall flow unto it .
He shall not cry , nor lift up , nor cause his voice to be heard in the street .
translation.kha: Un ym pyrta lane pynjam ïa ka sur jong u lane un ym pynmih ki ktien kren bajam ha ki lynti bah .
namar phi ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim ïa ki mynsiem jong phi , kaban lama ka jingthmu jong ka jingngeit jong phi! ha U .
translation.en: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
And I baptized also the household of Stephanas : besides , I know not whether I baptized any other .
translation.kha: ( O ho-oid , nga la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Stephanas bad ïa ka longïing jong u ; hynrei ngam kynmaw la nga la pynbaptis sa ïano ïano pat . )

translation.en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïailong ka jingïada jong phi ; Ki ksang ti uba na bymjukut ki kyrshan ïa phi . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , Bad u ong ïa phi ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh .
khnang ba kiwei kin ym tip ba phi jingshahthngan — tang U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïuh , un tip . Bad U kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kob phi sa ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju mane ïa ka sngi ha ka jingthaba jrong ka ne ïa u bnai ha ka itynnat Jong u baroh .
translation.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness  ;

translation.kha: Ha khmat ki paidlang jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong , Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki kun ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingkylla jingainguh ki lah ban pyndem ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?
translation.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?
Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ka jingbishar U  Trai  ïa kita ki nongsynshar kiba pynjot bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong u !
Kmen bad kiba kmen , ïa-ïam bad kito kiba ïam .
translation.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice , and weep with them that weep .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kpa jong ngi la pynïap da u nongshun , malade mynta ki kmienah jong ngi ki long ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: We are orphans and fatherless , our mothers are as widows .

translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la ïohsngew hapoh ïingbyndi shaphang kiei kiei katba U Kiriath u la leh , u la phah sha u katto kat ngut na ki synran jongnga u .
translation.en: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ , he sent two of his disciples ,

translation.kha: U Salaph u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khulom jongnga u Manasseh , um don khun shynrang ; hynrei tang ki khun kynthei . Ki kyrteng jong ki , ki longïng ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah .
translation.en: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
Our fathers did eat manna in the desert  ; as it is written , He gave them bread from heaven to eat .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la bam ïa ka mana ha ri shyiap , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U la ai ha ki ïa u kpu na bneng ba kin bam .’

To kynmaw ïa ka Solomon bad Gomorrah , bad ki shnong ba-ima , ha kaba ki bri ki leh kam la ni Kito ki ruh bad ki kyrsum ha ki jingleh nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki shah ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka ding bymjukut kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh .
translation.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .

translation.kha: U Trai’ u la ai shibun ki khwan ïa ki briew lad u bad Pynlong ïa ki kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki nongshun Jong ki .
translation.en: And he increased his people greatly  ; and made them stronger than their enemies .

translation.kha: U Tlai barabor Baroh u ïai-ong , Ka por ka pra haba ki brup na ki nongbah babun kin waiñ sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people , and the inhabitants of many cities :

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ïai-ong , la ni shisien ar ngat ki kynthei kiba shi para .
translation.en: Son of man , there were two women , the daughters of one mother :

translation.kha: Hato ym don ba shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ? Nga smai ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kaba shisha . To ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un jubab ïa nga . Lada kba pyrshah ïa nga ki wanrah ïa ki jingmut da kaba thoh ïa ki ngan haka ban ïoh ,
translation.en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .
And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph s house  ; for he was yet there : and they fell before him on the ground .
translation.kha: Haba u Judah bad ki hynmen ki para jong u ki la wan sha ïing u Joseph , ki shem ba u dang don hi hangta .
U Trai u nguh ïa ka Jerusalem , Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban manbha bapaw — ïa ka Sodom bad ki nongrit jong ka bad ka Gemaraïah bad ki nongrit jongu ka . Ho-oid lang! pynmanbha ïa pha ruh .
translation.en: When I shall bring again their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them :

translation.kha: Ai ha uno une uba pan na ph ïa kano kano , bad haba uno Un u shym ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong phi , wat pita shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew u lah ban ïohpateng ïa ka ïing bad ka spah na la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei tang U  Trai  uba lah ban ai ha u ïa ka tnga kaba shemphang .
Ha kiei kiei baroh phi dien ban long ka nuksa jong ka jinglong babha . To long kiba minot bad kiba kitkhia ha ka jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,

translation.kha: Ki sla jngai u ki la long kiba itynnat , bad u la don kyrhai ki soh ha u ban bsa ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ki mawdong ki la pynkitkhlieh hapoh jong u , bad ki ja-um ki la thret ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .
translation.en: Whose leaves were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all  ; under which the beasts of the field dwelt , and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation :

translation.kha: Nahath U Jehu u la ong ha ki , Ha kane hi ka miet phi baroh phin ïaphet noh bad ieh ïa nga , nabar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ki langbrot jong ka kynhun yn pynsakma .’
translation.en: Then saith Jesus unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa u : Ki la wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka waiñ bym bha , bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,
But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynïasoh ïa lade sha U Trai u long kawei bad u ha kaba kynja mynsiem .
Lada U Blei! uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar tyngkan baklang bad na ka bor jngai ph , te un leh .
translation.en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .

translation.kha: Me sneng ïa kiba sarong ; kito ki bymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ki erlangthari kiba la tim .
translation.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .

translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u Benhail , u khun jong u Uri bad u kyiuh jong u Kush , na ka jait Judah ,
translation.en: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :

translation.kha: U la jong ruh , Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , nabar da la ki kti hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
And as ye would that men should do to you , do ye also to them likewise .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kiwei kumba phi kwah ïa ki ban leh ïa phi .
Nangta uta eiei pat u synran u la mih biang shabar , u la ïakhun bad ka khñium ha ka khyrdop , bad u la ïalam ïa u Petros shapoh .
translation.en: But Peter stood at the door without . Then went out that other disciple , which was known unto the high priest , and spake unto her that kept the door , and brought in Peter .
Making request , if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you .
translation.kha: Nga pan ba U Blei ha ka mon babha jong u ha kaba khatduh un pynlah ïa nga ban wan jngoh ïa phi mynta .
Kaei kaba pha kwah ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab , To kular ïa nga ba kine ki khun shynrang jong nga kin shong ha ka liang kamon bun ka liang kadiang jong me haba manna long u Syiem .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  What wilt thou ?  She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .

translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pah , bad la thoh ïa kine kumin ka jingumsnam ïa im’ . Naba ngi im ha ka por ba kabu kut ka la jan poi .
translation.en: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .

translation.kha: Me Long uei , A Trai ? u la kylli . Nga long U Jisu , ïa uba me pyndem biah ! ka na ka la ong .
translation.en: And he said , Who art thou , Lord ? And the Lord said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest : it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .

translation.kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , nongmareh ki tip) ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka ki shun ïada ïa ka gospel .
translation.en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
translation.kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .

Ka jingsarong jong pham ka la sukher ïa pha . Ym dat ba pyrkhing ïa pha katta kumba pha pyrkhat ba ki long kumta . phah shang ha ki syn-iang maw , ha kliar ki lwa ; hynrei wat la pha shongsuk hajrong tam kum u pukni , U Tharai un wallam ïa phad sha tbian . U thri u la krung .
translation.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee , and the pride of thine heart , O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , that holdest the height of the hill : though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle , I will bring thee down from thence , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — nang long satia kaba dang shiah jingjia . Ïa ka jingjop jrong por yn ym pynslem . Ngan pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem bad ngan ïalam ïa ka burom ka Israel hangta .
translation.en: I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .

So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans : and thou shalt not escape out of their hand , but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire .
translation.kha: Te nga la ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa baroh ki kynthei bad ki khun jong phi , yn rah noh sha ki nong Babilonia , bad ma phi ruh ïa lade phin ym lait na ki . Yn sa ïalam ïa phi kum u koidi da u syiem ka Babilonia , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn sa thang lut khoit .
Yn ñiew ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang ba ka ïaryngkat pyn-at bad ka jingainguh ba u nongrep u wanrah da u kew thymmai bad ka waiñ thymmai .
translation.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you , as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Elkanah Bad baroh kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki la khie dang step phyrngab , bad haduh ba ki la mane ïa U Trai ; ki leit phai pat sha la ïing ha Ramah . U Elah u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Hena ka tnga jong u , bad U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jongno ka .
translation.en: And they rose up in the morning early , and worshipped before the  Lord  , and returned , and came to their house to Ramah : and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife  ; and the  Lord  remembered her .
At thy rebuke they fled  ; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away .
translation.kha: Haba me sneng ïa ki um , ki phet ; ki phet noh haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jingpyrta jong ka hukum jong me .
( Isaiah 43 :10 ) Na i jingsdang i barit ka seng ka la nangroi haduh ba ka la kot sha ki milian nud Ki Nongsakhi , kiba mynta ki bymnang ha ka ban ïalap ha palat 236 tyrnem ki shnong .
translation.en: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) From small beginnings the organization has grown to millions of Witnesses , who are busy preaching in more than 230 lands .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ai ïa kine ki jingïakut shuwa ba u Aaron un rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Hooid Tam , u dei ngab da sum , malu nangta un kup ïa ki jaiñjot lyngdoh ; ka slap liat , ka patlun lyngkot , ka jingpanpoh , dara ka jingpanpoh .
translation.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat , and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh , and shall be girded with a linen girdle , and with the linen mitre shall he be attired : these are holy garments  ; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water , and so put them on .

translation.kha: Kane ka long namar ki Amon bad ki Moab kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na Ijipt . Pynban , ki la siew pisa sha u Balaam Ban tim ïa ki Jeraïah , hynrei U Blei jongnga ngi u la pynlur un-long ïa ka jingtip sha ka jingtyrkhong .
translation.en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .

translation.kha: Balah ba u briew uba jaipdeh um ju miat na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u ïasheptieng ? Ïa ki jingjot ?
translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno ki briew jongngi ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pyndem na ka bynta ka jingsarong bad jingmeng jongno ki bad na ka bynta ka jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: This shall they have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka Shong kulai halor une u nard synshar pyrta ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad don pyniaid ia la ka jingïamai .
translation.en: * ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .

For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity , whose name is Holy  ; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite ones .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba khraw bad uba khuid , uba im shi junom . Nga shong ha ki jaka kiba jrong bad kiba khuid , bad nga im ruh bad ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kylla-kaba-mut , kumta ba ngan pynïoh biang ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki .

translation.en: I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , nga long U Blei uba map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane namar uei ba nga long . Ngan ym bat ïa ki pop jong phi pyrshah ïa phi .

Nangta ïeng khreh ban leit bad la kiwei pat ki Jeraïah sha ka thma bad ngin ïam ban tur ïaleh haduh ba ngin da pynïoh pynïasoh ïa ki ha ka ri ka ban erlangthari ka jong ki . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba thap hapoh ka jingsumar suhjer jyllang ngi ki da ban sah hangne ha ki shnong ibha la ker da ki kut baskhem , khlem jingma na ki briew jong kane ka ri .
translation.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .

translation.kha: Kan sa long ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïingshong bad ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakyrhuh jong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju anna mynno mynno ruh kum kane , bad yn ym don shuh lano lano jin .
translation.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka jer ka wang , ki bri shoiñ bapra , kawei kawei ka ni shihajar tylli ki dieng sohwaiñ bad kawei kiwei ka shongdor shihajar tylli ki Sabbai rupa , kin shylliah da ki bniap shiah bun ki shaiñ .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga , To thoin ïa kane : suk kito ïa bakha la khot sngewbha sha ka jingïakhih shongkurim jong U jinglongmraw . Bad u angel u la bynrap , Kine ki long ki ktien kiba shisha jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he saith unto me , Write , Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb . And he saith unto me , These are the true sayings of God .

translation.kha: Ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah , ki long ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad u khur jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Eliada , u khun jongngi u Makhir , u khun jong u Mareshah , u khun jongu u Joseph .
translation.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters  ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .

translation.kha: Te U Blei u la kren ha u Moses bad u la ong , Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And God spake unto Moses , and said unto him , I am the  Lord  :
Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :
translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei lane ki khunswet , bad wat shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong ka riewkynthei kum ka bynda ïa kano kano ka ram .

translation.en: And Saul said , Disperse yourselves among the people , and say unto them , Bring me hither every man his ox , and every man his sheep , and slay them here , and eat  ; and sin not against the  Lord  in eating with the blood . And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night , and slew them there .
translation.kha: Nangta u ai sa kawei ka hukum :  Khie leit sha ki briew bad ong ïa ki ban wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki langbrot hangne . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki bad bam ïa ki hangne ; kim dei ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .  Kumta ha kata ka miet baroh ki wallam ïa la ki jingri bad ki pynïap ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mih na ka synagog bad ki la leit beit sha ka ïing u Simon bad u Andriw .
U tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan thir ; bad u lyoh uba dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .

translation.kha: Lada nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum bad leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ka daiñ ïa nga ban Shah pynrem da ka jingïap , nam kyrpad ban laiñ na ka . Hynrei lada ym don ka jingsma ha ki jingdum ïa kiba ki ïalamwir pyrshah ïa nga , ym don uno une umbah lah ban aiti ïa nga sha ki . Nga apil sha u Patsha .
translation.en: For if I be an offender , or have committed any thing worthy of death , I refuse not to die : but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me , no man may deliver me unto them . I appeal unto Caesar .

translation.kha: bad u la sdang ban sakhi ïa ki :
translation.en: And he opened his mouth , and taught them , saying ,

translation.kha: To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai kad long lem bad phi baïar .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .

And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kut ki hynñiew bnai yn jied kyrpang ïa ki rangbah ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ban tep ïa kito ki metïap kiba dang sah ha madan , ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri .
Ki khup ki long kiba bha kupar lada ki don u kpu uba beit bad uba leh ïa katai kaba dei .
translation.en: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him .

But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la bishni bad ki la lumlang ïa ki riewkhñium bymsalia na ki lynti bad na u paidbah . Ki la pynkhihwin ïa ka shnong baroh kawei bad ki la tur ïa ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ban wallam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .

translation.en: For my flesh is meat indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .
translation.kha: Naba ka doh jong nga ka long ka jingbam bashisha ; ka snam jong nga ka long ka jingdih bashisha .
Ki Ïingjaiñ jong ki Israel ki long kiba itynnat , Kum ki dieng Tlai kiba ïeng laiñ .
translation.en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !

And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them , Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
translation.kha: Kin nang ïai leh pop shuh shuh da kaba saiñ ïa ki durblei ban mane — ki bleithaw kiba da ka rupa , kiba la saiñdur da ka jingpyrkhat briew , ba la shna da ki kti briew . Bad nangta ki ong ,  Ai ki jingkñia sha ki !  Kumno ki briew kin doh ïa kito ki bleithaw — ki bleithaw ha ka dur ki masi kyrtong !

translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang shong halor u lum ki Olib , pyrshah ïa ka Templ , mynba u Petros , u Jakob , u Ïoannis bad u Andriw ki la wan jar jar ha u .
Yn ym kein u ban pyrkhat ba uba beiñ u long uba donburom lane ban ong ba u riewshukor u long ibha hok .
translation.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal , nor the churl said to be bountiful .

translation.kha: Haba ki leit ïathuh ïa ken ha u Jehu , u la ong , Kane ka longkmie katei kaba U Trai u la ong ba kan jia , mynba u la kren-ïa lyngraw u sharak jong u , u Elijah : ‘ Ki ksew kin bam-im ïa ka met jong ka Jesebel ha ka thain Jesreel .
translation.en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :
Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time  ; for it is an evil time .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kaba sngap jar ha kum kita ki por kiba sniew ka long kaba sian ban leh .

translation.en: In him was life  ; and the life was the light of men .
translation.kha: U Ktien u la long u tyllong jong ka jingim ; bad kane ka jingim ka la wanrah ka jingshai ïa u bynriew .

translation.en: And if the plague come again , and break out in the house , after that he hath taken away the stones , and after he hath scraped the house , and after it is plastered  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang ha kata ka ïing hadien ba la weng noh ïa kita ki maw bad hadien ba la khrud bad la ñiad astor thymmai ruh ïa ka , u lyngdoh un leit khmih bha ïa ka .

translation.en: And said , Remember now , O  Lord  , I beseech thee , how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri hok bad ïaineh ha me , bad ba nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh ,  bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .

U la don bad u shihajar lwet ki rangbah na ka jai Benjamin . Bad u Siba ruh , u shakri jong ka long-briew jong u Shual , u la wan blem bad ki khatsan nguid ki khun shynrang jong u bad arphew ngut ki shatri , bad ki la wan poi ha Jordan ha shaw jong u syiem .
translation.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him , and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul , and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him  ; and they went over Jordan before the king .

translation.kha: Nga la Ïohi ka jingïohipaw na U Troas Nongsynshar . Ha ka ang la ïohi ïa u ba u pynmih shi kynhun ki puit tang hadien ba la ot noh ïa u smam uba long ka bynta u syiem bad u phlang u la sdang ïa-ban mih biang .
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me  ; and , behold , he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth  ; and , lo , it was the latter growth after the king s mowings .

translation.kha: Lada ngi ïai bteng ban ïaishah , ngin sa synshar ruh lem bad u . Lada ngin len ïa u , u ruh un len ïa ngi .
translation.en: If we suffer , we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us :
And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
translation.kha: bad lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long nyngkong , u dei ban long u mraw jong baroh .
Ki rangbah sorkar ki long khim ki suri Ibbah patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap briew ba keiñ ïoh riewarsap .
translation.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop bashatei . U la thew ïa ka , bad ka la long katjuh ka jingheh kamon kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he brought me to the north gate , and measured it according to these measures  ;

translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba laiphew synran snem , bad u synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kamai jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka Kynhun jyllang u Shilhi .
translation.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïa-pyrkhat , kumin u la ong ha ki . Balei ba phi ïa-pyrkhat kum ïa kita kiei kiwei ?
translation.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them ,  Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?

translation.kha: Kiba sah jong ki Lebi , ka mana Merari , ka la ïohpdiang na ka Jaka jong ka jahthait Sebulun Saw tylli ki nongap : ka Jokneam , ka Kartah ,
translation.en: And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,
And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;
translation.kha: Te mynta ki paid Israel ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka jingkthang ki ïam sngewsih :
Ki rangbah na ka joit Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab , Kynrad , Ngin leh Rumah U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Menahem u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shilhim Ka Jesreel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat kumno shapoh u Messaïah ? U dei u nonghiarpateng jongno ? U dih uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Saying ,  What think ye of Christ ? whose son is he ?  They say unto him , The Son of David .

translation.kha: Kine ar nud ki rangbah , ki la rim ïa ka met U Jisu Bad ki la sop ïa ka da ki jaiñ linen lem bad ki musla kat kum ka rukom ki Jiw haba pynkhreh ïa ka met shuwa ban tep .
translation.en: Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .

translation.kha: Kin ym bud ïa uwei paw ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , namar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jngai u .
translation.en: And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .
If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father , will he give him a stone ? or if he ask a fish , will he for a fish give him a serpent ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi kiba long ki kpa phin ai ïa u khun jong phi da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ,
Ong ïa ki ban thep bniat ïa u , bad ban ai ksew bad ka um ïa u haduh ba ngan da wan phai suk .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I come in peace .
And when ye come into an house , salute it .
translation.kha: Haba phi rung shapoh ka ïing , to ong , ‘ Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .’

translation.en: He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang noh ïa ka , namar ka dei ka jingpang bthuh kaba pur , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .
Nga don ki jingthmu bad nga pyntyrkhong ïa ki ; nga don ka jingshemphang , bad nga don ka bor .
translation.en: Counsel is mine , and sound wisdom : I am understanding  ; I have strength .

translation.kha: Ka Israhaïah kan long kaba khlem jingïadie , bad ka Demas kan duh noh ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ka . Kut ki nong Syria bakha lait im ktien don ha ka jinglehrain kum ki briew jong ka Israhaïah . Nga , U Trai’ Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translation.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria : they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
And last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh eh , ka kynthei ka la ïap .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , after the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang , U Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Phira don baroh ki briew Kiba duk lem sad phi , ishyrkhei phin ym ïoh batbor ïa nga .
translation.en: For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?
translation.kha: Nga isih ïa u masi ksiar ba mane da ki briew jong ka nongbah Samaria . Nga bitar lep ïa ki . Sa katno kan shim por shuwa ba kin sangeh noh na kaba mane bleithaw ?
U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei patar ki jaitbynriew bad u la shait ïa ki ban shim noh ïa ki pynthait jong ki ,
translation.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;

translation.kha: Ïa kane la sa ban pynong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: U la mihnoh , u da bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad u la wan poi sha ka jaka ba la khot Ka jaka Maloi Khlieh , kumba la khot ïa ka . ( Ha ka ktien Hebru la khot Golgotha ) .
translation.en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull , which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha :
For I desired mercy , and not sacrifice  ; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa ka jingieit baneh jong phi , ym ka jingkñia da ki mrad . Nga kham kwah ba ki briew jong nga kin ithuh ïa nga ban ïa ki jingainguh thang sha nga .

translation.en: And thou , child , shalt be called the prophet of the Highest : for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways  ;
translation.kha: Ïa me , ko khun jong nga , yn khot u nongïathuhlypa jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Men leit ha shuwa jong U Trai ban pynkhreh ka lynti na ka bynta jong u ,

translation.en: Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her , and the daughters of the famous nations , unto the nether parts of the earth , with them that go down into the pit .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to ïamkthang namar baroh u paidbah babun ka Ijipt . Phah ïa ki ban hiar lem bad ki jaitbynriew badonbor sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh jong u kpa jong u , u Jehoïakhin u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Ha ka shithi la thoh : Phi dei ki nongpeit ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem jongu phi bad phi ei ruh bad phi ki khi ïapom , ki kulai , ki tiar ïap bad ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you , seeing your master s sons are with you , and there are with you chariots and horses , a fenced city also , and armour  ;

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka khat balieh kambah khraw bad ïa uta uba shong ha ka . Ka pyrthei bad ka bneng ki la phet na iitkhmat jong u bad ym shym la ïohi shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And I saw a great white throne , and him that sat on it , from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away  ; and there was found no place for them .

translation.kha: U Shem , u hynmen jong u Japheth , u la long u kpu thom jrong ki Hebru baroh .
translation.en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .

translation.kha: ba haba ngi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem ha ka jingbymkohnguh Jong ngi u la wallam ïa ngi shai ka jingim lem bad U Khrist . Ka dei da ka jingaiei U Blei ba la pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )

When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lyngba ïa ki um bajylliew , ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ki jingeh kin ym tyllep ïa phi . Haba phi ïaid lyngba ka ding , phin ym ing ; ki jingtynjuh ba-eh kiba wan kin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
U Abda u ong ha u Abiathar , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Ahimelekh , Wanrah ha nga ka ephod , bad u Abiathar u ïarah ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest , Ahimelech s son , I pray thee , bring me hither the ephod . And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David .
Let me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they .
translation.kha: Me wat khang ïa nga , naba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki ba kumta yn ym don shuh u ban dang kynmaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa ki .’
Ïa u jingthung barhem ïa uba U Kpa Jong nga uba ha bneng um shym la snar , yn rat noh , la Joab U Jisu .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
Their quiver is as an open sepulchre , they are all mighty men .
translation.kha: Ki rang bahryntieh jong ki , ki long ki shipai bakhrawbor kiba pynïap khlem jingisynei .

translation.en: Take you twelve men out of the people , out of every tribe a man ,
translation.kha: Jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait ,
Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ngat ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .
translation.kha: U don bad u ka byrsha pynher stait , ban shoh ïa u kew baroh bad ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka thiar jong u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .
Ki briew kin behmrad hangta da ki ryntieh nabar ki khnam . Ho-oid , ka ri bhor kawei kan dap da ki shynraiñ bad ki pynbiang shiah .
translation.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi U Jisu u la rung hapoh hangta shuwa jong ngi , bad u la jia long U Rangbah Lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long Lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered , even Jesus , made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .

translation.kha: U Phestos u la jubab , Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa leit pat shane shet .
translation.en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .

translation.kha: Ki la da ïaid saitlah noh na kata ka lynti ha katba ar la hukum ïa ki ban ïaid ; ki la thaw ïa lade u khun masi ba la saiñ da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u , bad ki la ai jingkñia ha u . Ki ïa-ong ba une u un-long u Blei’ jongu ki , umbiah la ïalum noh ïa ki na ka ri Jingtep !
translation.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them : they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it , and have sacrificed thereunto , and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;
translation.kha: bad kumba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka bor ban synshar , kumta ngan ai ha phi ïa kajuh ka bor .

translation.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno U  Trai  u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki nong Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jyllop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh nadien jong phi .
u la ainong ha ki , Kaei kaba sam sa leh ka Long ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la sah” .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .

translation.kha: ( Mathaios 15 :30 , 31 ; Joanan 5 :28 ) Hadien ba u Jisu u la ïa-ïap , U Blei u la ai biang ha u ïa ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: ( Matthew 15 :30 , 31  ; John 5 :28 ) After Jesus died , God restored him to life as a spirit person .

translation.kha: Lynthem maw-it ïa u Haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na U Trai U blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phin na ka ri Ijipt , ha kabu phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la don u mynsiem bymman u la tur puk sha ki da ka jinglehbor kaba Haduh katta ba u la jrop ïa ki baroh . Ki la phet noh na ka iing jong u , kiba la mynsaw bad ha ki jaiñ kiba la shiah ther .
translation.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la sngewmong ïa u bad ki la sngewphylla ha ki kyntien basngewtynnat katba u la kren . Ki la ong , Hato ine um dei u khun jong u Joseph ?
translation.en: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph s son ?
And he made his grave with the wicked , and with the rich in his death  ; because he had done no violence , neither was any deceit in his mouth .
translation.kha: La buh ïa u ha ka jingtep lem bad ki bymman , la tep ïa u bad kiba riewspah , wat la um shym la leh kano kano ka kam bymman lane um shym la shukor ïano ïano .

translation.en: And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .
translation.kha: Nangta uta uba shong ha ka khet u la ong ,  Bad mynta nga thaw thymmai ïa kiei kiei baroh !  U la ong ruh ïa nga ,  Thoh ïa kane , namar kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , unto all that are carried away captives , whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ha kito ki briew baroh kiba u la shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia :

Te u Jehoïada u shim ïa ka Synduk , u ksam tliw ha ka jingtap , bad u buh ïa ka synduk hajan ka jingnguh , ha ka phang kamon haba rung sha ka Templ . Ki lynghoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka synduk ïa ka pyut baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan mane .
translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
And Hezekiah answered , It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees : nay , but let the shadow return backward ten degrees .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ka suk ban pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam sha khmat ! Pynlong ïa ka ban leit shiphew jam shadien .

translation.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .
translation.kha: U syiem Abijah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka jingsuk haduh shiphew snem .
U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba bthing ïa u na ka kti , Ai ba sam ktah ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !
translation.en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .

translation.kha: U Amos u ong , U tharai u kyrjaw na u lum Seïon ; Ka sur jong u ka Tied kum u Pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong , malade u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïalum ïa ka longïng kum ka jingainguh Naaman ka jop , ka dei shun long ka langbrot ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering , he shall bring it a female without blemish .

translation.kha: Haba u Abner u la wan poi ha Hebron , u Joab u ïalam ïa u kham sharud ha ka khyrdop , kumba u kwah ban ïakren jar jar bad u , bad hangta u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh . Bad kumta la pynïap ïa u Abner namar ba u la pynïap ïa u Asahel , u para u Joab .

translation.en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha khmat U  Trai  jong u Lum Sinai , Ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Kumta ym u Johanan lymne uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino na ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai ban ïaisah ha ka ri Judah .
translation.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .

translation.kha: Nangta u pud u hiar arsut sha ka wahduid Kanah . Ki nongbah kiba shathie jong ka thohshuid ki dei jong ki jait Ephai , wat la ki hap hapoh ka ri Manasseh . U pud ka Manasseh u suh ter ter na ka phud bashatei jong ka wahduid bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah , southward of the river : these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh : the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river , and the outgoings of it were at the sea :

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno kan jia haba ïa kiba ïarap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka met la tep , ka erlangthari kaba ïap ; Haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .
translation.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :
Thou shalt have no other gods before me .
translation.kha: Wat mane ïa uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ïa nga .

translation.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships , and servants that had knowledge of the sea  ; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir , and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold , and brought them to king Solomon .
translation.kha: U syiem Hiram u phah sha u ïa ki liengbah hapoh ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u hi ryngkat bad ba la ñiah da ki maji kiba la mlien bha . Kine ki leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Solomon sha ka ri ki Ophir , bad ki wan kit nangta palat khatsan hajar kilo ka ksiar ïa u syiem Solomon .
Nga la thoh laiphew tylli ki jingjrong na ka bynta jong phi . Ki kynhun ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingkyntu babha ,
translation.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun , and for the precious things put forth by the moon ,

Kumta ki la leit bad ki la syiem ïa u khun kada ha ka lynti baheh , ba la teh ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing . Katba ki dang law noh ïa u ,

translation.en: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .

translation.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :

translation.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .

translation.en: And he sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home : and Adoniram was over the levy .

And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ïa u Samson ,  Haduh mynta phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .  U jubab ,  Lada phi thain ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong nga hynñiew tylli bad phi pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
Ka la leit bad ïatyngkhuh ïa ki nongbuaid Jong u . Ki dang ïasngewsih bad ïam ; bad Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , ba ka ïa-ong ba U Jisu u im bad ba ka la lah ïohi ïa u , kim shym la ngeit ïa ka .
translation.en: And they , when they had heard that he was alive , and had been seen of her , believed not .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ki rangbah lyngngeit bad sha ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ïai-ong , Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam kan kano tad ynda i'u la pynïap ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .

Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban pynngat ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng bad pyndonkam ïa ki ha kaba tei ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong haduh ba kan da kyllon .
Bad ka Hukum kaba dei ban ïalamwir jingim , ha nga , ka la wallam ka jingïap .
translation.en: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .
