U Mynsiem u la batip syier ïa nga , nabar u angel u la rah ïa nga sha kiar jong u lymbung uba jrong . U la pyn-i ha nga ïa ka Jerusalem , ka Nongbah Bakhuid , kaban da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei
translation.en: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain , and shewed me that great city , the holy Jerusalem , descending out of heaven from God ,
Yea , surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh un ym leh ïa kaba sniew ; um ju leh bymdei ïano ïano .
Kaba koum kata ka jinghikai ka long kum ka pyrem kaba bam khong ïa ka doh . Ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la hikai kum ïa kita ki kai ki dei u Hymenaïos bad u Philetos .
translation.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
For my people have committed two evils  ; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , and hewed them out cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water .
translation.kha: namar ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar tylli ki pop : Ki la phai noh na nga , ka umpohliew ki um basngur ; bad ki la tih ki jaka pynlang um , ki jaka pynlang um kiba la pdang ki bym lah ban pynlang ïa ka um .

translation.en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .
translation.kha: Ki atiar kiba ngi pyndonkam ha ka jingïaleh jong ngi kim long ki atiar jong ka pyrthei hynrei ki atiar kiba donbor jong U Blei , ïa kiba ngi pyndonkam ban pynpra ïa ki kut baskhem .
U Blei u wan biang na Edom ; U Blei bakhuid u wan na ki lum ka Paran . Ka brup jong u ka thap ïa ki Bteng , bad ka pyrthuh ka dap da ka jingïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: God came from Teman , and the Holy One from mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and the earth was full of his praise .

translation.kha: Nga la don bad phi ha ka Tabor man ka sngi , bad phim shym la pyrshang ban kem ïa sa . Hynrei kane ka dei ka kynta jong phira ban leh , haba ka leh jong ka jingdum ka synshar .
translation.en: When I was daily with you in the temple , ye stretched forth no hands against me : but this is your hour , and the power of darkness .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u , Mynta te me kren-ïa shai kyrdan , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki man kren bapher .
translation.en: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .

translation.kha: kum u mluh ibha kwah hir hir ïa ka jaka tngen ; kum u nongïatrei uba ap ïa la ka bainong .
translation.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow , and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work :

translation.kha: Na ka ri ba ki Israel ki la ïoh , la ai ha ki Lebi sawphew phra tylli ki nongbah , lem malade ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them : thus were all these cities .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh te ba kaba bha Tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka lama ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ym to kano kano kawei pat kambah ngi lah ban leh . Ym ei Kanah kano ka lynti ïa ngi ban tip Kaei ka ban jia ynda ngi ïap .
translation.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works  ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him ?
And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba nga don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thou knowest how I have served thee , and how thy cattle was with me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Phi tip kumno nga la shakri ïa phi bad kumno ki kynhun jingri jong phi ki la roi ha ka jingsumar jong nga .
Bad mynta , ko hynmen ko para jong nga , de tip ba katei katba ma phi pynlang ki nongïalam jong phi , phi la leh ïa U Jisu ka long namar ka jingpyndem jongu phi .
translation.en: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .

translation.kha: U Abram u ong , “Nga la smai ha khmat U Tiras , U Blei bajhieh Tam Eh , u Nongthaw ïa ka bnoh bad ïa ka khyndew , ba ngan ym bat ei ei ïa kaba daym ka jong me , wat ïa u sai utai ruh .
translation.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the  Lord  , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,

translation.kha: Kumta haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u Pilat u la kylli ïa ki , Uno na kine phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Jisu Barabbas ne ïa U Jisu kaba la khot U Messaïah ?
translation.en: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?

translation.kha: bad u tang shu rah ïa la ka kti , ki rangïapom kiba la rit ki ïeng jat , ki mareh sha ka nongbet bad kurup ïa ka . Mar mar shiah ki thang ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .

translation.kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki kynhun shyieng jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlain jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha , mynba ap hangne ; U Trai u la hukum ïa to ban leit sha ka woh Jordan . Hynrei u Elijah u jingjubab , Nga smai da ka jingshaniah skhem jong nga ha U Tharai bad ha phi ba ngan ym hynñiew ïa phi . Kumta ki la loit ,
translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Tarry , I pray thee , here  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jordan . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And they two went on .
Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .

translation.en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .
translation.kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad ka bam duh ïa ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ baroh ha ka duwan . Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadem ngon haduh khyndew .
La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ka kyrhuh shaphang kine kiei kai ka la shynrang kylleng ka ri lum —Judah .
translation.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

translation.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .
translation.kha: U Omri bad ki shipai jong u ki mihnoh na Gibbethon bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tirsah .
Shibun ki nongshun ki la dat sawdong jong nga ; hynriewphew nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U Trai !
translation.en: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  will I destroy them .

translation.kha: Haduh kane hi ka shikhyllipmat ngi shahthngan bad im’ synñiang ; la pynkup ha ngi da ki jaiñjot ; la shohbeiñ ïa ngi ; ngi ïabuaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pud ; ngi la thait la jrem ïa lade na ka jingtrei shitom .
translation.en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger , and thirst , and are naked , and are buffeted , and have no certain dwellingplace ;

At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba man ki hynñiew snem ki dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uno uno u mraw Hebru uba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
Yn ym anna kadei ruh ka kynïan ha ka ri jong phi kaba hap khun lane kaba lyngki . Ngam pynjlih ïa ka rta jong phi .
translation.en: There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .

translation.kha: Ki la heh bor noh na ka jingtrei shitom ; kumba kin kyllon noh , bad ym don ba ïarah .
translation.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour  ; they fell down , and there was none to help .

translation.kha: Te , ynda U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi! ïa kata ka ri bad u la phlait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh kiba shong sawdong jongngi pa’ , pynïap lut ïa ki Amalek baher , khnang ban ym don shuh uba kynmaw ïa ki . Wat klet ïa kane !
translation.en: Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .

translation.kha: Nangta u “Soitan” u la rung hapoh u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Iskariot , ibha long uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .
translation.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la ei uwei u koidi uba pawnam uba kyrteng u Jisu Barabbas .
translation.en: And they had then a notable prisoner , called Barabbas .

translation.kha: U bret ïa ka kynïan shipai jong ka jingïap bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsha jongngi ka ki la ïap jylliew ha ka Duriaw Basaw
translation.en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .

translation.kha: U Trei u ong ha u Moses , Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito katba ba-mynshuwa , bad len sa thoh ha ki ïa ki ktien babha la don ha ki mawlyngkniap kiba nyngkong , ïa kiba me la pynpait .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la jam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .
Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sakkur , u khun jong u Imri u tat ïa ka bynta kaba stem .
translation.en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho . And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri .

translation.kha: Ïalang paralok bad uba stad bad phiah kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok badno ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba ngeit .
translation.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
And when he came , lo , Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching : for his heart trembled for the ark of God . And when the man came into the city , and told it , all the city cried out .
translation.kha: U Eli , uba dang pyrkhat khuslai shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u dang shong harud lynti , u da peit lyngngoh . Uta u rangbah u pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng ka shnong bad uwei pa uwei u lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , upon the mountains of Ararat .
translation.kha: Te ha ka sngi kaba khathynñiew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kata ka lieng ka wan neh den halor u lumbah ha ki lynter lum Ararat .

translation.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka jinglyng-a ïa ka jingïarap , namar ba U  Trai  u la wallam ïa ka jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .
Nangta ngan pynkylla ïa ki biria jong ki hima , bad kin duwai tang sha nga bad ym sha kiwei pat ki blei . Ki bhor kin kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language , that they may all call upon the name of the  Lord  , to serve him with one consent .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , myntan , ko khun u Briew , ngan shim noh na ki ïa ka Templ bakhraw kaba la long ka jingsarong bad ka jingkmen jong ki , kaba ki sngewtynnat ban khih bad ban leit jngoh . Bad ngan shim noh ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength , the joy of their glory , the desire of their eyes , and that whereupon they set their minds , their sons and their daughters ,

translation.kha: Bad kitab nga la ïaleh shitom ïa-ban kynjoh noh , ban pyntha , ban jrop , ban pynjot malu ban pynpra ïa ki , kumta ruh ngan ïaleh shitom ngab thung ïa ki bad banbeiñ tei pang ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that like as I have watched over them , to pluck up , and to break down , and to throw down , and to destroy , and to afflict  ; so will I watch over them , to build , and to plant , saith the  Lord .
Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
translation.kha: Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka kham bha ban leit hangta ban ïoh jinghikai ban ïa kaba ai jingkñia kum ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .

To shahshkor ! Ka nongrah-khubor ka wan ! Ka don ka jingiehnoh bakhraw ha ka jaitbynriew bashatei ; ka kynoi shipai jong ka kan pynkylla ïa ki nongbud ka Judah shad ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ki shong ki myrsiang .
translation.en: Behold , the noise of the bruit is come , and a great commotion out of the north country , to make the cities of Judah desolate , and a den of dragons .

Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams : for the  Lord  your God proveth you , to know whether ye love the  Lord  your God with all your heart and with all your soul .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pyndonkam ïa u ban tynjuh ïa phi , ban khmih la phi ieit ne em ïa U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

Hato ka pynphong ïa me u syiem uba kham bha paila me tei ki ïing da ki dieng Hadadeser kiba kham kynsai ban ïa kito ki jong Kawei ? U kpa jong me u la im kyrhai , u long borabor Uba hok bad uba kun beit , bad u manla ha kiei kiei baroh ba u la leh .
translation.en: Shalt thou reign , because thou closest thyself in cedar ? did not thy father eat and drink , and do judgment and justice , and then it was well with him ?

translation.kha: Baroh ki la baibam bad ki la kadiang . Nongthaw ki synran ki la lym hynriew tukri pura jong ki lyngkhot kiba sah tam .
translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïajubab , Dem ma de , ma nga keiñ uba ïakren malade pha .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  I that speak unto thee am he .
After that he appeared in another form unto two of them , as they walked , and went into the country .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha kawei pat ka rukom ha ki ar ngut na ki katba ki dang ïa-ïaid lynti sha la shnong .

translation.en: Now ye are the body of Christ , and members in particular .
translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ka met U Khrist , bad uwei pa uwei u long u bynta jong ka .
Ka ju shong hapoh uwei u Dieng Tlai hapdeng ka Ramah bad ka Bethel ha ka ri lum Ephraim , sad ki paidlang Israel ki ju leit hangta na ka bynta ki jingbishar jongnga ka .
translation.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim : and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .

A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .
translation.kha: Haba ka briew kan sa kha khun , ka sngewsih namar ba ka kynta jong ka jingshahshitom jong ka , ka la poi ; hynrei haba la kha ïa i khunlung , ka klet noh ïa la ka jingshah shitom , namar ka kmen ba la kha ïa i khunlung sha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And Jattir with her suburbs , and Eshtemoa with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: ka Jattir , ka Eshtemoa ,
A ki bieit ! Hato ym dei U Blei kiba la thret ïa kaba sawar , ibha la thaw ruh ïa kaba shapoh ?
translation.en: Ye fools , did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also ?

translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jongki pa , ki paid Judah , nga la Buh ka por ban pynsamthiah ïa phi ruh na ka bynta kaei kaba phira leh .
translation.en: Also , O Judah , he hath set an harvest for thee , when I returned the captivity of my people .

translation.kha: Phi tip ba buid suba kun ïa kane kano na phim ki kam kiba jylli yn ym ñiewkor Shuah ïa u kum eiei na ki briew jong U blei .
translation.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations , even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people .

translation.kha: Ki la wan ban maham ïa ki jingtipbriew bad ba-bang ïateh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki nongsuhjaiñ ki wan na ka ri kambah jngai biah . Kine ki nongshna kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah
translation.en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .

translation.kha: Mynhyndai kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien ba la otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .
translation.en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .

translation.kha: bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha kaba shynna ïa ka duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , malu ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïamih na ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U Trai .
translation.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ken ka Jingkhawai Mamre , namar dei ha kane ka Sngi ba nga la ïalam noh ïa ki jwat jong phi na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pateng phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi koum ka Jingkhuid Niam .
translation.en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .

And I will take the remnant of Judah , that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , and they shall all be consumed , and fall in the land of Egypt  ; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine : they shall die , from the least even unto the greatest , by the sword and by the famine : and they shall be an execration , and an astonishment , and a curse , and a reproach .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ki briew ka Judah kiba sah bad kiba la kut jingmut ban leit bad shong ha Ijipt , ngan khmih ïa kane ba baroh na ki kin jot noh . Baroh na ki , kiba rit bad ki bakhraw , kin ïap ha Ijipt , na ka thma ne na ka jingïapthngan . Kin long ka jingïohi ba-itriem ; ki briew kin ñiewbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba nga pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga shem sngewbha . Nga la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
Ïa ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .
translation.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
Ye are our epistle written in our hearts , known and read of all men :
translation.kha: Ma phi hi phi long kata ka shithi ba ngi don , ïa kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ngi khnang ba baroh kin tip bad kin pule .

translation.en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Lebi ruh u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa uta u briew , bad nangta u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .

translation.en: And again the word of the  Lord  came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , kaba arphew saw jong u bnai , U  Trai  u la ai ha u Haggai ïa ka khubor kaba ar
U ter ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep jong ka longïing jong u hi , bad ma u dara la ki khun shaneng ki ïabam sngewsih ïa ka , ki da ïong , O u para jyllang nga , u para jong nga !
translation.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave  ; and they mourned over him , saying , Alas , my brother !

translation.kha: ngin nud ban ithuh sha ki rudnong lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun jong i'u ki la kieng atiar bad ka jingryngkhiang ka don ha baroh sawdong jong ngi .
translation.en: Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .
Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .
translation.kha: Namar ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad mem shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don . Na kata ka daw U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa me mynta .

translation.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhublei ïa u Ruphos , ba u la jied ia U Trai , bad ïa ka kmie jong u , bad jongnga .

translation.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :
translation.kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi mihnoh na ïing bad u bad wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! Mynta u la tyrkhong bad la bthuh .

translation.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .
translation.kha: Lada phi pynshitom ïa la ki khun , phim ieit ïa ki . Lada phi ieit ïa ki , phin sneng pynbeit ïa ki .

U Khun U Briew u la wang , bad u la bam bad u la dih , pynlang pa la ong , ‘ Khmih ïa une u bhabriew ! U long u lat bad u nongbuaid , u paralok jong ki nonglum khana bad kiwei pat Ibbah la shah kyntait !’
translation.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking  ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !

translation.kha: Bad lada ki paid Jerusalem kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Aiñ baroh ba u Moses u shakri jong per u la ai ha ki , nangta ngan ym shah ba yn beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers  ; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them , and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them .

translation.kha: Wat leit ong ha la ka dohnud , kine ki jaitbynriew ki khnam bun pyntud ban ïa ngi , kumno moi ha ban eh ïa ki .
translation.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I  ; how can I dispossess them ?

translation.kha: Ngin don kane ka jingkyrmen kum u angkor ïa ki jingim jongno i . Ka long kaba skhem bad kabu thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka jingkah jongno ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba khnam shapoh .
translation.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;

translation.kha: Ynda u Yiron u la lah pyndep ïa ka mano lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka kaba Khuid Tam , ïa kaba sah jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingainong Ryngkat U Trai , bad ïa ka duwan , un ai sha U Trai ïa uta u langsohmoh uba dang im uba la jied na ka byndi u Asasel .
translation.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar , he shall bring the live goat :

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba bha yn ïa-ai kynmaw kum ka jingkyrkhu ; hynrei ïa ki riewbymman yn kattne noh .
translation.en: The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .
They shall be holy unto their God , and not profane the name of their God : for the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and the bread of their God , they do offer : therefore they shall be holy .
translation.kha: U dei ban long uba khuid bad um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; u kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga , bad kumta u dei ban long uba khuid .

translation.en: Lying lips are abomination to the  Lord  : but they that deal truly are his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa kiba lamler , hynrei u sngewbha ïa kito kiba bat ïa la ka ktien .
Bad nangta u ong , Ngin ym kynmaw Shua ïa ki pop jong ki badno ïa ki jingleh palat jong ki .
translation.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa phira , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uwei suba ia ban ïarap ïa phi ?
translation.en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .

translation.kha: Kynmaw myntan ïa kaei kaba Phi la tip shaphang U thri lyngba ki jingïashem jngai phi sad u . dih ma phi , ym ki khun ki kti lad ph kiba la ïohmad ïa phim ki jingïashem . Phi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , ïa ka bor lad u , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jongu u , bad ïa ki kham jong u .
translation.en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,
And Moses made a serpent of brass , and put it upon a pole , and it came to pass , that if a serpent had bitten any man , when he beheld the serpent of brass , he lived .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shna ïa u  seiñ rnong bad u wah ïa u ha u dieng . Kat uba shah puh bseiñ u peit sha uta u  seiñ rnong bad u koit .
Une u sah shipor ha ka ïing u nongpdem snieh ibha kyrteng u Simon , umbiah shong basah harud duriaw .
translation.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynriah na Hebron sha Jerusalem , u Dabid u shim shuh shuh ki tnga kliar bad ki tnga trai , bad u ïoh bun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .
Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba du uno uba pynbna ha naba paw ba u long u jong nga , U Te U Briew un leh kamut ïa u ha khmat ki jin jong U Blei .
translation.en: Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :

translation.kha: Bad halor “kata ka diengphna , U Khristan u la pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka bor jong ki nongsynshar ba kynja mynsiem badno na ki bor synrai ; u la pyntong ka jingthadrong ïa ki da Kaba ïalaw ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ka jingïaid Paidbah kaba jop jong u .
translation.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .

translation.kha: U Blei u long uba khlaiñ bad uba ïai jop ; baroh ar ngut — uba shah shukor bad u nongshukor ki dat ioh ka bor jongu u .
translation.en: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .

Then I beheld , and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire : from the appearance of his loins even downward , fire  ; and from his loins even upward , as the appearance of brightness , as the colour of amber .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw ïa ka dur kaba i kum ka durbriew bameh ding . Na ka syngkai sharum , ka met jong u ka long kum ka ding , bad na ka syngkai shaneng , u shat phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la kyrshut phyrnai bha .
shun pynshitom ïa ki jingpyniwbih kamar U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jong ki briew jrong U Blei . To ïarap ïa U Trai !
translation.en: To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .
Regard not them that have familiar spirits , neither seek after wizards , to be defiled by them : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat leit ban pan jingmut na ki briew kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba la ïap . Lada phi leh kumta , yn ñiew ïa phi ki bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Ki la pynpang ïa u ban phai dien noh na U Blei , bad kat khah ba un da tymmen ki la ïalam noh ïa u ban mane ïa ki blei nongwei . Um shym la ngeit hok shuh ïa U Trai U blei jong u , kumba u ïaiban u kpa jong u , u la long .
translation.en: For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .
Canst thou send lightnings , that they may go , and say unto thee , Here we are ?
translation.kha: Bad lada me hukum ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ; hato kan wan sha me bad ong ,  Nga kloi ban leh ei ei  ?
ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki , baneh pynïap ïa ki nonglur bad ïa ki kulai jong ki , ban ïew ïa ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah synshar ba-halor .
translation.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen  ; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers .

translation.kha: Bad haba U Trai u la pyndep ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ïa phi dara ba u la pynlong ïa phi u skhem ki Isaia ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;
And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiwei ki synran , ki la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun sawdong jong ki bad katto katne na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïania bad ki .
Ki bymman ki ïohthiah ïa Kanah bad ki bitar ; u shut bitar ha ka jingisih bad ki jah noh ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh junom .
translation.en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ot , phin ai shi bynta na ka san bynta ha u syiem , malu kaba law saw bynta kan long ka jongno phi , ba phin ïoh bhah symbai , bad ba phin ïuh jingbymman na ka pyntwa ïa lade bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the increase , that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh , and four parts shall be your own , for seed of the field , and for your food , and for them of your households , and for food for your little ones .
And Jeroboam s wife arose , and departed , and came to Tirzah : and when she came to the threshold of the door , the child died  ;
translation.kha: Ka tnga u Jeroboam ka leit phai noh sha Tirsah . Hamar ba ka rung ha la ïing , u khynnah u ïap .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata bad u la ong ha u julor , Wah pynsheptieng ; tang shuki ieit , bad kane sa khiah .
translation.en: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying ,  Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .

translation.kha: Da Shishak phi tip ba ki rangbah kiba trei ha ka Templ ki ïoh bam na ka Tep bad kito kiba kñia ïa ki jingangnud ha ka duwan ki ïoh ïa ka bynta na ki jingkñia ?
translation.en: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple ? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar ?
And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life .
translation.kha: U Samuel u synshar ïa ki Israel katba u dang im .
Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u la pah pyllait ïa u ; u nongsynshar ki jaitbynriew u la pyllait ïa u .
translation.en: The king sent and loosed him  ; even the ruler of the people , and let him go free .

translation.kha: Nga pynshah da ka met sha kito katba saw ïa nga . Ngam shngiam pynsangeh ïa ki haba ki briew ïa nga , haba ki puson ïa ki shñiuh na u ñiuhmat jong nga bad bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .
And a third part shall be at the king s house  ; and a third part at the gate of the foundation : and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: sa shi bynta kin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa kiba sah yn buh ha ka Khyrdop Nongrim . Ki briew baroh kin ïalumlang ha ki phyllaw ka Templ .
Hynrei lada “kata ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u lyngkhuh u la khmih bniah ïa u bad u la pynbna ba u lama naba khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa lade ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :

translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phoi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phira ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki ni ïa kata !
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw la la shem kynsan ïa lade ha ka nongbah Susa ba la ker kynroh ha ka pyniaid jong ka Etham . Nga la ïeng khrud ka wah Uri ,
translation.en: And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .

translation.kha: Ko ki nonglam lynti bamatlah ! Phi pjiar ïa u skain na ka jingdih jong phi , hynrei phi nguid ïa ka ut !
translation.en: Ye blind guides , which strain at a gnat , and swallow a camel .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tiar ïaleh u ha utai u khynraw , bad u nguh ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .
translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .

And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Lada ïa ka ïing ha kawei na kine ki shnong la die da kiba na ka jait Lebi bad ym shym thied pat ïa ka , dei ban pynphai pat ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat , namar ki ïing jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi kiba don ha kita ki shnong jong ki , ki dei ki jingïohkynti jong ki hapdeng ki paid Israel .

Hynrei U Jisu u shu sngap . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la krensih ha u , Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga buh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa ngi lada me dei u Messaïah , U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .

translation.kha: Ha jingpyrshang jinganna , ka meeting ka lama kaba seisoh .
translation.en: In my opinion , the meeting was a success .

translation.kha: To khmih naki na ka iaka shnong Bakhuid jong me ha bneng bad kyrkhu ïa ki briew jongki me , ki Israel , Bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud nabar ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .’
translation.en: Look down from thy holy habitation , from heaven , and bless thy people Israel , and the land which thou hast given us , as thou swarest unto our fathers , a land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: Kynmaw U Khrismas bad u Ksuid kin ïahap jingmut ? Kumno ibha jingkit u ne bynta bad u bymïaineh ?
translation.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial ? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel ?

translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Heh uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . Kumba U Trai u la lah kren-ïa da u Jehosheba u khun jongno u Nun , u Hiel u la duh noh ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Abiram mynba u bah ïa ka nongrim jong ka Jerikho , bad ïa u khuid khatwei jong u , u Sebul mynleh u tei ïa ki khyrdop jong ka .
translation.en: In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .

translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba lada ïa kane ka nongbah la tei pat bad ba ïa ki kynroh la pyndep , ko Syiem , phin ym lah shuh baneh pynïaid ïa ka ïapynbeit jong ka Ïuphratis Pdeng .
translation.en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .

translation.kha: U dei ban ïoh bynta mar katjuh ka jingbam kumba long kiwei pat ki lyngngeit , bad u ha ban buh ïa kano kano kaba ki ïa-ïeng ha-sem jong u ki phah sha u .
translation.en: They shall have like portions to eat , beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony .

translation.kha: Ki jingkyrmen jong ki briew bakha bha ki lam sha ka jingkmen , ishyrkhei ka jingkhmih lyngki ki rymphum kam lam shano sheng .
translation.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa ailad ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba kren ïa ka ktien U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To wat kyntiew ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei lymda ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .
translation.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,

translation.kha: u khun jong u Melea , u khun jong u Menna , u khun jong u Mattatha , u khun jong u Nathan , u khun jong u Abda ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Melea , which was the son of Menan , which was the son of Mattatha , which was the son of Nathan , which was the son of David ,
And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .
translation.kha: Ki rep lyngkha bad ki thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki lum ka jingot kaba dap kyrhai .
bad ki la ïapynlong ki jingtem ban kumin ïa U Jisu ha kaba rieh bad ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty , and kill him .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba sawphew Wai jyllang ka jingïashun u Usai u Syiem ka Judah , u Omri u long u Syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar khat-ar snem . Ha ki hynriew snem kiba tyngkong u la shihajar ha tyrha ,
translation.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel , twelve years : six years reigned he in Tirzah .

translation.kha: Haduh phi tharai ba sa la tur ïalaw ïa ka ri jong Phi bad pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap U Trai’ ? U Trai da lade u la ïathuh ha per ban tur ïajah pyrshah ïa ka bad pynjot ïa ka .
translation.en: And am I now come up without the  Lord  against this land to destroy it ? the  Lord  said unto me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban jong ïa U Blei aïu un leh dawai kynnoh ïa u ba u leh bymman .
translation.en: Who hath enjoined him his way ? or who can say , Thou hast wrought iniquity ?
Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre s sake .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba donkam ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingïathuh jong ki , namar ki pynkylla khongpong ïa ki longïing baroh da kaba hikai ïa kaei kaba kim dei ban hikai , bad baroh ka long ïa ka jingthmu basngewlehrain ban thaw pisa .
U Trai u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .
translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki wait sha u bad ki ainong , Nga iohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long kaba isynei . Ai jingbit ïa ine ba Ngin leit sha u syep Jong ka Israel ryngkat bad ki janai byrni Sidon ki syngkai jngai i'u bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , mala lehse un phlait im ïa phi .
translation.en: And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .

translation.kha: Ko nong Galilaïa , balei phi ïa-ïeng hangne da kaba khyllad sha ka sahit bneng ? une U Ujuh , ïa uba la shim ino shwa banyngkong na phi , un wan pud ha kajuh ka rukom ba phi la ïohi ba u kew sha bneng .
translation.en: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .
I speak not by commandment , but by occasion of the forwardness of others , and to prove the sincerity of your love .
translation.kha: Ngam buh ïa kino kino ki aiñ . Hynrei da kaba pyn-i kumno kiwei ki kloi ban ïarap , nga pyrshang ban wad katno ka jingieit jong phi hi ka long kaba shisha .
Hynrei paila um pynleit jingmut ïa kane , phi wat salia ïa u .
translation.en: But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .
And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki kynhun langbrot ha ki shyngoid dih um jong ki . U buh ïa ki hangta , namar ki langbrot ki ju ïa-pakor haba ki wan dih um .

translation.en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u la ïohi ïa u briew ïa uba la kha matlah .
Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Nalor “kata , ngan ai ruh ha me pung ka spah , ka jingkynshew , bad ka nam ban ïa une uno u syiem uba la ju ïoh mynshuwa dawai un ïoh biang pat .
translation.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor baroh u ong , Nga la jingïohknieh ba ki Briew jong ka Moab bad Ammon ki krenbeiñ badno ki pynsalia ïa ki briew jong la , badno ki kren khraw ba kin kurup ïa ka ri jongnga ki .
translation.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the revilings of the children of Ammon , whereby they have reproached my people , and magnified themselves against their border .
And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee , and peace be to thine house , and peace be unto all that thou hast .
translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ha u Nabal :  U Dabid u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , ko paralok jong nga , lem bad ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi bad ïa baroh kiba dei ki jong phi .
Ki khun shynrang jong u Shaul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba kham rit ka Mahalalel .
translation.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :

translation.kha: Ïa ki Eri yn pynjot noh bad ki duwan jingpyniwbih kin pra . Baroh ki briew kiba hangtai kin shah pynïap ha khmied ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .
And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there  ; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , nga la ïohi ruh ba ha kane ka pyrthei phi shem ka jingbymman ha ka jaka kaba ka jinglehhok bad ka hok ki dei ban don .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la sdang artat ban pynïoh pat ïa ka burom jong ka Israel , kumba ka la long ha khmat ki nongshun kiba la lute ïa ka . )
Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyndat ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jrong nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton — ki la kham jied ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .
That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .
translation.kha: Hato me la pan na U Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong me , bad hato me la kohnguh ban ym leh pop shuh ?

translation.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka pukri kaba don shabar jong ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la janmiet bha , ka por ha kaba ki kynthei ki ju wan tong um .
Ka jingmut kaba la pynshai bha ka long kum ka dur oh-shrong ksiar ba la pyndait ha ka rupa .
translation.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba haba phi pyndem ïa lade kum ki mraw ban kohnguh ïawan ïano , ha ka jingshisha , phi long ki mraw jong u kynrad uba phi kohnguh — lada ka long ka nongpop , Kaba ka jingmong ka long ka jingïaiban , lane ka jingkohnguh , kaba ka jingmih ka long ka jingïashoh bad U Blei .
translation.en: Know ye not , that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey , his servants ye are to whom ye obey ; whether of sin unto death , or of obedience unto righteousness ?

translation.kha: Da ka jingpynshohbieit , ïa ngi la btep bad u , bad im’ ïadon bniat bad ka jingïap jong u , khnang ba , kumba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïalap da ka bor jong ka burom U Kpa , kumta ruh ma me , ngi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .
translation.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .

translation.kha: Pynthikna , te , ba ka jingshai hapoh jngai phi kam dei ka jingdum .
translation.en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .

translation.kha: Myntan U Trai u kren ha phi pyndeng ka ding ha u Lum Sinai , phim shym la ïohi ïa kano kano ka dur .
translation.en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves  ; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the  Lord  spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire :

translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , lashai Dang step baroh’ na phi kaba la hynne ïa u Saul bad kiba la wan sha at ki dei ban ktieh dang step malu mih mar shu kynjat shai .
translation.en: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .

translation.kha: Ngin la jyllop , Lada ang ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha , pien sa pynïap ïa nga , bad lada nga ai jingat ïa phi , phin ym shah siat .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .
translation.kha: dei ban wanrah lai kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ar litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad ar litar ka waiñ .

Ka la long ka sngaid kaba shiphew jong ka snoh thlim , kaba long ka snem kaba arphew sai hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khaweh snem hadien ba la jop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U Trai , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .
translation.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten , in the selfsame day the hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and brought me thither .

translation.kha: Mynta , ïeng beit hangto , dara hangne ha khmat U Trai ngan mut pyrshah ïa phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang ki kam ibha khraw ba U Trai u la leh ban pyllait ïa Phin bad ïa ki kput tymmen lad pa’ .
translation.en: Now therefore stand still , that I may reason with you before the  Lord  of all the righteous acts of the  Lord  , which he did to you and to your fathers .
Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was gathered together as one man , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , with the land of Gilead , unto the  Lord  in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel naduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei haduh Beersheba kaba shaphang shathie , kumjuh ruh naduh ri Gilead kaba shaphang mihngi , ki la ïawanlang . Ki ïalumlang kum kawei ka kynhun ha khmat U  Trai  ha Mispah .

U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki shun kut jingmut ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel , ba kamet kmen sha pynriam sha ka jingpynjot thiaw pynlang ba baher kin shah pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka long kaba U Trai u la suda ïa u Moses .
translation.en: For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
Behold , I have told you before .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane ha shuwa ba ka por kan poi .

Ma nga , U Trai , ngan kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kob nga ong yn pyndep . Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ha ka por ka jong phi hi , ko ki nongïoh ïaleh pyrshah , kan kun ïa kaei kaba nga la maham ïa phi ba kun kun . NGA la kren , nguh U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Trai um shah ïa ki briew kiba bha ban shahthngan , hynrei u khang ïa ki pyrman ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki khiew .
translation.en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .
Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei kaba phi ong .
Ka million kaba nyngkong ka la don ki rukom pynïaid ïa ka jingmane Blei bad kumjuh ruh ka jaka ba la shna da u briew ban mane .
translation.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service , and a worldly sanctuary .

translation.kha: Ïa u Timotheus u paralok jong nga , wat la u dei u Grik , ym shym la pynbor ïa u ban nujor ,
translation.en: But neither Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised :

translation.kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingtieng baibam da u purew ba la khleh bad ka jingman Olib : lai kyllum u purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , sa ar kilo u purew lem bad u lanot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,

translation.kha: U syiem u law ïa la ka sati ba pyndonburom ha kaba shon mutdur ban pynkupbor ïa ki jingpynbna , bad ai ïa ka ha u nongsynran jong ka jaitbynriew Jiw , u Haran u khun jong u Hamutal , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .
translation.en: And the king took his ring from his hand , and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews  enemy .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah pule ïa ka , ki la ïaphai imat shai uwei pud ha ka jingsngew sheptieng , nabar ki la ïai-ong ha u Barukh , Ngi dei ban ïaheh ïa kane ha u syiem .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard all the words , they were afraid both one and other , and said unto Baruch , We will surely tell the king of all these words .

translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki khie lung kum ki ñiut ha ka sngi , kumin ki ñiuhmat kiba sawkyr-ang kylleng ka kper .
translation.en: He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .

translation.kha: Kumne u Joab u leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u , Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? U Abner u la wan shiah phin — balei phi shah ba un shu leit kumto ?
translation.en: Then Joab came to the king , and said , What hast thou done ? behold , Abner came unto thee  ; why is it that thou hast sent him away , and he is quite gone ?
But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me to da sumar adkar ïa lade ha ki jingjia baroh ; to ïaishah shitom , trei ïa ka kam u nongïalap jong ka Khubor Babha , bad to pyndep ïa la ka kam baroh kum u shakri jong U Blei .

translation.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .
translation.kha: U weng noh na ka kam ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ki syiem Judah ki la pynkyntang ban ai jingkñia halor ki duwan ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baroh ki lyngdoh kiba ai jingkñia sha u Baal , sha ka sngi , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .
Ha ka sngem kaba lai , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da sheng bad ki nongpynkhiah jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ïa ki dara kyllut jingkylli .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .
And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .
translation.kha: bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkha u nongthaw khiew , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .
translation.kha: Nangta u la leit sha ka khyrdop kaba phai sha mihngi . U la kiew ïa ki mawkyrdon , bad ha kliar u la thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la long lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .
Wat wan sha jan , ong U Blei . Loit ino ïa la ki juti , namar me ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khuid .
translation.en: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .

translation.kha: wahbah U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingisynei ïa ka , bad u la ong ha ka , Wat ïatim .
translation.en: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her ,  Weep not .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kyrkhu ïa u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh bad u la ai ha u ïa ka nongbet Hebron kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: And Joshua blessed him , and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor longsem U Trai Jong me ; ïa ka jingstad jong u ym lah ban taïew .
translation.en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga hukum ïa ka sahit bneng ba kane khih da ka jingingiew , Ban un-long kaba iphylla bad kaba i lyngngoh ,
translation.en: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .
And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta u la thaw ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .
Haba ar la wan sha ka pukri mynta ka sngi , nga la duwai , ‘ A Trai , U Bel jong u kynrad jongu nga u Abraham , sngewbha ai ka jingjop ha nga ha kaei ba nga leh .
translation.en: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :

translation.kha: namar phi ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim ïa ki mynsiem jong pa , kaba long ka jingrem jong ka jingngeit jong phin ha U .
translation.en: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .
translation.kha: Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lynthem maw ïa pha , bad kin ot lyngkhot ïa pha da ki waitlam jong ki .

translation.en: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,

translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ban leh ïa khie kaei baroh kaba ma me da ka bor bad ka manna jong me , me la lah tduh ba kun jia .
translation.en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .

translation.kha: Hamar ba mih ka sngi , u Lot u la poi ha Soar .
translation.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar .

translation.kha: Ha ka paw kaba bud , haba nga la khie thiah bad sa ban ai buiñ ïa la u khun , nga ïohi ba u la ïap . Nga la khmih bniah hajan bad nga shem pynïap ba um daym u khun jong nga .
translation.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck , behold , it was dead : but when I had considered it in the morning , behold , it was not my son , which I did bear .

translation.kha: Hato mem sngewthuh ba katba u Nadab u dang im , lano lano man ym ïoh un-long u syiem jong kane ka ri ? Mynba hi to khie leit bad wanlam ïa u shane — u dei ban ïap !
translation.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground , thou shalt not be established , nor thy kingdom . Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me , for he shall surely die .
And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?
translation.kha: Ngim lah ban shem u briew uba kham bit ban ïa u Joseph , u briew uba don U Mynsiem U Blei .

translation.en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .
translation.kha: Te , kumba u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kata ka sngi ban mane ïa U  Trai  , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .

translation.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .

thaba U ijuh u la wan phai shiah kawei pat ka jar jong ka duriaw , ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar baroh’ ki la ïa-ap ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .

translation.en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .

Ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong , U Tharai u la ai ruh ha la ïa une u khun , namar u la ïohsngew ba ngam shym long kaba la ieit ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Simeon .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Because the  Lord  hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also : and she called his name Simeon .

translation.kha: U Bela u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaba kjit noh ïa u slap kiba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmeh ïa ki jingthung kiba ai jingmyntoi na ka beit kita kiba rep ha ka .
translation.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :

translation.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Ki biria ki kylli , Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U Trai um patiaw ? Balah ngi daiñ ba-bang leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ? U Trai u ong ïa ki , Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi jingkhangïit , phi ïabeh ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi bad banbeiñ ïa la ki nongtrei .
translation.en: Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .

u rung Shobab ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong , Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u shym .
translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .

translation.kha: to un pynlong ïa ngi kiba kohnguh ïa u ba ngin lah ban im borabor kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , bad ban samla ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .

translation.en: And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan phah ïa ki saw tylli ki jingpynshitom basniew tam jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .

translation.en: But ye are a chosen generation , a royal priesthood , an holy nation , a peculiar people  ; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light :

translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said ,  Take this , and divide it among yourselves :

translation.en: How can you be a good husband , wife , or parent ?

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .

translation.en: ( The  Lord  God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you , as he hath promised you ! )

translation.en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country , and among his own kin , and in his own house .

translation.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance .

translation.en: As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .

translation.en: Also regard not your stuff  ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .

translation.en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah : and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day , and made them an ordinance in Israel : and , behold , they are written in the lamentations .

translation.en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .

translation.kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien ïathuhlypa kiba hapoh kane ka kitab !

translation.en: After this opened Job his mouth , and cursed his day .
Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .
translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban aiti ïa la ka jingim , khnang ba nga lah ban ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling  ; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .

Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
translation.kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u briew uba ot ki dei ban trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kyrmen ban ïoh bynta na u jingthung .

translation.en: That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :

translation.en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .
For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .

translation.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth , neither whatsoever worketh abomination , or maketh a lie : but they which are written in the Lamb s book of life .

translation.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people  ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon s porch .

translation.kha: Hapdeng kiba tlot ha ka jingngeit nga long uba throsh kum uwei na ki , khnang ban jop ïa ki . Kuth de don ka jingieid ha borbah ïa ki briew baroh , khnang ba nga lah ban pyllait katto katne na ki da ki lad baroh kiba don .
translation.en: To the weak became I as weak , that I might gain the weak : I am made all things to all men , that I might by all means save some .
I beheld the mountains , and , lo , they trembled , and all the hills moved lightly .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ki lumbah — ki la khynñiuh , bad ki lumrit ki khih shadien bad sha khmat .
Haba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynñiew , ka la don ka jingsngap pan ha bneng kumba shiteng kynta .
translation.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .

translation.kha: Katba ki im thliew lyngngoh ïa ki mawsiang , Ki shen ïa ki ikordor .
translation.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks  ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .

translation.kha: Ka la long la kham janmiet jongngi ka Sngi U Trai , bad ki synran ki la ïalumlang hapoh ka klass kaba la khang skhem , namar ba ki la pyrkhing ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Nangta U Jisu u la wan malade u la sheng hapdeng jong ki . To ka jingsuk kan longsyiem lem bad phiah , u la ong .
translation.en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki kynther ki la anna hangta , ki khmih na jngai . Napdeng jong ki , long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Ma ka kmiesan jong u Jubab ba kham raïot bad u Josis , dara ka Salome .
translation.en: There were also women looking on afar off : among whom was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses , and Salome  ;

translation.kha: Phira dat shun sngewrem .
translation.en: You must keep quiet .
What ? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you , which ye have of God , and ye are not your own ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ka met jong phi ka long ka jaka shong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba shong hapoh jong phi bad ïa uba la ai ha phi da U Blei ?

Ym don uba haka ban phrung Khubor shapoh ka ïing jong u briew kiba khlei bad kit noh ïa ki jingïadon jingïam jong u lymda nyngkong eh u teh u khum shaw ïa u brisoh kiba khlaiñ , nangta u sa lah ban lumrit ïa ka ïing Jong u .
translation.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh na Babilonia ! Iehnoh ïa ka ri ! Long kiba nyngkong ban iehnoh ïa ka !
translation.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans , and be as the he goats before the flocks .
And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka burom kaba me la ai ha nga , khnang ba kin long kawei , kumba ma me bad nga ngi long kawei .

Ha kaba khatduh , ka Herodias ka la ïoh ïa ka kabu jong ka . Ka dei ha ka sngi khap jong u Herod , mynba la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta barhem ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan ha ka jingsynran jongki u , ki Rangbah shipai , bad ki nongshong sneng bapawkhmat jong ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee  ;

translation.kha: Kane ka jingrakhe ka long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka shyllangmat jyllang ngi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa ngi ba U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .’
translation.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalap kiba stad kin tyngeh da ka jingphyrnai barieh jong ka sngewbiang . badno kito kaba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew ba-bang leh ïa kaei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .
translation.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
I have digged , and drunk water  ; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places .
translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih ïa ki pukri bad dih um ha ki ri nongwei , bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïuh ha ka wah Nile ba-rkhiang .
bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym kitei na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .
translation.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .
translation.kha: Bad ka bor U  Trai  ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don hapdeng Sorah bad Eshtaol ha ka jaka sher dara jong ki Dan .
Bad lada nga dang im , sngewbha bat ïa la ka kutlad bakyntang bad ïaineh skhem bad nga ; hynrei lada jia ba nga ïahap ,
translation.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the  Lord  , that I die not :

translation.kha: Kiba da shisha ma sa , U TRAI’ nongsharai , nga long U Blei uba im , to kham ïa phi ba ha ka jingbet jong nga Ngan synshar halor jong phi da ka ksang ti kaba khlieh , da ka bor jong ar Baroh .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :

Thy terribleness hath deceived thee , and the pride of thine heart , O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , that holdest the height of the hill : though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle , I will bring thee down from thence , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ym don ba sheptieng ïa pha katta kumba pha pyrkhat ba ki long kumta . Pha shong ha ki synrang maw , ha kliar ki lumbah ; hynrei wat la pha shong hajrong tam kum u pukni , U  Trai  un wallam ïa pha sha tbian . U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: He among the sons of Aaron , that offereth the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right shoulder for his part .
translation.kha: ha u lyngdoh uba kñia ïa ka snam bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
translation.kha: Ki la lynñiar , ki da khaweh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la ïohi ar ngut ki Israel kiba dang ïashoh , bad u la pyrshang ban pynïasuk ïa ki u da ïai-ong , ‘ Shahshkor , ko rangbah ,’ u la ong , ‘ phi ïalong para Israel ; balei ba phi ïashoh Kum ?’
translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpop ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew katba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki Ban leh .
translation.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .

translation.kha: kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U Tharai U blem jong phi uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ha kaweh ph la long ki mraw .
translation.en: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la bteng , shukor ïa kaei kaba uta u nongbishar bamsap u la ainong .
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki pop jong Phi ki la bat noh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .
translation.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .
I will do these things unto thee , because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen , and because thou art polluted with their idols .
translation.kha: Pha la long ka nuti ïa ki jaitbynriew bad pynjakhlia ïa lade bad ki bleithaw .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , Don mano mano ba la ktah ïa nga , ibha nga tip ïa ka mynsaw ka har ka la mynhynne na nga .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .

translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u ong , nga dei ban pynim ïa ka jingsliang paralok bakynsha ïa u Hanun , kam u kpa jong u , u Naarah u la leh ïa nga . Kumta u Dabid u phah ki nonglamktien ba-bang pynsep ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . Hobah ki la poi ha Amon bad ïakynduh ïa u syiem Hanun ,
translation.en: And David said , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father shewed kindness to me . And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun , to comfort him .
Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor haba nga mai tyngeh ïa phi ; ngan ai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad ngan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga bad phi .

translation.en: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem bad ki khun jong ki , bad ki nguh ;

Ngim ju twa ki ïing ki sem ban shong ban sah — sem shongneh ha ki ïingjah — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkhuit , lane u kew . Ngi la Kohnguh tylli ïa baroh kiei kai kiba u khop tmier jong ngi u Jonadab u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .
And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba la ju leit kiew sha bneng lait tang U Khun U Briew , uba la wan hiar na bneng .
U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul , u la kem ïa u , bad u la hukum ban teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri . Nalorkata u la kylli , Uei i u briew , bad u la leh aïu ?
translation.en: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .

translation.kha: U Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa U Jisu ban ïabam miet nabar u , bad U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u sad u la shong ban bam .
translation.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him . And he went into the Pharisee s house , and sat down to meat .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga un-long uta uba pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im jongu , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?
translation.en: I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Balei ba ngim shym la leh ei ei ban ïohknieh pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Syria ? Ka dei ka jong ngi !

translation.en: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him  ; ) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la lah bud ïa U Jisu mynba u don ha Galilaïa bad ïarap ïa u . Bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la wan sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u ki la ïadon ruh hangta .

translation.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
translation.kha: Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki ksew — kin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa phi . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki sniang — kin shu ïuh pynban ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .
