U Mikah u Jobab , Phi mut aïu , ‘ kaei kaba la jliah ?’ Phi la shim ïa u lyngdoh bad ki bleithaw ba nga la thaw , bad ph shu phet ! Kaei kaba sah malu nga ?
translation.en: And he said , Ye have taken away my gods which I made , and the priest , and ye are gone away : and what have I more ? and what is this that ye say unto me , What aileth thee ?

And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
translation.kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , u la ong ha ki ,  Ko para Israel , balei phi ïakyndit ha kane , bad balei ba phi peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei da ka bor jong ngi hi lane da ka jingriewblei jong ngi hi ba ngi la pynlong ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?

Katba nga dang ïadie lyngba biang , nga la ïohi ba ka por ka la poi ïa phar ban shoh jingtied . Nga la tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit jong pha da ka jaiñ jynsur Jong la Bad nga la kular ban ieit ïa Phah . Ho-oid nga la pynlong ka jutang shongksuid bad pha , bad pha erlangthari ka jong nga . Kane ka dien kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong .
translation.en: Now when I passed by thee , and looked upon thee , behold , thy time was the time of love  ; and I spread my skirt over thee , and covered thy nakedness : yea , I sware unto thee , and entered into a covenant with thee , saith the Lord  God  , and thou becamest mine .
So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .
translation.kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shim ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha u rangbah ai hukum , bad u la ong ,  U Paul , u koidi , u la khot ïa nga bad kyrpad ïa nga ban wallam ïa une u samla sha me , namar ba u don ei ei ban ong ha me .
Phi la ïadon malade nga ha baroh ki jingshah tyngkhuh jong nga ;
translation.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .

translation.kha: Nangta un tah snar khyndiat ha ki reng babha don ha ki dong jong ka iba ka jingiwbih thang kaba Hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . U dei ban theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh Thang kiba ne ha khmat jingkhah jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the  Lord  , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: haduh ha kaba khatduh U Trai u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jrong u , kumba u la maham lyngka ki shakri jong u ki nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . Te ki paid Israel ki la shah pynryngkang par shata Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangamei .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .
Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingjynjar bad jingpynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymhok .

translation.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty , thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness : I will cast thee to the ground , I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .
translation.kha: Me la sngewsarong ba me long uba bhabriew , bad ka nam jong me ka la pynlong ïa me ban leh kum u bieit . Namar kane nga la bret ïa me sha khyndew bad ieh ïa me kum ka jingmaham ïa kiwei pat ki syiem .
Hadien ba u la lah ino ïa kane , u la pyrta da ka sur kambah jam , Ko lawar , to mihnoh !
translation.en: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .
And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew sha u lum bad hangta u la shong bad la ki synran .
Bun ngam shym ïa-ong ïa kane namar ba de la shah lai klet , naba nga la nang ban sngewhun ha kaei kaba nga don .
translation.en: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingjam bad ka um phi lah ban thab na ki .’
translation.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .
And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her  ; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Hangne ka don ka mraw jong nga ka Bilhah ; thiah bad ka , ba kumta kan ïoh khun na ka bynta jong nga . Da kane ka rukom ngan ïoh long kmie lyngba jong ka .
(Khlem artylli ka don ka jingïapait hapdeng jongngi phi khring ba yn ithuh shai ïa kita kiba leh ïa kaba dem .)
translation.en: For there must be also heresies among you , that they which are approved may be made manifest among you .

translation.kha: Kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingsah ki jingjam jong ki khwai , ki jingriew jong ki kali ïapom , ki jingtyllun jong ki shaw . Ki kpa Kin phai pat na ka pynbha la ki khun ; ki kti jong ki kin noh kyrwep .
translation.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses , at the rushing of his chariots , and at the rumbling of his wheels , the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands  ;

translation.kha: kumta haba la bna ïa kata ka pop! , u paidlang un wanlam ïa u masi lyngraw Kum ka jingainguh namar ka bapop . Kin wanrah sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdeng Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: When the sin , which they have sinned against it , is known , then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin , and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban synshar ïa ka jingbitar jong phi , pien long khlem ka jingïarap kum ka nongpang bym ne kynroh , kaba lait rynghang shun Shah tur ïaleh .
translation.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the  Lord  said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad u Moses ki la long kita ha kiba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ïalam noh ïa ki jait Israel na Ijipt .
A Trai uba U Blei , uba long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh , nga kyrpad ïa me to thung ïa u briew uba haka ban ïalam ïa u paidlang ,
translation.en: Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,

translation.kha: kaei kaba ka Hukum kam lah Ban leh , namar ka jingong ba kynja doh ka long kaba tlot , U Blei u la leh . U la pynrem ïa ka pop ha ka jingjrong ba kynja doh da kaba u la Pha ïa U Khun jong u hi , uba la Wan kum ka jinglong u briew uba pop , ban jop ïa ka pop .
translation.en: For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :

translation.kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah ngon , ngam ïaroh ïa phi , namar ki jingïaseng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ïa-ban ïa kaba pynbha .
translation.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .
And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates : and they feared , when they heard that they were Romans .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien ha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul bad u Silas ki dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom , ki la sheptieng .
Na u Paul , u apostol jong U Kynther Jisu kat kum ka hukum U Blei u Nongpynim jong ngi sad U khriat Jisu uba long ka jingkyrmen jongno ngi —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour , and Lord Jesus Christ , which is our hope ;

translation.kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri Ka Jingsmai . Dei kumta ba ka Shong Beersheba ka la ïoh ïa la ka kyrteng .
translation.en: And he called it Shebah : therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day .

translation.kha: Nangta u Simon u duwai : Me , A Trai , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bnai , pynban me la jied ban shongkha ha ki lyoh nabar ka jingdum .
translation.en: Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .

But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u tnga jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U  Trai  un map ïa ka .

translation.en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .
translation.kha: Ha man ba phi rung ha kano kano ka ïing , to ong nyngkong , ‘ Ka jingsuk kan long ha kane ka ïing .’

hangtei u pynbynta kynhun kynhun ïa la ki briew , u tur pyrshah ïa ki nongshun mynmiet , bad u jrop ïa ki . U beh ruh ïa ki haduh Hobah , kaba shaphang shatei jongngi ka Damaskos , bad u la ïohi pat ruh ïa kat kaba ki la lute .
translation.en: And he divided himself against them , he and his servants , by night , and smote them , and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad por la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .
translation.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .

translation.kha: Kumne u Ahab u phah khot ïa ki Isaia bhor bad ïa ki nongïalap jong u Baal ban ïakynduh lang ha u Lum Karmel .
translation.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel , and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi kumno ki im , hynrei kan pynkhiah patiaw ïa ki . Ngan ïalam ïa ki bad ïarap ïa ki , bad ngan pyntngen ïa kito kiba ïam sngewsih .
translation.en: I have seen his ways , and will heal him : I will lead him also , and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners .

If , when evil cometh upon us , as the sword , judgment , or pestilence , or famine , we stand before this house , and in thy presence , ( for thy name is in this house , ) and cry unto thee in our affliction , then thou wilt hear and help .
translation.kha: ba lada kano kano ka jingjia bashyrkhei kan ktah ban pynshitom ïa ki — ka thma , ka jingïapthem , lane ka  nemsniew — te ki lah ban wan bad ïeng ha khmat kane ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa me . Ki lah ban duwai ha me ha ka jingshitom jong ki bad ba men sngew bad pyllait ïa ki .
Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka por jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kambah ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki lei jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .

translation.kha: Un ri satar ïa me na ki jingma barieh baroh bad na ki jingpang bashyrkhei bhor .
translation.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .

translation.kha: Nga la kyrkhoit ïa ka rukom im jong nga , bad nga kular ban bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: I thought on my ways , and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .
And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east : and his voice was like a noise of many waters : and the earth shined with his glory .
translation.kha: bad hangta nga la ïohi ba wan na shaphang mihngi ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon U Blei ki Israel . Ka sur jong U Blei ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , bad ka pyrthei ka phyrnai da ka jingshai ba-thaba .
To pynim ïa ngi , A Trai , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop , A Trai !
translation.en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .

translation.kha: Bad ha kane ka rukom phin leh pop pyrshah ïa U Khereth keiñ da kaba leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki parabangeit bad pynmong ïa ka jingïalang batlot jong ki .
translation.en: But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .
And it came to pass , as they journeyed from the east , that they found a plain in the land of Shinar  ; and they dwelt there .
translation.kha: Te ynda ki briew ki la ïaid kylleng ha ka phang mihngi , ki la poi sha ka pyntha ha Babilonia bad ki la ïashong sah hangta .

translation.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
translation.kha: U syiem Serksis u la pynlong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki rud duriaw jong ka hima jong u kumjuh ruh ïa kito ki briew kiba shong shapoh .

Mar ïaroi ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , ka kynhun rupa ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap u longïing u khun nongtong jong ka briew kaba long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka Shong u la ïadon lem bad ka .
translation.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .

translation.kha: U Blei u Joab , Ngan long lem bad me , bad haba me ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lam . Kata kad longsyiem ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phah ïa me .
translation.en: And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,
translation.kha: U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba kylluid ha ka khyrdop ka nongbah .

U kyntiew ïa kiba tuh na ka dewmet , bad u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki . U Pynlong ïa ki , ki phalang jong ki kynhun syiem , bad buh ïa ki , ha ki jaka badonburom . Ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki dei ki jong U Troas ; bad ha ki u la pynshong ïa ka pyrta .
translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill , to set them among princes , and to make them inherit the throne of glory : for the pillars of the earth are the  Lord s  , and he hath set the world upon them .

translation.kha: Ibbah nga daiñ khmih , na Dang lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka reng barben ba ka krong sarong eh malu kob . Kat nga dang ap kham , la pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw uba saw , bad ïa ka met jong u la bret shata ki thylliej ding bad ka pynpait .
translation.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .

translation.kha: Ngi lah don ong ba namar jong sakma ka burom kaba kham khraw mynta , kata ka burom kaba la tyngshaiñ bha ha ka por ba la leit , ka la jah noh .
translation.en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect , by reason of the glory that excelleth .

translation.kha: La don u briew ha Asaraïah uba kyrteng u Kornelios , naba long u rangbah shipai ha ka kynhun shipai ka Hima Rom ba la khot Ka Kynhun shipai Italian .
translation.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin . Ki Israel ki pynïap arphew san hajar shispah ngut ki shipai Benjamin ha said ka sngi ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote Benjamin before Israel : and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men : all these drew the sword .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Peris u la ong , Da lei law ruh em , ko Trai ! ngam pat ju ïam mynno mynno ïa kadei kaei ka bymjukut lane kaweh sang kat khim ka jinglehkmen .
translation.en: But Peter said , Not so , Lord  ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Ahab u syiem ka Jeraïah , u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah ,
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .
For Moses truly said unto the fathers , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you .
translation.kha: Naba U Moses u la ong , ‘ U Trai uba U Blei jong phi un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uwei na ki briew jong phi hi . Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u ong ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance  ; and I will fill their treasures .
translation.kha: nga pynriewspah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , da kaba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ki jingkynshew .

‘ U para jong me u la wan phai pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , ‘ bad u kba jong me u la phah pynnep ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha , namar u la ïoh pah ïa u ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingkoit jingkhih .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .

translation.kha: Na ka tare jong ka Massah ba shat Pynjngai , la ai ar tukri ki nongbah : ka Taanakh bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pynsat phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with her suburbs , and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; two cities .

translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki briew ka Phoenisia ! Pyrshang ban phet ïalap sha Spain !
translation.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish  ; howl , ye inhabitants of the isle .
Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid long ma u !

translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Who touched me ?  When all denied , Peter and they that were with him said , Master , the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli ,  Mano ba ktah ïa nga ?  Uwei pa uwei u len ïa ka , bad u Petros u ong ,  Ko kynrad , ki briew ki don sawdong jong me bad ki ïalum ha me .

translation.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion , and as a young lion to the house of Judah : I , even I , will tear and go away  ; I will take away , and none shall rescue him .
translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel bad Judah kum u sing . Ma nga hi da lade ngan patar lyngkhot ïa ki , bad nangta ngan iehnoh ïa ki . Haba nga patan tyngeh ïa ki , yn ym don uba lah ban pyllait ïa ki .
Hynrei u angel u la ong ha u , Wat sheptieng , ko Sherebaïah ! U Blei u la Shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad ka Elishah ka tnga jong me kane kha u khun ïa me . Men kyrteng ïa u , u Ïoannis .
translation.en: But the angel said unto him , Fear not , Zacharias : for thy prayer is heard  ; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son , and thou shalt call his name John .

translation.kha: hynne u kyntait , malade kum u ong ïa u , Nimrim ba kitab smam kthong ïa ka Law U Trai , u sing un sa pynïap ïa phi tang mar Shuah ïakhlad bun nga . Tang mar shu ïam , u Sing u wan bad pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .

translation.kha: bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar thoin u kew bad saw lakh litar ka nongpynim Olib man ka snem don bsa ïa ki rangbah jongno u .
translation.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .

translation.kha: Tang ma me bad ki Kynhun shynrang jong me ki Dei ban pyndep ïa ki jingkyiuh na ka beit ka jaka jyntang bun ka duwan , khnang ba ngan ym khie bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Me la longkmie u nongshong basa ha ka ïing jong ki Jentil kiba khlem otsher , bad me da ïabam lem malu ki !
translation.en: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .

translation.kha: Shim ïa u diengthew uba don ha khmat ka Synduk ka jutang , bad nangta ma me bad u Aaron men lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh . Hangta ha Khmut jongnga ki baroh kren ha utai u mawkyntang , bad ka um kan mihnoh na u . Ha kane ka stang bathoiñ pynmih um na uta u mawsiang na ka bynshet jong u Baïap , khñiang ba ma ki lem bad ki jingrai jong ki kin ïoh dih .
translation.en: Take the rod , and gather thou the assembly together , thou , and Aaron thy brother , and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes  ; and it shall give forth his water , and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock : so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink .
For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .
translation.kha: Namar kane balei bun na phi , phi pang bad phi swai , bad bun bah ki la ïap .
Wat pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei lynti ki kynruh , bad wat shim ïa ka kjap jong ka riewkhlaw kumto ka bynda ïa kano kano ka ram .
translation.en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :

translation.kha: Hynrei waiñ la ka jinglong ka met jong nga ka la long ka jingtynjuh bakhraw ïa phi , phim shym la ibit ne kyntait ïa nga . Pynban phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa u ebanjelist na bteng ; phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi jingpdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu hi .
translation.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Wat phong ïa ka jait ba la thain lang da u saiwul bad u sai linen .
translation.en: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts , as of woollen and linen together .
The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .
translation.kha: Ka lawar ding ka klang rhem bha , hynrei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid noh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki briew jong nga , namar ïa kito kiba sniew ym shym la weng noh .
Kat uba dang sah na ki khun ki ksiew jong me un leit ha tur u lyngdoh bad pang na u ïa ka pisa bad ka jingbam , badno kyrthep ïa u ban shah ba un ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh khring ba un ïoh ei ei ban bam .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .

translation.kha: Kumta u ong ha ki , Ngan sa wanrah pat ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ , bad haba nga woh , ngan pyntwa phum ïa une u mot !
translation.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel , saying , When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower .

translation.kha: dalade ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u sad ki kynhun jong u dei ban pyllait patiaw ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan .
translation.en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .

translation.kha: Ïa ki dieng jong u dieng kseh , u diengduh Kseh-Juniper , bad u dieng Sheshbassar , ki dieng kiba kynsai tur jong ka khlaw Lebanon yn khulom ban tei biang ïa pha , ko Jerusalem , baneh pynitynnat ïa ka Templ jong nga , ba pyndonburom ïa ka nongbah jong nga .
translation.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee , the fir tree , the pine tree , and the box together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary  ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .
We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ha ki dieng Jamynrei kiba don hajan ngi la wah ïa la ki duitara .

Ki ong ha kita ki nongleitkurim na Jabesh , Ïathuh ha ki la shang jong phin ba lashai , shuwa shiteng ka sngew , yn sa pyllait im ïa ki . Hobab ki nong Jabesh ki ïohpdiang ïa sier ka khubor , ki sngewkmen shibun ,
translation.en: And they said unto the messengers that came , Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , To morrow , by that time the sun be hot , ye shall have help . And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh  ; and they were glad .

translation.kha: U beiñ uba imat ïa kaei kaei kambah mutlop ha kaba ar sien u long kum u ksew uba leit phai sha la ka prie .
translation.en: As a dog returneth to his vomit , so a fool returneth to his folly .
Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .
translation.kha: Wat lada ki khot ïa nga U Blei jong ki bad ki kam ba ki dei ki briew jong nga bad ba ki tip ïa nga ,

Haba U Trai u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei , ki briew kin rieh ha ki thliew bad ki skum ha ki mawsiang lumrit ban phyrngab ban lait na ka jingbitar jong u bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u .
translation.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .

translation.kha: Ka jingthngan ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .
translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .

translation.kha: Ngan ainong ïa ki da kaba pynslem ïa ka rta jong ki , ngan pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: With long life will I satisfy him , and shew him my salvation .

translation.kha: bad U Terah u Ong , Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u paidbah u ong ha me ; mem long ma me suba ki kyntait , Nga long ma nga ïa uba ki la kyntait koum u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee : for they have not rejected thee , but they have rejected me , that I should not reign over them .

translation.kha: ka Dannah , ka Hahiroth Sepher ( lane ka Debir ) ,
translation.en: And Dannah , and Kirjath–sannah , which is Debir ,
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa u Haman la sdien ha ka diengphasi kaba u la shna na ka bynta u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la long jai jai .
Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh kat kaba me ïohi , malu kan longkmie ka jong me junom .
translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u la Jubab , Lada phi la long kba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei ibha phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang ba-don ha ka jingpynrem .
translation.en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .

translation.kha: Ki lynti ïadei ba ki bud kin long babha btuit bun kiba puta ; ngan pynjrong ïa ki ba kin jynthut bad kin kyllon . Ngan wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki ; ka par ka jingpynshitom ïa ki ka la kada wan , ma nga , U Terah , nga la kren .
translation.en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Te mynta kane ka hir kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , per ong : (Nga ai ïa ka ri ki nongai Joppa shat u syiem Nebukhadnessar . Un lute bad pynjot lut bad rong ei ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Ijipt kum ka bainong ïa ka kynjah shipai jong u .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey  ; and it shall be the wages for his army .

Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams , and go to my servant Job , and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering  ; and my servant Job shall pray for you : for him will I accept : lest I deal with you after your folly , in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right , like my servant Job .
translation.kha: Mynta shim hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang bad leit sha u Job bad ai ïa ki kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ïa lade . U Job un duwai na ka bynta jong me , bad ngan jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad ngan ym pynjahburom ïa me kumba ka dei hok ïa me . Mem shym la kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga kumba u la leh .

translation.en: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad ïathuh ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .
Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Irijah , ka Beth Hoglah , ka Emek Kesis ,
translation.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,

translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi! , to sah ha kajuh ka ïing tad haduh ba phin da mihnoh na katai ka shnong ;
translation.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .
Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :
translation.kha: Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang sepngi .
Nangta phin khot kyrpad ïa sa . phi wan bad duwai ha ar , bad ngan jubab ïa phi .
translation.en: Then shall ye call upon me , and ye shall go and pray unto me , and I will hearken unto you .
Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
translation.kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .

translation.en: And what nation is there so great , that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law , which I set before you this day ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don ki aiñ kiba hok kat kito kiba nga la hikai ïa phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead , which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan , where the Philistines had hanged them , when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa :
translation.kha: u leit shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad jong u Jonathan , u khun jong u na ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead . ( Ki la tuh ïa ki na ka jaka paidbah ha Beth Shan , ha kaba ki Philistia ki la sdien ïa ki met jong ki ha ka sngi ba ki la pynïap ïa u Saul halor u Lum Gilboa . )
Phi la dep bam ja shiteng sngi ?
translation.en: Did you have lunch ?

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong , Nga ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga .
translation.en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .

translation.kha: U Jair u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Kamon .
translation.en: And Jair died , and was buried in Camon .

translation.kha: Ïa ka pipa kaba ka karai da ka jingkhaïi pateng , yn pynkyntang shaei U Trei . Pyndep kan ym buh tang , hynrei kito kiba mane ïa U Trai , kin pyndonkam ïa ka pisa jong ka ban thied jingbam bad ki jaiñ ki nep kiba ki donkam .
translation.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the  Lord  : it shall not be treasured nor laid up  ; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the  Lord  , to eat sufficiently , and for durable clothing .

translation.kha: Da shisha katto katne ngut na ki , ki ïalap ïa U Khrist Naaman ka jingpynïap bad ka jingïakajia , hawei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .
translation.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :

translation.kha: Na ka jaka ba u synshar , u khmih shapoh halor baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthuh .
translation.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .

translation.kha: To kynthup ïa kaei kob la jia la slem Bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , na long U Blei bad ym anna uwei pat kum ma nga .
translation.en: Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,

And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongai jingmut bad ki nongleh myntor la wallam shapoh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ban ïathuh ha nga aïu ka kit jingmut , hynrei kim shym lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .

translation.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth , and , behold , he eateth  ; but he awaketh , and his soul is empty : or as when a thirsty man dreameth , and , behold , he drinketh  ; but he awaketh , and , behold , he is faint , and his soul hath appetite : so shall the multitude of all the nations be , that fight against mount Zion .
translation.kha: Baroh ki hima kiba ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin long kum u briew uba ïap-tyrsaw uba phohsniew ba u bam jingbam bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah hapdeng ka jingthngan , lane kum u briew u ban sa ïap na ka jingsliang uba phohsniew ba u dih um bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah ryngkat bad u pdot ba-tyrkhong .
Kin long kumne ki Angel bad kim lah ban ïap . Ki long ki khun jongki U Blei , ngab ki la mihpat na kabu ïa-ïap .
translation.en: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels  ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .
And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
translation.kha: Ha ka met jong u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .

translation.en: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel .
translation.kha: U khynnah u la nang san bad nang khraw ha ka met bad ka mynsiem . U la shong la sah ha ka ri shyiap tad haduh ka sngi ba u la paw paidbah ha ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him  ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa phi bad ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to ïapynbeit noh ïa ka jingïakajia bad u katba dang don ka por ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Shisien ba phi la don hangta , un aiti ïa phi sha u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi sha u pulit , bad un set ïa phi ha ka ïingbyndi .

translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lyer khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa baroh ki kper bad bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng Dumbur bad ki dieng Olib jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

translation.en: But Benjamin , Joseph s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren  ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .
translation.kha: hynrei u Jakob um shym phah ïa u Benjamin , u para trai jong u Joseph ba un leit lem bad ki , namar u sheptieng ïoh jia ei ei ïa u .
Nga ïew ïa ka jingweng jakhlia ba-pura jyllang ka , ba ka para kaba bud ka long kaba sniew kum kaba ha shuwa .
translation.en: Then I saw that she was defiled , that they took both one way ,
They feared the  Lord  , and served their own gods , after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence .
translation.kha: Kumta ki mane ïa U  Trai  , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa la ki blei kat kum ki rukom jong ki hima na kiba ki wan .
Phi shisha phi la thmu snier ïa ar , hynrei U Blei u la pynphai ïa kata shat Kaba bha , khnang ba bun ki Briew kiba sdang im mynta kin ïoh im namar kaba la jia .
translation.en: But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .

translation.kha: U Blei u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat U Khrist bad u la ai ïa u ha ka Balang kum U Trai uba ha khlieh duh halor kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: And hath put all things under his feet , and gave him to be the head over all things to the church ,

translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la na kham lieh blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong u kim tip shuh kumno yn har .
translation.en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .

translation.kha: Ngan teh ngan khuid ïa me kumta ba manna ym lah ngab phai na kawei ka liang shwa kawei pat , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut .
translation.en: And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .
But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Pharaoh u ïohi ba kita ki jakoid ki la ïap , u la kylla mutlop biang , bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
U Jubab u wan poi bad la ki briew baroh ha Lus , ïa kaba la ïatip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhie kaba ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan sa wan shen !
translation.en: The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .

translation.kha: Balei phi slem ?
translation.en: How come you're late ?

translation.kha: Na kane ka kot ka Jingstad jong U Blei ka la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ha ki ïa ki nongpynkhiah bad ïa ki nonglamktien ; kyang pynïap kato katne lwet na ki bad kin pynshitom beiñ ïa kiwei pat .’
translation.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God , I will send them prophets and apostles , and some of them they shall slay and persecute :
For then will I turn to the people a pure language , that they may all call upon the name of the  Lord  , to serve him with one consent .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan pynkylla ïa ki briew jong ki hima , bad kin duwai tang sha nga bad ym sha kiwei pat ki blei . Ki baroh kin kohnguh ïa nga .
Te da khwai ka jingkñia , u la pynjanai ha la ka rta ïa pli kiba la pynkhuid na ka pop .
translation.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
translation.kha: Bad ïa uno uno u dieng u bym pynmih u soh uba bha la ju khet noh bad bret hapoh ka ding .

kamut ki briew jrong nga ki ïawan paidbah ban sngap aïu me don ban ong , hynrei Kam leh satia ïa kaei kaba me ainong ïa ki ba keiñ leh . Ki ktien ieit ki long ha ki rymmiang shyntur jong ki , hynrei ki ïan bteng ha ki man khwan myntoi jongu ki .
translation.en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh , and they sit before thee as my people , and they hear thy words , but they will not do them : for with their mouth they shew much love , but their heart goeth after their covetousness .

translation.kha: Ladan U Blei u kem ïa me bad u wallam ïa me sha ka jingbitar , ai uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u ?
translation.en: If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him ?

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba lad ka sngi ba la thang lut , kaba la leh nyngkong ha u Lum synrai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities , and against the high towers .
translation.kha: ka sngi kaba dap da ka jingsawa ki turoi thma bad ka jingpyrta-thma jong ki shipai kiba tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ïa ki kut bajrong .

translation.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold  ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
translation.kha: U shna ruh laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit bad ar kilo ka ksiar ka leit ha kawei kawei ka stieh . U phah buh ïa kine ki stieh baroh ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .
Hynrei mynta ba i la ïarep , balei lang jingkheit ? Nga lah mo ban pynim biang ïa i kylliang ? lang sa longing ha kawei ka sngi sha kaba i don , hynne im lah da lei lei ban Wan phai pat sha nga .
translation.en: But now he is dead , wherefore should I fast ? can I bring him back again ? I shall go to him , but he shall not return to me .
Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in , then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .
translation.kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki lai snem kiba la buh da u syiem , u Ashpenas u la ïalam ïa baroh ki samla shynrang sha u Nebukhadnessar .
Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar khah , ki briew kiba bakha ki kmie , hynrei ki briew kiba sngewieit ki sngewsih .
translation.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
As an eagle stirreth up her nest , fluttereth over her young , spreadeth abroad her wings , taketh them , beareth them on her wings :
translation.kha: Kumba ka pukni ka hikai her ïa la ki khun , bad ka pyiar la ki thapniang ban kyrshan ïa ki , kumta ruh U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa ki Israel ba kin ym hap .
Te U Terah u long lem bad u , bad u long uba jop ha kiei ktieh kiba u sa . U ïalaw pyrshah ïa u shtah ka Assyria bad u kyntu ban pyndem ha u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ka proh bad kan jot . U Trai u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .
translation.en: The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .

If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .
translation.kha: U la ong ha lade ,  Kumba kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki briew jong nga ki leit sha Jerusalem bad ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  ha ka templ kaba don hangta , kin pynkynriah ka jingnguh syiem na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kin sa pynïap ïa nga .

U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor : Ngam long u shakri baïaineh jong phi . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , babha wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .
translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jyllang ka nongpang malu ïa ki kynthei Jahlil kiba don ha ki kyrdan kiba halor ha ka jingpli ka sahlang kba la mane ïa U Blei . Ki la sawdong pun pynshitom beiñ byrsha ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas malu ki la beh ïa ki shabar na ka thain jong ki .
translation.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .

translation.kha: U Tahpenes u la jubab , Ko ki hynmen ki para bad ko ki kpa , shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha shuwa ba u kpa tymmen jong i'u u Abraham un leit noh ban shong ha Haran , U Blei ka burom u la mihpaw ha u ha Meshelemaïah bad u la ong ha u ,
translation.en: And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,

translation.kha: baroh ki dei ban ai Kaba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kyrshut ïa ph .
translation.en: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
So your good conduct may draw others to listen to the message you tell them .—Matthew 5 :16  ; 1 Peter 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
translation.kha: Kumta ka akor babha jong phi ka lah ban khring ïa kiwei pat ban shahskhor ïa ka khubor ba phi ïathuh ha ki .—Mathaios 5 :16 ; 1 Petros 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
Ko phyrngab jong nga , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ong ba u don ka jingngeit lada da ki kur jongno u , um pynshisha ïa kata ? Hangto kata ka jingtah kuna pyndam ïa u ?
translation.en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?

translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba phi la sohkhram thiang kyndiah por , U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh , uba la khot ïa phi ban ïoh bynta na ka burom bymjukut jong u ha U Khrist , ma u hi keiñ un pynjanai ïa phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingsngewskhem , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka nongrim kaba skhem bashisha .
translation.en: But the God of all grace , who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after that ye have suffered a while , make you perfect , stablish , strengthen , settle you .

translation.kha: U la buh la ki kti halor jong ki bad nangta u la leit noh .
translation.en: And he laid his hands on them , and departed thence .

translation.kha: Nangta U Petros u la krensih , Khmih , me la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei borbah bad ngi la bud ïa me .
translation.en: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .

translation.kha: Mane la ka Ïing Hima jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehoahas ki pynkdang ïa ka kyr-ang bakhuid jong U Blei .
translation.en: Every Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses bears God’s holy name .

translation.kha: Ono uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; eit uno umbah duh nong ïa la ka jingim un ïew ïa ka .
translation.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .

translation.kha: Naba kiei kaba i kumta ka jingibieit U blang ka long kaba kham stad ban ïa ka jingstad briew , malu kaei kaba i kumba ka long ka jingtohkit U Blei ka long kham khlaiñ banbeiñ ïa ka bol brup .
translation.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .
Six days thou shalt do thy work , and on the seventh day thou shalt rest : that thine ox and thine ass may rest , and the son of thy handmaid , and the stranger , may be refreshed .
translation.kha: Trei hynriew sngi shi taïew , hynrei wat trei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , khnang ba ki mraw jong phi bad ki nongwei kiba trei bad phi , bad wat ki jingri jong phi hi , kin ïoh shongthait .

Hynrei namar ki pop jong ngi ïa u la pynmong , la juti namar ka jingbymman kaba ngi la leh . La pynkhiah ïa ine da ka jingpynshitom katba u la shah , la pynkhiah ïa ngi da ki jingsympat kiba u la ïoh .
translation.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions , he was bruised for our iniquities : the chastisement of our peace was upon him  ; and with his stripes we are healed .
And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano nabar ka kynhun kiba la nud ban ïasoh bad ki , wat la ki paidbah ki la kren ïaroh ïa ki .

translation.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .
translation.kha: U la ïohthiah biang bad u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew . Hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ba ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .

translation.en: And when ye stand praying , forgive , if ye have ought against any : that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi ïeng bad duwai , to map ïa kaei kaei kaba phi lah ban don pyrshah ïano ïano , khnang ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ïa ki jingleh bymdei kiba phi la leh .

translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
translation.kha: Ki nongaplangbrot ki la leit phai pat , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la ïohsngew bad ïohi ; ka la long thik kumba u angel u la ïathuh ha ki .

translation.en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance : I am their inheritance : and ye shall give them no possession in Israel : I am their possession .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki don ka jinglong lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki ïa kaei kaba nga la ai ha Israel ban hiarpateng na kawei ka pateng sha kawei pat . Kin ym don jingdon jingem ha Israel ; nga long tang ma nga uba ki donkam .

translation.en: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel  ;
translation.kha: Pynban , kane ka long kaei kaba u Joel u nongïathuhlypa u la kren shaphang jong ka :

translation.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , of needlework  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad ki jingpanpoh da ka linen bani bad da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ba la pynpur itynnat bha , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

Te u Serubbabel bad u Joshua bun ki briew’ baroh kiba la wang phan na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia , ki la leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jongngi ki u la Ong ïa ki shun leh . Ki la sheptieng malade ki la nongshong ïa u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa , u nonglamktien jongno U Trai .
translation.en: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the voice of the  Lord  their God , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the  Lord  their God had sent him , and the people did fear before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , kumta ruh ki thuh ïa kaweh tam haduh kawei pat ka sngi . Te kam shym la sniew , bad kam shym la phoi ksaiñ .
translation.en: And they laid it up till the morning , as Moses bade : and it did not stink , neither was there any worm therein .
A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .
translation.kha: U sakhi u pyllait im ïa ki briew haba u ong ïa kaba shisha ; haba u ong ïa kaba shukor , u shetkylla ïa ki briew .
Ki nongsynshar jyllang ki Jiw ha Jerusalem ki la phah katto kat ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi sha u Ïingjaiñ , ban kylli ïa u , Me de uei ?
translation.en: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Saul , bad u phah khot ïa u .
U Trai u la phai Sidon bad u la khmih sloit ha u Petros , bad u Petros u la kynmaw ba U Trai u la lah ong ha u , Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ha kane ka miet , trai ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa la .
translation.en: And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi , ïa uba Kine kiei kiei ki kriah , u wan na kawei pat ka jait , bad ym dat uno uno u dkhot na ka jait jong u , uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .

Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen , and ten chariots , and ten thousand footmen  ; for the king of Syria had destroyed them , and had made them like the dust by threshing .
translation.kha: U Jehoahas um don ki shipai kieng atiar kiba dang sah , lait sa tang ki sanphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai , shiphew tylli ki kali ïapom , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat , namar u syiem ka Syria u la pynjot ïa kiwei , da kaba ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa u pui pui .

translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :
translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un ai ka jinghikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki la jyrngam bad khie lung bad u la sdang ban sei ki sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
Ki briew bam-im ki kwah bhor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano shiah .
translation.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .

And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lem bad ïa ki blei jong ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .

Me la krai ïa nga , bad por la shahshkor ïa kamai pa kawei ka kyntien . Nga long u jong me , A Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , bad Kumta ki ktien jong me ki la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da kaba kmen mala ka jingsngewkmen .
translation.en: Thy words were found , and I did eat them  ; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart : for I am called by thy name , O  Lord  God of hosts .
Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang ïa ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingthang iwbih ;
Ong ïa u ban die ha nga katba ka shongdor haba pa’ daiñ ïadon ryngkat , ba ngan jaiñjot ïa ka kum ka jaka tep .
translation.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .

translation.kha: Ym don ba kyrshan ïa nga ibha nga ïasaid da ïa lade” nyngkong eh ha khmat ki ber synshar ; baroh ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Nga duwai ba U Blei un ym thew pyrshah ïa ki !
translation.en: At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei shuh na u . U Eli u ong ,  U long U  Trai  ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbit ïa u .

translation.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .
translation.kha: U Potiphar u la sngewbha eh ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u kum u shakri ïa u shimet hi ; kumta u buh ïa u ban long u nongpeit ïa ka ïing ka sem jong u , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .
Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan tap ïa ka sahkut bneng malu pyndum ïa ki khlur . Ka sngi kan buhrieh sha lyndet ki lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai .
translation.en: And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .
And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter , or concerning the treasures .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingbthah kiba u Dabid u la ai ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïadei bad ki ïing buh tiar bad kiwei kiwei ki kam la bud bniah .
Berakah ki riewkhuid ki ai jingkhublei ïa pa’ .
translation.en: All the saints salute you .

translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba U Trai u ne na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Hear ye the word which the  Lord  speaketh unto you , O house of Israel :
Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban jop ïa ka pyrthei ? Tang u briew uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .
Ki Briew kiba ïaid nongtuh ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu : Ade ! men pynjot ïa ka Templ pynlang tei pat ïa ka haduh sa sngi !
translation.en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,

translation.kha: Ym don u banbeiñ mynjur ïa kata ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh dei ban ïasam kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingot jingbah un ïor bynta mar kjit kum uta uba lytar shuh ka thma .
translation.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .

translation.kha: Me la leh ïa Kaei kaba me la ong ba men leh ha I bad ha ki nongsynshar jong ngi . Me la pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kham jur ban ïa kano kano Kawei pat ka nongap ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: And he hath confirmed his words , which he spake against us , and against our judges that judged us , by bringing upon us a great evil : for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem .
Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong ka long bymjukut .
kumta u Moses u mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , u im ha khmat jong u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïakylli para ma ki kumno ki urlong , Bad nangta ki la leit shad ka ïingjaiñ jong u Moses .
translation.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law , and did obeisance , and kissed him  ; and they asked each other of their welfare  ; and they came into the tent .
And he ran before , and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him : for he was to pass that way .
translation.kha: Kumta u la mareh ha shuwa jong ki paidbah bad u la kiew ïa u dieng Sykomore    ban ïohi ïa U Jisu , uba dei ban ïaid lyngba kata ka lynti .
Phan bam bun theh ha ka miej jngai nga ha ka Hima jongki ar , nabar phin shong halor ki kheit ban synshar hajir ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .
translation.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ka Bneng , bad nangta ang ino ha u katsha , Lada ma me , ko syiem , me don ka jingsngewbha ïa nga bad ai sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , shah ïa nga ba ngan leit sha ka ri Judith , shat ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga , khnang ba nga lah ban tei bapaw ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And I said unto the king , If it please the king , and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight , that thou wouldest send me unto Judah , unto the city of my fathers  sepulchres , that I may build it .

translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la ïap shabar ka nongpang , khnai ban pynkhlad ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .
translation.en: Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki balang la nang pynkhlaiñ ha ka jingngeit bad ki la nang roi ha ka jingbun briew man ka sngi .
?(Nga la ïohi ïa kata , la nong U Ïoannis , bad nga ong ha phi ba une u dei U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .

translation.kha: hynriew U ijuh um shym la shane ïa laiñ ha ki , namar ba u la Tip ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,

translation.kha: Ngin sa long ki briew kiba janai koum u Adam bad ka Im shuwa ba kin leh pep .
translation.en: We will become perfect humans just as Adam and Eve were before they sinned .

translation.kha: Ka um ba shu tuh ka hasem jingim , ka jingbam ba shu tuh ka kham bang .
translation.en: Stolen waters are sweet , and bread eaten in secret is pleasant .
In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsarong , kiba bieit ki kren shaba palat ; ki ktien jong kiba stad ki ïada ïa ki .

translation.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man  ; the Holy One in the midst of thee : and I will not enter into the city .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga ; ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki Israel . Namar nga dei U Blei bad ym u briew . Ma nga , uta Uba Khuid ngan long bad phi . Ngan ym wan sha phi ha ka jingbitar .
Ki don ki bri kiba kyntait ïa ka jingshai ; ktien sngewthuh ïa ka lane ki leit shaei kaba ka ïasam .
translation.en: They are of those that rebel against the light  ; they know not the ways thereof , nor abide in the paths thereof .

translation.kha: Ki jingaiei ki sdang ban poi ha u bnai uba na bad ki ïai kynton ha ki saw bnai ibha bud .
translation.en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps , and finished them in the seventh month .

translation.kha: Khie saw shaei ka shnong hangta ka ha khnam jong phiah ; haba phi rung shapoh , phin shym ïa u kynhun kada kiba la teh ha uba ym pat ju don bashongshit phalor jongngi u . To lwet malu wallam ïa u shaneng .
translation.en: Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .

With my soul have I desired thee in the night  ; yea , with my spirit within me will I seek thee early : for when thy judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness .
translation.kha: Mynmiet nga thrang ïa me da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ; haba me bishar ïa ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka , baroh kin tip kaei ka long ka jingbishar hok .

Kane ka la pynlong ïa U Trai ba bitar , kumta u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa shaei u Amasaïah . U nongïalap u la dawa , Balei ba phi mane ïa ki blei nongwei ki bym lah kdew ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong me ?
translation.en: Wherefore the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Amaziah , and he sent unto him a prophet , which said unto him , Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people , which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand ?

translation.kha: Ka burom jrong u kan kah ïa ka nongap na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka katba shynrang , naba la da na u slap bad ka erïong .
translation.en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .

translation.kha: Ki Jisu ki la kyrshan ïa kane ka jingmudui bad ki la ong ba kane baroh ka long kaba shisha .
translation.en: And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .

translation.kha: Shna kawei ka dabor rnong , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka ruh dei da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hap ka jingïoh bad kata ka dil , malade pyndap um ïa ka .
translation.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .
Why are they late for the meeting ?
translation.kha: Balei ki slem ban wan sha ka jingialang ?
Ko khun jong na , kyrpad jur ïa la ka kmie — dak lada nang dei tnga shuh ïa nga , pynlang ar umdih ngam dei shuh u tnaw jong ka . Kyrpad ïa ka ba kan sangeh ei na kaba klim bad ka jingleh nuti .
translation.en: Plead with your mother , plead : for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband : let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight , and her adulteries from between her breasts  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba long nyngkong mynta kmen sa longïing khadu , bad bun kiba long Khatduh mynta kin sa longsyiem Nyngkong .
translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last first .
And I am this day weak , though anointed king  ; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me : the  Lord  shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness .
translation.kha: Wat la nga long u syiem uba la jied da U Blei , nga sngewtlot mynta ka sngi . Kine ki khun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki long ka jingma ïa nga . To U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa kine ki nongkamsniew kumba ki dei ban ïoh !
Ki bri ki ong ha nga , Hangno kito ki jingbyrngem kiba U Trai u la pynphong pyrshah ïa im’ ? To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !
translation.en: Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki tim ïa uno uno uba setkut ïa u kew , ban ap haba un ktieh dor , hynrei ki ïaroh ïa uno uno umbah sei don die ïa u .
translation.en: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him : but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .

translation.kha: Katto katne nongput ki Arab ki la rupa lute bad pynpei ïa baroh ki khur shynrang jong u Jearim lait noh u Akhsah , wahbah khatduh . Te mynta ki briew ka Jerusalem ki thung ïa u Ahasaïah kum u skhem ba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead : for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest . So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .

translation.kha: Nga long uba lui lui , bad uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jongnga nga ki pynsngewrem , bad barben kaba nga Ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga .
translation.en: If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .

translation.kha: bad ban nam pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha ki lei briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .

Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Nalor kata , ngan ai ruh ha me bun ka spah , ka jingkynshew , bad ka nam ban ïa uno uno u syiem uba la ju ïoh mynshuwa lane un ïoh biang pat .

translation.en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .
translation.kha: Ma nga hi nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! Nga shem sngewbha bad kito kiba sngewrit bad kiba kylla-kaba-mut , kiba sheptieng ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;
translation.kha: Nga ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ jong u briew uba alhia , uba mutlop .

Mynta , ïa kai kaba phi la thoh shang ki bri ki bym pat shongkurim : Ngam don ka hukum na U Trai , ishyrkhei ang ai ïa la ka jingmut kum uwei uba da ka jingisynei U Trai nga longsem uba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , la pdiang sngewbang ïa ki da ka balang , da ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ha kiba ki la ïaheh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la leh lyngngoh jong ki .
translation.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem , they were received of the church , and of the apostles and elders , and they declared all things that God had done with them .
Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst , saying , The  Lord  our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u ïathuh ïa phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor jong ngi , hynrei u Hesekaïah u shukor ïa phi bad un shah ba phin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingsliang .

U nongïalap uba kyrteng u Elijah , uba na Tishbe kaba ha Gilead , u la ong ha u Syiem Ahab , Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , U Blei uba im jong ki Israel , ïa uba nga shakri , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snam kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u slap tat haduh ba nur-um ïa-ong kumta .
translation.en: And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .

translation.kha: Ynda ngi la kam kyndok ïa kata ka ri , nga ai ha ki jait Rephan bad ki jait Gaddah ïa ka iaki kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer hajan ka Wah Arnon bad shithi na ka ri lum Gilead lem badno ki shnong jngai ka .
translation.en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .

translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ba nga ïohi ? U Trai u kylli . Ki phai den ha ka jingïapthngan . Ki shipai jongki ki , ki shah baheh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh stet kat lah katno ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .
translation.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
Render unto them a recompence , O  Lord  , according to the work of their hands .
translation.kha: To pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh , A  Trai  ;
Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aïu kane ka pharshi ka kup jingman ,
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?

translation.kha: Hynrei , A Trai , me long u Kpa jong ngi . Ngi long kum ka dewbyrtha , bad me long kum u nongthaw khiew .
translation.en: But now , O  Lord  , thou art our father  ; we are the clay , and thou our potter  ; and we all are the work of thy hand .
O Israel , return unto the  Lord  thy God  ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .
translation.kha: To wan phai noh sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ko paid Israel . Ka pop jong phi ka la pynlong ïa phi ban jynthut bad kyllon .

U TRAI’ u ong , Ngan pynkhih ka thma ïa-pihuin ha Ijipt badno ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u la bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïakhleh kawei ïa kaweh paw , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun kin ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka tam .
translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkew ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha . Kim shym da don jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .
u Elisheba , u Eliada , bad u Geliloth .
translation.en: And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphelet .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Adam u la im sa proh snem .
translation.en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years : and he begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len beiñ ïa kata . Katto katne por hadien , kiba ïa-ïoh hangta ki la mudui biang ïa u Patmos , Mem lah ban laiñ ba me hir uwei na ki , namar ma me ruh , me long na Galilaïa .
translation.en: And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .

translation.kha: Ki Shna ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .
translation.kha: Kim shym la long ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaba kha kum ki khun u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei hi u la long U Kpa jong ki .
Hato ka long kaba dei ïa me ban lehhok katne katne ? Baana ñiewbeiñ ïa uta uba me hi me la thaw ? Bad nongbat ban phuh syngkhlieh ha ki jingthmu ki riewbymman ?
translation.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?

translation.kha: Baroh ngi ïoh jingmyntoi na ki jingbam bakynja mynsiem
translation.en: We all benefit from our spiritual food

translation.kha: La ai ha u ka iktiar , ka jingpyndonburom , bun ka bor ba kynja syiem , khnang ba ki briew jongnga ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jaiñ-da ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej kin Shakri ïa u . Ka iathuh jong u kan neh julam , mala ka shiah jong u kan ym kut shuh .
translation.en: And there was given him dominion , and glory , and a kingdom , that all people , nations , and languages , should serve him : his dominion is an everlasting dominion , which shall not pass away , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed .

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ai kum ka jingkñia ïa u ISAIAH u khun jong u , mynba U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham . U Abraham u la long uta ïa uba U Blei u la ïateh kular , la katta! ruh u long la kloi ban ai ïa la u khun marwei kum ka jingkñia .
translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried , offered up Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,

translation.kha: U Syiem Asa u pynkhiah ïa ka Maakah ka kmierad jongngi u na ka kyllan kum ka syiemsad , ñiar ka la thret ka bynthiew kynsha jong ka Ishar ka blei jingseisoh . U Asa u pynpra ïa ka bleithaw , u pyntbit ïa ka , bad u thrang ïa ki lyngngoh ha ka yn Kidron .
translation.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha khmih haduh katno ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ki long kiba sarong ! Ki ïaid da kaba pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki sien jam kiba rit itynnat bad ki jingdeng ha ki matsohlah ki sawa .

translation.en: And , ye fathers , provoke not your children to wrath : but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord .
translation.kha: Phi ruh ki kmie ki kpa , wat leh ïa la ki khun ha kata ka rukom ban pynbitar ïa ki , pynban to pynheh pynsan ïa ki ha ka jingsneng bad jinghikai ba kynja mynsiem .

La pynphong ka jingpynbna bad u Jehu u Pha ktien ha kyllaiñ ka ri Israel . Baroh babha mane ïa u Balaam ki la Wan ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba pum . Baroh ki leit shok ha ka templ u Baal , da kaba pynap ïa ka na kut ha kut .
translation.en: And Jehu sent through all Israel : and all the worshippers of Baal came , so that there was not a man left that came not . And they came into the house of Baal  ; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another .

And I looked , and behold a pale horse : and his name that sat on him was Death , and Hell followed with him . And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth , to kill with sword , and with hunger , and with death , and with the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai uba lieh bthuh . Ïa u nongshong kulai la ai kyrteng  ka Jingïap  , bad ka Hades ka bud syndah nadien . La ai ha ki ka bor halor shipawa na ka pyrthei , ban pynïap da ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ka khlam , bad da ki mradkhlaw .
U ju U Briew un ïap kumba U Blei u la thmu , hynrei a katno kan long kabu shyrkhei ïa uta u briew’ uba shetkylla ïa u !
translation.en: And truly the Son of man goeth , as it was determined : but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed !

translation.kha: U Abimelekh u la wan na Gerar lem bad u Ahussath u nonglehbeiñ jong u bad u Phikol u radbah shipai jong u ba-bang ïakynduh ïa u Isaak .
translation.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar , and Ahuzzath one of his friends , and Phichol the chief captain of his army .
For it is written , that Abraham had two sons , the one by a bondmaid , the other by a freewoman .
translation.kha: Ka ong ba u Abraham u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , uwei na ka kynthei mraw bad uwei pat na ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
U Trai u ong , Ko ki paid ka Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jrong sa . Phi kmen malu phi sngewbha , phi da leh kumin ka masi ba ïadie haba shoh kpa ne kum u kulai uba pah ,
translation.en: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced , O ye destroyers of mine heritage , because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls  ;
For I am in a strait betwixt two , having a desire to depart , and to be with Christ ; which is far better :
translation.kha: Ïa nga la tan ha ki ar bynta . Nga da kwah eh ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim bad ban don bad U Khrist , kaba long kaei kaei kaba kham bha ;

translation.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself : but the simple pass on , and are punished .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad ki kynriah na ka , hynrei u briew u bym pyrkhat un ïaid beit ha ka bad un babe kylla hadien .
Nga ong ha lade ba la dei ban kren , ba ma phin kiba la kham rangbah phi dei ban ïasam lem ïa la ka jingstad .
translation.en: I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .

translation.kha: Na ïathuh ha phi ïa kane ym khim ka hukum , hynrei tang kum ka jingpynhun .
translation.en: But I speak this by permission , and not of commandment .
And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban kren .

Bad u la ong ruh , Ko khur u briew , kun sa pynduna bam ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki briew hangto kin da sa shem jynjar bad sngewlehrain namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ba ki bam bad ïa ka um ba ki dih .
