translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :
And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa u Paul , ki la wallam ïa u ha khmat ka dorbar jong ka nongbah , ka Ariopagos , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi kwah ban tip kaei kane ka jinghikai bathymmai kaba me kren .
Haba u Saul u la synshar ar snem ha Israel ,
translation.en: Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,

translation.kha: U Simri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elah , bad u long syiad ha ka kajuh jong u . Kane ka jia ha ka snem kob arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Jehudi .
translation.en: And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me bania ngi la ju tyngkhuh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U Trai U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me kumba u la long pynlang u Moses !
translation.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .

translation.kha: ( Hebru 6 :1 ) Lada phi iaineh phin sa lah ban bim “ka jingbah kaba Eh —kata ka Long ka jingshisha kaba jylliew .
translation.en: ( Hebrews 6 :1 ) As you continue , you will be better able to take in “solid food”—that is , deeper truths .
And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone : and there was a rainbow round about the throne , in sight like unto an emerald .
translation.kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka phyrnai kum ki mawkordor , kum u Jasper bad u Karnelian , bad baroh sawdong ka khet la don u simpyllieng uba don ka rong kum ka jong u Emerald .
Baroh shu jingim jongu nga , nga la kitkhia ïa ki .
translation.en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )
The  Lord  repented for this : This also shall not be , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylla biang la ka jingmut bad u la ong ,  Kane ruh kan ym jia .
Hangta u pun u khun sha sepngi shaw nongshet Tabor , bad nongbat sha Hukkok , da kaba kynoi ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaneng sepngi , bad ïa ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban khñium , kumba don na ki , Ibbah la khñium — bun la pynjot ïa ki da u Angel ka Jingïap .
translation.en: Neither murmur ye , as some of them also murmured , and were destroyed of the destroyer .
And he erected there an altar , and called it El–elohe–Israel .
translation.kha: U pynïeng ïa ka duwan hangta , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ka da ka kyrteng El , U Blei jong ki Israel .
U Trai u ong , Ki briew ki wan na ka ri ha ka phang bashatei ; ka jaitbynriew kaba khrawbor na sha jngai bah ka Pynkhreh ïa ka thma .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , a people cometh from the north country , and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth .

translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , u para jong u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka Nongbah ; kumta u Katba u la ai ha u ïa la ka khun kynthei ban shongkurim .
translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .

So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jaka tep syiem hynrei namar ka jingpang jong u ym shym la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Ko rangbah , sngewbha wat ïaid wai na ka ïing jong per khlem da ïan rung ; nga ba-don hangtai ban shakri ïa phiah .
translation.en: And said , My Lord , if now I have found favour in thy sight , pass not away , I pray thee , from thy servant :
I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :
translation.kha: ngan ym beh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jaitbynriew kiba dang don ha ka ri haba u Joshua u la ïap .
wahbah u Isak u la don klang katto katne por , u syiem Abimelekh u peit na ka jingkhangïit bad u ïohi ïa u Isaak bad ka Rebekka ba ki ïaleh ieit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you , ye said unto me , Nay  ; but a king shall reign over us : when the  Lord  your God was your king .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohi ba u Nahash u syiem Ammon u wan tur pyrshah ïa phi , phi la kyntait ïa U  Trai  kum u syiem jong phi bad phi ong ha nga , ‘ Ngi kwah syiem ban synshar ïa ngi .’

Adam ka sngi ki Lebi ki leit rhah ïa “kata ka synduk sha u nongpynïaidkam u syiem , uba dei peit ïa ka . Ha Man ba ka ba-dap , u sekretari syiem bad u nongmihkhmat ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki sei shabar ïa ka pisa bad ki leit buh biang ïa ka syngkien ha ka jaka jongngi ka . Gera katkum ki la ïohi shibun ka pisa .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king s office by the hand of the Levites , and when they saw that there was much money , the king s scribe and the high priest s officer came and emptied the chest , and took it , and carried it to his place again . Thus they did day by day , and gathered money in abundance .

translation.kha: U paw u thmu ïa naba bha , wat haba u pynmong ïa phi . Hynrei haba u nongshun u buh ïa ka ksang ti jong u halor ka tyrpeng jong phi — da ïabishar !
translation.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend  ; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful .
And when they came again to him , ( for he tarried at Jericho , ) he said unto them , Did I not say unto you , Go not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha u Elisha , uba dang ap ïa ki ha Jerikho , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym leit ?

translation.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites , and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah , and upon the south of Caleb  ; and we burned Ziklag with fire .
translation.kha: Ngi la leit lute ïa ka ri ki Khereth ha ka bynta kaba shathie jong ka Judah bad ïa ka ri jong ka jait u Kaleb , bad ngi la thang ruh ïa ka Siklag .

U Nebukhadnessar un wan bad jop ïa ka Ijipt . Kito ki briew kiba la dei ban ïap na ka jingpang kin ïap ha ka jingpang , kito kiba dei ba yn ïalam kumta ki koidi yn ïalam ïa ki kum ki koidi , bad kito kiba la dei ban shaei pynsep ha ka thma kin ïahap ha ka thma .
translation.en: And when he cometh , he shall smite the land of Egypt , and deliver such as are for death to death  ; and such as are for captivity to captivity  ; and such as are for the sword to the sword .

translation.kha: Ngam kyrpad ïa me ba kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A Trai Nongbishar , me la kular ïa kane , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan ïaisah malade ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .
translation.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .

translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , u shakri jong nga u thiah pung ha ïing , um lah ban khih bad u da shitom jur eh .
translation.en: And saying , Lord , my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy , grievously tormented .
Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying , as soon as I was sent for : I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me ?
translation.kha: Bad kumta haba phi la phah khot ïa nga , nga la wan khlem kano kano ka jingpyrshah . Nga kylli ïa phi , te , balei ba phi phah khot ïa nga ?

translation.en: And he said unto him , What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .
translation.kha: Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?  uta u briew u kylli .  U Jakob ,  u jubab .

Ki rangbah na ka jait Reuben bad ka jaiñjot Gad , bad na ka shiteng ka jait Manasseh , ki la Khreh ïa ka thma , ki la khem ha shuwa jong kiba sah lad uta u paidbah , kamar u Moses u la ïa-bta ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: And the children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and half the tribe of Manasseh , passed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spake unto them :

translation.kha: Un long u briew uba khraw ha khmat U Trai . Um dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ lano ka jingdih kaba khohruh . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translation.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .

translation.kha: ‘ Na kane ka pateng bymman , yn ym to uwei ruh u ban ïuh sien rung ha kata ka ri kaba stai ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tmier jong phi ,
translation.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land , which I sware to give unto your fathers ,
Then David came to Mahanaim . And Absalom passed over Jordan , he and all the men of Israel with him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u lah da poi ha ka shnong Mahanaim ha ka por ba u Absalom bad ki Israel ki la dep jam sha shiliang ka Jordan .
Da shisha u Dabid u jubab , Nga long u shakri jong phi bad phin sa ïohi da lade kaei ba nga lah ban ar . U Akhish u ong , Ka biang ! Ngan pynlong ïa pa u nongai jong nga shi mar .
translation.en: And David said to Achish , Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do . And Achish said to David , Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kaba shadien jongngi ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka phang sepngi , shna hynriew tukri ki jingker
translation.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards .

translation.kha: Ki kular ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha Kane kano kabu jop halor u .
translation.en: While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud men shim ïa u langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduh bad ai ïa u kum ka jingkynha na ka bynta ka pop . To pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u ha kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .
translation.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .

translation.kha: Nangne u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amen , u lat jong kane ka nongbah , bad sha u Joash u khun syep .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Take Micaiah , and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;
translation.kha: Te u angel u la leit noh , bad u Kornelios u la khot ar ngut na ki shakri ïing jong u bad uwei u shipai uba riewblei uba long uwei na kiba shakri ïa u .
nabar nangta rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot pun pyndonburom ïa U Trai U Blei jongu phi , da kambah phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh moi sngewbha jongki phi kat kumba u la kerkut ïa phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the  Lord  thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand , which thou shalt give unto the  Lord  thy God , according as the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee :

translation.kha: Shisien , katsha dang leit ontep , la ïohi ïa kawei na kine ki kynhun , bad ki paidbah ki pynhap ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep u Elisha bad ki phet krad . Mar ïadei ka metïap ha ki shyieng u Elisha , uta u briew u im pat bad u ïeng joit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .

translation.kha: Da kaba pyntrei jur ïa ki briew , u Solomon u tei duh ïa ka Beth Horon Kaba shathie ,
translation.en: And Solomon built Gezer , and Beth–horon the nether ,

translation.kha: Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga . Leh kumba nga ong , bad phin lama Suki .
translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master s servants that are come with thee : and as soon as ye be up early in the morning , and have light , depart .
translation.kha: Kumta te , Dabid , lashai dang step baroh na phi kiba la iehnoh ïa u Saul bad kiba la wan sha nga ki dei ban khie dang step bad mih mar shu kynjat shai .
Ngan phuh ruh ïa phi ban ïalap , dara phin don ka bor ban tbeh noh ïa ki ksuid .
translation.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses , and to cast out devils :
And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u ong ,  Ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ki jingleh palat jong ki .

translation.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban wad dong ban pynshitom ïa U Jisu , namar ba u la leh ïa kane ka jingpynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

Hato pha la ïoh jinghun pun bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthei bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang Hapoh khyndiat por Pha la leh khnam sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh Kiba pha la leh .
translation.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .

translation.kha: Ym shym la teh ïa ki kti jong u , Bad ïa ki kjat jong u ym shym la khum ; U la ïap kum wahbah la shah pynkup ha ki nongkamsniew ! Bad ki briew barhem ki la ïam sa shisien pat na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Thy hands were not bound , nor thy feet put into fetters : as a man falleth before wicked men , so fellest thou . And all the people wept again over him .
But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei la bishar bad la pynshitom ïa ngi da U Trai , khnang ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyrthei .

Kumta u Ishmael u khun jong u Nathanael , u Jonathan u khun jong u kriah , u Serahaïah u khun jong u Tanhumeth , ki khun shynrang lad u Ephai na Netophah , bad u Jesanaïah na Maakah ki la leit bad la ki rangbah sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah .
translation.en: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite , they and their men .

translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaei kaba ma ang , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phin . Kanaan ka nongbah ka dei da shisha u khiew shet , hynrei kawei ka dih ? Ki metïap jong pli kiba phin la pynjop ! Phin ym don shuh hangne — Ngan bret ïa phi bashabar kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it , they are the flesh , and this city is the caldron : but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it .
Thus were their faces : and their wings were stretched upward  ; two wings of every one were joined one to another , and two covered their bodies .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw la rah shajrong kumta ba ki dei ïa ki khmut thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-marsyndah , bad ki ar tylli ki thapniang ki tap ïa ki met jong ki .
Long shlur , ko ki Philistia ! Ïaleh kum ki ngab , lym kumta ngin hylla long ki mraw ha kine ki Hebru , kumba ma ki , ki la long ki mraw jongki ngi . Kumta to ïaleh kum ki rangbah !
translation.en: Be strong , and quit yourselves like men , O ye Philistines , that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews , as they have been to you : quit yourselves like men , and fight .

translation.kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Bela , ki pynbudnam ïa nga da ki kynja jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .
translation.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .

translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la tam ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap U Trai ? U Trai da lade” u la ïathuh ha nga ban tur ïaheh pyrshang ïa ka bad pynjot ïa ka .
translation.en: And am I now come up without the  Lord  against this land to destroy it ? the  Lord  said unto me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .
translation.kha: U dei u nongshun jong ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .

translation.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city , Hear , hear  ; say , I pray you , unto Joab , Come near hither , that I may speak with thee .
translation.kha: La don kawei ka kynthei kaba stad hapoh ka nongbah kaba la pyrta na ka kynroh ,  Ha sngap ! Ha sngap ! Ong ïa u Joab ba un wan hangne ; nga kwah ban ïakren bad u .

translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong ki .
Eliada men dang ïoh khum Shuh nalor jong ki , kita kin ym dadien ki lad nga ; kan kano ka bynta kambah kine ïohpateng kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .
translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
Now if we be dead with Christ , we believe that we shall also live with him :
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi la ïap bad U Khrist , ngi ngeit ba ngin im ruh bad u .
Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jehoba namar ba ki kti jong u ki longsem kiba mih shñiuh kum ki jong u Aïu .
translation.en: And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .
Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpop ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
Kaei kane kob ka jingkhmih jong ka , ka long kum ka pha ? Ka long kabu bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka jingphyrnai kumto ka sngaid ne u bnai .
translation.en: I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .

translation.kha: Katba ka dang kren kumta bad u syiem , u Nathan u wei poi ha ka jingïam .
translation.en: And , lo , while she yet talked with the king , Nathan the prophet also came in .
Your mother shall be sore confounded  ; she that bare you shall be ashamed : behold , the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ka nongbah bakhraw kaba dei ka jong phi yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom . Ka Babilonia kan long ka hima kaba poh tam na baroh ; kan long kaba ryngkhiang bad ka ri shyiap bym don um satia .
Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jngai U Blei ka pynsat thah ïa ki um , bad ka pynkylla thah ïa ki .
translation.en: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .

translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u Maaseïah bad u Aaron nabar ki la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
For ye have the poor always with you  ; but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin ïai ïoh ïa ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh ïa nga borabor .
U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel u la tei kynroh ïa ka shnong Shekhem Kaba ha ri lum Ephraim badno u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la mihnoh nabar u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shang Penuel .
translation.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .

translation.kha: U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kparad Jong u ; u la ïapom nep ibha u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen , either in the warp , or woof , or any thing of skins , to pronounce it clean , or to pronounce it unclean .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup , la ka dei kaba da u  saiwul ne da ka linen , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh , dei ha kane ka rukom yn bishar la ka long kaba khuid ne ka bymkhuid .
Bad u la wan poi sha Dorkas laiñ bad ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh ban kem ïa baroh kba mane ïa me .
translation.en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .

translation.kha: Lada kita ki ki ki long kiba mluh Lehi , ki dei tang ki dak thlia ha ka sniehdoh jong ; uta u briew u long uba khuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall look : and , behold , if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white  ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin  ; he is clean .

translation.kha: Haba phoi la wanrah ïa kaba bha tam sha U Trai , phim long naba shah rem haba phi bam ïa ka . Jamynrei da sumar ban ym pyntngit ïa ki jingai kiba khiah jong ki Israel da kaba bam ïa kino tv ki jingai shuwa kaba ai ïa kaba bha tam . Lada phi leh kumta , yn pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it , when ye have heaved from it the best of it : neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .

translation.kha: Ki long tang kum ki jingthung ba dang lung , ba dang Shu mih bad bym pat suhthied , haba U Trai u phah ïa ka lyer , ki tyrkhong noh bad kit noh kum u phlangïap .
translation.en: Yea , they shall not be planted  ; yea , they shall not be sown : yea , their stock shall not take root in the earth : and he shall also blow upon them , and they shall wither , and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble .

translation.kha: Bad Kaei u ïathuh ïa pa’ ? u kñi u Saul u kyllut .
translation.en: And Saul s uncle said , Tell me , I pray thee , what Samuel said unto you .

translation.kha: U Lot u leh tud pynban . Hynrei U Tlai u la leh-isynei ïa u ; kumta kita ki pynbah ki shym ïa u , ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam noh! ïa ki shabar kata ka nongjop .
translation.en: And while he lingered , the men laid hold upon his hand , and upon the hand of his wife , and upon the hand of his two daughters  ; the  Lord  being merciful unto him : and they brought him forth , and set him without the city .

translation.kha: Haba ki jingthung ki la san bad ki kop sohkew ki la sdang mih , te ki ñiat ruh ki la pait .
translation.en: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .

translation.kha: Naba du du uba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno uba duh noh! ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jinglong kiba phi donkam , bad lada Phi don kyrhai ïa ki , kmen pynlong ïa phi kiba smat bad kiba seisoh ha ka jingmihpat ïa U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: For if these things be in you , and abound , they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Kane ka dat kaei kaba u ong shaphang ki kynhun shipai u Neko , u syiem ka Ijipt , ïa uba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Bithynia u la jop ha Karkhemish hajan ka wah Ïutikhos ha ka snem kaweh saw ba u Jehosadak u long u syiem ka Judith :
translation.en: Against Egypt , against the army of Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt , which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah .
Persecuted , but not forsaken ; cast down , but not destroyed ;
translation.kha: La pynjynjar ïa ngi bunsien , hynrei ym shym la pynlwet noh ; teng teng hapdeng ka jingartatien , hynrei da lei lei ym ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ; don bun ki nongshun , hynrei ngim ju duh paralok ; bad wat la ngi jur ka jingmong hateng hateng , ym shym la pynjot noh ïa ngi .
Man la u lyngdoh Jiw , u trei ïa la ka kam man ka sngi bad ai kijuh ki jingjia man ka por ; hynrei kine ki jingkñia kim lah ban kit neh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins :

translation.kha: Na u Onan shaw ki hynñiew tyllun ki bajan ha ka probins jong ka Asia : Ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ïa phi na U Blei , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan , bad na ki hynñiew ki mynhynnin katba ha khmat ka khet jong u ,
translation.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia : Grace be unto you , and peace , from him which is , and which was , and which is to come  ; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne  ;

translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjied jong ki .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u leit biang sha Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u rangbah synshar ka sorkar u la don hangta uba u khun jong u , u la pang , ha Kapernam .

translation.en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast , which was diverse from all the others , exceeding dreadful , whose teeth were of iron , and his nails of brass  ; which devoured , brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with his feet  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga la kwah ban tip kham bun shaphang jong u mradkhlaw uba saw , u bym long kum kiwei pat — u mradkhlaw bakynsha uba khñiot pynlwet ïa kiba u la ïoh da ki tnaw rnong bad da ki bniat nar bad nangta u kyrdem halor jong ki .

Uno uno uba ïakheiñ ko bakha ïa katno Kanaan ka sngi , un bor kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Terah , uno uno u ban bam ïa kaei kaei , un bor kamet ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai , namar u ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kata ka jingbam . Uno une uba kyntu don bam ïa film kino ki jingbam , un leh kumta ha ka jingburom ïa U Trai’ bad u ainguh sha U Blei .
translation.en: He that regardeth the day , regardeth it unto the Lord ; and he that regardeth not the day , to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth , eateth to the Lord , for he giveth God thanks ; and he that eateth not , to the Lord he eateth not , and giveth God thanks .

translation.kha: Nangta ka dak ka paw ; u lehhok tduh u sdang ban khiew shajrong na kata ka shnong . Ki Benjamin ki khmih shadien jong ki bad ki kyndit ban ïohi ba dat ka nongbah baroh Kaei ka la pluh .
translation.en: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke , the Benjamites looked behind them , and , behold , the flame of the city ascended up to heaven .
Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .
translation.kha: Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pynïap ïa la ki briew , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym don mano mano na ka longïing basniew jong me ban lait im .

Hynrei ha ki nongpynkhiah ka Jerusalem nga la ïohi ba ki lai kaba kham snier : ki klim bad ki kren lamler ; ki pynshlur ïa ki bri ban leh ïa ka bymdei , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh nala ïa kaei kaba Sniew . Ha nga , ki un-long baroh uba sniew kumne ki briew ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .
translation.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .

translation.kha: Kawei ka kupar ka wan kumjuh ha baroh , badno kane ka long kambah barew kum kano kano kaba jia ha Kanneh ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , dara kynsan kynsan ki ïarep .
translation.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .

translation.kha: Haba u khyllung u dap , ka un-long ka ba eh da shisha ia ka kmie .
translation.en: When a child dies , it is particularly hard for the mother .
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad briew , ka jingproh jabieng , ka jingsngewthuh — kim lah ïarap ei ei lada U  Trai  u long pyrshah ïa phi .
Te u Joseph u jubab , Kane ka mut kumne : ki na tylli ki shane ki long lah tylli ki snoh .
translation.en: And Joseph answered and said , This is the interpretation thereof : The three baskets are three days :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong ïa nga , ba at la pynïap saihon eh ki briew bad ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kumta , namar ba per la pynmih sian ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban ti ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .

translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna ban khang ïa ki lei u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — kito ki lawlynnong kiba u khun jong u Hammedatha uba jingartatiend na u Haggai u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka ha-sem .
translation.en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :

translation.kha: Na kawei ka to shuh kawei patar phi pynjahburom ïa nga bun phim don ka jinglehisynei haba phi krenbeiñ ïa ang .
translation.en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .

translation.kha: Ki Loit kiba dei na ka kur u Kohath bad u Korah ki ïeng bad da ka sur kambah jam ki ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And the Levites , of the children of the Kohathites , and of the children of the Korhites , stood up to praise the  Lord  God of Israel with a loud voice on high .

translation.kha: Namarkata ba ki langbrot Ki don u nongshoh-nar , ki la smai noh , bad ki mradkhlaw ki pynïap bad bam ïa ki .
translation.en: And they were scattered , because there is no shepherd : and they became meat to all the beasts of the field , when they were scattered .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban thret ar shah na ka bynta ki pop sad ka jingbymman lad ki , namar ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri jongngi nga da ki bleithaw ki bym don jingïam kum ki metïap , bad ki la pynïap ïa ka da ki bieit thala jong ki .
translation.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .
For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane , u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u .
Iddo phi jam ïa ka haw Jordan , U Trai un shah ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri mala un ïada ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh , ba phin ioh shongsuk shongsaiñ .
translation.en: But when ye go over Jordan , and dwell in the land which the  Lord  your God giveth you to inherit , and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about , so that ye dwell in safety  ;

translation.kha: Ka Mahli ka la ïing shabar ka jingtep ka da ïam . Katto ka dang ïam , ka la dem bad jngoh shapoh ka jingpait bad ka la ïohi ar ngut ki angel hangta kiba la phong da ki jaiñ balieh , ki da ïashong ha ka la buh ïa ka met U Jisu , eiei sha khlei bad imat pat sha kjat .
translation.en: And seeth two angels in white sitting , the one at the head , and the other at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .

translation.kha: U briew uba bha u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba babha ; u briew wahbah snep u sei ïa kiei keiñ kba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translation.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka khep u la leit sha Gibeon ban ai jingkñia namar dat kaba ba-don hangta ka hir ka duwan kaba donnam tam . U la ai da ki spah tyllep ki jingweng step Haneng ha ka por ba la kitei .
translation.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there  ; for that was the great high place : a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar .
But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ngan pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
Ngi la ïohknieh ïa ka ri u Og u Syiem Bashan baïar kawei : ïa ki nongbah baroh ha ka madan lum , ïa ki ri Gilead bad Bashan , haduh ki shnong Salekah bad Edrei shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: All the cities of the plain , and all Gilead , and all Bashan , unto Salecah and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .
translation.kha: Mynta nga long kum u ban sa ïap noh ; ym don jinglait na ka jingjynjar jong nga .

hynrei naduh ka por jong u Adam haduh ka per jong u Moses , ka jingïap ka synshar halor u bymriewblei baroh , wat halor kito ki bim shym la sa pop ha ka rukom kumba u Aram u la leh mynba um shym la Kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blang . U Adam u la Long ka duriaw jong uta u don sa wan .
translation.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .

translation.kha: Phi ong ba nga tbeh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor pun ai kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ha ki briew jong phi ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei kaba ki briew jong Phin hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba phi bakla !
translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .

translation.kha: Bad u ong ha u Shimiet , Nga khlei la ka jubanlak ha phoi ba phin ym shah pynïap .
translation.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei , Thou shalt not die . And the king sware unto him .

translation.kha: len pyndonkam ïa ki ban shem la kine ki Israel kin bud ne em ïa ki lynti jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la imat .
translation.en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .

translation.kha: Hib ka to ka la kut , ki la khlam i khiew krat bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa kito barabor kba la bam ïa ka jingbah shym .
translation.en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king s meat .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la ong ha nga ;
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jngai nga : Nga hi sa sngewskhem ba phi dap da ka jingbha , ba phi don ka jingtip baroh , bad ba phi lah ban hikai iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .

translation.kha: Lada ha kawei ka sngi ïa ka suiñbneng la lah ban thew malade ïa ki nongrep ka pyrthuh la ïingjah , tang kata hi ka ba-bang pynlong ba un kynja ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh kaba ki la leh . U Terah u la kren .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab , Ki briew kiba koit bakhiah kim donkam ïa u nongsumar , hynrei tang kito kiba pangnud .
translation.en: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them ,  They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Ishmael .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u banbeiñ sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kham skum Shuh shuh , Ko Khun U Dabid , to isynei ïa nga !
translation.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .

translation.kha: Nobah ym dei tang ba ka khubor shaphang U Tlai ka la mih na phi sha kylleng ka Medan bad Akhaïa , hyndai ka khubor shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Blei ka la par pylleng . Ym don shuh kano kano te ba ngi donkam ban noh .
translation.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia , but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad ; so that we need not to speak any thing .

translation.kha: u Matthaïos bad u Tom , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , bad u Simon ( ïa uba la khoit , u Riew-ieit ri ) .
translation.en: Matthew and Thomas , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon called Zelotes ,

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong , Ai kan bat ïa kito ki tiar . Ngim kwah ba ki briew kin rkhie ïa ngi . Nga la pyrshang ban siew ïa ka , hynmen kine shym lap ïa ka .
translation.en: And Judah said , Let her take it to her , lest we be shamed : behold , I sent this kid , and thou hast not found her .

And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohi ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar na bneng bad ba ka jingshai ka dap ha ka Templ , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa U namar ka jingbha bad ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .

translation.en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kor khlur-kba , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai banep . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bad pynlwet ïa ki ; ki lumrit kin lwet kum u pui pui .
Kat wahbah dang sah na ki khun ki kseh jong me un leit ha uta u lyngdoh bad pan na u ïa ka pipa bad ka jingbam , bad kyrpad ïa u don shah ba un ïar ïa ki lyngngoh khnang ba un ïew ei ei ban bam .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .

translation.kha: U Judas ( ym u Judia Iskariot ) u la ong , Ko Trai , kumno ka lah ban long ba men pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?

translation.kha: Men im da ka waitlam , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u per jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng shun ïaleh pyrshah , “Men laitluid na ka jingsynshar Jong u .
translation.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .

translation.kha: U tei ïa ki duwan ba-thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U Tiras u la jong ba daiñ ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: And he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , of which the  Lord  said , In Jerusalem will I put my name .

translation.kha: Ngim san bad ngi ïapstai kloi kloi kum ki synriah ki skud ; lane im’ jah noh kum ki syrngiew .
translation.en: He cometh forth like a flower , and is cut down : he fleeth also as a shadow , and continueth not .
And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father s brother king in his stead , and changed his name to Zedekiah .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynlong ïa u Mattanaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad u la pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Sedekaïah .
U dei baneh long uba khuid bad um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; u kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam Sha nga , bad Kumta u daym ban long uba khuid .
translation.en: They shall be holy unto their God , and not profane the name of their God : for the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and the bread of their God , they do offer : therefore they shall be holy .
For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;
translation.kha: U Jisu , te , u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . U long uba khuid ; um shym don kano kano kaba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u sha ki bneng .
Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei eh bad ki la ong ha u Petros bad ha kiwei pat ki apostol , Kaei kiba ngin imat , ko para ?
translation.en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?

translation.kha: U nongwei uba pynïasoh bad u paidlang jong U Trai um dei ban ong , U TRAI’ un ym shah ïa nga ban manla badno ki briew jong u . U Briew ba la shah dab um dei ban pyrkhat namar ba um lah ban khong khup , um lah ban don boitha lang bad ki paidlang U Blei .
translation.en: Neither let the son of the stranger , that hath joined himself to the  Lord  , speak , saying , The  Lord  hath utterly separated me from his people : neither let the eunuch say , Behold , I am a dry tree .
In that day sing ye unto her , A vineyard of red wine .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  un ong shaphang ka bri sohwaiñ ba-itynnat jong u ,
ka Hadoram , ka Usal , ka Diklah ,
translation.en: And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,

translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kumta ka masi bapyllun , ba la tur ïaleh da u skain ba kynthah na shatei .
translation.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer , but destruction cometh  ; it cometh out of the north .
At this also my heart trembleth , and is moved out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka  erïong , ka pynlong ïa ka dohnud jong nga ban kyndeh stet .
Phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei lada phi kumjuh ïa ka Law jong ka hima , ïa kaba la shem ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , To ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba ainguh ïa lade .
translation.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself , ye do well :

translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut ïaskhem ba ngan ym pynsah ïa kane ka nongbah , hynrei ban pynjot ïa ka . Yn ai ïa ka ha u syiem ka bamaïan , bad un thang lut khoit ïa ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krenbeiñ .
translation.en: For I have set my face against this city for evil , and not for good , saith the  Lord  : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire .
Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .
translation.kha: Ka jingieid kam julam jingsniew ia ki marjan , namarkata , ka jinieid ka jingpyndap pynkmen jong ka kyndon .
Khie ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah Jerusalem mala buh dak ha ka shyllangmat jong uwei pa uwei uba shem jynjar bad khuslai namar ki kiei kiei baroh kaba ijli kiba la leh ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go through the midst of the city , through the midst of Jerusalem , and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Kaei te , ka uta u trai jong ka ber sohwaiñ un leh ? la kylli U Jisu . Un sa wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki briew bad ai noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .
translation.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do ? he will come and destroy the husbandmen , and will give the vineyard unto others .
And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïashem ïa ngi ha Assos , ngi la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng bad ngi la leit sha Mitylene .

translation.en: Therefore let us not sleep , as do others ; but let us watch and be sober .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ngim dei ban ïohthiah kum kiwei pat ; ngi dei ban peitmat bad pyngngad .

translation.en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïaid ha ka jingdum ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ki la shong ha ka ri jong ki syrngiew , hynrei mynta ka jingshai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki .
Kumta u Dabid u leit rieh ïa lade ha ki bri . Ha ka jingkhawai miat bnai thymmai , u syiem Shual u wan shong bam ,
translation.en: So David hid himself in the field : and when the new moon was come , the king sat him down to eat meat .

translation.kha: To ai ki jingkhublei jongu im sha baroh ki nongïalam jong phi bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh . Ki parabangeit jong ngi na Italy ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translation.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .

translation.kha: Kumta ka pop jong ki khun u El ka long kaba la shyieng palat ha khmat U Trai , namar ba ki la ñiew khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiad bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , nabar lang buh ïa ka kjit jngai nga hangta .
translation.en: And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lydia uno un u pynbna ba U Jisu u long U Toi U Blei , u im ha U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jrong u .
translation.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .

translation.kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong bad ïa ki jingri jong ki barben ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: Ka Tamar ka la leit phai pat sha la ïong , ka law noh ïa ka jingkad khmat , bad ka phong biang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei .
translation.en: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .
Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .
translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri kiba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Heshbon , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , bad ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long syiem .
Ki briew kiba bymman da shisha kim ïohnong ei ei , hawei lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ka pynthikna ba phin ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .

translation.kha: Ha Kane , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la ong , Ka jingkrenbeiñ blei ! Ngim donkam shuh bun ki sakhi ! Phi la dang shu sngewkyiuh ïa ka jingkheiñbriew blei jong u !
translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , saying , He hath spoken blasphemy  ; what further need have we of witnesses ? behold , now ye have heard his blasphemy .

translation.kha: Ki la duh ka jinglur jongki ki bad ki wan da kaba kyiuh na la ki jong ki kut .
translation.en: Strangers shall fade away , and they shall be afraid out of their close places .
We heard him say , I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and within three days I will build another made without hands .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba u ong , ‘ Ngan pynjot ïa kane ka Templ kaba ki briew ki la tei , bad hadien lai sngi ngan tei ïa kawei pat kaba ym shym la shna da ki briew’

Ka jingïaleh pyrsa ïa u ka long kambah sniew hi kum ka jingleh byrtong , bad ka jingnang ka long hi ka bapop kum ka jingmane pynlwet . Namar ba me la kyntait ïa ka hukum U Trai , u la kyntait ïa me kum u shem .
translation.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .

But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wanrah ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur , un wallam shi kilo u  purew kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Um dei ban theh kano kano ka umphniang Olib ne kano kano ka jingiwbih halor jong u , namar ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ym ka jingkñia bam .

translation.en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .
Uwei na ki , u haw ban pynjyrsieh ïa phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kita ki briew kiba shang marjan bad phi , lane kiba shong sha jngai na phi .
translation.en: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;

translation.kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U Trai ; ki im ka jingim bymman pynlang pynmong bakla ïa la ka bor . Naaman ka jingtim U Trai , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phla ki tyrkhong .
translation.en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .
translation.kha: Bad nga da kyrpad jur ïa phi ban duwai ba U Blei un phah pat ïa nga sha phi kham kloi .

translation.en: And I said unto her , Thou shalt abide for me many days  ; thou shalt not play the harlot , and thou shalt not be for another man : so will I also be for thee .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ka ba ka dei ban ap slem ïa nga khlem da leh nuti lane klim ; bad ha kane ka por ngan ïai ap ïa ka .
Ki la kylli ïa u , Uei uta u briew uba la nong ïa me ban bor kumne ?
translation.en: Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee ,  Take up thy bed , and walk ?
So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .
translation.kha: Kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki jinglong ba kynja doh , kim lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
Kine ki lama ki ktien shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lemuel ka kren ha u :
translation.en: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .

translation.kha: badno uba lah ban ai hukum ïa ki ha ka madan thma , ktang ba u paidlang jongki me un ym long kumne ki langbrot kiba khlem nongsah .
translation.en: Which may go out before them , and which may go in before them , and which may lead them out , and which may bring them in  ; that the congregation of the  Lord  be not as sheep which have no shepherd .

translation.kha: Hynriew pynban nga la pyrkhat isynei ïa ki . Nga la rai ban ym pynïap ïa ki ha ka ri shympriah .
translation.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them , neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Jisu u mut ïa-ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïaw , hynriewphew ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
translation.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .

translation.kha: Hato smam sngewthuh ba katba u dab u dang im , lano lano Leit ym ïoh long u syiem jong kane ka ri ? Mynta hi to khie leit bad wallam ïa u shane — u dei ba-bang ïap !
translation.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground , thou shalt not be established , nor thy kingdom . Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me , for he shall surely die .
And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
translation.kha: Lada me kyntait , ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndap ïa ka da ki jakoid .
U Jisu u la mih na ka synagog bad u la rupa sha ïing jong u Simon . Ka kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka la pang bad ka jingpang lud kaba jur , bad ki la ïakhot ha U Jingsuk shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: And he arose out of the synagogue , and entered into Simon s house . And Simon s wife s mother was taken with a great fever  ; and they besought him for her .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , nga la leit sha ki thain ha Syria bad Kilikia .
translation.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka jer uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Apollos ïa kaba la ha ha Aleksandria , u la wan poi shaw Ephesos . U long u nongkren uba pnah nabar uba don ka jingtip bahynñiew ïa ki Jingthoh Bakyntang .
translation.en: And a certain Jew named Apollos , born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , and mighty in the scriptures , came to Ephesus .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih babiang , bad ha kane ka por nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli kaba her ha ka lyer .
translation.en: Then I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a flying roll .

translation.kha: ngat bapaw , weng noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki sniang , ïa u dohnud , bad ïa ki khyllai Baroh ar lem bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh ïa at .
translation.en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and burn them upon the altar .

translation.kha: U pynbudnam ïa ki nongpop ha kaba baroh kin ïohi ïa kata ,
translation.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar ba por thoh sha phi . Ha baïar ar tylli ki shithi de la pyrshang ban pynkheiñ ïa ki jinglyngkhuit bakhlaiñ ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :

translation.kha: hynriew ki phylliew ki la kem ïa ki malu pynïap ïa ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul : u Jonathan , u Abinoam , bad u Malkhishua .
translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie ha u syiem Moab , bad ki la praw hangta kabu u Sabad u dang rieh ha ka krem .
translation.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .
And they made signs to his father , how he would have him called .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la ai dak ïa u kpa jong u , da kaba kyrpad ïa u kaei ka kyrteng u mon ba u khynnah un don .
Wat pyrkhat ba phan kham lait im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw tang namar ba phad don ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .

translation.kha: Nga , nga long u dieng shongsaiñ bymshisha , bad U Kpa jong nga u Long u nongsumar pyrshah .
translation.en: I am the true vine , and my Father is the husbandman .

translation.kha: Na kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assir , bad u tei hangamei ïa ki nongbeh ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,
translation.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,

translation.kha: U syiem u tap ïa la ka durkhmat bad u kliang jam , A , ko khun jong nga ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! ko Absalom , ko khun jong nga !
translation.en: But the king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , O my son Absalom , O Absalom , my son , my son !

translation.kha: Haba uba lui lui u ïap kynsai , U Blei! u rkhie .
translation.en: If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .

translation.kha: Phi tap ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam sha kata ka jaka shano sha ba nga otsher .
translation.en: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
We have heard the fame thereof : our hands wax feeble : anguish hath taken hold of us , and pain , as of a woman in travail .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,  ong ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  bad ki kti jong ngi ki noh kyrwep , la kem ïa ngi da ka jinglyng-a bad ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong nga kin mih , kin ym mihnoh thylli .
U para nongdih u long u nongsynran uba sniew tam jong u hi . Un shah pynsamthiah lada u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ha ka ïingbishar , U Blei un twa ïa u lada um leh kumta .
translation.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not .
Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .
translation.kha: Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong bad aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei ka ngi lah ha u briew ka long kaba lah ha U Blei .
translation.en: And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .

translation.kha: hynrei lada ym don mano mano ba Lah ban pyut , te uta uba kren ha ki thylli bapher u dei ngab sngaid jar noh malade Kren tieng ha lade bad ha U Blei .
translation.en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .
As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long khlem jingïarap ha khmat u nongsynshar uba sniew ; u long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrhuh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .
Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la ithuh sha ïing .
translation.en: And he arose , and departed to his house .

translation.kha: Katba bha malu kaba sniew kamut ki jia ha ka suda jong u .
translation.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?
And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u wan , un sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba wan na U  Trai  bad da ka burom jong U  Trai  U Blei hi . Ki briew jong u kin shong ha ka jingshngain namar ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthei kin ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , bad un wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea ;
translation.kha: Ha uta u lyoh bad ha kata ka duriaw la pynbaptis ïa ki baroh kum ki nongbud u Moses .

translation.en: Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .
translation.kha: Wat ju ong ,  O ! balei mo kiei kiei ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynbarim ?  Kam long ka jingkylli kaba shemphang .

U lah ba-bang pom ïa ki dieng Kedar ban pyndonkam , lynti u jied da u dieng Sniew lane u dieng sai-sawar na ka khlaw . Lane u haka ban thung u diengduh ba ïai jyrngam bad u ap ïa u thret ban pynmih ïa u .
translation.en: He heweth him down cedars , and taketh the cypress and the oak , which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest : he planteth an ash , and the rain doth nourish it .

translation.kha: Haba ki babha na ka jai Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka jaka , ki la leit sha Laish bad tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ki jop ïa ka , ki pynïap ïa ki briew hangta , bad ki kai kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki shong ki sah hangta bad ki pyntylli ïa ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah na ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kabu kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Don u kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .

translation.kha: U Syiem bad ki bariew jong u baroh ki la tat hi ïan haba ki la poi ha Jordan , mala ki la shong pynthut hangta .
translation.en: And the king , and all the people that were with him , came weary , and refreshed themselves there .
Besides the cakes , he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings .
translation.kha: Nalor kita , u dei ruh ban wanrah kum ka jingainguh ïa ki kpu ba la khleh thiat .
Haneng ka khlieh jong u ki la buh ka jingthoh pynbna ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u : Une u longsyiem U Jisu , U Syiem ki Jiw .
translation.en: And set up over his head his accusation written , THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS .

translation.kha: Dang pat phyrngab la phah noh ïa kita shi Para bad ïa ki kada jong ki .
translation.en: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their asses .

translation.kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki brai kiba shong basah ha shi lynñiar jong ka rud durblei . U thri u la ai ka rai bishar halor jong phi . Un pynim ïa phi , bad yn ym pynsah ïa ti shiah .
translation.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïa-ong , Kane ka long kum ka dak ba ki Israel ki hap ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ka Aiu ka ktang , haba ngan pynsakma ïa ki sha ki ri nongwei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles , whither I will drive them .

translation.kha: Jubab ïa nga , A Trai , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un tip ba me , U Trai , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki sha lade hi .
translation.en: Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .
The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jong ka jingim jong ngi , ïa u syiem uba U  Trai  u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno uno u nonghiarthma .

translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , ( for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them  ; )
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Me la wallam ïa kine ki briew na Ijipt da ka bor jong me . Haba ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa kine ki briew ,

translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kumba u Elisha u la lah ong , hamar kata ka por ha ka snem kaba bud ka la kha khun shynrang .
U syiem ka Babilonia u lute ïa ka Templ , ïa ka Ïing jingkynshew ka Templ , bad ka spaiñ jongnga u syiem bad ki rangïapom synsar lad u , bad u kit baroh sha Babilon .
translation.en: And all the vessels of the house of God , great and small , and the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king , and of his princes  ; all these he brought to Babylon .
And thou shalt write Aaron s name upon the rod of Levi : for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers .
translation.kha: bad nangta thoh ïa ka kyrteng u Aaron ha u diengduh na ka bynta ka jait Lebi . Dei ban don uwei u diengduh ïa u nongïalam jong kawei pa kawei ka jait .
Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , ngi ïatih lut ha i kat ïa kaba phi ong .
translation.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la bitar ïa nga ñiar jong phi bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang kor ! woh kriah ei ei shuh shaphang kata !
translation.en: But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .

Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kin sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta . Kin bam ïa u soh bad kin dih ïa ka dud kiba dei ki jong phi .

U Trai u la shah ïa u ban kem ïa u Syiem Jehoïakim bad kurup katto katne ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . U la shim pat katto katne ngut ki kyiad lem bad u sha ka templ jong ki blei jong u ha Babilon , bun u la buh ïa ka jingkynshew ba la ïoh kurup ha ki iaka kynshew ka templ .
translation.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .

translation.kha: Ki la loit shai ka ri Ophir bad ki wan kit nangta haduh khatsaw hajar kilo ka ksiar .
translation.en: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .

translation.kha: Ngan pynrngad ïa ka heh Nile bad ngan buh ïa ka Ijipt hapoh ka ni jongnga ki briew Kiba sniew . Ki nongwei kin pynjulor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ma sa , U Tlai , ang la kren .
translation.en: And I will make the rivers dry , and sell the land into the hand of the wicked : and I will make the land waste , and all that is therein , by the hand of strangers : I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la jong , to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri Emim .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against mount Seir , and prophesy against it ,

translation.kha: liam kim ju bam ïa kaei kaei kaba wanrah na ïew lehniam ki sait shuwa ïa ka . Bad ki buiñ ïa kiba bun kiwei ki aiñ kiba ki la ïohpdiang , kum kaba sait ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa ki khuri , ki khiew , ki pliang rnong , bad ki jingthiah . )
translation.en: And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .

translation.kha: Kito na phi kiba pynryngkang banbeiñ pynksan ha khmat U Blei! da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , phi la dkhat noh ïa lade na U Khrist . Phi hir shabar ka jingïamai U balui .
translation.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .
And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u kyntait ban jubab wat tang shikyntien , kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa u lyngskor .
Haba u Peleg u la dap laiphew snoh ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Reu ;
translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :

translation.kha: U Jehoïada um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap ha ka phylliah ka Templ , te u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai : Rah ïa ka shabar napdeng ki ar laiñ ba ïeng ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .
translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds , the officers of the host , and said unto them , Have her forth without the ranges : and him that followeth her kill with the sword . For the priest had said , Let her not be slain in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kan kham bha kaba shon ha tnum ïing ban ïa ka sah lang ha kajuh ka ïing bad ka tnga kaba wad daw .
translation.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .

translation.kha: bad ki pynjrong ïa ki dohnud jong ki , kiba eh kum u mawsiang . Namar ba kim shym la shah ïa ka jinghikai kambah nga la phan lyngka ki nongshetkylla kiba la im slem bah , nga la bitar shahjingit eh .
translation.en: Yea , they made their hearts as an adamant stone , lest they should hear the law , and the words which the  Lord  of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets : therefore came a great wrath from the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sneng jong u bneng naba lai jngai ka snem kaba khatwei ha ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the third month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Namar ka jingshitom jong kita ki sngi kan long ka kham sniew , don ïa kaei kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la sloit ïa ka pyrthei ïathuh ka por ba myntoi . Lymne yn ym kein shuh hadien kumto Kata kaei kamai .
translation.en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa ph , Kane ka dei ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ki bleithaw , te thew ngim bam phi ïa katai ka jingbam , na ka bynta uta uba la ïathuh ïa phi bun na ka beit ka jingïatiplem —
translation.en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa lai lwet na ki khun shynrang jong u Saul , u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .
translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , the sons of Saul .
He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ngi shahshitom , ngi dei ban shong marwei ha ka jingïaishah bajar jar ;
Hodaïah ba U Trei Jisu u la lah krong badno ki , ïa u la shimti noh sha bneng bad u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translation.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them , he was received up into heaven , and sat on the right hand of God .

translation.kha: U Sheba u la leit lyngba ïa ka jaka jong ki jait Israel Baroh bad u la wan poi ha ka nongbah Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki dkhot jong ka kur Bukki ki la jingïalumlang bad bud ïa u sha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel , and to Beth–maachah , and all the Berites : and they were gathered together , and went also after him .

translation.kha: Hangta ha Babilonia harud ka wah shabar , nga la ïohsngew ïa U Trai ba u kren ha nga bad nga la sngew ïa ka bor jyllang u .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest , the son of Buzi , in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar  ; and the hand of the  Lord  was there upon him .
For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .
translation.kha: Ngam nang kumno ban pynroh , bad U Blei shen un pynshitom ïa nga lada nga leh kumta .
Ka kali ïapom ba la tan da ki khuslai rong ïong ka la otsher Shaphan shithi sha Babilonia , ki kulai rong lieh ki leit shaphrang sepngi , bad ki kulai thohbroin ki leit sha ka ri bashathie .
translation.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country  ; and the white go forth after them  ; and the grisled go forth toward the south country .

Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
translation.kha: Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei ban wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha kata ka jaka mane Blei : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep . Kim dei ban wan thylli ha khmat U  Trai  ;
kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkyrmen ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei , u sem ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh mynnyngkong ,
translation.en: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;
So being affectionately desirous of you , we were willing to have imparted unto you , not the gospel of God only , but also our own souls , because ye were dear unto us .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi , ngi la long kiba la kloi ban ïabynta bad phi ym tang ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei hynrei wat ïa ka jingim jong ngi ruh . Phi la long kiba ieit thep mynsiem eh jong ngi!
Em lah baneh map da lei lei ïa ki pop jongngi nga ? Hato mem lah ban map ïa ka jingbymdei ba nga leh ? Shen , ngan sa don ha la ka jingïap bad ngan ym don shuh haba men khmih ïa de .
translation.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression , and take away mine iniquity ? for now shall I sleep in the dust  ; and thou shalt seek me in the morning , but I shall not be .

And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the  Lord  your God . And all the congregation blessed the  Lord  God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  , and the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la hukum ïa u paidbah ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi !  Bad kiba la ïalumlang baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki la pyndem la ki khlieh bad ai burom ïa U  Trai  bad ruh ïa u syiem .
U la kad arliang ïa ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jongngi u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: ynda me mih nangne mynta ka sngi , men ïakynduh ar ngut ki radbah hajan ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kynton ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kada Ibbah me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuid haw shaphang jong ki , hynrei i khuid shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylliang , ‘ Ngan leh kumno kiei shaphang la u khuid ?’
translation.en: When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?
And the  Lord  gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers  ; and they possessed it , and dwelt therein .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular da kaba kyntang ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba un ai ha ki . Haba ki la shimti ïa ka , ki la shongduh hangta .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Judas , hato dei da ka jingdoh ba me la shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ?
Nangta ki synran ki la rupa phai sha ïing .
translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .
Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shylluit , ki tnat , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban long kiba ïadait lang kawei bad kiba la shu shoh da ka ksiar nylla .

translation.en: Thus was he fair in his greatness , in the length of his branches : for his root was by great waters .
translation.kha: Katno kaba itynnat uta u dieng u long — u jrong katta katta , lem bad ka jingpyiar ki tnat , ki thied jong u ki sam shaduh ki wahduid kiba jylliew — kiba tuid .
Ngan ïanguh ïa ki aiñ jongki me : A wat ioh da lei lei ïa nga !
translation.en: I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .

translation.kha: Nga longsyiem uba la khlaw borabor ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki brai Jong nga , kiba long mutlop ban ïai leh ïa ka bymdei bad ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti ,
translation.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people , which walketh in a way that was not good , after their own thoughts  ;
So when David was old and full of days , he made Solomon his son king over Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la tymmen bha , u thung ïa u Solomon u khun jong u kum u syiem halor ki Israel .
Ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Ki Israel ki la kut jingmut ban ïaleh ; U paidbah da kaba kmen u tyrwa mon jingsngewbha .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  for the avenging of Israel , when the people willingly offered themselves .

translation.kha: Nangta u them shalor jong u khynnah , u da buh ïa la ka shyntur , ki kham , bad ki kti halor ka shyntur , ki khmat bad ki kti jong u khynnah . Akaba u dang dem khashor u khynnah , ka met jong u khynnah ka sdang ban syiad .
