translation.en: And he went up , and lay upon the child , and put his mouth upon his mouth , and his eyes upon his eyes , and his hands upon his hands : and he stretched himself upon the child  ; and the flesh of the child waxed warm .
As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Dei ma nga uta ,  ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllon ha madan .

translation.en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , hato ka hok jong u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan na U Blei ne na u briew ?
U Trai u jong , To ïathuh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jrong u Jakob , ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah :
translation.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob , and publish it in Judah , saying ,
And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men : for all men have not faith .
translation.kha: To duwai ruh ba U Blei un pyllait im ïa ngi na ki briew kiba bymman bad kiba sniew ; naba ym uwei pa uwei baroh u ngeit ïa ka khubor .

translation.en: The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar , uba la wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ïing na ka ri ka jinglongmraw , u la kular ba un sa wallam ïa kiwei pat ki briew ban ïasoh lang bad ki .
Un jah noh na ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sai ;
translation.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .

And Samson s wife wept before him , and said , Thou dost but hate me , and lovest me not : thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people , and hast not told it me . And he said unto her , Behold , I have not told it my father nor my mother , and shall I tell it thee ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka tnga u Samson ka leit ha khmat jong u ryngkat bad ki ummat bad ka ong ,  Pleng , phim ieit satia ïa nga ! Phi isih ïa nga ! Phi buh jingkyntip ha ki paralok jong nga , hynrei phim shym ïathuh ha nga ka mut aïu !  U ong ,  Khmih , ngam shym pat la ïathuh ha la i pa bad i mei . Balei keiñ ngan ïathuh ha phi ?

translation.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering  ; ( for he is faithful that promised  ; )
translation.kha: To ngin batskhem da ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba ngi ïaphla , namar ngi lah ban shaniah ba U Blei u bat ïa la ka kular .
Mynta ha kaba khat , ha ka snem kaba khappud jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshaïah , la rhah ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jinglait ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew Uba la ïohkhiah , Kane ka dei ka sngaid Sabbaton , bad ka longsem pynshah ïa ka sah jong ngi ïa me ban ramhah ïa la ka jingthiah .
translation.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
And shall put thereon the covering of badgers  skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ïa kiba na ka jait Lebi bad thung ïa ki kum ki shakri ïa u Aaron u lyngdoh .

Mynta , la ei ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh awria Hapdeng jong phi kaba shyrkhei haw kor katta ba waiñ ki bymnang kin sngewmeng ïa kata . La ïathuh ïa nga ba Uei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka meinah!
translation.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .
I entreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me da la ka dohnud baroh ; ban isynei ïa nga , kumba me la kular !
Ka jingkyrmen bashisha ban ïashem biang bad kiba ieid ba thoin kiba la ïap .—Ioannis 5 :28 , 29 .
translation.en: A real hope of being reunited with your dead loved ones . —John 5 :28 , 29 .

translation.kha: Kaei kaban phi kham jied ? Hato kun wan sha Phin da u dieng pajut , ne ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit bad ka jingjemnud ?
translation.en: What will ye ? shall I come unto you with a rod , or in love , and in the spirit of meekness ?
And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people  ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon s porch .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla hapdeng ki briew . Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka baranda u Solomon .

U Trai u Ong ha ki briew jong u , To ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lyngkot ïaid kiba mynbarim bad hangto ka don ka surok babha tam . To ïaid ha ka , bad phin im ha ka jingkem . Hynrei ki ong , Em , ngin ym leh !
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .

translation.kha: Une un long ha phi u bniah uba nyngkong jong ka sniew .
translation.en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months : it shall be the first month of the year to you .
And Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Martha , Martha , thou art careful and troubled about many things :
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa ka ,  Martha , Martha ! Pha la khuslai bad pha la sngew jynjar halor bun kiei kiei ,
Mynta , ha ka sngi ha kaba kiba ïalap kin mihpat , ka un-long ka tnat jongno ? Ma ki baroh ki la shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .

translation.kha: U syiem u ong , Ahimelekh , ma me bad ki ba-ïashun ha-sem jongno me baroh phi de pun ïap .
translation.en: And the king said , Thou shalt surely die , Ahimelech , thou , and all thy father s house .
And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .
translation.kha: Shim ïa une u diengduh bad me , namar da u men sa leh ïa ki kambah .

translation.en: Moab is destroyed  ; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynjot ; ha sngap ïa ki khynnah ba ki ïam .
Kiba sniew kumba phi long , phi tip kumne Ban ai kiei kiei Ibbah bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Katno kam , te , ba U Kpa ba ha bneng un ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha Aner kiba pan na u !
translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?

translation.kha: Kanaan ka maw , ba u dem ban long kiba syriem kum ki para jongki u ha kiei ktien baroh , ba un ïoh long u rangbah lyngdoh uba lah ban shaniah bun babha sngewsynei ha ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , kum ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop ki briew .
translation.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .

translation.kha: U briew uba pynstad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u Syiem ; lada u syiem u pyniaid , don uba lah banbeiñ ïahap .
translation.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .

translation.kha: Khie leit bran pruh mynta , bad ïathuh ha ki synran jong u , ‘ La pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , bad mynta u dang leit shad Galilaïa ha shuki jong phoi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u !’ To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .
translation.en: And go quickly , and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead  ; and , behold , he goeth before you into Galilee  ; there shall ye see him : lo , I have told you .
And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh  ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them : so the land became Pharaoh s .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ u Joseph u thied lut ïa ka khyndew ha Ijipt na ka bynta u syiem . La pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei u nong Ijipt ban die ïa la ki lyngkha namar ba ka  nemsniew ka la jur palat ; bad baroh ka khyndew ka kylla long ka jong u syiem .
Lymne U Kpa da lade hi um habar ïano ïano . U la ai ha la U Khun ïa ka khor baroh ban bishar , ba baroh kin burom ïa U Khun kumba ki burom ïa U kba .
translation.en: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga , shim khia ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , bad phin im slem .

translation.en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .

translation.en: And he said also to the people ,  When ye see a cloud rise out of the west , straightway ye say , There cometh a shower  ; and so it is .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ruh ha ki briew ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa u lyoh ba u wan mih ha ka phang sepngi , hangta hi phi ong ba kan slap — bad ka long kumta .

translation.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïakhih pyrshah , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang jong ki briew kiba shong shnong ha ka ri Judah .

translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the  Lord  sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground  ; and the  Lord  rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh shajrong , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad ïa u phria , bad ka leilieh ruh ka la tied ïa ka khyndew . U  Trai  u phah ïa u phria uba jur , lem bad ka leilieh kaba thaba .
Balei phi nyngkong ia ka kali ?
translation.en: Why do you drive the car ?
A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .

translation.en: And his servants conspired against him , and slew him in his own house .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
Ynda kita ki rangbah synshar ki la dep kriah ha uta u paidïapom , sa jied ïa ki nongïalam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynhied shipai .
translation.en: And it shall be , when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people , that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people .

translation.kha: U ong ha u Saphon , Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .

translation.kha: phi pynbang ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kai kiei baroh kba phi ni ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jong nga u long kum ka ding ka ban pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .

translation.kha: U Beraïah u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Heber Bad u Malkhiel . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa ka nongbat Birsaith . )
translation.en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .
And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side , and three on that side  ; they three were of one measure : and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side .
translation.kha: Kine ki kamra ap phira ha baroh arliang ka jaka ïaid ki long baroh katjuh ka jingheh ; bad ki kynroh baroh arliang katjuh ka jingrben .
Hynrei nga pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha ki hajar ki pateng kiba ieit ïa nga , nabar katba sum ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translation.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .

translation.kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ha man ba phi kynjai ban ïarap ïa iwei na kine kiba rit tam , phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga .’
translation.en: Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .
And wheresoever the children of men dwell , the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand , and hath made thee ruler over them all . Thou art this head of gold .
translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa phi u nongsynshar ïa baroh ka pyrthei bashongbriew bad u nongsynshar ïa baroh ki mrad bad ki sim . Phi long ka khlieh kaba da ka ksiar .

translation.en: Then said Daniel to Melzar , whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u nongap phira uba u Ashpenas u la buh ban khmih ïa u bad ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u .

La don kawei ka nongpynkhiah kaba la tymmen bha’ , ka riewkhñium kaba kyrteng ka Anna , ka khun jrong u Phanuel na ka khait Asher . Ka la shongkurim tieng hynñiew snam bad mynta ka la iap phraphew saw snem ka rta . Kam ju mih shiah na ka Templ ; mynsngi bad mynmiet ka la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba shongthait bad duwai .
translation.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .

translation.kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki leh kumba u la hukum ïa ki ;
translation.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them :

translation.kha: To bat ha ka kti jong me ïa kito ki lyngkhot dieng ar tylli bad ai ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki .
translation.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes .

translation.kha: Hynrei hato u briew uba Kham khlaiñ u tam ïaleh ïa u bad kjap ïa u , u kit noh ïa baroh ki tiar ïaleh bakha u trai u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kaei kaba u la lute .
translation.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .

translation.kha: Hangno u don ? ki la kylli . Ngam tip , u la jubab .
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Where is he ? He said , I know not .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , La don shiphew ngut ki radbah ïa kiba la pynkhiah ; shano kiwei pat ki khyndai ngut ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  Were there not ten cleansed ? but where are the nine ?
They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Ijipt kin kyllon lang bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynïap lut ïa ki .
Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh ruma u Elijah u la ainong ïa ka , badno baroh na ki , ki dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .
translation.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .
translation.kha: U la mynjur ban siew ïa ki ka bainong sngi , shi sbai rupa shi sngi , bad u la phah ïa ki ban trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ jong u .

myntan ko Amasaïah , me kob ba me la ngop ïa ki Edom , hynrei nga ai jingmut ïa me ba men shongneh ha ïing . barli me pynkhih jingkulmar ka ban shu wanrah tieng ka jingrisa ha me bad ki briew jong me ?
translation.en: Thou sayest , Lo , thou hast smitten the Edomites  ; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast : abide now at home  ; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la beh noh ïa baroh kito kiba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ sbai bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba die paro ,
U Trai , U balui ki Israel , u la smam , Ngan ym kattne lano lane ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .

translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei naba long ha U Khrist , um ïai leh bapop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïai leh pop , um pat shym la ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
translation.kha: Ki kam ba ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jingleh jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban leh ïa kano kano kaba bha .
Ngan long U Kpa jrong phira , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kyntur jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .

translation.kha: Ka shab baroh ka wan na me ; me synshar Hamor ktien kiei baroh da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka kuna jong me , bad me lah ban pynlong ïano ïano uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .
translation.en: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha la ki khun shynrang , Teh jin lem ïa ka kada jong at .
translation.en: And he spake to his sons , saying , Saddle me the ass . And they saddled him .

translation.kha: Une u briew , ki la ong , u pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki bariew ban mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !
translation.en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .

Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki la ong ,  To ngin leh ei ei shaphang u Jeremaïah ! Yn don borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei . To ngin wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u ong .

‘ Nga , U Trai nga long uba suki ban bitar , bad nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ka jingïaineh bad map ïa ka pop bad ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah . Nalorkata , Ngam pep ban pynshitom ïa ki khun bad ki ksuid haduh kaba lai badno kaba sawphew pateng namar ki pop jongnga ki kmie ki kpa jrong ki .’
translation.en: The  Lord  is longsuffering , and of great mercy , forgiving iniquity and transgression , and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym ong shikyntien umdih ha ka . Ki synran jong u ki la wan ha u bad ki la kyrpad ïa u , To phah noh ïa ka ! Ka wan bud ïa ngi bad ka pynlong ïa kane ka jingkhynwin barieh !
translation.en: But he answered her not a word . And his disciples came and besought him , saying , Send her away  ; for she crieth after us .

And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban ong , ‘ U shakri jong phi u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’   U Jakob u la pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jong u da ki jingai sngewbha , bad haba nga ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .

Ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kli lum Abednego , ha kiba ki paid Jeriel ki mane ïa ki bleithaw , yn pynïong ino . Ki shiah bad ki ñiut kin San ha ki duwan jong ki ; ki bariew kin sa pyrta ha ki lumbah , To buhrieh ïa moi ! bad ha ki loit , To Tap ïa I .
translation.en: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .
But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab , the ruler of part of Beth–haccerem  ; he built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Rekhab , u nongsynshar ïa ka Beth Hakkherem distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Synrum . U pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .

To ong ïa ki nongsiatkhnam ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon . Phah ïa baroh bakha nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh bad ïa u khnam . Kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad wat ai ba yn anna ba lait pait . syep kylliang pat ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ka la leh , bad leh ïa ka kumba ka la leh ïa Kawei , Naaman ba ka la leh da ka jingsarong pyrshah ïa per , U bakynjah ki Israel .
translation.en: Call together the archers against Babylon : all ye that bend the bow , camp against it round about  ; let none thereof escape : recompense her according to her work  ; according to all that she hath done , do unto her : for she hath been proud against the  Lord  , against the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la wang phai na ka bhah Jordan uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad la ïalum ïa u da U Mynsiem sha ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u wan khiar bad u la khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .

translation.kha: te ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki jingthain jingtep jong nga , lane to ai ba kiwei kin bam ïa ka jingbam ba nga pynmih .
translation.en: Then let me sow , and let another eat  ; yea , let my offspring be rooted out .

They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ong para ma ki ,  To ngin ym tar pynkad ïa ka , to ngin ïakynting sbai ban shem mano ba ïoh ïa ka .  Kane ka la jia khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ki la pynïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong nga hapdeng jong ki bad ki la ïakhalai ïa ka jaiñkup jong nga .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la leh .

translation.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
translation.kha: bad ha Hades , ha kaba u la don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw , u la khmih shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa u Abraham , sha jngai bah , bad ïa u Lasaros ha syndah jong u .
Kum u Manasseh u kba jong u , u la ai pop pyrshah ïa U TRAI’ , bad u la miej ïa ki bleithaw kba u kpu jong u , u la myn .
translation.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did Manasseh his father : for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made , and served them  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka nongbah jongno ka Shemaïah kin shaphang bad ïam sngewsih namar ka jingduh neh ïa u masi ksiar ha Babel . Ma ki bad kita ki lyngkhuh kba sharak ïa u bleithaw kin ïam sngewsih namar jong u . Kin sa ïam pynpang haba yn law lyngkhuit ïa ka jingthaba rong ksiar Jong u .
translation.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it , and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it , for the glory thereof , because it is departed from it .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Khie leit hiar , bad wan ïalaw pat bad me ïa u Aaron . Hynrei ki lyngdoh nabar ki bynriew kim bit ban jem ïa u pud ban wan sha ar , ïoh nga pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan da kaba bah ha ka jingïohthiah ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , bad ki la pyrshang ban rah ïa u shapoh ïingjaiñ bad ban buh ha khmat lad U Jisu .
translation.en: And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .
And thou , profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day is come , when iniquity shall have an end ,
translation.kha: Me u nongsynshar uba bymman bad bymkhuid jong ki Israel , ka sngi jong me , ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom ba kut , ka wan .
Kumta nga la kut jingmut ban ym wan Shuah sha phi ïoh ka pynjyrsieh ïa phi .
translation.en: But I determined this with myself , that I would not come again to you in heaviness .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka long namar ba U Trai u ieid ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jrong phi , bad Namar kata u la ïalam neh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u malu u la pyllait na ka jinglongmraw ïa phira na u phaloh u syiem ka Ijipt .
translation.en: But because the  Lord  loved you , and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the  Lord  brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumba u Mosah u la praw ïa u , bad u la leit baneh ïalang ïa ki Amalek , katba u Moses , u Aaron , bad u Hur ki la loit ktieh sha kliar u lum .
translation.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him , and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .

And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la jubab ,  U Blei jong ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  uba U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngim leh kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka thma .

translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha nga , ym namar ba nga kham stad ban ïa uno uno uwei pat , hynrei khnang ba u Syiem Kynrad u lah ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi bad shemphang ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba la wan ha phi .
Kaei ka jylla kaban hapoh ianga ba bun briew kam ?
translation.en: Which Indian state has the largest population ?

translation.kha: Ïa u Er , u khum nyngkong jong u , u Judah u la pynïoh ka tnga kaba kirteng ka Tamar .
translation.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .
And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian , in that he told him not that he fled .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la shukor ïa u Laban da kaba um shym la ïathuh ei ei ba u thmu ban phet noh .

translation.en: Others cast spells on their enemies to make them sick or even to kill them .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki ai ksuid ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynïap ïa ki .

Hynrei u ong ha ki , Kaei kaba to lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kiba phi la ni . woh kata ka riew eh kaba ma phi! ki paid Ephraim phi la leh ka long ka kham kor shithi eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la leh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynjar bad u shah ïa phi ban kmen ha ka jingshngain ; ka miej jong phi ka shlei da ka jingbam .

translation.en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kaba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .

Ka la ai sngewbha ïa u syiem Solomon da ki jingai kiba ka la wanrah palat saw hajar kilo ka ksiar bad shikatdei eh ki jingiwbih bad ki mawlynnai . Kato kita ki jingiwbih ba ka ai ïa u ka long kaba bun tam ba um pat ju ïoh ha kano kano ka to .
translation.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices very great store , and precious stones : there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïohipaw u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u , Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Jeruel bad me . U Trai um don sad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .
translation.en: But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .

translation.kha: Ym dei ïa u Israel , shynrang lane kynïan , ban leit long nuti ha ka jaka maïan blei .
translation.en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel , nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa ka lyer kaba khlaiñ , u la sheptieng pynlang u la sdang ba ngam shapoh um . To pynim ïa nga , A Trai ! u la pyrta .
translation.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous , he was afraid  ; and beginning to sink , he cried , saying , Lord , save me .

translation.kha: U la saw pat shapoh ïing , bun u Elisha u kylli ïa u , Shano me leit ? Ngam shym leit shano shadong , kynrad , u jingbabe .
translation.en: But he went in , and stood before his master . And Elisha said unto him , Whence comest thou , Gehazi ? And he said , Thy servant went no whither .
So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city , knit together as one man .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki rangbah ha Israel ki ïalumlang na ka bynta kawei ka jingthmu — ban tur ïaleh ïa kata ka shnong .

translation.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls , let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar : for they offered them before the  Lord  , therefore they are hallowed : and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki kylla long kiba khuid haba la wanrah ïa ki ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kumta , shim ïa ki khiew buh ding jong kita ki briew kiba la shah pynïap namar ki pop jong ki , shoh pynstang ïa ki ban shna jingtap ïa ka duwan . Kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .
To kdew ïa ka lyndang sha Seïon ! To pait ban lait im ! Wat ym pynsakma ! U Trai u wallam ka jingjot bad ka jingpynkoit katba khraw na shatei .
translation.en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .
And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , Did not ye hate me , and expel me out of my father s house ? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u jubab ,  Phi la isih ïap ïa nga kat haduh ba phi da beh ïa nga na ïing i pa . Balei phi wan sha nga mynta haba phi la shem jynjar ?
Nga la wan hiar pyndeng ki dieng Almond ban ïohi ïa ki jingthung kor ha ka them , ban ïew ïa ki sla bathymmai Halor ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki syntiew halor ki jingseisoh Pomkranet .
translation.en: Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field  ; let us lodge in the villages .

translation.kha: bad kumta ngan ïaroh ïa me , ko Trai , pyndeng ki jaitbynriew , nga Rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee , O  Lord  , among the heathen , and I will sing praises unto thy name .
But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la bat ïa u , ki da ong ,  To sah bad ngi ; ka sngi la jan kut bad ka la khreh dum .  Kumta u la leit ban sah bad ki .
U Dabid u bitar lep ïa u riewspah bun u ong , Nga sma ha U Trai kaba im ba u briew uba la leh ïa kane u dei ban ïap !
translation.en: And David s anger was greatly kindled against the man  ; and he said to Nathan , As the  Lord  liveth , the man that hath done this thing shall surely die :

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khor ba U Trai u la ai ha u Sephanaïah ha ka por ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Etam u long u syiem ka Judah . ( U Sephanaïah u la ïapyrshang na u syiem Sheshai lyngngoh u Amaraïah , u Gedalaïah , malade u Kushi . )
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah  ; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah , a land of rivers of waters .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha Gudgodah bad nangta pat sha Jotbathah , ka jaka kaba pahuh um .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw her , that he rent his clothes , and said , Alas , my daughter ! thou hast brought me very low , and thou art one of them that trouble me : for I have opened my mouth unto the  Lord  , and I cannot go back .
translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa ka , u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih bad u ong ,  Waw , ko khun ! Phi la pynpait ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Balei ba yn dei da ma phi kaba pynpang ïa nga ? Nga la ai ïa ka jingkular bakyntang ha U  Trai  , bad ngam lah ban kylla pat ïa la ka kular !

translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong ,  Ma u da lade hi u la shim ïa ki jingshitom jong ngi bad u la bah noh ïa ki jingpang jong ngi .

kamut u syiem Asa u skhem lut ïa ka rupa bad ka ksah barabor kiba tang sah ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ban rah ha la ki rangbah synshar sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , u khun jong u Tabrimmon bad u ksiew jyllang u Hesion , lem bad kane ka khubor :
translation.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and delivered them into the hand of his servants : and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad , the son of Tabrimon , the son of Hezion , king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,

translation.kha: ka Mejarkon , bad ka Rakkon , kumjuh jin ka jaka sawdong ka Joah .
translation.en: And Me–jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border before Japho .
For they have made ready their heart like an oven , whiles they lie in wait : their baker sleepeth all the night  ; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ki khluit kum ka tyndur da ki jingïasylla jong ki . Baroh shi miet , ka jingbitar jong ki ka nang ing , bad mynstep ka mih kynsan kum ki thylliej ding .
U la shim ïa uwei na ka longïing jong u syiem , u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bun u , bad u la pynlong ïa u ban smai baneh long uba ïaineh skhem . U la rah koidi ïa ki rangbah badonkam
translation.en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Kam pher kumno ki nongaplangbrot ki kynhied bad ki pyrta , kim lah ban pyntieng ïa u rang ba un phet na ka jingri ba u la pynïap ; ha kajuh ka rukom , ym don kano kano kaba lah ban khang ïa nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh na kaba ïada ïa u Lum Seïon .
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .

translation.kha: ïa Kinah hima ki jingbuhbeit rynsan na ka bynta ki bani Jerusalem’ ban bud ha ka ri kambah u mut ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,
Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Joseph , bad mar kumta la wan sei ïa u na ka ïingbyndi . Ynda u la dep khi tmain bad bujli jaiñ , u leit ha khmat u syiem .
U Rephaïah , u khun jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shit jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei! u kun ïa kaba dei haba u bishar ïa ki bhabriew kba leh ïa kiei kiei kum kine .
translation.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things .

translation.kha: Phi la ïoh kumno U Trai u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki nong jingtep , lema bad ki Kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jrop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh nadien jong Phi .
translation.en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;

translation.kha: Bad kumta naduh mynta hi , yn ym don shuh u dieng , kam pher katno la ai um Bha ïa u , un jrong pud sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la ka kliar lyngba ki lyoh bad u ban kot kat kato ka rynïeng . Ïa ki baroh la buh ban ïap kamon ïa baroh ki biria ba dei ban ïa-ïap , la buh ba kin ïasoh bad kito kaba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa barhem kiba rit mynsiem , To long khleiñ bad Wat sheptieng ! U Blei un wan ban pynkoit ïa phi , un wan ban pynshitom ïa ki nongshun lad phi .
translation.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart , Be strong , fear not : behold , your God will come with vengeance , even God with a recompence  ; he will come and save you .
Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof : and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .
translation.kha: Kaba kut jong kaei kaei ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsdang jong ka . Ka jingïaishah ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsarong .
Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew umbah mih ktem bad ka donburom kob mawkyntang ki shin kynsan bad ïaid napdeng ngi ki lyngkhot doh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .

translation.kha: Man ka snem ki kmie ki kjap jongki U Jisu ki leit shaei Jeremaïah na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .
translation.kha: Kiba la ïa-ïeng ha syndah ka diengphna U Jisu ki la long ka kmie jong u , ka para jong ka kmie jong u , ka Mari ka tnga u Kleopas , bad ka Mari ka nong Magdala .

translation.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .
translation.kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah harum , ngam ïaroh ïa phi , namar ki jingïaseng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ban ïa kaba pynbha .
Lada nga la kum shkor ïa u khunswet , da Kaba tip ba ngan ksai ha khmat ka nongbishar ,
translation.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ïa kaba la rakhe da uno uno na ki syiem Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynba ki nongbishar ki synshar ïa ka ri .
Lada jliah ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dien ne ha khyndew lem bad ïa ka sim kmierad kaba pdem ïa ki pyllew lane kaba kput ïa la ki Kynhun , drama dei ban kem ïa ka Da kmie .
translation.en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :

translation.kha: Ho-oid , u dabi u jubab , NGA la shahjingit bad ïam kaba i dang im . Nga la pyrkhat ba U Trai lehse un sngewsynei ïa nga sad un ym shah ba i khunblang in ïap .
translation.en: And he said , While the child was yet alive , I fasted and wept : for I said , Who can tell whether  God  will be gracious to me , that the child may live ?
That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias , whom ye slew between the temple and the altar .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki rangbah balui lui kan hap halor jong phi , naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel balui lui haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sakharaïah u khun jong u Berakhaïah , ïa uba phi la pynïap hapdeng ka Templ bad ka duwan .

translation.en: And , behold , six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand  ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hynriew ngut ki briew ki wan na ka khyrdop kaba shabar kaba don shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , uwei uwei u rah la ka tiar ïaleh . Ryngkat bad ki la don u briew uba kup da ki jaiñ linen , uba rah ki tiar ban thoh . Baroh ki wan bad ïeng hajan ka duwan kaba da ka rnong .

translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .

translation.en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .

translation.en: And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :

translation.en: Rather , he told his disciples to memorialize , or remember , his death .

translation.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth , that he might eat the increase of the fields  ; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock , and oil out of the flinty rock  ;

translation.kha: U kñi jong u Saul u ïohi ïa u bad ïa uta u shakri , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïajah shano ?   Ngi ïaleit wad ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ynda ngim lap ïa ki , ngi leit sha u Samuel .

translation.en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .

translation.kha: Ki nuti dara ki kynteit lyngkar ki long ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .

translation.en: Be not wroth very sore , O  Lord  , neither remember iniquity for ever : behold , see , we beseech thee , we are all thy people .

translation.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .

translation.en: And Samuel said , When thou wast little in thine own sight , wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel , and the  Lord  anointed thee king over Israel ?

translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u trai u la bthah ïa la u sordar , ‘ To khot ïa ki nongtrei bad siew ïa ka bainong jong ki , sdang na kito kiba la shah khot bylla khatduh bad pynkut ha kito kiba la shah khot bylla nyngkong .’
Mynta ngi lah ban ieit ïa U Balei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi ainguh ïa u na ka bynta ka jingkmen kaba i don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u namar jong phi .
translation.en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;

translation.en: But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?

translation.kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jong u syiem u la ong ha u Elisha ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  U Elisha u jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

translation.en: And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .

translation.kha: Ynda phi ïap , ki sim nabar ki mrad kin bam ïa ki thap jong phi , bad yn ym don ba leit beh ïa ki .
translation.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air , and unto the beasts of the earth , and no man shall fray them away .
And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka dei u Jakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long noh U Israel .  Kumta U Blei u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Israel .

translation.en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ngam lah leh ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad me . To ngin ïakynton ïa ki maw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïateh kular jong ngi .
“Wat ki hynmen ki para jong u briew uba duk kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don paralok . Tam peh katno u pyrshang tyngeh , um lah ban ïoh paralok .
translation.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .

translation.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the  Lord  in Jerusalem , but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .

translation.en: Saying , Touch not mine anointed , and do my prophets no harm .

translation.en: But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?

translation.en: And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .

translation.en: O  Lord  our God , other lords beside thee have had dominion over us : but by thee only will we make mention of thy name .

translation.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us ; because we thus judge , that if one died for all , then were all dead :

translation.kha: u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .

translation.en: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , saith the Lord  God .

dara u Ahio u ïaid na khmat .

translation.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .

translation.en: Will you come with me ?

translation.en: Then said the king unto her , What wilt thou , queen Esther ? and what is thy request ? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom .

translation.en: Then Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , was astonished for one hour , and his thoughts troubled him . Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang ym dei ban thied pat ; ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , bad dei ban kñia ïa ki . translation.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .

translation.kha: Man ka sngi nga la don bad phi ban hikai ha ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga . Hynrei ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki dei ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: Yea also , because he transgresseth by wine , he is a proud man , neither keepeth at home , who enlargeth his desire as hell , and is as death , and cannot be satisfied , but gathereth unto him all nations , and heapeth unto him all people :
translation.kha: Ka spah ka long kaba shukor . Ki briew kiba lalot ki long kiba sarong bad bym lah ban shong khop — kum ka jingïap hi da lei lei kim ju hun . Namarkata ki jop ïa kawei ka hima hadien kawei pat na ka bynta ïa lade .
Naba don Shion , khamtam bakha la kylla na ka niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiwei da ka jingsuk bym ei jingmad jong ki .
translation.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,
translation.kha: Lada ngan jin da la ïap ha kata ka por , ngan jin da la don ha ka jingjahthait mynta ,

badno nangta ngan wanpaw ïalam paw ïa ki rangbah jong u baher sha phi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba wan phai sha la u jong u tnga . Phin kwah ban pynïap tang ïa imat u briew ; kiba law na ki paidbah kin lait im .
translation.en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .

translation.kha: hynrei un wanlam jingjahburom ïa kito kiba isih ïa me , malu ki ïing ki riewbymman kin jah noh .
translation.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame  ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
These things have I spoken unto you , that ye should not be offended .
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , khnang ba phin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi .

Ïa uta u masi lyngraw malade ïa uta langsohmoh ïa uba la kñia kum ka jingkñia namar ka thup , bad ïa kiba ka snam jongno ki la leit rem sha ka Jaka Kiba Khuid Tam ban weng noh ïa ka pop , dei ba-bang leit rah shab ka khak shong dara bad thang ïa ki hangta . Ïa ka snieh , ka doh , bad ki snier jong ki ruh dei ban thang lang hangta .
translation.en: And the bullock for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp  ; and they shall burn in the fire their skins , and their flesh , and their dung .
( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )
translation.kha: Naba da ka bor U Blei la pynlong ïa nga u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kumba ïa u Petros la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .
Ki briew naba shang ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synreit ïa u ; kumta ka kynhun ka lama kaba Bun .
translation.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .

translation.kha: Kumta u Hushai , u paralok lad u Arbad , u la wait pei sha ka nongbah tun ba u Asahel u dang wan poi .
translation.en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .
For unto us was the gospel preached , as well as unto them : but the word preached did not profit them , not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .
translation.kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka Khubor Babha , kumba ma ki ruh ki la ïohsngew . Ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ruh ïa ki , namar haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , kim shym la pdiang ïa ka da ka jingngeit .
hynñiew U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah lad ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .

translation.kha: Hynrei to wat kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla ha ka tap ; namar haba ki jingkwah ka dih jong ki ban shongkurim , ki phan noh na U Khrist , bad kumta ki don ka jingpynrem ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingtehkular bad u kaba mynshuwa .
translation.en: Having damnation , because they have cast off their first faith .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ma nga , u Nebukhadnessar , nga ïaroh , nga pyndon burom , bad nga ai burom ïa U syiem jong ka Bneng . khie kaei baroh kaba u leh ka long kaba daiñ bad kaba khoh , bad u lah ïa-ban pynhiar ïa uno uno uba leh sorkar .
translation.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven , all whose works are truth , and his ways judgment : and those that walk in pride he is able to abase .

translation.kha: Lada u sait ïa kata bad ka jingpyut ka da-ei noh , u daym shun sait biang ïa ka sa shisien , bad lai sa long kaba khuid .
translation.en: And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .

translation.kha: Ken ka dei ka seng jong ki briew Kiba shakri ïa U Blei da la ka mon jingsngewbha , ka bym ne jingïohnong eiei bad ka Don ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: This is an international , nonprofit religious organization of people who willingly serve God .

And he dealt among all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , as well to the women as men , to every one a cake of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house .
translation.kha: bad u sam jingbam sha ki baroh . U ai ha uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel mar uwei u kpu , shi lyngkhot ka doh syang , bad katto katne ki soh kismis . Nangta baroh ki la leit phai sha ïing .
Ki Briew kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbit kin ïoh im , ishyrkhei kito ki bym pdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka jingma .
translation.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .
translation.kha: Ngi itynnat ïa ka jingkhlaiñ ka jinglong samla bad ngi burom ïa u ñiuhlieh ka jinglong tymmen .

translation.en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .
translation.kha: Kan leit hangta ha ka por janmiet , bad ha ka step babud yn ïalam ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad yn buh hapoh ka jingpeit jong u Shaashgas , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u syiem . Kan ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewtynnat eh ïa ka ba un phah khot ïa ka da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

Ha Katai ka khyllipmat hi la jia ka jingkheiñ jumai kaba jur ; shi bynta na ka shipai boitha jong ka nongbeh la pynjot , pynlang hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïahap . Kita kiwei pat ki brisoh ki la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .
translation.en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .

translation.kha: Pi de shun pynlut ha ka rukom kaba de ïa kane ka pisa bad ban thied ki masi kthong , ki khunlangbrot shynrang , ki khunblang , u kew bad ka waiñ bad shun ainguh ïa ki ha ka duwan jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kin shnong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha u sharai jong por u Jakob , ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki sheng ki sah . Kin shong junom hangta , bad kumta ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh naba hiarpateng na ki . U syiem Uba kum u shakri jong nga , u Dedan un synrai halor jong ki junom .
translation.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .

translation.kha: U khohram u la khong lai ngut ki khun shaneng : u Sisera , u Elkanah , bad u Abiasaph ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jongu ka jait Korah .
translation.en: And the sons of Korah  ; Assir , and Elkanah , and Abiasaph : these are the families of the Korhites .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un eh ka brup bakhraw .
translation.en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .

translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa Aner kba sarong ; u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah baskhem ha kaba ki shong , bad u pynlong ba ki kynroh jong ka kin ïapra bad hap sha tbian .
translation.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high  ; the lofty city , he layeth it low  ; he layeth it low , even to the ground  ; he bringeth it even to the dust .
Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jong phi kin pynkhreh ban treikam . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kaba yn sa ai ha phi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .

U la phah ïa ka khubor sha kamai pa kaweh ka ijli jong u syiem ha ka ktien Bad ka rukom thoh jongnga kata ka probins , kaba ong ba uwei pa uwei u tnad u long u kynrad jong ka ïing jong u bad kaba u kren kan long ka ba kaban kut .
translation.en: For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Hosia , Pynkyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Amam ,’ namar ki briew ka Jesreel kim dei ki briew jongno la , bad nam long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .

translation.kha: Nangta u la thaw ka jingnguh ïa U Trai bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U Trai u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , dara ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .
translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .

translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong eh u la shongkurim badno u la ïapom khlup to khun .
translation.en: Now there were seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and dying left no seed .

translation.kha: Balei ba nga sngewsyiad haduh katta katta ? Balei ba nga sngur jynjar sieh ? Ngan buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong to ha U Blei , bad sa shisien pat ngan ïaroh ïa u , U nongpynim jong to bad U Blei jngai nga .
translation.en: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me ? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him , who is the health of my countenance , and my God .

translation.kha: To badonkam malu ka Jerusalem ; to lehkmen na ka bynta jong ka , phi barben kiba ainguh ïa ken ka nongbet ! To shad bad ka , mynta phi barieh kiba la ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong ka !
translation.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :

translation.kha: Ngam lah shah shuh , per dei ban kren .
translation.en: I will speak , that I may be refreshed : I will open my lips and answer .

And when the men of Ai looked behind them , they saw , and , behold , the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven , and they had no power to flee this way or that way : and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki phai shadien , ki ïohi ïa ka tdem kaba kiew sha suiñbneng . Ym don lad shuh ba kin lait im , naba ki Israel kiba la phet sha ka jaka bashrah mynta ki phai kylla ban ïaleh ïa ki .
Naaman ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dinah ka prie jongngi ki , ki khun shynrang jrong u Jakob ki la phai ktien ïa u Shekhem bad u Hamor u kpa jong u da ka buit shukor .
translation.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :

translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar nep na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynmlien ïa lade ïa ka jingim riewkynthei .
translation.en: But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .
translation.kha: Em , ha kine baroh ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop baroh lyngba jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!
U la bthuh ka nga kaba dih ïa khie kaei baroh . U la ai ha im ka jingkyang ngab tip ïa ka lawei , hynrei um ju ai ha ngi ka jinghun ban sngewthuh lut ïa kaei kaweh u leh .
translation.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .

translation.kha: Nalor kata , hato ki wah Abana bad Pharpar kiba ha Demas kim kham bha ban ïa kano kano ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban synrum ha ki bad baneh ïohkhiah !
translation.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa kine nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba ju leh ha ka sngi sneng jong u bnai lem bad ka jingainguh bam jong ka , bad ïa ka jingtieng thang kaba man ka sngi lem malade ka jingsuh bam mala ka jingainguh waiñ jrong ka . Keiñ ki jingainguh bam ki long ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month , and his meat offering , and the daily burnt offering , and his meat offering , and their drink offerings , according unto their manner , for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U buh ka to ban ngeit bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka nga ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh nangta ! Phet ban lait im na ka jingbitar shla jong per .
translation.en: My people , go ye out of the midst of her , and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the  Lord .
For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u smai , u pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong uno uno uba kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ka jingsmai ka pynbeit ïa baroh ki jingïatainia .

Bad kumno ïa ka khubor lah ban pynbna lada ïa ki nongrah-khubor ym shym la pah ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Katno ka un-long kaba phylla ka jingkhwan jong ki nongrah-khubor kiba wallam ïa ka kyrhuh babha !
translation.en: And how shall they preach , except they be sent ? as it is written , How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace , and bring glad tidings of good things !
And David said unto Saul , Thy servant kept his father s sheep , and there came a lion , and a bear , and took a lamb out of the flock :
translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  u Dabid u ong ,  Nga la ju sharai ïa ki langbrot i pa jong nga . Man ba u sing lane ka dngiem ki wan rong ïa u khunlangbrot ,
U thri u la ong ruh ha nga , ‘ Nga tip ba kine ki briew ki erlangthari kiba mutlop pait .
translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  spake unto me , saying , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la set ïa la ka turoi . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi la shoh , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynshet jongngi u bajanai , bad shi bynta na ka lai bna jong ki khlur , ba ka jingai jong ki ka la jah nong shai bynta na ka lai bynta ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shym la don jingshai ha ka shu bynta na ka lai pyntwa jong ka sngi bad ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka moramot .
translation.en: And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .

translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba ha Atad , kob sha jingkhie na ka Jordan , ki ïapynlong Hangta ïa ka jingbymngeit kaba jur bad kaba kthang mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndap ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .

translation.kha: U Phestos u la sah sa phra ne shiphew sngi lem sad ki bad nangta u la otsher sha Asaraïah . Ha ka sngaid kaba bud u la shon ha ka kamra bishar bad u la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Caesarea  ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .
translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; kim lah wat ban pynhiar mynsiem .
Kynsan kynsan bad khlem nang pyrkhat U Trai’ Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki erïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki erlangthari bad ka ding baklang ;
translation.en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .

translation.kha: Nga la noh mynsiem bad shitom pung bad sngi . Hadien Kata na la khie bad kitei patiaw sha ka kam kaba u syiem u la ai ha nga , hynrei sa la shaïong da ka jingïohipaw bad ngam da ban shemphang ïa ka .
translation.en: And I Daniel fainted , and was sick certain days  ; afterward I rose up , and did the king s business  ; and I was astonished at the vision , but none understood it .

translation.kha: U la dei U Jisu , umbiah hiarpateng na u ïabuaid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u la lah kular .
translation.en: Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa u bad kiba leh ïa kaba dei ki long kiba la pdiang sngewbha da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .
Kumno phi wiang ?
translation.en: How did you come ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïong , Ka jer kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kulmar kaba nga la pynlong bad ki paid Jerusalem’ bad Jehoïada .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .

translation.kha: Hadien dat , hajan u Dabid u la leit sha ïing ban khublei ïa la ki ba-ima , ka Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u . U syiem ki Israel u la pynkhraw nam ïa lade ha kane ka sngi ! ka ong . U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade kum u ibieit ha Khmut ki shakri kynthei jong ki rangïapom synshar jong u .
translation.en: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !
Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .
translation.kha: Phi kwah ei ei , hynrei phim ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi pynïap ; phi da kwah eh , hynrei phim lah ban ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi ïania bad phi ïaleh thma . Phim ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah , namar ba phim pan na U Blei ïa ka .

Nga , U Trai , nga la khot nabar ai bor ïa phi , ban khmih ba ka jingbishar hok la pyndep ha pyrthei . lyngngun jyllang phi ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bad ki bariew baroh ; lyngba jong phi ngan wanrah ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: I the  Lord  have called thee in righteousness , and will hold thine hand , and will keep thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , for a light of the Gentiles  ;

translation.kha: Da ïaid ha ki lynti bakha beit , khnang ba ïa “kata ka mait kaba dkoh yn ym pynduhbor noh , hynrei pynban , yn pynkoit ken ïa ka .
translation.en: And make straight paths for your feet , lest that which is lame be turned out of the way  ; but let it rather be healed .

translation.kha: haba u hiarthma ïa kito ki ri baroh , kad ïa ka Ijipt mad yn ym ieh .
translation.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries : and the land of Egypt shall not escape .

translation.kha: nabar ïa ka jingpynshitom kob ngan wallam ha Jerusalem kan nym wan haduh hadien ka jingïap jongu phi . Neng shuh ïa phi ban ïap ha kaba suk . Ki rangbah ki leit phai pud sha u syiem Josaïah bad khnai ka khubor .
translation.en: Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .

translation.kha: Ki la teh ïa u ha ki kynjri , ki la ïalam ïa u , dara ki la pait ïa u ha u Pilat , u lyngskor ka hima Rom .
translation.en: And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .

translation.kha: Ïateh pateng ha ki khup ki ksiew jong phi shaphang kata ka sngur ba phi ïeng ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi ha u Lum sianti , mynba u ong ha por , ‘ Lumlang ïa u paidbah . Nga kwah ba kin ïohsngew aïu ngan ong , ba kumta ktien tiengburom ïa nga katba ki dang im dara ba kin hikai ïa la ki khun ki kti ban leh kumjuh .’
translation.en: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the  Lord  thy God in Horeb , when the  Lord  said unto me , Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .

translation.kha: nangta kat katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka lawbah ki la wan shaw U Jehu na Jerusalem bad ki la kylli ïa u ,
translation.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip ,  Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong bad u la ïohi ba u paidbah byllien u la nang wan sha u , kumta u la ong ha u Philip ,  Nangno ngi lah ban thied jingbam ka ban dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew baroh ?
nangta ki leit rem ïa ka sha ka templ u blei jong ki , u Dagon , bad ki buh ïa ka ha syndah u mot jrong u .
translation.en: When the Philistines took the ark of God , they brought it into the house of Dagon , and set it by Dagon .

translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki : Mynta ngan ai ïa phi u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , bad phin long kiba la sngewhun . Kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym ñiewbeiñ shuh ïa phi .
translation.en: Yea , the  Lord  will answer and say unto his people , Behold , I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith : and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :
Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim jong nga kaba lyngkot ha ka pyrthei , nga thaw ki jingrwai shaphang ki hukum jong me .
Ki shiah bad shiah buid kan mih ha baroh ki ïingsyiem pynlang ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , dara ki myrsiang bad ki dkhoh kin shongduh ha ki .
translation.en: And thorns shall come up in her palaces , nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof : and it shall be an habitation of dragons , and a court for owls .

translation.kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah : Nga la ju ban pynkhia ïa ka bneng sad ka khyndew
translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;

translation.kha: ngan ai ba yn uta ïaleh ïa ki nongkhap kiba ïadait ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai Tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Baal Meon , Bad ka Kiriathaim .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,

translation.kha: Lada um pyndep ïa kino ki kamram ha ka , u Dei ban ïapyllait ino ïa ka khlem da siew ei ei .
translation.en: And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .
But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki paid ka Judah ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .
U syiem u ong ha u Joseph , U Balei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane borbah , kumta ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,
translation.kha: Nga la kylli ,  Sa katno kan long kumne , ko  Trai  ?  U la jubab ,  Tad haduh ba ki nongbah kin jot kin pra bad long thylli — tad haduh ba ki ïing kin long ïingjah — tad haduh ba ka ri hi kan long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .

bad khlur-kba bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jongno per , kada ïa ki jaiñ jong phi bad ïam , haba phi ïohsngew kumno nga byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem malu ki briew jong ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba ishyrkhei ban peit , ka jaka ha kaba ïa ka Kyrteng jong ka , ki briew kin pyndonkam kum ka jingtim . hynrei sa la jingïohknieh ïa ka jingdie jongngi phi ,
translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the  Lord  , when thou heardest what I spake against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and hast rent thy clothes , and wept before me  ; I also have heard thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la rung lyntang ki thliew jong ki jaka ïada jong nga bad ki wan ïuh beit nalor jong de ;
translation.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters : in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .

translation.kha: ka Ainias , ka Juttah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , lem bad ki pynsat phlang jongki ki : khyndai tylli ki shngain na ki jait Judah pynlang Simeon .
translation.en: And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs  ; nine cities out of those two tribes .

translation.kha: Ka nam jngai me kan khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U Trai Badonbor baroh u long U Blei ha Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee .

translation.kha: Ko ba-ieit jong nga , phi longïing kaba bhabriew kum ka Jerusalem , kaba ieid kum ka nongbet Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem khem kine ki nongbah bakhraw .
translation.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .

translation.kha: Lada ngi la ïoh shuwa ïa latai , ngin ym thap Hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei .
translation.en: For if we would judge ourselves , we should not be judged .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit thnam wat la mynnin nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga eh ba longïing uba shlur ha ka jingrang shaneng ka gospel kumba nga dei .
translation.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .

translation.kha: Phira la ïohi kumno u maw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mynshem mano ba ktah ïa u bad kumno u la shoh ïa ka ïapbriew kaba la shna da ka nar , ka rmiang , ka dewbyrtha , ka rupa bad ka ksiar . U Blei uba khraw u ïatih ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban sa jia ha ka lawei . Nga la ïathuh thik ïa kaei kaba phi la phohsniew pynlang nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jingmut bashisha .
translation.en: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands , and that it brake in pieces the iron , the brass , the clay , the silver , and the gold  ; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter : and the dream is certain , and the interpretation thereof sure .

translation.kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi tang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jied long kumta .
