translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki skhem ha lade ; ki bymman ki shu leh mynleh katba ki lah .
translation.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face : but as for the upright , he directeth his way .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , Pha long kaba la tim ! ‘Kaba la tim ! Pha la leh ïa kata kaban sniew baroh , malade nangta
translation.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness , ( woe , woe unto thee ! saith the Lord  God   ; )

translation.kha: Ktah ïa u shisien bad men ym pyrshang shuh da lin law ; men ym kheit da lin lei ïa ka jingïaleh !
translation.en: Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .
Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
translation.kha: To duwai ha U  Trai  ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donkam ban dang sah shuh hangne .

translation.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God  ; every precious stone was thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold : the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .
translation.kha: Me la shong ha Eden , ka kper jong U Blei , bad me deng ïa ki mawlynnai ba bun jait : ki Rubi bad ki Diamond ; u Topas , u Beryl , u Karnelian bad u Jasper ; ki Sapphir , ki Emerald , bad ki Garnet . Me don ki jingdeng da ka ksiar . Ïa ki la shna na ka bynta jong me ha ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me .

U Trai , U Blei ki Ishmael , u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeremaïah , ki briew ki ïa-ong ba ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong u syiem ka Babilonia . myntor , to shahshkor ïa kaei de kaba nga don ban ino .
translation.en: And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;
And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ruh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki briew kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbha jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa baroh kiwei pat .
Kine ki briew kim ba-don ka jingshemphang , hynrei nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jrong me .
translation.en: Their heart is as fat as grease  ; but I delight in thy law .

translation.kha: Me tip lwait ïa barabor kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , dara Laish , ki jingpynshitom bashyrkhei katba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u Trai u la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .
translation.en: Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa thlim jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing sahmiet Khaldi . Ïa ka Thep la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u de don ïap tieng shisien , bad hadien kata yn bishar da U Blei .
translation.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :
But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan thang ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka ding , bad kan bam duh ïa baroh kat kaba don sawdong jong ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Ladan phi thrang ban ai , U Bela un pdiang ïa ka jingai jong phira ha ka nongrit jong kaei kaba phira dei banbeiñ ai , ym halor kaei kaban phim don .
translation.en: For if there be first a willing mind , it is accepted according to that a man hath , and not according to that he hath not .
His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .
translation.kha: Haba kin ïap , kin leit phai pat sha ka khyndew ; ha kata ka sngi baroh ki jingthmu jong ki kin sa kut noh .
Hadad ba la buh jingkheiñ katno ka dei , ki aiti ïa ka rupa ha ki pynbah kiba dei peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , bad kine ki siew thar ïa ki misteri , ki nongthain jingtei ,
translation.en: And they gave the money , being told , into the hands of them that did the work , that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders , that wrought upon the house of the  Lord  ,

translation.kha: Akeldama ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jrong u bnai uba hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka jingïarwai niam ha kaba ai burom ïa U Trai hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat ba-thurmur kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :

And I will bring the third part through the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will try them as gold is tried : they shall call on my name , and I will hear them : I will say , It is my people : and they shall say , The  Lord  is my God .
translation.kha: Bad ngan tynjuh ïa ka bynta kaba lai kaba dang lait im bad ngan pynkhuid ïa ki kumba phrang ïa ka rupa da ka ding . Ngan tynjuh ïa ki kumba la ju tynjuh ïa ka ksiar . Nangta kin duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa ki . Ngan ïathuh ïa ki ba ki long ki briew jong nga , bad kin phla ba nga long U Blei jong ki .
Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang Ban pynring ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki tieng sohwaiñ jong phi kin dap da ki sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ïa u Doeg ,  Ma me , pynïap ïa ki !  — bad u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki baroh . Ha kata ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san ngut ki lyngdoh kiba bit ban phong ïa ka ephod .
U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban sa ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad Phin , kata , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tylli ki pynkynmaw .
translation.en: And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei na kine ki khynnah rit , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ym tang ïa nga hynrei ïa uta ruh uba la phah ïa nga .

Kumta ki paidbah ki sangeh noh ban mane ha ka Templ jongngi U Terah , U Blei jong ki kjap tymmen jyllang ki , bad ki sdang ban mane ïa ki bleithaw Bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah . Ka jingrem jong ki namar kine ki Pop ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U Trai ba-halor ka ha Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And they left the house of the  Lord  God of their fathers , and served groves and idols : and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass .

translation.kha: Katba ang dang plied , la sop ïa ki shyieng da ki thret , bad ka dohksah , bad ngat da ka sngewthait . Khynñiuh ym don jingpynhiar mynsiem ha kita ki met .
translation.en: And when I beheld , lo , the sinews and the flesh came up upon them , and the skin covered them above : but there was no breath in them .

translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u la ïaboi , bad U Trai u phuh ïa u pyrthat Bad u slap ha katai ka sngi . Te uta u bajaipdeh barhem u la bthing ïa U Trai bad ïa u Samuel ,
translation.en: So Samuel called unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  sent thunder and rain that day : and all the people greatly feared the  Lord  and Samuel .
Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .
translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
Hadien katto katne por ka Naamah ka ong ha ka Ruth , “Nga dei ban shem u tnga na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ba phin don la ka lad ka longïing .
translation.en: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her , My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee , that it may be well with thee ?

translation.kha: U Trai un phar ïa ka jaitbynriew na kaban kut ka pyrthei byrsha ïa phi , ka jaitbynriew kaba ka ktieh ka thylliej jong ka phin ym sngewthuh . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kamra suhjer u pukri .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;
And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u la dep kata ka jingïashad shongshit bad ka jingrisa , u leit kiew sha ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum .

Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban ter ïa la ka kam , hawei kynram ba ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka Sabbaton , ka dei ka sngur shongthait . Ha dat ka sngi , wat trei ei ei . Ka Sabbaton ka un-long ka jongu U Trai , ha ki ïing jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Six days shall work be done : but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest , an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no work therein : it is the sabbath of the  Lord  in all your dwellings .

translation.kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long Ibbah khlaiñ bad ki san ïa-ban long u diengsoh ba kynja shym . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh ban katto ïa ki lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh kat u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .
translation.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .

translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u kdew ïa ka khet u dab u kpa jongki u ïa kaba U Blei U Trai u la seng . U la long u sahmiet kiba jop , malu ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la khunlung ïa u .
translation.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .
Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
translation.kha: Ong ruh ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki kali na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun rit jong ki , bad ban wan ïalam ïa u kpa jong phi bad ki .
Hynrei ïa ki Israel la pynim da U Trai , bad ka jingjop jong u ka neh junom ; ki bariew jong ka kin ym jahburom .’
translation.en: But Israel shall be saved in the  Lord  with an everlasting salvation : ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end .
A man s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng kan wanrah ïa ka jinghap jong phi , hynrei lada phi long kiba sngewrit , yn burom ïa phi .
ba ba-don ki riewbymman napdeng jong phi kiba la ïalam bakla ïa la ki para shnong para thaw ba mane ïa ki Blei katba phim ju mane mynno mynno .
translation.en: Certain men , the children of Belial , are gone out from among you , and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which ye have not known  ;
And it came to pass , as he interpreted to us , so it was  ; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei ki la urlong kumba u la ong : Phi la buh biang ïa nga ha kajuh ka kyrdan , hynrei phi la pynïap noh ïa u nongshet kpu .

translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .
translation.kha: To map ïa ka pop jong u syiem bad jong ki paid Israel . Hikai ïa ki ban leh ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A  Trai  to phah ïa u slap ha kane ka ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ai ha la ki jong ki briew kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .

translation.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Simon bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit wad ïa u ,
bad ong ha u Samuel , To ïai duwai ha U Trai U blang jong im’ ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Yn sa sien ma u .
translation.en: He will go .

translation.kha: U Solomon u jingjubab , Me ju ïa pynkup ka jingneit bakhraw ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga , bad mynta ba me la shah ïa nga don lama syiem hadien jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .

translation.kha: Waw ju pynhiarkput , ko ki paralok jong nga , hynrei pynban , to ai ba ka jingaibor jong U Blei kan leh ïa kata . Namar ka Jingiathuh bakhiah ka Ong , Ngan pynkupbor , kun sawphew kylliang , ong U Tharai .
translation.en: Dearly beloved , avenge not yourselves , but rather give place unto wrath : for it is written , Vengeance is mine ; I will repay , saith the Lord .

translation.kha: Ki briew naba bajar kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kin dum mad ka jingjahburom .
translation.en: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbah Uba burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . phin shukor ïa ki nongwei bad shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki sngwthuh .
translation.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .

translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker kan long sien mitar ka lyntait bad hynriewphew hynriew syiar ka pyngkiang ,
translation.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board , and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board .

And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem ,  Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura halor ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .

Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shadem bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kiba kyrpang ha U Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moserah u la leh ïa keiñ khie baroh kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Ujuh u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synran jongno u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros . Khlieh noh na nga , me u Soitan , u la nguh . Ki jingpyrkhat jongnga me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !
translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .

translation.kha: U Ïoanna u la kren , Ko Kynrad , ine la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh nep ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyr-ang lad me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ba sangeh , namar um syiem long u jong ka kynha jong i'u .
translation.en: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .
And many more believed because of his own word  ;
translation.kha: Bun kiwei ki la ngeit namar ka khubor jong u bad ki la ong ha kata ka briew ,

translation.en: The  Lord  God of heaven , which took me from my father s house , and from the land of my kindred , and which spake unto me , and that sware unto me , saying , Unto thy seed will I give this land  ; he shall send his angel before thee , and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng , u la ïalam noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga bad na ka ri ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad u la kular skhem ha nga ba un ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Un phah ïa u angel jong u ha shuwa jong me , ba me lah ban pynïoh hangta ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga .
U kñia Nepheg ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shiah lehhok arphew khadar tylli ki langbrot kumno ki jingangnud ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u sad uta u paidlang baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .
And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .
translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit bad u la thoh ,  Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ïoannis .  A katno baroh ki la ïasngew kyndit !

translation.en: And they mourned , and wept , and fasted until even , for Saul , and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the  Lord  , and for the house of Israel  ; because they were fallen by the sword .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewsih kthang , ki ïambriew , bad ki la shahjingit haduh janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan bad na ka bynta ki Israel , ki briew jong U  Trai  , namar bun bah ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma .

U la ïohi ba Pha kuna ïa kiew ktien kiba u isih . U la ïohi ba pha bud ïa ki phai thala khlur ki lum bad ki lyngkha , kumin u biria uba threw jakhlia ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong u lane kum u kulai ïa ka kulai . Ko ki bynriew jyllang ka Jerusalem , phi long kiba la tim ! Hangno phin ïoh longkmie uba Khuid ?
translation.en: I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi shem ïa ki blei jong phi ha Un uno hangne , iathuh un shah pynïap . Hangne , lem Bad ki briew jong ngi koum ki sakhi , peit ïa kano kano ka thir kaba dadien ka jong phi bad shim ïa kaba dei ka jong phi . U Jakob um shym tip ba ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing jngai u Laban .
translation.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me , and take it to thee . For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them .

translation.kha: Kumta hawei ba ki la mihnoh na u Lum synran , ki Israel kim deng jingdeng shiah .
translation.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .

translation.kha: Baroh kine ki phai ki long ki bymlarkam ; Kim lah ban kun ei ei ruh em — Kine ki blei ki un-long bakha tlot bad ki bymdonbor .
translation.en: Behold , they are all vanity  ; their works are nothing : their molten images are wind and confusion .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar , Namar ym anna ka bor khlem ka jingaibor jong U Blei , bad ïa ki bor synriah Kiba don mynta la bthuh hangta da U Balei .
translation.en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers . For there is no power but of God : the powers that be are ordained of God .
And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .
translation.kha: Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba trei kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingshlur ïa kito kiba ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .

translation.en: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us  ;
translation.kha: ba un pynim ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , na ka bor jong kito baroh kiba isih ïa ngi .
Hato phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingkit , Hynrei ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :

translation.kha: lem bad katto katto ki nongap bad ki nongring kiba Don hapoh ki pud sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Abram .
translation.en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbah uba burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Phi shukor ïa ki nongwei bad shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .
translation.kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u ong ïa u ,  ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .  Mar kumta hi u la lah ban ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Jisu ha ka lynti .

translation.en: I have overthrown some of you , as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la pynjot katto katne na phi kumba nga la pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . Kito na phi kiba la lait im ki long kum ka dieng barhem ba la sei na ka ding . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga ,  ong U  Trai .
Haba u Sanballat u ïohsngew ba ki Jiw ki la sdang ïa ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh , u la bitar nabar u sdang ban krenbeiñ ïa Ngi .
translation.en: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall , he was wroth , and took great indignation , and mocked the Jews .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u ong , Phi dei ban iehnoh ïa ki bad pynkylla ïa lade na ki . Wat ïadon bynta bad kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,

translation.kha: Lada u bieit katta katta shun shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka jingsngew kan hir ka bainong jong u .
translation.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .

translation.kha: Uta u shakri u ong , Wat khuslai . Wat sheptieng ruh . dem U blem jrong phi , U Blang jong u kpa Jong phi , uba la thep ïa ki pisa ha ki byrni jong phi na ka byndi jong phi . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka dor ba phi la siew . Nangta u woh ïalam ïa u Simeon sha ki .
translation.en: And he said , Peace be to you , fear not : your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them .
And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her , and disallowed her not : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
translation.kha: ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kata kaba ka la kular lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
Nangta u Balak u la phah kham bun ki nongïalam bakha kham pawkhmat ban ïa kito kba mynshuwa .
translation.en: And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they .

translation.kha: Kumta ki langbrot jongki na ki ïaid sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynskhem ïa ki kylleng ka pyllait , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pylleng ban wad ïa ki .
translation.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .
The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka kur Merari ki ïoh khat-ar tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Reuben , Gad , bad Sebulun .

translation.en: The king answered and said to Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen , and the interpretation thereof ?
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Daniel ( ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar ) ,  Hato me lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba nga phohsniew bad aïu ka kit jingmut ?
Nangta ki la ap hangta , bad u Nabal ha Kaba khatduh u la jubab , U Dabid ? Uei uta ? Ngam pait ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap da ki mraw kiba phut na la ki kynrad !
translation.en: And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .
And let them make me a sanctuary  ; that I may dwell among them .
translation.kha: Ki dei ruh ban shna ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïoh shong hapdeng jong ki .

Kumta te , da shisha ma nga , U Trei Nongsynshar , nga longkmie U Blei uba im , ngan sa siew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingbitar jongu me , ka jingbynta jongno me bun ka jingisih jongno me ïa ki briew jrong nga . Kane sa tip ba nga pynshitom ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la lai ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will even do according to thine anger , and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them  ; and I will make myself known among them , when I have judged thee .
And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .
translation.kha: U Laban u leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u leit sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Leah , bad sha ka ïingjaiñ jong kita ki ar ngut ki mraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa ki blei jong u . Nangta u leit rung sa ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka Rakhel .
U Judah u ong ha la u kpa , Phah ïa u para bad nga , bad ïng ïamihnoh kumne kumne . Te yn ym don uwei ruh na i'u u ban ïamkthang .
translation.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .
For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Kumta , nga ong ïa phi , ba phin lah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng tang lada phi ïaineh skhem kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai Aiñ bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa .

translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :
translation.kha: u Adoniram u peit ïa kiba shah pyntrei jubor ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;

Ka la long kaba khat-ar , kumta ki shakri bad ki Nongap phira ki la thang ding da u jngi sad ki la ïeng sawdong jong ka , ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Te u Petros u la leit shatai malu u la ïa-ïeng bad ki , ban pyndei ïa lade .
translation.en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .

translation.kha: Badno lada at dang im , sngewbha bat ïa la ka kular bakyntang bad ïaineh ïaskhem bad nga ; hynrei lada jia ba nga ïap ,
translation.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the  Lord  , that I die not :

translation.kha: Ki kyllum ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid kaba ma ki , ki longsem ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u brup u longsem u mraw ha kano kano naba jop halor u .
translation.en: While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .

translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha aïu phi leh , badno katai kaba phi leh kan long bha .
translation.en: Ponder the path of thy feet , and let all thy ways be established .

translation.kha: Bad Phin thikna ba phi long daladie u nongïalam ïa uba matlah , ka jingshai ïa kito kiba ha ka jingdum ,
translation.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,

translation.kha: Suki kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !
translation.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: U Philip u la jubab , Lada uwei uwei un ïoh tang mar khyndiat , kan dakmong palat ïa ka arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ban dulir kpu kat ban biang .
translation.en: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhapnap ka pynmih tang ka jingjynjar . Phi long hasem bha ban shaniah ha U Trai .
translation.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be made fat .

translation.kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrsad ïa nga mala mynhynnin ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïaphah noh .
translation.en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki biria kiba ieit pun mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-ieit bad ba-ijli . ngam pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom pa ñiewbeiñ ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai .
translation.en: And honour not his father or his mother , he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynap na ka jingïap , Kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .
translation.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u kpu ba kynja mynsiem bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki la dih na uta u mawsiang ba kynja mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la long U Khrist hi .
Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kaba pynbun sap ka treikam kum ka myntor ; ki ngeit ba ka lah ban imat lute ïa kiei kiei .
translation.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it : whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .

translation.kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah u la kren , Ïa u Shim dei pun pynïap namar ba u la dem ïa uta uba U Trai u la jied kum u syiem .
translation.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said , Shall not Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the  Lord s  anointed ?

translation.kha: Ha U Blei tang kiba stad , to longïng ka burom lyngba U Jisu Khrist junom . Amen .
translation.en: To God only wise , be glory through Jesus Christ for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: U Tlai u thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi , u bnai pynlang ki khlur da ka sur krenbeiñ jong u .
translation.en: By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .

translation.kha: hynriew ym don ba ïakren ha Kaba paw , namar ba ki shemphang ïa ki nongsynshar lad ki jlew .
translation.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews .

translation.kha: Balei te ba mut kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ? Balei ba me la leh ïa Kanah ka kam batymmen ? Me la pyntong ïa u Ur ban shah pynïap ha ka thma ; me la shah ïa ki Ammon ban pynïap ïa u , bad nangta me shim ïa ka tnga jong u !
translation.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: ka dei ban pyndem lut ïa kata kiba ka la kular lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrsa haba u ïohsngew ïa katai .
translation.en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it : then her vows shall stand , and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
And the King shall answer and say unto them , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren , ye have done it unto me .
translation.kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ba man ba phi leh ïa kane na ka bynta uno uno uba rit tam na kine ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong nga , phi la leh ïa kane na ka bynta jong nga !’
wai ki sih bad ki mrad ki don shibun ban hikai ïa me ;
translation.en: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynïan na Hebron sha Jerusalem , u Dabid u shim haw Shuh ki tnga kliar bad ki tnga trai , bad u ïoh Bun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynïan .
translation.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
From Jordan eastward , all the land of Gilead , the Gadites , and the Reubenites , and the Manassites , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , even Gilead and Bashan .
translation.kha: shaduh shaphang shathie sha ka shnong Aroer kaba harud ka wah Arnon — kane ka kynthup ïa ki thain jong ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha kaba ki jait Gad , Reuben , bad ki Manasseh kiba shaphang mihngi ki shong ki sah .
myntor nam mut ïa ki bymngeit kiba alhia ne kiba lalot ne katba long ki nongtuh ne kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw . Ban lait na kine phi dei banbeiñ mihnoh shisyndon na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Syiem Joash ki ïasyllok pyrshah ïa u , nabar ar ngut na kine , u Josakar u khun jong u Shimeath bad u Jehosabad u khwan jong u Shamgar , ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïing kaba u la tei halor ka jaka ba la pyndap khyndew kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem , ha ka lynti kaba hiar sha Salu . Ïa u Joash la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbanbor u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Amasaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , smote him , and he died  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Katba ki kynthih halor ki lumbah , ki riew kum ki kali ïapom ; ki sawa Kum u phlangïap ha ka jing . Ki ïeng lat kum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .

translation.kha: Kynsan u Absalom u ïakohnguh kato katne ki rangbah jong u Dabid . U Amraphel u dong shong ha u khashor , bad katba u khashor u dang ïaid napoh u dieng Sning uba heh , ka khlieh u Absalom ka sharak ha ki tnat dieng . U khar u la mareh mala u Absalom u la shah hynñiew da kaba siaw ha shiteng suiñ .
translation.en: And Absalom met the servants of David . And Absalom rode upon a mule , and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak , and his head caught hold of the oak , and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth  ; and the mule that was under him went away .

translation.kha: ?(Nga la ïohpateng ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kparad tymmen jong nga . U Naboth u jubab . U Trai u kyang ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .

translation.kha: Kumba U thri u pynmanbha bad pynroi ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta duh da kaba kmen un pynjot dara pynduh pyndam ïa phi . Yn sa rat dyngkhong ïa phi na sier ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .

translation.kha: U Palal sa ba un sawdong kren , haba u Gallio u la ïa-ong ha kita ki Jiw , Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kdew sniew ba la leh , kan long kambah shongsaiñ ïa nga shun ïaishah bad ki Jiw .
translation.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ka Samaria ki la sngewbishni , Kum sem lah ban pyrshah ïa u Jehu , ki la ong , naba wat u syiem Joram lehniam u syiem Ahasaïah kim lah ?
translation.en: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , Behold , two kings stood not before him : how then shall we stand ?

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Seïon ki lehkmen , pynlang ki nongbah ka Judah ki sahkynmaw namar ki jingisih jongnga me , A TRAI’ .
translation.en: Zion heard , and was glad  ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O  Lord .

translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllung kaba long baroh sawdong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ badno ïa ka jingset , bad ïa ka pyrta ïa ka jingryngkhiang jong ka phyllaw . Jin kitkhlieh ïa ki mana baroh Kiba ïadoh bad kine ki tiar ki tar .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :

translation.kha: Hikai ïa u khynnah Kumno u dei shun im , bad un kynroh ïa ka baroh shi rta ka jingtim jong u .
translation.en: Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it .

translation.kha: Ka Hakhlieh , ka para u Gilead , ka ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ishod , u Abieser , bun u Mahlah .
translation.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod , and Abiezer , and Mahalah .
Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Sodom bad Gomorrah ban ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbah !
Hato me lah ban shem ïa ki pud ki sam jong ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong U Blei ?
translation.en: Canst thou by searching find out God ? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection ?

translation.kha: Kin dap ha ki ïingsyiem jongu me , malade ha ki ïing jong ki radbah synshar bad ki bhabriew jong me baroh . Kin long kiba Kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kob ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la ju ïohi .’ Nangta u Messaïah u phai bad u mihnoh .
translation.en: And they shall fill thy houses , and the houses of all thy servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians  ; which neither thy fathers , nor thy fathers  fathers have seen , since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day . And he turned himself , and went out from Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Ka kmie kaba la duh nong ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki ïakhun jong ka , ka la ïapler , ka da thrang ïa ka jingring mynsiem . Ka jingpynshai jong ka sngi jong ka , ka la kylla sha ka jingjam ; la pynjahburom ïa ka badno ka pang ka dohnud . Ngan shad ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban pynïap ïa kito na phi babha dang im . Ma de , U tharai , na la kren .
translation.en: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost  ; her sun is gone down while it was yet day : she hath been ashamed and confounded : and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Blei um shyiap la shah jem ïa ka pyrthei mynbarim , hynrei u la wanrah ïa ka jingshlei um ha ka pyrthei jong ki briew bymtip Blei ; kita kiba u pyllait im ki Long u Nongap , uba la ïalap ïa ka hok , bad hynñiew nguid kiwei pat .
translation.en: And spared not the old world , but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness , bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly  ;

translation.kha: Lada u masi kyrtong jong uwei u briew u pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong jong uwei pat , kita ki trai kin dei ïa u masi kyrtong kiba dang im bad kin ïasam ïa ka phlait ; kin ïashim ruh ïa ka thoh jong uta u mrad uba shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if one man s ox hurt another s , that he die  ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it  ; and the dead ox also they shall divide .

translation.kha: U Trai u la hukum ïa por ban ym bam lane dih ei ei , bad ban ym longing phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la wanlam .
translation.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .

translation.kha: Ka dei nongmareh ki pop jong phi ba um shym ïohsngew ïa phi! . Ka dei ki pop jong phi kiba pynïakhlad ïa pa na U Blei haba phi pylleng ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you , that he will not hear .

translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad nangta sa uba lai .
translation.en: And the second took her to wife , and he died childless .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban ïarap ïa me mala pyndep ïa la ki kamram kiba ïadei Bad ka jinghikai ha ka Ïingjaiñ , hynriew a uno u im ñiut bym biang um lah ban ïarap ïa me .
translation.en: And they shall be joined unto thee , and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , for all the service of the tabernacle : and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u sharak u la wang bad u ong , Ki khun jong Phin ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khup Shynrang baheh duh jong phi , hab ka erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .
translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
Concerning the Ammonites , thus saith the  Lord   ; Hath Israel no sons ? hath he no heir ? why then doth their king inherit Gad , and his people dwell in his cities ?
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Ammon :  Shano ki rangbah ka Israel ? Hato ym don mano mano ban ïada ïa la ka ri ? Balei ba ki shah ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Molekh kin shim ïa ki jaka jong ka jait Gad bad shongduh hangta ?

Kan long kumba u briew uba mih na ïing ban leit jingtap , bad u iehnoh ha ki shakri ban khmih ïa ka kam , Hadien ba u ai ha uwei pa uwei ïa ka kam jngai u ban leh , bad hadien ba u ong ïa u nongap khyrdop don peit ba .
translation.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey , who left his house , and gave authority to his servants , and to every man his work , and commanded the porter to watch .
Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
translation.kha: Hato pha la ïoh jinghun ban bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang hapoh khyndiat por pha la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh .

translation.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , bad ki la ïeng ha kjat jong u lum .
Ngi la ïaid lyngba ka jingpynjot bad jingpra ; ngi im ha ka jingma bad ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us , desolation and destruction .

translation.kha: Ka la Don ka jingpanpoh briew ha ka nongbam , hynrei ka snam kam shym pashait ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kam lah ban buhrieh ïa ka ; ka la pashait ha u mawsiang basyllen .
translation.en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbitar U Blei la pynpaw na bneng pyrsad ïa baïar ka pop bad ka jingsngew jongki ki briew kiba ki lynti basniew jong ki , ki la khang ïa ka jingtip ïa ka jingriam .
translation.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men , who hold the truth in unrighteousness ;
And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , la pynkyndit ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa baroh ki nong Ijipt . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khlem ïap .
Hynrei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jongnga u baroh bad kiba hapoh ka ïinglieng jngai u kin long ka jingbankhia ïa u . Kin sdien ha u kumin ki khiew bad ki pliang kaba la wah ha u snar !
translation.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father s house , the offspring and the issue , all vessels of small quantity , from the vessels of cups , even to all the vessels of flagons .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translation.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .

translation.kha: U shniah jong phi u itynnat halor ki ngab jong phi , bad u noh rymphum ha ka ryndang jong phi kum ki mawkordor .
translation.en: My beloved spake , and said unto me , Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .

translation.kha: U Moses u kohnguh sad u buh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha tyngkong ha Israel kumba U Trai u la hukum ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .

translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa u shakri kiba bylla , uba duk bad uba kyrduh , la u dei u para Israel lane u nongwei umbah shong ha ki shnong jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy , whether he be of thy brethren , or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates :

translation.kha: Lydia nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jongki me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .

translation.kha: Phin sa shem haba phin leit shadien ka kamra ban rhah , U Mikhael u jubab .
translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
Why Does God Have an Organization ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei u Don la ka Jong ka Seng ?

translation.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
translation.kha: Bad lada um shahshkor ïa ki , te to ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh ha ka balang . Khatduh , lada um shahshkor ïa ka balang , to ñiew ïa u kumba u long u nongmane blei thala lane u nonglum khajna .
Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins bhor kaweh jong ka Judia bun na kadlieng ka ri kaba hajar ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,

translation.kha: bad ka Resen , kaba don hapdeng ka Ninebeh bad ka nongbah bakhraw ka Kalah .
translation.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .

Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u , shim khyndiat ka snam jong u , bad tah ïa ka ha ki shkor kamon jong u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ha ki  tikmie kamon jong ki , bad ha ki  jatkmie kamon jong ki . Synreit ïa ka snam kaba sah , sawdong kata ka duwan .
Ha-ei u don ? u syier u kylli . Ha ïing u mirr , u khun jong u Ammiel , ha Dorbar , u Sisera u jubab .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .

So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
translation.kha: Ki la jop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka bor ban leh ïa kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kanaan .
U weng ino na ka Templ ïa ka duli jong ka blei Asherah , bad rah ïa ka sawar ka nongbah sha ka To Kidron , u stong ïa ka , u pynlwet pum ïa u dpei lad ka , bad pynsaphred ïa ka ha jingtep paidbah .
translation.en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the  Lord  , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and stamped it small to powder , and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .
And Jacob was wroth , and chode with Laban : and Jacob answered and said to Laban , What is my trespass ? what is my sin , that thou hast so hotly pursued after me ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la bitar lep ,  Ka kam sniew aïu ba nga la leh ?  u kylli da ka jingbitar .  Ka aiñ aïu ba nga la pynkheiñ kaba shong hok ha phi ban thwet ïa nga haduh katne ?

Wat khih beiñ ïa nga namar ka rwai sngewieit jrong nga , nongmareh ba ka sngi ka la pynkylla urlong ïa nga . Ki Shynrang kiba shi sa bad nga ki bitar ïa per bad ki pyntrei ïa nga ha ka brai sohwaiñ . Ngam don por ban sumar ïa lade .
translation.en: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem U Trai u la rah ïa nga shaei ka bynta kaba khap shapoh jong ka phyllaw , ha kaba nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ la pyndep da ka burom U Troas .
translation.en: So the spirit took me up , and brought me into the inner court  ; and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynshitom ïa ki Israel , bad kan khynñiuh kumba pynheh ïa u khak ha ka wahduid . Un kyntang dyngkhong ïa ki paid Israel na kaei ka ri kaba bha kiba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , mala un pynsakma ïa ki sha lyndet ka wah ïapyllait , namar ba ki la pynbitar lep ïa u da kaba thaw ïa ki Bealoth jong ka blem Assyria .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall smite Israel , as a reed is shaken in the water , and he shall root up Israel out of this good land , which he gave to their fathers , and shall scatter them beyond the river , because they have made their groves , provoking the  Lord  to anger .

translation.kha: Lada ki nong Ijipt ki kyntait ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Maim Ki Ïingtrep , te yn sa soi ïa ki da kajuh ka jingpang kaba U Trai un phah ha ki jingriewblei barhem Kiba kyntait ban leit .
translation.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up , and come not , that have no rain  ; there shall be the plague , wherewith the  Lord  will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .

translation.kha: Mynta , ka long katba bhah ban don kum kata ka jingsngewtynnat kaban khraw lada ka jingthmu ka long ka bha — kane ka long kaba shisha borabor , bad ym dei tang haba nga don ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .
Therefore is the name of it called Babel  ; because the  Lord  did there confound the language of all the earth : and from thence did the  Lord  scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah la khot kyrteng ka Babel , namar dei hangta ba U  Trai  u la pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki briew baroh ; bad nangta la pynsaphred ïa ki sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
To isynei ïa la , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .

translation.kha: Na ïai-ong skhem ïa Phin ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namar ba phira long ha ka liang jyllang la , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka peiñ .
translation.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .

translation.kha: Mynta ba u Abimael u la ïap , u Adonijah , u ïakhun jong u Dabid bad ka Haggith , u dei u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba bhabriew . U Dabid um pat ju sneng tyngeh ïa u shaphang kano kano , bad u la khih eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa laiñ ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ka kynum synran kaba anna sanphew nongput ki rangbah .
translation.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .

translation.kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei kad hapdeng halor ki kulai , ki shakor , ki ut , Bad ki kada — halor ki narud baroh ha ki jaka sher dara jong u nongshukor .
translation.en: And so shall be the plague of the horse , of the mule , of the camel , and of the ass , and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents , as this plague .

translation.kha: Baroh ki Paidbah jongki u Dabid bad baroh ki paidbah ha Jeraïah ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um don bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
translation.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .

translation.kha: Myntan ki shyieng jong nga baroh ki pynpang ; ka jingpang kaba bam ïa nga kad kput shuh .
translation.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .
And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;
translation.kha: u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh , u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;

Nangta U Jiw u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah pynkdor jong ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ha ki tymmen ki San kiba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u , Hato phi la dei don ïawan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , la kumba nga dem u riewsniew ?
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?

translation.kha: Kawei na ki khlieh jong uta u mrad ka i kumba ka la shah pynmong jur , hynrei ka jingmong ka la ïohkhiah . Ka pyut baroh Kawei ka la sngewlah bad ka la bud ïa uta u mradkhlaw .
translation.en: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death  ; and his deadly wound was healed : and all the world wondered after the beast .
Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .
translation.kha: Nga sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynshitom , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlot , dei hangta ba nga khlaiñ .
ka Ïateh , ka Tema ,
translation.en: And Jattir with her suburbs , and Eshtemoa with her suburbs ,

Then said he also to him that bade him ,  When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours  ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u nongpdiang ïa u ,  Haba me ai ïa ka bam step ne ka bam miet , wat khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong me lane ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me lane ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong me lane ki paramarjan kiba riewspah jong me — naba kin khot sngewbha kylliang ïa me , bad ha kane ka rukom yn sa siew ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh .
Ka Syndong ka jingïathong U Trei ka don slem bha ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba arphew snem . Ha kata ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .
And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpra phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah ha ka ri jong phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong phi .
Ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ha kaba dum phi dei ban ïathuh ha kaweh shai , dara ïa kaei kaba phi la iohsngew ha kabu rieh phi dei don Pynbna na ki tnaw ïing .
translation.en: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
And when he cometh , he findeth it swept and garnished .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ïa ka ïing kaba khuid bad kaba la pynbeit ryntih .
Ka lah ban long kumta , hynrei ka long kiba kham bha ban don tang khyndiat , bad ka jingpalei jingmut , ban ïa kaba bymnang shi lyndum da ki kti baroh ar tylli , da kiba pyrshing ban kem ïa ka lyer .
translation.en: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .

translation.kha: bad ïa phi yn khot ki lyngdoh U Tlai , ki shakri Jong U Blei jong ngi . Phin sa lehkmen ïa ka spah ki jaitbynriew , bad phin sa sngewsarong ba ka dei ki jong phi .
translation.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the  Lord  : men shall call you the Ministers of our God : ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves .

translation.kha: Ale hangto bad jingïathuhlypa ïa katai ka ban sa jia , khnang ba ïeng tip ïa ka haba ka ïailong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kiba la dep nabar ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .
translation.en: Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .

translation.kha: Kumta ar leit sha u bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga thop ba un sa ïap hi la kumno kumno un tang shu kyllon . Naba nga shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka jingdeng na ka ksang ti jong u , malade nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .
translation.en: So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .
Know ye therefore that they which are of faith , the same are the children of Abraham .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngewthuh te , ba ki khun ki ksiew bashisha jong u Abraham ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me .
translation.kha: Me tip kumno ki nongshun jong nga ki la isih ïa nga bad kumno ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga .
Nangta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u , Haba nga la phah noh ïa phi ha kato ka por khlup ka pla pait , ka pei , lynti ki jingud , hato phi ïaduna ei ei ? Ym duna wat kawei ruh , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  When I sent you without purse , and scrip , and shoes , lacked ye any thing ?  And they said , Nothing .

The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jong u , u nongpynjot jong ki jaitbynriew u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Judah . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano bashong ba sah ha ki .

translation.en: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people that were present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin : but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .
translation.kha: U Saul , u Jonathan u khun jong u , bad ki rangbah jong ki , ki sher dara ha Geba ha ka thain Benjamin ; ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka dei ha Mikhmash .
bad u la ai hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh ha kiwei pat shaphang jong u .
translation.en: And charged them that they should not make him known :
And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .
translation.kha: Bad halor kata ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka bor jong ki nongsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad na ki bor synshar ; u la pynlong ka jingthadrong ïa ki da kaba ïalam ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ka jingïaid paidbah kaba jop jong u .
Nangta u phai sawdong , u la ïohi ïa sa , malu u la khot ïa nga . Nga jubab , ‘ Hodaïah , Kynther !’
translation.en: And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .
And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki samla shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  bad ki la kñia katto katne tylli ki jingri kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .

translation.en: Take , I pray thee , my blessing that is brought to thee  ; because God hath dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . And he urged him , and he took it .
translation.kha: Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi ; U Blei u la lehsbun ïa nga , bad u la ai ïa nga baroh kaba nga donkam .  U Jakob u la ïai kyrpad ïa u haduh ba un da pdiang .
kane ka long ka hukum kaba khlaw tam mala kaba donburom kam .
translation.en: This is the first and great commandment .
And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ,
translation.kha: Me tharai ba me kham bha ban ïa u Balak , u khun jong u Sippor , u syiem Moab ? Um ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel . Hato u la ju ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ngi ?

Kumta U Trai u phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha Israel , kaba neh naduh Kata ka step haduh ka por kaba u la jied . Na khwai ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh ki la ïap haduh hynñiewphew hajar lwet ki Israel .
translation.en: So the  Lord  sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed : and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men .

translation.kha: Te ngan jin da la Ïathuh kum ki khup Syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba dang shu kha .
translation.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .

translation.kha: ki briew jong ka Judah keiñ babe ba ki la shaniah ha —kata ka hima ka bym lah ban shaniah , ka hima ka bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki haba ki khmih lynti banbeiñ ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them , nor be an help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach .
